This is twice the price of our last dog food but I think its worth it to not feed our dogs additives and fillers they do not need.  Highly recommend this food brand.
My very picky Australian Shepherd loves this food. I've tried every single kind of grain-free food on the market and this is the very best. We've seen a lot of positive side effects since switching.

column9: Your dog will write this review
column10: I heard a noise by the front door.  It's that man in the big brown metallic moving box again.  I guess I have to do due diligence and bark bark bark.He left another toy for my person by the door...but wait...what's that scent?  Did the man in the big brown box leave his hunt here?  My person opens the toy.  The scent gets stronger.  I stay next to my person as he clumsily digs into the carcass...you never know he might drop some.My person now puts some in my bowl.  Is he is giving me his leftovers again?  Not sure why he thinks I should be happy with that.  I walk over and smell it.  Wow!  Its that scent again!  I love it!  He didn't just leave me the dry, sandy chunks, but rather a flavorful collection of tasty morsels.  I look at him before I dig in...he's looking back as if wondering if he can have some.  I dig in and before I know it I finished it all.  I want some more.Before I fall asleep that night I wonder why my person gave me the best parts and dream of the man in the big brown metallic moving box hunting for us.

I started chewing this gum a while ago, but not regularly. I am now retired (64) and want to return to feeling some of the joys of childhood! I am a big baseball fan (specifically Yankees), and have always been. Chewing this gum just invokes that feeling of being connected to that lifelong bliss, and it tastes great!I searched for ways to purchase the product, and Amazon was great: price, shipping, speed of delivery!
The item arrived in perfect shape and all ready for my children's stockings.  Thanks for the speedy service!
excellent product just as seller described , recieved on time. would definelty buy again from this seller.

This product is not easy to find so we were excited to find it and anticipated it's arrival.Unfortunately, what we received was a case full of product that was past it's expired date.We contacted the company, by email (as that was the only way listed).After a few days they emailed back with a phone number to call.On that call they told us they could send us additional product, but that those dates were out of code as well. They blamed the manufacturer and took no ownership. They did not offer any other solution - no offer to take it back, no offer to refund our money.This was a disappointing conclusion for us.Selling product that is not in code is not only not acceptable, it is not honest and I believe against the law.

These are really hard to find in stores now, unlike Bubble Tape, and I've never really thought of buying stuff like this on Amazon but all is well.  Unlike the reviewer who received expired gum, mine shows an expiration date of some time in 2014.  This gum is as tasty and flavor-packed as I remember when growing up, unlike all the diluted, sugar-free, tooth-safe options today.

I never try other before, someone recommended. I use it on my sons goody bags for his party theme (baseball ) they came on time and not melted( it was crazy hot that day) good Flavor grown ups to enjoy it!

I used to love this stuff when I was young.  I remember sending away for a plastic bat & ball for a couple bucks and a few bar codes.  The gum was chopped up into fine little pieces, I recall it being in long strips of gum.  The big league chew tasted fine, I gave some of them away.
This gum is quite good. I always chew gum in the gym and this will stay soft through a long workout and run.
Brought them for my son's baseball party, was a hit with the kids, they couldn't wait to get the gum on the way out.

Big League Chew Original Flavor was a great purchase. I liked it because the stuff reminded me julienned carrots. And because I love carrots, I thought that Big League Chew would be a fun way to like veggies even if it's really a gum product.

column9: I LOVE HONEYCUP MUSTARD BUT NOT AT $8.78 PER LB!
column10: Great taste and texture, I like sweet mustards.  The list of ingredients is given except for specified spices. It's a 5 ***** for all that.But the rating drops because the hex-shaped jar annoys me, it's hard to get every bit out.Overpriced: I got spoiled when I bought a case of this at .99 each at my local discount grocery and just bought a jar for $1.47 there.  I can see around half of $4.39, we don't all shop at NYC Gourmet Food Shoppes, but c'mon, as good as it is, this is MUSTARD.
i use this mustard on and in practically anything edible...the flavour is spicy, tangy, sweet and delicious.sometimes my local grocery store runs out...so i buy it online...it is worth it.

Safeway/Dominick's Stores used to carry this wonderful mustard. But, as is often the case with the chain, they dropped it (they hate specialty items, in general - which is also why they no longer stock Henry Weinhard's superb sodas). Anyway, I've been looking for this for years, but couldn't recall the brand name; all I had was "Canadian-made, sharp honey mustard in a six-sided jar" What a wonderful discovery! My perfect luncheon: a bowl of Knorr Oxtail soup and a sandwich: extra sharp cheddar and Honeycup Mustard on buttered toast. Oh, and a cold bottle of Heinekens, of course. Eee-yummm!

I love making my own oat flakes with my grain mill and Bob's Red Mill is the best stuff around.  I get this at the natural foods store when I'm over that way, but buying from Amazon was quick and easy.  This is good quality stuff - I keep mine in the freezer though to preserve freshness.

My cats love this food, even the picky eater.  The neighbors cat came over visiting with the neighbor and discovered the cat food dish.  Now the neighbor says his cat will no longer eat his cat food and wanted to know what I fed my cats.

The coffee smells great.  I was so excited to try it because of its wonderful aroma.  I was very disappointed in the taste.  It was very weak.  Maybe I used too much water but not more than I normally use with other coffee.

I really really love this tea all too thrilled to get a bulk deal from  amazon because I usually have to order from an asian food grocer. This is a great green tea for any of you who have enjoyed the ito en tea's this is just as great and less expensive I really hope this sticks around on amazon!

I used to get this tea every time I went to this store that sold it, sometimes I even bought two or three of them because I loved them so much. My friend didn't like it because it wasn't sweet, but I really love none sweet tea and don't like sweet tea. So this tea is absolutely amazing to me. I am thrilled to see it available in bulk!

Our fine TSA in Minneapolis decided that the same two jars of Scottish heather honey that made it through Cardiff and Amsterdam gate checks (the tiny jars were apparently 4 ounces, I will remember to bring a magnifying glass next time) were too dangerous to fly from Minneapolis to Kansas City, so my father's gift (his family is from Scotland and the honey was bought in Scotland) was taken away... I hope whoever got it enjoyed it.  :)  Was glad to find this seller providing a nice big jar of Heather Hills Farm Scottish heather honey for a more reasonable price than I could find elsewhere online - the price is usually okay, it's the shipping that gets ya.  Heather honey is not the same as yer average clover honey... it's strong, very herbal I guess.  Smelled it before I saw it - the seal on the jar was not intact (although the paper sticker on the top was not broken) and a bit o' honey had leaked onto the bubble wrap.  I didn't mind, and nobody has gotten sick from eating the stuff.  Might be from pressure during transport?  Dunno.  Doesn't matter, Dad absolutely loves it and shared - it is *fabulous*!  Will be buying more.  :)

column9: I wish I had received the Honey Unbroken From Amazon
column10: My Wife & I traveld to SCOTTLAND A FEW YEARS AGO & NEVER FOGOT THE GREATTASTE of their Heather Honey. I was delighted when I saw that I couldorder it from Amazon .com. The return was acknowledged, but they offeredto return the amount Paid plus shipping to be added  to my Debit account.Still waiting for the refund which is fair, but, would like to taste theHoney.Maybe I'll try ordering again after I get the refund. Thanks Arnie

I love this product. The ingredients list is short and simple and my aging Labrador gets the extra Chondroitin and Glucosamine that he needs. I put a couple tablespoons of PetKind on top of his two meals a day of dry food. My lab's coat has never been shinier and his agility in his hips has come back full fold. I love this product and would recommend to anyone especially with a larger aging dog. This food has worked wonders for my 10 year old, 100 lb. black lab!
This is species appropriate for canines.  Ingredients are great.  Good protein sources.  Cans are easy to open.  Best of all, my dog loves it!

column9: Not the best, but good and cheap.
column10: The product is OK, a little bit less flavourish and more fragile than the Nori sheets I used to buy from Whole foods, but still they are useable, and regarding the highly competitive price, I am pretty sure I will keep buyng it from Amazon instead of Whole foods.

If you want to make restaurant style sushi this might not be the best choice. However I make sushi at home and these are a great product for that.Pros:-Cheap-Large are (Sometimes I get a bit left over and can give the roll an extra 1/4 turn)-Resealable plastic bagThey are also good in the fact that they are slightly "firm", meaning that when I cut them I don't get the flattening out problem because they are too elastic.One star off because they are not extreme in flavor, however they more than make up for that with their price.

column9: Perfect --If you know what you're getting yourself into!
column10: Be aware, this seweed is Not roasted or salted like Kim or laver wraps you may have had before. This is plain seaweed, which the taste can be a little unsettling for those who have never had it before. Other than that, a great product! Perfect, not too dry to where it crumbles when you try to handle it, not moist at all.
This is good nori! It comes in a resealable package, and tastes just as good as what I get from sushi resturants. Overall I am pleased

I eat quite a bit of sushi, and I have to say this sushi nori is up to par. Overall, the flavor is fine and the quality is amazing for the price. Can't do much better than this if you're trying to be conservative with what you spend on sushi.
I enjoyed these.  They arrived in good condition.  Tasted as expected.  Good value for the product.  I will definitely buy them again.

column9: At this price point this is great
column10: It's a little hard to get out just one sheet and they are a bit fragile.  But for this price, this is a heck of a product.  Tastes fine, not soggy, not horribly fragile.  All things considered, I'll probably order these again unless I get a better deal locally.
I'm not an expert in sushi but I've just tried these seaweed sheets and they are nice. I couldn't find any difference between these sheets and others that I've got from Japan...

I love seaweed, and with my thyroid problem, eating seaweed daily has become part of my life these last 5 months.  I am so happy to find it in such a large quantity and at such a reasonable price.  Thank you.
They are full size and come in a really thick resalable ziplock, they are not bittle and wrap without cracking ... awsome price! i will buy more.

column9: Five out of six dogs approve!
column10: I bought this to use as a low-calorie treat for my dog. Unfortunately, my dog wouldn't eat it. (She seemed to think I was nuts!), but my boss's five dogs all loved it. So while it didn't work for me, it did work for five out of the six dogs we tried feeding it to!

column9: very high quarlity, will buy more.
column10: Both my daughter and I like the seaweed very much,  I make sushi for my daughter, she likes the seaweed. high recommended.
We started making sushi at home and this seaweed was very easy to work with. You definitely need more than 10 sheets if you are experimenting.

column9: Good price, not so great flavor
column10: I bought this nori to have friends over to make sushi. It works well enough for the purpose of keeping your sushi rolled up, but in terms of the flavor of the nori itself, it is not very good. It has sort of a heavy, bitter flavor. I prefer a lighter nutty flavored nori.
I used these last week for the first time.  They are very chewy and make it difficult to eat and enjoy the sushi.  I only used 5 sheets and will be throwing away the rest of the pack.

Good price, great taste. I love making sushi at home, because it's just SO expensive ordering out. Nori keeps well in fridge (I seal it in ziploc freezer bag), and adds intersting je ne sais quoi, to any sushi roll.

Nori is my favorite snack food.  I eat it like potato chips.  This stuff is great for that purpose.  It's a little more chewy than other nori that I have had. But I actually like that quality.  A good product, fresh, nice quality, and a great price especially with Amazon Prime.

This product is just as expected.  I'm new to making my own sushi so I have no experience prior to buying this product. I've made many Spicy Tuna Rolls and the nori has yet to break on me.  I'm not sure if it's because I have practically mastered the art of sushi (not really) or just gotten lucky and not rolled the sushi too tightly.Either way this was a great buy, shipping didn't take long at all.  Had the nori by the end of the week.  Would buy again

I bought 100 sheets of Nori through Amazon and they processed my order promptly and received it in same................I found it to be of good quality and enjoyed it.............Will re-order from them unless I can find a better source...........If you know of better source pls advise............Amazon has always been good to me.............Thx Dan

Good price for the 50 sheets of sushi nori seaweed in comparison to the prices in the main grocery stores. My husband & I recently moved from an area w/ access to great Asian markets to a more remote area without any Asian markets. The nori seaweed sheets arrived in a timely manner in good condition.  The shipping price was a bit steep for such a light item but still cheaper then driving over an hour to the nearest Asian market and much more convenient.

Super happy with this purchase! It's exactly what I needed! Never found seaweed sheets at such a low price before. Good quality and awesome good price. I will definitely be buying this product again once I am finished with all the seaweed I bought (^_^).

I tried several brands...and this is the only one that consistently did not break. You need to moisten the sheet with a damp cloth or light spray so that the roll stays in a single pice and clings to itself. Better tasting also. I use this with suchesi and other sushi forms.

column9: Price is good, product is okay.
column10: They're not as big as the nori that I'm used to, and not as thick, either. I tore 3 out of 8 rolls the first time. I make my rolls without using a mat or anything, so if you roll by hand and like them snug, be careful with them- they suck up moisture MUCH quicker than other nori sheets, due to their thinness, and this makes them prone to tearing. The price is good for a pack of 50, though. I paid 6.89.
I use this seaweed for my fish tank to feed my Tanta ... You can't get a better deal , good quality seaweed and good quantity as well :)

I bought this to make easy hand rolls and they work out fine. I don't know if they're quite as good as what I get at a sushi restaurant, but you get a lot for a decent price. And the sheets stay together well and have a nice flavor.
Came quickly, great price, great nori. I will definitely order again! Thank you! I don't have anything but good things to say about it. It's not the tastiest, but it's well worth it.
Good Quality and Tasty Nori delivered to your door. I use these instead of lettuce for wraps and of course sushi. Tasty healthy way for iodine supplementation.
I was some what displeased with the texture these.  Some what difficult to work with.  But overall, they will do in a pinch.  Patty

I received the package quickly and with no issues. The product was exactly as advertised and used it that night to make my first ever sushi.I give it only 4 stars because it is exactly what I ordered and nothing more. So please don't think of it as negative in anyway because when I am done with these 50 rolls I will be reordering.

column9: Very good for a boxed mix!
column10: I do not find most boxed pasta dishes edible, but this one is pretty good!  Surprisingly good, actually.  It cooks up quickly and has a good tasting sauce - not too thick or too thin.  Add any kind of side dish - vegetables or meat - and you're set.  I like it!

column9: Use this as a Base to Get Creative!
column10: I used this mix as a base to make Tuscan Chicken Alfredo like they serve at that wonderful Italian Restaurant that we all know and love (but can't mention here). I used 2 boxes (preparing according to package directions) and added about 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, 1/4 cup chopped roasted garlic cloves (from the deli - already roasted), 1/4 cup chopped canned roasted red pepper (or pimento) and a 12 oz. can of white meat chicken chunks plus the broth. When it was done, I stirred in about 1 cup baby spinach leaves. This was delicious and made 4 very large servings for a great main dish.

column9: Hands down the best boxed pasta ever!
column10: First off thank you Amazon for shipping this straight to my door at a price that is still less than it would cost to pick it up at my local store. Secondly, there is no better box pasta mix out there. As a poor graduate student dinner usually costs me around a dollar or two and this is a nice way to switch things up and get away from Kraft mac and cheese. It's simple to make, kids and adults love it, it makes a good quick meal or a good side dish for a family when you're all in the kitchen debating what to make as a side with dinner that evening. Definitely a good buy!

I'am loving it. Quick, simple and versatile, a wonderful pasta that you can add boiled or baked chicken breast too. Some nights I get home late and family is tired and hungry and thirty minutes we have a hot meal that everyone loves! You can also steam some broccoli or cauliflower and add it in for a wonderfully rounded meal. If you like Alfredo, this is the item for you. for those that heavy Alfredo flavor you can always add more Parmesan cheese.James M. Enos

column9: Horrible flavor made my infant vomit causing setback in recovery
column10: Our 11 month old son had a bad, week-long stomach flu and had stopped taking the plain Pedialyte once he was able to start drinking formula again, but because he still had diarrhea he needed some Pedialyte. So I tried giving him this fruit flavor. He had a few sips via spoon and spewed projectile vomit twice. This is after having not vomited in over 24 hours. It put us back to square one. Smell and taste it yourself, it's awful. Maybe older kids prefer it, who knows, but I will never give this product to my child ever again.

column9: They made the treat too thin
column10: My cat prefers his daily vitamin more than ziwipeak treat.  I can't understand why they made the treat into very thin square.  They should have made it into a cube, so that cat can chew on it.  My cat did take a few bites of the treat, but they kept falling off from his mouth due to the shape of this treat.  He didn't go crazy over this treat like he does with other healthy treats I found elsewhere.

Our family absolutely love these chewy treats.  We not only use them as a snack, but I have recently found out that they are great for sore throats! My children feel that they actually help make their sore throats feel better.  We love, love, love them and hope the manufacturer never changes the formula.

We bought in quantity.  The sealed product wrap keeps the chew fresh for a long time so some storage time to eat them all is not a problem.  Now even the grandchildren share our ginger chew addiction.  The chews are a great after dinner palate cleanser/ refresher.

While I personally haven't tried this item, my four springers all give it two paws up!  The 12 year old Mama dog was barely able to go up and down stairs because of hip issues, now she gets her giddy-yup on while jogging down the hall, jumps on the bed and more closely resembles her five year old self.  I have told many friends about all of the Happy Hips products and while this is good for the company, it is becoming increasingly more difficult to just walk into my local distributor and pick these up!  Dogswell Happy Hips for Dogs, Beef Liver, Glucosamine & Chondroitin, 5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)
Got this for my mom for Christmas.  I could tell she was dissapointed.  Couple of cheeses, a few fruit, nice enough basket, but overall 10 to 15 dollars worth of stuff for 50 bucks.

It's good beef jerky....although it has more of a peppery type flavor....little spicy kick and the jerky is tough. It's just okay...not outstanding, but for the price I'd say go for something else cuz it's more peppery than sugary and it's nothing special just okay.

Anyways, the kibble is real small and my dogs do real well on the this formula.My dogs have only been on Surf & Turf for about 3 wks and they are doing awesome on it. My golden retriever puppy had weeks of stomach problems and lots of expensive and unsuccessful testing to try to determine the problem. My puppy trainer suggested I try this grain free food. I did and his problems cleared right up. It is expensive but has all natural and healthy ingredients and should actually reduce vet bills in the long run since he is such a healthy dog now. I plan to start feeding my cat Fromm food now too. She likes the smell of the salmon in the dog's food so I'll try the salmon cat food soon. This company makes quality food for pets and produces it here in the United States.

Our dog loves this food! It has good quality ingredients and it's reasonably priced for the most part. Our dog's coat shines, she barely scratches, no more watery eyes, and her poop is firm and less smelly. All in all, it's great quality food.Plus it's made in the USA which gives me a little more peace of mind about the quality of the food. The only downside is that it smells fishy and the fishy smell tends to linger on my dogs face.

My dog really loves this food. He's a picky eater and I find he really likes this one. It's very natural and rated high on dogfoodanalysis.com. He's tried some other flavours in the Fromm line, but so far he seems like like this one the best. His coat got much more soft and shiny since he's started eating it and he gets compliments at the dog park all the time. He's a cocker spaniel so the small/average size kibble is great. Would highly recommend. I believe this flavour is also grain free, which is a bonus.

My four year old chihuahua has had epilepsy since she was about a year old. After having serious seizures about every two weeks I took her to the vet and he prescribed her phonobarbital. After researching the horrendous side effects that dogs experience while on this medicine I decided to look for a natural method. After hours apon hours of researching I found this food and I am SOOOOO thankful I did. Almost immediatly after feeding her this food her seizures stopped and she has not had a seizure in a year and a half. Thank you lord for this dog food. My dog is my world and her seizures are gone. Another effect from this dog food is her coat, she use to have dry brittle hair and my husband constantly joked around about her being "mangy" she now has a full coat of beautiful hair. On top of all the wonderful benifits, my dog LOVES this food. Fromm four start surf and turf is highly recommended, your dog will thank you!

column9: My pup gobbles this food up!
column10: Fromm Surf & Turf is a great, healthy dog food. Small kibbles for any size dog (like the size of an eraser head on a pencil). Smell is not over pungent like some of the cheaper brands.My 5 month old pup was on Natural Balance from the rescue group that I got him from. I switched to Fromm when he had some while at a friends house and he gobbled it up, which he had never done before. He never fails to eat everything that is given to him. In fact, sometimes I wet the food a little so it will slow him down!I am switching him to Fromm Gold for Puppies until he gets a little older (per the vets request). He is steadily gaining about a pound a week, which is perfect.Lastly, I am happy that it is made locally here in Wisconsin.

Moved away from IAMs and 8 yr old Aussie is thrilled. His poops are smaller and stink less (I know, TMI but it matters!). Switched him when we got a puppy raised on the Fromm's puppy kibble and wanted them both on the same eventually.

column9: Fromm Four-Star Surf & Turf vs Blue Buffalo Wilderness Salmon
column10: My 2 Minature Schnauzers are 3yrs old and picky eaters. They were occassionaly spoiled by me adding chicken breast or turkey to their dry food. They eventually got bored of the Fromm Surf & Turf but for the first month loved to eat it. Yes, it's more expensive than the other dry foods but the ingredients used helped my prevent break-outs that one of my dogs were experiencing from allergies. I switched them to the Blue Buffalo Wilderness and it has higher protein and Omega fatty acids. The dogs enjoyed the change in food but it gave them both gas and one of them had diarrhea. I like the ingredients of the Blue Buffalo but according to my vet some owners are complaining about the same effects on their dogs because it's very rich. I'm remaining with the Fromm simply because of the quality and it's grain less so it helps my dog with allergies.

We've had a dog with food allergies so we can tell you that investing in a quality, grain free food is well worth it!  FROMM is a favorite with our little Cairn - we never intend for him to go thru the misery of allergies!

I wanted a food for a a dog with skin problems. His skin greatly improved with the switch, though he still itches some.  He loves the food. No recalls, American made with American ingredients was a big plus (no Chinese poisoned food).  I took off a point for availability, which increases the price. Fortunately he is a small dog and the food lasts a while.  He has done well so now feeling safe to expand the diet to other flavones in this line for variety.

I've been using Fromm Surf N Turf in my rotation (which has come down to this and the beef frittata veg by Fromm) over the last several months.First, I have an itchy/scratchy bichon.  Surpringly she does not have food allergies, but environmental allergies.  She gets better and worse, depending on the season.  Her coat is nice, skin, stool, all good.Next I have a sensitive tummy Portuguese Water dog who cannot have any grain AT ALL.  Surf N Turf is perfect and she digests it well.  I've tried several other foods and she just cannot handle foods with grain in it, not even the 'easy to digest' rice formulas.Even my little chihuahua, Cookie, does great on it.  Beautiful, soft and full coat, nice teeth, breath, stool and overall health.I do feed this as 70% of their overall diet, the other 30% being from The Honest Kitchen (Zeal and Love formulas).This is a food I've happily recommended!  And I don't see myself feeding anything else. Pleased with the customer service as well!

Our dog, 6 years old Bichon, loves loves this food!  We initially mixed this dog food with the old one to start with.  However, he only ate the grain-free one, leaving all the old food in the bowl.  :)

We had been feeding our large breed puppy another brand of premium dog food but for some reason, his stools were always loose.  Since switching to Fromm's he's been great.  No more loose stools and he's gaining weight at a nice, steady pace.  Love this food.

Received my Roasted Sesame Seeds (pack of 4) along with my Roasted Black Sesame Seeds and I'm enjoying them as well.  I love to use them in my Spicy Chinese Sesame Noodles stir-fried with tons of finely chopped garlic, thinly sliced onions and hot chilis, and shredded cabbage in several varieties of sesame oil.  Great! Try it some time!

These convenient sesame seeds are nearly perfect: toasted and crispy, they add a wonderful, rich flavor to many foods (stir fry, salads, greens, noodles... and even buttered toast!). I've also been known to consume them straight out of the bottle by the spoonful. The only way I'd like them better would be if they were organic.
The price was super for the excellent quality - flavorful.  Not often able to find quantity, for a good price.
I've been buying Flavia coffee for years. It's great...convenient and consistent.  The best part about buying it through Amazon is that it's cheaper than buying it direct from the company.

I have a Flavia machine at my mom's and a Tassimo for myself.  I have to say that the sumatra flavor is the best tasting single cup coffee of its kind.  It is addictive if it weren't for the high price.  Definitely worth it, not bitter at all and a deep, rich flavor.
We use a Senseo machine to make individual mugs of coffee and this Seattle Best decaf has the best tast of the decafs we've tried.

We have to serve decaffinated coffee in our home, and when we discovered Seattle's Best Decaf, we were delighted. It is tasty and has an honest-to-goodness coffee flavor. Unfortunaly we cannot buy this in retail stores. Fortunately Amazon carries it, so we've been ordering supplies as needed. Great Decaf Coffee!
I only drink decaf so believe me when I say I've tried them all over the years. This is the best decaf you can buy!

I got introduced to Seattles Best decaf on Royal Caribbean cruise ships.  Really good decaf, much better than the national brands and even better than Starbucks (even though they're the same company).  Biggest problem is that it's not available in my local supermarkets.

So my wife is a latte freak, and nursing, so decaf is the approved type.  After the Senseo left the market, I struggled and found the Aerobie AeroPress Coffee and Espresso Maker which is like a French Press for the 21st century.  After getting our recipe figured out, my wife, who's been buying Venti Decaf Latte's at $4 a pop almost daily for years now declares that Seattle's best Level 3 Decaf in her home-made Latte is the best coffee she can get.  We've tried other bands, and this is her favorite, hands down!
My husband loves this decaf so I thought I would check the price here.  Unfortunately he can get it for a lot less at our local Wal-mart.  $6.00 a bag in case anyone is interested.

I too have tried many different types of decaf - from putrifying instant decaf to moderately palpable joe - Level 3 delivers! In fact most of the Seattle's Best Level series is well received - wished they had just a slightly darker level of decaf (like their level 4 or 5 regular), but by no means am I complaining.
This is the best Decaf on the market - rich flavor without too much acidity. Great deal compared to Supermarket pricing. Fast shipping.
I was having a difficult time finding this coffee in a local store, so I checked Amazon and found it. It's my favorite.

column9: Must have for dry damaged chemical treated hair
column10: I absolutely love this coconut oil.  I use it in my hair as a pre-shampoo and woooowwww what a difference it makes.  My hair is shiny, bouncy and non greasy or weighed down.  This is the best coconut oil and there aren't any other ingredients!!  If you have dry relaxed or natural hair this is a must have in your hair care regimen

column9: FRACTIONATED COCONUT OIL,ITS "NOT" SOLID,ITS "NOT" NATURAL,& THAT'S NOT RIGHT!
column10: Length:: 9:59 MinsAll right,well before I get into the many reasons why I regret buying this product,I need to mention something very important first.AMAZON HAS DECIDED TO REMOVE ITSELF AS AN AVAILABLE MERCHANT FOR THIS PRODUCT,& LET OTHER MARKETPLACE MERCHANTS JACK UP THE PRICE!WHEN I ORIGINALLY PURCHASED THIS ITEM ON JUNE 30TH,IT WAS AVAILABLE WITH FREE SUPER SAVING SHIPPING/AMAZON PRIME FOR $16.31.NOT EVEN A WEEK LATER (4 DAYS TO BE SPECIFIC) & AMAZON.COM ITSELF NO LONGER SELLS THIS PRODUCT,& LET SEVERAL MARKETPLACE MERCHANTS OFFER THIS ITEM,STARTING AT A MUCH HIGHER PRICE OF $27.25 (NOW NO LONGER WITH FREE SUPER SAVER SHIPPING/AMAZON PRIME)!Well,that's enough for me to NEVER purchase this item from Amazon.com ever again,but there are several other reasons why.This coconut oil is not of a very high quality,as I could tell from the price that I paid for it,& it was not very highly recommended.Nowhere on the bottle or jug does it have the notation of extra virgin or virgin,which signifies that its high quality coconut oil.To be honest,I purchased this item so that I could use it as a hair oil to grow my hair back out since I've always had dry hair.A while back,I had a full head relaxer done & a large portion of my hair just fell out from lack of nutrition,bad hair care,& the strength of the relaxer.Now,here is the reason why you should NOT purchase this coconut oil,either from Amazon or at all.This coconut oil has been "fractionated" or chemically altered so that it will stay in a liquid form,regardless of the temperature.Anyone who has ever used coconut oil knows that its a SOLID at room temperature (between 70-75 degrees F).When it reaches a temperature of 76 degrees F or higher,then it will begin to melt into an odorless colorless liquid.I've wondered why someone would even bother to do something like this,& then I realized that it was all in the name of laziness.Some people don't want to take the time to melt coconut oil for each use,so if its ALWAYS in liquid form,then its easy & ready to go.Well,that's NOT what I'm interested in,I wanted to receive natural coconut oil as it was meant to be,not something that has been altered for the sake of convenience.Something else that you should know,even if this coconut oil has been fractionated,I do not suggest that anyone comsume this or use it in cooking.Its not of a decent quality,& I know that its been sitting around for a while,so I have no idea where this thing has been stored.Yes,coconut oil has an extremely long shelf life,but the fact that this isn't raw,natural coconut oil still bothers me.I'm not a very organic person,but I don't like it when I'm not sure what's in a product that I'm consuming or using on my body.Just so you know,coconut oil is very high in saturated fat,which is why it remains a SOLID at room temperature,like butter,margarine,shortening,lard & palm oil (NOT to be confused with palm kernel oil).Palm Kernel Oil is the ONLY saturated fat that is able to remain a liquid at room temperature.That's why you usually see it as one of the main ingredients in almost ALL store bought protein bars,sadly.Anyway,I was deceived into believing that I bought "real" natural coconut oil,& NOT something that has been altered to stay a liquid.Now,if that's what you're interested in,then there's nothing wrong with that.It would be nice if Amazon advertised in the product details that this coconut oil has been "fractionated".Without that information,noone that purchases this item would have any idea that they're being duped by the merchants selling this product.Its the merchants responsibility to give Amazon all of the information it needs in order to keep its customers informed.There is something else that might be going on,but I'm not sure that Amazon would actually do something like this.Amazon "might" already know that this coconut oil has been "fractionated" but chooses to not include that information in the product details.I don't like it when I don't have ALL the information when it comes to what's contained in my health & beauty products.Overall,I sort of knew what I was getting into when I bought this item,but I at least expected to receive "RAW" natural coconut oil,instead of something that has been chemically altered.If you are only using this as a beauty aid,then it might not matter to you that much.However,if you are looking for a natural coconut oil to cook with & consume,then I would recommend that you STAY AWAY from this product.Yes,I will admit that this is the first time that I've ever used coconut oil personally,but I KNOW what coconut oil is supposed to look like.Here's something else that you need to know,directly relating to this item when shopping on Amazon.Parachute Coconut Oil is available in a wide variety of sizes,since this is a "beauty" item to me,but Amazon has it listed in the "Grocery" catagory.There were 2 listings for basically the same amount of coconut oil,just in different packaging.The first one Parachute Coconut Oil, 67.6-Ounce had a large amount of coconut oil for a very decent price (NOT anymore) in one bottle.The second one Parachute Coconut Oil, 33.8-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 2) had the same amount of coconut oil,but split up into smaller jugs for a few dollars more.I bought 2 of the 67 ounce Parachute since it was $4 cheaper then the 33 ounce one,& I do love saving money.Well,as I mentioned before,Amazon JUST decided to remove itself as a Merchant for this product (UNLIKE "Fufilled by Amazon",where Amazon.com is just "holding" the product in a warehouse for a Marketplace merchant).The ONLY reason for this is that Amazon decided it wanted to "yet again" raise the price by either raising its own price of an item or remove itself completely (RARE) as a Merchant for a product.I'm very disappointed in this,but more so at the fact that I "thought" that I was buying "natural" coconut oil,& instead,I get this.One more thing,when I opened one of the 67 ounce jugs up,the jug was ONLY filled about HALFWAY so I can help it but to state that I genuinely feel CHEATED by Amazon.So,I don't think that I will be purchasing this item anymore from Amazon,especially since they like RAISING the price so often.Anyway,for those that don't really care & just want to save a buck,too late,as Amazon KEEPS jacking up the price.Everyone else who preferres to use a coconut oil that is actually natural & not "chemically altered" then look elsewhere.Here is why I bought this coconut oil,& also why I personally have decided to use coconut oil on my hair.This is how I felt about this coconut oil BEFORE I realized that it had been fractionated for convenience of beauty.I've decided to try & use coconut oil to grow my hair back out,after a relaxer basically ruined it.There's nothing wrong with relaxers,& I will continue to use them on my hair,while at the same time keeping it moisturized with coconut oil.If anyone has used oils to moisturize their hair,you know that it takes a while for your hair to grow back.I've heard of something called Vatika oil which is basically just coconut oil with a little bit of henna & alma extract thrown in.The rave reviews on that product convinced me that I needed to get some coconut oil to save my hair.Its not overpriced,but I wanted to see if I could get the same benefits & same some cash by just using coconut oil alone on my hair.Regardless,I believe that anyone buying this is using it on their hair,most likely,& not as an oil in their cooking,but I had to mention it.When you use coconut oil on your hair,it will start to feel more moisturized,especially if you leave it in overnight as a deep conditioner.I use henna combined with indigo (the 2 step process) in order to dye my hair black without the use of chemicals,since I've experienced irritation before using regular hair dyes.Coconut oil is an amazing deep conditioner after a henna treatment,as it tends to dry your hair out very much.The price of Parachute coconut oil is usually very reasonable,but it would always be nice if they lowered it anyway,since I love saving money.As long as you live in a semi-humid region,then the coconut oil should be soft enough so that you can melt it easily.Just scoop or shake some out into a small melt-proof squeeze bottle,& leave it out in a sunny area for a few minutes.Also,I would try leaving it in a sink with warm water,but that might melt the bottle,though,if too hot.Coconut oil will definitely help me to grow my hair back stronger then before,so that I can again use relaxers,within reason,to keep it nice & straight.

If you have't tried these pretzels, they are a MUST for your list.By far the BEST GF snack product on the market.  I have shared these with many of my gluten eating friends and they all agree that these pretzels are the best!
We love these pretzels.  They are not always in stock at our local store.  Ordering a case from Amazon was so easy, delivery was quick.
Special diets like Gluten free whose people are always looking for something tasty, this will fit that bill.
These are the best gf pretzels on the market. We have tried many others and these are far superior. A real winner!

column9: Excellent Product. As good if not better than "normal" pretzels!

I do not live in the US and have to go through a complicated process to get them as AMAZON only delivers these to US mainland addresses. They are worth every bit of the expense and complications as they are really really fantastic.
This is one gluten free item that rates far above pretzels containing gluten. Much better than butter pretzels whlich used to be MY favorite.......just have to remember that I bought them for HIM.
I love these pretzels.  Even friends and family who don't have to eat gluten free love them.  They have just enough salt and the texture is great.

column9: The Best Gluten Free Pretzels Around
column10: These are by far the best gluten free pretzels we've ever eaten. Also, Amazon had the best price and to top it off they had free shipping!
These sat in my pantry for a while because I was afraid to try them and be disappointed. Thankfully I wasn't. It's nice to have a crunchy snack that fills me up. Will buy more of these soon!
These are wonderful. They are a bit pricey, but if you want a Gf prezel that tastes JUST like the wheat prezels, then these are for you.  I just hope Amazon puts these on special again soon.

I love these pretzels and the Amazon price makes them even better.  They are $8.19 in my local store so I gave up buying them until I found them on Amazon.They taste better than wheat pretzels to me.  My GF kids love them too!
We can't get enough of these GF pretzels. They taste very buttery and rich. My son LOVES them. the twists are excellent, too.

Let's face it. If you have Celiac disease and have to be Gulten free you are very limited in what you can eat. Before I was diagnosed I loved pretzels and while nothing Gulten free tastes as good as the real thing this products comes very close. I now eat them every day and buy the product by the case. I would highly recommend to anyone who cannot eat Gulten to try this product as in my case it is a life saver!

Although it is my daughter that has Celiac Disease, I try everything she eats.  These pretzels taste great, if not better than 'regular' ones.  Most of everything by Glutino is very good.  Highly suggest!

column9: I like them much more than regular pretzels
column10: My son's celiac so we buy these pretzels by the case.  I was never a big fan of pretzels but I eat these all the time.  They''ve got just the right amount of crunch and salt, and they're good for dipping in things like hummos.  My kid loves them too.  They're a bit expensive but definitely worth it.
Excellent product, no one will know they are anything but the "real thing"They are crisp, light and delicious and quite a treat to take along when traveling or going to a party.

column9: I've died and gone to heaven...
column10: Wow! Incredible taste and texture... but watch out! Boris and I inhaled a bag between us in one sitting! They're just too good... ~ Natasha
These may be the best pretzels around. I think they taste great (and I'm not on a GF diet).

Most GF pretzels, cookies, etc. that are trying to be substitutes for wheat products always taste "off."  These pretzels are great! Crunchy, slightly salty, no dry rice taste. My boyfriend likes them as well as regular wheat based pretzels.  Watch for a sale and they are a terrific deal.
I would never guess that these pretzels were gluten free if I had not read the label.
These are great.  They are just like a regular pretzel.  It's so wonderful to eat something that is like you used to eat.

column9: wow - hard to believe the quality!
column10: one year ago i found out i had to eat gluten free and so many things like this are simply awful. WOW! What a fantastic surprise to try these very tasty pretzels! Thanks Glutino - almost everything I have tried from this brand has been quite good....

All the other GF pretzels I've tried have an "off" flavor. These ones don't! They have a great texture and flavor. I am the only one in my household who must eat GF, but everyone -- husband and kids included -- agrees these are good pretzels. They're crunchy, but light (not rock-hard on the teeth like some pretzels can be). Great alone for a snack, or just the right thing to combine with Rice Chex, peanuts, and seasoning for a great GF party mix!

We have tried MANY GF snacks and these are our families favorites. Most brands of GF pretzels are hard and flavorless. Not these! Light, crisp and yummy, we tear through them at our house!My 3 year old and I are the GF members of our household, but everyone loves them! My 11 year old generally thinks all things GF are "ick" by default, but she inhales these. Many of my kids friends say they are the best pretzels they have had, and they have no idea they are GF.We mix them with Rice Chex (GF but not other types of Chex or generic brands), raw almonds and chocilate chips for a yummy snack mix we call "Finnie Mix" - named for my 3 year old. Good stuff!We also grind them with raw almonds and use them as a fabulous breading for chicken nuggets.They are a bit pricey, but well worth it. The subscription offer from Amazon is a great deal (about $2-3 less per bag than any of the stores in my area) if you want to drop $60ish bucks at once.

column9: Great Snack for Gluten free kids
column10: Sometimes it is hard to find a quick snack for Gluten free kids.  These pretzels are the best of all the GF pretzels we have tried. We leave a bag at my sons preschool for snack time. He loves them.

column9: Best gluten free pretzels, best price
column10: Our son has celiac but our entire family prefers these to regular pretzels - my father in law, too. Fortunately, I can buy a case on line and use subscribe and save. It's about $2.50 a bag cheaper than buying locally.

These are the best pretzels.  I can't believe they are gluten-free and taste great.  Our family actually like them better than regular pretzels.
You wouldn't think these are missing anything, but they don't taste just like pretzels. But they're good enough for my sons friends and I catch my husband taking a few bites.

These pretzels are wonderful!My husband thinks they are better than regular pretzels. I prefer the twists, simply because I think they are more fun to eat, but the sticks are good for dipping. Both are delicious.

column9: WOW these are better than Wheat ones
column10: We bought some of these at a whole foods coop and WOW... I am gluten intolerant but my wife is not and so I shared anyway lol and we both fully agree that these are better than any pretzels we have ever had(that includes many many brands of Wheat pretzels). This is the best snack ever.
Gluten Free Glutino Pretzel Twists-The best tasting pretzels - they are crispy & have a good flavor.

column9: Yum!!  Wish they were slightly less so!!
column10: Not only can't I, the celiac in the family, stop eating them; but my non-celiac husband regularly steals them before I get to them!
My son and I have Cleiac and love the pretzels.  It is hard to keep them in the house because everyone likes them better than regular pretzels.  They are crispier than most.  Great product!!

I regularly buy the Glutino pretzel sticks for my family. We had been missing pretzel sticks after going on the gluten free diet and were so happy to find these. They taste really great, almost like their wheat counterparts. Each of the many bags we've eaten has always been fresh and crunchy - never stale. A bag of these pretzels doesn't last very long in our house.

I just bought these for the first time. WOW! They are wonderful--not at all  something that simulates  pretzel taste. column9: Best darn pretzels, GF or not
column10: These are the best pretzels we've ever eaten, and by far the best tasting gluten free product.  My family loves these, and it's only my son who has to eat gluten free.  It's nice to be able to give my son something that I don't feel like is a lesser product taste-wise than the "regular" version.  So glad to be able to buy them by the case since they are hard to find in stores.  The pretzel sticks seem to taste better than the traditional shaped pretzels--don't know why--could be mental on my part.

I love these pretzels.  Friends, family and co-workers are also raving about them.  No one can tell they're gluten-free.

Glutino pretzels (and Pastas) are the best on the market and taste SOOOO much like the real thing. I lived 35 years before discovering Celiac, I know what the real thing tastes like!!  They make our gluten free life so much more normal!!
These are the best pretzels ever.  They taste exactly like regular pretzels and have a hint of butter flavor.

My daughter is on a Gluten-Free Casein-Free diet and this is one of the only snack foods I can get her to eat.  3yr olds aren't known for their desire for new and different foods so this has become a staple snack food for her.

Gluten free pretzels never tasted so good. I'm a little disappointed with the price, as I can get them pretty much anywhere for the same price, but the Amazon prime shipping made it worthwhile. These are by far the best gluten free pretzels on the market!

column9: Just As Good As Wheat Pretzels.
column10: My kids were pretzels addicts before being finding out they had a wheat intolerance, so these pretzels were one of our first gluten-free purchases.  Many gluten-free products don't live up to their gluten filled counterparts, but these certainly do.  The kids loved them, and so do I.  We now keep them as a staple in our pantry.
I was not really sure these pretzles would be as good as claimed.Boy was I wrong, as good as "regular" pretzles if not better and healther!DO NOT HESITATE to try these, you will not be sorry.

My kids and I love these.  We take them on trips and outings with ease. Wish they weren't so expensive, but without any other G.F. pretzels in single serve packages that taste as good I guess sometimes you just have to pay for it to have something "normal" again.

My 14 year old was recently diagnosed with celiac.  It has been difficult finding snacks that she enjoys and can bring to school.  We have found these pretzels to be great, really delicious.  Even her friends prefer them to regular pretzels.
These pretzels are the best I have tried since switching to a gluten free diet approximately 2 years ago.I would definitely buy them again.
I cannot believe that these are gluten free.  They taste exactly like "regular" pretzels, maybe even better.  By far the best gluten free item we've ever tried.
Glutino Gluten Free Pretzel Twists are buttery, crispy, and they taste like regular ones.  Perfect for Celiacs or non-celiacs, they can't tell the difference, either.
These pretzels are OK for the gluten free diet but not a good substitute for "real" pretzels.

column9: Great deal on best GF pretzels I've found!

If you or your gluten-free child loves pretzels for a snack, and you have the space to store a dozen bags, this is an awesome deal! These are amazingly good pretzels and Amazon's subscribe and save price is the best you're going to find anywhere!!

Stores do not stock them since they are a bit pricey but well worth it for those of us who are gluten-intolerant.  These are a must for me.

column9: Get these if need a POWERFUL LAXATIVE
column10: I purchased these at a local store, and had half a bag for lunch.  They tasted OK, but were definitely not worth the after effects.  Within about 7 hours after eating these my stomach started feeling awkward.  Shortly after I started having cramps and severe watery diarrhea several times throughout the evening and late night.  Looking at the ingredients, the thing that stands out is carboxymethylcellulose AKA cellulose gum.  The package I purchased said cellulose gum on the ingredients list, but on the web sites it is listed as carboxymethylcellulose.  You will find they are synonyms if you Google them.  All I had for breakfast that day was a bowl of dry corn flakes, and didn't have time to eat dinner before my stomach started cramping.  If you look up this ingredient, or look it up along with "side effects" you will find it is undigestible and can cause side effects such as bloating and diarrhea.  Never again.  All I can say is please post a review if this happened to you to others are forewarned!

column9: Thumbs up from a new gluten-free dieter

column9: The Best Gluten Free Pretzels around!!

Despite what O'Reilly used as a tip at the end of his show, gluten-free usually mean more "carbs" for a similar serving. But as a Celiac, varity is truly the spice of life. Celiacs first response to diagnosis is to see all the walls between them and what used to be their favorite foods. Celiacs in this day and age are so much luckier than previous generations. Firstly, because Doctors are running the proper blood tests to diagnosis gluten-intolerance much more frequently. It might appear as if more folks are stricken with this these days, but I am convinced that is just because of this increased knowlegde by the Doctors. As to these pretzels. They may or may not strike you as better than your previous favorite, but you now understand that the previous favorite were the cause of "palor", malnutrision and gastro issues. So you must resign yourself to exploring the every expanding gluten-free offerings. These are not your Philly soft pretzels, but they make a great salty and crunchy "chip" with which to scoop up some hummus, peanutbutter, etc. Also, this size bag and the Amazon price for a box of these every month or two is one of the most affordable ways to enjoy these healthful snacks. They also good straight from the bag, but it easy to get carried away. My wife and I found out about my Celiac 5 years ago. It makes you read everylabel on every product you bring into your house. You may even go as far a throwing out all porous (i.e. wooden) utensils, your old toaster and several other things and can't be guaranteed sanitazied. You learn to trust mostly the food you make yourself, but when you learn that you can trust Glutino, and you can, subscribe to Amazon for regularly scheduled deliveries of all types of life giving goodies like the Pamela's Pancake Mix which go great with chopped, toasted walnuts, blueberries and a couple of raisins although, most maple, agava and other syrups are still safe.Glutino Gluten Free Pretzel Twists, 14.1-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)

column9: 1 Star based only on bad packaging  : (
column10: Maybe ordering this product in August was a bad move on my part, but I never stopped to consider that heat would affect the shipment the way it did mine. The product was shoved into my metal mailbox on its side and left to bake in the 90-degree heat, and when we opened the mailbox we were surprised to see that even the bubble envelope was covered in oil, thereby leaking oil onto the rest of our mail.  I opened up the envelope over a trashcan and retrieved the jar of coconut oil with a towel (for both gripping and cleaning purposes), and about 1/3 of the product had leaked out.  Yes, somehow a factory-sealed jar with a foil seal which was shipped inside a plastic bubble-wrap lined envelope still managed to seep out and leave a gooey mess all over the rest of our mail! I can't attest to whether or not this product is any good because I decided to throw it out.  I will say, however, that even though the oil didn't quickly absorb into my skin (as some people say it does), after I washed my hands I noticed that my skin felt a bit softer.  Always a silver lining in every cloud -- haha!  I'm pretty disappointed because I really wanted to try this product based on all of the great reviews it received, so maybe I'll order again in the winter.  I think it should be shipped in a box rather than an envelope, though, as it stands a better chance of being delivered upright that way.

column9: A Culinary Rainbow in Eden's Sea Breeze Garden
column10: This recently redeemed saturated fat is an unusually elegant offering. Liquid above 78 degrees, when below that temperature this exotic substance solidifies into a white, wax-like, creamy fat which for my tastes is even more versatile, flavorful, and healthful in culinary concoctions than coconut milk [though I LOVE everything about coconut].Since other reviews have effectively detailed health benefits, varieties of uses, and comparisons of brands, I'll work another angle and design a recipe specifically for the assets of this oil as my experience with it conjures...Imagine melting this creamy solid as you might do with dry chunks of fresh, unsalted butter dropped easily into a chef's stainless steel [or cast iron] skillet.  After the coconut lard has melted, coating the pan with its clear, wavering liquid radiating from mildly searing heat [not over 350 degrees], carefully sizzle in a half-dozen large, cleaned prawns and a fresh salmon steak.  Prior to hitting the pan, the sea morsels should have been eased from a state of cool moisture into a warmer, drier presentation, to avoid spattering when placed into the heated oil, and to avoid cooling the oil to a temperature too low for an immediate, light searing to occur on the surface of the ocean-plumped, sweet-pink edibles.Think of the sweet, paradise-rich flavor of coconut, coating a crisp, caramelized surface onto the salty tang of the shrimp and salmon meats... [Your mouth might be watering now. Mine is!]Put on a CD with the happy 40's tune of Rum & Coca Cola sending dancing notes around your stove-top, putting an upbeat rhythm into your head ... from down in Trinidad.  [Your feet will be making up their own motions now.]Crack a bit of sea salt crystal over the hissing ocean treats. Overlap that seasoning with cleaned, halved garlic cloves dropped into the skillet, followed by large sprigs of fresh dill, fennel stalks, and a half-cup of shelled, dark walnut meats.After the pan's contents have been seared golden on all main sides, pour in about a cup of dry white wine [enough liquid to retain itself without simmering away into steam, but not so much as to smother the meats and dissolve the top layer of dark, caramelized coating]. Squeeze a fresh lime into the steaming liquid in the pan, followed by a splash or two of quality blackberry juice and a sliced, fresh, ripe peach [which will stew into the concoction, coalescing into an almost unimaginable flavor of sweet, sour highlights held by a texture of pulpy fruit]. Simmer and swish the heavenly blend maybe a minute, taking care to heat all participants but not overcook the shrimp or salmon.Crack fresh black pepper over the brew in the skillet, then serve onto a large, multi-colored, festive plate, over a mound of Quinoa [see my review  Alter Eco Fair Trade White Quinoa from Bolivia, 16-Ounce Boxes] which has been cooked, then warmly toasted in Macadamia Nut Oil [see my review of  Macadamia Nut Oil 16 fl.oz] with garlic bits and chives, adding fresh mint as a last touch.Garnish the presentation of Quinoa, Prawns, and salmon steak with sugar snap peas which have been sauteed in almond oil [see my review of NOW Foods Sweet Almond Oil, Edible, 16 ounce] with slivers of red onion, angle-sliced celery, toasted, halved almonds, and sprigs of fresh cilantro.There you have a culinary rainbow, from a Shelnutt dreaming in Eden's Sea Breeze Garden.Before taking your first, saliva-rich bite, with your "Rum & Coca Cola" CD still dancing through the air waves in your gorgeous, eat-in, gourmet kitchen, be sure to have your KINDLE to read at the table, with a story ready which will rhythm your thoughts into the 50's, when songs from the 40's were still dancing in the minds of the cooks of the world, COAL & COCA-COLA, a short, true story with photos, about a bakery opened in that vintage era.Linda ShelnuttThis review gives a complement, contrast to a video review I've posted on Dr. Bruce Fife's The Coconut Oil Miracle.

Barlean's organic extra virgin coconut oil has a wonderful taste - great on toast, with a light sprinkling of cinnamon over the coconut oil!  Also tasty when mixed with hot oatmeal. I accidentally discovered that it makes a top-quality hand treatment, setting up a moisturizing barrier for my dry skin.  That lead me to massage the oil into my arms and legs, with gratifying results!It's reassuring to know this oil is organic and free from man-made chemicals.

column9: Why didn't I know about this soon!
column10: This coconut oil is AMAZING! I hope to never go without it. Where else can you find an amazing moisturizer, healthy oil for cooking and great tasting spread.  It has improved my skin so much I will never buy expensive creams again. Thank you!!

I have been using Barleans Coconut oil for about a year now and it has been a great addition to all of my cooking adventures.  It comes in a mostly solid form, so it is easy to use just the right amount.  It has a very nice but soft aroma and it adds minimal flavor to any dish that I have used it in.  I'm a fan.

column9: A must have if you have hairless animals!
column10: We LOVE this stuff!! We have hairless cats and dogs...they are prone to skin issues...allergies, both food and enviornmental. This is a godsend for all of them!! Plus, if they lick it off their skin, it's actually good for them!
Good quality product..uses it on my hair and it smells really good... Im so glad I purchased this coconut oil

If you are deciding to buy coconut oil, this one I thought was great.  I didnt try any others, to compare, but I purchased it based on reviews and enjoyed it.  It didnt do anything spectacular but I cooked with it, used it as a moisturizer, and I will probably try to have it in the house at all times.  If I get any other brand I will report back to compare.

column9: Does a good job on dry skin
column10: I like this coconut oil, I use it on my face after using a mud facial. Mud drys my skin out and this makes it fee very nice. I haven't used it for cooking as yet.
So glad I met coconut oil!  Great medicinal benefits.  I use it for skin, hair, coffee sweetner, and sauteeing veggies!

Okay so tell you; I LOVE THIS PRODUCT!! Well I love coconut oil period. I purchased this product at the health food store almost twice this amount and have been using it everyday on my face, skin, and hair. The dark spots on my face have lighten up to the point were they are almost gone, my hair is much softer and stopped falling out so much and my skin is super smooth. My next thing is to try to eat a couple tablespoons like some others to see if the weight loss really happens like some have said. But if it doesn't I'm still very satisfied about the other things it has done for me. It is definitely worth trying and sticking with.

Two jars of Barlean's organic coconut oil arrived on time and in excellent condition with a sale date in 2013.  All seals, external and internal, were intact.  Upon opening, no suspicious odor of any kind was noticed, only a light coconut smell meets the nose.  However, the oil, currently well solid, does not have a uniform appearance.  In places that might be due to proximity to the black jar. In other places, however, swirls of oil seem denser or grayer or perhaps not as gelled.  Any frequent user could tell me whether this is common with this product.  A call to the manufacturer's representative said comment could not be made unless the contents were seen and that I might easily return the jars to Amazon, which I would rather not do if it is able to be used.  Thanks.

This product is excellent! I am having a hard time figuring out what I can try that this WILL NOT be good on or with!! lol lol I have naturally curly hair, this product eases the frizz and tames the mane. It smells great too! Oh, after shaving my legs, excellent conditioner for my sensitive skin! I love this stuff!

This particular coconut oil has become my favorite.  Wonderful texture and aroma.  I'm substituting it for any kind of veg oil in baking recipes when I don't feel like using butter.  I also add it to my kids and my smoothies for added smoothness and healthy fat.  Baking some lemon poppyseed muffins right now with it.
I love the taste and overall quality of this coconut oil...Enhances anything I cook in it..and I use it as a body moistuizer & hair conditioner...

I have used this in my cooking & on my skin, and it's amazing! When I add it to my smoothies, it seems to suppress my appetite in the morning as well as give me a little boost of energy! Not caffeine sort of energy, but just a natural feel-good kind. I also use it every few nights on my face as a moisturizer and it's been phenomenal! I had awful dry patches this winter and it smoothed them out in days! It's also helped me even out the tone of my skin. I don't use it every night, however, because I'm scared it would break me out, as I have sensitive skin. This is definitely worth the price and you get SO MUCH product. I've barely made a dent in my jar!

This oil is amazing. It smells good; like real coconut and I know what real coconut oil smells like and it's very light, so it doesn't feel like you're using a fatty product. I'm extremely satisfied with it. Barlean's Organic Oils Extra Virgin Coconut Oil, 16-Ounce Jar

This product is amazing, I wish I could write something about this product that would not sound as if I work for the company; I don't think is possible.Let me put it this way..Less than a week after I got my first two packs, I reordered. Now even my family and friends are enjoying and getting amazed by this product.

I ordered this product along with another brand of coconut oil and six CD's. I arrived home to find an oil soaked box sitting on top of my mail box (I was away from home 2 hrs during which the mail was delivered) ....the temp was almost 100 degrees.  I opened the box to find a huge mess!  The other brand oil was enclosed in a sealed plastic bag that was dry inside even though the oil itself was liquified....when I removed the lid, the seal on the top was completely intact.This product, however, was put in the box loose.  The plastic jar seal was unbroken but the lid turned easily so I could clearly see how the liquified oil had come out and gotten all over the interior of the box.....including the six CD's....with oil seeping up into their plastic coverings and onto the paper jackets.  When I broke the plastic "ring" that is supposed to seal the outside of the jar, I found that the seal on the top was not secured to the top but had come loose so the oil came out and under the loose top.....since it wasn't in a bag, it went everywhere in the box.  This was a packaging DISASTER all around!!!!I found this order didn't "qualify" for leaving feedback under the packaging feedback tab in the order category.......so I can only assume it is the seller's responsibility; and the inner seal does definitely need to be addressed by them.  The oil tastes fine but I certainly will never order again.UPDATE:  I was gratified to find that Amazon reads these reviews and reacts to them....after posting this review, I received an email apologizing for my experience and advising that I would receive a replacement for the Barlean's.  I did receive the Barlean's which arrived with no problem; it was packed the same way but was sent two-day shipping so didn't sit in any heat for extended times....also, this jar didn't have the failed seal under the lid when I opened it.  I appreciate and was impressed by Amazon's response but, to be honest, I have to wonder if when regularly shipped it still wouldn't be a problem since it's not enclosed in a plastic bag inside the box and if sent via USPS in this heat is almost certainly going to melt.
the coconut oil was great - i really loved the product but once i got through the top layer in the jar the middle of it was hollow! What a disappointment~ i would have really liked a full jar!

I love coconut oil. I use it on my skin every day and I use it in my cooking (different container, lol).I get another organic coconut oil from a local store that doesn't have a strong smell like this one. It's not a bad smell! I love putting it on my skin, and I think it smells wonderful, but my boyfriend complains that I smell like toast! Haha! Because of that I don't know if it would work as well in cooking as the other coconut oil I get, and I have only used this one on my skin.It makes my skin feel softer. I also like to use it on my feet, not only because it has made them feel soft like real feet again (I walk around bare foot a lot) but because it is anti-fungal and anti-bacterial it can protect my feet! I like that!Great product if you like the smell of toast!

i like the jar/packaging for this product for a couple of reasons-- one being just basic marketing but the other being that it is a wide-mouth open jar which makes it easier to extract the oil out of when it gets low. That being said, when it comes to taste & smell i didn't think this one was nearly as delicious as the Spectrum brand. purchasing this one over another brand really depends on your personal preferences and what your intentions for using the product are.

Bought this after reading several articles about coconut oil uses. I use it on my hair and it has been better than any over the counter overpriced oil.It has been great on my skin without any breakage since I have sensitive skin.I only have one problem.It gets hard when cold and is sometimes hard to melt. I have found a warm place in my house and keep the jar there yet I see it can cause the plastic jar to be greasy. All in all I will get a lot of use this winter and not go broke buying skin and hair oils.

So I had used coconut oil in the past but wasn't enthralled with the brand I had or results.  I decided to give coconut oil another try.  I did a lot of research and decided to try this one.  First off, packaging was great and fast (I love Amazon Prime)!  In regards to the product itself...I love it!  I use it for my skin, hair and cooking.  I like coconut oil because it is not too heavy.  I have natural hair and a bit of a product junkie so I am always looking for a product that works with my hair.  I've used it for detangling, sealing, and in my hair mixtures.  This product leaves a subtle scent in my hair which I like experiencing and it moisturizes my skin without leaving an oily residue.  I tried cooking with it for the first time.  I made a curry dish and used the coconut oil as a base.  It was awesome and easy to cook with!  Not too greasy, did not burn.  I could definitely taste the coconut but it wasn't overpowering at all.  So all in all I would definitely recommend this product and I plan on buying it again!

column9: Where have you been all my life?
column10: This was my first experience with coconut oil. I selected Barlean's due to the very good reviews. Cooking with coconut oil was such a delight; light, delicate flavor, low melting point yet remains stable at high frying temps. I liked it so much I ordered a jar sent to my sister!
Package arrived covered in oil....lid was loose and inner seal was compromised.  Smelled good though!  Am afraid to use for cooking and unsure how to return.  Amazon, HELP!
This is clearly a high quality coconut oil. It is a very pure product with a wonderful smell and taste. It should remain at room temperature.

I love this coconut oil for my hair. It's very light and conditions the scalp really well. The only tiny issue that I have with this product is the smell. It sort of smells like cooking oil. I thought it will have a nice tropical coconut smell for some reason but it doesnt. overall its a great product for hair!

column9: Even better than my high hopes!
column10: After much research on amazon and other websites, I chose to buy this organic coconut oil to use primarily on my skin.  I love it more with each use, my skin is noticeably and increasingly softer and more supple after a few weeks of use, but even after the first use my skin felt and looked very healthy.  I have used it as a replacement for lotion, both on my body and my face.  I only need about two tablespoons to cover my entire body.  I believe it has even improved the skin on my face, which can be sensitive to synthetic lotions and break out.  The oil has a pleasant fresh coconut smell and taste, which fades after rubbing it in, so don't worry about smelling strongly of coconut (not like tanning lotion).As other reviewers have said: coconut oil is solid (hard vegetable shortning-like texture) at room temperature, but turns softer and eventually to liquid at 76 degrees fahrenheit.  So, it melts quickly on your skin of course.I also used some of the oil in a homemade hot cocoa recipe, it had a pleasant taste and didn't seem "oily".Hope this review helps!  I highly recommend this product. Great price for what you get, too.

Coconut Oil is good for so many uses, this coconut oil tastes amazing! Creamy texture... I use it even on my face at night...around my cuticles....I have read that it can have memory benfits....that would be awesome...

column9: Great stuff at a very reasonable price
column10: I was introduced to this coconut oil by my niece who is a natural products fanatic.  I must agree with her though.  This oil is very smooth,it smells wonderful and does the trick for soft skin and hair. Love it and would recommend it to others.

I love this oil, it smells great, it works its magic, it's great for babies, it's great for moms. If you use cloth diapers it's awesome. Strongly recumbent it instead of all those products full of chemicals like Johnson&Johnson stuff...
Love the product. Smells good and works good. Last a long time. I use this everyday and it leaves my skin silky and beautiful.

column9: Barlean's Organic Oils Extra Virgin Coconut Oil - Love it!  :)
column10: This is my first time trying coconut oil. I absolutely love Barlean's.I feel good about its' health benefits and use it to replace butter on toast and for stir frying. I look forward to new uses for the coconut oil. I plan on trying it as a hair conditioner - it's a product I wish I had discovered long ago.

This is an awesome product!  I used it religiously once a day and then smothered lotion on top of it on my thighs, butt cheeks, stomach, sides, chest and bikini area.  I went full term with my pregnancy and came out with not a single stretch mark.  How awesome is that!!!

This has a stronger coconut flavor than I expected, so it's definitely better for dishes that would go well with that flavor. I use it to make one minute muffins some mornings. It's also great to add a little to the pan when cooking chicken. Yum! Haven't tried it in my hair yet, but probably will at some point.
My mother in law got me hooked on coconut oil on Christmas, and I've used it everyday since! It's amazing the dry skin I get on my face in the winter... I will forever be using this product!
Its fabulous!  Great for hair, skin and everything.  Its light and not greasy at all.  I will recommend this too everyone.

I bought this exact same product, in the exact same quantity per box, at my local supermarket for just under $6.00.  I asked an employee if it was just a trial price, and he said that it was indeed the regular price.  As the other reviewers have stated, these snacks can be very addictive.  To be on the safe side, in case the supermarket does raise the price, I purchased four boxes - for the same price as Amazon is selling a single box!The one-star I rated this item was for the Amazon price, not for the quality of the product.
