They are indeed delicious!! - but Don't Waste Your Money Here unless they lower the price considerably. Rating is for price, not quality.

Like everyone else, I think this product is overpriced online and is cheaper if you can find it in a local store. I'm overseas; our BX only gets them occasionally, and they sell out quick. These taste great, and the whole family loves them!
These taste great and are pretty addictive, but this same box was about $5 at my local Ralph's supermarket. Don't buy this from Amazon!

column9: Black Forest Fruit Snacks Juicy Filled Centers 0.9 Ounce Pouches (Pack of 42)...
column10: Gang:I bought this as a back-up since my Ralphs' had run out of Welch's Fruit Snacks.I was pleasantly surprised at the quality and flavor of these snacks (and will buy more - if they're in stock).Four stars for the snacks (sale price: $7.24)!Amazon's price is absolutely unbelievable...One star for the price - and then you get to add shipping?  No way...
These fruit snacks are the best.  I bring them to work and share with fellow nurses.  It is worth the price to me as I trust Amazon and Amazon sellers for their service etc.

When we were visiting out west, our grandson had a box of these snacks.  Of course, Mama & Papa had to be sure that this wasn't just junk food with no nutrional value.  Were we ever surprised when we tried these little gems!  The center is filled with fruit juice - not just sugar water or some other substance.  When we returned to the east coast we immediately went looking for these snacks but to our dismay we couldn't find them anywhere.  As always when I need something I look on Amazon since they usually have it for less than anyplace.  Low & behold there was our grandson's BIG box of Black Forest Fruit Snacks!!  It took only a minute to order a box and we have been enjoying them ever since!  Thank you for stocking these great snacks!  Please don't ever stop!!

These fruit snacks are delicious and I thought I got a great deal. I did not price compare between 50 different physical locations like some of the reviewers. All I know is that these are the best fruit snacks I've ever had. I also recommend their Juicy Oozer's which actually might be better. The juice actually gives me the goose bumps when I eat them sometimes. These things are terrific.

This is the most tasty snack I have had in a long time. Its very addicting. However Amazons price is high. I got a box at my store for $5.50 well worth it.I just found out today it was on a trial at my grocery store and they were out of stock. My whole family enjoyed them ! I'm trying to find them locally now !

column9: Great Fruit Snack But small pouches
column10: I love the product, but the pouches need to be bigger.  There's at least 7 pieces of fruit chews in each pouch, and like the previous reviewer pointed out, the are addicting!!  Save your money and buy it from your local supermarket store b/c Amazon is expensive.

I purchased this item at the super market at Halloween time.  They are very flavorful soft, chewy treats. Similar to Gummi Bears but they have a juicy center and intense flavor. I went back to buy more because my teen age grandson loves them and they were all gone. Much to my chagrin they are only available in my area for Halloween. They make great snacks for children and adults.

the fruit snacks I ordered have an expiration date on them of 07/03/2012.  the centers of the gummie are dry.  there is no juice any longer in these.  If the expiration date is 07/03/2012, they have been shelved for about 1 year.  in the stores, they have at minimum a year out exp.

These fruit snacks are awesome and wanted to ship some down to my daughter so came to my trusty Amazaon Subscribe - When I saw the price, I started scanning because I thought this must be for 3-4 boxes at least - wrong!!!  I just bought 4 boxes at Menards and they were $6 each - I can ship those to my daughter for less than what one of these boxes on Amazon would cost.
I only gave it a five because of the taste.The price is too too high, yes.National Candy has them for less.It is the shipping that is high there though.
This is not as it appears! You do not get ten boxes but just one that all Kroger stores sell for around $6.00!

column9: they are fine and a good price
column10: Daisy Mae is chewing them happily.I would buy them again.I gave it 4 stars because rawhide chews don't warrant 5 unless they are so good I chew them

These rawhides are paper thin and make a wafer-like mess all over when my dog chews them. They might be the right size, but when it comes to weight they are way too thin. These don't compare to ones you buy at the store because my dog can shatter them with one bite.
My pup goes through 1 of these every 1-2 days.  She loves them, but they do make her rather gassy.  I think this was a very good value though.
My vet recomended I get rawhides for my dog. She loves them and they last forever but they give her the worst farts EVER!

Normally love this product and was excited about the individual packaging, HOWEVER, the cookies had a funny plastic-like taste to them.  Wondering if the plastic in the packaging off-gassed into the product.  Blek.
I used to enjoy their ground coffee in a drip maker. This coffee in an espresso maker lacked the depth that I would have expected. Nothing special.

I've been looking for a good wet food to feed my picky cat.  Previously went through every brand of canned cat food, and he'd eat the first portion out of the can, and turn his nose up at everything after that.  But he has kidney issues so the vet strongly recommends wet food...Found this food and he LOVES it.  It actually looks and smells like something I might eat (at a pinch), and I love that I can prepare only as much as he'll eat right then.  It also feels more environmentally friendly - one small bag vs. dozens and dozens of tin cans.  It appears to have all the nutrients and such that he needs as well.

I was looking for a good, clean food that was easy to store, easy to carry up 5 flights of stairs (if the elevator was out), that came at a reasonable price. Grandma Lucy's met those criteria. We feed mostly grain-free and high-quality foods to our two cats, because we've found over the years (with several cats) that this helps maintain their weight best and prevents dander (and allergies) for their humans.  I tried Prowl first, but it just didn't appeal to them or me: it was really powdery and, when prepared, looked like pureed meat baby food, way too soupy when prepared according to directions. So I looked at other options.Our vet had Lucy's on their list of recommended brands, but I never saw it in the store. Finally just ordered some, and it's a great success.  The cats don't always like it served alone, but we try to feed a variety anyway, so they don't get too set on one food. I usually mix 1/4 cup with a tablespoon of Wellness canned (flavors vary) and a tablespoon of pumpkin (to boost the fiber for our intestinally-challenged cat), all blended with some hot water (to warm up the chilled canned components), and they NEVER turn up their noses. They will eat it alone if they're hungry, but they prefer a mix.  The first time I tried this food, I was impressed with how appetizing it smelled--like Thanksgiving dinner, really.  Amazing.  The powdered flakes are NOT all potato, like other reviewers have implied. Some of the flake material is chicken or fish, but there are also chunks of chicken and fish for some textural variety.  I'm not sure if the flax seeds make any difference; I thought flax had to be ground or at least abraded to be digested. I might e-mail the company to ask.

I like salt, and I like having a citrusy garlicky one on hand. This is it! A nice texture, and very balanced with flavor, in my opinion. I would recommend having a salt grinder on hand to get the most out of this salt, as a grinder would incorporate the flavors well. It definitely chunky!

I ordered this item a couple months ago and love the flavor.  I use it just about everyday on so many foods(even popcorn). Since the grinder bottle is refillable I just ordered a large jar of it. I didnt give it 5 stars because I found one thing quite annoying.  The label information, except the Faerie's Finest logo, disappears as you twist it to grind the salt. I have never had any problems like that with other grinders.  So I hope the company reads  comments and come up with a label that will withhold the use.  As of now, when I refill the jar I need to somehow mark it with what type of salt it is.  (NOTE: all other information regarding what the contents are etc. are gone.)

I'm really pleased that Korean food is beginning to ebb into the mainstream, but anyone who's interested in cooking Korean food should still make the trip down to their local Korean market and buy the genuine article.Annie Chun has altered the taste profile of gochujang significantly, as well as consistency.  It has the consistency of sauce that's already mixed with sesame oil, but not the richness, and it's far too sweet.  The spicy is not full bodied, but flat, and there's a slightly weird aftertaste in the bibimbap I made with this sauce.I've never had any of these problems with gochujang from any of the major Korean brands (all you'll find in the vast majority of Korean/Asian markets).  Ugh.

column9: Very healthy for your babies - different texture; but good!
column10: Let me start by saying I'm a very cheap person and for the past 4 years have only give my cats Friskees wet food. I actually did splurge and get them Royal Canin Sensitive Stomach as dry food though, in my defense. And that stuff isn't cheap. However, in the past few months, my older cat started licking all the hair off of her stomach and was scratching constantly. Two trips to the vet and two steroid injections later, everything was ruled out but an allergic reaction to either the litter I was using (Arm & Hammer) or the food. To avoid paying more vet bills and to make my little fur baby happy, I decided to man(woman) up and get the good stuff. You know, the stuff with no disgusting animal by-products, rice, grain, and brewer's yeast in it. I never really took the time to read the back of the Friskee's label or the label of the Royal Canin. You think if you pay a lot for something it will be healthy, but it's not! I feel like such a bad parent.In any event I completely switched everything. Started using pine pellets for the litter, which is all natural, and got this Core brand food because it appeared to be exactly what my cats needed -something completely free of anything bad for them. I was also instructed by my vet not to feed them chicken or beef because a lot of allergies come from that. So I have only purchased the Turkey/Duck/Seafood types of Core food; both wet and dry.Summary of the wet: Yeah, it's almost $2.00 a can. Makes you a little ill thinking about it. But I've never seen my cats literally lick the entire plate clean and want more than two servings in a day of ANYTHING. When I fed them Friskee's I was easily throwing away half a can a day just by having it be left over and stale on their plate. Not with this Core food. They devour it and come back for more. It's amazing. My wallet doesn't thank me but those cats sure do!As for the dry food: It's a little different in shape/texture than other dry foods. They eat it, but I think they like the wet better. I leave out dry food during the day in case they get hungry so I know they are eating it, but they much prefer the wet.My animals eat better than I do and get better medical care than I do. *Sigh*

column9: Best Jelly Beans You'll Ever Eat!
column10: David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Jelly Beans are so delicious! I ordered 1 lb. each of the peach and rootbeer and loved them both. These are more flavorful and softer than jelly bellies. They're my new favorites. I'm trying grape and green apple next. A pound actually has a lot of jelly beans. The price is well worth the quality and flavor!

column9: Outstanding Juicy Peach Flavor - Highly Recommended
column10: These David's Signature "Beyond Gourmet" peach jelly beans are incredibly realistic tasting and almost juicy, seriously. This flavor is from David Klein, the creator of the famous "Jelly Belly" jelly beans, so I was thrilled to be offered this flavor in David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Jelly Beans Flavor Sampler to review since my family loves jelly beans.I also really like that these jelly beans are made with natural flavors and colors, and includes fruit concentrates fairly high up in ingredients list.Highly Recommended!CFH

I admit, I am picky when it comes to peaches. They have to be really fresh! And when we moved into our own home recently, the very first thing I did was plant a Sweet Georgia Peach tree. My favorite kind.Now, I have to warn you, these are NOT as wonderful as biting a peach still warm from the sun and fresh from the tree before you bring it in and wash it. The juice from these jelly beans don't run down your chin when you bite into them. BUT these are the best peach flavored candy I have met in a very long time. There are only a couple of these flavors I would consider buying a whole pound of in individual flavors. The first is the David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Lemon Jelly Beans and the second is this one.While your taste buds may find others that are better, these are the two that hit the spot for me.I was originally given a complimentary sampler of all of the flavors (which I reviewed) but these beans are so unique that I wanted to share my opinion of them on some of the individual pages as well. These ate A+ Jelly Beans!
Any flavor, any shape, Dingo Bones are a HIT with our Corgi!  Five paws, er, STARS!

column4: P. Carta "Live de life...drink de wine"
column10: Not suitable for medium to large dogs because they can disappear it in half an hour.  Good rawhide chews of this side should last for hours.
I take one every morning with breakfast. I get a little energy burst without that jittery feeling from too much caffeine. With all the benefits Green Tea has to offer, this is a staple in my home.

I was looking to get away from artificial sweeteners, and have been away from sugar for a long time.  I am so glad to have found this product on Amazon!  I had seen it advertised in Natural Health magazine many times, but could never find it at the store.  Since I am very familiar with stevia and have used it for years, I am IN LOVE with these packets.  Helps me get my daily water intake, keeps me away from diet pop completely.  Will order these packets again and again!  Oh yeah, the flavor is good, too.  Not overly sweet, but not too "healthy" tasting -- just right.
I was looking for a water mix-in without artificial sweetners. This uses Stevia, which I use at home. Just what I was looking for. It has fruit punch taste with tons of Vitamin C to boot.

I bought this 24-Count box of Extreme Berries over six months ago to liven up bottled water for my long stays on campus. I didn't really consider the purported health benefits and I think I snagged them when they were discounted. The first time I mixed some up I noted the taste was unusual in some way but also picked up on its "natural" flavoring. I'm not implying it's not naturally flavored, but that the flavor tasted natural, which is a good thing. Even at a discount they weren't exactly cheap either so I really wanted to like them. But 6 months later I have more than half left and I rarely finish them once I've mixed them up. I typically get through about 3/4ths of it and then I can't really stand the taste anymore. Now part of the problem is they may have aged and the ingredients may have deteriorated without the demonized preservatives I presume they excluded. But now it tastes, if it didn't always, like strawberry chalk. If it was the only sweet thing I ever allowed myself to have, it probably would taste pretty good. But now it kind of tastes like a bunch of ground up sweet tarts suspended in water without the sugar. Now that I've picked out this chalkiness it seems very distinct and I just can't enjoy it anymore. Now considering all the good stuff its supposed to have in it, and the ingredient list does seem to impress, it's important to be fair. This is a health food (dietary supplement as it says on the box) and that wasn't really what I was looking for. It's not the worst tasting of that kind of product I've ever had and all I can really say is that in that regard it meets expectations.Note that it is sweetened with stevia if that interests you. Really this is all about the antioxidant blend. I don't know what competition is out there but I can say the other means of imbibing the antioxidants in this seem to me like a far less palatable endeavor.

I have been using this product for years.  Like all products, the price may stay the same, but the contents are reduced in order for the manufacturer to convince the consumer they do not raise their prices.  Just keep one packet and watch in a year - contents will be reduced.  I now find myself using 2 packets to make one good drink.  I also like to sweeten it up a bit and found a great natural sweetener (great for diabetics) - Xylitol. column9: It's ok, but not for me
column10: I used to love eating mint chocolate chip ice cream before my milk allergy got too bad. It was one of my favorite flavors and so you'd assume that this would have been my first pick of the Dessert Delights group. Not so- it was actually one of the last flavors I'd purchased. Why? Because it's so very hard to get that artificial chocolate flavor right. You know what I'm talking about. For every one non-real chocolate scent, flavor, or what-have-you that someone makes, there's about 10 that taste terrible.I was actually pretty surprised to find that the chocolate taste here was well done. It didn't have that icky "this is totally artificial and vaguely resembles something chocolate" flavor that so many other things tend to get. It isn't identical, but it's darn close.The mint flavor is definitely the stronger of the two flavors, which in my opinion was a wise choice. It helps to mask any shortcomings with the chocolate. Mint is also the predominant flavor in this type of ice cream, so having the chocolate be too strong wouldn't really taste right.Now you're wondering why I only gave it three stars. Well, it's because despite the good flavors, I just didn't really care for this. It's OK, but it's not something I'd actually buy again on a regular basis. If you're absolutely craving ice cream then this is a must-must have, but it's just not my favorite.

But that firmness is what makes them so wonderful for vegetarian Greek gyros. I slice the steaks thin, marinate them overnight, briefly warm them in a frying pan, and serve them in a pita with hommus and tzatziki sauce. (I make everything vegan, including the tzatziki sauce.) The "steaks" hold up wonderfully, and come as close to Greek gyros as I have ever had. I also use them a lot in stews, where I find that slow cooking softens the "steaks" considerably. As are all the other Worthington and Loma Linda products, the steaks are versatile and can be used in many dishes. UPDATE: 11/08/10. I am wondering why the price on these and all Worthington/Loma Linda products has increased greatly. Anyone have a clue?

column9: I feel like I stole these!
column10: What could be better than someone dropping off your groceries? Dropping off months of them at a great price!I was able to order the case, delivered at my door in days, for a better price than if I had driven to my local store with a coupon. Of course, Worthington products are a staple in my home. I am a vegetarian so I am always looking for ways to add protien to my diet and these steaks are a quick, easy, and very tasty choice.The steaks are a gluten based protien that can be cooked or grilled whole or sliced and diced. They work well with gravies and will hold other flavors like soy sauce or spices. The best way to describe them is like a very firm dumpling that has been cooked in flavorful broth. They are very verstaile and my non-vegetarian family and friends like themI was able to purchase this case for less than half of what my local stores sell them for AND it was delivered! All I needed was someone to cook it up for us!Makes me hungry just thinking about it!
My meat eating friends love the Veg. Steaks.  I fry them; coat them with bbq sauce then broil them until they reach a crisp!  They are great hot out of the oven or cold the next day.
I started using this product as a minor and it will stay in my life as long as they continue to make it. Even my children like it.

I first tried these years ago as a meat-eater new to (and skeptical of) meat substitutes. I loved them!  Actually, my exact words were, "These are quite palatable."  My mother-in-law dredges them in torula and brewers yeast and fries them with diced red onion and they're just about my favorite food!

I had something like this many years ago and then couldn't find them.  They are fabulous if rolled in flour, fried in oil, and seasoned with a little steak seasoning.  They are also fabulous used as swiss steak (cook with onions, red and green bell peppers and canned tomatoes).

My husband is Vegetarian, he loves these Vegetable Steaks.  They cook up great whether we put them on the grill, in the microwave, oven or on the stove.  He loves them best in BBQ Sauce on the grill.Worth buying.. just wish they were more readily available in stores still.

THESE ARE PRETTY GOOD AS FAR AS GLUTEN BASED FAKE MEATS GO.  I PUT THEM IN STIR FRY AND EAT AS A QUICK SNACK.  MY DOGS LOVE THEM AS A TREAT.  I WISH THEY WOULD REMOVE THE SMALL AMOUNT OF MSG IN THEM HOWEVER.

Worthington Vegetable Steaks are  nutritious, versatile and very tasty.  I use them as "steaks", can be dipped in batter and pan fried.  Use in stir fry, strip into pieces, and add to stir fry recipe.  Yummy,as is, in a sandwich.Give them a try! : )
I do enjoy the Worthington Vegetable Steaks in place of real steaks.  As a vegetarian, this gives me one more thing to enjoy with my meals.
These are seitan-ish strips of un-Pollanesque wheat gluten.  I found them to be decent when chopped and stir fried into mixed vegetables, and you could reduce the broth to gravy.
Odd rubbery texture, smells a little like cheap dog food, but if you cook it with enough seasonings and aromatics it becomes much more palatable.  I porbably would not buy it again.

column9: Good Alternative to Honey Nut Flavor
column10: I used to love the now discontinued Honey Nut flavor, and this is a good substitution (I'm not a fan of other flavors). The flavor is mild and sweet. I am a big fan!

A very good variety for kids who like "plain" foods. It's not too sweet but there's also not much flavor either. Smells like a honey bun right out of the package. I will finish the box but it's just too boring for me. My personal favorite is Raisins 'N Spice and now I can see why. I prefer a contrasting taste and texture in my oatmeal. But it might be good for adults who like the hard-to-find Honey Nut. Same great quality as usual from Quaker.

column9: Chocolate was old, discolored and broken
column10: The package arrived on time and looked good from the outside. The chocolate squares were discolored and broken. I will not purchase this product from this vendor again.

column9: Great candies, picture does not depict chocolates that arrive
column10: I do really like these candies. They have something for everyone. I don't like dark chocolate but my fiance does so this suits us both since it offers two milk chocolate and two dark chocolate varieties. I also love that these chocolates come individually wrapped. I will admit the caramel are my favorite and I went through those really quickly. My only two critiques are the quality of the chocolate. Claiming this is "Premium" chocolate is a bit much. The chocolate quality is equal to Hershey's. The two milk chocolates offered are caramel filled and just milk chocolate, not filled with chocolate ganache or what the picture shows which is peanut butter filled. It literally is just a chunk of milk chocolate, which is mediocre.

These turned out to be very good for less expensive chocolate.  They are very creamy and thin with a nice filling in most of them.  I will not waste my tastebuds or the calories on inferior chocolate and these are OK by me.  Would order again...and probably will when these are gone.  Only complaint, I wish there was a little more variety in the pack.

Nice selection of flavors that were a big hit when these went into the office candy bowl. I only managed to grab one for myself, the raspberry-filled (which was delicious), but that's probably for the best since I'm working on losing weight.

We needed a bunch of these chocolate squares for a party, and ordering two big bags of these things via Amazon turned out to be the easiest way to go. It might seem weird ordering a bag of chocolates online, but it worked out well and I'd do it again.

I was very tempted to keep these for myself instead as the gift I was going to give them as. However, I know that my father would love these more than I. Arrived earlier than I thought, was very pleased.
these are super :) great value too! They were for my daughter who is away in college..she was surprised and impressed. I had them shipped right to her.
I ordered this for my sister for Christmas.  She loved it - hated me for sending it (ha ha) - but loved the chocolate.

The first bag was dated 2012 but the product inside was dated 2007 and was discolored and stale. The second bag was dated 2012 and the product inside was dated 2011 and was very good. I feel the first bag should be replaced. Thanks  We received a refund for the old product. Thanks
The individual chocholate squares are bigger than I thought, about an inch in length on each side. These chololates are good, I would purchase them again.

column9: Great price but a little disappointed..
column10: First off this product in itself is a great deal, the chocolate comes out to about $9.4 per pound at a price of around $15.50.  The chocolate in itself is absolutely fantastic but there is one flaw to this product.  I had to dock off one star because personally I like chocolate by itself and although this product does come with milk chocolate pieces I found that the majority of the pieces were the mint and caramel chocolate pieces.  I didn't get a chance to specifically count the number of milk chocolate pieces but based on an estimate I would rank as most chocolate types to least as mint > caramel > raspberry > milk chocolate.  I can't say for sure that if you order one that you will get the same ratio of chocolates but that is just how mine turned out to be.  Like I said earlier the chocolate is fantastic and I highly recommend this product if you're just craving some chocolate! Cheers!
It came to me in good shape and tasted even better! I love the brand and I am happy to find that all the four tastes are very good.

My mom likes these chocolates, so I thought I would buy for her for Christmas.  She was amazed at how big it was, and was able to share with the other families at the gathering.  I would recommend these.

column9: Nice assortment of high quality chocolate candies.
column10: This is a good value pack.  It includes our favorites-caramel, mint, raspberry, and peanut butter. 50 pieces of individually wrapped candy is a generous amount.I added these to my holiday gift treat bags-recipients were very pleased & delighted. Excellent, high quality chocolate. Although not Swiss chocolate- still excellent. (wink, wink).
My bag just came with the Milk Chocolate and Caramel, Dark Chocolate Raspberry, Dark Chocolate Mint, and Milk Chocolate (NOT milk chocolate and peanut butter).

Package arrived in a timely way and well preserved. Bought for a social gathering to be placed on a desert table. Unwrapped. Each candy is wrapped in foil type plastic. Four flavors. All of the raspberry center candies were broken. Not suitable for the table. Naturally, they will be for me only. Very curious. None of the other candies were broken. Almost as if by design.

Received this item and was looking forward to enjoying the candy.  But, to my disappointment, the bag did not contain the peanut butter squares that were advertised.  I only purchased this particular bag of candy because of the peanut butter square, but the manufacturer had replaced this item with another square with no indication of a replacement.  Soooooo disappointed.  Whatever happened to truth in advertising?  Overall, a good candy treat, just not what I had ordered.

column9: Doesn't contain Milk and Peanut Butter as described
column10: Well I ordered this because I could no longer find the Milk and Peanut Butter in the stores -- alas, I thought I had found it here.  Unfortunately not -- the package that arrived had just plain "Milk" instead of "Milk and Peanut Butter".
great taste the only complait is that they are a little big in size to put in everyone mouth , they should of made them a little smaller and thicker

column9: Healthy and Loved by my dog
column10: I have three levels of treats and a few beloved dog toys that I use to reward my dog during training.  It's important to keep aside special treats and toys that are only used for important training moments - when you MUST have your dog's attention.  Trader Joe's cheapo brand for getting him to sit, MilkBone for when he responds to a "Come" command and Paul Newman treats to distract him when he meets other dogs.  My dog hates boxers for some reason.  The first night after we adopted him, he attacked my neighbor's Boxer in the hallway as my neighbors returned from a vet hospital visit - it was awful.  About a week later we had the dogs meet again - this time outside on neutral territory.  We made sure they met at a perpendicular, rather than head on, to minimize the chance of conflict.  My dog loves these treats so much that he didn't pay any attention to my neighbor's dog as she sniffed him.  We gave both dogs treats and brought them closer, praising each of them for good behavior and correcting any aggressive behavior immediately.  The Boxer was given her favorite squeak toy in addition to some of these treats and all ended well.  I always carry these treats on walks just in case I see another dog.  These are high quality, healthy, and my dog loves them - he jumps up and down every time he sees me grab the bag.  I don't just hand these out - these treats command attention and are reserved for exceptional behavior and when I need laser focus from my dog!

and my dogs love em.  I break them into pieces so I can use them for training.  because they contain more protein than most, they break up nicely.  crunchy and satisfying for the pups....that about sums it up.

column9: cookies are old expiration date is in one month!
column10: My dog enjoys the cookies, they would be healthy, but not when they are old.  The expiration date is in November and I received the shipment in October.

Newman's Own dog biscuits are a healthy treat for my two dogs .. my 12 year old german shepard and my three year old american pit bull terrier. It is very important to me to keep my dogs healthy and happy, since they are the love of my life. I only feed them Newman's dog food and the biscuits along with occasional natural organic homemade biscuits. I love buying them from Amazon not only for the conveince .. I purchase many things from Amazon, being an older disabled woman, this helps me so much .. and the prices are great. I am so glad Amazon offers the food and the biscuits for my two precious girls.  Thank You.

column9: High Quality Dog Treats:  No Wheat, No Corn
column10: Newman's Own Organic Chicken Treats for Dogs are a big hit with my three dogs; a miniature poodle, a black lab and a standard doxie. Made in Canada these have the following analysis:Crude Protien: 11.5% minCrude Fat: 8.5% minCrude Fiber: 6.0% maxMoisture: 10.0% maxINGREDIENTS: Barley flour*, ground chicken*, carrots*, apples*, canola oil, rolled oats, natural flavor. Note: (*) indicates certified organic.SIZE: Medium sized in this case means 'heart-shaped', about 1.5" x 1.5". You could actually break them in half for small dogs.While this is not supposed to replace your dog's food, they'd like it if it did! The reason I give it 4 stars is because of the 'premium price'. I picked them up at a local grocery closeout store for $2 a bag with 18 months left until the the 'best before' date. My doggies haven't said anything about them being stale, so I guess Newman's Own has done it again.CONCLUSION: Organic, high quality dog treats. Nice product, but a bit pricey.

The good thing is that my dog likes these, and they're pretty healthy. (She would probably rank the chicken flavor above her kibble and above some crunchy treats but below chicken jerky and freeze-dried liver.) They also break apart easily to make them smaller for training. The bad thing is that they leave "sawdust" when they break apart. Regardless, they're pretty cheap, and as I said, pretty healthy. A solid 4 star treat.

All my 5 dogs love them (chicken treats). After searching many hours on the internet, I finally found a wholesome product that I can, with confidence, feed my pets. With the lastest pet food disaster, I never want to be in the position again of worrying about the safety of their food.  My dogs are small and the bite size hearts are perfect for them--they come in other sizes for the Medium & large dog.  The zip-lock packaging is great too in keeping them fresh.  Check out their dog food.  Again, I am so glad I found dog food that my dogs love that is prepared to a higher standard of organic, wholesome ingredients. What impressed me the most, the chicken are fed a veg. diet so no hormones, or antiobiotics--that means the chickens are not feed cancer ridden diseased meat.  Newman's Own Organics Adult Dog Chicken Formula (12.5-lb bag)
My dog loves these treats and they are grain free.  He has allergies and these treats are great for him.
I have two dogs with different dietary needs and I can use Newman's Own Dog Treats for both of my dogs!  I love the fact that they do not contain wheat or corn.  Great product at a great price!

My dogs love these treats. I like them because they are good for them and don't contain any strange ingredients. They are a bit hard, we have to break in thirds for our little guy but once we do that he can eat them just fine.  Overall a great purchase and will buy again.

column9: cookies a dog will love you for
column10: Newman's Own®Organics Dog Treats for Small Size Dogs, Chicken, 10-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)These are great!  My dog has multiple allergies - wheat, rice, beef, peanut butter, etc. - and this is an answer to his dreams - a dog treat that even he can munch on without any ramifications.  The product is all organic and the ingredients are what you'd feed your human family :>)Try these for your dog - I think you'll find that he'll love them as much as mine!
Been buying these organic treats for my labs for about 5 years now and they love them! I love the good nutrition and wholesomeness rolled into these treats.

I just bought this at the Godiva store and the cans were $12 each.Right now, Amazon is out of stock, but if they offer a better price - I will have to buy.  This is perfect with a little Amaretto added.

Tired of those insipid supermarket hot cocoa mixes? Waiting for the taste of real deep, dark, rich chocolate? Well, then you will not be disappointed with Godiva's Dark Chocolate Hot Cocoa. Definitely made for serious chocoholics. I am now totally addicted. Once you've tried it, you will never go back to Swiss Miss, Nestle's or any other whimpy imitations.

column9: The BEST hot cocoa mix out there!
column10: If you love rich, creamy hot cocoa, then this is the product for you!  I have been purchasing Godiva's hot cocoa mixes for several years - both the milk chocolate and the dark chocolate.  When they ran out of it at my local grocer, I was happy to discover that Amazon sells this product on-line.  I do not like sickenly sweet hot cocoa and find "just add water" mixes like Nestle too diluted for my taste.  I have even tried adding milk to thicken up other brands' mixes, but nothing so far beats Godiva.  The dark chocolate mix is AWESOME with a little Bailey's Irish Cream in it and topped off with whipped cream and chocolate shavings......  (NOTE:  Although Godiva's milk chocolate mix is good, it is still a little too sweet for me.)

It says "Pack of 2" in the text and photo. Yet they sent me one can. They added a comment in the receipt: "price is for ONE canister," as if they could change their minds after I placed my order.I've inquired and will report back what happens. If they send me another can, I'll change this to five stars. But it would be insane to pay for $20 for one can of cocoa, when it's $12 retail.

column9: Nice to be able to get a pack of 2...
column10: Godiva dark is my absolute favorite cocoa. It has a rich, complex flavor without the harsh overtones of Swiss Miss-style cocoas. It's also super-smooth and velvety, and dissolves perfectly in hot milk. It was very nice to be able to get a two-pack; the first time I bought this I bought a single, and since there are only ten servings per cannister, this is an expensive cocoa (although worth it now and then for real chocoholics!). Although prices change so make sure you check, when I bought the dual-pack it definitely saved some money.

column9: Excellent taste, but can says only to use milk.
column10: While the taste of this Cocoa is excellent, my only gripe is that it has no milk solids or anything included, therefore you must use milk as the base, and you shouldn't use water as some cocoas use.  This may be fine for some, but that adds extra calories.  As a rare indulgence or treat, that is fine, but if you drink hot cocoa very often, that is alot of calories.  Anyway, I only knock one star off for that, because in the end, it is a great tasting cocoa.
This is the only hot chocolate that I drink. It is rich, with a cup of milk (I use 0%). A nice kick of chocolate to get my day going.
What a delicious special treat! Probably the best hot cocoa mix available. Don't even think about comparing this to any grocery store variety. It's a bit pricey but enjoy it on special occasions.

column9: there is no hot cocoa before this one!
column10: That's it!  This is the best hot cocoa ever!  And you can use less (per cup) than the instructions indicate, so it lasts longer than you might think.

I purchased these as well as other shades of blue M&Ms for a babyshower I threw my friend.  The M&Ms shipped much later than I expected, then when they arrived, they were stale, mostly chipped and cracked like an elephant jumped up and down on ALL of the bags.  If maybe the M&Ms were mostly okay, that would be one thing but the majority of the M&Ms in all three bags I purchased (all different colors) were crap.  They tasted stale like they had gotten warm then frozen because someone caught the overheating error.  They were nasty.  I would have rather purchased normal M&Ms and picked out all of the blue ones than order these again.  What a waste of time and money.  It was embarassing.  I had no choice but to use the "best" looking ones in my favors as the candy arrived at the very last possible moment.  Never again.
they are treats for dogs, what more can you say. either the dog eats them or it don't. mine does. so there.

I just bought these a few days ago from a local vendor and paid more, glad to know I can save a few $ here.So, I have 2 boxers, one is 7 months, the other 5 years.  The 7 month old is all about chewing and nothing I have found keeps her occupied like this treat.  Both dogs are crazy for these.  What I like most is that they don't leave a stain on the carpet, other than normal dog slobber you get when they play with a chew toy.At one a day, it wont hit the pocket book so hard.
My dog loves these!  They keep him occupied for awhile and do not stain carpeting or clothing. I have been getting these for the last few years.  They are just hard to find.

I was feeding my Corgi Science Diet Nature's Best and Merrick puppy food, but as he got closer to turning one I needed to get him on adult food. It's very important to me to feed him healthy food that has low grain content and a higher protein content. The foods he was on were making him have slightly runny stools, and I did a lot of research before settling on Wellness Core. My second option is Canidae, which gets high reviews as well. He really likes this food, and the pieces are nice sized, not too big and not too small so he can choke them down.

My 5 yr old Keeshon mutt has chronic gastritis, which was causing her to throw up bile about once or twice a month, on a homemade diet with rice, veggies, meat, vitamins. I went to two animal communicators (psychics) and discovered she was allergic to carbohydrates. So, I switched to Core Wellness and noticed the improvement immediately. She also became less hyper. This stuff, to me, is worth every penny.

column9: Tastes like actual lemonade.But why so hard to get?
column10: I only found one  bag of this months ago, in Wal*Mart, and it was the only bag on the shelf. It was a  big bag and it didn't go for this high a price. I'm poor and I don't buy expensive candy or anything else. But  by the end of the bag I was completely addicted. Since then I have searched for it everywhere, to no avail.What is the deal with this? Was my bag part of an early test marketing, and they found out that it was SO delicious that they could launch it for a higher price? If so, they won't be getting my business again,-- regardless of delicious flavors and my "addiction". It looks like you can only get it online at this point.Too bad, because it is REALLY, REALLY good. Four flavors: Regular L., Pink l., Raspberry L., and Peach L.
I ordered this for my Boyfriend and he loved it. He asked where I got it and I told him Amazon, he was amazed.......He loved this candy and so do I. It taste just like the drink.

Excellent tasting hard fruit flavored assortment. Will definitely be ordering again.Everyone seems to love these and I can't find them locally. Arrived fresh and packed well.Good flavor assortment. Buy them.

column4: Antonia M, PhD "The Inner Power Doctor"
column10: Country Time hard candy is too delicious. Seriously.  They had these candies in the reception area of my office. My hand was always in the candy jar! Now there are no more candies. Have to buy my own because nothing else will satisfy my craving...which means I'll start snacking on all kinds of things, secretly wishing that I had a piece Country Time candy.
Wonderful Product!!! A Must For Anyone Who Appreciates Brown Rice. Great Flavor, Consistency and Price For The Amount One Would Receive In a 25 pound Bag!

These are hard to find in grocery stores where I live; so it's worth paying for shipping.  Although you can find hazelnut flavored creamers anywhere, even sweetened with Splenda now, this is for those of us who like our coffee black.  Yum for the Tum.

If you like filberts (AKA hazelnuts) this stuff is scrumptious. The only ingredient is ground roasted hazelnuts. They're not completely pulverized like creamy peanut butter; tiny pieces (fewer and smaller than crunchy peanut butter) liven up the texture. I imagine it would be great as a spread, but it's ambrosia right out of the container with a spoon. Plus, if you add a little liquid sucralose and a touch of cocoa powder, you've got low-carb Nutella. Mmmmm.

column9: Creamy, fresh and taste very good!
column10: Hazelnut Butter tastes amazing! This is my 2nd or 3rd time buying form this company, and while the butter is not cheap, it is worth the price becase it is so good and fresh. I can definitely tell the difference in taste. So far I tried hazelnut and pistachio butters, but hazelnut tastes better in my opinion. The butter is creamy but not as smooth as, lets say, store bought peanut butter (jeff), there are definitely crunchy pieces in there.This company also ships fast, packs well and stands behind their products!

Fasatchi makes some outstanding nut-butters! Bought 3 flavors (Hazelnut, Pistachio, and Pecan) and they all tasted true to flavor, surprisingly vibrant, and rich. If you like hazelnuts or want to adventure beyond Jiff and expect a terrific reward, then look no further! =)

column9: Excellent in chocolate chip cookie recipe
column10: I like this Fastachi product. I never used hazelnut butter before and needed it for a chocolate chip cookie recipe. They came out great. My son visited for the weekend and will take some back to his apartment. Amazon shipped the butter within three days. The only drawback for me was I would have appreciated storing tips. I want to know: should I  refrigerate it after opening? Again, the cookies are great! I will most likely order more of this hazelnut butter in the future.
Delicious alternative nut butter!!  Very fast service  and ease of ordering.  Am looking forward to trying the pistachio butter next.
This made very tasty cookies.  Started with basic PB cookie recipe-added powdered cocoa-dried cherries and chopped walnuts.  Fun to experiment with. Glad I found it on Amazon.
I ordered Hazlenut, Pistachio, and Walnut through Fastachi and this nut butter stays creamiest the longest.
THIS HAZELNUT BUTTER TASTES GOOD,  PARTICULARLY WITH JELLY AS IN NUT BUTTER SANDWICH,  BUT TO ME THE TEXTURE IS DISPLEASING AS IT IS RUNNY AND GRITTY.

column9: Was disappointed in the texture, but not the taste
column10: This hazelnut butter definitely tastes wonderful and rich. I was disappointed to find out how grainy it was, though. Honestly, I have made grainy hazelnut butter of equal quality using a coffee grinder. So if you have a grinder of some sort at home and want to save some money, try making your own before buying this.If you want smooth hazelnut butter of the same texture as creamy peanut butter and don't mind spending the extra money, try shopping with L'Epicerie.com and buy some of their hazelnut paste.

We use this to make nocciola (hazelnut) ice cream, which is generally not available in the US.  Just like a trip to Venice - ice cream-wise anyway.Drawback: to keep the butter moist and preserve it, there is a bit of excess oil that must be drained/squeezed.

column9: Hard to find if you're not near a Greek Grocery!
column10: I think I was lucky to be able to find these rusks on Amazon. Unless you live near a Greek grocery store, I doubt you would come across them. They are great for breakfast (I'd dunk them in coffee or eat them simply with butter) or snack. They are VERY filling. Quite yummy.

column9: I like the big jars of xyliol gum
column10: The order arrived quickly and in good order.  I love this gum.  It is good for all kinds of stuff besides tasting good.  It's good for your teath and your ears.  My wife gets ear aches and it helps with that too.
This is the only thing that I drink so buying it in bulk and cheaper than the grocery store is awesome.

This is a mix of lemon, rose and mint flavored turkish delight. It is a nearly no fat,  high carb treat with a mild flavor, a soft chewy texture and covered with powdered sugar. The sugar covering makes the colors hard to distinguish unless you look carefully or brush some of it off. I sometimes serve Turkish Delight with a sweet-tart dipping sauce made by mixing a TBS each of lemon juice and honey. Fans of the Chronicles of Narnia will remember that the Magic Turkish Delight was part of what induced Edmund to betray his siblings to the witch. Enjoy some in the safety of your home.Hazer Baba Turkish Delight, Mixed, Lemon Rose Menthe, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)

The Hazer Baba is good but not great. The texture is a little chewier than the better ones we've had. The taste is decent  though. We were spoiled while in Greece on the real deal. The Ginger People, albeit for twice the price have a five star ginger Turkish Delight that is par with what we remember from Greece. The ginger is there but it's flavor not overwhelmingly spicy and the texture is a little slice of heaven! Jody Koval

I love Turkish Delight and have been fortunate enough to have it freshly made while I was living overseas. I was a bit disappointed when I tried these. While the flavor is generally fine, they are exceedingly sweet and they weren't quite as soft as I had hoped, but that my be much to ask for in a packaged product. If you like Turkish Delight and aren't too picky about the texture, you'd probably like these fine.

I purchased this product as a gift, but since I received a four-box pack and I've never tried this brand, I decided to open a box and try it, to make sure it was ok before I gave the rest.  So glad I did. The sugar coating was stale and overpowering and literally dropped off the Turkish delight in literal waves.  Neither my wife nor I could finish a single piece of Turkish delight. The stale sugar taste made the product unpalatable and I threw all four boxes in the trash can.  I do not recommend purchasing this unless you like to eat spoonfuls of raw stale sugar.
A must taste for any sweet lover. The variety offered also gives you options and can also be useful in satisfying multiple persons.
Delicious - great price.  The candies are fresh and just as you remember delicious Turkish Delight.  I only wish they sold boxes of ALL LEMON!!!  I love the lemon!
This box was a hit, the one with nuts is not so great.  Very sweet though.
good flavors, but not fresh. powdered sugar gunked up on candy and edges are starting to turn hard.

Of the vatious brands of Turkish Delight we've tried, this one is, by far, the worst one.  Its texture is grainy, and the taste is medicinal, with the mint version being the most offensive.  We have nearly the 4-box order left, and will end up throwing it all away.  Buy another brand.

I buy this candy at least once a month in Boston. It's soft and gooey in mint, lemon, and rose flavors. The confectioner's sugar keeps the individual pieces from sticking together. I recommend that you eat this with tea or coffee because it is quite sweet.

column9: PET FOOD RECALL WORRIES?  NO PROBLEM WITH NEWMAN'S!
column10: Upon the initial pet food recall news, I immediately began my investigation into the healthiest food choices for my pets.  Although I am already diligent as a pet parent of eight, and none of the foods we use were recalled, I still felt I wanted to go even MORE natural.  In doing this research, I found out that not only does Newman's company make salad dressing, as we all know, but ALSO a VAST variety of human and pet treats as well! :)I got a great deal through Amazon on this pack of six bags, so I got two flavors and sizes for my dogs.  They are ALL natural, and when you touch them yourself and feel the texture, and see the actual oats and cheese or whatnot for yourself, you will be so happy you are feeding them to your pet instead of crap food.  People have no idea just how awful most name brand pet food is and that it is really like the equivalent of feeding junk food to their kids for every meal.  But it's not our faults when pet food companies are abusing our trust.Get these treats.  You and your pets will be healthier for it . . . physically, mentally, spiritually.

My husband and I like to buy Newman's products. We love their cookies so we thought our dogs might like them, too. So we got these dog treats and the LOVE them. They're even shaped like hearts! They come with 6 bags so they'll last a while but they're packaged so they won't go stale.

We purchased these for our poodle.  She is the smaller breed (appx. 10 pounds) so I was a little worried these might be too big.  As a whole piece, the treats might be a little large for her, but they can be broken in two very easily.  The bag actually shows you how to break them in two, of course it's pretty self-explanatory as each treat has a cut down the middle of them.  So, the actual size of the treat should not be an issue for those with large or small dogs!  As far as taste--of course I can only rely on how well our dog likes them-she loves them.  Of course she is a little piggy and likes everything, but she really seems to be more fond of these than cheaper treats we have given her.  Overall I am pleased with these treats and I would recommend them if asked!

My little cockapoo loves Newman's Own dog treats, especially the peanut butter flavor. She'll usually eat anything, but I feel better about giving her treats that are healthy, organic, and made with high-quality ingredients that I could eat. No by-products here! Great price & highly recommended.

My dog can be a picky eater when it comes to organic/healthy treats and he only eats these about 75% of the time i offer it to him.. i guess it depends on his mood? I actually tried them myself (i try all the treats i buy him before subjecting him to them because i will NOT feed him anything I find disgusting) and they're not too bad - tastes a bit like oatmeal. I do love how you can actually see the pieces of apples and carrots in the treats and I love how the ingredients are certified organic :)btw- the little story on the back of the bag "Newman Dog Tells All!!" is hilarious!!

In the interest of full disclosure, I didn't buy from Amazon - I bought these at PetSmart, but I wanted to do a product review because these treats are worth buying in bulk - they're amazing!These little treats are wonderful.  I am extremely picky about what my dog eats because he's had digestive problems in the past and also because I believe dogs shouldn't be fed the unwanted junk leftover from the corn/grain industry, food that has been irradiated, or food that is made in questionable countries (cough* China * cough cough).Not only are these Newman's Own treats a good price, they are a good size and are indeed made with quality ingredients.  As another reviewer said, you can literally see the oats and such in the baked treats (see the product picture I took).  Plus, they're shaped like little hearts - adorable!  The best things about these treats, however, are that (1) they're made in Canada from a company we all can trust, and (2) my dog absolutely loves them. These treats are made from certified organic ingredients with 7% fat (min).  With all the pet food recalls and my inherent distaste for low quality, Chinese, irradiated, or high fat treats these treats are a winner!Also, my dog is a terribly picky eater when it comes to treats (which is hilarious because he'd eat cat poop if I let him).  He has never eaten any biscuit that was not literally made in a bakery from a boutique.  This has cost me lots of money in the past (in finding treats he likes, and having to deal with the bags and bags of treats he didn't like such as Blue Buffalo, Mother Hubbard's, and Wellness bars).  I bought a 13oz bag of these at PetSmart today for 5.00 (far less than I spent on the other brands), and my dog will not leave me alone.  He literally dances to get my attention because he wants me to give him one of these treats.  It seems like neither of us could be happier with this product.  If I can remember, I will do an update once the bag is gone to see if this trend has continued.Is there anything Newman's Own cant do?

Three years ago we found out our dog Bella had severe food allergies.Fish,potatos,veggies,fruit and a few other selected foods are all she can eat. I look and could only find Newmans Own Salmon&Potato treats for her to eat.Since then they come evey 2mths ,by Sub&save. Today when I opened the first package I was shocked. The normally,heart shaped treats that are light, airy, thick, and easy to break,were nothing but,dark,flat,hard to break rocks. So my question is "What Happened?" Not only was it one package but all six. If this is their new product,they lost a customer.But if it was a bad batch, I say how dare they send this out to consumers,take their money,and think its right.Today there are many treats made that she can eat,but I stuck with Newmans out of loyalty,because they were first in making a great product Bella could eat.And Bella really loves this treats.I hope Newmans can fix this.

My little terrier is allergic to wheat and corn, and it's hard to find treats without those ingredients (which aren't good for ANY dog, regardless of allergies).  Both of my dogs LOVE these treats, and they are very reasonably priced, especially here on Amazon.  I also like Newman's business model, so I'm more than happy to support them and buy their products!!

This product is a win/win/win!  A healthy snack for my dog at an affordable price, and the proceeds go to charity.  Outside of the many moral reasons to buy these treats, my dog also loves them.  He rarely likes dry treats, but these are an exception.The treats are heart shaped and about the size of a quarter.  A couple of them are perfect for a small dog and one bag will last for several weeks.  It's really a great value.

column9: I liked it better than my picky dogs do
column10: I believe this to be a perfect dog treat and have great respect for everything that Newman's Own Organics does. Unfortunately, my two dogs (male 9 yrs & female 3 yrs) just are not impressed. I think perhaps if the 'cookies' were a little less dry and / or their excellent quality ingredients were just a little more aromatic that they would be more tempting and desired by my spoiled, but well loved dogs. If I break the cookie in half, it seems to release slightly more tasty aroma and I can almost talk the dogs into them.

my dog Loves the Loving Pets Gourmet duck and chicken sticks but I am concerned b/c they are made in China so I wanted to wean him off those and found the Newman's chicken sticks as a similar treat. My dog has met them w/ mixed reviews, he is not crazy about them but will ultimately eat it. I feel more comfortable that these are made with reasonable ingredients and made in the US
My love love chicken and also peanut butter Newman's snacks. Great ingredients and great taste (I've tried one:)

I love my dog and try to give her the best products that are out there. This product is organic and my dog loves them. They dont have a really nice smell to them, but my dog thinks otherwise... ;)I would recommend these to any doggie out there.

Harvey's the World's most picky eater, and turns his nose to foods most other dogs would woof down (pun intended).  He loves Newman's Own Organics Dog Treats, which is great.I love them more because of what they don't contain.  No wheat, corn or artificial anything.  Because the ingredients are certified organic I don't have to worry about pesticides and herbicides getting into his system.My husband likes them because they taste good.  Suffice it to say I live in an interesting household.
Both of my dogs love these treats.  I am so glad I can give them something good for them that they beg to have!  And no worries about what might have been put in them from another country.
I need some soft treats for reinforcement... this is definitely NOT it...it is hard like rock candy, and my dogs turn their nose up at this product... will not eat it...

column9: No matter how healthy it is... is nothing if your dog doesn't like it
column10: I supposed as a treat, this would do better than its dog food. But I was wrong when I received and tried it today. My dog does not like it at all. This treat feels like cookies and very dry. I got a small dog (Yorkshire). I don't know if big dog will find it delicious or not. Just my own experience.

We use these treat sticks to train our Labrador Retriever puppy. They break cleanly into small bits, are easy to dispense, and don't leave a meaty smell or greasy residue on one's hand. The only downside is that over time, the sticks tend to get rather hard.

I purchased these treats because they were on sale, but also because they're made in the US with safe ingredients.  My Yorkie loves duck breast jerky, but those treats are made in China, and I'm not sure I trust products from there 100% after the poisonous ingredients that were found in China-made dog food in the recent past.  Of course, I didn't expect my dog to enjoy these treats as much as the meaty duck, but he reacts the same way to these cheesey treats as the duck breast!  When I have one of these treats ready for him, his responses to commands (sit, lie down, etc.) are instantaneous - he really wants the treat!  I was concered buying 6 packs at once without first testing them, but now I'm glad I have 6 for him.  GREAT PURCHASE, and I'll be buying other Newman dog products in the future

column9: perfect food for my old dog :)
column10: Our cocker spaniel is now nearly 10 years old, and the solid gold food I'd been feeding him suddenly changed its formulation over a year ago(with no notice on the packaging), and he became subject to unexplained stomach upsets. After the contaminated food scare even tho Solid Gold was not recalled, I decided to switch, and this formulation is perfect for him to not gain too much weight. Newman's own is a brand I totally trust and have bought snacks for my human baby as well for years. After a year on this food, my dog is doing fine, but I do notice a need to supplement with fish oil for a healthier coat. That may be age related as well. But the stomach upsets have stopped. And I feel better knowing I am not exposing him to additional pesticides and hormones by going mostly organic with this formula.

i'm kinda new to amazon (only ordered books in the past)...and just set up the automatic service on this item for the best value!  SO worth it!!  you can't beat the price (seriously folks, the name brand pet stores sell this at more than double the price)!!  i love newman's own organics, and more importantly...so does my little, four-legged girl.

Newman's Own Organics Premium Dog Treats were thought to be something that my two dogs (minature daschunds) would enjoy, however Heidi, the older of the two dogs will not eat these treats. She is usually eager to get treats but she turns up her nose to these.  Max, the other dog will eat almost anything so he's getting to partake of the entire purchase.  I will not be reordering any more of this treat because I need something that both dogs enjoy.

column9: Natural Treats; a product I trust
column10: It isn't easy to find packaged food for pets that I can trust.  I have been doing a lot of reading lately about what actually goes into most commercial brand pet foods, and I am appalled.  I decided to start cooking for my brood, but the puppy was going bonkers for bicuits, which was kind of freaking me out.  I never thought I'd find something on the store shelves that satisfied us both...and then, in a WalMart in Honesdale PA (where my family owns a vacation home) I saw these.  I trust Newman's Own, so I read the ingredients.  I was happy, and my dog loves them, but I couldn't seem to find them back home in NJ, so I searched Amazon, and here they were.  I am slated to get a case every other month, but I might need to up that to once a month!
I have 3 beagles, and they love these treats.  I have found them to be quite reasonably priced, especially considering the quality ingredients they contain.

We were given a partial bag of these treats by a friend who no longer needed them. Our Boston Terrier loved them! Upon researching the product, and finding them to be a good product as well as a good bargain, we purchased 2 cases of them... not for our dog specifically, but to give them to our local Bank so they could give treats to the dogs in cars that came through the drive up window. (Our dog loves to get treats at the bank)... We have gotten great responses from our friends at the bank.We appreciate giving treats that can be dependable and healthy for our pet family. Thank you!

column9: Your small dog will love these and you will too!
column10: Our pups just love these snacks, and we feel good about giving them to themtoo!  The perfect size and not too hard like some dog treats for small dogs!I love how you can see the oats in them -- not junky, fatty fillers!
High quality with no bad ingredients.  Our 3 dogs love them, and we use them for training as well as treats.  Highly recommend.

Our dog loves these treats and we love how good they are for him. Amazon has also been the best deal we've gotten for them. Petsmart & Petco are a lot more expensive and don't have all the flavor choices.

column9: Too Dry - Causes my dog to cough
column10: This is very dry and brittle.  My dog started coughing as soon as he ate it the first time so I am not giving him any more.  Very disappointed since I like the Newman's Own Organic dog food a lot.

My dog loves these.  As far as dog treats go, these are pretty healthy.  I like that the sticks can be torn into small pieces for training/treats.  They used to be more widely available.  Now I can only find them on Amazon or Whole Foods.  Please keep them in stock!

My dog likes these very much,and I am glad I purchased them.  I shared them with a friend who has a puppy, and her puppy likes them, too.  I think they are healthy for my dog.  I do recommend them for a treat for anyone's dog.

column9: Newman's Own Organics Premium dog treats salmon  & sweet potato
column10: Great treats for allergic and sensitive dogs. They are scored for easy dividing. Our Labs love them!Pair them with salmon and sweet potato dog food.

column9: I should have read more carefully
column10: I have put 3 stars because my dogs are old and don't like cookies.  I'm sure other people have had a better response from their pets.  I didn't check the product description well enough to notice it.  Even broken up into bits, my boys leave them sit.  I guess it's back to jerky made for humans, so that I have a little USDA inspecting to make sure it's not Chinese poison.

column9: Disappointed, Brownie does not like it at all
column10: I figured this would be great since Brownie loves Salmon, but he doesn't even want to touch it.  I got him the Salmon and sweet potato one. He'd rather eat regular dog food than this which is quite weird for him.  He eats everything he can get his paws on, including non edible stuff. It might be because the smell is not very strong.  When I put it up close to my nose to smell it, I barely got a light whiff of salmon. Dog treats usually have a stronger smell which makes it more tempting for dogs.

These are hard treats shaped like hearts that you can break in half if necessary. They have decent ingredients though I try not to give my dogs anything with grain, the oatmeal and barley flour is not too bad. I only give one a day as a late night snack. My Doberman likes them but she is not too picky. My picky Shar-pei will eat them but is not enthusiastic about them (he prefers Merrick sausages). Overall, these are a decent snack for dogs as long as your pet does not have dental issues, these should be okay for them.  I want to make a comment about the packaging. This is one of the few "zip-loc" type resealable bags that actually reseals without having to mess with it a bunch of times. It stays nice and tight and keeps the treats fresh.

I'd purchased these dog treats in a local store (Medium sized) and it was a great size for my dog, my dog loved the treats and I thought that the ingredients were okay for my dog.  When I saw these on Amazon for about half of what I was paying retail, I thought it was a great deal and ordered the pack of 6.  Problem - even though the close-up of the bag image shows/lists the treat size as Medium, and I thought that I was ordering Medium, what I actually received was 6 bags of Small treats.  Of course I didn't catch that until after I opened the first bag - so no returning this item.  I'll use them but I really would have preferred to have received 6 bags of the Medium treats.  I alerted Amazon to this image problem, but more than a week later the bag image still lists/shows the treat size as Medium.

My dog loves these, and I believe (and hope not to be disappointed) that the Newman's Own Organics brand is to be trusted.The treats are small, and no doubt healthy, but I wish they listed the calories on their package. The ingredients are all good, but I'm trying to control my older dog's weight, and if these were very high-calorie, I wouldn't feed them to her. I'd look for something else. (I know, carrots and other veggies, but she won't eat them. She's a 9 year old rescue with terrible teeth, and set in her ways. My past puppies found baby carrots a great treat, but not this girl.)Maybe I'll contact the manufacturer and ask for the calorie count. But I do think it should be on the package.
Our dogs adore getting treated but one has reactions to some dog treats.  I am satisfied that these treats are healthy and they definately are enjoyed.
Finally a product I trust, that will give my Westies the nutrition they need without the added junk!  My boys have already showed signs of more energy.

Bought our first bag at Whole Foods for our new puppy! These are a great treat and good for him! Getting them mailed to us monthly by Amamzon is a plus as well as the savings of buying them by the box!

My three dogs really love these treats.  They are made in the USA and reasonably priced.  One word of caution - I use these to stuff a "Waggle" bone and let my Dal go at it.  He loves it, but if he lays down with the Waggle on a light colored rug, the crumbs that fall out will discolor the rug if they get wet.  No big deal as the discoloration seems to wash out just fine.

Simple.... Haven't found a dog that didn't LOVE these.  The quality was the first reason for using these.  Their acceptance sealed the deal.  I regularly buy a half dozen bags to cut down on shipping.  All I can say is my favorite poodle Mimi loves them...SPIKE
My little Shih Tzu loves her treats...one in the morning and 1 at night.  These are very healthy organic treats..Only the best for my Dog.
Trevor (Our beagle) thinks it's the best treat ever!!!!!!!!!!!! WE will certainly buy this snack again. It is priced right, as well.

The Newman brand of dog snacks shows up with good professional ratings for nutrition in  many places.  The fact that my dogs love these snacks is the icing on the cake.  Buying them  as a pack of 6  at Amazon completes the picture by the benefit of a bargain price.

Our dog loves all of the Newman's Own treats, but I think Peanut Butter is her favorite. The small size is perfect for our large dog and works well as a training treat, or bribe to get her to come inside.

A friend gave me some of these dog treats for a gift for my dog and they are the best.  My dog loves them and I can easily break off a small piece for training purposes.  My only problem is that I have a hard time finding them in stores so was glad to beable to purchase them on amazon.
My dogs really enjoy this treat..  The ingredients are excellent and the profits go to animal charities.  Nice all the way around.
My dog loves these because they are edible. I love them because they are organic, have no beef by-products (which dog is allergic to), and Newman's Own gives generously to charities.

We've tried chicken, cheese, and peanut butter. Sometimes the cookies are very small hearts and other times they are large hearts with chunks of oatmeal stuck in them. The smaller cookies are more tender and the large ones are a little harder to break apart. My dog isn't picky, so he's never had problems eating these.

Newman's treats make my dog smile. She loves them so much that she'll do several tricks for one treat: snuggle, paw-paw, and kiss-kiss. The 6-pack is a good value, too. You save money over buying them individually. Newman's is a top quality brand and a top seller. So, it's a done deal.

We're going through training school with our puppy and we need lots of healthy treats and snacks that aren't going to hurt her digestive system, since she seems to have a sensitive stomach. These are great- my dog loves them and I LOVE that Amazon has bulk ordering deals. It saves me time, bus fare, and is about half the price of the treats in the stores where I live. I hope these deals stay around for awhile!

column9: Newman's Own Organics Dog Treats, Medium Sized,
column10: Speaking for my furbabies, these treats are great!  I get the Cheese flavor, the dogs love them.  Terrific treats.

I love the fact that these are organic and with subscribe and save they are a steal! My puppy loves them, although they were too large for her until she was a little older (3-4 months old) she loves them now! Highly recommended! They are proof that organic treats do not have to be ridiculously expensive.

column9: bella has at least one broken heart every day
column10: Bella says these hearts are delectable, even though the bakers have included an "arrow" through the center of this heart treat for easily breaking in half.
My dog loves em, i trust the "Newman" brand after all he was a great man, and his family is committed to doing better in the world. and they love there dogs!

I compared Natural Balance, Wellness, and Newman's to make my final decision. Salmon is the 2nd ingredient listed and that was the deciding factor for me. These treats are medium size, so not the small training size that sometimes are convenient when walking the dog. I also like supporting the company cause of profits towards charities.

My Yorkie and Maltese just love Paul Newman's Organic Chicken and Vegetable treat. I sometimes mix it with their dog food when they get fussy about eating.I know it is a healthy treat so I do not worry about giving it to them or mixing it with their food. It makes it easy for me to order it through Amazon.

column4: Sandy M. Moschetti "Sandy in Benton City, WA"
column10: When I ordered this product I received free shipping. Since then they have added shipping and it is high. I won't be ordering this again. I have to say my dogs really loved these cookies. I have since bought them in town. Paul Newman makes great products..

I order these treats because I have a picky Chihuahua and they are the only treat that she will eat and can eat.She will eat 10 or 12 at a time running from her bowl to the carpet especially when I come home from work.Keep these treats coming
I have three dogs and they all love these treats.  Leave it to Paul Newman!  :-)

column9: Newman's own that you can trust
column10: Regardless if your dogs likes tractor oil better or not, Newman's Own is a label you can trust. Fortunately, my dogs do love it. All except for a couple (Salmon and oats) ingredients are certified organic, I'd say that this is a higher standard than most of the stuff I eat.

We bought our dog both the turkey flavor and the salmon flavor.  She seems to enjoy the salmon flavor much more but does like the turkey as well.  However (based only on my dog mind you) if you are trying to choose between the two flavors I would recommend the salmon flavor.
Fast service the items arrived the next day - Our dog loves them and they make great stocking stuffers for the holidays for our dog and the neighbors.
Great, natural product for the dogs.  They think they are eating candy, but really are eating a wholesome snack food.
I have 3 dogs( 28 - 45 pounds) who love the treats.  Nice size  to reward them.  I take them with me when I travel to the beach or dog park.
I use these for house breaking.  Works great.  Even now that the girls are a few years old the go out first thing in the morning and then go to where the treats are and wait for their reward.

When you have that "dog of a lifetime," it's even more important that your special dog get the best of everything. This product ensures that. No ingredients but the best, most healthful. What's not to love?
Our dog Maggie loves these organic treats. We give her only the very best and the healthiest of treats. Thanks Paul Newman.

My dog loves Newman's Chicken and rice organic dog food, which I have Amazon ship every 2 months. She also loves the Happy Hips brand of treats. I was excited to see Newman also offered treats, so I tried the Salmon and sweet potato. Unfortunately, she does not like this product, probably because it is in biscuit form.Now I somehow have to make her eat these over the next several months, even if I have to grind them up and put in her regular food.
These treats are so good I forgot they were for my dog!!! Really good with a nice tall glass of cold milk!!

column9: eats a few buries a lot
column10: My dachshund is very picky and spoiled.  She will eat these from time to time but usually buries them outside.

I have two dogs. One of them is a picky eater and totally unmotivated by food (much to the annoyance of dog trainers who have tried to use treats as a training tool with her). I have purchased other treats and found that I had to give them all to my second dog (who is in danger of getting fat!).  Not Newman's Own Cheese Treats! My picky eater loves them and eagerly competes with my other dog for her share. Excellent product.
So thought that I read the reviews, and bought a box (small size) and chicken treats.Small size dogs cannot eat... they're hard.  No smell without a taste.Have two small dogs cannot left the floor.

We call this kitty crack because we can literally get our cats to do anything for it. If they won't come in at night, we shake the bottle and they come running. They jump up on the chair and sit up for a small piece. It is nice to have some kind of control over this uncontrollable species!

These treats, which are pieces of pure freeze dried-chicken, are pure chicken and as suchare absolutely captivating to both my dog and cat, who will sit politely drooling, side by side, waiting for their treats, much to the amusement of friends and family.They are, however, fairly expensive.  The fact that I can buy them for a much more reasonable price through Amazon.com makes my faithful animal companions very happy, makes me look like a sport and keeps me out of the poorhouse.

I have ordered these chicken treats for my 4 kitties for over a year. They look forward to getting them and devour them with smiles on their faces.They are wholesome and not filled with fillers and by-products- just freeze dried chicken.The prices here are the best on the net and can't be beat. Trust me - I have looked :)Try them - My kitties personally guarantee you won't be disappointed !

We always take our family cat for at least one or two 30 minute breaks outside each day. It gives her something exciting to do after being cooped up inside the house. When our cat gets in a naughty, bad, or rebellious mood and won't come in the house, guess what brings her in? Yep, Halo Liv-a-Littles Natural Treats for Cats Chicken Breast Protein treats. She immediately runs to me when she sees the bag and jumps on the table and gobbles up each piece like a vacuum cleaner. And that's saying a lot, because our cat's very picky when it comes to food. If you have a picky cat, I highly recommend these treats for your cat. These treats will make your cat happy.

our cat has been getting chemo for the last year and our vet was very concerned about her losing weight.  These treats made a big difference - she has gone bonkers over the Halo chicken treats and she has gained almost 2 lbs. since we began giving them to her.
My Bengal cat LOVES these treats.  I used them during her show career as a reward and it really helped.  We continue to use them to this day.

One of my cats is going through chemotherapy and sometimes wants nothing to do with her normal food.  But she has NEVER turned down these treats!
