column10: Absolutely delicious on a simple grilled sausage; critical in certain recipes.  This product bears no resemblance to the overprocessed, over-colored, over-sugared GLOP that passes for mustard in this country; the mustard seeds are whole and fill your mouth with flavor. Subtly different from Dijon mustard, which is made with white wine, Moutarde Meaux is made with vinegar and the added tang is just sublime...  No pantry should be without it, and you will never, ever go back to the yellow stuff.

I love this mustard! It has a tangy flavor that enhances every food it is paired with. The appearance is unlike traditional yellow mustard, this mustard looks like tiny seeds with a small amount of clear liquid. The result is perfection - smooth with a bold flavor that is something like a "wasabi mustard." The thing is, it is REAL mustard, not a modern interpretation. I learned about this product at Costco one day on a sample table, and with Amazon's help I hope to always have this in my kitchen!

column9: Great in chicken piccata and other recipes
column10: I don't use capers a lot, but when I do, this is the product that I normally use. One of my favorite chicken dishes is chicken piccata. I make it every month or two.With chicken piccata, you have basic ingredients to coat (flour, salt, and pepper) chicken breasts. You fry the breasts in olive oil. Then, remove chicken, add some lemon juice, chicken stock, and capers to the pan drippings, bringing to a boil. Return chicken to the pan and simmer. Remove chicken to the serving plate and pour the sauce over the top. Yummy. And the capers add a really nice touch (by the way, sometimes I add a bit of white wine to the lemon juice, capers, and stock).Anyhow, awfully tasty. The capers add a necessary touch to the entire process. I'm sure that one can easily replace this brand with another and have an equally successful dish. But this is what I use and I'm satisfied.
I used these capers in my Paella and added extra flavour to my favorite dish.  Also, I use the non pareil capers on my mexclum salad with EVOO. Less fattening and delicious!

column9: Ham Sandwiches and Meatloaf  Will Never be Boring Again!
column10: Our left over Christmas ham sandwiches were certainly perked up with this mustard, and my meatloaf with catsup, brown sugar and mustard glaze became gourmet!I don't think I'll ever use another mustard again.This stuff is awesome!The jar was filled to the brim, unlike most big name brands.Price was good and shipment was fast.Highly recommend.

This is nice and mellow on it's own as hot tea.  For suntea I use 6 bags plus 2 bags FooJoy or Fujian jasmin and fresh picked young spearment leaves - brused. Great thurst quencher and dust remover.  This price with free shipping (buy two) is lower than I pay at my oriental supermarket.

column9: Awesome Organic Sweetened Condensed milk. WE us it in everything.
column10: I live it over a slice of hot fresh homemade bread.  Also great in coffee, tea, smoothies, makes great homemade icecream , the possibilities are endless for this great product.  Makes great organic key lime pies (our favorite). We use with Arrowhead Mills Graham Pie Crust,  6-Ounce Unit (Pack of 6) organic pie crust and Dream Foods International Volcano Lime Burst, 3.38-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 24) organic lime juice with our organic eggs for the most awesome pie. Also great in coffee, tea, smoothies, makes great homemade icecream , the possibilities are endless for this great product.

Have been using this in my morning chai for several months now and it is absolutely incredible.  The only "bad" thing I can say about it is that it can be a little addictive :)Follow up: We usually like to use cream in our coffee as a treat on the weekends (half-nhalf - what's that??).  The other day we were out so I used the Santini condensed milk instead.  All I can say is, wow!  Actually enjoyed it more than cream - and then I compared the labels.  The condensed milk has considerably less saturated fat and cholesterol than cream.  We're never going back!

column9: okay product, not good packaging all dented
column10: I bought this to make vietnamese coffee. It taste okay, I love that it's organic, but thats as far as it goes. Frankly, the only reason this item deserves 3 stars is because it's certified organic and taste like it should. The packaging is plain horrible.I bought a $10 can opener JUST for this item. The can opener is great, one of those swing-away or something openers that old-school people from the war eras swear by. My mom had a can opener 15 years ago and I vaguely recall using it in highschool when I still lived at home. I've managed to live for the past 10 years without one and I eat my fair share of canned goods. Even my cat's food doesn't need an opener and he gets 2 cans a day.Anyhow, 5 of these 6 cans were dented, but I checked and it seems edible/safe from botulism. None of the dents look like it was actually punctured. Still, the dents near the top made it impossible to open the can. So messy and sticky. Storing this thing is also a pain in the arse. Unless you plan to bake 5 pies and use the whole thing, the packaging is just plain horrible. It looks like it belongs in the 50s and is so outdated. It's not like it's a quarter or something extremely cheap, I don't understand why they can't update the packaging to make it more user friendly. Will buy a squeeze bottle next time. Actually I wanted to buy the squeeze bottle in the first place but the organicness made me think it was worth an entire extra $10 can opener purchase.If you want to use this for just coffee like me, stay away and get the squeeze bottle. If you are planning to bake 5 pies in one day, then awesome product for you (but they should then advertise it for only that use and I would have never made this purchase).

column9: Oh By Far The Best - Really Astonishing Difference
column10: I've had a lot of sweetened condensed milk over the years, predominantly in Vietnamese style iced coffees.  It's the kind of product that I never gave any thought to - I figured they all tasted about the same, blaa blaa blaa.I ordered this particular one because I'd never seen sweetened condensed milk offered in the organic format, because organic milk tends to taste better.I couldn't believe it when I first used this.  It is way, WAY better than any other sweetened condensed milk I've ever tried.  It is thick and rich, but not gloopy or glue-like.  It has more of a syrupy or honey-like flow, and even the color is more appealing - sort of a golden cream tone.  There is no hint of can/tinny flavor, and the milk tastes very fresh and natural, even with the sweetness.  To me, it seems that this is a little less sweet than some others I've tried; but I'm sure it's still certainly sweet enough for whatever baking etc. you'd want to do with it.  It makes awesome iced coffees, I would never use anything else now.

column9: MADE with ORGANIC MILK and SUGAR!
column10: Santini Organic Sweetened Condensed Milk. I like Santini condensed Milk, when I see it at my Local Grocer I buy it just like that, because it has the same ingredients and taste pretty much the same  as the top brand and for a lot less money, although Santini uses Organic Milk and Organic Sugar. I make Pies, Flan and a variety of Items, I love it in Coffee. The Price is not that bad here considering you getting 6, 14-Ounce Cans, and they are Delivered right to your front door so you don't have to drive around Town wasting Gas. I love the convenience and Santini Sweetened Condensed Milk! Thank You!

column9: Only way to make Pumpkin pie!
column10: I've used other sweetened condensed milk in the past, this is by far the best.  If I am using organic pumpkin for my pies then I don't want to add any ingredients that aren't.  This makes for a perfect pie - spices, eggs, pumpkin and this can is the easiest, best tasting pie! I know there are many other uses, but pie is what I use this for.

Amazon is selling this product for 20 cents more than my local Whole Foods Market, which is a super-premium-priced health food store. And you have to buy six at a time to get Amazon's inflated price. Such a deal!!!
Have not tried the product yet, but 4/6 cans are dented. Box was not dented, everything was secured in packing material, must have been dented at the wherehouse.

column9: Good product, but wish the cans were not so badly dented
column10: The quality of this organic product in good.  Unfortunately, I couldn't open all the cans because some were so dented I couldn't open the can.

I drink only flavored coffee.  Thus far, my favorites are Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee; Timothy's German Chocolate Cake; Van Houtte's Chocolate Raspberry Truffle and Spicy Mayan Chocolate.  The last one was my No. 1 favorite, so I was heartbroken to learn that it has been discontinued. I am currently rationing each precious K-Cup from my very last box of 24.Two days ago, I saw and purchased my first box of Folger's Vanilla Biscotti,  (Who knew that Folger's made K-cups?)  It's too soon to know for certain, but there is a good chance this flavor will make my list of favorites.  The good news is that Target sells it and other 18 count boxes of Folger K-Cups for $10.85.  That means you can buy 36 for $21.70.  Compare that to the greedy sellers on this page who get $48.46 and $43.04 (with shipping) respectively.

column9: Average columbian coffee, good but not great
column10: Had hoped for a really good cup of columbian coffee, and columbian (preferably supremo) is among my very favorites. As I drink 8 cups a day, I've tasted lots of coffees and lots of beans from around the world.  While this is a decent coffee, probably 4 stars when compared to other non columbian coffees, it is not among the better columbian coffees. My guess is that they use a higer percentage of just average columbian beans, and not many supremo beans. The roast is medium, but it is a little more bitter than you might expect for columbian.  I would recommend millstone columbian supremo if you want a good cup of columbian coffee. Supremo is the grade of bean, so if you don't see that you know you are getting a cheaper bean.

I drink Folgers coffee all the time. The black silk is my favorite.It taste the same as when I buy it at the store in a can but I like the K cups because it is easier. I just wish it did not cost so much. The Folgers is almost twice as much as other K-cups. Folgers needs to bring the price down.

column9: Great coffee but a lot cheaper at Wal-Mart
column10: I ordered this near the end of January when advertised for $19.80 for the same 3-pack along with Prime two-day free shipping. Never received the order. Amazon has sent several emails that the order will ship when product is available and I even extended the open order when requested. I doubt Amazon will fulfill this order now that the price has almost doubled and is over $45 with shipping.  Wal-mart is selling an 18-count pack for about $11.

Coffee is very much a personal taste choice. My favorite is Folgers Medium Roast Colombian in K-cups. It has a bolder taste than the Green Mountain breakfast blend, but is not overpowering. It is smooth tasting. Everyone has their favorites and this is mine. I was drinking Folgers coffee long before getting a Keurig brewer.
So far, the best decaf in a Keurig cup I have tried. Full-bodied and smooth and just what I need for my second cup of the day.

column9: I have 6 favorites, this is one of them
column10: This review is going to get posted in 6 places, as I'm indicating my preferences for 6 different coffees. If you like one, maybe you will like the other.Regarding coffee, I like strong and smooth.  I don't like French roast as I find it too harsh, but I do like Italian roast.  Kona is great and I like Hazelnut, Vanilla and Chocolate flavors.I drink my coffee with probably too much (at least 2-3 creamer containers worth to a 12 oz cup coffee) of evaporated milk in it or plain non-dairy creamer. No sugar.That being said...my favorite coffees are:Green Mountain Hazelnut Dark Roast Extra BoldEmeril's Big Easy Bold CoffeeNewman's Own Extra BoldTully's Coffee Kona Blend Extra BoldFolger's Gourmet Vanilla Biscottiand a special mention forTimothy's World Coffee German Chocolate Cake - It has an almost coco-nutty taste to it. Not the deep chocolate taste I was looking for, but the best I have found so far. Please if you can suggest a Dark Chocolate Flavor coffee to me; do so.Also since I have posted a review about a Senseo coffee and now clearly have switched to Keurig a bit about why... if you're interested..which why I put it last.  Feel free to ignore it.We decided to get a Keurig coffee maker after enjoying the Senseo system for over 3 years.Please note, since we got the Senseo system essentially free, not much thought was put into it's purchase. However it did introduce us to single serving coffee systems.We switched to the Keurig system from the Senseo for several reasons.1. Local availability of coffee. For some reason the Senseo system was waning here at the Rochester NY grocery stores and what good is a coffee maker without coffee?  Yes, you can buy online, but sometimes when your planning isn't the best, you might run out. What coffee they did carry was limited and not our preferences.2. Online purchases of Senseo coffees  were either for 4 bags of 16-18 of one variety or 4 bags of a mix of coffees. Invariably there was a few you didn't like.  I never saw small quantities of 5 or so.3. The Senseo "duck" for filling  with your own coffee never worked for us.  I'm an engineer and my boyfriend is an inspector. We literally did controlled experiments to get this to work and never could. Maybe we had a faulty unit, but based on reviews here, we were in good company. I knew many that had luck with the Keurig system however and we did as well.4. Once you open a bag of Senseo pods, they are starting to go stale, by virtue of being open to air. The Keurig system's coffees remain sealed and you can have many flavors "open" at once. Yes for those of you that are "green" there is more plastic waste. However I'm being selfish here and am being more concerned with the green in my pocket and fresh coffee.

column9: Really good coffee, good to the last drop
column10: With all the fancy coffee names out there, leave it to one of the old originals to come up with a great k-cup coffee.  I remember when I was a kid at my grand parents watching them drink Folgers coffee.  It was the only kind they would drink.  The old red can.  When I saw this k-cup with the Folgers name on it, I bought it out of nostalgia, as much as anything.  After receiveing it, we loved it, too.  It has a very mild taste and flavor.  Not quite as much "vanilla" as some of the other vanilla flavored coffees out there, but just the right amount.  To re-use an old phrase, it is "good, to the last drop"!
Very hard to find this in any of my local stores.  So ordering on amazon has been the easiest with the most reasonable prices.  Item shipped quickly will order again.

column9: Good coffee - Could have been fresher.
column10: Folgers Gourmet Selections, Lively Colombian Decaf, is good-tasting coffee, as far as decaffeinated coffee is concerned.  I find it is the perfect strength for me. It is between mild and strong. However, the boxes I received from Amazon expired in about a month.  Those I received from Keurig had 6 months expiration, so were a lot fresher.  For the price paid on Amazon, I feel the product should have had a later expiration date.

I love my Keurig machine and find the different flavored coffees to be such a nice indulgence.  I really enjoy this vanilla biscotti from Folgers.  Just has such a nice flavor and is a great afternoon treat.
Have tried many many brands and flavors. This is the best regular cup of coffee around.You will not be disappointed when you try this brand.

column9: Tastes exactly like my drip Folgers.
column10: I grew up on Folgers coffee. It was simply the best affordable coffee that could be drank on a daily basis. I was glad that Folgers has formulated there distinct coffee for the K-Cup. A few years ago I did try using folgers ground coffee in one of those Keurig My K-Cup Reusable Coffee Filter and it just did not come out right. I have had no luck with the refillable K-Cup with any brand of coffee. I honestly believe that a lot of product testing goes into these K-cups. It's not as simple as fill it up and run water through it.Folgers Columbian  K-cups taste exactly like I made it way back when with my Mr. Coffee. Becuse you are able to adjust the amount of coffee used in the Drip brewers this may or may not be as perfect of a match for your tastes. The one constant is the all important aftertaste. The Extra-Bold Newman's own and Doughnut Shop K-cups have a long, strong aftertaste that I really enjoy but they give you strong coffee breath. By comparison This Folgers has less of a aftertaste which Is nice when you know you will be in conversation with someone.There are many Columbian coffee K-cup choices and in reality they are all good. If you loved Folgers in the past. You won't be disappointed.Update 8-7-2011I have been drinking this now for well over 3 weeks now and I have to say it is now my new fav everyday coffee. Our 2 mainstays used to be Doughnut Shop by Coffee People Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) and Breakfast Blend by Green Mountain Green Mountain Coffee Breakfast Blend, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2) Folgers has replaced Breakfast Blend which is the milder of the 2.  Sooo Good!
Very delicious coffee, just when you need a good cup of coffee in a rush, there you have this little packs full of flavor and aroma. Loved it!
Good...but too strong leading to higher acidity for my morning joe.  had to adjust it with more water & salt to increase the pH. Not what i want to do..... not sure I would reorder.
If you like rich bold coffee, this brand has been the best choice for my family.  Folgers lives up to its morning wake up taste and smell!
We got the coffee in just a few days.  It is exactly what we had purchased in the grocery store and at almost half the price. Well worth it
This is a good cup of coffee and I will buy more.The price is right and brews up a medium coffee.

I'm what I refer to as a "middle-level" coffee snob; that is, I don't need a Barista to enjoy a good cup of coffee but I don't drink the plebeian brands (Maxwell House, Folgers, et al), either.  We were in Vermont for the weekend when the hostess of the B&B in which we were staying served a delicious coffee at breakfast.  Inquiring as to the brand, she told us it was Folgers Black Silk.  I couldn't believe that Folgers made such a rich, robust, yet smooth coffee.  As soon as we got home, I went out and bought a can of Black Silk, as well as ordered a box of K-cups from Amazon.  It's every bit as good at home as it was in Vermont.  The object lesson here: "Don't be such a snob; try new brands and varieties...some of them might pleasantly surprise you!"
I truly love this coffee,  It tastes very good- not too strong not too weak, one of my favorite brands

This review pertains to the Black Silk only. If you are thinking of skimping on your next K-Cup purchase, read this.No surprise, but you get what you pay for. While many of the other brands of K-Cups say "100% Arabica Coffee" on the side of the package, these merely say, "100% Coffee" - so you know there's gotta be some Robusta in there somewhere. I'd say the flavor is OK if you enjoy the free coffee at your local car dealership while waiting for a repair. Maybe even a step up to "diner coffee." Not terrible, but definitely leaves a burned aftertaste in your mouth. These were OK to try, but I would spend the extra pennies for better quality K-Cups in the future.
We like flavored coffee and this one is the best. Not found in many stores and is usually expensive in the grocery store. Would order again.
I have had a Keurig coffee maker for a couple of years and have tried many coffees, but this one is so like a freshly brewed cup of coffee its amazing and we love it!
I bought this and my wife and I like it.  It's good for anyone who likes a smooth taste.But oh my goodness how the price has gone up.  It is like a bait and switch on price.

I'm not a decaf fan, but sometimes, I want coffee when I don't need the caffeine. So, I tried this one.  I really enjoyed it, so I'm keeping it around.  It's comforting to have a cup before bed time.  It's a little strong for my taste, but don't judge that by me, since I'm a light to medium roast girl.

I am not a fan of Folgers coffee so consider me extremely surprised when I say in all honesty that this flavor of Folgers is one of my favorites!  It has a pleasing french vanilla taste and is wonderful both hot and cold.  Highly recommend!

column9: Folgers Gourmet Selection KCup Vanilla Biscotti
column10: I bought these for my dad, he received a Keurig Coffee Maker for a gift and was astonished at the price of the K-cups.  After trying several different brands, he couldn't find a flavor that matched the Folgers Vanilla Biscotti he used to get for his one cup coffee maker.  I first found them at an ok price for 12 cups, but found I saved $12 by buying here.  He says the flavor is great.

I love the Lively Colombian K-Cups.  It is very convenient and taste fantastic. Since I'm the only one in our household that drinks coffee it is worth the cost. This way I don't have to brew an entire pot that will get wasted. I have freshly brewed coffee any time I want it.
The coffee has smooth, light taste.  You can taste the flavoring, which is a nice change from some K-Cups where you can only smell the flavor.  Nice job, Folgers.
I LOVE my 2 morning cups of coffee, and really enjoy the flavored coffee K-cups brewed in my Keurig!!  This one is at the top of my list of favorites; very smooth and not over-powering flavor.

This Decaf is way too strong and bitter at the middle cup size on my Keurig.  I like my coffee plain and black in the morning. It still has a little bitterness to the 4th cup size, but it's fine for those times later in the day that I want a cup of coffee with flavoring. It is one of the best priced.
We have found another that he likes better, but my husband says this is a fairly good coffee.  I drink Decaf and he drinks the regular, so I have to go by what he says about the regular coffees.
Great tasting coffee; rich,robust and so flavorful. Very expensive however if you and your spouse each consume 3 cups every morning, although Amazon has the best price!

I'm kind of picky about my coffee, but I really like the Folgers Black Silk K-Cups.  I was expecting it to taste weak because it's called "black silk", but it's not weak at all.  I'd recently bought some K-cups at the grocery store that tasted too weak and didn't have a great aroma, but the Black Silk is pretty good.  Yes, it's expensive, but so are all K-cups.  I'll definitely buy this product again.  If you're looking for another good strong K-cup, you might also try the Starbucks K-Cups for Keurig Brewers, Pikes Place Roast, 54-Count.
This  is one of my favorite go to  coffees.  It it always  consistent in flavor!  Nice and nutty, and a very  good medium roast every day coffees!
if you like vanilla flavored coffee, this is a winner.  It's more expensive than other vanilla coffees but worth the extra cost.

column9: Ok for a K-Cup, but not quite the vanilla flavor you'd hope for
column10: For Folgers and this being a K-cup, it's not that bad for instant brew. But if you are looking for a bold cup of Vanilla coffee, this ain't it. It's mild in the coffee area and the flavor is like a mix of vanilla and butter toffee. While the taste is off a bit in the Vanilla area, it at least does not have that chemical taste of other vanilla k-cups I've tried.

Delicious coffee. That being said, it really isn't worth the money.  I don't know why the Black Silk is more expensive than the Folgers Columbian.  The Donut House coffee is equally as good as the Black Silk and costs much less.

Prior to K-cups I was not a Folgers coffee drinker. I thought I would give it a try.  I love it.  Not to strong not to light just perfect. I have even served it at dinner parties and had guests ask where did you get this coffee.Drink on!

Since recieving my brewer I have been buying all sorts of combo packs and experimenting looking for trhe best flavor for me and was excited to see the Folgers become available as I used to drip brew it, and liked it. Unfortunately I don't, or haven't yet, find the same flavor in the Keurig K Packs. Hmmmmmmm..... what changed?
Folgers Silk is my K Cup choice I love it, ,but,The price has increased too muchI ,will not buy anymore.Bed and Bath is cheaper per cup IF you use their 20% off coupon.
The wake up thrill of the morning is a great cup of coffee. Folgers k-cup offers just that and it was for a fantastic price.

I do not drink fancy coffee.  I do not own a burr grinder or an espresso machine.  I do like to fill up my Contigo cup for the commute to work.  I find that Folgers makes a smooth cup of coffee to drink on the way to work.  I actually use 1 3/4 of water to brew mine so it fills my cup to the top.  A single pack of sweetener and I'm off to work.  I purchased 3 of these 36 count packs because it was cheaper than picking them up from Walmart ($10.87 + tax for 18 count)

column9: Definitely the tastiest of the Folgers K-Cups
column10: Given that Folger's is basically "supermarket coffee" rather than any kind of gourmet blend, I was surprised by how good the Folger's K-Cups were.  So far, I've tried the Lively Colombian as well as these, and I definitely like these the best.  They're not as good as the extra bold flavors from Green Mountain or Coffee People, but if you can get them at a decent price, they're worth trying.  If you can get the GM or CP brands for about the same price, you'd be crazy to buy these.

I recently purchased a Keurig and of course wanted to have a variety of coffees and teas to try. I searched and found several coffees and this was one of them.I can honestly state that this is my favorite by far. The flavor is subtle, but clearly there. It smells fantastic and I will be purchasing again for sure.Pros: Aroma/taste  Price-you get three boxes  ShippingCons: None in my opinionOverall I will absolutely buy this product again, and will reccommend and share with my friends.
These folgers pods are delish. They are much cheaper on Amazon then in Walmart. So buy them here and save.

I have been sampling a few k-cups and this is nothing special. I purchased this cheap in amazon warehouse deals.  Its decaf but has nothing special to it.  Id much rather have the Timothy's Colombian decaf but that can get pricy fast.This is ok but more of a last resort. I do add some hot coco mix to it to fix it up.

column9: I was hoping to love this coffee, but it is very bitter.
column10: I have been searching for a smooth, flavorful decaf K cup that I could actually enjoy. I was thrilled to find  Folgers Gourmet Lively Columbian medium roast decaf K cup to try, but both my husband and I found it to be very bitter.

column9: You can't go wrong with Folgers
column10: A+++ to Amazon for offering Warehouse pricingA+++ to Amazon for free and very prompt shippingA+++ for delicious convenient cups of dark roast Black Silk Folgers Coffee
Not as strong as I would like but I can make it with less water. I did expect more from Folgers, but it is a nice alternative to some other K-cups out there.

column9: Bolder than the Columbian but the Columbian has better flavor
column10: This is another great coffee from Folgers! It is bolder than the Columbian but the Columbian has better flavor. We enjoy this as much as our everyday coffee Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50). But the Donut shop is still cheaper because of the amazon 50 count frustration free offering's. We will scoop this up any time it drops below 50 cents a cup!

column9: I love the other 2 Folgers, This one is not for me.
column10: The flavor of this reminds me of Gloria's Butter Toffee. The flavor of this coffee is good but it would benefit from a bolder bean. Many of our family members like this but it's not for me. If you enjoy a light brew you will like this.

I was very happy to find this coffee in Amazon, my daughters boyfriend loves this coffee and it made for a great coffee gift.  Plus I was able to order it from my living room and avoid the crazy Christmas shoppers.  I ordered it and it was at my door step by day two and wrapped and under the tree.  It came packaged very nice and he was very happy to have so much of it.  Thanks Folgers and Amazon you made this gift easy to buy and receive and give.

I like the Folgers Vanilla Biscotti flavor K-cups. The coffee has a very nice aroma to it when it is brewing, and tastes very good. It has a light vanilla flavor, nothing overwhelming. I definitely recommend this flavor.
Amazon had a great price on these K-cups. Made the perfect gift for the coffee drinker in our house. They were shipped on time also.

column9: Surprisingly tasty coffee at a nice price
column10: Let's face it - "Folgers" isn't a name that usually springs to mind when you think of great coffee, but this isn't bad.  Nice aroma, a balanced blend that's not too strong, but still provides plenty of flavor.  Give it a try if you're tired of overpriced K-Cups that cost almost what a coffee shop would charge.  Mrs. Olsen would approve.UPDATE: my review was based on a purchase price that figured out to 46.5 cents per cup.  They were worth trying at that price.  The current price of 65 cents a cup puts them in the same price-range as gourmet brands like Green Mountain or Coffee People, and they're not even close to the same quality as those brands.  If you can find them for under fifty cents a cup, they're worth trying.  Otherwise, don't waste your money.
There are no aromatics.  The coffee tastes like it is old.  There is no aroma when brewed and it tastes stale.  Just like all the other Folgers coffee.

Got tired of all the fancy coffee k-cups and just wanted a regular cup of Joe. This is it! Flavor is not so strong that you have to put in a lot of cream and sugar to get it down. Just simple wonderful tasting coffee!
Great tasting coffee and a really great price. I will be ordering again, as Amazon does not charge extra to ship to Alaska, like 90% of everyone else.

I am usually a coffee snob. I refused for the longest time to try Folger's k-cups. I thought the prices should never be equal to the gourmet brands. WRONG!! This Vanilla Biscotti is outstanding. Smooth, and delicious.  I love the new Starbucks k-cups,but trust me, Folgers is right up there with the best of them!

The Folgers Decaf was surprisingly very good!  I normally like a dark robust cup of coffee and have been unable to find a decaf that didn't have an aftertaste or was too bitter.  While this isn't a dark roast, it was still very very good.

Folgers Gourmet is amazing! Especially if you have the Keurig. I got if for my mom for Christmas and she loved it. Since my dad died she doesnt make pots of coffee anymore but the she loves the individual cups she can make!

column9: Not Bad. Not Outstanding. HIghly Drinkable Medium Blend. Produces a Decent Cup of Coffee.
column10: All in all, this Folgers Lively Colombian coffee is a decent medium blend coffee.  It has a slight bite, but is highly drinkable and has no discernible aftertaste.For medium blend drinkers, if the price is right, it is a k-cup worth trying.

column9: Nice option, especially when you need to surve a variety of tastes in a hurry
column10: My hair dresser's salon bought a Keurig Machine, so I have been able to sample a variety of K-Cups. K-cups are about 10 times more expensive than a regularly brewed cup of coffee so I have never considered buying one for myself, but having a Keurig Machine at a hair salon makes sense! People have a variety of tastes and K-Cups can provide a nice variety and freshly made one at that.The salon has a nice variety of K-cups: Folders, Wolfgang Puck, Timothy's, and Green Mountain (that owns Keurig).Everyone's taste vary, but here is my assessment of the ones that I have tried so far. So far, I like Folgers the best.FOLGERS GOURMETSELECTIONS LIVELY COLOMBIANPrice per cup: 69 cents (package of 36 for $25)Earthy flavor, fruity and nutty flavors come through.WOLFGANG PUCK CHEFS RESERVE COLOMBIAN DARK ROASTPrice per cup: 69 cents (package of 48 for $32.98)A dark roast with caramel and earthy notes, slight burntand papery flavors.TIMOTHY'S DECAFFEINATED COLOMBIAN MEDIUMPrice per cup: 60 cents (package of 50 for $30)A bit on the weak side, kind of papery, and less astringent than the others.Ali Julia review

I got my most recent 3 pack product in April and two of the three boxes had kcups that had expanded - I mean that the bottom was round and puffed out.  When put in the Keurig, a couple of them popped at the top and spritzed/leaked coffee out of the keurig and onto my counter.  The others crumpled when used.  We pay a lot of money for kcups and I encourage you to check all three boxes when you get them to make sure they are normal.  I am wondering what kind of extremes the packages are subjected to in storage and/or transit.  One of the three boxes had all kcups as they should be (sealed tight, flat bottoms).  When I reorder, I will check each box and return any with the defective packaging.Folgers Black Silk Kcup coffee is smooth, flavorful and doesn't get buried when you add milk (latte) or cream.  Delicious!
Coffe is bold and smooth. Not the strongest but enough for me. If you like smooth coffee without the bitterness try this

This is a really good coffee if you like a light flavor and gentle aroma to your coffee.  This is my favorite flavored coffee in the morning.  I drink my coffee black without adding any sugar so I enjoy just a hint of flavor and this K-cup certainly gives me exactly what I want.  Received these k-cups in a timely manner and will definitely order them again.
Really great bold flavour, my favourite out of the many I have tried.  It is more expensive but worth it.  Would recommend if you like a bold, strong tasty coffee, yum.

column4: Daniel Lindley "If you can't say something ni...
column10: It's mediocre. But it's not as smooth as other Folgers varieties. we like a mild to medium roast and that's what this is, for sure. But there's a touch of harshness that makes it less than desireable. But with coffee, opinions vary wildly! Give it a try. My wife and I wish Folgers would make the "Smooth as Silk" in a k-cup. (Not the black silk). It's available in cans and is soooooo good.

This is a very good coffee for everyday enjoyment. I occasionally enjoy a more bold coffee for that strong jolt in the morning or do get rid of the "3 o'clock 'blahs".  If you exclusively like bold coffees, you may want to look for other options.  However, this is a good medium blend coffee and is a pretty decent price (beats any coffee chain).  I still prefer the Vanilla Biscotti from Folgers to this one, but I know not everybody enjoys flavored coffee.
Reminds me of weak diner coffee - has a slightly off flavor.  Not at all pleasant.  Donut Shop and Barista House Blend are coffees of choice in our home.

There are plenty of tasty flavored K-cups out there.  Unfortunately, this is not one of them.  The base notes of the coffee itself are fine, but the flavoring has a very odd taste to it- sort of plasticky.  It doesn't taste like other vanilla or dessert-flavored coffees I've had before, and I'm a fan of most flavored coffee.  I'll try the other Folgers flavors to see if they are better, but in the future I will be giving this one a miss.
Sam's clud sale thsi same product for under $40 per 80 count. So, I will not purchase this productat $.67 per count plus freight.

column9: Eehhh...not that great but not terrible
column10: I tried these along with about ten other flavors (in multibrands). I would say this is not the worst coffee--that spot is reserved for one of the Donut House K-cups, but Folgers Lively Columbian lingers closely. I was just not wowed by this coffee and honestly, I am not impressed by the price on here. If you really love this coffee, you should out Sam's Clubs price on it.

column9: Not Happy With This Brand of Keurig Cups
column10: I waited many months for this coffee to become available and I am quite disappointed now that it has finally arrived.The taste is okay but there are grounds coming thrugh in each cup. I have used many many different flavors of mostly Green Mountain Keurig coffees as well as other brands and have never before seen a ground come into the cup. I will not buy this Folger brand again.
You are making it too inconvenient for me to give you a review. Make it easier- " less customer typing " or do not ask me to review again.
I have not received this product as of this day. Although Amazon does keep me abreast of their efforts to locate it.

column9: Hot Sizzling bubbly Raclette! !  Bubbly Bubbly..............
column10: Put in under a Reclette grill or just put it in your oven for 5-10 minutes.  Serve with boiled baby potaotes and cornichons.  You will be melted by the Raclette aroma and your melted velvelty bubbly Raclette.  Experience that you cannot forget!!!
Very good Raclette cheese, I lived in Switzerland for a long time and I missed Raclette, and now it is available in US  :-)
This cheese was bitter and very hard to slice. I didn't like it. I wouldn't buy it again but will try another type of raclette cheese.

I run trail races, and have been using the Honey Stinger gels for energy for those events.  This year I've done my first ultramarathons, and figured that the bars would be a nice bit of variety for the middle of the runs.  The Honey Stinger energy bars are a great solid food option; they're perfectly balanced with sweetness and texture, they sit well in my stomach and kept that uncomfortable empty-belly feeling at bay.  When you're sick of sucking down gels and you've got another hour or more before the next aid station, this can't be beat.

I was getting tired of Luna Bars, so I'm soooo happy I found these. Even my kids like them and I'll occasionally use them as as a snack for school or as a quick breakfast.  Not quite as yummy as the peanut butter variety, but I usually buy a box of each and switch off flavors.

I love honey stinger products, particularly the energy chews, waffles, and protein bars. I thought that these energy bars would be delicious just like the other products I love. I, unfortunately, am a little disappointed with the product. I was expecting a different flavor, I guess, than what these bars provide. They leave a weird aftertaste and I just don't seem to care for them. I really wish I had loved these, but I'll stick with the peanut butta protein bars from now on!

I bought these in-store so I can't say anything about shipping/etc. But I can vouch for taste. It tastes exactly like a frosted white cupcake, which, frosted white cupcakes are a bit much for me (I like minimal-to-none frosting on mine) so I can't eat too many of these [bites] at once. Not more than 5-6. They're very sugary. But, again, I rarely eat sugar, or even drink sugar (like soda), so if you consume it on a regular basis or frequently, these will just be normal(ly sweet) for you. They're very good & I recommend you at least try them.However, I have just found out they also have red velvet cupcake bites, so I kinda wish I had bought them (red velvet being my favorite cake, followed by chocolate absolutely with no frosting) instead of these, but, the store didn't have 'em & these are good too, I guess. :)

In June, my co-workers hosted a cupcake-themed birthday party for me. A co-worker who baked more than 50 cupcakes for my birthday party also gave me and every co-worker a box of Cupcake Bites. My boss ended up eating the whole box within a few hours. I've honestly haven't eaten much candy or cookies since June 2009 because of two traumas in 2009 that made my TMJ worse. So, I wouldn't know about the latest trends in candy or cookies. I mostly focus on drinks, cupcakes, jams/jellies/preserves, and soft foods (as you can tell by my Amazon reviews) because that's what people with TMJ and jaw problems can consume. Anyways, the Cupcake Bites are out-of-this-world delicious. Cupcake Bites are, I believe, one of the newest products from the makers of Cookie Dough Bites. I think Cupcake Bites were promoted around April 2011. Cupcake Bites are bite-sized cupcake morsels coated with sprinkles and white frosting. They're really soft and dissolve in your mouth - great for people with TMJ and jaw problems. They're from the makers of Cookie Dough Bites. Before 2009, when my jaw was in better shape, I used to like Cookie Dough Bites. Based from my memory - Cupcake Bites are way softer than Cookie Dough Bites, and they're so addictive and delicious. Cupcake Bites are by far the best product that the makers of Cookie Dough Bites have ever made. Cupcake Bites is one of the best inventions for cupcake fans and lovers. Your cravings for cupcakes are gone after eating these. And you don't have to deal with the mess of transporting cupcakes, especially in the sweltering summer heat. The downside though is that you need to refrigerate these treats during the summertime. Just like most candy during the summertime, it will melt. Anyways, you can buy boxes of these Cupcake Bites directly from the Cookie Dough Bites website. You can buy them from Amazon when available or physically in places such as the Dollar General Store. There's even a Facebook page for Cupcake Bites. In the end, if you like cupcakes, and haven't tried Cupcake Bites, I highly recommend you do so - you won't regret it!

I love this stuff. I found out about it from some Endocrinologists and Dietitians that I work with. It adds so much flavor to things and so little calories/fat! You can even mix it with water to get a decent alternative...I'd say use less water and add more if needed - the ratio on the packaging seems to be a bit too runny for my taste. I only add liquid for small amounts, like a dip or something, because it does not go a long way. I have read some reviews where people were not pleased with that fact, but I'd say it is not meant to be only mixed with water. It goes a very long way in shakes/sauces/baking/etc!I don't feel that the chocolate flavor really tastes like chocolate, so I just buy the regular and add cocoa powder if I need chocolate. That way I also have more control over how much chocolate flavor I get.

I thought it was very tasty.  Paired with all-fruit jam and rice cakes makes a delicious, healthy snack.  I found the mixing instructions to be right on.  So far have only used as peanut butter, but will try the smoothie route soon.  Good idea

The taste was okay, but different. The product was not bad, but I just doubt that I'd order these again. They actually do taste like pickles, which is good, but the taste is definitely an acquired one and I haven't acquired it yet.

Whether you like your martinis with vodka or gin, dry or dirty, these tomolives are fantastic. I was first introduced to these in a fine hotel in NY city and I have been a fan ever since. Much tastier than olives.
I've loved these since I was a kid.  These are the best Gummi Bears I have ever had.  You can't compare the taste and texture to any other gummi bear out there.
Best Gummi bears on the market as far as I'm concerned too bad you can't get them from a regular store almost anywhere.

Everyone raves about Haribo gummy bears. Supposedly they are the best. WRONGO! They are overrated and Heidi Quality Gummy Bears are simply the best- and classic. My dad used to buy me these as a child and I continue to enjoy their distinct flavor. My sister was a Haribo fan until I introduced her to these babies and now shes a fan. Taste test and see for yourself.

These gummi bears are delicious!!  They were fresh when I received them and I'm glad they came in small pouches so you can tell how many you had throughout the day or at work.  I use to eat Heide gummi bears as a kid and I love them.  Heide bears are one of the top two favorite brands of gummi bears and they are relatively inexpensive too.
these are the best ever gummy bears i have ever tasted in my life, i can remember eating these when i was a small kid .

column9: Heide vs. Jelly Belly Gummi Bears
column10: Both Jelly Belly and Heide have established themselves as leaders in the American Gummi Bear market, in fact, Jelly Belly was the first to ever make an American Gummi Bear. Unlike their European counterparts, such as Haribo Gold Bears, American Gummi Bears are soft and have a more opaque look to them.My all-time favorite Gummi Bear has been Heide ever since elementary school, but I give Jelly Belly a lot of credit for putting up a great fight. Jelly Belly bears are smaller and less resembling of a bear, but they sure pack a punch in terms of flavor. Heide bears on the other hand are larger and more bear-like than their counterpart, but flavor is more subtle. Both come in five distinct flavors and both are difficult to find in your average grocery store candy aisle.On average, Jelly Belly bears appear to be more costly than Heide bears per ounce, but of course that doesn't mean you won't find amazing deals like the one on Amazon that turn the tables. In general you won't go wrong with either brand, but my vote still goes toward Heide for bringing back all the memories of my childhood.
I've eaten quite a few different brands of Gummi Bears since the late 70s.  These are the best I've found.

Be carefull when odering from UBing Vita... I ordered a box of gummy bears to be sent to my son who is 4. It was to be his first package he would get in the mail with his own name on it. I thought he would be soo suprised!! But when it came it looked like a semi-deflated volly ball packed with the pouches of the gummy bears. I was upset because the picture on the site shows this nice box that folds open to see the Heide Gummy Bear and all the pouches neatly in place, but here I have this sorry looking hacky sack of a bag with the pouches all crumpled up. Needless to say my son was still excited to get something in the mail, but they should have sent them in the original box....

column9: Not like when I was a kid...
column10: I had all these nostalgic, wonderful memories from my childhood about these bears.  So sweet, delicious and comforting.  The perfect little treat.  Brother was I disappointed.  The bears were old, stale and disgusting.  I swear I remember them being super flavorful.  I feel like these had been sitting on the shelf since the mid 80's.  Needless to say the Black Forest are always fresh and I will be getting them next time fo-shizzle!

column9: Very good, but not better then Haribo
column10: Tried these out based on the reviews.  Pros: They are nice and chewy without being hard. The small packages make it easier to stop eating them. They have some fruit juice in them.Cons: The flavors taste all the same to me. They are not distinct tasting like the Haribo at least in my opinion, nor do the flavors have the 'pop' that Haribos have.They are still very good however, dare I say better then black forest? If you like Black Forest try these. If you like Haribo, stick with Haribo. You could also try life savers gummis or life savers gummis wild berries which I found very good (bought from box store)

This sixteen ounce jar of organic trail mix is loaded with minerals, vitamins and antioxidants. Everything we need for a healthy mind and body. But for $21.64, the nuts and seeds are a tad dry and flavorless. I will look elsewhere for my afternoon pick-me-up snack.Ingredients: Organic Tibetan Goji Berries, Organic Mulberries, Organic Raisins, Organic Cranberries, Organic Pumpkin seeds, Organic Almonds, Organic WalnutsT.B. Grant8.1.12
This product is advertised as 16oz, it is actually only 11.  I wouldn't be surprised if it wasn't actually organic either.

This is one of those items you will want to keep in your pantry for a fast and satisfying meal.  A thick soup that has a perfect blend of sweet and spicy (for a thinner version add a can of chicken broth).  Perfect for autumn...worked great for a tail-gate party!

I discovered this particular brand in my search for a gluten free taco seasoning.  When I noticed they had soup; I decided to give this a try (since it was a personal "gold box" deal)!  The first time I made it, I put chicken broth instead of water, and added a little frozen corn (when it was almost cooked).  I also added a dollop of sour cream when I served it.  The second time I decided that instead of extra corn, I'd add a diced grilled chicken breast, onion, a mixture of chicken broth (what was left of the box.. about 2 cups), a cup of water, and also about a cup of milk (because I didn't want it too thick).  It was fantastic!!  In conclusion, Nueva Cocina mixes are very handy if you want a fast meal!  Don't be afraid to add ingredients you think you'd like.  If you're the sort of person that likes corn chowder, or even creamed corn- this is something you should definitely try!!  I also highly recommend the "Black Bean Chipotle Chile" soup mix, and the (taco) seasonings!!!

This is super easy, just be careful to lower the heat after it comes to a boil, it will scorch easily. It's delicious, very rewarding on a cold day.The suggestion to add more corn kernels is a good one; another addition could be sliced frankfurters or sausage.  The chiles are not at all too hot;the soup would be too bland without them.

Very good soup.  Easy to make and brings Latin American flavors to life.  Works well with any meal.  My only complaint is that it clumped after letting it sit for a minute, so I had to stir it quite often. But overall, a delicious soup that I will continue to buy & enjoy.

I think this soup has the perfect blend of flavors - very flavorful without being too spicy or sweet. And all-natural ingredients make me feel good about eating it. I am becoming a fan of Nueva Cocina products!

I just made this soup for the first time, and it could not have been easier.  Add water, heat, and then garnish with a little cheese.I didn't find it terribly spicy hot. The chiles used are nice and mild.A tasty dinner indeed.
This soup is delicious.  I've made it with the 3 cups of water and it couldn't be better in my opinion.
This is a high quality soup but for me it would be great without the Green Chiles.  If you prefer mild salsa over hot salsa, this soup may not be for you.
Nueva Cocina has good products with good ingredients and are easy/fast to prepare. This one is tasty amd mildly spiced. I add onions, garlic, corn and peppers.

WOW!!!! Yummy to the tummy soup!!Quick to fix............use boiling water not microwave heated water. Stays hot longer and dissolves better.For added enjoyment I added some extra fozen corn kernels and chopped fresh serrano chiles...........Just a cow girl from Texas!!!!!Definitely a product to keep on the kitchen shelf!!!!

This is by far my favorite soup. I love that I can prepare this myself at home. I made this for my boyfriend last weekend and he was very impressed with the ingredients and taste. I now keep stock of this in my kitchen :) I have also tried their Lentil Soup and Mexican Rice... delicious!

column9: product was fine, had problems with delivery
column10: I ordered a box of six soups first delivery was only one envelope... had to call amazon to fix the situation.

Do not buy Crunchies products in the Hot summer months.  They are heat sensitive. As the packaging states "IMPORTANT- STORE IN COOL DRY AREA". The two cases I purchased arrived chewy and clumped together.  They probably cooked during shipping and are not a "Raw Food" and not as "Nutritious" anymore.  Two of the bags were more bits and powdered fruit clumps than chucks of fruit and one was opened.  Amazon.com does not accept grocery returns.  It was a waste of $40.

I like this snack, though it is not without its negatives. First, it is expensive... but then again it is suppose to be healthy, so that's a plus that makes up for some of the expense. Also, it seems like a good snack for kids. However, sometimes there is an unpleasant flavor with the "Tropical Fruit" flavor. It is not pleasant when you get a bad piece of dried fruit in your mouth. I also tried the "Organic Strawberries" and like those better, probably giving them a 4 out of 5. The strawberries are good to eat with dark chocolate.

I really wanted these to work for travels where I pack all my own food.  However, they are a decidedly poor alternative for travels, since most of the outer coating of the fruit turns into very messy powder.  The strawberry flavor is slightly less of an ordeal in that regards but still messy.  They are probably good for you if you want a stowaway fruit you can use when you haven't gotten to the store for awhile or want it out of season to sprinkle into something, but otherwise the price and messiness are both much too prohibitive.  I've bumped it up from two stars to three, however, after considering how they keep the enzymes intact and don't add sulfites.

Not sure why this item has received any bad reviews. These blueberries are just what I needed. Freeze-dried and naturally sweet.Regular/traditionally dried blueberries (not freeze-dried) often have sugar added to make them sweet, which I cannot have, so I am ecstatic that these are so good.I ordered a whole case and none of the blueberries were pulverized, no extra powder, they are all beautiful and whole.

These are very good, but too messy to eat alone as a snack.  The blueberries stained my fingers and mouth.  They are very good mixed with yogurt or in muffins.  Normally, they are a little pricey, but with the instant rebate, they are well worth the cost.
For those of you like me who care... These yummy snacks have about 140 Calories per package and one package is too much for one sitting. Very yummy and sweet lo-cal food to snack on.

I love this brand of freeze dried fruit but found the mango variety to lack flavor...unlike mango juice itself.  Maybe when you take the "juice" out of this fruit it's just dried fiber. Not satisfying.

Previous reviewes told of the mess involved with these, they obviously have not had freeze dried fruit before. Wether it is blueberries, strawberries, lychees or any other fruit, you will have a bit of a mess from the product. Get over it! Wash your hands, brush your teeth. Now for the item at hand, Blueberries. Typical freeze dried berries with good taste and that wonderful powder! Can not be improved.

column9: Really good - little powdery but good
column10: These taste wonderful.  They are a little powdery, which is to be expected since they are freeze dried, so don't breathe in as you're eating.  Fresh blueberries are better, but these are very good.  I saw a few reviews that mentioned everything arriving as powder, but mine arrived in good shape.One thing I really like is that the only ingredient is blueberries.  There's no sulfur (which I'm allergic to) or corn syrup.  These are good in cereal and as a snack, though you might want to have some water on hand in case you breathe in some blueberry dust.Highly recommended.

I don't usually buy these kinds of things, but couldn't pass it up when it was on sale a while back. These tasty, healthy treats are perfect for on the go! I snack on them while I am at school. Some fruits have more flavor than others. Raspberries are probably my favorite. Mmmmm my mouth is watering just thinking about them. My only complaint is the price is a little pricey. My girlfriend however doesn't like the tastey treat. May not be for everyone. Taste testing them somewhere could be advised, although I am not sure where you could test them out.

column9: Almost $4 a bag & messy. So why do I give it 5 stars?
column10: Taste. A very natural taste. A taste that only God could develop. This is a taste of the promised land (and tastes great with milk & honey). For Weight Watchers folks like me, you'll be happy to know that it's only 2 points / bag. If you're going to a festive occasion, or on a big date, or thinking of using it for your lunch break, stick with Sensible Foods Cherry Berries. But if you're at home, or somewhere where you wont mind getting a little messy, try this. The price is well worth it.

I've bought many packs of various types of the Crunchies brand dried fruit and they are all excelent in my oppinion. This type of Crunchies is quite 'crunchy' and I like to sprinkle these on my brakefast cereal in the mornings. Plan to buy more of these delicious Crunchies brand snacks in the future!

column9: Best of the freeze dried, and my whole families favorite flavor
column10: I started buying these as a "to go" snack for my baby/toddler who is allergic to a lot of stuff.  He loved fresh mangos so I selected this flavor.  Now he loves these so much, he seems to object to fresh mangos.  Now the whole family loves them.  We buy all the other flavors (except blueberries, tried them once -- they'd be okay for baking with, but not a great snack).  I've tried 2 other brands of freeze dried foods and I'd say Crunchies brand is the best -- size of pieces, texture/look of pieces, flavor.  Only improvement would be for it to come in a large cannister size too, and even the 1.5 ounce would be better if it was in a hard sided container like "Just ___________" brand (also okay, but more shrivled up, less like airy).Good Job Crunchies!

column9: Low Calorie, Nutritious and DELICIOUS...what more could you want?
column10: I was at Costco one fine Saturday afternoon when they were handing out samples of the Mixed Fruit Crunchies. I was immediately struck by how flavorful they are! Crunchy, and crisp, not leathery like most dried fruit. On their own they are a fun snack for kids and adults alike. I've also discovered that they make great flavoring agents for frostings, truffles, cakes, etc. I used a mortar and pestle to turn, for example, the strawberry Crunchies into a powder, then used that for the Triple Berry tea loaves and the Strawberries & Cream truffles I made during the holidays. The intense, refreshing, true fruit flavor is what I love about these. And the crunch, but then I'm a texture person!p.s. the other reviewer: It's the banana crunchies you think aren't good, I would bet money on it. My daughter doesn't like them either.

column9: Stale and Poorly Packaged - No Reply from Manufacturer
column10: I've bought these pineapple Crunchies in my local grocery store and they were good (though very expensive at about 6 bucks per serving). So when I ordered the six-pack of them here, I expected them to taste just as good. That was not the case at all. The outside of each package was sticky but that didnt bother me much. What bothered me is that the actual product itself was stale. Each piece (in 4 of the 6 bags I opened) was rubbery. Chewing the Crunchies only compressed it into a solid wad of what then seemed like hard plastic. The result was something that simply could not be broken up and swallowed. I also noticed that the built-in ziplock seal didnt work on these bags. After 4 bags, I tossed out the rest and contacted the manufacturer via email (twice). I never received a reply. I think the Crunchies people are selling Amazon bad batches. Avoid these at all cost!
these are so good! My girls and I ate the whole bag in a few minutes. The fruit flavor is awesome!

Crunchies Blueberries are my new favorite snack. Mine arrived whole and in good condition. There was some blueberry powder at the bottom of the bags, but this is only a problem if you love them as much as I do and insist on sifting through the powder to ensure you get every last blueberry. I haven't tried rehydrating them, as I like them crunchy, but my experience with other freeze-dried items is that they rehydrate well. Incidentally, freeze-dried blueberries are a lot cheaper than dried blueberries, but they retain almost all of their nutrients unlike regular dried fruit.

I love blueberries & love the taste of these.Light as air and not sugary like many dried fruits, so they are a little tart.Problem: Will stain your fingers, tongue, teeth and anything else they touch. :-(

I really like these things, they're great to snack on. If you're the type of person that likes to sit and watch TV and eat then these would be great to have on hand. I found myself eating an entire bag in one sitting, but at just under 150 calories for the full bag - who cares! They'll sate your sweet and crunchy cravings and you'll get all kinds of vitamins and nutrients from them that are really good for you!One another side note, I do sometimes get sulfite-induced headaches and digestive problems from dried fruits, but not with Crunchies! Just another added bonus.
These sounded good, but lack favor.  Not worth the price.  I won't buy again.

I bought these for my 3 year old.  He looked at them and was very dubious of the square little pieces.  So, I ended up trying them.  They are phenomenal!!!  I was holding my 6 months old (who has so far refused all forms of baby food and has only agreed to try the gerber puffies) and he grabbed one off the table and shoved it in his mouth.  It melted in his mouth and he was hooked.  He ended up eating 7 pieces before I cut him off for fear of giving him too much of something he's never had before.  But they kept him very happy for a while.

This is my favorite type of the Crunchies brand dried fruit! I've bought many packs of various types of the Crunchies brand dried fruit and they are all excelent in my oppinion. This type of Crunchies is very crisp and crunchy. I sprinkle these on my brakefast cereal in the morning and they last a while. Plan to buy more of these delicious Crunchies brand snacks in the future!
Even though it's all natural the taste is rich with fresh fruit flavor.  In this way it's even better than standard dried fruit.
Delicious. Just what I was looking for. Wishing to find its full panoply of offerings in stores so I don't have to buy in bulk.

some of these survived shipping ok.  some were 90% pulverized dust by the time they got to my home.  Would buy again, just not sure I would order these again from Amazon (usually these are very good from the local stores).

Because of the bulk price and the main image on amazon, I thought the packages would be larger, like a bag of Jerky. Turns out that the image you see is not the packaging that you get, the bags are shorter and smaller (see my customer image). At over $4 a bag ($25/6), I'd be better off buying freeze-dried fruit at the local nutrition shop. Plus the fruit pieces are fairly small; good for kids but I like bigger chunks.

My kids love these freeze dry fruits.  Great as a take  along snacks when we are on the go.  A little expensive for the amount of fruits you get. Will stock up the next time Amazon has these on sale (lighting deal).

I LOVE THIS SNACK =D Its like eating crunchy chips but they're sweet and so much healthier. I would eat them all the time, but they just add up- but don't most healthy foods? Sad truth :(.But get this treat!! Its really awesome. Plus, i love this taste of mango

I bought the variety pack and I LOVE the apple cinnamon snacks.They are so very good!  Little sweet, little tart, little crunchy, low cal and good for you!mmmmvery satisfying.The other flavors were okay...I wouldn't buy them again...but the apple is on my list of lifetime loves.
Apples and strawberries were crunchy and satisfying.  Pears were chewy and suspect as we were expecting crunchy.. Support from company was ok as they replaced however replacement pears still soft.

The berry flavors permeate and dominate the other fruit flavors.  The bottom of the bag has dried fruit powder that sticks and stains your fingers and anything else you touch.  Think Cheetos.  Definitely will not be ordering again.

Ok, so I have never had freeze dried pineapple before, so I am not sure if they are "good" compared to other freeze dried pineapple. But I found them weird. I've tried almost all low calorie freeze-dried pineapple snacks out there. This snack says it's made in the USA, while most others are imported.  One 1.5 ounce package has 150 calories, which makes it about average on the calorie scale.  "Crunchies" freeze-dried pineapple snacks are not chips, like other freeze-dried pineapple snacks.  "Crunchies" are chunks of freeze-dried pineapple shaped like canned pineapple chunks you buy at the store.  The consistency is very good and it is definitely crunchy.  But to me, the flavor was a little bit off.  I mean it didn't taste like natural pineapple.  The package states that the only ingredient is "pineapple," so I can't figure out why the taste is slightly off.  I opened a second package and tried it, but it was the same.  A third package was the same.  I will not be buying this product again.  If you are looking for a tasty freeze-dried pineapple snack, I recommend "Funky Monkey" or "Crunchy N Yummy" which are both sold by Amazon.

column10: These were decent, but a lot of the blue skins of the blueberries were just blue powder in the package after they came of the berries and got crunched up during shipping etc. They were nice and crunchy with decent flavor for freeze dried berries.

I like these so much I enrolled in the Subscribe & Save over a year ago.  It is not the cheapest snack, but I save money by ordering these in bulk through Amazon rather than buying these from my local grocery store.  There are no artificial ingredients or added sugars; this is just fruit.  Yet, this is a great portable snack that will not go bad sitting in your car, or your child's backpack.  I usually keep a supply in my car to satisfy my huger while driving home from work.I completely disagree with the serving size listed on the package.  It claims five servings per bag.  But, if you're eating these as a snack, you'll only get one serving out of a package, maybe two servings if it's for a child.  If you're using this on top of cereal or yogurt, then of course it will last much longer.  When the bag is empty, you'll find a bunch of fruit powder left at the bottom.  Don't throw it away, this makes a great topping for yogurt.This snack is not for everyone.  My kids and I love them, but my husband can't stand them.  These are not the consistency of other dried fruits, like raisins.  These are crunchy, just as the name implies.  You can happily crunch them like potato chips, or to make them last longer, eat one at a time, and let them slowly dissolve in your mouth, like a sugar cube.  Sweet without the guilt.

column9: The preferred salt for kitchen and table.
column10: Except for baking, Morton Coarse Kosher Salt is what I use in the kitchen and at the table. I prefer pure, plain salt to the somewhat muddled flavor of sea salt.  Table salt is much finer so it is harder to pinch and distribute evenly on a finished dish.This coarse, flaked salt is also necessary for topping pretzels and margaritas and making pickles. It is also especially nice topping whole grain loaves and on meat, poultry or baked potatoes. If you have a French recipe calling for "gros sel" something of this nature is what is intended. A nice gift that is easy to make using this salt is pickled lemons, which are very useful in Mediterranean dishes.Note that this salt is less dense than regular table salt. The label indicates to add 1 tablespoon per quarter cup if the recipe calls for table salt.
At $30 plus $23 shipping is a bit more than I typically pay ($1.99) at the local market.  Must be aware of pricing before buying anything here.

column9: Yummy! Fun Snacks for Kids or Adults Too
column10: I must still be a kid at heart because I eagerly awaited this GoPicnic Kid's Fun Food package. I had tried one of the adult snack boxes and loved it so I knew I would probably love other food packages too. In this box you get quite a few tasty snacks (all gluten-free) which include:Pop Chips - Deliciously crunchy chips that are neither fried or baked. They are salted perfectly and are not greasy or dry. The 3-ounce bag is big enough to share. These chips do no contain any preservatives, artificial flavors, colors, saturated fat, trans fat or gluten.Old Wisconsin Turkey Sausage - These tasty snack bites are meaty and delicious and taste lean.Enjoy Life Chewy Bars - These are chewy and crunchy with a hit of berry flavor. They are made in a nut- and gluten-free bakery. They contain no wheat, no dairy, no peanuts, no tree nuts, no egg, no soy, no fish or shellfish. They are also made without casein, potato, sesame and sulfites. These make a good snack or a good breakfast on the run.All Natural Sunflower Crunch - This is the tastiest treat in the box. These crunchy treats are made with sunflower seeds, sesame seeds, rice malt, cane juice and sea salt.Surf Sweets - Love gummy bears but not all the sugar? These gummy bears are made with organic fruit juice, fortified with vitamin C and have all-natural colors and flavorings. There are three small bags.GoPicnic ready-to-eat meals: Turkey stick and crunch - This is a box of five items which include an Old Wisconsin turkey snack stick, barbecue potato chips, Mariani dried apricots, Baja Blend fruit and nut mix and a piece of organic dark chocolate. If your kids are allergic to peanuts just take out the Baja Blend fruit and nut mix. It has almonds, peanuts, mango and cranberries. What a great combination.I can think of so many reasons to buy a box of these snacks. You might want one box per kid for when you go on a family vacation or it would be fun to have a few boxes for a movie night. This would also be the perfect snack box to send with the kids if they go camping. The only thing that needs refrigeration is the turkey sausage but maybe just sharing the package would be the solution. You could also keep it in a cooler in the car on a road trip. Some of the treats in this box would also be fun for school lunches.Now I'm being honest when I say that these treats are going to be loved by adults too. This is my favorite GoPicnic box so far. Yes I did share some of my snacks with my husband who was as eager to try everything as I was. We will definitely buy this for hiking trips and picnics. I received a tin of this tea from my cousin who had brought it over from Germany. I have honestly never tasted a better tea, and the aroma is amazing. The most notable flavors are bergamot and vanilla, making this a very soothing tea with just the right amount of fruity flavor without tasting overly sweet. I love it on its own (no cream or sugar with this one!), but it pairs wonderfully with orange-laced chocolate. Really a wonderful tea - I'm thrilled I can get it on Amazon!

This is a delicious black China tea blend presented in a beautiful, highly giftable tin box.This tea is available in 35 oz, 8.8oz, 4.4oz and tea bags; I usually get the 4.4oz tin as I am the only black tea lover in the house. One tin of 4.4 oz is enough for one large cup a day for ~3 months so I am guessing ~100 cups (I use a 1.5' mesh infuser).As usual with Kusmi, the tin is beautiful, with raised flower details and old-fashioned design and colors.The blend is a glistening black tea with pieces of citrus peel.The nose is reminiscent of a bergamot Earl Grey with spicier notes that I would describe as all-spice, nutmeg and even a hint of turmeric.The mouth is smooth, low tannins, with beautiful layered flavors of vanilla and soft spices and a savory-sweet finish.Kusmi recommend a brewing temperature of 85c to 90c (~185F to 195F) so make sure the water sits for a few moments after boiling before pouring over the tea. I usually like a rather long infusion time, maybe 5 to 7 minutes. I do not add anything to this tea but a sweetener would probably work if you like.To my knowledge, Prince Vladimir was one of Kusmi's first blend in the late 1800's and remain one of the most popular. I would highly recommend it to lovers of complex flavored black teas. In particular, if you already appreciate some higher-end bagged teas (Mighty Leaf Vanilla Bean or Orange Dulce?), I think you should give this superior blend a try.Cheers!

column9: Once in a while, in the short term, works for cats too
column10: Note that I'm NOT recommending you feed your cat dog food on any kind of regular basis: the two types of animals need different kinds of foods and nutrients. However, at the time I was having trouble finding cat-specific dehydrated food that I thought my cats would tolerate, and this was the one dehydrated food I found that included a high amount of protein *and* added taurine, which cats need, so I decided to use it temporarily while I looked around more. column10: No matter how highly rated of a kibble we would get for our little shih tzu & yorkie mix, she would throw up about three times per week. column10: Length:: 1:39 Mins* this review was originally posted for the 3 oz size, a verified purchase by me on Amazon)I purchased three well reviewed brands of catnip for Tristan, my six month old Savannah cat. In the video, I have just placed down three plates of catnip from freshly opened packages. The brands from left to right are Sojos Certified Organic Catnip, in the middle is the product in this listing - Cosmic Catnip (this video review shows the 3oz jar), and on the far right we have Frontier Catnip Leaf & Flower C/s Certified Organic, 16 Ounce Bag.Like the little bear at Goldilock's table, Tristan tries a bit from each plate; at the end of this clip he seemed to have no *overwhelming* preference for any particular brand though. As far as his physical reactions to each (sampled separately), he did not act "stoned" nor hyper, he merely scratches on his scratch pad a bit more with catnip than without catnip and gives himself a good stretch. He also strongly prefers catnip infused mice to non-catnip mice and I'm happy to oblige.As far which *I* prefer, if it's all the same to the cat (and it seems that it is) here's my take on things -The Frontier brand is by far the least expensive at just under fifteen dollars for 16oz. It is slightly more coarse and seems to have a little bit of stems mixed in. VERY fragrant though and turned out to be a close second favorite of the cat reviewing the products. I would definitely buy the Frontier brand again and use it for stuffing toys generously or for "marinating" his little cloth mice. Organic and suitable even for human consumption if you like it as a tea.The Sojos brand (1oz can) is the most expensive - by my calculations comes to over a hundred dollars for 16oz!. The description says it produces a "harmless, euphoric state" but we saw no evidence of that. Smelled fresh but definitely a milder aroma than the other two brands; had the finest chopped leaves of the three. Hand harvested if that is important you or your cat.With the Cosmic Cat brand, we *may* have a winner.....When the camera was off, Tristan returned to the Cosmic Cat sample several times more so than the other brands. I repeated this little taste test for the next two days and Cosmic Cat had a small but definite edge over the competition. I'd have to say that I agree with his choice; the Cosmic Cat brand leaves are darker and more fragrant than the other two brands. The leaves are also cut just right - not too fine/not too large, and no stems or coarse pieces. I find the Cosmic Cat brand's price reasonable, the storage container is very convenient, and the 3oz* size is enough not to be too little and not so much to get stale and spoil.Hope you find this information useful in choosing for your own cat or kitten.

My immediate reaction was to contact Amazon for a return label. But the site said food products were not returnable. I decided to call because I thought that there was significant misrepresentation of the product and that they would make an exception for that. Then I discovered that Amazon no longer takes phone calls to Customer Service!!! While I am surprised and a bit unhappy that Amazon has cut off calls to Customer Service, their "no return policy" on foods bothers me even more because the result is that anyone who calls their product a food gets a free pass on the requirement for an accurate description of the item. In the case of these cashews, the picture in the product description shows the nuts inside the container very  clearly, whereas they are barely visible through the  oil film on the inside of the package.  Well, I decided to try to make the best of it, so I emptied the nuts onto paper towels, as the reviewer mentioned above had done. and dried them off as well as I could. Unfortunately, the remaining oil had an old taste that was definitely not pleasant. column9: Bit of a Let-Down for an Earl Grey
column10: ***Tazo's Earl Grey Black Tea is very perfumy. I am used to drinking super-premium tea that have the real bergamot added, not the essence. So this tea tasted to me like regular black tea with a very, very strong bergamot-like flavor. I definitely did not care for it, although I love Earl Grey teas in general. On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "a more aromatic version of the Earl's traditional black tea scented with the essence of bergamot"; therein lies the problem---a little too perfumy and scented for me. On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Passion as "floral, lavender, fragrant, spicy, lemon". Tazo describes the aroma as "citrus, lavender, light smoke". You may like it; apparently the other reviewers so far do, but it is not for me at all.Also, be careful of letting this tea brew too long accidently. Even a few minutes too long results in a bitter, bitter tea, reminiscent of orange pekoe with a strong perfume added. What a letdown! Even properly brewed, though, this tea cannot, in my opinion, warrant more than three stars.The ingredients in Earl Grey are just black teas and bergamot essence. Note that Earl Grey does contain caffeine.Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.Instead of Tazo's Earl Grey, I would highly recommend Numi Earl Grey, which does not disappoint in any way and is comparable in cost. It too can be bought in bulk at the time of this review on Amazon.***

Earl Grey tea has an interesting history. Legend has it that the first tea scented with bergamot oil was presented to Lord Grey from a Chinese mandarin whose son was saved from drowning by one of Lord Grey's men. Twinings and Jacksons of Piccadilly both claim to be the first to have commercially blended this tea.
