And I mean boiling, not almost boiling.If you want to do it perfectly, give the tea leaves plenty of space - tea eggs are not the best choice to get the most flavorful taste. Ideally you will want to let the leaves float freely in the pot and then, after steeping, pour the tea through a strainer. But large tea filters also work. Examples are: swissgold® TF 300 Tea Filter or Finum 100 Tea Filters - Large (Make your own Teabags)3. SteepingRule of thumb: Steeping tea for less than 3 minutes will have a slight wake-up effect, more than 3 minutes (I usually do 3.5 minutes with this tea) will activate the "calmer" side of teas.I recommend Taylors of Harrogate Earl Grey whole-heartedly - but I guess that is self-evident, too! :-)
This is a very distinctively flavored earl grey -- very heavy on the bergamot...not for the faint of heart. It is my very favorite breakfast tea.

column9: One sip and you'll be hooked!
column10: The best Earl Grey you'll ever taste. First discovered it taking tea at the Four Seasons tea room in Washington, D.C. The aroma of bergamont oil will draw you in initially, but one sip and you'll be hooked. You'll never go back to bagged supermarket tea again...

column9: Taylors of Harrogate Earl Grey Tea
column10: I confess ... I'm not a tea connoisseur; but I do enjoy iced tea and the occasional cup of hot tea.  I've had a couple of orders of this Taylors of Harrogate Earl Gray tea and I really LOVE the additional zing it adds to my iced tea blend (3 family sized bags decaf tea, 4 regular bags green tea, and a generous helping of earl gray in those bags you can get from Amazon for tea and fill with whatever you like.  I think I have it on auto-ship.  I live in Florida, so we have iced tea year round.  Lovely fragrance and taste!  It comes in a foiled (is that a word?) plastic bag in a tin.  I keep it in the original bag, folded over and sealed with a clamp, in the tin and have not noticed any loss in fragrance or flavor.  The tin is very nice and, of course, re-usable.

Great taste and good amount of tea for the price. I have recommended this exact product to several friends and purchased Taylor's of Harrogate Earl Grey from Amazon 3 times now. Loose leaf is the way to go when drinking tea. It allows you to experiment with amounts, steep times, and temperatures more easily, so you can make the cup that is perfect to your own personal taste preference.Taylor's of Harrogate ships at a decent speed and tastes great.Plus the tin cans can be used for any type of craft thingy once they are empty, if you are into that sort of thing.

This Earl Grey tea is just ok.  The bergamont flavor is muted and dull which caught me by surprise.  I was expecting better from this product as it is marketed and packaged as high end.  Also, the tea leaves are broken and not full leaves.

column9: smelled good but tasted bitter/see revision
column10: We have been drinking loose earl grey tea for several years & this is not one of our favorites.It smells good but taste bitter & is best mixed with another Earl grey tea.7/30/11 Changed mind, after trying it awhile it seem to improve in taste. Maybe after havinga little air mixed with it made a difference ( like wine).

I really like several teas of Taylors of Harrogate, so I decided to try their Earl Grey. I was really disappointed: although the tea did smell deliciously of bergamot, there was no taste to it to speak of. Now, I can only drink it mixed with other Earl Grey teas to have a nice combination of taste and smell (and can recommend it in this capacity).

I found this Earl Grey to be a bit undecided, if that makes sense.  Although it smells beautifully of bergamot in the can, once brewed it's too weak for a flavored black tea but too strong compared to a green or white e.g. Teavana's Earl Grey White which has a lighter flavor but has a balance of its own.  Taylor's just doesn't have much body nor flavor and lacks a defined character.  No matter what, it always tastes "watered down".  It gets a bit better with 1.5 tsp per 8oz but it's still unbalanced.  I brew for 3 min.  If you like flavored teas on the "lite" side you might enjoy it.  It's somewhat similar to Lady Grey which I found too weak as well.
This tea tastes too much like bergamot for my taste.  I much prefer Twining's blend.  That being said, this tea isn't bad.

column9: Not as fresh as I expected.
column10: I love Sunkist Fruit Gems.  I was disappointed though in this purchase, none of the fruit gems are soft, they are hard and they aren't supposed to be.  The expiration date is far enough ahead that they should be fresher. I bought 12 boxes so I am not really happy about it.

This is very overpriced. Chinese markets used to sell them for 75 cents a can, but because of their popularity in New York they now sell them for around 2.50 a can. It is very salty, and you can even eat the bones. It sounds strange, but if you like salty goodness then you will LOVE this black bean fish.
this product was awsome;it is rich in colour and taste.it was delevired on time,and it was well packed.I loved it.if anyone wants a good quality of bottarga,he should try this one .

One of our favorite meals is a great steak with A1 Bold and Spicey. We were so disappointed when our Safeway stopped carrying it. Can't seem to find it in Oregon. Allow me to be a name dropper...  A1 Bold and Spicey  2 Omaha Private Reserve Filets  1 box Uncle Bens Wild Rice and Mushroom mix  JG Giants petite brussle sprouts w/maple bacon  Pepperidge Farm 5 cheese garlic breadAll these flavors together are just perfect. Naturally the Steaks are char grilled and the brussel sprouts are roasted. I don't care how great your steak is, it only get's better with A1.
I really enjoyed this coffee - it's full-flavored and not too heavy or acidic. A great holiday coffee to compliment a dessert or to drink on its own.
I purchased this coffee during holiday discounts.  It has a wonderful flavor.  Strong, so I mix it with my regular coffee to have it last longer!

This coffee is a good blend, but nothing spectacular.  The fact that it is organic and fair trade are the main reason I order it, though of course it also has to be a tasty enough product.  I add a dash of cinnamon during teh brewing process, and that livens it up a bit.

Opening this coffee bag didn't fill my kitchen with a strong vanilla-cinnamon aroma.  Nor did the bag emit much of a strong scent.  But once I tasted this medium roast I could tste the cinnamon.  It wasn't an overbearing taste, either, but just strong enough to be aware of the spice.  I couldn't even taste much vanilla.  So, for those of you who prefer vanilla over cinnamon, there may be other brands or flavors better for you.  For those of you who like a nicely-spiced coffee, though, this is a great blend.Just like the bag states, this is low acid coffee. The grounds are medium brown. I used this coffee in my cappuccino maker and created a mild espresso drink, with a bit of crema, flavored with cinnamon.  It wasn't too strong and definitely not bitter.  I like the subtle flavors of this blend very much.I've had other Bean Coffee flavors and like them all for their consistent roasts and flavors.  This seasonal drink is another such blend to add to Bean Coffee's quality roasts.  It's an ideal coffee for a cold winter afternoon, when one wants to sit back and savor a coffee for its flavor, rather than for its jolt.

I am really enjoying my deliveries of this ground organic coffee.The flavor is delicious and with the lower acidity I get to enjoy coffee even more than before. I will continue to order and enjoy this for a long time.
This is a wonderful flavored coffee without the fake chemical taste and smell. We like to drink it any time of the year and look forward to trying more coffee from this company as well.

I love this coffee, the brand and the flavor. It's one of the smoothest cups of coffee I've ever had. It does have a pretty strong cinnamon flavor, but unlike some other flavored coffees, it doesn't taste artificial. I will definitely be buying this brand again.

The coffee has a very "coffee-ey" flavor which is by no means overpowered by the hint of vanilla and spice.  It tastes like an expensive cup of coffee but the low acid is really smooth going down (and it doesn't taste bitter the next day).highly recommend this to anyone that just likes good coffee!and for people who are skeptical of flavored coffees which can often taste very artificial this one is subtle and only hints at some vanilla and spice which pleasantly waft when you brew a fresh cup!

This coffee has a lot of flavor and brews perfectly.  I don't like dark coffee and this coffee is is not too dark.  It has a lot of flavor.  I bought it when it was on sale, otherwise it is too expensive.  When I bought it I expected it to be whole bean, but is is actually ground coffee.  Its good year round, not just during the holidays.

I loved this coffee! I kept one bag and gave the other bag away as a Christmas present. The flavor is gentle and the coffee is low acid, so it is also easy on the stomach. I would definitely buy this coffee again!
This is an excellent blend for the holiday season.  My son has a problem with certain coffee blends and the low acid in this blend is perfect for him.  I would highly recommend this product.

I ordered during the gold box deal (was about half price or so).  This is good coffee, not great, not bad.  The vanilla-cinnamon spice flavor is just right, not too strong or overpowering.  I would not re-order at the regular price but would consider it again at half price.

I picked up 2 cases of Reese Artichokes on a Friday Sale.  These and Reese Artichoke Hearts, Extra Small Size, 14-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12).  Both were well worth what I paid at an average of $.99 a can, compared to $3+ in my local grocery store.These are great chopped up and added to salads, but my favorite way to eat them is to top them with a stuffing and bake.  This is an easy one:3 Slices French bread cubed2 Artichoke bottoms chopped1 clove garlic minced1/8 cup fresh parsley chopped1/4 cup Romano cheese grated1/2 tsp dried Italian Seasoning5 tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil1/2 cup chicken brothsalt and pepper to tasteCombine everything except 3 tablespoons of oil, top each Artichoke Bottom with a couple spoonfuls of mixture.  Then drizzle remaining oil over them. I also sprinkle on a little extra cheese.  Bake for 15 minutes at 425*F.

I was injured early this summer so I've had to turn to the internet and the mail to get the vegetables I used to be able to buy fresh.  I was amazed to find these at such a great price, but I should have remembered, that you get what you pay for.I've used two of the cans of the 12 I bought and both cans had the same problea. The bottoms are from old, woody artichokes and are very poorly cleaned.  Once you scrape off all the inedible woody tissue, you only have about 40% usable artichoke meat.  I won't be purchasing these again.

column4: FOREVER student of Life:D "Always learning co...
column10: Wonderful to NOT have the leaves to deal with and to ALWAYS have to spit out, just have the "meat"
The product did arrive very quickly.  However, the artichokes seemed hard and looked very old.  They had a rust color on the product itself.  Would not order again.

I adore artichokes, but waiting for them to cook and then cleaning all the thistle bits out just doesn't fit into most weekdays for me (or most other people, I assume).  These artichoke bottoms taste great and are super convenient and versatile.  I personally use them most frequently to make a healthy, low carb version of eggs benedict - simply grill or saute two artichoke bottoms and use them in place of the English muffin (and leave off that hollandaise, hehe).  As other reviewers mentioned, they are also great for stuffing and baking.  There are about 6 bottoms in each can, although sometimes you get only 5 if they're larger, as it's based on weight.

Bottoms are the best part of the artichoke.  With fresh artichokes you have to go to a lot of trouble to get rid of the choke and the leaves. These are ready to go.  Just drain the liquid from the can - heat and serve - or use them right out of the can without heating.  I like them sprinkled with onion powder and a little salad dressing.  I use a home made dressing of lemon juice, dried mustard and agave syrup.  One review complained that the artichokes were woody.  On occasion, I have found a little woodiness in one or two out of the whole can.  It is easy to cut that part out.  The woodiness is a fairly rare problem.  If you like artichokes but  hate the work and mess of preparation - this is for you.

While I don't particularly care for the citric and/or ascorbic acid  found in cans and jars of artichokes (Reese has no more or no less than others), my sister, who is an artichoke nut, loves the taste. Gives it a summery tang she says. That these are different from the fresh artichokes she scarfs down doesn't bother her in the least. She is rapidly going through the case of Reese I bought in no time (she really likes the convenience). So, even though canned artichokes aren't my favorite, they rate 5 stars.

These are dreadfully expensive at the store, but bearable here on Amazon. Dice them in salads, they are divine sliced on a turkey sandwich or topped with cous cous.  I haven't done it yet, but I'm going to top them with crab salad and I bet they will be great cold or browned under the broiler. Release your inner creative chef with these!

I love artichokes in recipes and this was a good value when purchased.  These work great in recipes in lieu of the actual canned artichokes, which can be tough and stringy.  The hearts are a great substitute and I am happy with the purchase.

I bought a case of these for a very small amount of money $12.64 but it was still to much. I opened one can and frankly these are really funky, but they might make a good mini-frisbee! If you do not want flavor, you have found your dream food.

I love using artichoke hearts in dishes.  These were awful!! The texture was gritty, tough, quite simply awful.  I gave the cans away to friends, all of which said they were nasty. Do not waste you time nor your money.

I love artichokes, and although not as nice as fresh, these are delicious! They are quite large and make a very good low calorie healthy snack that can be filled with many different items. Cerainly quick and easy to prepare!

These artichoke bottoms are HUGE and TOUGH! I'm wondering if they're even real, because they don't taste real!  I ordered a whole case of 12 and I wish I could return them, but I've already opened 2 of the cans.  I would not recommend them to anyone who loves artichokes!

I order these to make "Artichoke Bottoms" appetizer. I have ordered them to be delivered across the country for family gatherings so I don't have to worry if I can find them locally.4 cans Artichoke bottoms - rinse and dry3 cups grated fresh parmesan cheese - or buy shredded in deli1 cup mayo6 cloves garlic - finely minced4 teaspoons FRESH lemon juice4 teaspoons lemon zest1/2 cup pine nuts - coarsely choppedPut bottoms in cookie sheet with sides - make sure they lie flat, may have to slice a little off bottoms. Combine Parmesan cheese, mayo, garlic, lemon juice and lemon zest. Mound mixture into bottoms. Sprinkle with pine nuts. Bake 20 or so min at 350. If bottoms are large, you can cut into halves or forths for easier eating by guests. Tip: you can fix the bottoms, make the mixture, fill the bottoms before guests arrive. Sprinkle with nuts and bake. Very rich, very good, easy to make...M.C.

While doing a search on Amazon I was pleased to find the Artichoke Bottoms. I use them to make a stuffed Appetizer. They are sometimes difficult to find. Stores that once carried them no longer do. As a person who enjoys entertaining I like to serve different types of items. These can be used in a variety of ways. The price was very fair so I purchased two cases so I won't have the problem of trying to locate them for some time. But it's great to know that I can simply go on line and get them anytime I need to. Bill Connelly

column9: Delicious.  great shipping price from amazon
column10: Excellent delivery time. Great product.Entertain quite a bit.  My most popular dish has artichokes..Have them always on hand.
Very good and easy to use in receipes.  Unusual, but one of my cans was not artichokes.  Fluke at the factory, I'm sure.
We like any kind of artichoke in my family, but the bottoms are so easy to include in anything.  Salad, Spaghetti Sauce, roasted veg, etc.  I use them as a bulking agent with class.

column9: Best barbeque sauce I've ever had!
column10: I must be honest. I did not buy this off amazon the first time but they dont sell it around my house so I HAD TO find somewhere to get it from. its the perfect mix of flavor and heat. Iv never had a better sauce.

Don't waste your money on these cups...buy the packets and use you Keurigs smallest cup size (5.25 oz.) The packets are much cheaper and have real sugar.  These DO use an artificial sweetener and you WILL notice, especially in the aftertaste.  I have used 3-4 of these cups in the last week or so, then made some straight from a packet I already had...the packet was 100 times better.

column9: Best hot chocolate k-cup I've tried yet
column10: I have tried a number of hot chocolate cups in the past. All of them have had the same, soy-like aftertaste that always ruined the experience.The Swiss Miss cups have no soy (I just double-checked the label), only milk (powdered). The taste is quite chocolatey with a pleasant aftertaste. On the six-ounce brew setting, the flavor is quite rich.If you have been looking for a good hot chocolate for your Keurig, and found others wanting, you may want to give these a try.

Delicious!  I'm not a coffee drinker, but I love my mom's Keruig.  These K-cups are the best hot chocolate I have come across.  I make the 8oz. cup and it's so rich and delicious.  The perfect cup of hot chocolate.  I would totally recommend these for anyone looking for a new K-cup of hot chocolate.

I tried the other Hot Cocoa K-cups and didn't care for them.  They had a funny aftertaste to them.  I purchased these and I LOVE THEM!  They taste like Hot Cocoa and no bad aftertaste.  I will be buying these again and again.
This has to be a joke. Seriously, who on earth would pay almost $2.00 per k-cup (with the shipping)? Not the fault of Swiss Miss which is good but go to Walmart or a local store and get it cheaper!

I was told that Swiss Miss is the only brand of hot chocolate K-Cups out there that does not use artificial sweeteners...NOT TRUE.  Although they DO use sugar, it ALSO has sucralose in it too!!!!  I checked in the grocery store, and even the packets of original Swiss Miss has sucralose!!!  I guess I will have to stick to home made, until I can find something out there that believes in using NATURAL sugar!

column9: Mediocre is the only appropriate word...
column10: One of the really big selling points of the Keurig brewer was that it produced hot beverages other than just coffee.  Teas, cappuccinos and hot chocolates were all available and we were eager to try them.  I did my research after we got our brewer for Christmas, though, and was really disappointed to read a pile of negative reviews for pretty much every hot chocolate brand available.The Swiss Miss hot chocolate was on sale at our local grocery store so we decided we had to try it.  It had ranked a little bit higher than most of the other brands so I held out hope that it would work out.  I brewed a small cup when we got home and gave it a shot.  The consistency that came out of the machine was nice and the consistency didn't seem watery.This tastes exactly like the no calorie Swiss Miss hot chocolate available in sleeves.  While you're drinking it, it tastes alright, but then it's followed by a very plasticy synthetic aftertaste.  There's no mistaking the artificial sweetener here and I can see how that would bother a lot of people, especially those with sensitive taste buds.I think we'll finish the rest of the box, but I'm not convinced we'll repurchase.  We'll probably just use the Keurig to prepare the water and then use traditional hot chocolate packets.

This was bought as a treat for the kids. You won't know it's a toxin until you receive the package and you read the ingredients. Amazon refunded my money and instructed me to dispose of the product.  I haven't found a single k cup that isn't coffee that has natural ingredients. I guess the Keurig is a coffee maker and nothing else.
Why in the world would you pay nearly double the price of the retail product?  You can find these in 12 packs at most grocery stores for $8.69 or less.

Well you're not going to get truly exceptional tasting hot chocolate from any K-cup but of the varieties I have tested so far, the Swiss Miss comes the closest to approximating the taste of rich, milk based hot chocolate.  To get the best experience, I recommend using the smallest brewing size and then I add additional milk to mine, this drastically improves the flavor and add a little whip cream and it works in a pinch.
This is the best hot chocolate for the Kurig I have tasted yet.  I had previously bought the Cafe milk chocolate ones, but I was not impressed with the flavor.  This one is definitely a winner!
This is one of the better k-cup hot chocolates but it still has the sweetener aftertaste that is shared by all the hot chocolate k-cups.

I was a little concerned after reading some of the reviews of various K-Cup hot cocoas, but I was pleasantly surprised that the Swiss Miss brand lived up to it's conventional powder-in-a-pouch brother.  I use it on the smaller cup settings, but that seems to be a perfect amount for the kids anyway.  The only "drawback" is that you should run a small cup cycle without a K-Cup just to rinse out the equipment before your next cup of something different.  You aren't brewing here, just mixing, so it does leave a little cocoa in the cup basket.  Not a big deal.  Overall a hit!  Quick, tasty and no mess!

column9: Delicious but over the top price wise
column10: The Swiss chocolate was very good and my kids loved them however I didn't realize until after my wife purchased this item just how expensive it was per kcup! If you are looking for an occasional cup of hot choc for yourself this is fine but not for carnivourous kids.

column9: Tastes like plastic, waste of money
column10: These cups are not worth the minor convenience they provide.  The hot chocolate tastes like plastic... I can only assume it's a result of hot water hitting the plastic of the cup.  (Maybe the coffee ones don't give off this foul taste because of the filter inside?  I don't know.)  I can't even finish using the cups in the intended way; rather, I have taken to peeling off the foil, dumping the mix into my mug, and running a cycle of just water through the Keurig.  Nearly as simple, without the nasty taste.  I won't be buying these again.  I'll stick to using the normal packets and running aforementioned cycle of just water.Don't waste your money.

These swiss miss k cups don't really work, there is at least 1/3 of the chocolate powder left in the k cup. I tried tapping the cup to get things stirred up before placing it in the machine, no luck. The hot chocolate is weak even on the smallest setting. It also has a bit of an aftertaste. I'll keep looking, this one is not a keeper.
The hot chocolate is good. But you just can't beat warming up a cup of milk & using it to make your hot chocolate! But that being said, this is great for a quick cup of cocoa though.

column9: If you like chocolate you will like this.
column10: I purchased this for my 10 year old daughter to enjoy while Im have a decaf coffee and she loves it.  It is very chocolatey and she enjoys it very much.

I agree with some of the other reviewers in that the artificial sweetener taste is kind of off putting. It would be nice to find a K cup that is plain old hot cocoa powder, without all the other STUFF in it.
This is very tasty!  We have tried otherk cup hot chocolates and feel this is the best option.
For K-cup Hot Chocolate this is my favorite. It is just as good, if not better than the regular packet Hoc Chocolate.

I ordered what I thought was a really good deal of Swiss Miss K cups for 19.99. they stated that there were 44 cups on sale. Great! When the package got to our house there were only 12. I don't know who made the mistake or the company just wanted to get more sales but Amazon gave me my money back.
This is the best hot chocolate that I have found for the Keurig. If you have tried others, and been disappointed, you may want to try this one.
I am so glad that Swiss Miss has the K-cup products. I have one every morning as I do not drink coffee :0) Perfect amount of flavor. Not to watery and not to strong.

column9: Not as good as Cafe Escapes
column10: I actually purchased these retail at the local grocery store just to try them.  Cafe Escapes have a more chocolate taste on the 6oz brew, and was pretty weak, lots of clumping fat content, even when mixed with coffee or brewed at highest temperature. Will only buy these our of desperation.
Hands down the best hot chocolate to date for the Keurig universe. Sweet, creamy and super tasty. I enjoy it with a splash of Caramel creamer (milk/cream natural creamer, not oils)
$59 for 12 k-cups? This is totally ridiculous. Surely this is a typo! Who would pay $5 per k-cup for this or anything else like it?

column9: Great service but a little pricey
column10: My kids love Swiss Miss hot chocolate, but I get tired of cleaning up the mess when they make it using the microwave.  So I figured this would be a convenient way to keep the kids happy, and it is.  My kids love the flavor, there's no mess to clean up, and Beverage Depot was easy to work with and fast.  The problem I have is this is not economical.  I'd rather keep cleaning up the mess (or better yet, teach the kids how to do it) and save some money in the process.

I'm disappointed that there are not really good hot chocolate K-Cups.  The Cafe Escapes hot chocolate was awful.  The Swiss Miss K-Cups are better, but still not something I will purchase again.  The aroma is pleasant, as is the initial taste.  At 8 ounces, the drink was a bit weak and watery so this is probably best used at 6 ounces.  There is a definite aftertaste of artificial sweetener; while it is not strong, it does linger.
Very good cocoa.  Just got my Keurig for Christmas and I can't tell you how much I am enjoying a nice cup of cocoa in the evening at the end of the day...and this is great cocoa!

column9: You know how you use 2 packets for one mug of cocoa...
column10: Well you can't use 2 K-cups.  It comes out very weak no matter which size mug you set the keurig.  The K-cups are way more expensive also.  No real point in buying them.
I am really happy that they started making k-cups from their products. I enjoy this greatly, and recommend it to anyone that has a k-cup machine.
bought this for my wife and she loves it! The k-cups make it easy and fast. The taste is great.

column9: Just as awesome as the regular packets!
column10: Okay so I found out about these two weeks ago when my mother brought them home from our local Hanford's supermarket. I have to say is that they taste amazing! I think they out rank in my books the cafe escapes because of the taste quality they bring. Now everyone has a different opinion because it's proven that everyone's taste buds are not the same (even in genetics of people i the same family!), so my opinion could differ due to just our own taste buds.Anyway, my point is, I think these k-cups are great! The only issue I have is this: they need to package mini marshmallows into each box, attached to the bottom of each k-cup lol this way everyone can have marshmallows or not just like the original packages. Other than that, the recipe for this flavor of k-cup hot chocolate is awesome! Worth the money :)

I recently bought the Mr. Coffee Keurig. I wanted my family to take advantage of it so I got the kids the Hot Cocoa by Swiss Miss because they love there hot cocoa. It is very hard to find so when I found them made by Swiss Miss in K-cups it was a Win Win! Shipment was fast and received right on time. Note when making a cup: You should not use a full cup of water when brewing the cocoa because it will be too watery with no taste. But once we got the right amount of water the kids where fine and enjoyed it. I would buy again, good product!
It tastes watered down and gross. I tried the k cups a few different ways, and even after using 2 k cups for 1 cup of hot chocolate it had a watered down flavor. Just use the regular packets instead.
Are they saying a pack of 12 k cups is on sale from almost $60 down to over $20?!?!?!?!?! Please tell me it's at least 10 boxes for this price.

Only marginally better than the Cafe Escapes line, which isn't saying much. This still tastes like salty a** juice and contains artificial sweetener, along with a myriad of other chemicals. But it contains real non-fat dry milk, ooh!This product tastes very little like a prepared packet of Swiss Miss. Hot chocolate from a packet is not my favorite, but it is way better than this... and cheaper per cup, last time I checked. Save your money and take the extra two seconds to stir one into a hot water cycle from your Keurig. Your tastebuds will thank you.

column9: Great "wheat berries", i.e. whole kernel wheat
column10: I recently received a Vitamix Blender, and have been experimenting with using it to grind my own flour at home. Once you have tried *real* whole grain flour, you will never go back! The pricing of this 25 pound bag, with delivery, is better than I have been able to find anywhere, and the grains make a great, strong whole-grain flour. Note that this is not flour, but actual wheat seeds (often referred to as "wheat berries").In addition, the grains are fertile, meaning that you can use them to make sprouted grain. Or if you are a survivalist, you can plant the grains and actually grow a crop!Another main advantage of whole grain is its shelf life. There are reports that 2000 year old grain has been found and germinated! In any case, if properly stored, you can expect a 5-10 year shelf life from whole grain, as opposed to a much shorter shelf life with flour. I purchsed a 5-gallon bucket with a "gamma 2" lid for storing the grain, and I'm confident that it will keep nicely fresh for a long time to come.

column9: Great River Organic Wheat - Great grain at a great price!
column10: I decided to grind my own flour because in our two person household, the bags of flour go stale before I can use it all.  I also store grain now for long term storage because the economy in our area has declined, as a hedge against inflation and unemployment.  I was very impressed with Great River Organic Milling Hard Red Wheat and Soft White Wheat berries.  I called the customer service number before purchasing the grain to ask about issues related to long term storage - when the grain was harvested and how long it had been in storage - so that I could put proper dating for use on it when it arrived.  All the grain was the new crop grain, having been harvested August, 2011.  I had also ordered rye berries, and was concerned how long rye could be stored, using "superpails" with mylar bags/oxygenators/dessicants.  They answered all my questions thoroughly.  They even told me the best days to place my order so that I would have the best selection and price on Amazon!  I was very impressed with their customer service department.  I also had concerns that the grain be clean and free of bad kernels or any mold, mildew, or extraneous matter, as my husband was on the heart transplant list and after transplant suppressed immune response is an issue.  The rye and wheat was absolutely beautiful.  I saw no broken or bad grains at all, no chaff or foreign matter, and the products were essentially dust free.  All in all, I was very happy with the rye and wheat I purchased. Great River Organic Milling normally has free super saver shipping for their products on Amazon. Shipping was easy to track and extremely fast:  I ordered my grain on a Friday evening around 7PM, and by Saturday 4PM the next day I had my grain, even though I had been told it may take 5-7 days to get the shipment.  Great job!  I will be ordering more!
25# of wheat seems like a lot when you're trying to find a place for it!  Nevertheless, buying it this way is much cheaper because I can sprout it, grind it & grow it--and do.

column9: Great River Organic Milling Red Spring Hard Wheat
column10: GREAT product taste is wonderful bread the wheat berrys are clean no dust or dirt in it.Its is A great product I will surly buy again and from great river milling co I know I can Trust there product. THANK YOU and AMAZON.

column9: Makes fantastic home-made whole wheat bread
column10: I've made several loaves of home-made whole wheat bread with this hard red spring wheat and am thrilled with the taste and flavor.  The wheat berries are very clean, and even taste good just pinching a few to snack on.  Will buy from again.

column9: So happy I started grinding my own grain!
column10: This product is wonderful! I don't have anything to compare it to, other than comparing freshly ground wheat flour from these berries and store bought wheat flour. My husband and I were previously buying wheat flour from our coop in the bulk section but had been wanting to get a grain grinder to start grinding our own wheat for nutritional value and freshness. When I grind this wheat to use for bread etc, it performs so much better than the already ground store bought flour. I had much better lift in yeast bread I made a couple weeks ago! I pretty much bake everything from scratch: our sandwich bread, cornbread, granola (that has a little bit of flour in it), desert breads, cakes, hamburger buns etc., so I just keep this in half gallon mason jars on top of some shelves. They look nice and since 8 cups of whole berries makes about 12 cups of flour, it really saves space too. I called several local food stores and could not find anyone who could beat this price. This shipped so fast that I couldn't imagine what was in the box. I will be ordering again!
We received this product in great anticipation and we were greatly pleased in the wonderful texture and taste of the many loaves of bread we made!!

column9: Great River organic Hard Red Spring Wheat
column10: This organic hard red spring wheat berries produces very good tasting whole wheat bread. It came packaged well, the wheat is clean and ready to mill. It can easily be put in smaller freezer bags to freeze and it keeps very well that way. The price was affordable compared to other brands where you have to pay shipping and handling.

The grain was very fresh--the main problem was that I did not realize it was not the flour but the whole grain!  I had to find someone to grind it for me.  The bread was GREAT and the rise was nice and high--it had a fresh wheat taste.  The next time I would be sure to order the flour.

column4: E. Wenck "Spicy food is best food."
column9: Great quality grains at amazing price.
column10: I was very pleased by this purchase.  I ordered this as well as other grains from Great River for use in my porridge which is healthy, cheap and tasty.  I have cooked them up in my rice steamer as well as stove top and they come out with great texture as well as flavor.  I would buy them more frequently if they didn't last so long.  (Review used for each grain as I am equally impressed with each)
so long as the shipping costs are reasonable, this is a great grain at a great price.  make sure you have a good mill

I'm sure that the wheat is fine but when I received it, it was torn open and some of the wheat was lost.  Great River did a good job of packing it but during transit it received brutal treatment.  I know its probably not the companies fault in any way but I DO NOT WISH TO PURCHASE THIS PRODUCT AGAIN. Sincerely, Denny Moore
This is a black tea flavored with mint so there is caffine.  POOR description!!!!!!!!!  Tea is nice though and not too bitter.  Just wish they had a more accurate description.  :(

This tea tastes fine and is cheap etc. There is very little information on the box/label, however, and after some research I have discovered that rather than a typical peppermint tea (which is technically not tea but 'tisane') this is in fact black ceylon tea with peppermint added. That means it contains caffeine. FYI.
Have tried many pepermint teas.  This Dalfour tea is the best tasting peppermint ever.  It is mild and yet minty.  Plus, it is organic.

I love tea. There, I said it. I need a 12-step program for my tea addiction. I've tried lots and lots of different teas, and St. Dalfour's mint tea is the best mint tea I've had. Bigelow's Plantation Mint comes in second, and it's nice, but the St. Dalfour tea is subtle, not overpowering. The mint is there, but it's not too sweet and it's not too strong. This is a nice blend of black tea and peppermint, wonderfully balanced. I recommend it highly.

I've found this chocolate to be a great solution for my low carbohydrate diet.  This chocolate only has 5g net carbs per serving, but I find half a serving to be plenty satisfying for a chocolate fix.  Also, this has no artificial sweeteners, so I don't have to worry about digestive problems.If you don't like dark chocolate, you won't like this.  But if you're willing to savor the cocoa flavor, this is a great way to eat a small amount of chocolate without a lot of sugar.

This WAS a great product. It was great tasting and it had a crazy low amount of carbs compared to most anything else out there. For people who need to manage their carb intake, this was a real treat and there wasn't much else out there that compared. There is, I found on receiving my latest shipment, a new formula and the carb count has almost doubled from 8g per serving to 15g. This might not matter to most people but for some it can be a critical issue. I imagine it still tastes great with all the extra sugar and milk or whatever they've added but, unfortunately, this product no longer serves the niche it once did. Where it once was this great-tasting, low-carb indulgence, it's now just one of ten million sugary things out there.

These chocolate bars are made with 85% extra dark chocolate.  You have to acquire a taste for it because the darker the chocolate, the less sugar it contains. You have to acquire a taste for it because when you taste it for the first time, it has a slightly bitter taste. It took me less than a week to start enjoying the taste. Now, I find I don't care for regular chocolate because it's too sweet. It's also a much healthier chocolate to eat.

column4: FOREVER student of Life:D "Always learning co...
column10: This is my favorite Chocolate!!I hope they re-stock soon!!Not for Kids or Adults that like milk kind!!Kids usually hate this kind. It's good for you, that's probably why!I also like Dagoba Organic Dark Chocolate - New Moon , 74% cocoa, 12 Units / 2 ozmore cocoa the better for heart:0Don't have Coffee or Chocolate anymore :D
This is excellent chocolate. However, the bulk price here of over $3 a bar is high. Stores local to me sell it for $2.30, and that's not in bulk.

column9: Great for your Health and Delicious Too
column10: I bought these bars because of their high content of Cocoa and I have been very pleased with them. I drop a piece in my coffee every morning and makes the coffee tastes great. In the afternoon I use another square and let it melt slowly in my mouth as I drink tea.  These are two delicious ways to use this healthy chocolate.

column9: Lindt 85% from Amazon came in the original formula
column10: I ordered a 12-pack of the Lindt 85% cacao chocolate bars from Amazon in January... They are my favorite variety.... the 90% is too bitter for me, while the 70% has too much sugar. But the 85% is just right...and perfect for slowly melting in your mouth... And supposedly good for you health too, if taken in moderation.But despite some of the comments above, the box I received had the same (good) formulation for the 85% bars that I've seen in the past -- 5g of protein and 5g of sugar per serving size (four squares), along with 15g of carbohydrates (5%).I find I'm really satisfied by eating just two squares after lunch... And taking each square, and snapping it into four smaller pieces, thus eight small pieces in total... Letting each piece slowly melt in my mouth tastes great and is very satisfying as well.

column9: Love the chocolate,  but not the price
column10: This chocolate is heavenly! It is dark and creamy and melts in your mouth. It leaves a pleasant taste you mouth when it is gone.  My only problem is stopping at just one square.It has an exquisite taste!Amazon is always my first shopping stop - usually the price and convenience of buying on line cannot be beat.  However, in the last year the price on these bars went way up.  I use a nice tool that allows me to see a history of product price for the past year, you can find it by searching for price history alert and selecting the one that has the word camel in its name.  I find it very useful.On the positive price in terms of price, I discovered that Lindt Stores sometimes have a shelve with 'seconds' which means the mixture of ingredients is a bit off but you cannot detect the difference in the taste unless you are a professional taster. I could not. These seconds go for 10 bars for $15. Can't beat that for a totally amazing chocolate.

Eat a total half square a day for a chocolate fix (1/8 the quoted "serving").As you get used to it (it's bitter compared to what you might be used to) you can eat more at a time, but that only raises the daily price without increasing satisfaction, and adding a few more calories.The bar costs about the same at Kroger grocery.UPDATE: bars arrive pre-broken some of the time, not that it matters.  You're going to break them anyway.  They're well packed so it's not obvious how UPS manages to do this.

column9: This is the best dark chocolate ever
column10: This chocolate is not as bitter as you would expect for its coco percentage. It is smooth and has a nice snap. Do not get this if you don't like rich dark chocolate.

I'm a newbie to the world of high cocoa chocolate bars. I got one of these at my local grocery for $2, amazed they'd carry such a high end product, it's a very small store. My only previous purchase was a box of Chocolove 77% bars from Amazon. I've consumed one of a dozen bars.In comparing the two products, the only significant difference is the noticeable aftertaste of the Lindt bar which was not present with the Chocolove product. I'm talking several hours later after I'd brushed my teeth and gone to bed, still an aftertaste.Otherwise, both were very smooth with a rich chocolate taste. I chased the Lindt bar with a couple of dark Hershey kisses, amazing how sweet a Hershey kiss is after eating some high cocoa chocolate.Two other observations:1- A 3.5 ounce bar is huge. One bar is good for at least three servings for me. YMMV.2- The Lindt bar had a sealed foil wrapper, whereas the Chocolove bar had a folded paper and foil cover with no real seal.
Tastes great. Really low sugar. So tastes really great given the low sugar content.What else is there to say?

If you're looking for some dark chocolate, you may want to try Lindt.  It's smooth, silky and tasty.  Now that nutritionists recommend an ounce of dark chocolate with 60-70% or above cocoa a day, chocolate doesn't have to be a guilty pleasure. It's a non-guilty pleasure.  After all, chocolate is a vegetable, as a friend pointed out.  Chocolate is a bean.It's great for an after dinner treat and I find I can eat a piece or two of this bar without wanting the whole bar at once.  It's wonderful flavor and smooth texture.

I didn't love this chocolate.  I bought it to try as an alternative to Endangered Species 88% Extreme Dark because it contains a teeny bit of soy and I'm trying to avoid all soy.  Compared to the latter, you can definitely taste the cocoa powder in this bar... tastes like hot cocoa in the back of my throat; not a bad thing necessarily just not a true and rich/ bitter dark chocolate.  Probably more pleasing to the American palate, but I think I'll risk the 2% soy for the delicious taste of Endangered Species and cross my fingers that they'll eventually find an equally delicious formula sans soy!

This is my favorite chocolate bar! Looking at the particulars, it's sugar content is much lower then most other makers. On a sugar restricted diet, this is MUCH better then regular chocolate, (sometimes 22-30gm sugar vs 85% with 6-7 grams). The choice to me is do you want a bar of sugar with chocolate flavor or the rich taste of cocoa? It is an acquired taste, but easily so. I now find regular chocolate is too sweet and tastes of sugar, The only drawback is that it is more expensive here on Amazon, I get it locally at about $2.20 a bar. So shop!

column9: Exellence Extra Dark and Delicious.Good for the heart as medical reported.
column10: The taste is better and healthier than other dark chocolate with lots of sugar that we used to buy in Dept. Stores.It is my first choice for dark chocolate.Definity ordering again.

Just started the Primal Blueprint diet and dark chocolate of 85% or more is allowed in moderation.  This chocolate is smooth, and yummy.  I melt it down and mix with almonds or macadamia, spread in a pan, then top with sea salt.  Throw it in the fridge and I have chocolate bark!  Delicious!!

If you're used to super milky, super sugary US style chocolate and have no previous experience with dark chocolate please buy a single bar of this from somewhere and try it.If you enjoy espresso coffee and red wine this will be right up your alley. The delicious bittersweet taste is divine. The chocolate is not over sweetened but does have a very slight vanilla(?) taste.If you're new to dark chocolate try starting with a 60% dark and work your way to perfection.

I personally prefer dark chocolate with cocoa over 75%. As the percentage goes up, however, they add more sugars into it as not many people can stand the "original" taste. The 85% one is a balanced option.

There is not enough sugar for most people to consider this the best tasting chocolate ever, but for a serious chocolate lover, this is the best there is.  The ratio of protein to sugar in this is the highest of any chocolate I've seen that is not 100% cocoa. The amount of protein in it lets you know how much real cocoa is in it.  My rule is to never eat anything that contains more sugar than protein, and this very nearly passes the test.  No other chocolate I've found even comes close.  It usually tastes better if you eat it a few months before the expiration date.

column9: Authentic Dark Chocolate for True Dark Lovers...
column10: Before you buy this item in a pack of 12 bars, make sure you buy one from CVS and try it first. This is truly an excellent chocolate of choice for people like myself who love their chocolate as dark as possible. I have always associated chocolate with M&Ms and Hersheys bars until I tried this variety. The richness is not comparable to anything you have ever tried. Lindt 85% is not particularly bitter, and comes with a hint of natural vanilla. It really gives me that fix when I need it.Some reviewer has noted the bitter after taste which does not wash off. That is true. Therefore, you must have previous dark chocolate experience before you make this purchase. It's not for everyone; just like coffee or liquor is not for everyone either.

I use this for making hot chocolate and it is pretty good (3 squares, 2tbsp sugar, 1/4tsp salt, 1 mug of water heated on stove). Check the price in your grocery store, last time I bought this at my grocery store it was $2.50 per bar, which is a little less than the price per bar of this 12 pack at the time of this writing.

I have always loved chocolate, very milky chocolate. Then I was diagnosed with a cow dairy allergy and thought I had to give up chocolate all together because I could never eat dark chocolate even with a very low percentage of cocoa, like the sugary dark chocolates. I was bold enough to try the 90% as my first dark chocolate bar and while it was way too bitter at first, it only took three squares before I was hooked. I loved the snap while also letting the square melt in my mouth. I started eating half a bar each day for a few weeks until I slowed myself down and had to switch to this 85% but it is still great. I also use it in baking cookies and it works really well. I usually order from whatever seller amazon lists on the product page, but wanted to comment on the direct shipment from amazon. I ordered these bars during 90 degree weather in southern CA and was worried they would arrive melted (couldn't resist, I needed my chocolate fix), but amazon shipped them with two ice packs surrounded by styrofoam at no additional charge. The packs were obviously melted by the time they arrived, but the chocolate was perfectly fine. Thank you amazon :).

column9: More Cocoa - less creamy but tastes great!
column10: Not a creamy chocolate - I like the edge - almost bitter taste in this chocolate - and not much sugar!  Unlike the other excellent lindt's which have quite a bit of sugar (15-19?) this one has 5 grams per serving ( 2 per pack)

column9: High Cacao Content AND Good for Your Heart, You're A Winner!
column10: Cheaper and with greater cacao content than the other product I've been buying, I'm now a Lindt customer.  There is a big difference in flavor but that's due to the 85% cacao content so I'll have to forego my American sweet tooth and develop more of a sophisticated taste; if the Europeans can do it so can I!  Join me, fight higher prices and become sophisticated at the same time, it's not hard.  Beside, this stuff is good for your heart.

column9: Tastes bad and give me cramps
column10: As one reviewer said here, this used to be good but not anymore.I don't know what they started adding to this but it makes me sick.I won't go into details, but let's just say it's a real pain. In the guts.What a shame they took a good thing and ruined it.I only eat this sort of chocolate for the health benefits. Nothing relaxes thearteries and keeps the brain fed like cacao. Studies have shown benefits such askeeping the plaque off brain cells and staving off Alzheimer's.But I can no longer stomach this brand. I've never had such an intense stomach ache.I know it's not a chocolate intolerance since other brands don't do this to me.Whatever it is it is toxic to my insides.As far as taste goes, there are other brands that I like more. I'm not a fan of the way any of these intense dark chocolates taste but for the remarkable health benefits I eat a very small piece every day along with taking a daily asperin.
Great taste!For a dark chocolate, it is still creamy!Melts great, packaged perfectly.I don't know what else to say, other than buy it!

I think it's great you can buy a pack for a little less than going to the store each time you want a new bar of dark chocolate, especially when you eat it nearly every day.  It not too sugary like other chocolates because of the high cocoa content, which is the way I like it.I'm changing my review because they no longer use demerara sugar - they responded to my question that their sugar can be from sugar beets, which are genetically engineered. So I have started buying Equal Exchange chocolate from the Tropical Traditions site.  It's more expensive, but oh so good, and the chocolate is properly fermented.  I'm talking about the 80% Extra Dark chocolate.

I snack on maybe two squares/week (8 squares / pack). I like the taste, and it's healthy in moderation. It's also great for giving to some random acquaintance on birthdays if you don't care enough to remember until you see their facebook.I received the 15g-of-carbs version, but I don't care. It's really not a lot of carbs.
awesome chocolate, better than any other that I've had when it comes to bars aside from specialty stores. love this stuff

column9: Delicious and Healthier Because It's  85% Cocoa
column10: I have to have chocolate in my life. I'm finally able to be moderate about it. Not as moderate as Audrey Hepburn. I read that she was able to stop after having just one square of chocolate. I guess that depends on just how big that square was!I have obsessively researched dark chocolate and keep coming back to this one It takes great and, as long as I don't eat the whole thing in one sitting, is not excessive. THREE squares probably do it for me.I recommend Lindt Excellence Extra Dark Chocolate 85% for those who are trying to get their chocolate without abusing their health.

I purchased this product . It was shipped with polar pak to keep cool. The polar pak was ruptured and leaked gel all over the chocolate. Im sure the chocolate is good but not appetizing with gel all over. I went to return item and informed item is not returnable.
really dark, but not tasty. it depends on your personal preference, some people might love it.first time to buy food online, little bit wired.

I've recently "discovered" these gourmet dark chocolates and am enjoying trying out different brands.  At this concentration of cocoa, most of the chocolates become very similar.  However I will say the Lindt 85% is smoother than other brands (Endangered Species 88%).  Whereas the Endangered Species 88% is harder and less solvent in your mouth, this chocolate will melt in your mouth - allowing you to enjoy the flavor more.At roughly 75 cent/ounce this is not cheap chocolate, so you'll want to savor and enjoy it.  Letting it sit in your mouth and melt is a much better experience than chewing it to bits and swallowing it.  It doesn't' radiate flavor quite like milk chocolate does, so you have to work the chocolate a little bit to get full flavor.Another thing to note is that this chocolate (as is typical) is very high in saturated fat.  This is very typical for this percentage cocoa though - where the higher the cocoa, the more fat a chocolate has in it.  One square (this bar is comprised of 10 squares) has about the amount of saturated fat as a cup of 2% milk.  This treat is best enjoyed in limited quantities after a nice meal.  You definitely would not want to scarf the entire thing down at once.
You can find this cheaper at Rite Aid, even after they raised their prices $2.99/bar. These are $3.16/bar. I wish these were available as a subscription, but alas, no dark chocolate is.

Product was awful.the taste was not good at all and the texture was worse. They were not light nor fluffy. They were very dense. I made one batch and I threw them away. I would not recommend them at all.

I love falafel and looked forward to trying this brand because it looked authentic.  I knew as soon as I cut open the plastic envelope that it was a mistake.  Weird smell, and when cooked--weird, unpleasant taste.  It also didn't cook up in the usual manner but fell apart in the pan.  (I used the recommended amount of water, stirred, waited, etc. as per directions, and I make falafel frequently.  This is the first time I had a problem.)  I ate a couple, but ended up using the rest as treats for my dogs.  They liked them!

Since we're almost 100% vegetarian nowadays, the falafel mix is marvelous to have on hand when a 'meaty' meal item is wanted.  This mix is seasoned just right, is amenable to no-oil baking methods or healthy olive oil frying on stovetop.  The price is fair [competitive with any supermarket] and contents are fresh.  If your local markets aren't selling falafel mixes, go with this one and save the struggle!

My local supermarket used to carry this brand, I'm so glad you have it because the other just aren't as tasty. To me it's the best tastingfalafel mix on the market. Try it with roasted red pepper hummus on pita.Yum-Yum!

We liked the Sadaf Falafel, although it had a strong taste of black pepper.  We ate it with hummus and pita bread and it was a great fast & easy lunch.  Cooked it in grapeseed oil which is actually what the box recommended.
I bought these for the goody bags for my son's upcoming 3 year old birthday. They arrived quickly and well packaged. Non were broken. They are super cute and really tasty.
Not that it matters at all with taste, but they sent me regular lemonade when I ordered pink. If the color matters to you, just know you'll be getting yellow.
What can you say about Kool-Aid that we dont already know? I bought it on here as it was cheaper than buying in store.

My dog has digestive issues and this product works great for her.  I am not sure she loves the taste because she only eats when she is hungry and does not run to eat it as she would other brands.  But, it does work and that is what counts.  Thank-you for making a product for digestive issues.
Excellent coffee.  One of the best coffees I have ever brewed.  Full rich flavor.  As good or better than any Gevalia or Starbuck dark roast coffee.

I was buying this as a replacement for our coffee at the fire house. Little did I know my math skills were a bit off. My goal was to get a better coffee for the crews at a equal or better price. I miscalculated and realized that I was over charging for the coffee, so I decided that I'd just keep it and drink the mistake. Wow it isn't a flavor mistake. My wife and I love the coffee and it's flavor. It has a bold flavor with a smooth finish. No bitterness or bite at the end. I just finished the first of 4 bags I have. It has lasted a long time and I look forward to each and every cup.

This is a fantastic deal on a fantastic product, the third bonus is that it's shipped to you door!  No schlepping these heavy containers into the car, out of the car, etc.  The boxes are safer, from what I understand, than cans that can leach harmful toxins into our food.  Can't beat this deal even with coupons at the store.  We make soups all year round, and appreciate the automatic shipping!  Yum!

column9: Swanson Chicken Broth 48 Oz aseptic box pack of 8
column10: I like this larger size box of chicken broth from Amazon because it makes just the right amount of soup!  For health reasons, I do wish it came with less sodium, but it does taste very good as is.

Low calorie, low carb, adds flavor to everything. It is so nice to be able to have this delivered to the house rather than have to lug it from the store to the car then the car to the house. The pour spout is a nice feature as well.

The chicken broth is fine and I am assuming if you are about to purchase 3 gallons of Swanson Chicken Broth, then you are okay with the flavor. I sure there are better fancy broths out there, but they also cost more. This one here is a great deal, although you can catch broth on sale at your local grocery store as well.As far as purchasing mine on Amazon, the shipping was great. They bubble wrapped the whole inside so no damage occurred to the products.Realize also that I would recommend opening a chicken broth you didn't intend on using in a week or two. If you don't think you can routinely use 48oz of chicken broth in that time frame, I would recommend buying a smaller size.I give the product five stars because it work great for me, tastes great, and was at a great price.

My wife and I enjoy our couscous with some olive oil, black truffle salt, and ground black pepper.  It has a delicious taste and it has always been extremely easy to make.  Also, at 10 minutes, it usually takes less time to cook than whatever protein we're having.

column9: Add a little pine nuts with vegetable and it is a meal!
column10: The first time I ate these I was hooked!  I quickly beganmy search for the best price, etc.  I love these containers!They keep them fresh and easy to locate and organize on theshelf.I add a little olive oil, broccoli and pine nuts!  Outstanding!

This is my first time trying couscous. I followed the instructions except that i cooked mine in the microwave with a lid on. It turned out really good and I am very happy with the fresh aroma and the taste of this food product.

This is actually one of the better pearl couscous brands I have ever tried. Even on their own, they carry a pleasing flavor. Of course, Israeli couscous flavor is really set off when cooked in broths, soup, etc...The subscribe and save price on this was unbeatable, and the quality is top notch. Glad to have bought it.Enjoy!

column9: Delicious, quick and the kids LOVE it!
column10: Cook it hot in under 10 minutes in a flavored broth, or serve it cold as a fabulous pasta salad alternative. Best of all my kids absolutely love it and ask me to make it all the time. A+

column4: D. L. Brown "A Knower Of Good Things"
column10: This is my second purchase of this brands Couscous and I love it. I have found so many ways to use it and add to my menus when cooking. I am still eating it and enjoying it, the purchaase price is great and this has a great shelf life. When this runs out I will be buying more, this work for me.

I LOVE Israeli couscous and this product is great. Cheaper than Trader Joes (and equivalent in quality) and with Amazon free shipping I can have it delivered to my building rather than have to travel across town to pick up a few smaller boxes. I will definitely buy again when I finish with this shipment.
This is a wonderful product.  It's delicious, low-cal and healthy.  Mix with your favorite vegetables and you have a complete healthy meal.

I was so pleased when I tried this --- I eat it all the time now. The first type I got was Mediterranean and the grains were so tiny that it just turned into to a ball of glob. I didn't even realize couscous was pasta until I tried this Israeli brand. the kids love it too-- trying to catch all the little balls of goodness with their spoons.
My kids love the stuff and so do my wife and I.Brown it, water and chicken soup.......done.Great side dish.
There is a lot of couscous out there.  This is the best.  It tastes even better with a subscription discount -thanks Amazon.

column9: Very good -- but packaging/shipping/pricing needs to be improved

It would be nice if they would offer some varieties other than Plain.  How about Poppy Seed, Onion, Egg, Sesame, or "Everything"?Also, I urge the seller to provide better packaging for shipment around the country, perhaps a vacuum seal, since the shipping method is UPS Ground.FLASH (11/5/09): The seller has now more than doubled the price of the 6 bagels, from $4.50 to $9.50, PLUS it's still $5.49 shipping -- way too expensive, in my opinion!  Maybe they intended to provide FREE shipping, which would be a $.50 reduction vs. the previous total?

column9: Average queens new york  made Bagel

We have been ordering this from Amazon for some time now. Couldn't find a better price anywhere. The coffee is delicious and you only get half the caffine of a regular cup of coffee so we drink it as late in the day as we desire. Order and enjoy.

if you are lie me and hate the strong acidity of starbucks  coffee  etc,  this is the perfect choice for you -great in the whole bean ---nice mellow flavor --long time quality company ( ORIGINAL HOUSE COFFEE OF A & P  GROCERY CHAIN IN THE NY AREA

I have a sensitivity to caffeine that I only recently became aware of.  I need a little pick me up, but the amount of caffeine in regular coffee gives me the jitters.  I was excited to find this and it has lived up to expectations.  I do iced coffee and the flavor of this coffee is perfect for that.  Not only that, but it gives me a pick me up without giving me the jitters.  I really recommend this for anyone looking for a lower level of caffeine intake without going all the way decaffeinated.

On a trip to the grocery store a few weeks ago I picked up a bag of these Pretzel Crisps in the original flavor to try out, while my mother grabbed a bag in the garlic parmesan flavor. A few days later we each brought our new pretzels to one of my daughters softball games to snack on. As I ate mine, my mother insisted I try hers. Oh wow are these garlic parmesan ones good! It's not even a flavor I would normally have thought I would like, as I tend to like simpler flavors. But these are just so good, even a picky eater like myself love them. So on my next trip to the store I picked up 3 bags for myself and I'm snacking on them now.If you can envision a pretzel that has been rolled out flat with a rolling pin, that's what these are like. You get more of the crispy outside and much less of the white flour center you usually have with pretzels. Because they have a flat design, they even work as crackers. So you can top them with cheese, meats etc and use them with dips, just like you would a cracker, only they taste even better. They are very crispy, but don't crumble or fall apart when trying to eat them. The bags are resealable, and the seal works extremely well. The best part is since they have so much flavor, you can eat just a few and it feels like you've eaten a lot more. Lots of flavor is a smaller package.The nutritional info is:Serving size: 10 crackers/pretzelsFat: 1.5g per servingCalories: 110 per servingCarbs: 22g per servingSodium: 410mg per servingAnd there is a warning that these are made in a facility that processes milk and soy, for those with allergies to them.

I notice nobody has reviewed this product yet so I thought I'd put my $.02 in.  As a bonus goodie, I received a small box of eight pieces with a ProFlowers order (and can recognize most of them in the above photo).  I thought the candies were quite good, perhaps not on a par with Godiva but w-a-a-y above Russell Stover, and very fresh.  Flavors were pretty traditional: semi-sweet raspberry truffle, milk chocolate caramel, peanut butter shell, "Aspen" creme (very buttery) and so on.  My assortment came in a brown box with a yellow ribbon and contained a photo guide to the contents.  A definite treat!

They gave me an extra stalk of 10 (so nice), they arrived green and healthy and are still doing fine two weeks later.  I plan to use them in my classroom for each student to have in an open terrarium.

column9: A lot of green for your money
column10: I ordered 100 stalks from Betterdecor on June 15, 2012 and they arrived three days later on June 18 by way of the U.S. Post office.  They are bundled in packs of ten each, wrapped in damp paper towels with the roots in water crystals, all of which were enclosed in a sturdy plastic bag.  Foam peanuts protect the plants. So, the stalks (or stems) came fast, with healthy green leaves and healthy red roots.What you see on the internet is  what you get in your package.However, instead of receiving 100 stalks, I actually received 106 stalks, six more than what I expected.In addition, instead of being about 4 inches, the stalks measured at about 5 inches tall, so this, too, is much better than I expected.If you measure the stalks with the green leaves, they are about 8 to 8 1/2 inches tall.The item price ($27) and shipping cost ($2.50) are well-priced, so this is an excellent product at an extremely affordable price.  You pay much more if you go to a store.~~~Here are brief directions which include information edited from the product description.1. Give bright or medium light. Avoid direct sunlight or leaves will turn yellow.2. Keep the roots below water.  Tap water is fine.  Before watering, you may let the tap water sit for a day for the chlorine to evaporate.  If the water is heavy on fluoride, you may also use filtered or distilled water.  To keep the water clean, change the water once a week or once a month.An excellent source of water is fish tank water (from a fresh water tank). I've been using water from the fish tank and the plants look green and healthy.3. Regular indoor room temperature is fine.  Keep the minimum temperature above 50ºF.One may grow Lucky Bamboos in just plain water, with rocks or stones to hold them in place or you may plant them in regular potting soil.  I actually prefer putting them in soil.  For me, it seems they do better in soil.  Water regularly if you plant them in soil because the plant dries up if you forget to water.
Bamboo was sent and arrived in a timely fashion.  Plants were perfect.  I am a return customer and will continue to do business with them.

If you like spicy snack food, this is it.  I love this product.  My favorite is the ketchup fries.  I tried the buffalo one and Wow!  Too hot, but good.  The regular ones are good.  My store will not stock up on these so I'm buying here.  These are REAL tasty.  Will buy again.  Also, they don't weight you down.  They are light and no trans fats.  Yum!

column9: One of the best snacks for those who like "hot fries"
column10: My son loves "hot fries".  These are a healthier alternative to Cheetos Baked Flamim' Hot Snacks.  My whole family will eat these.  Obviously they aren't as tasty as the unhealthy version.  However, they are a better alternative :)

Couldn't give these more than three stars. The smell turned me off. Smelt like old ketchup. Hard to explain. The texture was good, and the expiration date is well into 2012. Not something I really look forward to eating, but the flavor is ok. Just expected something different. If you have issues with smells, then you might not like these. Wished I had bought the Buffalo flavor. Won't repeat buy on the ketchup flavor.

My local store frequently runs out of these. They are very tasty, and, wheat-gluten free. My "Pack of 12" shipping/handling is about $7.80 (30.8% of the item cost) to a major US Metro area. As I ordered two boxes which Amazon decided needed to come from two different distribution centers, I'm paying this rather high shipping/handling fee twice! Amazon does do groceries - but at what shipping and handling cost?
These are very good and make a great gluten free and dairy free snack. We are always looking for snacks that are like normal snack and taste good. This one works out great!

So so so good.  Seriously addicting.  Have to disagree with the reviewers who said they were spicy.  I think they taste kind of sweet.  Super light and not filling.  Love them.I have never reviewed (what basically is) a potato chip before in my life.  I guess there is a first for everything.

column9: Too much like pringles, I didn't like them
column10: I tried the Classic baked fries with kethcup.  Had I read the ingredients first I would never have bought them.  They are made from potato flakes like pringles and I have never liked Pringles.  These tasted odd to me and we had a houseful of company and a bunch of children under age 6 and no one liked them.  I crushed them up and put them under the bird feeder and only the chipmunks would eat them.  Nothing wholesome or good about these.  Back to my delicious Cape Cod potato chips, I will never wander away from you again!
I am in love with the cheddar cheese fries.  They remind me of a long forgotten snack food of the 1980's, a spicy crunchy bag of fries, only without the spicy.  As other reviewers have said, "YUMMY!"

This review is for the Southwest Cheddar cheese fries by Snikiddy.  I've tried the regular Cheddar cheese ones as well, but that's a separate review.  I do have to say, the Southwest is much better than the regular flavor.Snikiddy is an all natural brand.  They use better, pronounceable ingredients.  Although there still is corn content.  They claim they are gluten free, vegetarian, no msg and even kosher.  This particular flavor has ramped up spices in its flavoring mix.  It even has white pepper, which is unusual for a snack food.  But good!  There's jalapeno powder too.  So you can definitely tell they took the Southwest aspect of this snack seriously.I really liked the taste of this snack. Unlike the regular cheddar, it had a tastier cheese flavor.  But wow, was it ever spicy.  My nose started running while I ate it because it was so spicy.  But even with the spicy, you could still taste the cheese.  The texture was still a little chewy while eating after the initial crunchiness, but with a better flavor it wasn't as bad.  The spiciness is a little much at times, but definitely worth it for the flavor.I really did enjoy this particular flavor of Snikiddy fries.  And considering there are limited flavors of Snikiddy snacks in my area I'm glad I liked at least one of the flavors.Review by M. Reynard 2012

With that being said, I use a lot fruits, veggies and some peanut butter in my smoothies so every flavor does get masked.  A great way to get your fiber and protein. This adds something special to a regular burger and fries.  My husband loves spicy foods and he loves the kick that this gives him.

This product was shipped in great condition, and on time.  The problem being I thought I was buying the small wafers.  I am going to have to return these as my small dog will not eat them as she thinks it's medicine.  I guess they don't make the small bone looking wafers anymore.

(Also, a good deal but you can only buy at Costco)Their coats feel nice... and they have normal bowel movements.Overall, good deal and i recommend.

nowfood ow this is a great product even though I was surprised and even a bit sceotical to buy dog food on amazon ;), delivery was ok, I wasn't in a rush that is and the product is as good as advertised, high in protein and no byproducts which makes for agile, happy and active dogs. I had a Catahoula female and she seems to love the pebbles which as an additional benefit clean hER teeth though they could be ideally larger in size, the pebbles ;) not her white teeth...

There is some fault with this coffeemaker that makes it explode when washing it. I had not made coffee for 24 hrs, so it was cold when I decided to clean it with dish soap. Suddenly I heard a loud pop and the carafe was filled with glass. Luckily my hand wasn't inside and only one shard flew out - away from my face. I have no idea what caused it, but I'm thinking the carafe had some sort of flaw. I called Melitta and they have sent me a new one, but honestly, I'm kind of afraid to use it. The woman I spoke to said she had not heard of this happening, but I've found similar stories on the Internet, so it's not just me. It's a shame, because it's a very pretty coffeemaker and makes good coffee, as all Melitta pour-overs do. It's just a dangerous one.

column9: Not quite as good as the discontinued version, but still a great little pot!
column10: Great pot, much prettier than the old plastic exterior one. I don't like the lid, as I worry that when the plastic gasket that surrounds the pour mechanism gets old, it will be harder to keep clean, let alone seal.
These bars taste great.  Lots of sesame seeds in them but you taste more of the peanut.  Would buy again most definitely!

This bar has a unique taste. It is good chocolate and toasted sesame seeds. I eat it slow because it is dense but it is not too big of a bar-just the right size. It is not as nutritious as the other nut bars but it offers variety to the mix.

This was my first time ordering this product.  It was a great snack.  I love chocolate and this snack was a great alternative to chocolate candy from the vending machine.  They are easy to carry and if you don't finish all of it in one sitting the bar doesn't dry up since it's not made up of a bread.

These are very good bars. They aren't too sweet and are very filling. Just enough chocolate!I do just want to say that these are not chewy bars, they are crunchy and quite hard. I have definitely stabbed the roof of my mouth multiple times while eating these. The taste makes it worth it, but just be forewarned. If your teeth aren't strong, don't bother.
I put them in the refrigerator for a sweet treat ( now) but will put them in my back for school..
I have one for breakfast each morning and am set for the rest of the morning.  They have lots of protein so they are really filling.  And yummy too, with the bit of chocolate.

column9: The best bar EVER! (especially for gluten-free diets!)
column10: I will divorce my husband for a semi filled with these bars! I have Celiac Sprue and must eat gluten-free. I always travel with a box of these in my suitcase so I'm never stuck without food I can eat.
These are my favorite Kind Bars.  I like to eat them when I'm having a craving for sweets.  The chocolate adds sweetness without making it taste too sugary!!!
I could not live gluten free without KIND bars! They are nutritious, delicous and healthy .These are the best tasting bars on the market and sesame and peanut is one of my favorite flavors.

I really like these and so does my sister. They are very good tasting and don't seem to be that bad for you. They taste a little sweet, but not overly sweet and not loaded with sugar. This is one of my favorite KIND bars.
Don't get me wrong, the bars taste good, but golly gee whiz they are so hard I am afraid I'll break a tooth.  I cancelled my order for this reason.
The Caramel Glaze Pop has a great flavor! It was very easy to use. We also bought the chocolate flavoring - but like the caramel flavoring better. Shipped on time.

column9: excellent, bold, tasty, rich blend of spices
column10: This has many uses beyond pumpkin pie. It is a rich blend of cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and ginger and comes packaged in an air tight foil bag similar to coffee. At the 1lb size it is a bargain for the quality. It really has a robust, fresh flavor, and is great to add to yogurt, smoothies, coffee, tea as well as baking. Frontier has very good spice products in general but the Pumpkin Pie Spice is the best on the market as far as I am concerned. It can even be added to rice for an interesting twist and of course puddings, breads, cookies, ice cream etc. A very versatile spice mixture for any season and has multiple uses. Can't go wrong with this fine product!

I just cant say enough about this product.  I cant even describe the taste but wow! does it ever.  I am in the process of trying all flavors.  WOW!  WOW!  This is going to be my favorite,(Cinnamon Glaze).

The company shipped a little slower than I expected, but I'm spoiled by Amazon Prime! The product produces a thin, lightly crunchy coating that is sweet and spicy, tasting similar to red hot candies but not as intense. It's no wear near the glumpy, clumpy coated popcorns you buy in the box at retail stores, and that's fine by me. The commercial stuff is just too thick, hard, and sweet. Just be careful measuring this out to use - if you inhale any, you will be sorry! It will burn your nose and make you cry ....

I was pleasantly surprised at how this worked in my popcorn machine.  The glaze dissolved nicely into the oil and coated the kernels evenly.  The candy coating adds an extra crunch to the popcorn and the mild "red hots" flavor does not overwhelm.  I'm will be trying the carmel and chocolate glazes next.
very expensive when giant food stores still sell it at 3.99 a package. it think this was overpriced for a a still available prduct
I love mallo cups, but they are very hard to find in area stores.  The seller shipped the items at lightening speed, they were packaged well and didn't end up in pieces at my door.

We used to eat these candies all the time, when I was younger.  So, when I received these the other day, I was very excited.  But once I bit into one, I knew that these weren't the candies of yesterday.  I don't know if the candies were old or if they melted and rehardened.  Or maybe my tastebuds changed drastically.
