But I thought b/c I liked Amy's other soups...Well, I should have gone w/ my gut. This...was...AWEFUL. Plain and simple. If you have a love for chili like I do, don't even consider it. Walk away. Or pick up her Tomato Bisque instead.

I was expecting this to be like the regular Amy's Medium Chili, just less sodium.  Doesn't seem to be the case.  I love the regular, but this was really bland and tried "recovering" it with salt, then pepper, then hot sauce.  No go.  I couldn't recover anything like the regular. Since we don't have issues with blood pressure anyway, we're sticking with the salted version!

I ordered the following Amy's Low Salt Products: Lentil Soup, Pea Soup, Minestrone Soup, and Medium Chili.  All of them are great.  If you are just now switching to Low salt or no salt you may find them to be bland until your body adjusts to the lowered salt intake (that could take months or up to a year).  The biggest complaint most have is the dented cans.  My Minestrone and Chili came in without any dents, the Pea Soup had 2 dented cans and the Lentils had dents in every can.  These dents are not caused by shipping.  All of my shipments came in with the packages totally intact with no signs that the outer shipping box had been roughed up in shipment.  These dents are caused by Amazon or Amy's warehousing.  The cans are not in boxes, they are shrink wrapped so when stacked the cans are actually bearing the weight.  Too much weight and the cans begin to buckle and this buckling will look like dents.  You can also get this same effect if the warehousemen are slamming the 12 pack cans down hard on top of each other.  This happens when workers in the warehouse get tired and become careless, are untrained, or just plain don't care about their job.  If you want to feel better then stay on a low salt diet, if you have ankle swelling then get on a low salt diet and get checked for congestive heart failure.  If you have high blood pressure get on a low salt diet and then increase your intake of magnesium.  Backing off your salt is not easy as it begins to change the way you taste food but if you stay with it and get off the high salt diet you will begin to taste food and not just the salt.  Have you ever eaten at a restaurant where the cook's salt intake is so high that the cook can't tell if he has too much salt in the food he is preparing?  I have more than once and it just destroys the meal.  Instead of buying 12 cans now try the Amy's Low Salt by getting it at your local health food store one can at a time then if you like order from Amazon and save.  Right now they have a 25% discount code when you order.  Write it down and use it as it saved me a few bucks.  Hope this review helps you.

I love Amy's products and the light sodium chili is one of my favorites. I enjoy with shredded cheese or gluten free crackers. The chili is nicely spiced and great on cold days. This chili is vegetarian so can be eaten during Lent. I'm pleased that Amazon carries Amy's products and offers replenishment  after so many months. I have served the chili over gluten free pasta. Many of Amy's products are gluten free.

This chili tastes pretty good, but I really like my chili thicker.  I can let that go as I know that that adds calories, but at 250 calories/cup watch the amount of cheese you add.  I just feel like for that many calories, it should be a bit thicker.  It is pretty tasty though and I love that it's low in sodium.
I just didn't care for the taste - tried it room temperature and cold.  Cold it tastes better but I still couldn't get used to it or acclimated to it.

I am familiar with Aguapanela as I grew up in Southamerica. Pannela tastes very similar to the one we used to make home. It is also ver refreshing and I was trilled to know that it preserves all the nutrients from the cane juice. Being all natural, with no preservatives it was also a nice benefit of this drink. I would recommend it for all Southamericans and those that enjoy healthy and different drinks.

column9: SO MUCH CHICKEN THAT I DON'T KNOW HOW THEY DO IT
column10: I was told by my vet that I had to put the world's pickiest cat... my European Burmese, Dante, on a wet cat food after he had lived on a dry food diet the first 6 months of his life.  3 months later, I'd tried a can of every cat food at 2 pet stores with no luck.  Then, I decided to try the Soulistic brand of pure shredded chicken in gravy. This is a cat who wouldn't even eat boiled chicken and he inhaled this!  It has to be a texture thing with him because he hated pates and gelees. Now, after a year on the Soulistic plain chicken in gravy (He still won't touch the chicken with pumpkin!)he has decided to include the chicken and tuna in gravy.  We are delighted to have found a healthy diet for our cat at such an affordable price for a generous 5.5 ounce can.  One other company has offered a similar product but offers a 2.2 ounce can at a much higher price.  I agree that the chicken and tuna has more gravy than the plain chicken formula with gravy, but we feel that it provides a good balance in his diet by using the two varieties.

column9: Not as good as the Soulistic in Gelee
column10: Having purchased the Soulistic "Gelee" and BFF (made by the same company) I wanted to try the "Gravy" flavors to add some more variety.  Although the food looks appetizing and all the cats seem to like the food, I was dismayed to see that there seemed to be as much gravy as food in the cans.  I do not want to be paying the same price for cans that contain this much liquid and less food.  I will purchase the "Gelee" foods and BFF again, but it isn't likely that I will purchase the "Gravy" flavors.

I was purchasing the chicken, turkey and tuna products for our cats. After much research I've found that ONLY Petco sells this product, which led me to research the product more. When I realized the product was made in Thailand we decided not to continue using this product and switched to Lotus and Fromms, both made in the good old USA where our standards are held to higher standards. I don't care if its a USDA plant. Its not made in the USA... That's the deciding factor!

This is the only brand of food my cat will eat. He begs for it.  my picky persian's favorite flavor of soulistic is the good karma but he enjoys the tuna and salmon pumpkin soup as well as others. i feel good feeding him this product.
Lol It is too good cause it is freakin addictive. Best when it is frozen. The sweet subtle taste of strawberries.
excellent ritter sport chocolate with strawberry cream.i really like the tiny chunks of strawberry mixed into the cream.all of the ritter sport chocolates are first class.

So light, so delicious... I love this chocolate. You can taste the slight acidity of the strawberry and yogurt, there are also some crunchy pieces in there, probably popped rice or freeze dried strawberry or something. I am not sure but they sure taste awesome.

Didnt purchase from Amazon, but been eating a lot of these bars in the past few weeks.  Chocolate is stellar as usual, but the strawberry creme is a nice addition.  Its got crystalized or dehydrated strawberry in the matrix of the cream which adds a nice texture along with the flavor.  good stuff if you like strawberries and chocolate!

I love chai tea and this product is by far one of the best in powder form.  I enjoy this tea as a real treat when I'm not drinking my other favorite, jasmine pearls, and it clearly beats any chai tea from your favorite coffee bar.  Because it's in powder form, you can add as much or as little as you like per cup.  It lasts a long time as well.  I have purchased this product in the past and will continue to do so in the future.  I highly recommend this product!
Nice and sturdy for multiple use, We knew a neighbor that had one, and I used his for straining many gallons of cooked syrup.  Use wool, don't substitute quality when it comes to your food.

The consistency of these is very pleasing; somewhere between a slo poke (a carmel chew candy) and a milk dud would be where I would place it.The taste is very mild, bordering on bland.  There is a distinctive almond flavoring to it.  Not a flavor you would get from eating almonds, but rather the flavor you would get from using almond extract.

column9: my kids hated them, i loved them
column10: i ended up being the one who ate these up. i think they're delicious especially since its only fruit inside. my only concern... is the foil pack lined with BPA? their packaging doesn't say.my kids did not like having to suck the fruit out. they are 1.5 and 3 yrs old. i wish they DID like them because the mash-ups are so mess-free and easy to transport.

My kids (8 and 4 years old) LOVE these and so do I!  They are great for school lunches...we freeze ours and they are ready to eat by lunch.  My kids like green apple and strawberry banana the best.  I am very pleased with the ingredients.  We subscribed to auto-delivery on these.  Great deal!

column9: If you usually don't like curry, this is the one to try!
column10: As a Thai-American growing up with a Thai mother, I ate Masaman frequently, and usually saw my Mom with this brand.  It is absolutely delicious.When I have friends who tell me they don't like curry, I make them try this.  It is sweet (being made with coconut milk and cinnamon) and savory (having potatoes and peanuts), only mildly spicy.  Since it is made with coconut milk, it is also naturally dairy free!It is also highly adaptable - the recipe calls for potatoes, onions and chicken, but you could also use beef, shrimp, pork, or throw in some carrots, whatever you want!

column9: Authentic Thai Brand, Always the best!
column10: My girlfriend (many years ago) was from Thailand, and made something different every night. This one is easy, and I get teary-eyed enjoying this (exactly as recipe on the can describes)...I mean, what could be easier than chicken, potatoes, and onions? I have ALL the cans of this brand of curry. Each one different, Each one DELICIOUS!

My husband loves massaman curry. So I thought I would be on the search for a vegetarian curry paste. This product is totally vegeterian, no fish, shrimp, or other animal by-product. Just add coconut milk and whatever veggies you want and you're done...great for quick curries. Totally recommend.

This paste made Massaman curry chicken at home that tasted just like it does at a Thai restaurant!  Just keep in mind, a little goes a long way.  The recipe said to use the whole can.  I like it more mild (as do my kids), so I used about half to a third of the can, and even then it was a little more on the hotter side!  Next time I'll just use a 1/4 of the can.  So each can can be used for 4 meals!  A very economical yet exotic meal!

column9: great products and great shipping time!
column10: the best curry paste ever made ...I think!  A tip from my thai restaurant owners/chefs...and such agenerous tip it was....you will love this stuff.moonbare

column9: Now I can have my favorite restaurant dish at home!
column10: Yum! This tastes just like the masaman curry I always order at our favorite fancy Thai restaurant. It only costs a fraction of the price to make it at home, and it's so easy! I love it with zucchini and cauliflower, as well as the standard potatoes and onions. Try roasting some cashews to sprinkle on top... Delicious!
I really like this paste and how simple it is. It is not too salty, a 1.5/5 for heat, and has enough for an entire meal.

So I made semi-traditional masaman (potatoes, onions and peanuts with the cocount milk) but used seitan, broccoli and peppers as I had those in the house and it was awesome.  It really tasted so much like my favorite thai restaurant it was eeire, so worth it. Also its super easy to make vegan.

This is the secret to authentic tasting Thai food. Don't bother with those expensive jars of Thai curry paste, one can of this makes two pots whole, I just freeze half the paste in a ziploc bag for another time. This sort of authentic paste is what housewives use in Thailand, I was surprised to see.

I've never ordered canned goods online before this so I was nervous. Boy, what a great experience! I don't have access to a Asian market where I am and I really wanted to make masaman rather than order take out. I followed the recipe on the can, reducing it by half as was recommended in one of the reviews. It was really flavorful and a tad spicy, I might even try a quarter of the amount next time. So happy that this worked out!
We raise our own chicken meat and everyone loves to eat this curry chicken once of week.  Easy to make and delicious!  <><

I just received my order and within the expected time frame. What I expected were whole leaves, but instead I received 12 small bags of leaves that have been crushed into small and tiny peices. I am using them (I need them for a dish and they are hard to find), but I was hoping for the whole leaves. If you are interested in this item, please know that they are not whole leaves but small peices.

I have loved elderberry jelly since I was a child in the 60s. As an adult, I was extremely dismayed to find Smucker's no longer offered elderberry in their line of jellies. After much searching, I found Mrs. Miller's Homemade Elderberry Jelly on Amazon and could not wait for my order to arrive. And I was not disappointed! In fact I do believe Mrs. Miller's Homemade Jelly is the best I have ever had. The taste so fresh and crisp. The jelly wholesome and packed with flavor! The taste transported me back to my childhood and wonderful memories of warm toast and jelly in the mornings shared with my Mom. She would have loved it, too. My next order is going to be a big one!

Wonderful!! Wonderful!!  Wonderful!!  Elderberry jelly is one of my and my husband's favorite jellies.  When I lived in Ohio, I was able to make it myself.  But there are no Elderberries growing in Arizona so I was extremely happy to find some before my husband passed away.  Mrs. Miller's tastes just like I had picked the berries and made the jelly myself.  Thankyou soooo much!

Not only do plain elderberries taste good, but they have amazing health properties.  On May 31, 2012, Dr. Oz had a show featuring ways to prevent/reverse Alzheimer's.  He had a guest, a Dr. Fotuhi who is a specialist in brain growth and development.  Dr. Fotuhi gave the voice of hope - we all have the ability to make our brains literally grow and thus prevent/offset degenerative neurological conditions later in life.  One of the healthy approaches recommended on that show was eating elderberries.  That is an added incentive to eat something that is not only good, but good for you.While I never liked jelly/jam/preserves as a dessert or in any sandwich, I do like using a jelly/jam/preserve glaze on meats.  I was delighted to find this.  It tastes really good as a glaze on chicken and your guests will want seconds. Mrs. Miller's Homemade Jelly is fresh and crisp as others on Amazon U.S. have noted.  I can't recommend this highly enough!
I was afraid to order more because I was not sure how good this would be. My lost because it is absolutely fantastic. Definitely homemade, and the taste is awesome. Will be ordering a ton more.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: EXCELLENT for Beet Cake (recipe on back!!) BUT OVERPRICED!
column10: Good Ole NutriCity - They ALWAYS are WAY OVER market on their pricing, and then they add exorbitant shipping that always seems to cost as much, or more, than the item?? We have a so called (very pricey/spendy) "Gourmet Market" near our office and they price these exact beets at under three dollars - this NutriCity price works out to almost five dollars per jar - there it is. Buyer beware........  However, these Aunt Nellies Harvard Sweet & Sour beets are unusually gooooooood! So tasty right out of the jar, they are even better added to a salad, or rinsed and patted dry for a appetizer tray before dinner. BUT the BEST reason to buy these awesome BEETS is the HARVARD BEET CAKE recipe on the jar! It is the BEST spice cake you EVER tasted and gets a whole lotta veggies into your kids on the sly!! NO ONE, especially kids, will guess the secret ingredient that makes the cake disappear so FAST, so do NOT tell!! The cake is excellent with or without the optional walnuts and we like it both ways. Aunt Nellies Harvard Beets are recommended!

I stumble upon this product at Walmart and bought it without looking at the ingredients, thinking that it uses sugar. I was surprised to find out later on that this product lists high fructose corn syrup on the third in the ingredients list. If you don't care consuming HFCS, then disregard this feedback. For me, HFCS is totally out of consideration.

The beets themselves are great.  They're small/medium sized, sliced like one would slice an orange, and and firm and nice.  The syrup however is horrible.  It is thick and and not flavored in a good way.  While the first few beets in the sweet & slightly spicy syrup are OK, after the first few the syrup is unbearable.  I wish they'd dump the syrup and just put it in vinegar and maybe a tiny bit of spices.
We really like this flavor profile. It tastes mostly like blueberries, but the carrot and pear do come through. Great color and my baby really likes this one for now.

column9: Good idea, but didn't work for us
column10: Good idea, but my 2 year old daughter who loves to eat blueberries didn't care for this product. The only way I was able to get her to eat it was mixing it frozen in her yogurt. I wasn't too happy on price either when I found it for nearly half the price at my local grocery store.

We love this Knudsen organic juice for the 2 year old. My only problem is that the box is too small. Even though she is so small 6 ounces would be a better portion size for her. Again, love the juice box and adore the 32 oz bottle size for when we are at home.

column9: Sensible Sippers Mixed Berry on Subscribe & Save
column10: The little children who frequent my abode (the grands) appreciate these drinks.  I like the smaller containers as well as the fact these are organic.  I purchased on the Subscribe & Save program to keep the little ones with a steady supply.  Mom has outlawed soft drinks so these are a wonderful alternative.

My kids really seem to enjoy this juice.  The berry flavor is tasty and I really enjoyed that they don't have any artificial ingredients added.  Being organic is a bonus.  They are great for my 2 and 4 year olds, but are on the small side for my 7 year old and his friends.  I will likely purchase these again in the future if the price is low.  They're really small, which has been great to just throw in my diaper bag in case I need something to keep my hungry toddler quiet.

delish.  perfect mix of sweet and bitter with great crunch.only drawback is there is wheat flour in the cookie, whereas an authentic amaretto cookie has none. I'll admit that's quibbling, but it does add a tiny element of "not as good"ness to the texture/flavor.overall, a GREAT cookie at a terrific price.  I bought a crate load and I'll be using them for cheesecake and pie crusts, additions to breads, etc.  (not to mention, wonderful with a cup o').  but if you're a purist, you'll have to fork over twice as much $$.

column9: Best Biscotti you'll ever taste with your cappucchino.
column10: Do not hesitate to order these cookies.  The fine restaurants give these with your coffee.
These cookies are just wonderful-not too sweet and also great to use in cooking and crumble over desserts.
Taste is a bit bitter like most artificially flavored drinks.  But it does wake you up with a quick burst of energy similar to coffee.

column9: Can't keep enough of this in the house
column10: This is the best syrup ever. I can't go back to supermarket brands after buying this. I have tried many of this company's other products and haven't found even one of them I can live without now. I have also gotten all my friends hooked on these products!
Ordered 2 cans which arrived today. The cans were well packaged and sufficiently protected. Fresh, crisp, delicious - will definitely restock time and time again!!

I send nuts to a friend every birthday and Christmas ~ usually a different kind every time.  My friend commented that these are the best nuts I have ever sent, and I've been doing this for quite a few years now.  Great endorsement, and I'll be buying again!

My husband knows that I like good mixed nuts. I could not find good nuts in the local market .So I was very happy to get this product as a surprise. However, I was shocked when we received this product. The can was  dented ,and inside, the nuts mostly cashews and they were stale ,soft and not crunchy I would not order this product any more.

column9: nice, bold flavor; amazon's stock has january best buy date for order placed august
column10: Starbucks Decaf Caffe Verona is one of my favorite coffee beans.  If you haven't tried this particular roast before, I would describe it as quite rich and full bodied -- just the way I like my coffee.While amazon's stock is not quite as fresh as my local grocery store, I think it's fresh enough.  The bags I received for my order placed about a week ago (mid-August) and they are dated as best used by January.  Not bad.

I'm a huge fan of dark roasts, and my absolute favorite coffee is Starbucks' Gold Coast Blend; however, I recently took the difficult decision to switch to decaf for health reasons, and I had to give up my Gold Coast extra bold. I was stonewalled in my attempt to find a decaf that left no aftertaste and wasn't offensive to my finely tuned taste buds :o) I came across this on-line and took the decision to purchase it. I live in the Caribbean and there are no Starbucks stores in my country, so I bought three packs from Amazon, and prayed I wouldn't regret the purchase. At first, I was a little bit disappointed because this roast is not as dark as the extra bold I prefer. However, after a couple of days, I began to really enjoy this particular brew. I no longer dread my morning cup of decaf, because I have found one that truly satisfies my taste buds. I HIGHLY recommend this coffee for those switching from a dark roast to decaf.

It tastes just like regular Caffe Verona, except no jitters or muscle tightness in my neck which leads to a headache.  It's dee-lish-us!  I recently became very sensitive to caffeine, and I've always loved Starbucks, so I figured I couldn't go too wrong.  Not wrong at all!  It still has the deep, dark taste without the side effects.  Caffeine doesn't even wake me up anymore, so why bother?  Caffe Verona decaf... I love it.
great coffee--costs the same as in the store, with prime get it delivered free, and no state tax bargain--best coffee

I love Starbucks Coffee and Amazon.com allows me to purchase thier great product at a nvery fair cost. I buy this product over and over again. And, I will continue to purchase it as long as it is available.

column4: eastbayrae "Sometimes you have to club a seal...
column10: I had this sent to me in Afghanistan and I am lovin' it!  I have been drinking instant up until now.  There are not many choices over here and the Green Beans Coffee we have here is horrid at best.  I will keep getting this blend sent here.  Amazing scent and flavor!

column9: Screw chocolate.  Now I'm addicted to lemons!!
column10: This is amazing. I've never had lemon ice before, but tried this on a whim. I bought it at the grocery store because I thought it would be fun to find new ways to incorporate more fruit into my diet vs. buying junk food.  I couldn't believe how wonderful it tasted. Since then I've had trouble finding these packets because they're always sold out and now I think they may have even discontinued it at the Safeway where I buy them.  I love this stuff, so I'm very greatful for Amazon.com for carrying it.One caveat though, use at least 2 real lemons for the juice. I tried one with the juice I got in a bottle from the Realemon brand and it tasted flat. When I used real lemons it was like drinking pure heaven. This tastes much much better than any chocolate I've ever tasted in my entire life, plus I feel refreshed after I've tried it because of that lemony flavor.
This coffee tastes great and arrives fresh and ready to brew.  It is a nice dark roast that is 100% Kona, not a blend.  Will keep ordering!

At Whole Foods they sell a rice salad which I really like but it's $11 a pound !! so I decided to make it myself. That is how I became familiar with Lundberg Farms. This blend or Countrywild will do. Simply cook the rice as directed then stir in 1/4 cup of chopped pecans and 1/4 cup of golden raisins after removing the rice from the heat. Leave it covered for 10 minutes. It's delicious.

column9: Can't get enough of this stuff....
column10: Our favorite rice blend by far, this mixture of brown rice grains is nutty and flavorful without any extra "scents" like jasmine, etc. or tastes that other grains could contribute.  Just plain old tasty, healthy rice.  Perfect with some stir fry or a roasted chicken breast.  Cooks well in the rice cooker.

The Jubilee blend is one of my favorites from a caring grower.  The Lundbergs take excellent care of the land, much better than the other Northern California growers.  Great nutty flavor.  So good that you can just have it plain...and cold!

column9: Beautiful and High-Quality Rice But Too Much Short-Grain For My Taste
column10: Lundberg Jubilee is a blend of sweet brown rice, short and long grain brown rice and colorful red and black whole grain Wehani and Japonica rice varieties which are also very round and short-grained.  This product looks very pretty in the package and cooks up nicely.However, I bought this rice as a rice to eat with stir fry dishes and, in that capacity, I developed the opinion that this product doesn't have the amazingly appealing scent and texture that the Lundberg long grain rice has on its own.I will try cooking some rice salads with this Jubilee rice blend because, as some of the other reviews have pointed out, that's probably a good way to put this rice to its best use.From using this product, I have learned that for use as a side dish with chicken, stir-fry, etc. I think that long grain rice is a preferable choice.

This rice blend is wonderful.  It is very hearty, but the taste is fairly delicate and complex.  My husband who does not like brown rice, was really taken with this rice.  I have served it plain as a side dish to meat or fish, and also it makes a really lovely foundation for stir fried vegetables.  We're looking forward to trying Lundberg's other brown rice blends.

Thanks to everyone who wrote a review of this product. Your comments made me want to give this a try but I didn't want to start out with 6 bags just in case I didn't like it. I found the rice at a local store and one bag got me hooked! Now I order from Amazon to get a better price. As someone who though minute rice was the only rice this has been a wonderful surprise. Great flavor and texture! I did make a minor adjustment to the prep instructions. I use 1 3/4 cup of water to a cup of rice and bring water to a boil before adding the rice. Seems to work perfectly for my tastes.
This is a nice blend of rice.  My family eats rice everyday as one of our primary grains and I try to use as many different varieties as I can so it doesn't get boring.

Since I've stopped eating wheat products, I've been experimenting with a lot of different rices.  This one (along with other Lundberg blends) is by far my favorite.  The chewy texture and nutty flavor come out perfect every time.

I am a loyal purchaser of this rice blend. What's not to love? It's healthy, supports eco-farming, tastes great, and the best part is it's moist and you really can't burn it. No need for a special rice-cooker with this blend. Near perfection!
I love this stuff!  Some of the tastiest rice ever.  This company got their blend just right.

I love this blend! It's so nutritious and delicious!I use it in ... I guess others would say an "unconventional way".Love cooking it in my rice cooker with EVOO and chicken broth ... soooo good!We pair it with so many things, chicken ala King, grilled or sauteed turkey sausage with veggies, just plain grilled veggies, fruit, ... the list is endless.You can use this wonderfully aromatic blend for anything and everything!! Best of all you will not be disappointed because the taste is superb!The price has gone up since the last time I place an order, I hope it comes back down soon?Bon Appetit!

I first bought this not knowing what to expect. We love brown rice since we do only whole grains for the nutrition. This is excellent in flavor and a wonderful blend. The basic way I use it is in chicken stock/broth (low sodium) with a Tbsp of butter while cooking. Wonderful!! Highly recommended!! I had difficulty finding it locally... so I am very glad to find it online in even larger quantities!!!

This rice has a nice nutty flavor.  It isn't bitter like some brown rices.  For two people, I use the following recipe:6 oz rice2 cups low sodium chicken broth1 bay leaf1 tsb EVOOCook 50 minutes and rest for 10 minutesI'll add some saffron if I'm eating seafood.This rice is well worth the expense.  And yes, I know it's 10 times as expensive as white rice.

I ordered this item as a staple food supply, and I must say it's really good tasting and takes little time to cook. The 6 - 16 oz units would last two people probably a month. A very good source of carbohydrates. mmm

I was never much of a rice eater, until I discover Lundberg Jubilee Gourmet blend of Whole Grain Brown rice. I saw it on Amazon.com and took a chance and purchased some to try it. Now I can't live without it. No more plain old white rice for me. This stuff actually smells good while it is cooking. Kind of nutty earthy flavored, and has plenty of texture when you eat it. My favorite is to serve it with General Tso's Chicken. It's a great product, a little pricy, but in my opinion worth it. I have bought the six 1# packs about 3 or 4 times now on Amazon.com and will continue to do so.

Mind you, I never venture much beyond basmati, but I've decided to add more brown rice to my diet and figured I should try Lundberg Jubilee.  This stuff is really great!  I cooked it in the rice cooker, adding a bit more water than called for on the package, just to be sure.  The house smelled so good while it was cooking, and it came out perfectly.  I ate two bowls right away and have plenty left over for the rest of the week.  I'm sold on this stuff.

column4: Sir Not Appearing In This Movie "Sir Not"
column10: My family really loves this rice. With a little splash of soy sauce, I'd be happy eating this rice by itself!It's super easy in the microwave. We put one cup of this rice plus two and a half cups of water in a covered pyrex dish then nuke on high for five minutes, half power for 35 minutes -- fluff with a fork & serve. perfect. (YMMV depending on microwave power)

column9: Lundberg Jubilee Rice- whole grain brown rice
column10: This rice is an excellent rice for those who want something special from rice.  Since it's whole grain it is more nutritious than common grocery store white rice.  It is a very tasty option from brown rice since it's seasoned.  It can substitute for bread and even meat in some meals and it is filling.  I mix curly chard that I have cooked in my slow cooker with the rice finely chopped and add a salad and have a meal.  (I cook the rice separately.)  I usually cook my chard with uncured apple flavored bacon so with the seasoning from the rice, it's quite tasty.  Add a salmon steak and you have a meal or eliminate the salmon and have the rice and salad alone.  It's very versatile.  I try to keep a pack of six in the cupboard.  I don't remember how I found out about this rice but I'm glad I did.  It's a change from the ordinary.I would imagine that you could fry up some chicken livers with onions, chop them up fine and add this to the rice for a gourmet treat.  I plan to try that next.

column9: Lundberg Jubilee, Gourmet Blend of Whole Grain Brown Rice, 16-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)
column10: In vain I have tried to introduce more brown rice into my diet and that of my family.  Until now.  We love this blend of brown rices!  It has a natural sweetness and flavor that is better than any white rice we have tried!  To cook it, I put it in my microwave (1 c. rice, 2 c. water) and press the rice button.  When it is done, I push the rice button again.  I ordered a pack of six and will soon need more.  It is that good.

Purchasing Lundberg Jubilee, Gourmet Blend of Whole Grain Brown Rice, 16-Ounce Units (Pack of 6) was a great decision. This rice has a great nutty taste. The other benefit is that since it is whole grain it has a low glycemic index. The price is much better than I receive at the local grocers, when I can find this rice.I love it and I highly recommend it. You may never go back to white rice!!Lundberg Jubilee, Gourmet Blend of Whole Grain Brown Rice, 16-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)
This rice is suprisingly good, the texture and flavor are perfect. Who would of thought that there was a brown rice out there that is so good that we enjoy eating it everyday?
This rice is SO delicious.  It is by far my favorite Lundberg blend.  I highly recommend it. The taste and aroma is nutty and very un rice-like.

We had tried a few of these mixes from our local "health food" store and have purchased from their bulk section. Similar product in the bulk bins $5.49/lb, price per bag on shelf for Lundberg mixes $3.59(SALE) - $5.89. I'd gladly paid the price for this great stuff at the local store but went looking for it on Amazon to see if I could get it sent to my college student rather than pay to mail it WOOHOO not only is it here but eligible for free shipping and cheaper than I've seen it anywhere!! Life is good!

I prepared a package of this flavorful rice tonight for dinner.  Everyone loved it.  I used my rice cooker for the full package and it turned out perfect.  Just the rice mix, water, salt and a tad of butter.  Absolutely irresistible.  We didn't stop until we finished the last grain.  I can't wait to try the other varieties.  It is definitely worth the expense.  A much better deal here on Amazon than I can find locally.Try it, you'll be glad you did!

column9: Great  Product....but not a good value...............
column10: Great  Product....but not a good value for the price.  This is $5 per pound here but at the market its $3.49.  Makes no sense, sorry

Enjoyed, I bought using a kindle special offer and really became a fan of this tea. It brews a deep rich red, the mix reminds me of the English Christmas wassail but with more smoothness which comes from vanilla I think. Very nice for a cold and tastes wonderful esp. because their ingredients are so fresh.

Both of my dogs absolutely love these and have no digestive problems afterwards. They chew apart nice and easy, so there is no gummy mess, as least not as much as a regular rawhide. Best of all, they do not break their teeth.

Grandma's spoiled dog has been eating these for a couple of years and hasn't gotten tired of them.  Gives her something to work on...the prize being the red flavored center strips.  We usually end up throwing out the white part after she's managed to get the "good" stuff out of the middle.
She loves the flavor, and it keeps her busy!  Great for small dogs (mine weighs 12 pounds) -  I will purchase again.

To keep our dog happy (and to help fulfill her extreme chewing needs), we keep a supply of Dingo bones in the house at all times. She absolutely loves these things! They don't seem to upset her tummy and they keep her busy for at least 20 minutes at a time, so for us, they are worth the money. I really wish Amazon sold these things in multi-packs at a discounted rate, as that would certainly help to make them a bit more affordable.

These 9 ounce dingo bones are the perfect size for my 40 lb pup. He absolutely loves the taste, and I love that it takes 50 minutes for him to finish. Just be sure to have water available as he/she will be thirsty after gobble it down.

Everything about this sale was perfect.  It was exactly what I ordered.  the price was better than I could find in any store and it arrived before I ran out.  My dogs love these things which means I love them.  Good job!

We have two miniature dachshunds and they just love these!  For Christmas we wrap each bone separately in tissue paper and let them "open" their presents.  They just can't get enough of these!  Just remember to keep lots of water on hand.  As with all rawhides, they sure make the girls thirsty!

DANGEROUS BONES!!! Little dogs love these bones because they are tasty BUT they are truly dangerous. Our family Maltese (Pebbles) who had just turned one choked to death on one. They are not even safe if your supervising your dog because our dog choked on one in the presence of my sister. We were unable to do anything for her as we watched in horror as she slowly stopped breathing and got her to the vet in less than ten minutes. The vet attempted an emergency procedure and removed two peices and the bone had also tore her trachea. Her death was caused by these bones. These bones are not worth your precious pets life as it tore our family apart.
These almonds are very small, over-roasted, they are very dark and taste horrible!My suggestion: don't buy!, get another brand.

I bought these almonds after reading the previous 1 star review. After tasting them, I realized that they are 100% over-roasted. Only positive thing I can say about these almonds is the packaging. But apart from that...they really taste burnt. I hope that the manufacturers of these almonds can stop over roasting them and add a little bit extra salt. I have down-graded the rating from 3 to 2 stars as I think these are well below average tasting almonds.

when using Cafe du monde in yellow can grinds fall through into your glass. So disappointed.Can someone who has experience in the style of brewing please recommend a better product with smaller holes?Having grinds in your mouth cant be the reason people like this right?
I'm making perfect Vietnamese style coffee with no complaints! Do not screw the middle section down just place it on top. It took me maybe 3 tries to get it just right but it works perfectly.

Not bad. These are our first Vietnamese coffee filters and it seems to drip fine for us...although one of the two leaks out of the side. But the other one is perfect. Not bad for the price...we're not complaining :)

One of the filters I received works great, but the other one seems to be a bit more shoddy. The inner piece does not screw in very tightly, so it is difficult to achieve a proper dripping speed (I like my coffee to be very dark). With a little extra effort, I can get it to work. All in all, a good, but not great product.

column9: great coffee filter at a great price
column10: I have been enjoying delicious Vietnamese coffee since these arrived. They are easy to use, although do require some adjustments during brewing to make sure that the water flow remains constant.

Although more sturdy than others I've bought, the holes in the bottom of these are too small to allow the water to drain throuhg. Just add coffee and hot water without replacing the lid or screwing down the tamper and it takes over an hour to get it drained. One day I'll try drilling the holes out larger. Right now it looks like the openings in a very fine salt shaker.

column9: Quality control problem. No response on complaint from Tanka company.
column10: I really wanted to like this product.  The taste and quality of the properly sealed items are outstanding.  However, 2 of the bars in my box were moldy, within sealed packaging.  White mold visibly present upon opening the packaging.  I contacted the Tanka company and never received a response.  They claim 100% satisfaction in their product yet don't seem to respond to complaints.  I am less than satified with my money being wasted and no response from the company.

Maybe it's just me, but these things are nearly impossible to open. The plastic at the seal is weaker than the glue that holds it together and it just pulls right off. I haven't been able to open these without a knife.I got the spicy version and there is some heat to them. They taste good with the hint of cranberry, too.

column9: I liked it until I hit the wild rice
column10: Take the wild rice out of this and I'd give it 5 stars.  As it is, the weird textural thing the rice brings to the party is very, very unwelcome.  You feel like you bit into a piece of soft bone or  tendon and it adds nothing to the flavor.  I guess this helped them beef up some nutritional component or make it look 'healthier', but if I were them I'd leave it out.After the 'wild rice surprise' (I had no idea that was in there) I've eaten them and they've been acceptable.  At the current prices in my opinion the ostrim are larger, cheaper and better tasting without any weird textured ingredients.
Great tasty treat !  I could never have enough of these on hand :)  if you haven't tried one you must !

This product deserves 4 or 5 starts, not 3. I really like jerky but 98% of the products are full of junk. The healthy, all-natural jerkys at the organic grocery stores are insanely expensive ... several dollars per ounce. The Tanka jerky tastes great. I love this stuff. I agree the packages are a little tricky but no big deal. About the mold - sounds like a bummer but I haven't had any issues. I will definitely keep on ordering this stuff for once in a while treats and emergency snacks. The mild is good and the spicy has a little kick, but not too much.
I am really impressed with the Tanka Buffalo sticks. Great taste without being too spicy! A little dry but otherwise perfect.
This gum tastes great at first but does lose its flavor rather quickly.  Seems almost too thick to blow good bubbles with as well.
This product tastes ok, but has a little crystal flakes threw out the gum that makes chewing it a bit odd(at least for me). Other then that it seams ok.

I was hoping to stock up my emergency pantry with these but they're heavily dented and lightly rusted, packaged in only a plastic bag. I can't trust them to last very long like this but I'll figure out something to do with them.

My mother is a huge believer in home remedies, in herbs and plants to help soothe away your aches and pains. Burn your hand? Break off a bit of the aloe plant. Stomach ache? A soothing tea made of sarsaparilla root (which is apparently kinda dangerous...oops). My minor in college was Folklore, and I love this kind of stuff, different plants that supposedly help with different aches...I've seen it firsthand in my wife. She gets crazy bad migraines, and a good cup of mint tea can help her keep things under control. But I love the Red Leaf Teas website, especially their matchas, that list everything the plant involved in the flavoring can do. Take this tea for instance:Did you know that studies showed that pomegranate juice destroys breast cancer cells while leaving healthy cells alone? It may also prevent breast cancer cells from forming.Pomegranates also offer the following benefits to list a few :Lung Cancer PreventionSlows Prostate CancerKeeps PSA Levels StableProtects the Neonatal BrainPrevention of OsteoarthritisProtects the ArteriesAlzheimer's Disease PreventionLowers CholesterolLowers Blood PressureDental Protectiontaken from the Red Leaf Teas website.Now, part of me just brushes most of that off, but the part of me that is my mother's hippie daughter drinks this matcha just in case. My aunt recently started chemo to deal with her breast cancer, and one of the things that helped speed up the end of my grandmother's life was breast cancer, so I don't mess around with it. If there's even a slight possibility something might help prevent breast cancer in my body, I'm there. I've already had that scare once, so it's not something I take lightly. And pomegranates are just a good idea all around. If I can get that great, juicy pomegranate flavor without having to deal with the hassle of getting in to an actual pomegranate, even better.The smell is wonderful. Nice and strong and juicy, I can already taste the delicious smoothies that will come from this. But I'm moving away from the smoothies more and more, as I used to think the only way I would enjoy matcha would be in a smoothie and I have since learned that that is decidedly not true. I'm on my third cup today!I don't know how to describe the taste other than juicy, which I feel like I've been using too much lately. But it's true! All of the fruit blends I've had from Red Leaf Tea have been juicy! This one especially...and I can just see a Matcha Pomtini in my future. Or mix this with a little orange juice? Yum. This tea is definitely one I want to spend a bit of quality time with.

This is a really good taco and general sauce. I use it, though not exclusively, on eggs, meat, fish and green salad, as well as homemade tacos. However, at $2.50 a bottle and another $1.00 per bottle shipping, it is hardly worth buying here.  I can get it at our local market--where food is always more expensive than the large conglomerate city stores--for $1.79.  I wish Amazon would take this on as a Prime product, then all who like it would have a regular, less expensive source.

If you are a resident of the American Southwest, you probably would have eaten in a Taco Bell restaurant. It serves Americanized Mexican food - tacos, burritos, quesadillas, nachos, etc. They are delicious, especially with their small packets of sauces. This mild Taco Bell Restaurant Sauce is full of favors of chili pepper and other spices. I use it with tacos and burritos as well as other non-Mexican dishes. I highly recommend it.  I first noticed bottled Taco Bell sauces in supermarkets a few years ago but they disappeared from the shelves of my favorite supermarket shortly.  Recently, I notice that this Taco Bell sauce is again on the store shelf. See my comment below for additional buying option.
Why would anyone buy at this price when it is 1/2 the price per bottle at the local grocery store? Unless you were in Alaska or somewhere you couldn't possibly get this stuff?
This is exactly what is sold at TB - my only gripe would be the cost.  We love TB mild!  I wish they sold it in the packs though....

This is the most disgusting guacamole mix I've ever had the misfortune to purchase. If I wanted to taste Pine sol cleaning fluid, I would have bought myself a bottle. I wasted my money. Don't waste yours. McCormick's produce partners is the best.

I tried this after years of being a "no cake mix" snob. found it in south carolina, and can't find it up here in n.j. it is delicious. everyone who tastes it loves it. and it's embarrassingly easy. tip: make an icing out of cream cheese, powdered sugar and a tiny bit of maple flavoring and chopped pecans. worth every calorie.

column9: Delicious cake and a nice change from white or chocolate!
column10: This mix is delicious!  Works well with German chocolate/coconut frosting, cream cheese frosting or almost any frosting that isn't citrus flavored.  Rich flavor and nice find here on Amazon--it isn't carried in stores all the time.  I also recommend the Betty Crocker strawberry and cherry mixes, which are hard to find and are available here.

Okay, usually I buy organic cake mixes, but this was a new and unusual flavor so on an impulse I bought a package at my local Farm Fresh grocery store. I baked it in a bundt pan and only dusted it w/ organic powdered sugar as a frosting. All of us thought it was incredibly delicious. It does not taste artificial (like the strawberry cake flavor does-another impulse buy that I will NOT repeat). I wish it did not contain partially hydrogenated oil, but nonetheless it is soooo tasty, that I will continue to buy it.

column9: I could eat the whole thing by myself
column10: I don't generally like artificial butter flavor but this cake mix is to die for. It's good plain. It's good with berries. It's good with cream cheese frosting. But it's absolutely TO DIE FOR when topped with Nutella. Warning: you may gain 50 pounds.

THANK YOU AMAZON for carrying this. I found this ONCE in my local grocery store and made mini rum cakes using it. They were such a hit and we wanted to try them again but ALAS there was no Butter Pecan cake mix ANYWHERE in the city of Atlanta. *gasp!* On a whim I searched here and I am so pleased! Outstanding deal, to boot!TWELVE cake mixes? I am set for the year! I love the flavor of this mix - does not taste processed.
It is hard to find Butter Pecan cake mix and I was so happy to find this product on Amazon.  This cake mix tasted awesome in my recipe for Weight Watcher cookies.
This is a great mix.  Great flavor whether you make it as instructed or use it in other recipes.  We just love it!!!
I love this cake so much that I ordered a case; this cake is the best cake that I have ever had! If you love butter pecan you will love this cake!

column9: Betty Crocker's Butter Pecan Cake Mix
column10: I came across a great cake recipe using BC Butter Pecan cake mix using the Coconut Pecan Frosting in the cake mix. Now I have plenty of cake mix to make several special cakes for family and friends. The price was amazing for 12 boxes. Good price Amazon. Thanks again.
i've been looking for these cake mixes for several years and FINALLY found them on amazon.com

I use this product for a cookie recipe and it always gives me perfect cookies every time.The only complaint I have is that I cannot get it shipped directly to Hawaii, I have to mail it to a friend on the Mainland and then they ship it to me. It takes many months and costs a fortune by the time I finally get it.

The mix was a little lumpy...had some hard chunks that would NOT dissolve, they were as hard as rocks and some had to be fished out of the batter. The mix was not expired, it was as if it had been exposed to moisture or improper temperatures during storage. Still came out o.k. and tasted great.

If you like truffles, you owe it to yourself to try this out!  The first time I used it, I used too much, the salt is really salty & the truffles are real- well, you get the idea.  Only a pinch at a time turns scrambled eggs into a fancy treat!  Bought some several months ago and I'm back buying some for a friend who is a very good cook.  Had some trouble with their web site back then, but I hope they have it worked out by now.
I have tried 4 or more brands of Earl Grey tea and I like this one the best. It is fragrant and tastes as good as it smells! Very nice flavor, very smooth.

column9: One of the best root beers available
column10: First of all, for most people a birch beer and a root beer are almost the same thing. The taste is similar, and birch root is used in many products labeled as root beer. This company also bottles another soda called root beer, but this tastes better. It has a touch of wintermint in the complex flavor, spices, and vanillas. Nice  creamy texture on the tongue, less carbonation than most, which is good since it allows the flavor to come through. Yet it still has a nice foamy head.  They did not use high fructose corn syrup,  but chose cane sugar as their sweetener. It is more expensive but you can weigh down a soda with the corn syrup. So without it it is lighter and more refreshing.  I have to warn you, you may get spoiled if you drink Boylan's sodas as they are not cheap, but very addictive. Originally brewed in 1891, this New York classic has the same flavor as it did over a century ago.  Boylan's Birch Beer started in a apothecary in the early 1890's and developed into the most popular flavor of The Boylan Sodaworks. Boylan was a bottling and keg filling operation located in the heart of Paterson, NJ, the first industrialized city in the country. Competition increased however, and in the 1930's Boylan was forced to close its bottling lines, leaving Boylan's Draught Birch Beer as its only product. Shortly thereafter, the rights to the name, the formula, and the sole route was purchased by the driver. His grandkids the Fiorina's still run the company in New Jersey today, and have expanded to near a dozen very delicious flavors. They recently changed to the very good looking and nostalgic bottles and painted on labels that are different than the shown at the time I write this reveiw.

Absolutely the best birch beer, and best soda, I've ever tasted.  I haven't had it since I left New York.  On my diet I'm not allowed soda often.  So I figured if I can only have it once in a while, when I do I'm going to spring for the best!  Yea to Amazon for making our home town favorites easy to find!

Although I grew up in NYC, I had not tried a Boylan's until recently when I was in California. I was hooked quickly. Soon I found that this was being carried by Cost Plus, Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, BevMo... Now back in NY (Ithaca) I can't find it. One distributor carries it but it's a drive. Sometimes I order a case through Amazon. The Birch is the best Birch I've ever tasted. This is not too sweet and lightly carbonated. Very spicy. Excellent quality. Try the all natural line as well, it's great. The Black Cherry is phenomenal.

column9: Best Beer I've had so far!
column10: I tried this on a road trip when we stopped off in Omaha, Nebraska. I asked a worker at the Durham Museum what the flavor was like and she said 'its root beer with a more bitter flavor.' I tried it and was amazed that it tasted homemade, was less sweet, and better than all the other root beers on the market. I couldn't find this flavor in my hometown so I ordered it on Amazon unsure of how well Boylan's would package it. It arrived in a small box that I thought would have lots of bubble wrap in it but was pleasantly surprised when I found two perfectly die cut styrofoam pieces holding the 12 bottles in place on the top and bottom. I'm finally enjoying this Birch Beer once again!

column9: Best root beer type soda anywhere!
column10: Made with sugar instead of high fructose corn syrup. The taste is absolutely heavenly. The wintergreen brings back memories of good old fashioned root beer. However I would not pay these prices. I can get it at two of my local stores for $1 a bottle. Check with any store that carries soda aside from the normal, Meijers carries it.

I ordered Boylan's Original Birch Beer, the 12 pack, from Amazon. And the seller did a decent job packaging the bottles. All the bottles arrived intact and safely, and within a good timeframe from when I placed the order. I was first introduced to birch beer when my sister and I dined at Schlafly Bottleworks in St. Louis. My sister and I tried Lewis Osterweis & Sons' birch beer and ginger beer. This brand also has root beer. I liked the birch beer better than the ginger beer. My sister and I thought the taste of the Lewis Osterweis & Sons' birch beer was excellent and amazing. It's similar to root beer or cream soda, but different, unique, and yummy! The problem is that it's very hard to find Lewis Osterweis & Sons' birch beer. You can drink bottles of it at Schlafly Bottleworks or buy some from their giftshop or try to find some bottles at some other places in St. Louis, but other than that, you're kind of out of luck. I went on Amazon, and out of the birch beer products offered, the Boylan brand stood out. I went on Boylan's website and read how these New Jersey-based birch beers have been their "flagship" products for more than 100 years. I like how the birch beer is made with natural cane sugar. I've been a fan of Boylan's other drinks, but I didn't try their birch beer until recently. It's a nice birch beer, and it's great to share these bottles with your friends and family. I give a big thumbs up to this product!

The product is excellent with good taste and of course real bottles.  The shipping container was just great and provided GOOD protection for the bottles.  Product arrived in a timely fashion and I was very pleased with the overall service.  I would recommend this experience to anyone!

I love the flavor and body of Birch Beer. It is almost too light, as I can practically swill it except for the cost. I have been drinking the Creamy Red Birch beer for many years when it is available at Cost Plus, but this original flavor has never been available here, and Cost Plus says that the Red is all that they are shipped. The Red has vanilla in it, but otherwise I think the birch flavor and concentration may be the same.  I couldn't really tell the difference.  I will hop over to Cost Plus before these are all gone and buy some Red for a direct comparison. I do find both the Red and the Original to be a little too sweet for my taste, but the exotic flavors in them make it worthwhile to consume a few now and again.  A couple Birch Beers, after a hike on a summer day, are extremely satisfying, more so than a Coke or a beer.

A few weeks back I had the opportunity to try Boylan's Birch beer at the French Laundry in Yountville(which has been named the best restaurant in the world on more than 1 occasion). I fell in love with this drink and today found it on the shelves of Draeger's supermarket. It is unique and a true treat!

Was FLOORED by the amazingness of this soda!!  Natural, carbonated, not too sweet, authentic, feels like the way soda was before mass market products.  Great mouth feel and nice dark appearance with an almost stout beer head and look at first pour.  Will be in my normal rotation of beverages!!
Arrived as promised.  Extremely well packaged.  Has a wonderful flovor as I remembered from many years ago.

column9: Very Refreshing When Served Ice Cold
column10: Boylan's Birch Beer is great when served ice cold. When I tasted my first bottle, I was taken back by the taste. It was at room temperature and for some reason it just didn't seem quite right. I had placed more bottles in the refrigerator so when I tasted one that was ice cold I drank it in about 1 minute because it was that good. Try it, I'm sure you will like it too.

The above title pretty much says almost all I need to say about this product:  It has a dense texture and a wheat taste.  By itself the flavor is good but not 'yummy':  I would add some oil to the crust, both to the top and the bottom, to give it a little more flavor.  I don't think this product would enhance an otherwise homemade pizza, but I don't think it would detract from it either.
These are so delicious. Much better than the brands you find at the grocery store. I discovered them @ a specialty food store by my house, but I'm so glad they are on amazon @ a great price.
I really enjoyed this product. It tastes good and is very close to the Russian or Iranian versions. Also, the service and quick delivery were an added bonus.  I would highly recommend this product.

Guys, do you know what "malossol" means in Russian?"Lightly salted".This particular caviar was actually over-salted quite a bit.Other than that its a very good tasting caviar (I guess you can blame a puddlefish for that), very close to Russian Sturgeon's caviar.

Upon reading the other reviewer's comments, I tend to think that the chestnuts may have been improperly stored - healthful foods rot faster than unhealthful ones (the microorganisms know what's good!) As far as these chestnuts are concerned, they are DELICIOUS! I was actually surprised that they are as good as they are because I thought that since they save you all the trouble of roasting and shelling that you would have to compromise somewhat on taste. Not so! Excellent product. A delicious AND healthful snack.

Standard purchase this time of year - roasted chestnuts. My husband makes the traditional English chestnut stuffing for Christmas dinner.I tried these trying to do my own private taste testing to see if price and/or packing do make a difference.  These are a half the price of the more expensive ones packed in jars and it is a pretty large bag.  Taste wise they are OK, a little softer than the ones in the jar.  I read the other reviews about them going bad after opening.  I have the remainder of the bag in the refrigerator. Two weeks and  they are ok.  Still smaller portioned bags might be nice.I still say, the best ones are the ones in the jar that Wms. Sonoma sells,  but they sell out FAST.

My initial taste of these roasted chestnuts were positive! However, after a week, the remaining chestnusts in the ziplock bag turned slimey and is covered with an unappetizing goo. I had to throw away the rest of the bag for fear of spoilage. DO NOT BUY!

Of all the date sugars I've tried to bake with, this is by far my favorite. I simply substitute 1 cup date sugar plus 2-3 tablespoons water (to help it mix well) for 1 cup granulated or brown sugar. I've found that cookies made with date sugar are always better the next day (if they last that long). Great results making peanut butter, brownies, honey snickerdoodles rolled in date sugar and cinnamon, vanilla wafers. For chocolate chip cookies, I mix date sugar with a little water for one type of sugar and unrefined cane sugar (Rapadura or Sucant) for the other. The kids love them!

column9: Delicious and Sugar Free - A Low Glycemic Wonder!
column10: Many years ago I began to suspect that sugar consumption was adversely affecting my health.  I cut it out of my diet and noticed an immediate improvement in my energy, and other great benefits as well.  I even went to a doctor and took the fasting test to see if I am diabetic or hypoglycemic but was told that I am not.After that, I read "Sugar Blues", which further confirmed for me that sugar needed to be permanently removed from my family's diet.  Since then I have searched for ways to enjoy sweet treats without the negative effects of sugar.  This syrup is delicious and does not cause any of the problems I noticed after eating sugar!  It's wonderful after literally years of not enjoying pancakes and french toast to have this excellent product.  Thank you Fifty-50; your product is not just for diabetics!

Our family loves this syrup. I try to find foods for my family that don't have sugar in them because we all seem so much happier and healthier when we don't eat sugar. So, this syrup is wonderful because it has only natural fruit sugar and tastes great. I also love that it doesn't contain artificial sweetners which I feel are worse for my children than sugar. Since I can't buy it in any grocery stores in my area, I order it online by the case. That's how much I love it. My children love pancakes and waffles with syrup and this syrup makes me and my kids happy.

Tried to find locally... but as usual seems when I find product I really like and works with my health conditions I can no longer find it... So I will have to be creative in finding ways to use the dozen bottles when I really only wanted one at at time... tuff situation.... finding ways to use a really tasty product... LOL! Thanks to the company who makes it and Amazon for carrying it!

It may be of moderate glycemic impact, but this taste like cheap pancake syrup- the corn syrup ones, not so much like maple.  I gave the case away to the food pantry.  I still give it a three for unreasonable expectations perhaps.

I've purchased Copper River Sockeye Smoked Salmon both in Alaska and through Amazon.com.  Everytime I've had it, I have been very satisfied with the taste and quality of the product.  Interestingly, I've found it cheaper to purchase through Amazon.com than to buy it in Alaska!

Maybe i'm spoiled having grown up around friends and family that caught and smoked fish...  i was quite disappointed by the lack of flavor and mushy texture of the product.  My wife and i were of the same opinion, and now she's insisting i smoke another salmon fillet like i purchased from the butcher block at our local Fred Meyer (essentially Kroger NW.)  IMHO, you can get much better offerings at more reasonable prices and serving sizes if you look around, let alone smoking your own.  Will NOT buy again.
Not very flavorful and not a great value.  I believe there are better deals out there for smoked salmon including on Amazon.

This salmon isn't awful, but it tastes like plain cooked salmon, kind of bland. It doesn't taste smoky or briny, or at all like smoked salmon. It doesn't smell very appetizing either. There is much more flavorful and tasty salmon out there.

I write this as someone who lived for decades in Alaska and who has eaten salmon in every form imaginable:This stuff is as close to tasteless as any salmon I've ever eaten. That is quite a statement since it is pretty much impossible to screw up a red (chinook) salmon filet. A bit of salt and brown sugar for a rub, let it sit for a day, pop it into the smoker until it is done. It is automatically delicious and I've never known anyone, even a rank beginner, to screw it up. But somehow these folks found a way to produce a vaguely fishlike slab that tastes of nothing.This was so expensive that I will have to find some way to use it up but it will have to be some way which entirely disguises the lack of salmon taste and that won't be easy to accomplish.

I got my salmon yesterday, it smelled like it was turning rancid, then it had juices that smelled even worse. I am disappointed with it, I'm finished getting perishable food shipped to me. Also I thought I ordered Nova Lox, because when I went looking for it, this item was the third on the list.  I know now, make sure to get nova lox.
I ordered this for my Mother's Christmas present.She called and told me that is was bad; it had a terrible smell.

I tried these first as part of a sampler of Funky Monkey freeze dried fruit snacks and then purchased the single flavor set.  They are similar to the Just Tomatoes brand fruit snack, Just Strawberries and Bananas, so if you like those, you will enjoy these.Funky Monkey snacks are all natural, with no sugar or oils or fats added.  Just the natural sweetness of the bananas and of course, cinnamon.  Each package is 110 calories, so it makes for a good portion controlled snack for weight watchers and a healthy choice for kids.  The other Funky Monkey flavors are just as good.  Highly recommended.

I suspect the negative reviews are from people who were expecting this to be more like dried fruit. It is not. It's freeze dried, which is not the same thing.Let me start by saying that from way back in my teens, I was a huge fan of Seneca Apple Chips, and also of banana chips. I loved the taste and the texture, but eventually had to back off from both of them because they are deep-fried, and that, to me, doesn't make a great option for a healthy snack. Then, a few years ago, I saw products by Crispy Green on my supermarket shelf, and decided to give them a try. I tried the Crispy Pineapple, Crispy Apples, Crispy Apricots, and couldn't eat any of them. The freeze-dry process left them with a chalky texture that would make my skin crawl when I chewed them. (I have the chills right now, even just writing about that experience.)Then, in August of this year, a friend of mine gave me a bag of Funky Monkey to try. They were so delicious and not at all chalky, I didn't even think that they were freeze-dried! They are so light and airy. They fizz a little bit and melt on your tongue if you don't chew them right away. They are very pleasant to eat, and taste great. And the freeze-dry process retains most of the nutritional value of the original fruit, making this a great option for adults and kids alike.These are NOT apple chips, or banana chips, or dried fruit. If you're not accustomed to freeze-dried fruit, the texture may take some getting used to, but Funky Monkey does a far better job of preventing chalkiness than any other freeze dried fruit snack I've tried. And they have fun, exciting flavors! I brought a case of these along on a camping trip, and they were a huge hit! So many 5 star reviews can't all be wrong, right? If you haven't tasted these, at least give them a try.

These are so yummy! The whole family enjoys these as a snack. My kids would rather eat Funky Monkey for a snack than fruit snacks. And these are actually fruit, which as a mom I feel great about! I would highly recommend this product.

Bananamon is my son's absolute favorite Funky Monkey flavor. He asks for it at breakfast time (along with lollipops and chocolate--sigh) and I don't mind giving it to him, especially when we're on the go.It's way less messy than toting a banana in the car and he's getting three servings of fruit in the one ounce bag! Plus the only thing that's added is organic cinnamon.What could be better for my little monkey?

My 2yr old daughter loves these. I love the packaging because it's great for on-the-go snacks. We go through maybe 3 packs a week. They do go soft as they stale- usually last a day or 2 open before they go stale.

column9: No More Funky Monkey For Me!
column10: I did not like ANY Funky Monkey Snacks.  This one tasted like they took over riped bananas and they left a horrible taste in my mouth.  They fizzed up when you ate them and then I felt like a green banana was just given to me.  I won't be buying these again.

Neither my wife or I could tolerate the taste of these chips.  We found one person who like them & gave them to her.  I can see how kids might like them but for us they were too sweet & had an off taste.  Two stars since we eventually found someone who like them (tried several people who didn't want any after the 1st chip)>

This is a great snack for toddlers. It's real fruit with a little cinnamon. It is freeze dried, so the fruit is hard, but he loves it. The only thing that would make this better is if the bags were resealable.
Funky Monkey is awesome.  Can't wait to try other flavors. The cinnamon banana is outstanding. I also had the benefit of a coupon from Hungry Girl. Otherwise I might have missed this great product.
the taste is great and nutritious with very little salt and sugar. This is great snack for children and adults. My friends love it too.

column9: Crunchier than a fresh banana, but just as healthy
column10: When you compare the nutritional facts on a package of Funky Monkey Bananamon to that of a medium raw banana (calorie king website) pretty much everything is the same.  The freeze-dried ones contain a tad more sugars (15 vs 21) but the fiber and potassium are right on.Personally, I hate the texture of fresh bananas, but love the banana taste so these crunchy treats were wonderful.  The package clearly states that they are freeze-dried, which is VERY different from a dried fruit.  If you have not before had freeze-dried bananas, try a single pack!  Dried fruit can either be crunchy-hard or soft and pliable, of which these are neither.  They get gummy if you suck on them, so I can see them being a good treat for older infants/young toddlers with fewer teeth.The cinnamon was a nice touch to the banana, and not overwhelming at all.  My 3 1/2 year old tried to eat a whole bag without sharing, and now that I've compared to the "real" thing, I will let her!  These are going to be great to have on the run when a fresh banana just won't make it (like in the glove box during a WI winter).  The cost will prevent us from making these more common in our household, but with an expiration date 2 1/2 years away... well, a case would never last my child that long anyhow!

column9: Crunchy and sweet in a small package.
column10: I found these on an allergy website.  Luckily, Amazon sells them.  They have a good price here, it is till steep for the small amount that you get.  But it is a handy serving size for portion control.  Just think how many you could eat out of a large bag!  very crunchy and sweet.  The kids love them.  They like all the flavors.  I carry these with me in the car for a sweet treat when the kids get screaming.  Easy way to get more fruit in our diets and satisfy our sweet tooths!  We will buy again!
Tasty, healthy, low in fat and all natural! Great product! We always have it in stock at the office.  Bananamon is the most popular!  Thanks!
I love this snack as a take along to the movies. Better then Popcorn and better for you!

column9: IT IS NOT GOOD , VERY BAD TASTE !

column9: Swedish Fish as good as you remember!
column10: We used this product as a handout for a parade where we were using a water theme.  The candies tasted as good as everyone remembered and we had several people THRILLED to see a candy they remembered from when they were kids.  Those who hadn't had them before were intrigued at the look and loved the new experience. This delicious snack was a great price, and love the fact that these are individually wrapped. The heavy duty box is very convenient to use.
I got this for my sons 3rd birthday candy station. So it's perfect for what I needed it. The price was good too.
This was just what we needed for our float in the 24th of July parade to go with our fishing theme.  The kids loved it!
I enjoyed this product. I like to mix it with the Arizona ice tea to make a half and half mix. Great summer drink.
Yes, it has been thru some changes and I wish they would quit discontinuing my fave flavors or revamping them. This is not as rich as it used to be, but it is drinkable.

Wish, wish, wish this was still available. This is my favorite flavor of all time. I add 1 rounded tsp of instant Espresso with the coffee powder. It's not too sweet and this version takes only 2 rounded tsps to make a great taste. I don't buy the other flavors anymore as now it takes 4 tsps and they no longer offer this flavor. column9: Good soup.  No more dented cans.
column10: The issues with the dented cans seems to be over.  Have not had any in quite awhile now.This is one of my favorite Campbell's soups.  Hearty and good flavor.  Decent meat.  Good split pea taste.  Not gourmet, but plenty good to my taste.  Good buy when on-sale here or there's a coupon deal combined with subscribe-and-save.One can makes a pretty satisfying meal even for a big guy like me.

This is the closest you can get to the original Nesbitt's Orange that was sold the during 1940's, 1950's, 1960's and into the 1970s.  Everything since has used artificial flavor and corn syrup.  The flavor is amazing.

To be perfectly honest, this is the first time I've ever had Korean BBQ and it absolutely knocked my socks off.  A close friend recommended Mama Eun's home delivery service and I decided to go for it.  I placed my order, paid the bill, and forgot all about it.... until one day when the delivery guy dropped a package on my doorstep.Mama Eun's packaging system is great!  Everything came securely wrapped up inside a cozy disposable (or reusable) ice cooler.  The freezer packs inside kept the meat nice and cold during shipping and are now hard at work in my freezer (nice bonus!).Then, I went to town.I tossed about half of the package onto the grill and a few minutes later the aroma had my mouth watering.  Seriously, people - this is great stuff!  Everything is already marinated inside the package and ready to go.  The meat was so tender and fresh I seriously reconsidered every buying any kind of meat at my local grocer ever again.  Who knew delivered food items could be so darn yummy!Now I'm hooked.  I love Mama Eun's "homemade style" and business approach.  Everything was very professional (but not in a lame corporate way).  They even included some cooking tips/directions in the delivery.  Needless to say, i was very impressed by this company and will be back again soon.  I'm placing my next order right now...

I became a facebook fan. :) I ordered 2 lbs which was a lot more than I expected, but I think that I will order more in order to save shipping cost.

I've been to a bunch of Korean BBQ restaurants, and this was right up there with the best of them. The amount of meat you get is more than enough to feed 4, and for the price it's a great value.If you like Galbi, or Korean BBQ in general, I highly recommend Mama Eun's!!!

I always loved chamomile tea as a child, but recently it has never tasted the same, until I tried this brand one day and discovered that it keep the chamomile flower buds I think that is what really makes the difference. Normal powdered chamomile in a sack just isn't the same. I think this brand is excellent. It is very expensive though.To the guy who posted the bad review why don't  you post where you found this cheaper one you claim is just as good, because I have not been able to find any alternatives that are this quality for less. column9: One of the best Chamomile tea I have known in the world.
column10: I have tried almost all kinds of Chamomile tea bags on the market, This is one of the best I have ever tried so far. I am a repeat buyer of this and I recommend for everyone near me. Very good tea to solve insomnia if you experience one.

column9: Very weak... and a hint of plastic?

Could be the baggie it was in or the sachet, which is made out of some kind of plastic fabric.

I purchased a quart carton of chamomile tea at a street fair about 2 years ago.  I started using it a few months ago and it was excellent, in spite of its age.  It had a great calming effect on me and I went to sleep about 20 minutes after drinking it. I've tried the Sumatra and French Roast and are hands down my favorite k-cups. column9: Starbucks kcups rule- but cheaper at kohls
column10: These are some of my very favorite kcups! However, this is a ridiculous price! Kohl's has a box of 14 kcups for 9.99 ! Much better bargain.

I bought a 16-ounce bag of Bob's Red Mill Organic Golden Flaxseed Meal a few months ago and have been using it ever since. I have heard that you shouldn't keep it that long once you open it, but I haven't noticed any problems. The bag says "keeps best refrigerated or frozen," and I keep it in the refrigerator. I add about a tablespoon of the flaxseed meal to a ~16-ounce smoothie I blend fresh every morning, and I love it for that purpose! It doesn't really add any flavor that I've noticed, but I do believe it makes my pumpkin smoothies taste more like pumpkin PIE smoothies (I guess the flaxseed meal taste and texture reminds me of a pie crust being crumbled into the mix). I used more flaxseed meal in my smoothies a few times when the bag tipped out more than I was expecting, and it just made the smoothie thicker than I intended (not a big deal). The blender I use is a cheap single-serve blender, so it doesn't grind the meal up very much more than the original product straight out of the bag, but the texture doesn't bother me. The texture is not a fine powder like flour, nor is it sand-like as with cornmeal...it's flaky. I do have to wash my cup out within a few hours of finishing my smoothie, or the meal flakes will stick to the sides and make handwashing difficult.I have used it once as an egg substitute in a box cake recipe (for each egg, use 1 tablespoon flaxseed meal and 3 tablespoons of water; stir and let sit for about five minutes to get a bit gummy). Though the cake turned out okay, I'd probably not use it that way again. The cake density was a bit off, and my husband didn't like finding little flakes of flaxseed meal in his cake. He is fine with it in his smoothies, though.

column9: It's just like the others...not better...not worst
