I do not know, I was only looking for #1Note that 1 and 2 have their own taste.Number three (Bulls Eye) and the others have a similar taste to each other and I picked Bull Eye as the best of the rest (which tasted similar to each other)

These are really good.  I take them to work all the time for a nice treat for co-workers.  They are easy to make, and they really taste great!  We often add extra chocolate chips to them.The only con would be the same with any brownie: they are not kind to your waistline.

Looking for quick snack. Picked up this brownie mix at Walmart to test it. Most mixes just don't work for me. Added some butter and used less oil. Added some walnuts. Took them to Book Club members meeting. When I opened the container, the aroma was just right.  We all dug in and ate them right away. They were delicious.  Can't wait to buy some more.

column9: My favorite brownie mix, for sure!
column10: This is my favorite brownie mix out there.  This is a pretty good deal when it comes to brownie mixes online.  I sometimes try another online retailer but they are almost always out of stock.  It is nice to come on Amazon and find them in stock.  I would like the boxed mix because you get more mix and it will make a 9X13" pan but I make this work.  I use 2 pouches, which makes a thick 9X13" pan of brownies ("thick" meaning it is a little thicker than if you made the 9X13" pan with the Betty crocker box size).  I use the same directions on the back of the pouch as if I were making the 8X8" square pan (just using 2 pouches and the larger pan) and it seems to turn out just fine.I like the "fudge brownie" flavor.  The dark chocolate and the milk chocolate flavors of Betty Crocker brownie mix just don't seem as chocolatey.  I have tried Pillsbury, Duncan Heinz, and Ghiradelli and I like these brownies the best.  The flavor and consistency of the Betty Crocker Fudge Brownies are always the way I like it and they always seem to bake well (I sometimes have a problem with the Ghiradelli ones cooking since they are so thick, which is why I'm not the biggest fan).We live overseas and I had someone say that they wanted to learn my recipe for brownies.  I feel bad that I have to tell her to follow the back of the Betty Crocker box!
This is a good snack, you can have these whenever you want. I like to add nuts to the product.
Excellent product and such a handy way to buy it!  Amazon to the rescur, again!

These tasted really bad. They weren't expired, and there's only 3 steps to making them, so I don't know how they turned out so disgusting, but they did. There was a lingering bitter taste and no fudge taste to it.

column9: BEWARE! Contains partially hydrogenated oil...BAD for health!
column10: Of course my fault, because they do have the ingredients listed.  I gave it all to a food bank.  Thought about throwing it away but realize that maybe others may want to eat it.  What a quandry as they may or may not know that it contains hydrogenated oil which is so bad for our health. :(  There are alternative brownies brands on here that do not contain that....YAYYYY for those companies that offer quality products with quality ingredients!
I purchased the 2011 graduation buttermints to put in the Graduation serving caps that I purchased. The buttermints were an excellent price and arrived quickly.

column9: I can't decide if the outhouse or my cozy toilet is the better place for this product.
column10: After trying this for myself, I suspected that those high ratings were only illusions. My husband told me that company's consider these reviews as just another form of advertising and pay people to lie about a product's quality. I really can't imagine anyone thinking this product is drinkable, let alone, pleasurable. If you want a couple recommendations on decent tasting t-discs for your Tassimo machine, the Jacobs Latte Macchiato isn't bad if you add sugar. This morning though, I drank it after I tried the Voluptuoso and my mouth has a metallic taste to it. Not sure which one is responsible. Another thing, the milk in the disc tastes sour, but when you add sugar, there is a decent flavor there. For the 2nd decent beverage, you can take the Kenco Crema with some Coffee Mate's Spiced Pumpkin and Vanilla Spiced Chai (a liberal amount) creamers, with enough sugar, and have a nice smooth cappaccino. I've tried about nine flavors now, and the coffee, cremas, most lattes and cappaccinos, have the same inferior quality in looks and taste, as a cheap instant coffee, as well as, having your mouth taste like you just drank the contents of an ashtray. Kenco Crema is the only one that did not taste like nicotene. These are the coffees I've tried: Gevailia Cappaccino, Maxwell House - House Blend, Hag Crema Decaf, Jacobs Kronung, Carte Noire Voluptuoso Classic, Kenco Crema and Jacob's Macchiato. After finding one inferior brew after another, I've given up looking for a good cup of black coffee and/or cappaccino, for the Tassimo. Don't do what I did, which was believe all the positive reviews and downplay the critical reviews. My curiousity has been appeased after spending $34 in Tassimo beverages. Thankfully, 2 packages were free. Now I can either spend more money in S&H to return them, or drink all 56 cigarettes...coffee I mean. Oh by the way, for a tasty hot chocolate beverage, try Celestial Seasonings "Tuscanny" 1 bag made strong, followed by 2 pkgs Carnation Instant Hot Chocolate, with mini marshmellows, and hot water in a tall to-go insulated mug. Amazon sells both, but you can get the chocolate mix on sale for about $1.50 in a grocer.
My favorite snack mix by far.  The only thing I would change is to add more of those little crunchy rice balls.  Really good snack with cocktails...particularly with scotch or beer.

If you like Cheez-It crackers, there is no doubt you will like their snack mix.  There are items you are used to (pretzels) as well as some you have never seen in a snack mix!  I highly recommend this.  Just be careful--it can be addictive!
These are just so darn good!!  Always fresh and just the right snack!  Have a little, have a lot!  Your choice!

If you have not tasted these, then you do not know what you are missing. And the price is super low compared to what one box cost in your local grocer. Only thing, is mine was chock full of mostly cheezeit crackers and pretzels. I had to eat the whole box before I found a few crunchy bagel chips and rice balls. For Shame!
I am a huge fan of Cheez-IT. For the price I bought these was a great deal, to me. One of my favorite mixes, absolutely loved it. Great party snacks. And yes, they were fresh.
If you love Cheez-It Snack mix this is a must have for your pantry.  The price is great.  You get three boxes.  I put them into snack bags for my kids so they are always available for them.

I do not know what it is exactly but this is a strange mix of ingredients. Perhaps it is the "? garlic crackers in it, but I get a stomach ache every time I eat this. column9: The only Cheez-It flavor that I don't like

The Cheetos' powder gets on everything so it's really messy to eat, too.I frown every time I see these on the shelves now. What a disappointment.Cheez-Its Snack Mix: Not Even Once

Food and drinks in pouches are life savers!!! The apple sauce taste as good, if not better than those in jars. Huge advantages are that they fit nicely into back packs, no spoon requirement, one had eating action, and a great quick snack. If they can put more stuff into travel pack like this, I would eat and drink everything from pouches. One complaint is the packaging. They waste way too much packing material for the bulk box. It's 4 pouches inside a card board box, then 12 of those boxes in another box. I don't plan of selling these goodies so I can do without the extra packaging. Go cheap on the extra cardboard and pass the savings on to the customers.

This means more sugar in your product.  The flavor is blander and sweeter.  I liked the old cinnamon apple sauce a lot better.  It had a nice appley flavor and was healthier.

This is a wonderful product.  My kids loved having them in their lunches.  Healthy and tastes great.  What more could you ask for?  Expiration date was months away (always a plus).  Pricing was excellent.

This product is so convenient and delicious that I carry them everywhere we go.  When my grandson is over he does not head to the candy dish on the table he wants to have an "apple squeezer" as he calls it.  When he leaves he always asks to take another along.  We use these to take along on road trips too, no mess, no fuss just twist off the cap and consume.  Buying by the case is the way to go and the apple-cinnamon is our favorite but we do like all the flavors.

column9: Where have you been all my life?
column10: What took so long to come up with this?  These are great.  I buy them regularly in all flavors.  It's nice to throw a healthy snack in the bag and not have to worry about breaking jars or dirty spoons.  I eat them, my six year old takes them in his lunch, and my two year old eats them too.  Amazon's price is the best I've found.  This is my family's favorite flavor.  Seriously, we eat these every day.

I'm a junior in high school and I absolutely love these. They are so yummy and healthy. They're great when I'm in a hurry and want something quick to eat. Over the summer I do chores for over an hour before breakfast and these are great to keep me from getting super between the time I wake up and the time I get to eat. I would recommend these to anyone.

column9: delicious but watch out for small tops

I order but will not pass the top to my toddler. these are perfect when traveling and taste good. can get at some whole foods markets.

column9: No mess, easy snack and natural too.
column10: I only gave this product a four for one reason: there's not a lot of food in the pouch. :)Other than that, my kids love this. I have two pretty picky eaters, so any way I can get good food into them is a win with me. I don't have to send an extra spoon. We take these all over the place as snacks because there's NO MESS. It's wonderful.
It was everything I had hoped for. I was able to pass along some samples to family members with diabetes. Would be great for their quick sugar fix! I intend to order more.
My kids love these.  I love that they only have two ingredients - apples and cinnamon.  I just wish the packaging was recyclable.
I love these little pouches for my 11 month old! So convenient and easy to take on the go and I love that they are 100% all natural. Nothing extra added and in bpa free plastic!

This is a great healthy snack for kids of all ages.  It's great for an on-the-go snack or a fruit for kids cold lunches.  My kids love the applecinnamon flavor.  When I did the math, by ordering this applesauce through Amazon, I was getting it even cheaper than I could at Walmart.  Also, Walmart was almost always out of the applecinnamon when I would go to purchase it.  Ordering in bulk made it easy and convenient for me to always have enough on hand.

column9: Kids' obsession that we've spread to other families!
column10: My kids have always loved their "squeezy applesauces," and this flavor has become their favorite. I love the convenience and that it's just fruit. They love the fun packaging. I have turned so many of my friends onto this line for their own kids... amazingly even those who aren't big applesauce fans love slurping it out! My son also likes the Strawberry one, and my daughter the Peach. Cinnamon is the one they both seem to agree on so I buy it in bulk.
Kids love it! No mess. Great for travel, zoo, store, park, everywhere. Lid screws on/off. Doesn't have to be refrigerated.
These applesauce pouches are great.  My daughter and I love them.  Easy, portable and great flavor.  They also come in handy when backing and don't want to use oil in the recipe!

My girls (6 and 4) were not excited to see similar products if they had Elmo or other 'little kid' images on them, as they automatically thought it was baby food - and seeing that my two divas are anything but 'big girls', I was happy to see the package was big-kid friendly. In any case, this apple sauce is delicious and nutritious. We have tried all flavours by now and LOVE the cinnamon one (followed by strawberry, peach, banana, 'plain' apple).

I was very happy to find these on Amazon, since I love having the baby food pouches for my daughter when we are out and about, and the ones you can buy at Target (the best in-store price I've found) are significantly more expensive. At 8 months old, she's been able to hold it and feed herself for quite a while already...making it that much easier to use. It's a great way to contain the mess that carrying normal baby food around can bring. We don't use these all the time, but when we need them they're great to have.As a sidenote, I make all my other baby food, and would absolutely love if someone would come out with a refillable pouch so you could reuse instead of buying new each time...

Alright, I'll be honest...I am 23 years old with no kids, but I love these little pouches! They are super convenient snacks on the go. These Apple Cinnamon are my favorite because it is literally just apple and cinnamon! No added sugar or apple juice concentrate and only 50 calories.
This applesauce is best flavor in pouch and I am not a child! Have tried them all! Love the apples that are from this French province - what an on the go delight!
Bought these for my girls to take to school with their lunch.  They love them!  I love that it's just apples and cinnamon. Nothing extra added.

The product itself is great and my kids LOVE it!! I thought I was getting a super good deal with Subscribe and Save, then I saw it at Costco WITH a coupon and it was much cheaper there. MUCH.  Bummer!

This is my favorite Applesauce!  It is delicious.  I highly recommend it, you can take it on the go to eat.  Perfect for lunches or a snack.  I've bought this from amazon twice now...and it does not disappoint.  Yummy

I originally bought the applesauce crushers from Trader Joes and my son loved them. Decided to look on Amazon to get a better price and found these little gems. What I wanted was no sugar added applesauce pouches and these are the best price and love that they have plain and cinnamon (in addition to the other flavors) We have them in all our diaper bags and cars for emergencies. My son loves them so much sometime he will eat 5 in a row! I'm not a huge fan of applesauce but have tried them and they are really good. Even though they do contain natural sugar I still feel good that my son is getting his fruit! I actually just started feeding them to my 6 month old daughter with a spoon and she loves them too! I wish they were organic but that is the only thing I would change.

Great packaging idea for on the go treats for little ones in a car seat or as a tote along treat for the older sibling events who need quick energy!And the taste is good with various flavors to pick from!!  Check out the variety!

I've got an active, healthy eating toddler.  We're often on the go and this is something he has mastered eating in his car seat.  I love that I feel better about this product than many other snack foods.  Once less thing to worry about.
My daughters love these, they are their go to snacks when they are hungry!  We love that they are easy for them to eat on the go and they are great for lunches.

I am always on the lookout for natural food.  This is no joke just apples and cinnamon.  The taste is amazing and it is convenient. I can take these with me anywhere and I am able to eat them on the go.  I would highly recommend them to anyone who loves applesauce.  So far I have tried the cinnamon and strawberry. I am getting ready to order the peach and banana.
FINALLY a quick, easy, prepackaged snack I can feel good about feeding my kids. AND it's almost mess free! Absolutely perfect!!THANK YOU!!!

These are great for packing applesauce in school lunches or for snacks, and I don't have to worry about half an uneaten applesauce container being spilled in the lunchbox for me to have to clean up! My whole family thinks they are really tasty. I'll definitely buy them again.
My granddaughter says that the applecinnamon is "yummy-licious." The GoGo SquueZ containers make no mess. This is a good bargain and perfect as an on-the-go snack.
Bought a case of this applesauce as my 18-month old loves it!  It's perfect for when we're out running errands & he needs a snack. So convenient and easy to pack.  Great product!

column9: One of the best inventions ever!
column10: These are a huge hit at our house! Easy for both my 3 year old and 10 month old to use! Mess free as long as your kids don't squeeze them before they are in their mouth. My 10 month old will hold one of these and just suck it down! Great for on the go or just when you need a quick and easy (and nutritous) snack. I recommend these to everyone and was excited to find them in Subscribe and Save! YUMMY!

This is great for being on the go with 2 kids.  We can take them to ball games, swimming lessons, shopping trips, etc and the kids get a healthy snack without the worry of utensils.  My boys love them, I have told many other parents about them.  Subscribe to Amazon reminder delivery to get the best price.

These applesauce pouches are a great snack for my kids!!!  Not only do they LOVE them, but they are healthy for them too.  It is a very quick and convenient snack for when we are traveling or on the go.  I highly recommend these to anyone with kids (even good for older kids)  Super for lunch boxes too.
my kids love these, both for packed lunches, or a quick snack while i am making dinner, my speech therapist recommends to help with muscle improvement

I believe my 17 year old likes these better than my 3 and 4 year olds do. These are just easy snacks for them ALL to have in the car or in their lunches. They taste great and I would definately recommend.

These are great to grab to go since they don't require a spoon. I also keep some at my desk at work because I can eat them while I work.  Simply unscrew the cap and enjoy the applesauce!  The only negative is the cap.  My 10 year old has a difficult time unscrewing the cap because it's a small diameter cap that has the safety-seal prongs you have to break.  On and the applesauce tastes good, too

My 2 year old daughter has always loved applesauce, but she is borderline obsessed with these. She asks for one each time we get into the car. I was so glad to find this product - it's healthy and doesn't include other unpronounceable ingredients, and the package is perfect on the go. We can't keep these around in our house - they go fast!
My daughter is 10 and she doesn't eat apples except for in this form! She has one for snack every day!

column9: We are all addicted to these!
column10: My toddler, my 8 year old, and myself can't get enough of these yummy snacks.  I only wish they came in varieties with a little more nutrition, like some added mango or carrot or blueberry, or perhaps vitamin fortified, but that's ok.  This is a healthy snack that feels like a treat because it's fun to eat, and they are especially nice cold from the fridge on a hot day.  I take one wherever I go to keep the toddler happy.  He loves them, and when I pull a "fwoot" out of my bag it magically wards off tantrums in the bank or grocery store.  My daughter just had strep throat and liked eating these when nothing else sounded good.  And when I get a sweets craving, sometimes I have one of these first (50 calories, no added sugar) and that often takes care of it.  Highly recommended!

column9: loved by whole family, except one!
column10: My 5 year old loves these.  She would eat 3 pouches at a time if I let her!  My husband and I also like them (although I much prefer the apple-peach to the apple-cinnamon).  My 2.5 year old, however, just gags on these and spits it out.  I'm not quite sure what her problem is, because she does eat normal applesauce out of a bowl, but she really doesn't like these at all.  I think part of her problem is that she is expecting a different texture - this is much smoother in texture than applesauce from a jar.Despite her dislike we will continue to order these (amazon price is way better than our local store).

column9: Teens love them--not just for toddlers
column10: I've been buying these for about a year and my teens and hubby just love these.  I freeze them, so that they keep the other lunch items cold and it's ready to eat by lunchtime.  Their friends come to the house and raid my freezer just to eat these.  Healthy snack for those with braces.

The entire case was expired when I received it. I love this product, but I was very disappointed when I received an expired box of applesauce. I contacted customer support, and they are shipping a new box. Hopefully, the next shipment will be in date.

column9: Like the product, but arrived with only 2 months before expiration
column10: Amazon did not like my first review so I will pull some punches this time (but leaving this as 2 stars).  I ordered these with another grocery item which had less than 4 months before expiration (vs 6 months typically for that item in store).  The Go Go Squeeze pack which I received had only 2 months left before it expires (expiration 7/21/12 and today is 5/7/2012).  These typically have about 9 or more months of shelf life in store.  I also noticed a slight plastic taste/smell when I tried one which I suspect comes from sitting longer on the shelf.  I noticed this much more faintly on the ones I purchased in store which were good for another 9 months.  I am overall not really happy that I purchased these from Amazon, from now on I will be buying them locally.The two stars are for the handiness of the product.  They are just OK as applesauce and kind'a small for an adult at 3.2oz, but they can't be beat for pack-ability.  I am also not a real big fan of the plastic smell/taste that I notice when opening the product.  It does say on the package that it is BPA free, though it does not say what the packaging is.
For kids and adults alike, these granola cereal bars are worth the extra dollars. They have a unique whole grain taste. Great on the go snack. Waiting to try other flavors.

I use to purchase these cereal bars in my local grocery store but they don't have them anymore. To get them I have to go way out of my way. Ordering them through Amazon is a better value and it arrives at my door in the time promised.
These are tasty! The fruit flavor is excellent. I could almost eat a box a time. Plus, best of all they're fruit juice sweetened... No sugar.
Love to have these on hand for the whole family.  My 3 year old son is dairy-free, so I buy these for him.  But everyone else loves them too.  Healthy and delicious!

I bought these every week when I lived in Portland, now that I am in the Midwest I can't find my favorite breakfast bar. Loved getting them this way, they are fresher and even better than from the store.
I thought these were organic, but they are not.  Also, they have 13grams of sugar.  Not worth the extra money.  Sorry I got them.

column9: No egg, dairy, soy, peanut free facility...
column10: I'm so glad we found these.My egg and peanut allergic daughter loved the organic cereal bars I was buying and it made a good quick but filling breakfast or snack for us when we're busy. But then we found out she's also allergic to Soy and slightly to cow milk. And almost everything I've found that is egg free has soy, including the bars we were using.She loves these, and is happy to have her bars back.15 g sugar per bar... so definitely not an all the time thing

I bought these bars for several years at my local co-operative grocery store, and ate them daily--they are tasty. However, the price increased nearly 100% during that time, and I noticed that, although the individual wrappers within the box remained the same size, the bar within the wrapper decreased. When I stopped buying these, the actual bar was only half the size of the wrapper. That's deceptive packaging, so I refuse to buy these any more. I suspect that other shoppers likewise complained, because last month the store where I bought these stopped carrying them.

My son loves these cereal bars. I used to be able to get them at my local market for the past 5 years, until they were discontinued. My son has allergies to milk products and is unable to eat regular cereal bars and these are a great substitute. I am glad I can now continue to obtain these Amazon. We have tried other cereal bars that are diary and gluten free but they are not as tasty.

I have been having these as a mid morning snack at work for over 7 years now. They are so delicious and with much better ingredients and less preservatives than nutra grain bars. Now my little toddler loves them too! I worried they were discontinued when Nature's Choice, the original brand, stopped carrying them. But they were just bought out by Barbara's. Same exact delicious product thankfully!

i love the flavor and taste of these bars.  the multigrain is made up of oats and barley, giving the crust a fresh taste and not crumbly.  the triple berries is a nice blend and there is not one overwhelming flavor between the crust and berries.  150 calories, 29g of carbs.  it is a tasty and filling bar.  highly recommended for a breakfast treat along with a good cup of coffee!
Moist, juicy, and very good. I eat one or two of these a day. They taste great, but I do wish they were a bit cheaper.
We've tried other cereal bars and these are by far my toddler's favorite!  They are good quality and the Amazon price is terrific!
These are great! All of their flavors have great real fruit flavor, they're moist and it's tough to eat just one.Such an awesome alternative to the traditional sugar included cereal bars. Love them!

These are great! All of their flavors have great real fruit flavor, they're moist and it's tough to eat just one.Such an awesome alternative to the traditional sugar included cereal bars. Love them and Cherry is one of my favorites.

A little too sweet sometimes, but a great, allergen-free cereal bar. Also perfect for little hands, so I share this bar with both my 5-year old and my 1-year old. yummy! Just be sure to have a glass of water near by, these are very dense bars.
Great tasting bar.  I have one after lunch everyday.  Great ingreadients.  Healthy bar that will not make the scale go up.
These cereal bars are great.  They're sweetened with fruit juice and have lots of whole grain, but they don't taste like cardboard.  They're a great deal with the Subscribe and Save on Amazon, too.
If you like cherry, you won't be disappointed!Not a hard bar, very soft to eat.Some people may find it too sweet - but I don't.

These aren't the healthiest things a person could eat, but they are better for you than a lot of the breakfast bars available. My 2 year old loves them, so we have them on subscribe and save. She asks for these whenever she wants a snack.

While slightly high in carbs (29g)low in sodium (85mg)and 150 calories per bar,this is not a weight loss product nor does it pretend to be.The texture of the pastry is light(with the fruit inside)and filling and as these things go, fairly healthy.The sugars show 15g per bar but it is fruit sugar and naturally delivered.The taste is excellent and again as these go, hard to stop with just ONE.But plaudits to Barbaras Bakery for a fine breakfast product or just as a snack.

column9: Great Product - Best Natural Cereal Bar I've Tasted
column10: It's hard to find natural cereal bars that taste good. Well, these do. Not only that, this is the only brand that I've tried that I haven't become sick of after 3 years of discovery.

These cereal bars are fantastic. All of their verities have great fruit flavors and not to mention NO added sugar (fruit juice sweetened and plenty sweet enough). Perfect for a mid-morning snack or otherwise.

These cereal bars are fantastic. All of their verities have great fruit flavors and not to mention NO added sugar (fruit juice sweetened and plenty sweet enough). Perfect for a mid-morning snack or otherwise.

I was looking for a delicious breakfast bar that wouldn't fall apart and still taste great for the kids.  These are great!  I like that they have 150 calories for myself as well for a snack they are a great hit.  They have a nice fruit flavor with a wonderful oatmeal as well.

I thought that "NATURES CHOICE" and 100% natural meant just that.I'm on a special low acid diet, and natural blueberries are allowed, but all the other stuff they added is NOT.Here's what they left off the description above.INGREDIENTS: BLUEBERRY FILLING (FRUIT JUICE CONCENTRATE [PINEAPPLE, PEACH, APPLE AND PEAR] BLUEBERRY PUREE, TAPIOCA STARCH, APPLE POWDER, NATURAL BLUEBERRY FLAVOR, VEGETABLE GLYCERIN, LOCUST BEAN GUM, RED CABBAGE [AS A COLOR ENHANCER]), PINEAPPLE JUICE SYRUP, WHOLE OAT FLOUR, WHOLE BARLEY FLOUR, WHOLE OAT FLAKES, RICE FLOUR, DATE PASTE, APPLE POWDER, EXPELLER PRESSED CANOLA OIL, RAISIN JUICE CONCENTRATE, MALTED BARLEY EXTRACT, TAPIOCA STARCH, PEAR POWDER, NATURAL FLAVOR, SALT, ALUMINUM FREE BAKING POWDER (SODIUM ACID PYROPHOSPHATE, CORN STARCH, BAKING SODA), BAKING SODA.MANUFACTURED IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO PROCESSES PEANUTS, WHEAT, SOY, MILK, ALMONDS, PECANS, HAZELNUTS, MACADAMIA NUTS, CASHEWS, AND COCONUT.NOW, where's the blueberries...........instead of juice concentrate, Pineapple, peach and pear......i thought something like this would mean BLUEBERRY FALVORED on the label, so people would know.They show whole blueberries on the package, but used pear juice and concentrate to make the blueberry flavor.Returned for a refund. I tried one, and while they do not taste bad, they are a long way from real blueberries, especially if you are on a strick acide free diet.

column9: delicious instant coffee, but only $5 at local armenian/eastern european store
column10: This is an all time favorite.I prefer this over many types of regular coffee. It's very finely ground, smooth, nutty flavored, and it has a very creamy foam on top when you stir it well.Only complaint.... it's way over priced on amazon.I buy this at my local farmer's market for $5 a tin.

I'm not much of a coffee drinker, especially not instant coffee, but my family and I are hooked on the Israeli Elite Instant Coffee.  It is so good that I'm saving lots of money--I never stop for coffee on the way to work any more.  I'd rather enjoy my Elite coffee at home before heading out the door. I never would have believed that instant could taste better than brewed, but it does if you buy the right kind.

I usually grind my own beans, but occasionally I don't have time or run out and like to have some instant coffee on hand.  I used to have a friend bring me Kosher Elite coffee from Israel years ago and always liked it.  Glad they carry it on Amazon - even though it ships from Israel. It took about 2 weeks to get to California and the coffee is as good as I remember - nice and strong with a little bite to it.
Organic or not, there is no excuse for their terrible grainy texture. It's just bad. You won't like them. I don't get it, who decided this nonsense was 'brownies'? Mo thanks.
This is the best boxed brownies. My family loves these brownies.  They are soft and chewy and savory with robust, satisfying flavor. These are the most enjoyable brownies.

These are my favorite brownies that you can make at home by far and are also better than anything you can buy at a grocery store! They have a great consistency and deep flavor! They are also very easy to make. If you add extra water to the icing mix, believe it or not, you can make an extremely rich, chocolatey drink similar to a Starbucks (don't go there often-rude service here in Atlanta and probably most places!) chocolate beverage that was served years ago. I don't put frosting on the brownies and just make a small serving of this rich "hot chocolate" when I am making them because the frosting mix is so similar to cocoa mix. I would never buy a different brand!

Coffee was acceptable in strength (brewed as 9 oz cup) but there was little 'butter pecan' flavor to speak of.  I'm not likely to reorder this flavor.  I did appreciate each pod wrapped individually.  This keeps all pods fresh until used.Update (Sep-06-09): The flavor is growing on me a bit -- still not butter pecan -- but it's an OK cup of coffee.

column9: They must serve only Baronet coffee in Heaven! I'm sure of it!
column10: I now have Baronet Coffee flavors; Chocolate Fudge; Hazelnut; French Vanilla, and french dark roast. EACH flavor is true in taste....no artifical flavor at all. When you open a foil packet of any flavor you know what flavor it is....BUT you also can smell the rich, smooth aroma of the coffee itself. I don't know how they can be SO fantastic that no other brand I have tried can compare....but that is just the way it is. So far superior it continues to surprise and delight ! And now, if you will excuse me, I am going to order another Baronet flavor to add to me collection! If you can drink and serve a coffee that ranks above coffee shop coffee...why wouldn't you?! Enjoy

This flavor was delicious and went by quick in the house. I would recommend this flavor to anyone, but I wish it had more of a kick to it that coffee should have. I felt like I gave up the coffee kick for the flavor, so I ended up drinking 2 cups/day to make up for it - happily though.

I am so in love with these cookies form Anthon! The entire line of marzipan cookies are amazing and ver HARD TO GET unless you are traveling and find these in Duty Free shops.  SO glad I can now get them at Amazon and plan to stock up before the summer sets in!I am not a fan of marzipan at all but the entire cookie like has such a delicious chocolate base and yummy filling, you really don't taste that marzipan flavor other cheap companies use. THESE ARE AMAZING.

A friend of my mom's gave her a few of these chocolates and she loved them. She asked me to see if I could find them on the internet and there they were on amazon.com. The order was placed, filled and she is most happy with the product and soon will be ordering more. Thank you!
If you love marzipan and you love apricot, you can't ask for a more perfect combination!  It's a taste of heaven without the wait!  I just wish they were easier to find.

column9: I Should Have Never Tried It ... Too Late Now
column10: I was wandering around the international food aisle when this caught my eye. Sweetened, condensed milk in a re-sealable bottle rather than a tin can. I said, "Oh my! What evil thing is this?" And then I bought it. You might not be able to use a whole can of sweetened, condensed milk, but you sure can find lots of uses for a it when it comes in a squeeze bottle. I put it in my coffee, in my tea, over my fruit, over my icecream, and then I lick the plate.The really nice thing about this container is that you can turn it upside down so that the nice, cool, sweet goo that is La Lechera is ready to pour whenever you want it.Don't buy this unless you want a new addiction. Seriously.

column9: Condensed Milk in Coffee - Try it, the taste is awesome
column10: They should of used this type of bottles for ages.  Use to come in tin cans, typically I use it once, and it rots away because there is no good way to store it after opening.  Even though this bottle is a bit more costly, but use it, wash it, then buy the tin cans to refill it.  Eco friendly and pocket friendly :)

column9: I should NEVER have purchased this product!
column10: I purchased this product to make fudge with. I reasoned that I could make partial batches of specialty fudges by weighing out the sweetened condensed milk. WELL, the dispenser top on the container made this product just tooooooooo accessible. Reviewer "Paisleymonsoon" made it quite clear that this product had a sinister nature and that it could prove unholy to have it in your home. SO, I said to myself, "Self, you know you don't have an addictive personality, that is for weak people, and you've never been weak." Reviewer "Just Smile" also tried to warn potential buyers, but did I listen? NO! My husband is not into sweetened condensed milk (actually I have not asked him, I decided that I wanted, in this case, to assume) and I have not offered any to our pets either. You cannot share this with an animal that will eat anything, that would border on sacrilege. SO, since there is no one else to partake, and the lid bears a remarkable similarity to a delivery device, I have found that direct hits from a refrigerated bottle of it is as good as any a way to consume the mandatory amount necessary to sate my ferocious addiction. I suggest that sane, refined, civilized persons pass this product by, for the good of their own self-esteem, and for the good of their sane reputations. (NOTE: If they make the Fat Free version in these bottles instead of cans I will personally be in very big trouble!)

column9: Makes Vietnamese coffee so much easier!
column10: I am a huge fan of Vietnamese iced coffee, but dealing with the cans of sweetened condensed milk was such a pain. It was harder to open, messy to pour, and more difficult to store. This stuff is so handy because it's in a plastic squeeze bottle. I don't really notice any taste difference between this and other brands - I guess I'm no connoisseur of sweetened condensed milk. The only thing I would really change would be to make the hole in the cap a little larger because if you keep this in the refrigerator, it can be a bit difficult to squeeze the milk out.
Do yourself a favor and DON'T order this if you tend to eat sweetened condensed milk with a spoon!  One taste and you're hooked!!!!!

column9: Tip for easy way to store open CANS of this excellent brand of condensed milk
column10: I like the idea of these squeeze bottles and I will investigate how cost effective it is to use them instead of the cans which work well for me.I have been using sweetened condensed milk in my coffee, off and on since learning to use it as a child at my grandparent's adjacent farm over on the other side of the squash field.  My Father preferred HEAVY cream (we had our own cows) sweetened with THREE teaspoons of sugar but even as a child, I did not care for that over the top combo normally favored by those engaged in heavy labor (a good description of my father with his day job and plowing at night by tractor headlights) as a quick caloric boost.  In these sedentary days, your doctor would put you on the don't call back list for such a dietary sin.  I actually prefer BLACK coffee when making a brew with my favored fresh ground (Vietnamese, espresso) but I was given a Keurig as a present and all the K-cups available taste better to me with some milk in them and those machines are too easy to use for that first quick jolt in the AM. The canned milk is very rich and it will last forever in the refrigerator, unlike any fresh milk/cream.  I find that La Lechera seems to be less sweet than the old standby, Eagle Brand and that pleases me.  This brand works perfectly for Vietnamese iced coffee which if you have never had, I suggest you try soon-- I enjoy it on an occasional basis in the summer and everyone I have introduced to it likes it a great deal.Anyway, I had the same problems with storing open containers until I realized that pet food can lids would work well.  They are (presumably) food grade plastic, inexpensive at the pet super stores and fit the condensed milk cans perfectly (same size as a standard tuna/cat food can)-- some are even cleverly molded to fit several different sizes of can to also fit the larger cans.  With normal handling, the milk NEVER touches the lid so even mystery plastic should not be a great consideration but I would look for a brand that is not made in China from industrial waste if that is possible anymore-- I have 4-5 that I have been using as pet food lids for years, acquired pre-Chinese economic invasion.  These lids work better and easier than the side cutting can openers which provide the cutoff part of the can as a lid!

Sweetened condensed milk is yummy, we all know that.  What makes this product great is the container used.  Normally you buy it in a can and then if you don't use it all then you need to figure out how you want to store it.  And it is easier to use as well, with the squeeze bottle.  Good product, what more can I say.

WOW! Condensed Milk in a bottle, what a great idea! No problems with the bottle - just flip and squeeze!  Will be buying these from now on...

The product in the packaging is excellent to be sure but I find the squeeze bottle packaging to be vastly superior to the cans in which sweetened condensed milk is usually sold. Once they're empty, I use them to hold my home-made dark chocolate syrup. Win, win as far as I'm concerned.The only drawback to the packaging is that one can't cook it into dulche de leche but since that's available in cans from Amazon (saving one the trouble of cooking it), I don't think it's any problem at all.

column9: Yummy, wish I tried it before >***look at my  STORAGE/STABILITY information
column10: I wish I tried it before...used over strawberries, ANY FRUIT, and on Oatmeal, YUMMY!It's great stuff and don't worry about it going bad, it stays good for at least 3 weeks, then use the tried and true smell method before you toss it, but am sure it will be used by then.I plan on taking the top off when I use it next time in quantity...thickens when cold to the point of making it a real workout if you have more than two tugs on the bottle, take the cap off.INFO:check the "best before"-date on the label of the milk product to ensure that you are buying the freshest milk available.The sweetened condensed milk conditioned in a metal or plastic container if unopened can be stored at room temperature and the shelf life is about 6 month from the manufacturing date. The preservation of the milk is obtained through heat treatment (85-90 °C), condensation, increased sugar content and the air-tightness of the package. The benefits of this treatment include totally destroying osmophilic and thermophilic microorganisms and inactivating lipases and proteases, which decreases fat separation and inhibits oxidative changes.Opened canned milk should be immediately transferred to a clean glass or plastic container, covered and stored in the refrigerator. It should be used within 3 weeks of opening. If you don't consume the opened milk during these weeks, it is possible to freeze it (the earlier the better). The storage time of frozen milk at -18 °C amounts approximately 3 months. For reusing defrost milk in the refrigerator over night. If it contains a lot of fat, it is important when defrosted to give it a good shake to remix the fatty and watery parts.UPDATE:Oh, did you know water never expires if in any sterile container (if not sterile, add a drop of bleach to it) that is no biodegradable?  It may taste stale after a hundred years but it is still drinkable, won't hurt you...same goes with juices, like the ones I sent you.Manufactures are required to put best if used by, because the food quality may be a fraction of a percentage less than the quality when it was first canned.  Canned goods from the sea may have been a bit faded in a color and the consistency strained, but totally edible if the can was not breached.IT STAYED GOOD FOR almost 6 weeks, twice as long as my research...maybe it would have been great longer.. OPENED, BUT REGRIGERATED...Last night I opened some canned strawberries...had some sweetened condensed milk, really thick, in a squirt bottle in the fridge for over two months, it still was great, even though it's not supposed to last more than 3 weeks.  Had two cans of strawberries and cream.

It was weird weather for Ho Chi Min City. But what isn't weird over here. December is the start of the dry season, but tell that to the rain that was soaking me down to the bone. I just came back from delivering -- let's just call them school supplies -- across the Cambodian border. I needed out of the downpour and stopped at one of the dozens of two stool restaurants that lined the curb. I was gonna ditch the scooter and head over to Mien Tay Bus Station. Getting outta Dodge seemed like a good idea at the moment. But first, a cuppa joe."Cafe filtre, sil vous plait," I said to the 9 year old kid waiting tables. I coulda said it in English, Japanese, German or Russian. The kid woulda caught my drift. You grow up fast and fluent on Pnam Ngu Lao. Especially when you're hustling tables at Bobby Flay's latest dive.  The kid brought me my coffee cup with the dented tin filter on top, typical Vietnamese style. But instead of the usual crusty, fly-specked can of Longevity Condensed Milk, he brought this oblong thing...with finger grips on the side.  "Grenade in the house" I yelled and threw myself under a passing grandmother.When the kid stopped laughing, he helped me up and showed me it was just a bottle of LaLechera Sweetened Condensed Milk.  "What are you trying to pull, kid" I asked. I'm not gonna fall for another slipped mickey. Not at this stage of the game."It's really good condensed milk. Check this out: a new and convenient container instead of that awful tin can. Much more hygenic, with an easy pour spout and ergonomic design; not to mention it's quite attractive," he said, his eyes cutting from side to side to see who might be listening. The guy at the next table looked like he was trying to be invisible.  I gave the kid a little nod in that direction and he lowered his voice. "The taste is excellent." he sotto voced me. "Sweet and rich, but with an underlying caramel savor. It really brings out the soul of the coffee.  On a wet night like this, it's comforting.  Plus you can use it on fruit, just a small spoonful transforms fruit salad or a dish of berries into a rich, satisfying dessert. And for a special treat, spread a little on toasted raisin-walnut bread or try it on warm gingerbread." With that, the kid disappeared into the crowd. I never saw him again. Or maybe I did. I broke my glasses when the old lady from the grenade incident came after me with her cane.Anyway I tried the coffee with the LaLechera.  It was good. The rain let up so I got back on the cyclo and headed for the bus station. One too many good times here in HoTown.  Time to check out. Besides I was all out of the Hello Kitty pencils and had to pick up another dozen Spongebob Stencil Sets at the Staples in Hanoi. Maybe check out those new dayglo rulers I've been hearing about too. Snooze and lose, that's how it works in School Supplies. One last look around for memory's sake. Man, they don't call it HoTown for nothing. Christmas time and the place was crawling with Santas.

After a lengthy research of more than a year, I found out that though most sweeterners FEED bacteria and Candida Albicans, Xylitol DOES NOT. I started using Xylitol regularly and found out, to my surprise, that my worst Candida symptoms were GONE. The symptoms would recur every time I had fruits (darn!)or something made with refined sugar or other sweeteners like Splenda or Stevia, or even the Aspartame that is used on Diet Drinks. Whether I liked it or not, it became clear to me that I could not eat or drink anything sweet, that I could neither have any fruits and that I could not drink any diet sodas. I have intensely and extensively "tested" Xylitol for over a year and I can AFFIRM without a doubt that it is the ONLY sweetener I can use without getting my symptoms back.I buy chocolates made with Xylitol on a regular basis and I use this brand of Xylitol to make chocolate bread and all kinds of cookies. I also make healthy chocolate ice cream with Xylitol, unsweetened cocoa powder and soy milk. If it were not for Xylitol, I would not be able to put anything sweet in my mouth. One of the most recognizable and annoying Candida Albicans symptoms was that I had to get up every one or two hours every night  to urinate (!!). It was a nightmare, but it helped immensely when it came to "testing" what was good or bad for me. Conclusion: If I stay away from all types of sugars, natural fruits, fruit juices and sweeteners, and only use Xylitol-sweetened stuff, I feel much better in every respect and, very importantly, I can sleep 6 or more hours in a row without waking up to go to the bathroom.
