column10: French Vanilla and Kahlua not the best mix. I much prefer the Baileys version of this coffee. Nice for the first cup, after that it just like other coffee.

I have been drinking a ton of coffee lately and this French Vanilla blend is fantastic!  No sugar added into the grounds which I was worried may be the case at first.  Even without sugar it tastes delicious due to the french vanilla flavor.  My girlfriend and I both love it!
I was looking for a flavored coffee and this is it.  A very flavorful mellow blend, the vanilla is not overwhelming the coffee taste.

column9: White Coffee Kahlua French Vanilla Gourmet Ground
column10: White Coffee Kahlua French Vanilla Gourmet Ground Coffee, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2) purchased this item at Amazonis very good i am very happy for this product and price

Loved this coffee!!!  It's the best I've had yet.  Compared to other brand names including a famous mail order company that gives away a free coffee maker with the first purchase.  Not sure if I can use other brand names....

This is Jim Murray's call for whisky of the year in the 2012 Whisky Bible. He gave it a 97.5/100 points. I must say that it is a great whisky. Amazing craftsmanship it hits on all cylinders from nose to finish. Murray's professional skills pull more out of the nose and palate than I ever could, but there is a lot of wonderful malty, vanilla'd barley, citrus, fresh apples, briney complexity going on for sure. Very smooth and balanced all the way through, a touch of salt on the finish, then a beautiful wave of light oil.  Really nice and highly recommended.

I fell in love with the chocolate version of these candies when a friend brought them back from a trip to Germany. A perfect combination of chocolate, cream, and crispy wafer. I thought I might prefer the hazelnut version since I'm not a chocolate lover, but in this case, the chocolate version is better because it offers a better balance of flavors.  The hazelnut cream and milk cream are too uniform, where the chocolate offers a better combination.  These aren't bad; I just prefer the chocolate in this case!

Apparently there are two kinds of the happy hippos by kinder. Although these are good, I defintely the prefer the ones with the darker chocolate.  These pretty much look the same and if this was all I have had, they would probably get five stars, but I know the other one and it is so much better I can't give these more than three.  Also the ordering experience on these wasn't up to par.  I've ordered hippos many times and when I saw 91% off I jumped on the deal, skeptical but still got them.  They were anything but 91% off.  If anything they were more expensive than usual.  Euromart drastically inflated the price, said you were getting a case of them when all you got was a package of 5.  A case is 10 packages of 5 and that wouldve been a great deal and right about 91% off from what I paid for 10 packages of five.  Instead I got way less than I expected and pain a lot more for what I got.  That in and of itself made these less satisfactory.

These are some of the most delicious store bought treats that I have ever eaten. I cannot eat chocolate, and am always on the lookout for delicious alternatives. My daughter found a packet of Happy Hippos in a store in England, and when we tried them we were delighted. My daughter can eat chocolate, but said that these were easily as good as any chocolate candy she had ever had. They have a creamy hazelnut filling and a crunchy wafer shell-the hippo's body. They are delicious.

I love these...when we were poor and first married, we'd buy one roll for 5 cents and drive around sharing the candies and enjoying scenery in Germany (where we were stationed). Since then I have bought them from time to time...until a few years ago I found they make great throat lozenges.Now, at my advanced age, I keep a roll by my bed & know just how to get another LifeSaver during the night if my throat gets scratchy. And a roll in my purse for the same reason.So from 5 cents a roll to $40 for 60 rolls, these LifeSavers have always been a bargain.

PHENOMENAL PRODUCT!!  Had been buying these from Nationwide Candy and paying as much for freight as for the product.  That made the cost per roll right at $1.00.  With the amazon Super Saver shipping, the cost per roll is reduced to $.62!!  Now for the best part!!!...the rolls from Nationwide are .90 Ounces, and the rolls from Amazon are 1.14 Ounces!! Probably 3 to 4 more Lifesavers per roll.I buy these for my 93 year old mother who is in a nursing home and goes through about 5 - 6 rolls per week.  This was a great find (these are next to impossible to find in any stores...lots of Lifesaver products, but NOT the 5 flavor rolls).I will recommend this to anyone that will listen. And...even with the Super Saver shipping, the shipping was incredibly fast.  Absolutely thrilled with this transaction

The Five Flavor Life Saver hard candies are nice, sort of nostalgic.  But they are a substitute.  I really, really miss the Wild Berry Life Savers.I am a business woman and travel a lot.  A roll of Life Savers in the purse works well.  Bags of gummies or individually wrapped hard Life Savers do not.  (Gummies do not do the trick - in any flavor.)Keep the hard candy roll format!  Bring back the Wild Berry hard candy Life Savers!
This company delivered as promised. No complaints. The package was delivered in good shape. I'd order again. What more can I say. I ordered Lifesavers and they were shipped.
What else can I say about this many fine quality boxes of lifesavers for the price? Except I have to write more words for this review to qualify ...

I needed these lifesavers for baby shower favors and you cannot find these rolls sold individually anywhere!  The personalized wrappers from candywrapperstore.com were made to fit this size lifesaver roll and this was the best price anywhere for the candy.  Product arrived in good condition and after wrapping them, will be used as shower favors.  Had a few leftover wrappers and still can't find the individual lifesaver rolls anywhere!
Perfect in all regards - we used them in gift bags at a golf tourney - they were a big hit!
I use these at school for students birthdays. I put a candle in the end of the life savers, then sing Happy Birthday. The students get to take the life savers home to enjoy.

column9: Great quality food!  Even picky dogs love it!
column10: I can't say enough good things about the Lotus Wholesome Chicken dog food... we recently discovered this brand through our local pet store/groomer/doggy day care, which is known for carrying high quality and mostly natural/holistic brands of food.  We have a very hard time with one of our dogs, he is the pickiest little guy and will skip a meal or two because he gets bored with his food and refuses to eat it.  I have tried just about every high quality brand out there, always wanting the best for my four legged kids, and some of them, he won't even give the time of day.  This is THE FIRST food where he actually jumps up and down when it's dinner time!!!  He loves it, and I love that we're feeding such a high quality food.  The thing that sets Lotus apart from almost every other dog food out there is that it's baked, which helps in retaining a lot of the nutrients and protein, as well as the flavor.  It's packed with lots of high quality meat, grains, fruits and veggies, and everything is sourced in the U.S. and Canada(in the Chicken recipe... the Lamb is from New Zealand).One thing I have noticed, compared to other foods, is that it also has a much milder smell to it.  It just smells like something freshly baked(like tiny little cookies for dogs!).  Some other foods, which are very good, high quality foods, have an overpowering odor.  I think that might be part of the reason our dog turns his nose up at them, because it's too smelly.Luckily Lotus does offer a Small Bites formula in Chicken, Lamb, and Grain-Free Duck, because the regular adult formulas do have a pretty large-sized kibble that might be hard for smaller dogs(like mine).I hope my review helps spread the good word about Lotus and that other doggy parents will give it a try, your dogs will love you for it! :)

Don't waste your money on these oysters.  Okay appearance and texture, but the taste is awful, probably because they are in cotton seed oil.  Buy the ones that are in olive oil by Crown Prince. They are much better.

These oysters are small, about the size of the first pinky joint. The texture is firm and meaty, but smoke flavor is not at all strong. The cottonseed oil in here probably masked it. I don't get much smoky or oystery flavor. The ring pull top makes it easy to open.Some slight food safety concerns due to this being a product of China. Normally I read labels carefully before buying, but in my rush, I bought this. I will not purchase this product again and will choose more delicious smoked oysters from countries I feel safer about.

Although the smoked oysters were acceptable, the description was not. I purposely chose this product because the description said "product of USA." However, upon receiving the item, the packaging said "product of China." I won't order it again.
$15 dollars for a case of Fresca?  I can get it for $4 to $5 dollars a case at WalMart.

I've been buying and serving Lund's Swedish pancake mix for many years.  My grandmother was Swedish and she used to make us Swedish pancakes when we were very young children.  This mix tastes just like her homemade Swedish pancakes!  Yum!

I am ordering these today, but have eaten them many times.  No longer available in the stores I used to buy them in, I have eaten these since childhood.  And like the other reviewer said, you can easily recreate IHOPs Swedish crepes using this mix.  If you are near IKEA, they sell Lingonberry jelly which is very low carb and low sugar and is wonderul.  I mix some into butter and then put a spoon or 2 of the jelly on top as well.  Mmmmm, can't wait til these get shipped!!!!
Everything came as ordered and faster than expected. Glad this product was available online since none of the stores in my area carries this anymore.  Would buy from this seller again.

For years I have loved getting the Swedish Crepes from IHOP.  Everytime we went I would get this dish.  My wife surprised me one day by making Swedish Crepes with the Lingonberry preservers and the Lingonberry butter!  It is the BEST breakfast I have ever had and will be having a major impact to my waistline.  I refuse to let her make them for anyone else, not even the kids.  The Lingonberries are an excellent cross between cranberries and strawberries.  Not too sweet not too tart.  Wish the price was a little better otherwise highly recommend.  This review is also for the Swedish Crepes

These raw snacks are tasty little bits of heaven.  As a vegan who is dabbling in raw food, these are a great product to whet my taste of the raw lifestyle.  They are crunchy and a little spicy and are perfect as a salad topped or just a treat as I prepare dinner.They aren't everyone, mind you, especially for those people who aren't used to raw foods and the 5 year old in my house looked pained as he struggled to figure out what I had given him.  Give them a try, you might just like them!
I just bought these today and since I've almost eaten the whole bag I had to find 'em cheaper than they were at my grocery store.
These crackers are delicious but I think I might get them from Whole Foods from now on.  They were completely crumbled after shipping.

column9: Eh... there are definitely better Flax Snax!
column10: Yes, it is slightly spicy with a hint of jalapeno. The flavoring leaves much to be desired and I found it rather underwhelming. They should really reformulate this. Go Raw has much better ones than this. I would recommend the Pizza flavored over this any day of the week.

This is a very good product! It came in 2 DAYS! Which was amazingly fast! WAY BEFORE the expected delivery date! After opening it I noticed it had a strong scent which instantly caught my dogs attention!  The scent smells like a cross between dog food and bacon! The scent did not bother me it was just strong. The only bad thing about this product is it a but to tough for my 4 pound chihuahua, but I guess that helps clean tartar off his teeth so it's okay, it's just a bit hard and I wish it was a tad more soft. Haha now my dogs are following me and are being all good hopping to get another!  Overall very excellent product. I do reccomend this for  small dogs who enjoy meaty treats and are good chewers.

One of Washington's finest confections came to my doorstep in fewer than 48 hours from Amazon.com.  The Chukar Cherries were a special treat for a friend confined to a nursing home and the only thing she wanted for a special Valentine's treat.

These are the sweetest, freshest, most delicious dates I've ever eaten. They're nothing like the dates I've purchased over the years in the grocery store.  You have to experience these to appreciate this review! Five stars and more!

I have to say that I'm pretty disappointed in these dates in comparison to others I have purchased.  They were rather shriveled and not plump.  I felt that for the money I did not get much.Maybe it's the wrong time of the year to purchase dates...In my mind they should not be shriveled and they should be soft, otherwise they are old.

Thanks to another user's review, I tried these because I could not get organic dates in my local grocery store. What a treat! I don't have to leave my home and these consistently fabulous dates arrive on my doorstep! They do have pits, but completely worth the picking it out to have the soft, sweet, and healthy snack. I have never gotten a bad batch, so the quality control seems to be superb! I love them, and you will too! By the way....these are a much better deal $$$ than what you will pay in the stores for less in the bag!

The last two batches I received were moldy and inedible. I used to rely on Bergin Nut Company's dates for a sweet pick-me-up, but their quality has declined considerably. I will not be purchasing dates from this company again.

column9: Processed in a facility that processes wheat
column10: These were good. I noticed that they had a statement on them that said they were processed in a facility that processes wheat which is a problem for me. I wish that was advertised. The picture looks like it just says may contain traces of tree nuts. Also, as a heads up to people, these are not pitted, but when you put them in the food processor, the pits come out, but don't grind up - so that's nice. You can just pick them out.
I love these dates - we've ordered several packets and they have all been plump, moist, sweet and delicious.

column4: Nancy Rector "Author of A Painful Truth - The...
column10: One you've had Medjool you never go back. They are the softest sweetest dates. I'm a vegan stay away from processed foods and sugars I but still have a sweet tooth. These are a staple in my diet. Incredibly healthy. They are a wonderful candy replacement! Sometimes (if you can find pitted ones) you can stick an almond in the center of a few. Additional treat!Nancy RectorAuthor of "A Painful Truth - The Entrapment of America's Sick"(How Being Ill Got Me Arrested)

I found these are a bit more expensive than my local health food store but they are less moist so I guess I am getting more date and less water?  Whatever I enjoy them and the fact they are organically grown.

These dates are extremely moist and soft and because of that the dates at the bottom of the packet tend to get squished. Once you reach the bottom of the packet it is like eating dates jam. I purchased this product two times and have been very happy with the taste and consistency. Try making a Dates MilkShake with these dates. It is absolutely delicious.

I needed to get my order up to $25 in order to get free shipping so I looked around for something I enjoy that wasn't too expensive. After reading the reviews I decided to try Bergin Nut Company Organic Medjool Dates. They were very good. They were freshish - I've had fresher when I lived in date country but satisfying, yummy.

I have been into dates since moving to Palm Desert in the 1980's. I fell in love with the medjools which are the softest, sweetest, at lest from the desert. These are every bit as good and very soft and sweet, and dates are so very nutritious. I recommnend them highly. They also have a lot of potassium and about double or more of that in bananas for folks on diuretics. They're simply a wonderful food. The seeds grow nicely  into little palm trees. Dates are God's gift to man in the desert.

column9: These wonderful dates are better than candy
column10: Trying to be more health conscious I bought regular sunsweet pitted dates from the supermarket to substitute for an occasional candy treat.  They were ok, not organic, hardish, but still better for us than candy.  Store didn't have any last time, so I checked Amazon and here were these organic dates (with pits) so I ordered them after reading the reviews.  Absolutely worth the price!  Tender, tasty and no refined anything.  My next trial is to make raw almond butter sweetened with these dates (pits removed) in my Girmi miracle mincer.  I'll be ordering these dates regularly.

I got my dates today and they are sooooo yummy. They are plump and so sweet. I highly recommend. I actually only kind of liked dates because they are good for you but now I love dates. Who needs candy when you have these?

These dates are really very delicious, tasty and fresh, I had medjool dates here in california but their is no comparision with the quality of these dates, totally worth it, definitely will buy again....

column9: Love the product not the price
column10: These organic medjools arrived fresh and am pleased with the quality, however, I am not as pleased with the price. I couldn't find medjools locally and really needed to get my hands on some so I went ahead and bought these. Next time I will buy somewhere else at a cheaper price.
Man these are the most tender and flavorful dates I have had to date, they melt in your mouth. The pits are no problem because of how easy they are to eat. Trust me these are the best.

I ordered these dates first and we ate them immediately while watching tv... not what I intended!  Ordered a slightly cheaper brand and they were not as moist as these.  These have a lot of fruit and very little pit (which is easily removed.) Medjool is a large date and few to a pound. Spouse is diabetic and he carries a couple of these in a plastic container to use when he feels a low blood sugar coming on.  He prefers these to glucose tablets... for sure.  Wish these did not cost this much but we find they are worth the money in eating pleasure.  Thanks Amazon for another winner!

These dates are scrumptuous. They are soft and chewey, bursting with flavor. I keep them in the freezer. They are always pliable and easy to cook with. Terrific in smoothies! I always have a pack on hand. Unlike the store bought brand these are very tender. Four bags and have been pleased with every single date.

I bought these to use in a recipe for Acai Truffles. I was never one to eat dates by themselves. My family always served them in a fruit and nut bowl during the holiday season. I found them gritty and unappetizing. I took a bite of one of these while making my recipe and it was amazing. Beautifully moist with a hint caramel quality to the flavor.

Medjool dates serve very well as they can be part of the alternative materials for the soup in Chinese medicine. Compared to other dates sold in the US, this product provides large and sweet dates. The only downside is its relatively high price for the package. If the price is not the problem, I highly recommend it to you.

column9: Not enough bang for your buck
column10: Felt i had to put this out there. The dates were great, but for the price, I expected a lot more. Two small packages, I could buy these sort of dates for cheaper in my neighborhood.

I was never a fan of dates..in fact I always avoided dates among a pile of nuts UNTIL i ate one of these.. While I was trying to put on some weight I read on internet that medjool dates have one of the highest calorie content among dates..they're also called the diamond dates or the king of dates so I looked on amazon for medjool dates and found this one rated pretty high and I went with the public opinion and I'm glad to say that I'm a part of the same public with fantastic reviews about these dates! They say "See it to believe it" - I say "Eat it to believe it"! It just melts in your mouth! Absolutely awesome dates!

I never review anything, but these dates are beyond descroption. I've loved dates for years and years and sometimes I've managed to find some good ones. But these are so moist, sweet and perfect that I felt like a king eating them. Do yourself a favor and order these.

I have purchased several dates from different companies on Amazon and I must say that these are by far the best dates Amazon has to offer! They are a bit pricey, but well worth it. I only wish the bag was larger. 5 stars all the way!

These dates are the best kind I've had so far - they're juicy and tasty. Those buying pitted dates are missing out. They are a bit pricey but well worth it if you can afford it. Highly recommend them. I wouldn't waste them on baking though as they're so good eaten as-is.

In a nutshell, these Medjool dates from the Bergin Nut Company,are very fresh, soft and tasty. There have not been and hard or dry ones. I will definitely order them again. The service was timely and they were packaged well. No problems whatsoever. Rosey

Pros (+)- Sweeter than you'd think for 3g of sugar- Tastes like maple syrup- Great and healthy snack- Super low calorie in comparison to Special K and other cereals- 40% of your day's fiber- Only 1 gram of fatCons (-)- It's a little gritty once you chew it down, you can really tell it's got fiber, but nothing a bowl of milk won't fix.If you're comparing it to Kix, Special K, or any other cereal, it won't have the same texture or taste the same. It tastes really good for an 80 calorie cereal that's high in fiber and low in sugar. You can't win with everything.
I eat this as a snack. Tasty, low calorie and 1 gm of fat. I think kids would like this as well as it has a sweet taste. Purchased at WM for less than $3/box.

column9: I would rather eat the box
column10: On the plus side, the box would probably have less sugar. But on the minus side, you're paying $3 for 6 ounces of BHT flavored cardboard. I think you can get that cheaper at the Safeway.
Not only does this cereal have a horrible taste, the texture is terrible.  I ate one bowl and the rest went on the compost pile.

I've never had this cereal dry so I can't really relate to the complaints of the over-grainy texture of the cereal However, I have had it with milk and it's DELICIOUS. I so look forward to having this in the morning.
My entire family LOVES this cereal!  We like it with milk or dry as a snack.  The only thing I don't like about it is the price.

We got a small box of this as a sample with our Sunday paper last week. I tried it this morning dry as a breakfast snack. The taste and crunch are good, It is sweeter than I expected, but it leaves bits in your mouth that feel like sawdust. I might not have noticed this if I had eaten it in a bowl of milk, but I am not going to buy an entire box to experiment.

column9: Cardboard with a hint of honey
column10: I just forced myself to eat a whole bowl of this because it is healthy- which is it's only redeeming quality. I scooped this into my mouth quickly and simultaneously tried to hold back the vomit that was gurgling up. I then drank some of the milk in my cereal bowl to relieve my mouth of the nauseating flavor, only to find the taste had leeched into the liquid.If you like the show 'Fear Factor' or 'Bizarre Foods', you will like this cereal. I say save your money and just tear into a cardboard box instead of eating this.

I bought these for my daughter who gets car sick any time we go more than half a mile. Maybe it's my driving?I don't know, but these do work. They're "water" proof and once you close them they're easily disposed of in any McDonalds trash can. Added bonus that they're pink and paisley looking so she doesn't feel bad about having them around.
Surprised to find that this product is all natural. I am a squid eater and this ingredient is just perfect for my recipe.
This hot sauce has great flavor and just the right amount of kick to it. I need to get a bigger bottle next time!

Afters years of searching and testing - I found the best. You will not be disappointed. I have found this product to be consistent bottle after bottle. My eyebrows always sweat when sampling this product, which for me was the clincher. While being super hot, it does not destroy whatever you use this on - but rather accents the he full flavor of any food. Use with confidence - in fact my mouth is watering as I write this review.
Talked my waitress out of a bottle of this today. I love the flavor and the heat. No vinegar taste. If you like it hot you'll like this a lot.
Great sauce. Not just nice and hot, but has a great flavor. Add to chopped stewed tomatoes and have a quick, easy hot salsa.

column9: Spice up your food, clear your sinuses!
column10: I tried this Habanero Hot Sauce for the first time yesterday while at a Mexican Restaurant, and I must say it is DELICIOUS!The chicken burritos I ordered were not terrible, but they were quite bland. After adding on this hot sauce it completely turned that around, making a once bland burrito a terrifically flavorful experience!Yes, it is quite hot, so hot that it helped clear up my sinuses and sadly burdened the waiter with refilling my water a good 8+ times, but I tell you it wasn't anything overly spicy. I cooled down quite quickly, and unlike when I eat most spicy foods or sauces my breath and mouth did not suffer from any disgusting aftertaste!This sauce has greatly improved my outlook on bland boring food! (I plan on carrying a bottle with me anytime I'm invited to a known bland Mexican restaurant in the future!)
This hot sauce is not for the faint of heart.  Also, this sauce definitely has a kick, but it doesn't leave behind a lingering burning sensation on your tongue.

column9: Just like you remember from childhood...
column10: I purchased these for my mother, who used to love these neopolitan coconut sundae candies when she was little. We hadn't seen them in a store in years, and she was shocked when I presented them to her. Its unfortunate that you can't get a smaller amount than 5 lbs., but hopefully she eats them all before they go stale! The candy was fresh, but comes in a clear plastic bag inside the shipping box (not a candy box) which doesn't provide the best presentation as a gift (not a big deal - just sharing that).

This is the most unbelievable treat.  My dog will do ANYTHING to get one of these.  They can be broken easily into smaller pieces and are EXCELLENT for training.  The first ingredient is Beef--No wonder my pooch is crazy about them!
approved by my vet as having multiple quality ingredients MSM/Glucosamine/Condrioitin for canine joint support - pets love the taste also.

My Akita/Shepard mix comes to me for "back rubs" when his ongoing hip problems are hurting him....as long as he gets 1 1/2 to 2 of these a day - he seems to be more pain-free and have greater mobility.This natural product is cheaper in dose per body weight than any tablets I've found. Highly recommended!

I have looked for a joint supplement for my very active dogs for years.  Each one I have tried upset their stomach.  This is the only one I have found that seems to digest easily.  The taste? My dogs BEG LIKE CRAZY for these strips.  The best part? They WORK!  I have seen a vast improvement in my dogs joint health.  While my 6 year old Pointer mix is still having to have CCL surgery, these jerky strips seem to have made the rest of her joints stronger and more supportive.  My eight year old Brittany mix is now jumping back into our Subaru and doesn't struggle to get up after a long hike.  Highly recommend these treats!

I often take a short train ride out to Sunnyside, Queens to shop at the Butcher Block, an Irish grocery store; I'm able to pick up the Odlums flour I need to make soda and brown bread and there are lots of interesting new things to try. I spotted Tunnock's Tea Cakes, picked them up, and noted that even though they contained marshmallow, there was no gelatin in evidence. As a lacto-ovo vegetarian, about the only easy-to-find marshmallow option is Marshmallow Fluff, so these looked even more interesting, especially since the ingredients were simple and included real chocolate. They weren't expensive, so I bought a box.Tunnock's Tea Cakes ROCK. If memory serves, these are MUCH better than Mallomars--far less sweet, with a filling that reminds me of the filling in Russell Stover Milk Chocolate Mint Dreams (sans mint). I'd really like to try the dark chocolate variety but didn't see any. Maybe it's a good thing because I could easily eat a whole box of the milk chocolate variety in one sitting (the fact that they're not very large helps). And they're really cute, too--they're individually wrapped in foil which makes them a convenient to-go snack. Cross my heart, they're just perfect: a crisp cookie base topped with marshmallow, the whole of which is dipped in milk chocolate. What could be yummier? And besides, Tunnock's is an old, family-owned business--who better to support?Mallomar lovers owe it to themselves to give Tunnock's Tea Cakes a try if the opportunity to do so presents itself. In fact, anyone who likes chocolate and marshmallow would probably love these. Jump all over them if you see them for sale.

column9: If you like Mallomars, you will LOVE these
column10: Cookie with marshmallow on top, covered in milk chocolate. Delicious! Flavor reminds me a of a s'more. They're also wonderful hot-- with hot chocolate, tea, or coffee. These are a bit larger than Mallomars, and the chocolate coating on these is less waxy and more thick and chocolate-y. The marshmallow is also a lot taller than the ones on Mallomars. The cookie is a little more crunchy and graham-cracker-like than the Mallomars cookies.As a previous reviewer mentioned, there is no gelatin so they are vegetarian! Cute, classic packaging, which I remember from my childhood in England. All the cakes are individually wrapped in foil. Perfect for packing a lunch.Tip: try microwaving them for 5 seconds.... oo-ey goo-ey deliciousness.

column9: When a unexpected guest comes over
column10: These curry paste variety packs are excellent for use when cooking for unexpected guests.All need  modification in cooking methods to taste authentic.Modified recipe for Vegetable Biryani follows:The vegetable biryani is good but to get the best taste please follow below instructions:Heat  1 tbsp hot oil or ghee or margarine.To the hot oil add shah jeera, bay leaf, crushed cardamom, 1 stick of cinnamon and 5 cloves and Sautee 30 seconds.Add 1/2 cup sliced onions fry until caramelized.Sautee vegetables- carrots, potatoes, french beans and Paneer. ( other vegetables of your choice)Add Veggie biryani paste and saute some more.Then add required amount of water.Bring to boil,add Basmati rice and cook on medium heat until done.Optional: Add fersh or thawed frozen petit peas about 5 minutes before the biryani is done.Garnish with minced coriander leaves.Serve hot with lemon wedges and Onion rings and Raita.My guests loved it.... and were surprised that it was an instant paste rather than from the scratch.

column9: Good for a quick Indian fix
column10: Before I review, I will reveal that I am Indian. I grew up eating authentic, fresh Indian food, and now I cook authentic, fresh Indian food. NONE of the pre-packaged foods will come even CLOSE to freshly prepared food with freshly ground spices. It is impossible for a finely tuned Indian palate to relish pre-packed, factory-processed, preserved offerings. However, if you are not conditioned like me, then this is a great alternative to the restaurant fare we get in the US. Easy to use, quick and tasty enough. I bought the assorted pack and gave it to my non-Indian friends so they could cook their Chicken and Lamb curries....and they just loved it!I give 4 stars to this product for trying its best.

I bought this 6 pack because it was a good deal price wise and I have previously enjoyed this brand of Indian food.  We tried one pack and found the gravy to be very watery even though we only out on 75% of the water in the recipe.  I added tomato sauce to the remainder of the meal and it was much better.  I canceled my order for additional product.

First let me say that we do not eat Indian food very often, and I certainly do not know how to make it and I have never tried. It would probably require a specialty cook book and a bunch of expensive spices that would rarely be used. I also may not know good Indian food from bad Indian food, because like I said, we rarely have it. This stuff is delicious!!! We have not tried them all, but the lamb curry was excellent. I added some sliced onion and threw in a handful of frozen peas at the end and served over rice. It was fragrant, warm but not hot, and delicious! I know this is kind of bad, but I didn't have lamb so I used some thin-siced beef steaks that I had frozen. Anyway, the curries are delicious and easy to prepare, just add meat or vegetables, water and simmer. Some of the packets call for a little butter or something, but you'll probably have that handy. As for nutrition, they all say that they have 2 grams of fiber per serving. Sodium varies from about 480 to 660mg per serving but the veg. briani is 810mg., and calories are relatively low at 45 to 60 per serving, fat is 3 to 3.5 grams per servin, carbs are around 3 to 5. Try it, you'll like it if you are normally just a little adventerous in your food choices.

After reading all the positive reviews I decided to give this product a try. Man, was this surprisingly good! It tastes so authentic, yet so simple. Depending on which type I use, I usually add onions, chicken, potato. My favorite is the chicken curry which I added cauliflower, mushrooms, and chicken. My favorite! My least favorite was the lamb curry. Definitely give this a try if you haven't already!

column9: Very authentic Indian taste , Veg Biryani and Mutton Curry is awesome
column10: This is the closest you can get to the Indian Curry taste. I love all the flavors  but really like Veg Biryani. These packs make you a excellent Indian food cook in few minutes. Aromas are so good and authentic.

Much as I enjoyed Indian food, I am not an Indian by nature. But after trying this variety pack at home - following the detailed yet simple instructions on the package - I was so happy that I found authentic Indian tastes again, here in the US, instead of in Indian. By far, it is the BEST paste I have tried.

column4: G. Proulx "Up to my Neck in Tech"
column9: Unfortunately not what my non-indian palate was looking for
column10: Before buying this, I thought I loved Indian food. I also used to think I liked spicy food. These mixes have made me second guess both of those beliefs.I've realized I like some indian food,but my sampling of Indian food has been limited to several indian restaurants and a few homemade dishes. Admittedly, this is not a very impressive resume. Usually when I order, I get the mildest dishes (saag paneer with lots of naan) in the mildest forms. I've ventured into the spicier curries and regretted it.So, on to this product. These mixes were much too spicy for me and weren't the type of indian food I enjoy. Looking at the other reviews it is obvious many people love these mixes, and plenty of those people are indian themselves. So, take my review for what it is worth. If you aren't sure if you like indian food, or only like select mild dishes at indian restaurants, these may not be for you. If you know you like authentic indian food and don't mind spiciness, disregard this review and read the other ones.I was going to give this 2 stars, because honestly the rest of these mixes are sitting on my shelf. However, I recognize that plenty of others with more experience in this category of food love these products, so 3 stars it is. Good luck, hope this helped!

Kids couldn't get enough. Package ingridients are only slightly different so I ignored the directions added 2 packs to sauteed vegetables, mixed with chicken stock, coconut milk and added browned chicken. Very quick. Have yet to get a full plate of my own.
All you need is to buy jasmine rice and your fav veg, and voila!  SO easy and spicy and yummy. If it's too spicy for the kids, just add half n half cream.

I bought the pack of 6 because I'd like to taste all different flavors.  I had two of them so far and I really liked it.  It's easy to cook and taste is as good as restaurant curry.  I also bought Nan from Trader Joe's and had with this curry - it was perfect! I'll definitely buy this product more later.

I've been eating the Butter Chicken version of Kitchen's of India for years, but have never ventured past that one flavor. This assortment was a deal of the day, so I gave it a shot. I now have a few more favorite versions!The assortment consists of 6 packets, one of each of:Butter ChickenChicken CurryHyderabadi BiryaniLamb CurryFish CurryVegetable Biryani.While my favorite still is the butter chicken, all were tasty. My least favorite was the fish curry, but I have to admit I'm not much of a fish fan to begin with. While they all taste similar there are some differences, such as a greater level of spiciness to the hyderadadi biryani, and more oiliness to the chicken curry.All are prepared about the same (add liquid and the meat). Quick and easy prep. I like to modify the preparation a bit - for example, I use only a small amount of butter when preparing the butter chicken, replace the water with chicken stock and add peas.While these mixes fall short of what you'd get in a good Indian restaurant, they are quite good, very easy and economical. Highly recommend.

I am English and my Wife is Mexican so we both love spicy food (lots of Indian restaurants in England).The pastes are very pasty and really need to be mixed with plain yogurt to make them more creamy, just buy some plain yogurt, drain the water and mix til you get the required creaminess.Even then the result is pretty spicy, much too spicy for my young'uns and on the limit for my wife.Of course, you can use less paste and/or more yogurt.Very tasty for the price.

Tried the chicken flavor paste previously and felt in love with it. Used to live in southeast Asia before and this product tatse exactly like the ones I had in Malaysia and Singapore. Additionally, Its good that amazon provides this combination pack because I really want to try the curry cooked in different recipes.

column9: as near as I expect to get to the real thing at home
column10: Where I live the Indian restaurants are mostly very excellent. I'm a tolerable good cook but have never been able to duplicate Indian dishes at home. "You ain't bonafide!" as the child says in an old movie & perhaps I'm not. I can taste a spoonful & identify 8 of 10 ingredients but the other two are a mystery. I've tried some of these spice packs and find they're really excellent. Not quite as good as the local cullinary artists. But HEY if you're not a real cullinary artist this product gives very satisfactory results.My advice: Follow directions precisely until the end. Then stir in 1-2 tablespoons of flour while still hot to thicken the sauce. This was standard in grandma's time. Sadly forgotten now.
this curry pates really helped me cut back on time i would spend to make a good meal .will definitely buy again

This is a really fantastic mix that I keep as a staple at home.  The only thing is I pretty much disregard suggestions for meat and throw whatever veg I have on hand in instead.  I also cut the water by half, and add either coconut milk or cream with a bit of cornstarch at the end- makes it a bit thicker and gravy like (i know that's probably cheating!).  My favorite is the butter chicken mix- with a bit of cream at the end, it's pretty much way better than anything you'll get at a restaurant.
We buy the chicken curry at our local store. This pack is great. Lets u try different mixes and the price is awesome! !! Recommended! !

I spent my teen age years living in England and learned to love the curry that the Indian restaurants served there. Try as you may you can not make that curry with curry powder from U. S. stores. If you like curry, real curry, you'll really enjoy this product. Just enough heat to bring on the sweat.
No wonder why this is in the top rating in the Amazon food categories. It is very good~~!! Must try!!

column9: Easy to prepare, excellent taste but...a bit too spicy?
column10: I really like Indian food for some reason, especially chicken curry. Hence I jumped at the chance of trying this product a couple of weeks ago. Overall, I am pretty impressed.First off, the food is extremely easy to prepare. Most of the time you just need the chopped meat or vegetables, and perhaps some butter or lemon curd. It makes a quick and delicious dinner -- just turn on the stove, add water, curry paste, meat/veggies, wait 25-30 minutes, and bingo! I was surprised the first time how good it tasted. Just add some naan or rice and you have yourself an authentic Indian meal.So far I have tried most of the packs in the variety box. The chicken turned out well both times I made it (there are 3 different curry flavors) and also tried the vegetarian one. Now this may be only a personal quip, but I thought the curry paste is a bit too spicy at times. The second I made the chicken curry, I used more chicken than the recommended amount (1lb) and results were similar. The vegetarian is even more spicy. Just beware.

I've made curries from scratch and I'm not talking about adding curry power to something. Making good curry is a rather complex and time-consuming process. This product is well worth the money. It's as good as any curry I've ever eaten right out of the pouch. I recommend it without reservation.

column9: WOW. curry this good at home. who knew?
column10: My wife and I eat curry pretty frequently when we go out, so I know what good curry tastes like. The kids always order something else. I never thought of making it at home until I saw this package. I served chicken curry to my family yesterday and they loved it, even the kids. This is GOOD Stuff.
I used the lamb curry since I got some lamb in the fridge.  It came out good.  Love how easy it is to make it.  I added eggplant and carrot to the meat.

These were so easy to make.  And they make a great tasting curry.  They are processed in a plant that uses Tree Nuts so our daughter can't eat them, but my husband loves them.  I love that I can make rice and throw this together in no time.

I've been using Trader Joe's simmer sauces for years so am tired of that flavor. These packs taste more "Indian" to me. Hope some real Indian cooks will comment.I might get tired of these someday. Good that there are other curry paste packs including from Singapore, Indonesia...Prima Taste Singapore Curry Sauce Kit, 11.3-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4), bamboe Indonesian Instant Spices: Rendang (Indonesian Dry Curry Paste) (1 x 1.2 OZ)
I have not been able to try any yet, but was disappointed that they sent me 2 packages of Fish Curry and no Chicken Curry.  Not happy.
Tastes very good. Really easy to make, just add the ingredients and let it simmer. Make some rice while you wait and it's a full meal.

I grew up within an Indian community and have been eating authentic Indian food for years. This product is about as good as it gets, the flavour is spot on and the heat is perfect. I will be buying more of these packs.
Arrived just in time when my wife was away. Very delicious and good choice for a quick meal. Would definitely re-order it.

column9: delicious if you like it hot
column10: My sons really like highly spiced food and the expert mulatilayering in these boxes has made several memorable meals for them. We are very fortunate to live in Long Island where there are innumerable restaurants to choose from; although our 3 favorite Indian restaurants have closed there are many still open.  But not everyone wants to go out and eat spicy food. I can provide less spicy food and with these packets, highly spiced dishes, at the same meal so everyone's happy to stay in.

First of all, I like the price.  Trader Joe's Indian paste is $2 and $2.30 per packet.  This 6 packet for $10 deal is great!Second of all, I love the taste.  So far I only used the vegetable curry packet for my Yosemite camping potluck the past weekend.  I added a minced Roma tomatoe, half a head of minced red onion, and a cup of TVP from Bob's Red Mill.  The result was just fantastic!  It's a bit spicy, granted, but everyone who loves spicy food loves this dish.I can see that this and TVP will be my must-have in all my camping trips.  It is as easy as 1-2-3 and a super healthy, tasty side dish to eat with grilled meat and pita bread.

Out of the six possibilities, I have only made the butter chicken, but it was tasty enough that I have high hopes for the other five packages.  Preparation was easy: I mixed the paste with some turkey broth and butter, added pieces of chicken right away and some potatoes about halfway through, and mixed in some plain yoghurt during the cooldown period.  Very easy and relatively fast way to make dinner.While I didn't find this particularly hot, my wife did find it a bit tongue-searing. To help you gauge our heat tolerance, she likes several jalapenos in her salsa and I like a couple of habaneros.

I bought this to use with vegetables and know I use it to marinade meats and chicken as well. I stir fried it with vegetables and Tofu and it was wonderful. One word of caution it is spicy so use less to start with and add as you need to . I would buy it again. This was a great deal.

The Kitchens of India items came promptly and tasted sooooo delicious. I first was given one pack by a friend who said he purchased on Amazon.com. After trying it I knew this was something I had to get. I now have two 6 packs and will definitely be ordering more when they are gone!!
The flavor is nice, kind of spicy, easy to cook with meats or vegetables. If you are not sure which one is your favorite, just try this variety pack.
Family voted to have the butter chicken curry first, which was outstanding, then we had the fish curry, also fantastic.  These are very high-quality, fantastic results.
Decided to try these as a shortcut in recipes.  Won't be buying again.  I'll stick to creating my own spice mix at home.

A handy box with 6 Indian curry's, takes up little space in cupboard. Like I said..can't wait to try them out and experience the awesome Indian flavors and pleasant smells again... If you never ate Indian food, please give it a try, it's not 'scary' or 'weird,' it's very tasty.

After seeing this pasta reviewed by America's Test Kitchen... "Tasters lauded this 100 percent whole-wheat spaghetti for its "earthy," "wheaty," "nutty," "full" flavor, which was "heartier than white pasta, without being too wheaty." It also boasted a "pleasantly chewy,' "firm" texture. Its "good blend of whole-wheat flavor and regular-pasta texture" complemented the pesto and didn't overwhelm the marinara." I decided to give it a try. I've tried other "whole grain pastas" on the market without much success, off texture,taste and couldn't get my husband to enjoy them. After seeing this episode of ATK we decided to try it. I purchased a few pounds of spaghetti to try and surprisingly it was very good. My husband said "he would definitely eat this again, and can't wait to try other shapes of it." The description above is on point, it is hearty and has a pleasant chew...very satisfying!

I love this product. Made with organic non-GMO soybeans, organic cane sugar, organic green tea, organic lemon and vanilla flavoring, sea salt, carrageenan and water, and enriched with vitamins, this soy milk is healthy and tasty. It's got an appealing chalky-green color of Japanese matcha. Calories: 110 per serving (4 per box), 30 from fat. Low sodium and zero cholesterol. High in Vitamin D (35%), Folate (25%), Calcium and Vitamin A (both 30%). Iron 10%, Zinc 6%.Made in USA. Certified organic by QAI. I bought this at a local Chinese supermarket for about $2.50. I have also tried the Kikkoman Pearl Chocolate Organic Soy Milk, 32-Ounce (Pack of 6), which is also delicious. I'll definitely buy this again.
Recommended by a friend, I am a big green tea lover, would like to try out anything with green tea flavor, this soil milk tastes rich but not too sweet,enjoyed it a lot, will order more in the future

We decided to try this because sometimes it's difficult to dissolve powdered green tea in cold drinks.  We don't like to waste any of the powdered tea.  This product has a very good flavor cold.  Heated, it makes a wonderful green tea latte.  We tried that today, used a hand mixer to create a froth and enjoyed it very much.  The froth really holds up and doesn't break up before you are able to finish the drink.

I used to be able to find this product locally, but after the local grocer change suppliers, they could no longer get it.  This soy milk is thick and creamy and the taste in just fantastic.  If you haven't tried it yet, and like both soy milk and green tea, you really should give it a try.  Don't let the way it looks change your mind (like brownish-green yuk).  The stuff is fantastic!

column9: Best Chocolate and most fun shape
column10: I've known about Toe Buddies almost since my dear friends started the company.  It's been a true and utter joy to watch this idea of humor and quality chocolate come together.  What Jackie & Jeff don't know is that this chocolate has changed my life forever.  I'm never ever going to be able to buy cheaper chocolate again - even some of the more expensive fancy stuff isn't near the quality of these Toe Buddies - and that isn't even getting into how funny the shape is.  My first Amazon order is being sent to my running coach.  Getting this woman (me) up off the coach and jogging deserves quality chocolate and what is funnier than Toe Buddies being sent to my jogging buddies.Being able to purchase and ship through Amazon has just made my gift giving so much easier.
Usually dried papaya is either died a day glow orange or if not died there isn't a consistent color.  This dried papaya is uniformed color indicating great quality.

I really like the Bergin papaya spears, which are low sugar and do not contain sulfur dioxide, but decided to try the chunks this round.  Unfortunately, I didn't do enough research, or remember that I can't drink red wine because of the sulfites, and I had a HUGE, very uncomfortable reaction after eating these papaya chunks.  Now I am stuck with almost 6 pounds of it..so beware, if you think you might be allergic.  Also, in my opinion, this product contains way too much sugar...it's more like candy than dried fruit, and that's not what I need or want.

My husband is Puerto Rican/Dominican, this coffee and Cafe Bustelo really get him going! These are very strong coffees though, and if you're making regular coffee you need to add more water than usual or else, as my husband says, "you might as well inject it in your arm because it's so strong."
This is great on toast. Use this instead of cinnamon sugar. My kids love this.

My family really enjoys this product.  I make homemade cinn. raisin bread all the time and this just adds that omph of flavor that you just can seem to get into the bread, especially from the bread maker.We have also put it on waffles and it spikes up plain bread as well.  With two large bottles of it, I am sure we'll find other creative ways to use it in the future!
I cannot detect any maple flavor at all. If I had wanted cinnamon sugar I could have spent a lot less at the grocery store or mixed it up myself. What a colossal waste of money.
This is great !  We add to regular oatmeal for our touch.  It is better than buying flavored oatmeal in the grocery store.

column9: This stuff is great on oatmeal.
column10: It really makes a difference. I have bought it for years and always get excellent customer service. I don't write these often but they really deserve the compliment.

This is a nice looking, well packaged tree, however it is an OUTDOOR tree.  I felt like crying.  I ordered for my husbands birthday and we live in Michigan, you do the math...  Yeah, so I'm not sure what we will do at this point.

As a person who doesn't have a lot of time to cook when I get home this was so awesome. Microwave or oven to warm it was just awesome. It didn't take long to get to me I just wish I had calculated how much chicken it was going to be

I wanted to find some sugar-free hard candy I could buy in bulk, as all I can get at the grocery stores are tiny bags of highly priced candy.  Eda's seemed like an interesting prospect, so I ordered a 1 lb. bag of the Old Tyme flavors.The flavors themselves aren't bad, if a little unique.  They resemble the flavor they're representing but don't quite nail them - with the exception of cinnamon.  Frustratingly, you don't know what you get  until you've bought it, but flavors include peppermint, cinnamon, licorice, coffee, chocolate, lime, cherry and a curious dark red candy whose flavor I still can't place.The deal killer to Eda's, though, is the shipping, which is more than the cost of the product.  I paid over $8.  Eda's candy is okay, but only for a hard-to-find or really stellar item would I pay that kind of shipping for a 1 lb. package.  For me, it's on to the continuous search for bulk candy.

When I turned Vegan, I worried about finding a reliable source of Omega-3. Ground Salba is ultra convenient - just drop a spoonful into any dish and you've got an instant nutrition boost. I put it in my oatmeal every morning and can't even tell it's there.

I enjoyed the Salba much more so than flax seeds.  It has a nice nutty taste and can be mixed well with oatmeal or eaten alone.  I didn't find that it gave me more energy as some websites have purported, but knowing it is good for me is enough for me.

I prefer the whole grain to the ground seed.  When mixed with liquid (about 2 Tablespoons of Salba to 1 cup of liquid), it forms a gel.  The whole grain has the consistency of tapioca pudding; the ground salba is a bit too gritty for me, even after it gels up.  Whatever form one uses (ground or whole grain), Salba (chia seed) doesn't have much flavor of it's own, so it takes on the flavor of whatever I mix with it.I do like that it has omega-3 (which is good for my heart) and fiber (which is good for my digestion).

column9: use it in making baby food
column10: You really have to just use a bit or the flavor takes over a food.  I use it for baby food for the health benefits.
this stuff is grossly over priced and from what I have read, some vendors are packaging Chia seed as Salba. For the price and results, hands down, go with the Chia seed-

The 6 cans of Campbell's Shrimp Soup was never received.This was my first experience ordering thru Amazon which I am ver disappointed not to have received the soup. It is something I use for a Holiday recipe. I have sent my concern to the Company ordered from to obtain a refund. Campbell's Cream of Shrimp Soup 10.75 oz - 6 Unit Pack

My employer and his wonderful friend stumbled across this yummy candy at a convention and brought some back for us to try.  WOW!  We fell in love with the creamy rich taste each one had to offer.  At Christmas we sent gift boxes of this awesome candy to our clients and received an overwhelming response...BIG hit!!!  We will continue to order and eat this wonderful candy!  You really should try it...you'll be hooked too!  Enjoy!!

For many years I have been looking for the best espresso.  This is so good.  I do not see myself as an expert who buys fancy $800 machines but I have found this bean along with my Breville Cafechroma machine I always get the right espresso.  I still go to my local coffee bean store because their iced mocha latte is sooo good.  I still cant make a good mocha yet.

column9: Great expresso bean. Amazon stock is a little old
column10: This is a great bean that makes fantastic expresso in my Superautomatic. For true coffee snobs, note that the stock is a bit old - I ordered in Dec and got a March roasting. I know friends of mine who raise their eyebrows at anything more than a couple of weeks old.Honestly, I could not tell the difference once the expresso was made - it tasted hot and fresh. If you are not a snob, I recommend this; if you are true aficionado, find a local roaster, and get something that was bagged this week.Happy drinking!
Coffee Bean makes a good, dark bean but the mfg date on the bag is old. To be specific, over a year old. And not for the first time. If you decide to buy, it's something to consider.

This is one of my favorite coffees or at least it used to be. My last two shipments each have been over 1 year old according to the date printed on the bag. I think Amazon can get better control of the age of their food inventory but I'm not sure they want to do so.  For me I will be looking elsewhere for fresher coffee henceforth.
delivered on time and it tastes really good.  Not to mention myself, even my wife who is not a coffee drinker likes it. excelnet choice.

was looking for an alturnative to starbucks and this will give them a real run. the flavor is very rich and complete.  no watery taste here like i have seen with others. although the free cup they give you at one of their stores by bringing in the empty bag will only work if you can find one. out west is where they are at.

column9: For Use in Company Coffee Machine
column10: Ordered this item for a coffee/espresso machine in the office.  Employees are very satisfied with this product.  Signed up for auto ordering which is easy and has a discount.  Price is great!

I tried this coffee because my usual Lavazza was getting too expensive. There was a promotion going so this was at about 50% off the list price. I was hoping for an acceptable taste knowing that it was not going to be Lavazza and the other reviews were good. Unfortunately, all my 5 espresso shots turned out to be burnt-bitter taste.I use an fully automatic espresso machine and use beans solely for espresso shots and not for regular drip coffee. I picked this item because it specifically said "Espresso Whole Bean Coffee".  I tried different grind settings hoping I could make use of the 3 bags I bought but nothing helped.  Also, fyi... Eight oclock is my second choice since coffee prices are almost double I paid last year.

When they say smokey, they mean SMOKEY!  I'm used to meat sticks that are more like pepperoni These are not like that.  The smoke flavor is very strong. At first I wasn't sure I liked them but they are growing on me.

For me, a perfect day includes the beach, a good book, and Beef and Cheese Ole Smokies. The mild taste of the cheese mixed with the premium beef taste go together nicely and the wrapper keeps the sand off of the beef stick.

I am completely satisfied with these turkey sticks, as well as the beef sticks.Most sticks leave a greasy smudge in my mouth which is quite revolting but not these.Finally a great protein snack to keep in my desk

I could hardly tell these from the conventional fat loaded pepper sticks that I never eat because I like my heart the way it is, thank you.These were great.  I couldn't eat just one, and I had an excuse to eat several at a time because they're made with turkey!  It would be fun to serve some of these as an appetizer for Thanksgiving.

The product description of the Jalapeno and Cheese Ole Smokies is right. These really do taste like a jalapeno popper beef stick. If you are looking for something a little different, these Ole Smokies are the ones to try!

column9: So good they made me cry
column10: Buffalo Bills snacks ROCK in general, but after a friend ordered these Jalapeno/Cheddar Ole' Smokies and shared one with me, I realized I had to have some for my own.  Now I'm an addict, and why?  ...because these are just that good.  They have just enough smack of jalapeno-zip and a good squeal of cheese in them.  So good I had to write this review, finding it difficult because the tears of joy streaming down my face.  I think I'm suffering from my own kind of PTSD (Product Tested: Super Delicious!!!).  Truly a great, great flavor and consistency with these.

Do not waste your time...  The "beef sticks" are not good.  The flavor is fake and nothing like a real beef stick.  The texture will almost make you gag.  You do not even need to chew these beef sticks. There is a reason why you can get this amount of volume at the price.  Not worth it.
Nice variety of jerky.. a littly oily, but the taste is great. Wish it would be a little spicier on some, but the taste is great. Good product.

column9: Not what I expected -- sort of gross!
column10: These beef sticks taste very odd, and I'm not sure how to describe it. They're super-oily, which is gross, and the jalapeno/cheese ones have a lot of spice, which is okay. They just taste strange and have a weird texture. Try Ostrim beef sticks instead, they are far superior!

I'm always looking for new things to try and the Buffalo Bills Honey Ham sticks did not disappoint.  The good smoked taste of ham blended with the rich sweetness of the honey brings back fond memories of Sunday dinners at Grandma's house. Not too smokey, not too sweet... these ham sticks have a pleasant, satisfying taste. They are also a quick, tasty snack when friends drop in - I cut the sticks in bite sized pieces and served them with a dipping mustard. Everyone loved them! These yummy ham sticks are going to be regulars at our football parties.

It's rather tastey. It's cheese to pepper flavor content is well mixed with the smokey flavor. It's cheap and high quality so worth the shot, maybe you'll like it better than I did. Thinkin about it, I kinda want some more.
I got this as a sample. Absolutely delicious. They use real friggin soy sauce and you can taste it. It was a real pleasure to eat this.
The taste resembles a smokey cocktail wienie gently glazed in honey wrapped in a beef stick. It didn't taste bad, just not my thing. ChooChoo was awesome as usual with fast shipping.

column9: Maybe I got a bad one
column10: I personally did not care for it. It had a non-smothering smoked pepperoni flavor which was pleasant for me but it had too much beef heart for my taste. It wasn't bad, just not my thing. choochoo was awesome with same day shipping as usual.
These were pretty damn good, I actually really like the smokey flavor and the meat tastes familiar but satisfying. I'd buy these again.

I love the smooth taste of all of the honey stung  Buffalo Bill's jerkys but these 9" Ole Smokies are definitely my favorite! The wrapper means that I can keep these sticks handy any place. Gotta be prepared for those jerky attacks!

There are to things I really like to snack on and that's, Jerky and Spicy Stuff. Believe it or not, these beef stick's have a little spice to them(not a lingering spicy).The reason I gave these a 3 of 5 STARS, is because I make my own Beef and Deer Jerky and although these Jalapeno and Cheese are something different and tasty, they come nowhere close to my awsome homemade jerky made from steak, not ground beef part's such as (beefheart).

I didn't care for these. It tastes like old salty ham and that horrible clove oil used for tooth aches. It's disgusting. I couldnt even eat it past half way. I actually had to get up and brush my teeth.

My dogs go absolutely bonkers when I go to get into the bag of these.  I feel good knowing they are 100% natural too.  They break in half easily so you don't have to give it to them all at once.  I have a small dog and a large dog so this comes in handy for the small one so he's not getting too much at a time.

ok so i have a dachsund....hes a mini but he weighs around 20 pounds because he is very long.....he is very crazy and also very picky....about people and food lol. Well, i used to get the chicken kabobs sold by smokehouse but i recently tried these and my dog begs for them.....when he gets one he gets so excited and chews it right up.....they break nice and easy too so he doesnt have a hard time chewing them like other dog products such as greenies and jumbones. If you have a dog that you love and chrerish and he or she means the world to you?? BUY THEM THESE THEY DESERVE IT!!!!!! I will be buying and buying till there is no more of these because i dont know anywhere in MA. that sells them....best product ever and its MADE IN THE USA!!!!!!

This is a superior product than the other Smokehouse Chicken Barz that is offered for a fraction of the price.  This product is easier for my dog to consume and doesn't have sinewy parts to it.  My dog is a very picky eater and snobs just about every treat that I've purchased from the pet stores.  This is my dog's absolute favorite.  Amazon's price is very reasonable.

column9: Does "Made in USA" = Ingredient USA Chicken or from China?
column10: I would like to hear from Smokehouse as to "country of origin" for the chicken they use in this product - since all the other products they sell (like regular chicken strips) are from China.  Is this basically the same Chinese-processed chicken imported and then combined with some vitamin E inside a US factory? Made in USA doesn't equate with product country of origin.I wouldn't be suspicious except that they are a huge importer of chicken from China.  Why would this product be any different?

Your dog will love these.  They are crunchy rather than pliable, and easy to break off into small pieces.  With all of the problems related to chicken treats made in China, it's worth spending a few bucks more to get a product made in the USA.
I love that it only has two ingrediants:  chicken and vitamin E.  And better yet?  It's all made in the USA!  I will continue buying these!

I had been feeding mostly the chicken jerky treats, feeling good about it since the only ingredient was chicken.  Then I saw the reports of kidney failure linked to the ones made in China.  It's hard to find them made in the USA, and they are much more expensive.  Then I found these.  They are made in the US.  Ingredients are chicken and Vitamin E.  The texture is different, but my dog likes them just as well and they have the added advantage of being "breakable", so you can give them smaller portions easily.
My dog loves these treats.  I feel good feeding them to him since they are made in the USA, which is hard to find in a treat.  They are expensive, though!
My mini schnauzers LOVE these treats!  They are light and crunchy. Best part is they are made in the USA!  I will not buy any more treats from China....

My dog goes absolutely berzerk when I pick up this bag and he knows he's about to get one of these treats!  He loves 'em!  Probably his favorite.  All that said, if I have to think of a negative - the treats are crunchy - so when he eats on carpet, they do produce crumbs - but he cleans up after himself pretty well, so it's not much of an issue.

column9: One of Two dogs accepts them, but shipping is a problem
column10: I've been trying to find chicken jerky dog treats not made in China and these are the closest I've been able to find to this point (but I've found some made in Maine that look possible - I haven't tried them yet but intend to). These are US made, but not like what comes from China. They are hard and brittle and formed in some fashion into strips/bars. One of our dogs accepts them OK (not her favorite, but will take them), the other just turns his head away and only eats them when he realizes it's all there's going to be.But my last shipment from Amazon is going to be my last. I ordered several bags and they arrived with the pieces mostly in small shards. Don't know if Amazon shipped them in that condition or the shipper managed to mangle them en route (the box was not mangled in any way but it could have been dropped). But given the fact they're not ideal anyway, I'm not ordering any more.Not my favorite and not really recommended. Going to keep looking. The Blue Buffalo chicken treats (Blue Buffalo Wilderness Chicken Dog Jerky Treats) are good, but outrageously expensive ($10 for a 3.2 oz bag!) and mostly very small pieces, so after one bag, no more.

My two dogs (shih tzu and malkie) love these.  They are more crunchy than jerky, which concerned me at first, but the 'girls' handle nicely.  They receive one treat per day and this is usually it.  I also love that it's made in the USA.  I have repurchased several times and highly recommend.

Our 10-year-old Silkie Terrier Mabel is a very picky eater.  Because she has such a little mouth, she can't manage most treats.  These can be broken up into little pieces for her.  And because they're natural chicken, at least they're good for her.  I'm sure she'd recommend them highly.

column9: Okay but not a home run
column10: I ordered these when trying to find a chicken treat that is USA made. For years I had bought the Waggin Train brand.  My dog loved them, but had a diarrhea every time she went "number two" and neither we nor our vet could figure out why.  Finally after seeing the story about chews made in China, I stopped buying them.  Within a week my dog had totally stopped her diarrhea!  She has hardly had it one time since and that was last year.  Back to topic - the bag does say USA made which is comforting, but the chews are very hard and crunchy.  I just rescued a male Shih Tzu and he ate them, but my girl wasn't impressed.  I am still searching for a USA made chew that is not hard as a rock.
We have been buying these for a few months now and are pleased with the quality and that they are made in the USA. Our dog loves them.
Great product.  Dog likes them.  They are made in the USA.  They are a bit expensive but worth it.  I will buy this item again.

After reading articles concerning jerk chicken treat made in China, I checked the website for an alternative.  This product  produced in the USA provides my dog a  yummy treat and provides me with emotional relief that I am feeding my dog a safe treat.
Unless your dog is younger and has great teeth, I do not recommend you try these. They are extremely hard.

column9: THIS IS MY DOGS FAVORIT TREET
column10: SMOKEHOUSE CHICKEN BARZ ARE HOT RODS AND LEVI'S FAVORIT TREAT AND IAM GLAD THAT IT'S MADE IN THE USA

My Papillons (ages 8 and 9) have been the pickiest damn dogs I have ever met.  You know when the vet says "they will eat eventually, they won't starve"?  Well, no.  These damn dogs would starve if they didn't get to eat something they liked.  I have been struggling for years to find food that is not made in China, not made from chicken from China even if manufactured in the USA.  Finally, I found Halo.  I integrated the Halo Spots Stew kibble and the Halo Spot's Stew chicken canned into the Paps diet over 2 weeks.  Week one they ate half of the Halo and by the end of week two they were eating ALL of the Halo product and the small amount of the old brand was left in their bowls.  Their skin is fantastic, their poops are a perfect consistency (not too hard or too soft) and they are energetic and just happy and excited for meal time now.  I also feed them the Halo LiL Bits freeze dried chicken treats.  All of the ingredients are from USA and made solely here.  And, I am thrilled that my favorite TV talk show host, Ms. Ellen Degeneres is a part owner of the company.Thank you Amazon for offering this here as it is hard to get in my somewhat small town pet stores who seem to cater to gross China food that will make all our dogs sick.

I have spent 2 years trying to find some sort of dog food that won't break the bank, that's made with dog health in mind, and that my dogs actually like. having said that, I was truly skeptical about buying this, simply because of the price. I mean, it's dog food, they all look the same. But. it's. awesome. I started off by mixing in a spoon full of it into their regular food, and for the first time ever my dogs were cleaning their plates. its got chunks of real vegetables in it, and in combination with the dried food (also Halo, I mix the salmon with the lamb) my dogs are eating like kings and queens: 3 types of meat, 15 types of veggies & fruits...wow.I'm totally in love with this brand. I have switched over EVERYTHING, their treats, their dry food and their wet food.if halo comes out with a flavored water supplement for dogs, I'll probably buy that too. its just a great brand, reliable, and with a conscience.
My dogs love this food.  They eat it up as soon as I put it in their bowls.  I feel good about feeding my dogs this food.  You can see real carrots and green beans.

Love the item, but found it Cheaper at Vitacost.com.  Our dog had all kinds of health issues until we switched to Halo. Hs skin itched, he kept getting ear infections and he got very sore and limped after just a little exercise. Worst of ll, he could no longer go jogging with my wife and was acting old at the age of 6. Now he is healthy again and has the energy of a puppy again.

column9: NOT as Good as I hope for..try...
column10: I tried to switch my pug puppy to this food from another holistic brand and found it too rich for her. She started throwing it back up in just an hour or so after eating a very small amount of it. I switched her to WELLNESS Just for Puppy Holistic Nutrition. She has done very well with this. They also guarantee it or your money back. Price is comparable with Halo.

column9: Only dog food I will use
column10: After reading horrible reviews about dog food and with the onset of my puppy having seizures, I made him only home cooked meals specifically for dogs.  He was having stomach problems and went through many different recipes always consulting with my Vet, but then I found Halo dog food.  My dog eats this and looks for more, his stomach problems have subsided and he's doing very well. This was such a relief due to his seizures and stomach problems and I tried so hard to make him well.  He's been on Halo canned chicken Spots Stew now for 2 months and I am so relieved.  Now if only I could do something about the seizures, all would be well.  However, I give very high recommendations for Halo food.  A bit expensive, but worth every penny.  I need to add that I know how much Ellen Degeneres loves dogs and put my trust in her advocating Halo food.  I'm not sorry. Thanks Ellen.  Thanks Amazon for carrying it and offering monthly subscriptions.

This dog food is packed full of great stuff. You can see the chunks of chicken, carrots, peas and pasta. I feel good about feeding this to my dog. This can size is perfect for dogs under 10 pounds. My little chihuahua loves the stuff and one small can lasts us about 2 days.
THIS STUFF LOOKS GOOD ENOUGH TO EAT RIGHT OUT OF THE CAN. WE USE IT TO GIVE THEM A TREAT FROM TIME TO TIME. THEY LOVE THE CHANGE AND ENJOY IT. GOOD WHOLESOME FOOD FOR YOUR PETS.

column9: If only it would have worked...
column10: I wanted this wonderful food to work for Sheldon, but even a teaspoon added to his lamb and rice kibble gave us not so good results.  I wonder if he is just too little to try it...he is 4 months old.  Anyway, we may try it again when he is older because it seems like such a good quality food and that is what we strive to feed him.  I do have to say I was surprised when I opened the can.  I was expecting a chunky stew type food but it isn't.  It is a course puree with chunks of vegetable in it and that was fine with me too.  Also, he loved it!  If only it would have loved him back.
Arrived very fresh and well packaged.  Will be back!  Best plant selection/shipment Ive had!

You really can't beat this stuff.  It's so easy to make great ice cream using this product that I don't bother with the more complicated recipes anymore.  Mix 1 3/4 cup milk and 1/4 cup cream with a box of this mix, blend right in your ice cream maker's container with a stick blender and start up the ice cream maker.  That's all it takes to make a quart of lovely vanilla ice cream.  I decrease the fluid and replace with fresh chopped cherries and later chocolate chips when the mixture has thickened for a wonderful ice cream that has all my friends begging for more.  Since I use 2% milk and sometimes no cream at all, my finished product is much lower calorie than pre-made ice cream and just as good.  You don't have to feel guilty at all enjoying ice cream this way.  Fresh peach ice cream anyone?  The chocolate version of this mix is also delicious. Junket Ice Cream Mix Chocolate 12 count. A great and easy treat that will keep your ice cream maker churning all summer.

I was so happy to find Junket was still made and to find it in 12-count boxes in both chocolate and vanilla...even better!  You don't even need a churn, just an electric mixer, some patience, and you can make it in your freezer.  (The directions are even on the box for this method.)  A taste of childhood relived.

column9: quick and easy vanilla ice cream
column10: Junket has been around for a long time.  My grandmother used to use it when we were children and that was 60 years ago.  Junket still makes great ice cream and in an ice cream maker it takes only 20 to 30 minutes.  You can use the soft serve immediately or let it set up in the freezer for a thicker product like you buy at the store.  Nothing store bought in the taste. Good rewarding ice cream to serve to guests or to sneak for yourself as  late night snack when no one is looking.

Wonderful product...couldn't be easier to use...don't have to hassle with heating milk and using a ton of egg yolks...great flavor and wonderful starter to add other flavors (extracts, candy, caramel, etc.)  Great seller...enjoyed my buying experience...thanks!

I bought a soft serve ice cream machine and wanted something I could mix really quick when my son had his friends over. I tried with milk to make a healthier treat. It tasted OK. I added some extra vanilla extract to give it a richer flavor. When I mixed it with 2/3 whole milk and 1/3 heavy whipping cream......... say no more. It was absolutely magnificent!!!!! Wonderful flavor. Will definitely buy more when I run out. Very easy and quick.

column9: Nice tea, not sure about its effects.
column10: Great taste which is aslo very intense, so even if you brew it in a large 16-18 oz cup , it will still taste good.  Just wanted to mention that it is totally different from 'Ballerina' teas; there is no senna but mostly fruit and herbal ingredients like hibiscus, dried prunes and others.

If you're health minded like me and crave a hot, sugarless cup of tea in the wintertime, this might be for you. It's certainly worth a try. You may feel the urge to sweeten it up. However, in that case, I would suggest you not tamper with the tea itself, but have a slice of toast and jam with it. Health benefits? Well, it kind of makes me feel good. It settles my stomach.
