Not a significant source of calories from fat, saturated fat, cholesterol, dietary fiber, sugars, vitamin A, calcium and iron.Distributed by Magnit Enterprise, Inc., 415 Woods Of Arder Road, Staten Island, New York 10312. Phone: (347) 707-2399.

A friend of mine recommended to use this tea when she heard me complaining of my bowel movements. I am not into herbal teas or anything herbal that helps to resolve the physical problems. I am a "take a pill" person. But this time, I decided to go with it and does not regret at all. Besides of the great taste, it really improves your movement and does not give any cramps. It's very gentle. I am not the person who likes to recommend things, as tastes differ. But I can recommend this tea and you will enjoy it just as a tea too.

I thought the tea was quite expensive at first, but it helped me and a friend of mine alot, and it iw well worth the price.I have used many products in order to achieve a regular movement, but this has been the best. I started a few weeks ago and drink the tea twice a day with some honey. I am now moe regular than I have been in quite a few years.

column9: Yes they are cute, but wasn't like photo shown.
column10: I ordered these seeing cute little bunnies, rabbits and jelly bean birds nests thinking I was getting a variety, I bought 2 packages, and I got ALL jelly bean birds nests which are cute but 24 of them wasn't what I was expecting. But they are cute, probably best they are all the same since its for a preschool class, they seem quite sturdy. not sure if they are really edible though.

I purchased this product to make nut roll and it turned out great.I sent a few boxes to my sisters back east and they tried it and loved it.I know I will order more as soon as I use what I have.  Worked Great!

Asbach candies,shaped like little bottles, contain supreme Uralt Brandy inside the best dark chocolate available anywhere.  The combination is exquisite! Good enough to be a delicious dessert after a big dinner or a tasty treat any time!  Some would suggest waiting until after noon.  I would also but can't resist when they're around.  It's the chocolate you'll crave!
Menadione Sodium Bisulfite Complex (Source of Vitamin K) is a severely toxic synthetic form of vitamin K and is known to cause severe liver damage in cats. I would never feed my cat that food.

column9: Not as good as the Soulistic in Gelee
column10: Having purchased the Soulistic "Gelee" and BFF (made by the same company) I wanted to try the "Gravy" flavors to add some more variety.  Although the food looks appetizing and all the cats seem to like the food, I was dismayed to see that there seemed to be as much gravy as food in the cans.  I do not want to be paying the same price for cans that contain this much liquid and less food.  I will purchase the "Gelee" foods and BFF again, but it isn't likely that I will purchase the "Gravy" flavors.

column9: My cat drives me nuts..but with this Soulistic drives him nuts
column10: I have purchased so many varieties of cat products....ranging in price...this is not cheap but my cat for the first time isnt being picky and what makes this even better, he doesnt walk away and throw it up...so penny for penny...in my house..the price isnt so bad.I plan to find all the gravy ones...he does like the gel ones too and yes it stinks but cats wont eat what they cant smell...so be it...now to find an easier way to get it to my house..other then paying high shipping cost or driving out to Petco.

One wonders how S---bucks has a chance with the Caribou brand as competition! Unfortunately for us they don't have a Caribou location near to us. My husband likes this Caribou Blend and Caribou Mahogany.  When he runs out I order more from Amazon! Caribou is TOTALLY his favorite coffee!

Normaly I do not care for Spagetti sauce in a jar, I always prefer homemade. One day we were shoppin in Cosco and Rizzo's was handing out samples of their sauce, we were very suprised by the taste and bought a few jars. My personal favorite is the Tomato Basil, I fry up a pound of ground chuck and when its good and brown I add a jar of the Tomato Basil sauce, to me it tasts like the meat sause at Buca di Beppo. Like I said it is the best sauce that I ever found in a jar. If you look them up on the internet you will see that they have a popular resturant in Crabtree PA and have video links that show cooking recipies that they use there.

I first found Primo Pasta at a local restaurant who served it exclusively. It was so good I asked the server to find out what brand they used, and it turned out to be Primo!  I purched a few packages from Amazon, and it turned out to be great at home too.  I've had Primo with regular bottled sauce, canned sauce, and home-made Pomidoro sauce, and it has never dissapointed me. The flavor is entirely different from regular pasta, and the preparation time is just the same.  I love pasta, and for my money, Primo is the best!!

I originally bought the glaze at a local produce store, but they stopped selling it. I'm so glad I found it on Amazon. I love this glaze, a balsamic vinegar reduction, so much that I've purchased many bottles of it and have given it to friends to enjoy.  They, in turn, are now buying it. It's PERFECT on tomatoes and mozzarella.  My personal favorite is the glaze with cherry, but I'm sure all varieties are equally as good. Verrrrry yummy!!

My order was delivered to my home in amazing time!!  I was expecting about 3-5 days for estimated delivery..nope, it was there in 2 days!  Too bad some of the candy rolls were broken, wrappers torn, and that was INSIDE the factory packaging.  If this was factory seconds, that would have been nice to know up front. Not sure I will order from  this company again.

column9: I ordered the wrong item....my fault.
column10: I wanted the Peppermint Breathsavers, not the mint candy.  Was upset when it finally arrived, and didn't realize till much later I goofed. Have finally used them up and will order the correct, this time.  That was a lot of mints.

I use amaranth flour for a muffin recipe which is from arrowhead mills. Amaranth whole wheat muffins, delicious and healthy:-) However Amaranth has to be stored very carefully, it can go rancid very easily.

Bob's Red Mill Amaranth. It works well in anything you want to have a nutty or fruity flavor. It goes great with things like apples or peaches, cinnamon, walnuts, etc. It works best mixed with other GF flours. It can be a little strong on its own. I like the 6-month subscription plan. It almost makes it affordable.

column9: Very good but needs to be paired with other flavors
column10: Amaranth flour has a very earthy and nutty flavor.  The flavor is stronger than many other whole grains.  It pairs nicely with other assertive flavors but may be too much on its own.  I used it in a recipe for corn fritters (lots of spices and served over black beans) and it was excellent (even my three year old loved it).  Amaranth is a grain with a lot of fat (heart healthy fat) so it needs to be stored in the fridge or freezer or it will go rancid.  Amaranth is an excellent source of protein, calcium, and iron.  Its considered a super grain because of its high nutrional content.If you are looking for ways to add whole grains to your diet I would suggest trying this grain. Bob's Red Mill is usually a good bet for these types of products.  I have always had very good luck with this brand (always high quality).

I bought this because it was listed as a bread recipe ingredient and I could not find it around here.  I have not tried that recipe yet but used it as a replacement as recommended in cookies and pancakes this weekend.  It has some fiber so would be a little more healthy than regular flour and has a nice taste.  The cookies had so much sugar you might not be able to tell, but the pancakes seemed to have a nice flavor.

I use amaranth flour to make my own version of high protein "Cornell" white bread in the bread machine because my hubby won't eat whole wheat bread.  Amazon's price can't be beat on this item.  I used to buy it at the natural food store but it's very pricey.  Buying it in a three-pack helps too.  I store it in the freezer.Just in case you're wanting to make high protein bread, here is my recipe.  Both vegan and dairy versions are included here.  I make it in a Breadman 1.5 lb bread machine, set on white bread, regular cycle, light crust.Add 1-1/4 Cups warm water to bread machine panAdd 2 Tbs. butter OR 3 Tbs. lecithin granules to waterTo a 1 cup measure add the following:  1/4 cup amaranth flour, 1/4 cup white whole wheat flour, 3 Tbs. soy flour, top up the cup with unbleached, unbromated white bread flour.  Add 2 more cups of bread flour.  1 Tbs. powdered milk OR powdered soy milk, 2 Tbs Sugar, 1-1/2 tsp. saltUse bread machine yeast, 1-3/4 tsp.Start machine.  After 10 minutes of kneading check to see if dough is too wet or too dry, add water or bread flour accordingly.

I use this flour in gluten free breads and pastry because if its high protein content. It works well in combination with oat, millet, sorghum and other gluten free flours to make a high protein, high quality and very palatable product.J.R. WiltSouth Caro;ina

column9: Ounce for ounce, a great value
column10: I truly thought finding Amaranth Flour would be an ordeal. But here it was, available and able to be delivered to my door! When so many of the GF flours are packaged at under a pound, it is somewhat of a treat to have this packaged in 22-ounce bags. The 4-pack makes it that much more convenient. The flavor and the weight of the grain itself really add to my GF baking!

The flour in the shipment I received smelled like mildew. Since I was trying Amaranth flour for the first time I wasn't sure if the strong odor was normal. I tried baking a loaf of bread with the flour. Even after baking, the strong odor was still present - the bread smelled and tasted like mildew. I had to throw both the flour and the bread away...

Our golden retriever has had ear infections forever and now her ears are sooo much better.  With the lotion (and as of the past year, a grain-free, raw diet), she's like a different dog.  I use the lotion every other day and it's great.  My only complaint is that they changed the packaging and the new spout doesn't work as well for me.

This stuff works great and it's all natural.. But - I spilled it everywhere trying to get it in my poor dogs ear. If she wasnt so obedient she would've been all over the place as soon as I started spilling. Fix the bottle please, at the rate it's going I'm not going to have any left and I just bought it.. Plus I feel like I might be getting a bit too much in her ears, not that it does anything, its just wasteful.Otherwise, great scent, nice and gentle, my dog even seems more cheerful.

This product is by far the best ear cleanser; better than the prescription one as well. Max has chronic ear problems secondary to having atopic dermatitis. Ark cleanser is gentle yet very effective ; I use a bit of vinegar diluted with water regularly as well but then use the ark cleanser; it soothes his ear immediately and leaves a scent of cinnamon .  Poor Max his ears get so inflamed that it even takes the prescription meds 3 days to get the swelling to go down ; so this ark cleanser working on day one has totally amazed me.  It must make Max feel the difference as well because no more struggling with him to be still he actually leans towards me when I use this product. Super thank you please don't stop making Ark ear cleanser. and its all natural ; just doesn't get any better than that.

column9: BEWARE - TESTED ON MYSELF - BURNS LIKE FIRE!!!
column10: My aussie mix acted like I was hurting her no matter how gentle I was applying this stuff for general cleaning of her healthy ears.  Noticing cinnamon leaf oil in the ingedients, I wondered if that might not be an uncomfortable thing to squirt on tender membranes. I tried a little on a q-tip in my own ear and YOW!!!!!It took copious rinsing with saline solution to stop the burn, which indeed felt just like I'd stuck one of those kid-treat cinnamon oil toothpicks in my ear.  I felt terrible for having inflicted it on my dog, and especially on the ears of my recently-deceased 21 year old cat, who didn't seem to enjoy the experience either.I wrote a detailed letter to Ark Naturals immediately, worried that this formula is out there being put in other animals' ears.  It has been over a month with no response whatsoever.  No matter what their response is, I think this is disgraceful and suspect.The ingredients claim to be human-quality -- I recommend testing it on yourself to see if you may be inadvertently hurting your pet. Mine is Lot #61180, FYI.

I just love this product!  It was recommended to me by my groomer.  It has saved my poor poodles ears from infections.  I also love their "eyes so bright" product which has saved my cocker spaniel from eye problems.  Use a cotton ball for easier application.I highly recommend this product!

This ear cleaner is just the best for dogs.  My German Shorthair always has her ears flipped up and is in the bushes or trees. She used to shake her head and would have dirt in her ears. Just use some makeup removers and put this "Ears all Right" solution on the pads and gently wipe out her ears. It works right away and she no longer wakes up shaking her head. Highly recommend for your dogs if they have ear issues. I also have a male and when I get the ear cleaner out they both come out to get their ears cleaned. Try some as you won't be disappointed.
I had used this product before and it worked great for cleaning and maintenance for my pet's ears.

column9: Excellent alternative to conventional medicine with side effects
column10: I have used this ear wash on my, highly sensitive and allergic to everything, Weimeraner for a couple of years now.  We have even been able to avoid prescription medications if I catch the ear soon enough!Has a pleasant smell and Aloe Vera along with some other extracts for a soother, calming and refreshing product for your pet.I add tea tree oil to the bottle for an antiseptic, antibiotic and antifungal effect.Good luck!

column9: Mrs. May's Trio Bar Variety Pack
column10: My wire asked me to purchase these for her on my Amazon account. She loves them and I've found them to be great also.

column9: YUMMY! *Even if you're not a health nut!*
column10: I'm not a big fan of granola, trail mix, or any other "health" bar. My friend (who is a health nut!) gave me one for breakfast while I was at her home. I thought, "This is going to be nasty." (LOL) Little did I know that would start an addiction that has lasted for over two years :) The variety box comes with blueberry (my fav), strawberry, tropical, and cranberry. After you find out whether or not you enjoy these, you can set up for a monthly (or every other month) shipment and Amazon doesn't charge shipping fees for it this way, which is very cool! Do try. You will enjoy these! :)

column9: Too much seeds and nuts, very dry
column10: I'm all for a healthy snack bar but I thought this bar tasted exactly what it's made of - seeds and nuts. And for me I need more than that in a bar. These bars are made with seeds, nuts, and some fruit. I'd prefer more fruit and less of the nuts and seeds as these are too dry for my taste buds. Flavors included in this variety pack are: Strawberry, Blueberry, Cranberry and Tropical Bars.
Just received this product.  Had tried Mrs. Mays freeze-dried fruit (which is also excellent).  I thought if they were so good, what else do they have that would be a good snack.  Very pleased.
Excellent on the go snack (just throw it in my purse)!  Having celiac and needing convenience is not easy.....these bars are the right mix of sweet, crunchy and salty!  Love them.
These go with us to work or just when I want a snack. Better than chips and cookies!! I keep these on hand along with a few others. Auto delivery!
These are almost half the size of the Mrs Mays bars I normally buy.  Too expensive for these little bars.
I LIKED THIS ITEM VERY MUCH.  MOST BARS HAVE TOO MUCH CHOCOLATE OR SUGARY MORSELS.  I ENJOY THE FLAVOR OF THE FRUIT

I purchased these after tasting one from a co-worker. Once at home, my wife thought it was bird food but once she noticed me eating them, the box disappeared. I've ordered from this dealer in the past and plan to order again, soon. Excellent product and excellent service. I'm very, very pleased!
Lots of nuts with dried fruites, no artificial sweet taste!Great to keep in bags and in the car!Loving it!
These bars are really good - nutty and slightly sweet. My kids love them and I feel good about giving them as a snack.

I really like these nut filled health bars.  In the past I could only find them at my local wearhouse store so I went looking on line.  As usual, Amazon came to my rescue.  These bars are smaller than the wearhouse bars but not too much. The were at my door quickly and in good shape.

Mrs. May's bar tastes great and I have them before tennis or during a round of golf. Works well for me. The only thing is the size of the bar offered through Amazon is smaller than the size from Costco. Be aware of that!
Product is very tasty and nutritious,  not too sweet not too salty,  very good

column9: Yummy and good for you too
column10: These bars are so good.  They remind me of panut brittle.  When Costco stopped stocking them, I had to find another source.  So a-searching on the web I went and found them here at Amazon and on a subscription basis too.  So now they keep coming and I'm enjoying my Trio bars every evening as part of my bedtime snack.
Found Mrs. May's Bars at Smart & Final in San Jose Ca., they do not carry them any more. Glad to be able to get them through Amazon.

I just tried these today and found the item to be very fresh and love the natural aspect.  There are no trans fat, no additives, no preservatives, no cholesterol. The item is gluten, dairy and wheat free, non-GMO and Kosher...for those who do not know what Kosher is that simply means it is a food that conform to the regulations of the Jewish Halakhic framework.Ingredients included for the Blueberry bar...which I might add is my favorite are Cashews, Almonds, Pistachios, Blueberries, Sesame Seeds, Sunflower Seeds, Pumpkin Seeds, Dates, Raisins, Rice Malt, Natural Flavors, Cane Juice, Sea Salt.  I was very happy to see they use Cane Juice for the sweetener instead of a refined sugar.3 nuts, 3 seeds, 3 fruits, 170 Calories, 14g carbs, 6g sugarThis is the first bar I have been able to find that is truly natural and taste wonderful.  The Cranberry is a bit tart, but I did not find it so tart I would never eat it again.The only negative I found is that the product is made in China.

The bars are basically sweetened granola nut bars, without the oats, and taste much better than other granola bars I've tried. They have quite a bit more nuts than most, so despite the small bar they pack a lot of protein. I think they're a great balance of sweet, savory, crunchy, and chewy, the only downside is that the seeds sometimes get stuck in my teeth. So far I've enjoyed three boxes of these, all on sale, and got great value out of them. At normal price, they'd be a so-so value. The fact that they're made in China doesn't worry me (remember, the last major Salmonella recall was from a US peanut factory), but I would support them at higher prices if they were made here.

These bars are super tasty!  If you're a nut and seed love these are the right bars for you.  The different flavors such as strawberry, blueberry, and tropical just give a hint of taste but i can certainly say the perfect amount!Taste wise these are delicious and they're definitely not terribly bad for you!

column9: A tasty snack bar, that's full of good stuff!
column10: I first became aware of Mrs. Mays products through Mrs. May's Dry-Roasted Snack, Almond Crunch, 5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12) which our family enjoys.  So when I saw Mrs. May's  Trio Bar Variety Pack being offered on Amazon I decided to place an order.The Trio name comes from each bar containing the same 9 base ingredients which are:Nuts - Cashews, Almonds, Pistachios.Seeds - Sesame Seeds, Sunflower Seeds, Pumpkin SeedsFruits - Dates, Raisins and the "flavor" of the particular bar.In this box you have Strawberry, Blueberry, Cranberry and Tropical (Pineapple, Mango & Papaya). So far I have tried Blueberry and Strawberry and I have to say the difference is slight, but it is there. I do like the consistency; crunchier than some granola bars, but still easy to bite. The fact that these aren't filled up with flours or oats like most snack bars is great too. Overall I like these, but if I had one complaint it would be their size. At only 1.2oz they are small, but I guess because of the nuts, seeds and texture they are still a filling snack.*I've included a picture in the customer images to show you just how little filler these bars have.

Mrs. May's Natural Trio Variety Bars are delicious, healthy, and small enough to carry in my handbag, just in case I need  "pick-me-up".So glad that Costco restocked them, as they're one of my favorites there!!

My mom first turned me onto these. Unlike gooey, sweet (and high calorie), granola bars (which I thought these would be), these are at the same time crunchy and chewy, not too sweet, and delicious!  Everytime I share with colleagues they demand to know how to order them for themselves (I'm in Iraq).  This batch was good but in the past I received a batch that was slightly stale.

I bought the variety box of Mrs. May's Trio because they are gluten free.  I was amazed at how great they taste - best energy bar by far.  I will keep stocked up on them, as I try to travel with a "safe food" to eat if I have a hunger attack.  These are definitely now on my shopping list!

column9: Kids love them too + they're Vegan!
column10: These are the best bars I have ever had. They are all delicious. I have kids ages 14, 12,9 & 2, and they all love these! I love the fact that you can actually pronouce all the ingredients, so you know exactly what you are eating.
Very tasty-whole nuts and fruit put together into a bar. Crunchy, but not too crunchy. Bought them for my vegan daughter, but I love them too.

Read the very fine print... made in China.  If you call the company they will tell you they use American Products and ship them to China to be made into Bars... and them ship them back to the US.Why not put made in China on the Front of the packaging... if there is nothing to be concerned with.. let people make there own decision...

Mrs. May's  Trio Bar Variety Pack, 1.2-Ounce bars (Pack of 20)This nuts, seeds & dried fruits bar has been reduced in size by about 1/3. It was large enough, prior to this size reduction, to satisfy your hunger until mealtime, but not any more. The company did not reduce the price, just the size.

column9: Delicious but won't buy again because of country of origin
column10: Very tasty bars of wholesome ingredients...at least that's what's on the label. The bars do taste great and I'd buy them regularly except that the bars are made in China. It's sad the manufacturer has decided to save a buck by selling out US workers and exporting our food production. I won't buy them again until the country of origin states "US."

column9: Taste good, but pedigree is troubling for several reasons
column10: We bought these bars at Costco and liked them enough that we wanted to see whether they could be bought more conveniently through Amazon.  Only then did I learn what I had missed on the box - that the food products are shipped to China for assembly and some content.  We would willingly pay more to have this become a product of the U.S., but because of the implications for environmental impact and job creation, and potential health issues with the current product, we will search for alternatives.

column9: Peanut taste with a hint of the labeled flavor - Made in China
column10: Bars are small, very sticky, peanut taste with a hint of whatever flavor is on the product packaging.  Sort of bland.For better tasting alternatives, I really like the Kind bars and the "non organic" Nature Valley bars.

I enjoy this product very much and consider it a healthy food but the review is based upon the condition of the product when it arrived to my home. I ordered two boxes of these bars however the majority of the bars inside both boxes were cracked and broken apart.

column9: Don't pay attention to the negative reviews!
column10: These are easily the best snack bar product I've ever found.  They are solid nuts & (to a lesser degree) fruit.  No cheap fillers here...just crunchy, natural goodness.It is a travesty that the overall reviewer rating is not close to 5 stars.  This is because of all the knuckleheads who've left poor reviews due to the product being manufactured in China.  If you are leery of food products from China, DON'T BUY THEM.  Nearly everything we buy today is manufactured in China!  Leaving a negative review because of that, is similar to the jerks who give 1-star reviews to products that had shipping issues (delays, damage, etc.)One nitwit complained that they were too "hard" for his/her teeth.  Well, nuts are crunchy, genius.  A trip to the dentist might be in order.Bottom-line:  If you have concerns about these being produced in China, don't buy them (and DON'T LEAVE INAPPROPRIATE NEGATIVE REVIEWS).  For everyone else, do yourself a favor and try these...they are simply fabulous!

So...they get 60 percent of their raw materials from the United States, they ship them to China for manufacturing, then ship bars back to the United States for sale.That's like living in Sacramento and driving 500 miles to Portland for an "earth friendly" meal, and then driving back to Sacramento and bragging to your friends about how eco-minded you are.Why not just eat a local nut bar and pour a gallon of gasoline down the drain every time you finish a box? It would be the same as eating Mrs. Mays bars.This company is destroying the planet just to make an extra buck.We are SUCH a screwed up country...we're IMPORTING food!!
This product satisfies on all levels.  It is a healthy snack, a hunger quencher and a guilt-free endulgence.  It also tastes great and won't bankrupt you.  Highly recommend!

If you don't have any, store them in an airtight container and examine them before you eat them. Or better yet, don't buy them. column9: Made in China and bad for the planet
column10: I loved the taste of this product but just noticed they are made in China.  I contacted the company to get more information. They said they test for quality but in fact the list they gave me was for bacterial contaminants only. They do not test for lead or other heavy metals, just salmonella, aflatoxin and microbiological testing. And they do not own the factory, they just contract out the production and inspect the factory.As for the ingredients, some of them are from China, such as the malt syrup. And the US ingredients are shipped all the way to China, the product is made, then it is shipped all the way back. This was to cut costs according to a business journal report on the company. I hate to see what the carbon production is for each bar based on that practice. And for the price they sell the product for, which is quite expensive, this way of saving a buck speaks poorly to the company's ethics. I for one will no longer buy this product.

column9: In a crowded market, there are better choices out there...

My first impressions were that they were Waaaay too hard and crunchy - I felt like I might break a tooth on these things!  But maybe someone younger would not worry so much about that :).  My second concern was when I read the small print that these are manufactured in China...not so good in my book.  As everyone has seen, in recent years china's foodchain has had some tremendous snafus and quality control issues, which I doubt are resolved yet. column9: Trio bars are delicious!  My favorite energy/snack bars
column10: Mrs. May's Trio bars are my favorite snack/energy bars. I love them. They come in four flavors and you get five of each flavor in this variety box. Blueberry is my favorite, followed by strawberry (I like berry flavors). Cranberry comes in third, but I still really like it, just not as much as blueberry and strawberry. Though cranberries are pretty tart, the cranberry bar is not noticeably tarter than the others. My least favorite is the tropical but only because it has a less distinct taste than the others.The name comes from the ingredients. The bars have a trio of trios: 3 nuts, 3 seeds and 3 fruits. The nuts, seeds and 2 of the fruits are the same in all the flavors. The nuts are cashews, almonds & pistachios. The seeds are sesame, pumpkin, & sunflower. The two fruits that are in all the flavors are dates and raisins, but you don't really see or taste them so I wonder if they are cooked down into the "glue" that holds all the other ingredients together. The third fruit in each flavor is (obviously) dried fruit in the named flavor, though the tropical is a blend of three different tropical fruits, none of which dominates. The only other ingredients are rice malt, natural flavors, cane juice and sea salt.These are great bars for anyone who has issues with wheat or dairy. The label says they are wheat free, gluten free, dairy free and kosher. They also have no preservatives. If you have peanut allergies, the label says they are packaged in a peanut free facility that processes other nuts.Because of the nuts, they have 12 grams of fat per bar, but I've been reading articles that say nuts are a great snack and the fat in nuts is "good" fat. The label says there is 1.5 grams of saturated fat which surprised me but I guess some of the fat in nuts must be saturated. To round out the rest of the nutrition facts: calories, 170; total carbs, 14g; dietary fiber, 2g; sugars, 6g; protein, 5g; cholesterol, 0g; trans fat, 0g; and sodium, 45mg.I love the nuts and seeds and the bars don't have the mealy texture that a lot of energy/snack bars have. They are low sodium but high in taste and they are really satisfying. I used to get granola bars but these are so much better.

column9: Value for money but watch out sugar content

They provide a healthy snack when you need something small. We pack them for a trip and I always take them when I'm playing golf. Some of our friends and relatives started buying them after getting them from us. It's nice to know that you can get them at Amazon.com because you don't see them much at other stores that carry health or snack bars.

The variety pack of bars are very tasty.  As a gold box item I also felt I received a tremendous value with the bars.  My wife, son, and I all enjoy even if the occasional pumpkin seed is a bit weird.
they are all so good I could not choose a favorite - I am glad I bought a box because these were fantastic.

These little bars are quite delicious and healthy.  I originally bought these at Costco but saw these on sale one day on amazon so I decided to give them a shot.  The bars that they sell at Costco are a bit larger 220 calories than these ones at 170 calories.  I ordered 4 boxes and none of mine have been stale like some other reviewers have complained about.  Worth the money.

column9: brittle but good bar.. though made in china
column10: After getting past my initial expectation of a more chewy bar, I grew to rather like these bars. But they are a bit brittle - prone to shatter and crumb when you bite.The nuts and seeds taste quite well, and the fruit flavor is not too sweet; it's just enough.I'm uncertain if I'll buy them again though, after noticing they are made in China - whose reputation for poor QA, especially in food products, precedes them.But I'll give them 4 stars based on the taste, and leave the ethical / safety concerns to the reader.

Excellent taste in an easy to carry pack.  Just put a couple in your purse for a quick snack and you have an easy solution for between meal energy boost or as a solution to a hungry stomach if you cannot get away from your desk for lunch.
These bars are the best, you feel like you have eaten a meal not a snack. no chalky or powder taste. AGAIN THE BEST!!!!

I've been eating these for months and actually really enjoy them.  I just came online in order to buy some more and decided to read these one-star reviews (I couldn't believe somebody didn't like them!) -- I have eaten my very last Trio bar.  And (sarcastically) thank you very much Mrs. May!!!!

How long will it take people to realize that foods made in China are potentially dangerous?  There is no regulation there and Chinese companies cannot be trusted with food products.  I will buy no food made in China.

I think that these bars are very good and so healthy.  They are a great snack to take in the car when traveling and a better choice than those bad snacks at gas stations.  The flavor is awesome and very delicious.

column9: Do you trust gluten, dairy free from CHINA?
column10: As others have said, I don't trust these coming all the way from China.  I think the hard crunch others are talking about is because these are STALE.  I doubt they are supposed to be as crunch as they are.

column9: Smaller than the Trio bars from Costco
column10: I was disappointed to find that these bars are about half the size of the ones sold at Costco. 24 small bars at Amazon was priced only slightly less than Costco for 24 of the larger bars. If you are a Costco member, it's a much better deal to buy them there.
I just bought my 2nd box from Costco and decided to compare prices on Amazon.  Thanks for showing reviews...I will not purchase this again since it is made in China!

column9: I LOVE these, but don't buy them here: they're too expensive
column10: I've tried several brands of pure fruit and nut bars and like the Trio bars the best by far. I bought them regularly at Costco until they stopped carrying them several months ago. Recently I tried the online version here at Amazon. Quality is again top-notch, but something seemed to be missing. The new bars are TINY.Thankfully, Costco is stocking them again. Costco charges about $17 for twenty 48-gram bars. These guys want $25 for twenty 35-gram bars, a third smaller for half again as much money.

column9: Not Fresh? Do we have a health risk ??
column10: I have recently noticed that the last few months of Trio snacks received are stale and more brittle than usual. I am told that this product is made in China which concerns me.I cannot find madatory expiration dates on the box which causes me even greater concern. I hope Amazon is reviewing their food products prior to shipping.

Finally a great tasting nutritious bar, without force feeding you chunks of chocolate, marshmallow, peanut butter, or some other various filler to negate the taste of the raw ingredients. Wonderful product, will buy again.

In a world of very few dairy, free gluten free bars, this one takes the cake!  It is crunchy and flavorful, it has good quality ingredients and is a healthier option for a quick snack.  I love them!!!

column9: A lot of bite for a small bar.
column10: The bars look small but are packed with so much! A great snack in the afternoon!
I am really not a 'healthy eater', but I love these bars.  The sample pack let's you sample different flavors, but they are all really good.  Just the right size for a wonderful snack.

I had the opportunity to purchase this when it was a Gold Box deal.  Earlier that day, I was getting a massage (rare treat), and they had these bars.  I was starving, so I purchased one.  After tasting that one, I placed an order for this through my cell phone.When it arrived, I was surprised that they were not the full retail size.  These are about half the size as the ones you buy in a store.However, that being said, they are delicious.  I am not a whole foods type person.  I prefer to eat according to taste, not whether something is healthy for me, or good for the environment (sad but true).  So these are quite tasty if I'm willing to buy a box of them.My only complaint is that htey are a tad tiny compared to the retail size.

column9: exactly what it say it is, three nuts, three seeds, three berries
column10: This is definitely not my favorite product from Mrs. Mays but still very tasty.  I don't personally enjoy the texture of these 'bars' as they are very hard.  I see some people have complained about them being stale and I wonder more if they are just not used to the texture of the bar.  Also, when I think of a 'bar' I am thinking of something sort of cakey, sort of chewy, and these are not at all like that.  Really, they are just a bunch of nuts and seeds held together with some sort of hardened liquid.  The only thing I could relate it to would be sort of like a brittle, with a similar texture or consistency but not sweet like a brittle.  I really like the blueberry and cranberry flavors, strawberry is okay but could definitely pass on the tropical one.  These snacks are healthy, filling and pretty tasty and something great to munch on when you are on the go or looking for something to fill the snacking void that is a bit healthier than a bag of chips.

column9: I am NOT a big healthy food nut but..
column10: ...these don't taste like you are eating healthy! I went to my nephews wedding and in our gift bags at the hotel they put these Trio Bars. I read the package and said no thanks! I brought them home and gave them to my son. Well my mom still had hers and she made me taste one....78 years old and still pushing me around! Well she was right...they ARE good! I contacted my sister and asked her to get me more from her son if she could. She then told me they were on Amazon and I was really happy because I could not find them in the stores locally.I am NOT a health food person. I love my fattening food but I have been trying to eat a bit better lately. You know how it is with getting older. I will GLADLY eat these because they are delicious. If you love nuts, you will love these bars. Crunchy, touch of salt, touch of sweet, filling....they just fit the bill! I've gotten my son to eat them for breakfast because he's not a breakfast person. It makes me feel good to know he's got some healthy energy food in him and not some caffiene loaded beverage!Look locally and see if  you can try a bar. To me they are very rich and filling so one is plenty for me even though they are slightly small. I think once you try them you'll get the bug to eat them regularly. They certainly are better for you than a bag of chips!

column9: Made in China--who knows what's in there
column10: I noticed (after purchase) these are made in China, which is unexpected for a high-end bar.  Who knows what's in there?  I don't, and I don't want to find out.

We like these Mrs. May's Trio Natural Bars. These are a little on the chewy, sticky side, so beware, if you have dental problems (chew carefully). Packaged in an almost indestructible cello package. The ingredients are as follows: Cashews, Almonds, Pistachios, Fruit (Cranberries or Strawberries or Blueberries or Tropical-Pineapple, Mango, Papaya), Sesame Seeds, Sunflower Seeds, Pumpkin Seeds, Dates, Raisins, Rice Malt, Natural Flavors, Cane Juice, Sea Salt. That's it! There are 20 bars in a 24 oz or 700 gram box. Each bar is 1.2 oz or 35 grams. The box says: vegan/no trans fat/no additives/no preservatives/no cholesterol/gluten free/diary free/wheat free/non-GMO/kosher and product of China (that worries me more than a little). Calories 170 each, 100 calories from fat, 12 grams total fat, 1.5 grams saturated fat, 0mg cholesterol, 45mg sodium, 14g total carbohydrate, 2g dietary fiber, 6g sugar, 5g protein, 2/4% calcium, 8% iron, 0% vitamins A & C. Yummy flavor, can taste the nuts and fruit, not too sweet for most people, certainly a lot less sweet than any other granola/snack/breakfast/protein type bar we've tried. Wish they were bigger, pretty small. Otherwise, very good bars.  Nice having 5 bars of each flavor all in one box!

We purchased the item from Costco and have enjoyed the snack without reading about its origin [individual bars have a lot of attractive information but does not have country of origin].  To replenish our supply I decided to order it from Amazon and for the first time [after reading the reviews] became aware that the food product was made in China. What guarantee is there that the product is GMO free? Are random samples of the food item tested for GMO presence? Is the product manufactured in a facility that does not process non-vegan items?  Who has tested food products from China for presence of heavy metals and other contaminants and is there a continuous testing? The claim is that the product is "all natural" but who has verified that components used are grown on land that is not contaminated with chemicals and heavy metals.  The product is very tasty and we have not suffered from food poisoning but now that I am aware of the country of origin I have grave doubts about the integrity of the product for long term use [bioaccumulation of contaminants and cumulative effects over time] and will look for similar snacks that are made locally [Made in USA]. I have no confidence in food products from China based on available evidence of widespread pollution and contaminated pet food ingredients and baby food.

column9: Amazon's box was stale. This was not a problem from Costco.
column10: I've been buying Mrs. Mays Trio bars at my local Costco for years, and agree that they are the only health bar that one can look forward to eating. However, Costco stopped carrying the product, so I bought it from Amazon. Some of the bars tasted stale, almost rancid, even though the sell by date is in Feb. 2010.I didn't realize the product is made in China. Unfortunately, if this is the case, I will have to rethink my choice. Also, because I cannot buy the product locally, and what I got from Amazon was sub-par (compared to all the other instances when I've used the product), sadly I will probably give it up.

These bars are hard as a rock and who knows what's really in them if they are made in China.  I threw mine out when I realized where they came from.  Why doesn't Amazon disclose country of manufacture?  And shame on this company!

column9: I love these, but please make them in the US!
column10: I love these.  I mean, I really love them.  And I was about to order them, but out of curiosity glanced down at the reviews.Mrs. May, I hope you read these reviews!  I will be one of your faithful customers forever if you start making these in the US.I choose not to buy any products (especially food) made in China, because of 2 concerns: 1.  Human rights issues and the use of prisoners as unpaid laborers (this is why the price is cheap on Chinese-made goods) and 2.  Concerns for quality control.
If I had known they come from China, I would have saved my money.  As it is I pitched them directly into the garbage!

column9: In response to the China negative reviews
column10: Search the net for articles on Mrs May's. The original owner could not, because of the labor required to make the bars by hand, maintain a profitable business. New owner ships most of the raw ingredients to China where the bars are assembled and sent back.Others are free to comment on this reality; I'm just very fond of these very tasty bars.

Everything has been fine with this order:  Delivery time, quality, excellent taste.However, I was surprised to see a box of 20 when the picture showed a box of 24!In checking after I received the order it is clearly stated that it is a box of 20, which I didn't notice.  The picture showed and still shows a box of 24.Time to change the picture!

column9: Great service at a great price.
column10: I've used Trio bars as an energy bar for hiking for years, and couldn't find them at a reasonable proce locally any longer, so was happy to find them here.
I EAT THIS BAR AFTER A GYM WORKOUT.  IT TASTES GOOD & I FEEL IT'S A VERY HEALTHY PRODUCT.  I HAVE RECOMMENDED IT TO FRIENDS.
This is a very tasty & nutritional bar full of nuts & fruit. But they are made in China.  Not knowing the safely quality I eat these sparingly
No taste and my teeth hurt from trying to bite through it. It's made in China too, I didn't know that when I bought it. I gave the whole box away.

The product is great; full of all sorts of nuts that are good for everyone to eat. I don't like it being put together by China. Please let Americans produce this product. However, I have canceled my on-going order. Please check your records to mkae sure I don't get another shipment. Thanks!

column9: I like it, but wont buy again
column10: Its just not right.  Unfortunately this product is made in China.  Weird but true.  I think my food should come from North America at the worst....except for bananas! ;)

column9: Tastes fine. But no food from China, thanks.
column10: I wished I'd noticed this product was manufactured in China before I purchased it, because that knowledge would have stopped me.I don't trust ANY food from China, period. No claim they make (gluten free, dairy free, etc.) can be trusted. On top of that, these ingredients are shipped there and then shipped back. I'm paying for diesel fuel to push ships instead of ingredients for my food.This'll be the last batch I buy. They taste fine, but I'll buy closer to home, where the food is local and the processes are regulated.

column9: A Great Gluten Free Protein Bar
column10: I was given a Mrs. May's Trio Bar on a trip recently.  I was pleasantly surprised at this not too sweet, nutty, crunchy treat.  And it's gluten free as well.  I saved the wrapper and ordered some for myself.  I remembered the one given to me being in a different wrapper and larger than the ones I ordered. This person lives in Canada, so perhaps that's the reason for the difference.I enjoy them to sustain me between meals, and have them in my backpack on the trails.  These bars are a great summer option since there is nothing that will melt.  Do they taste as good as some of the other bars I eat?  No. I'm not intolerant to gluten so have many many options.  There is only 5 grams of protein per bar, but more than most granola bars provide for comparable calories. If you need to avoid gluten, I think you'll find that these bars are a tasty option for you!  Even if you don't need to avoid gluten I think you'll still find these are a tasty option, more nutritious than most granola bars, with much less sugar!

I bought a box at costco and liked these better than any bar I've eaten before. They are higher in fat due to the amount of nuts, but much lower in sugars than the average bar which is one reason they tasted better to me. Though they are crunchy I didn't find them too hard as one reviewer found. (I'm almost 60 and don't have that good of teeth). Now that I looked at the Amazon reviews I'm disappointed they're made in china so I will have to rethink whether to buy these again.
Excellent bar to take the edge of hunger.  Use as afternoon snack or when we travel.  Easy to pack along or just put in your pocket.
This is an excellent snack bar. Has a nice balance of fat versus carb to tackle hunger and give you fuel between meal. Great tast. Quality ingredients. Arrives very fresh and has good shelf life

I've eaten all flavors of these Trio bars. I started buying these about 5 years ago. They are just nuts, seeds, dried fruit and a little cane juice. Previously the bars were larger and were 7 Points Plus points with Weight Watchers. The current bars are a little smaller and are only 5 Points Plus points. They are a complete meal. I always have one in my purse and two in my car. If I'm out running errands and get hungry I'll eat one for a totally satisfying lunch. I take them on all road trips and eat one for breakfast while I'm driving.I think I'm on about my 8th box of these Trio Bars. For a person who doesn't like sugar, sweets and fillers, this is a healthy, wonderful snack (or meal).

I think this is one of the best snack type products that I have ever tasted. Unfortunately I wish it was made in the USA and not China, since there some questionable food products that come from that Country.

column9: LOVE the bars (my kids do, too) but assembled in CHINA
column10: I am a little sad because my entire family just loves these bars!  They are yummy and use whole foods.  I do wonder, however, being sent to China -- if the coating that sticks them together is good or what exactly is in there since China is not known for quality regulations and the recent baby food and dog food scandals.  I won't be buying anymore until everything is done right here in the USA.
Nutty, crunchy, and a little sweet. Better than most cereal bars. Fairly healthy, but the fat content is a bit high.

I love the Trio bars.  I personally LIKE that they are crunchy ("hard" as some would say).  I originally had one at a friends house and was told she purchased them at Costco.  When I inquired at the Costco near me, I was told they no longer carried the Trio bars.  The Mrs Mays website indicates that Whole Foods and BJ's carries Trio bars, but the locations near me - do not.  The shipping charges on the Mrs Mays website are pretty high - which brought me to Amazon.  I was also told by CS at Mrs Mays that the 1.7oz bar was only available at Costco.  The bars sold here at Amazon and the Mrs Mays website are the smaller 1.2oz bars.  I'm not thrilled that they're manufactured in China.  If anyone knows of a similar nut/seed crunchy bar - please post in comments!  Thank you!

column9: The best granola bar on the market!!!!
column10: All the other granola bars are ground up and pressed into a bar. This bar is whole nuts and pieces of fruit held together with rice syrup! Good for you and tastes incredible. I will never go back to a traditional granola bar. YOU HAVE TO TRY THIS BAR!!! I have this as a lunch replacer when I am in a hurry.

column9: China not ready for prime time
column10: Someday, it will be safe to buy food products from China. Today is not that day. Everyone knows China is very poorly regulated and the Chinese people suffer from all kinds of side effects as a result. Why should that problem and uncertainty be exported? The only way to manufacture in China is for the outsourcing company to STRICTLY and CONTINUOUSLY audit the manufacturing process -- because we cannot rely on their native legal and regulatory controls to ensure a safe product. Trio is not Apple Computer. They can't afford to scan the manufacturing all the time.I had a Trio bar yesterday - first time - and so I wanted to buy more. But I'll have to think twice about this product until they bring manufacturing back to the USA or at least to a country with a recognized high manufacturing standard. Health food + uncertain origin DO NOT equal a viable product. Sorry Trio!

column9: I Have Wet dreams About these Things
column10: I do not care if they are produced in China. China does produce terrible products, this is not one of them.I eat them every-other morning and I am not radioactive thus far, I think.They are super healthy and make me feel awesome! Because I am awesome.I have only eaten the ones from Costco, but I would assume that they are very similar.

I used to get these at Costco, but they no longer carry them.  Thanks for having them available.  I got addicted to the great taste.  The high protein content satisfies hunger.  They are a perfect snack for on the go.

I like these Trio Bars because they have simple ingredients, nuts and fruit with rice malt and cane juice as the only other and last ingredients.  They taste great!  I can keep them for a long time in my car in my glove compartment, and even when it heats up past 100 degrees, they do not melt or spoil.  In that way, I can have good nutrition when I may be stuck on the run and hungry (5 grams protein) and not have to resort to fast food.
I am rating this bar for taste and its exceptionally published nutritious content, rather than for its "Made in China" possible implications.
Love these bars! I didn't realize they would be so small though. I guess I should've known from the 1.2 oz description. Just wish they sold the larger ones. Otherwise, awesome.

column9: Mrs. Mays Trio Bars, tasty, but made in China!!
column10: I love how they taste, very fresh nuts, not too sweet.  A perfect snack item, but then I saw they are made in China and that was a huge disappointment.  That's a long way to travel for a snack item.  If they were made in USA I would give them 5 stars.
I am gluten intolerant and a friend introduced these bars to me in August. They are absolutely awesome! Filling, so tasty, not like most of the gluten free cardboard tasting things we sometimes get.

the first time i had these bars was by accident. an impulse buy at a health food store. but i was HOOKED after that. Not so sweet as to b confused with candy bars, but sweet enough to put a smile on your face. VEGAN, with lots of nuts, and fruits. great snack fro the vegan on the go.

I have to eat gluten free, and a lot of snacks are just not very tasty.  These are excellent tasting, and the ingredients are some of the best foods you can eat.  I deducted one star for "Made in China".  However, I have never had better tasting "processed" food.All the flavors are tasty.The bars' cost is on par with other, less enjoyable snacks.They are my go to snack when I am away from home.  They taste so good that I had to review them, and I almost never write reviews.
Productswas excellent and arrived in the promised time.  I will defintely order again.  I shared this with a friend and they said they will order it as well.

column9: The only bars my husband will eat...I wish they were organic
column10: Unlike most bars these are very crunchy because they're loaded with nuts and seeds!  My husband loves them.  I wish they were organic ("natural" does not mean "healthy", as we all know).

I am a big fan of these bars. The flavor is great and they are a fantastic alternative to those processed protein bars.  The only negative is that this product is made in China where the manufacturing standards are shady and as far as I am concerned, shouldn't be trusted. Too bad because this  is a good product and I would have continued buying them otherwise.

I ordered this to replace the same Item which I have purchased at Costco, however, the bars are smaller (1.2 oz. v. 1.8 oz.) and more expensive.  However, these bars are my lunch when hiking or working on field projects.  They pack a lot of nutrition and stick to the ribs.

column9: The absolute BEST fruit and nut bar!!
column10: I first tried them at B.J's but they were sold only once.  Thankfully Amazon had a supplier.  They are the best nut and fruit bar, not sticky sweet like most.  They are excellent with a more reasonable calorie count, too.

We have tried all the BRAT feel better drinks, and this is our favorite flavor....its like drinking the milk leftover from a bowl of cinnamon toast crunch.  So good!  More importantly, though, its always worked when my kids are sick with the stomach flu; keeping them hydrated, calming their tummies, and helping stop diarrhea.  Which is great news because I can never get them to drink Pedialyte, AND that drink doesn't have the extra "feel better" benefits of the BRAT drinks.  I also like that this drink works for adults too who have similar stomach problems (eg morning sickness and digestive disorders)! Plus, its all-natural and doesn't contain any of the common allergens, so as a parent, I actually feel good about giving them this product.  A+ in my book!

Just like the other reviewer said, it tastes like the "milk" left over after a finishing a bowl of cinnamon cereal.  I thought it would be thicker (because of the apple and banana puree in there) but it is essentially like drinking yummy rice milk.  For people with multiples allergies (like me) it is a safe drink that I can actually drink without making me sicker.  And the Amazon price ($5 a quart) is much cheaper than I can find it in the local Whole Foods ($7 a quart).  And yea, it is expensive, but face it, if you are puking and sick, you won't be chugging the whole quart at once.

Just like many of the best Italian olive oils come from top wine producers, Marques De Grinon EVOO comes from one of Spain's greatest wineries, Marques De Grinon, known for it's exceptional Cabernets and Syrahs from its estate in Castilla-La Mancha. This olive oil is quite complex and rich, more buttery and less bitter than typical Tuscan oils, but every bit as fresh and flavorful. I would put it as a worthy alternative to the Tuscan oils, particularly for dipping in bread, where it's softness makes it especially delectable. It's too expensive to be used for everyday cooking, but it can be drizzled on steaks and chops at the end to add aromatic and flavor nuance to grilled meats and vegetables. Really, this is a world class oil.

For those of you wondering why the 2-pack is much cheaper per oz. than the 3-pack, here is  a possible reason (yes, you guessed it): the back label reads "Harvest Fall 2008/Released Spring 2009/ Best Before End Of April 2011". That being clarified, it's still a great olive oil, its charming tomato aroma still full and unclouded. But Amazon is less than honest in not providing this information as of August 2011, an unacceptable omission - hence 3/5 stars, in order to draw attention to this issue. Amazon does not provide the harvest/best before dates for 3-pack or other packs either.

EXSPENSIVE.....THAT'S RELATIVE. AROMA & TASTE THAT WILL LEAVE U DREAMING. THE BEST OLIVE OILS ACCORDING TO A FOOD MAGAZINE ARTICLE R COMING FROM GREECE SPAIN & TURKEY. I JUST ENJOY THE AROMA OF THIS OLIVE OIL. WELL WORTH THE EXPENSE.

10/10 ....Well worth the small premium for this high-end oil. You won't be using this to cook with, so it will last for some time - So you're not really paying that much extra!Great taste - Such a difference to the supposed premium oils offered in many a deli....

column9: Tully's Kona coffee is my new favorite coffee!
column10: I've loved every blend of Tully's coffee that I've tried, and this one is my all-time favorite.I really don't know what Kona is supposed to taste like, but I really like the taste of this coffee. It's dark, rich, and strong, but not so strong that it has me bouncing off the walls after a few cups of it. If you like extra-bold coffee, you may want to try this. I think it may appeal to those who like either strong or medium blends. It's delicious!

For my husband's birthday, I ordered this coffe as Tully's Kona Blend is his favorite.  However, it does not appear to be a true Tully's Kona Blend -- the labeling on the cup says 10% Kona Blend.  I won't be buying this from here again.
I was very pleased with my order of Tully's Kona Blend.  I received my order in under a week and it was exactly as advertised!
I'm re-doing the accessories in my kitchen and had to purchase a Keurig single cup coffee dispenser. I love Kona Coffee and, while this is a blend, it's pretty good. I will be buying more.

I love Tully's coffee.  I didn't love that the only way I could get it, was to go to Seattle.  Now it can come to me.  Excellent coffee, I've turned a lot of folks on to this coffee.  Drink up!Tully's Coffee Kona Blend, K-cups for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)
Comes up as 108 count @ $72.39 in the search.  When you click on it it's 108 @ $86+

column9: Very good and hottest wasabi so far
column10: This is the third different type I've tried(Schnucks and Hapi).  They are very good, but a little crunchier/harder than the others I've had. That is the only dislike.  The hottest wasabi, but still manageable.  I like the Hapi brand a little better since they are not as hard, but these are a little cheaper so they are both great.

Great stuff!  I've had many different brands of wasabi peas, and JR is by far my favorite.  Fresh, crunchy, green and very hot (I've tried other brands that were the exact opposite of that).  Only tiny gripe is that I ordered two 5 pound bags, and was going to give one as a gift, but they sent me one humorously large 10 lb bag.  Not a big deal though, I just divided it up.  Anyway, you won't be disappointed!
this one is my favorite out of most wasabi peas I tried. perfect heat and salty taste. the price is outstanding too.

Absolutely delicious.  Very crispy and fresh.  And you can't beat this price.  They come in a poly bag and you can fill them in some smaller containers and use as you need. They stay fresh for a long time.  Indeed a very healthy snack alternative.

column9: Yummy, Sweet and Hot, Hot, Hot!
column10: I love wasabi peas, plain and simple, and these are absolutely wonderful. They are good sized, nice and crunchy, tangy sweet with that bite of HOT that wasabi is known for. The price is good for the amount you receive, and they taste fresh and yummy. I like the 'no MSG' aspect, because MSG gives me a headache (always has), and there are some I've seen that do have MSG in them, so it's nice to know these don't. When compared to other snacks, like chips or cookies, wasabi peas offer a kick pick-me-up snack that's much more healthful for you. Dr. Oz even said on one of his shows that they help boost metabolism, so you can't beat that! My son will even eat these peas, and he doesn't like anything green!These came in a bag, but it was the crinkly type of bag, that was stiff and it broke and tore, so the bag opened and spilled peas out. Fortunately, they were packed in another bag and twist-tied, and so they didn't spell out and were kept fresh.These are a LOT of peas in a 2lb bag... so know that you're getting a lot, and I do mean, a lot of peas. I found them flavorful, not overly hot, with just a touch of sweetness to them. I will definitely be buying these again.

column9: You get what you pay for
column10: I don't know if all these wonderful reviews are from people who work for this company, but I would never recommend these! I love Hapi Snack's Wasabi Peas, but they're expensive and hard to find. I was thrilled when I saw these. However, they have a strange "fake" taste and worst of all, they are like eating rocks - LITERALLY! Every fourth or fifth pea I tried to eat was a solid rock. I actually chipped my tooth. My dental work is going to cost me a lot more than what I saved on these. They're not that hot, either. If you like Wasabi Peas try some other brand. These are not worth the $11+ shipping. I've never left a negative review like this before. But buyer beware.

I have ordered the wasabi peas from two other companies.  The wasabi peas from JR Mushrooms are the absolute best! Just the right amount of kick and no hard, break your teeth peas!  Will definitely order from them again!
This is such a good deal and are the best peas.I recommend thes to anyone who loves wasabi peas.service was great and shipping came really fast.
Not very tasty. Glutino is better. After sitting on my shelf for awhile I was going to try again. They had some kind of white thing on them!

I purchased these Chocolate-O's for my daughter who has multiple food allergies.  The texture was similar to an "Oreo" cookie.  However, the Chocolate-O's are not as sweet.  My biggest disappointment was the quality control.  When we opened the box, the filling was smeared on the outside of the cookies.  It looked liked the cream melted, oozed out then hardened. There was very little cream filling between the cookies, and a third of the cookies in the box didn't even contain any cream filling in the middle.  They were just two chocolate cookies stuck together.  If they'd put actual filling between the cookies I'd try them again.

I eat these when I have a craving for OREOs... They are a little dry in texture, but nothing a good glass of almond (or another non-dairy) milk can't fix. The flavor is excellent! For being gluten-, egg-, and dairy-free (which is required for my diet), this is excellent.

column9: Delicious and healthier alternative to other fried chips.  Nice cheese flavor.
column10: I recently tried these, after usually sticking to the Black Bean Sea Salt flavor.  These are certainly different from that flavor, but just as enjoyable.  The cheese flavoring is the perfect flavor for my pallet.  I won't switch to these from the Sea Salt ones, but will definitely add them to my chip rotation.Since these are fried in oil, they are by no means a health food, especially if you are focused on calories. That said though, they are an excellent snack and a much healthier alternative to potato chips or corn chips.The main thing that surprised me about these chips is how good they taste. To me, they taste just as good, and are just as fulfilling, as the other salty crunchy snacks that I tend to munch on in the evenings. I enjoy them plain out of the bag, and also find that they are good with salsa or dip.I wish the price was a little lower on these and wish that the bags contained less air and more chips, but otherwise I think they are great. I highly recommend that you try them.  The pricing here on Amazon, is usually about 30 cents per 6 ounce bag cheaper than what they charge at the local grocery store, HEB.  Specialty stores like Sprouts and Whole Foods charge even more for them.
To me there is nothing like the smell of fresh ground coffee beans just before you put it to brew. I would highly recommend that anyone who is a big coffee lover, this is a very good tasting coffee.

So I have a confession to make. I don't like pina coladas...or getting caught in the rain, for that matter. They're too sickeningly sweet filled with tropical flavors built to give me heartburn. I love fresh pineapple, but when I wasn't on meds to help fight my acid reflux, even looking at one was enough to send me into heartburn agony for a few hours. But now I can indulge and it's wonderful! Anyway, yes, I don't like pina coladas because of the creaminess as well, so I'm glad they released a pineapple matcha as well as a pina colada matcha. Pineapple I can definitely get behind. We love pineapple in this house, my wife spent some time in Mexico and fell in love with them there. We even have one of those pineapple corer/slicers, a big piece of $10 equipment with a single purpose that I refuse to live without.  I am very excited to be trying this matcha and I'm praying it will help feed in to that pineapple addiction we've found ourselves with. Maybe I'll try it swirled together with some strawberry matcha...I love the taste of pineapples and strawberries together.  Or any of the berries, for that matter. They just balance each other out so beautifully.So after a bit of mental back and forth, I decided to give this one a go. Pineapple can be done well in teas, so hopefully this one will live up to expectations. When I first mixed it up, my wife could smell it from across the room. "That has to be bubble gum or cotton candy." Nope, just pineapple! It does smell very sweet. At first sip, I'd be hard-pressed to find pineapple specifically, more of an overall tropical candy flavor with a touch of a medicinal aftertaste, like chewable baby aspirin. But in the aftertaste, the taste that lingers on your tongue, I found pineapple. Yum, yum, yum pineapple. I'm not too sure of this one, I'm going to have to try it with strawberry, but it's got all of the sweetness of pineapple and none of the tartness that makes it so good. I don't think this is one I'll be stocking up on, but I don't think I'll be forcing it on my friends either. I won't have any trouble finishing it, but I doubt I'll get more. Still, I am grateful to have been granted the chance to try it! I just don't think I'm enough of a tropical fruit fan to fully enjoy it.
Bought these as a wedding favor for my wedding, and they were great. Ordered a few boxes and they were fresh and came fast! Thanks Jelly Belly!

column9: More beans than I know what to do with.
column10: I bought this on impulse, the moment I came across it on Amazon-- I had been shopping for Jelly Bellies after not being satisfied with the pricing of bulk beans from brick and mortar/warehouse stores. 10 pounds of beans for $65?  One click and several months later and here I am.  I've had these for months and I've hardly put a dent into them.  I've had to resort to finding creative things to do with them-- like putting handfuls into individual baggies and hiding them throughout the house so I can have "surprise jelly beans" when I'm not expecting it.The only reason I knocked off a star in this review is because these beans literally come in just a cardboard box.  No plastic bag holding the beans, just a bunch of beans sitting in and against cardboard.  There were some small exposed seams and I did have some concern if the beans could be exposed to creepy crawlies. A one cent bag to protect the beans while they are in the box would be appreciated.

Fabulous product line!  No odors!  No stains!  I have two male 8 pound Pomeranians and they love these as a treat at night when my husband and I are watching a movie.  It is great to not worry about them staining the bedding or furniture.

I love Trader Joe's.  LOVE.IT.  However, a 1.7-oz package of freeze-dried mangoes typically retails for $2.69 in the store.  When I saw the $11.00+ price, I thought it was a multi-package product.  Well, it doesn't appear to be.  BUY THE FREEZE-DRIED MANGOES.  They are unreal, and my absolute favorite of all the TJ freeze-dried fruits.  I could eat it all day long.  Just buy it in the store for under $3.00, not at this price.  Sorry.

I thought the bag would be much bigger for the price, since you can get them at Trader Joe's for about 1/4th of this price. (bought for about $10) Sadly, it was just one small bag.They were, however QUITE delicious.

WARNING! HIGHLY ADDICTIVE SEEDS!Seriously, I ordered these hoping they'd last like a month or so and I ate all the bags in under 2 weeks. These things are fantastic! I've always loved seeds but hated the way that salted seeds messed up the insides of my cheeks. Enter saltless seeds... So good. I have to make myself not eat them. I also had to google "Is eating too many sunflower seeds bad for you!"
Their taste is very good, very fresh and I love the packaging - you'll get 6 tubs - so you can open just one at the time, which is good, because otherwise we would eat them all at once.

Of the reasonably priced dry cat foods, Nutro Natural Choice has the best ingredients. Our cats like it, too, and were gaining weight, so we switched to Healthy Weight, which seems to have brought that problem under control. Nutro Natural Choice Healthy Weight has therefore become our regular cat food.

These M&Ms remind me of tiny little Almond Joy's surrounded by a bright candy shell.  They are spectacular!! I hope this company does itself and every candy lover in the world a favor by making these "special limited edition" candies a regular in their product line.

I had been using this product for years, but can no longer find it in the stores. It is a key ingredient in my asian inspired bloody marys. My fan have been missing them. Now that I have a case of this all important ingredient, I can make them happy again. :)

I made these cookies and took them to work and they were a huge hit!  The cookies taste a lot like the chunk brownies so it's probably the same mix.  They sell a similar cookie at the local store and the office deemed these cookies are much better than the store bakery cookies that were previously the favorite treat.

'I use this product because my husband has congestive heart failure andthe safe levels of potassium chloride is over 4000 mg per day. Neveruse that much but the flavoring in food really helps. Cannot find thisproduct in any of the local stores.  Product was fresh dated Thanks foroffering it!

We don't use salt in our home and this product really helps provide lots of flavor to our foods.I have had a lot of trouble finding this item in my local grocery stores so I was pleased to find it here.

column9: Easy to use and no sodium!
column10: I love this as an alternative to beef stock and bouillion cubes.  It is the only sodium free that I can find.  Why do they have to put salt in everything.  I wish manufacturers would start leaving the salt out of everything (and sugar) and let us season to our own tastes
I was greatly disappointed. Because I like regular HerbOx products. I can't stand the taste of potassium and it is not good for me. But the ad states nothing about this fact.

I have Meniere's disease and need a sodium-free diet. The markets in the city where I live do not offer a product like this, so I was thrilled to find it on Amazon. It also contains no MSG. Excellent flavoring.
Hard to find in the stores, but always available on Amazon. Great item. Highly recommended for your low sodium diet.

Fantastic flavor enhancer for those of us on low sodium diets. A word of caution, however; salt is replaced by potassium chloride. If you are on a potassium sparing blood pressure medication, You should discuss use of this with your doctor. On the other hand, potassium can help lower blood pressure, and one serving of this product is a healthy dose, similar to that in a potato, or a banana. I take Diovan, and was concerned, but my BP has lowered while incorporating a teaspoon a day in my diet, and I am highly pleased with this product.

column9: Sodium free bouillon is a godsend for peoploe on low sodium diets.
column10: Maintaining a low sodium diet is extremely hard.  Sodium free bouillon helps make things tasty and I am very happy to have this product available.  I only wish it were available in my local stores.  I use both the beef & the chicken bouillon to season vegetables, gravies, and soups.  Because one member of the family is also gluten intollerant, this particular product is especially a boon for me.  Thank you, Hormel for this product.!

I was looking for gluten-free, low-sodium beef bouillon granules, because I'm tired of smashing cubes, and the powder in the envelopes costs too much. I use bouillon in cooking and to make onion soup mix, because the packaged stuff contains gluten. What a huge disappointment! The first thing I made with this was a stovetop beef-onion gravy. My husband asked "Where's the beef"?  There was literally zero beef flavor in the gravy. Ok, so what about onion soup mix? I made the mix, whipped up some dip, and again, it tasted nothing like the stuff from the familiar blue box mix. Other bouillon turns out a perfect copycat. The worst thing? I've got 6 jars of this stuff! I guess I'll keep smashing cubes.Bottom line - ZERO Beef Flavor! Look elsewhere.

Herbox sodium-free beef broth is a great product.  It allows me to add meat flavor to my vegetable soups without causing my blood pressure to go up.  Also, the potassium is good for controlling blood pressure.  More Americans should use it.

I am using both the chicken and the beef sodium free bouillon and like them. They of course aren't as good as sodium but they sure fill the spot that is missing in soups and stews when you can't use salt anymore.
This is a good product.I like that it is sodium free,and tastes the same,not lacking in flavor..makes nice chicken broth.

I thought I'd cut down on the sodium in my diet, so I bought this. It cut down on the sodium, but was pretty tasteless. I won't buy it again. I'd rather cut back on the regular stuff and at least have some taste to the dish!
My husband started to use this broth as a hot drink when he was put on a low sodium/low fat diet and he loves it.  It makes a satisfying hot drink delivering lots of full-bodied flavor.

The name of the product, "Herbox Granular Sodium Free Beef Bouillon," sounds like it will be healthy for you. You can read the word "Beef" on the front of the jar.  When the product arrived I noticed that the jar clearly says "Beef Flavor."  The picture on the website clearly does not show the word "flavor."Herbox Granular Sodium Free Beef Bouillon, 3.3-Ounce (Pack of 6) This product is just a bunch of chemicals and does not have any beef in it. I cannot use this product to flavor my soups and stews because it will make me sick and give me headaches because of the chemicals. I am very disappointed.
Far beyond satisfied! So buttery sweet and all the almonds are perfect sizes. These will make very special holiday gifts this year for a few special family members.

column9: Love the chips, Not the Crumbs.
column10: I love Sweet Chili Riceworks chips.  I first tried them at Costco, then could not find them again.  I emailed the company and found Walmart was to get some in.  I purchased 6 bags, but once again found they no longer carry them.  I finally found them once again at Amazon after contacting the company.  But I will not be buying from Amazon again.  The chips are nothing but crumbs in the bags and I ordered 12.  They came all crushed, very few whole chips.  I am greatly disapointed.  I love the chips, but would like a local place to purchase.

I used to love the Sweet chili Riceworks but they must have change the recipe. It doesn't taste as good. Also, although the chip bags came in a box, the chips had been crushed. I will not/not buy them again.

column9: A healthy snack that tastes decadent
column10: My brother, who lost 70 lbs. five years ago, has come across something great - this Riceworks product, Sweet Chili is just the ticket when you are watching the scale and REALLY want something - anything....This is it for you - the brown rice chips are coated with a snappy chili flavor, and it is possible just to have a few and be satisfied.My brother lost his weight on SugarBusters, while I lost mine just by smaller portions, but we are in the same place of wanting healthy bang for our food buck -I plan to order my own packs - and give him some bags, as he did me -It is delicious, and I won't tell anyone it's healthy...

column9: Why mess with a good thing?
column10: These chips used to be amazing: like nothing else on the market.  I could go through a bag a day all by myself.  They were insanely delicious.  The only minor issue was that a certain amount of the spices they used to flavor them would collect at the bottom of the bag.  So, they decided to "improve" them by reformulating (i.e. changing) the spice mixture so that it would adhere better to the chips.  STUPID!!!  Now, instead of tasting like a product in a class by itself, they taste like a second-rate Doritos.  Unless you have a wheat allergy, there's no longer any really compelling reason to buy these chips as they now taste like any other product on the market.  It's really sad.  I rarely write reviews for anything, but I was so disappointed by this, I just had to mention it.  Why do companies always have to ruin a good thing?  I mean, I'm sure I should thank them for the sake of my hips, but my taste buds are still in mourning.

column9: Watch out, these have hydrolyzed protein in them!!!!
column10: I'm very VERY careful when it comes to putting food into my body. If it isn't natural, then it dosn't belong in the body. These rice chips do taste good, and are a FANTASTIC switch from more proccessed chips (like doritos). These chips, however, do have hydrolyzed protein in them, which is just like MSG. This ingridient isn't natural, and in the long run has been proven to give health problems.
