I have opted for the Lundberg chips, which do NOT have anything unnatural in them.I'm giving this item 2 stars due to the fact that they are delicious, they are a great substitute for other chips, but fell short of being completely different then those proccesed chips i've learned to hate.

I consider myself somewhat of a chip connoisseur, and while Tim's Jalapeno Cascade style chips used to be my favorite, these ones are healthier and comparably delicious, if slightly more expensive. Great product overall.

Every single bag we recieved was bad.  Tasted like they were well past the expiration date.  Complained, but seller was very difficult..and would not refund or return.  We now get these at costco when they have them..and they are always great at a much better price! Don't buy from this seller!
These are the best chips around and the fact they are made of brown rice makes them even better.

Try these instead of corn chips which will only go to your hips.  There is still some corn in them but rice flour is the main ingredient.  I like the spice, crunch, finger-lickin' goodness of these flavorful chili chips that don't give me heartburn like potato chips do.  I use the dregs for a spice to my salads or add into turkey meatballs.  With the puffiness of the package the product stays nice when packed for a trip.  The bag is durable too for repeat folding and clipping.  I also like the green package variety with the lime taste by Riceworks and keep both in stock.  Vicki

Anything from this brand, Riceworks, is fantastic. It is a high-quality snack which everyone can enjoy. (I am not gluten-intolerant) and I would choose these above a regular chip any day. I just love these things.

These hard to get chips are delicious, but came smashed despite careful packing.  The box must have been dropped kicked to the door.  Wish that they were still available locally at Costco---but I may have to order again in the fall, regardless.  The whole family treasures these chips and we ration them since the bag is so small. Nothing comes close to these!

column9: Awesome chips...but not at this price!
column10: Great chip but not at this price...this company is ripping everyone off.  Amazon used to have these at about 2.00 per bag...that was great...but this is now...go to a health food store and buy these there...way too expensive here!

It is very hard to find this in the stores here in Las Vegas, NV. The price is also great.  I can not get enough of them.  I had to buy at least 24 pieces to last me 2 months.  I will be ordering again.

These are great chips. I have tried both the Salsa Fresca and Sweet Chili and love them both (if I had to choose one over the other would take the Salsa Fresca - just my personal preference). Will be trying the Sea Salt in the near future.Can't go wrong with these chips!

column9: Hoping Riceworks is available soon at the grocery!!
column10: While in NYC over the New Year, my husband and I stopped at a small grocery in uptown New York and bought a few munchies that we had not seen before.  After one bite of Rice Works Sweet Chili, I was hooked on the spicy-sweet and crunchy flavors.  All the ingredients are even good for me.  When we got home I went on line and found them on Amazon.com.  What a find!!!!  I have shared my purchase with several friends and relatives.  They were an instant favorite.  Apparently, they are not available here in McKinney, TX until summertime. Can't wait.

A fantastic chip!  Low in fat and calories compared to most chips!!!  You cannot beat the flavor.  Amazon is out of stock and I'm hoping they will restock.  If you enjoy them too, let Amazon know!!  Thanks!

I'm always looking for healthier alternatives to the standard grocery store chips, and these certainly fill that bill.They are definitely spicy -- I like things with a lot of flavor, so they're perfect for me, but if you're not into foods that supply a little after-kick, these may be a tad too spicy.Amazon's price isn't bad, either.  I've seen premium chips in the store for about 50% more than these.I'm very pleased with these, and plan to purchase more.

These chips look very much like a Dorito but they pop or snap more when chewing I think these are the best of the 4 Flavors maybe too spicy for some but i like that they have some kick ! If you like a little spice these are great if you have a weak stomach you may need to try the milder seasalt version ! Enjoy..... I know I will buy these again ....!!!!!!  J.B.

My wife likes all things crunchy.  Chips are her favorite food and she loves these chips.  Me, on the other hand, never met a chip I liked -- until now.  These are, without a doubt, the best-tasting, most addictive snack food ever.  We stumbled on them while vacationing in Montana. When we got home, I bought a box of 12 bags from Amazon and devoured them in two weeks.  Remember that chip ad from many years ago:  "I bet you can't eat just one?"  Well, I bet you can't!!
THIS PEANUT BUTTER BY FAR IS ONE OF THE BEST THAT MY FAMILY AND I ARE ENJOYING! THERE IS NO HYDROGENATED OILS AND NO OTHER ADDITIVES IT IS PERFECT.

column9: Made from biirch, made in USA
column10: I am glad to see that more and more companies are manufacturing xylitol, because the sooner it catches on nation-wide, the sooner the prices will drop and become reasonable. Hopefully, xylitol will eventually replace sugar as the sweetener of choice. It shouldn't cost more than sugar does.I like this brand because it is USA made from birch, not corn and not China. No offense to China, but since almost all of our jobs went over there, the quality of Chinese products can be, well, BAD. I try to avoid "made in China" as much as possible and I look for "made in USA." This product satisfies both requisites. And it's excellent.
I think American quality is returning. This tastes wonderful, very sweet, looks, measures, and tastes like suger but with 60% less calories, plus made from healthier plant.  Just a bit pricey.

I was paying upwards of eight dollars a pound for American birch-based Xylitol. Not anymore, when buying this. It has a granular appearance, a bit coarser than table sugar but not by much; dissolves quickly and has no aftertaste. As long as AMZN keeps carrying this, I'll keep buying it.

I tried this product after years of using corn-based xylitol. Even though it is said there are no corn proteins (thus potential allergens) remaining in the final product of corn-based xylitol, and all of the companies I contacted insisted their China-sourced xylitol was organic and free of GMO's, I decided to switch to a birch-based xylitol. None of the corn-based xylitol distributors I contacted could actually "certify" this information, and few will back up their claims in writing on their websites.I also contacted the distributor of this particular product (Zveet) who told me that although their birch trees are not certified organic, they also do not use any chemicals on the trees. This is pretty much what the corn-based, China-sourced xylitol distributors said, and although I might have missed it, I could not find this confirmed on their website either. While I would love to find a xylitol product that certifies such claims, I decided to take them at their word and I tried the product since their product is originating in the US.I found it to be nearly identical to corn-based xylitol with really only two exceptions: the crystals appear slightly larger (which really does not impact anything) and it tastes a bit "cooler". Many people comment on the cool taste of xylitol which I have never noticed until now, and I found it very pleasant. Other than this, it is the same as all the corn-based xylitol I have used. It also has the same level of sweetness, which is somewhat lower than sugar. You can counter this by either adding a bit more xylitol to the product (about 10% seems to do the trick) or by adjusting to a slightly less sweet taste. Birch-based xylitol appears to be the same in calories as corn-based, which  is 40% lower than cane sugar, and better for your health than sugar or fructose over-all. I use xylitol along with a bit of Himalayan Sea Salt in my nasal wash since it has soothing properties for delicate membranes. I also use it to sweeten my tea, and in cooking and baking just like regular cane sugar without all the negative effects: Xylitol is very low on the Glycemic Index; it is a prebiotic meaning it is fermented in the gut creating short chain fatty acids (SCFA) which encourage the growth of good micro-organisms, vs sugar and other fructose sources which encourage the growth of harmful bacteria and yeasts; it is an anti-inflammatory, vs sugar which causes inflammation. There are so many reasons to use xylitol instead of sugar that I could go on and on but I feel this would be out of the scope of my review. My only reservation regarding xylitol in general is that it is still a highly processed food so, if for no other reason, it is probably best to limit the amount of consumption.I thought Zveet would be my new go-to xylitol and was prepared to place another order. To my surprise the price increased more than 20% in only one month (from $23.99 last month, to today's price of $28.99). There really is no good reason for a price jump of this magnitude so I deducted one star for unstable pricing. My usual supplier, Natrazyle Kosher Xylitol, has remained fairly consistent in terms of low prices. It is currently $24.97/5 lbs on Amazon. Of all the companies I contacted, Natrazyle appeared to be one of the few willing to post on their website that their corn is grown without the use of pesticides and is non-GMO, so it has been my primary source. Since price is a factor I will probably continue to order Natrazyle. If Zveet brings the cost down and it remains stable I will probably return as a customer, if only to support US manufacturing.

The Zveet Birch Xylitol tastes like sugar, looks like sugar, and works in recipes just like sugar. I used to just omit sugar from recipes that called for a tablespoon or so, but with this xylitol I go ahead and add it. I've also tried it sprinkled on fruit, sweetening whipped cream, and in homemade hot chocolate. The only thing it seems to lack is the resulting sugar crash that consuming regular sugar used to cause me. And that's a good thing!

column9: Exceptional. Birch xyltiol is so much better
column10: I have purchased this alot and I only buy Birch xylitol. The regular is from corn and corn is full of GMO's. So get the birch wood and it doesnt have all of that. plus this is Made in the USA. I support USA 100%.This is close to sweet as sugar but not the same flavor. you cant bake with this using large amounts. i usually mix/bake with Agave inulin powder as well..no sugars in it either.

column9: I can't believe it's not real sugar!
column10: So many things to love about this product...1. It tastes great, we can't tell by the taste that it's not cane sugar.2. It's supposed to be good for you in small amounts, especially your teeth and gums.3. It's from Birch Trees, NOT corn like most other Xylitol is.4. It's made in the USA. Fabulous!The only drawback is the price is so high. I won't be able to use this in large amounts due to the price, and also because it could cause stomach upset if too much at a time is consumed. Every day I allow one teaspoonful of this Xylitol to melt in my mouth for it's beneficial effects. I don't have any particular reason for this dosage. It just seems about right for me. So far I've had no negative effects.

Very good product, made in the USA and well priced compared to the competition.  As always, delivered quickly by Amazon.  I have switched over to xylitol completely for granulated sugar.  Also use agave and honey.  Have lost about 10 lbs in the past two months without really trying.

This made in the USA birch derived xylitol is superb.  I love the fact its from an American business.  Xylitol has many benefits and finding it in bulk at a better price than most all suppliers was an added bonus.  Good for your daily diet, good for your teeth, and beneficial in other ways too!
Tasts like sugar. No unpleasant aftertaste. I enjoy it in my coffee and it makes great sweet tea. I like the fact that it is made in the US from Birch trees.

My kids love these!!The first bites brought smiles and"YUMS".I also really like and enjoy this mix!The quality of the tasty fruit is much better than i thought it would be! this fruit is not to hard or to soft.Its perfect for snacks,treats or just because!! Plus there is vitamin A,c,calcium and iron.Also this is not overly sweet either! I will buy this again!!
Great mix of dried fruit - lots of ways to use from trail mix to cookies, deserts - really good deal for all we got - fruit is good quality - will be keeping on my subscription.
This package is a good mix of dried fruit and not just mostly raisins as many are. The price at Amazon is better than anywhere else I've checked.
I use this dried fruit in hot breakfast cereal. Price is great, product overall pretty good, but the added sweetening is a bit heavy for my taste.

column9: Love It, but would like nuts or sunflower seeds
column10: We've been looking for some time for a reasonably priced trail mix to take on our hikes, especially hikes we take on vacation. While we like Costco's taste-wise, the pieces of dried fruit are too large as is the original bag. We needed a bag that each of us could carry on a 5-8 mile trek in mountains and foothills, and then I found Emerald Harmon's Farmer's Market Dried Fruit which is just sweet enough, but not too sweet. A 10 ounce bag is perfect although, having no willpower, I could probably polish a bag off just watching a baseball game. But watch out: as with most trail mixes, a quarter cup is 130 calories. On the other hand, we've got to be burning serious calories when hiking.We do prefer Harmony's Original Trail Mix which has nuts, M&M-like candy, and sunflower seeds. That cuts down on the sweetness, but I've just taken to adding sunflower seeds which I order separately.Note: Though this has not nuts in it, it is processed on equipment that also processes peanuts. Even though this has no peanuts in it, those of you with kids that have a peanut allergy should know that.P.S. Harmony is made by Diamond, and living near Diamond's headquarters in California, and buying their products for over 40 years, I know that their stuff will be fresh. I have nothing to do with Diamond, so consider this a personal endorsement.

column9: Hard to find dried fruit without nuts
column10: I was looking for a low fat dried fruit mix.  That means without nuts and coconut flakes.  This meets that criteria.  Lots of raisins, other dried fruit bits are raisin size cubes.  Walmart's Tropical Trail Mix is cheaper and better.

column9: Best Gift instead of Expensive Gift Baskets!!
column10: At $14 plus Free shipping, I ordered 3 of this 6-pk 10 oz dried fruits,  added Amazon wrapping and shipped to friends & relatives! I will never buy those expensive Costco Gift Baskets. PERFECTLY HAPPY and VERY HIGHLY recommendable!  Tastes great too - ALL NATURAL blend of Raisins, Pineapple, Papaya, Cranberries and Apples! I got one for myself!

I used to buy it in Walmart till they stopped  selling it  so  I order it  from Amazon now.  its the  best dried fruit mix on the  market.  The only problem I have is its  gone in  3 days in my family.  The  bags are large  and  sealed well  it is the  freshsest tasting Ive  found  out there  we  all  highly recomend  it  .  I carry it in  my  meds  bag at all  times  it doesnt spoil  and  helps  keep my  blood  sugar  in  line  when its too low .  travels  well on  trips  no  sticky  fingers  and  stays  fresh.  great  stuff .

column9: Great product - beats Wal-Mart for price
column10: I love dried fruit in my salad and oatmeal, but when our Sam's Club quit handling it, and Wal-Mart's price went sky high, I searched for alternatives. I buy these in bulk and they are exactly what I want at a very good price. Quick shipping, also.
Looked good from the description -- but there's way too much sugar added!  Why add sugar to cranberries, raisins, papaya?
The fruit packets arrived quickly, were as advertised, and are delicious!  I will do business with this company again if I purchase more.

column9: Emerald Harmony Farmer's Market Dried Fruit
column10: Emerald Harmony Farmer's Dried Fruit I shared with family, friends, FaceBook and Church Members. I receive great replies, good, great and delicious. The Trail Mix great to eat 1/4 for snack and I was told eating 1/4 is not enough, great to with cereal and with salad.Don't just take my word, try all the Trail Mix and see for yourself.I can't found Emerald Harmony Trail Mix in Tallahassee, Florida and you do get more for your money.

waiting with anticapation to get my tasty dried fruit, it arrived i opened it quickly to scarf down some tasty delicous fruit, put a handful in my mouth, man i wish i would of captured a picture of the expression on my face after chewing some, cause the taste that i was expecting compared to what i actually tasted was like the difference between night and day, i even tried to soak it in water to get rid of all the sugar, bottom line is go and buy two cans of fruit cocktail, and you'll still be money ahead, very disiponted in amazon com for selling this kind of garbage, especially after you purchase it, you cant return it if disatified,

Full of nutrition and tastes great. They arrived in perfect condition and my wife and I liked them immediately. I highly recommend this product as it is very tasty, healthy, and does not contain substances that increase the likelihood of headaches. Go ahead and purchase with confidence, I am not sorry I did, and neither will you.

Since I eat a lot of dried fruit, I thought this purchase was a fantastic deal compared to the prices I pay for a different brand. I was extremely disappointed with this product. It was like eating pure sugar. The sugar taste overwhelmed the taste of the fruit. I ended up giving all 6 bags away, to people who loved it. I guess there is just no accounting for taste!

They taste really good. Problem is. I have been told by many many people dried fruit is one of the best snacks ever because its good and healthy. Turns out this treat is not so healthy as implied. Im not sure if its maybe dried fruit just has alot of carbs, or the company on purposely fattened it up. But if you just look on the nutritional label you'll see. Its not as bad as a candy bar, or chips. But its not "healthy" either. Great product none the less. I think if I dont over indulge on these and drink mostly water, it will be better for me :)
This is an excellent product, small quality fruit, great mixed with nuts for trail mix or add to my cereal for added flavor and nutrition. Price isn't bad either.

I have been looking for fruit snacks that don't have nuts in them, and this fits the bill! Everything is a little sweet for me, but in small amounts it is fine.The apples are not crunchy whole (or even half) slices like I was expecting, but are cut up slices (small pieces) that are soft. It is probably 50% raisins, but that is fine as well. The craisins aren't whole, but are slices.All in all this is a good mix.
This is great.  Premium quality fruits, not like the sugary, perfumy stuff at most grocery stores.  Relatively inexpensive too!
Cheaper to buy a bag of sugar & eat it with a spoon!  Fruit is diced in small pieces so forget tasting anything but sweet--as in candied.  No potential health benefits here.

column9: Not at all worth the money
column10: I like to sprinkle diced dates into my oatmeal cereral, then microwave.Most of the bits of this and that in Emerald Harmony Farmer's Market Dried Fruit are still hard and have no taste.  I suppose you could steep this dried fruit in boiling water until it has a chance to absorb water and reconstitute into something worth while.
I just dont understand why the date on my fruit is stamped "Best Before 05 Jan 12"!  I order in Feb. 2011.  What's the deal, stale fruit.  UGH

column9: Boston Cookies Vegan Assorted Flavors 12/3.5 Oz (Multi-pack)
column10: I am vegan and ordered these cookies wanting only the choc chip; however it came in a asst flavors.  I loved all the different varieties.  I popped them in the freezer and took them out when I wanted something sweet.  They thaw deliciously and have wonderful flavor.  I will buy them again for sure.
This is one of the best buys I have found on Amazon.  Shipping time was amazing, way before expected.  I was very happy with my purchase! Arizona Sugar Free Green Tea is a great drink.

column9: Great Tea at a Great Price
column10: This is, in my opinion, is hands-down the best loose tea I've ever had.  It's a unique blend of flavors and you can really taste the lemongrass, hibiscus flowers and the honey bush!  It's really tough to find loose tea anymore.  Trying to find one that's fair-trade, certified organic and caffeine-free at a good price is next to impossible.  I got this tea at Amazon for half the price I paid for it at a gocery store.  Really a good product.

I'm a big fan of red roobios teas.  I've tried several other brands and liked them all, but this Rishi tea is in a whole other world of flavor beyond any brand I've tried.  It's really, really unique.  Try it.  I think you'll love it as much as I do!

I have been drinking this rooibos for about a year now and I love it. The smell is purely amazing, reminds me of when my parents would open the coffee can in the morning and I'd butt in and say "Hey let me smell it!", I catch myself doing that with this tea. I use to work in the grocery business and really payed attention to prices. On average 1 can of this rooibos runs for about $12.00 at your local grocer, on Amazon its $16.99 for 2 cans... Do the math, this is a steal! I have ventured into other tea brands like shopping at overpriced Teavana and getting prettty darn good rooibos. Yet, I still find myself coming back to the rishi, can't beat the blueberry or the jamaica red bush. Also, I have never had a problem with it being to overwhelmingly tart. If it's too tart, brew less.
I really enjoy this great tasting tea. It is excellent for anyone who likes a citrus-like taste. Beautiful color.
It's my favorite tea!  It is a tea that tastes as good as it smells. Hold it in your mouth and savour before you swallow. This is the third time I've ordered it. Please keep carrying it!

Pretty good, but a little too tart. You kind of lose track of the sweet roiboos taste with all the sour berries mixed in. Also the berries sort of get all mushy and grainy if you let the wet loose tea sit out for some hours, which means that you can't really brew additional cups with the same batch.

column9: not bad, but doesn't cook evenly
column10: I really like the fusilli version of this brand, so I bought these to use in my mac & cheese recipe. However, these don't cook very evenly. I've learned that even though the instructions say 10 minutes and don't over cook, it's necessary to cook them for 12+ minutes. They taste fine, but I've had issues with them being hard. They do re-heat OK, but I bought another brand at the grocery store that I like better. Unfortunately it doesn't appear to be available on Amazon.

column9: Good Pasta but takes a while to cook about 12+ minutes
column10: Ahh the backpackers Corn Pasta, hard to find actually, and this is GMO free!  I like it, very tasty, and like the effect.  It smells like polenta when you are cooking it.  It does take about 12+ minutes to cook! I wish they made a thin version that cooked in 5 minutes like macaroni and cheese.

Received these cherry preserves this afternoon and half of the first jar is gone already!  Happened to have a loaf of orange whole wheat bread and the combination of the cherries and orange rind bits was wonderful.Highly recommend.  No artificial anything and large chunks of quality fruit.

column9: Very tasty - received quickly and intact.
column10: I buy this for my dad, but kept a jar for myself.  It's not really tart, fairly sweet, with plenty of whole cherry chunks.  It looks pretty on toast, and I could see using it as filling in a chocolate cake.  The fact that it doesn't have a lot of artificial stuff helped me make up my mind.
This may be the best jam I have ever had.  Among other things (as near as I can tell) it has no artificial colors, preservatives, or corn syrup.  I think it does wonders for toast!
The best cherry preserves we've ever had. It's a Sunday morning favorite for my daughter and myself!

I used to think that strawberry preserves could not be improved on. But that was before I tried Bonne Maman Cherry. The perfect combination of sweet and tart. Just the right consistency. Also makes an amazing meat glaze. I go through two jars a week. Lately without even bothering to put it on toast. Someone please help me.

column9: Not Too Thick and Not Too Thin!
column10: Anyone who loves cherries will love these preserves.  They aren't too thick or too thin, but are just right for topping bisquits or toast.  Huge cherry chunks make up the bulk of the recipe.  This is pretty sweet stuff so use moderately.  The jars are huge and come packaged with adorable red gingham screw-on tops.  You can't find preserves this good in most stores and believe me, I've looked.Also, these were packaged very well.  Great overall!

Bonne Maman products are available in many fine grocery stores, but for some reason we have a hard time finding their cherry preserves, so we were very happy to find that Amazon offers the product.  It is absolutely wonderful, and Amazon ships the jars carefully and quickly.  I thought six jars would last a while, but at the rate our family eats it (on toast, on waffles, on to-die-for peanut butter and cherry preserves sandwiches, spooned over plain yoghurt), I think I'll place a double order next time.
These preserves are so good I am sorry not to find out about it sooner. They have fruit in them, not just pectin. Delicious. Will never buy any other product.

This cherry jam is absolutely DIVINE!Not too tart....not too sweet.....the flavor of the cherries is distinct and provides a great contrast to toast, English muffins or P and J sandwiches. We were disappointed that one jar of the 6 jars was lost completely to breakage....boo hoo. Pros definately outweogh the cons.

The Bonne Maman Cherry Preserves is our favorite and difficult to find in local supermarkets.  It arrived in excellent time.  However, although it appeared to be packed well, one of the six jars was broken and the package was quite a mess.  I was asked earlier to review this product and included a photo of the package as it arrived.  I also asked for a replacement jar, but have had no response.
The most fabulous jam on earth! Heavenly chunky with full pieces of rich cherries. excellent on toast. Not to sweet, not too sour, just right. Real jam, the way nobody else can do it.

column9: Grandma's Preserves Were Good, But Not This Good...
column10: Cherry preserves have always been a weakness of mine; Granny Walls would make them after Gramps and Dad picked the cherry trees clean.  I have wonderful memories and the taste of these delightful treats has stayed with me through the years.Sadly, Granny no longer makes preserves.  The commercial products available to replace her preserves left much to be desired; they were overcooked, much too gluey, too sweet, and had little natural cherry flavor.  Then I found Bonne Maman on Amazon's Best Deals space and decided to take a chance.  Eureka!These preserves have a fresh, clean cherry flavor without any hint of overcooking or artificial additives.  They are thick enough to stay on your toast or bagel, but not so gluey as to sit in a gelaninous blob.  There are plenty of whole cherries, not the chopped up pieces in inferior products, so that this is actually a true cherry preserve rather than jelly.  I definitely recommend these preserves to anyone who loves cherries; I'll be buying more when I run out even if they aren't on sale!  And, I'm going to try the other Bonne Maman products, too.

I love cherry preserves.  I usually buy them from Trader Joes or local orchards here in Oregon.  These are the best preserves I've ever had.  They're expensive but worth every dime.  The shipping was lightning fast too.

column9: Very late shipping, all jars were open...don't buy
column10: I love this jam. I buy it at my local store. However this time I decided to buy 6 of them from Amazon. Big mistake. Fedex delivered these 4 days late...apparently Amazon had the wrong address. When I finally received them, all of the jars were already open, spilling jam everywhere on the inside of the box. Fortunately I was able to save most of the jam...but now I've got old, perishable jam. I don't know how long it'll last. I would advise all to not buy anything like this from Amazon...ever.

column9: delicious whole ingredient snack, great pre-portioned packs
column10: Was happy to find a delicious snack that didn't taste "healthy," was easy to grab and go, and didn't have any gross ingredients like splenda or weird chemicals.  I was thrilled to read the list: bananas, wheat flour, sugar, egg, canola oil, baking soda, salt, vanilla, baking powder.Delicious and nothing for me to feel weird about in there.  Would love the added benefit of organic eggs, flour, and expeller-pressed canola but everything can't be perfect.  Very happy with my purchase.

It came fast looks better than expected. Bonsai boys of ny rocks thanx so much. Oh and I order it on Sunday came on Tuesday I think it came fast cause I live in the Bronx so yeah and it came from USPS it's been a week and it's doing amazing! Love these boxwoods. Would buy again very soon!!!!

I really was pleasantly suprised by this. Used it to bread some chicken breast and ended up with a nice crisp coating that didn't come off in the frying pan. You do need to add seasoning to your coating.Very good product!

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: Great product ...good price....Louisiana Fish Fry Products Natural Fish Fry, New Orleans Style, 10-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) I found this stuff at my fish market! I like these size much better use once and throw away as opposed a large box.
This product is wonderful because you can control the amount of salt in your mix. It provides a nice light batter instead of a thick, sodium-laden one. Works for chicken as well!

Our daughter sent these berries to us for Super Bowl which was such a nice supprise but what was even more of a supprise was how big the strawberries were and how good!!!!  They were delicious and I will definitely be sending these as gifts in the future!!

If you ever visit Canada you cannot miss the Ubiquitous Tim Horton's franchises, it seems as if they are on every corner (and small wonder: everything they sell is excellent, reasonably priced, and served with typical Canadian efficiency and politeness.) The quality of Tim Horton's coffee is pretty remarkable -- it is very, very good -- and the price is not outrageous (I picked up a 39 ounce can in a Canadian Walmart for about $16.50 in American dollars toward the end of november, 2010, which was about the same price they were selling for in the Tim Horton's stores.) Note: Their decaf is every bit as good, but I haven't been able to find it in cans larger than 13 ounces.

Have been hooked on Hazelnut creamer for years now, so I was looking for a more convienent way of satisfying my habit. This is a good product does not need refrigeration, but it is way overpriced. Probably won't purchase it again.

column9: GOOD PRODUCT AND RESPONSIVE CUSTOMER SERVICE
column10: I was happy with the product.It was advertised as being a larger size than it actually was and customer service processed a refund and issued an apology.

column9: NEW TWIST ON A TRADITIONAL HOLIDAY DELIGHT
column10: I have always loved stollens whether homemade by my aunts in Milwaukee or the imported German stollens. I must say these cranberry stollens are really tasty without being sicky sweet. They are chocked full of all the ingredients of traditional German stollens but the addition of cranberries really makes for a full flavored treat. Sometimes you will get a sour flavor from the addition of cranberries to breads but not in this fine German product. The flavor is excellent and the cranberries add an additional fruity flavor to this fine holiday bread. The bread is moist and not dried out like many other stollens. Very good and different for those who want to try a new twist to the traditional stollens.
My wife and I love this coffee, it is our favorite, this is the best quality we've found. Very rich flavor yet smooth.

I absolutely love illy coffee ever since I had it in JFK airport.  It is so smooth with no bitter taste at the end.  Very rich coffee like they have in Europe.  However, the flavor of the blue label/medium roast had a better flavor to me.  I thought I would like dark roast better, but medium was more my taste.  That's all.

I bought some of this from my local grocery store and came to Amazon to compare prices. Just have to say that it's absolutely delicious! I thought Major Dickinson's by Peet's was good, but this coffee is just superlative. It is rich and robust, not bitter at all, and has a delicious nutty flavor. My new favorite! Amazon needs to carry more whole bean suppliers of this coffee, however as I prefer to grind my own.

column9: This is what coffee should taste like
column10: I find that most of the time when people order coffee it comes out looking like iced tea.  Peet's taste like coffee should taste & BANG ZOOM you're to the moon.
I would like to say to my surprise the Cashews were very large and and tasted great.. The tin was very nice.. I recommend buying this product to see and taste for yourself.

I've had curry before, perhaps a different type of curry, because this is not what I remember curry to taste like. This particular curry was thick as I remember it, and perhaps it was different because it its dry beef curry and not the chicken curry I am use to.I found the taste to be very rich. It was alright. I didn't care for the pieces of leaves, whatever it was, that was in the soft. I thought after a while, they would soften up like scallions, or something along those lines, but they didn't. It was a bit of a pain having to stop and pick them out of my mouth.Made it for hubby and he seemed to like it. However, he agrees that we won't be in a hurry to run out and buy the product. I imagine you'd have to be an avid Curry fan to be excited for this product. For me, it was just okay.

column9: Delicious, quick and simple curry mix. I'm going to buy more.
column10: I love curry and frequently cook Thai / Indian style meals and love those kinds of restaurants as well. Rendang curry is a sweeter (coconut milk) southeast Asian-style curry that I've never tried before, so this kit looked like an easy way to try it.Bottom line -- preparing a meal with this kit is EASY and the results are DELICIOUS.The kit comes with two packets -- curry spice mix paste and powdered coconut milk. All you have to do is...a) cut up some chunks of your preferred meat (I used roughly 2 pounds of ribeye steak) and brown it in a pan with a little oil,b) heat some water and mix in the coconut powder and curry paste,c) put the browned meat from the pan into the pot with the curry sauce mix.The results are amazing -- extremely flavorful, and not too spicy for the novice curry lover (I prefer a little more spice in mine so I added some pepper flakes and powdered cayenne). All you need to go along with this is some white rice, or noodles, or vegetables... really, whatever you prefer. I used white rice with mine.The one tip I have is to add the coconut powder first, and do it slowly, whisking it in the whole time. If you dump it in too fast, it can clump up and require more mixing than it would if you add it slowly.All in all, this mix is a relatively cheap, easy, and quick way to whip up a delicious Asian-style curry (the description says it's a Singapore-style curry). I'm going to be getting more of this, and other flavor mixes as well!

I probably would not buy this if I had the chance to. It was an odd, odd, flavor. I really didn't have any steak or meat to add to it so I just made the sauce and ladled it over rice.  It wasn't half bad but rather sweet for a meal for me.I do have some issues with this product.  The first thing is that is is made in Singapore.  Why are we importing food products from another country and does our country check to see if it meets our standards?  Secondly, some of the measurements are not in our form as in 4/5 cup of water. What is 4/5th's???  I know, a little less than a cup, I think. But, since I don't have a 1/5th cup, it was a problem.The serving size is 2 tablespoons.  How can I have a meal with two tablespoons of liquid and meat? Its a mini size.All in all the stuff wasn't that bad but I wouldn't want it again.

column9: Easy and Tasty, but not healthy
column10: The Rendang Curry from Prima Taste is an easy to make and tasty dish.  Unfortunately, it is not the healthiest.  But I don't mind eating a little fat sometimes, and we did enjoy the taste.  Additionally, it was easy to make witch makes it very convenient.We added beef as the directions say, but also some onion, bell peppers, and garlic.  The addition of the vegetables not only adds some nutrition, but also adds to taste and makes the product go farther.  We ate it over rice.  Please note, as I stated above, the paste is primarily fat with some sugar and spices.  It is not healthy at all.  The meat, added vegetables and rice provide more nutrition and allow you to eat less of the paste/sauce, thus reducing the percentage of fat calories compared to the total calories consumed.  (80 of the 110 calories per two tablespoons come from fat)The price is a bit high, considering you have to add other things to it, but it is not outrageous.  I just think those that are budget minded may choose alternate curry pastes that are less expensive.Over all, I give it four stars because we really did like the taste and it was very easy to make.  I took one star off because it is not very healthy and the price is a bit high.  For an Asian (Singapore) treat once in a while when you also want a quick dinner, it is a tasty meal.

This was a fabulous curry sauce kit!Spice packet was good and tasty.  We made ours w/beef filet tail.Initial concerns over dehydrated coconut sauce mix were totally unfounded.  This had a tasty flavor, smooth texture, and was a great mid-week meal.I would highly recommend these for busy people who enjoy good food, but don't have a whole lot of time.

This is my first experience with this particular brand of curry. My wife is the usual cook in the household, but she sprained her ankle pretty badly so I was given dinner duties last night. Turned out to be the perfect time to try this out.I have to say it is extremely flavorful and bursting with curry goodness. I was impressed, as was my wife. The kids even ate it, and they aren't huge fans of curry. The only reason I can't give this 5 stars is because I can find similar very good curry at my local supermarket and save a few bucks in the process. It's certainly better or as good as most, but not so much better that I can justify the extra cost. When you have a family of four to feed on a limited budget, this is a luxury item. Good as a treat every now and then, but not as a regular purchase.

I'd never had beef rendang, but I've love most curries so I gave it a shot.  The instructions on the package say to buy 28oz of filet mignon.  However, a little web searching revealed that beef rendang normally uses slow-cooked cheaper cuts of meat and the Prima Taste website has instructions for how to prepare the curry that way - basically just use half of the sauce and seasoning initially and add the rest near the end, plus use more water.Anyway the end result - using chopped up beef round, and pouring the curry on top of bhutanese red rice - was spectacular.So why 4 stars instead of 5?  I couldn't find any good options - even on the Prima Taste website - for adding veggies.  The meal is the beef equivalent of a death by chocolate dessert.But if you're looking for a delicious and different curry, this stuff gets it done.

My wife and I tried this the other night.  She made stir-fried veggies and meat.  I took care of preparing the sauce.Oh, you need to look carefully on the back of the box for an important part of the directions.  In VERY small print it says to add 4/5 cup of water to a pan, then add the contents of both enclosed pouches (curry and cocoanut milk) and heat to a boil.Anyway, once the sauce was ready we added the meat and veggies to the it and let it all simmer for a while.  When we just couldn't wait any longer we scooped the sauce/veggies/meat onto rice and enjoyed.One box makes enough easily for 4 generous helpings.I knew it was a hit as soon as my wife was asking, "Where can we get more of this?"  My response?  "Amazon."  :-)I also knew it had scored major points when my wife was texting her sister with her latest yummy discovery.All in all, the ease of preparation is quite easy.  The result is great.  We will be buying more!  (We have to, I finished the last of it today in my lunch at work.)As for spiciness...it's not too spicy.  I don't enjoy or do "spicy" very well...taste and otherwise.  But this went down well and I enjoyed every bite.5 stars all the way.

column4: Marshall Carter "Ornery Gamer, Fiend Club Member"
column9: A tasty dish for curry lovers, but on the pricey side.
column10: The Prima Taste Rendang Curry sauce kit makes a more than serviceable Rendang Curry, containing everything you'll need sans the beef, but at this price point, you might be left scratching your head as to why it's so expensive. It makes a delicious and easy-to-prepare (brown the beef, then mix, heat and eat, basically) Indonesian curry. You'll be waiting for your rice cooker to finish well before your Rendang curry is ready to put over it. It's a rather mild, sweet curry, so if that's not your cup of tea, then steer clear, but it was a nice change from the mostly Indian curries that I generally have and while I did end up using a healthy dose of Sriracha with it, the flavor was good without it (I'm just generally used to something more spicy and that's what I had my heart set on).There are only a couple of negatives with this one. The finished product is a bit on the oily side and there are leaves throughout the mixture (I see some are referring to these as the Keffir lime leaves, but they seemed more like lemongrass to me, hard and husk-like) that are probably meant to be removed from the end product. I ate a few, just to see what they were, and it wasn't altogether pleasant. You'll want to watch for those.Aside from that, the only real downside to the Prima Taste Rendang Curry Sauce Kit is the price. At nearly $7 a kit, it's a bit expensive for what you're getting, although I'm sure that if you bought all of the necessary ingredients separately (if you can get them locally), it would cost more (albeit with some leftover ingredients) and take a whole lot more time and effort. From a convenience point of view, if you love Rendang Curry, it's probably more than worth that price. If on the other hand, you've never had it and are just looking to try something new, paying for a 4-pack might be a bit more investment than you're willing to make.

Prima Taste Rendang Curry is mighty tasty. I'm no expert on Singaporean food, but I have traveled and lived in Asia so like various types of curry. The box contains powdered coconut milk and the curry paste in separate bags. Additionally, the recipe calls for 28 oz. of beef, 2.5 t. vegetable oil, and 4/5 c water. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes. The package says there is no added MSG, artificial coloring, or added preservatives. The package also says it contains the following common allergens: soybeans, wheat, tree nuts, and milk products. It is a product of Singapore. I didn't have enough beef thawed so I also used some chicken. It is easy to prepare.Both my husband and I liked it.  I don't mind the bits of leaf in it. Sadly, it is quite high in fat and contains a bit of sugar. Serving size is only 2 tablespoons of the mix and that has 9 grams of fat and 5 grams of carbs. I realistic serving is probably 3 times that plus the meat and rice or whatever you serve it with. I may buy this as a treat, but I can't have it all the time. Maybe, it would be ok if I broke it down to very small servings...which is what I did with the leftovers.

column9: Taste is okay, but half of it is pure fat and sugar
column10: Preparation is easy. Just dump the contents of the two bags in the box into a pan with some water, mix it really, really good, and bring it to a boil. Doesn't get any easier than that.The taste is okay, with a little zing to it, but the coconut is a bit too dominant for me. Balancing this a bit more on the spicy side would be more to my liking.So, that's all for the positive aspects. Now on to the negatives.One word: Fat.Actually, there is another word: Calories. Lots of them. Galore. Through the roof.One serving of this sauce is two table spoons, ca. 22 g. That is not much. Chances are, that you will eat way more than that during a normal meal.Well, do it at your own peril, because those two spoons you are eating have 110 calories, 80 of those come from fat. Of the 22g on your two spoons, 9 g are pure fat, 7 of those are of the saturated kind. These two spoons will supply 14 percent of your daily fat intake (with a 2000 calories diet). 3 grams of sugar are also included in those two spoons.I wonder how those people in Singapore can stay that skinny with such a hearty diet?!On the other side, there are no vitamins, iron, calcium or other of those pesky healthy ingredients in the sauce. Makes me wonder how that can be, if they really used all those natural things they mention in the ingredients list. well, I guess most of those onions, chilies, leafs, garlic, and so on, are just in there in miniscule parts. Most of the contents in this sauce must be the vegetable oil (but those too usually have at least some vitamins in it, don't they?), sugars, and so on.So, it basically is a fatty, sugary, unhealthy, vaguely spicy and almost too sweet concoction.And don't even get me started on the price - are you kidding me? I can feed my whole family for that amount at one of our local Thai/Chinese/East Asian places ...

column4: Tracy Foote "College Savings Plan Author, Pho...
column9: Kids loved this - a meal and a half for us~
column10: I don't do much curry cooking so I wasn't sure how the family would react. Turned out to be a big hit. It's basically two envelopes (a dry and wet mixture) that you add to your fried meat, and dinner is reading within minutes. I found it very easy to use. The family ate all the meat the first night, and we used the leftover sauce over rice on the next meal. I'd definitely recommend this for curry fans.

Oh this dish was so very surprisingly delicious!  Instead of beef, I used three packages of Gardein Beef Tips -- the best-tasting vegetarian food ever.  Inside the box you get two packages, one of the redang paste and the other is coconut milk powder.  The directions could not be easier: brown the meat, mix packages together with water, boil, add  the meat.  As a Caribbean woman, I must have flavor in my food, something that I only find in Caribbean and southeast Asian cooking.  The flavors were very bold, not spicy at all and a bit on the sweet side.  There was a lot of gravy even though I tried to boil it down for almost 15 minutes, but that's quite alright.  I really hope that this is sold near me but even if it's not, I'll definitely be ordering this from Amazon.  Highly recommended!

column9: Not spicy enough and too sweet
column10: This was real easy to make with the supplied ingredients.  I added fresh vegetables and beef and prepared it according to the directions.I liked the flavor but it was a little sweet and not spicy enough compared to what I get in NYC.If I make this again, I'm adding some chilies.  I served mine over jasmine rice.

column9: Better than I expected, makes a ton of food
column10: Wow.. Testing this out for dinner right now.Better than I expected.Tasty curry (reminds me of panang thai curry), just add water!  Was worried about all the fatty coconut oil (7 g saturated fat), but now realize that each one of these makes a *ton* of curry.  And a little goes a long way, flavor-wise.  Box is rated for 15 servings and I believe that is realistic.Serving suggestion: with beef or tofu, over rice.  side with veggies (great with Broccoli and Asparagus).Likes:- Flavor.  Spicy but not hot. Delicious.  I personally add liberal Sriracha sauce.- Value.  Makes quite a bit, easily.- Packs light. This would be a fantastic camping / backpacking treat for a large group.- Shelf life.  Lasts long for a quick meal backup plan.Dislikes:- A little rich on the coconut side, but a little goes a long way.  Plan on leftovers.Overall exceeded expectations.  Highly reccommended.

Have been to an authentic Tai restaurant a few days before trying this sauce kit, I was surprised to find that it tastes exactly like what I had ordered at the restaurant. Both were delicious, but Prima Taste cost me a lot less money. I didn't expect a boxed sauce kit to taste this good, but it does. It's easy to make, too. The kit includes the coconut portion of the mix (no need to buy coconut milk like other products). It's mildly hot/spicy, but newbie's should be able to handle it (I don't like overly spicey dishes, myself. I always get mild taco sauce).One downside, I can't find this product in my local supermarket! The Prima Taste website does sell online, however.Hopefully, they will start stocking this item in the near me.

I'm a long time fan of Patak's curry sauces and had never used a kit before. Adding the wet ingredients at home definitely makes for a fresher tasting curry. I really liked the flavor and the sauce couldn't have been easier to make. The only downside is that this curry sauce, like most of them, is very sodium-heavy. A single serving is more or less a day's sodium. But given that curry isn't really a health food at the best of times, this is a worthwhile once-in-a-while splurge and is guaranteed to make the most stove-phobic person feel like a great cook!

I don't cook much and rarely make a meat dish, but I decided it would be fun to try this.  It is very easy to make and it is delicious.  My husband who always says he doesn't like Thai food really enjoyed this dish.  He was very impressed so I didn't tell him how easy it was to make.You just cook your meat (I used round steak) until it is tender, then add the ingredients and there it is an impressive curry dish.  I thought it tasted as good as our local Thai restaurant.  It is not  hot and spicy so if you want it to be spicier you should add some pepper of some kind.Over all I love this product and would buy it again.

I am not particularly familiar with Singaporean food, but I do love curry in all of its iterations (Thai, Indian, etc.), so I was excited to get this.  This curry is a mix of a spice blend and a coconut base, which makes for a tasty sauce.  The box recommends beef, so that is what I used.  Following instructions I pan-fried the beef, then added the spices and coconut mix.  The box suggests using a different pan to make the sauce, but I just dumped it in with the beef and it still turned out well.  The result was a flavorful, slightly spicy curry, which went well over jasmine rice.  The box also suggests mashed potatoes, but I think I far prefer it on rice.  This is a great dinner for a rushed night- simple, fast, and tasty.

For a long time I've wanted to make a curry.  But, I never took the time.  This kit includes everything you need except the beef.  You could use chicken or any other meat you wish.  The curry was very tasty with just the right amount of spice.  It was a little spicy but not too hot for your average American family to eat.  This is a great starter kit to have around for those nights where you want something a little more substantial than throwing spaghetti on but don't want to take the time to go through a lot of prep work.  Just mix the coconut powder with the included sauce, brown your beef, throw it in the sauce and in a few minutes you have a curry.  In fact it took longer to cook the brown rice we had with this than to make the curry.

column9: Love this dish! Paired with skillet ready veggie pack from Trader Joe.
column10: I like curry and often eat out in restaurants were I pick these types of dishes.I made mine with potatoes, sliced beef and a package of roasted fiery veggies from Trader Joe [ready for skillet].  It was delish!

I followed the directions of this package, except I add a lot of sliced carrots in it w/ 2 lbs of really good beef sliced the recommended width. While the taste was really good, the meat was too tough for me to eat because of the width of the cut. If I had to do it again, I would not use beef and use it w/ chicken instead because the coconut wasn't able to soften the meat enough.Originally, I was expecting the final outcome to be a bit drier and more like a stir fry like the picture on the package, however it does leave a good amount of sauce that gives you the option of adding more ingredients like vegatables into the mix.For something that requires not much prep work, it's an excellent method of cooking if you don't want the hassle of finding all the spices and ingredients involved in making a curry. This is exactly the type of product I would take w/ me on a trip like camping or somewhere I wouldn't have my regular pantry available. It's absolutely simple to use and cook. It's also not very spicey, so it if you perfer more spice I'd recommend adding that.As a quick option to cooking, I'd highly recommend this production.

column9: Not really a curry, but interesting
column10: This is a mix to make a spiced beef dish. If you are expecting a curry (meat and veg in a spicy sauce) this is not what Rendang consists of. Instead, this is a meat dish, on the dry side, that uses beef tenderloin and spices and coconut milk to make a main dish. The package calls for beef tenderloin, but theoretically, you can use iver, duck, chicken, lamb, goat or any other meat.  This type of dish is a sort of meat preservation; after caramelizing and coating the meat with spices, it can last at room temperature for some time.This is an Indonesian dish originating from Sumatra and is flavored with coconut milk and a mixture of including ginger, galangal, turmeric, lemon grass, garlic, shallot, chili. It's very nice with plain boiled rice.

column9: Was so good that it blew my mind!
column10: This is the perfect blend of spice and sweet.  It transformed my steak and mushrooms into something magical.This is so easy to fix.  Just brown the meat and veggies (mushrooms in my case).  Remove from pan and mix coconut  powder with sauce and 4/5 cup water (I used a 1-cup and filled it to about 1/4-inch below the rim).  Another reviewer mentioned that the coconut powder is difficult to mix in.  Using a whisk solved this issue, and I was able to whisk everything together in a matter of seconds.  After everything is mixed together, add the meat and veggies back into the pan, and bring to a boil.  Another reviewer mentioned the tough vegetable pieces (leaves).  I noticed that too, but cooking it a couple minutes longer solved that issue.I think that this might just be the easiest, tastiest dish I've ever had.  I'm anxious to try the other varieties of Prima Taste kits.

This dish proved difficult for us, although it was simple to prepare.  The Papa Bear found it too spicy, the Baby Bear didn't like the look of it and refused to try it, and the Mama Bear (that's me) found it sweeter than the curry I usually eat. A quick read of the package says that this is in the Singaporean style, which we have never tried. That may be what made it difficult for us. I'm giving it an extra star because it is probably good when served to people familiar with Singaporean food.Preparing the dish was a snap, just adding the sauces in the package to sauteed beef, bell peppers and onions. However, because the sauces rendered the rest of the food inedible by most of the family, I wish I had just left the meat, peppers and onions plain, and served it to my family that way. I suggest tasting the sauces before adding to the meat, thus preventing an expensive dinner mistake.

column9: Easy to make and mMm delicious!
column10: I love curry. It's so simple and tastes delicious with rice, some vegetables (carrots, potatoes), and meat. The packaging says that beef is the recommended meat, but chicken, pork, and other meats also tastes good with this Rendang Curry. With my Asian heritage, I was skeptical at first regarding the "authentic" taste, but I am thoroughly convinced that Prima Taste has done a wonderful job creating a delicious, easy-to-make Rendang Curry. The curry is fresh, has the perfect blend of spices, and all the ingredients are combined just right.For about one box (One Rendang paste pouch and one coconut mix pouch), I was able to serve between 3-4 people.Here are some of the ingredients that I added to curry (One 12.7 ounce box):1) 1 - 2 cups of carrots2) 3 - 4 potatoes3) About 16 ounces of chicken breastI'm drooling just typing this out.Served with rice, carrots, potatoes, and your choice of meat, you've got yourself a delicious dinner. Amazing Rendang Curry sauce kit. Well done, Prima taste.P.S. Make sure you eat this with couple or several other people. Not that one could eat this by themselves, but the curry is VERY hearty and has a large percentage of daily intake of saturated fat in one 12.7 ounce box. Cheers

We have enjoyed Rendang Curry before at restaurants, but never prepared it at home. This product is as good or better than any restaurant version we have experienced. In the box are two pouches, one with the Rendang paste, and the other a dry coconut pre-mix.  You just cook up 28 onces of thinly sliced beef tenderloin (we used tri-tip)and then stir in the content of the two pouches along with 4/5 cup water. Done!  We served our Rendang Curry over a bed of brown rice.  I would have given this product 5 stars but there were two things that detracted from giving it the highest marks.  First, I felt the instructions were a little to simple and lacked some needed detail.  I also found that 4/5 cup of water was a little strange.  Who measures in fifths? I actually found that I needed to add just a little more water to make enough sauce. Second, the mix contains chunks lemon grass, which are woody.  I kept having to remove these woody chunks from my mouth during the meal.  My wife on the other hand ate them.  But, I didn't like that aspect of the meal.  Otherwise, this was a very easily prepared and enjoyable dining-in experience. Yummy!

This is probably hands down the best curry I have ever made at home from a kit. I made it using Tofu instead of beef and it was still amazing.  We loved how easy it was to make and how great it smelled. The biggest negative was when we opened the box the packaging inside looked like an MRE. When you opened the packages to add to your pan/pot it still looked like MRE type food, but once it started cooking it started to look like and smell like a real meal.Pros:Easy to makeDoesn't take longTastes great! Tastes like something you would pay fifteen dollars for at a restaurant.Smells wonderfulCons:Looks like an MRE when you open the box and still looks like one when you are pouring out the contents.The powdered milk is a pain to mix in and keep from clumping.My final thought, everyone should give this curry a try! Our family is actually going to try some of the other options that Prima Taste has soon and if they are even half as good as this one then we will have some great meals.

column9: No Problems with Coconut Powder If Done Right
column10: If you're cooking for two, I suggest using only half of the coconut and curry sauce packets. The biggest headache was trying to figure out what the heck is half of a 4/5 cup of water. Clearly the instructions are British in terms of measurements. I guessed that halving it amounts to just under a 1/2 cup of water. As for meat, I had a nearly 1 lb. package of beef. I didn't want to end up with too much sauce and not enough meat, which some reviewers here seemed to have gotten stuck with.If you want to make sure the coconut powder melts, make sure your saucepan is very hot. I did this by first stir-frying some vegetables (onions, mushrooms, whatever) using a non-stick cooking spray (less fat) then used that same pan to fry the meat (this time adding veggie oil). Once the meat was almost done, I put it aside and the poured the coconut and water together. Since the pan was already very hot from frying the meat AND the veggies, the coconut powder melted easily with the water. No grains left whatsoever. I added the paste and it didn't take long to boil. Then I poured the veggies and meat into the sauce and mixed it up together.Tip: some reviewers have commented that the paste sticks to the inside of the foil packet. For the stuck paste, I used a narrow silicone spatula, the kind you use for frosting cakes. It removed a lot of it easily and cleanly.The rice was done, and so I just added it all together. It wasn't as spicy as I hoped it would be, which I fear may be due to my adding too much water :( Still, it had lots of complex flavors in it. The package says to use any leftover sauce packets within 3 days, so I look forward to making another meal out of it pretty soon. Either way the taste was very pleasing, and I would buy it again.

column9: Fast, tasy, and a great alternative to standard boxed meals.
column10: Just-add-meat style box meals are great for a hectic work week when food needs to get on the table quick, but there's only so many times Hamburger Helper or broccoli and chicken casseroles can be eaten before they get boring.  Prima Taste's Rendang Curry kit spices up your fast meal options by throwing in the taste of Singapore style cuisine.The meal is easy and quick to cook, only requiring you to brown beef before throwing in the Rendang paste and coconut seasoning.  The seasoned beef and sauce mixture is fantastic over rice or pasta, and throwing in any of a variety of vegetables makes it more of a complete meal.Although a curry, this particular meal isn't spicy at all and shouldn't scare off anyone who doesn't like food overly hot.  In fact the end result is a very subtle and pleasant flavor.  Personally I'm not a fan of sweet foods that should be savory (Pineapple on pizza?  Utter blasphemy.) but the level of coconut flavor is perfectly balanced and doesn't make the dish too sweet.  This boxed meal is highly recommended if you want to try something different from the norm that's still a snap to prepare for a family.

What a delight this product is! Just mix the two pouches included in the box with water, bring to a boil, and add some cooked pieces of beef (or chicken, vegetables, whatever). The resulting dish tastes like restaurant quality! The Rendang Curry sauce is a perfect balance of sweet, spicy, and a bit exotic - not too challenging for the timid eater, but not unrewarding for those who like new tastes. And I wasn't kidding about licking the plate afterwards (and the spoon I stirred things with, and the pan I cooked everything in). Seriously delicious!The only reason that I've knocked off one star is that some of the larger bits of herbs and spices are tough to chew and are a distraction. Not enough to be a real problem, but it's a bit annoying to be chewing away at a piece of dried leaf when you're anxious for the next bite of meat and sauce.The box is labeled as "family size" and that's no lie - you can add plenty of meat and veggies and have ample sauce. I'm definitely going to make this a staple in my pantry!

I wanted to cook something fun and easy this weekend for my friends and I, so I decided to take a chance and order this Curry Kit and wasn't disappointed.  Was able to prepare while talking, getting drinks, answering the door, etc. and came out tasting amazing.  Although you could use just about anything, I used a whole onion, a pasilla pepper, a full skinless chicken breast, and for spice I used a small amount of Sriracha "Rooster" sauce as well.  Came out great!

column4: Writer of Books - Mage - Mom to Two "Writer, ...
column9: Ten stars! Restaurant quality, incredibly good!!
column10: I loved this so much that I am actually writing this review while EATING it!!To begin, I have never had really great curry. It's usually too grainy or too cheap-spice flavored or too sweet. But I love the smell of curry and I have had good curry at vendors etc. Well, this is by far my favorite of all time! It's so good, you could serve this to friends, to impress your boss at dinner, for a romantic evening (okay, it's still curry...) or just to enjoy a night off. The absolute only issue I have with it is the stalks/leaves that are in it. I found them super tasty, but tough and distracting to the dish. I would suggest pulling them out as I did, easy enough.The flavor is just the best curry. It doesn't taste like a quick 'I want restaurant curry at home..." at all. This could be some very expensive take out. It's super quick to make. I used beef and cooked it up to pretty much done. Then finished the sauce, which thickened up almost instantly. Personally, next time I'm using chicken or tofu or may just make the sauce alone! It's a bit spicy, my super-sensative hubby thought it was borderline too spicy, but he ate an entire bowl nonetheless.  It's got an almost fruity side note in the flavor, just the right amount of sweetness. Also, it has this wonderful texture and thickness! Not too runny, covers my jasmine rice well but not thick.I could go on and on about the Prima Taste Rendang Curry sauce kit. Let's just say that I am going to try their entire line of kits.

I was intrigued.  I had never tasted food from Singapore before and couldn't resist.  It was exceedingly simple to make, with easy instructions only made a bit puzzling by odd measurements:  28 ounces of beef is specified, along with 4/5 cup water (does anyone actually have a measuring cup for fifths?).  I just purchased a piece of meat in that general range without worrying too much about it and cut it up into bite-size chunks (the instructions specified one centimeter) and browned it.  Then I removed the meat from the pan.  The next instruction was to add 4/5 cup water, which I just estimated.  It's not important.  You can cook it off or add more if needed.  I stirred in the coconut milk powder -- no problems with clumps.  I added the paste.  When that was boiling nicely, I added the meat back in.  It was all done in no time at all.I served it with some jasmine rice and some mixed vegetables.  Not being familiar with Singapore cuisine, I wish the package had offered some suggestions for sides.  I went to the website hoping it would offer suggestions, but no.The package makes about five adult-size portions.  Leftovers stored and rewarmed well.Taste?  Well, it is different.  How can I describe it?  The first taste is sweet, but like many curries, the flavors change in your mouth.  The sweetness is not very noticeable after that first bite and you can taste the other flavors blending.  It is quite tasty and we all enjoyed it.  It is mildly spicy, and it left just a slight tingle in my mouth.Our general opinion was that it was very good.  It's not something we will be eating every week, or even every month.  But when you are tired of the same old same old, it's a pleasant change, and the fact that it is so very easy to make is a plus.At the time of this writing, the Amazon page says the product contains "Crustaceans, Tree nuts.  Manufactured on equipment that also process peanutes, sesame, fish, soy beans, wheat, milk and egg products."  In fact, the actual package says only that the product is manufactured on equipment that processes crustaceans and the other items.  I did not read the Amazon page before eating this product and was not aware of the crustaceans notice; I am allergic and would not have eaten it if I had read the Amazon page.  However, I had no allergy problems with this product whatsoever.Update:  June 2012I have fixed this many more times since the initial review and recommended it to several people.  This stuff is addictive.  I have serious cravings.  It's that good.

column9: good, fast curry, great for travel
column10: I love curry, and own a full spice cabinet. I chose to make this one night when I was busy, it made a lot of curry for one person, enough for leftovers. The spice factor, for me, was only medium. I fought the urge to add a fresh chili, more spices.cook the beef slowly, with some broth, before adding the packets. I enjoyed it over rice.Will buy for camping this summer.

A product that I will buy over and over again. I'm very basic when it comes to spices , nothing too bland , nothing too overwhelming. I always feel that spices should enhance the flavor of the original product and not be over-bearing. Such is the delicate balance of this Curry sauce kit. Usually curry often falls in the over-bearing department ; not so with this kit.The balance was very satisfying and enhanced our meal.

I have never been a huge fan of curry.  I think it has more to do with my taste buds being drowned in Italian food most of my life, but I continue to enjoy the cuisines of the world.  I received a package of the Prima Taste of Rendang Curry and found it to be a perfect match for the stew beef that was slow cooked.  One of the things that sold me was that the sauce has a slightly sweet taste, which cut the feeling of the curry being its usual overpowering self for me.  I will definitely purchase more of this in the future.
Why go out for Asian cuisine. This kit made a delicious curry in no time at all.  Add some rice and you have the perfect weeknight meal. Recommended.

My family loved this quick dinner kit. In 20 minutes our rice was done the curry had simmered and we were ready to eat. Instead of the beef recommended we used chicken breast cut into hearty chunks. This blended well with the sweetslightly spicy curry mix. We would defintely order and eat it again. There are no draw backs that we could see and we were pleasantly surprised that this was a product of Singapore.

Caveat: As a vegetarian, I ate this dish prepared with tofu rather than beef. Maybe that mattered more with this sauce than it would with others. But it was OK, without any special or redeeming qualities. The preparation was certainly easy, though that 4/5 of a cup of water (with the instruction printed in 2 point type) stumped me...what measuring cup comes in fifths? I got out a magnifying glass to be sure that's what they wanted. But the flavor just didn't punch as I thought it should, and there was a vague chemical flavor way in the back that left me unimpressed. A bit of tang and hot, but I've had better mixes and far better sauces. Shared with my son and grandson, and their feelings were the same.

I love curry, in its many different forms and preparations. I love the powdery yellow curry, Red Curry, Green Curry, Massaman Curry...Indian, Thai, Chinese, Malaysian, South African...and in the case of this product...Rendang Curry, which is Indonesian.Rendang is traditionally made with coconut milk, galangal, tumeric, ginger root, lemon grass, garlic, shallot, chilis, and other spices. Making this dish usually takes hours, but with this box you can cut down that time a bit.You brown your meat, whether its lamb or beef, pour in the curry mixture (which I added coconut milk to instead of water like other reviewers) then cook for another 15 to 20 minutes and let it get all married together and smelling magnificent. And although this is an Indonesian dish I paired it with Jasmine rice to bring out more flavors and add another aromatic layer. I also recommend serving with some cold sides like chopped tomato, cucumber, carrot, and red onion.

This was dinner last night and it was delicious!My family made it with beef as suggested. The ingredients were very easy to follow and it ended up tasting fantastic. We typically visit and Indian restaurant once or twice a month for the curry and we all agreed that this product was a great replacement for the curry fix that we need.When I think of buying a boxed dinner I get nightmares of the days of hamburger helper but Prima Tasting has created a product that is simple yet still delicious.I would purchase this product again especially because I would like to make this dish with mutton. If you like curry but do not have the time to build the flavor profiles over a few hours consider picking up the Prima Tasting kit. I would recommend that if you are not familiar with curry that you use more beef, pork, chicken, or mutton than recommended on the side of the box. This will dilute a bit the potent spices. The spice kit is a bit heavy with cumin but when I usually order at an Indian style restaurant I would ask them to go light on the spices so this might be a personal preference of mine.

column9: So flavorful it can easily be stretched to flavor more meat
column10: Normally, when I review a product, I'm careful to use it as specified. This time, I made an exception. The reason is because I love curries, especially Indonesian curries, but I'm currently following a low-carbohydrate regimen, and most premade curries are a little too carb-heavy -- including this one. It's got a fair amount of sugar in the ingredients, so the whole box contains 75 grams of carbs, which is a lot for 28 oz of meat, the amount of meat specified on the box.But I just *had* to try this curry. So my solution was to make a lot more meat, thus stretching the sauce so each serving had less sauce.This one box flavored 4-1/4 pounds of stew meat and 2-1/4 pounds of lamb. That's about three times the serving suggested on the box. You'd think the result might be thin flavors, but I have to say each bite was delicious and highly flavored. Absolutely restaurant-quality, as others have said. And I love the bits of pandan leaf that populate the sauce. It's just a great, pleasurable, satisfying meal.I did notice that the coconut doesn't break up easily, but if you wait until the mixture is just about boiling, it breaks up eventually. I wish I had used coconut milk instead of water, and sauteed the meat in coconut oil, as another reviewer has cleverly suggested -- I think those options should be mentioned on the box.What I did do was fry the stew meat in batches in a large frying pan. When all the meat was fried till nearly done. I put it back in the pan and poured in the curry mixture, which deglazed the pan, and cooked the whole thing for another 15 minutes or so. For the lamb, I did something different; after sauteeing the lamb, I put it in a pressure cooker with about 2/3 cup of the sauce and cooked it for 12 minutes. Unbelievable flavor and tenderness. I think I'm going to use the sautee-till-brown/pressure-cook-with-sauce method every time I make this kind of curry from now on.I really highly recommend this kit to anyone who doesn't mind a little sugar in their curry (and I admit it wouldn't have that "restaurant flavor" without the sugar). Now that I know one box can flavor 6 pounds of meat, easy, I regard this is both an economical purchase and a relatively low-carb treat.

My whole family really enjoyed this kit. The sauce was fresh, flavorful, and super easy to make. The instructions were simple, cook the meat, then make the sauce in the kit, then add the meat to the sauce and cook some more and then serve on rice or mashed potatoes. The taste was wonderful. The coconut flavor was noticeable and you could smell it too. It really did only take a few minutes to have a great meal ready. I used chicken instead of beef and it was really good. I'd imagine it'd taste good with pork as well.

I love curry but it is time consuming to  make from scratch. The Prima taste Rending Curry Sauce Kit is a real time saver and  makes a wonderful tasting dish. I added a few  more fruits and vegetables to my taste. My family loved it. This is the first beef curry mix I have used because chicken curry is my favorite but I will add beef now that I have found a way to make it so delicious.

I frequently make curry dishes from scratch.  I was looking for this box meal to make an easy version of that.  It succeeded in the easy department.  Making this meal was as easy as making Hamburger Helper.  Just cooking the meet, start the rice cooker, and add the sauces.  I was very pleased with the ease in cooking.  The flavor, however, left me a little disappointed.  It wasn't bad, but it just wasn't as good as homemade.  My family ate it all and said it was okay but gave it the thumbs down for future purchases.  They'd much rather eat my homemade.  I'm afraid I have to agree.  Although this was all right, it's worth the extra effort for better flavor.  I would be interested in buying other flavors from this company, and I would recommend this product to anyone that struggles in the kitchen.  It does make decent curry very easy.

Most packaged sauces are pretty boring and light on taste, but this is no ordinary packaged sauce.  This sauce is delicate and flavorful - it tastes like I spent hours working on the perfect spice blend.  I decided to make it with a lean London broil that I purchased on sale.  I sliced the meat thin and followed the package directions exactly.  The only thing I would do differently next time (and there WILL be a next time) would be to knock all the lumps out of the coconut premix first since it took sometime to work them out during the cooking process.  I served it over jasmine rice, topped with grated carrot, and with a side of steamed broccoli.  Next time I think I will try it with lamb.I was pleased to see that allergen safety information for this product is listed completely on the product page.  For those of us who do deal with food allergies this is very important.The serving size of this product is 2 tablespoons and the box contains about 15 servings.  One serving has 110 calories, 9 grams of fat, 5 grams of carbohydrates, and 230 milligrams of sodium.  So you do want to be careful if you are watching your sodium.

column9: A curry sauce for those who are kitchen challenged.
column10: Prima Taste Rendang Curry Sauce Kit is for those who are challenged in the kitchen but want to enjoy an exotic dish.  I tried this curry sauce kit but I didn't enjoy the flavor.  Not enough curry or spice for my taste buds (I had to add a lot of extra spice to liven up the sauce).  If your taste buds are bland or if you do not enjoy some zest in your food but you want to enjoy the Southeast Asian flavor then you will want to pick up a box of Prima Taste Rendang Curry Sauce kit today.  But, if you're like me then save your money and learn how to make your own spicy curry for less dosh,

column9: Easy to make and add to, you can make it more cost effective with sirloin
column10: I made a very tasty Valentine's Day meal for my boyfriend tonight.  Well, also for myself.
