This is the case with far too many other brands, and if one flavor completely buries something I was looking forward to tasting that just ruins the tea for me. What you get with this blend is an insanely delicious hibiscus tea (I'd go so far as to say it's the best of their hibiscus line in fact) with a pronounced but not overpowering taste of raspberry along with the rose overtones. Each flavor really complements the other, and nothing feels out of place. It's just simply perfect in my eyes.If I could compare this tea to anything, I'd probably say it reminds me a bit of Celestial Seasoning's Raspberry Zinger but with a hint of rose, and perhaps less zing... although this tea far exceeds that description. It's something that has to be tried to be appreciated, and because it's a limited time seasonal release (what could be better for Valentine's Day than some of this tea!) you'll want to stock up soon!And if you're a huge fan of this blend like me and you're looking for a better deal, visit the manufacturer's website and pick it up in bulk. At around 18 cents per bag, their 250 count offering is a frugal way to assure you can enjoy this tea year round!
The peanut butter is my favorite flavor.  This soft granola is very good and makes me wonder after all those years of eating "brick like" granola, why it took so long to invent it!

This stuff is really, really good.  It's almost like soft, crumbled oatmeal cookies.  It might be too good - it's hard to stop eating once the bag is open.  Nutritionals aren't bad - 4g fat (1g sat)/130 calories for a 1/4 cup serving. I think even non-granola lovers would like this.

Does not replace powder but i find they are convenient for quick trips out of the house. I think these at least twice as expensive per fl oz when compared to powder so we only use them when we go out and do not have/want to go through the process of mixing powder and water.Not sure, but i will assume that some kind of preservative is used in the nursettes that allows them to keep for so long, so i just feel better using powder more often than not. Great product though

column9: Most excellent powered sugar. Very fine grain makes great icing.
column10: Love this orgainc sugar. Very fine powered grain just like 10-x sugar but better since it's organic. Makes great icing, or use to dust cookies or cakes. This is just like any other powered sugar just organic.Top has resealable lock like ziplock bags, much beter than the old boxes of powered sugar.

I think the sugar is pretty good, no complaints of the product, tastes great, if you do not heat it. Very granular once heated and will require melting the sugar completely over heat to remove the granular texture.It is very lumpy and will require sifting to obtain what you need for deserts. great in whipping cream, ice cream, frostings glazes etc...I felt good knowing I have given my kids deserts that are not full of chemicals. No better way of showing people how much you love them than by giving them pure, delicious food, including healthy quality deserts. Yes I said healthy deserts, if you include fruit, whole grains, eggs and milk in your deserts you are taking care of the sugar craving as well as sneaking healthy food in. Try a homemade cereal bar made with organic sugar. YUM.

column9: acceptable - shocking how much of this some recipes call for
column10: powdered sugar is something that you don't really like having around but you do need it for at least frosting and ice cream

I am very unhappy that Canidae did not mention the formula change. My Pomrerain has lost 1/3 of his weight since the last bag I bought. I had noticed the color in the food looked lighter but than he got diarrhea and now has been diagnosed with diabetes. He had been doing very well since I had put him on Canidae Platinum 2 1/2 years ago until this change.I know he is an older dog but I thought I was giving him some of the best food for him.Hopefully not many people have had to experience this with their dogs.I know the diabetes may not be due to the food but the diarrhea ???I had my kittens ,now cats, on Felidae but now I will consider another brand. The bag got smaller but the price stayed the same and I do not want them getting sick also.

Canidae has changed their formula and it is also now being made by the Diamond pet food company.  Do your research...many, many users of this new formula have dealt with very sick dogs.  There is nothing on the packaging that states "new formula".  I noticed a change when I opened the package...different color of kibble.  I checked the ingredients llisted on the back and compared to an outdated brochure from the company.  I thought that the new formula would be OK.  I haven't had the severity of problems that others have had, but after reading several postings at different sites, I susupect that the changes I have observed in my senior golden in the last month or so has to be the food!  Time will tell..she gets homemade food tomorrow.

I discovered this tea a couple of years ago on a trip to Colorado. I liked it so much that I wrote down the name of it so I could buy it. I had no luck initially, but recently searched again, and of course, it was available on Amazon.com. It's every bit as good as I remember. The tea is so fragrant and flavorful. Truly good stuff. I also ordered the African Nectar, which is amazing.
this mint too is so refreshing! such a good pick-me-up especially in the morning and a great alternative to coffee! you will love this flavor- it's one of my favorites :)

This would have to be the best beef jerky I've ever eaten. I've tried dozens of brands, even Jack Links other styles, but their steak jerky is simply the best by a mile - so good I get it flown half-way around the world to me!

I've been buying Puroast because I have GERD. I can drink this coffee and it's fine but I sure miss a strong cup of coffee. This will do,but all the blends taste the same- a little watered down. But I'll take it.
Exceptional crackers...arrived unbroken, fresh, very tasty and the rosemary aroma is addictive. Try Cream Cheese with some fresh lemon zest and rosemary or thyme on top.

column9: Love the aroma. But a bit on hard side.
column10: These have just the right amount of flavor & aroma. Although they could use more rosemary if you ask me. I would love to eat the whole box in one sitting but my sore mouth would stop that. They tend to poke and scrape because they are tough & hard and when you bite do not break evenly or crumble. So beware tender mouths.
I am Iranian and love to steep tea and this is one that really matches what I used to drink. I drink this tea everyday and Amazon had the cheapest price (than stores).

These gummy snakes were an instant hit,from the time i opened the box!!! first the taste is excellent,my kids love them.(this mom tryed them to ! ) :)the 36 inch gummy snake is very well worth the money,i cut pieces off of each childs gummy snake as these are long enough for several helpings.these can not be found in our area stores.also these came in differnt colored stripes.

As a Midwesterner I did not grow up eating moon pies. They aren't for sale around these parts. I ordered a box after my son read a children's book about moon pies. He wanted to taste the moon.  The order took forever to arrive and the pies were only a few days from expiration.  They tasted bland and dry and overly sweet.  We will continue to imagine the moon is made of cheese.

These are very soft, super pliable white flour tortillas for making soft tacos. These are only 6 inch in diameter though but great for portion control if you are trying to limit your carbohydrate count.Each package is 8.2 ounces and contains 10 tortillas to a pack.These were super fresh tasting and amazingly, the expiration date was 'better if used by 03 January 2013' [as of my writing this on July 03, 2012], so these obviously have an excellent shelf-life if you want a staple in your pantry for snacks and whatnot.Ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (Wheat Flour, Niacin, Iron, Thiamin Mononitrate, Riboflavin, Folic Acid), Water, Partially Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil (Soybean, Cottonseed) With Mono- And Diglycerides, Glycerin, Corn Syrup Solids, Salt, Baking Powder (Baking Soda, Corn Starch, Sodium Aluminum Sulfate, Calcium Sulfate, Monocalcium Phosphate), Potassium Sorbate And Calcium Propionate (Preservatives), Monoglycerides, Fumaric Acid, L-Cysteine Hydrochloride.Nutrition facts:Serving Size 46 G (two tortillas)Servings Per Container 5Calories 150Total Fat 4 GSaturated Fat 1 GTrans Fat 1 GCholesterol 0 MgSodium 340 MgTotal Carbohydrate 24 GDietary Fiber 0 GSugars <1 GProtein 3 GThese are made in the USA by General Mills

column4: Phyllis L. Fischer "church of the angels"
column9: a delightful snack with a little zip!
column10: this cracker is a great snack food, right out of the box. It has a zip to it, and for those of us who like food with taste, this cracker is perfect. I highly recommend it!

If you have problems with Aspartame (which is in every gum out there...not just sugarfree gums) and you love to chew gum then SteviaDent is really the only option unless you want to eat TicTacs.  It is really good although quite expensive, but completely worth it to me so as not to compromise my health.  I chewed every gum out there and lots of it, but had recently started to notice a painful lump on the roof of my mouth. My immediate reaction was...of course cancer, but I had 2 dentists and an oral surgeon check it out and all confirmed it was not. Not only that, Aspartame upset my stomach to the point that I had an extreme amount of bloating and gas every day.  I didn't initially attribute either of these things to Aspartame, but when I started to notice the lump was bigger and more painful upon chewing my old gum, I started doing my research and Aspartame turned out to be the culprit. I ended up ordering a case of the SteviaDent and pitched everything I owned that contained Asapartame.  The lump on the roof of my mouth disappeared within 2 days of not ingesting aspartame and my stomach bloating and gas completely went away.  Worth spending the extra $ until more gums start making their product with Stevia instead of Aspartame.

This gum tastes so good and is sweetened with Stevia - all natural.  You can't go wrong.  I love it and have been chewing about a pack a day!  :-)  Also, Stevia Co. is great to purchase from.  Fantastic customer service!

Why does the ingredients list prominently feature sorbitol and xylitol?  With the stevia, that's 3 sweeteners!!!  And sorbitol causes painful gas and bloating.  Want a gum sweetened ONLY with stevia.  Does that product exist?
This gum is great if you want something more natural without all the sugar and harmful ingredients in sugar-free gums. The flavor lasts for a very long time. I will buy this again once I run out.

I love this gum, but realized after purchasing that the first ingredient is maltitol, a sugar alcohol.  I was really looking for something sweetened with stevia...period.  The flavor and texture were really good, and I'd give it 5 stars if they would dump the maltitol.
Finally a sweet taste that doesn't make me dizzy like sugar does, or sick like the artificial sweeteners do! :-)

column9: Stevia sweetened?? Not really, don't be deceived.
column10: Here are the ingredients that are on the label:Ingredients: Gum Base, Maltitol, Sorbitol, Xylitol, Glycerine, Natural Flavor, Gum Arabic, Stevita Stevia extract, Resinous Glaze, Soy Lecithin, Carnauba WaxThis is NOT a stevia sweetened product, not as one would expect with something called "Steviadent" and with "Stevia Dietary Supplement" on the front of the package. Stevia shows up #8 on the ingredient list even AFTER Glycerine, Natural Flavor, Gum Arabic. And the term "natural flavor" can mean anything at all. The manufacturer doesn't have to tell you what it is because it is considered "proprietary information"--could be ANYTHING, most likely something artificial, unnatural and most probably, something unhealthy or else the manufacturer would be proud to list it openly.I made the mistake of ordering this gum without checking the ingredients first. I even popped one into my mouth. It was pretty bad both in taste and texture; had to throw away the rest.There's another sugar-free gum that has less nasty ingredients:It's Xlear Inc. Spry Xylitol GumIngredients: Xylitol, gum base, natural flavor (spearmint oil), vegetable glycerin, gum Arabic, soy lecithin, beeswax.It still has Xylitol in it which some people's systems can't tolerate but generally most people can and so far, research shows that the only "side effect" is loose bowels in some people. That might be a plus for some folks!Spry Gums have a much nicer texture and taste in my opinion and come in several different flavors and in jars of 100 and even 600. So the savings is phenomenal.Made with non-GMO Xylitol made from corn.http://www.amazon.com/Xlear-Peppermint-Sugar-100-Pieces/dp/B000COIT8Y/ref=sr_1_4?ie=UTF8&qid=1342563776&sr=8-4&keywords=Xlear+Inc+Spry+Xylitol+GumPS: there are much better stevia products available anyway.

I was preparing to go on the HCG diet and Stevia is the only sweetener they allow.  I'm a big gum chewer (especially when dieting) and I couldn't find Stevia sweetened gum in any store.  Should have gone on Amazon sooner! found SteviaDent Gum, ordered it and received it within 3 days.  The gum was fresh and extremely tasty, now I'm hooked.  After about an hour it does change texture quite a bit but other than that, the taste is great and it gets the job done!Stevita Co. Inc. SteviaDent Gum ~ 12 packs ~ Buy the case!

column9: Wish I could add this to my subscribe & save
column10: Just like the other reviewer, I got all the aspartame out of my life.  I did not realize it was one of the major causes of migraines, which I had a problem with for quite a while.  Since cutting out aspartame and most processed foods, I haven't had a single migraine.  But I had also quit smoking years before that and haven't been able to live without gum since.  I used to chew Trident with Xylitol (instead of aspartame), but my holistic doctor tossed that out, as all the chemicals in mainstream gum are also migraine triggers.  So, I tried every natural gum I could find.  This is the only one that is actually in the ballpark with mainstream gum.  One of the other reviewers said that the flavor was weak and didn't last long, which compared to Trident, is true.  Trident et al. use chemicals to overpower your mouth with flavor.  Steviadent is a more mild flavor (just give it a couple weeks and your tastebuds will get used to not being overpowered and enjoy the calm mint flavor).  Compared to all the other sugarless, natural gums, Steviadent blows them out of the water.  The other natural gums I tried, lose their flavor immediately then taste like rubber and become really stiff.  Steviadent maintains its flavor and when the flavor fades, it stays soft and just tastes flavorless, like any mainstream gum.  So, if you are looking for a chemical-free, aspartame-free gum, this is the best one currently available.

column9: No punch - Maybe I got a bad batch?
column10: The taste is fine, but the flavor is a little weak and does not last long.  Additionally, there seems to be variations in the strength of the flavor between pieces in the same pack.  I have had 10-12 packs of the stuff.  Maybe their quality control will get better with time or maybe I just got a bad box.  I suppose if you are a big gum chewer the slightly bland taste is acceptable to avoid the refined sugar or artificial sweeteners, but I think I'd rather spend my money on something else.

column9: Flavor Doesn't Last as Long as I Hoped
column10: Flavor is very tasty, yet it only lasts about 10 minutes. I'm on the HCG diet, and these are one of the only approved gums without sugar or an aspartame-like ingredient.

column9: Great gum with no sugar, aspartame, or sucralose!
column10: After years of pressure from my wife, I've finally agreed to give up all artificially sweetened products.  I didn't want to add more refined sugar to my diet, so I assumed that I would simply have to do without many products.  One of the main reasons I resisted this change is because I am a frequent gum chewer.I discovered SteviaDent on Amazon via a Google search, read the ingredients, and decided to give it a try.  I had low expectations because I've been very dissatisfied with other sugar-free, aspartame-free, or sucralose-free gums.  To my surprise, SteviaDent is a much better product!  The mint flavor is good and long lasting.  The texture (mouth feel) is much more like regular gum than other products I've tried.  I'm very happy with the product.  This gum has satisfied my craving and makes my wife happy since I am no longer chewing sugar, aspartame, or sucralose!The only negative I've experienced with the product are the frequent and large percentage price changes on Amazon.  I've delayed orders or purchased elsewhere when the price is high at Amazon.

The description stated that this gum is naturally sweetened with Stevia. It said NOTHING about containing artificial sweetners (sugar alcohols). My digestive tract can not tolerate sugar alcohols (and I have Type II Diabetes so I do not chew regular gum). A case of this gum is expensive but I thought it would have been worth it (I love gum)if it was ONLY swwetened with Stevia. I feel duped!!!

This is much better for you than regular gum, no toxic artificial sweeteners, no sugar added to your system, it is made with Stevia thus is natural and not harmful. For a review of toxic additives, here is that listing [...]

I tried this gum for the first time and was not impressed.  The flavor is extremely short lived and the gum has a tendency to fall apart quickly.  I really want to find a stevia flavored gum in order to avoid aspartame, but this is not the brand.

I wish I could find this gum in local stores, however I am glad Amazon sells it by the case.  I love the mint flavor and have found that switching to Stevia and not using the other unhealthy sweeteners found in all gum, even sugar free gum, helped me kick the craving for sweets.

column9: best of all I have tried so far
column10: I decided to trust other reviewers and buy this product, as I must chew something while studying and food was just getting me pudgy.  Most aspartame gums just give me migraines, and I worry about eating a chemical that cancer thrives on, so I have been trying to find natural items to chew on.  This gum is almost too strong at first and reminded me of Altoids in flavor for the first five minutes or so, after that it mellowed out, and within a half hour was barely there...just a hint remained.  Enough to not want to throw it away, though it wasn't as good as it had started out being.  The consistency of the gum is the best of the various brands I have tried.  If anything it is too soft for the first half hour, but I prefer too soft for too long over chewing rubber after a few minutes, as had happened with all of the other brands I tried.  And sadly the consistency does not lend itself to blowing bubbles.  I will likely buy this product again, and will ask my local stores to get it in as well.  It seems equivalent in price, and better in quality than most natural, or even chemical-laden gums.
this gum is pretty good and seems to hold the flavor a little longer than other natural gums. it has a very strong peppermint taste which i like and no side effects.
Good strong flavor with weird texture at first but no NutraSweet so I'm happy!  Will buy again but wish the flavor would last longer.

I am pleased to report that this product is super when it comes to the safety of your health.  Not causing health problems is very important to me and my family and friends.  I have been telling everyone I know that chews gum that this one is not only safe but does not lose its flavor on the bedpost overnight.  I chewed on serving for three days and it was still going strong.Also, when I was not feeling well from a dinner out that was over powering with garlic, I sucked on a piece and it seemed to calm my stomach down big time.  I also like to flavor my water, so I put a piece in a cold bottle of H20 and it was great....Especially the peppermint.  The gum even tasted better when the water was gone.  This is a great gum that has also controled my sweet tooth and I don't have the craving for sweets like I did before.  I truly believe I could write a book on this fantastic gum that was developed by the second healthiest country in the world.  Have a great life and a great day.Counselor CounseletMillard's Blueberry Farm and Art Studioand author of: BORN TO TESTIFY that can be purchased at Barnes & Noble warehouse.

I just got my package. It's a 12-pack, each pack contains 12 gums so you'll have 144 gums for $15, which is about $0.10 per gum. It's the same price as regular gums, however the big plus for the Stevita is the complete absence of aspartam, an additive for sugarfree products which is terribly nocive and toxic. They put stevia instead. Stevia is not toxic, according to several studies.Seriously, check out independant studies about aspartam. If there is one thing you can do for your health, it's first removing aspartam. And it's not that hard. It was for me about gums, but no more!About the product itself : it has a good taste but it doesn't last a long time. Moreover, the gum looses its consistency really fast.But definitely the best alternative so far!
The flavor is strong if you like that.  The gum has a different consistancy. I had trouble with it sticking to my teeth.

No sugar or artificial sweeteners. Great for a low carb diet. Use this instead of candy when watching a movie or when ever you would have worthless snacks. The peppermint has a bit of a bite at first but it fades. The flavor lasted about an hour. Kids loved it.
Stevia gum gives a burst of minty flavor and it doesn't get hard even when you have been chewing for a while. Worth the wait and the money.

This gum was a lifesaver for me while dieting.  The flavor is strong for the first few chews, then fades gently.  This is not an all-day flavor, but a good diversion from eating when you need it.  I chew one pack a day while at work (10 hours).I will definitely buy this again; but wish our local grocery stores carried it in stock. (hate waiting on shipping).thanks!

column9: Like that it is a natural sweetner
column10: Did a diet that only allowed Stevia for sweetness additive.  I am a huge gum fan and this was my only option.  It was a little spendy and the flavor doesn't last long but it is a good natural choice.
I'm removing artificial sweetners from my diet. I love to chew gum at work and this is great! Flavor lasts a long time.
I wish the price was lower. This will work for now until a mainsteam company gets the idea to use truvia in their gum!

column9: Great Price, Great Taste, HUGE container.
column10: Red pepper seems to make up about a quarter of my husband's diet, so we finally decided to take the plunge and buy it in bulk.This pepper was very fresh and very flavorful - it even has a fruity note which is unusual in pepper from the shelf at the local grocery or big-box store.  (it's just not fresh enough!)  Tastes great, too - a little bit hotter than usual.Be prepared for the size of the container!  Four pounds of red pepper is about 1.5 GALLONS by volume.  The jug is about 10" by 7" by 5".  Unless you're about to make an epic vat of chili, you may want to decant into smaller containers for daily use.
We use this product to sprinkle over the front lawn to prevent dogs from doing their business.  Quite successful for that purpose.  Oh, and it is tasty if you add it to your food.  LOL!!

column9: Not as hot as I was expecting
column10: Granted I wasn't buying this for cooking but to deter dogs from my lawn.  I thought the product was not hot at all, this is after tasting a few of the flakes.  It was a waste of money overall.

I bought this because I love red pepper flakes.  I am always having to buy more...I basically put it on everything I eat!  Anyway, I thought this would be perfect.  It's good, but unfortunately I will never order this from them again because the jug was not sealed.  It has a lid but it did not have a seal.  I was expecting there to be a saran or foil seal (like meds, ketchup, other seasonings, etc).  If this does not bother you than it's a great deal.

I live in Chicago and I always stop at Portillo's to get a smoothie.  I like the Pina Colada smoothies, but they can be a little costly.  I love Torani's syrups and when I found the puree's I simply fell in love!  They are better than Portillo's.  All you need is low fat milk and ice and you've got the best smoothie ever!  I imagine you can use it for cakes, as well, but it makes a really great smoothie. Also, try it with rum for a pina colada cocktail.  Check it out!  You'll be hooked just like I am.

column9: Mush - it disingrates in mayonnaise. No Chunks.
column10: I just tried this brand after after having not had it for a long time. It seemed to disintegrate in mayonnaise. It is the consistency of baby food. It dripped out of the sandwich even though I didn't use a large amount of mayonnaise. On the plus side there were no off flavors.I have been getting my tuna at Costco, they have Kirkland(house brand) 7oz cans. There are huge, solid chunks of real, white tuna meat. They are hard to break up with a fork. This is by far the best tuna I have had in a can, but I get it from Costco more because the size is better to make a couple of sandwiches, instead of the normal one and a half or so I can get out of  5oz cans. This Bumble Bee brand was just one sandwich for the same 5oz. I don't know if there is more water, or the consistency just meant the tuna didn't go that far because it broke down. Maybe the next time they shrink-ray the tuna and go to 4oz cans, the extra large family size will be large enough to get two sandwiches out of? As for now I am going to hold off on buying from a supermarkets until I can get at least a 6ox. Until then it is Costco. Note: My rating has nothing to do with the size issue, that is just a bonus rant. I can't mention tuna without getting mad about the size of the cans, although actually getting a can of mush is much worse!

column9: Best donut shop coffee in a K Cup
column10: This coffee blows all other donut shop coffees away. The medium roast, smooth taste, and energizing aroma are the three best features. Absolute best K-Cup coffee out there in the light to medium roast (& unflavored) category!

If you love the jalapeno flavor, but don't want your tongue scorched, these are for you.  I love the jalapeno flavor, and can eat these like candy.  The seeds and the white pith in the middle have been removed before pickling, so all you get is the flavor.  This style of jalapeno was easy to get in South Texas.  We used to get the Clemente Jacques brand.

I buy these at Christmas time to stuff for parties.  They are a hit and getting hard to find.  :) Some wait for my tray of stuffed peppers with anticipation, and will be disappointed this year if I can't find them.

These peppers are great and mild as advertised but a little on the salty side.  Also, they are not really "whole" jalapenos.  They have been cut open and had the stems and seeds removed.  For me that's a plus but just be aware they are not whole.

I got hooked on these (mild) years ago but could no longer find them locally.After finding these on Amazon,i've orded at least seven cases!Not too hot but with full flavor.Two slices of buttered bread,some peppers,some sharp chedder or ANY cheese and a cheap toasted sandwich maker...WOW!!...Oh!..And the juice they're in is an excellent condiment/pepper sauce!

I BOUGHT A CASE OF THESE PEPPERS AFTER TRYING SOME THAT A FRIEND GAVE ME. SOMETHING MUST HAVE HAPPENED TO THESE PEPPERS DURING SHIPMENT.  I AM GUESSING THEY GOT FROZEN ALONG THE WAY.  THEY ARE INEDIBLE!!!  I HAVE TRIED 4 OR 5 CANS OF THEM AND THEY ALL ARE EXTREMELY SALTY AND TASTE HORRIBLE.  I WOULD LOVE TO SEND THEM BACK AND GET SOME CREDIT OR TRY ANOTHER BATCH. PLEASE LET ME KNOW WHAT CAN BE DONE.THANKSED SESSIONS

My family loves these peppers!  They were so mild, but still had enough flavor to taste like a jalapeno pepper.  I wish I could find them more often.  They are very hard to come by.  If you like mild peppers, these are excellent.
We originally purchased the graham crackers for my 2-year-old, but my whole family of 4 really loves these too.  Worth ordering in bulk!

If you are looking for a good chocolate chip cookie taste, but want to limit your snack to 100 calories, then these cookies are for you. No, they don't taste like chocolate chip cookies having hundreds of more calories, and it would not be realistic to expect them to. But for a low calories snack they are quite good, are not too hard or soft, and have a satisfying taste.Shop for price. These are expensive to start with for the amount of cookies you get, and the current price on Amazon is higher than the eighteen dollars that I pay when these are on sale at my local supermarket.

column9: Good product, but poor customer service
column10: I love this peanut butter, but was not well treated by this vendor.  When I received my order, one of the jars was broken and peanut butter had leaked all over the rest of the order.  I contacted the vendor to request a replacement jar or a credit; my request was totally ignored.  I will continue to buy this product, but not from this vendor!

column4: Jason Kirkfield "The Pride and Sorrow of chil...
column9: Classic treat but why pay double for shipping
column10: Moon Pies are a classic treat that taste great. And why not? They are essentially graham cracker cookies filled with marshmallow cream (Fluff) and dipped in chocolate. Amazingly, not even unhealthy! No cholesterol or trans fat. 220 calories but we all have to live a little and each one is bigger than a hockey puck after all.So let me cut to the chase:Both sellers here charge as much for shipping as they do for the product! That effectively doubles the price of a 12-pack box to more than fifteen dollars.Here's the solution. I found Moon Pies in all three flavors (Chocolate, Vanilla, Banana, though I only buy the original!) at the Cracker Barrel Old Country Stores which are attached to the restaurants. The cost? Four ninety-nine plus tax for the same sized box. That was last year. Also, Chattanooga Bakery (they invented the Moon Pie eighty years ago) indicated these are available at many Wal-Marts across the country. Buying locally would prevent some of the shipping damage (i.e., melting) some people have reported.If you are not located near a Cracker Barrel or Wal-Mart which sells these, you can buy them direct (moonpie dot com) for six bucks per box plus shipping.Enjoy!

My kids LOVE these chocolate moon pies, so I order a few boxes 2-3 times a year. (They are not available locally - in Northern California.) The secret to receiving them in pristine condition is to order them during cooler weather months. If you order in the summer they will arrive melted.

column9: My Wife Could Become Addicted, But Not At 110 Calories Per "Pie"
column10: Before my wife and I were married, her favorite dessert was - of all things - Moon Pies. When we left Southern California in 1964, we couldn't find them anywhere. So, with the advent of Amazon and online shopping, I looked them up, and although I had to order from 2500 miles away, I surprised her yesterday with a "just for the heck of it" gift.She was elated, and she said that they were just as she remembered them. Delicious!But, these were a THIRD the size of the ORIGINALS, and the calorie count of 110 for what is basically a marshmallow-filled cookie, she may have to wait another 45 years to get another batch. The look on her face was worth the $25 it ultimately cost me, but neither of us can afford the intake of those calories today. If only they had put the "Only 110 Calories" in small print on the side and not in big print on the front, top, and back! Ignorance is bliss...

I was very pleasantly surprised at how fast these were shipped and how fresh they were. These were also very fresh and soft. And, also for my husband. He had never had a moon pie.Thank you for making them so affordable. I would definitely highly recommend this seller.
although I hate them lolI have no problem buying them for a friendHe loved them and shipping was perfect he ate them within two daysLOL
That shows on the box in the pic. it is single Decker and I got dubble Decker.
This package arrived timely and in perfect conditions. I give it 4 stars because I would have wanted to know that these Moon Pies were double deckers -- the product details should be expanded.

My dad and I love moon pies, so when father's day came I decided to order him a box. To my dismay the box came and we opened it up to find 12 melted, crushed, and smooshed moon pies that looked completely inedible. I felt horrible and was very upset at this. On top of that, my father says it tasted like they were 10 years old. I will never order this product again.

It is challenging to find a gluten-free granola bar that you can take with you when riding your bike, kayaking or other activities.  I was thrilled to find these True Bars!  They have a great flavor and are actually palatable unlike so many gluten-free choices. They are easy to carry with you and give you a burst of energy on the go. I love em!
True Bars are so good and this flavor is a good, well balanced, classic flavor. Its has a lot of sugar in it so if that floats your boat, go for it. Delicious and will buy again!

I really enjoy this True Bar, I run outside and this bar is perfect as a pre or post sanck. The ingredients are just delicious, plenty of fruit and nut and not loaded with loads of sugar as I find with a lot bars, a great treat and well worth buying!!

Enjoyed upon receiving.  Not a night and day difference, but using with scotch seemed to provide a smoother finish and reduce the "burn" quality (i drink it neat.)  HOWEVER, after about 5 uses, pressing the button to release the scotch through the aerator no longer worked!  I pressed it several times, to no avail - then held it in place to see if it would eventually free itself, also to no avail... poured the scotch into my glass out of the top, so that i could then shake and smack the aerator and the stopper eventually freed itself.  But the stopper - which appears to be magnetic - has not worked well since, and i would inevitably have to smack it a couple of times prior to pouring to get it to work (since you can't smack it while there's anything in the glass.)  Anyways, I call the manufacturer for a replacement and I have to pay to ship it to them.  They pay return shipping for replacement - fair enough - but i'm still paying extra for dealing with the hassle.  Hopefully the next one will not have this issue, as this seems to be the first mention of this problem.  I will update if the next one has this issue.Take note manufacturers, if YOUR product has a fault and it has inconvenienced a customer for a legitimate reason, consider paying for their shipping to soften the hassle of an exchange.

column9: A nice tool to add to ones go-to drinking set
column10: I had my skepticism, I start with that because if you like what you already drink what could an aerator do to it?  Well it does enough for me to keep this little tool out and nearby my good alcohol.  I did the old side-by-side non aerated to aerated single shot taste test.  For the really cheap clear alcohol all I can say it does is make it have less of a burn while drinking and actually smooths out the after taste to a nice fade off.  As for higher end, scotch in my case, I tried a 12 year single malt & a 17 year old single malt.  Starting with the 17 year old scotch, this stuff is smooth and great to begin with, the side-by-side test concluded with the aerated scotch being much more floral/aromatic, the after taste was MUCH more enjoyable as it seemed to melt into a buttery feeling and just faded off into bliss.The 12 year old scotch, it's good on the rocks and a splash of water.  With the aerator it turned a 12 year old scotch into a very close 15/16 year old scotch.  All the little notes of flavor came to live, I won't way it is perfect but a cheaper bottle of scotch in my cabinet just payed for this little aerator.  All the harshness and lingering after taste of the 12 year old scotch, just melted away.  Again not on the same level as the 17 year old but pretty darn close.  I can put the max of 2 full jiggers, or more :), and know that what comes out will be a nice drink all around.For the $$, I'd suggest you give this a shot (or 2) if you like to enjoy a fine liquor.  I know I will defiantly be keeping this at close hand when making my drink, or drinks for others.  I'm very tempted to by a few for some good friends and family to spread the enjoyment.  The stopper and release button are NOT mechanical!  An ingenious and fool proof design of two opposing magnets creates the opening effect while the weight of the magnet closed the stopper.  Truly is machine washable and pretty durable.

I must admit I was a bit skeptical about this product and the promise that it will actually enhance the spirits that flow through it.  After now using it for a few weeks I can testify the product really does work.  Side-by-side tests confirm.  My bourbons poured through this product have more "nose" and I can clearly pick up on nuances that otherwise would not come through.  If you are a serious bourbon drinker, this product is a must.

Spirits I've tried with the Vinturi Spirit Aerator: Bowmore Legend, Glenlivet 22 yr, Johnny Walker Blue, Deleon Reposado, Don Julio 1942, Hanger One, Remy Martin XO, Patron Silver, Patron Anejo, Lagavulin 16 yr, Burichladdich 12 yr, Stranahan's Colorado Whiskey, Leopold Bros Rye, Silver Tree, Maker's 46, and Bulleit Rye. Basically, I've tried it with scotch, whiskey, bourbon, vodka, tequila, and cognac. Every single one of these was smoother and had more intricacies after using the Vinturi than without. Now that I am spoiled by what the Vinturi does, I get mad at myself when I am too lazy to grab and use it. The reason I am not giving it five stars is due to the button/plug on the device sticking (the button is pressed to release the plug, allowing the spirit to be aerated). Every once in a while, even after cleaning it after each use, the plug does not open when I press the button. Once the spirit is poured into the Vinturi and the plug does not open, there's nothing left to do than pour the spirit into the glass without aerating it and then pound the Vinturi against my palm to get the plug to unstick. It seems like a common problem and it is quite annoying. However, the Vinturi works well enough to overlook the infrequent annoyance.

Bought the Vin Spirit a few months ago.  I have now given away 8 of them to friends.  Everyone is simply amazed at this product.  Pour virtually any hard liquer thru it an Voilá.  Something volatilizes off. What is left is very smooth and mild. If you pour a jigger thru the device try it.  Then try a tiny amount not passed thru.  You will be amazed!!!  Worth every penny.  Especially for that guy who thinks he has everything and also knows it all.  I promise he will learn something is indeed new under the sun. A word of warning.  This device MUST be washed after every use otherwise it sticks closed and does not work!  But, it is well worth the extra effort. The comments about the device sticking closed are true and therefore it must be washed with clear water after each use.

Does exactly as advertised. I'm not even a whiskey drinker and I could tell the difference. It was much smoother and really brought out the vanillin in the drink. Really took the edge off. I had this really high quality whiskey. Had a sweet aftertaste, but it was so sharp it stung my throat. The Vinturi helped bring out the smooth notes and the oak barrels.Great for mixing, too! Like for a whiskey sour. If you like spirits, you need this.

I purchased this product for my husband for his birthday, as he is an avid scotch drinker. Once he tested it, he was amazed with how well it worked. He could definitely taste the difference, even in his scotch blends. The claims that it ages scotch are definitely true. I would recommend this product for any scotch drinker who wants to enhance the taste of their scotch.

I bought this as a gift for my dad. He says he likes it, primarily because it makes it easy to control the size of the drink. Unlike Vinturi's wine aerator, the alcohol is held in the top, then released when you push the button. He said it also makes the drink a little smoother.

We have the wine aerators and thought that we would give this one a try.  It definitely makes a difference.  I bought one for my son and husband as gifts since the are both Bourbon drinkers.  They loved them.

I have owned this product for a month now and have not had any of the problems stated in other reviews.  Since I am an enthusiastic whiskey drinker the device has seen heavy use in that time. I purchased the device from a local wine & spirit shop and for it's utility it seems to be perfectly priced.  It saves valuable tasting time swirling whiskey about in the glass.  If something happened to it I would replace it and am recommending it to all my whiskey drinking friends.  If you muddle whiskey with cola or slam it down just to get toasty, this is probably a waste of money for you.  If you truly enjoy whiskey and other fine spirits and actually take the time to taste it on the way down the hatch you will get a lot of utility from this device.  At first, I would put it back in its box after I went through a gill or so.  Now I just rinse it off and leave it on the counter.

column9: Awesome product with a fatal flaw
column10: I own all the Vinturi Aerators.  The red and white wine aerators are amazing, but this one is frustrating, especially in front of company. Why?  The button.  The workings fail almost every time I go to use it, as the button sticks.  I clean and rinse it every time I use it, but I end up having to shake it and force fluid through it trying to get it unstuck.  Fatal flaw costed it three stars.
The Vinturi Spirit Aerator is what you want if you drink quality liquor. I highly recommend that product As well as all of this manufacturers  products

column9: Works to an extent, but not convinced of it's value yet
column10: I have a Vinturi Aerator for red wine and it worked wonders so I decided to pick up the spirit version mainly for use with scotch.The product seems sturdy enough and is dishwasher safe.  It is a bit larger than I had anticipated, measuring about 6 inches without the base.  The magnetic release is convenient in that it allows you to measure exact servings of either 1 or 1.5 oz, but the mechanism itself feels as though it may fail eventually.  The magnetic mechanism has not misbehaved yet (the product is only a week old), but it is the only concerning structural point.Now the real question, "Does it work?"  Well the answer depends on what you're expecting of it.  I use it for single malt scotches, and I will say that it drastically reduces the amount of time I need to let a scotch breathe before imbibing.  As of yet, I have not found a magical dram where this product opens it up and reveals scents and flavors heretofore hidden, but I am willing to give it a shot.If you're on the fence, you might want to wait and see if the product goes on sale or you develop a strong urge to perform science and test aerated vs straight spirits for yourself.

I'm a long-time wine drinker and we regularly use the Vinturi Wine Aerator -- which works great in the aromatics and flavors of wine.  So I figured it makes sense for Whiskey / Bourbon.  My husband tried this Spirit Aerator out with a small batch rye bourbon (doing a before/after taste) -- he said he could defintely taste the difference. After a few uses it appears to work as consistently as the red wine Vinturi Wine Aerator.  I'd recommend both products if you don't want to wait for your drinks to open up on their own.

I bought this for my husband for Christmas from another place for more money. He LOVED the product and wanted to give them away as gifts.I was happy to see Amazon had them at a lower price.It really does make a difference on ALL types of alcohol.Just be sure to clean it thoroughly after each use or it can get sticky.

I gave this to my son for Christmas and he loved it. We performed taste tests with 2 different bottles of Scotch and you could really really tell the difference.  The aerator somehow enhanced the taste.  We did several blind taste tests and 100% of the time each person prefered the aerated sample.  I don't understand the science of it but it really works and I don't even like scotch!

Although I have a shot of scotch several times a week, I don't own a shot glass.  When I saw this item online, I thought it was a great "excuse" to get one since it'll serve both as a shot glass and an aerator (expensive one at that..!!!)  It actually works.  You can tell the difference when pouring straight out of the bottle vs. through this aerator.  Just like the one for wine, this brings out the bouquet of the spirit and the taste is slightly more pronounced.

column9: hard to say but there is a difference
column10: i purchased one of these for the wine and the spirit, the wine I can definitely sense a difference in the bouquet and flavor however in spirits it's so so.
Who would have thought that adding a little air to a straight drink would release all that extra flavor and aroma plus soften the fire.
The Vinturi aerator brings out all the wonderful flavors of even a moderately priced scotch single malt whisky.  As with there wine aerators, this is another great product from Vinturi.
Bought it, tried it on some bourbon and there was absolutely no difference. I returned it the next day (minus $5 they took for return shipping.. thanks alot.) Definitely skip this piece of junk.

This is a great buy when you catch it during a  price drop!  I got the 6 boxes for just over $7.00. Right now its up to $25.  Ridiculous.  Great product, but price fluctuations cause me to dock a point.

column9: Far and away, the best value for the money.
column10: I enjoy espresso so much that I probably drink around eight ounces a day.  I've tried more than a dozen different beans in the past year and even invested in a burr grinder under the assumption that surely, the best coffee will only come from that which is freshly ground (and preferrably recently roasted).I originally bought this coffee as an accident--again, I didn't want anything pre-ground.  The price was highly suspect as well--I'm used to paying around $10-18 for a good pound of coffee.What stuns me is that this has clearly become my favorite espresso.  I don't tire of the flavor and it doesn't taste bitter or harsh or acidic.Give the coffee a try.  I'll be pretty surprised if you don't believe it's the best $20 you ever spent on espresso.

I'm just getting into the routine of drinking coffee and this is by far one of the better products I have tried.  I originally bought this brand because I thought it was actual expresso (not an espresso coffee blend), but I'm glad I ordered it because it's an excellent morning pick me up.  Combine it with some heavy whipping cream and you're good to go.

For use on my espresso machine at home, I've tried various espresso coffees sold on Amazon.  Most have been very good.  And if doing a side-by-side taste comparison, a few of the past ones probably better than others.  But this one is noticeably the BEST.  Especially in drinking espressos, rather than lattes, etc., the coffee flavor on this blend is superb and the absence of any bitter taste is immediately noticeable.  For use in an espresso machine, this is the one!

like others i was sceptical about purchasing 4 packs of coffee i've never tried before. here is my impression, smooth, clean and very creamy.  i have a saeco espresso machine and was worried that the grind was too coarse. was not a problem to more finer ground coffee such as Illy or Lavazza. enjoy!

column9: Made this non-fan of "English breakfast tea", a fan!
column10: There is a lot of indifferent quality tea out there, and as a sometimes fan of Asian Green, White, and Oolong teas, I should have considered that before I decided that I didn't much like Assam ("English Breakfast Tea"), except as one ingredient in that heady, spicy tea blend called Chai.Okay, I'm wrong.  I just don't like "meh" teas, and even the expensive stuff sold in bookstores and "gourmet" stores can be pretty meh.  I take it that Ahmad Barooti Assam tea doesn't exactly position itself as an ultra-premium blend, and it does tastes pretty much like what any other English Breakfast or even Lipton Yellow Box tastes like -- only much, much sweeter and richer, with a depth of flavor unfamiliar to many of us in the U.S. who would hardly recognize something as tea if it doesn't come in a paper pocket with a tag stapled to it.For newbies to loose tea:  use an infuser.  Those tiny ones you have to pack to get any in there are of no use; tight packed tea resists water infusion.  Some pots have a ceramic infuser, or you could just live with a few leaves in the bottom of your cup -- they won't hurt you a bit.  I'm happy steeping this tea at a ratio of 2 tspns (3-4 grams) per pot, with my pot holding about 2.5 cups of water.As a side note, I'm also fascinated by all the translations to Arabic, Cyrillic (Russian) and what all on the box.  I know that this might reflect a bit of snobbery towards my own country, but I take it as a good endorsement when a tea product is loved in many nations, including the top tea-consuming ones.  (U.S.A. is more of a coffee country, although I'd say we are not picky enough about our coffee, either -- but that's another conversation.)Brook Bond (an Indian favorite) was my previous, and perfectly acceptable choice for Chai blending, but now I have (temporarily) set aside my spices and am enjoying Ahmad Barooti on it's own, or chilled with a splash of ginger syrup.  (Don't know where to refer you to get that; I make mine by whirring chopped ginger root in a blender with water and sugar.  It keeps fresh tasting for a long time, too, in the fridge.)Nice, nice stuff.  Buy loose tea.  Shop around.  And look for recommendations over trusting a fancy container or a fancy price.

column9: Easily the highest quality bagged teas on the market
column10: Mightly Leaf Tea should be considered in a class of it's own for tea.  The leaves and herbs used are extremely fresh.  When you open a plastic (not paper that breathes) pouch, you are immediately hit with the sweet aroma of fresh tea.  I have never smelled another tea bag that even comes close to the freshness.  Even most bulk teas are not packaged correctly or quick enough at the manufacturer to keep this much freshness in the tea.Mighty Leaf Tea is a bit more expensive than other organic tea, however the quality of the leaves and herbs is the highest.  Might Leaf Tea uses large pieces of leaves, herbs, and flowers - unlike most teas that use shreds of leaves.  Shredded tea oxidizes very quickly due to the increased surface area.  This results in tea that loses flavor and smell very quickly.Mighty leaf uses silk bags which have larger pores than paper bags.  This means that the water penetrates the tea bags more fully, allowing the newly tea-infused water to spread to the cup more quickly.  Brewing tea too long will create a bitter taste.  The problem with most paper tea bags is that infused tea water cannot spread quickly enough through the cup to create a bold, full flavor before the 3-5 brewing time has passed.  This means that either your tea is not full flavored or is bitter.  Mighty Leaf solves this problem by using silk bags.Each Mighty Leaf Tea bag is sealed in a plastic pouch.  Since plastic is less porous than paper, these pouches keep the tea and herbs fresher longer.There is nothing to not like about Mighty Leaf Tea.  I only wish that Mighty Leaf Tea started selling Tulsi tea and I would be in Heaven.Mighty Leaf Tea is clearly the creation of tea experts who appreciate the highest quality organic ingredients.  They have created a tea bag system that is far beyond what any other company has done.  Every type of tea that Mighty Leaf Tea offers tastes incredible.  So choose your favorite flavor and enjoy tea as it should be experienced - fresh, bold, and delicious.

I bought some of the "best" food on the market - even had to give him human tuna (in water) until he gained a little strength.  Found BFF Tuna & Bonito and it was love at first bite!  His feces are great.  It is grain- and carbo-free.  That made THE difference.Highly recommended.

My picky cat loves this brand of food, and it has helped with his colitis too. Because we go through a can a day, I mix the wet food with dry food in the bowl, and add some water. The cat thinks he is eating all canned food, but it makes the can last 2 days instead of one.

column9: This is the food to feed your cats
column10: I got a surprise kitten a few weeks ago and I had no idea what to do.  The person that gave me little Maurice recommended this for the wet food and Purina Pro Plan Selects Adult Cat Food, Natural Salmon and Brown Rice Formula, 7-Pound Bag for dry food. He Loves both. Maurice loves not just this flavor of wet food, but the Best Feline Friend Cat Food, Tuna & Salmon Soulmates Recipe, 3-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), Best Feline Friend Cat Food, Tuna & Shrimp Sweethearts Recipe, 3-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), and Best Feline Friend Cat Food, Tuna & Tilapia Twosome Recipe, 5.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 16) flavors.All these flavors are a big hit for my kitten, he eats as much as I put down for him and the vet said that he's the healthiest little guy he's seen in a while.All in all, buy the food, feed it to your cat, your cat will be thankful for a grain free delicious food and you'll be excited because it costs less than most of the canned food at petsmart!

My cats LOOVE bonito fish flakes! I buy a giant bag for cheap at the Asian grocery store, and give them some every so often as a treat. I was pretty psyched to see a cat food with bonito in it! They go nuts when I crack open one of these cans and put it down for them. I know this flavor is special because one of my cats usually doesn't care about wet food, but even she gets excited for this one!
We selected this cat food as it is grain free. Our cats love it and are so excited when they get this treat!

I have tasted several brands of barley tea.  All of the following were cold brewed, including the one I bought here.  One of them was a gift from Japan and wasn't roasted, so it wasn't bitter at all.  One of them was roasted and VERY bitter.  Another one was a mixture of lightly and deeply roasted and tasted okay (not very bitter).  This one I am reviewing however, is excellent in taste.  It isn't bitter at all, even after cold brewing for several days.  The package says it is gently roasted in small quantities.  That, plus the fact that it is organic, I believe is the reason it doesn't have the bitter taste.  If you don't like bitter drinks and want to drink barely tea, this is a great choice.

column9: Very Flavorful with a Hint of Spice
column10: We found this in a spice shop while on vacation.  Being the Maker's Mark lovers that we are, we couldn't resist buying a bottle.  My wife decided that she wanted to make barbeque chicken last night, but realized we were out of barbeque sauce, then she remembered that we had this sauce.  The chicken turned out wonderful.  This sauce has a slightly sweet flavor with a hint of spice.  This is a must try for the Maker's Mark lovers out there.  Well, I have to run, I'm off to buy a case of this sauce on the Web!

column9: Maker's Mark Bourbon Flavored Gourmet Sauce
column10: Bought this sauce for my son for Christmas.  He likes to try different bar-b-q type of sauces. Said this one was really good.

I bought this for my bf since he loves Maker's Mark.  He loved this sauce too, although the bottle is kind of small.  We marinated chicken in it and also used it to dip steak in.  It has a great flavor.  I need to buy more!
Mix this sauce 50-50 with catsup for a super topping for meatloaf. Not a sauce to cook with but can be added the last 5 mins. amd on the side. Amazing!!!!!!

I don't know what sauce several of the other reviewers are trying, but it is not the Maker's Mark Gourmet Sauce. This stuff is absolutely awesome. It is the only sauce I use. Great on beef, chicken, and don't even get me started on pork. Slightly sweet, but with plenty of kick from the spices. This absolutely blows away the competition.

I came in with the idea that the Beam Sauce was the best. In a blind taste test, including this Makers Mark sauce, all 6 of us picked the same winner...............it was.....................The Jack Daniels!
did not recieve on time and shipped to the wrong address. item was recieved a month + after the date it should have been and not in time for my boyfriend's birthday.
The are really good deli-franks. I am really impressed with the taste and the fact that everything in them is good for your and fat free. Getting the protein and veggies is great.

These deli franks are one of the greatest vegan products that I've tasted from Cedar Lake. They taste like real meat franks that I wouldn't be able to tell the difference if I haven't known they're vegan. That's what's great about eating this kind of food. I get to enjoy delicious food without worrying about my health. These franks are guaranteed to be filled with nutritious ingredients that are not artificial. It is an added bonus that they're also juicy!

This vegan deli-franks from Cedar Lake are to die for! I guess we all have our own opinion, but I really do like the taste and texture of these hotdogs. And if the meatless part is not enough to satisfy my vegan needs, they are also fat-free! This fact makes me enjoy eating them more because I don't have to feel worried about gaining some extra weight. There's really nothing that can beat a delish and nutritious combo meal!
I'm not really a vegan but I love these! They are a healthier choice compared to "real" hotdogs but their taste is still highly palatable. I find them perfect in the grill.

If you are a meat lover you might not like it as much, however this Cedar Lake Deli-Granks vegan can food is good news to vegetarians.  It's meatless and fat-free, plus it tastes pretty good.  Recommended!
I picked this bar up at the Amish Market in NYC.  The combination of dark chocolate and chili pepper is amazing.  I'm craving more!  It's one of the best chocolate bars I've ever tasted.

This is literally the best tasting chocolate bar I've ever had. My wife gave me a bar for our anniversary since I'm a big fan of dark chocolate. The hint of spiciness with the crunchy accent takes this morsel high above any other chocolaty treat.

column9: We love these in our house!
column10: I was first introduced the the Old El Paso Gordita Dinner Kits when I went over to a friend's for dinner back around 2000.  They made chicken they had cubed up added the seasoning etc.  They were fantastic! Since then have been regularly eating these and haven't regretted it one bit!To me the best part of the kit is that it comes with a creamy zesty ranch sauce packet which is tangy and pretty spicy but not too hot.  I even save the packet of the leftover sauce and use it for the next several days on things like nachos.  Yum!The next best part is the gordita shells themselves.  Nice and thick yet soft.  Make sure you warm them up in the microwave first to make them taste and feel better.  We usually throw them in the microwave between paper plates for about 80 seconds at between 30-50% power. Would like it if they were slightly bigger but for most people they are probably the perfect size.  The texture is great.  I always prefer soft shelled tacos and burritos over hard shell tacos, so if you prefer hard shell then this kit may not be for you or buy this in addition to hard shells and have some friends over ;)Sometimes we use ground beef; other times ground turkey; cubed chicken.  All taste great.  We probably have these once or twice a month (4 nights of food when you figure in leftovers) as buying 6 at a time is a commitment but we don't mind.  I think we used to get the 12 pack but then they weren't in stock for a while so we became sad until I recently did another search and came across the Pack of 6.*Another note if you want to save a step and some time:  The instructions say to brown the meat first then add water and the seasoning.  I skip the water and add the seasoning immediately to the meat in the beginning then brown the meat with the seasoning already on it.  I don't notice a difference.  Also recommend using a leaner ground beef to avoid a grease puddle at the bottom of your meat when you are done.

These are good. Old El Paso has always had good sauce and this kit makes life easy when I'm hungry and didn't remember to get all the stuff to make these big soft tacos. They are so easy and if I add a few of my own ingredients, they taste home made.

I used to purchase Old El paso Gordita Dinner kits all the time at my local grocery store, I was so disappointed when both local chains discontinued carrying them, they were so good and my kids really loved them. I was checking out the groceries on Amazon and was delightfully surprised to find them there! If your family enjoys soft tacos I highly recommend that you try the Gorditas, the shells are thicker than traditional soft taco shells they are really good, and the south western ranch sauce is awesome ! They are so easy to prepare and the price is very affordable.

These are simply awesome.  I was so excited to finally find them again.  Our local grocery store stopped carrying them and my husband has been bugging me almost weekly about having gorditas.  The sauces are simply the best!  These are by far better than the gorditas you get at any mexican restaurant.

My previous second flush non organic darjeeling which this purchase intended to replace was way way better in every sense at a much lower price.

I experimented with more than 10 places on Amazon for Darjeeling first flush and settled with Tao of Tea. Highly recommend for the price. I have been drinking this tea for more than one year. Decent quality for the price. The down side is that the tea seems to be not from any single tea estate and therefore the quality varies from batch to batch.

Nothing compares to first flush Darjeeling which fills the room with its aroma. Unfortunately the tea does not survive very long, no matter how well it is packed and sealed. The freshness lasts no more than a couple of months. I know, I've bought it direct from the Makaibari estate in Darjeeling on a visit there.This is the best first flush Darjeeling you can get online or from any local store outside India. It's almost there, not quite. The container is great, with two lids protecting the tea, you can use it later to store tea from other sources that comes in paper cartons.

I recommend it everyone who likes to have first flush taste ...  not strong at all, spring tea in mind ...Their service is very good , shipment and packing, all the good for us ...We are going to continue to buy the tea...

After trying a few other options, I found these, and will be buying them as long as the price remains reasonable.  They may be a little wet, but they roast evenly, and you can buy with confidence.

column9: Not at all what I thought
column10: So Amazon suggested this as an alternative to Crawford Garibaldi biscuits.  Being how I am in search of a suitable replacement for the old Sunshine raisin biscuits, I figured I'd give 'em a try.  What a mistake.  Not only they are nothing like the Sunshines, they are nothing like the Garibaldis either.  The pictures on the package are quite misleading, suggesting that there is actual fruit to be found inside the biscuits.  Not so.  Yeah, there's a couple of raisin specks in each biscuit, but if you didn't already know that you'd be hard-pressed to figure out what kind of fruit it was supposed to represent.  On the upside? You probably won't find them very treat-like unless you long for dried out wafers with vaguely representational fruit-specks in them.  Get the Garibaldis instead. I think the FDA should classify these things as illegal drugs.  They're so darn good that I can't even have them in the house (I haven't bought them from this vendor (and I won't comment on the price), so I'm just talking about the Golden Double Stuff Oreos, themselves).  While I was binging on them, I'd force myself to eat "only" one "line" of 11 cookies a day (there are 3 convenient "lines" in each pack and that re-sealable flap on the front is great for easy access while keeping them fresh during their short existence in my vicinity).  Even so, as I continued to shovel them in, I'd sit there moaning about how my liver and pancreas were hurting, my teeth and tongue were coated with fur, and my eyes were jiggling around in their sockets.  Sometimes, some crumbs would fall out of my mouth while I was complaining and I'd have to root around for the errant pieces like a pig looking for truffles.Now, given their ingredients:"UNBLEACHED ENRICHED FLOUR (WHEAT FLOUR, NIACIN, REDUCED IRON, THIAMINE MONONITRATE [VITAMIN B1], RIBOFLAVIN [VITAMIN B2], FOLIC ACID), SUGAR, HIGH OLEIC CANOLA AND/OR PALM OIL, DEXTROSE, HIGH FRUCTOSE CORN SYRUP, CORNSTARCH, SALT, BAKING SODA, NATURAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOR, SOY LECITHIN. CONTAINS WHEAT, SOY."You might do as I did and say, "Heck, they're not that bad.  After all, I can pronounce (and even recognize) most of those things."  But, according to the label, the Serving Size is two (hah!) cookies.  Those two cookies contain 150 calories and 7 grams of fat.  Plugging that into the old Weight Watcher's point formula gives 3 points per 2 cookies.  Four cookies is, essentially, a full meal.  The 11 cookie "line" I was eating was the equivalent of 2/3 of my daily point allotment.  Of course, with the pain in my liver and fur on my tongue, I really didn't feel any desire for any actual meals.  So, I guess the points evened out in the end.Anyway, I've banned them from the house (I've been Oreo free for maybe a month, now).  I still have to force myself to not go down the cookie aisle, though.  And, if I do succumb and enter the aisle, I stand there and stare at the package with a mournful, puppy-dog look on my face while I yell at myself (on the inside) to just walk away.  So, I rate these at an absolutely wonderful, perfect, yummy, delicious, etc. 5 stars out of 5 and wish they were illegal.  Darn, they're good.  A 6-pack, hmmm....

I have traveled the world of earl grey tea varieties and there are many good ones (and even more bad).  However, I have never had a tea that registered near perfection like this one.  I have been sipping this tea for nearly a decade and it is absolutely outstanding (and had fantastic experiences ordering it through Amazon).  I highly recommend it.  I do always warn folks to avoid tea bag teas in general since they are mostly created using the lowest quality tea leaves ("tea dust"), so invest in a tea stick (Google it) and enjoy loose leaf varieties so you can have a cup of tea at it's highest quality.  For what it is worth, never allow the tea leaves to sit in your hot water for more than three minutes (less than half that time for a cup rather than a tea pot full).  Enjoy!

After the demise of the Williamson & Magor brand,I've been on the hunt for a replacement earl Grey tea. Today my quest has ended! Taylors of Harrogate loose leaf earl Grey is made from full tea leaves not bits and dust. Most importantly, they use "REAL" oil of bergamot,the ingredient that makes an earl Grey tea well,earl Grey tea. Nowadays, Many manufacturers are replacing it with an artificial flavoring that may smell similar, but quickly loses it's taste when heated and becomes VERY,VERY bitter if steeped for more than 3min. This Taylors of Harrogate loose leaf earl Grey tea is extremely aromatic and it's floral/citrus notes from genuine bergamot oil is unsurpassed, flavorful, and very forgiving if over steeped! I Would give it ten stars if I could! High quality product.

This was the best Earl Grey Leaf Tea I have ever had.  A delightful aroma of the bergomot and a nice cup of tea to enjoy while reading.  This is unlike any prepackaged Earl Grey tea, it is more subtle and enjoyable.  Truely a great cut of tea can be brewed from the Earl Grey Leaf Tea.
hands down this is the best Earl Grey tea available. We've tried many, and this is the one. Go with subscribe and save and save a bundle.

This is Earl Grey tea with NATURAL oil of bergamot not the synthetic oil of bergamot that most other Earl Grey teas have. And when you compare the taste between the two, you'll see there's a significant difference. This is really fabulous tea.

column9: The best Earl Grey out there!

I have been drinking Earl Grey for over 30 years and sadly watched the demise of my favored vendors one by one.  After the last disappearance, I tried the Taylors on the basis of the reviews.  Disappointment is not the right word. It smelled strange out of the box, and after brewing it properly discovered that it bore no resemblance to the dozens of different Earl Grey experiences I have had.  It is heavily dominated by the peaty nature of the Chinese black tea base (almost an Oolong) and the bergamot is barely detectable.  Unique, but not what I want.  De gustibus non disputandem.

This does not have the strongest Bergomot odor of all Earl Grey teas I have tried, but it does have the strongest Bergomot taste.  It is not as balanced as Bigelow's, and not weak like Twining's Bergomot.  It covers up all the tea taste, you can't tell what kind of tea it is.  It is economical to use, since you have to use less. I love Bergomot aroma, but I'm not this partial to its flavor.  Others have complainted of heavy Bergomot in Rishi's Earl Grey, but although its odor is extemely powerful, its it does have some tea flavor.This is good to mix with plain tea to introduce Bergomot taste.

column9: You Can See and Taste the Difference!
column10: Do you know what's inside your tea bag? Brands of tea that you buy in a supermarket usually have tea bags that you can't see through. Cut one open- what you'll find are crushed and powdered tea leaves that are meant to brew your cup of tea quickly- normally 15 to 30 seconds.If you buy loose tea you'll be getting whole tea leaves- leaves that take longer to "open" and brew, but which normally produce a tea that is a better quality and which tastes better.Might Leaf tea bags come individually sealed in see-through cellophane packets. The tea bags themselves are made of see-through thin woven silk, and inside are tea leaves that are a lot closer to loose tea than anything else you've seen in a bag. You have the convenience of a tea bag with the quality (almost!) of loose tea. If you're not ready for loose tea yet, try Mighty Leaf teas. Yes, they cost more than usual tea bags, but you'll be very pleased with the tea they make. If you like white tea, their White Orchard tea gives you an aromatic, mild, flavorful light-colored cup of tea. You can re-steep the tea bags 2 or 3 times, and if you do that the price per cup becomes very affordable.I used to laugh at the Great Depression stories of my relatives hanging up tea bags to dry on a clothes line. Most of us don't have clothes lines any more, but these tea bags are worth saving and using again!

column9: Delicious and fresh with a sweet apple taste
column10: Celestial Seasonings seems to have cornered the market on good chamomile tea. I've tried a few others out there--this one consistently has a fresh, slightly sweet flavor that others lack. Their quality control is obviosuly good; I've never had a cup of this tea that was rancid or flat.

We also put a couple of tea bags in our bath water for a soothing chamolmile tea soak.It has a flowery/grassy flavor and is best a wee bit sweetened.  It is one of the best tasting chamomile teas we have tried.Used in moderation it is not dangerous to your health and is a long-standing, respected herb in natural medicine.People with severe hay fever may not tolerate this tea very well, but it doesn't affect me and I have WRETCHED allergies and all season hay fever.

I have been purchasing this tea locally for a couple years now, but I think I will order in bulk online now.I have mild cases of tourettes syndrome and crohn's disease, and chamomile has helped me to cope better with both.  I discovered by accident that my tourettes symptoms were noticeably lessened when I drink chamomile regularly, and although I am no neurologist, I suspect that some of the herbs help stabilize the erratic nerve impulse loops that are so common to those afflicted with the disorder.  I have also concluded that the calmed nerves were not simply the result of drinking a warm drink.  I have experimented with a number of other teas and drinks, both caffeinated and non-caffeinated, and although they relax me, they don't help as much as chamomile.As far as crohn's goes, regulating the diet and eating frequency are very important, but chamomile helps to calm nerves and all kinds of tissue.  It isn't a pain reliever, but it definitely helps.ZEN NOTE: I also discovered by accident that I can achieve a sort of zen state by adding a small pinch of caffeine powder to a big cup of chamomile, and after some research, I think I discovered why (on a vary basic level): they affect different parts of the body; it is not a simple matter of chamomile calms you down and caffeine spins you up.  According to the wikipedia page on caffeine, caffeine is structurally similar to adenosine, a molecule that, in the brain, will protect the organ by inhibiting neural activity and increasing blood flow under certain circumstances.  Caffeine, being structurally similar, will block the brain's adenosine receptors for a time but will not cause the same effects once there.  It just sits there, and neural activity stays high.  Chamomile's herbal properties, for reasons unknown to me, stabilizes nerves and thus calms all kinds of tissues.  Combine caffeine and chamomile to create a drink that calms the nerves and yet maintains a high level of neural activity.It is quite pleasant.

I had heard of people not caring for the last few drops of a warmed can, so I figured that it would be best to drink it before it had the opportunity to warm up.  What a great decision that was!  Shortly afterwards I felt a burst of energy surge through my body and I was more productive then I have ever been in my life.  Normally I would take a 8:30am nap at work, but not today.  Was was ready to work and to get everything completed in a orderly fashion.  However, a problem soon surfaced as there was no more work to do for a few hours and I had all this energy to burn off.I highly recommend this product and would suggest that everyone purchase as much as you can.  This drink will change your life and make you complete all of your activities with ease.

I have a 10 yr old & a 7 yr old dog. The 10 yr old will eat anything, the 7 yr old is extremely picky & has a delicate stomach. We were using brands of dog food you find in the grocery store until a trainer opened our eyes to the difference in qualities of dog food & the effect it can have on behavior as well as overall health. There are 2 websites we checked before we chose Premium Edge Healthy Weight II, one was  the Whole Dog Journal 2010 Approved Food List ([...]),the other was Dog Food Analysis ([...]). On both websites this food is recommended. Both dogs absolutely LOVE this food & I feel so much better knowing that they are getting quality food.

It's really important to me to feed my pets quality food.  My first dog had severe allergies to food, and all of the vets we took her to caught that.  She had terrible skin rashes, raw hot spots, and constant ear infections--all of which are indications that she had food allergies.  I wish I had had the Internet back then so I could have saved her life.  She eventually ended up getting stomach cancer and dying at the very young age of five.  I truly believe that if we had switched her to a quality food, she could have lived a longer, happier life. It was an important lesson for me to learn, and I will never feed any of my animals sub-par food ever again.I have had my current dog on Natural Balance Ultra Premium as well as Solid Gold Hund n Flocken.  Both of those foods are of good quality, but are also very pricey.  If you would like to do your own research on different food options and brands, [...]and [...]are great sites.Natural Balance, Solid Gold, and Premium Edge have all received 4-star ratings at dog food analysis.  The biggest issue with Premium Edge (and all of Diamond foods--including NB and SG) was the fact that there weren't any written guarantees that they did not use Ethoxyuin as a preservative.  I emailed Diamond foods, and received an email stating that they and their suppliers no longer use Ethoxyquin as a preservative.I'm really impressed with Premium Edge.  It is a good quality food and it comes at a much better price for me (on top of being significantly cheaper, the bags are 35lbs as opposed to NB and SG's 33lb. bags).  The final selling point for me is that my dog really LOVES her food now.  With both previous brands, she would eat half of her food and then walk away and eat the rest of it later when she got hungry enough.  With Premium Edge Skin and Coat, she scarfs everything down right away.  She even BEGS me to feed her in the morning and evening now.All in all, I'm really happy with my choice to switch to Premium Edge.  It's an affordable, good quality dog food, and my dog LOVES it!  I highly recommend giving it a try.  :)

column9: Superb, top of the line dry dog food
column10: I got this bag just today. It arrived promptly in a giant box. Opened the box & the bag had no tears, scuffs, or any damage. Perfect condition. I have two Labrador retrievers who, in the past, have suffered with ear and skin allergies.We want the best for our dogs, and Premium Edge is the answer. Their coats have never looked better, and they seem to love Premium Edge Dry Dog Food, skin and coat formula salmon, potatoes and vegetables.

I have used Premium Edge Lamb Formula dry dog food for years.  While many dog food manufacturers use real lamb - and not lamb meal - in their adult formulas, this is the ONLY manufacturer that uses real lamb in its Puppy Formula as well.  Hounds have sensitive stomaches and lamb digests best without upsetting their stomaches.  It also promotes a shiny, healthy coat while minimizing shedding and flakey skin conditions that are experienced by some breeds.  The food nuggets are small in size and appropriate for all breeds and sizes of dogs; the nutritional values are the highest or on level with that of many so-called "premium" brands - and better than that of some.  I have fed Premium Edge Lamb - both adult and puppy - to my Salukis for 12 years and heartily recommend it.  Read the order of ingredients in your pet's food; they are listed in the order of most to least included in the product.
