column9: Stevia DOES have some bad side effects!
column10: I've always heard that Stevia has been used for hundreds of years with no ill side effects, so I was very interested to try it... especially when I started making my own yogurt, and would do anything to get my toddler to eat it! I did some research and found that the SweetLeaf brand was supposed to be the best, as far as extraction methods and experience. I got a bottle of the Vanilla Creme, and also the plain, and added it to our yogurt. It was fantastic! We all loved it, and the toddler begged for more. I was so relieved to have found a great way to reduce the sugar in our diets and still have such a great sweet taste. It was perfect, I was happy. But then, strange symptoms started to surface. At first I got headaches, which became increasingly severe, and then backaches that felt like spinal 'brain freeze' (when you eat something too cold too fast.) It didn't occur to me at first that it could be at all related to the new Stevia. Then my toddler started telling me he was itchy all over. Then I got my menstrual cycle 2 weeks early. Finally it dawned on me that it could be related to the Stevia since this was the only thing at all that had changed in our diets. I googled 'adverse reactions to Stevia' and found several webpages where people described symptoms identical to mine. I was truly shocked. I stopped the Stevia... all the symptoms went away almost immediately. I realize now that there is a difference between the flavored liquid Stevia, which contains a 'proprietary blend' and 'natural flavors' (which could mean anything) and just the straight powder with nothing added (I haven't tried that, but won't now.) It also occurs to me that maybe the only Stevia that can truly be considered historically safe is the actual leaf itself, straight off the plant out of the garden. I still believe Stevia's safety record in the countries where it originated, but I think something has probably been lost in translation with the processing of it here in the US. Just my opinion. It should also be noted that anyone with allergies to ragweed should not take Stevia because it can cause asthma attacks. Hope this helps someone.

Love this product. The liquid stevias are great. They are economical, easy to use, and help me keep my sugar intake down. What I really love about them the most is that unlike the powdered stevia, there is very little aftertaste. This is my favorite flavor of all the flavors and the one I find myself using most often. I was never able to use Stevia by itself before because of the aftertaste but that all changed with the flavored liquid stevias. I can comfortably just add this Vanilla Creme stevia for any sweetening I need and it does the job well. Just love it.

We've enjoyed all of the SweetLeaf liquid stevia's we've tried, but we really love the Vanilla Creme! It seems to go well with coffee or hot chocolate, and adds a gentle touch of Vanilla to other beverages like Chai tea, or on home made ice cream or with a bowl of fruit.

Being diabetic I find these products to give me once again the pleasure of enjoying beverages that do not run my blood sugar up.  The great thing about this product is that it is all natural and not a cocktail of non natural chemical mixes.
I have about ten different flavors and I particularly like it to flavor my water, but I think it's good in oatmeal and smoothies,etc.  Well worth the price!

I've been using stevia for a few years, but just ordered my first bottle of flavored stevia.  I love it and want to try more flavors!!With the powder, it's easy to use too much, but I always have to use nearly a dropper-full of the liquid for it to be sweet enough for my taste.

The Flavored Liquid Stevia in Vanilla Creme is THE BEST I have ever tried. It's so good!  This tastes great in coffee, and in smoothies. I blend frozen strawberries in the blender with a little fat-free milk, a few TBSP of water and this vanilla creme Stevia and it's amazing!!!  Some flavors I have tried have been bitter, but not this one. It's delicious!!!! It's also a great value here for around $15. for '2' bottles. If you find this in many health food stores, it's close to that price for 1 bottle. Good product, good value.

Unbelievable taste and health benefits in one little dropper.  Add to Seltzer and soy creamer for an Italian Cream Soda to die for!  Best of all, Stevia helps balance your blood sugar, so it satisfies your sweet tooth and eases low blood sugar all at once.

column9: The most pallatable stevia to date
column10: When I was told I was insulin resistent, I knew I had to give up using sugar, especially in my coffee.  I tried a few stevia packets from different companies but hated the taste, or aftertaste these left.  They altered the taste of the coffee beyond the point of enjoying the drink.  Then someone brought me a liquid form of stevia and it was decidedly better than the granules.  I still wasn't totally satisfied, but I was making do.  One day I went into a health boutique where I discovered the SweetLeaf Liquid Stevia with vanilla and finally coffee tastes like coffee again!

column9: Wonderful stuff!  So glad Sweetleaf came up with this!!
column10: I've been using flavored stevia drops for several years now and don't know what I would do without them.  All the flavors are good but the vanilla creme is an all around winner so if you can only afford to try one flavor this one might be your best bet.  Don't be discouraged by the seemingly high price - one of these little bottles will last a very long time plus you're getting pure high quality ingredients, nothing to damage your health like with sugar and artificial sweeteners.  I find I like stevia better to sweeten cold things than I do hot things.  I personally like about eight drops in a large (8 - 10 oz) tumbler of cold seltzer water that I make using the Isi soda siphon ISI Soda Siphons.  Sometimes I add dry milk powder for a low calorie treat that mocks an ice cream soda.  Sounds odd but it's very good actually.  Now if only Sweetleaf would come out with ginger flavored drops I could make my fav soft drink - ginger ale!!!!
This is an excellent Product. A great alternative to artificial sweeteners. I came across this product after I discovered I was allergic to artificial sweeteners. I have been using it ever since.

The great thing about liquid stevia is that it lacks that "chemical taste" (even though stevia is an all natural-no chemical product) that powdered stevia has. I tried Sweet Leaf vanilla stevia at my friend's house in my tea and the vanilla flavor is wonderful! The best part is that stevia is something like 200 times sweeter than sugar and contains NO calories (not to mention no harmful chemicals), so it only takes about 5 drops to sweeten an entire cup of tea! Highly recommended!

column9: Delicious and fresh but, caution is advised...
column10: Firstly, google the health benefits of fungreek [they are numerous].Secondly, fenugreek is one of those spices that you cannot deal with like other spices. These little seeds are hard as rocks and unless you want to ruin your spice-grinder, I'd highly recommend you follow my procedure for using fenugreek:Well, to begin, fenugreek is actually a legume (so, if you are prone to gastro problems with beans and legumes then you might want to take a beano or equivalent supplement before ingesting fenugreek).If you want the benefits of raw fenugreek seeds. Put 1/4 cup of fenugreek seeds in a 2 cup or so capacity container and add 1/2 cup boiling water and let steep for an hour, place steeped fenugreek covered in fridge overnight and you will have some lovely, slightly chewy, less bitter fenugreek that you can add to soups and stews or eaten by the spoonful as a health supplement. One thing you will notice, is, when you add hot water to fenugreek, they will not only soften, but, they will sprout out little tail-buds which makes them sort of mid-sprout and highly digestible.If you want to fully sprout fenugreek, you can google for many techniques.If you only want to sprout this fenugreek, I'd say this is highly sproutable since even adding boiling water to the seeds did not stop them from sprouting little sprout ends.Warning: If you 'toast' fenugreek it will stink up your house to high hell and it takes days and days to get the odor out of your house and if you are planning on selling your home, you do NOT want to toast fenugreek!Anyway, my husband hates fenugreek and I love it with a passion. I think fenugreek is one of those love or hate spices.In closing, this fenugreek is very high quality, fresh and definitely sproutable!Happy fenugreeking! lol

I have been searching for a high quality fenugreek for a while now, for a specialty Indian dish that I make, and this is absolutely amazing! It smells so wonderful, and is packaged very nicely. The spice is fresh, and I don't know how I'll every use it all, there is so much, But I will happily try!

This is impressive fenugreek! Item arrived very quickly, bulk bags were in good condition and the fenugreek itself was among the best I've encountered. Really delicious! In fact, so good I find myself having a cup of warm fenugreek tea without anything else added...something I've never enjoyed before but the flavor of this is wonderful.Wonderful for flavoring especially if you like to avoid the heavy chemicals of bullion etc...for other uses (ie, lactating women), I'd go with the organic variety instead. In fact, now that I know the quality of this fenugreek seed, my next purchase will be organic from the same company. Delicious, very nice price and fast shipping.

I do not recommend this product , I had bought it to sprout,  out of whole cup full of seeds I only got 4 shoots of sprouts , I tried cup full 3 times , that means they have pretreated this with some chemical to give it self life or its GMO, if you wish to find out true quality of any seeds you buy sprout  some of it , if it sprouts well then you know they have not been messed with in lab , if they do not sprout means nutritional value has been taken out by some form of pretreatment , this was disappointment

This is not a good quality seeds. Amazon should check its quality before shipping to customers. Seeds do not germinate at all and taste is different than other fenugreek seeds. I do not recommend this product.

The seeds look fresh and clean. It's a good value for the price. But for me it's not a good buy for the reason that it doesn't meet with my purpose.I bought these seeds for sprout because other reviews said it's good for sprout. But I use 2 cups seeds for sprouting according to  general seeds sprouting instructions and only 4 to 5 seeds grow. While I use the same sprouting technique to sprout mung bean seeds, they grow well. So I think maybe the seeds are not good for sprout.So I give it 3 stars.

column9: oops I reviewed the wrong brand!
column10: I'd been devastated when, recently, my favorite brand fennugreek seeds (which i use only for sprouts) began having 15% "HARD" (i.e., wouldn't soften even with 24 hours of soaking) seeds.  I've switched to Starwest and find they have had 0% hard seeds and sprouted to 1/2 inch sprouts after soaking 24 and then growing 24 hours.  Very gratifying.  Have them every day!

column9: Large amount for a good price
column10: When I compared the price of this item with the others on amazon I found out that this one has the largest amount for a low price so I ordered it.  then, when I tried it I found that it tastes so good and has a strong smell.

I bought fenugreek seeds as a nursing supplement, because this way it was much cheaper than buying any nursing tea out there.  I've been using them for a few months now, and have been able to exclusively breastfeed my baby.  I steep a teaspoon of seeds 2-4 times and drink throughout the day.  when the seeds become soft, i munch on them, too.  In the beginning the tea and seeds tasted pretty bitter to me, but in a few days i got used to the taste, and now i enjoy it, especially when adding raw honey

I bought these seeds for sprouting, as I assumed they would sprout. After 4 days it was apparent that they will not, and are dead. I bought an alternate brand advertised as sprouting seeds, and after 2 days, they were growing.

I must say even though I really like Frontier products this one really disappointed me. Maybe there was an issue with this particular stock the thing is that any of the seeds from the bags sprouted. I will keep buying spices and other products from this company but I will certainly pay more attention to the reviews of their sprouts before thinking about buying any from them.

used this for fenugreek tea for breastfeeding milk production. I never had a problem with milk production while using this like I did with my last child. Just let 1Tbsp. sit in a glass of water overnight, remove the seeds and drink the "tea" (tasted better warmed up and with a little honey). This and a lactation cookie every now and then and I was able to breastfeed my youngest son for 9 months now when I ran out of milk at 6 months with my middle child.

column9: Much better than corn starch for gluten-free cooking.
column10: Many gluten-free baking recipes call for arrowroot, which is hard to find in health food stores.  (I'm in Austin, Texas. ?)  Anyway, this is incredibly cheap--it's a tenth the price of some suppliers.When to use this:  in any recipe where you would use wheat flour for a thickener, like soup, sauce, gravy or pudding.Why to use it:  your alternative is corn starch, which can be shiny and tastes like corn.(Imagine vanilla pudding that tastes like corn.)  Arrowroot isn't as gluey as corn starch, and doesn't thicken as well, but it won't overwhelm other flavors.  (Imagine chocolate pudding that tastes like corn.)
This product was excellent, the response quick, and the price extremely reasonable. I highly recommend using this company if you need a sizeable supply of product.
This is a great binder similar to cornflour and I had very good results when I made fish chops with this product.
Thanks for the large container of arrowroot.  It is also a better price than I canget at our local health food store.

i purchased a jar of arrowroot from you and i use it in all my cooking when only for myself. the main purpose of arrowroot is to thicken gravy or other sauces but can be used as a seasoning for other foods if used in small amount. i would recomend it for those who want to spice up their cooking.

Roasted red pepper seems to be an unknown culinary item to many of us but adds a unique flavor to salads and seemingly everything else. I add these strips to egg omelettes, sandwiches and sometimes soups. It's a magic ingredient like capers that we should use more of. The label says "Product of Turkey" which is good news to me and I have had previous experience with the Roland brand which I like. I ordered a four (4) pack via Amazon Subscribe & Save last year and just received my second pack last week. The only reason I'm going with a 4-Star rating is that this order arrived with slightly dented cans. The product is still completely usable and the price was right regardless. I did submit packaging feedback and hope this will not happen again. This shipment moved via USPS here to Hawaii so substantial extra handling likely happened. Since I'm the first reviewer, and if you haven't used Roasted Red Pepper before, try it in your next recipe or preparation. If it's a go order these in bulk.  John

column10: red pepper strips have  very good taste, though i wold like them firmer.one thing though is irritating, it's black skins  here and there left uncleanedafter fire roasting. otherwise,.it's very good.
Good price and an OK product but not the flavor or color equal of others. They are a little yellowish and the taste is just OK. Not in the same class as Cento.

Absolutely amazing, gives a weird little loop to traditional cocktails like the Manhattan and makes a really, really deep complex champagne cocktail.  A wonderful note to add to recreating the classic era of cocktails.

Man do I love these rhubarb bitters!  I went though my first bottle in a month & plan on venturing into some more flavors soon.  I plan on experimenting more with the rhubarb, but for now, it's hard to beat a splash of Fee Brother's rhubarb bitters, a few fingers of bourbon and Blenheim's spicy hot ginger beer (the one with the pink bottle cap). on ice.  Spectacular!
I made a drink using Aperol, which contains Rhubarb, and this bitter. It really brought out the Rhubarb flavor without overwhelming the drink.

column9: Of all the 5-star Fee Bros bitters, these are my favorite.
column10: I drink a lot of whiskey and soda water, and there are no bitters I would rather put in 'em than these ones. Best bitters ever. (Still buy more flavors, though, because they're all fantastic.)

Our dog is a very strong chewer and we are always looking for something that is safe for her to chew, but will keep her interest for extended time. Tried the reindeer antlers and she enjoys them, but once they have been chewed on she loses interest. Not so with the moose chew.  She chews on it until she gets tired.  There have been no sharp edges or shards to injure her. I bought a 2-pack to try and the first one has lasted a few days now.They are expensive compared to rawhide or pig ears, etc.  But it has held her interest longer than nylabones. Haven't seen any bad digestive reactions so far.
The bones were just as described.. the dogs loved them! The small were very small next time i'll order the larger ones!

I gave the two pieces of antler to a friend's two pitbulls and he said they had devoured them in about two hours. For the price, it was a waste of money. I guess if someone had a smaller dog it would be worth it, but the dogs in my arena are big dogs and bigger chewers and the antlers didn't last half a day. I won't spend money on antlers again. I will try to find someone who goes hunting and will give them to me for free. Nice idea though.

column4: A person who likes to read
column10: Both of my dogs love these antlers and they are much cheaper than other antlers available through amazon.  My doggies love that they can easily get to the marrow, but perhaps because of this, these don't last as other antlers.  On the other hand these hold the dogs attention longer than other antlers.  I am extremely happy with this product and will continue to order them.
My 5yr old Border Collie mix and 9mo old American Bulldog mix LOVE them, more than the deer antlers.  Last a long time and they chew on them for hours.  Much safer than rawhide!

I was buying these at the pet store for $20 EACH, with this deal you get two for that price.  I ordered the largest size possible because I know my corgis like to chew the heck out of these.  They love these.  I've discovered they prefer the flat ones to the rounded type.  One that was sent in this deal was just a little curved, which makes it harder for their stumpy legs to hold while chewing, so they "argue" over who gets the un-bent one!  If I hold the crooked one then they will chew it but they definitely like the flatter one best!  A very good value if your dogs are chewers!!!
Bought the largest size and hoping it was the size it said on the description it was not , half the thickness easy if not smaller , not what I paid for

I got this for my 80 lbs german shepherd mix. Unfortunately he doesn't like it, but the 5lbs chihuahua does!The big one goes through rawhide quickly so I thought this might slow him down a bit, but no luck. He gives it a lick once in a while, but doesn't want anything to do with it most of the time. The chihuahua loves it, but it's way too big for him so he just chews on the corners.

column9: Dogs loved it, but it goes quick
column10: My dogs LOVED these, but they didn't last as long as I was hoping. My lab mix has had hers for about 2 hours and it's 2/3 gone. I'm going to do some research and see if there are other antlers that are a bit denser as these are a little pricey to go that quick. However, if you're dog isn't a destructive little beast like mine is, then you're fine :)

These moose antlers are a great natural treat for my small dogs. I bought the first antler piece because my trainer recommended  it as a preservative-free product. The pieces I purchased through Amazon are small but for little dogs like my 7 month old Chihuahuas they will last a long time. I prefer these over bully sticks or rawhides because they do not cause any tummy upset or difficulties with the pups' stool. For small dogs like mine, just a few minutes with a bully stick today means a rumbling tummy tomorrow. When I first introduced the antler piece, the female barked at it and ran away. The male immediately took to it so his sister had to give it a try. Now she loves them as much as he does. They will sit or down or just about anything to get their antler. Another plus is that I will let them bring the antler onto my lap! Not so with a slimy bully sticks.

I was very excited to purchase these antlers for my dogs. I am always searching for new natural yet different chew options for my dogs. I was very disappointed when the antlers lasted no more than 15 mins for each dogs. Maybe these are better for x-small to medium dogs.
