I have a 12-year-old and 2-year-old dog that are VERY food/treat/chew motivated.  I was so glad to find these as it fit all of my requirements on natural/no antibiotics/USA, etc. etc.  Since neither have ever turned down a treat or chew, I was shocked when they walked away.  For two days I've tried to get them interested. Nothing.  Took them to a neighbor whose dog also walked away, and then to a friend whose dog did the same thing.  Wish I could give it zero stars, but review has to show at least one.

column9: Same fruit every month for three months
column10: I ordered this for my parents and each month they received oranges.  Three months worth of nothing but oranges (yes there were sometimes different varieties, but REALLY?!?!), and for this amount of money!  Not a nice gift at all.  Nothing interesting, nothing exotic, just oranges.  Very disappointing and embarrassing to be the giver of this gift.

I fell in love with this dressing while on vacation in MT. All I can say is that it is the best dressing I have ever tasted. I love to use it in a salad of baby greens, dried cranberries, almonds, goat cheese and maybe some chicken. It is so good!

column9: Wild Huckleberry Fat Free Vinaigrette is ABSOLUTELY the BEST I have tried!
column10: I love a good vinaigrette, and this one is the BEST huckleberry I have EVER tried! It's bursting with flavor (and real huckleberries!) You would never know it's fat free! It's not only perfect for salads, but I have mixed it with a little olive oil and dipped my sour dough bread in it...mmmmm!!! The ONLY negative...it's not easy to find!

column9: Love These, Probably Even More Than Other Gummies I Have Tried...
column10: I have tried the Albanese 12 Flavor Assorted Gummi Bears, Fat Free, 5-Pound Bags (Pack of 2) and the Haribo Gummi Candy, Original Gold-Bears, 5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) - they both have their pros and cons, when compared to each other.  Reviewing them here is beside the point... I only mention both Gummies, because of their popularity, and to help compare this gummi to them.The Albanese gummies I have eaten were very soft and flavorful, while the Haribo gummies were more stiff and not as juicy in flavor.  When I tried the Haribo gummies, I found an upside to them being more stiff and less juicy - they actually felt a bit healthier to eat.  If anyone understands that?  There are just some foods that you eat, and afterwards you can just feel how unhealthy it was for your body.  -.-;  Thankfully I have yet to get that feeling with these gummies.Anyway this gummi is between both of the mentioned gummies for softness - not on the extremely soft side (Albanese), and not too stiff (Haribo).  It provides you with a firm bite, yet a soft, gummi chewing experience.  Do not expect these to have as much flavor as their other (Albanese) gummi bear friends.  As another reviewer pointed out, they are not extremely juicy in raspberry flavor (like Haribo); I do not mind, so I am still giving them all five stars instead of four.No sewage smell, no negative smell at all.  Both 5lb bags were packed in clear bags, and then packed together in one of those green bags to help preserve freshness, and also to deter them from picking up any unwanted smells during transition - worked great!I hope you enjoy these gummi treats as much as I am!  I have already subscribed to them, as I am just one of those people who like chewing on something gummi.
BEWAREI opened the bag and tried one. Had to spit it out - tasted like sewage. I smelled bag and the odor is horrible. I am wondering if these were in a flood. I would not recommend.

column9: Not bad, funny smell and taste when first opened.
column10: These had a distinct medicine smell to them when I first opened the bag, it dissipated after a day or two so I'm assuming it is tied to some sort of preservative agent used when packing them.

column9: A Subtle, Not Too Sweet Flavor
column10: If you don't like your gummies too sweet, these might be for you -but beware the raspberry flavor isn't very intense either.  They have a nice soft texture and a decent overall flavor:  I would order them again if there weren't any better options out there. 3.75 Stars.
Maybe the other guy got a bad batch, but these are delicious -- they taste like Jello.  The texture is nice, too, maybe a touch softer than gummy bears.

column9: Not bad for what I paid
column10: Not sure if the first reviewer got a bad batch or what, but these dont taste like they came from the sewer. Haribo makes better tasting candy by far, but if you can find these on sale theyre not a bad deal at all.

This is a really good tea.  Even though doctors say don't give any water to babies under 4 month I gave my first daughter this drink since 1 month.  She was very gassy and this drink helped her a little.  Sometimes I was given it to her instead of water and she loved it.  They also have other flavors too.  Highly recommended.

My son is almost 5 months old and he's been drinking this tea once a day since he was 3 months. It is the only thing that has helped with his tummy issues. Almost since birth he's had fussiness, gas, rock hard stomach and screaming fits. We've tried switching formulas, we've tried the mylacon drops as well as gripe water. Nothing really worked and his doctor sort of insisted it was all in my head. My sister, who lives in NY bought this locally and from day 1 I could see a difference. The screaming stopped, so did the constant gassiness. The fennel is the key- it's what helps with all the stomach problems. It's a pity most people don't know about alternative treatments such as this. You can't find it in a supermarket and I was actually shocked they sold it here on Amazon. Aside from the helpful nature of this tea, it's also a great in-between drink for the baby. I would recommend this to any parent that's had similar experiences with their child. This really is a wonderful product!

My son is a very gassy baby.  My pediatrician recommended giving him water in between feedings, which he would take a few sips and spit out.  We started using this product and he loves it; it also helps with his gas better than gripe water or gas drops.  Great product!
This is the first time i purchased this tea.I love it, its easy to make and baby loves to drink it.

Generally speaking, I love mussels and was hoping these mussels might substitute for those times when I couldn't get fresh ones. The smell was unpleasant, reminiscent of cheap cat food. The texture was mushy. Perhaps being packed in water is not helpful; I would not order them again. Have been very pleased by almost everything else I have ordered from Roland, however.
nice mix, very tasty and not too salty but has lots of tiny broken pieces. I bought 2 cans and about 25% of each can was crumbs. very disappointing.

The chocolate amaretto fudge is INCREDIBLE! Great flavor and texture....Mo's fudge is perfection! The chocolate and cherry flavors are perfectly balanced, and the texture is rich, firm enough yet smooth and creamy. I really appreciated the fast delivery and wonderful service. I would give 10 stars if I could, and will definitely be ordering again from Mo's Fudge Factor.
Want a very unique BBQ sauce, this is it.  On a dare I used it on a pork tenderloin roast having no idea how this combination would work. The result was WOW!

My son who has celiac disease got a box of these at Whole Foods - as a teenager he ignored the bunny shape, but he couldn't stop eating them and he is usually pretty picky when it comes to GF foods.  That's why I'm going to be buying them by the case from Amazon.

column9: Yummy yummy yummy I've got bunnies in my tummy
column10: I bought a box of these for the first time this week at my local health food store.  There are not a lot of gluten free little kid friendly cookies out there, or even for adults.  There's a pretty strong sweet smell coming from the cookies in the bag.  The chocolate bunnies do have a chocolate flavor and the vanilla bunnies do have a vanilla cookie taste.  They are a bit on the gritty side, anyone who has been gluten free long enough can tell you that this seems to be the norm of a lot of gluten free items anyway.  They aren't overly sweet, they are just plain tasty and when my 3 month old gets old enough for gluten free snacking, these are going to make a good finger food treat for him once in awhile.

column9: Not the Annie's I'm used to
column10: These cookies are not very good on their own. The cocoa ones are almost bitter instead of sweet. The vanilla ones are just kind of bland. The texture is a little lacking as well. I would recommend these to accompany something else, like a gluten free biscotti for your coffee, but not on their own.I'm glad Annie's is making gluten free items, and I wish I could try Annie's guten free mac and cheese, as it has good ratings. For now, I just have to wait and hope they come out with a better gluten free cookie than this.
My son has a gf diet and these cookies are one of his favorites. They are great for school lunches or snacks. They taste so great the whole family eats them.

I just started eating gluten free and I was worried after reading the varied reviews, so I bought one box of these at HYVEE instead of the multipack offered on Amazon.  I was pleasantly surprised, these are pretty good!  chocolate tastes like chocolate, and the vanilla taste like vanilla.  not sure what the negative reviews are about.

We bought these to take to school since they were declared peanut free on the box, but unfortunately as is often the case, it is also gluten free.  Despite their odd texture (gluten free stuff is often "grainy" feeling to chew I find,) everyone in our house liked them, especially the chocolate ones.  For those with food allergies though, this box states "made in a peanut-free and tree nut-free facility" and is not labeled as containing any of the 8 major allergens.  We love that they are all natural and made without GMOs and that they are shaped like cute little bunnies.  These cookies are made from rice and corn flour instead of wheat.  The only downside is that they are a bit expensive, however we have only found them so far in Whole Foods here in Hawaii and they approach $5 a box.  We managed to set up our subscribe and save when the discount was still 15%, but it has dropped to a dismal 5% across the board (boo Amazon, first Amazon Mom and now subscribe and save).  Still cheaper than buying on the economy though.

Okay, these cookies are simply dangerous to have around the house...because its hard to stop eating them!  They taste pretty much exactly like the non-gluten free Annie's bunny cookies, which is a plus, and they are great to take to parties.These are crunchy little bunny-shaped cookies, but if you don't like the crunch then just open the bag inside and let them get a teensy bit stale and they will be softer.  I actually prefer them that way, the same as with Teddy Grahams (also better when softer).  But Annie's bunny cookies seem slightly less sweet than the other kinds of tiny cookies out there, but still sweet enough that kids will like them.  They also enjoy the shapes and different flavors all in one box.As a side note, the box itself is cute to read.
My son LOVES these little cookies.  He has a wheat and dairy allergy so it is hard to find little snacks that he can have.  These are perfect and you can't beat the price.

column9: Too Good for me to buy!
column10: These are very good.  Too good for me to buy anymore ;)  We just couldn't seem to help ourselves when these were in our house.They definitly have the gluten free texture a little gritty, ricey feeling.  But its nothing terrible (I should note we are newly gluten free too 3 months, so I still taste and notice gluten free things).  But the flavor was great, especially the vanilla.Unfortunately, we just ate these too fast.  If you have some self-restraint I would highly recommend these.
My daughter loves them.  And for me, there not that bad for being GF.Amazon shipped out quickly.We will for sure buy these again.

column9: one of the better gf snacking cookies out there
column10: I am quite finicky when it comes to gluten free snacks but Annie's gluten free cocoa and vanilla bunny cookies are good at satisfying a snack craving. The texture is not too grainy and the flavor is just right; they are not overly sweet which I prefer. I like giving these to my kids because they aren't full of junk. The only downside is the price but you have to up your bottom line in general when purchasing gluten free products.

Just finding out my 4 year old had celiac was horrible! We thought it would be terrible finding gluten free treats for her, and while there isn't a ton of selection out there I was happy to find these. The taste and texture is similar to a teddy graham, maybe a little harder. The flavor is spot on and my daughter seems to really like them. The lack of gluten just made them slightly drier than a teddy graham but it's not terribly noticeable. The price on these was fantastic and the fact that I can get them online is wonderful. These products while very tasty, can be difficult to find in normal grocery stores. Highly recommended snack!

column9: Can't even tell they are gluten free!
column10: My wife found these at Whole Foods and she can't get enough of them. I like the regular bunny grahams and these don't too much different. They are especially delicious if you dip them in Nutella. Whole Foods also offers another gluten free flavor "Snickerdoodle" that my wife actually prefers to this variety. Hopefully Amazon will get the Snickerdoodle flavor or possibly a gluten free multi-pack sometime in the near future!
Good tasting gluten free product.  My granddaughter (who has celiac disease) likes the vanilla, and my grandson likes that chocolate.  He can eat gluten and he still likes these cookies!
I like these cookies. Usually gluten free means too much sugar. They are sweet but definitely not too much sugar. The kids loves these too!

column9: Great - Just what I was looking for
column10: I had seen some chocolate non gluten free animal crackers at the store and was thinking that I wished I could find some GF ones.  When I found these shortly after that I was thrilled.  I love these cookies.  I think the only negative is that they are too good and I can't stop eating them!  They are little so would be great for kids too.  I've been gluten free for 7 years and so it's been a long time since I had non GF cookies but these matched the taste of what I remember for chocolate animal cookies.  I like the vanilla ones too but I haven't had trouble finding those kind of cookies.  So I was more thrilled about the chocolate cookies.I know some people rated these low and of course we're all differentso far as what we like.  I've bought my share of GF stuff that tasted like cardboard.  But personally I love these cookies!
My son loves these.  He loves the taste and that he can even share these snacks with friends and no one knows they are gluten free.

column9: My baby loves them, and I agree
column10: I have a nine month old baby who I have decided to feed a gluten free diet for at least the first year. I found these and they seemed like something she would enjoy. They are the perfect size for her little fingers. She is so cute when she eats them. She seems to like the chocolate better, and gets it all over her face. They are not too sweet, which makes me feel better about giving them to children. I tasted them, and while a little chalky, they are some of the best gluten free cookies I have had. If you want them to taste just like cookies containing gluten, you won't be happy. But if you want a pretty darn good gluten free cookie these are it. My own gluten free mommy tried them, and said there was no way she would be able to order a case from Amazon because she would eat them all wayyy too fast.

At first, I didn't realize Annie's offers GF bunnies and was delighted to discover them while browsing through GF foods on Amazon. They taste great, and look just like the regular flour/wheat snacks. My kids are able to enjoy GF bunnies just like their friends( regular wheat).  I just wished they have different packaging to distinguish flour/wheat bunnies from GF bunnies. It will makes shopping easier for sure.

column9: Great price, delicious gluten free cookies
column10: I'm glad Annie's came out with a gluten free version of it's bunny cookies. They taste great. Now it's one of my kids favorites. Good price on amazon.
I am so happy to have a treat to give my 5 yr old son. We love these delicious little gluten free cookies.

column9: I think they're disgusting, but my kids LOVE them.
column10: My 3 and 5 year olds love these little cookies. It's great that Annie's has come out with a snack that "looks normal" like the Teddy Grahams many of their little friends get to eat.They are gritty and have a strong "gluten-free" flavor to me (if you know what I mean), but as a kid-friendly, allergen-friendly snack, I am pleased.

column9: Not as good as the vanilla....
column10: I have to agree with my son ~ these weren't as good as the plain old vanilla gluten free bunnies. At all. The chocolate bunnies were so chalky tasting. Ick. We picked out all the vanilla ones and ate those. Unfortunately, they had ended up tasting a little like the chocolate ones. Sorry Annie's!

Signed up for auto delivery because this seemed like such a super deal.  Not so much.  They're ok but have kind of a funky taste and texture.  My two older kids will eat them.  My youngest likes the chocolate but gags on the vanilla.  Literally gags.  Not a feature I appreciate in an emergency snack.  We've tried the other flavors too- snickerdoodle and ginger.  Mixed reviews from my crew on those.  All in all they aren't the worst GF snack I've bought but I cancelled auto ship on these as I expect it will take an eternity to go through the 6 boxes we have now.

column9: have to like to eat crumbs
column10: We enjoy these cookies BUT we opened 4 of the 6 boxes tonight and they are in small pieces.  They are small cookies to begin with and once you start having them be broken they are now crumbs.  I will not buy these again.I purchase the cheese cracker bunnies and they are in excellent condition.  Beginning to wonder if these were all broken before they were shipped.

column9: Not as good as the Chocolate Bunny Grahams
column10: I normally love most Annie's Homegrown products, but these cocoa/vanilla cookies will probably be sitting in my pantry for a long time.  The taste is mediocre, but what I dislike the most is how crumbly and "dusty" these cookies are.  My kids make a terrible mess when eating these.  I highly recommend the Annie's Chocolate Bunny Grahams instead of these cookies.
The children love these bunnies but I find the texture a little "grainy".  Annie's other products are much tastier.

What happened Annie?.. There are very few Annie products that id say "YUCK" to.. this is prob the only one, really. But, yeah. Just NOT good. I cant understand if some of the other reviewers have just been eating WAAAY too much, bad, gluten free food and permanently damaged their taste buds, or what..??? But these just arent tasty.

I have a hard time understanding where all these positive reviews come from, because these cookies are nasty! They have a horrible flavor and the most bizarre aftertaste that I can best describe as akin to the smell of a wet dog. I can't believe how bad these are. We passed them aroung the office, and each person's reaction was worse than the one before. Holy moses, these are nasty. I had no idea it was possible to make something that tastes this bad.
THESE TREATS ARE THE ONLY ONES MY 14 YEAR OLD DOG WILL EAT. SHE LOVES THEM.
She will play with it before eating it.  Since she is small it acts like a tiny ball for her.  They are expensive, but less so at Amazon than at a pet store.

I have three small dogs and these are one of their favorite treats!  I don't have to worry about them choking and I feel I am giving them a healthy treat!  Please don't ever stop making them Pet N Shape.
This tea makes you feel calm, relax and peaceful. Great flavor with a hint of chamomille. A must have in my household. No caffeine so sometimes I give a little cup to my kids. They love it!

column9: Peace in a Cup. I love it!
column10: Tasty, wonderful and it really works. I cannot live without this stuff! I love to have a big cup of the Peaceful Bliss blend in the evening. It helps me relax after a busy day and give me an overall feeling of calmness. (Stress and busy mom of a 6 year old boy)

I first tried this sauce at the farmer's market and found myself coming back for more. I prefer the original WildeBerryaki variety and my boyfriend likes the Spicy variety. It goes well on stir-fry or rice. Tastes like teriyaki sauce with a soft blackberry essence - a great summer food! Also - it's gluten free and low in sodium, which is a plus. Will purchase again!

We switched to this dog food after our 12 yr old mixed breed dog started losing weight and developed severe dermatitis, itching, scratching and shedding! For 12 yrs, we had been giving her a name brand dry product we purchased at local pet stores.  She is a completely different dog these days!  She has gained back all her weight, is happy, and does not itch,scratch or shed.  I HIGHLY recommend this dog food!  It is made of natural, good ingredients.

column9: Great dog food for dogs with allergies
column10: We have giant breed dogs who are allergic to corn, wheat, and soy.  This food is perfect and even better that I can now buy it on-line instead of going to specialty dog food stores around town.

Honestly, it's good food. My dog eats 1/4 of a can with each meal (mixed with kibble) and he loves it. He's a 3-year-old male Ridgeback, and he looks great. He's healthy, has a nice coat, and eats well.

This is some of the best food available. My 127lb German Shepherd has been fed this formula twice a day for many years (since back when it was O&M)and at 15 years of age is still going strong! All of the seven shepherds we have on this food are remarkably strong and healthy with no digestive, skin or allergy issues.

A great organic dog food for senior dogs. The company resides very close to where I live and are active in the community. I found them at a street fair where they were giving away free samples and all the dogs were very happy about it. They have a friendly staff that really cares about your pet. Highly recommended to keep your dog happy and healthy. Laughing Dog has different formulas so you can find the one that is just right.

Our family has 4 dogs and a cat :) The most fragile is our wolfie dog (siberian husky). Ever since we switched his food he has more umph in his prance! I think all the omegas and coconut oil really help his aging joints.  We went from a dog we thought we were going to have to put down a year and a half ago to a happy husky. Also, his poops are firm, moist and consistent now (sign of good health).

column9: Kibble size - 8 lb. vs. 16 lb. bag
column10: UPDATE: No word on the kibble size, however the 16 lb. size lasted about 6 - 7 weeks for my Westie. Then the remaining 1/4 bag turned moldy. If you have a small dog, stay with the 8 lb. bag!My 11 yr. old Westie loves this food. His breed suffers from skin issues. We see improvement with his skin, he's more lively - and he's definitely more enthusiastic about eating!I bought the 8 lb. bag to try it. This time I bought the 16 lb. bag. There's a big difference in the kibble size with the 16 lb. being not quite double - but significantly bigger. Westies are not big dogs. He's doing okay with it. I've contacted Laughing Dog to see if that's normal. I didn't see a difference in the product description or on the bag - unless I'm missing something.Anyway - great product! I feel better knowing he's getting good natural ingredients and extra nutrition.

I have just begun my endeavors in making yellow coconut curry and thus have been trying numerous curry powders and pastes. By far this is the best I have tasted and has surpassed the flavors in my favorite Thai restaurants. I purchased just one of these containers and went through it in under a month (constantly making curry). Because of this, I ordered the 3 pack and am pleased. The shelf life is about a year for the containers (after opening refrigerate) so it fit my need. The packaging is interesting because it is in the container is similar as shown (I have added a picture of what it looks like) but the curry is in an internal plastic bag as well. The instructions on the container are good but have some measurements in grams. The only thing I would do differently if fry the paste before adding anything. This really unlocks the flavor of the curry! From my experience I add about the amount of curry desired to a frying pan then add oil until the curry paste stop absorbing it. Let it fry, stirring occasionally, for about 3 minutes on medium heat (don't burn the paste) until it turns a deeper brown then add coconut milk and other ingredients as desired.

This is my first for adventure into yellow curry paste, and I love it.  Even though it is not as hot as some of the other curry's, the level of spice and flavor does not disappoint.  I followed the recipe on the side of the container.  It does use the European scale of measurement that at first was a little intimidating.  I did notice under "nutrition", that it it listed 2 teaspoons is 10 GRAMS.  That means that 50 grams is 10 teaspoons.  There is no law that says you can't use more.  I intend to hit the net for more recipes, plus i have some of my own ideas, HEY,FAKE IT TILL YOU MAKE IT.  The flavor profiles in this yellow curry allows you to take an all expenses paid, TRIP THROUGH YOUR OWN IMAGINATION.

I loved this brand of raisins because it has a natural fruit taste. Sun maid raisins is hard and taste like it has sugar with a gritty feel. These are soft and moist. I bake alot with these, but mostly enjoyed by the handfuls out of the box. My grandchildren love them. Will be ordering more. I'm glad I found these on amazon, never heard of this brand.

I couldn't disagree more with the negative review this has been given. I thought it was very good! It does have a bit of a different taste, slightly like molasses, I thought; but the peanut flavor is there. I didn't find it to be runny at all. Maybe the earlier reviewer hadn't refrigerated it. (It must be refrigerated after opening as there are no added preservatives.) I have stayed away from PB for years because of the fat content and calories- now I can have it again! (And, no, I don't work for the company, either!) I find it to be very satisfying even without the extra calories and fat. So I would urge others to judge for themselves. If you need to limit your calorie and fat intake you just might want to give this a shot. I'm sure glad I did!

column9: Peanut Butter Cups Without the Chocolate
column10: This is an alternative to peanut butter for people on restricted diets or just plain watching calories.  It is sweeter than peanut butter, much like the peanut butter in Peanut Butter cups.  I found it satisfactory as an ingredient swap for peanut butter.I purchased this right from the company and was pleased with the turnaround time.

Fifty-50 Peanut Butter Creamy, Low Sodium, 18 Ounce Unit (Pack of 6) Compared to regular or low fat peanut butter, Better'n Peanut Butter  is low sodium, low fat and contains only 55% of the calories of low fat peanut butter.  In my judgement it tastes better.  A real winner.
This product is great- it is slightly sweeter than normal peanut butter (think pb plus honey), but has a great peanut taste with similar texture and consistency as real peanut butter.
This peanut butter tastes awesome.  I spread it on alternative bagels for a total of 3 pts.

column9: Great taste for nearly fat free PB
column10: I love this PB when I want a snack without the heavy feeling of regular peanut butter.  The nutrients are still in there.

This is a great low cal, low sodium substitute for peanut butter! I love Jif. It is my all time favorite. But this brand is highly recommended by Hungry Girl. Love her! The only reservation I have buying it online through Amazon is the price. Wow! I found it at Trader Joe's for $3.99. Seems like a bargain now. Amazon should adjust the price for buying in bulk.

column9: Tastes better with jam or jelly
column10: I can't eat this on its own, because I can't get past the fact that it's not real peanut butter. (I also don't like other food substitutes, like soy milk, tofu, etc.) I love peanut butter. But if you eat Better'n Peanut Butter with a lot of jam or jelly, then it tastes pretty much like a normal PB&J. I still prefer the real thing though...but this is OK since I'm trying to cut down on fat content. I just wish it weren't so sweet.

Although we make most of our baby's food at home, we like the Plum Organics for meals on the go.  The packaging is great because you don't need a bowl -- you can just squeeze the food directly into a spoon.  The package will reseal and you can use it again since your baby's saliva never contacted the unused food.  My son seems to like this flavor (although he isn't very picky), and the ingredients are simple, so I still know what I'm feeding my baby.

We have been using these for our son for over a year now. It seems recently that the quality has gone down hill. These feel a bit too watery now. I've tried a few batches from local store to compare if this was a one time thing. Looks like they all are the same watery kind now. I've compared this to other flavors, and seems like this is the only flavor that has this problem. All other flavors are still the same good quality.Manufacturer : Please don't try and fix something that's not broken.
My son loves all of the plum organic baby foods.  He is 8 months old never turns away from their flavors.

My little one loves these and they are great to have stashed in the diaper bag during long trips or outings. (Especially plane trips...little one eats them with out a spoon, just sucks on it like a straw so no mess!)

column9: Great. But thined out with water
column10: I love the convenience of this product. And the quality is great.  However the reason it's less expensive than other pouches is that it is thinned out with water.  It's fine, but if my daughter gets ahold of it, it runs everywhere.  I prefer Ella's product over this even though it's a lot more expensive.

I got this for my 10 month old baby. She doesn't know how to hold the pouch and suck out the food herself so I squeeze some in a spoon and feed her by hand. Sometimes I squeeze a little in her mouth to get her used to eating it that way too. Plus this way there's no bowl for her to grab! She absolutely loves the flavor. Sometimes I squeeze some in a bowl and mix it with yogurt and feed it to her with a spoon. She loves that too. Can't wait to try the other flavors.It's definitely easier to store these in a baby bag once they're open--I haven't had any spills with this, unlike other baby food jars.

I could spend a lot of time writing a very glowing review for all the Plum puree products, but I will simply say our 13mo old has been sucking on these things since 7mo and he loves them. Whenever solid food fails, he will always happily eat a Plum puree. We have tried all the flavors, and this is one of his favorites. Great for also mixing into plain yogurt or plain oatmeal for a little flavor. Also great for tossing into the diaper bag for a quick on the go snack. Amazon's great pricing on these makes it a no brainer to stock up.

I love this babyfood.  It is a great combination of the 3 fruits.  My daughter is 6 months old and she really seems to enjoy this one as well as the pear and mango.  This combined with the spoon that screws onto the end is great.  All you have to do is throw them in your diaper bag and go.  Super convenient.  Would definitely recommend.
it's so easy to carry on the go and yummy too :)even my 8 year old loves to eat as a healthy snack.

column9: good quality taste and packaging... kids love it!
column10: bought this for my 8 month old nephew and he loved it. My 8 and 5 year old loved it too. Excellent source of fruit for the whole bunch.

I make my baby's food and only use organic ingredients.  We buy most of our produce from local farmers so winter selections can get a bit limited.  I decided to try these because the only ingredient is organic peaches and I was SO excited to find them because peaches are one of my absolute favorites and packaged organic ones have been really hard for me to find, so I was even more excited to find them already handily pureed and packaged into baby food.I got them ready for my daughter and immediately noticed that instead of an orange-y color, they were dull and brownish.  My daughter still seemed excited to try them though, but then she made a horrible face and actually shuddered.  I tried a second spoonful in case she just needed a minute to get used to the flavor, but my normally adventurous eater (who begs for things like edamame and feta cheese) refused to take it.  The only other thing she has rejected that way were jarred baby food green beans (but she likes steamed/pureed green beans).  And then I tried it (and wished I had tasted it first to begin with) and they were just awful.  To me they only tasted vaguely like peaches - bland, slightly sour, and even a slight bitter aftertaste.  I've never had any fresh, canned or frozen peaches that have tasted like that before and I'm particularly sorry that I got a case before trying just one.  Ah well, live & learn and come summer I'll be able to feed her the real thing.  The use by date was over a year away and the seal wasn't compromised (and we tried another pouch just to be sure it wasn't a fluke one) so I don't think it was a product freshness issue.

column9: Not Yum, but does the trick
column10: The good news is, there is only a little bit to gulp down. It doesn't taste horrendous, but it isn't on my list of favorite snacks. You can't beat 15g of protein in one little ounce, so I'll take it!

This Two Leaves and a Bud tea is, as always, a high quality tea.  The leaves are whole, without stems or tea dust, and the tea bags themselves are well made.  But it's the taste of the tea that matters and this is Really Good.  It has a clean, fresh taste that lingers in the mouth and throat.  One box and my husband and I are now Peppermint Herbal Tea addicts!  And no caffeine, so it makes a great bedtime drink.
This is the BEST tea!  I enjoy it year round, and serve it iced during the summer. It is fresh and has real mint taste that many others lack.

I brought item a few month ago and loved it so I decided to the monthly shipping  since I enjoyed it so. However the second order shipped I found not to be as strong and flavorful. I haven't finish the entire box which contains 100 tea bags. I hope it gets better.

Have purchased Two Leaves and a Bud tea many times over the years and have to say that the peppermint is, by far, my favorite. The mint is clean and refreshing and the tea is high quality. The tea bags are made of a fine mesh and the leaves are large cut and release very little dust that can ruin the end of a cup. I prefer to drink my tea after steeping for 2-3 minutes (don't like it overly strong myself) and find I can usually get a decent second cup from 1 tea bag. It is one of my favorite peppermint teas though I have knocked off one star for the high price and the fact that the mesh tea bags occasionally rip if you're not careful when pulling the tag off.
I rate this as a decent mint tea, although it doesn't stand out among the crowd. I like the way the teabags are made. And I prefer the organic.

These were pretty good, but with some odd side affects.  After eating them I suddenly started promising all my friends a better life, and that I was working for them.  While simultaneously giving all kinds of things to my wealthiest friends, and implementing policies in my life that clearly only helped the wealthiest and myself.  Kinda strange.Oh, and the after taste reminded me of driving by a cow pasture.

I've had mixed results so far with the K-cup coffees, but this is the best yet. Black Tiger is potent and delicious -- almost too much so -- and it has become a morning staple for me. I would definitely recommend it if you like your java super midnight onyx smoky black.

column9: Not the best cup I've ever had
column10: I'm sorry but my family and I did not enjoy this coffee at all.  The box that it was shipped in was covered in coffee grounds for one thing.  And to be honest, it really has no flavor to me.  My husband and son literally love a strong cup of coffee and they did not like it.  I read the reviews before I ordered this because I wanted to try something different.  Some said it was very smooth, that's because it has no flavor. I will stick to Timothy's World Coffee, Extra Bold Rainforest Espresso; there is no comparison as far as flavor.
This is a great strong coffee that's not too bitter as some can be.  I've tried a number of bold coffees for the keurig, and this one is definitely my favorite.

We bought our Keurig machine a few months ago. Like everyone else we tried all the varieties that came with said machine, and ordered more varieties to try.  The Coffee People Bold Black Tiger Dark Roast is simply the best of them all.  Good strong coffee flavor, no bitterness.  Try it, you'll like it.

I love this coffee.  If you like a bold and flavorful blend this coffee is perfect.  If you've found the k-cups you've tried are too weak try this one.  The coffee is bold, not burnt, with a complex flavor.  We get this coffee on automatic delivery.  We never want to run out.
This is a nice rich, strong cup of coffee.  Not bitter - no "aftertaste".  I always drink it black!
This blend is bitter and does taste earthly  like drinking mud?  Really, it is the Wake Up blend is much better

This and Black Gold Extra Bold Are without question better than any other.Better than all but the most expensive roasts in any coffee house I have found.If you like a smooth spicy Strong cup, brew this on the 5 oz setting and enjoy.
This is by far my favorite K cup coffee, and I've tried quite a few.  I like a very bold coffee and this one fits the bill.  Fresh brewed coffee from a pot simply can't compare.

This coffee doesn't taste bad, but it doesn't smell like coffee. If I put non dairy creamer in, it has a bad smell that stops me from drinking it at all. Still looking for a good strong coffee that I can enjoy.

column9: COFFE PEOPLE BLD BLACK TIGER DARK ROAST COFFEE, K-CUPS
column10: THIS COFFEE IS GOOD. I LIKE DARK COFFEE.  I PREFER THE DARKER COFFEE, BUT THIS WAS STILL GOOD.  NOT TO BOLD.

This coffee is the best I've tried yet.  It is a dark, strong, full-bodied coffee without being bitter.  I use it on the medium cup size setting and it is perfect for me.  For those that like coffee-shop coffee, this would be a good on to try.

Had not bought this coffee before but have the kcup unit for it and wanted to try something new. It's been the first choice of coffees in the office and we're just about due to order more. For my taste, this coffee is perfect, dark yet not too strong.
This is not my favorite coffee but I'm still giving it 4-stars.  To me it taste a lot like the Starbucks coffee that hotels and conferences put in those giant coffee pots for the public.

column9: Good, but not the best I've had
column10: This is a nice, dark coffee, but I think I like mine darker than most and I found that this didn't make a big enough, dark enough coffee. I really like the Midnight Magic by Timothy's better. However, if you don't want super dark, this would be fine for you.
I struggled for a bit to find a K-cup that was strong enough for my coffee tastes. I am not sure if this one has the strength I need, but it has  the strong flavor that I enjoy.

This is the K-Cup I go to when I want a nice, bold coffee.  Not too strong and not too bitter, this coffee hits the spot! Wonderful on its own, but this is a great dessert coffee as well! Stands up well to the medium Keurig setting and might work on the large setting for those who prefer a little weaker cup.
If you like a Dark Roast and lean to the bold cups then you should give this one a try. I have several I like, and will buy again, and this is one of them.
This is a very good dark roast coffee. I slightly prefer the flavor of the Green Mountain Double Black Diamond, but this is a very close second.

column9: If you want bold, get this one
column10: Most Keurig coffees come out weak, but this one is nice and strong.  Not too strong, just about right.  I use each pod twice to make a larger cup and this one works great for that.

Have pretty much tried all of the K-cup varieties available since getting our first Keurig machine about a year ago (we now have one in our weekend home as well) and this is my personal favorite - makes a nice bold cup of great-tasting coffee (particularly if you "double brew") that's now my first thing in the morning everyday brew! Might be a bit strong for some but great for those who like their coffee a bit stronger.
Not bad but a little too bitter for our taste. Enjoy Coffee People extra Bold better.
I have tried many of the K-Cup coffees and have found that the Black Tiger Dark Roast offers the best in flavor and richness. There is nothing worse than a "mild" cup of coffee in the morning.
I like strong coffee and I have found this is the best offered for the Keurig--and I've tried them all.
Great coffee but not for the faint of heart!. Tiger bold is strong coffee - great if you find the usual K-cups too weak.
This is my favorite K cup by far. Strong, bold with tons of flavor. I have been looking for several months for coffee as good as this.
I just got a Keurig brewer and have been trying different coffees.  This is one of the best.  It makes a full flavored 8 oz cup.  I have been very happy with all the Coffee People products.

Finally a K Cup that has a personality.  Strong but not burnt.  Lots of distinctive coffee flavor.  I like stronger coffee and run at the second cup size.  Later in the day I'll switch to the third or fourth cup size and the flavor still comes through.
I am a lover of Bold Coffees. Black Tiger is strong but not bitter. If you need the bitterness JetFuel and Wakeup Call from Coffee People may do the trick. I will certainly get Black Tiger again!

My husband likes his coffee dark and strong, but not too acidic.  I usually drink decaf, but occasionally have a cup of regular.  Of the many k-cup coffees we've tried, this is a favorite of both. Bold, with good aroma and smooth flavor.  Perfect for my husband on the smallest cup setting, and for me on the larger.
This is the strongest cup of coffee I've had with my Keurig K-Cup brewer.  I was looking for strong and I got it!  I've tried A LOT of other K-Cup brands, this is by far the best.

It has a nice strong flavor but I get a few grinds in my cup which is a first for all the k-cups I have tried.  I ordered Timothy's Midnight Magic along with this which I like better and would order again.  I probably wouldn't order this one again due to the grinds.*** update: 3/6/08 - I have had grind problems in other brands as well so I wanted to edit this review to state that I would order this one again.

BLACK TIGER K-Cups from Coffee People are my new favorite. I have had a Keurig machine for about nine months and just discovered this coffee very recently. I can't tell it is a "fast" cup of coffee. It tastes as good as the best brewed bold coffees -- the highest praise for this one!
So often the K-cup format brews up a weak cup of coffee, but not this one.  Plenty strong and great flavor. Love it.  (And sad that it is currently unavailable from Amazon!)
From the several makers of K-cup coffees I've tried, Black Tiger makes the best tasting cup of coffee!  It's robust, yet not bitter or acidic.  It's the perfect morning coffee for me.

This is simply the best coffee k-cup.  A little known fact about coffee is that the longer it is brewed the more bitter the taste.  To get a mild cup of coffee you should actually use a stronger roast, use less water and add hot water to the completed beverage.  This coffee makes the smoothest and best tasting cup I think I have ever had from a home coffee machine.

column9: Coffee People BOLD BLACK TIGER Coffee for Keurig/K-Cups
column10: This product is very delicious and two cups can be made from a K-Cup because of its boldness. The price is very reasonable for 50 of the K-Cups too!Verne Quick Southern California, U.S.A.Coffee People Bold Black Tiger Dark Roast Coffee, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers, 25-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)

I enjoyed this coffee.  It was full flavored and very earthy.  I didn't like this as my first cup of the day, but as a great follow-up or afternoon beverage.  I prefer something a little more acidic when I wake up.
One of the few k-cup type coffees that actually tastes like a cup of coffee

This is a winner. Bold, dark and full of flavor. I have a soft spot for Coffee People after visit Portland, OR a few years ago and becoming addicted to their coffee kiosks. Got to love the "Little Guy", who make a superior product.
I have tried most of the other dark bold coffees and this is my favorite. It is the first K-cup that my girlfriend really likes. They very quickly disappeared soon after she discovered them.
Buy this if you love good coffee.  I took a chance and was glad I did.  My other favorite is the "Bold Organic" from Coffee People.  If you like one you'll like the other.

column9: I wake up thinking about this coffee!!
column10: I have been using a Keurig for a few months now and have tried lots of different K-Cups. The Coffee People Bold Black Tiger Dark Roast Coffee is my favorite! It has a wonderful aroma and a deep, rich flavor and color. I definitely need a little push in the morning and this does the trick, just the smell of it in my cup helps to get my day off to a great start!

I have owned a Keurig brewer for over 2 years and have never had a problem with any K-cups. I had previously purchased these K-cups as part of the Subscrible and Save program and had been happy.  The last order I received has been a disaster, either the filter piece is missing from the K-cup or the K-cup is not sealed properly.  Amazon customer service was excellent as usual and replaced the order, but I am having the same problem with the replacement cups.  I know it is not my brewer because I have other K-cups that work just fine.  It is very messy when the coffee grounds either explode all over the place or end up in the cup.  It is extremely aggravating to go through 10+ K-cups to get one cup of coffee.  Again, this is not the fault of Amazon, but rather the manufacturer of these K-cups.  I will be canceling this Subscribe and Save plan.
This is just a great well rounded bold coffee that will be on my short list for the future.

I have been using both Newmann's and Timothy brands!  After reading the Coffee People Bold Black Tiger reviews I decided to try a box and truely enjoy this great cup of coffee - bye-bye my morning Starbuck's stop!
This is the boldest (strong, dark, Starbucks-like) of the 3-4 Bold K-cups I've tried. If you like strong coffee this is the way to go.

THIS STUFF IS GREAT . I LIKE STRONG ROADSIDE CAFE COFFEE STRONG 4 A.M. AFTER YOU'VE BEEN DRINKING STRONG THIS IS IT . THIS WILL WAKE YOU UP BUT WONT FRY YOUR TASTE BUDS DOING IT . AS MIKEI SAID TRY IT YOU'LL LIKE IT !

I like my coffee bold and flavorful and really enjoyed all the Coffee People's bold blends that came with my Keurig coffeemaker.  Black Tiger and Wake Up Call are both huge winners.  My husband loves it as well.  This will always be in my coffee rotation.

I have had a K-cup machine at work for a year or two; and one at home for over a month; I am an addict for strong coffee/ we have a club at work (not k-cup related) and we get PEETS' coffee/ its really bold and rich.I have had most every extra-bold roast for the K-cup machine. In my opinion, the Black tiger is a great tangy bold coffee with enough earthiness too but nicely powerful and flavorful. A great combination. A double dose of this in the travel mug and its heaven. If you are like me and like dark coffee that actually still has flavor... You will really love this one.
I don't know if it is the high altitude(Colorado-6200ft) but many of the KCups exploded in the box.  Blew the tops right off of the KCups.

I will be honest. I bought this coffee because of the name. I automatically thought of the movie Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy when they are talking about "sex panther" and I figured what the hell and ordered it out of curiosity.Was I surprised!At the first sip I thought this coffee was brewed with pure awesomeness!!Dark, smooth and tastes amazing.If you like the dark strong coffees (ie: Jet Fuel) then you will defiantly like Black Tiger.
Nice bold coffee with great taste,,,will definitely get you movin in the morning,,one of my favorites...
Better than Starbucks, better than Dunkin!!!  We now prefer to make our own Tiger and Go then stop at any of the coffee shops on the road!  Amazing!!  Hope Black Tiger never goes away!!
I consider myself to be a coffee connoisseur and I think this coffee is awesome!  I have compared it to other K-cups and this is by far the best I've had.
This has a nice flavorful taste without being bitter.  I'm on the automatic delivery and have been thrilled with this coffee!!!

column4: Robert W. Lake "Beatnik in the Information Age"
column10: I was surprised at how great this coffee tasted and for .40 a cup it is also very economical considering they sell for .55 elsewhere. I would implore any one that has a K-Cup to get these. For all of us I want a fresh cup now, this is out ticket.
This is excellent.  I lke bold taste AND NO BITTERNESS TO IT AT ALL!

Writing this on behalf of my husband who uses the Keurig machine.  He loves the Black Tiger!  It's one of the few K-cup coffees he feels is strong enough.  Make it on the small size brew and it's dynamic.
Love this coffee,  buy it all the time, You can't go wrong with this one!!!!

I was really surprised, I initially tried this product because my usual coffee was out of stock. The flavor is deep and full without being bitter, which can happen with some of the darker roasts. This has quickly become our family's favorite coffee choice and I haven't gone back to my previous preference. A very good morning wake up call. I wouldn't recommend for anyone who prefers lighter roasts.

I ordered this coffee for my Keurig brewer and I was very disappointed with the flavor.  It was very bitter and acrid.  I like strong coffee--but this was just unpleasant to drink.  I ordered 2 cases and we managed to finish off one of them... I'm giving the second one away as I can't bear to drink another sip of it.  It tastes like burned rubber.  Blech!  I can not recommend this product.

I'm a fan of this brand and this one of my favorites of theirs. It is strong, earthy but not bitter or acidic for the strength.The 5 star rating is vs other kcups, not coffee in general (although its a great whole bean buy too).
A little less than I expected.  It tends to have a muddy taste - not what I expected since they said it was the favorite of the company.

Since I got my Keurig about 6 months ago I've been trying different coffees to see which I like best.So far, this is the worst.  It's thin and tasteless.Like another reviewer, I usually make the 10 ounce mug.  But with this item the results were dreadful.Now I make a 6oz cup and it's STILL bad.I don't understand why others seem to like this coffee.  Did I get a bad batch?  I don't know.For comparison, I like Cafejo Adrenaline Explosion for my Senseo.  So far I haven't found it for the Keurig.

This is the absolute worst coffee I've ever tasted! I love strong coffee and this was awful. One reviewer said it tasted like burnt rubber...YES..that's it! I'd also say it tastes like rotten sour garbage. (Not that I've ever tasted that!) But the way old garbage smells in a dump or that's been sitting in a garbage can outside in the hot sun for several days...that's what this tastes like. Don't waste your money on this!

column9: Great coffee, way too expensive here.
column10: This is one of my favorite k-cup coffees. Bold and assertive but smooth and without bitterness. Unfortunately it's out of stock at Keurig.com where a 24 count box sells for $13.90(for members)and includes free shipping. I considered ordering a box here until discovering the unreasonable price plus shipping of this item from this seller. Buyer beware!

column9: great tasting bold coffee.  make sure you're getting a good deal!
column10: thought i was getting a great deal - wrong.  one box for 22.55.  other sellers 2 for 26.64.  VERY misleading!  Returning and WARNING YOU.  by the way - this coffee is one of the best K-cups

I have only seen one Keurig brewer here in Japan. Don't those little plastic packages generate an awful lot of non-degradable waste? Do we really need more, especially for the sake of saving a few seconds making morning coffee???

Bought this for my husband, it's his new favorite. He likes a really dark 11 oz. cup of coffee so I always get Extra Bold varieties for him. Some of his other favorites are Green Mountain's Dark Magic, Timothy's Midnight Magic & Rainforest Espresso.
My wife loves STRONG coffee. this is the only K-cup that did the trick for her. Makes a good bold cup of coffee.

If you like your coffee strong this is the K-Cup for you!  I've tried the 'bold' coffees from various manufacturers here on Amazon and this is the one that wins hands down.  It's strong, it has a kick but the flavor is still smooth and subtle.
We ordered jet fuel and amazon sent us Black Tiger dark roast instead and it is now my husband's favorite coffee!!

column9: Coffee People pods are the best
column10: Black Tiger is my favorite coffee pod. First, it is delicious coffee. Second coffee people pods are the only pods I have seen where you get some crema, or the creamy looking froth that high pressure brewing can get. This is the sign of a well brewed cup and something that drip cannot duplicate. I used to mix up my pods but after trying the Black Tiger I have 4-5 boxes and unused pods that will never be used. The other Coffee People pods also get some crema.

column9: If you like dark coffee, this coffee is very dark
column10: I like dark coffee and this is just about as dark as you can get. I love it. It is full flavored and smells great as well.
Didn't like it... I like strong coffee... but this tastes smokey.  Just didn't like it.... Don't mind the Green Mountain Bold Magic... but this... just can't choke it down. Sorry.

column9: Just what I was looking for.
column10: To begin, disregard the low ratings for this item given by other reviewers. 1: they are not reflective of the coffee as a product, and 2: the issue was obviously a market-wide increase in price as I cannot find any site or retailer that sells them for the prices they claim.As far as the coffee, I am very pleased with it. I can be very picky with my coffee and took a gamble by ordering this specifically instead of a variety pack, luckily I was not disappointed. It tastes distinctly of coffee without being harsh, even when there is plenty of cream and sugar. A common problem I have with stronger coffees is an acidic aftertaste that persists unless I eat something or try to wash it down, but  I have not had any issues with this and I am nearly through my first pack.I can't speak for other blends from Coffee People, but I honestly can't see myself wanting to. Black Tiger is absolutely delicious and just what I like in the morning or when I come home from work. Very satisfied.

This is definetly a keeper in my pantry.  I tried the Donut Shop and the Black Tiger and by far everyone prefers Black Tiger. Donut Shop tastes, well like a cup of coffee from a Dinner, or McDonalds. But Black Tiger has a strong taste without any of the bitter undertones.

The Coffee People Bold Black Tiger Dark Roast is by far the best K-Cup I have tried.  I have had my Keurig brewer for about a year now and I have bounced around from brand to brand sampling the different coffees to find one that really speaks to me.  The Black Tiger may be that coffee.  I like a strong cup of coffee, but I don't want it to be bitter or taste burned.  The Black Tiger has no bitterness or over-roasted taste to it.  It is very smooth and full bodied.  I have also tried the Timothy's Rainforest Espresso and this coffee is far superior in texture, body, flavor, and strength.  I keep 3-4 different types of K-Cups near my brewer and ever since I bought the Black Tiger it is the only coffee I have drank!
This is by far my favorite coffee.  I would rather have a cup of this coffee then anything from even a coffee shop.

column9: Not bad, but we like Timothy's Midnight Magic and Green Mtn Dark Magic better!
column10: Not bad, but we like Timothy's Midnight Magic and Green Mtn Dark Magic better! Please read my review under Timothy's Midnight Magic for in-depth comparison. Overall, not a bad cup, bitter smell, not as bold as the others listed above. In fact, I prefer the Diedrichs French Roast over it as well.#1 Timothy's Midnight Magic  (see review)#2 Green Mtn Dark Magic  (Target)#3 Diedrichs French RoastA lot of people seem to really love the Black Tiger based on the reviews, I have them sitting on the counter, but once my friends try the Midnight Magic from Timothy's, they never try anything else. Just my limited experience. :)

I actually ordered this because what I usually order was out of stock. WELL.........Turns out to be the best thing to happen to my morning coffee! I like my coffee to have a strong taste, & this definitely delivers!

column9: Coffee People K-Cups, Black Tiger Bold, 25-Count Box (Pack of 2)
column10: Tastes great and the price was good.

I have not tried an Extra Bold Coffee that I did not like. Having said that, I find the Coffee Peoples Black Tiger Extra Bold to be very good. I normally drink this product after dinner. The name is a little intimidating but overall a goood cup of coffee. I like strong fresh coffee, however I find my guest like something milder than Bold coffee.

I enjoy this flavor of coffee everyday at work.  This was the alternative I chose to Dark Magic, which is also a good brew.  Often many coffee flavors tend to taste different over time, usually more acidic than I would care for.  But this is a good rich, dark coffee that you can order for a long time.
Assertive, kick-n-the-pants first thing in the morning, get you going kind of coffee.  I love it.  Nicely balanced, very bold.
Excellent K-cup coffee . Robust, flavorful and almost as bold as advertised.  One of my favorites.  Worth a try

OK, here's the thing, I love my Keurig coffee maker.  Finding a good deal on K-Cups is another issue alltogether.  Coffee People's Black Tiger Bold is a good value and a great cup of coffee for those who like a strong, rich, dark roast.  Thanks, Amazon.  Now, if you would please get rid of shipping charges on coffee orders of $50 or more, I'd order more often.  Anyway, get this coffee.  You'll love it.

After being a Starbucks drinker for the past 20 years at least, the Kcup has won me over, especially Green Mountain coffees and blends like Black Tiger.  None of this coffee is ever bitter or acidic like Starbucks.  It's strong but as it's perfectly measured you never get that "put too much coffee or too little water" feeling.  It was interesting to see a CNBC special on Green Mountain, which also makes the Keurig brewers; they said the makers are sold literally at cost and they make their money off of the coffee.  Starbucks is now selling Kcups...for over a buck each!!  I say drop the Star and save some Bucks!
The Extra Bold Black Tiger has a full rich taste that is smooth. I plan on ordering this brand on a regular basis. My office staff also loves it.
I love dark, strong coffee and this is one of my favorite K-cups. I use the mug setting (9.25 oz?) on my B66 and it's perfect. This coffee has a slight bite to it, but in a good way!

Coffee People K-Cup Extra Bold Black Tiger Roast is an exceptionally robust, bold flavor without even approaching bittnerness.  And, it avoids the 'greasy' richness of some other brands, which for me at least, can cause a queasy stomach.  This is my favorite!

I received a 25-count box of Bold Black Tiger Dark Roast that had 3 packets with unsealed tops. In fairness, I don't know if this was the result of poor quality control in production or damage during shipping. My order included a box of Gloria Jeans K-cups which did not have opened tops so I suspect that the tops on the Coffee Peoples cups were not glued properly.One day after voicing my concern, I received a replacement. What great service - I'd give them 5 stars now!
I generally like bold-flavored coffee, but this was too strong for me.  However, my son-in-law absolutely loves it, so if you are looking for really strong flavorful coffee, you should try this.
If you like a good, robust coffee, this one's for you. Great bold coffee flavor with no bitter aftertaste - not for the weak-hearted!
I like strong coffe and although the Keurig is a great product, I still find myself making pots of drip coffee regularly. For a quick strong cup though Black Tiger is my favorite.

Since I have started drinking Black Tiger each morning, everything else just disappoints me.  Black Tiger is bold, which I like, but it also has the flavor that lasts all the way to the end of the cup.  It is really one of those blends that stand the test of time for me.

This is hands down the best k cup out there. Great flavor, strong but not bitter, good bodied cup o joe. coffee people seem to have the best k cups out there. I do enjoy Newman's own special dark roast, but this black tiger is the best. Jet fuel is very similar, but not as good as this one>

When the labled this product "extra bold" they were not lying!  So far, it's the only coffee I've used in my Keurig where I changed the size of the cup so that I had more water.Perfect for Monday morning's or travel mugs!  Daily coffee I prefer something not quite so strong.  My housemate added hot water.
I like Dunkin's coffee.  Since no coffee is totaly consistant I find this brew at home to be nearly as good as the best cup from Dunkin. That says a lot in my opinion.

The flavor and strength is perfect for me. I like to have a very full cup at a time and with this coffee I run the Keurig large size setting followed by the small size setting (using the same K-cup) for a, full to the brim, delicious cup fo coffee.
Extra Bold Black Tigar Dark Roast is the coffee I keep coming back to and it always taste very good.
This is a decent coffee that is bold tasting up front, which I like, but then has a harsh aftertaste.  It is cheaper than the others, I didn't mind it, but it was not my favorite.

column9: Solid Dark Roast offering from Coffee People
column10: Coffee People Extra Bold Kcups are some of my vary favorites for using in my Keurig Brewer.I'm a Huge fan of strong , Bold dark roasted Coffee and Black Tiger delivers.

column9: k cups subscription Coffee People Black Tiger Coffee
column10: Great coffee at a great price, love the ease and the saving of the subscribe and save and getting my coffee fresh with free shipping.  All the Coffee People and Gloria Jeans k cup coffee are very great, I love the bolds the best.
The Coffee People K-Cup is a very bold coffee and a great pick me up for the early morning caffine jolt!
Great rich flavor. Long time user but a 25%breakage rate-never had cups do this before.I noticed the cups seem to be more "puffy"with air, perhaps this is the problem.

You may be wondering what is disappointing about a four star coffee.... This is a better than average brew, reasonably strong while not bitter (so no robusto beans), but the flavour, if "intense," it is not particularly rich. If you love Timothy's Rainforest Espresso & Parisian Nights, this coffee is not in the same league. It is similar to Green Mountain's bold roasts.

Most reviewers seem to find this coffee to be the best ever or just horrid. I thought it was just ok. A bit of a bitter aftertaste if you ask me. It's pretty much the same as Coffee People's Jet Fuel and Wake Up Call, I can't tell the three apart. Interestingly, their Donut Shop is fantastic -- if you like Coffee People (and you can't beat the prices here on Amazon), I'd go for that one.

column9: Raoring feel good wake up for boost for sure!
column10: I ordered this coffee because our staff requested a dark roast coffee. In particular,folks wanted something to help motivate and wake them up during early morning meetings because the flavored ones just didn't seen to have the punch in it needed for those early morning meetings. Well, this coffee was a hit and folks were purring and roaring and asking for me to order more. Great buy and great wake-me up!
this is the 2nd time i've ordered Black Tiger and there's a reason for it...it's GREAT!  no added flavor, just bold great tasting coffee.

column9: One of the better k-cups we've tried
column10: My wife and I have tried many different k-cup blends; Paul Newman, Green Mountain, etc, but this is, by far, our favorite.  Strong coffee with plenty of flavor, yet, not harsh.  A great way to start your morning.
My husband and I both love this coffee - favorite so far - bold and delicious!
First truly full bodied and strong coffee I have encountered with my new KCup machine.  Strong enough for the 11 ounce setting, coming from a heavy Starbucks/ Peets Coffee drinker...
I was looking for a smooth robust coffee and I have found it with the Black Tiger

I originally tried the variety pack that came with my Keurig and it had the Bold Organic from coffee people which was excellent-- I went online to buy some and saw all the great reviews for Black Tiger which steered me to buy it instead of the Organic. Boy, what mistake-- it was VERY bitter and I was stuck with two boxes of it!  If you like your coffee with a bite then go for it.  This is bitter even at the mug setting. If you like your coffee smooth avoid this like the plague! After two months of trying to use this up, I'm finally finished with it. I was the only one in my family that would go near it-- it was like swallowing a bitter pill every day.  Never again! I thought I should warn those out there from being swayed by bitter-coffee lovers.David
Excellent balance of intense dark roast flavor without bitterness. One of the most flavorful K-Cups around!

Good if you like a strong, bold cup of coffee.  My husband does, and he brews a medium size and a small size from the same K-Cup (with our Keurig B60,) into his travel mug and he's good to go. For me, it's way too bold.  I've since ordered him the Timothy's Columbian and he likes it even better - a bit smoother and more mellow taste, but not weak.  My preferences lean toward flavored blends.

column9: Black Tiger - One of my Favorites
column10: I drink my coffee black and prefer the bolder, stronger k-cups.  I don't like the french roasts or the other dark roasts, but I do like my coffee strong.  After having tried many different extra bolds, Coffee People's Black Tiger and Gloria Jean's Black Gold have become my favorites.  I alternate between the two of them and sprinkle in Green Mountain's Sumatran Reserve now and then which is also very good.

column9: Dark but not as full as I like
column10: This is a bold coffee which I bought based on another review.  It's OK, but I didn't find it to be as "deep" or satisfying as some of the other k-cups such as GM Sumatran Reserve or Timothy's Extra Bold Rainforest Espresso.  Tastes differ so if you like a strong, dark coffee, try it - it may be just the one for you.
Our guests and i really loved this one! Big bold dark yummy! I am always amazed at the quality of these K cup coffees.

*THIS* is the stuff right here!I had been going through a ton of K-CUP varieties trying to find a really good, strong coffee. I'm a bit of a coffee-snob and most of the K-CUPs I tried just left me saying "Meh... It's 'ok'. Not terrible, not great just 'ok'."Even the K-CUPs marked 'extra-bold' left me wondering who decided this coffee was even deserving of the name "slightly bold", let alone "extra bold". I usually found myself using 2 K-CUPS, and running the small cup size twice just to get 1 decent cup of coffee - and even then the flavor just wasn't quite "there" (to me, they always taste "old", as if someone ground halfway-decent beans but then left it out open and exposed to the air overnight to spoil.).. and then I picked up some Black Tiger.. Yeah!!! This is the *only* K-CUP I've found so far where I can choose the 12 oz brewing size and still get decent cup of coffee that doesn't taste like someone rinsed out my cup and served me hot water instead of coffee.Now even as such, this coffee is *still* not nearly as good as the cup of coffee that I can get with my good old french press using coffee that was roasted 2 days ago and ground 2 minutes ago. Sorry, ain't no way a K-CUP is going to get you that level of coffee. Ever.However, this variety is still darn good for a K-CUP and definitely deserving of my morning cup of coffee! (coming from me, that's saying *alot*!)
I love this coffee for my wonderful Keurig Brewer! I like strong coffee that is not bitter, and this one fills the bill. One of the very best available!

I've had the Keurig machine for almost 2 years now and have tried a lot of the flavors and Black Tiger is still the best out of all of them.  I like my coffee strong and flavorful and tried others with "extra bold" in their title and they are not as strong as Black Tiger.  It is the one I re-order more than anything else and I thought it's about time I give credit where credit is due.

column9: nice and strong, but too much carbon
column10: I do like dark roasted coffee -- but there's a thin line between dark roast and burnt to a crisp.  Maybe it was just the box I got, because so many people seem to like it -- but I tried several times -- and never got past the carbon ash taste.

column9: A good cup but problematic cups
column10: Good strong coffee.  The problem is with the kcups themselves.  In my keurig these are the only cups I've ever had a problem with.  After making my second cup of the morning there were coffee grinds in my coffee cup. Happened a couple of times.  No other brand has done that...might have been a bad batch in my box.  Nevertheless 3 stars for you.

The best I've had is Tully's Kona blend but this isn't bad.  Strong and smooth.It's been a year and half since I wrote that review and I'd give it a lower rating now.  While I still drink it for variety, I'd lower the rating to three because of its harshness.  Try Green Mountain's coffee.
Tiger Dark Roast is one of my favorite k-cups because it is bold yet smooth.  If you like a dark and rich cup of coffee, this one is a winner.

My husband and I agree that Black Tiger is one of the best dark coffees around. We've tried them all and were stuck on Rev until we tasted this. Coffee People does not make a bad coffee. So glad we can still get a good coffee from them since their coffee shops only exist in airports anymore.
This is my husbands favorite coffee to use in his Kureg, he loves a strong bold coffee and this fits the bill.

column9: Good, but not a personal preference
column10: Tiger Black is certainly a decent coffee with a bold flavor that will definitely perk up your day. I've just found that it's not to my personal taste; I don't like dark roasts as much as mediums, such as another flavor by Coffee People called Donut Shop. This is because the dark roast flavor overpowers the cream I use, while the Donut Shop is a good balance that I will gladly have every day.Don't let that discourage you: if you like dark roasts, this one may yet become one of your favorites.
This is all I drink out of my Keurig, very strong and tasty and wakes you right up.  Plus the design is very catchy too.

column9: The absolute best coffee I've had for Keurig
column10: This is probably the best coffee made for the Keurig single serve brewer. Bold statement, I know, but this is one bold coffee that stands apart from the mediocre "Green Mountain" blends that Keurig offers. This is a strong, in your face, wake you up, no holds barred coffee that I wish they made available in whole bean bags (or even pre-ground, it's that good) just so I could take it with me for when I didn't have my Keurig. The only downside is that it can get a little expensive, especially with how addictive it is to drink.I would NOT recommend this coffee for anybody that like to flower up their morning brew with sugar, cream, sweeteners, or heaven forbid those awful flavored creamers.If you like good coffee, drink this and you will not be disappointed.Written while sipping a cup of Black Tiger coffee.

column9: Excellent coffee , good price and fast shipping
column10: If you like strong coffee , this is one of them . I  drink this every morning , a good  wake up beverage.

Black Tiger is the tastiest dark roast the Coffee People produce. Smooth, not bitter, full-bodied... This is a great choice for dark coffee lovers that want to dip their toe in the wonderful world of Keurig. The dangerous name belies the smooth, fantastic cup you'll enjoy in the morning.
Great value and taste.  The coffee taste is bold and not bitter.  Not a fan of starbucks.  This stuff is strong, mellow and has a rich flavor.
This is one of my all time favorite brands. This is for "real coffee lovers!"  I like a good strong cup of coffee in the morning and this fits the bill.

column9: One nasty cup of Joe.....it even smells bad
column10: I was looking forward to a nice bold cup of coffee and for the extra price I thought it might be good.  It was nasty and I could not even drink it.

column9: If you like your dark roast coffee, this is the best we have found
column10: We have had our Keurig about 6 months now.  Overall, we think most of the coffee selections brew pretty weak coffee.  If you know anyone from Louisiana, this is not going to cut it. We like our coffee dark and heavy.  With that in mind, we have tried just about every dark roast coffee available.  This is by far the darkest we have found with bold flavors that live up to the larger cup size.

I got a good deal on this from the Amazon warehouse, so I jumped on it.  I'm not at all disappointed.  While it's not the best coffee in the world, it's what I consider to be a very good dark roast.  I would compare it favorably to Starbuck's dark roast, but maybe not quite as bold.I'm not much of a coffee snob, so I can't really give much more of an in-dept review, aside from it's a good dark roast.

column9: coffee people black tiger dark roast k cups
column10: I tried these kcups because the reviews were good. It is a very good high quality coffee and very smooth, but as far as being xtra bold it was not. Its not weak but not xtra bold like most said it was. I usually drink emerils exbold, or green mountain dark magic these are the two I would recommend for those who like a very ,very strong cup of coffee. also tullys italian roast is also another kcup I recommend for bold coffee drinkers. I am waiting for a delivery of green mountain double black diamond I will make sure i give a review when I taste it lol.

This is one of my favorite kinds of coffee for my Keurig. It has a nice dark taste that is not overpowering while still being strong. A lot of K-cups say they are strong. I've tried many - Emeril, REVV, GM French Roast, etc. Many have a weird side taste or are bitter.Not Black Tiger! It is strong and smooth and my go-to when I need the caffeine kick-in-the-pants. I hope they never stop making this product.

This coffee is burnt tasting.  Like burnt toast.  The burnt taste overpowers the other flavors that may be there.  Not much coffee flavor detectable, reminds me of and old fashioned large percolator, after several hours, only more burnt tasting.  I have not had this problem with any other K-cups.  This one, Black Tiger, stands out as the worst tasting.  Adding milk added will not mask the overwhelming sour, bitter and chalky flavors.  I have tried it several times over the past 2 years, so I think I have sampled a few representative "batches."  My wife, who prefers the darkest roasted coffees, consistently complains about the taste, and drinks it only as a last resort.  She drinks a lot of coffee, and I see her point.Try any other brand, Donut Shop, Dark Magic, French Roast, any other brand is much more drinkable.  Maybe some folks appreciate the burnt taste.  If you like the taste of burnt toast, then you might like "Black Tiger."
Black Tiger K- Cups are awesome. My Wife and I enjoy the coffee. Gonna have to order more. K-Cupsarrived on time without a hitch. Good Stuff!!!!!!!!!!

Being a coffee lover, I have found that many of the K-Cup offerings are a little weak for me. I tried a few of their Bold Coffees, but when I found the XBOLD - Black Tiger, I stopped looking further. And I was much better off buying through Amazon as the price was better than retail or via Keurig.

I bought this coffee for my son who loves his coffee stronger than I do and he loves it.  He said the flavor was very good and I will be buying more.  After he uses one of these bold black tiger k-cups he leaves it for me and I use it a second time and it is very good for me and not as strong which I like so this has worked out for both of us.  Would definitly buy more and recommend if you like your coffee more on the strong side but not bitter.
I have this coffee. It is not the best coffee I ever had. It not as strong as other coffees. I would prefer French roast.It does not give you much energy.  THE END
was not sure I would be keeping my machine since I really love a dark roasted cup of coffee.  This one fits the bill and now I love my machine AND the coffee it makes.

This is one of the best if you are looking for a bold tasting cup of brew from your kuering. I will be a repeat buyer. Good price for a nice tasting coffee.

Had been looking for just the right coffee that matched my whole bean favorite blend [Seattle's Best Sixth Avenue Bistro].  Tried around 15 different pods, and this is the one that did it for me. Great, robust, flavor.  Try it!

I grew up in Seattle and Starbucks French Roast is my addiction. Since it is not available in K-Cups I have tried every kind of french roast or dark roast K-cup and found this one. For those who like strong dark roast, this is the best.
I have found my nitch with this coffee...It is really bold and delicious...If you are looking for a good wake-up coffee this is for you...I really like this one a lot!

Good coffee.  Typically we like Diedrich French Roast coffee and we thought we'd try something new.  Bold, but no bitter aftertaste - that's a plus.  Sometimes, bold coffees are bitter, but this is smooth.  Worth a try.

I enjoy "extra BOLD BLACK TIGER" coffee by Coffee People.  If you like strong smooth coffee, then "BOLD BLACK TIGER"  is the coffee for you!Wish you would sell this and other K-cups I purchase in case qty's andcase price.
