column10: This is an instant Chai Latte Mix in a k-cup.  It is tasty and has a nice amount of spiciness and creaminess.  It may be a little heavy on the sugar and/or cardamon for some, but as a mid-morning, mid-afternoon & evening drink, it is a nice, pleasant drink.However, before purchasing, you should know what you are drinking.  The ingredient list is:INGREDIENTS: SUGAR, CREAMER (HYDROGENATED COCONUT OIL, GLUCOSE SYRUP, SODIUM CASEINATE (FROM MILK), SODIUM POLYPHOSPHATE, DIPOTASSIUM PHOSPHATE, SODIUM STEAROYL-2-LACTYLATE, SILICON DIOXIDE), NONFAT DRY MILK, INSTANT TEA, NATURAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS, MODIFIED FOOD STARCH, SALT, SUCRALOSE.CONTAINS: MILK, SOY, TREE NUTSand:70 CaloriesTotal Fat 2.8g / Saturated Fat 2.8gSodium 133mgTotal Carbohydrates 9g / Sugars 9gOverall, I like this k-cup despite the fact that it is a little heavy on sugar.  For me, the spiciness is a nice combination, but I like cardamon, cinnamon, ginger & cloves.  For those who are pickier or prefer a different combination of spices, there are Chai Latte Mix recipes on popular recipe sites.  It you have the inclination, you could probably come up with your own mix t suit your own tastes & dietary requirements.
This taste very similiar to the Chai Latte from Starbucks (not exact, but close enough) and you don't have to pay $4 per cup. It's a winner in my book. Very delicious.

I'm very picky about chai teas because I don't like them to have too much "spice" in the after taste; basically, I don't like the black pepper too much. But this chai latte has the perfect blend - it's not too much, nor too little. I was addicted from the first sip. And I love that once it's brewed and steaming in my cup, I don't need to add anything to it! This is my favorite thing to brew into my travel mug and take with me on the ride to school in the morning. Just brew and go! Very soothing for sitting in stressful traffic.

I had no idea that this even existed.  I am not a Starbucks person or a connoisseur of teas and coffees.  But in reading the review while looking for interesting K-cups, I stumbled across the Cafe Escapes Chai Latte and decided to give it a try.  It is GOOD.  Only thing that I do differently is add some sugar, it is sweet, but I prefer it even a little sweeter. It has a great spiced flavor with a nice creamy texture and while this is one of the more expensive K-cups out there, it is worth it for me!

column9: Horrible aftertaste of artificial creamer and instant tea.
column10: Tastes like powdered milk and artificial tea. I really don't like the aftertaste. I've had the real deal in coffee shops and this is nothing like it.  By the way, ingredients say artificial creamer, powdered dry milk, and instant tea.... among other things. The flavor while drinking may get 2 or 3 stars, but the immediate and lingering aftertaste takes it down to one star.

The Chai Latte taste delicious and just like if you were buying the Latte at the coffee stand.  My only complaint is that I bought this online for about $16 for a dozen and then found them at Target for $11 for a dozen, same brand and everything so I don't think I will buy them online again unless I find them for a similar price.
Horrible after taste. I'm not sure what sugar they used but it ruined the product. Haven't found anything that tastes like starbucks yet but still searching.
Just use real ingredients instead of chemicals.  It should be a treat, not a toxin. Even the hot coco has the artificial sweetener.
Really wasn't very satisfying to me.  I was quite disappointed.  I will not order this product again.  I think it's the spice flavor and smell that turned me off.
Tastes watery and fake. Nothing like real Chai. Save your money.  The only way to make it taste okay is to make the smallest size then add milk or cream and reheat in the microwave.
There is something off about this flavor, either the dry milk or the sugar type they use. It tastes like they used a non natural sugar.
If I had to compare this product to Green Bean or Starbuck's I would say this product taste better than buying Chai Latte from both of these establishments.

This is very comparable to Starbucks, Panera, etc.  I bought a Keurig just for this product, as I already have a Tassimo but their chai latte is disgusting.  Sounds extravagant, but will pay for itself in a little over a month vs going to one of the aforementioned shops every morning.
I wondered how it would taste?  well, it is awesome and K cups are too easy!  Will be ordering again soon.

It's true, as mentioned in another review, this can taste a bit watered down if made on a larger setting.  I make my latte on the 6oz setting, then add frothed milk and top with a sprinkle of cinnamon.  It's truely a wonderful treat!  PS - you can also buy the frother on Amazon!

A very good latte. Past reviews had me worried that it would be too sweet, but it was a groundless concern. I limit myself to one cup a day, (very hard to do) it seems to be what I reach for when I want to relax. I will be ordering more very soon!

my son and i are both hooked on this tea.  i used to make it from scratch and am just amazed by how much this taste like that did.  sometimes we add a little creamer of the same name just to make it even more rich.
Horrible sythetic flavoring. Why doesn't Tazo make a kcup for chai lattes? Wish I could have my money back. Couldn't even drink a full cup of this stuff.

I just purchased a Keurig and was excited by the idea of being able to have a chai latte at home. I'm a Starbucks regular (I could have bought a car for all that I have spent there over the years :) and was happy to see that some of the previous reviews indicated that this was a great product.So I ordered the Cafe Escapes K-Cups and was very, very disappointed. I didn't even finish the first cup and won't be using the remainder of the box. It's nothing like a Starbucks, nor was it like any of the other brands that are commonly used in coffee shops and cafes. I can't remember a time in the past decade that I haven't finished a chai - there's some brands that I like better than others but the fact that I would rather give or throw away the 15 remaining K-cups speaks volumes. It tastes artificial and there was a definite aftertaste.In short, chai drinkers beware!! I'd recommend purchasing a sampler pack so you can try this one out without getting stuck with the full box.If anyone has recommendations for a different brand that tastes better, please let us all know!!
At first taste you think it's great, but it leaves a slight chemical taste in the mouth, I would not buy this product again. Straight teas have tasted much better than the latte style.

column9: Great Taste,  NOT for the lactose intolerant
column10: Chai tea is my FAVORITE hot drink.  So I was excited when I got my Keurig this week (hint-buy the square trade warranty via Amazon to hedge your bet against Keurigs unreliabity...I'm covered carte blanche for 4 years!!)and the first thing I bought was this Chai latte.Great taste- 4.5 stars. My problem arose after.  I'm lactose intolerant but have no problem with chai lattes from Starbucks and other coffee to go places.  Anyway, I've had this K-cup Chai more than once now and it must be whatever milk solids this company uses.  Each time it gives me problems.  I'm sad to say that I'll have to switch from this k-cup chai to my own recipe for Chai as found on allrecipes.com.  That is a complete combo of mixed spices and powdered creamers and I have no problem with that.  But that's okay, my machine came with a "My K-cup" so I'll probably save money anyway.If I had no problems I would rate it 5 stars.

After reading previous reviews, I was excited to enjoy this product.  I'm a big fan of Tazo chai made at Starbucks or at home using Tazo concentrate.  I've experimented with various home made recipes and those have come up short.  While Cafe Escapes Chai is creamy, it's missing the peppery notes of Tazo.  Also, it left an unpleasant aftertaste similar to artificial sweeteners.  I actually checked the label, but didn't find any listed.  I'm happy that there are only 16 in the box as I won't have as many to use.  Back to Tazo concentrate for me!

I love this Chai Latte, I have one every morning! I like it better than TAZO for its perfect sweetness. I like mine better when I add 1 cup of milk and choose the medium size. It is perfect to take in my thermos to work. The milk makes it a little creamier, that is what I miss in this chai, hence the 4 stars.

As a previous poster mentioned this chai flavor is quite watered down but it is still pretty good. I like a lot of sugar in my regular coffee. And I like that this is sweet enough that sugar is unnecessary. It has a great flavor I just wish it was a little bit stronger. For that reason I gave it four stars instead of five. But I will purchase it again. It is unfortunate though that there are not many more chai k-cups to choose from. If you anyone knows of any other chai tea cup brands please let me know :)
This is one of my favorite Keurig flavors. I'm glad it's available on Amazon because it is very difficult to find in stores in my area.

They're pretty expensive for a K-cup... but theyre VERY good, so its a trade-off. I've also found that they leave a residual taste in the next cup of coffee, so its very important to follow the directions and run a cycle of just water after using this if the next cup isnt chai.
These are my favorite K-cups! I don't need to add anything to them. They're yummy as-is. I've even got my family hooked.

column9: I am now a chai addict.
column10: My friend bought be me a Keurig Mini machine for Christmas and I was so excited to try all of coffees and teas. I saw these chai tea lattes at Bed Bath and Beyond and wanted to try them. They are great iced but after trying one hot I am totally addicted to chai. Now I have to start my day with one of these or it's just not the same. I know these do contain artificial sweeteners but I don't think there's a bad after taste. All I taste is heaven in my mug. I've already used up so many that I have to buy a new box (or two) today so I won't run out. If you like chai lattes then definitely try these out. They are my favorite k-cup!

A mediocre experience. The drink is too sweet, not spicy enough. But the real downside is the milk base which tastes like something made with dry milk powder dropshipped in a disaster area. Has little to do with the Tazo stuff one gets at Starbucks. Will keep looking.

Drinkable, pleasant, flavorful. I will probably try some others to see if they are a little spicier, but would be happy with this if not. I do like that this one already has the milk/creamer in the k cup- great for mornings. Must not be too bad, I'm drinking 2-3/day :-)
So tasty, and the smell is a touch of heaven.  A nice alternative when you don't want a cup of coffee.Have shared this with my friends and they love it too!

I'm a big fan of chai, and usually opt for the Oregon or Tazo variety.  I saw this and had to try it, as the convenience of a single serve chai made in 45 seconds seemed to good to pass up.  My expectations were pretty high, as k-cups are usually pretty delicious, and the prices are steep.  I sampled this one on the 7.25 oz. setting on my machine, and it smelled wonderful as it brewed/mixed.  As it poured into the cup, I took some time to read the ingredients.  I noticed that this k-cup is nothing more than and instant chai powder mix with powdered milk creamer and sugar.  Actually, the first ingredient isn't even tea, it's creamer.  I didn't get too hung up on the details and tried the drink.  It tasted OK until the end.  The after taste was terrible, and very unpleasant.  It's hard to describe, but I didn't like it.  The overall taste of the drink was on the watery side, and lacked the creaminess that I'm used to with a good chai latte.  It also had a very artificial flavor to it.  I don't expect a k-cup to deliver what my local coffee shop can, but this one definitely fell short.
The product had a great taste and it is a good buy!  Purchased on Amazon.com and it was easy to do so!

Love the smell of these chai cups, tastes really great too. I brew one and then mix with a cup of coffee, it's how I prefer it. Only issue is that the price listed on amazon is twice what I pay at the grocery store ($7 for a 12 pack). That is ridiculous. But, if you are a fan of spiced coffee, try this. It really is lovely.

I was a bit apprehensive to try the chai, mainly because it's my favorite and I was hoping it would live up to my expectations. I tried my first cup of it this morning and it was unbelievably amazing! My favorite type of chai is Tazo, and I think this might be even better. The chai came out frothy, spicy and yummy. It was perfect. I read some of the other reviews and was a bit apprehensive to try it, but I didn't have any weird aftertaste at all. I think I might have found my newest morning addiction!!

I bought these after I ran out of the Celestial Spiced India Chai and I was instantly addicted. This is the best tasting chai (outside of a cafe) I have ever had. You can't go wrong with this creamy and sweet choice!
I like this tea. A little sweet but very good. i dont want to be without it. I recomend this to anyone that likes a latte.Its worth a try,
These cups brew a perfect Chai Latte!  Nothing needs to be added - it's all in there- just as if it was ordered at a fancy coffee shop.

My family absolutely LOVES this chai latte. As noted in other reviews, no, these are not low-calorie, and they may indeed contain ingredients that folks don't like. However, when it comes to taste, it's incredible. They compare extremely favorably to the chai lattes we used to buy at Starbucks, even when using the "large cup" setting. My only complaint? With only 16 cups in a box, they go fast!

Arrived on time & as described but the quality of the Chai Latte K-cups wasn't up to our standard. We'd rather get Oregon Chai Latte Mix Original packets from the local grocery store.  The K-cups are watery so we actually added milk to the water to make it creamy (not suggested if you want to keep your keurig working for a while!).

column9: Hydrogenated Oils (trans fats) in this product...
column10: I do not consume any products that have hydrogenated oils (trans fats), and the fact that Green Mountain would still use hydrogenated oils after all the evidence against it is really disappointing.
I love the chai latte but it is difficult to find in stores.  I was surprised at how expensive it is and will be looking for a better price.
This is a great product to relax with.  I just forget about everything and have it go down to relax my soul.

column9: Wish I had read more reviews before buying. Or the ingredients list.
column10: In case anyone doesn't know, eating foods with hydrogenated oil is like injecting tar into your arteries. I was so excited when the pods came -- the flavor sounded so good and even smelled good, and I'm sure it tastes delicious, but before taking a sip, for some reason I read the ingredients right after brewing. I think because it came out all creamy which made me wonder what was in it apart from the spices, etc. I had to throw the rest of the unused pods out because I wouldn't want to give them to anyone else. Anyway, my own fault for not thinking to look into the ingredients. Hopefully this helps someone else not make the same mistake. Only reason I'm even giving this 1 star is that zero is not an option.

column9: Creamy, sweet, spicy, and aromatic from start to finish.
column10: I assess my warm beverages in a series of steps. This was my experience with Cafe Escapes Chai Latte, which was brewed as a larger 9 1/4 oz. serving in my Keurig B40:Step 1 - Blow steam off the top of the freshly brewed chai tea latte, inhale deeply. The thick aroma of sugar and spice is promising and surprisingly flavorful. (I had seen a lot of water pouring out of the Keurig and into my mug during the brewing process!) It's so disappointing to get a whiff of something delicious, only to taste a watered-down version of it when I take a sip, so I hope that I won't be let down this time!Step 2 - Sip gingerly with my eyes closed. Hooray for follow-through! Even when brewed in a large mug, I would say that this chai is as flavorful as its aroma promises. It has a perfect balance of sweetness and spiciness. Also (at least when brewed in a large mug,) it wouldn't be too harsh on the palates of those who aren't fans of spicy chai drinks. Moreover, although this chai is creamy, it isn't so rich that it would be a chore to drink it from start to finish.Step 3 - Wait for aftertaste, or lack thereof. I am happy to report that this chai tea latte doesn't have that thick, sour, curdled milk aftertaste that I sometimes experience with chai tea lattes.From start to finish, this chai was exactly what I was hoping it would be. However, if you want your chai on the spicy side, you may want to try brewing a more concentrated 7 1/4 oz. version of it, or look for another brand.Cheers!
This is the best K-cup tea I've found so far. It tastes very good and doesn't use the word "exotic" to add random spices that are not necessary. It is surprisingly rich and flavorful.

This stuff is really good, I have it in the evening instead of dessert.  I can enjoy at home at my leisure and don't have to drive into Starbucks.Café Escapes Chai Latte  K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count
I enjoy Chai Latte and have to taste test each type - coffee-shop, mix and semi-pre-made.This is really good.  For my taste it is the prefect blend of spices and sweet.

I'm so glad I purchased the Chai Latte for my K-Cup machine. I wasn't sure if they made any Chai teas for the machine, but when I found out about it, I jumped right on it. The box contains 16 delicious Chai Lattes...it's an awesome way to start any day. Highly recommended!
Came in when it was scheduled to and it is absolutely delicious just as the reviews say it is. Works perfectly with Keurig coffee maker.
Love how creamy and wonderful this tea is. Tasty treat and so easy of course. I love Chai Tea and this is good.
I love Chai tea- and these little Keurig K-cups are excellent. My only wish is that they would make a non-dairy one as these have milk in them.
A very convient and enjoyable chai. It is much less trouble than other methods. I am enjoying this very much.  Keuig is the way to go here. What a great thought.

I have been searching for a Chai Tea Latte for my Keurig.  This one is DEFINITELY sweet and spicy.  Much sweeter than I prefer. I am not sure why we can't find one without the sugar or the sweetness.  I like spicy and I like creamy.... I feel like the cardamon makes it sweet enough without the added sugar!  The first sip tasted good but by the time I finished my cup I lost all interest.

I got this on sale at a department store and it was probably the flavor I was most excited for, BUT I was an idiot and didn't check if it had dairy in it. I'm allergic to milk, and after a cup of this I was really sick. From now on I'll read the labels. The good thing is that it tasted pretty good, I could taste the tea in it and wasn't a super over milky version.. I guess I just have to make my own version of k cup chai.

column9: My daughter "I don't like tea" found these "Amazing"
column10: I recently moved my daughter into a dorm in college, and we got a Keurig for her room, figuring she will be drinking coffee, to help with the late nights.  Well we had some coffee, I got her hot chocholate, and offered to buy some of the Chai Lattee's as I like them.  Her reply, "Mom, I don't really like tea",  I sent 4 for her to try when she wanted to.  The first morning in the dorms she tried it, I got a text message, "the Chai tea is amazing, can you get me more?".  Thankfully, we had not already headed back home 6 hours away, and dropped some off a few days later befor heading home.  Best place to get them, that I have found is Bed Bath and Beyond, using my 20% off.

Chai Latte is Excellent. My husband loves this product and we just can't seem to keep enough of this product in our home.  It's gone before I know it and time to restock the item.  It smells so good and the taste is wonderful. Especially on cold winter days.  Please keep this tea in stock as I will be ordering it often.  I wish it came in a larger sized box. Maybe it could come in a 24 size box.  Thank you for stocking this tea, it is sometimes very difficult to find.
I love the Chai Latte.  Used to purchase them at Bed Bath and Beyond, but they no longer sell it, and was thrilled to see you had them.

When I bought this product, I had no idea of the ingredients.  The first ingredient is sugar and the second is some kind of hydrogenated oil.  I hadn't read the ingredients until after I made it.  Honestly it is delicious but I knew this was way more than just coffee!  I gave it away to t he friend who had recommended it to me!  It is only 70 calories she said!~

column9: Perfect prop for Breaking Bad Costume
column10: I bought this product for my Breaking Bad Halloween costume. This stuff is pretty much dead on: it looks almost exactly like the blue meth from the show. Very pleased.
great deal great flavor it came with few breaks, I would buy again, you can get your rocks off with this sealed good

column9: Rock Candy for Birthday Party Favors
column10: I bought this product to use as party favors for my sons 8th Geology themed birthday party. I chose these for the price because they are cheaper than buying the rock candy on the sticks. The rocks are bigger than I expected but they were in pretty bad shape. Most of the rocks were fused together and you cannot even see the strings on most of them. I cannot even tell if they all have strings in them. Most of the strings were broken into small pieces. Besides the size of the individual rocks themselves I was not very happy with this product.

column9: Like a tiny beacon of sunlight...
column10: Silky smooth and oatfully delicious, this chewy morsel makes for a wonderful breakfast or a hold-me-over snack that hits all the right notes of savory and sweet, utilizing the honey and oats to perfection.  I know there is a lot of hyperbole here, but it's deserved.  The bars a tad small, and so they may not be entirely filling for a meal, but the sharp sweetness that comes from this bar is probably too sharp for a larger bar.  As it is, this is the perfect bite (more like four) and for that I'm happy to munch away between lunch and dinner.
Okay YES these granola bars are yummy and the perfect texture but.... Your getting RIPPED off!!! You can buy a box for under $2 at walmart!!! They have all flavors and they come in 10 packs!!!

I really like this jelly!  It's great on really sour, sour dough toast, especially because it's so sweet.  I see Amazon currently doesn't have it in stock.  I hope they get it again soon.  None of my local grocers have it so I currently have to buy it directly from people in Hawaii and have it shipped.
I received my order in a very careful, thoughtful package.  It kept the food fresh.  The product is softer than other brand and the quality is good.
The resident shar-pei here loves these treats. Although she's generally not a picky eater, I think her interest in these are sufficiently so that I would consider repurchasing.

I realized after I got this that pickled eggs and livers are not my thing.  Anyone want a few partially empty jars? Outside of personal taste, the products appear of better quality and should appeal to people with a taste for this sort of food.
I wish three of the four jars were full of gizzards. The eggs are also exquisite though!  As always...Lake Side and Bay View, provided an excellent product!

My sixteen year old border collie loves this food.  She's was used to dry dog food so I started out mixing this with the dry which she eats heartily, but she really woofs it up when I give it to her plain. Usually I give it to her mixed with the dry food.  It is definitely doggie friendly as well as nutritionally excelent.

column4: N. Ferguson "Two, Daisy, Hannah, and Kitten"
column9: human grade ingredients, yummy for dogs
column10: I occasionally buy canned food to tempt my 17 year old dog to eat a bit more-- she enjoys this product.Blue Buffalo uses top of the line ingredients, human food grade-- there's a chicken version and a fish version. I'm really careful to keep on top of the literature about pet foods, and so I'm confident that this food meets a high standard. No yucky meat "by-products", meat and meat meals are the top ingredients, no indigestible corn or wheat, a wide variety of wholesome and varied vegetable ingredients and several probiotics to promote healthy digestion and absorption of nutrients.  On top of that, this is a very palatable food.I came across this food at the local Tractor supply (I was there to buy chicken feed!). I'd never heard or read about Blue Buffalo, but after some research I can say that I respect what they are doing, and I've changed to Blue Buffalo food for my cat, too.

column9: First food my dog eats consistently!
column10: When we transitioned our dog from puppy food to adult dog food, we switched him from wellness puppy to this food.  This is the first food he has eaten consistently.  With other foods, he'd be interested in it for the first few meals and then would refuse to eat it a few cans in.  He'd wait to eat the other stuff until he was starving. He eats this food almost right away and doesn't leave any behind!The couple of small cons are1) his poo stinks to high heaven now2) I don't think there's fish oil in this food (I didn't see it listed)Sometimes the cans arrive dented from Amazon, but we've been able to send them back for a refund when there are major dents.Edited to add:My dog has developed tear stains since starting this food, but i'm not sure if it's the food or because he's now an adult and his body is different from when he was a puppy.  I'm going to switch him to another food and see if they resolve.  But he does really love this food.Edited again to add:I don't believe the food caused my dogs tear stains.  He had a parasite and when we treated him, the tearing stopped and hasn't returned after several months.  He has however, become bored of this food and won't eat it unless we mix a little sweet potato in.
my very picky dog just adores this brand..... I can't get her to eat anything...but Blue buffalo Canned Dog Food!The answer is in the can!  I was referred this...pass it on!

5 Stars for the product minus two for the price mess up from the shipper...ultimately corrected...but I will now purchase the cans at the store....my dogs gobbled this down, mixed with their kibble---so I am very happy with the product

My three dogs vacuum this food up - they eat every morsel and stand over each others plates and make sure nothing is left.  I used to use Nutro products, but this food is a higher grade and they love it more.  They also enjoy the beef, lamb and turkey canned entrees, and the chicken dry food.  Try it!

My dogs love blue buffalo, I love that it's so good for them, and the vet says it's really good for them. Perfect:) we mix dry and moist together, cuz it's better for their teeth. If you can afford it, it's the best.

Something is not right here. I've been a customer of Amazon for more years than I can count.  It's not the first time I've had a problem with seller or product, but in the many purchases, this is a first! I recieved one can of dog food for $11.00. Oh, the arrival was quick , packaging fine but not what I expected from the purchase information. The number of one stars I've given over the years are to few to count. This left a very bad taste in my mouth. By the way the information seemed to say I'd be sent a case of 12 cans.
This is the best  multi-grain  product I have purchased you will be regular! The best  price is on Amzon, I will be ordering this product again.

This is such a unique way to pamper myself every day. The flavors in the tea seem to know exactly what I need at the moment; giving me a feeling of comfort and luxury and contentment. I love to come home to this drink after a long day, or to take the packets with me when I am on the road. I have even served it iced with a touch of agave nectar the tangy blend is quite delicious and refreshing!The packaging is also quite beautiful and I was thrilled to receive it so quickly.

The price says $66.97 ($0.20 / oz)32oz times 6 is 192 ounces.  $66.97 divided by 192 is a hair under $0.35 cents per ounce.Juuuussst a bit off there fellas.Can't really comment on the quality, but the price is no better than many competing options.

Having a new found love of spring rolls I thought these were a great buy and pkg'd to share with friends and family. They turned out really well!I read somewhere you can fry them. My grandkids like the texture better fried.. as in egg rolls. When I tried to fry one in olive oil it fell apart. I ate it anyway, like a salad with peanut sauce!

For someone who loves the taste of bourbon and whiskey but can't have alcohol any longer, I thought the concept Arkay has was a huge deal.  I mean, come on..All the taste without a hangover...the beauty is in the marketing!  So, I bought a bottle. And that my friends, is where this slippery slope of my happiness endeavor crashed landed into a bank of trees. I saw a You Tube video where this bar tender said...it's weak...but good. I read the reviews where it smelled like shoe polish and tastes worse...(who drinks shoe polish?) Still, I had to try this incredible idea. I purchased it on a Thursday and had it delivered to my door step on Monday...so far...so good. It was packaged nicely and unscathed from its long journey across the state. I opened the bottle and waited....waited for the fresh aroma of whiskey...(It's not scotch...) to fill the air around me. This, my friends did not happen...I could not place the smell but it was very medicine like. I poured a bit in a glass and took a sip. Immediately...my mind went back to when our border collie tried to eat our living room rug. We bought this spray that was supposed to be so god awful bad that when you spray it on something, your own dog won't touch it. At that point in my life, I put some on my finger thinking it couldn't be as bad as advertised. That drop of "dog eating your rug repellent" was the only thing I could taste for three days...Not much different than my first sip of this "whiskey". I couldn't figure it out. I was like Vicks mixed with cough syrup and Listerine. I did the old, "this tastes terrible...try it thing" to my wife only after I filled the entire glass with Coke. She was brave...but could not place the taste as well. After walking around with this "whiskey" taste in my mouth for about an hour, I figured it out. In the medicine drawer in our bathroom, there are two expired products that not only taste, but smell like this Arkay product. Orajel cold sore medication and Orajel tooth ache pain reliever. The only difference is the numbing affect. So there is your review. If you want to sample this product before you buy it...take a drive to your local drug store first.

column9: Pillsbury cranberry bread is my favorite
column10: I have been making Pillsbury bread mixes for at least five years.  They taste good and are easy to make, even for someone like me with no previous baking experience.  Cranberry is definitely my favorite.  I substitute three tablespoons of apple sauce for the oil in order to minimize the fat content, and I use three egg whites in place of the two whole eggs.  I also like to add extra dried cranberries to the mix, one-third of a 4.2 oz. package, which is 1.4 oz by weight.  I use a glass loaf "pan" and bake it for 50 to 55 minutes at 375°F.  (Note: The only ingredients needed are the bread mix, eggs, apple sauce or oil, water, and optionally extra dried cranberries.)  I recommend adding the extra cranberries for improved flavor.

Great product... can't find in stores anymore, so had to order a case of 12. No matter, we'll use them all before 2014! Make the recipe with orange juice instead of water and add 1/4 cup more dried cranberries, and your family and friends will think your "special" cranberry bread was made from scratch!
Fluffy, delicious muffins just as if you made it from scratch.  Takes just 5 minutes then in the oven and 18 minutes later you have the best tasting muffins.

Please, if you are looking for flavoring and not extract...do not order from Olive Nation.  I ordered flavoring and got extract, which I cannot use.  When contacted they told me that they interchange the word "flavor" and "extract" (indicating that they are the same thing), which they are NOT the same at all.Just beware!Derra Sims

Out of the 16 pods in the pack with the machine the Roma is easily the best in my opinion.  I like my coffee fairly strong so I select the 110 ml and use less frothed milk.  Here in Australia the pods only cost 68cents each.
Awesome! Worked great and tasted even better! ---- ---- ----  - - - - - - - - - - -  -

When I have my occasional martini, I include dinner in the form of olives. Everybody knows how good fish is for you, so naturally, I supplement my martini with healthy olives with anchovies! I spear several--sometimes I mix blue cheese stuffed lives with the anchovy for the extra nutrition, of course. Recently, to my horror, BevMo was out of my favorite olives so in desperation I ordered these. Why the lurid name, I can't guess; what's sexy about anchovy stuffed olives? The olives arrived in a timely manner but there had been some leakage in the box, so I hope I don't die when I get around to using them.
What isn't there to like? This DaVinci Penne Rigate is excellent. Good enough to put on your auto-ship orders!Yumalicious!

If you don't have an Auntie Anne's close to you - this is the product for you!  The kit is easy to use - the directions are well written and easy to follow.  The finished product may not have looked like one from the store but it sure tasted like it.  If you can turn on an oven you can make these pretzels.  The kit comes with either salt or sugar/cinnamon - make both.  The kit makes 10 pretzels (large) or you can make them smaller.  Go for it - you'll be surprised and they will taste great.

column9: Delicious and Lots of Fun With The Kids
column10: These are delicious and lots of fun to make with the kids.  You can make regular pretzel shapes or whatever you like, my kids love making the letter of their names.  The directions state to use warm water to activate the yeast, but I was surprised at how hot it needs to be.  I made several batches that didn't rise before I used hotter water.  Now I use a thermometer to make it just right - if it is too cool it will not activate the yeast.
Love these packs. I have made pretzel dogs, bites and sticks. I  have even used the pretzel mix to make calzones and pizza. Both came out great.

I find this product to be a fantastic alternative to the energy drinks I usually consume to get over the mid day hump. While it will not facilitate all nighters, it enhances my mood and increases my ability to focus.  It has a very clean taste with non of that chemically after taste you experience with Red Bull, Rockstar, Monster, or even VitaminEnergy.  I truly feel happier, and more productive after a BrainToniq.

I bought a can of this at Whole Foods for $2.69 on a whim, and my afternoon was spent remarkably focused and productive. I didnt even get to participate in our office daily whine-fest about being tired.I thought it might have been a fluke, so I bought another can and felt the same way, so I bought a case of it from here.It really does work for me, I have ADHD badly and by 2:30 in the afternoon I'm miserable and bored. I find myself getting more done and thusly sleeping better at night. It might be a placebo because its so expensive and my mind is justifying spending the money, but I'd say it is worth a try for anyone. It doesnt taste absolutely awful, which is a plus.

I love this stuff! Within 5 minutes I'm better able to focus on the task at hand and the effect lasts for hours. I'm an engineering student and this is just what I've been looking for to help me through those tough problem sets. I'll update after I've been drinking this for a while and can comment on long term effectiveness. Tastes great too!UPDATE: I stopped buying this because it's too expensive. Maybe I'll try it again when I have a real job :(

I bought a case and drank one every afternoon at work. I am not sure if it was the placebo effect, but it seemed to give me a little afternoon lift whereas I would normally be dragging. The taste is probably not for everyone. I gave one to a coworker and she gagged. I drink it over lots of ice and find it to be tasty, albeit probably an acquired taste. In any event, it was too expensive to drink every day so I stopped. Might pick up another case in the future.

You are receiving this from the world's biggest skeptic. My 13-year-old son convinced me to buy four of your Brain Toniq drinks at Wholefoods even though I told him it was a big joke to think a drink could make you focus any clearer or have any positive effect whatsoever. We each drank one of your drinks around 2:30 pm. I couldn not believe it--I felt clear headed, in a great mood all afternoon and evening. I felt "sharp" in two business meetings that afternoon and actually forgot I had taken one of the drinks. My 17-year-old son commented about my great mood and why was I so happy? It was then that it dawned on me that my day was no different than most, except for the Brain Toniq drink. My skeptism kicked in again. The drink could not be responsible for how I felt.So the next day I took another one of the drinks and again, same great mood, same happy feeling, same sharpness of thought and my entire family noticed. Wow! If anyone thinks this is just another marketing ploy or scam to get people to buy some kind of energy drink, forget it...this is the REAL deal. You have my permission to let anyone read my email to you or even inquire with me! Finally a company that actually delivers on their promise. Thank you so much! (By the way, we went back and cleaned out Wholefood's inventory, HA!)Ray RamirezHighlands Ranch, Colorado

On my quest for a new type of energy drink that is more natural and doesn't contain caffeine, corn syrup, fructose, taurine, and all the other "unnatural" ingredients most energy drinks contain, I stumbled across Brain Toniq. I read many reviews(Amazon) on this drink before I made my order. From what I read I had HIGH expectations and after ordering a pack of 24, I can honestly say, I wasn't let down.First off, you gotta love the flavor of this drink. It's got a nice, smooth, clean citrus flavor that just makes you want to sip on this stuff all day. I LOVE it!! You'll be done with the 8.4 oz can before you know it and wishing you had more to sip on (my only complaint).Secondly, once consumed, the drink gives me almost an immediate mental edge bordering on a comparison between DVD to BluRay quality (for all you TV enthusiasts out there). It's not some huge "rush", but slight and enough for you to feel like you just got a great 8 hrs of consistent sleep. If I had to describe it in 2 words, it would be like a "Brain Refresh".With that being said, Brain Toniq is NOT going to give you a surge of energy, nor is it going to speed your brain up to the point where it turns you into a complete "tweeker". It is nice and steady with no burnout.Brain Toniq is also not going to keep you up when you have 3 hrs of sleep and are looking to stay up for a longer period of time. It may help a little, but I have personally found that if I'm very tired (lacking much sleep) then I can fall asleep on this stuff. What it DOES do is improve your mental focus and thought process a bit when you may be suffering from "brain fog".I wouldn't really classify it as an energy drink, so if you purchase this under that assumption, then you'll be sadly disapointed. Brain Toniq doesn't even mention the words "energy drink" on their can and I truly believe they don't want you to think of them as one. Their labeled the "organic think drink" and that is exactly what it is. If your looking for a refreshing drink to give you a nice little mental boost through out the day, then this is the drink for you.TIP: If you'd like an extra "turbo boost" of mental and physical energy that's 100% natural to combine with Brain Toniq, try Panax Ginseng pills/shots. This will give you that added benefit of energy and mental power.

Very seldom do I ever write reviews on new products..however, I happened to come across BrainToniq at my grocery store and decided to give it a try.  Im not a fan whatsoever of carbonated drinks including sodas but I was won over my BrainToniq's smoothness and above all taste! It does not have stimulating effects but provides a noticeable charge of energy and a sense of calmness and stamina.  Very surprising that a product delivers what it claims...very rare.  The only downside is the price but what it delivers justifies the cost. Worth a try..even for the taste.

column9: Rating on taste & effect on thought, NOT price
column10: I did not buy a case of this, I bought a couple at Sunflower Markets to try out.In spite of what I've read others say, it tastes good.  However, it's not like your buying this for something tasty.  It helps me when I drink this, as I have a brain fog that tides away for the most part when I drink this.  I've stopped and it slowly comes back.  That being said, for $2.00-$2.50/daily, a little expensive for 8.4 oz.  (1 Cup)At sunflower markets, it was 2 for 5.00, which is where I got the $2.50 price tag.You figure 1 month being 30 days, $2 would be $60.  Then again, I guess some people do smoke cigarettes at around $50/carton, so it's not a far stretch for some...

column9: Seems to prevent brain fog, but nothing spectacular
column10: I've been on the Brain Toniq (1 can a day) for 2 months, with a pause of 1 week while traveling. My diet is healthy (exclusively from Trader Joe's or Whole Foods), includes chicken meat and seafood, but no beef, pork, trans fats, sodas, chips or junk food. Here's what I noticed since I've been on Brain Toniq:* In the very first weeks, I noticed random memory improvement. However, that was not remarkable, and not constant. If I suddenly had a significant memory boost, I would've noticed.* In the first three weeks, I observed less brain fog during the afternoon.* In the following month, my daily health log showed no brain fog.The latter is an improvement that I can attribute to Brain Toniq. At some point in the future I plan to go off Brain Toniq for two weeks and see if the brain fog comes back.UPDATE (2 years later): I haven't had brain fog in 6 months, without using Brain Toniq or anything equivalent really. It turned out that the brain fog was caused by being assigned dreadful projects at work, and trying not to procrastinate on them, despite not believing in their goals.
got a 106% on my mid term an a 100% on another one 82%in speech class so i guess it does work.

column9: Tastes great but don't know if it really works
column10: I first tried this product from Whole Foods and instantly liked the clean, refreshing citrus flavor. Since then I had a few dozen but I didn't really notice anything significant in terms of a lift although I have to say I have been getting plenty of sleep since I bought a big box of these. So it's mostly a good and thankfully a small amount of really refreshing soda.

Not a miracle but, in my experience there is no such thing when it comes to these drinks. I will say that does seem to give a mental lift and I really like the taste, it's different.I'd probably buy it a lot more often if it cost less. I wouldn't mind drinking one of these every day but even with free shipping $44 is not much cheaper than the average $2 a can it usually goes for at the store. Pricey for 8.4 ounces.

Brain Toniq, the Non-caffeinated Think DrinkMost aren't aware of the damage chemo can do to your brain (it's called "chemo brain"). It not only fights to kill the gremlin but attacks other cells as well. I've been on a search for any energy/focus drink that's natural with no artificial sugars (bad for anyone) for 2 years. This one is my favorite.It cost a bit more ($44 a case is the best price I've found, no shipping fees) but it doesn't have the icky, sweet, over-flavored taste of most similar products on the market. The only way I can get those products to taste close to Brain Toniq is to cut them 1/2 club soda (or any fizzy water) and 1/2 energy drink. This works well & gives you more to drink for 1/2 the price & 1/2 the calories. With Brain Toniq I can grab it and go.* Focus is noticeably improved.* Even maneuvering through traffic is noticeably improved.* Brain Toniq works for me.

Brain Toniq is an interesting product. I love the fact that it is an energy drink and focus enhancer without all of the additives and caffeine. However, I'm still not exactly sure what gives this product its effectiveness. There's no major amounts of vitamin B or no ingredients like taurine or guarana, so what is it? I don't know, but I do know the ingredients are good and that it works. That's good enough for me.The down side to this product is its very pricy, especially considering the drinks only have one major ingredient, agave nectar. So why charge $2 a can for it? I guess they just can. If they can continue to succeed with this product at that price then I commend them for their marketing abilities.Overall this is a 5 star product with 3 stars for price.

Brain toniq is really made from the "best stuff on Earth" read the ingredient list! Stay away from the caffeine guarana turbo drinks. Brain Toniq gives a smooth cognative boost with out the palputations.Sincerely, Tony Maciorski

I love this product I feel really energized when I drink it.  I really love the fact that it's all natural and give me a energy boost in the middle of the day. If you're on the line about trying to give it a shot! It has a great citrus taste and no funny after taste.

column9: A Smart Choice to Fuel Your Brain
column10: On a whim, I purchased this item at a grocery store.  I needed something to give me clarity, focus, and motivation to complete my graduate school coursework.  Within an hour of consuming this drink, my mind felt sharper; I was more productive, calmer, and accomplished a great deal within a few hours.I have consumed other energy drinks and I must say that this drink triggers a state of mental acuity without the potential pitfalls of caffeine, sugar, and chemically produced ingredients.  It appears to be made from wholesome/natural compounds like nectar, citrus extracts, and other super rich nutrients.In short, it's a "smart" choice for the body, mind and your pocketbook.  It's a great price at $44, with free shipping.  Per drink, it's much cheaper than what I paid at the grocery store!Highly recommended for students and professionals who work mentally demanding jobs!

I failed my Biology class with a D. I try my best and I still do very bad. After failing I thought maybe I have ADHD.  I'm always late, disorganized, and make careless mistakes. I found a list that attributes what I havepoor organizational skills (home, office, desk, or car is extremely messy and cluttered)tendency to procrastinatetrouble starting and finishing projectschronic latenessfrequently forgetting appointments, commitments, and deadlinesconstantly losing or misplacing things (keys, wallet, phone, documents, bills)underestimating the time it will take you to complete tasksDespite getting a D on my Biology class, I passed one test. I had not realized that it was this drink that helped till the end of the semester because well I thought it was just an easy test, and no. Many of the ingredients were important for helping me focus such as DMAE.You may buy DMAE separately but I think DMAE is one of the most important ingredients in this drink to help you focus. I truly think that the ingredients in the drink will help you but most importantly DMAE.So perhaps I have ADHD but if DMAE will continue to focus I think that is a great alternative than Adderall to help me focus. Till then I will continue taking supplements unless DMAE stops working I will take visit to my Doctor. Its a shame that I may have ADHD but a huge discovery because I have been not doing well in my classes and I'm continuously late, and have all the symptoms above.Oh yeah also Rhodlia Roea mimics Adderall in a very weak way.
