I do not believe that I have not helpful as I gave a thorough review. So if you have doubts let me know. If you think this review is fake let me help you out with that by getting rid of your doubts. Also I clearly list the ingredients and their functions on what they do to your brain so this drink works. The only draw back is the price.

Before buying a big case, I decided to buy a can from Whole Foods to try first. Tonight was the tester - I am up working as usual and it is 12;40 am. I took Brain Toniq about an hour ago. First of all, it's a very refreshing drink, with a tropical-fruity flavor and kind of a perfumey aftertaste. I liked it.However, as far as "effectiveness" ... I should know better but I had high hopes that this beverage would help me not hit a wall and get sleepy at this point in the evening. But eyes are heavy and I'm just about to give up and just go to bed in a few minutes. Sadly, it didn't work for me. I may give another can a try to take to class to see if I retain the day's lesson better.It sounds like a great idea and I'm sure it works for some people - just not me ao far.

column9: Is it safe to drink Blue Green Algae?
column10: Blue Green Algae is known to cause health issues when you swim in lakes where it is growing. so I'm surprised to see it as an ingredient.[...]Consuming water containing high levels ofblue-green algal toxins has been associatedwith effects on the liver and on the nervoussystem in laboratory animals, pets, livestockand people. Livestock and pet deaths haveoccurred when animals consumed verylarge amounts of accumulated algal scumfrom along shorelines.

If this were just a good tasting, better for you than the sugar and caffeine bombs little drink, it would be great.  The problem with it is the mystical IQ enhancing promise.  Basically, you drink it, it tastes good, it's crisp and not too sweet, but you don't suddenly get smarter or feel the need to do calculus for giggles.  It's a nice drink trapped in herbal hype, and hence a hyped price.  Fail.

I am a fairly good cook and had no issues with the preparation.  The texture was dissappointing.  I boiled the gnocchi as instructed, then sauted it with onions, garlic, and butter.  A little parmesan cheese and fresh ground pepper was added.  The gnocchi did have a strong whole wheat taste, but the texture was gummy.  Once the product cooled some, the texture did slightly improve.  I will use the remainder of my 6-pack order of gnocchi, but I will try another method of preparation to impove on the taste.  Unfortunately, I don't know if this gummy texture is inherent of gnocchi, since I have never eaten fresh gnocchi.  I cannot recommend this product.  I prefer a good whole wheat penne.

column9: FINALLY, bacon that really tastes like bacon!
column10: If you're older than 30 or so, you have probably noticed that the bacon in supermarkets is getting worse and worse as it gets more and more expensive. The texture is weird, and the flavor is unappetizing. I have tried every brand of bacon around, looking for the bacon I remember from my youth. I've been to butcher shops, I've been to Costco, I've tried every brand on the supermarket shelf, and I even once spent $14.99 on a pound of artisanal organic nitrite-free (and thus grey) bacon. None of it had that straightforward quality of great bacon: cooks up to a great, crunchy strip without burning, and tastes like pork and salt, with no "off" flavors.Rejoice, bacon lovers! Burgers' bacon nails it. It tastes like Oscar Meyer used to taste about 20 years ago. Unfortunately, this is a lot more expensive than supermarket bacon, but hey, it's not like I gobble the stuff by the pound. If you're going to eat bacon in the first place, you might as well go "whole hog" (excuse the expression) and get something that delights you.All the flavors are medium-thick sliced and quite meaty. No fatback-with-a-streak-of-meat "bacon" here.I ordered my sampler directly from Burgers' before I realized Amazon had the same thing for the same price. It was delivered in under a week, in styrofoam coolers thoroughly filled with ice packs.(Oh, and if you're hesitating about the health aspects of buying so much fatty pork, don't -- may I recommend the excellent book Why We Get Fat: And What to Do About It? You already know bacon gladdens your heart, and now there's scientific proof that it's good for your cardiac health as well! Enjoy!)
mmmm smells good and makes you smell fruitylicoius. the best gum i've eatin this summer. great great great!! so juicey too

LISTEN UP, GUYS! I CHEW THIS GUM ALL THE TIME! EVEN WHEN I'M SLEEPING I'M STILL CHEWING THIS GUM, THAT'S JUST HOW GREAT IT IS! WHO CARES IF IT GETS MY HAIR, IT SMELLS NICE AND MAKES A NICE HOUSE FOR ALL THE CATS IN MY HOUSE! TRUST ME, CHEW THIS GUM AND YOU'LL LIVE FOREVER AND YOU'LL WIN FREE FOOD AT KFC FOREVER!

It doesn't say ANYWHERE on the package that these bags are biodegradable--which is the whole reason I ordered them.  To avoid literally hundreds of plastic bags (nearly 1,000 per year, since we have 2 dogs) going into the environment annually from this household alone!  If they were biodegradable, then manufacturer would say so.  Don't be mislead.  I'm returning mine.

Well what a disappointment...the bags in two of the rolls were just tubes, not bags????  I didn't bother to check out all 120 bags, just tossed the bunch.  Good thing these were for cleaning the cat's litter box, it would have been bad news to have been outdoors "scooping" after a dog. Should have returned them but for $7 it was not worth my time.  I will stick to their blue bags.
Color is great, but see through is not! Buy the boring blue ones. You might feel a little less stupid walking your dog while holding an *opaque* bag of poo.

Colors make picking up "poop" more exciting however when you have to walk a little bit through a park filled with people with a brightly colored bag that clearly shows a lump of "poop" in it, its not as exciting as it is embarrassing. The times I put it in my pocket I can't count enough but then my pocket starts smelling like "poop" so I'm just gonna order the blue ones from now on :

They pick up poop well. I especially like the bright color, which draws attention to would be evil doers that you have a bag of poop ready in case they get out of line.  Cheaper at amazon than target, petsmart or other places online.

A new color every month keeps the poop scooping exciting!  I mean, what's not to love?Ok seriously, these bags fit nicely into the dispenser that's attached to my dog's leash so I'm never caught empty handed.Pros:  These are the correct fit and thus dispense properlyCons:  Um.. blue or red would be nice?I don't know, they're poop bags!  They do the job with a splash of color.

column9: It wasn't broke, but they fixed it anyway...
column10: These bags are just fine, though my first bags on board had the original black bags, and I think there were 20 per roll.  These bags are much larger, and consequently they only hold 15 per roll.  I have a 30-lb dog, so maybe if he were a great dane I'd need a bag that went up well beyond my wrist, but I think I'll skip these in the future for a smaller bag so I have to change the roll less often.  As far as function goes though, they're great.

I always purchase bags on board to pick up my puggles poop. I normally buy the blue bags but decided to purchase the colorful ones because they were a couple dollars cheaper at the time. I guess these bags are defective because I have had a few of the bags open on the wrong end and my hand went all the way through. This is not good when you are about to pick up poo. So I don't know if it was just a bad batch or what but I will definitely go back to buying the blue bags as I have never had a problem with those ones.

column9: These bags used to be good
column10: I open up my new bag of 360 today and take my 2 110lb dogs for a walk.  I open up the bag to pick up my dog's droppings to find out the damn bag has been shortened.  What a HUGE PIA.  Not only are they shorter, they are also thinner.  What a complete waste of money, now I have 358 bags that I have no need for.  Looks like it's time to find another bag for my dogs.

I have an 80 lbs Greyhound that poops like a horse.  He can easily fill a bag on a single walk.  The bags are the right size and have not torn.  Nothing is worse than using a bag to quickly realize you are literally picking up dog doo with a naked hand.  These have saved my hand from the cheap bags my wife keeps buying from the pet store.You could put a softball in these things.

Our family got two greyhounds last year, so we needed to have something that would pick up A LOT of poop.  These poop bags are great!  I have never once gotten poop on myself, which I am quite grateful for.  The bags have never broken, and I have used them for some pretty sharp, frozen poop!I do not use the dispenser along with these bags.  I just buy the bags and bring the roll with me on walks.  They are fairly inexpensive as well, which is great when you have at least 4 poops a day, 7 days a week.The last thing I would comment on is that a tightened bag does not hold the smell in completely.  I didn't expect that it would when I bought them, but I wanted to make sure that anyone buying them knows this.
I really like these bags because they are biodegradable and come in cute colors.  Plus, buying from Amazon was a bit cheaper than Petsmart.

Before I got my puppy, I was collecting plastic bags (instead of using my reusable cloth bags) from grocery stores to pick up my puppy's poop.  I refuse to be one of those people who think that dog poop will melt into the sidewalk after a certain period of time.  I also do not want to be blamed for starting the next Black Plague if dog poop could start a plague like that.In comes this `bags on board' bone thing stocked with bags for like $4.  I'm thinking, "Well, $4 is less than the price of a Bacardi and Diet...why not?!"  Man.  I am not looking back.  For some reason, my puppy pooped her way through all 30 bags in a little over a week.  Good for her... I guess?  So I had to re-up.  I almost went with stuffing plastic grocery bags in the bone and then decided that $7 was worth 120 convenient poop bags.  They fit perfectly into the bone.  The bone is not bothersome on the leash.  And, most important, I never forget a bag!  I don't really care about the colors and I don't see a quality difference between these and the `regular' blue bags.  The bags are not super thick, but my fingers have not broken through the plastic and poop has not come through the plastic.I am conscious of the destruction waste causes.  I do recycle.  I do wish that these were biodegradable.  But, instead of collecting the big grocery bag plastic bags, I am going to use these smaller bags for poop and my cloth bags for groceries.  Right now, the bags are a little big for my puppy, but I am sure she will grow into them...gross.

column9: great product, love the color assortment
column10: My first Bags-on board roll was given to me by my sister, and my B-O-B dispenser was given to me by a friend.  I quickly discovered that they are a MUST HAVE if you live in town and you LIKE YOUR NEIGHBORS!!My first refills were purchased at a local pet supply chain... I got these online to get a better price.  I love the color assortment of these refill bags, up until now I just had the basic original blue bags.What else can you say?  They are great poo-poo bags!  HAHAHA

I've been using the original blue Bags on Board refills off for over 10 years and have never had a problem. I ordered these for a change of pace; they are more transparent than the originals, which wouldn't bother me except they are also not as sturdy. I was using a bag from the 3rd roll in the package, and a hole tore while I was picking up. Ick! I will order the traditional blue rolls in the future!

These rainbow bags are much larger than my original Bags on Board brand. They are easily able to withstand payloads from my enourmous great dane. What else can you say about an item that is used for poop? It works.

Several of the rolls of bags were defective, so that individual bags split along the seams. This would obviously lead to some very messy clean ups, that were more like using a piece of ripped saran wrap (no surefire hand protection) than a bag. Sticking with the trusted blue ones, which I haven't had an issue with.Also, these are definitely normal, plastic bags. They are not biodegradable.

column9: Never had a doggie waste bag fall apart before
column10: I used most of the rolls in this pack without a problem, but recently I started a new purple roll and two bags I pulled off the roll tonight immediately tore open.  I took out a third and it started to tear from the top, but I managed to be delicate enough with it that I could use it to pick up after my dog without having a mess on my hands (literally). I've never had this happen before, but I won't buy these bags again!  I can't be caught outside without a way to pick up after my dog and I certainly don't want to risk using bags that will tear just trying to open them.

column9: Bags on Board Rainbow Bag Refill Pack
column10: Before Ordering,I read some reviews here that claimed that the bags weren't worth buying.But i decided to try them once and had no problems with them.They were reasonably priced,quite colorful and hold up well. Would definitely order again.

column9: Not just for doggie poo anymore!
column10: I am currently a contractor in Afghanistan, and we use porta-potties and toilet units that absolutely cannot handle anything but toilet paper.  These bags are a GREAT solution for what to do with one's feminine products.  Large enough to handle each change, but small enough to not be wasteful, inexpensive, and fun, friendly colors make these an excellent solution to one of life's little problems.I'd imagine they are also good for doggie poo ...

The bags are awesome for picking up the dirty stuff.  After I got the bags and the bag holder, I realized that it's probably going to take my whole dogs life to use 180 bags! Unless you dog poops every day on a walk you might want to consider a smaller package.
This bag is a good size and is thin but heavy duty. The only thing is it's a little difficult opening the bag but once you get it open it works great.

column9: Not quite as nice as the ones that came with the leash
column10: I have one of those retractable leashes that has a slot for the bags built into it. It came with a pack of bags similar to this that was light blue. (both were bags on board brand)These bags are very similar to those ones, but harder to open.It's not that big of a deal, when I need more bags I would buy these again, but if it is the same price as the light blue ones I would buy those instead (which I why I gave 4 stars instead of 5). But if these were cheaper I wouldn't hesitate to buy them again.
We have ordered these bags a couple of times and we do not have any complaints!  We like that they are biodegradable and the size is perfect.

column9: Great price & they do the job
column10: Poop bags are poop bags.  They do their job well and they are a good size.  Some bags get to feeling pretty small to use when your dog is 100 lbs. This one does not.
We have purchased these bags from the pet store and have not had a problem.  Half of the bags we have used are not properly sealed at the bottom and are unusable.

The first roll of bags was fine, but so far every bag on the second roll has been defective ... the bottoms tear open as soon as you put your hand into it, or (WORSE) tear open as soon as you put your doggy mess inside.  Gross!  I'm not real enthused about finding out if the rest of the rolls are defective or not ... I think I'll just cut my losses and pitch them into my recycle bin.

column9: visible at night so neighbors don't panic or glare
column10: I like these bags for night use (especially thecoveted yellow and bright green ones.  Orange isthird best and purple doesn't help.  When I haveyellow or green, they are easier to see at nightas I walk my dog and neighbors are more likely torelax and get in their house, rather than stick aroundto watch me pass by.I always pick up after my dog.  However, in my neighborhoodthere are people who open their door and let the dogs out togo where they please unsupervised.  Or there are stealth walkersthat let their dog go, then walk off, without picking up.I don't like finding others' surprises on my lawn either,so using bags is a must to be a good neighbor.PROS: Bags on Board are well made, I don't feel like themoisture is going through the bag onto my hand like I didwith another brand. As mentioned before, the bright yellowand green are great for night use.CONS:  Unlike the blue bags on board, these are a thinner materialand seem to stick closed.  The bags are all attached on a roll, soafter tearing free one bag, I usually rub the top bag edge  betweenmy hands very fast and try to get the bag to separate, then when itgives a little and I see that milimeter of separation at the top ofthe bag, I carefully pry it apart and open the bag fully.  This isBEFORE I go out with the dog at night, because in the dark, I'd neverbe able to see the milimeter separation and pry the bag open it timely.It takes awhile to rub the bag material and get it finally opened.Blue bags by contrast are easy to open without having to rub.I will continue to buy these bags and the blue ones, but because of thedifficulty getting the bags open, I have to rate this at 3 starsUPDATE - dampen one finger before you rub the edge of the bag and itsticks a little, making it easier to open the bag

These refills for the Bags on Board container take the boredom out of your walking routine!  Colorful, convenient, and cheaper in quantities; how can you go wrong?  At 5 am it is especially nice that these bags tear evenly, neatly, and easily along the perforations, and that the opening has dark bars making it easily distinquished.  With this kind of cheap convenience there is no excuse for not picking-up after your dog.

column9: Cheery bags for a dirty deed
column10: As the title says, these are cheery bags for a dirty deed.One bag usually suffices to take care of the business done by two 25 kilo dogs. I'd estimate the bag rupture/burst/break/tear rate at a little under 0.5%, which is acceptable considering the cost and how thin they are - usually it's just a small tear.Sometimes it's a little tough to open the bag, I suggest pinching the end with your fingers and rubbing back and forth to make it easier. Usually a bit of moisture helps that as well. We usually just use the pinch method before knotting the bag to the handle of the leash, then when it's business time it's simple to address things quickly without fumbling to open the bag.Good deal, worth the money. Love the colors.
This review is pretty straight forward. These bags are great just like their blue bags.  I love the Bags on Board holder in which their bags fit.

Its great that they come in different colors but I'm more impressed by the fact it has a black bar across the bag design.  I used to have a hard time telling which bag ended and when the next one began.  Its made it easier and its durable too.

column9: Good price, roomy, easy to open
column10: I like using these bright bags because I walk my dog at a popular park and I want people to know I pick up after him. I don't want someone stepping in a mess, much less glaring at me thinking it was my dog!I've never had a bag break and they are easy to open. They've got the Bags on Board logo printed on them. They're pretty sheer, so if you don't want to be obvious about what you're carrying, go with a black bag. I usually put an extra one under the roll, so that I don't unexpectedly run out.

I like these bags because they are big enough to do the job.  My dog is now 6 months old and weighs around 50 lbs.  Hopefully, they will still work when we are fully grown.  I'd been using the blue ones which are fine, but I liked the colors for a change.  The small rolls are good because they fit (I do use a soft cloth case) in my back pocket.

The description of this item on Amazon says these bags are biodegradable.  According to the manufacturer's website, nothing says this is true.  The packaging does not mention this, nor does any thing anywhere else.This is deceptive advertising.  I paid for an item I did not receive. I wanted biodegradable bags.

column9: Bags on Board waste pickup bags
column10: These are decent bags with an easy tear off strip. They hold the contents well and basically do the job they are intended for. I guess the bright colors makes them a bit more exciting.

The product was delivered prior to the promised time.  I expected a rainbow of colors to my bags.  However, the delivered product was all one color - blue.  Nice bags, however, I expected a color rainbow.

I go through alot of these bags and they are great! I love the colors and the size is perfect for me. I have a medium sized dog about 50lbs and these work great with her. The bags are great quality - I have never once had an issue with them breaking or not working. I highly recommend these.

Not only do these bags make picking up dog stuff more colorful, they also are a great way for people to see that YOU are picking up after your own dog, AND not leaving those little ubiquitous blue bags on the sidewalk... And they look great in his neon green bag dispenser.

So far I have only opened one of the rolls of bags. It seems good enough, but if my dog's poo was just a little bigger than I'd be having a hard time. For reference, my dog is an 8 month old female border collie/lab mix (about 35 pounds).

Overall, this was a decent price for the volume of biodegradable poop bags...the only problem was that each bag in 1 entire roll (orange)did not have an opening on 1 side (i.e. both ends were closed). Defective. Also, these bags are hard to open in the cold as we can't figure out where the opening is each time & it doesn't initially open easily when rubbed together to find the opening. Overall, ok for the cost (although, I think I found similar cost at Home Goods with cute colors too). One note for "big" dog owners; these bags are small. It's ok for us as we have mini dogs.

column9: My go to poop bags for my dogs
column10: I have been ordering these bags from amazon for a couple of years now, and they are my preferred choice. Compared to other bags I have used in the past the perforated edges make them easy to tear off and even more importantly they are easy to open. Also the side that opens is clearly marked. These points are important when walking two energetic dogs who can get excited so I like to be able to get the bags out and open and the poop scooped up as quickly as possible.
Love them! I've used other brands and they didn't tear well. These are sturdy and tear off well. Worth the money!

column9: These do the job, but don't hide the smell
column10: These do the job--carry dog poo--but they do not hide the smell. So if your dog poops early on in the walk, you get to smell poop the rest of the way until you find a trash can. I think it's worth it to pay a little extra for the deodorized bags.

Easy to tear off and does not jam up my little fire plug carrier.  When its cold out, its tough when the bags  wont tear off and I have to take my gloves off and struggle with the bags....these are easy and fit nicely
Along with the "bone" case, this is most convenient for doggie pickups.  Second time I've purchased it, and will continue to do so.
It is what it is. Our community now has erected a poop station The bags are actually bigger and stronger

excellent bags for picking up you dogs waste. strong and easy to pull apart.This pack has enough for our storage in the car for three months we own six small dogs. That's alot of poop but we feel it's a job that keeps the walking paths clean and safe for others.  Thanks

I've been using these bags for cleaning up after my lab since we adopted her last year.  They are super handy, and fit in standard dispensers.  These value packs on Amazon are a great deal - much better than store pricing.

I really like using these bags, as they are waterproof, so no leakage, it also reduces the amount of smell! They are not the strongest bags, but strong enough for the purpose. They will tear if you throw them against wall etc. Bright colors also make it easier to see, and also more fun.I have been using them for over a year now and very satisfied with them.
These bags do the job and in color.  It's nice to know that I have a plentiful supply of bags that don't have holes in them.  They're also very easy to use.
Used them before for years and would never be without them! Don't know how anyone can "walk the dog" and not have these bags on board.

column9: great product that does what it is supposed to do.
column10: The colorful bags are easy to carry while on walks with your pup and do exactly what they are intended to do.

These bags started off okay... but once we got to the 3rd refill we began to notice that many of the bags either a) didn't open at all or b) both ends were open! We figured maybe it was just one refill, but in four of these refills we have had the same problem. We had to throw away about 1/3 of the bags or try to use them even though they are defective. Will not be buying these in the future.

Great quality of bags.  colorful.  easy to insert into the dog-bag-holder.Remember, the bags must be thin enough to fit a large number of them in the roll, and thick enough so you dont feel like you're picking up poop with your bare hands!  as far as picking up poop, the thicker the better! We purchased another product from Amazon with a LARGE NUMBER OF BAGS for ~25, and while it was much cheaper than THIS product, the bags are so thin that its really nasty to pick up the poop.
Doggie poop bags are a must, might as well be pretty. I've ordered these before - never get caught short on bags . . . buy in bulk!
They're poop bags that do the job and look exactly like the colors pictured. I got exactly what I expected from this product. Would buy again.
these little bags are a lifesaver for those puppies who enjoy long walks! I wouldn't go anywhere without them! Unfortunately there are only 15 bags per roll, which seems like not that many...
These bags are large enough for my hands, & keep the stink in when tied. Thick enough that moisture won't come out & handles sticks, wood chips, & rocks well.

I bought the bone bag holder and it only comes with 60 bags so i figured id stock up now and bought the rainbow ones too, the colors are bright and so far none of the bags have any holes in them. the only thing that i dislike is that you can smell the dog droppings right through the bag. but what can you expect.
This is a good deal on doggie pick-up bags for a small dog.  I have a poodle and the bags work great.
great bags that do exactly what I need them to :) wish they made other color options (i.e....all green, all yellow, etc). but would recommend them for their functionality & price

column4: Leesa S. Chwan "L. Chwan, RN, BN."
column10: these bags are great and leak proof!  also, i love the rainbow of colours!  i would be lost without them :)
These bags were exactly what we expected.  Hold up well and do not rip or fall apart like other brands.  Fits in all holders too.

What can I say, they work.  I keep on buying work great and never guilty of leaving dog mess for someone else to have to deal with.  I wish everyone used doggie bags.  These work great in the plastic bone holder sold separately.
The bags are wonderful! They keep your hand dry and you have a nice barrier against yucky pool feeling. I just bought more!

Love these bags...just the right size for smaller dogs (I have a Crested and a Pomeranian), sturdy (that's important!)..and in color too.  They only have blue ones at the pet stores.  Good deal, better price than at the pet superstores.

If you walk your dog then you need to carry bags to pick up those doggie "diamonds" :) So I like carrying bags in a handy carrier and using colorful bags.  These are a good price and purchasing an eight pack helps me to stock up.  I put a few in my emergency kit too!

column9: Good bags, great price on Amazon!
column10: These bags are pretty handy to have.  They beat trying to use recycled grocery bags (which often have holes in them that you only notice once you're out on your walk).  The bags are thin but pretty sturdy.  Some reviews complain that they are too big, but I have a small dog and don't find that to be the case.  They are long enough that you can tie them in a knot, any shorter and this would be tough.  Overall a good buy and a much better price than you would find in the pet store!

Sure you can use those plastic bags you get from the grocery store..but I continue to buy these bags because I can store them in my glove compartment, my purse, my puppy training bag, and anything else small I might have. They also tear off well and open well. I've had some before that drove me nuts because when I tore one it tore the bag and it took me forever to open it. These work well for me.  As for the colors, the dogs could care less, but I like them!
I've purchased cheaper bags since buying these which work well.  These are thicker and cheaper here than at a pet store.
This are the cheapest bags I've found! They don't have any weird scent and are big enough for big-dog waste.
Very fast shipping.  Best price out there. For me the bags last about 4 months for 1 dog. They have never ripped on me!
The bags are sturdy and were received in a timely manner.  Love all the different colors too.
work fine.  I'm a dog walker so these are a very necessary item.  I've been using them for years.  love the different colors

column9: Bags on Board are the Greatest!
column10: Love the convenience of having a doggie bag when I'm out for a walk with my dog. Super convenient!

I've now ordered bags from "Bags on Board" several times and plan to continue doing so. I do have the leash clip to carry them that way, but the rolls are small enough to fit easily in jacket pocket. Not to be too graphic but I have large dogs and these work.

This is the best deal I can find over the web. The bags are pretty long compared with other brands I bought before. So they are good for big dogs, too. On the other hand, you get only 15 per roll, not 20 per roll. Try to get bags of darker colors. The yellow ones are too transparent.
Like these poop bags because they are pretty durable and they claim to be biodegradable. Will buy again.
Great bags ... they do not tear during use. I think that's the most important factor. :)
These were relatively cheaply priced and they definitely do the job.  I will probably buy them again.
Great to have along for the walk.  Good size, easy to use, biodegradable.  The number of bags in the pouch lasts a good while and the variety of colors are pleasing.

The bags are great- easy to use and biodegradable, which is awesome. They're long enough to easily tie when you've finished, and they're pretty! I just wish there were more bags in a roll. I feel like I am always running out.
Perfect size and colors.Just wish more folks would buy and use them.Bag fits like a glove over hand.Simply pick up and turn inside- out.Tie a knot and be done with it.Great product.

These bags are very sturdy and large enough to hold any size dogs poop. I find them to be very sturdy...never found a hole in any bag or had a finger poke through. These Bags on Board do a very good job at what they are intended for and that's all one needs to know.

column9: as functional as it is colorful
column10: these little rolls of bags are smaller than other brands you can get at baby supply stores. we originally received it as a baby shower gift. the powder scent and the durable plastic keeps odors within, which is especially helpful when on the road or in the midst of plenty of people.

The doggie bags are environmentally friendly (decomposable), and they were an excellent price. They work well, are big enough to pick up a couple different doo-doo droppings per bag, and are easy to use. Great product.

column9: I don't even have a dog :)
column10: I used these for party favor bags because I like the colors and they matched by ballons and ribbons.  They are bigger than regular favor bags and will rip if you put something really heavy or pointy in them, but easy enough for the kids to rip open and get to the prizes.  They are great for the diaper bag or holding wet clothes...  and cheaper than the versions sold for dirty diapers.

I'm a big fan of Bags on Board 100% biodegradable bags.  The construction of the bags are sturdy and dependable, which makes cleaning up after your pet easy.  The various colors are a nice touch to a good product!
Don't skimp on cheap bags... stick with "Bags on Board" for picking up waste.  They are the best!  I would purchase from this company (thru Amazon) again.
Not only are these bags colorful, they make cleaning up easy! I will certainly reorder when my supply gets low.
These bags work great, and it's nice to have the different colors to look at for a change. I also love that they are biodegradable.

This product is claimed to be biodegradeable, but it is not.  When the bags arrived, they were clearly different from the originals that we received as a gift, so my wife called the company and learned they had changed the chemistry of the plastic, and they are no longer biodegradeable.  They said that the EPA requires that anything in a biodegradeable package must be compostable, and they do not recommend that animal waste be composted.
I was amazed at how quick I received this order. I can't comment on the product itself as this was purchased for someone else.

column9: I may have gotten a bad batch...
column10: I originally got these in the 1 pound bag and they were great! Perfect condition, great assortment, neatly wrapped individually. The candy itself is amazing. If I were rating the 1lb bag, it would absolutely be 5/5 stars. But this review is about the 3lb bag and NOT the 1lb one (I mention this because the same seller lists both bags in a single listing). I decided to get the 3lb bag and I was terribly disappointed. Over 75% of the bag was one flavor, the bag was a cheap generic bag which split open in shipping (the 1lb was in a very nice, tough, and resealable bag), the individually wrapped candies themselves were covered in an unknown sticky residue, and many of the candies were either 1/2 piece or 1&1/2 pieces inside the wrappers. It seems the 3lb bag contains the rejects from the 1lb bag.  Maybe I just got a bad batch? I guess I will return it.Edit: the seller has been very helpful and explained that the batch I got was likely damaged in transit, and has verified that the 3lb bag is the same quality at the 1lb and that I likely got a bad batch which could be returned. And so I will return them and purchase another to see, as the candies themselves are amazing enough for me to mention that they are amazing twice in the same review. Hopefully the next ones won't have the same issues.
These hard candies are SO good.  I haven't found the nutritional info on them but that may be a good thing.  My fav out of all of them.
I am a little bit of a coffee snob.  Wanted to find a good organic coffee.  This is great,better than some of the non-organic coffees I have had.  Have already reordered, and bought some as a gift.

A friend recommended I try this and it was very good tasting coffee. A smooth after taste and a kind of woodsey flavor. Some other coffees I have found that are great are the Wegman's dark roast espresso beans (which I brew lightly) and also the medium roast regular coffee at panera Bread.  Just thought I would throw that in as a bonus. LOLNice coffee.

THis is one of the better Community Coffee flavor's.  Community isn't made for all taste.  It is really popular here in S. Louisiana and we love it.  I was glad to see it on Amazon because the price locally was getting pretty high.

This coffee has a wonderfully rich flavor.  My husband, who brews his coffee quite strong, was pleased with the flavor.  His comment was, "Just like they make in Germany!". From him, that is the best compliment this coffee could get.

column9: My favorite coffee for a while
column10: I've been drinking the breakfast blend for two years now. Every now and then I'll change up and do a different brand of coffee, but I always come back to this one because it's perfectly balanced to my tastes. The reviewers here saying it's too bitter really surprise me. The lack of bitterness is exactly what I love about it. I can make it strong without ruining the flavor. I guess everyone's taste buds are different. Mine were raised on cheap grocery store coffees, and this stuff is miles better in comparison.If you like Community Coffee, keep your eyes open for coupons here. There's usually one for $3 off every few months.

I tried Community Coffee at a friends house a few months back. He gave me a bag of whole beans and I took it home to try. My wife loved it. When we ran out she said our regular coffee just didn't cut it anymore, so I ordered some more community. we love the breakfast blend.

I was reluctant to taste this coffee because I had not heard of it before, however, I was getting tired of Maxwell House having used it for years. This coffee surprised me, it was good.. It was at a great price also.

column9: Worst coffee ever, dump them all in the garbage
column10: The worst coffee I ever bought. As soon as I opened the bag, I know what a terrible mistake I made buying three bags of cheap coffee. It smelled foul, it expires within 1 month of purchase, and it definitely contains more than just grounded coffee beans (leaves, branches etc). But I still tried to brew the coffee, I brewed one with a french press, terrible taste. And then I tried to brew it with a Moka, still terrible. So now they are where they belong, the garbage bin. I don't know if my three bags of coffee all happened to be outliers, but I just cannot agree with the other reviews.

column9: Believe The Reviewers Who Complain About Imminent Expiration Dates!
column10: I should've paid attention to the reviewers who warned that their coffee arrived shortly before the marked expiration dates on the bags.  Mine did as well.  No way I'll go through the three bags in time.  For that reason, and the fact that this coffee tastes no better than what you'd get at your corner gas station, I'm cancelling my Subscribe and Save order. One other thing I should've checked out: the majority of the five star reviews are the only product the reviewers ever reviewed.  Must be a Community Coffee Employee Incentive Plan.

This coffee is smooth and mellow but it isn't as rich and flavorful as "hi-end" coffee. I enjoy it but...I'd put it in between cheap brands like basic Folders and more expensive brands like Starbucks.

I recommend Community Coffee highly, I enjoy most all of their coffees and normally purchase direct from their website. Amazon sends it to me cheaper, glad to see it carried here! This blend is very nice, give it a try...

column9: Very bitter and should be packaged in a can
column10: This coffee should come in a can or a plastic container with all the other bad tasting coffees. Worst coffee I've had in a while.
the best coffee in the world! Very good and definitely convenient through amazon since you do not even have to leave your house and waste gas money

This is my favorite coffee out of all coffees, other than German coffee.  So many flavors and blends to choose from.  They also are huge supporters of our Troops.  They have a Military Match program when you buy 4 bags they will match 4 bags FREE.  I have been able to keep my hubby stocked with coffee through every deployment thanks to Community.

column9: this stuff is bad, like gas station coffee bad
column10: Actually I think I have had better gas station coffee. It's just awful, no other way to explain it. I'm not exactly a snob or anything, I often drink folgers or store brand but wanted to try this because of all the rave reviews and I don't get it. It's just bad.

column9: Go for a better coffee most any would be better
column10: This is not great coffee I was very disappointed. It does not have a nice coffee flavor it is smooth and not bitter, but no flavor.
Bought this after reading that this brand was rated best coffee in the world. Turns out it tasted just like regular coffee. Nothing special. I'll stick with my Dunkin.
The coffee isn't bad but it defiantly is not anything special.  For the price it could be more ethical (fair trade, organic, shade grown etc.).  The taste was OK but I'll stick with Dean's Beans.

column9: Good ground coffee at a great value
column10: This purchase was an Amazon "Today's Deals" that we took a chance on because of the price. We purchased three bags for $10.We brewed our coffee in a Bodum Columbia 8-Cup Stainless-Steel Thermal Press Pot, which we purchased from Amazon in 2007 (see our review!). The pot holds 34 ounces, so we started with three rounded scoops of Community Coffee. Later, we switched to two heaping scoops and enjoyed that, too.How does it taste? Well, Community Coffee is on par with brands like Millstone and Seattle's Best. My wife liked Community Coffee better than Eight O'Clock Coffee.We brew two pots each morning. We each drink a cup and then pour the rest in our own Thermos Nissan 34-Ounce Stainless-Steel Vacuum Insulated Briefcase Bottle, another great purchase from Amazon that has helped us significantly reduce our coffee bill - no more $4 lattes!Since the coffee arrives in ground form, it is important to use it up quickly and keep it sealed in an airtight container.Rating: 5 stars.

I grew up with Community Dark Roast in my house!!  But have recently tried just about all of the different roasts & blends.  You have to try Breakfast Blend and Cafe Special.  They are great morning coffees!
I love my Community Coffee.  Breakfast blend has one of the best tastes besides the Cafe Special.  I enjoy this coffee with my husband on the weekends.
These chocolate bars are the best.  Forget the Kit Kat that everybody compares them too.  They are superior.  They are not that easy to find, so get them here!
Love these absolutely delicious chocolate wafers!! I have been looking for them for a while anf finally found them on Amazon. They are sooo good and crunchy!!

This salt is NOT smoked. Read that again. It is a 2 pound bag of white salt that has a fake hickory smell. It is small crystals, about the size of table salt crystals. My guess is that they tried to infuse flavor into the salt rather than smoking it. The hickory flavor is very faint, and very fake tasting. You are much better off buying real smoked salt, such as Gourmet Hickory Smoked Sea Salt by The Spice Lab Inc. I am not in any way affiliated with The Spice Lab - I bought their salt simultaneously with Faerie's Finest in order to compare the two. Not only is it inferior to The Spice Lab, but Faerie's Finest is the worst smoked salt I have tasted.

I could not get over the fact that when I opened the first can.....it wasn't filled halfway with water.  Cans of small shrimp from most other companys, by the time you drain the can, are at least 50% empty.  This can was really packed to the top with tiny, cleaned shrimp.  They taste great and make a really great salad with the addition of a little lettuce, onions, celery, and mayo of course!  The price is a little more since you only get 6 cans as a case from Amazon but when they have the 40% off sale....it's worth it.  I will be buying these again!  I highly recommend them.

column9: Surprised at how good these are
column10: These are definitely the best canned shrimp I've ever had.  Actually I tended to avoid canned shrimp, since it's usually a pretty icky product.  But I like shrimp, and I wanted to be able to have something like this on hand to throw into salads etc. conveniently.I was really surprised by these.  The can indeed is pretty full of shrimp, although of course is does have some fluid in it.  I suppose you could use the broth for something if you wanted to.  The shrimp are small, but they are also fresh looking, very well cleaned, plump, and smell good.  They have natural looking color tones, which canned shrimp usually lack.They taste very close to regular, larger fresh shrimp.  Granted they are canned and cooked more thoroughly than one would with fresh shrimp.  But even considering that, they offer a nice, full, true fresh shrimp flavor for a canned product.  They don't taste fishy, too strong, weird, metallic, old, salty, or any of the other negative flavors that other canned shrimp I've tried usually have.  The texture is also appealing, like fresh shrimp that have been chopped, so they have a nice, meaty but delicate texture - not mushy or rubbery.  The overall effect is that you are eating freshly cooked, nicely flavored shrimp that's been diced.It's nice to be able to keep a convenient canned shrimp on hand, since shrimp is such a healthy and low calorie, high protein food.  It's surprisingly adaptable too.  So far my favorite use is mixing the shrimp with hearts of palm, sun dried tomato strips, some mixed cooked beans, a few olives, and French dressing.  That goes together in about 60 seconds and makes a delicious and nutritious salad.
I bought this because I like shrimp salad sandwiches, and it was very tasty, and I got 3 sandwiches out of every can. I'm satisfied with the value of the purchase.
Very pleased.  The can was mostly shrimp not water.  I like the flavor and texture.  I will definitely purchase more.

This is the only flavor that I like.  For some reason the sweetness goes well with the the softer consistensy of the dried chickpeas.  I would buy this flavor again, but not the other ones.  These have a slightly chalky, soft consistency compared to nuts. I was expecting something a little crunchier. I love that they are beans and have fiber (6 grams). The #2 ingrediant is evaporated cane juice and #3 is brown rice syrup. And if you are watching carbs then nuts are lower. These have 23 grams total carbs and 6 grams sugar. The fat on the other hand is much lower then nuts - only 2 grams of fat. 140 calories for 1/4 cup so about the same calories as most nuts.

I really like this product.  It has a rich and full flavor of cinnamon and vanilla.  I am always on the lookout for a sweet snack that does not give me a sugar rush and does not contain nuts because I have an allergy.  I find the roasted chickpeas are great for traveling since they are filling, but won't make you feel horrible like eating a bag of chips will.

I love roasted garbanzo beans.  I make them and eat them at home all of the time.  When I read some of the negative reviews, I thought to myself, "Well, I guess these people have never eaten roasted garbanzo beans before they do have a strange consistency," and I went ahead and ordered some any way.  It seemed pretty impossible to me that these could be messed up.  Well, congratulations!  They are horrible.  The person who said they were like chalk was 100% correct.  I have never made garbanzo beans at home and had them turn out this way.  They are like powder.  Yuck!  I wish I could return them; they are that bad and disappointing.  Please save your money, and if you really want to eat chalk, just go to the school supplies section of Target.

column9: These smell great, and my dog says they taste good.

My dogs love these, although I don't think they have ever met a treat that they didn't like. My one dog has allergies and I was glad the ingredients in these treats can all be pronounced. I would purchase these again.
Our dog loves these! Easy to break, smells good, and she seems very excited to have them. No complaints at all. We'll be purchasing more of these in the future.
I have purchased all the flavors and our dog enjoys them all. I like the size for calorie control and the ingredients don't include any junk!
OMG! The dog absolutely loves these and we feel good about giving them to him because they're all natural and low in calories.  He's a big black lab mix and needs to watch his waist.

My dogs are allergic to common grains and common meats, so I'm always looking for fruit/vegetable treats.  My dogs LOVE them!  And they are picky.  And if you are interested - they are shaped in cute daisies! We've also purchased the apple/pumpkin and the cranberry/pumpkin but haven't tried them yet.  I'm sure they won't disappoint!

Yes, I did try one. They taste very bland, actually, to me they had very little flavor. But my rabbits and the dog love them. Kind of expensive but if you get them at the $1 per bag rates you are getting a big bargain even with the shipping and handling. I actually ordered some treats from a different business that sells bunny treats and found it was this same product repackaged, a smaller amount in the bag and a bigger price. So I checked Amazon and found that the identical items were sold as doggie treats in a bigger bag and less cost. On top of that nice savings (I don't have a car at the moment so I can't drive to the pet store)the animals fight each other to be first in the handout line. I wish I could get the recipe for them. And, I'd like to buy them in a 5lb bag. Does anyone sell them that way? They'd make a nice doggie Christmas present.

Can't say enough good things about this product.... We've tried 3 Fruitables varieties - pumpkin/apple, pumpkin/cranberry, and pumpkin/blueberry - and the pooch craves them all. As he has kidney disease, it is very important that his treats are low in protein and fat, and these treats follow the specifications of what we should be feeding him perfectly! As other reviewers have mentioned, they smell so good it's hard to believe they're not meant for human consumption... I haven't had the nerve to actually try one... yet. I would highly recommend them!

column9: Healthy and my dog loves them!
column10: My veterinarian sister recommended these and I'm so glad she did! My dog loves them and the ingredients make me feel great about giving them to him. Awesome dog treat!

column9: Great treats! A hit for humans and animals alike!
column10: Finding treats for my aging dog has been a challenge. She has dietary restrictions which include no salt and low protein. She won't eat some of the obvious, more common snacks (sweet potato strips for example) and finding Fruitables has been great!!! They actually stimulate my 16 year olds appetite.  And, they are so inexpensive!!! After spending a fortune at the boutique stores, Fruitables are quite a find.

My GSD loves these treats.  It's getting to the point where she hears the bag crinkle she comes running and shows me all the tricks she knows!I like these because I can grab a few without getting stinky hands!!!

column9: Awesome ingredient list, dog loves them.
column10: Ingredients:Pumpkin, Organic Oatmeal, Pearled Barley, Whole ground potatoes, Oat Fiber, Apples, Canola Oil (with mixed Tocopherols, a natural preservative), Organic Cane Molasses, Cinnamon, Vanilla.Dog loves them, I love their ingredients.

I don't have terribly picky eaters, especially when it comes to treats, but I wasn't sure they would like the Fruitables.  I got them the Pumpkin Banana & they love them...I will probably get them the other flavors to try.

These treats are low calorie, which my slightly full-figured Cockapoo's appreciate.  If you're one of those people that "reward" a lot during the day, it is amazing how fast the calories can add up.....these are all-natural treat, and the dogs like them too!
All four of my dogs, ranging in age from 1 to 14 years old, love the fruitables products.  I highly recommend!
I have two dogs who LOVE this stuff!  It is a healthy, low calorie treat that smells great.  My babies can get as many treats as they deserve:-)
My Golden Retriever loves these treats. He knows where I keep them and sits by the closet waiting for me to give them to him.

I bought a package of each flavor of the Fruitables treats and my dogs love, love, love them! They're definitely crunchy but no different than any other crunchy-type biscuit. While two of my dogs would eat garbage, one is a bit more persnickity. Even he gobbles these down! Between Fruitables and Zuke's, we're done with grocery treats forever!

My dog thoroughly enjoys these treats.  The smell is very enticing (even to his human master!!), the size of the treat is very manageable, he enjoys the texture which is nice and crunchy and I'm sure it tastes really good because he keeps coming back for more when I show it to him!!
Both of our dogs just love all three flavors of Fruitables!  They have become a wonderful training tool and general reward favorite.

column9: Fruitables - All-Natural Pumpkin & Blueberry Dog Treats
column10: We have a Newfoundland that we like to pamper. He also has a sensitive stomach. These treats were recommeded by our vet. The treats are human grade quality - and each piece is about 7 calories. I use them as training treats and "just because your a good dog" treat - he loves them.

In Alex's (my dog) opinion, they don't quite compare to liver treats, but he readily accepts them.  Since he is supposed to be losing a few pounds, they help cut back on his daily caloric intake without depriving him of a little snack now and then.

Our dog has a sensitive stomach and often doesn't chew his food completely. We have searched for healthy treats he'll actually chew and that won't bother his stomach. He LOVES these treats! They crunch satisfactorily, smell good and don't bother his stomach. His tail wags like crazy the second he sees the cookie jar come down filled with these!
My boy loves these treats, they have healthy ingredients, and are low-cal. I've bought all the flavors and I highly recommend.(They're wheat free!)
My dog loves these - and they smell delicious.  A healthy treat I don't feel guilty giving to him.

The flavor is fine but don't be fooled by the photo, which makes the bag appear to be much larger than it actually is. It fits in the palm of an adult's hand. Really small amount for the price. I think freeze-dried is a better value.
Item arrives with in the specified time.  I was very pleased with the item and would use this company again.

column9: A big hit with my dogs.
column10: Obviously, I can't tell you how these taste, but I know my dogs love them. This was the first time I bought the FunBites Beefhide Chews, and from the package displayed, or even the product page, It didn't give a lot of information about the size, but these chews are 5 inches in length, and approximately 3/4 inch in size, so these chews last a long time. They were a bigger package at a cheaper price than what I was buying for my dogs. I'm very pleased with them.

My dogs Abbey and Chewy love FunBites.  What I like about them is it keeps my dogs amused for hours while they chew on them.  The other reason I bought them was to help clean their teeth.  My vet says dogs live longer when they don't have tooth decay.  He said the more teeth they lose from tooth decay the harder it is for them to chew their food when they get older.  I always keep Funbites in our house.

The beagle is still not feeling up to speed but the lab seemed to be ok by the end of the next day.  Has anyone had any issues.  It scared us.RegardsLeanne
My labs just love these chews. I'm going to keep a large stash of these from now on!
Just bought some of these the other day. If you are looking for a dog treat that is nutritious and will keep your pet entertained, this is it!  So glad this product is available on Subscribe & Save!

It relaxes her to the point where she is able to fall asleep (without drugs) and sleep soundly through the night.  Why we didn't investigate this years ago is beyond me, but I thank the day we met an herbalist. This is a good product.

column10: I have been using this tea for awhile now and it helps me much better then prescription medication for stomach gas, I suggest if you suffer from gastric problems to try this tea, and also for IBS TRY SMOOTH MOVE TEA.

column4: J. Loscheider "No one knows I'm a radical"
column10: Xantham gum is essential to any gluten-free baking. You can use guar gum but it just isn't as good. This is top quality product, and a little goes a long way. Most recipes only call for a teaspoon or two. An order of 6 8-ounce packages should last an average household two years (unless you bake bread twice a week, then it's only a year maybe :-) ).One caveat - this is a very fine dust and it is best handled carefully... unless you like a pricey haze of xantham around your kitchen.

Gluten is not a concern for us, however, we use many vegan recipes which are also accommodate gluten free sensitivities.  Sometimes I use gluten/flour with those vegan recipes.  This product makes egg-free cookies and other baked goods truly excellent.
Great price on serious quantity of Xanthan Gum, the low-carb all-purpose thickener for those on low-carb diets. With Subscribe & Save, I can get enough to share and more if I need it.
This is a 'can't live without' product for those on a GF diet.  This bulk pricing is a great deal.
Xanthan gum is the key to (most) gluten-free baking, and Bob's Red Mill is one of the most reliable sources for all gluten-free baking products.

Bob's red mill is generally the way to go for GF products.  I first bought this at my local grocery store and tried it to make sure I liked it.  I looked it here on Amazon and saw that I could save (a LOT) if I bought in bulk.  My only worry is that I hope I can use it all in time.
Gluten free baking just wouldn't be the same without this stuff.  We've used other brands but this one has a finer texture.

This purchase was a random one; I had never heard of the product before but I was looking for some little Christmas gifts and stocking stuffers for my husband. Well, he is the grill master and when I came across these rubs I thought I'd give a couple a try. I am so glad I did! This Smoky Barbeque Rub is absolutely delicious!! A great smoky-sweet rub with just enough spices and a great blend of flavors. It grills up really nicely. We have used it on chicken and pork and it is just plain yummy. We haven't tried the other one (pork rub) yet but I am looking forward to doing so... This was a truly great find; I highly recommend it!

We discovered Lavazza coffee while staying in an upscale club in Chicago. The coffee maker in the room had Lavazza Gran Filtro as the choice. I was impressed by the coffee coming out of this little machine, but figured it was just the opulence of the place overwhelming my taste buds. Then I discovered a small Lavazza coffee shop nearby and the coffee was even better. My love for Lavazza coffee was born.But alas, too much caffeine makes me nuts. Could the decaf be any good? It is! The same smooth, slightly sweet, never bitter taste of Gran Filtro comes through in the decaf. We keep both the regular and decaf on hand and regularly get good reviews on the coffee we serve. I've stopped buying anything else.

We love dark roast coffee, so take that up front for this review. However, I was shocked to see I could subscribe & save Italian Decaf coffee shipped to my house for under $4 per bag. Then, I realized you only get 8 ounces per bag, which is half the grocery store size normal bags. Then we brewed it. I don't think it tasted bad, but even the smell of the grounds wasn't as fresh as other companies. And the flavor was pretty empty - it is so smooth that we found it almost flavorless.Also, this is a chemically decaffeinated product, and we find it is worth it to pay an extra $1 per bag and go for the Swiss Water decaffeination which is natural and not chemical.Anyhow, the flavor wasn't to our liking and we have moved on.

I love this coffee!  It tastes like regular coffee, yet it's decaf, which means i can still have a good night sleep.  I can drink it even when it becomes cold.  I hope they continue to carry this item :)

column4: My husband is the cook "T Schnabel"
column10: My husband is spoiled, or so he tells me. After this he can't find any other decaf he likes as well. He must be right. Every so often I'll make a cup in the evening and I don't really realize it's decaf unless I think about it. For someone who can't imagine getting through the day without coffee, it doesn't get much better than that.For myself, having tried all the house brands (coffee bean & tea leaf being the best in that bunch) along with Gevalia and Illy, Lavazza has become the favorite. Gevalia was nice for the variety. For reasons I can't explain, Illy has become a backpacking tradition. Don't go without it, but don't have it many other times, either. Lavazza is the household daily.
Made correctly (use a tablespoon of coffee per cup), this tastes like good Italian coffee even though it is decaf.
This is the most wonderful chip in the world. I love them. They are very crunchy and have a nice jalapeno taste.

column9: very delicious and easy soup mix
column10: I found this jar of  Tamarind soup base in a Vietnamese market here in Northern Virginia because I could not find the tamarind paste in my local asian store.I just finished making a small pot of 3 cups water to 2 tbs or so (to taste) and added edible taro stem (warning - you MUST MUST MUST get the edible taro stem from a Vietnamese market!!! There are many poisonous varieties of taro stem due to calcium oxalate - that are irritating and potentially hazardous to your health that are sold elsewhere that require very hot long boiling with salted water then drained and even then I am not sure it is safe...) with tomatoes and green onion and catfish.I once had this soup years ago from a Vietnamese friend and she used the tamarind paste instead.  This powdered soup mix is the closest thing to real tamarind paste and has a very delightful tasting salty and sour taste that feels so refreshing for summer!Basically, you just add this sauce to water, add the catfish and bring to a boil then simmer till the catfish is cooked. Then you serve it by putting it in a bowl, add the chopped tomatoes, and eat it with Jasmine rice. You can also substitute fish ball (made of fish cake - found in Asian markets) or shrimp, any seafood. I love it with shrimp.I was amazed at how realistic this soup tasted to what I remembered. Highly recommended. Too bad they don't just sell one container at a time instead of having to buy in bulk quantities as one jar will go quite far for the occasional Gourmand.
This is so good!!!  I love it on fish and chicken, and it just makes things taste so much better....

I have used this product before and it is excellent.  Unfortunately, when this shipment arrived the seal on the item was broken and some of the product had already been squirted out of the container into the lid.  I can't use it and according to Amazon's policies (pressurized container) I can't return it.  I can't even request a replacement to be sent - very unimpressed with Amazon.

I received last week this extra virgin red palm oil, and for those gourmet vegetarians like me, I strongly recommend to use this oil to prepare a Tofu Stir Fry (tofu, zucchini, and yellow squash, with some spices as coriander, garlic and salt). Delicious and very healthy Dish!

I love the palm oil.  It is organic, extra virgin, and unrefined--which is what I was looking for.  One of the jars arrived broken and the company remedied the situation immediately.  I will definitely order again!  Also, it was the best price I could find.

I received this red palm oil about 3 days ago. It is absolutely delicious. We consume it straight from the jar as an anti-oxidant supplement.It smells like a mild spice but when consumed tastes like carrot puree. And since I love carrots, this is awesome :)The only bad thing is that I didn't order more...

Red Palm Oil is a wonderful, healthy, tasty addition to a low carb diet.  If you are searching for a new healthy fat to use in your meal preparations, in addition to the coconut oil you are already using, then Red Palm Oil is for you.  The bright orange color comes from the abundant caratinoids in the red palm fruit. It is also rich source of vitamin E, and CoQ10.It adds a wonderfully unique flavor to egg, meat, and fish dishes.  I typically like to blend red palm oil w/ coconut oil for pan frying salmon, or grilling meat or poultry.  It also works well in chili recipes.Red Palm Oil is difficult, if not impossible, to find in retail grocers, including the large, organic, health food grocer.Even though this oil is widely used throughout the world, being produced in countries such as, West Africa, Malaysia, Indonesia, and South America, it must be a scarce import to the USA.  Why else would the price for this oil be so expensive?  When you add $10+ shipping cost to the $14+ retail cost, that's EXPENSIVE! for 16oz, relative to other healthy cooking fats like olive and coconut oil, or butter.I've tried both the Okonatur and Omni brands sold by Amazon, and while both are good, I prefer the Okonatur.  The Okonatur red palm oil seems to smoke during frying a little more readily than the Omni brand, which may be due to a different fatty acid profile, however, the flavor characteristics of the Okonatur are more pleasant to my palate.For price comparison purposes, I have purchased a 16oz jar of Okonatur Red Palm Oil for $18.99 retail (San Francisco, CA) That, vs the $28.00 it will cost on Amazon - not a difficult choice to make.Bottom line: Buy Online if you can't find it locally - but give red palm oil a try.
I love cooking with Red Palm Oil,  I use a lot of West African Recipes.

I buy this product as a dietary supplement for my African Grey Parrot.  It helps keep his feathers nice and shiny and discourages plucking.  Its not appropriate for all species but greys eat palm nuts in the wild and need a high intake of oil in their diet.  My bird loves it and will eat it right off the spoon.

I bought this for my parrot but have ended up using it for me, my dogs and parrots. It taste great and I can see an improvement in my birds feathers and my dogs coat.The price was great and it got to Alaska in just a few days.
This is the second Red Palm Oil that I have tried. THis bottle of oil smoked when I turned on the heat. I hadn't had that to happen before. I am satisfied with the flavor though.

This is great red palm oil.  Even though most people are using it to cook with, the health benefits are much greater if you do not heat it.  It is great in a salad.  Use with organic vinegar, salt, cayenne, and other spices you would like as a dressing.  CoQ10 is destroyed upon heating, so cooking is a terrible way to get the health benefits.  Also, the vitamin E is destroyed upon being heated.  This product also contains an extremely high content of vitamin A, which is also destroyed upon heating.  The one user who described his birds appearance glow after using this product must have fed it to him right out of the jar, without heating it.  Even though cooking with is occasionally is okay, remember that almost all of the time, it is much better to eat it raw (unheated).  This is one of the truly great raw foods which is loaded with, as far as I am concerned, the most beneficial combination of nutrients that every body needs.The Okonatur Red Palm Oil is Extra Virgin and Organic.  It has all of the characteristics that Red Palm Oil should have.  It remains solid in cooler temperatures, but becomes liquid at slightly higher temperatures (well below cooking temp!!)  A hot day will cause the oil to become liquid.  The color is a deep reddish orange, which means that all of the nutrients that I described above are present.  The pungent taste comes from the way the palm fruit tastes.  The pungent taste is also an indication that this product is fresh and pure.  If Red Palm Oil tastes bland, it is a sign that it is not fresh, and the beneficial nutrients are missing!!  I personally would never cook with it, as my body seems to need all of the nutritional benefits derived from eating it raw.This is a company dedicated to delivering a product with all of the nutritional benefits intact.  They are not concerned with just making a quick profit.  I can tell by the way they take care to deliver the very highest quality Organic, Extra Virgin Red Palm Oil that they care deeply about their customers.  I thank God for people dedicated to the health of their customers, rather than dedicated to lining their pockets with gimmick products.  I can tell you, this product is truly a winner.  I can assure you that this is one company where the owners as well as the employees eat their product.Try eating it raw, (i.e., uncooked), and you will see great improvements in your health.  It is truly packed with nutrition and health.  Everything from your eyes to your hair to your attitude to your energy to your sleep and more will improve upon eating this Red Palm Oil the correct way.It has been my great pleasure to have found such a wonderful product, as well as a great company to purchase it from.  Don't just take my word, eat it raw and you will write the same raving reviews I just did!  An extremely satisfied customer!!!
red palm oil is healthy. it's loaded with vitamin E, along with other nutrients. other healthy oils are: coconut oil, sesame oil, flaxseed oil, hemp oil, nuts, seeds, and some others.

column9: Supposed to be healthy; Taste is Gag.
column10: I heard all about red palm oil from an Underground Wellness blog-radio show. It sounded really healthy with all the antioxidant and Vitamin E tocotrienols, so I decided to give it a try.Here is first experience with red palm oil:The oil looked somewhat like a more viscous tomato paste and then the smell hit me. It didn't smell like something I wanted to eat. I tasted a little bit and found it to be an indescribably bad taste - somewhat like when you throw up a little bit in your mouth. I kept an open mind and used it to cook some everyday items like meat and eggs. The oil smoked almost right away over heat. I was rather disappointed in that, but someone else said they experienced the same thing and that it's not supposed to do that. The food I made with it gained the flavor of the palm oil, unfortunately, and it was rather strong.I'm thinking that when you use it, you need to put it in dishes that will overpower it with strong spices and other flavors. If anybody has any suggestions on complimentary cuisine, I'd appreciate it. I still think the health benefits outweigh the bad taste, so I want to keep using it - just sparingly and in dishes that overpower it.

This bottle is $14.00 plus $15.00 for s/h.  I'll have to keep searching. I guess.  I am giving this three stars as, to be fair, I have not tried it, but three stars is middle of the road....not a bad rating, not a good rating.
This is great for everyday busy self feeders or you can get a attachable spoon from boon company that works great. Great taste and it's great for stroller snack!!!!
Our baby loves these pouches and quickly learned how to self-feed with them.  We take some with us every time we leave the house, for easy, portable, healthy snacks.

I was very excited to find a natural butter flavor as opposed to artificial. Unfortunately it is HIDEOUS! It tastes like pepper and smells sort of like curry. It's so ridiculous all I can do is giggle.
I got the product in time and it is exactly what I expected it to be.

The closest method was to add some chicken drippings to a base made from roasted chicken wings and vegetable broth.  Imagine Foods Organic Free Range Chicken Broth is better than my mom's chicken broth, and she was an award winning cook.Even though the price has gone up recently, and I run towards extremely thrifty, I still buy it.  Once you try it you simply can't be satisfied  with any other chicken broth.  Add any chopped veggies and chicken, pasta or grains if desired, and you have a superb soup.

Whole spelt tastes SO much better and milder than whole wheat!It's a great product.Holds shape well.Digests easier.Whole grain benefits.I like it a lot.

Very nice gave as a gift, came in a pink polka dotted coffee cup and saucer and still looks great weeks later my mother loves it

column9: Order for my mom for Mother's day
column10: I ordered this item on Tuesday with a delivery date for Friday, the item was received today, Thursday. Not a huge deal but I was surprised since I selected a specific delivery date. With all that being said my mom said the Orchid was beautiful. It was extremely well packaged, my mom said it took her a while to unwrap the Orchid. Just found out our grandson is allergic to almost every food :( I was looking for an alternative for popcorn and found these, what a life saver ! I was a bit skeptical as to how big the bags were, but was satiated in the end. Finding halal gummies like this in the US is not an easy task. Rest assured, they were Zabiha halal.As to the product: the taste of this type of candy is initially sweet due to the granulated sugar after which you begin to taste the flat-cola type of flavor. As far as crab "zippers" go, this didn't do too well of a job, so I will try another brand (and seafood gets cold quickly so I don't want to spend all day trying to get it open).

column9: I Would Not Recommend This Gum
column10: First of all, I was under the impression that this gum contained Stevia.  After getting it, I saw it does not.  It doesn't have aspartame in it, but it does have Manitol, etc.  Secondly, if you have tried nicotine gums, this is the consistency...it comes in the same packaging  as nicotine gum, and it's tough to open and tough on the fillings.  I think now I need a few old fillings replaced after chewing several pieces over a week's span.  Thirdly, if you write to the email address on the gum package, they don't answer you.  I wrote to them twice over a week's period of time with no response.  I wanted to know, since ONE piece contains 25% of the daily requirement of vitamin A, what if you chewed several pieces in a day, every day,--would you reach toxic levels of Vitamin A in your body?  Well, I guess I don't need to know that now anyway, because it is NOT a gum you'd want to keep chewing, as it is too tough on fillings.  I would not buy it again!

column9: Perfect for what it was designed for
column10: This is a dental gum.  Don't expect it to taste like chocolate ice cream or something.  It's good for your teeth and is great at freshening your breath.  However it has one more awesome use for my purposes.  It contains sodium bicarbonate which buffers acid.  If you suffer from GERD or even worse LPR  this gum can provide some short term relief.  Your saliva naturally has some bicarbonate in it and this will add to that and periodically swallowing does wonders for my LPR symptoms.LPR causes sore throats and mouth due to acid reflux.  The mint form is cheaper, however mint relaxes your esophogeal sphincter and is a big no-no.  Cinnamon is supposed to help lower your blood pressure and doesn't have the same negative effect as mint in my experience.
I love this gum and it's hard to find in stores.  There's no sugar and no nutra sweet, just great taste and a chewing gum that's actually good for you.

I purchased the saffron with an eye to giving it away as presents to three women who are dedicated cooks. Although I myself did not try the product, they have reported that although the saffron did product the lovely yellow color in the dish they had prepared, the flavor was not entirely "right".  This is a more affordable version of the more expensive saffron that can be used in a pinch but if you want the total experience, you will have to splurge for the better quality stuff. However, this saffron is still much better than the coloring agents found on supermarket shelves that merely reproduce the desired yellow tinge to dishes.
I'm new to using this abd have found the taste wonderful. It adds a great flavor. It's now on my regular use agenda
The description states 1 ounce but what I received was 1 gram. I am in the process of getting a refund, no idea how long it will take.Also, $25 for 1gm of saffron is a ridiculous price!
