This product was also moisturizing, with a pleasant smell. Although when you are lathering with it, it smells tropically...like coconuts with a hint of almond, once rinsed, I really didn't notice a strong lingering odor.  This shampoo moisturizes your hair while nourishing it, leaving your hair feeling clean and healthy. The packaging is attractive and fits nicely in a corner of the shower (or bath). The bottle has a tall with a simple, slender design.  And finally, it is affordable. Overall, I give this product a 4.

I generally take a shower and wash my hair at the gym. From time to time my hair gets dry and dull and my scalp itches from washing it almost everyday.  I was pleasantly suprised after using CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Ultra shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo, my hair was soft and shiney and my scalp was itch free. I highly recommend trying this product. All you have to lose is dull hair and an itchy scalp.

column9: Nice product to try, but you'll probaly not stick to it
column10: Pros:- Good scent- Rich texture- Easily foam-ableCons:- After a month or two I've started noticing some odd smell in my bathroom, I think this shampoo does not age wellNeutral:- Can't say that my hair felt different comparing to other hair products, but then again that's very rare.Bottom line:Nice product as a refresher, but you'll probably won't stick with it.

column9: CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Ultra Shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce
column10: CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Ultra Shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce. Shipping was okay. I love the smell. Price is similar to what they have in stores.  I would recommend this product. I would buy again.

This shampoo smells good, lathers nicely, and rinses well with no residue, BUT it left my hair feeling like straw and almost crunchy. This was immediately after rinsing it out of my hair, before applying conditioner. My hair felt so raw and rough. I did not like it at all. Heaps of conditioner were needed for it to feel smooth again. It was still hard to detangle even after the conditioner and I always comb my hair while in the shower with conditioner in it too. It may work well for someone out there, but definitely not me.

My husband and I both used this shampoo for a 2-week period in order to give it time to "work". The shampoo did nothing for my hair. It feels like a light conditioner, and leaves my hair feeling heavy and drab. I am giving it 3 stars because I think it has potential of working on a different kind of hair (I have very fine, straight hair), and it has a non-offensive scent.

I have been impressed with this shampoo in terms of helping relieve my dry scalp and hair. Anyone with this problem knows full well how frustrating it can be--and if your like me you've most likely tried a lot of different shampoos which claim to help only to be disappointed. This shampoo has such a luxurious feel to it and I love the scent of Shea butter (I note some others don't agree). I use this shampoo 2 to 3 times a week and have truly noted my hair appears a lot less dry and brittle--more importantly others have as well. This comes at the expense of less body though which is the only reason I don't use it every day. This may be an issue (only) for those with thin, fine hair like mine. The good news is this it's a shampoo you need to use daily to get good results. I will defiantly be getting another bottle when this runs out.

This shampoo cleans and leaves my hair soft and manageable for days. Nice lather, and rinses out easily, leaving no greasy residue. I only wash my hair twice a week and this shampoo keeps my hair soft and clean during all the days in between.  It also smells great.  I've been looking for a good, inexpensive shampoo for a while and I think I finally found it!

column9: excellent Shampoo for soft but manageable hair
column10: This is a great shampoo.  Not only does it clean my hair nicely, but it leaves just the right amount of a very pleasant scent.  I am middle aged, and my hair is getting drier, and from the first use, this has left my hair softer.  I don't have dandruff, but my scalp is dry and will itch after using some shampoos, not so with this one.  One of the benefits I found it that it is a bit richer than some other brands, and being less watery, you can get results with a very small amount so that the bottle lasts much longer.  Since I wash my hair every day, I only use conditioner every other time, and that routine is working well for me.  This product reminds me of a salon quality shampoo at an affordable price.

All in all, I actually liked this one pretty well. It left my waist length hair feeling fairly "fluffy" rather than limp or weighted down. Hair seemed slightly less prone to frizz especially in the high Florida humidity. Easy to open cap is a nice touch and unlike similar items, this bottle didn't leak. Also, I strongly preferred this fragrance over the other line.All in all, a decent product with decent results for a decent price. Nothing to get overly excited by but all in all, not a bad product whatsoever.

I have used the "total care" from Clear and LOVED it. Made my hair silky, manageable and smooth. Did not leave my hair greasy or flaky. I love the total care and will go back to it. Love it better than professional lines that I have used in the past.Now to talk about Shea Cleanse. I love the smell, I feel like I am on a tropical holiday (reminds me of tanning lotion). It seems as though it will work as well as the total care. But I only got the shampoo and using Pantene conditioner with it. I feel as though I have gone back to my old products by using this combo (the flaky scalp came back). I would hate to rate it low, because the trust I gained by using Total Care makes me feel as if the Ultra Shea could be as good if I used the conditioner along with it. I find is that the "gold" bottles are hard to find at stores. Because of Vine sometimes releasing products to us sooner, this may change as retailers carry more of the line. I am only saying this because I used the 2 different products together. The outcome might (and probably would have) been better if I had both the shampoo and conditioner. I have found the Total care, but no gold bottles. So that alone, and my overall satisifaction with the total care makes me want to stick with it. I totally recommend this line. Espcially since I have long thick hair. I think It all depends on your hair style. Oh, and the price is great too!

column9: Shea, Shea, Shea, what you want.....
column10: This review is for Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Ultra Shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo & Conditioner.This is the third of the clear scalp and hair beauty products that I've used, and I'm starting to wonder if there's any difference between them. I didn't wash my hair and suddenly think "Wow! This product brings out all of the potential my hair has ever had!" but it wasn't bad. My biggest complaint about this particular product is the scent. I'm not sure how to explain it, but the scent seems a little chemical to me. It reminds me of a very faint version of the way your hair smells after a perm.This product isn't so bad that I won't eventually finish the bottle, but it's not something I plan on purchasing in the future.

This has been great for the family members whose hair tends to be very dry.  The packaging leaves a little to be desired since the top popped off during shipping, but it was tight in plastic bag so no product lost.  Otherwise, smells nice & clean, not overpowering, washes well and leaves hair feeling smooth.

column9: Requires lots of extra rinsing, but works quite well
column10: I have salt and pepper middle aged hair, and it always feels a little stiff. Also, my scalp tends to crack and bleed if I wash my hair as often as I think it needs. This shampoo made a big difference. My hair is much softer, and even better, my scalp isn't as prone to cracking. I like the smell very much, although if you don't like coconut and vanilla, that may be an issue for you.The one drawback to it is that it takes a lot of time to rinse out thoroughly. It also doesn't rinse well with cool water. This means I have to take longer showers, which I do find to be a noticeable drawback. Still, on the whole, I like it and will most likely continue using it.

I wish I had a bit more to say about this product.  I used both this and the conditioner of the same line.  As a result, and with apology, my reviews for these products will be very similar.The scent of the shampoo is fine.  It's neither particularly outstanding nor is it bad.  The scent, such as it is, is not very long lasting.  The shampoo seemed to do a good job of cleaning my hair.After using it, I didn't notice any particular change in my hair.  It didn't seem stronger or shinier.  It's possible that I could see improvements with repeated use, but I've used other shampoos that give a fantastic result with the first wash.It simply seems to be a fine, basic shampoo and seems mild enough for everyday use.

I found this shampoo to be okay but not anything I would buy again without some improvement. It had a nice lather to it and washed out of my hair easily, leaving it feeling clean but not squeaky. What I really didn't like about it was the smell. To me the odor was similar to play-doh, which is not a pleasant scent in my book. It would need to be unscented or lightly scented with a more tenable smell before I would use it again.

The first time I used this shampoo, I was really surprised how my hair felt when I rinsed it out.  It rinsed out really clean, unlike the Aussie I had been using for two weeks, which leaves a coating on my hair.  I think the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Ultra Shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce makes a good clarifying shampoo.  Also, my hair did look better the first few times I used it.  (I wash my hair every night.)  But then, the shampoo seemed little different than the others I used, and my hair didn't look any different.  Thus, I just started alternating it with my other shampoos--Aussie Moist Shampoo, 13.5-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6) and Garnier Shampoo Daily Care, 13 Fluid Ounce.  Unlike those two, the Clear Scalp does have a slight perfume smell, but it's not a strong scent and it doesn't linger.  Good for those of us hyper-sensitive to perfume scents.

column4: David McCune "self-deprecating and proud of it"
column9: Good for hair, great for scalp.
column10: Were you to glimpse my hairline, I think it is safe to say you would not find me a likely candidate to review shampoo for Amazon.  There is about as much scalp as hair, and what hair I do have is kept Army-short.  Still, despite being follicularly challenged, I can endorse this product for two reasons.Reason #1 is right there is the title "SCALP and hair".  I've tried a ridiculous number of hair products, yet I always seem to be dealing with dry scalp.  This product is literally the best I have yet found at leaving the scalp moist without feeling oily. This is true even when using it after swimming, which has always tended to bring out the worst in dryness for me.Reason #2 is that I sought out a second opinion.  My wife, who has long and beautiful hair.  She also has a stable of hair-care products that I find bewildering in its extent and price range.  She pronounced this to be a very good product, and would use it "if it's not too expensive".  Having no idea what would be "too expensive", I clarified that this would be about one order of magnitude greater than the current price.  In other words, this is a good deal.So there you go.  Ringing endorsements on both the scalp and the hair aspects of this shampoo.5 stars.

I have used this shampoo for two weeks now. I can't really say it is that great. It is supposed to be for a dry scalp, which I have. However, it seems to leave a film on my hair and a layer on my scalp no matter how much I try to rinse it out.The one thing I do love about it is the smell. It smells like coconuts. However, I would not buy this again for cleaning my hair. I will finish the bottle but after that, no more.I have been using it with CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Ultra Shea Smooth & Nourish Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce . The conditioner works well but not the shampoo.

This is an extremely nice shampoo.  It has a nice blend of ingredients such as shea butter sunflower, coconut and almond, to list a few.  These ingredients promote a great clean feeling and a nice refreshing smell once the product is washed out of one's hair.  I also felt like my hair was lighter after using this product.  I did accompany this shampoo with its counterpart;CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Ultra Shea Smooth & Nourish Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce  I usually do not use a shampoo and conditioner set, but the results were very nice.  And for what it is worth a little goes a long way.

I took this shampoo (and the conditioner) to the beauty salon with me.  The products meet the approval of my stylist and the owner of the salon. The shampoo was pleasant smelling, and left my hair soft. I also noted that it was quite easy to wash out. In the days since my wash, I haven't seen any flakes, or experienced anu itching.

column9: Leaves my hair clean and smelling good
column10: My hair is thin, and most shampoos leave my hair feeling dry and stringy. The Clear Scalp Ultra Shea shampoo really cleans without drying my hair out. After rinsing my hair, it no longer feels dry and stringy. I use it in combination with the Ultra Shea conditioner, and my hair feels really good. My wife uses both the shampoo and conditioner and also likes them. My one complaint is that it does not rinse off easily. I have to rinse a lot to get it out of my hair, and my hair is short. While I don't like to use the same shampoo very often, this is one that I will use a lot. My wife and I both love how it smells, too. Try it, I think you'll like it.

I tried this shampoo along with the conditioner of the same kind and found them to be very heavy for my curly hair. It also made my hair look lifeless, which was pretty strange because my hair did feel very soft to the touch. It is a pearly creamy liquid and smells wonderful, I was hoping to be able to use it since it did make my hair feel soft when washing it, but cant explain why the end result was so bland. Anyway, I have a feeling that it is not for curly hair.

My hair is very dry and my scalp is very prone to dandruff. Usually without an extensive dandruff treatment that leaves my hair really really dry, my dandruff never goes away. Washing it will sometimes make it better for a day or two, but that's about it.This is first shampoo I've tried that doesn't dry my hair out AND gets rid of dandruff. I usually wash my hair every 7 to 10 days. I haven't had a dandruff problem between shampoos since I've been using it, which has been about a month. It feels good on my scalp, leaves my hair soft, and it smells good, too. ^_^I think is probably best for anyone with dandruff or a problem with excess oil or product buildup on the scalp.The conditioner that goes along with this is equally impressive.

It's summertime and I have dry hair and scalp resulting in an itchy head.  This product has not made it any better but it's not any worse either.  I just don't see any results.I do not care for the scent of this shampoo one bit.  To be honest it smells like play-doh to me.I have used Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty's Dry Scalp Shampoo & Conditioner and saw results immediately.I found this shampoo to be very average with a not too great scent.  I don't think I'd recommend it.

column9: Shiny hair and no itchy scalp
column10: My daughter is prone to dry hair. She has long, curly, super thick hair that tends to get flyaways and frizzes easily.She's been using this shampoo with the matching conditioner for the last week, following the instructions on the bottle.Her hair has been very shiny, and her scalp isn't itching like it tends to do usually just following shampooing. She's just thrilled with the shampoo and conditioner, she likes the scent and the shape of the bottles.

I was a bit nervous about sampling this shampoo as I have been using the same cheap shampoo for years since it doesn't upset my allergies and it got my hair clean which is what shampoo is supposed to do isn't it? So this was my first experience with a better bran shampoo and I have been thrilled. The first day I used it, I noticed first of all that while scented it was with a very mild scent which shouldn't be bothersome to anyone. The next thing that came up was driving my husband into the hospital due to a heart problem. As wives tend to do when they are waiting through the ER and finally admission routines, you rub your face and hair wondering how bad this was all going to be. Every time I touched my hair, I was amazed at how soft and silky it felt and then I remembered, "Oh yeah, new shampoo". Then touching my hair calmed me down. Thankfully hubby is home now and feeling much better and as I continue with the use of this shampoo I find it doesn't leave my hair greasy or limp like some shampoos with conditioner tend to do. I really like it and I'm glad I was given a very big bottle to try it out since it will last me awhile!

Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Ultra Shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo is a nice shampoo.  I've got very, very dry and frizzy hair, so I usually avoid products with sodium lauryl sulfate and sodium laureth sulfate.  This shampoo has sodium laureth sulfate, but when I used it with its accompanying Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Ultra Shea Smooth & Nourish Conditioner, my hair emerged silky (though still frizzy since the beauty industry has yet to invent a flat iron in a bottle).I usually use $20 per bottle shampoo and matching conditioner from my local salon in attempts to make my hair behave.  I'm not going to stop using those in favor of this more economical shampoo due to the presence of sodium laureth sulfate.  But I'm going to add this one in about once a month for a little variety and as a way to stretch my expensive shampoo out.  Every little bit helps in budgeting!A few bonuses: this product smells fantastic and the bottle design that dispenses shampoo from the bottom is terrific!

I am not a scientist. Therefore I don't know how to speak about "moisture lock" (is that even possible?) or PEG-9M, or "Methylisothiozolinone." I do feel favorably toward shea butter and Sweet Almond Oil." The list of ingredients on the label is two inches long. It has more sunflower seed oil than it has coconut oil. It doesn't appear to have dye in it.As an older woman with "fine" hair I find Clear does a good job for me and smells good. The shampoo is creamy and makes my hair super-soft. This means there isn't as much "movement" of my hair as is normal and sometimes that's good. Since I do worry about product build up, I have always switched off shampoos, never using just one brand. This shampoo works well with that schedule. I've used Clear for almost a month now and have had no problems with it.

Clear scalp is the best shampoo I have used in years. I love the idea that it has the vitamin E and Shea butter in it and  infuse the hair with moisturizer and clean the the skill as it moisturizes and clean the hair at the end of the day. This product is good, I like I'm going to buy some more of this product and keep it on  my self as I run out. The price is just right.

I have dry, fine, slightly wavy, shoulder length hair.  It can tend to get a little bit fly-away if I don't use a good moisturizing shampoo and conditioner.  This shampoo is working just fine for me, and at around five bucks, it's a good value.The texture of the shampoo took a little getting used to.  It's creamy and thick, almost lotion-y.  It does lather up nicely, but it's a denser lather most shampoos.  From the feel, I was concerned that it wouldn't clean as well, but it does a good job.  My hair comes out clean, soft, and shiny.I notice a bit of residue with this shampoo, but that's pretty common with moisturizing shampoos.  I use a clarifying shampoo (like Neutrogena) a few times a month to remove residue.

I have to say I really did like this shampoo.  It lathers nicely and cleans nicely which is the whole purpose of it.  The fragrance is nice and not overpowering.  My hair is really short so I only had to use a little bit and I always wash my hair twice so I think this one is going to work out.  I used it with the matching conditioner and had wonderful results.  This shampoo at least didn't leave a heavy veil on my hair as some do so it's worth taking a try.

I was skeptical at first to try this product, because I thought it would make my hair dry and my scalp itch. I was so wrong! This product is thick, moisturizing, and nourished both my scalp and hair. It also did not tangle my hair during the wash. I will definitely purchase this product.

I am no expert when it comes to scalp and hair treatment as it has always been my policy to looks for the item that's on sale. When I got an opportunity to get a bottle of the Clear Scalp & Hair Therapy shampoo I found I  had two very interested "clients", my spouse and my granddaughter. I ordered the Clear on the Vine program and once it arrived both wanted to be the first to try.My granddaughter used the shampoo first and the results were amazing. The end result was that her hair looked fantastic so I asked her what she did and nothing more than a single wash and her hair , according to my spouse, looked the healthiest it has even looked in her 25 years. It was  vibrant and silkily and no longer dry and brittle feeling. She is a young girl thus there was no concern for the graying. My granddaughter said her hair was the softest she has ever had.She said that the shampoo is a heavy dense mixture that feels rather good when applying especially when comparing it to previously used shampoos, which were rather "watery". She said the smell is nice and certainly not too strong.The shampoo came in a 12.7 oz package, which was found to be perfect for leaving in the shower. The packaging is nice and heavy with an excellent top for dispensing. It sits easily in the shower basket or will set on the edge of the tub without falling over.After one washing that may be far too early to really test a product so a couple of days later I ask her to repeat the process. Her hair really did not need shampooing after only two days however she accommodated me by starting all over again. The end result was equally as good as her first shampoo and I have one girl that is really excited about the product. She advises the shampoo goes on cleanly and there is no burning or tingling and the aroma is still  non noticeable.Now she has convinced her grandfather to use the shampoo and that I will do. The results have been great however I must be honest as I don't; have all that much hair. What I do have, ended up soft and fluffy.About the price. This shampoo is not priced any higher than any of the leading brands one can buy at the drug store or the big box stores.

To be honest, I was a little nervous about using a shampoo with "shea" on the label since I could only think of shea butter as a heavy-duty moisturizer, but I decided to give this product a shot.  And then when I saw that the shampoo looked creamy, like a conditioner instead of a shampoo, I feared flat, oily hair.  My worries were needless -- this is an excellent product that does not leave that feared residue on my hair.Because I read several years ago that your hair depends mostly on the last product used on it, I tried this shampoo both with and without conditioner (CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Conditioner) to gauge its results.  After using the shampoo, my hair feel clean and tight.  I expected that blow-drying would result in unmanageable hair that would catch on my styling brush.  Nope.  My hair looked healthier and shinier than it does with my regular shampoo.  It had a clean look without the flyaways.  The scent is light and pleasant.To give some context to my experience:  I have fine hair, although I have a lot of hair which makes it look thick.  I find it difficult to find a balance that calms the static and/or frizz in the fine hair without weighing everything down.  This shampoo is one of the few I've tried that accomplishes that.  Note: my hair is not color-treated or damaged.  With the conditioner, the results were even better, mostly because my hair took better to styling.-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann

column9: Makes my hair super soft and shiny!
column10: I love the consistently of this shampoo- It looks like the conditioner, creamy consistency.. Goes on and isn't drying- I love the smell- I use conditioner after but it makes my hair very shiny!  I have thin hair!  Been getting compliments of how shiny and soft my hair has looked lately- Love the Clear Scalp line!

Considering the suggested price for this product, this is a nice shampoo that left my hair moisturized and clean. There were no tangles of hair after rinsing and it has a nice scent.This shampoo goes a long way on medium length fine hair. I put less than a quarter sized dollop to my wet hair, lathered and massaged it through my hair, and thoroughly rinsed my hair with cool water.I would definitely recommend this shampoo. It is really nice and does a good job.

column9: A good shampoo at a good price
column10: I have medium to long fine hair, and I have tried just about every shampoo on the market from 97 cent varieties to the big bucks salon versions.  Some are better than others, but I have to say that Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty's Ultra Shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo is towards the top of my list.  It cleans well while leaving my hair shiny and my scalp well conditioned.  I have been using it along with the matching conditioner, and I love the way my hair looks and feels.  You might find something you like a little better but not at this price.  For $5 per bottle, you should give this a try.  You won't be disappointed!

Mrs. JS says:I have two main requirements for shampoo: lather well, and leave my hair clean with no residue. I also always hope for a shampoo that will calm my somewhat-frizzy curls into softness.While this shampoo was outstanding for the lather (really does a nice job there), it did leave a perceptible residue buildup in my hair after a few shampoos. (I do not use a conditioner.) I also didn't notice any impact on making my hair more manageable or softer looking, sadly.It has a coconut-y smell (maybe that's the shea?), and it does leave my skin nice and soft (I tend to use shampoo as a body wash as well), but since that's not enough I won't be running out to buy more.While Mr. JS says: as a guy, I review from a solid position of ignorant indifference. I say this shampoo feels good and makes nice lather. On second and third day not so much squeekiness from my hair; is that a residue thing? Maybe that's the "nourish" part. But it smells nice.

column9: Creamy, lots of lather, coats your hair to make it shiny
column10: This shampoo is very creamy and lathers more than other shampoos I have used.  As some have noted, the fragrance is coconut/vanilla, normally two of my favorite scents, but I'd prefer there be a little less scent in this shampoo.  When I rinse this shampoo out of my hair, my hair still feels coated with it a bit which I guess is how it makes your hair shiny and retains moisture.If your hair is exceptionally dry, this might be worth a try.
This product provided a good clean feeling without a lot of residual perfume odor let over. It rinsed out well and after about a weeks use did not appear to leave any build-up.

This shampoo is wonderful. It smells so good and my scalp and hair look and feel great. This is a nice-sized bottle (12.9 oz.) and it has a nice flip open top cap on it that makes it easy to access the shampoo and then close it back while you are showering. I like the idea of a shampoo that is also gentle on your hair and scalp and I will definitely buy this one again. Everyone in the house loves it!

This is a very nice shampoo that appears to work at cleaning hair without any irritation or adverse reactions.  My only complaint is that there is no verbage anywhere on the bottle to advise whether or not this product would be suitable for color-treated hair.  And while I understand that the ingredients are nutritional and balanced for most hair types, I still would have been more comfortable knowing that my color would not be compromised.  So I had my husband use it for 2 weeks.  He was extremely happy with the results and appreciated that there was no heavy perfumed scent to deal with.Update:  August 20, 2012I decided to investigate and found my local Wal-Mart sells the Clear Shampoo color treated/damaged hair version (lavender colored bottle).  I have been using it for about 7 days and am very, very happy with the results.  In fact, it is so rich and creamy, that I haven't had a need to use a conditioner afterwords.  I just put on a little Paul Mitchell Super Skinny Serum and I am good to go.

column9: CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Ultra Shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo
column10: This is ok but not as good as my favorite Paul Mitchell. It has a creamy pearlescent look and texture with a Playdough-Coconut subtle scent. Aside from the scent which took getting used to it does a descent job of cleaning for the price which is the main selling point of this shampoo line. I'd rate this right in the middle 2.5 out of 5 stars.

column4: Richard C. Drew "Anaal Nathra/Uthe vas Bethod...
column9: Works great, nice scent - label is a little misleading
column10: The shampoo does a great job and the scent is not too strong - although it does linger. You can smell it hours later if you rub your fingers through your hair. The label is a little misleading - the beneficial effects are if you use the conditioner. It's like selling a bike and stating you'll set records. IF you use the optional shift, brakes and seat. So, as a shampoo - great. The other benefits? Nope.

I don't ask for much from a shampoo. Clean my hair. Check. Don't smell too strong. Check. The downside is that it is a very thick shampoo like a conditioner, so it doesn't lather very well and it takes more rinsing to get it all out.The cap is really a poor design. When I opened the box from Amazon, the bottle was open. The bottle, packing, and box were covered in shampoo, because light pressure on the top of the bottle opens it. That would probably be fine if you buying this from a store, but it is not good for being shipped.

There isn't much to say, so I will keep it simple. This is a really good shampoo, leaves my hair feeling very clean and detangles my hair. It smells greatand feels very silky. I have used it about 4 different times now, and I have enjoyed it. I have natural, course hair and it does help to soften my hair. I approve.

This shampoo has a slightly sweet, but pleasant scent. It lathers well and leaves my hair soft and silky. However, after using it for several weeks, I noticed a build-up on my hair. I recommend using a clarifying shampoo about once a week to remove the build-up.By the way, I am the wife of your Vine participant.

I liked this shampoo quite a bit, although please note this review is only after one use. I am not able to agree with the build left behind after once use, but did not experience that so far. I did not love the smell, but I liked it better after smelling it on my hair. I have thick semi-long hair, and I felt it did as good a job at cleaning it as any other comparable shampoo for this price range (like Pantene). I did not think it was the best shampoo I have ever used, but it was as good as I have bought at the grocery store in awhile. Pretty decent shampoo that cleanses well and feels good in the hand and on the scalp, though I would balk at paying almost five dollars for this in the store or on Amazon.

I love the aroma of shea, so I knew going in that I was likely to enjoy the Ultra Shea Cleanse and Nourish Shampoo.  I have a long mane of fine and frizzy hair that is a pain to wash, a pain to comb out and usually requires a quarter of a bottle of shampoo simply to work up a lather.  With this shampoo, a quarter sized amount of creamy shampoo (not gloppy or watery) sufficed for the entire mass of hair, quickly working up a lather.  Being a mom on the go, it's been a while since I considered washing my hair anything other than something to get over with as quickly and with as  little soap as possible (to avoid drying out my skin and hair).  This shampoo turns showering back into a bit of a luxury.  I actually enjoy lathering up my hair, and my skin and scalp do not become dried out or itchy from the product.My budget really isn't up to affording salon level hair care, so having something this good for a reasonable price is a definite plus.  My hair has seen definite improvement, from the shampoo alone (I have to see about getting some conditioner in the same line).  Normally, combing out the tangles from my hair after a shower takes a good fifteen minutes of frustration, pain and endless snarls.  My hair tends to feel sticky and wraps around the brush or comb until I have to pull hair out of my head to free it.  Not so with this shampoo.  My combing out time was cut in half and while I did have a few snarls in my middle-of-the-back length hair, they were minor ones that came right out with a few tugs of the comb.  My hair is less frizzy, has more shine and feels a lot less dried out than it does when I've used other shampoo.  The containers are also well thought out.  They stand easily on the tub corners, or in the shower baskets.  The pop out dispenser means I can flip up the lid and flip it down again with no worries the pop up will snap off and no extra mess.  Containers are easy to handle and visually appealing.Definitely will be looking for this one in the future! It's a winner!^_^ Shanshad

This is a nice shampoo that lathers well using only a small amount, seems to cleanse acceptably and moisturize "mature" hair fairly well (I still need conditioner, though). It has a very minimal, pleasant fragrance I can't put my finger on to describe, which does not linger. Overall a pretty good product, but if you are looking for a sulfate free shampoo, this is not it. It does contain sodium laurel sulfate. I'm not wowed by it, but it does the job admirably for the price point.

This stuff is so nice.  It has a smoothness that reminds me of a high-quality hand lotion.  It feels so good on the scalp and it seems like you use less than most other shampoos.  The conditioner is also smooth and silky.  What a great combo!
Not a bad shampoo. Good scent, foams well, moisturizes as promised. Has a consistency a little too dense which sometimes makes squeezing it out of the bottle hard.

I do like this shampoo.  It is very moisturizing.  My hair is dry , so this is important.  The scent is definitely shea butter, just like the scent from shea butter hand and body lotions.  This scent does linger for more than a day.  So if you like the scent of shea butter and need a moisturizing shampoo, I recommend this one.

I use this, my daughters use it, and my son uses it too!  We've all tried it.  It is a little heavy on the conditioning though.  Because of this, my wife does not care for it.  It is a great shampoo if your hair tends to be dry.  My wife thinks she may like it better in the winter, just not right now with heat and humidity.  It has a really nice scent that is not too overpowering.  Overall - we recommend.We will definitely be buying some more sooner than later!

About my hair:  Long (middle of back), naturally straight, never been colored or treated in any way.I have awesome hair.  It bleaches itself to a nice dark golden light brown during the summer with great highlights.  I'm lucky and get complimented often on it.  That being said, the most I ever do to it is add in layers or have it trimmed.  I rarely blow dry it.  I shampoo/condition it almost daily (gasp!).My favorite shampoo is Infusium 23, but a couple years ago they changed the scent/formula and it hasn't been great since.Enter Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Ultra Shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo (& conditioner).It smells amazing.  My first thought was "warm summer beach day".  Light vanilla mingling with coconut and perhaps a bit floral.  Its intoxicating and I absolutely love it.A little bit goes a long way and it works into a great thick lather.Rinse, and it doesn't even suggest you'll need to repeat - because you probably won't.My hair is left feeling clean, soft, shiny and easily manageable.  Did I mention how great the smell is?  My husband loves it.I use it with the conditioner and I could not be happier.  Definitely will be my new go-to shampoo and conditioner combo.

Received this product from Amazon Vine.  I have short hair that I guess is "normal" as opposed to dry or oily.  I thought the texture of this shampoo was very thick, so thick that I thought I had grabbed the conditioner instead of the shampoo.  It felt a little greasy to me, and took a lot longer to rinse out of my hair than my daily shampoo.  This shampoo smells good and it's probably a good shampoo for certain hair types.

My hair is course and thick so I have always had to use cream rinse, but not with this shampoo. It is really creamy and leaves your hair shining and soft. I've only used it a few times but can really tell the difference in the texture of my hair. Good stuff!
I shared Clear Scalp & Hair Therapy with my family to get their takes on it.  The unanimous opinion is that it cleans and leaves the hair feeling good and the ladies love the scent.  Good choice!

For years, I have been battling with my hair. Too dry. Flakes that I could never get to go away. I have tried so many different products trying to get these issues under control. For the most part, other products seemed to help for a few days, a week or two if I was lucky. Then, sadly, my issues would pop up again.When I first saw the commerical for Clean, I knew that it may be different than all the other products I have tried before. Claiming to work at the scalp then down the hair instead of the other way around. Upon first use, I noticed how light the product was. It didn't feel heavy or feel like it was still in my hair after rinsing. Clean promises to change your hair after 7 days. Mine took two. The first day, I noticed how much softer my hair was. By the second, my flakes were all but gone. I use this product every day and I am still amazed with the results. Something that I have been battling for so long to be gone like that. Clean is a product that I have been recommending to all my friends and family. And I could not be happier with it.

I really love this product. Both my husband and I have fine, thinning hair (an aging thing) and our hair lies pretty flat. We both found that after washing with the shampoo, our hair had a lot more body and shine and was easier to manage. I was able to "poof" up the top without using a curling iron, which I find drying.My husband discovered that by shampooing in the product and leaving it on for several minutes, it really got into the scalp and helped with the itching from the  dry scalp problem.We'll both definitely keep using this shampoo.

I just shampooed my hair with Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Ultra Shea Cleanse & Nourish Shampoo and I must say I was very impressed with this shampoo. I love the smell of this shampoo. It has a crisp and clean smell. It is thick but not to thick. It lathers very well. This shampoo is very soothing to the scalp. My hair and scalp were very refreshed after using. This shampoo is also a good value for you money.

I ordered this product to try and got it today. It leaked out of the bottle but at least the packaging smelled nice. I gave it a try and oh I should mention; I have super sensitive skin and this product does not irritate it. I used it with the matching shampoo and together they made my hair feel really soft and like I said not irritated which is huge. I have to be very careful what products I use and the scent is pleasant. Not too powerful.

column9: Nice mild scent-also great for my hair
column10: I have highlighted hair, fairly short, and also dry.  This Ultra Shea shampoo works wonders on it.One thing I especially like, because I tried the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce, is that the Ultra Shea shampoo has a very mild, almost vanilly scent to it.  The moisturizing shampoo I tried previously had a perfumey very strong odor.  Not good when you are sensitive to scents.The shampoo is thick, lathers easily and abundantly, cleans my hair without drying it - what more could I want?  My hair has more body and is easier to control, too.  I will continue to use this shampoo.I like the container, too.  Just the right fit for my hand, self-closing, narrow so it doesn't take up a lot of room.

This is a creamy, shea butter based shampoo. It works well with coarse, gray hair, leaving it manageable with little to no frizz. Does not require a conditioner to compliment itThis is smooth on application and only requires the tiniest amount. You will get your money's worth and won't have a dry frisly hair which needs to be conditioned after washing this out.The mailman left this on a porch in the sun and some of it oosed out, so do not leave this in heat.

I love this shampoo, especially now in the summertime, when my hair is a mess: dry at the ends, gross at the scalp. I use this shampoo about every other day, along with the Ultra Shea Conditioner, and the combo makes my scalp feel clean, my ends feel soft and hydrated, and everything feels balanced out in general.  The scent is pleasant- hard to place, but pleasant and not overpowering at all.  The lather feels rich and rinses out well.  So far, I'm very pleased with this shampoo!

The good news is that this shampoo leaves my coarse, wiry hair remarkably soft and smelling great. The product is named Clear, but the shampoo is creamy and thick, not clear. Nevertheless, it is a premium shampoo that I recommend to anyone without overly sensitive skin.Which brings me to the bad news. I love the shampoo - my skin doesn't. The results in my hair are great and I would recommend it to anyone. But I broke out all over from using it. For me, the juice isn't worth the squeeze. I can't have breakouts and soft hair. I'd rather have my usual haystack-style hair and clear skin.

The product is good but it left my hair a bit fuzzy, more volume than I really wanted. So I cut the amount I used and it was better. It does the job. Once I found the right amount of shampoo, it gave my hair a glossy shine as well as volume. I will be using this in future!

I tried this product and had favorable results.  The smell, color, consistency and lathering potential of this shampoo is just about what you would expect from any shampoo.  I did find that it moisturized my hair, which is prone to being dry, when used in conjunction with its matching conditioner.Sodium Laureth Sulfate (SLES)is an ingredient in this shampoo, and many people have skin or eye irritation issues with shampoos containing SLES.  I didn't notice any irritation.I find this shampoo performs better than some salon brands, or mid-priced shampoos.  For that reason, I will probably buy it again when I run out.  At its price point, this is really a nice shampoo.Update 7/6/2012:  After using this product for 2 weeks, I continue to have good results.  My hair stylist even asked me what kind of shampoo I was using and she said it smelled good and made my hair very shiny and moisturized.  When I told her she was incredulous that I wasn't using a high end product to get these results.  I find that the matching conditioner is a real necessity - it prevents flyaway hair and relaxes my hair.  The shampoo is good at stripping away styling products and buildup.

Okay !!!I LOVED it !I have long hair that's a little bit on the dry side...but this shampoo would be great for any length hair....and I believe personally most any type of hair .Used this---and I LOVED it.Very light ---yet delightful scent.Goes on luscious and creamy and stays that way on your hair moisturizing and creamy and dreamy.When I rinsed it out--my hair was soft and smelled nice--not over powering --but NICE--clean smell !!This is the most lovely shampoo available over the counter that I have found in a really long time...and I have tried many over the years....if you desire to moisturize your hair and keep it feeling good ----without a big scent --than this would be for you !

column9: the only peanut is Mr. Peanut!
column10: Great quality wholesome nuts, minus peanuts - which aren't really nuts, anyway. Not as many pecans or cashews as there are almonds. but a nice mix. Sticking a handful into your mouth will keep you busy for a while and fill you up. Low on carbs, high on essential fats and protein. Excellent!

I definitely agree with all the good things that the other reviewer say about this product. I've used MRPs (mostly Met-Rx) for decades and also attest to their benefits. However, I gave it only three stars because I strongly object to the ad's omission of the fact that Labrada Nutrition's Lean Body contains sucralose.Sucralose replaced aspartane---which from its invention at Searle was known to damage brain cells---as the no-calorie sweetner of over whelming choice by food packagers.Regrettably, sucralose is known to kill off our probiotics, the bacteria that enable food's digestion!We all have the right to take our chances. Nevertheless, the vendors of products that they encourage us to eat have the duty to inform of what those chances are.

This product is the best meal replacement drink I have seen to date.  I keep waiting for other products to catch up to them, but so far they haven't.The main difference between this meal replacement and other meal replacement products I've seen is in the carbohydrates they provide.  Most other meal replacements I've seen either use sugars or maltodextrin as their main carbohydrate.  The problem with this is that they have a high glycemic index.  This means that when you eat them, your blood sugar rapidly rises and your body responds by making a lot of insulin.  Then in a very short time, your blood sugar is low and you have no energy and are hungry again.  This product is low sugar and no maltodextrin which is great.  Hopefully it has a low glycemic index.The oil blend is this product looks to be good.  They don't report the exact percentages of omega 3, 6 and 9 fatty acids but they do contain omega fatty acids.As for the protein, it's a blended protein that's 40 grams per serving.In my opinion, the taste of these products is great, but that's only an opinion.  Concerning the nutritional value of this product, everything I've said here is easy to validate with a little research.The only downfall of this product is the cost.  It's a lot cheaper to just blend protein powder, oatmeal and Udo's oil in a blender, but that obviously isn't nearly as convienent.  All in all, this is a great product, but be sure to shop around because the price can vary greatly.
I'm using this as a meal replacement in order to lose weight.  This is the best tasting shake I've had and the nutritional content is better than others I've tried.

The product arrived right on its scheduled time. This shake is great for pre or post workout. I absolutely love it. It tastes good with milk or even water. Definitely a great way to help lose weight and stay healthy

So this is my first time with protien shakes and the first one didnt go down well. But I had another and actually liked it. Ive been doing 2 scoops with ice, water, and a banana for breakfast and lunch. Snack on nuts and have a healthy dinner and am already down 7pds. I definetly recommend this product, just ordered vanilla ice cream flavor and cant wait to try it. Also I shopped around and this price was the cheapest ive found by almost $10.
This powder is really good,doesn't have the funky taste a lot of the powders do... Very hard to mix by hand, almost have to use a blender.  It is good with skim milk or water.

Okay, I bought this product to do a shake diet. Instead of two scopes, I use one unless I was going to exercise, then I use two scoops. This is real good. I use water for my shakes so it won't be more calories. If you ever decide to do a shake diet, just know you're going to piss it off if you use water, milk have you on the toilet so it's best to do the water. I love this product! I've bought it two times and I've dropped off 20 pounds just doing a shake diet.Do one scoop [do two scoops thirty minutes to an hour before going exercising]Do this every hour [you can have two solid meals but don't go over 250 calories, and no drinking shakes or eating after 8]Use water instead of milkThat's how I did it and I lost a lot. I would have gave it five stars but the price went up. When I first bought this product, I paid twenty-five dollars and some cents. Now it's almost thirty dollars. They need to go back down on the product. But if you're not doing a shake diet and just use this for workouts and stuff, I don't know how it's going to work you. Well I do know when you workout, you going to feel it like with any other workout but the next day, you will not be sore. That's why I love it. When I'm exercising, I feel the burn, the pain. I even feel it once I'm done but later that day or the next day, the pain is gone! If you buy this product, you'll love it! Great taste too if you know what you're doing.

This protein powder was highly recommended from a few of my friends when I started looking for something to help with my work out results.  This protein powder taste fantastic, especially when mixed with some frozen fruit and peanut butter, just like an ice cream shake.  It fills me up, it can be used as a meal replacement.  It also has helped me increased muscle size much faster then previously.  This product is great and I recommend it for anyone from an everyday Joe just trying to get into shape to people who are very serious about working out.

I bought this product b/c I tasted it once and I was hooked. I have it in the morning as my breakfast. Just add water and a banana and BAM! Instant Yummy breakfast. Keeps me going until my 11AM snack time :)
Delicious Shake !  Great Value and such a large sized container for the price.  I was shocked !!!  It does what it ways, lose weight, more energy and keep your muscle strength.
This is the only protein powder that I have used that tastes great even mixed with just cold water and a shaker.

I tired this product for the first time & have tried several others over the yrs. I found this one to be very nice in both flavor & texture. It blends well & doesn't have the chalky taste many others have. I tried it w/ just water & it was okay & tried it w/ lowfat greek yogart & also w/ some fresh fruit blended in to make it more as a smoothie. I work 12 hrs shifts & sometimes having this as a meal replacement works well rather than a lot of snacks with  meal while working or for the grab & go breakfast @ 4am (mixed the night before & chilled overnight & put in water bottle). I tied the strawberry flavor & will try others as i go along. ***HINT drink very chilled for best results.
Excellent product. The chocolate flavor is amazing. If you prepare this protein shake with crushed ice (as one recommendation ) you will "taste" a delicious ice cream. I love it!!

Althought he price wasn't the cheapest around, I was in a pinch and decided to use my prime account to get this protein really fast. I love it. It tastes like brownie batter - best protein out there, although its a MRP so the calories are a bit higher than a standard whey pr casein. Nice blend and great product.

Great taste and excellent nutritional value. Would definitely recommend to someone looking for a high protein shake or meal replacement. This fills me up a lot more than a standard protein shake. Will buy again...

column9: I use it as chocolate dessert replacement.
column10: If one loves chocolate, this works great in a very low carb diet instead of sugar laden cake one can buy. I use 1 1/2 of the enclosed measuring spoon full of it and add very little water to it. Have it with my afternoon coffee like a small bowl of chocolate. My cravings for sweets have vanished. (1) Have taken the glamor out of chocolate. (2) Have made it practical. (3) In spite of being near the fridge all day working from home, I restrained myself to looking forward to this one dessert once a day. Now I'm used to it and feeling in charge.

I've tried a lot of protein shakes and frankly, most of them have tasted like sand. One even made me gag. This one actually tastes good. It's not something I would crave because of the taste, but for a protein shake it's really very good! I recommend it!

I am using this for as a meal replacement for weight loss purposes.  I'm definitely seeing results, however I find it to sickeningly sweet (and I have a sweet tooth)! It's like over sweetened cake batter and I can't even stand the smell. However, my husband likes the flavor and is drinking it because he was encouraged by my results! I'm going to try ordering something other than the Vanilla Ice Cream .

This is the best shake I've tasted by far. I started replacing dinner with this shake on Tuesday February 1, 2011 and as of today (Saturday February 5,2011)I have lost 4 lbs! I will definitely be purchasing more.
Simply excellent! Great tasting and works. I have been using this for months with success. I highly recommend this product.

I have been drinking this product for almost a year now but lately it seems that the taste has changed. I used to like the chocolate ice cream a lot, but now i dont really like the taste. i think i am gonna start looking for other alternatives.
Yeowww! 2 scoops almond milk mixed with one scoop powder tastes really great! I'm using it as a meal replacement once a day and succeeding at some weight loss as well. Can't complain!

column9: Tastes Different than it Used To
column10: I've been using Lean Body Shakes for a while now.  They've always tasted great but this last shipment tasted chalky and was quite difficult to drink.  I'm not sure if they changed the formula or if I got a bad batch but its enough to make me cancel my subscription to my monthly purchase and go another route.  I'm very disappointed.
If your in athletic mode,great product for replacement of nutrition,especially after tough workouts. Completely balanced meal with high quality protein.

I have just started using this supplement after workouts and it has taken me a bit to figure out a taste combo that I can live with. The milk-shake flavor may be a little bit overboard. I would probably like just a normal chocolate flavor. The recommendation is two scoops but I use one and I still feel the taste is quite strong. I mix one scope of this with 2 cups of almond breeze almond milk and sometimes some frozen strawberries - blend it in my blender and it is a great drink. It also provides enough chocolately flavor to cure any possible sweet tooth I might have.

This is the best tasting protein drink I've ever tasted.  It really reminds me of chocolate ice cream. I was disappointed when I read 21 total carbohydrates and 290 calories per serving.  The product may be appropriate for someone who burns a lot of calories, but not for anyone on a low carb diet.

I purchased this for my Marine Corps husband to put in his care package, he is on his 2nd deployment in Afghanistan.. and this was delivered in 1 day!!!! i couldnt believe it, i thought the email made a mistake, but nope.. not even 24 hours later it's on my doorstep. talk about fast delivery!

There are a ton of meal replacement products out there. It really boils down to taste and price. Labrada Nutrition really goes out of their way to put out good tasting products. the prices are pretty decent too.

column9: Labrada Nutrition Hi-Protein Meal Replacement Shake
column10: It is delicious, fast to fix on those rushed mornings and is filling and satisfying. Would recommend this to anyone with a busy schedule and wants to fell he/she has some nutrients in their bodies.
Vanilla tastes like cake batter. It makes it hard to mix with other flavors. And its very sweet. So maybe chocolate would be a better choice next time
Cheaper than the other meal replacement shakes without sacrificing too much flavor. I used to use the GNC lean shakes, but they got too costly.

Labrada Lean Body is the best tasting meal replacement shake available!  I've been buying MRP shakes for over 10 years and I haven't found another brand that comes close to this.  It tastes great and mixes completely.  No clumping.  I have only tried the chocolate ice cream flavor ( and the chocolate peanut butter in the packets) so I can't speak on the taste of the vanilla or strawberry.  If you are looking for a good MRP, this is it.  Don't waste your money on anything else.
The product taste great for a Meal Replacement Powder. This works for me as I work and go to school fulltime and have less time cooking or preparing food. It satisfy my appetite for 2-3 hours.
Great product. I use as a pre and post workout. Has everything I need, even the fibers. I've tried a lot of other Meal replacement, and this one is the best. The taste is great!

This is one of the best tasting vanilla shakes around.  I'm so happy I tried this, its a nice change from the usual chocolate.  I made this in the blender with water and ice, kinda thick so it would last awhile.  Even my kids like this one and want their own milkshake when they see this come out of the cupboard!
I've been bodybuilding and drinking protein shakes for 20 years and they never taste very good, but this stuff in Strawberry flavor was damn good!  I'd recommend it

This is a reorder.  I enjoyed it so much I reordered.  It gives me energy and the shaker I ordered as well with the bobble ball in it makes it easy to just shake it without using a blender.  The taste is great.  I will be reordering this product again.

Of all the protein shakes out there, this one actually tastes good! I use milk instead of water. You can use a blender to mix it, but if you have a good arm simply shaking or stirring it works just as well.
Great tasting product with very good mixability that leaves me satisfied till the next meal. Just not enough calories per serving with the powder alone.
Quite satisfying and good taste but lacks mixability in blender. Many, many times I have to clean powder off of blender container sides and reblend.
Love this stuff - 1st try used shaker cup to mix - would recommend using electric wand mixer to create milkshake effect - and the chocolately taste is yummy
tastes good, easy to prepare, separate pouches make it easy to carry along with at work.

Alright, either this thing has no scooper or mine came with none which is really lame. There is nothing in my house that measures in grams so I don't technically know how much powder to put. This is extremely annoying. Other than that, it tastes great.

I started this 2 weeks ago.  I have the strawberry flavor and I take it with almond milk since I have a dairy milk allergy.  It is very tasty at best!! Also, I have been having regular bowel movements since replacing my breakfast and sometimes dinner with Lean Body Protein Shake. I think I'm about to lose some weight too!!!

Tried this product after doing a little research online (including here).  The product lived up to its good reviews.  Like most protein shakes, this is best cold.  I usually make a drink after exercising but with classes starting back up, I plan on switching to mornings since I'll be preoccupied during class.  The only downside to the product for me was trying to find the perfect amount of 10oz. of water to get the shake to taste perfect (I think I managed that feat twice), but nonetheless, it's still good.

Look, I know there are nasty tasting whole earth raw shakes out there that are seriously nasty, and as an industry we've come a long way in flavor with these, but this vanilla ice cream powder is so nasty that I cannot describe it other than to say that it smells like a cheap "buttercream cupcake" candle, and it tastes like a whole truckload of quarters and fake Splenda sweetener rusting in your mouth...the way your mouth is cold when you haven't slept all night, like all that nasty at the same time.Now with all that said, the chocolate ice cream flavor is the best ever!! I make it as an after gym hot chocolate breakfast and it's just delicious and it works like even I can't believe. Get the chocolate and give it a little more water than it calls for, it's great.Gonna try the strawberry one next, hopefully it's like the chocolate one.
This product was offered at a great price and only took a few days for delivery. Will definitely make many repeat purchases. Thanks.

I've have never had a good tasting protein meal replacement shake and this one is no better.  I know taste preference is all subjective.  But if you don't like the sickening sweet flavor of artificial sweetners and that nasty after taste, then you won't like this. Please note I hate the taste of diet soda too, just to give you a reference point.  After forcing myself to drink it once a day for a week, I just couldn't do it anymore. column9: So far, it's the best salt I have found
column10: I felt that I had to give an update reassuring people a little more about this product.  I can assure you that I have no connection or financial interest in this company or in regard to this Himalayan salt.The reason for my interest is that I have an autistic son, and I am very watchful for contaminants in his food. I avoid the type of sea salt from the ocean since heavy metal contamination is an problem.  So when I found this Himalayan salt, I was glad because the label states that they monitor the contents for contaminants.  And it doesn't come from the ocean, which greatly reduces the likelihood of heavy  metal contamination.One reviewer was quite concerned because there seemed to be some sediment left at the bottom of a glass of water when he attempted to dissolve the salt.  He felt that this sediment was dangerous and not fit for human consumption.So I did some research of my own.  I tried to dissolve some of the salt in a glass of water also.  I noticed that some of it did not dissolve immediately.  It took a while, but eventually all but some red powder had dissolved.  So I know that some of the salt dissolves immediately, some of it will dissolve after a lot of stirring and perhaps after it sits in the water for a couple of hours.  But the red powder did not dissolve.I looked up Himalayan pink salt and found out that the Bavarian consumer protection agency analyzed the composition of 15 Himalayan sea salts sold in Germany.  They found that it was composed of 10 different minerals, including, of course, sodium and chloride (98%).  It contained 2-3% polyhalite or gypsum and 10 other minerals in small amounts.Gypsum is a very soft sulfate material made up of calcium sulfate dihydrate.  I am assuming it is safe for consumption since it is used as a coagulant in tofu.Polyhalite is a hydrated sulfate of potassium, calcium and magnesium.  It's reddish color is due to various levels of iron oxide in salt deposits.This may seem alarming, but I did yet more research and found that insoluble minerals do not absorb and simply pass through the body. Based on that information, I am not ready to assume that this insoluble mineral is harmful.Himalayan pink sea salt has been harvested from the salt mines in Pakistan since the 13th century.  So they've been eating this stuff for a long time.  And if they've been consuming it for that long, and if that's the way it comes out of the ground, I think I can feel pretty good about it.I am not 100% confident about my conclusions, but for now, I am feeling a bit better about serving this to my children rather than serving any other salt on the market.

When my grandson was born, Diogenes was able to retire and seek the sleep he so deserved after searching so many centuries for an honest man. My grandson speaks his mind eloquently and succintly.  Upon the arrival of my order of Funfresh Foods Real Food Trading Company Himalayan Pink Sea Salt, 2-Pound, I quietly served it at a family meal.  Almost instantly my grandson asked who put sand in the salt.  I smiled, chuckled and told him no one had put anything in the salt and that this was special pink salt from half way around the world.  "It has sand in it, Grandpa! I don't like it!" he replied.  Nay, nay, not so, I assured him (and everyone).  "Let me show you."I drew a small glass of filtered water and added a liberal amount of the pink salt.  (BTW, if you like the C.Cola bottled water, *asani, much of it comes from the same source in FL as my tap water)  So I swirled the pink salt around in the water.  Let me mention that I have a degree in science and a bunch, like a lot, of chemistry courses so I know that table salt, sodium chloride (NaCl) is really really soluble in water.  Well, after much stirring I got quite a bit of pink insoluble grains on the bottom of the glass and, most disturbing, the liquid was cloudy!  I've been watching it for a couple of hours now and nothing is settling out.  I'll keep watching, but what the cloudy water means is there is either a fine particulate that will settle out in time or there is something else in the "salt" that is not or not completely water soluble or is colloidal, which does not make me feel good about this product.It is my understanding that most table salt is produced by crystallizing the salt from a saline solution, either natural (sea water) or man made.  The difference between "regular" table salt (at least in the US) and Kosher salt is that regular salt is allowed to crystallize undisturbed and will form cubical crystals while Kosher salt must be raked during the entire crystallizing process, thus forming the light flaky crystals familiar to that form.This product, it appears to me, is a mined mineral that contains a high NaCl content that is not further refined.  It is finely ground perhaps in the hope that end users will not notice that it also contains rock, sand, or whatever makes up the Himalayas.  The product claims to contain less Sodium (Na) and that may well be true, but is that lower Sodium content because it has ground rocks/sand in it?I'm returning this because it is an inferior product that is not what it is advertised to be.  This might be fine for a live stock salt lick but it is not fit for human consumption!Many Hours Later:  The cloudiness is clearing, so my conclusion is that it was caused by very small particles that took longer to fall out of suspension.  Nevertheless, sediment is sediment and sediment is not salt!  This is another example of when a low price is not a bargain!

My dogs did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my dogs. The first three ingredients are Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, and corn gluten meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, dogs cannot digest corn, it is just a filler and causes them to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging of such a disgusting product; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for,  I usually buy my pets all natural, organic foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness.

I appreciate that this gum is sweetened JUST with xylitol (unlike some of the others widely available which also contain aspartame and/or acesulfame potassium).  Overall, this gum has good flavor and texture.  The other reviewers are correct that it loses its flavor fairly quickly however, hence the 4 instead of 5 stars.
