Served with food, I doubt I would notice it, but, served alone, it is more apparent.

I don''t consider myself to be a coffee snob; I'll drink 3 hour sludge left over from the office pot. On the other hand, when I want a good cup of coffee, I want it strong, aromatic, and flavorful. This particular offering was aromatic, quite flavorful, but I can't give it the full 5 stars because it was a bit weak. To achieve the strength I like, I needed to use more coffee than I should.

Melitta's Blanc et Noir is a recommended solution for a busy lifestyle. The main benefit is that you don't have to spend time grinding coffee beans: just measure what you need and go.As with all coffees, you might have to experiment a bit with the serving size - I am trending towards using more coffee than directed to get the flavor I want - but the bottom line is that no matter how you measure or serve this ground coffee, you'll be rewarded with a flavorful, but not bitter cup that tastes great with or without cream and sugar (I've tried both). I think any time-challenged person who enjoys good coffee should give Blanc et Noir a try!

To start off, I'm not a coffee drinker.  I got this coffee for DH, who is a Major coffee drinker so it's really his review.  According to DH, this coffee is Perfectly roasted.  Much better tasting that that over-roasted coffee from Starbucks.  The only reason that I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that DH says the coffee is very finely ground and doesn't work very well in his coffee maker.  However, it would be excellent for an espresso maker.

There is no doubt about the fact that I enjoy a brisk cup of coffee everyday in the morning. But, there just hasn't been the most definitive taste that I've ever tasted. Still, Melitta which makes great coffee filters, and excellent tastes of coffee. Yet, I did get to try a nice cup of their Blanc et Noir coffee blend, and it really isn't bad. While it doesn't seperate itself from most of the stronger flavors, it still tastes pretty good. While it isn't as strong as Maxwell House or Chock Full O' Nuts in ground blends, the Melitta Blanc et Noir does flow into its own. If you're looking for a nice alternative to any ordinary brand, than this would be a great option.Price: BTaste: BOverall: B

This coffee really surprised me. It was flavorful and very smooth. There was no bitterness to it (something that I really dislike in coffee).I used just a little more with this than my usual scoop amounts.We usually drink some version of Costco's Starbucks brew or Dunkin' Donuts.I liked the Melitta Blanc et Noir better than anything else we've had in years.It is already ground, fairly fine too but it brewed well in our cone filter coffee maker.

Whereas most coffee blends involve a blend of different coffee bean varieties, this blend features a range of different roasts. I suppose it also includes different varieties but the label tells us nothing in that regard. We are only told it includes both light and dark roasts, thus the name which translates as "White and Black". The taste, of course, combines the features of both roasts and is an interesting, mild flavor with only slight acidity. I drank it black with nothing added in a variation of the French press method to get the full impression. The grind is very fine which is the most preferred these days, especially for a drip process. The fine grind might be a problem for those using unfiltered methods, such as percolator or even the French press which uses a crude metal filter(I like my coffee unfiltered). This coffee is a great choice for coffee connoisseurs.

My husband did not care for it at all. I thought it was okay but nothing I would pay extra for. I think you definitely need to use more of the coffee than the directions call for or else it is really not that flavorful. I will probably end up mixing it with a can of my regular coffee and finishing off the bag that way.

I'm a coffee drinker that prefers to grind my own beans because it is fresher that way. The more recently it was roasted the better. I like dark, hearty coffees, but not ones that have been over-roasted. A select few ground coffees can be good, and this is one of them. Melitta strikes a nice balance between the light and dark roasts. The dark roast predominates but the light roast helps make it smooth and flavorful. This is a fine grind and makes a more potent pot of coffee than similar amounts of your standard ground coffees like Foldgers or Maxwell House.They've priced this mid-range coffee competitively and I would recommend it to people who appreciate a flavorful, aromatic coffee. It cannot replace just roasted and freshly ground coffee, but you'd be hard pressed to find something much better outside of a gourmet shop. I've used Melitta's filters for years, and now I'm enjoying their coffees as well. Because of the Blanc et Noir Ground blend, I tried their Colombian Medium Roast and found it to be quite good as well.

I am a coffee addict or connoisseur if you prefer a more genteel description. I will not turn down any coffee as a rule, and my only motto is "the stronger the better".That being said, I grind my beans in a burr grinder and have found a great brand of premeasured and preground coffee for the drip machine, and have tried more than my share of brands looking for that elusive coffee perfection. I typically go through at least one handmade latte each day and a pot of drip brew a day. Yikes! I tried this brand in both machines. I think the advertised concept, a blend of light and dark roasts is a great idea; it's something that I do myself and it makes a nicely balanced cup. Upon opening the attractive package, coffee smelled great, and I measured the usual amount for espresso. The finely ground Melitta ground beans produced crema (that means they were fresh) and before I added steamed and frothed milk, I tasted the brew. It was fine, but nothing special. Upon adding the milk the flavor really diminished and it was kind of grainy and grassy...not very appealing. To be fair, I then made a batch in the drip machine according to package description. While the espresso made with the Melitta was acceptable, the drip coffee was frankly horrible. It tasted burnt, harsh, and acidic, without any well-rounded smoothness. This is a coffee with a lovely art deco package, but not much else to recommend it. Let's just say, if I was stranded in the desert it wouldn't be half-bad. Otherwise, I'll take my tried and true coffee.

UPDATE JANUARY 2011I am now a pretty regular drinker of this stuff! In fact, I just ordered some more and I note the price has gone down which makes it very afforable, take in the free shipping, and it's an absolutely delicious  steal!I am really enjoying this Coffee. I usually drink Folgers at home and have done so for nearly 20 years. This was a pleasant surprise, the aroma as it was brewing was scintillating, the taste (with my regular creamer and sugar) was a treat for my taste buds.I finished two cups and was tempted to drink more because it was such a smooth tasting coffee. I used 6 heaped tea-spoon fulls for make 8 cups (as marked on my coffee maker) and it worked out just about right for me; though some hard line coffee drinkers make like it stronger than that!The package itself was a little hard to open, I found the best way was to cut the top off with scissors and use the metal bands on the package to securely close it as airtight as possible.This a really nice coffee but the only way to be sure you will like it is to try it.

My taste is usually for bold coffees and nothing French roasted.  I prefer Colombians and Sumatras, and various blends such as Fresh Market's Tres Rios.  However, I also keep the cheap can of Folgers around for when I'm too lazy to grind, and while it's not great, it's certainly acceptable.  The Melitta Blanc et Noir on that scale is far higher than the Folgers, but not among my favorites.  I don't see myself ever pining after it the way I would if I hadn't had my favorites in a while.  Blanc et Noir bills itself as its literal translation Light and Dark, and by blending these two I think it takes away some from the tastes of both.  It does serve as a richer breakfast type coffee if the typical light breakfast blend is too bland or weak for your taste.

column9: Good Coffee; somewhere between smooth and bold
column10: This is good coffee...I think it is just short of 5-start rating.  The boldness and dark roast is tempered by the lighter roast. Bold coffee drinkers could probably make it stronger and enjoy a bold taste due to the fine grinding. I don't think any coffee drinkers will be displeased with this roast.  We made a pot for a dinner party and everyone gave it the thumbs up!

Nice strong and dark flavor without the bitterness.  I found it taste even better with half cream than milk or soya milk, which kinda mellowed the deep flavor.  I really enjoyed the coffee with two full scoop full (it is ground coffee) with a French press.  The package comes a press seal and a metal wrap to seal in the freshness.  Highly recommend that you keep it in the fridge once open and should use within 2 weeks.  Loved it.

I like a smooth rich cup of coffee.  The Melita Blanc et Noir delivers.  It's one of the best ground coffees that I've purchased and is easily comparable to coffee from one of the better specialty stores.  The coffee arrived vacuum packed and tightly sealed.  At $0.55 per ounce ($8.80 per pound) it's also competitively priced.Strongly Recommended.

When I read the name of this coffee, I figured that a mix of light and dark roasts would simply taste like a medium roast. However, I was pleasantly surprised that I was mistaken. As a blend of light and dark roast, this coffee has some distinct attributes that a medium roast can't achieve by itself.The flavor of this coffee leans strongly toward the dark side. The taste is full and slightly bitter, but it's not over-roasted like some dark coffees. However, the light roast comes across in the aftertaste, which is relatively mild. I find the transition from a strong flavor going down to a more subtle aftertaste to be rare, and this makes for a very interesting coffee.I'm impressed with the quality of this coffee, and am certain that most coffee enthusiasts would give it a thumbs up. Of course, it may not be everyone's favorite, but it's definitely worth a try. I would definitely get it again!

I freely admit I like my coffee strong.  That's how I learned to drink it and that's how I make it.  So let me lead off by saying that I have one quibble with Melitta's coffee, but it's fixable:  If brewed according to the instructions on the bag, it's Church Coffee, a thin, bitter brew that doesn't do justice to the rather good coffee in the bag.I was careful, I read the instructions several times just to make sure that it was two teaspoons per six ounces of water, not two tablespoons, which is roughly what I use.  But no, Melitta insists you use two teaspoons, and so I thought "Fair enough, I'll do it their way."  That was a mistake.  While it wasn't undrinkable, it sure wasn't anything to write home about.  I will say that it made decent iced coffee later that evening, which did go a long way to improving my opinion of it.The next day I made it my way, and I have to say that it's really excellent coffee.  It's smooth and flavorful without a hint of bitterness.  And the iced coffee was even better this time.  I've always enjoyed Melitta coffee, and I think their Blanc et Noir is a very nice addition to their line.  It's particularly attractive at the price it's being offered at here.  But use it with the caveat that the instructions may not yield the best possible cup of coffee for your taste.  Don't be afraid to play with the measurements.

As the name implies, this is a blended cup. I like this kind of coffee. This is not roasted like French Roast or even Italian roast. This veers more to the flavor that you might expect at Dunkin' Donuts. It is drinkable. It is a "session coffee" - the kind that you can enjoy, and then not worry if you want to have a second cup.The challenge for this kind of coffee is that it doesn't become bitter if you put too much in your filter. I made this with a Melitta filter, in a Melitta maker. I'm satisfied. There is a strong finish to this coffee, but even at a higher strength, it won't overshoot.I used to work in a fine hotel restaurant. We served a rich but mellow cup. This is that kind of drink. I know it says "Blanc et Noir," but it is not cowboy coffee or even Midwestern diner coffee. This is a cup that you would serve to guests without reservation.I drink coffee with a blend of half-and-half and 2 percent milk, and often with a bit of sugar. Many mornings, I reach for French Roast and I make it fuertissimo. So, perhaps my sense of "strong" is unusual. But, I think you could do fine with just milk on this coffee. It probably wouldn't handle too much cream.

column9: The Best Part of Waking Up...
column10: Is great coffee in your cup...  Melitta Cafe Collection Blanc et Noir Ground Coffee doesn't quite make it as great coffee, but it is very good coffee. I compare it to something similar one would receive at a good, four-star hotel - it beats the coffee served at fund-raising socials, but doesn't compare to the fine coffees grown in Kona, Hawaii.If you follow the directions, using only 2 teaspoons of ground coffee per 6 oz. cup, you will find this a pleasant, smooth brew with which to start your morning or to keep you going into that long night.  There is none of the burnt taste some of the darker roasts are prone to having, no bitter after-taste, and no acidic flavor to this coffee.  However, if you make the mistake I initially did - yes, I didn't read the directions but used the same measurements I always do - and use 3 teaspoons per cup, you will find this an unpleasantly strong brew.  This is a coffee I would definitely serve to friends and family.Melita Cafe Collection Blanc et Noir Ground Coffee is a good value for anyone who wants something better than the grocery store carries, but doesn't want to go broke purchasing coffee for home brewing.  Because it uses 1/3 less coffee, due to its fine grind, one gets approximately as many cups of coffee as would be obtained from regular grind sold in one pound bags.

column9: Be bold, be bold, but not too bold
column10: I love this coffee, and I would definitely buy it again. After reading a few other reviews, I think that's because I like my coffee flavorful (and not bitter), but not overly bold. This coffee has a full but subtle flavor that carries just a hint of dark beans (or French roast), but it's just a hint, not overwhelming. Very smooth: It would be easy to drink cup after cup. My only criticism is that the packaging was not as easy to open as some other coffees I drink; next time, I'll start with a pair of scissors.But I do plan to purchase more of this coffee; I recommend it to others with coffee taste similar to mine.

I'm a thrifty person, and I usually buy store brand foods, but coffee is the one item we really splurge on in our house. I've recently become really picky about my coffee. I work from home, so I don't hit up Starbucks or Dunkin' Donuts on the way to work. I used to be able to literally drink ANY coffee, and wouldn't be able to tell the difference. Now I can barely stomach what I used to drink, like Folgers. These days I buy Starbucks beans and grind them at home, or use the self serve dispensers at the grocery store that are organic or green mountain brand.This Melitta coffee didn't disgust me, but I wouldn't start buying it exclusively as a replacement for the coffee we currently drink. When I asked my boyfriend his thoughts on the Melitta he said it was good, kinda of nutty. Then I asked him if I could replace the Starbucks beans and instantly a big emphatic "NO!" came flying out of his mouth. No consideration what-so-ever that this could be a replacement. I find it to be a mild blend, not really enough flavor for me. I tend to like the bold beans like French Roast.It will do in a pinch but I don't really think I'll purchase Melitta in the future.
Very rich and full body coffee worth every effort in seeking out at your local grocery store. Perhaps one of the best commercial coffee's available in the mass market today!

I love Melitta products. Even use the now almost antique ceramic coffee cone to brew cups individually (they're better brewed that way).  I also admit to being a coffee snob and someone who is qualified to judge the flavor and worth of a brewed cup of "the nectar of the gods."  So I was hopeful that the Blanc et Noir would score higher than the Creme Brulee which I recently reviewed..While better than the Creme Brulee, I felt the Blanc et Noir lacked the full-bodied flavor I come to associate with rich, premium coffee.  I normally use three heaping measures (special pewter Melitta coffee measure) for a 10-12 oz. cup, because I prefer a full-flavor brew and my preparation of Blanc et Noir was done in this manner.  What should have been a rich and smooth brew was in actuality an acidic "thin" tasting coffee that rated slightly above average but not by much.  I realize I am spoiled by purchasing whole beans and grinding them prior to use.  I feel pre-ground coffee does not keep that freshness, so this is partially a factor.  But that aside, Blanc et Noir is not a coffee I would purchase again.As with my review of Creme Brulee, I am disappointed to give Blanc et Noir a less than stellar report, however, search further.  There are better brews on the market.

column9: Good Coffee - every bit as good as store brand
column10: Not a bad cup of Joe. Smooth, medium roast flavor and smells divine and I preferred it to Starbucks. (I do not like the taste of burnt beans.) Only one little problem, I did a taste test with this up against Kroeger store brand coffee a generic.This was almost a dead tie. the flavor and density was comparable with the only obvious difference being that the finer ground of the Melitta meant that it was less acidic and didn't upset my stomach as much after my 4th cup. Unfortunately the disparity in price can be depressing and makes the Kroeger brand appear more reasonable to my budget.Too bad, I do like this coffee.

I love my coffee and I order my own from a coffee dealer.  I usually grind my own beans for the freshest taste.  I was anxious to try the Melitta Cafe when I saw it was available.  I understand that there are other Melitta blends besides the lighter French style that I received.My reaction to French roast coffee was reaffirmed when I tried this coffee.  That slightly burnt, bitter taste was there and, while it was minimized somewhat, I found myself disappointed.  I had that for my morning coffee and my afternoon coffee and I was going to do the same the next day.  However, I decided that I really didn't want any more of the Melitta so I switched back to the coffee I had been drinking before.  I think that those who like Franch roast coffee will enjoy this product.  As for me, I will pass.  But, hey, what do I know.  I mean, I still have most of the Blue Mountain coffee I bought in Jamaica sitting on the shelf because I didn't it was all that great.

Let me start by saying that I am someone who enjoys a good cup of coffee, but by no means am I a 'coffee expert' in the analytical sense. For instance: it would be impossible for me to tell if a certain batch of coffee were from Columbia rather than Hawaii without looking at the packaging; however, that level of discrimination is not, in my experience, necessary for me to enjoy either or both varieties. My taste buds know what they like; and they, in concert with my eyes and nose, provide me with all the information I need to make a determination concerning the quality of the coffee being served to me.Melitta has done a great job of packaging their Gourmet Coffee Cafe' Collection, giving it a subdued yet elegant appearance that beckons one to take a closer look. Opening the bag and testing the aroma I was able to tell that this was no off-the-shelf everyday coffee: my impression was of a full-bodied coffee but without the overpowering smell of a dark roast. Time to put my coffee maker into action. Blanc Et Noir is a combination of dark and light roast coffees which should theoretically have the same flavor as a medium roast; however, this is definitely not the case as I was able to detect the dark roast as well as the mellowing influence of the light roast. I drank my first cup black and was pleased at the lack of bitterness. My second cup was with cream and sugar. Both ways produced a wonderfully flavorful cup of coffee that I enjoyed completely. This would be the perfect coffee to serve to guests, or to pamper oneself with while reading a good book.

As a coffee fiend who drinks anywhere from 5 to 10 cups a day, I can heartily recommend Melitta Cafe's Noir Ground Coffee. I'm a bit surprised that I like it because I'm a diehard Maxwell House, Chock Full o' Nuts kind of guy who tends to shun the overly fancy coffee that I believe appeals primarily to yuppies (or whatever the current equivalent of a yuppy is). You know, those who like Starbucks, as I don't, and think coffee should have foam (it most definitely should not). Melitta Cafe's Noir Ground Coffee isn't anything like that. It's just good, full-bodied, robust coffee for those of us who have been drinking this beverage all our lives.Brian W. Fairbanks

I like my coffee normally flavored, but I figure 'Try something else'.  And sure enough, I was not disappointed.  The coffee is very smooth, bold but not too much so, and has enough caffeine to get me started.  A very satisfying and enjoyable cup of coffee that I can only recommend to any coffee lover!!!

First, our family drinks an almost absurd amount of coffee.  I pull 10 to 20 espresso shots on a typical day, mostly lattes and frappucino drinks.  Occasionally, we make drip.  For reference, I won't even drink "office" grade coffee or typical garbage like Folgers.  I would rather drink a glass of water or a good tea.  So, I am rather familiar with good coffee and probably more demanding than most reviewers here.As a result, I would rate Melitta Blanc et Noir just OK.  It's average.  It is more bitter and acidic than I would like.  It is maybe comparable to Starbuck's coffee which isn't that great.  It is definitely better than many store/house brands.  However, there are some good to great coffees out there including Millstone, Cost Plus' varieties, Peet's, and Illy, the latter, especially being frighteningly expensive.  I do, however, encourage you to try Illy as it has a fantastic, reusable tin.With all that, I give it a bump to 4 stars.  That is because, here at Amazon, especially with their subscription program, it is cheap.  You would probably not notice the difference in frou-frou'ed up drinks with a lot of cream and sugar.  Also, it deserves 4 stars because it is somewhat interesting.  Blanc et Noir is a blend of dark French roast and a light roast.  I expected it to be some middling blend in between, but actually you do get a sense of both the mild roast and the more full, smoky darker roast.  It is interesting, but I'm not sure I'd like it over and over.  I prefer more single bean roasts like a good Columbian Supremo or a well-blended house.Finally, it is listed as "Extra Fine Grind".  It is very, very evenly ground which is impressive, but it is not that extra fine.  I would say more of just fine.  It is definitely way too coarse to use in an espresso machine, even with a pressurized portafilter.This product is worth a try, and also be sure to pick up a can of Illy (even for the tin) and try some good Columbian Supremo if you haven't already.  These are good reference coffees, and I made a bunch of A/B tests among them and a couple others before writing this review.
we like strong flavored coffee and this really fills the bill.tastes good and isn't bitter. i will definitely buy more.

column9: Comparable to premium coffee from your grocery store
column10: I drink good coffee, black, nearly everyday. I usually purchase Tully's, Starbucks, Seattle's Best, etc. ground (occasionally beans). I normally prefer bold blends but will sometimes go with a lighter coffee just for variety's sake. I brew my coffee drip using a non-bleached filter.This Melitta proved to be a nice bold blend that I enjoyed very much. I found it to be comparable with my normal coffee and at $6 per bag it is priced a little below what I would normally pay at my local QFC.Recommended.

I'm sitting here this morning having a cup of Melitta Cafe Collection Blanc et Noir as I peruse the paper and facebook and look for goodies on Amazon. Let me just say that I really like this fine blend of the dark and light coffees. What you get is a coffee that's very drinkable with or without cream, as light on the palate as any American breakfast coffee. Yet there are wonderful subdued flavors of the darker and richer coffees one might expect down at the local coffee shop. My normal cup of home-brew is something along the lines of Starbucks Cafe Estima or Sumatra, so I do like the heavier, darker brews. And this Blanc et Noir just hints at those beans in a beverage which is smooth and aromatic and suitable for nearly every occasion. If you like the flavors of the darker brews but find the full-bore coffees sometimes overpowering, this is the blend for you. Blanc et Noir finishes with mild tones of citrus. Very nice.

column9: makes the best iced coffee, bar none
column10: This coffee scored well when compared over a few days use with the coffees we normally use, also premium coffees. First, if you are looking for a great iced coffee, look no further.  This makes the best iced coffee, bar none. Second, my husband and I both like a strong, robust, on the dark side coffee, fine ground and black with no cream or other additions.  The price we pay for this preference is that we often go too far over the edge into bitterness.  This coffee, by blending the light with the dark, gets around this potential bitterness factor better than any coffee we've used.  We will be buying this again as right now it is in first place with us.

I have long been a fan of German based Melitta products, and found their coffee to be far superior to most of the mainstream popular coffees, and even some so called "exclusive" or "select" blends.Blanc et Noir is one selection from their Cafe Collection, which I would put in the medium to dark roast catagory.A full bodied flavor without acidity, but not too strong. That is when made in French press, I don't use old style "leave it in the pot all day" machines.A lot of people have switched to the pod type or single cup brewing systems lately, and in fact coffee consumption seems down in general, in favor of herb teas and non caffeinated drinks. So it was nice to go back to an old style ground coffee taste.If you like European style ground coffees, you may also like to try Douwe Egberts Intense - Real Coffee Dark Roast Ground Coffee, 8.8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 3) which is Dutch, or the bold flavored Jacobs Krönung Coffee, 8.81-Ounce Vacuum Packs (Pack of 4).Another point worth mentioning is cost, these value packs here work out pretty cheap compared to pod systems bags or cups, and are even not that bad compared to everyday grocery store prices. When compared to gourmet stores like Gevalia, they are a steal, and great quality.
I highly recommend this coffee and the other brands from Cafe Pura Vida.  If you enjoy high quality pure coffee, it is in your best interest to enjoy try this for your home and office.
These candies have a different, but pleasant cherry flavor.  Also like the lemon & orange flavors from the same company.

I gave these, in three different flavors, as party favors as guests were leaving my party.  They were well received and even now, months later, I always keep a tin in my handbag for when I just need a sweet pick me up.  Satisfied.

I really like the La Vie hard candies, they are sweet, but not to the extreme, plus in the tin they are easy to take with you.  As a sugar lover I find them very satisfying and they take care of any craving I have.

Great Stuff. Because I liked it so much, I've sent it to relatives. This seasoning can be used on almost any salad or main dish. Wish it were available in retail stores, but maybe there's a reason why it isn't. (Perhaps a spoilage or shelf life issue.) Hope it remains available at Amazon..

This is my favorite seasoning: scrambled eggs, mashed potatoes, roasted potatoes, potato salad, soups, salads, poaching chicken for "curried chicken" (chicken, mayo with curry, cranraisens, cashews), anything put on barbeque, add to any breading mix (panko, flour, bisquick, etc.), season roasts, sprinkle on salmon or any fish cooked any style, add to pasta sauces, etc.  I cannot find it any more at 3 different CostCos I have look at in CA and PA.
This is a great addition to a full spice cupboard. I use it when I saute mushrooms for use in strogonoff and it adds an excellent zing. It is also useful in many Italian recipes.

I purchased 2 sets of 36 to use for a movie package with Secret Santa gifts. These popcorn packets come individually wrapped with the Orville Redenbacher's box picture/logo on the celophane. They also have nutritional information on each packet. They are a 3.3 oz package. I am very impressed. They look like something you would buy out of a vending machine or at a convenience store. Great gifting product!

column9: Gave this to my grandparents and they asked for more
column10: I have a hard time finding gifts for relatives, and I was pleasantly surprised to find that this was a hit with my grandparents.Every time they pop it on a day I call, they say "we had your popcorn!" My grandparents rarely mention any expensive gifts I give them, and they don't need anything at all.This is the perfect gift, because they use it as a special treat and like it.You can't ask more from a product than that.

column9: Tasty when it works, but potential fire hazard
column10: I bought these because I like the Movie Theater Butter flavored microwave popcorn.  I've bought the in the store and thought this was a great deal.But these have a serious problem.  The bags say to cook for no longer than 2.5 minutes (that's 2 minutes, 30 seconds) and to stop if, before that, the popping slows down to a pop ever 2 seconds.I cooked about 10 of the bags and half of them burned through before reaching the limit, all while not slowing down the popping. One bag burned right through at about the one minute mark, with about 30 kernels popped.  Butter-goo was all over the microwave. What a mess!I'm going to throw out the rest, because I'm terrified one will actually burst into flames.
The best popcorn I've eaten in a long time. Product arrived way before its expected time. Amazon, you done it again! Thanks. I am very well pleased with the product and service.

I had been getting this product throught the Subscribe and Save program but cancelled due to a bad batch.  The popcorn tasted stale and would burn in one small spot and ruin the whole bag.  Not sure if it was a storage problem or quality control.Amazon was great in crediting my account for the bad batch but I am hesitant to try it again.

column9: Great price..BUT expires in less than 3 months
column10: This was a great price so we decided to give it a try. If I knew then what I know now, I would NOT have done so. The expiration date is April 2011, and I'm writing this review at the end of January. It will probably keep, but we fixed one bag and it already tastes stale..so I am going to contact Amazon and see what they say. When I buy in bulk, I expect the expiration date to be reasonable, and less than 3 months on this huge pack of popcorn is NOT reasonable. Would not recommend.

column9: Good Price - Very Limited Use by Date
column10: Got 36 bags at a very good price. Only problem is the "Best Used By Date" is less than 6 weeks away. I love popcorn but not enough to have it every day to use it up. I will be giving most of it away. Hopefully not all these great food bargains are just clearing out of "old" stock!-Reea

this has got to be the absolute WORST microwave popcorn I have EVER had.  Lots of unpopped kernels.  The "butter" was more like "seized" glop (warm, lumps of lard).  I threw out the first bag after eating a small handful.  I took the rest of the order to work for those who appreciate this type of thing.  It didn't disappear very quickly, so maybe I am not the only one that thinks Orville Redenbacher's is a HUGE WASTE of money.
THE SMELL WAS BETTER THAN THE TASTE. THE TASTE WAS GOOD BUT IF IT WOULD HAVE TASTED THE WAY IT SMELLED THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN GREAT.

My son has autism. He is on a gluten-free, casein-free, and soy free diet, so there is not a lot of pre-packaged stuff out there that he can eat that he actually wants to eat. We have tried the Glutino pretzels, they are good but have soy. My typical son on an unrestricted diet likes them and asks for them. But my gf/cf/sf son can't have them.I brought home a few sample bags of these from a TACA meeting (Talk About Curing Autism) and my son ate them right up. I was glad to see them on this site so I could order them in bulk.I tried them and didn't think they tasted bad. Of course, they could use more salt for my taste, but my son gets enough sodium from other sources, so I'm glad that they aren't salted.

I have a son with autism who is allergic to gluten, soy, and milk products.  He loves these!  My typical daughter does as well.  I think they taste fine as well,like others they could use a little more salt, but my kids don't need the extra anyway.  I'm so happy I can now buy them by the case!

column9: Light, Crunchy and not too salty
column10: I really was impressed with the Wylde pretzels. I had purchased it on a couple of different occassions, but my latest purchase in August 2007 was the best. It seems that they improved their recipes. My children love it and I am planning on reordering some more.

I thought  they had a stale texture and they didn't have enough salt. Ener-G does make a type of sesame pretzel that is incredible but these aren't it. Hope this helps all the gluten-free people like me.

column9: The ONLY egg-free GF pretzels I've been able to find!
column10: I think they taste great as well. They aren't really salty enopugh, but I can live with that. My son and I are both allergic to eggs as well as having problems w/ gluten.

column9: Product has been on the shelf for a long time before sending to us
column10: The expiration date on the package is 09-30-2011, as compared to expiration date in 2012 for the same product we buy from a local store. So the product must have been sitting somewhere for a long time before it was sent to us. Plus it does not taste as good as the one without the sesame. I will be very reluctant to buy food product from Amazon!I was not told that I can not return this item when I ordered it. I would have made a different decision if I were told so.

I love these small, round 3/4" pretzels!  What sets them apart is that they have 3 gr of FIBER in every serving!  That equals my husband's Metamucil (registered trademark) dietary fiber!  Plus, they taste very good, it's hard to stop snacking...Don't look for alot of salt on the outside, but the overall flavor is salty enough for me. A serving has 230 mg, or 10% of your daily sodium intake.Nutrition Facts: each bag has 4 (30g) servings of 40 pretzels, each serving has 130 calories, 30 from fat, 3.5g total fat, 2g saturated fat (9%), No trans fat or cholesterol, 24g carbohydrate (8%), 3g dietary fiber, 1g sugar, .6g protein.I once bought a bag of the Ener-G GF 2.65 oz. pretzels,Ener-G Foods Crisp Pretzels, Wheat-Free, 2.65-Ounce Bags (Pack of 20) and they taste great - but each serving has twice the salt, almost twice as much fat (6g), and less than 1g fiber.  That is alot of salt for a snack.  (all the other values are about the same).  Put enough fat and salt in anything, and it will taste good...I choose the Wylde pretzels!PS:  Don't eat these unless you have sound teeth - I had a temporary, plastic crown break while eating them.

I've been buying this product for years at the HfS, but decided to start ordering cases on Amazon.  The product came not packed well and the pretzels were in a million pieces and clumps.  I emailed Amazon and they sent me a new case.  Well, the same thing.  I emailed them again and theyrefunded me and I was thrilled at the exceptional service !!!!!BTW, these pretzels are very good and also soy free !

My son loves these little pretels. They are also great in Gluten free Chex mix!  I like the fact that they have a unique round shape - it makes it easy to distinguish from "regular" pretzels.  I'm sure my allergic son is eating safe food and not his brother's wheat pretzels!  Highly reccommend!!

I have a daughter with Autistic Spectrum Disorder... DAN! (Defeat Autism Now!) had an article that implied some connection between gluten and dairy allergies to behavioral difficulties in children with this disorder. So, we decided to try a gluten-free, dairy-free diet to see what happened. I have to say I have seen a good deal of improvement in her general behavior as well as her focus and retention rate.From what I understand it is a good product for kidney patients as well because it is low protein. And it's Kosher Parve.I tried these pretzles because of this new diet and now my whole family is addicted! They are tasty, crunchy and not too salty, but still satisfy my desire for salty foods. We will be buying these from now on.

column9: My picky eater grandson loves these!
column10: My little grandson who has celiac eats these practically all day, he loves them. I like them too. We tried once getting the sesame ones when these weren't available but they taste awful to us. I guess it's a matter of taste. PLEASE get these back in stock!!
I suppose which type of gluten free pretzel you prefer is a matter of taste, but these are really hard, crispy, and fresh tasting, which I prefer to the regular Ener-G GF pretzels.
Taste like I am chewing on glass. Hard and I am afraid I am going to break a tooth. Don't waste your money on this product.

These pretzels are one of our favorite gluten free snacks. Some people in our home eat them because they can't have gluten, but the rest of us eat them because we like them. Also, buying them in bulk makes them much cheaper.

column9: Good option for food allergic child
column10: My child has many food allergies, gluten being one of them.  This pretzel not only tastes good to him, but to all of his friends that we share them with as well.  They are a little on the hard side, but he doesn't mind.  He even liked them as a young toddler.  I like that there is not too much salt on them.  Pretty good.
My daughter, two grandsons, and I (all celiacs) think these are the BEST GF PRETZELs!  Even the nonceliacs like them too.  Highly Recommend!
I think that they taste like sawdust, but my son loves them. So happy to find a GFCFSF pretzel option. Great for lunch snacks.

column9: Saltless and Hard as a Rock
column10: A the salt on the outside has broken off before packaging and the pretzels are hard enough to break a filling.  They do have a good taste though.

column9: My highly allergic son's favorite pretzels!
column10: These are harder/crunchier than other pretzels, & lower in salt.  That's why we like them so much.  My son - who has severe food allergies - can eat these without any problems.  They make a great addition to his school lunches.Enjoy!

I have endometriosis and was looking for snacks that would not aggravate my condition.  These pretzels are so delicious, I can eat them all day with no negative effects.  I will say that people either hate these or love these though.  The people who hate them seem to be males more than females and usually are people who do not have any alergies.  My best work friend (who is vegan) sneaks into my desk constantly for them.  The taste is like eating just the outside crunchy part of a regular pretzel.  They are very crunchy and well suited for travelling, stashing in your office desk, and snacking during surfing the web.  I reccomend these to people with food alergies that miss their wheat snack products and often get a craving for a salty snack.Additionally, I find them to be a great value and they last a long time.  They are less suceptable to getting stale than regular snacks.  I ordered two boxes eight months ago and still have a few bags left.  When I open the new bags, they are just as fresh and tasty as the ones I opened eight months ago.  If you get tired of snacks and want to rotate variety, these pretzels will wait until you are ready to fit them back into your lunch pack.

We have such a horribly restricted diet, and these are pleasantly & surprisingly good, I even like the way they taste, its definitely not a wheat pretzel but freakin AWESOME for what it doesnt have in the ingredient list. Its one of the rare things I can actually not have to make from scratch myself. I love this company for having created them, I just wish the local markets hadn't stopped carrying this line.

column9: Gluten free 4 yr old loves this and so does mom
column10: I love this product the pretzels are salty and crunchy. I'm not gluten free...and I like it. My son is gluten free and he loves it cause that was his favorite snack. I've bought the smaller bags in a store and they were stail and didn't have enough salt. The 8oz. bags are perfect it last a week for school snacks.

This is the second order recently received that contained a case of stale pretzels.  Every bag was stale.  No excuse with posted expiration date over 6 months out.Until recently I have had no complaints with the quality of these pretzels, and my family has really enjoyed them.  But now having paid over $60 for 2 stale cases, you will lose a good customer if this happens again.

Our guy is gluten, casein, soy free.  Very picky about his snacks.He love, love, loves these pretzels.  They are a great alternativeto other illegal snacks for him.  They taste almost exactly likegluten-filled pretzels.

We love these pretzels!! Great flavor and texture! You would never know they were gluten, casein and soy free! They have become a staple at our house!  Ener g is a wonderful company with delicious products for those who have food allergies.

Just like regular pretzels.  Even my "gluten free means flavor free" teenager prefers them to regular ones.  All those I have shared them with say they are the same as the gluten ones with slightly less salt.  I like that too.

column9: Best gluten-free pretzels I ever tasted.
column10: These are the best gluten-free pretzels I have ever tasted.  Even my grandchildren who do not have to eat gluten-free love them.  They prefer them to regular pretzels.

I just received these pretzels but have not tasted them yet because I noticed under the ingredients on the package that it says may contain traces of sesame or poppy seeds.  My son is allergic to sesame seeds and this was not stated on the website under ingredients.  I notified Amazon and they will look into this.
GREAT PRETZELS JUST WISH IT COULD BE A LITTLE CHEAPER FOR CIALICSEVERYTHING I HAVE PURCHAED ON AMAZON HAS BEEN GREAT
The flavor is very good. However, they are a little too hard for my 18 month old daughter; she does better if I break them up for her. For me, I could use a little more salt.

These pretzels are a great gluten free crunchy snack and not too salty.  I love to just grab them and go but my girls love too dip them in warm cream cheese!  I think they're better than regular wheat pretzels.

I ordered a case & was dismayed that all the bags contained 70% broken pieces.  I bought these for my gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free son & for small children, broken food is a big deal.  I will pursue a refund from Amazon.Once you can get past the broken pieces, they taste good.

I was very happy with this product.  Even my husband, who doesn't need to eat gluten free, liked them.  Nice and crunchy with a very good taste.  I tried a smaller bag at the local store for 2 bucks and liked it.  Then, I saw these and it was a much better buy.  Compare prices though, because right now this size isn't the best deal.  It was when I bought it.

Another great produce carried by Amazon for those suffering from Celiac Disease or anybody else who wants a great tasting crunchy pretzel.  My husband was diagnosed with Celiac Disease 4 years ago.  It has been my goal to make him feel less restricted in a world that is chock full of gluten.  I read every food label of anything I purchase so it is nice to know that there is a wonderful worry-free snack food out there that tastes even better than regular pretzels.  Good thing you can get this product in 4 oz bags or you would not be able to pace yourself. Thanks again Amazon for making such a wonderful produce as Wylde Pretzels available and accessible to all.
My son is on the GFCG diet and these are his favorite snack. Although one shipment the pretzels were all broken in pieces.  But usually they are great.Support Autism Awareness
They taste great, they don't taste gluten-free. Very crunchy. Keep fresh quite a while. My 11 year old loves them, and his teacher does as well.Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Soy-Free.

Both my kids love these. I think the Glutino GFCF ones are better, but if you are avoiding soy, these are good. They are pretty hard and crunchy. Not loaded with salt which is nice if you are giving them to kids.

These pretzels are good. Not too salty, not too hard. Best of all, they contain no soy flour! The trick at our house is keeping the non-celiac from eating them all before we can to them - he prefers them to conventional pretzels.

These pretzels are the best.  You will not be able to tell the difference between these and wheat pretzels.  They are very crunchy, so that could be a downside to some people, but I happen to like that.
as far as gluten free products go - these aren't bad.  seems like nothing is really "good" so the best you can hope for is not terribly unpalatable.

column9: Excellent Snack for Healthy Kids this summer
column10: My kids have no idea these are so good for you and they are well worth the price compared to the health benefits!
I like to dip a little edge in white almond bark for that sweet-salty taste.
I'm all for reduced-salt, but no-salt is just nasty. I love sesame seeds so I was really eager to try these, but blech. They are also too hard not crispy - Glutino's pretzels are much better.
MY SON AND DAUGHTER IN LAW BOTH CAN ONLY EAT GLUTEN-FREE FOODS SO I USE THE WYLDE PRETZELS TO MAKE  THEM MY HOT AND SPICY PRETZELS. THEY ARE QUITE HAPPY NOW THAT I FOUND A GLUTEN-FREE PRETZEL.

My son is allergic to milk, eggs, and peanuts. He is also unable to eat wheat. These pretzels are the best. My son loves them and has brought them to school for a snack..everyone ate them!  Even my husband and I enjoy them and we don't have allergies. Actually, I'm constantly telling my husband to stay of of these! This is a must have if you have someone with allergies :)

This is the only gluten-free, soy-free and casein-free packaged snack I can't live with out. My whole family loves them. Some bags give the impression of having less salt than others but the crunch is always right on. Even if I didn't have to eat gluten-free these would be my top choice for snack food. They are great in chili or soups as a substitute for crackers too. I am so glad to be able to buy an entire case!
My son loves these pretzels!  They are one of his favorite snacks.  They are very crisp and tasty.

My son is gluten/casein free and LOVES these pretzels.  I even know some friends who tried them and liked them so much- they want to buy some for themselves- and they aren't even on a G/C free diet.These bags are a great deal.  I compared all the sizes of the bags and prices on Amazon.If your child has food problems, buy a bag from the local health food store, try them out and then come back to Amazon and buy a case or two.  Definitely the best deal.

My daughter has recently had to avoid gluten due to an immunity issue and we tried these locally. She is picky, but I tried one and almost lost my stomach. Horrible. There are other items that she likes. When it comes to snacking we just stick to potato and corn products and avoid anything sesame .

These gluten-free casein-free pretzels are as good as the real thing.  These are a very satisfying snack replacement and much healthier than some of the other options.  My 2 and 4 yr olds love these.  The mulitple packs are a significant cost savings over buying single bags locally at the grocery store.

column9: So Good It's Hard to Keep Them in the House
column10: This is an awesome snack.  I haven't had regular pretezels in 4 years so I'm going by an old memory, but these taste similar to what I remember pretezels were like.  The shape is an "0" instead of a traditional pretzel shape.  I like that the serving size is 40 of them; I can eat a lot of them without feeling guilty about it.
I can't keep these away from my family who do not have to be gluten free. They are a little on the harder side, but taste is good.

Well, it is all about personal taste, and I love these!  If you have to begluten free these pretzels make a great snack.  I haven't actually tasted a regular pretzel in over 20 years, and I never really liked them anyway.  But these are perfect.  Small, not too salty, and fresh, I think they are a super snack food.  I buy them by the case and so does my father, sister-in-law, and brother.  All have a gluten intolerance and think that these are the best since sliced bread!

My favorite pretzels in the world are Ener-g sesame pretzel rings-light and crispy and with seeds on the pretzels. Thought I was buying those,only in a bigger package.These are hard and dry-not crispy-dry!and must be made with ground sesame seeds because I can't find a seed on any of them.Next time will read description and check picture better.

column9: There are other and BETTER gluten-free pretzels out there...
column10: We have been a gluten free family for many years and have been enjoying the new products that are now continully being introduced.  These pretzels are not nearly as good as the ones by Ener-G Foods (small size bags) or by Glutano (larger, family size bags).  These Wylde pretzels are, as one reviewer already commented, not salty enough - that is, not salty enough for me to feel they qualify as satisfying a pretzel yearning.  These pretzels are also much harder than the others, which I don't find appealing.  That being said, I would highly recommend the Glutano or the Ener-G Foods pretzels over these.  I rated it 2-stars simply for being another gluten free product.

These are pretty interesting... They aren't that good at all. We bought them on a road trip, and landed at a hotel one night. All the fast food places were closed, so we ate what was left of our food... two packages of these. My daughter (who is GFCF) had opened them and spit them out... my sister and I ate them, and gagged... but, we were hungry (ha)...They have the pretzel crunch, but the taste is off...  Maybe if there was more salt.. or flavor..I wouldn't but them again.
Thanks for the Menudo. I just had a craving for it here in Afghanistan. It really hit the spot. Don't worry, I'll share it with my friends. Thanks again for supporting your troops!!

I used to have a lot of menudo soup as a kid so every once in a while - when mom's not around to make it - I satisfy the craving with a can of this.  However, I suggest buying it at Walmart or your local grocery store for a few bucks.  The Amazon price for one can is beyond ridiculous!!  I can get 4 of this size can for the cost of one on Amazon.

Finally found a great organic diaper cream (ointment, really) that works!  Also clears up my baby's eczema.  Thick ointment leaves baby's skin soft and smooth.  Not too sticky or gooey...baby's bum is clear and clean.
My daughter has very sensitive skin, we have tried every diaper cream out there and this is by far the best.  I love that the ingredients are all natural and organic.

column9: You bet your bum it works!
column10: A few weeks ago, I met a nice gentleman at a bar.  You know the story - girl meets boy, boy buys girl a drink, girl blacks out, girl wakes up with a rash. But this wasn't your ordinary rash. It was itchy, but not that itchy. It was red, but I couldn't tell how red because of the location of the rash. I was embarassed to go to the doctor for fear that I'd have to explain that I spent the night with one of Ricky Martin's backup dancers. Instead, I looked to my local grocer for a home-made solution.  I tried Neosporin, soap and water, Tuscan Whole Milk baths, deep tissue massages, all with minimal improvement to my stubborn rash.Just when I was about to accept the fact that I'd be wearing crotch-less pants for the rest of my life, I saw an episode of "I Didn't Know I Was Pregnant" where one of the reenactments showed a woman using applying organic diaper ointment to her rash. I immediately zipped up my pants and ran to the store. I can't even begin to explain how relieved I am to be rash-free!I've heard this product works well on babies too. 5 stars!

I'm always looking for better, more natural products. I usually use Aveeno's diaper cream, but I decided to give this cream a try because it's organic and has all natural ingredients. It has a nice consistency and is easy to spread. You can see the skin through it and tell if it looks better or worse. Unfortunately it caused a rash on my daughter's bottom. I tried it several times to be sure that it was this cream that was causing the rash, and it is. I'm going back to Aveeno.

column9: Love Love Love this diaper ointment
column10: I bought this ointment at a friends recommendation a year ago because my son had broken out with a case of eczema (he was then 4 months old).  I started applying it not only as a diaper rash remedy but to his patches of eczema and it really helped.  My son's eczema cleared up as soon as I realized that the shampoo I used was causing the problems but I still use this ointment as a diaper cream.  He has never had a bad diaper rash, but the moment I see pink on his bottom I apply this cream and the pink is gone by the morning.  We have had a pretty brutal summer heat wise and I broke out in a heat rash on my legs (first time ever).  Exhausted from trying everything else that didn't work, I applied this cream to it and the rash went away within a day.  It has helped both my son and I.  I will always have a tube of this in my house.
I love this product for my baby's bottom! It works great as a barrier and diaper rash ointment and I wouldn't use anything else.

Our baby is a month old, and I haven't been putting anything on her bottom because she's been just fine.  A few days ago, one of her creases looked red and irritated, so I pulled out a tube of this stuff to apply some.  Then I noticed that it is supposed to be used as a preventative.  Oops.But, the next day, the red irritation was totally gone.  So, I don't know whether that counts as prevention or cure, but it obviously helped her.This seems like good stuff.Also: another reviewer mentioned that the cream is gritty.  Maybe that is why that reviewer's cream was on clearance at the store to begin with?  I bought this on Amazon a couple months ago, and ours is not gritty at all.

Bought this for our daughter before she was born, along with Govia stick, which did not keep my girl from getting rashes. This stuff works great. Have had no problems with separation or it being grainy. Putting it on is a bit gross as it is thick, but that is necessary for it to be effective. Works as well as Triple Paste, but bwtter because it is organic.

We are so pleased with this diaper ointment; our daughter has never had diaper rash when using this daily and with each change.  I love that it is made with all-natural & organic ingredients, without the harmful chemicals that are included in most commercial baby products.

Arrived in less than 3 days! Great price and I don't have to think about ordering again-it arrives in 6 months! This diaper ointment is the best I have found. My child has never had any severe diaper rash; and with any irritation this ointment clears it in 24 hours. I won't use anything else. I've used it on my hands too for my excema-great stuff!

When my son was a newborn, his tushie skin was super sensitive.  He immediately developed a rash at the hospital, the nurses kept on using A+D, and due to circumstances beyond my control, I could not correct this mistake until a couple of days into this situation.  The rash was very bad at that point, and none of the hospital's ointments were working.I immediately started putting on Nature's Baby Organics ointment (which was a cream at the time), and his rash started to improve rapidly!!!  I was so happy that my newborn was finally getting some relief, and so impressed with this brand!  It cleared up my newborn's heartbreakingly bad rash in a matter of days.I have been using Nature's Baby Organics ever since, and I loved it even more when they upgraded their product to an ointment vs. the cream!!!  It performs even better, and I could not be happier!  I have been recommending this product to all of my friends, and I will continue to use it with my second baby.

I love this cream, it is organic, goes on nice and smooth, smells ok, and works great!  On really bad rashes I would recommend California Babys diaper rash cream, but on more mild to moderate rashes this stuff is great!  I also love this companys baby powder, the combo of the 2 works best!  It is also ok on cloth diapers, I use Happy heinys organic hemp one size, they are great and only natural materials touch babys skin!

I got this lotion from Buy Buy Baby because I found it on sale recently.  I will mention that I have also bought Nature's Baby Organics products on Amazon and this has been the only product that gave me issues.  When I started using it, the product came out clumpy with small gritty pieces, almost like large sand granules.  Maybe because it is a more natural product it tends to separate after a while.  If you rub the grit pieces between your fingers enough, they break down.  I have put this on my baby thinking that the heat from his body would break down the clumps but this was not the case.  I've notice the grit is still there when I change him again.  The grit that formed is not soft.  I think it is crystallized material but like I said, if you rub it between your fingers enough, it will break down.  I wanted to let people know about this product issue because it is an expensive cream.  I feel that I spent a lot of money on a product that turned out to be unusable.
He takes his mini bone into another room and eats it facing away from us. We believe he does this in order to hide it and be sure we won't take it away.

The medium are a good size for my 30 lb Sheltie.  This is his treat after his dailly brushing and he just loves them.  They do help his breath although, as another reviewer pointed out, they are not a substitute for brushing.  The pantry pack is a good value.

We have two small Maltese and they absolutely love these treats. We often break them in half to make the box last a little longer. As far as helping their breath, they help a bit. When it comes to their dental needs their is no substitution for manually brushing their teeth.
My little rescue mini poodle Bugsy loves these wonderful little chews. Small dogs like Bugsy benefit from the cleaning done with these.
my dog loves these and they really are good for thei teeth and their breath! This big bag enables them to be  at a very good price and do last quite a while. Reccommend, quick shipping!

column9: Package wasn't received, and both UPS and Amazon said it was the other's problem
column10: I have given my dogs these dental treats before and they are very popular with them. The package I found on Amazon was a good price for the large quantity ordered. Since now I have paid the money and never received the item, and basically have found no direct route of getting refunded, I am not happy. I will be reluctant to purchase from Amazon again because there was no way for me to get hold of them for a reimbursement. I contacted UPS and they said Amazon likes to handle these things directly. And from looking all through Amazon's website, it says to contact UPS directly. And when I try to put in for a refund, the product not arriving is never an option---and there is no phone number or way to email otherwise. I guess I am out $30 for this purchase. I am disappointed in both Amazon and UPS for their service. I think if the product arrived, I would have likely been happy with it.
I found this product to be dry with extremely minute particles.  Not flavorful at all.  I will not buy this product again.

column9: Multiple use product at a great price!
column10: I use chicken stock/base for a multitude of things...soups, rice, etc...and I bought this mainly because of the price I got it at. I hate boullion cubes, so I always look for the "base" mix...and this one is just as good as the others I've bought at the market. Great flavor, great price, what more could you ask for!?!

This is one of those products that you use and then think, where has this been all my life! Adds a great flavor to soups, gravies and other chicken dishes. I would leave out the salt to dishes I plan on adding this too.

This is a great price on Amazon, an item with lots of uses. I have tried this in soups of course, hot dishes, mashed sweet potatos, while steaming veggies and in dips. Not as high is salt as others (still high) but the flavor is good. I add a little dash of herbs for a warm drink when its cold outside and its nice. I've tried lots of brands but I keep coming back to this brand.
The is the best decaf coffee ever for breakfast and with dessert in the evenings.  The blend is perfect, smooth, with no bitter aftertaste.
I'm not big on drinking straight coffee (I like specialty coffee drinks like frappes & mochas) but I actually really enjoyed this one.  It was nice & light and sweet.  I would recommend this coffee.

I really like the smoothness of this coffee- not acidic or bitter. It is neither dark nor light...a nice "non-offensive" middle of the road coffee to have on hand. I did get grounds in my coffee one time this week, but I am fairly new to Keurig and don't know if this is the occassional thing that I can expect, or if this was an isolated incident. Will keep my eyes open for it, but overall happy with this purchase. I plan on reordering.
This coffee never fails to work in our brewer.. Some other brands some times fail to work and clog the brewer head..
Keurig K-cups can be expensive, but ordering them through Amazon allows me to buy them in bigger quantity for a reasonable price, and usually with free shipping!
I enjoy a good cup of coffee in the morning and when time is short a k-cup works for me and my husband. It's that simple.

Apparently my opinion does not matter ? I simply stated that I think their should be some sort of oversight . Why not post it and see if your customers agree ? I am not out to give you negative feedback but I am being prevented from giving a review ?

This is the most accessible of the Islay single malts. If you have an affinity for peat in your whisky, then Lagavulin 16 is a fine choice. Go for the 12 YO for a more bold, higher ABV, but equally rewarding experience.  Wonderful balance of sweet peat, sherry, vanilla, BBQ'd bacon, dark fruits...exceptional single malt.  A great deal if you can find it <$60. Highly recommended.
These are really easy to make and delicious. I usually sprinkle some chopped walnuts on top of the muffins too. This recipe requires 3 eggs but it's still really good.

column9: Real Banana Flavor With Lots of Chopped Nuts
column10: An excellent muffin mix with real banana flavor and lots of chopped nuts.  To me, these muffins taste every bit as good as commercial banana bread purchased from coffeehouses like Starbucks and Peet's.When I used baking cups, one package of mix produced 24 mini-muffins plus 2 standard muffins.  The muffins took a couple more minutes than the package directions called for when I used the convection oven option for my electric range.  When I don't use baking cups, one package produces 24 mini-muffins.  My muffin pans are the Dr. Oekter Nonstick Mini-Muffin Pan and the Good Cook Nonstick 12-Cup Muffin Pan.The Krusteaz Banana Nut muffins have much more flavor than the Krusteaz Oat Bran Muffins, although both mixes produce muffins with very good texture.  Maybe it's the three eggs that make the Banana Nut muffins taste so good!  I purchased both Krusteaz mixes (in single-batch boxes) at my local grocery store.

column9: fast and easy to make and even tastes pretty good
column10: I used to buy these at a local retailer but sadly although they still carry the brand, they stop getting the banana nut flavor and kept getting lemon bars and pecan something flavors.I bought some other brands available and they didn't taste good at all and texture wasn't ideal either.I am glad amazon has Krusteaz Banana Nut flavor muffins.They are moist but not to soggy, and fluffy enough and not dry.All you need to add is 1/2 cup of water, 1/3 cup of oil, and 3 eggs.I usually cook it in the cupcake pan with cupcake paper and instead of 400 degrees F like the box says, I put it in 375 for 17 minutes and it comes out just perfect.I am too busy and tired to bake banana nut muffins/bread from scratch so this mix is convenient and tastes great.

As a guy, I don't do much baking. Although, after reading the directions on the box, I figured it'd be tough to mess this recipe up.I chose the mini-muffin route. For the muffin tins I was using, this box of mix yielded about 30 muffins. I also included about ¼ of a banana, finely chopped, in my batch (I always feel so short changed when I buy a banana/apple/etc. muffin and it turns out to just be fruit "flavored" with no actual bits of fruit in it). The estimated cooking times on the box seemed spot on. In my 400° oven (thermometer verified), the ideal time was about ten minutes per twenty-four mini's.I'm surprised the instructions don't recommend adding fruit as an option, because these things came out great! Not only that, but they were quite easy to make. It couldn't have taken me more than thirty-five minutes from prep to clean up.I'm deducting one star for the banana flavoring (dried bananas, according to the ingredients panel). I can't really blame Krusteaz for this because all commercially processed bananas/banana flavorings always seem to taste like they're way beyond ripe. I'm one of those people who likes bananas that are fresh or still a little green.Nevertheless, I'll definitely be buying Krusteaz again.

I am not a good baker, but even I can make this mix! Just add water, oil and 2 eggs and bake. For those watching their waists, these babies pack a wallop at 220 calories though, but they are very tasty.

I'm so sad the previous reviewer felt so poorly about this mix. I think it's FANTASTIC! I went to a different grocery store that didn't carry this brand and I just bought whatever was there. Did not even begin to compare.  I made a batch for my Sunday School class and people went bazonkers over them. One man even pulled my hubby aside and asked if we had anymore at home!!!Now, I'll be honest I didn't make them "straight up". I used one of the suggestions on the side of the box and added chocolate chips A-MAZING!!! Right now, I've got one giant muffin and big ol' glass of milk right beside me and I am one happy camper.

column9: This brand has a great reputation but....
column10: I was very disappointed with this Krusteaz Banana Nut Muffin Mix.  I've used this brand many times and have never been disappointed before but this muffin mix is HEAVY and almost tasteless.  The banana and walnut flavors should stand out but they don't with this mix.  Don't get me wrong.....there is nothing wrong with it but it just does not bake and taste like other Krusteaz mixes that I've tried so my anticipation has tainted my view of this product.  I suggest you try a box from the local stores before actually buying a case from Amazon.  You may love it or, like me, don't find that it bakes into a very good muffin.

To say these snacks are incredible might be overblown, but they're not far from it.  The kids grab these things so fast, you don't even know that you've bought them - they're gone as fast as them come in the door.  This variety pack is particularly nice, especially if you're buying them for sportsteam snacks.  The kids just LOVE them and mom and dad eat them too! If you're afraid to try them because of the nasty things we had in the 70s, you know, those things that PRETENDED to be fruit snacks? These are NOTHING like that at all! Great stuff! Highly recommend!
This is probably the best fruit snack there is. I'm addicted to these. I at a whole box of G-force gushers in 10 minutes.

My wife brought  a couple variety packs of Fruit Gushers for the last Halloween give-away. Unfortunately, we had a few packs left over so we've been consuming them from time to time. My wife likes to give them to our toddler as a little reward. He loves them, of course. Actually, they are rather good. They're a candy that looks like a small irregular blob. It's soft to the touch and tastes fruity. The trick is that when you bite down the soft blob crushes and releases a sweet and fruity flavored syrup into the mouth. They're quite flavorful and enjoyable to eat. My main worry would be that the candy itself is quite sticky and hard to get off the teeth, so brush carefully after indulging.Gary Peterson

This cashew butter is some of the best I've ever had!  I buy it as a special treat for myself...and I'm almost out so I need to reorder.  Do yourself a favor and try Superior Nut Company's honey roasted cashew butter.  It's delicious!

This is a good product.  It so extremely thick, it is not spreadable like peanut butter.  But personally I like that, because it means it has less added oils and is almost pure cashews so I'm getting my money's worth.  I've made my own cashew butter before in a blender with organic cashews, canola oil and a touch of salt and it was extremely good and I am likely to make my own again.  But this is a wonderful ready-made.  So extremely cashewy and the right amount of salt and sweetness from the honey.  I love it and am ordering more.

Bought it, but unfortunately, could not eat it.  Contains peanut oil.  I am allergic to peanuts, peanut oil, peanut flour (a new ingredient in some tempura batters I found out to my horror - love tempura-battered fish, but can't risk it now).  Gave this to my Mom, she loved it.  So sad I could not try it myself.  She said it was absolutely delicious!

The cashew butter tastes great, but there is a possibility of peanut oil being used in the product. Also it says that it is made in a facility that processes peanuts.I can't eat peanuts without getting sick, but I can eat this! If you're severely allergic topeanuts or other nuts, stay away.
Product quite pricey. It tastes okay, but not a distinct cashew taste because of the honey flavoring.  Next time I would buy plain cashew butter and forego the honey roasted kind.

This is the second time I have ordered this product because the first time I ordered it, I couldn't believe how good it taste. So I ordered it again and it's still very good. I've had it on toast, melted it in ice cream and on a spoon. Delicious in all three. Try it, you'll gonna love it!
These were perfect with the cherry ones for a wedding I did this weekend.  People loved them!  They are not clear but that honestly doesn't matter in the long run.  They taste great!

Agree with the other reviewer. This product claims to be safe for diabetics, yet the first ingredient listed is maltodextrin, not stevia! I am a diabetic, and maltodextrin spikes my blood sugar just as much as table sugar does. It should not be legal for sugar substitutes to use this ingredient, and say "safe for diabetics" on the label, when it is not!  I was so upset that I had this product and had been using it before realizing that it had maltodextrin in it. It had not even occured to me that I needed to check the ingredients on a package that said it is STEVIA. I'd understand if it said it is a stevia blend like some others, but this is marketed as a natural, diabetic friendly product and it isn't.There are a lot "sugar free" products out there that also contain maltodextrin. I was not expecting to find it in what I thought was a natural sweetener.

This product is bad for you!! I bought this assuming that "Stevia in the raw" meant that it was in fact, just stevia. NO!! The number one ingredient listed is Maltodextrine. Maltodextrine is TWICE as bad for you as simple sugar. So by cutting stevia with maltodextrine, In The Raw has negating anything positive about this product, and made it JUST AS BAD FOR YOU, if not worse than, table sugar.  Total waste of money, if only I had read the label when I was still in the store.

There isn't much to review about a product that I use every day, and is consistently just what I need for my "sugar" bowl. Stevia in the Raw is much easier to use than those little packets of other brands....it dissolves better and you can use it just like sugar, in baking, coffee, tea, on your cereal, etc. It can be conveniently measured cup for cup in baking. It may seem expensive, but when you realize the ease of use and how far a bag of it goes, you will be satisfied.
This item is a lot cheaper at the grocery store!!!!  It is about 7 dollars a bag at your local grocery store.
This stuff is addictive. I marinated pork loin chops in it overnight & grilled it the next day-Yum!

This marinade is the best we have ever had. The flavors are wonderful. It's really great on pork tenderlion. My husband maarinates it overnight and then he is constantly brushing more on the pork as he grills it.

Made Shoyu Tamago for the first time using this product.  Shoyu Tamago is a hard boiled egg that is peeled then rolled in gently simmering tamari so that the egg white absorbs it.  It is a beautiful presentation when sliced and the flavor of the tamari is much richer than "regular soy sauce".  However, the sodium taste is also more intense and that's why I gave it 4 stars instead of 5.

column9: Fresh and lots of banana flavor
column10: These banana candies are like taffy and they don't stick to your teeth! Strong banana flavor and when chopped is great in brownies...
Great taste. My only regret is I did not double my order. It would have been double the pleasure for sure!

The Banana Split Taffy candy was delicious and full of that old time banana flavor. It was very sticky though. It hand started to melt. I had to put it in the refrigerator to get cold, before I could get it out of the paper without being a gooey mess. I guess you shouldn't order taffy though the mail when it is hot outside.
I love this! Delicious with strawberry! I mix this with milk and coffee, it is good for morning. I just cannot help eating more!

We have been enjoying this cereal in our household for the last year.  Our teenagers like the cereal even more than my wife or me.It costs less than the similar Kashi Strawberry Fields cereal, and surprising had slightly better nutritional value.

This isn't a review of the product per se, but a warning about the listing: It says that it comes out to 19 cents/ounce at regular price, and 16 cents/ounce with Subscribe & Save. If this is really for 4 12-ounce boxes (so 48 ounces), then those numbers are completely wrong (too low). With Subscribe & Save, it comes out 28 cents/ounce.

Brownie Points has great customer service, and their brownies are truly terrific.  The brownies have tasty combinations and I like the fact that they come individually wrapped.  You can freeze them and take out as many as you want.
I sent these brownies to my 20 year old son twice, and he said it was like dying and going to heaven.  He is very picky about what sweets he eats, so that is a huge compliment.
Received these as a gift from a friend...best brownies I've ever had!  Try them (you won't regret it!)

I was born in Hawaiian and used to eat these when I was growing up. Ecstatic to find these on Amazon. Kind of pricey but I wanted them! These are just like I remembered. Now I just need to go back to Hawaii for a vacation so I can eat all of my other favorite foods...

column9: Finally, the ones we've been looking for!
column10: My husband grew up in Okinawa. Ever since coming to the States 20+ years ago, he's been on a quest to find the perfect seemois -- or dried plums. We search every Oriental Market, every Asian Grocery store and have placed countless orders online. Kaj's nailed it. THESE are the plums that remind him of home. We're now placing our third order!

i have looked and looked for these and have had no luck until now. yeah, yeah there are oodlesof Li Hing Mui things out there. not hard to find but i have a long and happy relationship withLi Hing Mui.  my back ground. i was raised in honolulu from in the 1950's (yes, it was exquisite)from 3 until 13 when i went back to the main land. these are EXACTLY like the ones i could buy at thelittle corner store, run by a very old asian guy, who kept all his preserved seeds in gigantic roundglass jars that had glass lids. there's a serious quality to these and they have the perfect consistency!not too dried, not too moist! the balance of salt and sweet is just as i remember it. i have lookedfor more, even in hawaii! and never found it. i chalked it up to things seeming better as a kid thanas an adult! turns out it can be the same!

I had this product on a layover in Hawaii it is the best li hing mui I have ever had and was born and raised in Hawaii.  There is a massive " BUT" here in that the order was placed 5 days ago and it has not even shipped yet! Their customer survice is a 1and the mui a 9 for a net 5 overall rating. It will be interesting to see if the company sends it by a faster shipping method to make up for their delay.

Delicious if you know what you are ordering.If this is your first time tasting this product it can be an acquired taste. Good quality and unfortunately I bought the last supply a few months ago and haven"t been able to get more. AWWWW

My beautiful little cocker spaniel, Kiko, had a terrible skin condition called seboria.  He secreated a thick oil that made him and everywhere he went smell awfull.  His hair fell out by handfulls, and he was covered with scabs.  His underside developed a black mold that wouldn't wash off.  None of the vets ideas worked.  I tried everything.  I kept him on dog food for dogs with alergies which helped a little.  I bathed him twice a week with a strong shampoo but before he was even dry he would be stinking again.  He made our whole house stink.  His skin was red and swollen and his feet were so sore we called him tripod.  We were considering having him put down. But he's such a sweet, good dog, I kept looking on line and reading blogs.  I finally found Zinpro Biscuits and now after a year on them he's like a normal dog.  He's so beautiful. He has a long, extremely full coat, and I can bath him once a month.  Only the good part of seboria has stayed with him, the fleas don't like him.
