column9: Only Way to Make a Bloody mary
column10: ZorroZ has made me realize what a real bloody mary is. This stuff is thick and has incredible texture and flavor. The heat is strong but not painful to drink. It's seriously good with or without booze added. I drink this stuff for breakfast and have cooked with it..I've used it on grilled fish, steamed rice, and have poured it on tacos. It's just a great drink!

column9: Good if time is of the essence...
column10: I actually prefer Thai red curry Thai Kitchen Red Curry Paste, 4-Ounce Jars (Pack of 12) to Patak's but this is pretty good too.  By definition, Madras is hot so you have a few options: deal with the heat, use coconut milk or yogurt to mellow it out.This curry in combination with a pressure cooker = Dinner in 20 minutes.  Personally, I like boneless skinless chicken thighs.  For vegetables, I use an onion, a potatoe, some carrots and occasionaly a tomato.  When I feel like splurging a little, I use boneless lamb or bone-in goat.On the econimcal scale, this product is very cost effective.  On the I'm lazy scale, this product makes meal preparation a breeze.  Like I said: Use a pressure cooker.

My kids love these Earnest Eats snacks. I like that they are more nutritional and healthier that traditional snack bars in the grocery store. I also admire the use non-oil alternative products such as almond butter and non-processed sugar such as dried fruit for sweetness. I have already ordered these bars 3 times and will continue!

I love these bars and decided to order them online.  The box they came in had a good exp date, but after eating a couple bars that were hard and didn't taste right i realized the exp date on the individual packages was March of 2012.  I received the bars in May.  I think this vendor used a box with a good date and put old product inside.  I will never order these again online.

column9: A popular product from a major movie
column10: Although these delicious delicacies can stand on their own merit, they have a know reputation.  Everyone remembers the red stapler from "Offices Space" (1999). But only a connoisseur would associate gummy bears with "Ferris Bueller's Day Off" (1986). While Ed Rooney (Jeffrey Jones) was making his principal getaway on a school bus, a young lady offered him a gummy bear. It was warm and chewy as she kept them in her pocket.You do not need to keep these animals in your pocket to enjoy them. Just be aware that they may not blend well with temporary fillings. You can just suck on them in that case.

column9: Wish I could rate it 0 stars.
column10: Honestly... is it so hard to make a sugar free cookie that tastes good with all the sugar alternatives available in this day and age?I literally had to spit this out it was so awful. Just unreasonably bad.It was dry, hard, bitter, stale tasting, and nothing like peanut butter.I enjoy eating spinach more than these cookies.5 bucks I'll never get back.

I LOVE this Barney Butter!  These packets are the perfect size and source of protein to provide the energy boost on hikes, bike rides, camping and all my outdoor adventures.  I'm so glad I found these after trying so many different bars, goos, and other nut butters.  The taste is great and is so much healthier than alot of the other alternatives.  I've also been taking them to work and keep them in my car for a long commute.  Further, my kids love the taste as well so I now can feel good about them enjoying a healthy snack anywhere we go and at school.  This is truly the perfect food and now in the perfect package to go with me and my kids everywhere we go.  If you havn't tried Barney Butter, I highly recommend.  And the prices on Amazon are better than the stores so its a great deal.  Enjoy.

I thought I'd try these packets since I really like the full size Barney Butter and wanted something handy for my kids' lunches, the car, etc.  The package came in today and these are the perfect quick and healthy snack.  It was very easy to open (there was a little notch, my 9 year old had no problem either) and it is the exact same smooth and creamy consistency that I love in the full size Barney Butter jars.  I am always looking for dense nutrition that my kids will actually eat.  They love Barney Butter and I am so grateful for such a high quality product.  I'll give my kids these packets for their lunch, on their way to soccer practice or if afternoon activities delay dinner.  That it is peanut free is great because some of my kids' friends have peanut allergies.  This is a great quality product.

column9: This is the best ever and 90 calories??? Are you Kidding ME!!!
column10: Absolutely the best! 100% Natural, just roasted almonds. I love this product, my friends loves this product and my girls take them to school everyday, more and more each day as they give them to their friends. This is the equivalent and laziness to the gogurts of Almond butter! Could anything be better tasting, easier, more healthy and more convenient. Frankly, I feel as though I have become lazy as I would rather eat this than make a meal!. Cannot believe I ate peanut butter for that many years! No mess either if you are looking for a late night snack to eat while laying in bed! :-)

column9: Excellent, exactly as expected, perfect taste & consistency
column10: Because it's nutritious, I bought a total of 96 packets to add to breakfast bags for the homeless. I figure it is a form of quick energy that can be tucked into a pocket to consume later, and no worries about peanut allergies -- It's produced in a 100% peanut-free facility. I tried it myself to make sure the flavor was right. I'd never had almond butter before and it tastes somewhat similar to peanut butter (which I love) but a bit milder, as you might expect. Printed on the package are instructions to squeeze, mix and enjoy (or something to that effect). I had no problem with the ones I tried and would buy again. Very good with 100% whole wheat and sesame seed Ak-Mak crackers, also sold by Amazon.com. It easily squirted out of the packet onto crackers once opened.

I take these snack packs with me everywhere!  I travel a lot and I never get on a plane without a few in my purse.  Just knead for a few seconds and tear the pack open, you can squeeze straight into your mouth from the pack, or spread on a bagel or apple (or in yogurt and granola - delicious).  The perfect snack.

column9: Poor quality and gritty, Expiration Date Unknown
column10: We received our order form Amazon last week and it came in an unmarked box with 24 counts in it. There's no expiration date whatsoever imprinted inside or outside of the box, nor is it on the packets themselves. We don't know how long it has been sitting in the warehouse. Judging by the texture of the almond butter upon opening, it must have been quite a while. The texture is rather gritty, and very dry. It's almost hardened and cannot be squeezed out whatsoever. We tried to soften the spread by warming it in the boiling water with pouch intact but it had no effect. It was completely solid when we opened each pouch. You can't squeeze it out. It is VERY difficult to open each foil packet without scissors on hand. Very badly made inside out, in short.

I tried this product because of the price, I usually get Justin's, but this was so much cheaper, I thought I would give it a try.  Not even close, this product has no taste what so ever, will not purchase again.

I bought these mostly as a portable snack for my kids.  This almond butter is really very tasty, probably my favorite almond butter, with a rich, toasty taste that we all love.  However, the oil and butter separate in the packet, and while I can mix them reasonably well by massaging the packet for a few seconds, my kids have trouble with it.  They have difficulty getting it worked well enough to really mix it, and so the oil drips out first when you open the packet, and then the hard lump of remaining butter is difficult to squeeze out.  So, even though this stuff is quite delicious, these packets aren't ideally suited to the situation I bought them for.  YMMV, of course.

These snack packs are perfect!  I am a huge fan of Barney Butter by the jar, but I travel a lot and taking a jar on vacation is not always practical.  They pack well and are just enough for a snack or for me to add to a bagel or something for breakfast.  As long as you follow the directions and knead them a little bit, the texture is just the same as by the jar.  Love them!!!!!
Tried kneading it to get it out of the packet, but it hardly budges. NOT RETURNABLE so buyer beware!

I thought this would be the best idea for an energy snack yet.  It tastes great, for that I may have given it four stars; but the packaging is terrible.  How do you get the almond butter clump stuck in the bottom third of the packet?  It will not roll-up from the bottom and whose mouth is big enough to eat it using your teeth like eating an "artichoke" leaf?  The point is to be able to eat this on the run which you cannot do with this package unless you have your dissecting kit with you.  Someone needs to post a video on how to eat this.

This is the perfect size to take with me to work and eat on my apple or my celery. I love the 90 calorie packs, otherwise, I'd for sure eat way too much...The texture is really smooth & creamy and not grainy like normal almond butter. It tastes comparable to Jiffy Peanut Butter... I actually really like it!!

I have tried alot of almond butter and they are not all created equalI love it and my little 2 year old loves it which is great because itshealthier then the normal peanut butter out there.So handy for being on the go for both of usFinally a snack that we both can eat and enjoy and that is healthy ...Thanks

I have loved Barney Butter by the jar and when I saw they offered snack packs I was excited to try them.  Delicious all natural almond butter, only 90 calories, easy to carry with you to work, to the gym, on a trip, wherever you go.  I was so excited when I also found one in my snack package on a recent Jet Blue flight.  Follow the directions on the package and remember to knead before opening and you will be treated to a smooth, tasty, and nutritious spread to apply to crackers, a bagel, or for a special treat on apple slices.  If you haven't tried them yet, you don't know what you are missing!

column9: Very good, maybe they changed the formula?
column10: I was worried after reading all the reviews that the almond butter would be hard, but it wasn't at all.  It was very smooth and creamy.  Maybe they changed the formula recently?  Either way, this was a very good, good tasting almond butter.  I like the serving size better than Justin's because it was more manageable.  The 200 calories in Justin's vs. the 90 here could be a little much, depending on how hungry you are, and since it's a single serving, you have to eat the whole thing.

Update, August 2012: They've improved both the packaging and the contents since my last review. I don't notice the "grittiness" much at all, nor does it taste over-toasted, as I'd mentioned in my prior review. The packaging has an updated design and all the packets have a proper tearing point. Definitely recommended! Bumping this from 4 to 5 stars.-------These are higher protein, lower sugar, and cheaper than energy bars, and even more portable. They're a great way to stave off hunger, gluten-free. I keep one or two in my bag along with a Larabar or two, but this is the healthier & more economical option. The taste is a little "overcooked" to my taste - a deeply roasted flavor - so it may not appeal to all kids, but I'm sure many kids would like it. It's great to squeeze onto an apple as you eat it, or just eat it out of the packet.It does require some kneading before you open the packet - just squish it back and forth for a minute - because it separates like any natural nut butter would. There is a tiny bit of grittiness to the texture, but not really noticeable if you mix it up first. I'd rather have a little grittiness than a ton of shortening added to make it smooth.The other catch is not all the packets are notched properly, making them near impossible to open without scissors. There is a simple solution - I just take scissors and go through each new box, making a tiny nick on any packet where the cut doesn't go through both layers. It only takes a minute to do the whole box, and then they're all ready to go.

I initially began to buy these a few years ago when I was looking to improve my diet. I think I read about Barney Butter in some healthfood article. I love nut butters and immediately had to give this a try. The pack of 24 comes in a nice box that's easy to store in the pantry. Inside are 24 individual packets of Barney Butter Almond Butter. The packets look exactly as they do in the pictures here on Amazon - about 5x2 inches. Even though the description reads as "no-stir" (not here but on their webiste) I still squish the butter around in the unopened packet for about 30secs to a minute otherwise it comes out pretty runny at first and then dry at the end. When you mush it around for a little while, the butter comes out smooth as can be! I spread this butter on bananas, apples, celery, crackers, or just eat it on its own. My 10 year old LOVES it. He thinks it's cool that it comes in little packets and he can have almond butter anytime anywhere. He takes it as a snack to school as I do to work. I've also taken it on hiking trips. Totally convinient and yummy! LOVE IT!

I don't particularly care for almonds, but wanted to have more in my diet, since they are so healthy. A nutritionist told me that 2 T of almond butter would equal one serving of almonds. I had tried jarred almond butter several years ago and found it rather dry and tasteless. I ordered some Barney Butter online and the minute I tried it, it was love! It is creamy and delicious and well worth the cost. I eat it in my oatmeal, on bananas or banana bread, or on whole wheat toast almost every day. I usually buy jars of it, but the little packets are really nice for travel or to keep at work.
Best almond butter i have tasted.  I also love the packets - portion control!

column9: Hard as a rock Almond Butter
column10: I love almond butter and saw that the barney butter had mixed reviews but decided to try it. I like the single serving size but the almond butter was hard as a rock and not edible. I contacted amazon and they did at least give me a full refund.

I appreciate this product because it's easy to carry, full of good nutrition, and light on calories. These are great on the go. I use them when I'm out hiking, or at work with no time to eat, or just out power shopping. I have diabetes and these have a great protein-to-carb ratio and can be working into any "zone" type diets, or even progressive stages or Atkins. They taste good, they have just enough salt to keep the flavor from being bland.Tip: Almond butter naturally separates, so you need to mix this inside the tube before you open it. I often rip the top off and just squeeze the butter right into my mouth. If you eat it this way and you don't squish it up before you open it, you'll get a mouth full of almond oil. Which isn't the worst thing, but it's not very tasty... and, if not mixed, the rest of the butter will be dry and hard to get out of the tube. It's very easy to work it around with your fingers a few times before you open it. And, if you store them on their side, instead of standing up, it makes the "mixing" much easier.I have this stuff on auto order, which makes it really a bargain and and excellent price per tube. We go through a delivery about once every two-three months. This is a great product that I was glad to have found on amazon.

Just got it in yesterday and tried it out on some pretzels. I am very impressed. After reading reviews, I knew to use my hand to mash it up before opening, to stir the ingredients. Super creamy and easy to use on the go. I brought some packets to work this morning to spread on an apple. Excited for my afternoon snack today :) So convenient too!

I bought a box of these snack packs to take with me when travelling.  My hope was that they would give me a nice protein boost once or twice during the day.  While they might have given me some protein, they also came with a huge side serving of aggravation -- and they don't taste very good to boot.First, the almond butter itself is simply not very good.  If, like me, you're used to almond butter from natural food stores, you're used to one ingredient -- almonds.  With Barney Butter, they load it up with extra oils and salt.  It tastes too sweet and too salty as a result.  This is like the McDonald's of almond butter.  Also, the separation problems cannot be easily overcome in a little packet like this.  With a jar, you just stir.  With a squeeze packet, you can try to keep kneading it and mixing it up before opening it, but the reality is, you're in for a huge blast of oil when you first open it, followed by a clay-like almond paste down below.Second, the packaging is straight-up awful.  It's made of reinforced plastic, so you basically need talons to rip it open.  Why they went with double-thick plastic for something you're supposed to tear is beyond me.  Then, once it's open, the oil separation problems described above make it hard to get the almond butter to keep pushing up.  You have to keep tearing it again or cutting it as you inch your way down the tube.  And if you try to use your teeth to drag the almond butter up to the opening, you're in for some unpleasant cuts in the corners of your mouth due to the wide size of the packet.  It's just an all-around mess.I would never buy a jar of Barney Butter due to the unnecessary extra ingredients and weird taste, and I would certainly never buy these snack packs again due to the ridiculous packaging.  In the future, I'll just go back to carrying a little jar of real almond butter with me when I travel.  At least I can open that.

These packets are all oily and the product inside is all seperated and gross. In addition they add a ton of sugar. How is that healthy eating?  Thought it would be good for my kids, but it's awful, might as well have them eat peanut butter.

column9: Good way to include fat in a low calorie diet
column10: I've been on a weight loss diet since summer of 2011 and I've lost quite a bit of weight. One thing that helps is to include some source of fat. Avocados fit the bill most of the time, but sometimes I want something else. This is a great little snack pack for some extra energy when I need it, and it's fun to eat when I'm watching my favorite shows too.It's easy, just knead the package a bit to mix the oil into it, rip the top off and squeeze out the goodness.I can eat something delicious this way without breaking my calorie budget.

column9: Great portion control, handy healthy snack
column10: I love almond butter and I got excited when I found these packs of almond butter measured in single tablespoon servings.  Turns out I don't like this almond butter as much as any other brand I've tried. I think this has been made by dehydrating almond paste and reconstituting it with palm oil. I'd still like to find real, ground almond butter in a smaller size package.
This is the BEST tasting almond butter in the world! You must try Barney Butter!  I order the product all the time and my kids love it!

I'd hate to bring almond butter in a jar to backpack or long day hikes.  It's weighty and messy.  I was really happy to have found this product as oppose to bringing energy bars, which I hate.I eat it by squeezing on top of a piece of hard tack (hard cookie).  It is a fast and delicious source of energy (90 calories) and protein.Some people would eat junk filled with lots of calories during backpacking and long hikes, thinking that the activities justify the calorie intake.  I kind of disagree.  I'd rather eat cleaner fuel than say SPAM or Vienna sausages.  Good fuel in the body produces good output.  This little packet is it.

I'm on a restrictive diet and was shopping amazon for deals on almonds. I began to wonder what almond butter tasted like, and rather than whip the old Vita-mix out of the cupboard, I bought these individual packets, which are great to slip in a purse or hide at work in a file marked "Old Accounting Forms." I couldn't be more pleased with the taste - richer and deeper than I expected.  It's remarkable enough to think about telling my friends about while being reluctant to share any packets. I can't wait to try this brand in a spicy thai sauce.  This is a also great way to try this product without dropping the $30 on 3 jars without knowing if you like it.

I have been eating similar almond butter products (i.e. Justin's Butter) and they contain twice as many calories and are twice the price! The flavor and texture with the Barney Butter is so much better than with Justin's. They are smaller packages, but very lightweight and portable. I will definitely order again!

I really enjoyed having these portable. portion controlled almond butters. My only negative comment is that they are a bit sweet for me. I didn't know that they contained sugar, so I bought them. I know now that I prefer almond butter without sugar.

I was looking for the "other" almond butter pouches, but the price of these caught my eye. I read most of the reviews and was apprehensive about ordering this product; however, it arrived fresh. I did not get a gritty batch, my Barney Butter Almond Butter pouches were perfectly smooth and creamy. However, they taste too much like peanut butter! There are no peanuts in the product, obviously, but the almond flavor is seriously lacking. I'll still finish the whole box, they are decent, but I'll go back to Justin's which has a beautifully pronounced almond flavor.

In the need for a low carb snack?  This is it!  No skimping on the taste...it is amazing!  Smooth and creamy and oh so good!  Perfect with apple chips or celery!  No regrets...will order more!  Much more!!!

I LOVE Barney Butter! It is so smooth and the almond flavor is just exceptional. I have tried other almond butters and Barney Butter is by far my favorite. In addition to being delicious, it gives me energy and is also quite filling. As an added bonus the snack packaging is fantastic for a few reasons. I like it for myself because it is easy to transport and is only 90 calories so that helps me to monitor how many calories I am taking in.  I also love it because my kids have allergies to tree nuts and they love Barney Butter so much that they ask for it by name. Due to their allergies we have to be very careful about what they eat and therefore are always bringing food with us to restaurants, birthday parties etc. The snack packs are a Godsend because they are so easy to just grab and go. I highly recommend Barney Butter overall and especially like the snack packs.

I'm an almond butter junkie trying to lose weight on WW, not easy, b/c this stuff is highly caloric. These packets definitely help in portion control at 90 calories.  I like the taste and texture. One reviewer or more mentioned that the expiration date is not printed. On my box is printed: Best By Nov 17, 2011.  I bought these months ago, so that is definitely a good thing. I knead the packet and it is not a problem to get out; and sometimes i just eat it plain, w/o crackers, as a taste of something yummy. Like that it is peanut-free, as I have a toddler granddaughter around and she is highly allergic to dairy, eggs, and peanuts. Packets also have a convenient, easy-to-open tear notch at the bottom making these easy to eat on the go and for travel.

When I want to lose a few pounds, I simply count calories eaten and moniter calories burned. It is simple, and foolproof if you follow the formula. BUT, I have food weakness and cravings like all of us and I ADORE nut butters!! While almonds are very healthy, the caloie count is up there! Then come these amazing 90 calorie treats, so creamy and flavorful that my mouth is salivating as I type! It is so easy to add the 90 calories to my daily count and still stay on my diet while feeling like I am splurging on someting that tastes so wonderful that it has to be sinful!! God bless the people at Barney Butter! May you all prosper with good health and cheer!

column9: Best lunch idea for my kids!
column10: These snack packs have been a lunch life saver! I can throw them in my kids lunch box with a container of fruit, veggies, yogurt and crackers. Now they use their packets to "create and build" their lunch. One of my kids makes her version of a smoothie..yogurt, barney butter and raisins. Sometimes the kids eat the almond butter right out of the pack-- like a drinkable yogurt. They love the taste, its super easy for me--so glad we found these for our lunches.

column9: Better than peanut butter!! Love Barney Butter!!!
column10: Barney Butter is fantastic.  It tastes so much better than peanut butter and is better for you.  I absolutely love it!!
Great product.  Very tasty.  I love the 90 calorie packs.  Just enough in 1 pack for a snack.

column9: Barney Butter is the best almond butter!
column10: I tried Barney Butter at a friend's recommendation and I have to say that it's just delicious - smooth and creamy -not like other almond butters I've tried.  The taste is really rich.  And the packs are perfect for traveling-  whether hiking outdoors or for kid's lunch boxes.  VERY DELISH!!!!

column9: perfect for fueling up during a long Hike
column10: I have been eating Barney Butter since 2007 and just found the snack packs a few months ago.I love them. these are the perfect size for stuffing in your pack during a long hike when you need quick energy - only 90 calories. I gave a barney butter snack pack to my girlfriend during a hike, boy was that a costly mistake, she now grabs two every day (one before her Yoga class and one for after her class). Love my Barney Butter!

My box of 24 Almond butter packets just arrived and they are great. Like all almond and peanut butter packets you have to squish the packet around with your hands to mix in the oil but after a few minutes its smooth creamy almond butter. The box (not the individual packets) has the expiration date printed on the side.

column9: Easy almond butter on the go
column10: This almond butter is so delicious and the texture of it is different than any other almond butter I've tried. The little packets make for perfect portion control or an easy way to take the almond butter with you on the go!

I LOVE this product! The 90 calorie packets are so convienient and they help with portion control. If I had the whole jar, I would probably eat the whole jar in a few days! Very smooth creamy texture.

The Smooth Barney Butter is a delicious almond butter. I have only tried the creamy so I don't know how to compare it.  I actually prefer a grittier almond butter and this almond butter is as smooth as a Jif or Skippy peanut butter.The individual packages are great for traveling or portion control but I probably wouldn't purchase this again anytime soon as it costs too much for my frequency of use.

When I originally received my package of Barney Butter packs, I was excited to rip one open and try it out. Unfortunately, what I received was a mouthful of oil and a hard as a rock sludge of dry almond butter. Not good. In order to make this work, you have to knead it around in your fingers for about a minute or two before you open it. Once you do, it's pretty good - but it's hardly "easy."

column9: Very Disappointing. Do NOT order this
column10: I read a similar review saying that the person had received an unmarked box with the 24 packets and that there was no expiration date and it was gritty/of a weird texture, but I figured it would just be the luck fo the draw. This came to me and the packets are completed separated into oil/nuts and you can't even mix them. I cant even get it out of the package. They're basically inedible, and not creamy and soft like the samples I received directly from Barney Butter which is what I was hoping for. I basically have to just throw these out.

column9: Good price, hard to squeeze and not as tasty as others
column10: While I like that these are inexpensive and come in nice little single serving size pouches there are a couple problems with this product:1) The pouches are very difficult to squeeze, the almond butter seems hardened as other reviewers have also mentioned2) The pouches do not really contain a full serving unless 1 tablespoon is a serving.  Usually 2 tablespoons is condiered a serving of nut butter.  1 tbsp is really not enough to spread for a sandwich.3) The consistency of this almond butter is kind of sticky/ gooey compared with other more creamy ones I have tried (ie Trader Joe's).

column9: Tasty but impossible to get out of the packet
column10: I've always loved Barney Butter in a jar so was keen to try the convenient packets. Unfortunately they've not been a good buy. The product separates, and no matter how long I knead I can't get it to blend. When I tear open the packet I get a brief drizzly of very oily almond butter then there's a big lump left over that's near impossible to dislodge without cutting open the packet with scissors! Not even close to the consistency of the jar. Really disappointing.

I enjoyed this product, however, the ingredients separated and the really thick portion was difficult to knead into the rest of the mix. The taste is great, the packaging convenient and I would purchase this again.

Delicious almond butter in measured dose. Wonderful snack product. You do need to knead it or run warm water to soften up but goes great with a bagel or crackers. Will buy more. Can travel with too easily.

I keep these in my purse and in my desk drawer at work. They're just the right size for a quick snack. Not only that, they're delicious! I usually suck the nutbutter right out of the packet, but sometimes eat with carrots.  I'm hypoglycemic, so it's nice to keep a few packs in my purse in case I need an emergency snack.

column9: I am ending up throwing this out..can't get the almond butter out of the packets.
column10: I purchased Barney Butter Almond Butter 90 Calorie Snack packs( 24 .6 oz packets) on Amazon.com.  I am an Almond Butter Fanatic and thought this would be a great way to keep myself from eating too much at one time, and also have with me for snacking when I am away from home.  I have tried to eat this snack packs three times, and never have been able to get more than a small amount out of each packet.  I first knead the packets to warm and loosen the almond butter, but when I tear the packet and try to spread out the almond butter, moslty oil and just a small amount of almond butter comes out..I paid over $ 11.00 for these packets, and am going to end up throwing the entire box out because it is just impossible to get any almond butter out of the packet.  I am very dissappointed with this product.

I receiving the product the taste was interesting and much different from and Peter Pan jar I usually would have. In a good way, though getting the butter outside of it's package prove to be very difficult. I made the purchase so that I may travel with individual packs whenever I was heading to the gym and needed that pre-workout snack. Unfortunately because at times I couldn't get the butter entirely out of the package without ripping the whole thing open I felt like I wasn't getting my money's worth in return. So all in all, good taste with a Henz ketchup like difficulty of getting out.

column9: My new favorite almond butter brand!
column10: I love buying almond/peanut butter packets because they're so convenient, but they're usually expensive (1.25 a pack) at my local whole foods. This price is fantastic and I love the smooth texture of this almond butter. I eat this on the go with a banana or as a lunch snack tucked into a baggie of cut celery.
I was mad at first because I had really hoped there would be more protein in this little packet. But then I tasted it...um, yum. Super duper yum.
When it comes to nut butter, I have to be careful of portion control.  Barney's Almond Butter 90-Calorie Packs takes all the guess work out of it for me.  They are delicious!

column9: Quick easy food on the run
column10: These are the best for when you need something to eat and you're out.  They also make great emergency desk food.  I use them for when I'm on my way to the gym after work and I need some fuel.  They taste good, they're super portable, and they are healthy.

I love These!  on a 50 calorie rice cake......delicious!  I've been on a 1500 calorie regiment for almost 7 weeks and these 90 calorie packs are just perfect for a snack.  The package states "knead, tear, spread the love", I knead for at least 30 seconds to make sure it is all mixed up(I think of it as exercise for the fingers), there is a starter for the "tear" which makes it super easy to open and if you like almonds and peanut butter you will like almond butter, if you don't, then don't buy these. I absolutely will be buying these again.

I love the almond butter- but the little packets are a bit funky.  You have to knead them, then open and squeeze- no big deal, but unless they are for traveling (or keeping something for diabetics after a low is restored to normal), the cost isn't worth it.  The jars of Barney Butter are a much better value.  Flavor is great.
I was disappointed to receive this and see it had added ingredients.  I will switch back to fresh ground.  The packaging does make it easy to travel with.
Fast shipment. Received as expected.Great size--90 calorie packs. Hard to find nut butters in smaller portion sizes.Very satisfied

These are awesome!  Delicious and the perfect size.  I get the almond butter fix without over eating.  I put in in my bag with a banana and have a filling snack whenever I need.  I also use one pack on a whole weat english muffin with a side of fruit for a filling and healthy breakfast.  They also don't waste with the packaging.  This is my favorite food product of 2012!

I love this stuff!  It's great for a little pick-me-up in the afternoon, after a run, out on a hike, etc.  I've tried nearly every "butter" on the market and this is indeed one of my favorites!  I also use it in place of tahini when I make hummus.My only complaint is this: I wish the packets were a little bigger - 1 oz or so.  But I suppose I could always just eat two...

column9: Good on-the-go snack... a little hard to tear open.
column10: Portable, healthy, and reasonably sized so you won't go overboard and consume too much of a good thing.If they could do something to make it tear open a little easier they would be perfect!

Love these convenient to go packs! Just enough for a quick, healthy snack! I eat it right out of the pack, on an apple, or it's even enough to spread on an english muffin. It's tasty too, this almond butter is better than trader Joes! Will definitely make this my new go to snack!
I really wanted to like these, but they are much sweeter than I would prefer. I think they would be much better without the added sugar(Evaporated Cane Juice).

Loved this product.  The fact that each one holds 1 tablespoon and is easy to dispense makes it a great item to pop in my purse or workbag and take on the go.  It tastes great too.  Definately recommend this product.

I usually buy Justins nut butter packets but wanted to try something else. This almond butter is waaay smooth,unlike Justins almond butter. I would of liked more flavor options, like honey roasted. It's a great on the go snack!

Never had almond butter before but saw a dr. oz show touting the benefits of eating 2 tbsp before bed to give you more energy in the morning. Found this and ordered it straight away. Came quickly, individual packets are easy to open. I'm kneading it based on the other reviews, and it's been simply delicious. A great protein rich snack and just 90 calories. I bought a single packet of one of the other almond butter products at the grocery store today. It was 180 calories, so probably better if you want to make a sandwich, but I'm LOVING the barney butter. Will definitely be ordering more and keeping some of these in the car for a quick snack for the kids. Big thumbs up!

column9: Best almond butter I've ever tasted!!
column10: First, I want to tell you that I'm allergic to peanuts and had never found anything that came close to the taste...until now. I ordered this product due to the good price and ease of taking these packets to work. I was extremely surprised when I tasted it and checked the package to make sure it wasn't real peanut butter. I'm not sure how they've done it, but this product is excellent. Barney butter is now a staple in my house.
These are really good to have on hand for fruit snacks, etc.  They are not as sugary as some other almond butter snack packs which is better.
LOVE these little portion controlled packets!  I could EASILY sit down & eat a jar of this stuff all at once.  EVER-SO-YUMMY!  Buy this stuff 'cause you'll LOVE it!

I keep a few of these in my purse in case of low blood sugar or the afternoon munchies. The little bit of protein makes me feel better quickly. I'm not a huge fan of almond butter, but I know it's better for me and it tastes pretty good. Just be sure to have something to drink with you :)

These little packets are great for bringing to work or other events. I spread it on bread, rice cakes, crackers, and more. The only reason I gave 4 stars is because sometimes the consistency is still separated- you need to knead the package for awhile so everything gets mixed.

Almond Butter can be pretty pricy in stores like Sprouts or Whole Foods, these little snack packs are just the perfect amount to eat out of the package or spread onto something.It's been great having these in my lunch every day.

column9: Delicious, but how do you get it out easily?
column10: I really do like the taste and idea of this product, but getting out out of the pack was another story.  I think the cups work better.  I wish this wonderful company would package the almond butter in a package that allows us to get it out more easily.

column9: Texture is fine, don't like the taste.
column10: There is nothing wrong with the texture of the almond butter I received today.  I don't care for the taste, but that's personal preference, not a problem with the product.  There is no expiration date on these little packets nor on the box.  Ingredients are listed on the packets, and it's made in an peanut-free facility with a USA address.  The little packets are easy to open and convenient to carry to work or send with a child in a lunch.

The packets are cute and convenient, but the almonds inside leave something to be desired.  First, the oil and almond paste separate and are not easily "mushed" back together.  Secondly, the overwhelming sensation is of way too much oil to enjoy .  Flavor is otherwise ok, but nothing to write home about.  I'll stick to raw almonds.

I ride a motorcycle to and from work,  so space is at a premium.  I needed lunch that was economical, easily portable, and nutritious.  These little packets of almond butter fit the bill perfectly.  I signed up for a subscription, but had to cancel because monthly shipments were not available.

column9: Too small a portion size, needs a lot of kneading
column10: This product has a very smooth texture (if you knead the package enough before opening it) and it tastes just fine.  I have to roll the package between my hands until the product feels warm before it can be squeezed out and spread nicely.  The portion size is too small for an adult serving; however, this is a nice size for children.  One packet will adequately cover but not fill up 2 small celery sticks that are about 3" in length if that helps to quantify the portion size. If you don't have anything to compare this product to, you will be happy with it, but I purchased the individual packets of Justin's almond butter before purchasing these, and I liked the Justin's product better because the servings are bigger and their product requires much less kneading.

The concept of a portable food like this is great.  I think the servings should be closer to one ounce each and I wish they didn't have any added sugar.  Nonetheless a great alternative to some other sugary snack.
Taste fine if you like Almond butter. Obviously I don't like Almond butter. Stick with regular Peanut Butter and your kids will thank you.

column9: I'm sure it's great almond butter but mine tasted rancid
column10: I have heard raves about Barney Butter. But the product I received tasted rancid. I know I should have returned it, but I'm not very good about returning things especially things I've ordered online. I have tried to kind of look for a product expiration date on the box but didn't see one.I was really looking forward to these packets because they are so portable, I had planned on using them by taking them to work for lunches. And also, you already know each measured portion has 90 calories! Oh well, for now I will continue to cart my almond butter in little rubbermaid containers.

I was VERY excited to order this Barney Butter after reading about it in a magazine, and I loved the idea of the individual packets.  However, I was extremely disappointed to find that the almond butter was rock hard and dry within the packets, with a little bit of oil at the bottom and no possible way to mix the two together.  When I sampled it, it was like chewing on rubber.  I ended up throwing the entire box into the garbage.

Unfortunately, I did not read every word of the description prior to ordering this product.  My mistake.  All I saw was "all natural almond butter" and "no trans fats or hydroginated oils".  Upon receiving the product and reading the ingredient list on the packets, I found that the almond butter contains Evaporated Cane Juice, Palm Fruit Oil, and Sea Salt.  That doesn't mean "all natural" to me.  I expected to see only almonds and possibly salt on the ingredient list.  I will not purchase this product again.

I received this package in the high heat temp and the company did not take any steps to protect the quality of the product! I attempted to taste the product even when I was concerned due to how hot the product was upon arrival. The almod butter was bad!  The temp has been around 105 in the St. Louis area and the company did not request any special shipping to protect the quality of the product! The temp with the box in the heat had to be even higher baking in the mailbox! I found out after the product arrived in bad shape that a return was not even an option! BAD BUSINESS!  I would never due business this way!
The contents settle to the bottom of the pack and you really can't get it out,it's not conveient.I am not going to order it again.Jason's almond butter packets are much better.

column9: Not Natural or healthy for you.

column9: I think I might know what the change is in these bars.

I believe they added more of this new date and removed tiny amounts of other more expensive ingredients (protein powder).  That would increase the sugar  and calorie content as shown, lower protein levels, and raise the fat content slightly.  So, if these bars taste more sweet, have more fat and have more sugar, it's due to the extra content of dates (and maybe almond butter) and decrease in soy protein powder.That's my theory.Either way the bars taste pretty good right now - and there are no better alternatives on the market.

These bars are So amazing!!! They taste great and very very healthy and are so easy to throw in your bag when you have little time to no time to eat!!! I have tried so many bars and these are by far the best!!!

column9: Maybe the best bar out there, but not perfect for athletes!

But here's the real problem: First the bar uses non-GMO soy isolate (!!!!) as a protein source which many experts believe will alter your hormones profile by lowering testosterone and raising estrogen . . . exactly what a fitness enthusiast or person seeking longevity would not want. It also contains licorice which is on the possible list of supplements that can lower T. Even though the bar has an alkaline ph you might experience heartburn due to the soy isolate. Is it possible the licorice was added to combat the GERD/heartburn as well as enhance the taste? Perhaps, but at what cost?On the positive side I'm not sure I could name a better bar or better tasting bar overall, and again I've tried them all. Most taste terrible or are loaded up with fake sugars like Stevia (billed as being healthy) which a lot of people just can't digest very well.
Great snack. Sweet but healthy. My 4 year old niece even loves it and I feel good about giving it to her since it has so many healthy greens.
These "Greens Plus Chocolate" Energy Bars taste good and are healthy. I like the fact that there is no white sugar used for sweetener.

The Greens Plus natural bars are the best I have ever eaten.  They are very nutritious and satisfying.  I eat one every morning for breakfast.  As a result I don't get hungry again till late afternoon even after a ten mile bike ride or a walking game of golf.

Chewy and sweet, covered in chocolate, it's easy to grab one of these when you're on the go as a quick snack or a light meal.  They are also filling.  I will often eat one for breakfast when I'm running out the door.

Great Chocolate Flavor!  Filled with great healthy ingredients (like green food) but you can hardly tell they are health food the flavor is more like a snack bar should taste.  I would recommend this to anyone looking for good nutrition and great taste.

Agave Nectar is a very destructive substance.  It has no place in anyone's diet, or in anyone's bodies.Until they take Agave Nectar out of these bars, I'm never eating another one.

column9: No Need to Duck This Treat
column10: In the four ounce package are fourteen wraps, chunks of dried sweet potato wrapped in what looks like duck jerky. Inside the package is a small package of moisture absorber, a desiccant, not the kind of addition one normally finds in a food product, pet food or otherwise. The wraps aren't visually appealing to a human, but dogs will only be concerned with the scent and the taste. On the top of the pouch is a tear off strip to open it. A resealable plastic zipper seals the pouch tightly to keep the wraps fresh.Our three girls wear their emotions on their paws and their faces. Thus when each was presented with a duck sweet potato wrap their interest and their excitement were unmistakable. There were no sniffy-sniffy hesitations, no circle walkings, no signs of disinterest and definitely no looks of can't youdobetterthan this. Evie immediately grabbed her wrap between her jaws and began chewing, oblivious to the world. Piper and Bella, the two shih tzus, grabbed their wraps eagerly and slunk off to their respective corners for some private feasting. Piper in particular had a primal transformation, guarding her prize with laid-back ears and a low, stay away growl, hovering over her wrap like a miniature wolf guarding its kill. All three dogs were in a state of ravenous "wrapture" with their treats.I like that these wraps are too chewy for the dogs to finish off quickly, though Evie the vac nonterrier finished hers in half the time as her two little sisters. The duck jerky was eaten first, followed by the sweet potato piece with no lessening of interest or enjoyment. Of all the many treats and chews offered to this canine triumvirate, few have elicited such intense enthusiasm and prehistoric passion.We noticed no ill side effects in any of the pooches from these treats. There were no upset tummies, and no bouts of diarrhea. The verdict of this jury was unanimous and definitively pawsitive.

I ordered the sweet potato duck wraps for my 2 small poodles and for my sons Bassett and Pointer, all four dogs loved them, and they are good for them to boot, we didn't tell them that.LOLNone of them have any idea they are dogs.

column9: How to stop drinking from the pop machine at work...
column10: I love tea, but I drink so much of it that it's not practical to bring a gallon of tea to work with me every night.I also like it with a LOT of ice, and if iced tea doesn't have any ice in it, I just won't drink it. What's the point?I bring a 32oz wide mouth bottle to work with me.I fill it full of ice at home, and top it off with water, throw a cold brew bag on top and seal it up.When I drink it, I just fill it with water from the drinking fountain, and put a fresh cold brew tea bag on top.If I fill it with water from the fridge at home, (And keep it in the fridge at work.) there is ice left in it after I finish it a 3rd time.If I'm still thirsty after drinking 3 quarts of ice cold iced tea, I generally buy a bottle of fruit juice out of the machine, and drink half of it, then refill the little bottle up with water and add emergen-c to replace the lost electrolytes.Yes, I work at a very physical job, and lose a lot of water due to sweat every night.Without cold brew bags, I just can't have iced tea at work unless I bring a huge wide mouth gallon drink cooler to work.Fresh tea, made just before you drink it, is best.How is this not perfect for me?

column9: Saves me thousands of dollars every year
column10: In the 90's I got hooked on the Lipton glass bottled iced tea, their unsweetened, no lemon.  But it was expensive, and my stores didn't stock it very well.  I'd go in there and buy twenty 6 packs at a time when I could.  And at anywhere from $5.50 to $7 per six pack, that added up since I'd drink more than one six pack in a day.I tried other home brewed teas, but none were close in flavor to those lipton glass bottles i loved so much.Then a client of mine made a comment last winter about these cold brew bags, and I decided to try it.I was in LOVE.  They taste almost identical to the glass bottles, but at a fraction of the price.I use a two liter pitcher, put three bags in it, and it's perfect.  The cost savings alone are even better than when I quit smoking. :)A month or so ago I took it to the next level, and got a nice big two liter filtration unit, and so filter my tap water through there, and then into my pitcher with the iced tea.  And once I started filtering the city water, it was absolutely perfect.Price is slightly cheaper at the brick and mortars by me, but I like the convenience of getting 12 boxes at a time without having to get them myself at the store.

I love tea, and I prefer brewing my tea with loose leaf tea leaves if I have the time, but I must confess for ease and convenience this tea can't be beat....three minutes max. No cooling period necessary, and no melted ice cubes to immediately dilute your tea when you need to serve it right away. column9: Good tea that's easy to make
column10: Everyone who witnessed this purchase's arrival insists that 12 boxes is more than anyone would use, but I've already gone through an entire box, in the month since I purchased them, so it's "only" about a year's supply for me. I expect to go through it faster once it warms up, but I'll probably also go through it more slowly if winter weather rolls around again before I've used it all up. (So far I've been "hogging" it all to myself.)The sheer volume of the 12-pack aside, this tea is bitter enough to wake me up, but sweetens nicely with honey or Sugar in the Raw (for later in the day, when I want it tamed down a little). It's also really easy to make. I just fill my 1-gallon pitcher about half- to two-thirds full with cold water from the tap (the water where I live actually tastes good, I just need a little boost of caffeine), put two to three teabags in it (with the strings anchored on the pour-spout of the lid, so I can pull them out later), and stick it in the fridge overnight. I find that I generally make a pitcher each night on weekdays, which would be much more time-consuming if I had to boil the tea, find something heat-safe to put it in overnight, etc.If you drink a lot of tea (I bring a liter of it with me to school & work each day), then this is a great deal. Otherwise, you may want to consider going in on a 12-pack with a friend, or buying the "by the glass" cold-brew teabags so you can brew it on the go (much harder to do by the quart).

I bought this dog food because the bag showed pictured of veggies and chunks of meat, and with a name like "Beneful" I thought I was purchasing a nutritious brand of dog food. My dogs did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my dogs. The first three ingredients are Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, and corn gluten meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, dogs cannot digest corn, it is just a filler and causes them to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging of such a disgusting product; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for,  I usually buy my pets all natural, organic foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness.
