column9: The Original Chocolate Covered Coffee Bean
column10: These are absolutely exquisite.  Kopper's invented the chocolate covered espresso bean, and this is that original product.  Absolutely delicious.  But beware!  These are highly addictive!  On a positive note, there are enough in this 5 lb. bag to share with friends and neighbors!Another note: although you will not find it anywhere in the item description, these are covered in DARK chocolate.ENJOY!

The chocolate layer on these expresso beans is much thicker, softer, and have a slight cigarette-smoke taste compared to the Kona version Koppers Chocolate Covered Kona Coffee Beans, 5-Pound Bag that I really liked.  My initial impression is that I'll probably have to give these ones away because I can't stand the cigarette smoke taste (I'd prefer my chocolate to taste like chocolate, and my coffee to taste like coffee).  Once again Amazon just threw the 5-pound plastic bag into a cardboard box and it got ripped open a bit during shipment (but this time it didn't melt since it was shipped in the winter).

column9: The best choc covered espresso beans
column10: The Koppers Chocolate Covered Espresso Beans are wonderful - best I have had - Great price for a full 5 lbs.  They are dark chocolate, which is a good thing.  I will be purchasing more - makes great gifts for coffee lover's - I can not keep out of them!!

column9: Agree with previous reviewer.  These have a burned flavor.
column10: To begin, I love chocolate covered espresso beans.  Previously I've purchased them from a company in Hawaii and from Trader Joe's but I figured I could get these in bulk and delivered through Amazon, so why not.  Unfortunately, the burned, almost cigarette-like flavor mentioned by a previous review is real.  While this brand isn't horrible, it's definitely not my favorite and I will not purchase them again.

All I can say is these are great!  I'm a chocolate lover and can't drink coffee straight and these are terrific.  You will need to pick small bits of the bean out of your teeth, but that could be a bonus.  Pop a couple of them and you'll feel the caffeine shortly.  Five pounds may seem like a lot, but at around 45 cents/ounce, this is a great price.

The product itself is a decent quality chocolate covered coffee bean.  I don't mean "decent" to be derogatory more so than I mean it to convey a sense of "what do you expect at such a good price?"I did not buy these for a community jar, or what have you, I bought these for my own personal consumption and they fit the bill perfectly.  They are a great snack in the morning on the way to school, or when I'm up bright and early to go fishing, or when I'm merely sitting on the computer reading the morning news (gotta love technology).I do have to disagree with the "cigarette smoke" aftertaste; I did not get that at all.Again, if you have specific tastes for your coffee beans, you probably ought to skip these.  However, if you want bulk and consider 'a coffee bean a coffee bean' then you will not be disappointed.Oh, one last thing, if you ship any sort of chocolate in the summer months, it has the distinct possibility of melting, no matter the lengths the distributor goes to prevent it.  These distributors gave fair warning about this and gave me the opportunity to cancel.  I took a chance and, although my item did in fact melt, it was not that bad and I consider this a good buy.

I love dark chocolate and coffee so when I saw these I had to try them.  Then after I finished with a 1 lb bag I ordered 5 lbs!  However I have found a little self discipline and ration myself to 15-20 per day.  Awesome-m-m-m.

column9: Fantastic...... but now they are much more expensive.
column10: Myself and everyone who I've given a bag love these - not too sweet with a great dark chocolate & coffee taste.  The price has gone up significantly recently... but will probably still buy another bag sooner or later.
My beans arrived quickly and in great condition; no melting or bruising of any kind.  The chocolate is semi-sweet.  I would have preferred a darker chocolate, but they are still scrumptious!

For those "hooked" on dark chocolate coated coffee beans there is no better, or less expensive, way to buy.  It gives you enough to share with friends and family and still be a confirmed Dark Chocolate Glutton.

column9: Good taste and texture, not much of an energy boost
column10: I've tried chocolate-covered espresso beans from several different companies over the years.  Usually, two "beans" is all it takes for a mild energy boost that doesn't jangle the nerves.  My favorite supplier sold their business and stopped selling them, and so I decided to try Koppers.  Although it has a pleasant taste, good texture, and is a high quality product, Koppers doesn't have any effect otherwise.  If you're looking for something to replace a cup of coffee to keep you alert or increase your energy level temporarily, this isn't it, unless perhaps you're willing to eat five to seven of them at a time.

I purchased this product as an alternative to a rawhide. Our 5 month old German Shorthair Pointer puppy ate it in a matter of 6 minutes or less. She loved it, but it was more of an expensive treat.With a puppy, I needed something to satisfy her chewing urge. The treat fractured into small bits all over the floor but our dog was willing to pick those up. The pieces looked rather sharp and that was a concern. Others mentioned it was made in China and I would like to add the first ingredient is corn.  It might last longer for very small dogs.

Good product, but more of a treat for my dogs.  It took them just a matter of minutes to have the SmartBone gone.  Maybe good for dogs that are not big chewers.  I was hoping for something more digestible but as sturdy as rawhides

column9: Safer than rawhide, don't last as long but also cleans teeth
column10: I picked these up from my local pet shop for a bit cheaper than what they are on offer for from Amazon, so you might wish to shop around.Over all I am quite satisfied with these "bones." They are much safer than raw hide chews given they are made from dried chicken, which means unlike raw hide you know these are actually digestible. This is the biggest reason I bought them. My vet recommended not giving my Sheltie raw hide as they aren't properly digestible. Whether this is true or not, I've heeded her advice.Baird, my Sheltie, really seems to enjoy them. When he sees one coming out of the bag, his tail is wagging like crazy. He enjoys these as much as our old family Sheltie McGyver enjoyed raw hide. The only difference I see between these and raw hide is that raw hide lasted roughly 30 minutes longer in chew time than these. I'd say Baird can chew through one of these in about 30 or so minutes, while our old Sheltie could chew on a single raw hide for an hour, at which point we would throw away the little nub. There is nothing left of these bones after 30 minutes.As far as the dental application goes, it does smell of mint, so I assume it should, if nothing else, help with doggy breath, though to be fair Baird has never really had "doggy breath." I also use some dog mouth foam so I don't know what really keeps his breath "fresh" between the two.If you aren't too sure about raw hide for your dog and want something you know can be digested, these are definitely worth it.For those that try to keep track of where the things they give their dog come from, these are made in China. I've tried finding something similar not made in China, but it seems such a thing doesn't exist or I just can't find them.

Great product but made in China. Once I realized this after purchase, I got a little worried. Kind of over priced in the regular retail market. My dogs like it & have been ok but I wish I knew ahead of time where it was made.
SmartBones Dental Dog Chews are the perfect treat for my two pomeranians and one Pembroke Corgi. No rawhide, nothing to upset their sensitive stomachs. They "dance" when I give them their daily chew.

The girls lost their taste for rawhide, but were still looking for something to chew. They love these Smart Bones, and they are better for them as well. I will be reordering them when there gone!SmartBones Chicken Dog Chew, Mini, 24-Pack
Read your labels, people!!! SMART bones are made in China!!!!!! A neighbor told me how great these were. After buying them, I read the fine print in the back. "Made in China!!"
there wonderful, my dog loves them, and I feel good giving them to him, I will always get these for him.
My dogs just love these and the chews are safe for them. Their breath benefits from the mint and their dental exams show much less plaque . I must keep bags on hand; they expect them.
I have given this bone to several different breeds and sizes of dogs and it is a major hit! And I don't worry about them choking on it as you do with rawhides. LOVE this product and will buy more!

column9: picture of the package of the dog chew is not what I recieved
column10: If you open the link to the Smartbones you will see that it shows a picture of a package containing a 3-pack of dog chews.  I did not get this bag, I recieved a single dog chew.  I was under the impression by looking at the description on the bag I was getting a single pkg of 3, Not just 1 dog chew.  This made these quite expensive and I ordered two :-(

column9: Only 9 cents per cookie (Family Pack), they won't even last long enough to get stale!
column10: I was extremely happy with the freshness and packaging of these cookies the last time I ordered. Another reviewer stated that they were extremely disapointed with the cookies, arriving broken. To that I ask, why didn't they contact the company for a replacement?  Granted, it's disappointing to have paid for your item and then find it arrived damaged, but stuff happens in transit and I'm sure the company would have been happy to make up for that and make good on their quality product.In the past Biscoff was more expensive through their site, biscoff.com. Now they're offering this Family Pack (256 cookies) also on their site for $23.95.  If you're just looking to get the biscuit cookied, this is the best deal, whether you buy on Amazon or Biscoff.com.  That's just 9 cents per cookie. If you do the math the other cookie items range from 11 to 30 cents per cookie, ouch! So buy the "Family Pack" if you're looking to get the basic Biscoff cookies for as cheaply as you can. They won't last long enough to get stale anyway!

I have also fallen in love with these cookies but have recenlty been remanced again by them.  While in the Crown room for Delta I was pleasantly surprised to see these cookies in a larger size and in a 2 pack.  Same wonderful flavor and crunch but in a larger cookie.  Love the idea, not as many wrappers to unwrap.Haven't received my order yet thru amazon so can't comment on condition of cookie after shipped.

I can buy a single pack (32 cookies) for $1 at my local Kroger. $1.Now, if you don't live near a retailer and you know how AMAZING these cookies are, then by all means, purchase them for this insane rate. It's surely a treat for those unable to buy it anywhere local who have a craving for them. But do yourself a favor and check the grocery first.$1.

I love these cookies, the first time I had then was on a plane.  They are addictive do I was glad to find them on line.  But I had to buy a lot of packages at once and many of the packages contain mostly broken cookies.

I heard that people are familiar with these cookies from what the airlines offer as snakcs.  I never had them until my mom came back with one from a trip.  It was so good.  I ordered more right away on Amazon.  They came quickly and they taste delicious!
What a yummy little cookie.  I remember these on my flight. I even saved the wrapper to ensure I buy the right kind.  These are it.  Delicious with coffee or milk!

column9: Just as good as on the flight!
column10: They are just as good as on my recent plane trip.  My only issue is limiting myself to say 4 cookies at a time. ;)
it was so yummy that it steered me off my diet for two weeks while i finished off 4 paacks =(

column9: light, crisp, elegant, slightly ginger, not too sweet belgium cookies
column10: I saw the reviews for it while I was looking for some international snacks on Amazon and everyone really liked it so I ordered it and it was well worth the wait.  They're elegantly made, being flattened but slightly curvy, light in weight and texture but definitely crispy when you bite into them. They're like thin biscotti in that they're crispy and light and they're better to eat when you dunk them in your coffee or tea and they're not too sweet and they have slightly  gingery/cinnamon (but not overpowering) taste.  They're like elegant gourmet lightly made ginger cookies - I can see why everyone loves them!  I buy them regularly for my mom.  Fortunately, I've found that our local Walgreen's has them all the time - they're that popular!!  Giving them to a friend would be like giving your friend a very special treat.  I would definitely buy them again!!

Like man others I too fell in love with these while traveling. They are perfectly packaged with just 2 per - as long as you have the will power to not open more than one..  I have never had a stale one and the tastes is always the same.

Wonderful cookies!!  Was planning to ghive some way for gifts.  Decided not to.  They will not last long anyway.  It is hard not to eat a pack in a say or 2.  These are alittle smaller than the ones you get on Delta Airlines.

I was first introduced to Speculoos during a business trip to France. The Biscoff family pack provided me with every thing I dreamed about Speculoos and more. My wife and I use them almost every morning with espresso or latte. I prefer them with espresso. It has great taste, very fresh and crispy and it is a great deal. Shipping and delivery was extremely fast and efficient. Yes, I will order it again.

column9: The Best Cookies Ever - See Shipping Note!
column10: Continental Airlines has served these cookies for many years.  I, too, got my first taste on a business flight and was immediately hooked.  I just wanted to mention that the shipping is a flat $5 if you order directly from biscoff.com , rather than the $9.45 price listed on the item here.  I believe the flat rate is rather new, but it will be especially welcome during the holiday season as the cookies make great stocking stuffers!

Product was delivered with none broken. Quality item with a consistent taste. Only thing is these are cheaper to by directly from Lotus Bakery than Amazon and this particular size is not the jumbo size given out on the airline. Next time will by them directly from Lotus Bakery - they have greater variety and are a little cheaper.

I've been a big fan of Biscoff cookies since a long time. They are from Belgium and they are delicious crispy caramelized cookies with a hint of cinnamon. They go great with coffee. The good thing is that they are not too sweet, you never get fed up with them! I always buy 5-6 packages of the family size Biscoffs and keep them in my kitchen pantry for anytime. Found out that they are available in Safeway and in Walgreens too!!! Life is short, have a Biscoff!!!!

These cookies are so good. I love them. I first had them on our round-trip Delta flight to Hawaii last fall. I asked for extra. I recently discovered them at a national chain drugstore and here they are on amazon, too! They are so delicious but it's hard to stop eating them once you start...or so I hear...haha. I am not sure about any packaging/shipping issues that may be a problem. Enjoy!

column9: Delicious Cookies - Not so great packaging/shipping
column10: This was my 2nd order of these fantastically delicious cookies. Like most others, I discovered them while traveling on Delta Flights.  Well my last trip I asked for more and when the "stingy" FA didn't soothe my palet to my liking...I vowed to look them up and by my own! The 1st shipment I ordered 2 family pack cases. Good thing too cause I insisted my wife try them and now have her hooked! So for my next order I ordered 3 cases. The first shipment arrived w/o damage - no cookie damage, cracks, crumbs etc when opening a pkg. For the second shipment of three packs, we've been through about 3 or 4 packs and this time we have crumbs and cracks...cookie looks fine and breaks when you grab it out the pack.  Unfortunate for such great tasting cookies! I only hope it's limited to a few packs. They should at least label the box fragile to curb some of the rough handling, tossing, and stacking. But that's a ding on S/H...the product is GREAT!!!

My wife picked up a couple of packages of these cookies from the local grocer (Kroger). They were on sale, 2/$5, much cheaper then what they sell for on here. Anyway, a wonderful cookie that is like a crisp ginger cookie. They go great with coffee. Try your local grocer in the imported food section and if you don't see them, ask them to start stocking them, you will be hooked on these little pieces of heaven.
Delicious and timely they arrived in good condition (not many broken) though they broke very easily afterwards. No issues.
Had these cookies on flight to Washington DC and just had to order them. They arrived ahead of scheduled time,intact, and every bit as good as I remembered.

I stumbled upon these in my local grocery store last year and decided to give them a try as they looked similar to my favorite cookies that I used to buy in Germany (Speculatius).  Love Love Love these!  They're not quite as thin as the German ones, but they're the same rich consistency and fabulous with a cup of tea.  By the way, the ones I buy at the store are often broken as well ... I think it's an issue with the way the distributor packs the boxes.  Even broken, they're great!

These are really the best cookies. My son simply had to have them after our trip to Hawaii on Delta. (wonder if they are the only airline that serves these?) At any rate they are great. Shipping is steep though.

I really love these cookies. I ordered the family pack and almost overdosed on cookies. Well, I ate a lot and they were yummy for my tummy. I'll deal with the calories later. The taste is wonderful and you just want more.

these are fantastic cookies, simple, yet delicious, with or without milk.my order arrived and the box had clearly had a rough trip.  cookies on both ends of every package were crushed.  i included that info in my original review, frankly holding the shipper responsible, not Gourmet Center.  Gourmet Center replaced the cookies - clearly concerned with customer satisfaction.it's great to have a company back their words w/ actions.thank you
These cookies have a very unique flavor.  I made Christmas treat bags for friends and they loved them.  My family highly recommend them.
The family pack arrived in very good condition but think I would order the individual packs next time.  Cookies get stale if not eaten right away once pack is opened.

I tasted these cookies for the 1st time on a Delta flight.  I was so impressed with the flavor and freshness that I saved the wrapper so I could buy more.I've located the cookie at our local Walgreen's.  They are as delicious now as they were then.Enjoy!

column9: Tasted burnt, but company sent new pack!
column10: I was so excited to get these, but the taste was nothing like I remembered!  The cookies tasted burnt, and the color was a lot darker than pictured.  When I contacted the company, they blamed it on the packaging, saying they hear this complaint a lot with the family pack.  The person I talked to said I'd have more luck with the individually wrapped ones, so she sent me a free box of those.  I'm not quite sure how the recipe/cooking process would be different based on how the cookie is packaged--makes no sense to me!--but the company did redeem themselves by offering a new pack.  And they do indeed taste a little better.

I worked as a flight attendant for four years-- these cookies are addictive! I've never tasted anything quite like them... kind of like a rich creme brulee in cookie form. Delicious... especially dunked in a hot beverage. Haven't completed my order yet through Amazon so not certain of the packaging... but worth trying!
This is the best cookie I have ever had.  The shipping was prompt and everything was packed very well so it all remained in tact.  Perfect in every way!!!

Recently I was forced to bypass the airport food court because of a seriesof gate changes.  I finally sat down on my Delta flight exhaustedand starving.  Once we were airborn, disappointment was still withme as I thought my lot would be pretzels and bad coffee.  But, soonI was eating these wonderfully delicious cookies and wanting more.I even saved the wrapper (sadly losing it later) hoping I could buy themelsewhere.Voila!  I found them, and they are fantastic. . . .
These cookies are served on some airlines. Excellent taste especially with coffee or ice cream; a great treat. They also freeze well and can be eaten frozen or thawed.

THis was the only gift my mom wanted for X-mas. I didn't know where to start but I am glad I found this great deal. Everything came promptly and undamaged. She eats a package of 32 in 2 days so don't underestimate the power of a craving!

I first had this cookie on the Airlines and kept the wrapper becauseit had been a long time since I had enjoyed such a delightful flavor.Since then I have bought by the case, to give to friends whenever I have had the need. We also have them with a little ice cream for dessert. Also in the afternoon with Tea. In any case it is always a delite to share with a friend a product of such quality.

I went on a flight two years ago with my 1 yr old daughter from OH to CA, the flight attendent gave me three of these cookies. I loved them so much that I called the airline and asked them what kind of cokkie it was. My daughter is now 3 and she still loves the cookies. I prefer the individually pack cookie but they are a pain to open everyone. This family pack is great.
I got hooked on these after flying and finally decided to order some.  This was about the best price I found and the cookies arrived fresh and in great shape.

As the others have said, I had them on various flights and even embarassed myself a few times asking for 4 and 5 packets.  I found out that I could get them through here and have been doing so.  I give tubes of the family packs (32 cookies) away as occassional gifts but usually try to horde them all for myself.  I didn't have any packaging problems, either.

Yep, like so many others, it was a Delta flight that had me hooked on Biscoff. These cookies - how can you explain them? They aren't fatty fat fat cookies like Oreos... they are thin and crisp and a little bit, uh, "pinky up." And super tasty. Love them. Love, love, love.

column9: Cookies are good but packaging sucks!
column10: I first tried this cookie on a Delta flight. I really liked it. After i returned back from the trip, I ordered these cooking online. I was eagerly waiting for them to arrive. But when they came, 50% of the cookies were broken into small pieces. I would probably never order online unless they improve the packaging.

I first tried the biscoff cookies on my way to New Orleans. AirTran was serving these as snacks for the travelers. I liked it so much that I decided to order a family size from the Biscoff company. Unfortunately, when they arrived I noticed that most of the cookies were cracked, chipped, essentially crumbled into pieces. Why wouldn't it be when the cookies were just packed in a weak wrapper/packaging box and had been tossed around during the period of shipment?I'm fairly disappointed that I wasted my money on a bunch of destroyed cookies.

Unfortunately my job status took a dive in recent years and I found myselfworking in an airport as a janitor.  Part of what I had to do was toclean up after arriving flights as people departed the planes.  Luckilythe sloppy passengers left a few packages of Biscoff for me to gobble upas I did my rounds.  I was addicted instantly to these tasty morsels.Thankfully I have escaped this demeaning and demoralizing work where the rich passengers treat you with contempt.  Now I can enjoy my Biscoff andcurse the miscreants who populate the sky today.
The product was delicious.  However, we sent it as a gift and there was no way to put a gift card because it didn't actually come from Amazon.  I won't order again without a way to attach gift card.

I add a bit of vanilla almond milk to a bit of the sauce and it is absolutely delicious. It also helps me to get more than one meal out of each bottle. (Add the milk to some sauce in a bowl and then add to your entree.)

Twenty-something years ago my husband and I and our two kids went to St. Lucia.  While there, we visited the Baron's factory because my husband is very into hot sauces.  This one, Baron's West Indian Hot Sauce, a mustard-based sauce, became his very favorite.  For those twenty years I have ordered it from a distributor in Indiana, but recently when I went to do so, their website was gone. AAAGH! I was thrilled to discover I could get it on Amazon and ordered two big bottles.  He says it's "smooth; I love it not being vinegar-based, and it brings back the islands in my mind.  Just hot enough".

My son return home from a vacation in St Lucia, and brought a bottle of this awesome sauce back with him. This sauce combines the heat of a Scotch Bonnet(like a Habanero) with a sweet mustard base. We use it everywhere. Mix into BBQ sauce for some kick! I was thrilled that we could find this at Amazon, couldn't find it in any stores. Bought 2 of the 28 oz bottles six months ago, and need more! If you love it hot you need to try this!!

Like the others I had this sauce in St. Lucia and immediately fell in love with it.  I am a bit of a hot sauce junkie but this has been my go to hot sauce ever since I tasted it for the first time.  Great on burgers, try it mixed with A1 for steak amazing!!John

column9: Best Hot Sauce in the WORLD!
column10: I found this hot sauce the very first time in Los Angeles at the farmer's market at the grove. I fell in love. I was going through the small 14oz bottles in about 2 weeks and they were expensive,  so I was so excited to find these HUGE bottles on amazon for the great price. The shipping is almost as expensive as the hot sauce, so I tend to order about 3 bottles at a time so they can last me a few months. This is some HOT sauce, with an incredible flavor. Its wonderful in indian food, and mixed with ketchup or ranch but I pretty much put it on all my foods. I highly recommend it!

I am very much into hot sauces and came across this one by accident. Wow, this stuff is amazing and gets the full 5 stars from me. It carries enough heat and is loaded with flavor. It should carry a warning on the label to advise people that it is highly addictive. After using it about 6 times, your body gets the craving for it. I have plenty stocked up and under locked doors.

I first found this sauce on a trip to St. Lucia. I put some on a chicken sandwich and I thought I had died and gone to heaven! I _hate_ hot sauces that are just "hot", there's no point. This sauce is spectacular at bringing out flavors from food that you've never tasted before as well as adding multi-dimensional heat.Buy the big bottles, and use it on everything!
I dont usually use mustard based sauces as an all-purpose, but this is different.  Decently hot stuff with wonderful flavor.

column9: I might have to buy a case
column10: I bought this on Amazon a while back on a whim and I'm loving it.  Personally, I wouldn't consider it so much of a hot sauce, to me hot sauce is an ingredient whereas I LOVE this on my burgers.  I'll definitely be buying a couple bottles of this for the grilling season this year.

As previous reviewers have mentioned, this is one of the most flavorful (if not THEE most flavorful)of all the hot sauces I've tried. Very original taste and much more of a kick then the generic hot sauces. I've yet come across a house guest who hasn't raved about it. On that note - if you don't like HOT it might not be for you.

I first had this sauce when visiting St. Lucia years ago.  I didn't expect it to have quite the heat that is has.  It is hot, but still retains a lot of it's flavor.  I put it on everything from eggs to sausage breakfast sandwiches.
This hot sauce is some of the best out there. We got it in no time too which we always appreciate.
A friend of mine brought me a small bottle from St. Lucia and I loved it.  Finally found it via Amazon so I am stocking up on it now.

This is the best dark chocolate/coffee I've ever had.  Only complaint is the excessive shipping charged.  Don't understand the high shipping, and when inquired to the supplier, I received no response. No one appreciates being gouged - looks like there's price fixing on this product.

We tried this popcorn after the local grocery store had it on sale.  We loved it.  Not salty, and chemical tasting like others.  reminded me of the popcorn we made in the hand popper.  I checked with the manufacturers website and if you let them know you want it, they will let your retailer know. However, it is bag for bag cheaper here.We had no problems popping it using the 3.0oz popcorn button on our 1000 watt micro.

Our family loves this popcorn but have difficulty finding it in our grocery store. Although we haven't perfected the tear off strip that forms the bowl, we do find it workable. The flavor has an authentic butter taste and we have had no burnt kernels. Our microwave is 1000watt.

Jolly Time's "Homemade" popcorn comes in a clever bowl-bag that's supposed to tear open along one side to form a convenient bowl.It's a clever idea, but it certainly didn't work in my 1000 watt microwave:1. Popped kernels burn quickly during popping due to the way the unusual bag unfolds.  The popcorn was hopelessly scorched, even if I followed the instructions carefully.  I eventually managed to minimize scorching by stopping it so early that only half the kernels had popped, although a few kernels were still scorched at the top of the pile.2. The bag doesn't really open into a convenient bowl.  The opening is just a narrow slit.  Any effort to open it wider causes gaps to open at the ends, causing popcorn to spill out.3. The bottom of the bowl is searingly hot, so you can't rest it comfortably in your lap after popping.  It was too hot to rest on wood furniture.So the bowl-bag has serious problems, and precious few advantages.  It was a nice goal, but this product just didn't deliver.

I actually purchased 2 sets of this tea. One for myself and the other box for my friend in Saudia Arabia. I decided to try drinking more tea and less coffee and wasn't sure if the switch was really going to happen. I had already purchased several brands of teas from my local suppermarket but nothing was convincing me to give up the coffee until I got this selection.This ain't your mothers tea!!The first one I tried was the Jasmine Flower Tea. The directions say to let it brew for 1-2 mins but as soon as i poured the hot water you instantly get an aromatic hint of things to come. Just a little milk with this tea and your tastebuds are dancing a jig.Pay close attention to the brewing direction of each variety because some require a longer brewing time.I have replaced 3 cups of coffee with these teas and cut down on my sugar intake(not putting as much sugar in the tea as I did the coffee).There is one problem though...I do not know if my friend in Saudia Arabia is going to get the box I bought for him.

column9: A treat for green tea lovers
column10: I received this for Christmas and have tried 2 varieties so far, and have been impressed with the assortment included. Being organic is a plus and the flavors are pleasant.
read my reviews for the other colors I purchased I am very impressed with this company and their products.  this is real silver sugar for you holiday baking
This just tastes like sweet milk - I did not care for it and will not purchase it again.
My kids love this healthy peanut butter - definately the best healthy peanut butter we have had - my kids like it better than the popular branded peanut butter as well :)

I bought this brand because my favorite brand was sold out and I thought I would try something new.  What a mistake.  This "peanut butter" is not entirely peanuts!  Its peanuts mixed with oil.  So what if its Organic.  If I want Organic peanut butter, I want it made out of peanuts.  I got crunchy, because I love the nuts in crunchy peanut butter.  But this is really smooth, slightly peanut flavored oil with a few nuts mixed in.Dont waste your money.  This stuff is gross!  Gross!  Gross!  I will never purchase it again.

I have multiple cats, and they are very finicky about their food. If I try to substitute other types of food, they actually will refuse to eat it! I know it sounds ridiculous, but that is how much they love Fancy Feast! I love the fact that I can buy this product on Amazon for less money and it is shipped quickly to my door. I do not know what it is about this food, but cats love it!!

column9: What happened to the subscription price?
column10: I've been getting this on subscribe and save for about 6 months now.  It's always run around $26 for 24 cans.  That makes each can of food about 20 cents cheaper than my local grocery store.  But for some reason, this month the price has spiked to over $34. column9: An Uncommonly Palatable Red Wine Vinegar.
column10: O Zinfandel Vinegar is among the 13 specialty wine vinegars made by the California-based O Olive Oil company. I'm not a big vinegar fan, as vinegar in any but the smallest of doses makes me sick. But I keep some on hand to use sparingly in salad dressings. I tried O Zinfandel red wine vinegar a few years ago after it had placed first in America's Test Kitchen's Gourmet Red Wine Vinegar taste test. I've also seen Jacques Pepin use it on his cooking shows. It's a sweet vinegar, which Americans tend to prefer, very different from harsh super-acidic European vinegars. This is vinegar, though, so it's not sweet in the syrupy sense. It has a sharp, well-balanced flavor that is unusually rich by vinegar standards, with hints of cherry. This is how O Olive Oil describes it:"Handmade in small batches in the Orleans method and aged in oak barrels for over two years. Smoky spice and voluptuous cherry notes emerge from old vine California grapes in this artisan vinegar."The description of the flavor is about right, but it needn't be as pretentious as it sounds. Use O Zinfandel in anything that calls for red wine vinegar, or just drizzle it on greens or vegetables. It's especially good in dishes that contain onions, as it balances out the sharpness. In case you're wondering, the Orleans method of making vinegar was the first commercial method developed. A small amount of vinegar containing the mother bacteria is added to a cask of red wine. After a few months, the vinegar is moved to another barrel for aging. O Zinfandel is aged in oak barrels for 2 years, at which point bing cherry juice is added, before aging another 6 months. Ingredients are: aged zinfandel vinegar and bing cherries. Acidity is 6%, and it contains sulfites.

I won't be running out of tea for a good long while, but when I do, I'll buy this again.

It only took one cup to hook me on this stuff. This brew has no caffeine, lots of beneficial vitamins, and tastes really good. Place a heaping teaspoon in a travel mug, add a bit of water to moisten (it helps reduce floaters), slosh about, fill it up and away you go! Yes, the tea does settle on the bottom of the mug so you don't get a mouth full of attractive bits sticking to your teeth.The flavor is nutty, full bodied, and leaves no blah aftertaste like most herbal teas. The flavor stays consistent. No bitterness from this cup of Red Bush tea!

Yes it does smell a little like tobacco but why is that a bad thing?  I have certainly smelled a lot worse smelling teas.  The taste is amazing and I like that it is organic and pure Rooibos with no added crap.  I usually mix in a dash of stevia sweetener and it makes it that much better.  Enjoy!
Fabulous, Fresh and Great value! I've had rooibos in South Africa and this brings me back to that fresh quality tea experience.
I had never tried Rooibos tea before.  I had just read reviews about it.  I am so glad I bought it.  I have at least two cups of it a day...either hot or cold.  I'll be reordering this product.
Not only is this tea delicious, but it's organic and very cheap! I've bought Rooibos from over 5 other stores, and it has never been this cheap or this good! Davidson's for the win

Red Rooibos is my favorite tea, and buying it in bulk saves so much money, this bag will last you a long time, you just need to invest in some kind of strainer.The quality i'm glad to say is great too.But this tea just isn't for drinking, you can use it in baking too!A quick google search will lead you to some recipes.

column9: best rooibos I have tried so far
column10: I have tried many rooibos teas over the last two years.  I made a decision to take most of the caffiene out of my diet and this has so far been the only non-caffienated tea that I have liked.  A mild taste, nice color.  I will of course keep searching but no bagged rooibos I have tried has come as close as this loose version.  I make it using three cups of hot water, 1/3-1/2 cup of loose tea, in a coffee press.  Two things I like about this tea are: 1) it is very hard to make a brew which is too strong, 2) not being a "leafy" tea, it contains no tanins which means if you brew too long that is OK, you don't get the wicked bitterness from tanins which you would find in other teas that contain them.Hail Flavius!

It is hard to get the right rooibos tea flavor.  I have tried multiple varieties and brands.  This one is my new favorite.  The right strength with hints of vanilla.  Soft and easy on the tongue.Hint - Steep it all day, tastes even better.

Unfortunately, I have to agree with another review.  This tea tastes like an extract of pipe tobacco.  It is the most god awful tea I have ever drank.  I highly recommend you buy a small sample before putting down the money for a large bag.
Great tea, very high quality for a bulk product! I am very happy with the outstanding flavor of this tea!

I recently started drinking teas from different parts of the world and am glad that the tea from Davidson's is a great price and delivery is great so far. I would recommend the "South African Rooibos," tea because it is mild not bitter and has a pretty color.

Order came and on inspection the tea is clean and pure.  On brewing, my impression was that it was on the bland side.  I realize that all the rooibus that I have had before was in blends so I am not sure if the tea is old or if this is the nature of the product.So I use it for the basis of my own blends.  It is good with mint, citrus peel, hibiscus, roses, and candied ginger.  I like just a little sugar or stevia with these blends.  Anyway, use your imagination.

column9: Best rooibos tea money can buy
column10: This is my first time buying a Davidson's product.  The weight/price (overall value) was what ultimately convinced me to buy it.  I also wanted a red tea that was Organic, and this one's USDA Certified - what a consider a bonus.  Like others before me have suggested, the packaging is decent, but probably for long-term, I would advise putting it into something more air-proof like an metal canister (since zip lock bags allow air to pass through over time).With regards to flavor, it's exactly what I've been looking for.  My previous favorite was the Kalahari Rooibos-Honeybush tea, which had a distinct but natural and not overbearing sweetness.  Davidson's matches that flavor for me perfectly, without any additives which is a BIG deal to me.  Also, if you're an environmentalist like me, I would suggest using tea infusers (not strainers, because red tea is very light and tends to float atop of the water), which fully submerge in your teacup.  You'll save on teabags and all associated wastes!Red tea quality tends to be measured in terms of "leaves" to stems ratio.  Since stems don't really carry any flavor (they are considered "fillers" - company's use these to sell the product by weight rather than quality).  The higher quality red teas will therefore have a greater leaf:stem ratio, but this is something that you'll most likely have to check for yourself after purchase.  As a quick and rough estimate of this, you can gauge the redness/darkness of your tea based on one teaspoon - you'll see different tea spoons of different teas will offer a different color and taste strength.Overall, I've been sold on this tea, and you will be too.  Will definitely buy again (and soon too).  Subscribe and save!

I'm a fan of Alexander McCall and Mma Ramotswe, so when I saw a chance to try her bush tea, I couldn't resist.  When you open the bag, it smells a little like aromatic pipe tobacco.  The flavor is surprisingly delicate, especially compared to green tea, and it's much easier on my stomach (green tea upsets it).  I drank 6 cups or so in place of coffee at work today and hope to make a habit of it.

I've had more expensive rooibos before trying Davidson's. I love this tea, it is very reasonably priced and the tea brews in 5 minutes for a easy pick-me-up. Will recommend to others and re-order again.
Never had any Rooibos before but if this is how it tastes, I will be having it again. I drink this stuff by the buckets ha. Its pretty good.
Great tasting tea and healthy.  Great price being organic.  It taste wonderful as iced tea w/lemon  & sweetened with agave nectar.

I really don't like being so negative in a review, especially when it is about Tea. I purchased tea regularly and probably have about 6 or more cups of hot or cold variations of white, black, and green tea. this was my first attempt at trying this kind of tea. I was instantly reminded of growing up in New Jersey and falling in a pile of leaves on a rainy winter day. This tastes like a mixture of wet leaves and stale cinnamon. It could be the healthiest in the world, I don't know, but it doesn't taste good at all.

to put it into few words, this tea doesn't have any personality! It might have medical benefit as some of the reviews here mentioned, however this tea just doesn't invite you, or I guess it's just me.
I received this order very promptly and found the product to be excellent! The quality is everything you would want in a loose leaf tea. I will definately order from Davidson's again!
This tea has lots of flavor and is of high quality. I highly recommend this to any tea lover. It is great by itself and as a base for home made chai.
Thank you Davidson's for making such delicious teas.  This one is my favorite so far.  It has a hearty flavor and I love that I can buy it in bulk making it more reasonable.
For how little (per ounce) it cost, the quality of this item is extremely good. No frills, nothing fancy, just good, plain rooibos.
I am going to buy it again, my family members liked it very much! It is not only tasty, it is so healthy and at affordable price. Thank you, Amazon!!

This tea is excellent. I expected a great tea and I got one with this product.  It is flavorful but no flaver overpowered another and I like the fact that it is organic. It is really good iced with a little sweetener or your choice and milk.

column9: I will never buy teabags again
column10: This stuff is great. I wasn't sure when I took my first drink as it was unlike anything I had ever drunk before. Very flavorful.

I rate it high-ish because it tastes fresh and I'm sure it's authentic, but...it doesn't seem to have a lot of flavor.  I'm sure it's good for you and whatnot.  I blend small amounts of it into my coffee (I don't taste it).  I've heard from friends that it's good when blended with hibiscus, so I'm going to give that a try.  So purchase this tea if you want, but buy something else to blend it into.
Love Davidson's Teas but this is not one of my top picks.  Just like other reviews, tastes grassy and like hay.  Probably not going back to this type.
Tried this for iced tea. It wasn't terrible, but not that good. Tasted funky to me. It may work for hot tea, but I wouldn't recommend it for iced.
Too fine for my tea ball (which is average size, I think.)  Some of the tea sifts through.  Also, I wish it were stronger in flavor.

column9: Boy was this one a mistake!
column10: I thought by all the rave reviews that this was gonna be good choice but I only have one word to say....YUK!

column9: A little goes a long way
column10: This tea has a strong and very unusual taste and smell. I like it but in small quantities.

column9: Great tea, great value for money, great for high blood pressure!
column10: My wife suffers from high blood pressure and not wanting to get hooked on blood pressure medicine, sought out natural ways to control her blood pressure. A collegue of her's recommended rooibos and thats how we started drinking it. Its expensive to buy by the teabag and this product was the best value for money we could find. Love the taste, no additives and best of all, my wife's blood pressure has come come down noticably(she's been drinking a large cup daily for the last six months).

This is a great tea. I highly recommend all Davidson's teas and I am really glad I discovered them for myself and my family- chamomile, rooibos, hibiscus, green teas- the price is great and you get the organic tea of high quality & quantity.Rooibos tea, like green and black tea, has been found to be rich in anti-oxidants and flavonoids. In fact, Rooibos tea has been found to have as much as 50 times more SOD than Green Tea. It also has other anti-oxidants not found in other teas.The effect of free radicals (a by-product of normal cell function) in the process of aging and declining of the immune system is limited by the anti-oxidants in Rooibos tea.Rooibos tea is completely pure and natural, as it contains no additives, preservatives or colorants. It is a soothing drink for people on a calorie-restricted diet, without adding kilojoules.Rooibos tea is also strongly recommended for people suffering from irritability, headaches, disturbed sleeping patterns, insomnia, nervous tension, mild depression or hypertension. Rooibos tea contains no caffeine and therefore has a soothing effect on the central nervous system. Rooibos tea is also low in tannin and therefore does not have a negative effect on the absorption of iron and proteins into the body.Rooibos tea has anti-spasmodic properties, thus relieving stomach cramps and colic in infants. Rooibos tea also relieves stomach and indigestive problems like nausea, vomiting, heartburn, stomach ulcers and constipation.Furthermore, rooibos tea also supplements the daily amounts of calcium, manganese and especially fluoride, needed for the development of strong teeth and bones. It contains zinc and alpha-hydroxy acid, which promotes healthy skin and magnesium which is necessary for a healthy nervous system.Rooibos tea has a soothing effect on the skin, relieving itching and certain skin irritations like eczema, nappy rash and acne when directly applied to the affected area.

column9: High Quality Rooibos! Very good deal!
column10: I have tried many various Rooibos tea and this tastes one of the best for me. It is very good value for the amount, I've been drinking one bag for almost 6 month now. Highly recommended for Rooibos tea lovers!

I have been drinking Rooibos now for sometime and have become quite fond of it both for its taste and health benefits.  This is an excellent product at a great price.  I usually brew it at night and take it with milk.  It can also be taken without milk and has a mild sweet taste on its own.  Love rooibos (redbush) and can't recommend it enough.

Rooibos (Roy-boss) tea is surely an acquired taste but once you get use to it it's really quite good! This one brews up a very nice deep dark reddish color. The taste is not easy to describe, it is deep and earthy. This tea does not have caffeine so it is a great tea for those that can't have or don't like the feeling you get from caffeine. This is a very nice soothing tea I find myself reaching for more and more!

I have been drinking this Rooibos from Davidson's, along with their South African Honeybush, for the past six months, and I can't believe I was missing out on these great tea varieties for so long. This Rooibos has a delicious aroma and makes some of the best homemade iced tea I've ever tasted, with a gorgeous deep red color. Just be sure to store it in an airtight container after your tea arrives, because it comes in a paper bag that is not meant for long-term storage and will let the aroma out.

column9: Excellent Rooibos tea at a great price!
column10: I receive a pound of this tea every month and I love it. This is a great, organic tea that is caffeine free and full of anti-oxidants. It makes excellent ice tea as well. I highly recommend buying Rooibos Tea through Davidson's Tea Company & Amazon.

Rooibos tea is "sweeter" than other teas.  I just use a little honey to flavor it.  This tea is very good, I even make 2nds with it.  A nice caffeine-free break from green tea.  Sometimes I will have green in the morning and this before bed.Davidson's used to be very slow on their delivery, but my last 2 orders have arrived ahead of schedule.  Much improved.The product comes in a plain brown bag, but I quickly put it into a sealed container so that is not a problem.

I have never tried rooibos before and was pleasantly surprised when I drank my first cup.  I now drink it daily in the afternoon and it has fast become my favorite tea.  I usually drink it blended with Jamaica sorrel (hibiscus sabdariffa also known as roselle) and African honey bush and just add a few drops of lemon juice.  It tastes great every time, served hot or cold.  I sometimes add rose hips to the blend, and this further enhances the taste.  I am running through my rooibos in no time, so I am about to place another order and this time I am also going to add the green rooibos to my blend.

I drink Rooibos tea because its caffeine free, great mild taste and has a beautiful clear red color.  Its a good quality product at a good price. Now that I know the quality of Davidson's product, I am going to try different tea products from them.

I originally purchased the Choice brand tea bags and fell in love with the Rooibos flavor.  However, you get 6 boxes of 16 bags for twice as much money with the bag tea.  So I bought this to save money and found that this brand doesn't have quite the same richness.  I put 4 teaspoons in 16 Oz of water and brew it for 10 minutes and it lacks the flavor of a single bag of the Choice brand tea in the same amount of water.  I have even added extra to try and duplicate the flavor and it just isn't the same experience.  Don't get me wrong, this tea does not taste bad or anything like that, it is just different from what I expected and my only other experience with the Rooibos flavor was the Choice brand.  I am going to have to search around and see if I can find a loose tea with the same flavor as Choice.

I enjoy rooibos tea very much and drink it all the time.  Usually loose tea is fresher and better tasting.  I was wrong.  This tastes like stale wood shavings.  I think this sat around in a warehouse for a while.  Odd that Amazon did not have this product in the "leave feedback" email I received.  I had to do a little search to leave this post.

column9: maybe i got a bad batch
column10: I have had several rooibos teas.  Most in tea bags. some at starbucks.  As soon as I opened the bag I knew there was a problem because it was ground almost as fine as coffee.  It went straight through my tea diffuser and the grounds were all in my cup, plus it tasted nothing like any rooibos I have ever had.  Pretty bad actually.  Highly disappointing.  I was so excited about this shipment.  Do not order this.  get it from your natural foods store where you can see it if gonna get in bulk.  If not stick with the 10.00 boxes of these tea bags for sale.  Tastes like you could use this in an iced tea machine maybe with a fine filter so you can brew like coffee.  Otherwise useless.

column9: Weak taste, smells good, very dusty
column10: Smells good, tastes weak and the batch I got was very dusty and the small particles did not get filtered out with a standard strainer. You cannot make multiple infusions with this stuff. This is fairly disappointing, but I suppose something has to be wrong with a very cheap bulk tea. I probably wouldn't buy it again for this reason. If you don't mind a little debris on the top of your cuppa or using a lot of tea in your infusions, it's okay.

We have been paying big bucks for little cans of Rooibos tea at the health food store and brewing ice tea with it that we drink by the gallon. I was surprised that the Davidson's Rooibos was richer and tastier and brewed up a nice clear amber/brown color. Better quality and less expensive!

This is a classic from South Africa and I'm from the same place so it's not new to me.  This tastes like Rooibos should taste.  The picture shows a brown paper bag.  Mine arrived in a high tech foil pouch with a brown paper exterior.  Which after you cut off the seal has a zip lock top. No need to find another container as one reviewer suggested now that the packing is improved.  I sleep best when I drink Rooibos before going to bed.  I like drinking it all day.  It's good for you and caffeine free.  I drink it with milk or Almond milk.  The history of Rooibis is it was developed as a tea substitute in South Africa due to the expense of importing tea in the 1700's and 1800's.  It's not a true tea and what's in the bag is a lot finer than a traditional loose leaf tea.  Until it expands from hot water a few of the tiny leaves will slip through most brewing devices.  The leaf size is just a FYI, not a problem for me.  With the free shipping from Amazon this is probably the best Rooibos bargain in the USA.  For the true South African experience you need to dunk Beskuit (pr. Bess-kate) a Biscotti like rusk in your Rooibos tea.  Amazon carries "Ouma Rusks" the number one brand of Beskuit in South Africa or just Google the recipe, I bake my own.  Being that this product is from South Africa UPS decided to send my Prime 2nd day air order via Timbuktu, but I won't knock the product for UPS's incompetence.
We love rooibos, tasty and healthy too.  This makes a great pot of tea and goes with milk, cow and soy varieties quite well.  Recommended for all tea lovers, especially rooibos fans.

I've been reading the other reviews and am quite perplexed. When I brewed the first (and only) pot and took that first sip I felt that there must be some mistake, no one would have emptied an ash tray into my tea pot on purpose, would they?  I really had to check for cigarette butts.  The taste of this tea...well, is very interesting.

I don't know how to feel about this tea.  This tea looks and smells like good quality rooibos (although a little finer than other inexpensive loose rooibos I've purchased), but the taste is a bit lacking.  I found the taste to be a little dull and diluted however for this price point, it is easy to overlook this a bit and compensate with longer brew times and slightly more loose tea.  I've found that you really do need the full 2 rounded teaspoons per 8 ounces plus a little extra and brew for a minimum of ten minutes rather than five (this also helps get more of the nutrients out of it anyway).  This ends up making a fair cup of rooibos.  I should note that I drink mine plain - no sweetener, no milk, etc.  I will probably purchase this again just because it is so inexpensive, and I enjoy rooibos.  It tends to be hard to find just plain and especially in this quantity for this price.  Just make sure you use the right amount of loose tea, and this can make a decent cup of rooibos for the price.  Can you buy better?  Sure - keep in mind it's organic and the quantity/price point so if this is a daily drinker for you and you use a lot quickly, it's worth it.Pros - inexpensive, good smell, rich/dark color, organic, plain rooibos without additivesCons - weak/dull flavor, little finer than other loose rooibos

Though I haven't tasted any other rooibos tea, and thus have no frame for comparison, I do drink a fair amount of loose tea.  I ordered this tea to try a new style, and also because a pound of it costs what many loose teas cost for only two ounces.  I therefore had fairly low expectations, but was pleasantly surprised--I really like this tea!  I drink it almost daily and I find that it helps me wind down before bed.  (On the other hand, it doesn't make me drowsy by itself, so I can drink it fine any time of the day.)  Whatever health benefits it has are just a bonus; I drink this tea for its taste, and I'm pleased to say that it's the cheapest loose tea in my cabinet.I was also pleased with the packaging.  Based on the photo and price, I expected a plain paper bag, from which I would need to transfer the tea as soon as I opened it.  Actually, the bag is quite sturdy and lined with plastic on the inside.  It is also resealable like a Ziploc.  Since I don't have any tins large enough, I just keep the tea in the bag as it is.

column9: Davidson's Organic South African Rooibos, 16 oz bag
column10: I was a little worried by the other reviews but I really wanted to try this 'tea' because of its health benefits and because it is caffeine free.  When I got my order and made some to drink, i really like it...it is now my favorite drink next to my japanese macha tea.  The fragrance out of the bag reminds me of cherry tobacco and when the drink is made, it has a beautiful reddish clear color and the scent is like a deep rich red tea scent.  I drink it straight, no sugar or honey and i love it.  I would buy again and I recommend this product.  Enjoy!

column9: A Delicious Tea at an Amazing Price!
column10: I cannot get over the deal you can get when you participate with the Amazon Subscribe & Save program for this tea!  If you are nervous about commitment, don't be!  You can cancel at any time.  You can change your preferences any time as well!  On top of that, the tea ships for free & you don't have to worry about remembering to order more!  Or if you are running low, you can opt. to have your shipment sent sooner!  It's really great!I really enjoy this loose leave Rooibos.  I drink it iced.  I love that I can let it brew forever without having to worry about over brewing it.  It's also great that it is caffeine free because I usually drink unsweetened iced tea rather than water.  Last thing I need is to OD on caffeine!  The color when it brews is really pretty.  It is a beautiful reddish brown.The downside is the tea is rather fine & it goes right through my big ol' tea ball.  I made reusable giant tea bags that are just for brewing this tea!  So make sure you get a super fine mesh tea brewer or buy loose leaf tea bags to use with this!

column9: You can't go wrong with this rooibos
column10: I must say that I don't notice much of a difference between the bulk rooibos teas that I have tried.  With that said, this is as good as any I have tried, and the best price by far.  I personally like green rooibos even more, which to me has a more complex and delicate flavor.

column9: Great price on my favorite tea
column10: This is a delicious variety of rooibos tea - my favorite!  It's full of good stuff and naturally caffeine free so it can be enjoyed any time of day.  (For me that usually means all day long)

column9: Davidson's Rooibos tea, not infuser friendly.
column10: I have been using loose teas for many years.  However, Davidson's Organic South Sfrican Rooibos tea was cut so thin that a lot of the tea and sediment goes right through most tea infusers. Actually, the Rooibos tea seemed to be cut for tea bag use and was accidently placed in the wrong container. I would question the company before ordering.  PS: Since I ordered the tea from Amazon.com, they stood behind by complaint and rectified the problem immediatly. Never a problem when dealing with Amazon.com.  Russ (Russell3006) Amazon.com Storefront.

I'm a South African living in a place where Rooisbos is otherwise very very expensive.The tea itself has a taste as good as anything you'd buy in South Africa, the packaging is nicely minimal and the price has turned it from a luxury into an everyday product (which is what it is in South Africa).
This tea is delicious.  Let it seep for awhile.  Next time I will get tea bags.  Loose tea is not for everyone.  It seems to help a little with my pain, but that could be the placebo effect.

I am in no way a tea connoisseur but I really like this tea. I was buying Twinnings Rooibos in the bags and that's just not economical compared to bulk tea. I enjoy the taste of this tea and find it as good or better. You will need the extra fine tea strainers though, the tea is too fine for the common balls or cheaper presses.

If you drink a lot of rooibos, this is perfect for you. This is a very standard, run of the mill rooibos and hits the spot. It's not extremely fragrant but the flavour is right and it's perfect for brewing up a bit pot. This is a huge bag though so I don't think I will buy it again (at the very least, it'll take me a year or two to get through it, and that's with drinking a lot more rooibos than I normally do!). It would be more useful if the retailer sold teas in a smaller amount (say, 4oz or 8oz). Even if you're a heavy tea drinker like I am, it'll take you a while to finish this bag, and that's assuming you're not interested in variety.Also, to the reviewer who previously said that the product was so ground up it was unusable; rooibos tea is an herb, its not actual ground up tea leaves. All "loose-leaf" rooibos looks like this and admittedly, it can be a bit of a problem with tea brewing contraptions that have larger filters than others, but this is a problem inherent to rooibos itself and not this specific product from this specific maker.

This is a very nice tea  --has a mild taste and doesn't require anything added  -- It is very good tea  -- nice mild taste  -- very simple  --  I like that  -- just Rooibos Red Tea  --  I love loose teas and I have liked the ones I have gotten from Davidson's  -- This is a great value  ------  I actually thought I had ordered the Chai Rooibos and was going to send it back but I am glad I didn't  - I am very pleased with tea  --  Sometimes those other flavors can overwhelm  them  but I am trying that one next  -

I love this tea - delicious rooibos in a light-protective bag. Shipped quickly.I spent a good amount of time online trying to find organic loose-leaf tea and I finally found it. This large bag will keep me for a while, but next time I'll definitely come back to Davidson's.

This tea is very enjoyable. It's soothing and has a pleasant light sweetness. I brew it in a coffee pot in place of coffee- 1 tablespoon per 2 cups. It is also very good when mixed with spiced rooibos tea bags to make them more mild. It tastes a little bitter/earthy when chilled, but the initial flavor is easy to adjust to. I also add flavored green tea to the rooibos when making it into iced tea. A good combination is raspberry green tea with rooibos. I haven't had much luck blending flavors of black tea with the rooibos. It's fun to experiment with the flavors. I also think the price is very reasonable, and the package is resealable, so you can keep it fresh. I just squeeze the air out before closing. This tea has more antioxidants than green tea. Maybe that's why I feel better during the day if I start my morning with a cup.

Just received and made last night. Surprisingly delicious - both hot and cold with ice!And has a natural sweetness. Tastes like tea even though it's not. Deep color.Nice to have an evening drink that is caffeine free andfull of good antioxidants.Very nice packaging with zip-lock enclosure, but with the large amount that comes with this order,I'll probably put it in my large tea tins to keep it fresh longer.Great Price! Will buy again.

High-quality, straight rooibos - and plenty of it.  The flavor is mild, so use plenty of leaves - it won't get bitter on you, and the flavor really comes through as you brew it stronger.I haven't tried to yet, but I can imagine this would make a good base to mix your own fruit or floral tea.And a whole pound of it will last a while.

column9: By far the most healthful tea in my opinion
column10: I was turned on to rooibos tea by a nurse practitioner I was working with in the emergency department during flu season.  She drank a mug of this daily, and swore she never got sick.  As a PA, I did some research about this leaf and was nicely surprised to find there is some scientific weight behind this tea!  It has great anti-inflammatory properties, and I have noticed improvement in my immune function - everybody else in the house will have a cold, or the flu, etc. and I'm the one still feeling fine and going to work.  There is also evidence to show it can help to keep blood sugar under control in type 2 diabetes.  After reading other reviews, I feel I should mention that it has not helped with my chronic migraine problem, but that's not why I started drinking this tea.  And it tastes pretty good, hot or iced - well worth trying!

column9: Taste is Subjective, Especially with Different Teas
column10: I recently started to drink 2 or more cups of both the red and the green varieties of Davidson's Rooibos teas.  Personally, I like the tastes of both varieties and enjoy drinking the tea, regardless of any consideration of potential health benefits.  For me, the tea requires no additives, which are found in other brands and/or used by other consumers.But taste is such a personal, subjective thing and it is understandable why the Amazon reviews for this product contain such diverse opinions in this regard.  My suggestion is to try the pure form before you make a decision based solely on these reviews to see if you like it or not.

I really like the taste of this organic rooibos tea. The leaves are a bit small but works wonderfully if you infuse it using a french press, instead of using a meshed ball tea infuser.I'm from South Africa and even thought I know people there like it with milk, I would recommend it without milk, probably personal taste.It's a wonderful healthy alternative to any hot caffeine drink. enjoy.

column9: Well worth the money, best source for Rooibus tea
column10: I purchased a can of rooibus tea at a tea shop and paid through the nose for a small handful of tea bags.  This item comes in bulk, and if you have the proper strainer, you will save a ton of money.  Personally, I use a teabag I got from Starbucks (ordered a rooibus tea and kept the bag) and am careful not to let the top get below the surface of the water.  The bag appears to be silk, finely woven.  The rooibus tea is excellent, brews well, and you can't make it too strong.  It has a mild flavor, and this product is as good as any I have had from other sources, perhaps better.  My cost is way, way down by buying in bulk, and this is the only way to go.  My wife and I drink it every day, usually a couple of times a day.  Since it's caffeine free, no worries even if you drink it at bedtime.  Thumbs up.

column9: Good for a change of pace
column10: This Rooibos Tea has a good taste and is a pleasant change from the Gunpowder Green Tea I usually drink. It is of much finer texture than green and needs at least 50% more ( 1 1/2 tsp.) per cup, to brew a decent cup of tea. That isn't so bad, due to it being greater in volume than Green Tea. Most tea infusion balls would be too small for the amount needed per cup and is best brewed using a fine mesh, cup style infuser. I find to like it better to drink as iced tea and have mixed it with Green Tea, which I think I like the best. All-in-all, it's a great value and I would recommend it for a change of pace. Give it a try..

column9: Produces a deep, mellow flavor with hints of vanilla and black tea
column10: If you are interested in a caffeine-free brew with a rich, full-bodied taste, you need to try Rooibos tea.  If you want the absolute best Rooibos for the price, you need to try Davidson's Tea in bulk.Rooibos is generally expensive, and many types available at the store are combined with other flavors (fruits and extracts).  Generally, all of these taste good, but each can hide the true quality of the Rooibos used.  The few pure Rooibos teas you find are closer to triple the price of normal 20 count boxes of teas.  These boxed Rooibos teas are actually quite good, one or two are even better than this Davidson's Tea, but expensive--you might get 1.5 ounces for the price.  Amazingly, Davidson's is able to give you 16 ounces of Rooibos for a couple dollars more.We like our Rooibos strong and we would go through it very fast with Rooibos by-the-bag, so we seldom get the pure Rooibos.  That is, until now with this bulk version.Coupled with a good method of infusing (I highly suggest the SwissGold TF 500--it is non-reactive with the tea and it is sufficiently sized and made for extended use), you will make great brews.  Rooibos can give you two great brews, and a third brew that is, at best, mediocre (make this a hotter, longer brew), using four teaspoons in the TF 500 mentioned above.  This keeps me going until evening, when I share another set of strong brews with my wife.  As you may tell, I use a very large mug.  :-)The bag is plastic-lined paper, and has strong ziplock-type top.  You can probably get by leaving the tea in the bag for some weeks, but if you need to keep it for longer, you should buy vacuum containers.We are elated with this so much, that we've ordered four other Davidson's bulk teas.  Expect reviews on these soon.

Just received my shipment in yesterday with the tea in excellent condition. Smells and tastes great! The longer this tea is steeped the better (opposite of regular tea), I steep mine for 10 to 20 minutes. Very happy with this product, and very glad it's organic... wouldn't buy it if it wasn't.

Was a bit skeptical upon ordering, having never tried Red Bush Tea before.  I really like it's earthy taste and use the loose tea in my reusable K-Cup with my Keurig Machine. I took a chance and ordered 2- 1 lb.bags, glad I did. No oxylates in Rooibos leaves, (Red Bush Tea) because it is not actually from "Tea Leaves" but a different kind of bush, make it perfect for people who tend to be kidney stone formers! YAY, that is great news!  I recommend Davidson's Organic South African Rooibos Tea.  I will buy this again. You do need to transfer the not so hot zip lock bag it comes in, after opening, to another air tight container, but that is a non issue.  I put a dash of Stevia in my cup of tea and it really comes alive, hot or iced!

column9: Ultra High Quality Tea - Great Packaging!!!!
column10: This product arrived well packaged and before the estimated arrival date. The packaging looks unmentionable but it is double sealed at the top and has a zip-lock re-sealable function. I opened the package and immediately smelled the aroma of this high quality tea and noticed the aluminum foil lining. I made a huge cup of this tea using 1 tsp of tea per 1 cup of water. I boiled the water and let it sit for 5 minutes with no heat before immersing the infuser. I let it do it's thing for 15 minutes and then poured one of the best cups of Rooibos I have ever had. I will try with cinnamon and cloves tomorrow, hot then iced. You ar emissing out if you don't get some of this awesome tea!

I drink a lot of ice tea, made in a West Bend ice tea brewer.  To avoid the fine grind that others have mentioned, I also used a coffee filter.  The tea seemed to turn out fine -- good color, etc.  However, when I poured the first glass I couldn't believe the smell.  Apparently, it doesn't seem to bother other people.  It sure bothered me.  This stuff is probably great if you have a bad cold and can't smell.  Otherwise, try a small sample before bulk ordering.  This morning I blended a small amount with Earl Grey decaffeinated.  This turned out pretty well.  I can taste the rooibos but the smell is pretty well subdued.  Used in this way, one can get the benefit without the overpowering smell.  I mixed roughly 2/3rds Earl Grey to 1/3rd Rooibos.This seems to be a cultivated taste - kind of like eating oysters.  I may learn to like the smell, but for right now I'm looking for different ways to blend it.

This was my first foray into rooibos, but after making the trip, I'm glad to say that it was worthwhile.  There is a darker, smokey, kinda flavour to this tea.  I find it more earthy and mellow and when I want a cup of that, then I reach for this one.  I will drink this tea and I shall purchase it again.  A good choice for those out there looking for a decent rooibos at a decent price.

column9: Pleasantly Mild, with purported health benefits.
column10: I love a mild tea, and this one is on the top of my list.  I love to dink herbal teas because of their purported health benefits, because in many cases they do actually have health benefits. This was my first time I've tried Rooibos and I will continue to drink it because I like the subtle taste so much. I can't speak for other brands that provide a loose tea like Davidson's Tea does, but I have really enjoyed the quality and quantity provided by their product. I think the overall value is immense when you compare it to other brands that charge you  double the money for substantially less product. The bag this comes in is an excellent storage bag because it is resealable. This isn't as strong as Honey-Bush tea, and is also slightly less sweet than I had imagined it wold be.  I was interested in the claim that Rooibos can help give relief from common Allergies to pollen, what you could call "hay-fever". From whatI can tell I have had a small improvement in my pollen allergies. Overall there is a lot of value present here and Davidson's has done a great job.

column9: Dealer has an excellent quality of Rooibos Tea
column10: I was introduced to Rooibos tea when our family lived in South Africa for a short-time in the 1980's.  I've tried several Rooibos teas from different companies and was never quite satisfied until I purchased Davidson's Rooibos tea.  If you read this Davidson . . . "I'll be back!"

A whole pound of great tea!The quality of this tea is equivalent to teas I've purchased that are far more expensive.The package arrived before the estimated date, in great condition.I will be ordering from Davidsons again!

Tis rooibos is the real deal. After spending three weeks in south Africa and falling in love with rooibos tea, I made it a mission of mine to find the smooth drinking red tea in the states. I tried four other brands before getting this 1lb bag of loose tea. Very Good product. Made an excellent cup of tea. The picture doesn't do the bag Justice as it has a zip-lock feature. I vacuum packed 3/4 of each and stored them in the freezer. The partial bags are in the fridge ready to use. I'm looking forward to drinking these fine organic teas for some time to come and save big $s as well.

I love this tea and the quality is great.  I will buy it again.  The plain flavor of the tea is rich and you can enjoy what roobios tastes like with out all the foo-foo flavor adding it receives with so many other Roobios tea packaging.

The leaves are miniscule, so you'll need a mesh steeper. Davidson's have  improved their packaging and now use a resealable bag. Regardless, I take some out into a little tin and seal the rest so it stays fresh. To serve, I had a drop of honey. Usually I add a bit of milk and froth it.

I'm from Germany and have been drinking this tea for years. Now living in the States, I thought I have to forever live without it! I didn't want to spend $4 or more at Trader Joes.. not at the rate I'm drinking this stuff. And I don't like green or black tea. Hot in the winter, cold in the summer, and the kids love it too! I found this on Amazon and wow! this is awesome! Way better than the individual tea bags! Add some vanilla or carmel sirup or (for adults) some Amaretto! Heavenly!!!
I use in my refillable keurig  k-cup and it brews the perfect cup of rooibos. This is the best quality loose rooibos I've purchased. Will definitely be a regular order going forward.
Its not sweet but its not bitter... Definitely a new flavor to me but I liked it since the first day.

column9: No bitter after taste. My favorite tea by far!
column10: This tea is my favorite. Smooth taste. I'm not sure if it is because the tea is caffein free or just my imagination but seems to have a calming affect on me. I have shared my pound bag with friends and everyone loves the tea as well. I am ordering more today :)

I first bought this tea because I'd read articles on the health benefits of it. Roobibos has a nice flavor and I'm now a repeat buyer. I like making suntea with it and it is good hot in the winter, also. I like that it is organic and caffine-free.

This tea is of excellent quality, very fresh, and tastes delicious hot or chilled.  Obviously everyone's tastes are different; be sensible and try a cup at a local coffee shop before ordering an entire pound!In addition to the wonderful earthy taste and aroma, Rooibos has many beneficial health effects.  While there isn't a massive amount of peer-reviewed scientific research published regarding Rooibos, what is out there clearly shows significant anti-mutagenic and anti-carcinogenic properties.Personally, it has helped me with my blood pressure, which tends to run high in my family even though I am young.  I have also almost completely weened myself off of caffeine (impressive as I was a ~4+ cup of coffee per day guy previously).  I can't recommend this tea enough!

This is a great tea if you like Rooibos. It tastes great, the color is great, and they give you a ton of it for a low price.The two main complaints I've read about this tea is 1) packaging and 2) the tea is cut too fine.1) The tea came in a nice resealable package, not the one shown, but covered in the same plain brown paper bag-like finish.2) When I first opened the bag and for about a month or two I noticed no sediment at all. Once I got down into the bottom portion of the tea and started mixing it up I noticed sediment. If you are worried about having no bits of anything in your tea, this could be a problem. They are tiny small fibrous strands that you don't notice at all when drinking.Otherwise, the tea tastes great and you can brew it for as long as you want for desired strength (recommended 3-7 minutes).

You can beat the flavor or the price of the rooibos. I live in South African for two years and I have been looking for a robust loose leaf for sometime. This does not disappoint. Best flavor for an herbal tea in the world.

column9: Nice flavor, and a great price!I

I didn't want to pay the high price again, so started searching Amazon for something comparable.Although it's not the exact same flavor, it still taste nice, and you can't beat the price. column4: Jolly Green Giant "You can try Birchbox too! ...
