Because of this odd delivery location, my wife ran over the box when she backed out of the garage and did not see the box.  we lost half of the cups.  Thius is the third time I have written about this matter to Amazon with no results.  Hopefully someone will respond to me.fred santaniello

In the past, the Donut House K-Cups have been of the highest quality & would have been rated 5 stars. However, even tho the quality of the product is still there, the last time I received the 80 pack, several of the K-Cups were broken & the coffee missing. Some of them were broken within the box & the coffee was everywhere. That is the reason for the 4 star rating - will order them once more to see if the last order was an anomaly.
SO FAR, This is the BEST K CUP coffee that I have found. It is not too bitter & not weak. To me, IT MAKES THE PERFECT CUP OF COFFEE.

this is a great second choice coffee. i live out in the boonies and cant get to a dunkin donut store very often (the only online source is a bit pricey )so i buy a lot of this product.this is the only other k-cup that i care for.
This makes a great cup of coffee and is not too strong. It's the perfect morning brew to get the day started.

This is my favorite coffee.  I drink a cup or two each morning.  To me, you cannot tell a differencebetween the decaf and caf flavor.  I prefer Donut House Coffee brand to others I have tried.  Nolingering aftertaste, no irritability caused.  Thank you for an enjoyable product.

column9: Light Roast: Bitter for this gal...
column10: I hate calling out an entire brand, but sadly, I must. I accidentally ordered this thinking it was a different, very similarly named brand, and didn't realize it I brewed a K-cup. It was so bitter, typical of this brand (this is my third attempt with this brand). And of course, I just had to accidentally buy the jumbo 24-count pack. Even with a 1/4 c of cream or a whole packet of hot cocoa, it still has a big bite to it. Anyway, it's just not for me. Good price, though, and arrived on time.
We've tried a lot of coffee cups and I find this one the best tasting.  I hit the "biggest" cup button and the coffee still has a lot of flavor for me.
I am very pleased with the Donut House K Kups brew.  It is good from the first cup to the last.  It must be good I am ordering another case right now.

The packaging is great since it has a perforated U-shaped slit at the front so that you can leave this box on a shelf and access the little k-cups through the perforated opening. When the box arrived intact; all the k-cups were intact. (We have ordered/used at least 4 of these boxes now).
It is OK, if you are in a hurry for a cup of decaf but I won't rave about it.  I bought it for my decaf drinking friends and family.  I guess I prefer decaf Folger's in my reusable Keurig cup.
I buy these for my dad...they are his favorite.  We normally buy Caribou Blend for ourselves, but these are a close 2nd.

column9: Not bad for a light roast!
column10: My father-in law purchased this coffee as an 80 count box at Sam's Club, and since he really likes it (and so does my mother-in-law, I thought I'd also give it a try. My preference is actually a darker (medium) roast, and I also prefer an extra bold amount, but for this coffee, if the water setting is on medium, then it's a good flavored, moderate wake-up coffee with only a very small amount of bitter aftertaste. In short, it's not bad for a light roast!

This ooffee is great it's not too strong but not weak. It has a nice flavor to it, and the price is right. I love the Keurig machines and am always on the lookout for K-cups and these are some of my favorites... great with a bagel and cream cheese or cereal in the morning or iced in the summer. A definate repurchase for me.

My family has owned a Keurig for about 6 or 7 months now and we have been buying this specific k cups since then. They have a very good flavor. It is also a plus that they are decaf.I would recommend this product  for anyone who loves coffee.

column9: Donut House Collection Light Roast K-cups
column10: The coffee is delicious.The problem is every time we try to brew it ,it clogs my Cuisinart k-cup brewer.I had the same problem with this brand in decaf.It doesn't happen with any other brand so I know it is the grind of this particular coffee.I will be throwing it out.

For some reason, I keep getting grinds with these K-Cups. I haven't had a problem with anything else in my Keurig. I'm not sure if the issue is with a bad lot, or the shipment. Regardless, I've gone through a few cups and plan to toss the rest of the box. Money wasted!
This is my favorite light roast.  Any flavored creamer goes in it tasting great.  As always, ordered $25 worth and got Free Super Saver Shipping!!

The Donut House Decaf has a great coffee flavor and seems to be near acid free. A great alternative to people who do not like the dark robust European flavor. I love them both and alternate between the Green Mountain Robust Magic and Donut House. Having tried most of the brands on the market these 2 stand out to me as having the best coffee flavor.If you don't like to drink "brown water" (stay away from the organic Newman's Own Decaf - horrid!) the Donut House is for you!

My mother really enjoyed this coffee.  Most other coffees are so strong but this she could drink it without watering it down. We received it a day or two earlier than I thought we would, so we were able to start enjoying earlier than planned.

This has become our go to decaf coffee.  we brew this one on the middle setting and it produces an aromatic and flavorful cup of cofee.  THe coffee is smooth with no bitterness.  Wish the product was availble on a subscribe and save.
I BOUGHT THIS COFFEE FOR MY BROTHER IN LAW AND HE LOVES IT. IT IS VERY REFRESHING COFFEE AND IT TASTE DELICIOUS.

column9: perfect for those who don't like strong, bitter coffee
column10: Don't buy this if you like Starbuck's coffee.  I love this because it is mild.  In the past, I bought Green Mountain coffee, but I always added water to dilute its taste.  This is a perfect mild taste.  K-cups are expensive, but these taste good, so it's worth the cost.

I purchased this coffee product for my wife.  She hasn't found another decaf k-cup brand that she prefers over this donut house product.  She loves this.  I prefer a deeper, more robust french roast flavor.
Love this coffee. Am a big fan of K-cup coffee and when I ordered this coffee I didn't know what to expect but it's wonderful!
This coffee has a good flavor, its just a little strong for my taste. I added some creamer and it tasted good, but I prefer Donut Shop.
THE DONUT HOUSE LIGHT ROAST COFFEE IS VERY GOOD.  IT WORKS WELL WITH THE KREIG COFFEE MAKER, AND THE COFFEE HAS VERY GOOD FLAVOR.
This was bought for my wife who loves coffee. She says the taste is good. It had a good mild flavor, not bitter but smooth. She says it is a good pick me up in the morning.

I purchased this product by accident for my Mom, but either way we were going to drink it. We ended up loving this coffee. Has a good bold taste. To me it almost tastes like Starbucks, but this is way better and cheaper!

If you own any of the Keurig K-Cup Brewers then you should definitely get this package. Its filled with 24 count K-Cups for your Keurig. Get a nice cup of coffee fast. They also have other flavors but this is for the Regular which we bought for ours. Nothing better in the morning than a nice fresh cup of coffee and I love the taste! Its not just a generic bland coffee blend. Please try!
The Donut House coffee is wonderful!  My husband wanted something lighter for the mornings - and he loves this!!!  The price is amazing via Amazon and the free shipping made it even better!!
Good flavor if you want a light brew and smells great when brewing.  I usually order 2 boxes so I get free shipping.

After shopping around for some K-cups that were affordable, I decided to give Donut House a try.  We don't like the heavier French roast types or flavored coffees, so this brand and type are a good one for us. We like a light  to medium roast coffee.

This blend has got me hooked. I was an avid DD fan but 11.99 for 14 cups. I even was grinding my own DD and using the adapter filters. Definitely cheaper. Still the convenience of the k-cup is nice.  Then I tried this blend. Not only is it comparible in taste...its actually better. Much better.  Sorry DD.  Since each even cheaper in quanitity I wonder how fresh the cups stay?  In either case this is an awesome blend
This product is very good and i get more for my money than in the grocery store.  The convenience of having it come to my house is more that worth it.
This is,a great product .received it very quickly with no problems and would buy again. If u own a kreger you should try this it is good stuff.
THIS WAS A GREAT GIFT TO MYSELF THE COFFEE IS GREAT THE TURN AROUND TIME IS OUTSTANDING THE PRICE IS BETTER THAN MOST PLACES AROUND TOWN.

I got the box of Donut House Coffee OK but there were mixed together the regular coffee and decafinate coffee.  I wasn't happy about this...I try called customer service but there was no where showing customer's phone number.

column9: give you only a half cup of coffee
column10: I'VE BROUGHT THIS PRODUCT BEFORE AND DIDN'T HAVE ANY PROBLEMS.  NOW WHEN I PUT THE K-CUP IN AND PUSH THE BUTTON ON I WILL ONLY GET A HALF OF A CUP.  FOR THE PRICE IT'S NOT WORTH IT.  I WOULDN'T BUY THIS PRODUCT AGAIN.

While this was supposed to be a light roast, I found it extremely strong and bitter tasting. Buyer beware: If you like light roast coffees as I do, this isn't one of them even though it's labelled that way! I won't buy it again!

Too strong for a medium brew, there is much better.  Coffee People Donut shop is my favorite unflavored coffee.  Also, about 15 cups out of a 50 cup box popped the seal when brewed, this caused grounds to go in the coffee.  I will probably not buy this coffee again.
This is the best tasting decaf k-cup I have tried so far. It is not bitter at all. I would recommend this blend to anyone who enjoys a great cup of decaf!
This is a very good deal, I looked at other on line stores and found the best price here. Coffee is a bit strong for me but my husband likes it.
Came right away. Tastes great. Great bargain compared to what you pay in retail stores. We drink it every day! Am going to buy k-cups on Amazon every time we need them now!

I am probably not the best reviewer - I love dark roasts.  Diedrich Coffee, Dark French Roast, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2) is usually my coffee of choice, but I'm trying to find a lighter roast I enjoy.  Darker roasts aren't healthy for you - they say light roasts are much better.  I won't give up yet, but this definitely isn't the one I can drink every day.  I found it bitter - a very odd taste.
Good flavor for a light roast coffee. I have had particularly good luck with the "Donut House" brank of Keurig K-cups!

When I bought this coffee I was expecting a light-roast coffee with smooth body and great flavor as could be found in some donut shops in days gone by.  For me, this doesn't fulfill either.  This coffee should be described as bold, there is nothing light about it.  Forget about smooth body, instead it has an acidity and bitterness that I found unpleasant.  I'm still debating just tossing it out or letting it collect dust in the event I need to use it if I'm out of all other k-cups.This coffee made it to my "Do not buy again" list.

I mistakenly grabbed this Donut HOUSE blend at Costco thinking it was the Donut SHOP blend of k-cup (by Coffee People).  I realized it wasn't Donut SHOP the first time I made a cup.  It was REALLY light - basically colored water, very little flavor if made on the recommended 8 oz brew size.  Not much better on a lower setting either.  If you like a very, very mild coffee, then this is for you.  I'm not a fan of strong coffee, but this was WAY to mild and I'll be making sure I'm getting the Coffee People Donut SHOP coffee rather than Donut HOUSE in the future!

I have to say that this is becoming an every morning favorite for me. It is not pretentious. Terms such as bold, fruity, nut-like and the such are not appropriate here. This is just good ol' coffee. Sure to please all with its flavor. I recommend it. The other fancier coffee are for those moments when you want to have the fancy stuff. Now, back to my cup of Joe.
I've been buying this product for over a year.  Nice taste, not too strong or weak.  Having tried a few different flavors, this one has been my favorite choice.
I don't like the burnt taste of Starbucks, so we ordered this coffee.  It comes out perfect on the 10 oz setting!  We are ordering more today.
This coffee is a great morning breakfast blend.  Beats out our local coffee houses any day of the week.

I am a fruitcake lover, and am extremely particular. If a fruitcake doesn't measure up to the ones I used to eat as a child, the deep, dark, aged-in-brandy, old-fashioned type, I don't really feel that I've had my fruitcake fix for the season. But this one fills the bill. It's dense, moist, spicy, nutty and PERFECT!
This is the best fruitcake I have ever tasted.  If you like the dark, dense, moist, rum- enhanced kind, you will love it too. Handmade by monks in Oregon.

I purchased this fruitcake for both my mother and mother in-law.  Being fruitcake connoisseurs, I took it very highly that both felt this was the best fruitcake they ever had.  I highly recommend this to anyone who loves fruitcake!

I'm on a quest for the perfect Christmas fruitcake since I had one when I was in high school, many, many, many years ago.  I can't remember the name of the immortal fruitcake and my mother has passed on, so I'm pretty much starting from scratch.This Christmas I tried the Trappist Abbey fruitcake and the Glenfiddich fruitcake.  Be aware that both are very small, no larger than a small container of sour cream but in a square shape; in other words, roughly 3x3x3, enough for two people or three skinny servings.Of the two fruitcakes, I prefer this one.  It's moister and contains more cherries.  I like cherries.  In fact, there seems to be more fruit overall, including pineapple.  And it's soaked in brandy as opposed to scotch which, while I have nothing whatsoever against scotch, just doesn't translate as well as brandy to fruitcake.Next year I've decided to make my own fruitcake and make it self-igniting which may bring it closer to the legendary fruitcake so firmly entrenched in my memory.

I ordered the 1 lb. fruitcake (along with the 1 lb. date-nut cake), and when both of them came in one small brown box I got concerned. Like others who have ordered, I was a bit taken aback by how small it was. So I took my first bite with full intent of savoring it. It is very dense. It carries its weight in fruits and cake bread: pineapple, cherries, raisins, walnuts, pecans; the cake is lightly sweetened with honey and soaked in 120 proof brandy.The 1 lb. portion (16 oz.) contains 8 servings. Each serving is 2 oz., worth 220 Calories, 80 Fat Calories. Hopefully that gives you an idea of how dense this fruitcake is. It is packed with goodies. For its amount, personally I find it a bit overpriced, but if you can savor every bite, then it's worth it.By the way, I uploaded a photo of the 1 lb. fruitcake in my hand, just to give you a sense of size so you're not surprised when you order and receive it.Would I buy it again? Not immediately. I'd shop around and try other ones just to compare. I may or may not re-purchase, hard to say, but this was definitely worth a try.

column9: This fruit cake is a find
column10: Of all the fruit cakes I have purchased, this is the closest to a home-made fruit cake, so I'm happy! It's packed with fruit and especially glace cherries, so the smallest piece is satisfying. It's not sickly sweet. The cake I bought was only 1lb, which also makes it the smallest cake I've purchased, and on the expensive side, but worth it. Because it is so rich, it packs a punch and will last me quite well. It was delivered in excellent condition.
The best fruitcake ever. Our family has been buying these  as Christmas traditon for over 25 years! I am continuing the traditon!
This fruitcake will dispel your old ideas that fruitcake is dry and distasteful! It is delicious---all it is advertised to be!

I've just received this Fruitcake & already tasted,to my expertise:at first-way too much sweet, secondly-the cherries are with  artificially enhanced flavor & color  has spoiled the taste of fruitcake, I would recommend for this fruitcake recipe less-less sugar,naturally dried cherries and some green pistachio for highlighting taste & color! I must admit the packaging & presentation of this fruitcake are impeccable! prompt shipping from the seller! S.Faleev

I have eaten this fruitcake in other years, and loved it, but I think they sent me a leftover this year. Dry, crumbly and tasteless, I have to admit this one was just plain awful. Luckily, I was able to order one from Assumption Abbey since this one came that met all my expectations and then some. [...]

There are so many artificial ingredients in this it made me ill to read it.  If you can smell the bourbon (which is just above the salt) then you have a better nose than my hound.  If you want sodium benzoate, yellow #5, yellow #6, red #40, blue #1, partially hydrogenated soybean oil, diglycerides, artifical flavor and sodium propionate, this is your fruitcake.  I wish I could send you mine.  The flavor was very disappointing but what can you expect with all those chemical.  They need to let the nuns make the cake.  I think the monestary part is just a ploy.

It's my fault for not looking to see the dimensions, but I just assumed that it would be a standard fruitcake size. When it arrived I was shocked to see how small it was. Lesson learned. I have no idea how it tasted because it was a gift. But overpriced for such a small fruitcake.

Being one of only six people in the world that eat and likes fruit cake, I was disappointed in this product. It has alot of fruit in it but the cake is dry and crumbly. My wife who hates fruit cake likes it, does this tell the story?

column9: The best fruitcake money can buy IMO
column10: I have tasted fruitcakes from several manufacturers in the United States. The Trappist Abbey Monastery Fruitcake is the best. It is small in size but it is a dense quality content. The sweetness is just right. It is extremely rich composed of quality nuts and fruits. Unlike other fruitcakes it does not leave behind a sticky sugary ooze. The bite is soft yet it has a mild crunch to it. Size for size compared to other fruitcakes this one is pricey. You get what you pay for. When I feel the urge again I will order the Trappist Abbey Monastery Fruitcake.

column9: Wonderful, old-fashioned dark fruitcake from Trappist Abbey
column10: I have been buying this wonderful, traditional fruitcake from the Trappist Abbey for many years now. My family used to make a fantastic fruitcake until my grandmother, mother and aunts got too old to continue. The Trappist Abbey fruitcake comes the closest to the taste of my family's old recipe cake.I have served this fruitcake to guests who loved it. Even my son thinks it is wonderful and always looks forward to receiving one as a gift. I also have given it as a gift to friends who remember the old-fashioned fruitcakes.The Trappist Abbey is a dark, moist fruitcake stuffed with fruit and nuts. You can wrap it in cheesecloth and give it a drink of brandy, bourbon, or rum if you want, but that certainly is not a necessity.I recommend this brand wholeheartedly and I plan on sending in this year's order shortly.

These are so awesome that you can eat them all year long, not just the holidays. Also, their "Fratters" are to die for. Move over chocolate lovers. These are fruit cake slices dipped in chocolate!!! So yummy!!
This cake was very good, I would recommend it to any who likes fruit cake.  Even non eaters will will be rewarded if they will try it.

The review must be 20 words long, so can I say "yum..", 20 times?  Seriously, the one lb package is small but the food is so rich, that for me, it makes 16 1-oz servings. Very rich but not too sweet.  I served it for dessert after Christmas eve mass with a good Irish grass-feed cheddar (KerryGold) and a white wine that goes well with sweetish things. Excellent!

I was very happy with the product, I wish I had brought two of them because it did not last very long with my family helping me enjoy it. And this was from people who claimed not to like fruitcake. If you like old fashioned drak fruitcake than this is the one for you!! Will order again before Christmas because it was so good!!!
This is the closest I have found to the one my grandmother made each year.  It is dense with fruit and nuts with just enough batter to hold it together.

When I opened the medium sized packing box I found a fruitcake about the size of a 3x3x3"cube.  I first burst out laughing at the size and then I looked at the product box as this wasn't what I expected a pound fruitcake to look like!  It's very dense, with lots of nuts and moist fruit, but it is a bit difficult to cut in spots.  I've loved fruitcake for over 50 years, but I think fruitcake is very subjective, just like pizza.  I wouldn't order it again as I like mine with less densely packed nuts.  There's nothing wrong with the taste, and it does have more delicious cherries in it than most cakes.
the cake when received was fresh and moist.My wife absolutly love it and said she had never had any better,fact is she has ordered more and is planing to give as gifts next xmas

A friend actually lamented that it had been a long time since they enjoyed a good piece of fruitcake so I ordered this as a gift.  Their review was that it was perfect -- good flavor, right density, etc.
It is the most delicious fruitcake I've had in 50 years, my aunt to whom I also sent this fruitcake loved it... Thank you

It's a good thing I ordered the small one because if I had ordered the large I would have eaten it all myself.The fruitcake was moist, flavorful, nice balance of fruit and nuts. Not too much of the candied cherries. I really enjoyed it and would order it again
I bought this for a gift for a Fruit cake lover. It has a lot of fruit and soaked well in alcohol. It apparently is not a fruit cake with a lot of cake.

Having been reared in a family with a tradition of fruitcake made from scratch (and soaked with brandy) it has been many years since I have had fruitcake simply because I did not care for the occassional foray into commercially made fruitcake.  But lately I have had a craving for a really good fruitcake and decided to try Amazon in this quest. Happily, the fruitcake did not disappoint. Made with care and quality, side benefits included fairly low calories (compared to others), high fiber and a satisfying taste experience. Thank you Amazon.
I've been a fruitcake fan all my life, and this one is the BEST I've ever tasted! A great treat. A real pleasure.

column9: not the best ever year i must have fruitcake this looked good but dry stale like not much flavor not
column10: not the best i am disappointed very dry not  tasty sorry but i won't be buying from them again. first time i have eaten fruitcake i don't like i love fruitcake every Christmas very disappointed

This a great fruitcake. Let me start off by saying im not a huge fan of fruitcakes. The first thing I noticed was this fruitcake was TINY!!! I was shocked, I will never buy one again for this price. It was about 4"x4" on the large side.  It fits neatly into the palm of my hand. It has a nice red cherry in the middle with some pecans arranged to point to it from each corner, clearly an attempt at a design.The fruitcake itself is delicious, it is a dark, dense, and moist cake. It is dominated by nuts, but not overpoweringly so. It has a great flavor of brandy, spice, and cinnamon. It was like eating a pumpkin cake mixed with cinnamon rum raisin bread pudding in flavor. It had just enough fruit to provide it with a nice little burst of refreshing juiciness in the midst of the spiced flavor, walnuts, and pecans.If price is not an issue and youre just looking to get a good fruitcake, go no further, or if you dont mind spending the money just once to try it, go ahead. Im glad I bought this as it really was a delicious treat, but I will not be able to get it again until I have a little more cash on hand. They would make great gifts though due to their "fun" size.Pros:DeliciousCons:TINY, should be like 7-8 bucks.Taste: 9.5/10Appearance: 7/10Value: 4/10Gift Power: 8/10 (If they like fruitcakes)

I have been  buying and eating fruitcakes for 70 years and nobody comes close to yours.  You folks are the fruitcakes KING OF THE WORLD.  For heavens sake, don't ever change the recipe.  Don't know how you make them so moist. I suspect it that soaking in brandy you put them through.  I was a little worried that I wouldn't be able to drive a car after eating a piece of your cake, but I made it home with only one eye working.  I just ordered a three pounder for Christmas, and if it goes as quick as the two pounder we just finished i'm sure I will be back at the trough.  Lt.Col. Von Freeman  US Army Retired

For years I have looked for a "store-bought" fruitcake that lived up to the ones made by my mother and grandmother when I was young.  This is it!  My only regret is that I didn't get to lick the bowl after they poured the batter into the pan.

column9: Delicious fruitcake, and very quick shipping!
column10: I bought my mother a fruitcake from the Trappist Monks for her birthday this year. Yes, we're among the apparent minority that loves fruitcake. The cake arrived in very secure packaging right away - within 3 days during the week between Christmas and New Year's! I asked her if I could have a bite sometime, but she ate it all herself. I take that as two thumbs up for the flavor. She did say the cake was moist and delicious and thanked me many times. I should have ordered two. This will likely become a birthday tradition in years to come.

column9: More than Cake More than Fruit
column10: The Tappist Abbey Monks, know how to put together a Fruitcake that is over the top.They use only Fresh ingredients, such as Oregons finest nuts and fruit, then they top it off with the very best Brandy and let it soak to give it an unmistaken tast.  I love it and would recommend it to anyone iven if you don't like fruitcake, you will love this one.

column9: Some objectionable ingredients for health consious individuals.
column10: Expected something different. Unable to view entire ingredients before ordering, something I always do. I took a chance ordering because of the name, thinking that the use of the product name "Trappist Monks" would not put ingredients detrimental to health in the product. I am health consious and oppose partially hydrogenated vegetable oil and high fructose corn syrup. If you have no objection to these ingredients, than I guess the product is O.K. I personally would not purchase again.

I agree with one of the previous reviewers. The fruitcake looks good and seems to be mostly fruit and very little "cake", but all those preservatives!!! Besides the long list of preservatives, there really isn't any flavor to the cake itself. All one tastes are the fruits. The price I paid for this little tiny square of it was outrageous! Do yourselves a favor and get the fruitcake from the Assumption Abbey Monks. The cake has a delicious flavor having been soaked in liquer and it doesn't skimp on the fruits either!

column9: Not pleased with cake/Took 19 days to arrive
column10: I ordered this and I got confirmation they sent my fruitcake to my PO Box via UPS.  Which of course, can't be done!!  My fruitcake arrived 19 days later.  It was vacuum sealed.  It was not moist.  It was as heavy as a brick and very tiny like half a brick.  Careful around small feet and pets.  As I was trying it...I was also reading the ingredients on the back.  Horrifying....They say "fresh" but the ingredients list says mono & diglycerides 2 times, artificial flavor 3 times (one is artificial butter), partially hydrogentated oil, many preservatives including Sulfur Dioxide, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Benzoate of Soda and also something called Gum Tragacanth.  I always knew the candied fruit in fruit cake may not be naturally dried fruit, but I prefer that the rest of the cake is truly fresh.  I tried this `cause it came in a small size and was less expensive, but normally I get the Assumption Abbey Trappist Monk (Missouri Ozarks) cake, which only comes in one size, but does also have 4 stars on Amazon reviews.  It's ingredients list was much less of a shocker.  It is very very moist, you can taste more remnants of the  rum (but not boozy - my kids like too).

The fruitcake I ordered honestly tasted bad. The cake looked burnt on the outside and tasted that way too. The fruit on the inside ( i think it was fruit) was black .It was very disappointing this is the first time i bought this type of fruitcake i might of just had bad luck, but i wont be trying it again.
I found the cake to be very dry. I was disappointed with the taste.  I wouldnt buy it again.

I LOVE fruitcake and actually asked for a good one as a Christmas present.  Boy, was I disappointed!  It was dry(stale) and flavorless, with only a bland piece of pineapple or cherry here or there with mostly nuts.  I believe fruitcake should be mostly fruit, otherwise it should be called nutcake.  Plus, there were no citron or any kind of citrus pieces to liven it up (though they probably would have no flavor even if they were there).  I'm glad I received this, though, because I've always dreamed about it, so now I know.  I guess next year I'll have to content myself with Entemann's -- it's doughy and way too sweet, but at least it's fresh and has that "fruitcake" flavor.
Wow.  This was really, really small.  I was kind of embarrased as this was a gift.  It may taste fine (no feedback on that yet) but I'd sure opt for something bigger next time.

column9: Unreadable ingredients - PLUS - High Fructose Corn Syrup
column10: Somehow a fruitcake called Trappist Abby sounded "pure" to me soI didn't check ingredients - mia culpa. After attempting toread them, I at least recognized "high fructose corn syrup" Thedisappointing taste of this fruitcake led me to consider the contents so,finding them less than pure, I pitched it.

column9: No Wonder people wont eat fruitcake!
column10: I have been experimenting and buying fruitcakes on line from some reputable sellers.  This arrived the other day.  I paid $15 for a 3x3 square and it is THE WORST FRUITCAKE I'VE EVER EATED!  Where is the fruit?????  IT is more like a nutty drier health food bread.  And there was no taste of bourbon or anything alcohol as said in description.No doubt about it..............This is TERRIBLE!  Fruitcakers BEWARE!
Best coffee in town!  The aroma & flavor are wonderful.Would like to order ASAP but it's not in stock. Please alert me when available.thanks!

I love sardines--especially skinless and boneless.  I have tried other brands, but Cole's is the best.  Not too salty or oily tasting.  I also like knowing where the fish I eat comes from.  Worth the higher price.  I plan to purchase again.
Big, flavorful and nutritious! A dab of mayo and some salty crackers andI'm good to go! Great for camping, hunting and long car trips!

If you think all sardines are the same, you are going to be in for some surprise.  Cole's products and these sardines in particular are simply delicious.  They are packaged in a wonderful olive oil, boneless and fantastic.  I am a big fan. column9: Sugar Free cookies are a joke
column10: So many people, usually diabetics, buy sugar free cookies/snacks "because they can't have sugar".  These may not have sugar, but they have sugar alcohols which DO affect blood sugar, and they're mostly white flour which gets turned into glucose quickly.  These cookies have more calories and more carbs per biscuit than the regular ones!  The regular ones are actually not bad in the carb/sugar department (3g total carb per biscuit, 1.6g is sugar) and you don't have to worry about unpleasant gastric side effects from sugar alcohols.If you're thinking of buying these because you're diabetic, do yourself a favor and get the regular kind and account for the carbs which will be LESS than the sugar free ones.  Unless you're going to be a total pig and eat the entire package it won't make a difference.  I have Type 1 diabetes and count carbs, and I take the appropriate amount of insulin for however many biscuits I'm going to eat.  The regular Kedem biscuits are fantastic with a hot cup of tea, and you couldn't pay me to eat the sugar free kind which would affect my blood sugar even more than the regular ones.Oh, and the sugar free biscuits are more than twice the price of the regular ones.

column9: Pretty healthy, but not a low sugar product
column10: Now, one of the reviewers of this product complained about the sugar content of this cereal by only looking at the ingredients list, which is not how to determine the nutritional value of any product (especially when the reviewer cannot distinguish between nutritive and non-nutritive ingredients). This cereal has just as many simple sugars as Frosted Flakes, but the cereal does not claim to be low in sugar. What's important about this cereal is that it offers quite a bit of fiber and vitamins/minerals (not as much as some cereals, but since I have no deficiencies in this area, I didn't mind). Also, it only has 3 times the salt of a half cup of milk which is not LOADED. A can of healthy choice soup, now that is loaded with salt.Now, I chose this cereal as a replacement for Frosted Flakes/Honey Nut Cheerios, which against my better judgment I continued to have every morning. I should point out that I don't drink coffee in the mornings and I don't drink soda (less than 1 a week on average). I also eat no sweets.  Simple sugars (listed as just "Sugars" on the nutrition label) seem to be treated like carcinogens, while most people don't realize that aspartame (artificial sweetener in most diet sodas) really is one. If your diet is already low in sugar and you feel confident you can burn through those sugars pretty quick (since I don't drink caffeinated drinks, I need that jolt in the morning), then this is a good choice. If your diet already has quite a bit of sugar or your doctor tells you to cut down on simple sugars (or you also have a couple of cups of caffeinated coffee with sugar every morning), then go with another bran cereal without the oat clusters and syrups (which I really do not like that much). Also, if you are concerned about the total carbs, please note that a normal 2000 calories diet would include about 300g of carbohydrates (so yes, high protein diets contradict  this).Since taste is completely subjective, I won't put much emphasis on it. In my opinion, it tastes pretty good (but I don't consume many sweets during the day).

column9: Goodbye Rawhides! Hello Peace of Mind - & Dogs Love 'em!
column10: Love these! I actually straddled her back, attempting the only thing I  knew how to do - the human Heimlich Maneuver! Like where exactly is a dog's sternum, anyway? Well, I tried anyway and thank God it finally did dislodge & we got it out! Was it the Heimlich? I don't know. Probably not. I mean, she still won't tell me... After all, I guess it was very traumatic for her.But in all seriousness, what I do know, is that was the last time any of my dogs have had any kind of regular rawhide bones! Which, I really wanted to let everyone know of my personal experiences; I believe anybody who is at all concerned about giving their dogs rawhides and/or experiencing a similar problem is on the right track to avoid them.Our small part Chihuawa/part something else, first 2 times in-a-row, threw up repeatedly w/rawhide pieces and w/foam. He was VERY sick the 3rd time, so we definitely stopped that! The ONLY kind I did finally take a chance with were granulated rawhide munchy sticks, & they're all fine w/these; though I'm still nervous about them choking on a piece, but neither of them have had any problems with Boodas so far, & they don't swell up in their throats like regular rawhides.So, now... It's Booda Bones!Yes, they are a bit on the pricey side, especially for my 2 larger aggressive chewers. I agree with some other reviewers that they are not very long-lasting. LOL] comment, with some editing).

Smoke point of cold-pressed Avocado oil is about 375 degrees F. Only the *Refined* avocado oil has a smoke point of about 490'F-520'F. A lot of the flavor is removed in refining, usually resulting in a bland taste. Cold-pressed oil can be refined.

column9: Nothing but the Best Fir My Cat
column10: This is the greatest food I have ever found for my cat. He's old and not in the best of health, but since I switched him to this diet he has had an incredible change in his health. His diabetes has reversed  itself, and his kidney functions have become normal again. He will continue to live many more healthier years. And, he loves the food!

we have 4 cats all of varying weight and this food was well-tolerated with minimla vomiting upon change to this new food. The cats like it, and their overall healthiness and shiny coats reflect the good quality nutrition provided. We would buy again.

This organic onion powder is fabulous. I use it in EVERYTHING! You can purchase really inexpensive onion powder at your grocery store, but it costs like only 50 cents, so you have to wonder how it's made. But this is delicious in stews, soups, sprinkled on grilled meats, salads, etc. I love it!!!

I love Frontier Brand/Simply Organic Spices. These spices are fresh & pure. This spice diffinitely adds just what is needed to make yummy foods for my family & me. I buy different kinds of Frontier spices/Simply Organic spices from Amazon-they have the best prices!

I am not a big fan of dry substitutes for fresh ingredients, however, I make an exception with this item.ProsOrganic!!Dry so keeps wellGreat for fried chicken, rubs, salad dressings and other similar recipesTastes and smells greatCons??

With more and more news coming out about our foods and spices being adulterated with chemicals and pesticides, the wife and I have been doing a lot more shopping for organic foods and spices. Amazon.com is one of my favorite places to shop for just about anything and when I started looking for organic spices, Amazon.com did not disappoint.The Simply Organic brand has several items available on Amazon.com and so I bought some of the onion powder and also some of the garlic powder. Because it comes in a 3-pack, I shared a bottle with each of our kids after they arrived.The bottles are big enough to last a while and the price is right. The quality appears to be superb and you can't go wrong with any organic food item. If you are an Amazon Prime member, you get free shipping on top of it. I will buy this brand again when I run out.

I use herbs and spices liberally on all my food.  Simply Onion offers the right-sized jar (2 ounces) for people who use onion powder as often as I do.  In addition, the bargain price comes in when they package 3 jars at a time.  I know larger sizes of spices are available, but if they aren't used frequently, they do go stale.  The taste of Simply Organic Onion is great and three 2-oz. jars help keep it that way. Can't beat it for the price.
The apricots appeared home grown,and taste quite good - not overly dried or moist, just the right amount of drying. Have bought from them twice and pleased with the product both times.
The fruit came fast, fresh and delicious. We enjoyed the different types of fruit.
Southern Fruit Sensation - Loose Leaf Black and Green Tea -2 oz has a mild flavor.  Enjoyable tea for any occasion.
I am not an expert on gogi berries. I use these every day, so I ordered in bulk. They are on the smaller/dry side of the equation, but still chewy enough to eat out of hand.

My husband is on this chewy spree kick.  I started buying this 2 pound bag for him, but he just breezed right though it & wanted more.  These are very hard to find in our rural area, so glad nothing is out of reach with Amazon!
My order was damaged during shipping, and they personally called me to correct the order and even threw me is a surprise:) I have never had better service anywhere.. these people are A++
Very happy! Shipped as quick as possible. Candy was fresh and delicious. Already about half gone, will be ordering again soon!
These are really good cookies. They are a little bit soft, and a little crispy around the edges. One serving is  five cookies = 120 calories. It seems like a lot of cookies.

column9: Simply Put The Best BBQ ever made.
column10: Seriously. Its the best BBQ ever made. I have tried many. Kraft, Jack Daniels, Bullseye, even restaurant bbqs, etc. Those are all cheaply made, poorly executed BBQ products. Yet one among the shelve stands out. I picked up World Harbors Sticky Rum BBQ and was delighted to find out just how amazing it tastes. Its all natural as well with no gluten, just wheat and soy. They also have many other flavors as well ranging from Apple BBQ to Mango and regular BBQ. Sticky Rum however is just amazing..and it goes with everything from chicken, beef, mash potatoes, french fries you name it. Simply the best. It's mouthwatering, smoky and sweet and I hope they continue to make it.

This sauce on initial taste was questionable because of the strong rum flavor, but once I started cooking with it and the sauce had a chance to caramelize it had a pretty decent flavor to it. I would not say this is the best BBQ sauce I have ever had but it does deserve three stars.
I love this barbecue sauce!  I cannot find it in the stores here any more, so I am happy to be able to order it through Amazon!

column9: 4 year old boy says, "I really love it!"
column10: Background: My sons (ages 2 and 4) are picky eaters. Very. So in order to get them to eat their veggies, I serve these cold and call them smoothies.My 4 year old says of this flavor, "It's my favorite. I really love it. It's really yummy."Some of the reviewers has mentioned not liking that the spout is on the corner instead of the top. I asked my son if he minds and he said, "It's very cool"Also, some complaints were made about them breaking open in transit.  The packages I got were sent from the company to family in Texas and then forwarded on to my APO address (literally across the world) and all of them arrived intact.  I'm thinking the packaging problem is with Amazon.I love that they're organic and my sons think they're delicious!I only wish Amazon offered them at a better price. And shipped them to APO.

column9: Decent but leaked as other review.
column10: My son likes this just fine.  But we also had two packages out of the 12 leak during shipment so had to clean up all the other packs and throw those two away.  Luckily I got these super cheap or else I would have complained.

column9: Hard for toddler to use; taste isn't great
column10: I only bought one package of these, since they were on sale for very cheap.  We go through 2 fruit and veggie pouches every day, so I'm always on the lookout for a deal.A few of the pouches actually leaked all over the inside of the box, so there was a huge sticky mess and several had to be thrown away.As for the non-leaky ones, we had two problems:(1) The placement of the spout.  All the other pouches have a spout at the top, and that's what my toddler is used to.  He had a hard time eating out of this one, with the spout on the corner.  I'm not sure why they did that, but it's not working for toddler self-feeding.(2) The taste.  My 21-month-old son LOVES fruit and veggie pouches.  He will eat pretty much anything in pouch form, from broccoli to spinach to green beans.  These, however, he did not like.  He would only eat about half of it before he would give it back to me, refusing to eat more.  That tells me that either the packaging or the ingredients are inferior.Bottom line: we will not be purchasing these again.

Original review: This is a good quality product and a great value, but the bag I got was a little stale. When I open the packages of other brands, I get a noseful of fresh peppermint aroma and that is missing here. Davidson needs to use  more sophisticated packaging to keep it fresh. How about something similar to the bags coffee comes in, instead of a paper bag with a folded over top?Update April 2011: Davidson's has upgraded their packaging to a zip-top bag with a foil barrier, and the difference is amazing: intense peppermint aroma and rich flavor. Excellent.

column9: There is no peppermint smell or taste
column10: I've got this herb a month ago and checked it for a smell - there was some (not very sharp) when rubbed between fingers. I'd poured a week's worth of use, and close the rest of package tightly, but smell/taste is gone by now completely. I don't know why is it - I have used herbs for a long time, never had this experience. It is dissappointing - it was too good to be true thing.

The price on this is pretty good, but it seems the adage of "you get what you pay for" is also true. There is only the most mild smell of peppermint when you open the bag, and crushing some between your fingers doesn't release any additional scent. I've tried several brewing methods, and the peppermint taste is weak even with steeping it a long time. The only way to get a cup that approaches a decent flavor is to use a lot (couple of tablespoons) for a brew. Still, even with using a lot per cup, the taste is more grassy than minty.I really enjoy peppermint tea, and often add it to black teas to temper their strong flavor. While the price on this bag was great, I won't be buying it again - way too weak. There are several other brands out there that cost a bit more, but are a far better value.

column9: No taste, no smell, more like oregano
column10: Don't waste your money!I drink only peppermint tea and by now I became an expert in it. This is NOT peppermint or anything close to it. I get more flavor from the cheapest tea in the supermarket. The leaves are crushed too small and they smell like grass or weak oregano. No taste, except for some bitterness (grass?). I am trying to see how to return it. OOOPPPSS can't return it. I will give it to my cow : )

A little goes a long way with this superb aromatic peppermint. I enjoy adding it to my green tea while brewing and avoid adding sweetener as a delicious ice tea or hot tea. I brew two pitchers, store them in my fridge, and either drink it cold or zap it in the microwave for a hot tea. I find this tea a super deal.

column9: Ten months since purchase-STILL GOING STRONG!
column10: The packaging for this tea is now GREAT!! BUT, since there had been complaints of it loosing its flavor, I have stored them in glass jars in the very back of my kitchen cabinet. As soon as they are opened the rich aroma is abundant. We have been drinking this tea by the gallon for the last several months. It has helped my family with head congestion which is just another positive as we drink it because of the flavor. This is a GREAT price and a great tea--would recommend to anyone. You can perhaps now keep it in the foil lined bag--but I just wanted to be on the safe side. Glass does not absorb odor--thus I felt it put in a dark place would do the trick-and it did. I WILL be buying this again until I can get a VERY large plant to grow--which may never occur! :)
i was really disappointed with this tea, because i expected mroe from loose leaf tea. my wife thinks it smells like marijuana, and i couldn't taste even a hint of mint. total waste of money

column9: Lacking That Fresh Peppermint Taste I Was Looking Forward To :(
column10: Lacking that fresh minty taste. Also, I wish the leaves were not so fine. Tea leaves leak through my my infuser. I will enjoy this bag of peppermint tea but not as much as I was looking forward to since I expected a clean fresh taste.

I ordered this pack 4 months ago. It's huge! If you drink other teas, this supply will last for a year or so. This is also a disadvantage as I can no longer smell the strong aroma of fresh peppermint, feels like it dried a lot since it was delivered. Smaller packages would be better.

couldn't be happier with the price. I've got it in my bulk freezer to keep it fresh and fill up a tupper ware full of tea once a month. probably a half an once or once a month at most. really good tea for the price.
The price on this tea is awesome and it's organic and great tasting to boot. I put this in an airtight container and it lasts for a very long time. I doubt I'll ever go back to tea bags again.
This is my absolute favorite tea. It's very minty but not overwhelming. Good price since it's a big bag. It came packaged very nicely too.

I bought this stuff a while ago--- talking many many months here.  I still have 1/2 bag left.  I use it every so often for guests who are picky about coffee.  The stay fresh bag really works.  It's about 90% as strong as when I first got it.  Decent tea!  I add a bit to cheap bitter coffee to spin up the flavor a bit.  Friends "love" my "coffee."  He he he!  And Yes, I also do the same with my spearmint teas.  :)
This tea is very fresh and has nice flavor. I drink it every day and is very satisfied. Highly recommend!

You don't even need sugar with thisi add it to my mixture of teas and add un fooled around with Lemon/Raspberry and this is so refreshingEasy to stay hydrated especially for elderly who have problems drinking enough fluids and youngsters who don't need anymore sugarYum Yum Yumand the saving of teeth and innards from the effects of sodai have no problems with packaging or freshness always 100%and they ship pretty fastthey know i am thirstyPeace and Grace

Buyer beware.  I drink a lot of peppermint tea and I was looking forward to trying this product.  Unfortunately, while the bag is labeled Peppermint Tea, the product inside is very definitely Spearmint.  The smell and taste are extremely different though evidently the people packaging it can't tell.  It's also not returnable. I will not be purchasing anything further from Davidson's tea.
I buy Dingo treats for several reasons. One, dogs love them, two they don't leave stains and three the price is reasonable. Our Siberian Husky carries her's all over the house.

Good quality product, our two small pooches loved the peanut butter!  They're the perfect treat, not too messy and keep the dogs busy for a good amount of time (their ears pearch up when they hear "Who wants a DINGO??").

Our 3 dogs love Dingo bones.  But these peanut butter flavor bones are an obsession of our smallest rat terrier.  He's only 5 pounds, so bones tend to last several sittings for him.  Give him one of these and he's occupied for as long as it takes to finish.  He'll still play with other bones, but he loses his mind when he sees me go for this bag.  I just wish they were priced as well as the other Dingo products and less difficult to find.

column9: Dog loved it but left a mess
column10: My doberman went nuts over this bone.  He tried to devour it rather quickly.  My only complaint about this bone is that it left a mess on the floor; the red color of the bone rubs onto the floor.  It did wipe up fairly easily.  Just make sure when you give the bone to your dog he's not eating it on a carpeted floor.

I was on a business trip with my husband and we took our poodles along.  I needed treats for the poodles and saw these - figured I had nothing to lose.  WOW, my dogs loved them!  Usually they will hide their treat and try to steal the treat for the other dog, but with these they never left their own.  Amazing - I must buy more!

I have two 70 lb. dogs. One chews on anything but the other chews on almost nothing. Both will immediately attack this bone and have a ball chewing on it. The one dog usually ignores regular rawhide but I didn't have to wait and see with this, he took to it right away. The price fluctuates wildly with these kinds of bones, so watch for a sale. I paid about 3 bucks.

column9: WARNING: Open package received with signs of used product
column10: Just wanted to warn any potential buyers that I received an open package buying from Amazon LLC.  I think that's pretty disgusting since this is a product that's intended for consumption by your pet.  Also, there were portions of the red "meat" that looked like it had been chewed on and the white bone portion was stained red all over.  Basically it looked as if a dog had chewed on it for a little and then repackaged up and sold on Amazon.  Buyer beware.
Out of all of the different bones and treats we've given our dog, these are one of his all time favorites!

I have a labrador retriever. He weighs 82 lbs. He loved the bone, but I made the mistake and allowed him to eat the bone in one sitting. It was too much of a shock to his digestive system.  The next morning he developed diarrhea. I' m not sure if the bone is the reason the diarrhea lasted so long, but to be causious I will not buy the bones again.  To be fare about the product, I bought three of the bones and the last one was the one associated with my dog's problem, but of course that last bone is the only one he eat in one sitting.  I believe the product would be best for larger dog's than mine, or for smaller dog if the owner regulator the amount of the bone that is eaten at each sitting .
The Dingo mini peanut butter bones are a favorite for our 11-year old Yorkie. Be forewarned - she won't eat any other bones any more!

My dog absolutely loves these and he is such a picky eater. I probably tried almost 6 different dog treats but I had to give them away to friends because he wouldn't touch them. These however he will chew up until they're gone. He also likes to hide them and save them for later. He doesn't however like the peanut butter ones.
Our Golden Retriever really loves these. Don't give them to him often and use them for a special treat.
My cairn terrier Daisy loves these basted bones. Having troublefinding them in retail. I hope its not a sign that the productis discontinued. She also likes the peanut butter basted flavor.
Ok, It lasted about 1hr. My dog ate it in 1hr so i would say he enjoyed it. I never tasted it myself but i guess it was good.
This food is remarkable in too many ways to put here in the review. Try it you won't be sorry.

My boxer loves these treats. They are great because you can break them into several different pieces and fit them into different sized toys. Big bag has a lot of treats in them so it should last awhile. They are dry so they tend to crumble pretty easily but nothing the little furry vacuums cant pick up.

column9: Can't make them this good at home!!
column10: I'm very particular about what I feed my dogs. I often make my own "canned/wet" food and treats at home to ensure the quality and safety of the food I'm feeding my dogs. After looking at the ingredients in these biscuits and checking out the price when purchased in the 12 pound box, I realized I could not make biscuits of this quality at home for this price. My dogs really love these biscuits, and I feel good about the quality of this product. I also love that I can divide these biscuits into various sizes, as I have dogs that range from 6 lbs to 130 lbs. Even with 5 dogs this 12 lb box lasts a long time, and it is packaged in 3 heavy zipper bags, so you don't open all 12 lbs at once and they stay fresh. I would recommend these to anyone who cares about what they feed their dogs.

column9: Good for dogs on raw diet
column10: My doggies eagerly look forward to their 'Biscuits' every day.  We feed raw turkey and chicken and these are used as a treat.  Getting them from Amazon is the most economical way for us and they are not all broken like boxes we have picked up from pet stores.

I have 2 dogs a Golden and a black lab pup 9 months that love these biscuits, you can break them into 4 or 8 pieces just turn them upside down to the cut to snap them. The girls love them so much that I've taken to breaking them in half after there snapped into 4 pieces so they don't gain weight

I have known for a long time that Canidae is a great product, and is not usually sold in stores, so when I saw these biscuits on the Amazon website, I immediately ordered them.  I have two Eskies (miniature American Eskimo Dogs) so I had to have enough for both of them.  This is a big package, so it was definitely enough.  Canidae is so highly rated for both dry and "wet" food that I didn't have to worry about these biscuits containing anything that might not be good for my Girls.It has "Balanced Omega 6 & 3 Fatty Acids" and they are advertised to help control tartar and plaque.  Can't speak to that yet (neither has had a dental for a year) but I do know they love them.  It's a single biscuit that can be snapped into 4 separate pieces.  My Girls, both under 26 pounds, receive 2 half-pieces in the mid-afternoon (that's 1 biscuit broken into 2 pieces) and although one of them trots off with her half-piece as soon as she gets it, the other stands right where she is and crunches down the first half-piece and looks for the next one (just about demands it!).As the package ran low I knew I had to have more for them, and so re-ordered from Amazon.  Another package duly arrived, before the first one ran out, for which I was thankful.  And so were The Girls!

The Canidae Dog Treats, Lamb and Rice flavor, is the best treats for my dogs.  I have been feeding these treats to my dogs for years, and they are still the best.  They are snap biscuits so I can regulate how much I give them at a time, and guard against weight gain.  I use the Lamb and Rice because one of my dogs has an allegery to chicken and wheat.  I have never had a problem with Canidae Dog Treats, as they are healthy and safe to feed my dogs. I have been feeding the Canidae Dog Treats for well over 20 years and I plan on continuing to do so as long as I can still get the 12 pound box, as I have Big Boys to feed.
great dog biscuits. not super easy to break apart, but easier than most. dogs love them. they smell great too!
While I do think these treats are healthy and nutritious, they are on the large size. I generally break them in to 4 pieces (the biscuit itself is scored), and then break them again for the treat.

The Canidae dog treats has been well received by my 1 year old Presa Canarios.  The "snap" configuration of the treat works great since you can break off as much or as little as you want.  I liked the nutritional content of the treats.  So many times the dogs may love the treats but they are not the healthiest for them.  These treats are good for them and they love them.....  I have switched my dogs to the Canidae dog food as well.....

I have been buying these Canidae treats for a while now for my dogs.  I feed them the same formula Canidae kibble and canned food, so these treats fit in well with their diet - no worry about upset tummies.  They smell kind of nice too, almost like cinnamon.  There is usually a good amount of crumbs at the bottom of the bag which I just sprinkle in their food bowls at dinner time.  I'll continue to buy these for my dogs for as long as they make them.

I have fed Canidae All Life Stages food for several years to my mixed dog collection, with great results, but for some reason, had not offered the Snap Biscuits.  Finally, I purchased a bag and offered them up.  Well, they must taste treat-like because they gobble them up, and have evidenced no digestive upsets.  Safe and tasty is the verdict.  My test group is aged two years through 10 years, size eight to twenty-five pounds, in generally good health.

column9: Great Value, A Little Broken Up
column10: I was looking for a bulk price bargain on my preferred premium dog biscuit for my two Vizslas & this definitely met that criteria. Canidae's Snap Biscuits always have some bits and pieces in the bottom of the bag, which is understandable since the biscuit is a snap variety. I was afraid the larger quantity might mean more waste & I was right. There were three (3) plastic 4# bags in a large single cardboard box to comprise the 12#, so they must shuffle a bit & in the end the amount of tiny bits & powdery crumbs in the bottom of each bag was a significant amount of waste. Though I'm sure I could use the wasted crumbs in their food bowl, I am very careful to watch their food intake at meal time.I love the nutrition & quality of Canidae's Lamb & Brown Rice Snap Biscuits, but I will likely stick with the single 4# units in the future, which are packed in individual bags.

I decided to try these treats because the reviews were so good and the price was great. That and the fact it is such a well known brand I had high expectations.  I have a 10 month old Weimaraner that I thought would love them, however he rates it a 2 star. I was hoping he would be a little more excited about them. They are a larger treat so I break them up into smaller pieces. They also have good things in them.  Most of the time he will eat the treat. Others times he will take it and then drop it in the living room and come back to it later. I will not be getting them again.
chips cousin teddy eats canidae dog food and treats. chip only likes the treats. i like the idea that he is getting his 'greens'

These are one my favorite kind of Sun Chips. They have a zesty taste that is not too sharp or bland, with just the right "kick",  and a nice crisp texture. While these are not a health food, their sodium and fat content is much better than other snack foods. These chips work really well with a dip and vegetables for a pre-dinner snack.Shop for price. The price printed on the 10.5 oz bag that I buy at my local supermarket is $3.79 (and I pay less on sale), so the price on Amazon is higher than the manufacturer's suggested retail price.

I love this tea... I love it so much I consume pounds of it annually.  2 years ago I was diagnosed with Stage 4 Non-Hodgkins Lymphoma.  I'm convinced green tea has been an essential part of my recovery :)

I love the taste and it is so easy carrying it around with me at school, now i can enjoy my favorite drink. I bought it because anna nicole smith loved these drinks and we do not have them in new zealand so I bought a box and they are great. thanks. please keep them on amazon!! they are awesome.
THis stuff is awesome. I mailed it to my husband in Pakistan and he loves it.
I bought this for my daughter. And, she liked this nesquick a lot. Ha ha ha. Also, It is cheaper than walmart. Thank you.
The product was received in a very timely manner and was as described.  I would order again from this individual.

Absolutely love Maxim Instant Coffee!It has the perfect mixture of cream, sugar, and coffee.If your in for a creamer or sweeter mood just add a bit extra of what you want to your cup and it is amazing!!I love the single packets and can take them with me anywhere for a great coffee break!A+++++++++

A friend who has gone to Korea gave me a couple packs to try. I found that it was much smoother and less bitter than US instant coffee, but also thought it was a little weak. I used a regular-sized coffee cup, so perhaps it's larger than the ones they use in Korea? Will try my next pack using a smaller cup size to see how that changes it. I normally use Sweet-n-Low in my drinks, and would prefer to do that in this, as well, to save on the calories, but for a quick coffee when my Kureg isn't available, it's pretty good.
We did not know that this item came with cream already in it. My husband likes it better without the cream. Other than that it is good.

column9: This white truffle salt smells good but I wonder if it is a natural flavor or not?
column10: I love truffle flavor salt. I have used a couple of different brands of black truffle salt that have been quite good. The salt has been mixed with little black truffle bits that are very visible.I came across this white truffle salt and thought I would try it. I must admit, it smells like truffles but I don't see any truffle bits in the salt. That made me wonder whether there is real truffle in this salt, or if it is a chemical concoction. All the label says is "Italian White Truffle Flavoring." No where does it say it is natural flavoring. This is quite expensive salt and understandable if it is made from real white truffles. But if it isn't, ???Until this question is settled, I would recommend caution in the purchase of this product.

I wanted to get this food because the price is more reasonable as compared to my cat's normal food, Science Diet Indoor Formula. I bought a small bag to try it out, and I'm glad I did, because I'm not buying it again for the fact that it makes my cat's poo ridiculously smelly! Even though I clean the litterbox near daily, wipe it down with cleaning wipes, use sanitizing spray on it, and have an air purifier clsoe to it, I can STILL smell when he has gone to the bathroom. The cleaning combination was effective when he was on Science Diet.If it doesn't make your cat's poop smell something fierce, then this is a great deal. The product has good, all natural ingredients, and is inexpensive compared to the other brands.

column9: OMG, this stuff is so good!
column10: If you like Asian food, and you like it HOT, this is just the ticket for you.Also good in curries and cajun dishes. I know the Amazon listing says thisstuff is "unavailable", but this seller has this offered for $0.89, and thatis what we call a BARGOON! Sells locally here for around $3.Use it to stir fry shrimp, chicken, or beef, or just use it like you would anycondiment like salsa or Tabasco sauce. Amazing flavor, and trust me, this stuffis hot. About a 7 on a scale of 10. Tremendous garlic and hot chili flavor, willmake you discover cooking all over again! This will perk up any Chinese takeout,and its even good in Hot n' Sour Soup! Its very thick, almost like a paste so alittle bit goes a long way. 5 PodsBTW, this is actually the Huy Fong product you'll find elsewhere on Amazon. Its thesame stuff.

column9: 5 stars just for the customer service alone
column10: Great customer service. Sent me a new bowl and lid when mine was faulty with no questions asked.I love the baby cook- I cook all my baby's food as well as most of the dinners for my husband and myself! It makes great creamed potatoes! I love that you don't loose any nutrients from the steam process- you just blend the food in it's own steam juices!I have used mine every day for well over two months- as i said, for both the baby and my own food, and we have not had any problems with limescale or build up.

I love the Baby Beaba!  Yes, you can save yourself $150 and do the same thing with your steamer & food processor, but there's something to be said for the convenience of this product.  Compact and steams/purees all in the same appliance.  In fact, it's small enought that I leave it sitting on my kitchen counter.  If it weren't for this product, I probably would resort to the premade, store bought baby food, because who really has time to lug out bulky pots & the food processor????  Worth spending the extra money!

We love this product. Granted, you can steam vegitables in a pot and puree them in a blender but the combined function in the maker along with the built in "no-guessing" measurment, makes it simple to use, convenient and easy clean up. We pour the puree into icecube trays and defrost two cubes per feeding, mixing flavors is so easy. We also prefer the cheaper individual storage containers with green lids vs. the beaba product. Bottom line, this product makes providing quality food easy.

This item is awesome!!!! I have three daughters and I don't feel like making baby food consumes all my time. It so simple to use and clean and requires little effort.  It also has a simple step by step booklet so anybody can use it!!!  I also bought the top 100 baby foods book and I am loving making my 5 month old food.  I would recommend this product to anyone who wants to make their baby's food from scratch....VERY EASY TO USE!!!!!!
This is a great product and easy to use.  You just steam your food and process in one.  Less to wash and great time saver.  You can prepare a weeks worth of food in one hour.

I LOVED the Beaba the first two months I had it. I used it about twice a week for cooking food to store and twice daily for warming meals. After four months of use, the switch that engages at the top (safety feature) won't stay engaged, so I have to twist the top aggressively several times to get the machine to turn on - whether cooking or puree mode. So that's my first major disappointment.Second, the quality of the plastic doesn't seem to withstand the temperature of the steam, so the base of the main container has several cracks and leaks at the bottom. I am concerned about the plastic too - given how the steam is damaging it, I feel this may be one of those plastic that we are warned against heating foods in.For the price, I don't feel this product is worth it. Better to use a crock pot or food steamer and a Cuisinart.

This product is so great to have.  It makes fresh baby food in no time and clean-up is quick and easy.  Blade easily comes out of mixing cup for cleaning.  Blender is powerful and purees in seconds.  The only con is the size of the mixing cup.  For an average size sweet potato, I can only cook/puree half of it at a time.  Other than that, it's perfect.  I would highly recommend this product.

Since I bought this product, my life has become so much easier. What is more important is my 9 month old girl loves food I make with it. Thanks to Beaba Babycook, my baby eats so well. I am so happy now that my baby girl looks and is healthier now, since I started using this product. The jar as well as blade are easy clean and durable.Pro: convenient and easy to make multiple meals (wash/peal, dump, steam, grind, and serve),  easy to clean, dishwasher safe  multi-functions  lightweightCon: relatively small for making a bigger child's multiple meals in advance  The water depository for steaming is small, which requires pouring water multiple times when making multiple meals at  onceIt may seem expensive, however, it is worth every penny.*** I am a dad. If I can make baby food, anyone can as well.

Beaba is a wonderful, time saving machine.  My daughter just starting eating solid foods and the Beaba allows us all to sit down and eat at the same time.  She eats basically the same foods that we are eating for the night.  The all-in-one allows me to cook and blend her food without multiple tools or pots.

I've had this for a couple of weeks now, and I love it.  If you don't want to spend the $, there are certainly cheaper ways to get the same end result -- fresh, healthy baby food.  However, I'm a working mom of two who is willing to spend some extra $ for convenience and for the assurance that I am not going to forget that I'm steaming veggies on the stove and leave it on so long that it ruins the organic food I just spent a bunch of money on!  The ease of use, from prep to clean up, is a big plus for me.  Plus, I make small batches, with different combinations every time, so my daughter is getting a better variety of foods on a weekly basis than when I made food for my son (I made large batches of food with the pot/steamer/blender combo for efficiency, and there was only so much room to store it, and only so much time to steam all of the different types of food).  I'm also more likely to make my own food on a consistent basis because of the convenience; in the couple of weeks I've had the Beaba, I've only reached for a jar one time in a pinch.  It takes up very little space as well.I would definitely recommend this product to someone who is willing to pay a bit more for some added convenience and ease of use.  The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because of the price tag, but I believe it's been worth it overall.  It seems like a quality product and seems well made.  If the price makes you cringe, just don't get it; you'll get by without it, for sure.  If not, and convenience is important to you, then I would recommend giving it a try.

This is a great product.  So far, since receiving it, I have used this babyfood maker to make my fresh daughter sweet potato, butternut squash, yellow squash, cauliflower, strawberrie/banana, & poi.  the basket holds a good amount of vegetables/fruit (more than enough for one feeding), the steaming & pureeing process is very simple:add the spedicifed amount of water (a booklet & recipe booklet is included), the blade is very sharp and creates beautiful pureed food.  My daughter has loved everything I have made using this thus far.  Clean up is easy, storage is easy.  My only complaint is that the cover seems kinda loose. There is a latch thing that slides and is supposed to ensure a close and tight fit, but there I find myself holding the cover down just to ensure that the food/water doesn't come out the top.  otherwise, very good product - I enjoy using it and feel it is worth the cost.

column9: Bottom of blending bowl cracked and leaked after 3 months
column10: I loved this product. The idea is perfect...healthy food for baby, minimal clean up, compact design. 1-2 times a week, I would use both the steaming and blending function to make 2-3 purees for the week. I also used the steaming function at least 2 times a day to heat up the frozen food. Everything seemed great, but after 3 months, the blending bowl started leaking. I changed the rubber gasket, but it still leaked. It turns out the bottom of the blending bowl had multiple cracks through it. I ended up buying a replacement bowl for $22. Hopefully it lasts longer this time. I also had similar problems that other people had with the brown stuff in the steaming reservoir. Overall, I probably would not have made this purchase. There are less expensive options out there. But after spending $150 on the thing, I had to replace the bowl, even if it was $22.

We recieved a Babycook as a baby shower present and were very excited to start using it.  As our daughter started on solids, the babycook worked great.  It's very simple to steam, blend and cleanup.  About a month into the transition to solids, you'll realized that the babycook is just too small to handle all of the fruits and veggies you want to cram into the little basket and it take a few rounds of use just to create enough food for 1 week.  While it's a bit more to clean it's much more efficient to steam using the stove and then a traditional blender.Additionally, our motor burned out after just 1 month (this appears to be a problem according to numerous posts).  I can't report on the customer service from Beaba but will follow-up with a resolution.  So far, I'm not impressed as there is no clear 800 # and you can only submit a claim via email.Knowing what I know now, I would not buy this again nor would I recommend it.  It does look cute on the countertop but just doesn't really replace the traditional tools to make baby food.

column9: Could not be happier with this gadget!
column10: Wow, that is all I can say!  Very impressed - totally worth the money.  It's made preparing fresh baby food for my daughter a complete breeze...and I'm a full time working mom!  Invest in this and you will not be disappointed.

column9: Don't know how I could have lived without it before!
column10: I have a 6 month old and 2 year old twins. I bought the baby food maker for the 6 month old and if I had known about it earlier, it would have saved me so much hassle, especially with making food for 2 babies! Before, I had to use lots of pots and pans and then I pureed using a hand held blender. This has made my life so much easier. It's so quick and easy and I hardly have any washing as I just give the parts a quick wash straight after use. I use it for making puree to add to plain yogurt for my 2 year olds who absolutely love it. I also use it for pureeing vegetables they usually take a dislike to but if I blend them into mash, I can sneakily make sure they are getting the veggies! I love that you get to use the water that the food has been steamed in so you are still able to keep those valuable vitamins that get lost in boiling. I think this machine is just fabulous and I would recommend it to every busy mom out there.

The only thing I would change about this is to make it bigger to do bigger portions when I want, but I like that its small portions so I don't have to store so much.  Used it with my first daughter and will use it with my second starting next month

column9: Must have from 4 months and on
column10: I received this as a gift from another mom. Since we have started trying solids, I have found it to be a life saver. It is perfectly designed, solves many things in one product and space. Simply put, you don't need anything else to prepare baby food when you have Baby Cook.

column9: Great way to make baby food
column10: This is a great device! Worth the $$$. You'll save money not buying overpriced baby food in jars.Get it.

This is by far one of the best things I have bought since my baby was born.  It is kind of like my pump, in that it was an initial investment that has paid for itself.  I spent $5 on vegetables and made food for 2 weeks!  I thought because I worked I would not have time, but I just make some on Sunday's.  Since I can make food for weeks, I don't do it that often.  I freeze in ice cube trays and once it is frozen, break it into ziploc bags and keep it in the freezer.  When I need food, I just thaw out a cube!

column9: Bought in 2008 and still going strong!
column10: I bought the Beaba Babycook back in 2008 when it came to the US and was only available at Williams and Sonoma. We still use it practically every day for our little one and for us too. We started her out as a baby with steamed and pureed foods and now we just steam everything that can be steamed. I am happy to say that, perhaps thanks to the Beaba?, our toddler loves, loves, loves to eat steamed broccoli. She is the talk of the day care where she gobbles down her steamed broccoli like there is no tomorrow. I steam it and put it into an Aladdin 24-Ounce Micro Lunch Bowl, Grey, aVivo Kids Bento Box, Orange and Pink or a Foogo by Thermos Leak-Proof SS 10 oz Food Jar in Pink. Just make sure that you use the liquid and pour it over the veggies. Otherwise they may dry out after a while. I also like to reuse the liquid in noodles or rice for our toddler's lunches at daycare.I'm surpised though that the price hasn't come down since 2008. But I heard that Sam's Club offers the product a bit cheaper...Also, I mixed delicious ice coffee with vanilla icecream the other day - right there in the Beaba. Just had to make sure to clean it out properly later so as not to inadvertently mix caffeine with steamed broccoli...It's true that the basket becomes a bit discolored but it's not really a big deal.

I was given this as a gift, and I'll admit that I was skeptical about how much baby food I would actually make, and whether I would have time to make it while taking care of my little one.  Then in a VERY short amount of time today I made 4 whole ice cube trays of different purees.  I'm hooked - looking up recipes for different things I can make.My little one started solids very early (started rice cereal for reflux at 5 weeks and never looked back).  So I will use it a lot longer than those who start at 6 months.
