column10: I tried to like this cereal because I love Kellogg's Frosted Mini Wheats, but this just didn't go down good for me.  It was too sweet, and it didn't really taste like I thought it would.  I was expecting the taste of cinnamon rolls but instead it was as if I was tasting an impostor.  Yes, I could taste cinnamon but something else was just a tad off.  Further, the size of the mini wheats I felt were too small to have have that correct texture I enjoy with normal Frosted Mini Wheats.  I did end up eating one entire box so it wasn't horrible, but I won't be buying anymore of this.

column9: Great flavor, small bites ideal for children
column10: Our family enjoyed the cinnamon roll flavor of Kellogg's Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bites.  The cinnamon flavor was a welcome change to the familiar Frosted Mini-Wheats, but I didn't care for the Little Bites size.  The smaller bites grew soggy in the milk faster than Frosted Mini-Wheats usually do.  However, the smaller bites were perfect for my younger children.  Everyone who taste-tested the Cinnamon Roll flavor in my house enjoyed it, but I still prefer the original Frosted Mini Wheats.
These were very tasty.  I loved the cinnamon roll flavor and they are high in fiber which makes them a great snack!

column9: Not too sweet, lowfat and good amount of fiber
column10: Cinnamon taste but not too strong, and although it is a sweetened cereal, it wasn't too sweet like some children's cereals. My only complaint is it got mushy in milk very quickly.I waited to do the review until I finished the box because sometimes the first bowl tastes okay but after a few servings I want to toss the box -- that didn't happen with this cereal. I liked it.

Kellogg's Frosted Mini Wheat's with Cinnamon could be a great cereal for little kids to snack on in the afternoon or in my case, 25 year old grad. students. The cinnamon taste itself does not overpower the other elements of the Mini Wheat, but rather acts as an enhancement to the sweet flavor. When put under the milk test, much to my relief all of the flavor does not end up in the milk or at the bottom of the bowl--it's called cereal in milk, not flavored milk with something approximating cereal in it. Overall, the cereal passed the milk and dry test and proved itself quite tasty in both scenarios. Spoons up.

column9: Healthier option if you need a sweet cereal.
column10: I tend to stay away from sugary cereals due to the lack of nutrition, even though I do enjoy the taste.  Well Kellogg's is trying to remedy that issue by creating this sweet cereal that is somewhat healthy.TASTE: I love cinnamon and really enjoyed the taste of this cereal.  While you won't mistake it for a Cinnabon, it has a nice sweet flavor to it.  The whole grain does not detract from the taste.NUTRITION: The serving size is 47 mini-biscuits.  This gives you 190 calories (10 from fat), 12 grams of sugar, and 6 grams of fiber.  The sugar content is actually lower than you'll see in a lot of sugary cereals.  And the real star is the 6 grams of fiber.  This is a nice bonus as most people do not eat enough fiber in a day.  This cereal is considered an "excellent source" of fiber and is also made from 100% whole grain.Overall, I find these mini-wheats to be a solid combination of taste and nutrition.

column9: Doesn't taste like cinnamon rolls, but I like it anyway. Serving sz: 47 biscuits = approx. 1 cup
column10: Kellogg's Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bites Flavored Cinnamon Roll, 15.8-Ounce (Pack of 4) smells like cinnamon rolls when you open the box, but it doesn't taste like cinnamon rolls.  I'd say Kellogg's Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bites Flavored Cinnamon Roll, 15.8-Ounce (Pack of 4) is flavored just right. It has the right amount of cinnamon & doesn't taste sickeningly sweet.  I usually eat this cereal dry for a snack, but I like it with milk too.Nutrition Facts without milk:Serving size: 47 biscuits which equals approx. 1 cupCalories 190Total Fat 1gSaturated fat & Trans fat, Monounsaturated fat 0Polyunsaturated fat .5gCholesterol & Sodium 0Potassium 200mgTotal Carbohydrate 46gFiber 6gSugars 12g which equals 3 tsp.Ingredients:Whole grain wheat, sugar, contains 2% or less of cinnamon, natural & artificial flavor, brown rice syrup, gelatin, caramel color, BHT for freshness

column9: Great Size; Tasty; Sweet; Decent Fiber
column10: This cereal has been a hit for our family.The "little bites" size is perfect for both straight-out-of-the-box snacking (including for our young kids) as well as spooned from a bowl and milk.  I think I prefer it to the straight "Mini-Wheats" size for it's just easier to eat while also maintaining the feel and texture of the typical size.The "Cinnamon Roll" flavor is close to being too much sweet, however. It's good in a generically maple-y sweet sort of way (not a perfect cinnamon roll, really), but a fair bit sweeter than frosted mini-wheats (to say nothing of plain, old unfrosted mini-wheats).Like other varieties of mini-wheats, these are a good source of fiber; they get soggy if left in milk too long; and there is a lot of debris (smushed cereal) at the bottom of the box.

If you've followed the evolution of the this cereal, you know that it started with big, palm-sized chucks of rolled wheat goodness. The Mini-wheats were the bite-sized improvements on the larger parents allowing breakfasters to get the cereal in their salivating mouths without having to use their spoons as a knife and often making a milky mess. Evidently the mini-wheats weren't bite-sized enough because Kellogg's has introduced the Little Mini-wheats and boy are they cute. With the legacy wholesomeness from the wheats and mini-wheats, the Littles are healthy and delicious. It's rumored that Kellogg's is now working on the atomic Mini-Wheats, but in the mean time, the Littles should suffice for your morning bowl.

I really enjoyed this cereal.  The size is smaller than the normal mini-wheats, so they absorb milk much faster.  The cinnamon flavor was very much like a cinnamon bun, minus the obvious texture differences.  I didn't find the sweetness or the cinnamon overpowering, it was very well balanced.  All in all a winner.

Well, there's not a whole lot to say about cereal in a review, so I'll just focus on taste and texture.  First off, I'm used to buying the regular sized frosted mini-wheats, so these small ones are kind of amusing.  It's like a mini mini-wheat!  I don't find that the size makes them any easier to eat; if nothing else, it makes them go soggy a bit faster.  As for the taste, the box says "cinnamon roll" and indeed it does taste strongly of cinnamon, and oddly, maple syrup.  It's not an unpleasant taste, but it maybe should've been called "cinnamon toast" flavor instead.  I would prefer it to be sweeter, but I've got quite the sweet tooth!  I'm sure people who prefer a more mellow cereal would enjoy this one a lot more than I did.  Also, 47 of the little squares is apparently the recommended serving size.  What a joke!  Well, anyway, after trying these out, I think I'll stick with my old frosted mini-wheats!

These are mini bite sized "hay bales", is what my kids call them. They are tasty, and very cinnamony. I liked them, and my kids love them! Great new taste in a small bite, great for small mouths that love cramming lots of cereal in at a time. Glad we tried it, I would recommend this new taste, it's great!

column9: Tiny and Tasty Cinnamon Squares of Wheat
column10: Cinnamon roll is a welcome addition to the lineup of available flavors. Kellogg's does a nice job to replicate cinnamon roll taste in this delicious cereal.It never hurts to try something new and the smaller square is the latest venture into the realm of Mini-Wheats offerings. The "Little Bites" are about half the size of standard Mini-Wheats; I've grown accustomed to the normal-sized mini, as I habitually go with one square per spoonful in order to regulate my milk to Mini-Wheat ratio; however, the size of the miniaturized Little Bites may appeal more favorably to small children as well.It's the same delicious cereal with a new size and a new taste experience. If you're already a Mini-Wheats fan and you enjoy the flavor of cinnamon rolls, then there's a high probability that you'll like this one as much as I do.

Open the box, tear open the bag inside, and you get an instant whiff of things to come - the tantalizing scent of cinnamon and sugar wafts out immediately.When you think cinnamon rolls, if you're like me, you think of warm and gooey and sweet. The Cinnamon Roll Frosted Mini-Wheats are smarter, though. They keep the sugar fairly low-key and don't overdo the cinnamon either. It hints at sweetness and teases the taste buds with the idea of a cinnamon roll without going over the top with it.The result is something you can eat a whole bowl of and not feel guilty about. Something that doesn't lose it's appeal halfway through the bowl, as so many sugary cereals do. The smaller nuggets are easily bite-size and retain their crunch well, as long as you don't drown them in milk. And it's a hearty cereal - eating a reasonably-sized bowl will fill you up nicely for at least a little while.Simply put, it's a big hit in our house.Fill up a bowl, pour on the milk and dig in. And don't forget to take in that lovely scent of sweet cinnamon when you open the box.

column9: Like eating Cinnamon Rolls, but cold, not hot
column10: I personally dislike Kellogg's wheats, whether regular or mini. They always remind me of miniature hay bales and I disliked them since I was a little kid.But these Cinnamon Roll flavored Mini Wheats tasted great. My wife loved them too. She didn't even bother to pour them in a bowl and put milk on them. She just ate them from the box as a snack food.If you like Cinnamon Rolls you will love these Mini Wheats for sure. You get a sweet treat plus the fiber you need in your diet at the same time.UPDATE: It has been at least a month since I tried these and they still have the great taste of Cinnamon Rolls. My wife has bought more of them since we finished off the sample box in less than a week. If you don't like Mini-wheats, I recommend that you try these if you like Cinnamon Rolls. You will not believe how much they taste like the real thing. Some who have tried them said they have a maple taste, which is true. Real Cinnamon Rolls usually have a maple frosting coating on them so these mini-wheats are an accurate representation of what a Cinnamon Roll tastes like.

I anticipated that it would be very sweet. It was, but it also had a pronounced cinnamon flavor. I do not like eating sweetened cereal- its too sweet for me. I like to use 1/3 bowl of sweet cereal combined with plain corn flakes, bran flakes, grape nuts, or oat cereal. That dilutes it down to something with flavor and a little sweetness. After trying the Mini-Wheats with just milk, I added the plain and it was just right with a cinnamon twang. Eating it straight it had the taste of a cinnamon roll. So now you can decide from there.Looking at the box, it said a serving was 47 pieces. I counted out 47 and the bowl was barely half full. So think about doubling the nutritional numbers if that is important to you. It also means the box will only last for 4 servings. That makes it expensive. Well I'm rating it on the flavor and my choice to water it down.

column9: Very tasty cereal but tastes more like maple than cinnamon
column10: Length:: 2:38 MinsI'm a big shredded wheat fan. I like plain shredded wheat with fruit on top, I like lightly sugared mini-wheats and now I've tried this new cereal from Kellogg's, Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bites. This particular cereal is Cinnamon Roll flavored and I found it to be quite tasty. I'm not so sure the cinnamon flavor was pronounced enogh though. To be honest it tasted more of maple-ish flavor than cinnamon. But it was good nonetheless. The Little Bites are about 1/3 the size of a regular mini-wheat. Not only does that make them a pretty handy size for snacking but may appeal to children as well.The cereal holds up well in milk. Unless you let it sit for a while, it will not mush out on you. I was worried about that because since they are smaller there is more surface area for a typical serving when compared to mini-wheats which are larger in size. But unless it takes you 10 minutes to eat your cereal they'll be fine. Of course the longer it sits, the softer it will get.The nutrition specs are decent. About 190 calories per serving (230 with 1/2 cup skim milk), 6g of Dietary fiber, 12g Sugar which is a touch more than I usually like in cereal, but still, it's not overly sweet to my taste. My current mini-wheats have 11g sugar so this compares to those.I was surprised to discover that a teaspoon of white granulated sugar equals about 4.2 grams which means this cereal per serving has the equivalent of nearly 3 teaspoons of sugar. With plain shredded wheat, I would normally use 1 teaspoon of sugar. According to the Nutrition Facts, a serving is considered to be 47 biscuits. Since it is  unlikely that you will be counting your biscuits each morning, here's a little hint. In my video you can see about 21 biscuits, that was 1/2 cup. So A heaping cup would be just about 47 biscuits.Overall I like this cereal a lot. I switch between cereals quite a bit for variety so this will be a nice new treat for me. I find them great for breakfast as well as occasional snacking.
I love the "baby" mini wheats and the cinammon is iceing on the cake!  Great aftertaste but I am prejudice I have loved Kelloggs Frosted mini wheats since I was a kid. Recommend wholeheartedly!

I really liked the taste and size of these mini wheats as the cereal bites had a hint of cinnamon flavor reminiscent of a cinnamon roll. The flavor was not over powering but just enough to hint at the cinnamon roll flavor.I also liked the size of the bites as they allowed my older teeth, and mouth, to easily chew and digest the cereal.Recommend.

Frosted wheat of any size has been one of my favorites for a long time. This Little Bites Flavored Cinnamon Roll version is a welcome addition to the group.  I don't get the cinnamon roll experience that some of the reviewers have described but I do get a slight taste of cinnamon. Count me in as one who enjoys the taste and who is looking forward to getting more when this box runs out. As you probably know, Publix runs a Kellogg BOGO quite frequently and I plan to take advantage of the offer next time it appears. Unless you dislike the taste of cinnamon, chances are you will enjoy this cereal. It is worth a try.

I am an ingredient freak. I love that this cereal has no high fructose corn syrup or partially hydrogenated oils. The ingredient list is actually quite short, which is something that I always look for. The only downfall is that the serving size is rather small, and there's 12g of sugar in a serving. However, if you know anything about the way your body processes carbs, the fact that there is a lot of whole wheat and fiber in this cereal decreases the speed with which the simple sugars metabolize. I'm not trying to rationalize and say that 12g of sugar is "ok" in this cereal, but I'm just making the point that this is better than some other cereals with the same amount of sugar per serving but less whole grain.Another reason why I love this cereal is the way it tastes. It's delicious! Imagine Frosted Mini-Wheats with a hint of maple syrup and cinnamon instead of the vanilla frosting taste. I wouldn't say that it tastes *exactly* like a cinnamon roll, but the cinnamon flavor is definitely noticeable and wonderful.This cereal is great in milk and also dry. The small size makes them good for snacks (but it also makes it easier to go over the serving size if you're watching calories or other nutritional info!).Overall, as a cereal lover, I would definitely recommend these new Mini-Wheats! They are delicious!

column9: I LOVE these tasty little bites
column10: First and foremost - They taste good!These are tiny little nuggets; about 1/4th the size of mini-wheat's that I've been eating by the handful ever since I opened the box.  There is a little sweetness with a cinnamon undercurrent and a BIG crunch.  I did have to laugh at the serving size - it's 47 biscuits.  Now, I counted them out and found 47 biscuits measure about 1-cup.  I guess as a society we've taken portion control to new heights.There are 190 calories but only 1-gram of fat in that cup serving; also no cholesterol and no sodium for folks like me who have to count that kind of stuff.  There's 200 mgs of potassium so if you add that banana on top you're really getting your daily dose.  There're 6 grams of fiber and 5 grams of protein per serving.  The sugar grams come in rather high at 12  but you're not going to add anymore by the teaspoon so for a special treat I'm not worried.Last word - They taste good!

These mini-wheats aren't bad. They've got a good cinnamon flavor and sweetness, but comparing them to a cinnamon roll is kind of a stretch. The texture with or without mill is certainly not like a cinnamon roll. With milk, they taste like cinnamon-flavored shredded wheat. Without milk they taste pretty good as a snack too.

column9: Kellogg's Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bites Flavored Cinnamon Roll, 15.8-Ounce
column10: Kellogg's Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bites Flavored Cinnamon Roll, 15.8-Ounce, We enjoyed the cinnamon smell while eating the cereal in the morning. The little bites are just right for our 2 and 4 year old grandchildren. We like the fact that they are whole wheat and better for all of us. The box has games on it which are fun also.

When I open the box of Mini-Wheats Little bites it smelled as if I had a box of Cinnamon Rolls. That was nice; what makes it better is the cereal does not taste overall sweet. The Mini-Wheats are much smaller and more convenient for children to eat. I ate this with 2% Milk and found it was good. I would do so again. The taste is not exactly that of a cinnamon roll but close enough to be enjoyable.A serving size is described as 47 biscuits and caloric intake is given dry and with a 1/2 cup of skim milk (190 and 230 respectively). This cereal is made of 100% whole grain fiber A serving contains 24% of your dietary fiber for the day as well as providing 90% of the daily requirement of iron. There is a list of other vitamins and minerals that range from 0 -25%. Though this is truly a whole grain cereal the second listed ingredient is sugar at 12g per serving and 2% or less of cinnamon.

column9: It's not the taste but the size
column10: My boys all said the same thing, the flavor was good, but it was really the size of these mini-wheats that made them great.  The bite size was what gave this a 4 star rating.  The flavor was just a bonus

These came just as my kids (5 and 2 years old) were wanting an afternoon snack. I got right into the box and gave them about 20 biscuits each. (A serving is 47) They loved them! I was curious so I made myself a small bowl too. They are so good. The size of the biscuit is just right for their little mouths. They aren't too sweet, but still have enough sweetness to get the kids to like them. They really do taste like a cinnamon roll. I am pleasantly surprised and will continue to purchase these for them! (Note: we ate them dry.)On another note...I have very picky eaters and have been concerned about their vitamin/mineral intake since they seem to want to live on peanut butter and jelly or cheese sandwiches. I checked the nutritional info and was shocked (and happy) to see that a serving gives 90% of Iron and lots of other good nutrition and fiber. That means that I can give my kids a serving size appropriate for them and they're still getting good stuff from something that they love.I think we may have a new family favorite!

I love cinnamon-flavored cereals, therefore I was quite interested in trying Kellogg's Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bites Flavored Cinnamon Roll cereal. Frankly, while not a bad cereal, I doubt I would buy it in the supermarket. First of all, the manufacturer was not kidding in naming the cereal "little bites." 47 pieces of these tiny mini-wheats constitutes a serving, which did not even begin to fill my cereal bowl. By mid-morning, I was hungry, which normally doesn't happen to me when I eat oatmeal, Wheaties, or Cheerios. I would suggest that a serving of this cereal would be better suited to a mid-morning or late evening snack, or consumed with toast and fruit on the side if served for breakfast. It would also make a good snack for children to take to school. And, second, I not detect a strong flavor of cinnamon, although the smell was nice. When I am going to indulge in a cinnamon flavored cereal, I like a sweeter cereal with a stronger cinnamon taste, such as Cinnamon Toast Crunch.For those who are interested in the nutritional facts, a serving with 1/2 cup of skim milk has 230 calories, and only 1 gram of fat. Although there are 46 grams of carbohydrates in a serving, there are only 12 grams of sugar, which would generally indicate that I should not have become hungry so soon after eating the cereal, so my conclusion is that the skimpy portion was primarily responsible for that. As a contrast, General Mill's Multi-Grain Cheerios, also touted as lightly sweetened, has 150 calories for a one cup serving (with skim milk), 1 gram of fat, 24 grams of carbohydrates and 6 grams of sugar. I find that latter cereal to be filling on its own, which as I indicated was not the case with the Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bites. My conclusion is that if you are looking for a lightly sweetened cereal, there are better alternatives to the Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bites.

I'm a fan of Shredded Wheat.  I'm a fan of Cinnamon Toast Crunch.  This one is somewhere between the two, but miles away.  Not too bad as a snack without milk, but I did find the sogged down version to be extremely lacking.  With milk the artificial cinnamon is a little overpowering and not quite right with the shredded wheat texture.  I'm not quite sure how else to say it.Not bad, especially as a midday snack.

column9: Crunchy, subtle flavor, but gets soggy quickly
column10: The flavor is not too overpowering, and the sugar content is relatively low - all of which are positives.However, given the miniature size and the build of the cereal, it gets soggy in less than a minute, and - personal preference - I like cereal when its crunchy. This one included, the first few bites right after pouring the milk are great, but soon there after its soggy and just not nearly as good...

The cinnamon roll-flavored Mini-Wheats try to strike a balance between the healthy cereal and the sugary cereal, with decent results. It definitely has more flavor than most healthy cereals, though I was not a fan of the aftertaste, which to me seemed as strong as the actual cereal flavor and lingered for a bit. It definitely has a cinnamon flavor, though it was nowhere as sweet as a real cinnamon roll. Just keep in mind that the cinnamon flavoring comes at a cost on the health side - there are a significant amount of carbs here.The smaller size of the bites makes it better for snacking, but worse for breakfast if you like to use milk, because they will get soggy significantly faster than the regular-sized wheats.

column4: Meryl K. Evans "Content Maven behind meryl.net"
column10: Even as an adult, I love breakfast cereal for a snack, dinner, whatever and I'll eat them dry or with milk. I like the original, the Chocolate Little Bites (addicting), Touch of Fruit in the Middle that I wish didn't have the frosting on top as it's sweet enough from the fruit. I also love cinnamon-flavored food including cinnamon rolls.The cinnamon flavor in this cereal is less on the sweet side and more on cinnamon's bitter side. It also tastes artificial. The label says it uses natural and artificial cinnamon flavoring. Is cinnamon really that expensive that the cereal has some artificial flavoring?This has 6g of fiber -- above my minimum required of 3g from cereal. Surprisingly, the cereal didn't fill me up long enough until the next meal. The biggest question is the cinnamon "roll" part. This is more like cinnamon whole grain wheat. No signs of a cinnamon roll.As for the sweetness level, I'd say it's about in the middle. Cereals like Lucky Charms and Honey Nut Cheerios are sweeter cereal than this. But this is sweeter than original Cheerios, Corn Flakes and Crispix.I don't plan to buy this. There are better cereals out there.

Ok...  I generally look at eating cereals like this as eating a lufa sponge.  Not exactly appetizing.  I am sure that there is some health benefit that I am unaware of that makes it worth my while to chow down that lufa, but of the many things I do to try to stay healthy...  I love to eat and generally won't touch anything that I don't enjoy.  That said...  the cinnamon flavoring of this cereal is really pretty good.  It has enough cinnamon that you know what you are eating (if you don't like cinnamon, don't even bother get a fruit-iced cereal) but yet is not overpowering.  I think it's a great way to get guys like me to eat stuff that they should, but usually won't.  If you buy I hope you enjoy and thanks for taking the time to read my review.

I enjoyed this cereal very much and have already purchased another box locally.  The mini-wheats have a sweet cinnamon flavor that is very much like cinnamon rolls.  The small size is great for scooping with a spoon and for a quick snack by eating dry.  Nice addition to the mini-wheats lineup!!

Wow, I actually enjoyed eating this cereal. When I finished eating, I told my roommate to try it, because it was that good. It kind of reminds me of a fig newton cinnamon cookie I ate recently. The good thing about it is that cinnamon is not overpowering like Cinnamon Toast Crunch. It's not too sweet, but it's just right, probably because the amount of wheat in each bite. I will definitely be eating this for breakfast this week. I'm going to have to add this to my shopping list, when it's time to buy cereal again.

I am a big fan of both Frosted Mini-Wheats and cinnamon, so I was excited to get this cereal for review.  Unfortunately, I think Kellogg's has not made a good thing better.  For those new to Mini-Wheats, it consists of bite-sized frosted bits that are shaped like pillows.  Biting into one reveals the wheaty layers, and there is a brown-sugar flavor inside.  The significant amount of fiber makes it a good choice for those wanting to stay full for a while.This "Little Bites" version changes that formula in two ways: it makes the bites smaller and it adds cinnamon.  I like cinnamon, so that is nice, but it is more of a background flavor than a real punch, almost like they were afraid to change the flavor too much.  The smaller size is a misstep, in my opinion.  It means much more surface area, so all of those wheat layers are almost immediately turned to mush.  A great thing about the normal mini-wheats is that the outside is soft, but the inside stays crunchy for a long time.  The Little Bites instead turn quickly into porridge.I do not hate this cereal, and in general I am a fan of changing up old formulas.  Just show me a flavor with "LIMITED TIME" on it and I am in.  So, it is not that I am stuck on the traditional flavor.  Instead, I think that this was a bad experiment.

This new Kellogg's Mini Wheats cereal has a fairly good cinnamon taste, and the fiber amount is pretty good for a breakfast cereal. I do have a problem with the carb count on it. Most cereals come it around 25 grams of carbs per serving, this one comes in at 46 which is pretty high. Its like having a candy bar for breakfast.

column9: Picture makes it look better than it is
column10: I like mini-wheats in general for the fibre content. So I was looking for a nice flavored variety and decided to try this out.The taste is where I had a problem with this. It's sweet enough, but the cinnamon seems to leave a bit of an after taste. That's the main reason I'm rating this lower.Otherwise, it's pretty good. The size of the bites is nice - I like that it's smaller. You can control better how much you want to serve.Maybe I'm being a little too picky with the taste. So I would recommend trying it out to see for yourself.

column9: size is great but too sweet
column10: I love the size of the little mini wheat squares, it makes them so nice to eat. The taste is OK but much too sweet, too much cinnamon too, I would like to see the small squares in the regular flavored mini wheat squares. Since the squares are so small the company should not put much sweetening on each one so it doesn't become over sweet like this one is. My son thought it was great though and ate almost the entire box, I have about 2 cups out of it and he ate the rest so I guess kids will like this.

For the most part I love everything about this cereal. The flavor is wonderful although tastes a little more like brown sugar than I would of thought. I love that these are the little bites so I can just snack on them straight from the box which is perfect since I'm not a milk drinker. They are bursting with flavor for such a small item. However, these little bites have one downfall which is the carb count. The carb count is really high (46) considering these are smaller than the normal size mini wheats. With that being said this is a great cereal to eat and your family will love it if you're not worried about carbs.

column9: Didn't quite hit the spot for my gang...
column10: My family loves cinnamon-flavored cereals. Their favorite was one that was made by another company that has since stopped producing it. They were hoping to find something similar with these Mini-Wheats Little Bites, but found the same problems as they do with Kellogg's Cinnamon Toast Crunch - they don't hold their crisp for very long, and the taste just isn't as good as the other brand they loved so much. We'll keep searching.

I wasn't sure how Kellog's was going to make mini-wheats taste like not just cinnamon but like cinnamon rolls, but however they did it they succeeded. The cereal has that extra sugary spark found in cinnamon rolls. Obviously, it is sugary, mores than even frosted mini-wheats. If that's what you like in your cereal though, this is a good way to go.

I am a cinnamon roll fanatic. I love them, especially mom's home made ones, but that's beside the point. I saw a new cinnamon roll flavored cereal and jumped at the chance to eat some.I poured it in the bowl, added milk and chomped away. The first half of the bowl was pretty good, but as the milk soaked in the cinnamon flavor quickly disappeared and I was was left eating wheat. It tasted bland and just blah. But, like I said the first half of the bowl was decent until the flavoring wore off.Then, as with most mini wheat cereals I tried it straight from the box. The taste that way was much stronger and more enjoyable, but I am not one that eats this type of food directly from the box so I don't see myself enjoying that.All in all, it was an ok cereal for me. I'm not sure I would purchase it again, or if I did it would be a every 6 months or every year just so I remember why I don't get it more often.

I handed these over to my husband who is the Mini-Wheats lover in our family. My daughter likes them also. Personally, I think they taste like a bunch of sticks exploded in your mouth. Though these smelled delicious when opened, my husband was decidedly unimpressed with the flavor. There wasn't much of a cinnamon taste. The smaller size  of these is ideal for children, but apparently annoying to adult likers of the regular Mini-Wheats. My husband kept complaining about the diminished bites.

column9: Good, but that serving size is annoying
column10: Lately, I have been trying to eat lean protein for breakfast.  That means egg whites and greek yogurt.  While both delicious, these can get a little boring for breakfast.  Once in a while, I just want a bowl of cereal that tastes like it is bad for me, but in reality is not.  Enter Frosted Mini Wheats.This is a cereal brand that I have enjoyed for a long time.  They make several different flavors, and frosted wheat is not that bad, considering it is a great source of fiber.  Food purists might not like the amount of sugar in the frosted wheats, but all in all, not an awful choice for a once in a while breakfast treat.  So, when I learned there were Cinnamon Roll flavored Mini Wheats, I knew I had to try them.  Cinnamon Roll flavored stuff has been a recent obsession, so that I get the flavor of a comforting treat without the fat.I did not realize the difference between Mini Wheats and Mini Wheat Little Bites until I saw them.  These are much tinier than regular Mini Wheats, hence the slight name difference.  Were the Minis not mini enough? Otherwise, these are your standard Mini Wheats.  They look a little like straw, but I truly think they are tasty.Nutritionally, they are not awful, but higher in calories and carbs than I would like.  However, a great source of fiber and very low fat.  So, for a once in a while thing, once again, not awful.  My biggest complaint is the serving size, which is 47 biscuits.  Really?  You could not have just made it half a cup?  For people who are a little OCD about precise serving sizes, it is a major pain to sit there and count out 47 biscuits each time I want to make sure I am getting a correct serving size.  It is a major flaw as far as I am concerned.Taste wise, these were good, not fantastic, but good.  But between the annoying serving size and the amount of calories and carbs, I am not sure this would be a staple in my pantry.  I think there are better, healthier, easier options out there. And if I were going to splurge with carbs for mini wheats, I would probably do it on the blueberry ones.

These were ok, but they could have used more cinnamon flavor. I do understand that these are probably marketed to kids, and many kids don't really care for strong flavors, but when I'm buying something with a "Cinnamon Roll" flavor, I expect to really taste cinnamon, but the cinnamon flavor was barely there.

I was excited when I saw this new Frosted mini wheats.  I like several of the other Mini wheats flavors and this looked right up my alley since cinnamon is one of my favorite flavors.  The smell when you first open the box isn't entirely pleasing to the nose, alittle bit overwhelming.  Fortunately the smell doesn't last once the ceareal is out of the box.  The Cereal stays crunchy for a long time in the milk.  The cinnamon taste could be a bit more for my taste buds but I liked it well enough.  I think the thing I least liked was the smell out of the box.

Both my wife and I are big fans of Mini-Wheats. My wife loves the Kellogg's Frosted Chocolate Mini Wheats Little Bites Cereal 16 oz while I used to love the raisin filled mini wheats they made in the 90s. Sadly, they've since been replaced by the artifically flavored and erroneously named Frosted Mini-Wheats Cereal, Touch of Fruit in the Middle (Mixed Berry), 18-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4).  As we're both fans of cinnamon rolls and the new Kellogg's Raisin Bran Cereals, Cinnamon and Almond, 14.5-Ounce (Pack of 4) (also by Kellogs), this seemed like a good one to try.Unfortunately, I really didn't like it. I didn't taste any cinnamon at all and the icing on the mini-wheats doesn't taste like any cinnamon roll topping I've ever had. I've had ones from organic co-ops to Pillsbury DoughBoy encrusted ones. This just tasted...odd and unpleasant to me. After finishing a bowl, I realized that it tasted like my rabbit's hairball medicine smelled. molasses and malt. Sure enough, malt flavoring is the main ingredient in the icing. As such it was hard to want to take eat any more after the mental picture of me gulping down Laxatone developed. On the plus side, my rabbits REALLY wanted this cereal. It's pretty close to what they eat anyway.My wife liked the cereal however, She didn't think it tasted like cinnamon rolls, but she found the taste pleasing. As such the cereal was one for two in my household and so it gets a thumb's in the middle here. One last note though, each serving is 47 grams of carbs. That's pretty impressive.

Generally speaking, I really like mini wheats, so this cereal was appealing to me already.  I enjoyed the flavor very much since it didn't taste artificial.  I also liked the fact that it contains brown rice syrup in it instead of corn syrup.  It gives it a different flavor that enhances the cinnamon and combines very well with the wheat.My active teen daughter is a big breakfast eater and if she eats cereal, she's usually hungry within a couple of hours.  This kind held her for 4 hours.  It is hard to measure 47 pieces (serving size) so we just served about a cup which is a little more than what the average cereal calls for.Overall, the cereal tasted good and was good for the tummy.  I'm looking forward to buying some more.

column9: So the Mini-Wheats were too big?
column10: First there was Frosted Mini-Wheats, in original size, then there was Frosted Mini-Wheats Bite Size. Well, if for some reason those were too much of a mouthful, we now have Frosted Mini-Wheats Little Bits. Yes, these are about half the size of the Bite Size versions. This particular one is "Cinnamon Roll".There is nothing new to the table here with the exception of size, which I is unnecessary. Personally, I like original flavor and size the best. But the Bite Size edition were accommodating. These come off as a desperate attempt to give attention to a brand that needs some sort of life put back into it and all they came up with was making them smaller and having a new flavor, which is actually too sweet for me.A serving size is approximately 47 biscuits. Thats 1 gram of polyunsaturated fat, 46 grams of carbohydrates, 6g fiber, 12g of sugar, 5g of protein and 200mg of potassium. Generally they look good but I guess those that are watching their carb intake might want to be careful.These probably fit on a spoon better than its predecessors in a bowl of milk, but I like the other kinds cause they snack better without the milk. But here, these small ones are easily to snack more than you should.I am grading this product 2 stars for 3 reasons 1) I dont think making them smaller has any reason for existing outside of Kellogs filling the shelves with more versions of something that was fine to begin with. 2) This flavor, Cinnamon Roll, is sweet and has a synthetic taste to it. 3) On the plus side, I like Mini-Wheats in general, so it saved it from being one star.

This is such a great product.  It sweetens and adds a lovely amaretto flavor without being made of sugar or artificial sweeteners.  The Madhava brand is terrific and there are so many flavors to choose from that I know I will be using this as my sweetener of choice and trying them all out!

I have never made menudo but, I use this for chili and tacos and have used it for many years.  A+++ product.  Was unable to find it in the local stores after moving from Texas to Montana and was happy to find it at Amazon.com.

Once I received these in the mail, the dogs went nuts!  I have two boxers and a yellow lab, who are avid chewers, and I needed something that would last.  The rawhides give them loose stools, so I was searching for something that wouldn't upset their G.I. tracts.  Overall, they have lasted quite some time without damaging the teeth as the nylabones have been doing.  Being in the vet business previously for 12 years, I would highly recommend these for the hearty chewers.  Make sure you obtain the proper size for your breed (I ordered the 3 large for my guys who are 50, 70, & 80 lbs).  They do not seem to splinter while chewing, but I would not leave the dogs to chew on them unsupervised to reduce the possible hazard of choking.  The vendor also shipped the items out in a timely manner, and compared to the other antlers on the market, I believe that the price was very reasonable.

I bought these antlers for my adult Doberman, my Catahoula Leopard Dog, and my Doberman puppy. All three like to chew on pig ears, rawhide, busybones, ect. After reading reviews about antler dog chews, I thought that purchasing the antlers may offset the cost of constantly buying rawhide since the antlers are supposed to last about a month. Unfortunately, none of the dogs even gave the antlers 5 minutes of chew time. This product may be better for people with heavy duty chewers. I read that the inside of the antlers are the best tasting for the dogs, but it doesn't look like my dogs will ever get to the inside. I will not be purchasing any antlers again, and I'm out $30+. As for the seller, I did receive this product in a timely manner. Note that the antlers are  placed in an envelope without any packaging.
I have a 90 lb dog and a 20 lb dog and they both have been chewing on these antlers for weeks now.  Well worth the price!

To be succinct, this is not very good.  Think of a watery dressing with little in the way of ranch flavor, more like a hint of ranch. Yes, watery dressing with a hint of ranch.Its not good.  Be cautious.

column9: I eat more veggies with this dip!
column10: This is a handy product to have around if you're watching calories/carbs/fat.  I know I need to eat more vegetables, but usually don't.  Having this makes it fun and not drudgery.  Peppers, broccoli, anything tastes good in this dip.  I've given it as gifts to people wanting to modify their diet due to special events or changes in their health.  Recommended.

column9: The only Walden Farms product that disappoints
column10: I have been a fan of Walden Farms pancake syrup as well as their chocolate syrup and the jams.  So I had high hopes about their ranch dip.  UGH!  I'm sorry to have to say it, since their other products are great, but this was an unpleasant esperience.  The texture managed to be both slimy and clingy.  I thought the taste was particularly unpleasant and I threw the entire content away.  Kept the jar, though - Walden Farms uses nice glass jars!  So I am still a fan of theirs, and I will continue to buy other products from them, but NOT this one.

column9: Walden Farms product line is great
column10: All of Walden Farms products are literally life savers. Not only are they fat free, sugar free, calorie free, carb free, etc. but they are absolutely deliciouse and at a reasonable price. I am on Nutrisystem now but am using Walden Farms products along with it and will continue with Walden Farms product line from now on. They offer healthy, tasty alternatives to everything you can imagine.

So refreshing! This iced tea is hassle free, with the large tea bags. Since it is unsweeted, you can add whatever sweetener you want, and to your taste. My family uses sugar, splenda etc. So everyone is happy with this Iced Tea! Perfect for Summer!!!

I got a packet of these on a whim, because I do love a light and crispy cookie. Oh, my, the guava creme filling just boosted this treat into the stratosphere! Delicious! Light and crispy and creamy too! Now I need in large quantities!!

My son doesn't like peas.  I've tried feeding him the Gerber Organic peas and he dodges the spoon.  So since all of sprouts food is good, I thought - hey, I'm sure Tyler Florence's peas are better than Gerber.  Boy was I wrong!  It started when I first opened the bag - it smells absolutely horrible and the color is a yucky brownish green.  So I warmed it up and sampled it before giving to my son.  OMG, I almost had to wipe it off of my tounge.  It is really really bad, and that is about the kindest thing I can say about this pea/greenbean/mint mix.  I tried to give it to my son and his reaction was as bad as mine.  I just coulnd't force feed him somethign I couldn't stomach myself.  So far all other Sprout flavors are 5 stars, but leave this one on the shelf - - - it is BAD!

column9: Introduce a wide variety of flavors now
column10: I am a big fan of Sprout baby foods and so is my 6 month old son. We started with stage 1 but quickly went on to the yummy combinations of the stage 2 foods. The flavors all work so well together and I believe I am expanding my son's palet now so he's more likely to accept and like a wide variety of foods and flavors as he gets older. The beans with mint is a unique and welcomed twist on an otherwise tough veggie to get infants to eat.  If you MUST you can always add just a small pinch of sugar. My son loves it.  Keep coming up with the fabulous flavors Tyler!

column9: unsatisfied with the food, and disappointed with their customer service
column10: Bought it form amazon , and found some "weird" stuff in 2 out of 4 bags I have opened, and the amount in one bag is quite significant. Looks more like leaf or pea skin to me. Contacted their customer service, and sent the picture I shared here. They told me it's "quite unusual" in the first email. In the 2nd email told me it is called "browning" generated during the process on rare occasions, and emphasised that "it is not a safe issue" wihile they are trying to improve to prevent this happen again. They offered coupons for replacement in both emails. As we are relocated out of the country, I asked if they could mail the replacement instead of coupons which is useless to us. They stop replying email and my other inquiries, and don't even bother to say a "no".We carried this a long way with us, and it turned out that we are not comfortable to feed it to our baby anymore. The pouch shows dark green, and strong smell. Definitely not "a slightly sweet puree with a bright green color" as stated on the package. We also supplied Gerber and happy baby stage 2 food. This is the only food that my girl disliked.Unsatisfied with the food, and really disappointed with their customer service.

OK, I admit I did not actually try these myself.  However, my son really loves them.  I was suprised to see the negative reviews of this product, as they seem very appetizing.  They're a nice green color and the mint adds a good smell to them.It's actually hard for me to find veggie-only (no fruit) organic baby food at my local grocery store. I really like that these are a way to get my son veggies that he likes.  The packaging is convinient--it reseals well in the fridge.  I also find the pouches great for throwing in the diaper bag when we go out.  They're a bit pricey, but I think worth it for the convinience and the quality.

Normally I really like Sprout Baby Food for my child.I always have a little taste before giving new baby food to my child.  The third little noticed ingredient is mint. Mint gives it a very bad taste and I wouldn't have purchased this product if I had noticed it also contained mint. I am disappointed with this I was not expecting mint with peas and green beans. I wish I hadn't purchased so much.
This is the worst flavor of baby food I ever tasted. It tastes like grass. The mint is just making it worst. Thank God I only got one piece.

I dont know what all the bad reviews are about? This is practically the only all veggie organic baby food option i could find, 99% have a sweet fruit mixed in to mask the vegetable flavor so baby will eat it, if you prefer that thats your choice but for any foodies out there you'll appreciate the mild hint of mint in this combo. No its not 'overwhelming' as some state IMO its just a hint and its mint..not a chemically added flavor so whats the problem?? its an all organic all veggie option for those interested.

column9: I love every other sprout product
column10: But this does not taste good.  I don't like it.  Baby doesn't like.  Hot / cold doesn't matter, it just tastes strange.

this is an EXCELLENT way to gett veggies into ur kids diet. i would def recommend going to ur local whole foods and purchase 1 pouch to see if ur kid will like it b4 buying it in bulk on amazon. it does have a strong minty flavor, but i think thats y my kid loves it. its all pure and organic, u cant get better than sprout.

column9: The only food my child has refused
column10: I have given my child a wide variety of fruits and vegetables so far, and this is the only food that we have offered him that he has flat out refused.  I try everything that I give him, and I almost gagged when I tasted this.  The mint taste is very overpowering.  I was not expecting mint to be mixed with green beans and peas.  But I did not want to force my likes and dislikes on to my son, so I sent this off to daycare with him and also stashed an extra pouch of organic carrots in his bag just in case.  Needless to say, my son came home with a full pouch of this, an empty pouch of carrots, and a note saying that he absolutely refused to eat this.  They even tried to trick him and dip the peas/beans in to the carrots and it was still a no go.  My son eats up peas alone, but there is something about this combination that does not work.

Baby reviews are hard, as it's all in how the LO reacts, and every little darling is different. Mine did not like this. She loves her green beans, and she loves her peas (we get the earths best), but she gagged on these. My guess is the mint. I tried it before giving it to her, and didn't like the taste, but figured it was worth a try. I'm sure some babies would love it, but mine was not a fan. The after taste it left in my mouth was not good, so I imagine that was part of it as well. Thankfully we had just purchased a single pack of it at Walmart, so we were only out the single, so before purchasing this larger pack, I would get a single somewhere local. We like a lot of the sprouts organic baby foods, but this one just wasn't for us. :)

column9: This has mint in the ingredients
column10: I ordered this thinking it was peas and green beans as the front of the label says.  When it arrived I checked the ingredients on the back and it has mint in it.  I gave it a try anyway (mint is healthy) but my baby did not like it.  It is a really strong mint flavor/smell.  My baby love the plain peas though.
As much as I love other Sprout baby food products, unfortunately, this one is not a winner. The flavor leaves much to be desired. My baby completely refuses to eat this.

I have trouble getting my 7 month old to eat any green veggies.  I was skeptical after reading some of the other reviews for this product but I decided to give it a try anyway.  He LOVES this flavor (and all other Sprout flavors he has tried so far).  I am so glad I decided to give it a try.  And yes, it does smell a little funky but don't let that stop you!
My son loves peas, but won't eat green beans. I gave this a try, and he loves it. We've tried a number of the stage 1 foods and a few stage 2. So far both me and my baby are very pleased.

I do not understand all the negative reviews.  This entire product line, including the peas and beans w/mint are awesome!  My daughter is an adventurous eater, and always eats every last bit out of these pouches.  She only eats them when we are traveling as I make most of my own baby food, or just feed her what we are eating.  The only negatives I have found are with the sugar levels of the cereals (peach rice pudding, etc).  The first ingredient is fruit juice.

I was disappointed to see the low rating on this product, I had to give my two cents.We opened a pouch of sweet peas & beans last night.  My son wanted no part of it.  He would not open his mouth.  Today, we tried it again.  He devoured it.He's our first baby and it seems that every meal, every food is hit or miss.  Like us I think he might just not be in the mood for it, or maybe wants something else?No matter the reason, I love the Sprout pouches.  I've tasted each one and they are much better than some other baby foods.  I also make some of my own baby food and mine lack flavor diversity.  So Sprout is a good way to get him into new foods.

I've tried all the Sprouts with my son and he's loved them all...except this one.He'd already had peas and green beans I'd prepared for him fresh prior to trying this and I figured he'd like this too.He literally recoiled.Naturally I had to try it as he hasn't turned down a single food item I've introduced to him yet (including Greek yogurt and Indian lentils by 8 months)...you couldn't pay me to eat more of this stuff.Yes, the mint was the primary culprit, but overall the flavor resembled peas and green beans very little.If you want to try it, get a single pack from the store before buying a case.

column9: Don't listen to the bad reviews!
column10: This baby food is great.  My baby loves this pea/green bean/mint combo.  Don't listen to all the negative reviews.  My guess is that some of the parents might not be into mint as a seasoning.  Ithink that introducing fresh herbs such as mint is a great idea.  My baby eats the entire pack, no problem, and she is 10 months.  She's been eating it for a few months now.

column9: This product looks and tastes awful.
column10: I bought these thinking they would be good for travel (they are), taste good (they don't) and help me get more veggies into my then 9 month old. Well he's 10.5 months now and most of these pouches are still sitting in the kitchen because he wouldn't eat the ones I tried to give him. He's not a particularly picky eater, but with these he clamps his mouth shut tight and turns away!

My daughter does not like Peas! No idea why?..But she ate this..I love that its organic. I did find that when I warmed them she ate all of it. If they were room temp. she did not go for all of it she only ate about 6 spoons and she was done.I would recommend to friends and family for their little one, love the fact that it has no preservatives and its all natural.

column9: Great - but expensive on this site
column10: My daughter likes all of the Sprout products but the prices on Amazon are very hight - I buy this on a competitors site for $3.00 less per 12 pack!!

My son is a human garbage disposal. He will eat anything and everything but he wont touch this stuff. i also tasted it myself and i can understand why. the "mint" that they add tastes like tobacco or something. i tastes nothing like mint and they put a lot of it too.

column9: Decently Balanced and Delicious Snack Bar!
column10: I love these bars. They are primarily seed based, so if you don't love seeds then you won't love these bars. However, they are Gluten-free, Dairy-free & GMO-free if you're looking to rid yourself of any of the above mentioned items. Also, they are vegetarian and possibly vegan depending on your stance on honey.Personally, I just wanted a snack bar that was gluten free, soy free, msg free, preservative free and tasted good. That's what I got here! I like the cranberry version too.These bars are a bit expensive and difficult to find in stores.  The Whole Foods here in Raleigh used to stock them, but no longer does.  I have to buy them online right now as I haven't found another local store that sells them.  Also, they are a bit crumbly but I never pull mine all the way out of the package so it usually catches the mess for me.Over all, one of my favorite snack bars.
These are so good, hard to find in stores, but darned expensive. I get them for a special treat sometimes, there is no better bar, but oooh the price! that stops me from making it a habit.

I really like this product.  It's a different kind of chili, in that it's more like jazzed up bean soup than traditional chili. For low sodium, it's pretty zippy.  And, I like the texture provided by the corn and green peppers.  Other than that, I like the handy tear-off top and the fact that Amazon will deliver it.  I, too, have it for lunch every day.

I had been looking for low sodium products to try, so I was glad to come across this no salt added vegetarian chili. It tastes pretty good. I hardly miss the salt because it had all the flavor and thickness of regular chili, though it was a little too hot for my tastes. I prefer the mild version...but, if you like your chili very hot and spicy, you'll probably love this. I was, however, very disappointed with the packaging of my order...unlike the mild chili I purchased, there was no type of protective bubble wrap or packing peanuts, so all except two cans were badly dented when I received it. I have to say I was suprised with the poor packing of the order as I've never had any issues with Amazon's packing procedures. Other than that, I was satisfied with the product and plan to order more of the mild vegetarian chili.

column9: Health Valley No Salt Added Spicy Vegetarian Chili
column10: I have eaten this product every day for lunch for several years now and I really like it, first of all for it's low sodium content (75 mg), I have found no comparable product anywhere close to that, I also like it's organic attributes, protein content and it's taste, although I am not a garlic lover and wish they would greatly reduce or eliminate it entirely. I try to disguise the garlic taste with turmeric and flax seed oil, which works pretty good.

About a third of the cans arrived with major dents in them.  No wonder they get put for sale through the mail - no one would ever buy these off the shelf.  That being said, there is an odd taste in here I can't put my finger on - I think it is unusually bitter - I add some cumin and fresh tomato and that dilutes the odd flavor a bit and it turns into some pretty good chili.

Health Valley's Santa Fe Organic White Bean Chili is the WORST chili I've ever had. It's not incredibly spicy (I didn't end up having to put cheese,sour cream or yogurt on it) It vindicates those who believe vegan/vegetarian is bland and awful. Healthy,I'm sure,but not of the "tastes good and good for you too" ilk. There's nothing distinctively Southwestern about it either--like using black beans and blue corn. Fantastic World Foods' Southwestern Chili is not only better, but it's edible and its spiciness it punchy. Avoid this one. It probably is better as compost.

I am rather hard to please with 'straight' (unflavored) coffee.  I don't like any bitterness, nor too strong a taste, but yet want a rich coffee flavor that can stand up to a large mug.  I've found this Kenyan AA to have all the qualities that make a satisfying morning coffee.  To me, it tastes like really good coffee is supposed to.  I've tried many types of K cup coffees and this is always the one I come back to.  I enjoy flavored coffees for later in the day, but my first morning cup needs to be 'pure' and to me, this is as pure and rich as it comes.  If it were wine, it would be called smooth and full-bodied.  If it were chocolate, it would be semi-sweet.  In fact, it reminds me of chocolate because of the roundness of its flavor.For those who like 'rocket fuel' type coffee, this will seem too mild, but to the coffee drinker who prefers medium or even light roast coffee and wants something deeply satisfying, this really fits the bill.Now, if only Amazon would sell it in those big 'frustration free' boxes.  I'd sure buy it.  Highly recommended.

my family drinks and prefers 'bolder' coffees.this one is mildly bold, makes avery satisfactory normal tastingbold morning commute coffee. we didn't find any roughedges in it yet. i drink mine with extramilk and that tends to smooth out any coffee.gave it 4 stars.  will probably reorder.

column9: Really good coffee, but (today) inflated internet price
column10: This became my favorite coffee after spending a week in Kenya.  While I continue to search for the "right" beans and/or ground Kenyan AA coffee by which to duplicate the "real deal", the appeal of K-Cups--for both home use as well as to insert in my office's Keurig machine--was too much to resist.  I was happy to find the Kenyan AA K-Cups on Amazaon.  However, based on its availability at another just-discovered internet site, it does not make sense to pay 36-60% more (depending on quantity purchased) from Amazon.com, even though I so value its excellent service.
My favorite coffee is Kenya AA.  This is not the best, freshly ground but is a 3.5 to 4 stars.

After Green Mountain decided to discontinue everyone's favorite K-Cup flavor, Expresso, Kenyan AA came the closet as a replacement.  If Green Mountain does not revive the Expresso flavor, I will go back to Melita Columbian brewed in a conventional drip coffee maker.
I love this coffee because it is bold and bright without being extremely acidic.  Very good cup of black coffee!
We could not find this coffee at the stores near us, wouldn't you know it, Amazon  had it.  thanks Amazon

Strange how I couldn't order this blend from Green Mountain Coffee - They've been out of stock for ages now. So happy to see that it was offered here! I ordered 4 boxes just to be sure not to run out again! The blend is strong yet smooth. No bitterness to it at all. It's my favorite wake up coffee! I am certain if you try it you will love it also!

I'm a really big fan of Kenyan coffee and this did not dissapoint.  I found the flavor to be quite pleasing.  Although I still find that I prefer the freshly roasted whole beans I purchase from "Whole Foods Markets" but this hits the spot for my Keurig.
The Kenyan highland cooperatives consistently get high marks for their coffee. The Green Mountain product is the only K cup access I've found.

This coffee has the characteristics I like. It is a medium roast and its extra bold. But the kicker is a very subtle taste that I can't identify that makes it unique. I sense no bitterness and no aftertaste. Just a relatively strong cup of good tasting coffee. I think it might be my favorite.
This is a great blend, it is a distinctive, rich and flavorful coffee.This is my favorite flavor, great aroma, great taste, bar none.

I love this coffee!  Unfortunately, the only way to get your attention is to give it one star, and I do so because of the pricing issue.  Do not buy the larger quantity.  Order 2 boxes of 24 instead.  Do the math.  You will pay much more if you order 48 than if you order two boxes of 24.  Shame on Amazon.  Those in a hurry may automatically assume there is a savings if they place an order for the larger quantity.  They will be wrong, and feel duped.

There is only one bad thing to say about these! They disappear fast! Oh my gosh, they taste so great, everyone loves them. I bought these as a gift for my daughter and son-in-law. They loved them, and so did their guests that dropped by to visit.

Living out in the boonies, I find it a bit hard to stop by the convenience store or the vending machine. So, this sizable pack of munchies is plenty to hold me over for long days working in the office.

In the age of Michael Pollan's, "In Defense of Food", these are traditional candy bars that even our grandmothers would recognize. They make great party favors, and are good for that special occasion. They came quickly and were just what we had expected.

column9: Most delicious cooking oil, Best Value
column10: I decided to try rice bran oil when I was on a diet that excluded some other oils and recommended rice bran oil. I tried some from the health food store, and fell in love with the taste, but it was very expensive for a tiny bottle.  I started looking for a bulk source online.  Tophe pure rice bran oil 1/2 gallon, here on Amazon, was the best value I found.It tastes delicious on salads and in cooked foods.  I think it is the most tasty cooking oil I've ever used.  I like it better than olive oil or coconut oil because it doesn't have a strong flavor that would conflict with some foods.  It seems to go with almost everything.  I've ordered this Tophe oil twice now, getting several half gallons each time.  Shipping is a little high, but if you order several at once, it isn't bad at all.

Like another reviewer (Purple Cloud); I've been purchasing this oil for at least 2 years or longer. I cook quite extenisvely and frequently utilize high end products and equipment to complete my recipes. Many of these items I either purchase online or in specialty food markets. I happened to be reading a cooking magazine or some such material that listed the health and cooking benefits of rice bran oil (helps to reduce cholesterol and it has none, has no trans fats, and has vitamin E among other benefits). This oil also has a very light, almost non-flavor which is great when you lightly sautee delicate vegetables, such as asparagus. I don't want my oil competing with the flavor of my food in some cases. Because of the light flavor, I actually bake with this oil and have absolutely no residual oil taste. I don't even think I own any canola or vegetable oil. I also love the fact that this has a high smoke point (490 degrees) higher than peanut oil as a matter of fact, which is absolutely great when I want to sear meat in a pan. As does everyone else, I also want to save as much money as I can, especially when I am purchasing high end products. To save money purchasing this oil, I actually order this directly from Honest Foods.com, which is cheaper than the listed Amazon price, although this oil is being sold here by Honest Foods. I also look for coupon codes when ordering from Honest Foods to save even more money. I typically also purchase two or more at a time and Honest Foods reduces the price to $8 per 1/2 gallon. I have never had my oil "go bad" and simply store it in a cupboard, and I do not deep fry anything, so it's not as if I use mass quantities in short duration. This is a great product and everyone should try it. Also, this product is made and processed right here in the United States.

column9: It only took me 40 years to discover this fantastic oil!
column10: No kidding.  My wife has been asking me for 40 years why french fried potatoes and other vegetables never turned out right.This Tophe Rice Bran Oil is the answer!  French fries that are brown and crispy on the outside and soft and perfect on the inside.  And no greasy mess. No sagging. And the paper towel you use to absorb excess ends up perfectly clean and dry.This oil is a chef's dream.  I only wish I had discovered it 40 years ago!  If you appreciate vegetables and meats that are perfectly fried - look no further.Don't take my word for it.  You have to try it just once - and you will never settle for anything less.Outstanding oil in every respect and super healthy to boot!

This is a terrific product.  I have been wanting a clean tasting frying oil with high heat and smoke points to deep fry my chicken.  And this is it.  I use this along with my Fagor pressure fryer which makes it a perfect combo to get the broasted chicken I can make make at home.

This oil has a lot of health benefits and I have definitely noticed a difference in my cholesterol readings since I started using it as my primary oil for stir fry and so on.  It has a high smoke point and an extremely light flavor that doesn't interfere with even delicate foods like scallops.  I now use olive oil as my cold oil and exclusively Tophe rice bran oil for all cooking.  The company also ships very fast.

I had been wanting to try rice bran oil for several months, but couldn't find it anywhere locally.  I even went to an Asian grocery store and they had never heard of it!  After searching I discovered that Amazon had the Tophe 1/2 gallon rice bran oil for a better price than any other that I could find, so I ordered two of them.  I poured both into my deep fryer, and WOW!  I couldn't believe how easily and perfectly everything browned, and everything came out perfectly crispy on the outside.  On the inside, very moist and delicious.  Plus, this oil doesn't soak into the food like a lot of other oils, so you don't really get an oily or greasy taste.  I just received my next three bottles so I can change out the fryer next time.  I'm totally sold on this oil, and I really don't understand why it's not available everywhere. It browns and crisps better than peanut oil, is better for you than canola oil, has a higher smoke point than most oils, has a light taste that doesn't stick to foods, and makes a fantastic coating for charcoal grills to keep food from sticking to them.  After just a few weeks those are my observations, and I'm still finding things I like.  This is really THE PERFECT FRYING OIL.

column9: Awesome stuff!! Great for animals too!
column10: I had been searching for quite sometime for affordable rice bran oil and this was the most reasonable Ive found and its great. My horse ver recommended 4oz. a day of this oil for my horse to help him gain weight. Worked wonders. He is now at perfect weight and it also helped with muscle and his coat looks soo shiny and healthy. great product can use for dogs and cats too to promote weight gain or help with coats. Tried cooking up my tofu with this also and it tasted really good. all around great stuff.
this product arrived quickly and in good shape.  I like using his oil for frying as it gives the food a nice light taste.

Excellent price for outstanding oil. I won't touch highly processed vegetable oils that are usually rancid from processing additives and high heats, and with lousy omega 6-3 ratios. Rice bran, although not expeller pressed, does maintain a fantastic nutritional profile. No off-putting tastes, fairly high smoke point. Highly recommended.

column9: Wonder if I got a bad batch
column10: I have used rice bran oil before that I purchased through Williams & Sonoma and it was great: light, clean tasting and almost no smoke at high heat.This is not the same stuff. I tastes fine but smokes like crazy even at medium heat.I wonder if I got a bad batch.

I first saw this product on the Dr. Oz show. I don't watch often but it was on one day...  Anyway I ordered this product here on Amazon, I used it in my daughter's birthday cake.  No one could tell the oil was different, I deep fried some french fries the other evening and family really liked them. I have also used this for marinading steak for the grill, A+.  I am getting ready to order my second bottle.

I just received my order of Tophe Rice Bran Oil and the taste is phenomenal.  This will be the only that I will be using in the future.  The Customer Service Dept at Honest Foods are exceptional and courteous.  They extend excellent service in any discrepancy that may arise.  I will be a future Honest Food customer.  A Happy Customer

I got my order yesterday (prompt delivery) 2/8/2012 and I could not wait to try the oil. So this morning I decided to have an omelette for breakfast. Boy, was I impressed and I am not exaggerating.First, the oil is light and it did not have an after taste. After discovering the blood type diet, I found out that certain oils are not good for my blood type.To add to what other customers have said, this is a great cooking oil with health benefits. I will save my olive oil for cold dressings. Although this half gallon is cheaper(I think its' due to the packaging), I plan to keep the rice bran oil in a dark space until I get a dark bottle to preserve the oil since the shelf life is considered 6-12 months.Cheers to good health!

Just look at the health benefits of rice bran oil!  I've been buying & using this oil for about 2 years.  I do a lot of stir frys, steaming, and this oil is very delicate/mild in taste; does not interfere with the foods' tastes at all.  (unlike canola or corn oil which have that heavy unpleasant taste that takes weeks to get used to.)  I will always use this.
I don't profess to be a cook, but find using this product to be unique. It doesn't smoke when put in a hot skillet. So far I've found this to be a good product.

We love this product and are now using it in place of olive oil.  It has a much higher smoke point, so is perfect for frying.  The first order took a while due to high demand, but our second order came within days.  thanks so much!
Great & Healthy Oil. Try it out for yourself. Use it with all your Fried foods. Price point works too as it is one of the best Oils around.
I was a littled worried when purchaing this product because rice bran oil ages rapidly, however this brand is very fresh and of excellent quality.

I've read that rice bran oil has health benefits most other oils don't have so that's a good thing, but it also has virtually no taste so it doesn't affect the flavor of what you're making.  For delicately flavored dressings, that's a real advantage.The fact that it has a very high smoke point is a joy when sautéing something--no more smoky kitchen--and if you're a fan of deep fryers there's no lingering odor after cooking as there is with peanut oil.  I still love olive oil some things, but this is my new favorite for everything where that isn't the appropriate choice.

I have moved from Olive Oil to this now.  It is light and no heavy after taste.  It also helps you not to gain weight and I used it in all of my foods when it calls for oil.  Very good product!  Love it!
This oil is not only great to fry with because it can stand high heat its also wonderful when roasting or grilling vegetables and is healthy for you to.
This oil is great for cooking and making soap. It is similar to olive oil without the olive oil taste.
I know fried foods are not good for you. But if your going to do it this is better for you than vegetable oil and it does not smoke at high temps. Fantastic product.
The product arrived just at the right time.  The label was confusing since it read 12 oz when it was really half gallon.

This cooking oil is great. You can use it for high heat cooking or low heat cooking.Best of all it leaves no after taste, takes very little in the pan.I pour a little in the pan, spreading it with a pastry brush to coat the pan and that is all I need to cook with, so one bottle of this goes a long way.And it is good for you, what else could anyone want out of a cooking oil ?Buy this, you will not be sorry you did.
I have good baking luck with this healthy oil. I will continue using it as long as it remains high quality and Ilike it.
I don't cook with oil but I do now I heard about it on DR OZ it was suppose to be better for you. It actually makes the food taste better more of its own flavor. It now sits beside the Crisco
Rice Bran Oil has a very good flavor, and does not smoke or burn.  I am really pleased with my purchase.

this is a great brand! i have been using RBO for years. i fry foods guilt free and use it for all my baking. tophe rice bran oil is high quality, smooth neutral taste and the 1/2 gallon bottle is made of BPA free PET plastic. I got that directly from the company. I think their customer service is fabulous too. seems like a very dedicated company. try it! it's was a great switch for us.
This is my first time. I have not used this oil b/4. The taste is  good, I am planning for using it just like Dr.Oz recomended. Thanks
Received the item fast! Since Dr. Oz recommended wanted to try it. Glad that I did. Will order this item again. Thanks.

I was not sure how I would like this oil, especially since, with a high initial cost, plus high shipping, it's pretty expensive.  However, rice bran oil is much more nutritious and better for you, so, I reasoned that since I don't really use all that much oil, it wouldn't be that big a deal.  I think that I will look around and try to find a source in my area, to save the shipping charges (I live in a highly rural area and there aren't too many health food stores nearby) but if I can't, I'll probably go ahead and order this.  The taste is slightly different, but you get used to it quickly and it's a very lightweight oil, which I found very pleasant.  It also has to get very hot before it will start smoking, so it doesn't make as much odor in your house, if you're cooking something for a long time.  It seems to me that it held a constant temperature better, too.  All in all, I really like it and I like that it's a healthier choice for the few times that I fry something.  Even though it was expensive, I feel that it's worth it, and it's also worth the trouble of looking for a closer sourse.
Bot it to be a healthier me. If Dr. Oz says to do it...I  do it. Thanks for making available to us consumers.
This item is mislabeled. The company says it is legal to do so. It is labeled as 12 oz. but is really 64 oz. (I guess).

I'm reviewing this candy because I have discovered it has helped relieve my chronic sinusitis. Constantly sucking on these mints greatly improves my production of saliva, and that in turn seems to keep my nasal passages moist. I cannot speak to the way this might work, but I can state with confidence that in my case, it does.

These fabulous mints have kept me off cigarettes for 3-plus years. Besides being the best tasting mint out there, they keep me calm and focused. Treat yourself to a great tasty treat and fresh breath.
I would buy some in a store to see if you like them.  I do and the price was better on here.
I could onlu buy Ice Breakers as a large department/grocery store.  And it is 40 miles from wjere I live; so dsvr on your gas and save a little chenge at the same time.
