American manufacturers are notorious for discontinuing great products so they can avoid doing any manufacturing process that doesn't follow a preset, cookbook methodology requiring as little innovation and creativity to meet consumer needs as possible. The result? They spend all their advertising dollars telling us what we SHOULD like, NOT what we DO like and I, for one, am sick and tired of it! I thought our economic system was based upon supply and demand; apparently it's based how little the capitalists can do, in order to benefit themselves, while ignoring what their customers want. I will buy as much of this gum as I can get my hands on, and will absolutely NEVER buy another product manufactured by do-nothing, greedy Cadbury Adams.
This gum is being discontinued and I was glad to be able to get some of it before it was too late.

Why is it that when you find a product that is good, it has to be discontinued?  My husband had throat cancer which caused his saliva glands to dry up, not totally.  This gum does help in secrete saliva.  What are you replacing this with?
Good chips and like the fact that the small bag size keeps me from eating too many (unless I grab a 2nd bag). Healthier Chip in a snack sized bag. Simple good tasting Chip.

I've been an avid PopChips (100 calories per bag) consumer so far. Much as I enjoy them, I thought it was time to look around at other healthy options. That's where these chips came in. I love avocados and potatoes! So pairing them together could only get better. The chips are crunchy and yummy. My only gripe is that they are a tad oily but considering it avocado oil, I guess it's not that bad. I'm definitely looking forward to trying the other flavors.I didn't see any calorie information on this listing page, so I thought I'd add it. Each bag is about 175 calories and holds a fair amount of chips. Since I like to keep my daily (almost) consumption under 100 calories, I share a bag with my husband:)

I'm trying to get my husband to eat better. But he misses his potato chips. I got a case of these thinking they would last a while (at least a couple of months). He liked them so much, they were gone in two weeks!

I purchase these for my kids lunches because they are a healthy alternative to industrial oils that can be unhealthy and even toxic.  We avoid canola and other vegetable oils in favor of olive oil, coconut oil, and avocado oil.

I don't normally eat plain chips and when I saw "Avocado oil" on the package, I hoped there would be a slight avocado taste. Not here. If you like plain, salted chips that are simply cooked in a healthier way, these are good chips. They are crispy, lightly salted and well made but there's no real flavor to these other than potato and salt. I give them a 3.5-4 stars review.

I didn't expect these packages to be so small, but I do like the chips.  They have a lovely flavor--different from any I had eaten before.  I would buy these again to have on hand when I am compelled to eat a salty snack.
These chips are the best! If you have to eat potato chips, the avocado oil helps one feel they are somewhat healthy.And the lime flavor is great.Natasha

I found these when ordering Avocado Oil at amazon.com (under, "people who ordered this, bought this...").I bought the 24-pack Kettle Cooked/Sea Salt/Avocado Oil flavor.  Arrived in 2-days/no shipping because I am an amazonPRIME member.FABULOUS!  Taste JUST like regular Kettle chips, only I know they have GOOD OILS and not bad!For everyone who hasn't licked the desire/need for an occasional chip, but wants to avoid wheat/GMO corn/omega-6 oils....this is for YOU!Taste great.  Satisfy the chip urge.  NO GUILT!TRY THEM!  You won't be sorry...
These are delicious, crispy, with mild tangy flavor. The only problem is self control with them. They are a nice alternative to regular chips.

Edit!Kudos to the seller for correcting the picture.Old review - no longer valid:They should not put a 13.2 ounce can in their ad when they are selling the 5.5 ounce size. It is good cat food so 3 stars for that.

column9: OK - Not as good as Shasta Diet Black Cherry
column10: If Amazon ever offers Shasta Diet Black Cherry get it!Hansen's is a good 2nd choice taste wise but I have had several smashed cans of pop in each case I order.Also allot of cans with pinholes in them & those half or more empty & have to throw away.Also the cans have this Black Soot stuff on them that gets all over your hands, cloths & anything else you touch.  Think it's because of the poor packing of the soda & the cans rubbing together during shipping.Shasta packages their soda so much better!  No Soot!  No smashed cans & No pinholes in their cans!Amazon offers Shasta Diet Soda to purchase but doesn't offer Shasta Diet Black Cherry Soda yet.Why, I don't know.  I know Shasta still makes Diet Black Cherry as I have purchased it at grocery stores.Any Diet Soda that you can purchase from Shasta tastes better & is packaged better than anything Hansen's hasto offer.  Also you throw away money with each case you buy because of the cans being smashed & having pinholesin them.  Taste wise Hansen's is a good Second choice for diet soda.Oh that Soot from Hansen's cans..., if you get it on your cloths, it's there Forever!

My favorite soda flavor is black cherry. I'm not real picky and will often buy the store brand diet version.This, however, is definitely a cut above. It has little of the diet aftertaste, and the cherry flavor is quite robust.I definitely recommend this flavor if you like Dr. Pepper and other black cherry drinks.
This soda is delicious. However the price should be lower but I will purchase this again. Another flavor that is even better is the root beer.

column9: HANSEN BEVERAGE DIET BLACK CHERRY SODA
column10: HAS AN EXCELLENT FLAVOR.  I HAVE HAD 3 CANS SINCE PURCHASE AND HAS PLENTY OF "FIZZ".  STANDARD FLIP TOP RING TO OPEN. ONE CAN WAS DAMAGED WITHOUT BEING ABLE TO SEE.....LEAKED OUT INTO CARBOARD CASE CAUSING SOME DARK AREAS AND WEAKNESS IN THE CARDBOARD CASE. ANOTHER SODA I WILL CONTINUE TO PURCHASE WHEN ON SALE RELATED TO NOT HAVING SODIUM IN IT.

I've been buying the diet black cherry and diet cola for a few years now. Both are fantastic but the black cherry is one of the better diet sodas I've tasted.  In addition to the taste, I don't mind my children drinking it either--they love them--because there's no caffeine and it's without all of the artificial ingredients that are in traditional sodas. Great price on Amazon too.
I love this diet soda.  I particularly love this flavor of black cherry. This brand is difficult to find and for a reasonable price.

I am a soda fanatic, black cherry being my absolute favorite! I mainly stick to diet since I try to watch my weight and not drink the regular sodas that contain 30 grams of sugar. My first natural soda was zevia black cherry, which was delicious however pricey ($6-7 for a six pack). I found this at Trader Joe's ($2.50 for six pack)...tried it...and loved it!!!! It does not have a real "diet-y" taste or bad after taste. The flavor is not weak either like some black cherry sodas I have tried. I look forward to trying other Diet Hansen's sodas.

I use this tea whenever I feel the slightest tickle in my throat - I used to have either Bronchitis or Pneumonia on a bi-annual regular basis, but haven't since I've had this tea.  I find it is great for all sorts of lung issues and have recommended it to a number of friends and co-workers.  It was recommended to me by a trusted natural products chemist.

They're still moist, well packed, and not badly broken by the shipping process. Lots of clove oil and flavor.The only problem I found is they weren't sorted quite as well as other cloves I've bought. There were pieces of stems left in the bag.That said, the stems are so light, I doubt they significantly impact the total amount of cloves in the package, and for the price I don't think it's a bad deal.
I was happy with the delivery time. The cloves are in good shape, my only complaint is there not as strong as i had hoped.

column9: High quality citrus extract 3 little bottle set
column10: They're three flavors, orange lime and lemon. When I open the cap of each bottle, the aroma of each is definitely authentic. This product is worthy of being described as high quality.
We have loved it! It has enhanced our cooking and eating experience.The flavors are real and not that processed flavor. It has been excellent in smoothies and other drinks.
This is a very simple set of flavorings, and they are nice and strong. You don't need to add much to get a nice deep flavor!

This makes one great lo-carb drink BUT it even makes a greater ZERO carb yogurt mix. Use 3 ounces of water per packet and refridgerate. Use 3-5 TBSP (or per taste) per 5 ounces of low fat light yogurt. This makes the absolutely BEST tasting yogurt there is. I use Chobani 2% (plain of course). There mudslide is also great in yogurt and in a cocktail too. What a find. And no carbs and no calories-unreal.

Personnal, I prefer the French Vanilla flavor, but my wife goes through a can of this in like a week! She says it's the best powdered cappuccino she's ever tasted, and won't even touch another kind anymore.

I have used this product for a couple year now and love it.  In fact, instead of mixing it with water, I mix it with my coffee in the morning and enjoy it more then the mocha's I was getting at well-known coffee places. I used to by this product at a couple stores who longer carry it, which was really frustrating. Being able to buy it online is great!

With so many to choose from, this product is becoming harder to find at the store.  Ordering it here was the easiest and fastest way to get it.  Love this product!  Tried several brands, but Folgers has the best combination of ingredients to make it cafe-quality.  Add nonfat half & half and/or nonfat ice cream and your cappuccino will be every bit as good as cafe-purchased--and you'll save a fortune in money and calories.  Shelf-life is good, so buy it by the case and you won't have to worry about running out.  Can't go a day without my mocha-cap fix!  On a hot day I add nonfat chocolate ice cream and I'm in Heaven!
I have been going through a lot of different cappuccino mixes; and this one has to be one of the worse. It doesn't taste much like chocolate mocha.
I drink this everyday and love it.  I used to get this as a monthly automatic purchase.  I was bummed they discontinued this option but I do love the product.

My husband bought me a case of the Mocha and absolutely love the stuff, I hope Amazon want stop selling it cause Walmart has and I can't find in other grocery stores. I'm not a big coffee drinker but love cappuccino's and now I can have it anytime I want a cup!
Love this product, hope it continues to be available in subscribe and save. Tastes good and relatively economical. Wish it came in a sugar free mix.

Ok, I was a little irritated, when I found out our local supermarket no longer carries this brand. I had to resort to buying it online. If I didn't like it so much I wouldn't have even bothered. Wonderful coffee!

I use this to make frappuccino. I don't add sugar or sweetener for the mix is perfect. With just ice and milk blended with Folgers cappuccino, the result is a delicious, creamy smooth taste. I've tried several flavors, including Dragonfruit Freeze and Raspberry Sorbet, in addition to Kiwi Watermelon and have enjoyed them all.  However, I find that the flavor doesn't last very long - maybe about half an hour tops.  Which for me at least, means I end up going through a pack or two a day.  This gum would be perfect if the flavor lasted a bit longer.
The ecstasy of chewing this flavor of gum cannot be put into words.  If I were the president of my own country, this gum would be used as currency.

Xylitol feels like sugar, looks like sugar and tastes like sugar, with no side effects.This gum is very flavorful and long lasting. I'm very happy to be able to chew bum again.
This gum is wonderful.  I was very excited to find it in the larger package.

column9: Brown Rice Balls Dog Treat in 16 oz.Plastic Containers
column10: I have purchased this product many many times and have never ever had a problem with it.  These are the only dog treats my dog loves.  Normally, these are fresh and soft but crunchy. I had to take a pair of pliers to hold the rice ball and then hit it with a hammer in order to break it into pieces.I did contact Rawhide Depot and they did offer a refund.  I was told it could be the vendor.  We'll see what the next batch brings.

Honestly, this stuff takes just like Skippy peanut butter!  It will separate after a while but all you need to do is stir it up a bit to get the lumps out.  I developed a nut allergy later in life and could not be happier to find a peanut butter substitute that tastes just like the real thing!  Highly recommended!

With an "allergy kid" in the house, we have removed all peanut products. This is the closest thing to real peanut butter we have found. I would love to give it a higher ranking, but it seems that the price has gone up significantly and is only available in a 6-pack.

column9: So that's why it costs so much!
column10: I was really hesitant to buy this food because it costs about twice the most expensive premium brand grocery dog food costs at the pet food store, but decided to give it a shot since Amazon offers a deal for subscribing. (I bought the 15 lb bag, which is why I don't have a verified purchase in the 30 lb listing) I honestly wouldn't even know about this product if our new puppy's breeder hadn't recommended it, and was using it on their pups. I'm not one of those people that have to eat organic, or those guys that have to have the word "holistic" on their animals' food. In fact, I usually just buy what's on sale, as long as it meets my personal quality standards. But after trying this, it kind of makes sense why they cost more.When I first opened the bag, I noticed that it did not have that strong dog food scent that most dog foods I've purchased for my dogs have. It actually smells kind of good, to where I would almost be brave enough to taste it. Second, the kibble size is perfect for my golden retriever puppy. Not too big or small, and it perfect for training treats. In the morning before feeding my dogs in their bowl, I usually let them earn their meal through training, and these are perfectly sized and tasty enough to use for that. The outer layer seems almost coated, so you don't get kibble crumbs in your hand and into your fingertips. Third, and most importantly- It's really good for your dog! Prior to buying our new puppy, I did a lot of research (as a good prospective dog owner should) on raising a healthy dog. One of the biggest things that stuck with me was that you WILL pay for your dogs' health- either in the form of good dog food, or in the form of a vet bill. Have a nice day:)

column9: Tried a lot.... this one the best!
column10: We are relatively new pet owners.  We've had our goldendoodle for 10 months and during that time, we've tried a variety of products.  Started out with Wellness, moved on to Chicken Soup, I think there was another one in the mix, and then landed on this one.  I don't have anything negative to say about the others- our dog likes them all- but this one made a huge difference in her bathroom schedule.  She is so regular right now, I could set a clock to her.  I attribute it to the food.  We are very happy with this product.

Our puppy was being fed this food for a little over a month with no problem. She eagerly awaited to be fed, and wagged her tail the whole time she was eating. However, in the past couple of days she has been very gassy. It seems to be related to this food, because when we switched back to a raw diet, there were no problems. It seems like all of a sudden her body changed, and is not accepting of this food. She was farting every 5-10 minutes... very SMELLY gas that would clear the room! Her stools were also soft and very smelly.I'm going to switch to the grain-free "Instinct" line of food by the same company, and see if this helps. I'd like to go 100% raw, but it just is a bit too much work.
These are the best tasting fat free refried beans on the market.  I have tried many organic brands.  Bearitos are the best.  I highly recommend them.

I was very disappointed when I received this product because there was only one pack of pudding in the box. For some reason, paying $8.99 for just four puddings was crazy. I was expecting four packs of four, not what I received. Will definitely just go to the store next time, a whole lot cheaper.

column4: Kimberly J. Karas "a New England mom"
column10: I absolutely love the convenience of K-cups and Pumpkin Spice is a favorite flavor of mine by Green Mountain coffee.  It's not always in stock so if you think you might want it, grab it before it's gone.  The price will vary on it as well, so as a general rule the closer you can get to thirty dollars on a 50 pack for k-cups the better.  I scored mine for thirty-one dollars.  There is a good spice flavor with the pumpkin and it goes well with my efforts to eliminate sugar from my coffee.  I'm just trying to enjoy the natural flavors with a hint of milk.  This is a great flavor for that goal.

I just tried this coffee in the Keurig edition while waiting for my car to be repaired and, being the pumpkin coffee junkie that I am, well, temptation just provided me with a new favorite! This coffee has just the right amount of spice - not too heavy or too light, and just makes the perfect cup. Don't try Millstone's - yuck! Had SO much troule just choking that one down. If you call Green Mountain, you'll find out that this is their NUMBER 1 selling flavored coffee. Highly, highly, highly recommend!
MY DAUGHTER & I BOTH ENJOY PUMPKIN SPICE COFFEE.  SAW IT AT BED BATH & BEYOND.  PURCHASED A BOX FOR $12.89.  HAD IT FOR BREAKFAST THIS MORNING.  NO FLAVOR WHAT SO EVER.  I WON'T BE PURCHASING AGAIN.

column10: I normally love Green Mountain's flavored coffees-- I buy them almost exclusively. I was very excited to see the Pumpkin Spice flavor back for the year so I eagerly bought them. The first time I made it, I thought I accidentally reused the K-cup because it tasted so watered down. I tried again and again, and every cup is the same. It smells great and has some pumpkin flavor, but it is not strong enough because my coffee has never tasted so watered down before. I have to add quite a bit of creamer and sugar to hide it.I haven't had this problem with my Keurig before or since. I am still going to go through my 18-pack, but I don't think I will be buying these again. Hopefully next fall's batch will be better!

It's, by far, the best pumpkin coffee around! I've tried many. Some stores have it on their shelves- like the one that sells bath & bedding items that has a twenty percent off coupon that never expires. ;)

I  do not often write reviews but I love this flavor. It doesn't require additional sweetening in my opinion, it's perfect.
Love this coffee. Reminds me of fall and thanksgiving. It smells so great and tastes great as well. Yummy! Fan favorite.
Very good coffee.  You have to brew it on the 8oz setting for the best flavor.  Will be ordering more when they are back in stock at this price!
I love this coffee, great brand and best flavor I've had so far... and I've tried a lot of different brands/flavors.

Some of the other pumpkin spice flavored K-cups that I have tried smelled really nice, but had absolutely no flavor.  This one fills the kitchen with that spicy aroma and has a full flavor!  I even run through a 2nd shot on smaller cup size.  It has that much flavor!

I really enjoy pumpkin coffee, even in May.  I love that I can order it from Amazon when I cannot find it in any stores.  In fact, I've started ordering all of my k-cups from Amazon since it is so much more convenient than running around trying to find what I want then standing in line.  I think it's a better deal, too.  This Pumpkin Spice is a mild roast and is not as rich as some other coffees I like but it certainly does the trick.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: I absolutely adore this flavor. Not only do you get a nice amount of pumpkin spice flavor per cup, but it keeps rather well- meaning that you can continue to enjoy this flavor even after other places stop carrying the fresh brewed stuff that they make themselves.OK, the basics of this are good. You've got a decent coffee bean base and as long as you don't add too much water, you can have a decently strong cup of coffee without it being too watery. (Unfortunately one of the problems with the Keurigs is that you have to measure the water to your personal preferences, otherwise you get an overly watery cup of whatever you're brewing.) The spice flavor is not only nice, but it isn't overwhelming. You can still taste the coffee over the spice, which is something that occasionally bugs me about some of the other flavors out there on the market. (Such as the Dunkin Donuts Strawberry Shortcake blend. Blech.)Would this replace a cup of freshly brewed Starbucks, Dunkin Donuts, or WaWa coffee completely? Not really. It's good and I'll definitely purchase this stuff again when I see it, but it doesn't completely replace the stuff that you can brew in a bigger coffee pot. Like most Keurig products, this is ultimately a product of convenience. It's delicious and worth buying in my humble opinion, but it still won't replace "the good stuff".
