Having a convenient Cinnabon snack whenever I feel like it is the ultimate in small everyday pleasure. The bars are fairly small and relatively low on calories (150 cal). They can be eaten either cold or heated up, and I definitely prefer the latter option. The microwaving instruction call for them to be microwaved for just 3 seconds, but I've found this to be too short. I recommend at least 12 seconds or maybe even more. The bars taste pretty authentic, but not quite as well as the actual Cinnabon buns (naturally). Nonetheless, they are tasty enough to satisfy your cravings. I highly recommend them.

I love the Cinnabon cereal and the raisin bread so I thought this would be delicious too.  It was terrible.  I couldn't even finish the first bite.  I don't know what happened but this product is a very big disapointment

This is so much easier than trying to choke down a half teaspoonful of raw cinnamon powder daily to help my heart.  Not to mention so much more tasty. A few seconds in the microwave and - oh my!  These are easy, handy, tasty!

These are moist, soft and chewy with a really nice texture.  The cinnamon flavor is really good -- nice and strong (I love cinnamon!) and really natural tasting, not artificial like a lot of cinnamon flavors.  They are a little on the small side (like 5 or 6 bites) but also pretty low cal (150 cals) so they make a nice snack or light breakfast.  I will definitely be buying these again!
These taste so wonderful.  I was scepticle about trying them but im glad I did.  It is very easy to eat more than one!
You have to try these. They are much better than I expected. They taste just like a cinnamon roll without the mess. It's very difficult to eat just one of them.

I like how the chews taste faintly like the real fruit. However, only eat a few chews, because I accidentally ate ALL of them in the same day, and felt sick of them afterward. Now I really don't want to ever eat them again. The mango and melon smell a bit odd when you open them, but taste fairly good.I was bummed because I dislike artifical and real banana flavor, and the majority of the chews were banana! I still ate them, it's just that I wasn't a big fan of them.The chewiness was odd, kind of tough, yet kind of soft.If you like chewy fruits in exotic flavors, then buy them.

When I ordered Poppycock in Jan. it was great.  In April it had far less coating and about one third the nuts as before.  I believe this product has been taken over by Conagra and it is a shame that it still says "original" on the package.  I will not order it again.

My friend just gave me a can of Poppycock.  It is the absolute best tasting glazed popcorn I have ever had.  Each popped kernel is a large, satisfying bite.  The nuts are not too many and not too few.  The glaze finishes it off perfectly.  I am usually sickened by excess sweetness, but this sweetness has me coming back for more.  I am addicted and I am blaming my friend for my inevitable weight gain!

The 30 oz. Poppycock was very expensive and I should have respected another person's review. He rated it as a 2 star product.When my order arrived, it was old and spoiled. I could not eat it.Later, I ordered 4 cans of the 24 oz. Almond, Pecan and Popcorn Poppycock and there was nothing wrong with them. (With the exception that 2 of the cans were crushed in shippment.)No, I didn't send anything back.Yes, I will continue ordering this product from Amazon.com. (My neighbors enjoy it too.)

Have you ever had a popcorn snack and thought, "Was this popped a few years ago? The popcorn is stale and tough." Well, that's something that does not happen with Poppycock. Likewise, I've eaten popcorn with a glaze that is so thin you can't taste it. That's also something that never happens with Poppycock.Poppycock is so much better than other popcorn snacks that they shouldn't even be in the same category. Poppycock also doesn't use peanuts. Instead it has almonds, pecans, or cashews. To say it's the premium popcorn snack would be to damn with faint praise.Ok, it's more expensive than it's "competitors" but then nothing else is competitive with Poppycock. If you are worth a premium snack, the Poppycock is the one you want.
I was already a fan of this granola. If you don't like to break up your granola, you'll hate it. It's like a granola bar so you have to turn it into cereal on your own. I think the taste is great.

column9: Unfortunately, I got a bad shipment (I hope).
column10: Amazon kindly refunded my purchase price of this item, as upon receipt it was rancid.  Also, all the bags were one hard "brick."  I had to pound it with a meat tenderizer to break it up (I was determined to try it, in spite of the rancid smell). I was disappointed, as I am always searching for a honey oat granola that does not contain raisins.  I was looking forward to a wonderful granola, and the packages I received were inedible.I even offered it to my horses and they curled their lip at the smell.  So again, I hope that I was just unfortunate in receiving an old batch of the product; but at that price, I won't try again.  Hopefully someone else will have had a better experience and will have a good review for what appears to be a great raisin-free granola.

I RECENTLY RECEIVED BIG SKY GRANOLA.  IT WAS DELICIOUS.  I'M ANXIOUS TO TRY THEIR OTHER GRANOLAS.  WE USE THEM AS A SNACK AT HOME OR WHEN TRAVELING.  WE HAD THE GRANOLA AS A CEREAL AND ENJOYED IT THIS WAY ALSO. A GREAT PRODUCT AND THE PRICE IS RIGHT.  ROBERT

column9: Super good but watch what you pay for it
column10: This is the best of the Big Sky granola's, superb. But the price from this vendor is nearly twice what it should be.

****I enjoy bergamot a lot, but this tea was way too fragrant for me; still it was different and enjoyable to try. The bergamot flavor is strong, not subtle, and a bit overwhelming---it's all you can taste.The ingredients of this tea are premium black teas with pure oil of bergamot---that's all.The manufacturer writes: "Oil of bergamot comes from the rind of a citrus fruit which grows very well in the Calabria region of Italy. Pure top quality oil of bergamot is expensive but no blend or man-made flavoring can match the ethereal aroma and finely nuanced flavor of the real thing. Certain Earl Grey fanatics have grown especially fond of the top grade Calabrian oil of bergamot that we use and have asked for more, ..More,... MORE! Thus was born Stash Double Bergamot Earl Grey. In our Double Bergamot Earl Grey tea, the black tea base still serves as a solid foundation for this blend, but the oil of bergamot takes wing and soars to new unprecedented heights. The flavor is quite pronounced but not at all soapy or bitter which would happen with low grade oils. Is the flavor too strong? For a conservative drinker, maybe yes, but more adventurous types really seem to like it."I must not be adventurous enough. I do agree with the manufacturer, though, and it might be the tea for you if you're a huge fan of bergamot and want a lot of it, and I also agree that it tastes pure, not soapy or bitter at all.****

Perfect for kids who can't have a heavy breakfast in the morning before school. My daughter semi-suffered for a year and a half before I remembered this stuff. I had never had it as a child, but I have always remembered its jingle: "You're gonna love it in an instant!". Well, its true- you will. Flavors included are: dark chocolate, french vanilla, chocolate malt, strawberry, and milk chocolate. My daughter said that the dark and the milk chocolate tasted alike, and she was crazy about the malt-flavored packet. I tried the strawberry and vanilla, and was suprised that they were good as well (I was expecting a too sweet, artificial taste to them). I am not a vitamin freak, but I love the fact that anyone in my family can get some vitamins and protein in them from just gulping this enjoyable beverage down. Made on equipment that also processes soy. Delish (I had a friend that turned me on to this word back in '97, so beat it, Rach(a)el Ray!)!

column9: Yummy, but you might find a better price...
column10: Definitely a 5 star product, but we get it at Costco in a 30-pack for about $10. If you have Costco in your area, you might want to check it out. (Update: The Costco pack is all Milk Chocolate, BTW--thanks for comment pointing that out. Also, it's only about $8 as of 3/2012.)

column9: five stars for quality, three stars for 'variety'
column10: as a huge fan of carnation instant breakfast (in vanilla), i thought, "hey! why not try the variety pack?" so i ordered this six box variety pack.now all the actual product was quality, however most of what was in each box is chocolate. i'm not a huge fan of chocolate, so this was a disappointment. as usual i love the vanilla, and i also quite liked the strawberry (tastes a little less sweet than strawberry quik). however there are THREE kinds of chocolate in each box: milk chocolate, dark chocolate, and chocolate malt (two packs of each flavor in each box).for something called a 'variety pack' there sure seems to be a lack of options other than chocolate.i am plowing my way through the six boxes and am going back to ordering just plain vanilla.i hope this helps someone out there!
My daughters weight isn't low, but she eats so little that her Dr recommended this as an option for her.  We use whole milk for her and my other two use skim.  Great for the whole family.

column9: Mmmm, when chewing cereal is too much work...
column10: These are pretty nutritious.  Certainly more so than a bowl of most cereals.  My kids are liking these primarily because it's different than usual eggs/toast or cold cereal, which are usually on the menu for breakfast.  Probably the same at your house, too.  And I imagine that these would be a time saver if we're running late.  The flavors are good.  The dark chocolate doesn't taste much different from the regular chocolate, unless you're trying them side-by-side, so I didn't even offer the difference to my kids.  They won't know.  Our overall favourites are the chocolate malt and vanilla, though.  I wish there wasn't quite so much chocolate (6 packets of the 10 are a chocolate based flavor.)To make these healthier, I plan to get some plain Greek yogurt and clear fiber powder and add a bit to each drink.  That ought to make these more filling also.  And, FYI, the flavor of the drinks should be sufficiently strong to overshadow any yogurty taste.

I was able to save about 20.00 by purchasing these through Amazon, as opposed to our local grocery store.  Since we go through a box a week, the savings can add up quickly.  Would definitely recommend.

I drank this in the mornings when I was pregnant. Wish it wasn't so expensive, but it's a convenience food and good to keep around in case of emergencies. I remember the coffee flavor from when I was a teen, which I am not able to find now, but you can add a spoon of instant coffee powder (good with all flavor varieties except strawberry) to get a similar flavor and a little kick.

column9: Well worth the price on Amazon!
column10: The Instant Breakfast variety pack price cannot be beat because you do not pay tax! With a "Prime" membership, you also get this in two days!

Yamamoto is a brand I always try to get.  This product is good.  The only thing I'm less than thrilled with is that there seems to be a lot of stems that float to the top of the cup and stay there.  I don't always use a tea ball, so this is tricky trying to drink without taking in one of the twigs.Flavor is excellent, but I think I'm going back to the tea bags.

column9: Tastes like Cinnamon grape nuts - $12 for about 2 cups
column10: Service was great but product was not.  Ended up costing me something like $12 for 2 cups and tasted like cinnamon flavored grape nuts cereal.  Won't be buying this again.

I liked the fact that Dixie Carb Counter Sweet Commute Carb Controlled Maple Oat Granola has no artificial sweeteners. The carb control granola helps me control my glucose numbers and allows me something sweet to eat as a snack. This product is not chunky so you can add this to yogurt, cereal, or toppings to ice cream.I liked the sweetness level even though apple flavoring from the low glycemic fruit juice dominated the maple flavoring. I was expecting more finger food or larger chunks but the smaller size works well for adding to yogurt. I sometimes combine this with my morning bowl of fiber cereal to give it sweetness rather than using artificial sweeteners.Price is comparable for the size package.

The whole fam gobbled them down! I didn't get more than 2 I think. I am not familiar with these but my husband is all wild about them so I ordered some this year. I got the buy 3 deal. There were NO other deals on Amazon and they were wayyy expensive at the BAM stores around here if they even had them at all. They are really pretty in the box. I couldn't tell the different flavors apart. I gave the other boxes to my landlord and in-laws.

I first tried this sauce at a California Tortilla and instantly had to have my own bottle.  It has a great smokey flavor and plenty of heat to go along with it.  What I like about this sauce is that the heat doesn't overwhelm the flavor, they combine to enhance whatever dish it is you add it to.
I love the Da Vinci Hazelnut coffee syrup and it's so hard to find in local stores. You can order from Amazon in packs of three and it lasts a long time. I love it!!
DaVinci Gourmet Classic Syrup, Original Hazelnut, 25.4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 3). This is the same coffee syrup they use here at the coffe shop in the town I live in.

I have been a Keurig / K-cup user for about 3 years.  I have tried truck loads of different brands and flavors.  I like strong, robust coffee.  I do not like flavored or "weak" coffees.  If you have the same taste, then "Coffee People" make the best coffees for you.  They are all robust, taste great, have no bitterness, and if you want to make a larger than usual cup of coffee (if your machine can adjust the setting sizes), than these work great for that.  Any of there flavors are nice.
I've tried a lot of k-cups that purport to be strong (Green Mountain Double Black Diamond, Coffee People Black Tiger, Newman's Organic), but this is the closest I've come to my own strong brew.

Coffee People has the best k cups if you like extra bold coffee. The Jet Fuel is the boldest of all with little bitterness and a real kick. It is smooth and rich. You can't beat the price on Amazon 2 - 24 count boxes for $21.00. If you like Dunkin' Donuts coffee, I would also recommend the donut shop blend from Coffee People. Jet Fuel is more like a Starbucks cup of coffee without the rude Barista's and enormous price tag.
This coffee is aptly named.  Just a few sips and I felt like taking off.  It really woke me up, great stuff.
This is my favorite K cup right now. Strong cup o joe, but not bitter. Great every day coffee.
Looking for that quick fix then this is the coffee for you.It's like a expresso without the fuss.

I have a Keurig coffee maker at work because I have no access to a kitchen to use a real coffee maker.  Besides the Emeril's, this is the only k-cup that tastes like real coffee to me.  And quite good, too.  Not terribly bitter, as I feared.

column9: Strongest K-cup I've Found. Really Good.
column10: This Coffee is strong. Everything I drink says bold or extra bold on the label. This coffee is strong. If you don't like it strong back up slowly and step away from the Jet Fuel.On first drink this one can be overpowering. By the third time you drink it you'll enjoy the punch. I love this coffee. It might be my favorite.I like Wake Up Call and Parisian Nights for every day, but I only drink one cup on weekends and this really hits the spot. No over roasted flavor here. Just really good strong coffee.

My husband likes strong coffee and this fits the bill. Jet fuel is a good name for it. You get 50 cups for the price which is great. I was buying this from other companys and paying close to this with shipping for one box.

I've also tried the Green Mountain Dark Magic, Timothy's Italian Blend, Gloria Jean Black and Gold Extra Bold, and out of the four Coffee People's Jet Fuel is definitely my favorite. It's perfectly rich with a clean after taste. If you enjoy dark roasts this is a must try!

I like my morning Joe strong and flavorful and this scrumptious brew does the trick, in spades. If your eyelids don't pop up like window shades after the first sip, you better check the obits in the morning paper; you're probably dead.

My wife needs a strong cup of coffee in the morning, and this seems to work the best.  Tully's French Roast and Green Mountain's Dark Magic were close, but not strong enough.  We love the k-cup speed, convenience and lack of waste.
My only complaint about using the Keurig machine is the Kcups are often not as strong a brew as I enjoy - since I've discovered Jet Fuel-no longer a complaint-excellent flavor & strong brew!
Keurig coffee is a little weak for my taste.  That's why I tried this "Jet Fuel" coffee.  It has a nice strong flavor similar to Arabica coffee and has the extra caffeine to boot.

Hands down, "Jet Fuel" K-cup coffee by the Coffee People is the best on the market!  Don't let the title of this coffee put you off.  It is a bold coffee, but not excessive in any way.  No after taste either.  Just a taste for another cup.

column9: Best K-Cup I've tasted - the only truly strong cup thus far
column10: Granted I haven't tasted all of the extra bold varieties yet, but I ordered the Coffee People "Jet Fuel" because of the user reviews. I agree wholeheartedly - Jet Fuel is the best tasting k-cup I've tasted thus far. The sample "dark" coffees that came with the Keurig coffee maker had me thinking I had made a mistake.I am a Starbucks expresso drinker usually. I have a really good Jura expresso maker, but it has been on the fritz, and starting the day without coffee is not an option. Thank you Coffee People for helping me start my day right :)

column9: The best coffee ever put into a kcup
column10: I tried many varieties of kcups when I first got my Keurig a year ago, but I kept going back to Jet Fuel each time. All other coffees were too weak, even if I adjusted the brew size. Jet Fuel comes out perfect every time, bold and flavorful. This is the only coffee for people who love strong coffee. I won't waste my money on anything else!

I am a coffee lover and have tried many K-Cup flavors/brands over the past few years.  My complaint is usually that the coffee is weak.  Not so with Jet Fuel - this stuff REALLY wakes you up.  Careful though!  More than one cup will send you through the roof.  I made the mistake of having two when I first ordered a box of Jet Fuel and found myself sweating and shaking a few hours later.  I find that Jet Fuel saves me money because I only have one cup and I am good to go.  Coffee People also makes "Wake-Up Call," which is another good, strong coffee.  It's a little less of a kick than Jet Fuel.  Both are very good.  Cheers!

Of all the Kcups I've tried, this one fits me best.  It is the ONLY variety I've found that I don't have to reduce down to an espresso shot in order to get a strong cup of coffee.  I can make this in a normal size, and have a normal cup of coffee that still tastes strong.  I've had a few other people taste it who thought it was way too strong, so I gave them my leftovers from Coffee People Donut Shop, (which I found undrinkable).  Love this coffee.  It's the only one I order.
I really liked this coffee, it was just as good as everyone claimed it was.  Strong, bold and flavorful!  I would recommend!
Completely lives up to it's name.  Extra Bold Jet Fuel.  This is one of the best extra bold coffees that I've tried.
Very good bold, non-bitter flavor.  Wife and I both like, though not quite as much as the Dark Magic (forget the brand), but close.

column9: Nice -- holds up well to the larger cup size
column10: Not much else to add - I really like this coffee.  I use the largest cup size on my brewer (10 oz) and it holds up really well and is not watered down at all. My wife doesn't like her coffee too strong, so that also means a lot more for me.

This is a good strong coffee - I do use 2 K-Cups for a typical sized coffee cup.  But I prefer a strong blend without the bitterness (Starbucks)Jet Fuel most reminds me of the coffee in Europe, full bodied, strong - always fresh tasting.  Something the vast majority of coffeefound here in the states has no resemblance to.

column9: Jet Fuel - best ever for the K pot.
column10: My son sent me some of this coffee so this is my second order of Jet Fuel.  This coffee has great flavor with no acid or bitter taste.  The taste is smooth and even. I like my coffee strong and do not use either cream of sugar so flavor is very important to me and this is the best I have tried for my Keurig Brewer.

This must be what crack tasted like, this stuff is STRONG, i made a cup for my contractor, who only drink the extra strung stuff, and he was so surprise, even tho the job has been completed, he keeps coming back for the coffee.
Length:: 0:51 MinsCoffee People K-Cup Dark Roast, Extra Bold Jet Fuel, 24-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)
If you like a good, very-strong cup of coffee like I do, then this is the coffee for you.
As the title suggests, this will wake you up, the flavor is very nice but not something that will make you close your eyes and savor.  But, if you need a kick start, this is it.

What to say, this is a good bold-tasting coffee that comes in great use when using the large cup size setting on the Keurig.  Enjoy these in bulk from the warehouse if you can, otherwise the price isn't too bad.  I have never seen this one in stores either.
Simply - a very good bold coffee! No bitter after taste. 3rd time ordering. A true friend in the morning.
I am glad I found this coffee.  Nice flavor at a great price. I like a bolder coffee and this coffee meets my requirements.
Great stuff -keeps you going working nightshift and wakes you up when you first get to work.I highly recommend this product

column9: My go-to for that extra boost!
column10: Love this stuff... it's definitely addicting and tastes great.  The name cracks me up and definitely lives up to it.  Perfect little boost of energy when you're burning out.
If you want a extra bold coffee that is smooth, then this is the coffee for you.  I have this K-cup on a selection spinner at work and I am constantly filling it while the other choices go unused.

I am a coffee snob.I have been for a long time.I was having a hard time with the whole Keurig thing after we first got it cause every cup I made seemed week to me.This coffee has good strength to it and flavor.The other one I have found that is strong enough is the Starucks VeronaIf you like strong flavor coffee I think you would be happy with this one.
I enjoy a nice bold cup of coffee in the morning and a lot of coffee's that are bold tend to be bitter which I'm not a fan of. This coffee is very bold yet, smooth.  One of my favorites.  Enjoy!
It's dark and bold enough and not weak, though I wouldn't call it "Jet Fuel" strength but it tastes okay once you add sugar and Bailey's creamer to it.
One of the best coffee K-Cups on the market. Couldn't wait to get it and try it out. I'm a jetmechanic and was blown away when I first seen the name. Very good!!!!!!!
This is a well balanced , BOLD addition to my mornings.  I love a strong, non bitter tasting cup of coffee in the morning, and this one did the trick.  Jet Fuel is worth the price of gas!
Tastes great and definitely an eye opener!  Gives you that added boost throughout the day!
I drink many diiferent kinds of k cups and this one is ok. I like bold and tasty without bitterness and this coffee didn't meet my expectations.
Jet Fuel is bold but not bitter. Now it is one of my favorite flavors.
This coffee is strong enough, which is good; however, it becomes bitter as you swallow it.  Since I drink my coffee black I can't cover up the bitterness with cream and sugar.
Great strong coffee. I find a lot of k cups to be a little weak, but not this one.
Great taste but too many times coffee grains were in my cup. Hope this can be solved because of the good flavor.

This coffee is exactly what it's name depicts: Jet Fuel. This coffee is not for the weak caffeine consumer. I'm a daily caffeine consumer and this is what I turn to when all else seems to have lost it's punch.

I thought I'd try these after getting a gift certificate. I've had the Green Mountain Dark Magic and that has been my favorite so far.Jet Fuel is a bold flavor, not bitter, but there is a bite to it. I really like it and this is the type of coffee I prefer for the morning!! Not sure if I'd re-order as I prefer the smokiness of a french roast but overall a nice bold roast from Coffee People! :)

column9: Jet Fuel great but beware of packaging
column10: I love my Keurig. I love Jet Fuel (second only to Parisian Nights). However, beware if you buy the 2 pack of 50 k cups. When I first ordered coffees (1 box at a time), I liked using the boxes as display with the k cups sitting neatly in their boxes as pictured. The second time I went ahead and ordered a 2 pack of 50 and they just shoved 50 k cups in a cardboard box. I have no way to display them and quite frankly do not have room for a tacky brown cardboard box full of free floating k cups. Other than that, this is a great coffee, but if you like to display the varieties using the boxes pictured on Amazon that they are supposed to come in...beware of buying more than one box. When I ordered these, I also ordered a 2 pack of Parisian Nights from Timothy's and they came in two separate boxes that I can put out for display. Why one would come appropriately and the other sent out ghetto style is beyond me.
Every morning I pop a Jet Fuel into my Keurig B60 and am never disappointed! Great bold coffee taste and always tastes fresh. I also love the Organic dark roast by Coffee People as well.

column9: STRONG COFFEE BUT ACCEPTABLE TO ME
column10: very bold flavor. wife had a hard time getting use to the boldness of the brewed cup. i liked it and i will re-order it. right now, i am trying other brews.i used the 5 ounce button to run one k-cup twice to get a strong cup. other users might think about adjusting brew temperature to the low end (187 F), as a suggestion, in order to moderate the bold taste.

column9: Best coffee for the first cup
column10: Thsi is a rich bold smooth taste.  If you like coffee that looks and smells like true coffee. try this one.

column9: A good cup of coffee for the Keurig
column10: In Louisiana we love a good bold cup of coffee and with the Keurig it's often hard to get the mug size cup with a good hearty flavor. The Jet fuel helps satisfy that longing for the morning "kick". Now only if someone would make a K-cup with chicory I would be set.
Wow, they don't call it "Jet Fuel" for nothing.  This stuff really packs a punch!
Jet Fuel is the best cup 'o joe around. Deep, dark and strong - I just subscribed for an automatic monthly shipment it's so good.

column9: Love extra bold coffee, but this one tastes bitter
column10: I've bought at least 10 different flavors and brands of extra bold k-cups and this is my least favorite.  The overwhelming flavor I get with this coffee is bitter.  I thought it might be an acquired taste so I gave it a few cups before making a final judgment.  I'm too cheap to throw it out, but I can't wait until it's gone.  I much prefer the Donut Shop and Black Tiger from Coffee People and Timothy's Midnight Magic.I am a big Coffee People fan too so this was quite disappointing for me.
Very good coffee, this is one of the best that we have tried!!! You will not be disappointed.

column9: Good coffee at amazon great sale price
column10: I bought this coffee for my wife office and they seem to love it.  Good coffee and great sale price.  You can not go wrong with this coffee.
This is a great flavor. I would not call it strong, just a nice smooth cup of Joe....

column9: Jet fuel for a toy plane only
column10: Was told this was a very strong bold coffee by a friend. I thought it was a medium to weak coffee, leaning towards the weak side with a bitter taste. Did not have that robust coffee taste. More like something I would get at a IHOP. My wife is a weak coffee drinker and she likes this. So this tells me I am right regarding my opinion on this coffee.I have pretty much gone through all the K-cups that are labeled "extra bold" and I keep coming back to the "EMERIL"S BIG EASY BOLD" K-Cups. I think I will stick with that from now on. The Emeril's Big Easy Bold has that great robust coffee taste without the bitterness. Just a great quality coffee.

Coffee People Extra Bold Kcups are some of my vary favorites for using in my Keurig Brewer.I'm a Huge fan of strong , Bold dark roasted Coffee.Jet Fuel is another strong Kcup offering from Coffee People.

column9: Not horrible, but a little bitter for me
column10: After all the good reviews I was expecting a better coffee, but it's not my cup of tea, so to speak! It's drinkable, and pretty strong, but just has that nagging bitter aftertaste that some people don't mind, but I don't really like.

The coffee offered through Amazon.com is always the coffee that you can have difficulty finding in the store. My choice being one of those.. But the coffee, the price and the delivery is exceptional. I have tried two other coffee delivery services so far, and so far I am quite pleased with Amazons line of service as well as the product line they distribute.
Really like this product. I do not like any coffe's that are not extra bold. I did not find it too strong, but find not extra bold weak. This is my personal preference.

column9: said to be bold but not bitter.... !
column10: having tried this recently, i can agree.someone at the bean-ery managed to roast thiscoffee without burning it.very smooth, considering the bold and dark natureof the roast.i am glad i purchased this from Coffee People.
This coffee is truely jet fuel.  It has a strong bold flavor and is not bitter.  The name says it all.  One cup of this and you will be well on your way to a productive day.  I love it!!!

column9: By Far The Best Bold  K Cup Out There!
column10: This coffee is great. The only reason I did not give it 5 stars is due to a little bitterness in flavor but, overall a great cup for the true coffee lover.
I love this coffee!  It is strong and bold just the way I like it.
This is so far my favorite K-Cup.  Very rich, and yet very smooth.  No bitterness or bite.  Excellent cup of coffee.

If you are looking for a dark and insanely strong brew look no further.I had been hankering for a morning coffee to supplement the always enjoyable Coffee People Donut Shop.  Seeing as how it isn't a terribly dark brew I was looking for something else with a little more giddy up.  I tried both Coffee People's Extra Bold Wake Up Call and Timothy's Extra Bold Rainforest Espresso but neither quite hit the spot.  So I decided to give the Jet Fuel a try.  Hmmm...I might have overdone it.Honestly, I really do enjoy a strong cup of coffee, but try as I might (even went so far as to add cream, which I never do since I prefer my coffee dark and bitter like my life) I just couldn't stomach it.  I hate to knock a bunch of stars off a decent product just because I didn't like it, after all taste is opinion, this product appears slghtly flawed.  The coffee tasted a bit over roasted and that imparted not only bitterness, but quite a bit of acidity as well, that made it hard to stomach.Bottom line, great choice if you really want a freakishly strong (like, point your finger and cover your open mouth strong) cup of coffee to get you going.  However, definitely not a tame cup if that is what you're looking for.

column9: Avid Coffee Drinker, I Found THE PERFECT Brand
column10: I will never go to Dunkin Donuts again. The flavor that this coffee gives is amazing. Usually, K-Cups from Green Mountain and other companies seem a bit too watery for a person that loves bold and strong coffee. This brand is just that - bold and strong without any bitterness. Every cup is perfect when pressing the 'Large' selection.There's not much else to say. If you love the bold taste of a strong brew from an old fashioned coffee brewer then look no further than Coffee People. I order this kind as well as the extra bold which is great too. No bitter, just bold and smooth!

There's absolutely no bitterness to it at all, and its rounded, full-bodied flavor is, indeed, reminiscent of Dunkin' Donuts - our local coffee shop that has grown into a national phenom!  See ya later, Starbucks!!

column9: Jet Fuel Powers up the AM
column10: We love the Jet Fuel Coffee, it has a mellow flavor, not bitter, and very bold. The kind of coffee we love.

Extra Bold Jet Fuel is the perfect coffee for anyone who knows, appreciates, and drinks nothing but the best. I have ordered virtually every k-cup available and enjoyed many of them greatly. But when it comes right down to the final choice, I'd ALWAYS rather that the cup was Jet Fuel. Why drink your second or third choice when this one is available?

Looked around for a very strong first cup of the day.  This is it.  Great strong flavor without bitter aftertaste.  Makes it just a bit easier to get out of bed in the morning.Also decided to try the subscription service.  Love that too.  One less thing to remember is one less stress.  It was also very simple to double the qtys for this month's shipment so I don't run out!

column9: Jet Fuel has the proper name
column10: I tried a box of Jet Fuel, but unfortunately, the coffee tastes just like the name implies.  Last time purchase for me!

This is Coffee People's double bold K-Cup.  It has a very acidic taste to it, but is certainly not bitter.  Although the taste is slightly above average for this type of blend, you should be warned that this K-Cup may not be for everyone.

I bought about 5 different kinds of K-cups when I first got my coffee maker, which I love by the way, and I'd have to say that this was my favorite one out of them all. It has the perfect balance of everything, I was really surprised.

column9: NOT for the faint coffee lover!
column10: I have switched around and tried a lot of different BOLD, VERY BOLD, and EXTRA BOLD coffees, both on and off of Amazon.  Over time I have narrowed it down to 2 and finally to this one. Extra Bold Jet Fuel from the Coffee People.  It is really bold and full flavored. Meets all of my stringent requirements for a "WAKE UP" coffee.
This will get your jets going in the morning. Flavorful, not overpowering. Worth waking up to.

Very much happy with this coffee and brand.  I only purchased it because of the name, seems like a good name for a wake up  coffee, to my surprise has an excellent taste and rich body not to mention aroma was pleasant first thing in the morning too.  Actually was on my way to reorder product today  enjoy

I am a big fan of strong, dark coffee. Unfortunately, this did not deliver. It not so much strong as it is burnt tasting. I much prefer Dunkin Donuts or Starbucks Extra Bold, although they are much more expensive.

I had this coffee once before which is why I ordered it again. However, it was not quite as strong as I remembered. I will probably order it again, but not if I can find a better cup in another brand.

column9: Good taste but not great quality
column10: I love a strong cup of coffee. My favorite is Green Mountain Double Black Diamond, but I tried these because they were significantly cheaper. I really like the taste of this K cup. My only complaint is that about every fifth cup or so, lots of grounds came out into the coffee. I have never had this problem with another brand. Since I couldn't drink those that had grounds in them, I really didn't end up saving as much money as I thought with this brand.

IF THIS COFFEE WAS SMOOTHER WITHOUT LOOSING ITS BOLDNESS, IT WOULD BE PERFECT. A LITTLE HARSH AFTERTASTE, BUT STILL MY FAVORITE COMPARED TO ALL OTHER EXTRA BOLD K CUPS. I ADD A TEASPOON OF INSTANT TO SMOOTH IT OUT.UPDATE: Two years later I am still drinking Jet Fuel. I had tried all others but Jet Fuel is clearing my favorite. I now give it 5 STARS.Bold and earthy, not for the light hearted.
Coffee People K-Cup Dark Roast, Extra Bold Jet Fuel...  Awful coffee. I will never buy it again. But now this is just what I think.

column9: jet fuel coffee cannot be finished
column10: I purchased this because I typically enjoy strong coffee and I wanted to give this a try.  I cannot drink this. It is bitter and almost chokes you. I have tried it several times, not wanting to waste the money I paid for a two pack, but have given up. There are many strong bold coffee K-cups out there that are quite good. But this is undrinkable.

column9: Make it Sugar Free with Splenda
column10: I like the sugar free kool-aids but they have Nutrasweet which I cannot have. I use the regular packs like these which are very well priced and add Splenda instead of sugar and it tastes wonderful.I don't drink soda's so this makes it easier to get some of my daily water.

The cost of 48 packs including shipping comes to $43.8 cents per package. I purchase the same on sale at my grocery store for 10 packs for $1.00 which is 10 cents per pack.Now I know it is wise to stock up when they are on sale.This is no bargain, just the opposite.

column9: Variety too limited and the price is ridiculous
column10: Not only does this pack contain the regular varieties you can find at any broken down liquor store (like the one in the horror movies) and nothing else, but they package them FOR YOU.  Now, this is all well and good IF you're going to give a deal on them, which they do not.  3 packages for a buck? Please.  I'll limit my choices for a good price, or pay a good price for the freedom to choose, but I won't take a hit on both. And where are all the hard to find flavors? Koolaid is packaging these things all wrong.  Now, lemon-lime flavor happens to be my favorite.  So, I come on here looking to spend maybe 7 or so dollars for a bunch of them, BUT NO!  Look at the way these high-way robbers priced and packaged the things! There's no way in heck I'm about to spend 24 bucks for lemon-flavor AND be forced to spend a year drinking the same flavor.  It'll ruin my affection for the flavor and make me cranky.  The wife doesn't like it when I'm cranky.  I'm not married, but if I was, I'd be cranky and the wife wouldn't like it.  She'd probably divorce me for spending 24 bucks on one flavor of koolaid.  She'd say she needed more variety and didn't want to pay the high-price for it.  In summation....it's friggin powder and flavor, for crying out loud. Give us a break.

column9: Good variety and you can easily make it 0 cal with Splenda
column10: As another reviewer has mentioned you can make this calorie free by using Splenda instead of sugar which is exactly what we do.  We always keep a pitcher of Kool Aid with Splenda in the fridge when you want something "sweet" but don't want to drink down a couple hundred calories.  It's a great guilt free way to satisfy that craving.For those reviewers saying the cost is too high:  Each packet makes about 64 oz.  64oz x 48 packets = 3072 oz.  By my math thats the equivalent of 153 20oz bottles of Diet Coke which would cost you over a hundred dollars.  Don't look it as 50 cents a pack but less then a penny a ounce and you'll realize its not a bad price at all.
i purchased these back in dec 2011 and i still have them now it are really good tasting kool aid and plus they are a variety packs so thats a plus.

column9: Nobody in their right mind would buy kool aid at these prices!
column10: Most stores where I live will sell me ten packets of a much broader variety of flavors than this for a buck. That means five bucks for fifty packs of any flavors I want. I'd have to be insane to pay these prices for koolaid.. Almost fifteen dollars for 48 packets? Come on now.

This 48-count box features something for just about everyone-cherry,grape,lemonade,lemon-lime & other flavors. There is bound to be something here for even the pickiest. Now if they would only add some of their newer flavors...

I got this because we can go through it like crazy. After comparing stores, I found that this was the cheapest option for me, and I get six more than any store will give for the price! Plus, it was delivered right to my front door!

"For those long hot summer days leading in to back to school days kool aid a fun summer drink that kids and adult likes."my grand kids and I enjoy this drink with added fruits and berries. so go ahead mix some up!Kool Aid Variety 48 Packs

I've been drinking this since I was 10 years old, and it would drive me bouncing off the walls.  This is the original recipe Jolt Cola, without all the Guarana and garbage they put in energy drinks nowadays (including the Jolt PowerCola).In terms of energy, nothing compares.  You can taste the caffeine.  I just wish they still made Jolt Espresso Cola.Mix with cold coffee for those late night MERP or hacking sessions!

I love Jolt.. but really, 12 bottles for $38 ?  Give me a break.  That is way overpriced, especially since as the description says "they're still making it"... its not like its impossible to get because they don't make it.I'm changing my negative review based on price, because the Amazon Nazi's (yeah you know who you are) got very upset with me.

These are so cute. It is sometimes hard to tell from the pic all of the details..but these are adorable. I bought these for my daughter's Birthday party...I made a point of asking people if they were good, because sometimes the candy may look good but be gross, and everyone said they were really yummy. I think these are worth the price and they come packaged really well.

This candy interested me - something different for trick or treat - because it was mentioned in an article in "People" magazine (I have written to the Editor of People).  We live on Harbour Island (Tampa), a neighborhood with many children, so it is fun to put forth an extra, creative effort each year. So I looked on-line and found these Fish Kabobs were available from a company through Amazon.  Amazon's products have always been well-packaged; sent on time; and to my satifaction.  What a surprise when I received these and found they are made in China!Apparently, to send them back, it must be done through that seller - who has some odd practices.  The return postage had to be my responsibility (more than $10 sent the cheapest way); there is a 15% re-shelving fee!; and the man at TheOnlineCandyShop was nebulous as to the return address.  He thought it was on the package, but the one on the package was not right.  He gave me a different one, and I can only hope that is correct.If I do receive a credit to my card, it will be very small at this point.  I was tempted to just throw the candies away.
The flavor is not outstanding, although it is a little better than the Hazelnut of this brand.Hard to believe that this brand is widely used (as the literature of the company claims).
Price was right, but we were disappointed by the overall lack of vanilla flavor, and by the strong and unpleasant flowery notes.

We love making special coffees and this just added a great touch to them.Also we have put it on top of our soy ice cream and found it to have a nice taste on that as well;)OH we have also added it to our soda, making vanilla coke, vanilla dr. pepper and vanilla orange soda.. Very Very NICE:)
good quality for the price, I am still to find fresh cashews whether in store or online.  This order works well for cashew milk.
Great product and a very good price. I love these nuts and so does my entire family.

What's not to like?  The top Irish chocolatier and Irish Cream truffles!  Yum! My wife and I toured Ireland last year, and I wanted to give her some Christmas gifts that would remind her of this very pleasant experience.  FWIW, if you're planning to go over, be sure to visit Derry and Belfast as well as the Republic.  The Irish-American Folk Museum in Ulster shouldn't be missed!
This is the best micro-wave rice I have had.It is sticky rice like you would be served in a restaurant.I buy it regularly.
We love this cereal... while eating in it might be a bit harder if you love LOADS of milk, we don't generally and my kids eat this up faster then i can buy them!

I love pops and thought this would be so awesome...portable breakfast that doubles as a bowl.The only problem is that the lid on the pops cereal is not very good because 4 of the 12 cups came open. Boooo!!!I won't be ordering this again from amazon.

column9: How did they mess this up?
column10: The cereal is amazing but this container is so awkward. If you want to eat from it, the bowl is really tall so when you put milk in it, the cereal overflows, and if you use only a little bit of milk and try to spoon the cereal from the bottom the cereal falls out because the container is too tall and thin and not wide :
It you haven't, give it a try.  After drinking half of a bottle, you will know it's good stuff.
These cherries are fantastic. No dyes, great flavor.  Great alternative to traditional maraschino cherries.  Highly recommended.  They are perfect in a manhattan!

I seem to have entered my green tea "wave".After years of only black tea, then white, oolong and green tea, I have discovered the loose fruit flavored green tea mixes sold by Teavana, which are delightful. Teavana makes tea drinking a pleasure with all the available accoutrements and utensils.This green tea mix is flavored with apple pieces, hibiscus flowers, rosehip peels, blackberries, and blackberry flavoring, raspberries, plum pieces, cactus blossoms and spearmint and is called Blackberry Mojito.Fruitmixes are nothing new in the tea world, but Teavana's product is most fresh in the vacuum sealed pouches and has a wonderfully delicious fruity fragrance. However as an infusion, I found its slight astringent tartness somewhat objectionable, which most likely stems from the rosehips peel. Perhaps other people prefer this. If compared to the Lipton fruit flavored green and white tea bags, which are available now, and look like little pyramids, I have to say that I do prefer their taste, but as a potpourri Blackberry Mojito is the winner.

my cat began having digestive tract problems that my vet attributed to having a lack of fiber found in most cat foods. he also began having teeth & weight problems so she recommended increasing his intake of moist food, which have even less fiber than dry cat foods. i found this supplement at the petstore. i keep a measuring scoop in the bag & just mix it in w/his wet food, even my finicky other cat doesn't even notice the powder mixed in. there has never been a problem w/them getting sick from this supplement, like cat grass tends to make them puke, but it has improved both of their digestive tracts and makes me feel better about giving them more wet food since this adds the extra nutrients & fiber they need.

I started putting a small amount of this mixed into my 16 year old cat's canned food once a day after he got a bad virus.  A friend, whose cat had a serious blockage, had discovered this from a homeopathic vet in Manhattan.After using this for many months, my cat is much stronger, brighter, has a fabulous silky coat, and no sign of illness. His energy has increased substantially.I do not work for this company, by the way.

I purchased this for my three cats, as a way to deal with hairballs and add some vitamins to their diet.  All of them are generally healthy, but this was recommended.  I'm really sorry that I spent the money.I followed the instructions, adding a small amount to their food for two days.  They did eat it; something that surprised me.  Usually they don't like anything different with their food.By the middle of the second day all three of the kitties were spending the majority of their time sleeping and trying to find dark places to hide.  They only do this when they are not feeling well.I stopped using the supplement and within another two days they were back to normal.  My cats are not overly sensitive, but this product really affected them badly.  I strongly suggest you use caution before adding this to your cat's diet.

Cardamom?!  Holy smokes!  So delicious, so different.  Try adding them to an affogato: vanilla ice cream, shot of espresso, cardamom bitters.  Mmmmm...  Of course, they're also great in whiskey cocktails.  Excellent quality, a better price for Scrappy's brand than I've seen in my local fancy-pants grocer, AND I've never seen Cardamom available anywhere else.  Just now discovered this product and love it!

I got these because I love cardamom & I love champagne cocktails. I haven't worked them into the perfect champagne cocktail yet - but it's an enjoyable work in progress. They are great in lots of things, but the simplest is just shaking a little into ginger ale, it makes even cheap diet ginger ale taste amazing!I was put off by the price, but I am very glad that I purchased them!

I have tried either 4 or 5 of the Fancy Boy Grinders and love every one of them.  I think the reason I like them so much is because they add real flavor and not salty at all.  I highly recommend this product.

Nice idea.  Grinder works great, but I am not too happy with the seasoning blend.  Most dominant (to me) is chile/cumin, which is not my favorite combination and not heavily used in Creole/Cajun cooking, which is "my thing".

I had been having difficulty getting my nineteen year old Shih Tzu's favorite dog food.  When a dog is that old, you don't change anything!  This was a flavor of Mighty Dog that he had never had before, but he loves it!  Thank you for making a little old dog and his person happy.

column9: Chai Tea with Whipped Cream and Nutmeg
column10: While you can make your own chai tea, it does take some work to gather all the spices and then steep them in milk. The Oregon Chai tea mixes are rather easy to use. You can either make regular tea and add the packet like you would milk and spices or you can serve this with hot milk or even just water.If you are looking for a very creamy version, you can make a 16-ounce cup of hot water in the microwave and then add one packet of Oregon Chai Tea Mix, 1 packet of hot chocolate and 2 Constant Comment tea bags. That is my favorite combination so far.While the tea packets are for an 8-ounce cup, I make a much larger cup of tea, so this is perfect to mix with a tea bag and more powdered milk.Ingredients: Sugar, dried whole milk, dried nonfat milk, natural flavors, dried honey, tapioca maltodextrin, decaffeinated dried black tea and salt. Yes, salt!Each packet is 100 calories.Also look for Ready-to-drink individual servings and liquid concentrates where you just add milk.If you are just using a packet of this mix and 8 ounces of water, you might still want to add some powdered milk to make it extra creamy. Whipped cream and nutmeg also make the drink more delicious.~The Rebecca Review
The is product was great and I will purchase the product again in the future.  Even after there was an issue with the delivery process, I would still purchase the product

This product is aweful and if I could, I would give it NO stars.  Big Train Chocolate Mint syrup takes no more like chocolate mint then say...motor oil.  It smells aweful and tastes even worse.  The initial out of bottle smell actually reminded me of alcohol/liquor.  The syrup is a complete and total disappoinment as well as a waste of money.  Amazon should be ashamed to sell this product.

Baba Roots is the best. Good for energy and vitality, they don't last long around me and I wish there were more around everywhere. It is interesting to think they truly are almost everywhere around the world. It's an earthy, herbal root drink that is good for the body and mind.

Very disappointing. It initially seemed like a good and healthier alternative to rawhide. I am extremely unhappy that this item is made in China!  I NEVER give my pets anything made in China.  There is much information out there about pets becoming ill and dying from products made in China.

column9: Love that they are not Rawhide

He instantly sat and waited patiently for me to open the pack of Smartbones.I am so glad I finally found a better alternative to rawhide. I feel more ease at heart leaving the house with this treat in his paws.The only reason I am giving it four stars it's because my pup was able to finish quite quickly. SmartBones, Mini (Chicken flavor) is a great alternative to rawhide bones. I recommend this product for all dogs. My dog JJ loves this treat!
I love this product. I wanted to make a home version of Dunkin' Donuts coconut cream coffee and this syrup did the trick. The bottles are huge and will last a long time.
Seriously killer summere treat with low calories: unsweetened almond milk, forzen pinapple,torani sugar free cocoanut. Maybe some frozen overripe banana if I have it. Do it.

I drink a lot of smoothies, and this is outstanding in a fresh pineapple smoothie. Just like a Pina colada! Delicious. Doesn't even sound good in coffee, so haven't tried that. But over greek yogurt is also good. Be creative!

This rice is good and very nutritious. It doesn't swell or fluff like white rice or parboiled rice. A cup of this is a lot for one person and could last 5-7 days. Very tasty rice.  Found additional recipes on line.  The price was very good, the shipping was very fast.A pleasant transaction.

Yeah this rice is really tasty except for the occasional rock that is slightly smaller than the rice and the same color.  So...you may want to buy at your own riskNote: This happened more than once to both myself and my husband with more than one bag!

column9: STOP, Read my review before consuming this product
column10: Ask a Chinese friend about "forbidden rice" (禁米), unless they are history buff like myself, they will give you a puzzled look.  The term refers to an obscure trade policy during Manchurian dynasty, not an exotic rice.  I will not going to bore you  with history here.The story about emperor depriving commoners of red rice is a hoax made in America, like the legion of fortune cookies. Most fortune cookies are made in a wholesome factory near Atlanta.  We trust that fortune cookies are safe to eat.  "Forbidden rice?"There is a red rice in China, dark red, close to red bean.  The color varies from gran to gran. Its thick bran provides a pleasant nutty flavor and al dente texture.  The color does not come off easily.  You can get them from Chinese grocery store.What is sold as "forbidden rice" at Amazon and Costco has a uniformed black to deep purple color.  It appears to be rice over-milled, dyed, and polished.  Drop a few grains in water, you can see color coming off.  And the color tent to sink to the bottom. That is a easy tell tail.  When cooked, the favor and texture of bran are absent.  If they use red rice, they have milled away its bran to make the rice easy to dye.There is nothing wrong with using food coloring.  But is the ink FDA approved?  We do not know.  The label does not say.I am returning mine to Costco.  I will ask Costco to pull it off the shelf.
I use this with steel cut oats, winter wheat and the Forbidden rice.  It is my favorite breakfast.  The rice adds a great flavor

column9: For Brown Rice enthusiasts, a real treat
column10: This rice is very interesting. When cooked, it turned purple, as did the water it was cooking it. The texture is much like brown rice, sort of chewy and grainy. It had a nice flavor. If you are only used to white rice, this rice will be an adjustment.

I got some of this Forbidden rice at my local Harris Teeter, the packaging is thin and with only minor handling the bag sprung a leak.We cooked the rice in our Rice Cooker set to the Brown Rice setting, it was chewy with kind of a nutty flavor. Certainly its different from White rice, but to me it wasn't all that different from Brown rice or some other steamed grains that we've tried.Unless I had a recipe that called for it, I wouldn't buy this again.
These roses are gorgeous. Fresher than any I have ever bought in a store. Will buy them again for my daughters baby shower.  Service was great and arrived on time.

column9: Such a tasty cereal, no longer available in local stores
column10: This is the best shredded wheat cereal.  The honey and toasted almond flavor is so much better than all that gross frosting available.  I have never been a fan of frosting since I was a kid, but I don't want the plain stuff that much.  Thanks Amazon for having it available. We also like to snack on it after school, watching tv, and as a night time snack!  Sometimes we add some m&m's and raisins and put it in baggies and bring it to our kids' soccer games!

column9: This stuff is really good, but expensive...
column10: This stuff is one of my favorite cereals. It tastes good, it's full of fiber, little bit of sugar. It also DOESN'T contain lots of refined white flour and other stuff that gums up the works like most cereals.If you need a good source of tasty fiber, but not the caked on white sugar like Frosted mini wheats, this is the good stuff.But darn if it's not one of the more expensive cereals out there. Great cereal but I couldn't find in the stores nearby anymore. So glad I could get it through the mail. Why isn't it in the stores anymore ????

Post Honey Nut Shredded Wheat is a very nutritious and fulfilling cereal. My entire family loves it, exspecially my 7 year old daughter. column9: My all time favorite beverage! Super Yum!!
column10: I was at a convenience store a few weeks ago that happened to have the pink grapefruit Perrier. I decided to give it a try on a whim - usually I prefer unflavored sparkling water - and I fell in love!I don't like sweet beverages and many of the flavored sparkling waters leave an odd after taste, almost an artificial chemical type thing. I don't get this with the pink grapefruit at all. Instead it creates a wonderful balance between the light, tangy, grapefruity taste and the sparkling bubbles. There is no sweetener added at all, just the very light grapefruit taste.I highly recommend this flavored sparkling water. YUM!

WARNING: If you drink this, you will never ever want to drink anything else again.I never write reviews. Especially for food, let alone a beverage.I happened upon this beverage by accident. My boyfriend and I love Perrier and we discovered this flavor during an out of state trip to see his parents. It was so good we searched across the internet to try to ship it to our home state, but without luck. Turns out we couldn't find it b/c we were searching "pamplemousse rose" the original labeling. My genius boyfriend decided to search for grapefruit :-) and he surprised me with a huge case.I know this sounds silly but I haven't even had Perrier since we discovered this flavor. It beats all of them and totally agree, you will never want soda after this.

Love this stuff! Not sweet at all, more of an aroma. Just perfect for after a long run or on a very hot day. Packaging was fine for delivery although plastic wrap on bottles was a little fragile, fell apart when i picked up the case, plastic bottles fell loosely back into shipping box. Not much of a problem, simply an observation.
I love the grapefruit flavored Perrier water and have trouble finding it in stores, so appreciate the ability to order it through Amazon

I've always loved the mineraly taste of Perrier, and I prefer the plastic bottles to glass. It seems more carbonated. Before trying this, I liked lime slightly more than plain, and disliked lemon. This is my new favorite.The other review was correct in saying the grapefruit is more of a smell than a taste. It's so subtle that you could pour tap water back into an empty bottle and get a similar level of flavor.Most importantly, it contains no artificial sweeteners. I dislike the aftertaste of all artificial sweeteners, including the small(er) amounts added to tonic and soda waters. This has none of that. Nor is it affected by or will affect your appetite for sweets. It's not that kind of drink.

It's amazing and a shame Costco pulled it from it's assortment.... Was glad to find it here on Amazon, though almost for 50% more than at Costco, but what can you do.....It has literally replaced my desire for soda (Diet Pepsi and the like) .... Doctor's should be recommending this...

column9: Believe it or not, this is the best BBQ sauce on the market.
column10: And I've tried them all.Maybe its the anchovies. Who in their right mind but these radio clowns John Boy and Billywould put anchovies in barbecue sauce right! Well why not, most all good steak sauces andWorcestershire have anchovies, and you cant make a decent Caesar Salad without them either.What this sauce does to food is amazing. For ribs and chicken it just doesn't get any better.Not a real tomato taste like most mainstream BBQ sauce, and not a mustard flavor either likeyou will find in Florida and South Carolina. And although JB&B are in North Carolina, its nota traditional NC style sauce either and thank god for that cause NC BBQ is the most overhypedand overrated stuff I've ever had. So they went in a whole new direction with this recipecause there's nothing else like it.I use it as a finishing sauce on the grill, or you can dilute it with water or vinegar anduse it for a marinade, even on steak. Its also great on rotisserie chicken and wings. If youwant more heat get the Hot and Spicy version. Its even better.BTW, my favorite recipe is for ribs using Emeril's Rib Rub and John Boy and Billy's GrillinSauce as a finisher. Great combination. Check the web for other more creative recipes likeThe Spammer (one can Spam, one bottle Grillin Sauce and an oven) Hilarious.Edit: I see I'm being dissed by some guy in Atlanta that seems to know zero about BBQ sauce,you can look at this bottle and see its not that sick sweet stuff you get from Kraft or KCMasterpiece. And his comments about this sauce "not sticking to ribs",,,,,lmao. I doubt heeven knows how to cook. The point of this sauce is not to pour it on a plate of pulled pork,where it really shines is as a finisher on the grill, and I can assure you that it will "stick"to whatever you're cooking. Its not designed to drink out of the bottle, but caramelize it onthe grill and the transformation will reward you.Oh yeah, Mr Raines...you'd be surprised how many people in the South eat sardines and Viennasausages.

The previous reviewer said this sauce went in a "new direction" and he's right...straight to the do not buy again list. He likes it but he's also gave good reviews to vienna sausage and sardines. To each his own I guess. If you like a sweet ,smokey, thick traditional sauce......this isn't for you.I could maybe see using it on pulled pork or maybe chicken, but in no way would I use it on ribs. I don't think it would even stick to them. I've tried many many sauces of all flavors, textures and degrees of hotness. Some I've loved and others I can do without.Maybe their sweet and mild sauce would be better but I'll never find out.Spend your money on something else. There are many better choices out there.

column4: D. P. Wright "If it ain't broke, I'm gonna fi...
column10: Not much to say about green beans other than they were clean, no extras like sticks or stones and packaged well.  Less than ten bucks a pound with shipping is a good price for small quantities.  Normally if my funds allow I buy around ten pounds and that gets the shipped price per pound down to around seven bucks for Costa Rican coffee. That's from a different vendor.  For a 1 pound emergency order I am very happy.  These are good beans for a decent price and they showed up on time.  How can you go wrong?Now that I've roasted these beans I have to update my review.  They are very good, same quality as the other online vendors.  While I don't have the best equipment I have been roasting for several years so I'm not just blowing smoke.  I roasted these past first crack to about 435 degrees. I like to bring them up slower than the 30 degrees per minute I see recommended all over the place online.  If you like the fruity flowery roasts that's a good speed.I like dark and nutty or chocolatey so I try to shoot for about 20 degrees a minute.  Not difficult in my hotrod air popper but quite a chore when indoors with my freshroast.  I know that nutty sounds funny when not going to second crack but it's all in the heat curve, you can get these earthy flavors from a lighter roast if you but take your time.There are candy bars that would love to smell as good as these beans after they were roasted.

This was my first attempt at roasting, and I was pleasantly surprised.  The product was just as ordered, arrived quickly, and tasted great after my first roast.  It was inexpensive, and exactly what I was expecting!

column9: Pure dehydrated coconut but not dated !
column10: It is indeed finely shredded. The pieces, of course, are all different sizes. I'd say the typical piece is about an eighth of an inch long or maybe 2mm if you speak metric, by a sixteenth of an inch wide, or maybe 1mm. Being dehydrated, there's a lot of it per package. Each 8 oz. package says it contains 2 2/3 cups. That's a lot of coconut shreds.Another aspect of being dehydrated is that it doesn't have a strong coconut taste like the fresh stuff would, but it does smell and taste real (in case you wondered). I wanted it for low carb, gluten-free Nonpareil Trail Mix I'm concocting. Obviously the primary use would be baking, like macaroons, or maybe putting a frost on top of frosting on baked goods, like the package illustration. You can also use it to make your own coconut milk for use in Thai and Indian cuisine.Here's a real positive: This coconut is unadulterated. The package says, "Ingredients: Organic Coconut (shredded and dehydrated). Color may vary as this product contains no sulfites." NOTE WELL many producers add a chemical called Sodium metabisulfite to their coconut products, notably to the meat and milk, to "preserve whiteness". This you don't want. Google it. An outfit called Livestrong says that a fatal dose of Sodium metabisulfite is estimated to be 10 g for the average adult, and lists numerous other negative effects. When I ate a different brand of coconut that was laced with this poison, I suffered serious intestinal pain and then the runs. Causal relationship? Hmmm. Anyway, this Let's Do Organic Coconut is blessedly free of such chemicals.I would add a caution here, that if this finely shredded, dehydrated material eaten as is, that is to say dry out of the package, it could present a danger of aspiration (accidental inhalation). If a person were to breathe at the wrong time, it could "go down the wrong pipe" because it is so fine and light. This would apply to children and the elderly in particular, but could be a hazard for anyone. I also noted that it has a particular tendency to get caught between teeth.I can figure a reason for not dating a product and that reason is not in the best interest of the consumer. At any rate, I could find no marking tho' I searched carefully, except "EDO349" stamped right over the barcode on the package back. If that's a code date, it's meaningless to the average consumer. Dating is one of the first things I look for when I'm shopping in person. I guess this is a drawback of online grocery purchasing.

I really appreciate being able to find a great organic coconut with an affordable price.  My only complaint would be I would have liked to know it was a very "fine" shred.  But, it is very delectable & I would purchase it again.

I use this product almost daily, mixing it with cereal and other items.  Taste is great.  I only wish the shreds were a bit larger.  The texture is just short of being powder, at least compared to what I've purchased before.  It is unsweetened and organic, both of which I insist on. Overall, a very good product.

column10: Wow.  So far, two two-star reviews.  One obviously had no idea what they were ordering; the other wants crispy cookies.
