column9: Best and Most Effective Deodorant I've Used
column10: Firstly, I have been using this specific deodorant for 4 years. I originally started using it when other products started to give me an under arm rash, I noticed this one said for "sensitive skin" so I gave it a try. Since I have been using it I have not got any more rash or redness. It has a nice, pleasant smell and is not overpowering. Actually, it is rather unnoticeable until you are actually perspiring, which is what I think deodorant should do. Like another reviewer stated, if I want to have a stronger smell, I will use cologne or body spray.Since I have used it for 4 years I have not lost one shirt to this deodorant... it does not stain. I thought I should mention this since another reviewer stated it stained all his shirts. Maybe he got a bad batch or has some sort of chemical imbalance...In summary, if you have sensitive skin and or other deodorants have been bothering you with there wild smells, give this stuff a try.

When i use some other deodorants, especially those super scented ones, my arm pits tend to get itchy and irritated.  I tried this deodorant specifically because of the non-irritating aloe claim.  Their claim is accurate, I love this deodorant because it keeps me dry with NO irritation.  It also smells pretty good, if i want to load up on scents i'll just add some cologne.

I love Degree Deodorant. I know it sounds weird to love a deodorant but I never get rashes, breakouts, or perspiration when I use it.  They all say they last countless hours but this one really does the job for a solid 18-24 hours.  Definitely will not be switching to another brand anytime soon.  (The price is more than reasonable as well).

Granted, deoderant is a pretty personal thing and you'll likely want to try a stick of this before ordering a six-pack.That said, this product goes on invisible and is flake-free.  I like the pleasant, smooth scent as opposed to the sharp, nostril searing fad deoderants like Axe.  (My wife seems to like this better as well!)And, of course, it keeps my dry and stink-free as any deoderant/anti-perspirant should.Buying in bulk is nice, and the Amazon "Subscribe & Save" allows me to have my regular necessities delivered to my door automatically, free of shipping and even at a slight discount to the local store.  You just can't beat that!

The deodorant is a white substance, goes on white, and white clumps remain hours later.  I'm very disappointed that this product specifically states "invisible".  This is NOT invisible and there is nothing on the packaging stating that it is white in color.  Unilever should be reprimanded for falsely representing this product on the packaging.
I have tried to find underarm protection that is effective and does not irritate...Finally this is it and reasonable priced too.  I have written to Lever for a catalogue of all their products.
There are three men living in my household. this subscribe and save works out p[perfectly so no one is ever out of deodorant. And all of them like the quality of the product.

I ordered the 6 pack on a 6 month subscription. The price is about 50 cents cheaper per stick then the local grocery store. I occasionally get irritation from deodorant so chose this one with Aloe. It seems to help with the irritation. The scent is nice and mild, not overwhelming. I was in a situation where I wasn't able to shower for 24 hours and the deodorant never quit. I don't plan on that happening again but am happy to know if it does I wont stink lol. If this is your normal brand try the Subscribe and Save and see if its a savings for you.**UPDATE**Amazon raised the price of the deodorant and is not longer competitive with local stores. Due to this fact I am no longer on subscription with this product. It's still a great product but no longer at a great price if you can get it locally.
This is so much cheaper buying it in bulk than at the grocery or drug store.  Plus, you will not have to worry about running out of a stick for awhile because you have 6!!!!!  Great deal.

Since purchasing and using the new Degree Men Anti-perspirant & Deodorant with aloe I have noticed that I have fewer days with itchiness and irritation. It goes on great and doesn't have too strong of a fragrance. I highly recommend this product.
Degree has always been my favorite for deodorant. I got a nice deal this time, much cheaper than that in walmart.
Decided to try this because "Cool Rush" by the same company was "out of stock".  I am very pleased with it.  Can't tell the difference from Cool Rush.
I usually get very irritated under my arms. And so far after 3 of these I'm ok.

column9: Degree Men Anti-Perspirant & Deodorant Cool Comfort
column10: Degree Men  Anti-Perspirant & Deodorant, Cool Comfort 2.7 Ounce (Pack of 6)  I really appreciate the reviews entered by other users.  I find that as I age, my skin seems to becoming more sensitive.  I was pleased and appreciative to 1) discover that Amazon offers this product (I couldn't find it locally; and, 2) to read that others had success using it.  To put it mildly, I was really uncomfortable after using other products.  As others have stated, it is non-irritating, has an unobtrusive fragrance that does indeed seem to only activate by rising temperature.  I had found comfort by using Colgate-Palmolive's Speed Stick "Pro Skin."  However, when I could no longer find that brand and called the company, I was told they had ceased manufacturing it. Trying Degree's Cool Comfort in the midst of this very warm summer leads me to highly recommend it.  Thanks Amazon!
This is the best deodorant for me. I've been used it since i've tried the first time. I like the perfume and feeling
This is a great product. Keeps me dry all day long, and is one of the few deodorants that am not allergic to. Also the scent is is commendable.

Although this is a "Cool Comfort", this particular one is NOT the same as the picture!  The ones sent do NOT contain ALOE and does not work the same for soothing sensitive skin.  We returned one in hopes that it had been shipped wrong, but the replacement did not contain Aloe either. Ended up returning it as well as we have to have Aloe to prevent discomfort.This can be a good deal for those whom it doesn't matter one way or another, but if you need the aloe keep looking because this isn't it!

I have been using this product for more 10 years. Other deodorants caused irritation and rash, but this one does not. I can only complain about the price and availability. Many stores do not carry cool comfort and the price is always significantly more than the other degree deodorant products. Amazon is cheaper than most retail stores, but still relatively expensive.

Please don't call the producers of Hoarders: The Complete Season Onebut this is the only deodorant that doesn't make me break out AND gets the job done.  And, it smells good without being overpowering. The last product that I liked stopped being made.  Hence, my hoarding....

Just bought these thinking they were not going to be the white stick ones but they were. The deodorant itself smells really good but it just leaves white staines on your clothes which is really annoying. And now that I opened them I can't return them so I'm stuck with 5 of these terrible deodorant sticks.

It is very effective tool to get rid of bad odor. I can feel the good smell even 8 hrs after using it. My clothes smell good thanks to it. I would highly recommend it for the price they are being offered.

column9: The Only Deodorant I use.  It's the Best
column10: I perspire heavily if I don't use an effective product.  I have spent much of my life searching for the best, most effective anti-perspirant for me.  Once I found Degree and specifically this scent, I have not wavered for years.  I now buy it by the 6 pack which lasts me about 6 months.  It works perfectly for me.  It is definitely worth a try.

I tried this because of the "for sensitive skin" claim, and so far I am very pleased. With any other anti-perspirant I get itchy after 2 or 3 days and then I have to wait before I can use it again. I've been using this for a week now with no issues. Works great -- very subtle scent.

Thanks to this horrible deodorant, I have damaged over 20 shirts of mine. This deodorant works great and does the job, however you soon realise that all your shirts are becoming damaged. You will notice large yellow stains under the arms of the shirt, where you applied the deodorant. These stains DO NOT come out and your shirts will be permanently damaged. This is one of the worst products I have ever used. Stay far away from this horrible product or risk losing all your favorite shirts.

column4: D. Mikels "It's always Happy Hour here"
column10: When participating in the daily rat race, it is always a bonus to stay cool, calm, collected.  Needless to say, one does not feel cool, calm, nor collected when perspiration and pesky odor are in keen evidence.  (To the contrary, that's when one feels hot, agitated, and dis-combobulated.)  I prefer the former to the latter, which is why, for many years, I've used DEGREE MEN DRY ANTI-PERSPIRANT & DEODORANT, COOL COMFORT FOR SENSITIVE SKIN.This stuff glides on easy and clear, is non-irritating, and has a pleasing smell.  More importantly, this stuff works, folks; the anti-perspirant and deodorant protect, hour after hour--and all with soothing comfort (because it contains Aloe Vera).  No perspiration stains.  No BO.  No yucky rash.  It's Cool Comfort, baby.What I don't like is once most of the deodorant bar is used, and you're twisting up what remains, it tends to break apart in flakes and slivers and chunks.  Why?  I don't know.  But for the most part, that's a small price to pay to stay cool, calm, collected.  DEGREE MEN DRY ANTI-PERSPIRANT & DEODORANT, COOL COMFORT FOR SENSITIVE SKIN.  Dry is cool.--D. Mikels, Esq.

column9: great for travel, do not contain BPA
column10: First off, the bottles DO NOT contain BPA. The lids are coated in an epoxy that does, but there is another layer over that to help protect the BPA from getting to the formula. I actually called Similac's parent company to verify this.Yes they are expensive, but I get coupons all the time from Similac and use those to buy these bottles. They are wonderful for camping, fishing, or any other time sanitation may be an issue. All you have to do is attach your own nipple and ring. Much less to wash.Though they are really not made to do it, you can punch out the center from the ring and put in a standard nipple. It seems like it will leak, but it doesn't. Then you can just throw the whole thing away.

I always have a couple of these in my diaper bag!  We bought the case for our recent vacation and they worked out so great! No washing bottles at the hotel or needing a refrigerator or cooler.  I reccomend that you buy a 3 pack of those super cheap evenflo bottles just to use the nipple and ring.  We bought a pack of these for $2.99 and use the rings/nipples everytime since our Avent ones don't fit.  Love these ready to feed bottles!!

These bottles are great because they completely eliminate the need to measure and mix formula, and you never have to wash another bottle. (I use them with disposable nipples). My baby likes them too; he actually seems to prefer the ready-to-feed Similac over the Similac I mixed myself. Bottles are also especially useful for travel. I'm serious when I say they are almost as convenient as breastfeeding. Extra time is always golden when you have small children, so if you need to bottle-feed, these are definitely worth the price!

column9: Great product, but pricey on Amazon
column10: This product is great to throw in the diaper bag for on the go feedings.  I bought it from Amazon and then read the reviews it can be purchased cheaper at Target.  It is $9.99 for a 6 pack at Target, so Amazon is cheaper by $4, plus you get the convenience of it shipping to your house.  If you register on Similac's website, they will send you $5 vouchers which can be used in store.  With the $5 vouchers, each 6 pack $5, bringing the Target total to $20 instead of the Amazon's $36.  Also, I took the advice of another poster and bought the cheap Evenflo bottles to reuse the nipples ($3 for a 3 pack).  Definitely a great suggestion as the disposables are $1 each.

My daughter loves this stuff. Convent to toss into the diaper bag and great for the earthquake kit. When I have this in stock (My wife goes through this stuff pretty quickly) we usually give this to our (now) 3 month old right before her nap or when she's supposed to go to sleep. It's a little thicker than the powder stuff so it fills her tummy pretty well. I have also noticed she doesn't spit up that much when we use this stuff.

Those bottles are ideal for traveling. Unlike the 2 oz bottles, they don't come with a ring and nipple. However the same ring and nipple fits both bottles. Since my baby only likes silicon nipples, I use the Evenflo ring and nipple and they fit well.If you're not using the Similac nipple, avoid twisting the ring too tight, to allow some air to enter the bottle as baby is drinking, and you need to interrupt baby's drinking every now and then to let air in the bottle. However if you're using the original Similac ring and nipple, baby can drink non stop as the air enters the bottle regularly (Similac nipple has holes designed for that). Hope this helps!
These bottles make night feeding and traveling super simple.  Just toss a few bottles in the bag or put one by your bed at night, and pop a nipple on when you need it.

I'm a working mom who wants to keep breast feeding but couldn't catch up with my baby's growing appetite. She eats about 21 ounces per day. I give her about 15 ounces breast milk, the rest of it is formula. The powder formula must be finished within a month once the bottle is opened. This produce is convenient and the size is good for us. It's like one bottle a day. It's a little bit pricy but since my daughter mainly has breast milk, it's still affordable.

Our six month old is only using about 8 ounces of formula a day so the larger bottles are no good for us.  The size of the 8oz bottle is perfect, can easily be used with a stand size nipple right on the bottle and is easy to transport.  Our baby does much better on the ready-to-feed verses the powder, I think that is because the consistency is a bit thicker which settles in her stomach easier.  Perfect if you are having to supplement in small amounts because of breastfeeding.

I hate pumping and rarely get more than 3 ounces at a time.  When I started working part time and going out on a date night again, we didn't have quite enough breastmilk to last the day.  This has been such a help.  8 oz portions are great for supplementing, as you use what you need all at once and don't have so much waste (the larger ready to feed bottles need to be used in 48 hours, and the powder needs to be used in 1 month).  These bottles are the perfect size for those sporadic uses/supplementation.  Great for the diaper bag too now that baby is too distracted to breast feed outside of the house.  Fits perfectly in the pocket of the diaper bag, and you can buy the nipples that just attach to the bottle.Our son who was breastfeeding exclusively prior to using this has taken to the formula well and doesn't seem to mind the taste.  We use it to mix with his rice cereal and oatmeal too.

The Similac bottled formula is what you will find in my emergency car kit. I breastfeed at home and on the go but a situation arose that I was not able to nurse our son Henry. We were stuck in traffic and were nowhere near an exit. Thankfully this was in the ECK and I was able to open one up, place a disposable nipple and feed the hungry baby. The formula when sealed after the first use can be stored for a few hours in the refrigerator or cooler. This formula did not have an awkward foul odor or color. The option to be able to use inexpensive disposable nipples is wonderful.To sum it up, this product does what it intends to do. Provide a sterile, simply, and convenient method of feeding baby on the go.

Go for it..!! Am sure many of you are using it and a review is actually unnecessary. Once on a vacation my baby didnt like the bottled water locally available, fortunately had these ready to go bottles and these ended up saving the day for me.

column9: Cheaper than buying in the stores
column10: I started purchasing the instant formula's through Amazon.com about two months ago versus buying it in the store.  It is cheaper and easier buying through Amazon.com.  I am in the process of ordering more after I finish this review.  Overall, the instant formula makes life easier than having to measure out the powdered formula.

I love the portability of this product.  My daughter blessed me with a beautiful grandson in December 2011.  She initially went the breast milk route, but found it to be difficult.  Similac Advance early shield gives my precious gift everything he need as far as nutrition. My daughter lives out of town and we travel back and forth a lot.  The ready to feed is just that, ready when you need it.  The price is comparable to what is in the store.  I order and it is practically there instantly (a day or 2 at the most)and  it allows me to order and send directly to them.  It's my way of helping out and being of help when I am not there. Five Stars!

Pros: Perfect for on-the-go, no need to warm it up.  I always have 1-2 with me in case we are out longer than anticipated.  Also have a 6-pack or two on hand at all times in case of water emergency and unable to make powdered formula.Cons: The liquid is browner than it is when made with powder, so it stains clothing more easily.  Also, this option produces more environmental waste.
My son take breast-feeding a lot. so 8 fl oz is perfect size to store once open.it is great product for traving.

column9: Very convenient for on the go feedings
column10: These bottles are great if you are on the go and need a quick and easy bottle. We use them all the time when we are out and about.

column9: Great for travel and middle of the night
column10: I have a 5.5 month old and he likes this stuff almost just as much as breast milk.  The premixed are incredibly convenient.  Unfortunately individually packaged items are not going to be all that cheap.Make sure you sign up for "Amazon Mom", I've had about a year of free two day shipping which really makes ordering off amazon worth it.

column9: Thanks to Amazon for giving a good value for the money
column10: I won't write a review on its quality as if your have gone for this, you might have already consulted your doctor. I purchased it for my 2 months old daugther from Amazon because its cheap here. If I purchase the same quantity from Walgreen, it will be close to $52, in Walmart it will be close to $40, but in Amazon its really affordable. Thanks to Amazon for giving a good value for the money we spent.

The baby had a bit of reflux and this formula helped him.It is sterile, homogeneously mixed and ready to feed. The only draw back I see with it is that if your child does not drink 8oz at once, you need to refrigerate the left over formula(this happens for us and we just put it in the refrigerator). I sometimes use evenflo glass bottle collar with nuk orthodontic thin neck nipples.It works fine.
It's a must-have when bringing my baby outside. So convenient and my baby is very happy drinking it. Highly recommend it!
These bottles are easy to travel with, easy to use, and the perfect size! So convenient when on the go and even at home.
LOVE THE TO GO JUST TOO MUCH $$$ LOVE THE IDEA AND ALL JUST WISHED THEY MADE AN IN BETWEEN SIZE FOR 2-4 MONTH OLDS WHO WASTE OZ.

We use ready to feed for night feedings.  It is great because our baby likes to eat ASAP and can get very loud waiting for a bottle to heat up or get mixed.  These ready to feed bottles are also good when we are away from the house.  It is much better than keeping bottles cold when away from home.

column9: Very convenient for busy moms!  Thanks Amazon and Similac
column10: I really appreciate the convenience of this product! I just pop one in my diaper bag and go.  I am so glad I saved all the nipples from the hospital.  My daughter actually prefers these nipples to the ones from her other bottles.  I do wish that they would include at least one new nipple per package though.  Still...Amazon brings this product to a level that I can afford.  Thank you Similac for a great product and thank you Amazon for putting it right at my doorstep at a discount!  I get one of these packs once a month and I am set!

column9: Only formula will buy & very satisfied!
column10: Similac Advance Early Shield w/ Iron Ready to Eat is the best.  I have absolutlely no complaints about it except the cost.  Yes, they cost more, but it is for convenience.  We actually tried powder to be more cost effective & didn't have as good experience with them keeping it down (spitting up).  I can count on one hand the number of times at not keeping this ready to feed formula down & that says a lot if you have a sensitive eater.  I know several babies w/ food allergies/sensitivities/eczema that do well with this.  It is also important that it has the iron.  Similac has been around a long time & I have nothing but good to say about it.  To be able to just grab these @ anytime & not have to heat/etc. is wonderful - SERIOUSLY, wonderful.  Just shake, open & feed (if still on the bottle put on a nipple or pour into a bottle).  Always make sure to check the seal on each indidual bottle.  We haven't had many issues, but when you go through this many bottles a day it can happen that maybe one was dropped/not sealed.  No need to worry about it, but for any brand this is something I feel is important.Amazon offers a competitive price as I've purchased from numerous places.Hopefully the price will come down in the future as more go to using ready to feed.  Afterall, this is what hospitals provide after birth so it has to be healthy.  After the 2010 recall on powdered formula, the ready to feed bottles flew out of stock everywhere & I think a lot of those that maybe wouldn't have tried it were forced to & liked it.  If more utilize the ready to feed cost will come down eventually - fingers crossed!!!I give this product 5 stars.

column9: Very useful for travel, great size.
column10: This 8-oz bottle is the perfect size for my 9 month-old baby. We use these as we travel a lot by car and plane - all you need is to warm it up and add a nipple. They don't need to be refrigerated before opening and you don't need to carry baby bottles to pour them into. No need to mix and measure milk powder & water when you are on the go, no messes, no hassle. They do not leak and are easy to put in a purse or diaper bag.

column9: Very easy and tastes good too.
column10: My baby breastfed but eventually I needed to supplement.  I tried several different formulas and my baby just did not like them.  I read somewhere that the Similac Ready to Feed tasted better than other formulas and didn't have a grainy texture like the powders.  I decided to do a taste test myself and I too found that it had a pleasant taste (a little sweet like breastmilk) and did not have a bad smell like the powders.  So I began feeding my baby 1/2 formula and 1/2 breastmilk and he took it without any problem.  After a few weeks of that process I was able to move to 100% formula.  The ready to feed really is very simple to use and take along with you.  I'd say it's almost as easy as breasfeeding.  I wish it came in a 4 oz size rather than an 8 oz size.  The 2oz size is not enough (and way more expensive) and the 8oz is too much.  It's fine when I'm at home and can refrigerate the extra but when I'm out and about the extra often gets wasted.But other than that I'm really happy with this product.  With Amazon Prime and Free 2 Day shipping it's a great value too.
My baby was a frequent spitter upper, but since switching to this she hasn't spit up at all.  Great stuff!!!
Wife uses breast milk during the day and formula at night because it is so much more filling. This is excellent formula. No problems thus far

column9: Extravagant and not "green", but good for emergencies.
column10: I keep a few of these on hand and in the car as an emergency backup - they're way too expensive to use for every day (and, jeepers, the plastic gods would send me straight to some recycling inferno in the afterlife).
I hope the product description should be given more detail so that the consumer will choose the very right one.overall, it's a good experience to buy Similac and get it within 2 days.

I buy these for the times when I am in a serious rush- just toss a few in the diaper bag along with some standard size nipples and rings and I can be out the door in a flash.Pros:-Fast and easy.-I don't have to worry about them leaking all over my expensive diaper bag.-I don't have to keep them refrigerated.-The bottles are compact, so I can fit more in my bag vs. large bottles with water in them plus a container of  powdered formula.-No washing bottles, only nipples and rings.  I stocked up on Evenflo and Gerber cheap plastic bottles and I have more nipples and rings than I know what to do with.-Toss it out when you're done, so your diaper bag gets lighter and easier to zip as the day wears on.-I think they even make disposable nipples for these, not sure though.Cons:-Very expensive compared to powder (and even more so compared to breastmilk- stupid school schedule making me dry up.)-Unless you want to carry around another bottle to empty some of it into before the feeding, you have to use it right away, no refrigerating leftovers.  My son rarely eats 8 ounces at one feeding, so we waste 2-3 ounces per bottle.Overall, I think that they are prohibitively expensive when it comes to everyday feedings, but the cost is worth the convenience for the occasional outing.

column9: Great and Easy! Worth the Price!
column10: When my daughter was born, the hospital provided the smaller versions for me to take home.  I decided to breast feed and supplement with formula as well.  My daughter loved the Similac Ready Right Now.  It has also been really easy on her stomach. My husband and I will continue to feed her with this formula. Thank you Amazon for selling this product and AT A GREAT DEAL!!!

I am so incredibly disappointed that this item (and many other formula items) is not directly available from Amazon anymore.  I was a regular customer for this product but can not afford the increase in price and also the shipping/handling that other companies charge, for the very same thing.  In all my years as a customer here and with all the thousands of dollars I've spent with Amazon, this is the first time you've disappointed me.  :(

The Ready to feed idea is great. I recently travelled with my twins on a long flight (almost 20 hrs). It was very helpful especially with two babies. But, it leaked with my regular Dr.Brown's nipples. I was kind of disappointed because it would spill all over my kids's neck. It kind of worked by holding the bottle at a certain angle sometimes. It would be best if it came with disposable nipples. On the return flight I poured the RTF formula into my regular Dr.Brown's bottles and fed my babies. This way there was no leakage. I didn't like the idea of carrying many Dr.Brown's bottles to prevent leakage but atleast I didnt have to prepare formula on the flight with two babies. I would definitely recommend buying these RTF and maybe try it with different nipples.On similac's website I saw that they had disposable nipples but not sure if those would fit these.
This is for 4 six pack boxes. You can get these boxes for 6.99 at Target, so this price is over $10 more. My bad for not checking the local price beforehand. I won't make that mistake again!

I loved these since they are so convenient.  I hate powder formula since I always have problems with clumps and they are messy.  It was so nice to just open one of these rather having to mix and shake and get powder all over the place.  And they carry so well....alas, due to the BPA chemical leaching issue, I switched to powder again.  I hope they switch to BPA free containers.

column4: Taking baby to the zoo tomorrow
column10: Five days and no shipment for an in-stock product?! First time you let me down Amazon... My baby can't wait so I'm off to the dreaded grocery store. Baby food ships first guys...  B A B Y food! :)

I like the similac formula bottles.  However, I was looking to find these bottles for a lower price through Amazon, so I came to order these bottles.  My understanding from the way the product was described is that there were 24 cases of 6 bottles, not 24 bottles total.  At 24 bottles total (which is what I received), this is a worse price than what I pay at my grocery store (which is the most expensive place I have bought them).
I ordered this product in October and it still hasn't arrived.  There is apparently no way to contact the shipper.  The item itself is excellent but this level of service is atrocious.

column9: This milk makes our baby really sick!! :(
column10: Sorry to give this 1 star. but this milk really makes our baby really sick!! :(, literally!!if your baby can take it, I guess it's a good one but for us, we had the worst experience with it.Here is our story.My baby had been solely breastfed. After 9 months my wife was running short of her milk. She didn't have enough breastmilk for the baby and he didn't take as much solid food as we would want him to.We gave him Similac Advance, it was recommended by the hospital. First Similac Advance Liquid, he threw up 9 times within 2 hours after half an hour of feeding. That happened twice. A few days later, we tried Similac Advance power, he threw up again! This time 5 times plus serious diarrhea for 5 days. He has lost 5% of his weight within 2 days. That's really bad.We were desperate. We took him to the hospital twice that week. The doctor though it was stomach flu.However, I didn't quit agree with him. What a coincident that 2 different formula milk feeding incidents would throw my baby off balance. I'm a computer engineer and dealing with solving and debugging problems all the time.I was firm with the doctor that this was not a coincident. I thought it might have something to do with the protein in the formula that my baby couldn't digest. We decided to try Lactose free formula (Nutramigen from Enflora). It smell and taste really awful (my wife tried it and she gagged.As we thought, my baby rejected to drink it. Then I tried Good Start soy. Same story, smell bad but not as bad as Nutromigen. My baby also rejected to drink it.Now we were really desperate, not enough milk for him and he doesn't like to eat solid food!! He would throw up + diarrhea if he gave him normal formula milk. Phone call to 4 advise nurses, no luck! I finally search on the internet and found a lot of similar story to what we experienced (including this on Amazon reviews).I decided to give it a final try, crossing our fingers really tight. Good Start Gentle Plus is our last hope or my baby would not have any more milk to drink. He's losing weight!!And then miracle happened!!! This milk works wonderfully for him. The only complain I would have is that it doesn't smell as good as the normal cow milk-based formula, however, doesn't smell or taste awful like the other two.My baby didn't quite used to the tasted in the beginning and didn't really want to drink it at first. So we tried mixed it with breastmilk for a few days.Now he is a happy baby, gaining weight, doesn't throw up and used to the taste of it.My wife and I are now happy again :)

column10: I ordered this item for my great grandbabies it made themsick, this is not the first time I've had a problem withsimilac hospitals need to stop putting newborns on thisI think they have a contract with the hospitals

For whatever reason, these are disappearing from grocery store shelves. When I don't want to take the time to saute fresh ones, these are a convenient addition to pasta sauces, etc. The brands I'm finding locally are either the grocery store brand or Giorgio, both of which have a peculiar flavor to them.
I highly recommend the organic roast; if you enjoy high quality pure coffee, it is in your best interest to enjoy try this for your home and office.

This coffee was recommended to me by a friend and fellow coffee-holic. From the moment I opened the bag and smelled this beautiful roast - I knew I was going to love the flavor. Although I'm not a coffee aficionado, I drink many different types and I know good coffee when I taste it. The Vida Helsar is smooth yet distinctive and perfect for anyone who loves a good cup(s) - and it's organic. I've tried the Cafe Pura Vida La Margarita Honey Whole Bean Coffee, 12 Ounce Bag blend and it is also very good.

I just tried this coffee, as I enjoy experimenting with different products. I am really enjoying it from several perspectives: 1) It had a really different taste than what one normally gets from most store-bought coffee, 2) it not at all oily...many coffees are overly roasted to hid inferior quality...no need to over-roast this coffee as it stands tall on its own -- you can see the lack of oil by how the coffee comes out of the grinder cleanly, and 3) we like supporting both organic, sustainable farming, as well as local boutique businesses.Bottom line, this is coffee we really enjoy, especially on leisurely weekend mornings, and it is now on our short list of most-favored coffees.  Highly recommended without reservation!
I'm pretty new to the coffee scene, but I really like this roast. It is quite flavorful and rich. It was the first coffee I bought, I tried a few more and I came back to this.
Alright.  This is now one of my favorites.  I really love this tea.  Smooth.  A little earthy with some flowery notes.  Not overpowering.  Just right.

I first tried the tea when i had a terrible cold and it was a life saver-soothing, delicious and light. it's beautiful to look at and even nicer to drink. if you like herbal tea, you'll love this.  i definitely recommend it.  makes a lovely gift, too (my brother got me a collection of Chartreuse teas with a fancy teapot for christmas!)  enjoy.

I have been enjoying Chartreuse Teas for three years.  Their blends are fantastic, their teas are hand packaged, and the flavors couldn't be more vivid.This is nothing like the teabag tea you are used to.  You'll actually see the petals, the berries, the clipped grasses, the small chips of real organic material that, when you soak them in hot water, release their all-natural oils, vitamins and amazing flavors.These are highly recommended!

I have tried many apple sauce varieties over the years, including virtually all non-organics in my younger years, and I have been through the gamut of the organic apple sauce offerings. Through them all, this one clearly comes out on top and it is the only one I buy. It is a brilliant mixture of the classic apple sauce taste with a twist of peach flavoring. The peach is stronger than the apple sauce flavor, but it has a freshness to it. It is sweeter than the average apple sauce, but much more flavorful. Definitely give this one a shot, nothing beats it cold and it's only 60 calories per cup with only organic ingredients.

column9: A tad artificial tasting but better than most applesauce cups

Awesome flavor! I love ordering these in bulk! Perfect for stocking the pantry! Thank you amazon!! Will order again for sure!

Each pouch makes a half-gallon, about 16 servings (or better yet, make it 12 or less servings!).This is a really great idea. column10: WE WERE IN GATLINBURG, TN. AND WENT TO A WINERY AND BOUGHT SOME OF THIS MIX. WE WERE UNABLE TO FIND IT ANYWHERE AT HOME (LYONS GEORGIA) SO WE LOOKED IT UP ON LINE. My girl friends and I first discovered this product in Gatlinburg at one of the wineries.  We love it.  It is wonderful on a hot summer night or anytime.  It is easy to mix and just freeze.  You have to try it.

column9: Lt. Blenders Sangria Wine Freezer, 9-7 ounce Pouches

Amazon's price is the best we have found so we have more sent automatically every three months and do not have to waste our time running to the store when friends pop in.  Amazon saves us time and money and provides us with hours of pleasure.

Very good product, mixed with a good red wine.  Slushy texture after frozen, I really enjoy.  I myself mixed it with a muscadine wine, delicious.
These are terrific!!  Just pop in the freezer and you have a refreshing drink for anyone that drops by!  Love 'em!!!

This is a great escape from the carbonated bottled Sangrias. They are sweet for sure, but no complaints. I mixed it with Ocoee Red Table Wine from the Ocoee Winery in Cleveland Tennessee. What a great combination. If you like Sangrias, you must try this!
This is a great product and mixes well with Red Wine. I really love this product and has come to me several times and each time it is always delivered fast.

We took this pouch out for a day of sailing with friends.  It was frozen solid at the start of the day, but it kept thawing, and we kept drinking.  Great drink for the summertime and convenient as well!

They were WAY too sweet- bordered upon undrinkable.  And even though there was wine in them, they froze completely solid. I tried the Sangria Wine Freezer because I really liked the margarita and the mojito mixes. And the verdict is.....too bad I bought it in a pack of 3, as I don't know what to do with what's left over. It's too sweet, and doesn't have any exciting flavour. Also, unlike the mixes made with hard liquor, the wine freezes too hard, so it's tough to get it out of the bag once frozen. I had to leave it out of the freezer for an hour or more so I could pour/squeeze a drink!

column9: Roland Balsamic Borretane Onions - very good product
column10: We ordered the onions packed in balsamic vinegar already being fans of veggies and salads with balsamic vinegar. This is the first time tasting this product and have no experience of other versions of this Italian delicacy with which to compare it. So, we're not sure how this might measure up to with other similar products which may or may not be better.I was hoping for something that my guests would enjoy more, but the product was good. We did not try any of the pastry presentations which would have been very good, I'm sure. Other reviewers will be able to offer better comparisons.

column9: Add a kick to salad dessing
column10: I have tried many rice vinegars over the years and only Marukan has the right balance of acid, sweet, and seasoning, that with olive oil and a bit of pepper makes a simple, flavorful dressing that doesn't overpower a salad.  Adding a bit garlic and Italian seasonings also creates a wonderful dressing.  It is very difficult to find Marukan in stores and that's why I have been buying it at Amazon.

column9: So great on salads and any vegetable
column10: I was so glad to find this Rice Vinegar on Amazon.  I love this on any vegetable whether it is fresh or steamed.  I will be reordering this on a regular basis.

The product showed up with three bottles and at least one of them was leaking. I don't know if this is a bottling problem, a shipping problem...whatever. It does not matter. It is the kind of problem where the effort to try and resolve is simply not worth it. We took pictures before opening the sealed bag but I can't seem to find a place here to upload them. Deer Off really does keep deer, woodchucks and rabbits from eating our garden plants, shrubs and trees.  It works winter and summer in our semi-rural southern Wisconsin location.  Rain will wash it off, but usually applying it every few weeks does the trick.I recommend using the concentrate.  Keep the bottle in your refrigerator.  No, it won't make your 'frige stink!  We mix it up as needed and spray it with an inexpensive plastic pressurized sprayer.  Diluted concentrate in the sprayer does not spoil, but will freeze in the winter as it is water-based.The concetrate seems expensive, but it's much cheaper than buying the pre-mixed version.  Just a light application on each plant is all that's needed to be effective.

I have been using this product for approximately 3 years.  It definitely fends off any critters (large or small) from eating your plants.  The solution is very strong, so I use it mainly on flowers and shrubs as opposed to vegetables and or fruits.  I imagine it would be ok to use on edibles, depending on the permeability of their skin, however this is one marinade I would absolutely pass on.  The residual effects of the application last for quite a long period, at least 6 weeks to 2 months.

I wanted a deer repellent that was nontoxic and didn't rely on predator urine. After reading test results of various products, I tried Deer Off. It does work - we have herds of deer that come through my suburban yard, and it saved my hosta flowers this year (deer ate every single one before I got Deer Off). The problem is that I have to remember to keep a supply of it onhand, because if I don't use it every six weeks or so, it eventually wears off. It can also be hard on your sprayer. The handles broke on the two spray bottles I used, so I started using a pump sprayer. I have to filter the concentrate, because it can clog the sprayer with little bits. I combine it with some liquid kelp and fertilize the plants at the same time.I don't know about squirrels or rabbits, because even though we have them, they don't cause much damage to my shade garden.
excellent service, excellent product.  finally, the deer are avoiding our gardens!  only wish deer off wer a little less expensive.  overall,  great job!  thank you!!
Definately keeps deer away from gardens and plantings. However, the squirrels keep picnicking on my fruit trees-not an effective product in this area.

I have a terrible deer problem in my garden. Vegetables and flowers can be devastasted overnight and they trample the gardens too, sometimes laying down and crushing large plants. They will eat every daylily bud and tomato plant I have.  I spray this on once a month [more if it rains a lot] and they really don't touch the plants. I bought a large sprayer type cannister with a pump and mixed a large batch and use it as needed over the summer.  It is 100% effective for me.

I have grown roses for about 10 years. When my husband and I moved to the country I had the rose bushes eaten down to the canes.  I lost over 50 bushes while I tried product after product.  You name it-- human hair, soap, mothballs, motion detector pumpkins that lit up and made noise....I even found someone who kept large cats and tried lion dung.....nothing worked until I found this product.  Here in Florida with our heavy summer rains, I apply it more frequently. Great product!

Deer Off deer, rabbit and squirrel repellent may actually repel deer if you can get the repellent on the plants. I carefully followed the dilution instructions, poured the mixture into a sprayer, and started to use it. Within a few minutes the sprayer was clogged. I ended up putting the mixture into a sprinkling can and sprinkling it on the plants -- a very inefficient way to use it. I tried to clean the sprayer and finally had to throw it away. It was a sprayer I had used successfully with other sprays. I would not buy this product again.

Sprayed several days in a row but it did not keep my irrigation feeder lines from being chewed through.  I replaced the feeder lines four times and sprayed each time and the "varmints" would not stop.  I finally raised the main and feeder lines about three feet in the air with stakes and bars and so far it seems like they got the message and went away, hopefully.  At any rate, the spray did not do me any good.  Sorry.
This is the only product that seems to provide any protection for my garden from deer.

column9: Disappointing Grape Flavor Not As Tasty as Other Switch Flavors
column10: Since my teenagers really liked the The Switch Orange Tangerine, 8.3 Ounce Cans (Pack of 24), and the The Switch Black Cherry, 8.3 Ounce Cans (Pack of 24), we thought we would try the Grape Flavor.  We were disappointed. Although still drinkable, it is just not the equal of other flavors of Switch.The positive is that the beverage is all-natural, and packaged in the smaller-than-regular-12-ounce soda cans. It also has less carbonation than regular grape soda, which is a nice change.  But the negative is that the Grape flavor cannot hold a candle to the the two other flavors we have enjoyed.  It is on the sour side and leaves a slight unpleasant aftertaste.  Not at all the satisfying, smooth and true fruit taste of the other two Switch flavors which we have tried.I cannot recommend this flavor, although I still like the brand and plan to sample some other flavors.  I would definitely order the Tangerine/Orange and the Black Cherry again.

i have a weak spot for grape soda (among other not so good for you treats). admittedly i don't pay that much attention to what goes into them, but i do try to moderate what i consume from time to time.this stuff is great! tastes almost as deliciously bad for you as the real thing, but since it's not as syrupy as welch's grape soda, it actually is more refreshing after downing the whole can.if you're concerned with all the bad stuff in the other stuff, but can't keep away, give this one a try.
For me, this is just like drinking a grape soda, except it's better for you since there are no added sugars, artificial sweeteners, or other unwanted chemicals.  Just 100% juice!

These drinks are great. I discovered them while having lunch with my children at school. I was very happy to see that Amazon carried them because I had been looking for them retail and couldnt find them. I love sodas but have been trying to cut back, and The Switch drinks help me by still giving the carbonated soda taste without the soda and caffeine. And what is even better, my kids think they are drinking soda, but are still drinking healthy. The Switch drinks will definately be a drink that is repurchased in my household again....

This is one canned juice drink that I really like. Its not too sweet and has a nice clean flavor. The only things that I didn't really care about is that its a little over carbinated for me, and there isn't really enough of it when I'm used to 16 oz. size or larger drinks. The cans could be at least a little bigger.  One other thing that I really liked about it is a little shot of Spiced Rum goes good with it too.
Great carbonated beverage. My son gets it at school and loves it.  I can't find in local stores so I bought it here.Kids love it.

I've seen a lot of bad reviews about this product, but I do have to say I do see any merit to them.  I bought this product very skeptical of what to expect, because of the reviews; however, it is well worth the purchase.  My wife and I love these drinks, and they are a hit with our children.

The Switch is a great product and a great value for the price. I keep a supply on hand at all times by regularly ordering two cases at a time from Amazon. The drink is delicious and wholesome, consisting, as they say, of just bubbles and juice. The flavors are rich without being too sweet as there is no added sugar or syrup. I love The Switch and highly recommend it.
Our teens switched to Switch on their own and soda consumption has dropped off voluntarily.  That was the goal - a peaceful transition to less sugar and less overall intake.

column9: Very good~You can taste the skin of the grapes.

column9: Bought the case for my boyfriend. He loves them all. Theyre really popular in my school.

column9: For me, not worth the extra
column10: I am NO kind of expert, I don't have a fancy "food critic" palate.  I'm just a regular middle-aged guy who occasionally likes to have some tasty warm tea.  I generally refrain from adding sugar or cream, so I enjoy strong tea...but not too bitter.Numi Organic Tea Magnolia Puerh is not too bitter...that's good.  It was easy to drink and tasted nice.  But it was nothing special.  All the marketing materials and fancy write-ups about what Puerh tea is sort of set me up to expect something really special.  On the whole, the taste was quite pleasant, but I noticed nothing to set it apart from Bigelow or other name brands that are a cut above Lipton but a cut (price-wise) below Numi.I was disappointed that the tea didn't smell better.  With magnolia added, I expected to catch a whiff (I lived in the South for awhile, so I know magnolia).  Nothing.  It smelled like "regular old tea."My daughter (aged 17) liked it a bit more.  I think she appreciated the lack of bitterness, and she did add a half-teaspoon of sugar.  My wife was quite neutral.  And in the end...I'm neutral too.

Numi's organic pu ehr teas are harvested from ancient tea trees in China; a little research shows that it's a type of tea with an interesting history. None of that really matters, though, when you're raising a steaming mug to your lips (or an heirloom bone china teacup if that's your style). It's all about the aroma first, and then the taste.This magnolia tea did not signal "floral" to my senses, nor for that matter vanilla as mentioned in the packaging. As it cooled slightly I did notice the "earth notes" developing and I found it very pleasant without milk or sweetener.The first time I brewed it I used one tea bag in my favorite giant mug, and let it steep for 4 minutes. This was just about perfect in strength but I found that I enjoyed it more while hot than cooled off, so I have switched to a smaller mug and two minutes of brewing. I don't drink tea every day and always choose it to suit my mood; this Numi Organic Tea Magnolia Puerh, 16-Count Full Leaf Tea Bags (Pack of 2) is a good choice for mid-evening when I want something more bracing than herbal but with less kick than my beloved smoky Lapsang Souchong.Numi distributes several kinds of tea. While I enjoyed this green-and-black blend, I would be interested in trying some of their white teas and possibly the reds, and I would choose loose tea over the bags. Intriguing!Linda Bulger, 2010

To start with, I'm not a big fan of hot tea.  I like iced tea, but I prefer to drink coffee if I'm having a hot beverage.  That said, I was pleasantly surprised with this tea.  It has a good, smooth taste to it.  To me, the taste is not overwhelming or bitter, and it is smooth and strong enough that I didn't feel compelled to add any sweetener.  I would fail miserably if I tried to describe the taste to anyone else, but I can say that I quite enjoy it and will probably pick up some more now that the weather is starting to cool off.

column9: Nice for a change of pace!
column10: I have tried and enjoyed many of Numi's teas - in fact some of my favorite bagged teas are made by this company.  I'm not a "tea connoisseur" by any stretch of the imagination, I just know what tastes good to ME, so I can't comment about "floral notes" or "grassy tastes" or any of that type feedback.  And, I make my tea in a manner which would probably make a true tea aficionado cringe - I put the tea bag into my 12 oz. mug, fill it up with filtered water, and nuke for 2 minutes!  For me, it comes out perfectly this way.This particular tea was a pretty color, smelled wonderful, and made me happy to drink it.  I didn't add anything to it the first time; the second time, I added a packet of Truvia (stevia/erythritol mix) and liked it even better slightly sweetened.  A nice cup of this in the evening satisfies my urge to "graze" and fills my tummy with warmth and satisfaction.  Give it a try, see for yourself!

I am seriously addicted to Puerh tea & was thrilled to be able to try a new Puerh!  I am not disappointed!  I like it very strong, so I use 2 tea bags rather than 1 per cup.  This is very sweet & not bitter in the least.  I was concerned that the floral flavor would be overpowering, but not so.  If you like a flowery tasting tea, you might be disappointed in that regard.For a green tea blend, it still brewed pretty dark & very rich.  I sweeten my tea with honey & use half and half.  This is a tea that pairs very well with cream.Puerh tea is unique in that it is allowed to ferment or compost a bit.  Sounds really strange & nasty, but I guess that's what sets it apart from any other tea.  I have noticed that people either love this stuff or flat out detest it.  I have also heard that it is commonly drunk after a fatty meal to aid digestion & also that it is a weight loss aid.  I don't care either way about any of these things.  I just LOVE Puerh tea & if it does all those wonderful things then I consider myself lucky to love something that loves me back!Going organic is a no brainier.  One should never drink non organic tea.  You are getting a mega dose of pesticides.  Don't believe me?  Do your homework, & you will say thankee.Bottom line, I like Rishi Puerh Tu Cha the most (offered on Amazon) 5 stars all the way.  However, this makes a delicious substitute if I can't get my Rishi!

This Magnolia Puerh Organic Green Tea Blend from Numi is perfect to have with meals, because of its subtlety. Its lovely aroma and taste do not overwhelm other flavors, and it acts almost as a "palate cleanser." It's also an ideal tea for an afternoon break, when you need that "pick me up," as Puerh, from the Yunnan province in China, is legendary for its healing and energizing "Qi" qualities. This tea also contains antioxidants and other good stuff, that in this crazy world we can use to be healthier and less stressed. As someone who has recently given up coffee, I find this tea is a good java replacement; it makes an excellent breakfast beverage for non-coffee drinkers.This green tea blend has a rich golden color when steeped for at least a minute (packaging recommends 2-4 minutes, but not longer) and the box is eco-friendly, using 85% post-consumer waste and soy based inks, with the tea bags being biodegradable.  The box has a slot on the lower part of it that you can punch in, so you can get your individually wrapped bags out one by one. Great hot or cold, or as I like my teas, tepid, this is a wonderful tea for all occasions.

column9: A good way to introduce yourself to pu-erh tea.
column10: Like strong cheese, and lambic beer, regular pu-erh teas are an acquired taste. Earthy, funky, musty and complex, all a bit too much for the beginner.  The Numi magnolia pu-erh, tones the pu-erh aspect down to a subtle level. Surprisingly, unlike most scented teas I've tried, the magnolia doesn't overpower either.The nose is rich, sweet and fruity/floral, the body is medium-to-full. The initial flavor is sweet, fruity and slightly floral, the pu-erh comes out in the finish, earthy, but tempered by the sweetness of the magnolia. As the sweetness fades, the pu-erh gains strength, but never too strong. The direction say to steep in boiling water, but I find the flavor is better with a slightly cooler water (185-200 degrees).If you're interested in trying pu-erh tea but are intimidated by its unusual flavor, this will give you a 'safe' introduction.

column9: A good tea, but needs less steeping than directions call for.
column10: Numi teas are generally good quality, and this one is no exception.  It's a blend of green tea, black Puerh tea, and Magnolia flowers, which gives it a complex combination of flavors that's quite interesting, although heavy on the earthy well-fermented side.The directions call for steeping 2-4 minutes with boiling water, but I found that range to give a bitter brew heavy on the black tea tannins.  I had much smoother results that highlighted the magnolia and green tea elements by steeping for only 1 minute with boiling water.  It's even better when I let the boiling water cool for 2 minutes before pouring over the tea and steeping for another 2.

column9: This is not a green tea
column10: I noticed that several reviewers compared this to green teas.  This is actually not a green tea; it is a blend of green tea and black tea.  I found it to be more characteristic of black tea, albeit with a soft, flowery aroma and suggestions of fruit and vanilla in the flavor that I think reflected the addition of the green tea (green and black teas are not different kinds; it just depends on how they are processed).I'm not quite a tea snob, but I probably come pretty close.  I drink tea every day, both iced and hot, and have for most of my life (my parents never thought children should have coffee, but we often drank tea).  I'm careful about how I steep my tea and use water of different temperatures and different brewing times for different teas, depending on their requirements for optimal flavor.  I have definite tea preferences, although they are wide ranging, and I buy many high-end teas (although good old Red Rose finds its way into my iced tea regularly).I found this a very pleasurable, very drinkable tea.  I brewed it with just-boiling water, as I would a black tea, but steeped it for only about 3 minutes (note that I like my tea dark).  It put me in mind of a darjeeling but was more complex and, I think, benefited from the smoothing influence of the green tea.  The earthiness that is claimed to be typical of Puerh tea was definitely present, but very mellow.This is my first experience with Puerh tea, so I did a little reading on it.  It really does have a long history and is one of the first Chinese teas; tea trees known to be more than 1000 years old are still growing and producing tea.  Puerh tea comes from the Yunnan province, one of the most ideal tea growing regions in the world.  It's reputed to dispel the effects of alcohol, help digestion, refresh the mind, and lower cholesterol and triglycerides (wow, what's not to like!)I don't know if it really does have greater health benefits than other teas, but I'm glad I had the opportunity to add it to my tea lineup, and I believe it will continue to hold a place there.  Actually, writing this review has made me want to drink it again, so I think I'll go brew a pot!

The tea is rich in flavor and is an organic green tea blend.  The flavor is full and mixed with floral, light fruit and a very crisp tea.  This is not a green tea though.  It's a darker color tea and I enjoy it without any extra sugar or milk.  If you like a full flavored floral tea, this one's for you.

Although this is a green tea, the color in the cup is a rusty brown. Because of that, I initially expected the flavor to have a high astringency and acid content, but even after steeping the tea for three minutes it was not bitter. In fact, the tea has a very nice, smooth taste. The magnolia flowers contribute a mild floral scent, but I'm not sure what they contribute to the flavor without also being able to taste this same tea without the magnolia. In any case, the floral essence isn't overpowering.This is a good tea for day-to-day drinking. The flavor isn't so unusual that I'd want to save it for occasional use; in fact, I've taken some to work and I enjoy having a cup in the afternoon.

This tea was superb. I used two bags in a four cup automatic tea maker on the mild setting the first time around. The tea came out perfect. The green tea flavor was subtle with a hint of magnolia. I drank mine unsweetened, the flavor was so good. I was able to use the same bags again by setting the automatic tea maker to the strongest flavor setting. The tea came out tasting the same. Definitely worth buying. I will be buying it again!

I drink a lot of tea, have since I was a little kid.  Though growing up my mom would only drink herbals because she didn't like caffeine.  When I was about 20yrs, I met some friends who were obsessed with tea and taught me how to make loose-leaf tea, not the stupid bagged stuff.  The problem with bagged teas is that with bagged tea you get the worst, left-over part of the leaf, or dust, in those bags, so the quality of the tea is much lower than most loose-leaf teas.  Also with loose-leaf teas you have the option of buying bags you can use so you have your own bag tea as well with whatever quality and quantity of tea you want.  With all that said, I have found "Numi" to be a very good tea company as far as mass-produced sold in-store teas go.  They are definitely on the higher end of my list of good teas when you aren't in the mood for measuring your own.  I have used several of their loose leaf teas ( such as the Numi Flowering Tea Assortment - 9 Varieties )and they are good quality, so I was excited, but apprehensive to try this tea.  This, is for bagged tea, I am happy to say, very very good.  It has a light fragrant taste, and is ideal for night time.  I know green tea at night time sounds like a bad idea, but green teas caffeine content isn't as high as black tea and isn't likely to keep you awake, even for someone like me who is highly caffeine sensitive.  Its just a very nice tea.  The first time I over steeped it quite a bit, but even then the taste was still smooth and the taste of tannins was not too strong, the second time was still slightly over steeped, but could barely taste the tannins at all, when steeped properly, there should be very little or not taste of tannins in this tea at all.  Overall, I was very impressed with this tea, the only reason I can't rate this tea higher is because of the price.  32 bags for [...] just isn't very cost-efficient.  That's equivalent to about 6-8pots of a normal sized tea pot.  I can buy about a 1/2 lb of good quality green tea for that price which will yield a lot more tea.  However, its still a great purchase for people who like bagged tea and I highly recommend it to those who do.  :)  God Bless ~Amy  EDIT (11-19-09):  My husband reminded me that although the tea in these bags is great, the string on the bags has a tendency to come off when you try to take it out of the package, which is definitely a con, but does not change quality of the tea, just something to note when taking it out of the package.  :)

I am a great fan of greens and oolongs, particularly scented teas.This puerh brews deep reddish-brown liquor.  It is a full-bodied, smooth tea.  It has a light, not overbearing floral scent and a bold, but slightly sweet, fruity taste and a somewhat astringent finish.I do not taste the green except in the finish.  In fact, I wondered at first if there actually was green tea in the blend.  I was also interested in what is in the teabag, so I opened one to examine it.  There is indeed green tea in it.  The teabag does not contain tea dust.  It contains fannings, which are pieces of broken leaf.I have added photos so you can see the liquor and the contents of the teabag.You can drink this pleasant tea unadorned if you wish.  It is a good afternoon offering and is suitable to serve with dessert.  It marries very well with Dare Cookies, Lemon Creme, 12.3-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12).  You can steep this tea two or three times.  I brewed it at about 200 degrees Fahrenheit because green tea brews bitter in boiling water.  Brew it in simmering water.  I am pleasantly surprised and think this is worth trying, especially for those who want to try a new type of tea.

This is not you usual black tea product.  Puerh's earthy flavor with the magnolia's sweet floral flavor is refreshing and diffferent.  I drink this every morning for it's flavor and health benefits.  One of my favorites, I highly recommend.  Best place to buy this is on Amazon.

If you are looking for your run of the mill green tea this may not be for you. I actually drink this by itself but I also mix it with a chai tea that I love and it taste great. The tea color is brown not green and it is a different flavor. I would say it is closer to a weak black tea and it does not have the bitterness or the aftertaste you get with green tea. I really like it. I actually picked it up for $2 at tjmaxx (good place to buy tea...I'm for real) but it is worth $7 a box for sure.

I love this tea.  Though I usually prefer unflavored teas like green or honeybush (Numi's honeybush is also excellent, by the way), I've really fallen for this tea.  It's rich aroma and surprisingly dark color are instantly enticing.  It has a very smooth mouthfeel and a complexity and uniqueness of flavor (a bit like a lighter, less bitter coffee with a hint of barnyard and malt)that one does not often find in boxed teas.  I'd definitely recommend it for tea enthusiasts.Note: don't worry about the 3-5 minute brew time--this tea does not seem to become bitter regardless of steeping length.

I am an avid tea drinker & this one tops most. The aroma alone is enough to make me want to steep a cup. The flavor is sublime. It sounds in the description as though it is a "busy" flavor, however the nuances are very subtle & pleasant. I love this tea & have bought more!

This tea is excellent. It is not at all bitter and has a relaxing mild flavor. My favorite part is that it does not seem to be very caffeinated. Since I drink it at my office, I enjoy that it seeps to full flavor in a short period of time and I have never had a tea bag fall apart.

I had to buy another box of this within a week. I got one cup out of the first box. My grown daughters loved it.A committee meeting of the family tea-drinkers resulted in the following:Awesome scent. Floral but not overpoweringNot bitterVanilla taste is just right--not too muchI rarely add any sweetener to tea and didn't need any with this. It was fine straight and just as good with a little milk.This is not a green tea--the color brewed is the same rich color as most black teas.

I am not a heavy tea drinker, and I cannot speak to all the tiny details of taste. But this tea is delicious, and has a very nice flavor. I, personally, prefer it slightly sweetened. (And I will confess to using plain old sugar to do it. ) It has become my treat in the early afternoon, my feet up, relaxing with some Norah Jones before everyone comes bounding in.Give it a try. You will not regret it!

column4: J. Rose "JR From the Ball so Blue"
column10: This is a gently flavored tea. Nothing overwhelming. But amazing, smooth flavor and what I have come to expect from Numi: stunning quality of tea.I love this manufacturers teas. They are spot on. A real value.
This tea is very good.  I love that it is organic and has a wonderful scent.... very nice in the evening :-)

column9: A pleasant green tea with some floral notes
column10: Numi Organic Magnolia Puerh green tea is very pleasant. It is not a particularly flavorful green but it does have some body and a pleasant note of floral from the magnolia. I prefer other greens, smokier, stronger blends, and will not make a habit of it, but I have enjoyed this tea.

I am not a big tea drinker (I like coffee more) so I am trying to find teas that I can like.  I tend to like dark teas more than herbals.  This tea was interesting to me because it wasn't just a straight green tea but a blend.  I also am a milk adder so you need to know that.  I found that you can add milk to this tea and it seems to still have a very pleasant flavor.  IT might be a little too flowery for me or earthy or whatever that puerh flavor was but I enjoyed the expiernce and it was a very pleasant tea.

Numi has created another delicious organic tea blend that combines health and luxury.  The scent of Magnolia Puerh is a fragrant and floral tea blend--a pleasant and subtle aroma. The brewed mahogany elixir has a light floral, tea and wood flavor that is refreshing and soothing. The caffeine level is mild and the tea has a light acidity that balances the flavors nicely.Puerh tea has a long history of being a luxury tea in China. Valued for its flavor, it also has the reputation for health promoting qualities--weight loss being a notable one.Numi tea company provides quality teas that are slightly unusual.  Their master tea blender consistently creates delicious mixtures. They utilize organic teas and recycled materials so that their products have a minimal environmental impact. Enjoy this tea in health and prosperity!

I am a regular drinker of green tea, so I was happy to have the opportunity to try this Numi Organic variety.  When I first smelled the tea while it was steeping, I was happy to note a scent equivalent to jasmine tea, which is my favorite green tea.  Unfortunately, even though I tried many cups, using different water temps, (full boil, pre boil, boil and cool a bit..), and many different times to soak the tea bag, I found the tea to be weak and rather insipid tasting.  Too bad...  I had high hopes for this tea...

column9: interesting, good tea, not a great tea
column10: If your tastebuds bore easily, try this tea. It really does change flavors, and dramatically. Unfortunately, I didn't find any of the wide range particularly outstanding. It starts with a fresh herbal taste, and as it cools it develops a green flavor that gives way to an earthiness and finally a bold and almost crispness that is fine over ice. Interesting, but not one I'd reach for regularly. If you are into sipping adventure, give it a try. If you are just looking for a 'nice tea'...others are better.

column9: A very palatable and easy to drink puerh
column10: Puerh tea is one of my personal favorites but understandably a lot of casual tea drinkers are often turned off by the earthy-muddy taste that a true puerh produces.  Puerh's unique flavor comes from the process that used to create tea which involves a lengthy fermentation period.  It is this fermentation process that gives puerh additional benefits and is known in China as a 'dieter's' tea because of its diuretic properties.Numi Organic's Magnolia Puerh is a high quality tea utilizing only organic elements (the grean tea leaves, the puerh leaves as well as the magnolia) in this blend.  By combining green tea and magnolia Numi has created an easily drinkable puerh blend that first time and more casual drinkers can immediately latch onto.  My only caveat is that while being a delicious tea blend, the base flavor of puerh is significantly diminished (but its still there!  if you know what you're looking for) so puerh purists may not find the appeal here.  Still, this is a very tasty blend that makes puerh more accessible to just about anyone that enjoys a good cuppa.

I am not much of an avid tea guy; I tend to drink tea more because of the health benefits than the taste.  But Numi Organic Tea tastes better than most teas I have tried before thanks to a full taste that is never bitter and is almost worst drinking for the taste alone let alone all the health benefits that come along with drinking it.

This is a very gentle green tea. I've had some green tea that have a "chalky" taste, but this one does not. It has a pleasant scent, but it is very subtle. Make a nice, strong brew, but the magnolia et.al could be stronger.

column9: Great Flavor But Hard To Get Right
column10: Now that I have gotten used to the short brewing time of this tea I am greatly enjoying the flavor! This tea is fruity and sweet on its own making this tea a great blend for serving with dessert or on its own after dinner.

I'm usually a big Jasmine Green Tea drinker 2-4 cups a day so I thought I'd try this Magnolia Puerh.  The whole leaf tea has a very nice depth to it which is complemented by the light floral aromatics of the magnolia blossoms.  All in all it's very enjoyable and I expect I will be adding this to my afternoon tea routine.  Can't give up the Jasmine though, I love it.

As the weather begins to cool, more of us will turn to a cup of warm team during the day.  I have grown to always trust Numi, for its quality and consistency across product lines.  The tea is packaged beautifully.  Per cup price is approximately fifty cents, and I think it's worth it for a special treat.  The magnolia scent is lovely.  Even the quality of the tea bags is worth comment, but it's inside them that delivers the full flavor of the tea.  These are full leaf tea bags, which defines a quality cup of tea.I'd recommend this tea, but also others form the Numi line.

I'm not a big coffee drinker but especially at this time of the year, I still want something to warm me up on the days that you can't chase away the chill.  This is a great drink for any time of the day and has a wonderful taste.  It doesn't have that funky aftertaste that many teas have.  Highly recommend.

column9: Still good when you let it sit forever
column10: I often make tea and then forget I made tea, only to find it hour later, cold and bitter.  When I left out this Puerh tea, I felt bad.  This isn't some Lipton crap, I didn't want to waste it.  I took a sip, and it was cold but still good, not bitter, just more flavorful.  Amazing!  I microwaved it up and enjoyed the drink.

column4: M. Jobbagy "Follow Your Bliss - Joseph Cambell"
column10: I liked this tea. It's 100% organic, which is always nice. Even the packaging is ecologically designed with 100 % recycled materials, with at least 85% post consumer waste materials.The tea itself tastes quite good, the hint of magnolia is a subtle flavor that makes it almost fruity tasting. For a green tea, it does brew quite dark, looked like black tea to me. I wouldn't have known it was green tea unless I saw it on the box.I drank it straight, no sugar, milk or anything. Others may want to add a spot of honey, or perhaps sugar. I would suggest using organic, to keep it as healthy for you as possible.I am going to try to make some ice tea with it, I'm sure it will be just as delightful.

As I poured boiling water over the tea bag a subtle scent of magnolia teased my nostrils. "Teased" is the operative word: the aroma stimulates the senses, but mostly vanishes when one actually begins to drink the tea; I can't say that I actually tasted it.  This tea is remarkably free of bitterness for a green tea, good for those who want both a pleasant and healthful experience, although I think the health benefits of green tea are overrated. Black tea generally has as high levels of antioxidants as green, cup for cup, but I suspect that the reason green tea is favored by some is that it is lower in caffeine; thus if caffeine gets in your way, you can drink more green tea than black and thus get more antioxidants into your system.Regarding the packaging, each teabag (I like the convenience versus loose tea) is enclosed in its own biodegradable packet and has a tiny slit to help the consumer open it easily. I think the box, which is rather close in size to roughly similar items on the grocery shelves (Celestial Seasonings, Bigelow teas, etc.), is a little large to contain only 16 tea bags.

column9: Doesn't taste like a green tea
column10: I like this tea; but by no means does it drink like a typical green tea (say a jasmine). It has a dark tint and really tastes a lot closer to a black tea than a green.I love the smell and taste of Jasmine and had high hopes for the Magnolia Puerh however it had an "earthy" quality that was somewhat hard to get comfortable with. Not necessarily bad, but bordering on the fragrance of something like the stale smell of wet tree leaves in a pile. Nevertheless the quality of the tea leaves was very high and the packaging and wrapping were all top notch.Incidentally this is made with Pu'er leaves which were part of a huge speculative bubble in [...]

Numi teas have an enviable reputation in the American tea world:  they're known for being full-bodied and smooth, with good quality, clean leaves.  Numi's new organic Magnolia Puerh lives up to its promise.This blend of green and black tea has a light floral scent and a slightly sweet, fruity taste.  It has earthy pureh notes and an interesting burgundy color.For a lighter, less acrid taste, you may want to try making it with water that almost comes to a boil.This is a tea for the more adventurous tea drinker; the mix of darker earthy notes and sweet magnolia may not be for everyone, but it will certainly find its niche.

This is a lovely tea that is both full bodied and light at the same time. The tea is not bitter, and thus avoids a common problem I've encountered with Numi teas in the past. To test it, I underbrewed (less than 2 minutes) and overbrewed (7 minutes) the tea as well as steeping it for the recommended time of 3-5 minutes. Underbrewing, as expected, results in a weak tea barely recognizable as more than flavored hot water. Surprisingly, overbrewing, while resulting in a faint bitterness from the tannins in the tea, is not nearly as bitter as other teas when overbrewed. Optimal steeping provides a subtly floral, light, delicious tea that is highly enjoyable in the late afternoon -- perfect for a pick-me-up but not a jolt! Highly recommended.

So often a flower influenced tea will have too much of the flowery flavor and scent in it but this one does not.  It's very good tea and even better if you bypass the bag by cutting it open and dumping the tea into your mug, steep and strain.  That paper tea bag no matter what it's made of keeps the full flavor of a good tea from being difused.

Let me start by saying I am a tea drinker rather than a coffe drinker so a good cup of tea every morning is very important to my well being...as well as those around me.  This morning, rather than my Harney and Sons loose leaf green, I used the Numi Organic Magnolia Puerh.  I realize that loose leaf is stronger and slightly tastier than bagged tea, but I am a Numi fan and was looking forward to their usually outstanding flavor.  This tea, however is pretty bland.  I had to add a speck of natural sugar to get a flavor from it.  Now, I haven't ever had Magnolia Puerh before, and this may be the type of flavor that comes from this type of tea, but I can't say I enjoyed a great cup of tea this morning.  The first thing I noticed was there wasn't any aroma.  No, ahhh moment when smelling the tea.  Then, upon first taste I didn't notice a flavor.  I decided to add a bit of sugar, but even then, not much.  A very faint smell of the Magnolia, but the flavor still pretty uneventful.  If you like a very soft tea, then this is for you, but if you like robust tea then skip this one.

This is a delicious tea. Please try it, at least once.  I did, and will be drinking htis tea during the winter months when I prefer hot liquids.A single box contains 16 biodegradable tea bags containing a full-leaf tea "blend" of fermented broad-leaf wild tea leaves called: PUERH.  It is a rich flavorful taste with a wonderful aroma of flowery vanillas and earthly notes to hints of fruit.Oh,and the color of the tea is red.Enjoy!

I really liked the flavor of this tea.It has a nice hint of floral that i can taste but not overpowering at all.It was even ok cold as I got busy and could not finish it right away.There are other reviews who give better comparison to other kinds they have had.This was my first time trying this brand or kind. I usually drink store bought kinds like Lipton and Bigelow.This is certainly a step up from them. On my Lipton i have to use two bags per cup for how i like it with this i could get it plenty strong for my taste from just the 2min steep time with one bag.Yes i even tried it (gasp) with sugar and milk as that is what i grew up on and it really held the flavor well.Sorry i am not more technical with my opinion but this is the best i can do to simply state i liked it.

After brewing a tea bag's worth of Numi Organic Tea Magnolia Puerh flavor, I am rather surprised that it is green tea (it says on the box "green tea blend" so maybe it's blended with black tea?).
