I usually drink a jasmine green tea and it's much more delicate than this. I'd compare the Numi to a black tea in its robustness. Also, I am not really sure what a magnolia blossom tastes like, but I didn't detect anything floral about this tea either in aroma or taste. There's a kind musky note to the flavor, but that's it. It's not a bad tea, but I don't think I'd choose it again.

This tea, when you brew it and drink it without any sweetener, tastes just like the kind you get at sit-down Asian restaurants, and I mean that as a compliment.  Usually, I feel slighted if there's no honey to put in tea, but tea that tastes like this needs no embellishment.  As for a flowery description of just how it tastes, and the tea's aroma, please let me leave that for someone who knows how to describe beverages in those terms.  Just know that the Magnolia Puerh is delicious on its own, and also with just a little honey.The instructions on the package advise you to brew the tea for 2-4 minutes, no more, because if you brew longer, the tea can become bitter.  I took it one step past, boiling the water and letting it cool for a few minutes before I poured it over the tea, and then brewed the tea for about 3 minutes.  Perfect!The packaging of this tea makes it feel really special, and if you're so inclined, you could make yourself a little tea ritual by brewing it in an individual teapot and unplugging from the world for a little while.  Or you can elevate Chinese take-out to something more special by making some of this tea to go with it.  However, the teabags are also packaged for portability, in individual foil packets, so you can take teabags along to enjoy anywhere.

I drink many different kinds of tea, including plain and flavored blacks, greens, and a wide variety of herbals. Green tea has never been my favorite, but I enjoyed it thoroughly in Numi's superb Magnolia Puerhl Green Tea Blend. This black and green mixed tea is medium-bodied, flavorful, and absolutely bitterless. The deep color of the brewed tea suggests a high proportion of black tea in the mixture, but I tasted the green tea as much as the black. With just a hint of magnolia - very similar in effect to jasmine - the overall flavor was extremely enjoyable. Perfect for afternoon teatime!

Drinking Numi tea is always a wonderful experience.  I find that taking the time to savor the fragrance of the Magnolia Puerh is  "centering."  This is a mild tea, that leaves a nice aftertaste.  I've been trying to chose green teas over black, but haven't found any green teas that I like as well as this one.  To be honest, while I definitely enjoyed this variety, my favorite remains the Numi Ginger Oolong.Even reading the box and recognizing the care that is taken with this product (and all the certifications that it has)  confirms it's not my imagination that drinking Numi is not the equivalent of having other teas...even the organic ones.  After having this green tea blend, it's going to be hard to use those other brands in my cupboard.

column9: Lacks flavor and aroma, but is certainly smooth
column10: This tea disappointed me. I don't believe it has much flavor or aroma, and therefore it isn't pleasant to drink. Fortunately, as a result, it's a relatively smooth beverage and goes down easily.The instructions on the tea-bag wrapper (each tea bag is individually wrapped) stress not to steep this tea for more than 2-4 minutes. So just to be safe, I steeped the tea for 3 minutes in very hot water. The water developed a rich, dark brown color -- certainly unlike most green teas I've had in the past. This tea has a slight aroma, but I wouldn't call it floral: this tea is supposed to be scented with Magnolia flowers. In terms of flavor, despite the dark brown color, it is very weak and virtually flavorless. My first sampling was without sweeteners, but now that I know what the tea tastes like naturally, I'll be sure to use a sweetener to make it more interesting.The tea isn't bitter -- it's actually quite smooth. I just wish it had its own distinct flavor and aroma. As somebody who enjoys a cup of Earl Grey, this is definitely on the "weak" side.Fortunately, you can feel good about buying this product, because it's organic, and the packaging is made from recycled and biodegradable materials. Throw the teabag into your yard when you're done, and you complete the cycle intended by the manufacturer. I like the individual wrappings, allowing me to slip a few into a bag or put them into my desk drawer without worrying about them going stale. The packaging in general is awesome.If you like a smooth tea with very little flavor, this is probably a good choice. I don't think it tastes bad, I just don't think it's necessarily memorable. In other words, I won't find myself saying "I could really go for a cup of THAT tea".

This is a very healthy tea while still having a lot of flavor. It didn't taste like most green teas I've had but more like a good black tea while still having the health benefits of green tea. Other reviewers detected a "sweet floral" taste. My tastebuds must not be that refined because I didn't detect that. To me it was a nice earthy strong tea. Just make sure you don't over steep it like the directions indicate.

I've tried both the Numi "Chocolate Puerh" and "Magnolia Puerh" teas.  Both are excellent quality.  The flavors are distinct, not overpowering, and enjoyable.These teas are enjoyable with just a touch of agave to sweeten the cup.  The flavor is pleasant without any need to be enhanced or covered up by anything else.  A touch of lemon juice also works well.  And a dash of vitamin C can be used in harmony with this tea.I do agree with the instructions to not let it steep too long, in fact a good full flavor is obtained at the low end of their recommended steeping times.I like what they have written on the box about being high quality and healthy.  It is nice to not find "artificial flavors" added.  This company appears to really care about producing a good product and protecting the environment.

When I first put the tea bag into the hot water, I was rewarded with a burst of floral scent.  Unfortunately, it faded away rather rapidly, which was a disappointment.  I love fragrant teas.This is a very nice tea.  The flavor is fruity, a bit on the mango side.  It has a nice delicate complexity that develops as it cools down in the cup.  The directions say to steep for 2 - 4 minutes, and cautions against over-steeping and resultant bitterness.  I steeped it for two minutes initially to avoid any threat of bitterness.  The directions also say to pour boiling water over the tea bag, which I thought was strange.  I was taught to never use boiling hot water with green tea, so I am a bit puzzled about that.I steeped the tea bag in 8 oz. of water.  If it is steeped only two minutes, there might be enough flavor left for another cup of tea - whether it is suitable for re-steeping will probably be a matter of personal preference.  If the yield is only one cup, however, that puts this tea on the pricey side.This tea is described as a "Magnolia scented green tea and black Puerh blend."  Quite frankly, I can't detect much black puerh taste to it.  Good quality black puerh on its own is robust with complex earthy flavors.  Despite not quite aligning with my expectations for a puerh tea, I like it.  It has a fruity complexity of flavor that is not at all unpleasing.

column9: Can One REALLY "Fall in Love" with this Product ?
column10: According to my own personal experience, that would be an absolute, resounding "YES!" This tea now ranks for me at the very TOP of my favourite tea choices (of which there are at least 20).  Bravissimo!

I brewed several different bags with different temperatures of water for different lengths of time. Every time the steeped tea smelled like fish. I looked up what causes Puerh to smell like fish, and a couple different websites said it is caused by old tea that is stored poorly. I also tried to return it, but this product is not eligible for returns. Please don't waste your money on this product. It went right in the trash; what a waste of $9.

I am more of a black tea drinker but Numi's Magnolia Green Puerh Tea sounded delicious. I was not disappointed. There is no need for sweeteners since the tea is very palatable on its own. There is little to no after taste unlike many green teas I've tried. The fragrance of the magnolias is confined to scent. You can't taste herbs in it. It is also a great tea to drink with a meal as it is a palate cleanser. I found that out quite by accident when I tried it alongside a rather pungent cheese. Excellent tea and I will be purchasing this again. It is well worth the money.Be sure to follow the steeping instructions. Only leave the bag in for 2-4 minutes and don't squeeze the bag. That will release the bitterness of the tea and detract from the natural qualities. It is perfect right at about 3 minutes when the tea is a medium golden brown.

I need to say first that I'm a big fan of Numi brand tea.  Yes, it's more expensive than other teas, but I find the price is more than deserving for the quality.This particular variety has a wonderful flavor.  It contains the earthy, rich flavor of the puerh, with the floral (almost sweet) flower of the magnolia.  The red magnolia and brown puerh gives the tea a deep burgundy color, which is really quite nice.  Puerh by itself can be a bit strong, but combined with the herbal magnolia makes the flavor just right.  I don't usually put milk in my tea, but it went really nicely with numi puerh tea.  I also appreciate that it's organic and contains no pesticides.This tea may seem a little expensive, but all in all I think it's a very reasonable price.  You're getting 32 tea bags for $14, or 43 cents each.  That's not all that bad.  Whenever I make tea, I make a whole pot and use two tea bags, which ends up being about 4 cups.  All in all, I highly recommend this tea and will be enjoying each cup I brew.

column9: One of us loves it, the other doesn't
column10: I gave this a three because my husband thinks it is a 5 (he just loves the "earthy" taste) and I think it is a zero (I think it tastes like dirt, or maybe mushrooms). These average out to a 2.5 so, giving it the benefit of the doubt, I upped it to a 3.  It clearly is a matter of individual taste!
I did not care for the taste, but then my favorite tea is english breakfast.

This tea has a pleasant aroma, before you take the first sip.  It has a very pleasing taste, and since it's organic it should be better for you than regular tea.  Try some today, you won't be disappointed.

This Magnolia Puerh and green tea blend is surprisingly smooth and easy to brew. I've brewed it as a green tea and as a black and it is delicious both ways. Brewing it as a black tea brings out deeper and richer (yet still smooth) tones. Brewing it as a green highlights the florals. I appreciate that the flavor oils (magnolia) are not too strong as other flavored teas I have tried. No strange oil slick at the top of your cup, and not oily residue in the teapot. The floral is there, but it doesn't overpower. This is a well made tea.I use a Zarafina machine to brew all my tea and have found that one Magnolia Puerh tea bag is good for 3-4 cups of tea. This is a delightful tea blend and I will buy again.Is this review helpful? Please let me know. Vote. :-)

column9: Beautiful Magnolia, but not a fan of Pu-Erh
column10: I love all kinds of tea, and Pu-Erh is about the only kind I've not yet tried, so I was excited to try this version from Numi.  I enjoy many of Numi's teas- the Genmai Cha and Rose White are two of my favorites.  When I first opened this teabag, I was struck by the beautiful magnolia smell.  I've never had a magnolia tea before, and it's a beautiful scent.  There were slight hints of the earthier pu-erh underneath, but in the dry bag, the most overwhelming note is magnolia.  After brewing up a cup for the recommended 2-4 minutes I sat down to drink.  At first, it was difficult to discern exactly what I was tasting.  I could no longer smell the magnolia notes that I could discern in the dry bag.  When I tasted the tea I finally got a sense of the pu-erh flavor- deep and earthy.  I know that pu-erh is a love or hate thing, and this is basically when I discovered that I do not love pu-erh.  I find that it tastes a bit rotten.  The magnolia masked it a bit, but really, if you're not a fan of pu-erh, don't bother, because it's still pu-erh.  I now know that I am not a pu-erh drinker.  If Numi ever makes a magnolia green tea, however, I will certainly buy a case.  The positive I took away from this was that I really like magnolia scenting.

column9: Two thumbs up from the tea snob
column10: I admit it. I'm a total tea snob. I don't use tea bags for the most part because I frequently find that tea in tea bags are stale tasting. This is definitely not the case with the Numi Organic Tea Magnolia Puerh. It was wonderful! I'm normally a fan of green teas. This is a mix of green and black teas. I was surprised that the black tea did not overpower the flavor. It was an excellent blend. The directs say to use boiling water. I found that using boiling water brought out some of the black tea bitterness so I used water just below boiling. The aroma was beautiful. My neighbor stopped by and asked for a cup after smelling my cup. You can't go wrong with this tea purchase.

After reading the fascinating history of this tea,I made it a must to check this Tea out firsthand.The current weather in L.A. is as hot as heck and I normally wouldn't have a HOT cup of tea but I wanted to try this very much and I figured getting up at 6am the heat would be tolerable and I was correct.The freshly brewed cup was a delight,but pay attention to the instructions on the box!  This stuff gets as dark as night in no time fast but the flavor is a joy and one you shouldn't miss!While I was savoring this cup of delightful tea,I was also brewing several bags of this beautiful tea for my ice tea later in the day and as I sip that Ice Tea now while typing out this note,I gotta tell you this is a joy that shouldn't be missed.

i love love love this drink mix! i use to live by a coffee shack that use this for their chi tea, but i moved away and none of the coffee shops in my area have a a drink that comes close in flavor (sooooo bland).a to top it off this mix is super easy to make and can be use for more than just hot/cold drinks.

column9: Great product, but buy it at the store!
column10: These are delicious and have been a hit at the office, so I looked for a good price to buy several. Amazon had a great price, but these were not shipped with any type of refrigerant! All of the bags contained hot liquid when they arrived. I don't want to penalize the product for poor shipping, because they do deserve all five stars. Pay a little more and buy them at the store!

these drops were delicious. i love hersheys candy. but remember the outside temperature before even thinking about ordering chocolate. my order arrived safely and well packaged. we ate every last drop of the candy. and we were happy with the candy. good quality...fresh...very happy with it.

I bought these drops in the store and they are excellent. My mistake was ordering more through Amaxon.com. I ordered through Amazon because the price was so much lower than the store. The first order arrived totally melted, pure liquid. When I called to complain, they promised to notify the warehouse that they must be shipped in a cold pack and sent out a replacement. Obviously the warehouse didn't get the message or just didn't care, because the replacement arrived melted also. After being promised that the third time would be different, they sent a second replacement...but NO, this was also melted. After this I insisted on a refund, which I promptly received. Would love to hear from anyone else who ordered if they are still shipping unrefrigerated. I would start ordering through Amazon again if they fixed this problem.

column9: Wonderful candies for self or parties/ order in cold weather
column10: I found these candies on sale at the local Pharmacy in mid 2011, which was the first time I had ever seen them. They were sale priced then and a few bags of these for the bridge table was quite reasonable. After the introductory period, the prices wet up to  four to six dollars a bag, depending upon the store I was in.I looked for them on Amazon from time to time, but did not spot them until Christmas. I ordered a four pack and was delighted when they arrived just in time for the holiday hustle and bustle. They made a great thank you for the UPS man, mailman etc along with a little cash. Chocolate always enhances the deal! They are great stocking stuffers and wonderful for last minute thank you presents. I had to order more to fulfill my needs. I HAVE to have a stash of my own for times when nothing but chocolate will do!I read other reviewers and see that they must have found these before I did and apparently ordered when it was still hot. Their chocolate melted. I do not know how Amazon generally handles perishables in the summer. The first time I ordered these, they were not on Prime. Now they are. I do not know if that will effect shipping. But, for the present, I would say, order your stash while it is cold.If it is summer, call Amazon to see if they will handle this as a perishable.As a chocolate, it it the usual great tasting Hershy's with a coating on it. The outside coating is not sugar like M and M's, and it will melt. But it makes for easy handling in eating. It is not soft like the usual candy bar. It will melt in your hand, but not readily. You are able to hold a hand full through a conversation and they will not melt.  I introduced them to my Bridge buddies and now see them served at Bunco, Yahtzee and other get togethers. They are popular and I love them. From me, they get 5 stars!

Growing up I have always been a huge fan of chocolates. Hershey chocolate has always been one of my favorite. When this product was first introduced I thought it was a pretty neat concept that I can have a pouch of hershey chocolate with me anywhere, well that was the idea until I bought one. Let me warn you guys before hand because these little bastards are addictive. The other night I bought a pack from CVS since they go on sale for about 3 dollars a pouch, which is a great deal. I opened the pouch and started eating little by little while I was watching Breaking Bad on netflix. Next thing you know, halfway through one episode I finished the whole bag. It was really a sad and horrific moment at the same time. Sad because I finished it within 20 minutes but horrific because these bad boys are really high on the calorie count. For about every 15 pieces, it measures up to 200 calories. Considering I ate the whole bag, I probably racked up to 600-700 calories within 20 minutes, but then again that is my fault because I have no self control. The taste is great, and really easy to chew on. They are very smooth and melts in your mouth. Overall, this is an amazing snack but very unhealthy for someone like me who has no self control over chocolate.Thanks for reading my review! Hopefully I helped and if you have any questions or comments please let me know.

column9: Love the candy, but it ships melted
column10: This arrived with all packages containing drops that had melted into one large clump.  I've had the Hershey's drops before and like them very much.  However, unless packaging/shipping is changed, I don't recommend that anyone buy this thru Amazon.

As with the previous reviewer, mine came with just a glob of chocolate inside.  We should know better than to order chocolate in the summer time but at the same time someone should know better than to ship chocolate in the summer time.

Place at soil level for bugs, has three stips in the package, plus I am using other bug control. Wish I had started these sooner, my plants would not be over run. I am also watering soil with neem oil, good results. one teaspoon per gallon, every three or four days.

These things catch of lot of whiteflies, but they also catch other insects, such as juvenile praying mantises. And, although it makes me feel good to see hundreds of dead whiteflies stuck on the trap, there are still lots left eating the vegetables. So you will still have to use chemical controls, like insecticidal soap, to reduce the population of bad insects.

If you have fungus gnats, these will control the problem.  Fungus gnats are irresistably drawn to yellow, and these sticky traps are bright yellow.  Only issue I have with them is that there must be a better way of using them than attaching them to the plant with a twist tie.

column9: Very good; similar to what we had in Dominican
column10: We had "Chinola" while in the Dominican Republic and loved it. Found this on Amazon and it is very very similar, though not quite as sweet. Had some issues getting it correctly from The Latin Products, since they sent Jam instead of Juice for some reason, then I had to prove to them by taking pics that they had sent the wrong thing. But they did correct it and let me keep the Jam as well (which is excellent too). Very good product; not cheap, but when you are desperate for Chinola, its worth it. And yes, I do now know the difference between sh*t and chinola! (if you have heard that old saying before).

column9: Improve your Circulation with a Top Vascular Fitness Drink!
column10: This virtually unprocessed cacao powder from Equador is a top quality low calorie food with an extremely high antioxidant concentration (especially the polyphenol epicatchin). You can make a delicious hot drink of it with Soymilk and only 4 grams of powder. It will result in an immediate increased blood flow through your body from brain to feet and lowering of your blood pressure for a couple of hours.For me as a diabetic with a clear vascular dysfunction it is especially beneficial by eliminating this defect through an acute increase of the powerful natural blood vessel dilator Nitric Oxide (NO). Most cacao powders are far more processed ( e.g. at high temperatures) destroying  the vast majority of the healthy cacao polyphenols.Many recent research articles in prestigious medical journals have confirmed these important benefits for cardiovascular health. At present there are very few unprocessed cacao powders on the market.In short if you wish to improve your vascular fitness, try out this one!As a public health physician I can assure you, you will not be dissappointed.

I wish I could send this back, but I take the blame and call it a life lesson...try a smaller amount first! Seems so obvious now.  If i were reading this, I'd think I was dumb too, who orders 2.5lbs of a product (normally used in small quantities) without tasting it first? I know, I know.  I'm an idiot.Anyway.I know this is raw, and I'm not calling the Sunfood folks liars, I'm sure it is, and I've bought and liked a number of their other branded products (from their website), but: this has a very bitter taste to it that sort of leaves the overall impression of burntness/ashiness as the flavor.  Don't get me wrong, it's pretty intensely cacao-y, but it's also flat and harsh at the same time.And no, I'm not confusing raw cacao powder with cocoa or sweetened cacao or any other thing.  I've tried 5 other brands of raw cacao powder and liked them all, to varying degrees (8-10 on a love scale).  We were going through about 8-12oz a week in our green smoothies so I thought I'd go with this to try and save some money, and since I'd liked every other brand we'd tried, I didn't think anything of buying a huge quantity of a brand I hadn't tried. Now I know better!! I'd put this closer to a 3-4 on a scale of 1-10.  It's OK to use in very small quantities to impart a vaguely chocolatey flavor (like a teaspoon in pancake batter), but other than that, the bitter ashiness really rears its head.I'm so irritated with myself for buying this without trying it, that at this point we're basically just not having smoothies (and my morning banana-cacao smoothie was something to look forward to!)My guess is that in a month or so, we'll finally admit to ourselves that we threw money away, suck it up and just chuck it all.It's also worth noting that the Sunfood brand raw cacao powder is fattier and (therefore) more caloric than other brands.  I don't know if that has something to do with the flavor profile (doubtful though because raw cacao butter, which is the extracted fat, is neither bitter nor ashy).SO disappointed.

This tea really tastes good.  I love tea, and so I know bad tea when I drink it.  And believe me, this tea is good.The can says it is from Kenya.  It also states that it is fair world trade, or something like that, so that the farmers there get fair pay, better health care, and education.  That was good news!And another reason this tea is good, is because, even though it doesn't say "vegan", after reading the ingredients, it is vegan-friendly.So there's lots of good reasons for me to continue buying and drinking this product:1 - I love tea, and I love lemon, and this tea really tastes perfect.2 - It is fair world trade.3 - It is vegan-friendly.4 - The price is fair.Thanks to the tea growers in Kenya, and the manufacturers of this product.  I love this tea.

I just recently started ordering Steaz teas through Amazon. So far I have ordered 8 cases. I love the convenience of having great tasting iced tea in a can. At home I still make my own iced tea but the taste of Steaz is very fresh. The sweetened teas have 20 grams of sugar per can so I alternate between sweetened and unsweetened. Sometimes the case arrives torn but the cans are never dented so I don't mind.

I love this tea from the very first time my supervisor introduced this tea to me.  My store sells it but ofter is out of stock.  So when I came across Steaz being sold on Amazon with an option to subscribe, I was like a pig in slop....LOLIt's not that sweet but lightly sweetened which is a taste that you must acquire.  Overall this tea is healthy, refreshing and tastes great.

I have bought variations of Steaz tea from our local organic produce stand for years, but hadn't tried the lemon.I was delighted to find it on Amazon, with such nice reviews! It's free trade, so that feels good to be helping the bottom of the production chain in quality of life. It has such a nice lightly sweetened fresh lemon flavor that it's addicting. And , as a WW member: it's zero "points plus"! Living in the desert, I find, as I get older,that I need to keep hydrated. This can of yummy tea is so handy to keep in the refrig at work.

I found this tea at Whole Foods Market and fell in love and decided to come on here and see if I could get it cheaper (it is cheaper here only with subscribe and save). It is so refreshing and each can only has 80 calories - lightly sweetened with a dash of lemon - yummy!!

Wonderful ancho flavor. So much better than the typical supermarket variety ancho powder, if you can even find it in its all-by-itself state. This is the best ancho I've used for my grilling rubs. Works equally well with the rub blends I've whipped up for meats and those for veggies. So far all the chile products I've gotten from Angelina's have been fresh and produce the depth of flavor I hoped for.

I don't think any Mexican cuisine kitchen should be without Ancho Powder.I like to make a mild red chili sauce with it for enchiladas.Recently I started purchasing Ancho from here and have come back [for other products] just because theprices are good and the quality of products [that I've tried so far] have been great.Will be back with other chilie reviews.

In my opinion chili should have a lot of dark, rich chili pepper flavor, and this is very good. It is a little hotter than most ancho peppers, so I suggest tasting your chili before adding extra hot peppers. We use this in a restaurant, and it is also priced right.

The ancho chile powder was as good or better than I've ordered in the past.  It was also a lot less expensive and easier to use in the large plastic container.  I've already used it in a lot of my mexican / Bobby Flay cooking, and think its great!

after years of using starbucks espresso roast in my gaggia titanium, i thought i'd try something different.  there is really NO comparison...the lavazza beans produce coffee that is less bitter and sweeter than any of the starbucks coffees...there is a lovely thick crema on top of the glass (thicker and tastier than any i've ever tried)  i can even happily enjoy full cups of americano coffee from my gaggia (doesn't work really well with other beans, again, they tend to be bitter and acidy)highly recommended!

Don't have a clue what the negative reviews are about...it's a food product and there will always be natural variations in consistency. I haven't experienced any with this product. Even though I received a 1kg bag with a broken seal, it was still excellent (it's a sin to waste it, LOL!). [...]. As far as the "light" color goes, oily black beans clog super-auto machine's grinders so they're usually not recommended. FWIW, the Illy (see below) is black as night and it's pre-ground so I don't have to worry about clogging as I can manually bypass dose the machine. You can do the same with any espresso you buy pre-ground or grind in an external grinder.Personally, I love the stuff! I was introduced to it by friends who bought a Saeco Incanto Sirius super-auto (HIGHLY Recommended) and use Super Crema and Illy Decaf pre-ground (fantastic, but you need a mortgage to buy the stuff) and I loved them so much I bought my own Sirius and tons of Lavazza (as well as the Illy decaf). I've had the Saeco from Memorial Day to Labor Day this summer and have brewed circa 800(!) shots, going through SIX (6) kilos (13.5#) of Super Crema in the process and have yet to brew a bad shot. It does fine in cappucino and cafe crema as well. I bring 12 shots into work on fridays (bagel day) and everyone loves the stuff...I haven't met one person who didn't enjoy my Super Crema espresso and that's served from a thermos!Buy a bag and see for yourself....for LESS THAN the price of Starbucks garbage, you can get the real deal here. I just bought six more bags of the stuff...I'm keeping most of it and giving one or two away as gifts to family/friends. Remember the old caveat: there truly is no accounting for taste, LOL!Enjoy!UPDATE (4/8/09): After approx. 4,000+ shots, I haven't changed my opinion. If anything, I love this stuff even more now! I am completely addicted to Super Crema to the point that I can't stomach anything else. I still haven't had a bad shot with the stuff. If you find better, let me know, please! You'll have to go some to beat Super Crema in my book, especially at the under $[...]/lb. price point!

Fantastic espresso beans!  I usually drink Illy, but thought I would give this a 'shot'... and I was not disappointed! This has a slightly smokier flavor than the Illy roasts, produces a NICE crema, and is ultra smooth.In short, give this a try.  Highly recommended for my fellow coffee heads out there...

Lavazza produces the best espresso beans according to me. Someone was complaining against the quality - may be the packs that you bought were too old and yes- generally espresso does upset sensitive stomach, that does not indicate bad quality of coffee beans. I am from Europe and can say that Starbucks coffee is not to my taste, I have to agree with Mr.Hernandes. The bitter taste that they achieve has blends and notes of something quite different than the normal espresso bitterness.

These are ordinary coffee beans, not the super oily dark roast you want in expresso beans.  In fact they are a little on the green side.  They probably make decent coffee.Update 9/3. I have revised my review from 3 stars to 5. This is wonderful stuff, full-bodied and creamy.  It isn't what I expected; it's better.  I'm reordering some today.

If you have a super automatic (like my Saeco Incanto Sirius), and like an excellent Italian espresso or coffee crema, this is it!  The beans are traditional European espresso roast. American espresso beans look like they have been dipped in black oil.  The color of European espresso is more brown in nature, without the oily residue on the beans--thus no "gunk" to plug up your super automatic.The flavor is amazing.  It is a balanced coffee, with notes of floral and spice.I was hesitant to spend $25 on a kilo of coffee at first; this is now my regular!

This is the best espresso I've ever tasted. I like it strong and smooth, not bitter. This is rich, with a thick crema (which I think is more due to freshness than anything else. A side benefit--the beans are completely non-oily, which is good news for my fully automatic espresso machine.
This is a very good deal on a high quality Espresso roast.  Grind it very, Very, VERY fine and you won't be disappointed!
The best coffee I have tried yet.  Better than Starbucks, Tullys and even Seattles Best which I like.

column9: If you love illy you will love this!
column10: rich. mellow.  low acid.  not nearly as caffeinated as many other products (aka starbucks!)  Whether you drink espresso or are like me and love my morning latte, it fits the morning ritual of grinding the beans, smelling the aroma and sipping the luxury.  This is NOT Starbucks.  If you like wine comparing this product to wines would be like comparing a fortified red to select vintage, well aged red wine.

I get rave reviews from everybody who has a cup of my Lavazza.  I have a built in Miele machine that loves these beans and produces a fantastic, deeply flavored, highly aromatic coffee with a rich crema topping.

column9: Good Coffee! But 2.2lbs is a lot...
column10: Great coffee!I should not have purchased the 2.2lbs bag.It's an awful lot of coffee for two people.I've probably wasted at least 1 pound, since it has now expired and lost it's zip.But it is delicious! And gives you quite a lot of energy :-)
The coffee beans were delivered fast,And it's great too! Tasty, a lot of crema! Great for espresso lovers!Getting my second bag from these guys and will definitely get more!

column9: Strongest Crema of any Coffee ever Tried
column10: Really thick crema. Better than Illy, Starbucks (greasy yuck).It is really the best espresso experience. What I feel is way too expensive for a bag of coffee.But I pump one espresso aday, so I think it's worth it.I keep it in a deep freezer bag once opened, and my daily stash in my old Illy tin (that I have a ton of).

column9: My morning get the engines started juice
column10: Have been a fan of Lavazza for several years.  Had been cheating and using the Gran Crema espresso pods with our latte machine.  Thought I should try using the whole beans and grinding myself to reduce the packaging that I was contributing to the landfills.  I miss the convenience of the pods but the taste is just as good and it has the desired effect of waking me up and making me tolerable in the world's view.

I tried a bunch of the small roasters amazon sells and the most gracious I can be is that they are inconsistent.Lavazza Super Crema is fantastic espresso.  It appears to be a blend.  either way, best whole bean espresso I have found.

column9: The best espresso beans we've ever brewed.
column10: Super Crema pretty much says it all.  These won't be our every day beans due to their premium price tag, but you do get what you pay for.
I have tried many many coffees, Starbucks, Tullys, Gevalia, and all my locals in the Seattle and Portland areas. This coffee is far far superior give it a try.

This was one of the worst tasting coffee's I have ever tried. Something must be wrong with the batch, mis packed or everyone else who reviewed this is nuts.I have to assume there was some kind of problem with the beans. It was bland and lacked flavor. The beans looked nothing like any espresso beans I have ever seen. No real crema, yuck.Sending them back, why suffer?

This is about the worst expresso coffee i have tried.Was looking to see a dark Italian roasted coffee but it is not a true dark roast. The color is brown-tan and does not even taste like an expresso. I use a Gaggia Baby machine for many years and have tried many different coffees including other Lavazzas but this is a poor excuse for an Italian type expresso. Starbucks is better, and that is a stretch.AL.

column9: Dankest Teriyaki slabbed strips on the market
column10: These strips are delicious. I just bought my second pack and received in in about 4 or 5 business days(ordered it on saturday and got it on wednesday).takes longer to ship it here than it does for me to eat it. Stuff is almost too good. I'm glad it goods for you though, makes me feel better about eating 5 strips in an hour. It's much easier to chew if you cut it up into smaller strips and put that in a bag or something. The only thing i wish was different about this product is that i would like to see a zipper on the packaging, but from the looks of things, this product seems to have been put through a food-saver. Awesome all around. I will never be ripped off at a gas station for their bs jerky again.

I never knew such a thing was called "western cut".  I had discovered this product when it was sold at the Texas Renaissance Festival near Houston in 2004.  The original supplier has since gone out of business, but Buffalo Bill's is a very close substitute.The hotness won't blow your head off, and the sweet adds a nice contretemps, but this is a very . . . "very noice" . . . jerky.The product I had grown used to was a little drier and a little hotter, but Buffalo Bill provides a fine, fine jerky.  I like the idea of pulling out a giant slab of jerky, and getting 8 or 10 good-size "chaws" from it. My only regret is that a 1.4 LB bag is gone so quickly.You can expect a razor-thin sheet of jerky that is easy to tear, or bite, into portions.  Occasionally, you will encounter the "hidden treasure" of a chunk of fat that melts in your mouth. Crushed red pepper abounds, but it'll fall off by the time this jerky reaches your maw.  What you are left with is a jerky you can tuck into your cheeks like a squirrel and enjoy for an hour, or a jerky you will be compelled to chew and swallow as quickly as possible so that you might get to the next bite.If you like a smooth, slightly-hot, imminently chewable slice of jerky, I encourage you to try this product.

I love hot and spicy foods. The heat and flavor of the Cajun Western Cut Beef Jerky are a perfect match with big taste and a jolt to the tongue. The Big Slab size goes well with friends, cool beverages, and watching the big race - plenty to share.
Jerky is a bit dry, but it is stil very tasty. Good value compared to what you can buy at stores.

column9: I can't believe I ate the whole thing !!!!
column10: I have never found jerky of this quality anywhere before ! I was very surprised at the taste and there was hardly any fat on these great slabs !  This is one of the most hunted items that I've never found until now, I would recommend this product to anybody, once you try it you will be hooked, it it the best of the best.

I'm a big jerky fan and saw the reviews for this Western Cut (which I've never tried before).  This is NOT what I expected.  I have to rip jagged pieces off the paper thin flat sheet of jerky and I can barely taste the spices considering this is supposed to be Cajun.  Essentially I'm finding that this product for me is just "something to chew".  I also ordered Buffalo Bill's Hot Short Shots which I am enjoying quite a bit more (although once again I would not consider them to be hot).  I will consider trying other Buffalo Bill's products based on the Short Shots but I am very disappointed with the Western Cut Jerky.  So much for trying new things...
I think this product is a great deal for the price. It is tender & the flavor is awesome. I'll buy it again & again.

column9: GET SOME BULK PRICES WITH FREE SHIPPING!!!
column10: Very good jerky.. Would be 5 star, if not so expensive. Really the best I've tasted by far, and I've tried about 60+ different jerkys. But I could by one from here in CA. that is cheaper and has more in it. And the taste is not too far from yours.. I'm going to be looking for that jerky company that every bag I buy they give one to the troops in Iraq and Afghanistan. Being stuck in those hell holes, a bag of jerky was a real moral booster. Really basically any thing from home was.. So really a good jerky if you got the money...

Recently I really wanted some good beef jerky and happened to find this on Amazon.  I decided to try it out and am really glad I did.  This seller shipped quickly and even included a bonus sample; I can't wait to order from them again. The jerky is  sliced really thin and packed with flavor.  Another reviewer wrote "You can chew off a piece and savor the flavor for quite a awhile and is a welcomed difference to the norm," and I couldn't describe it better. The rest of my family loved it as well!!  I can't wait to try out some of their other flavors and products.

This jerky is a wide and very thin strip of *something*... I was expecting actual meat pieces... this was more a processed and flattened with a steam roller product.  BBJerky does have some *excellent* products but I did not care for this one.

Literally exactly the same jerky as the cheap strips you buy out of the bins and place in a paper bag at a gas station or truck stop. Was expecting something a of a little more high quality than truck stop jerky. :/

It's paper thin and NOT SPICY AT ALL. It's like chewing cardboard, and it basically comes out to $2 a thin slice. I've gotten quite a bit of jerky off of Amazon, and for the price I paid, I'm not impressed ):
My sister who orders this from Amazon on a monthly basis, converted us. We've combined orders for it with my sister and have at times ordered on the side without her knowing because its so good!

column9: Found it after years of hunting!  YAY! Placed 2nd order today~
column10: You have not had beef jerky until you have found a thin cut red pepper like Buffalo Bill has made. I have been only finding this stuff randomly on road trips and debating long days in the car to get one or two pieces again. Instead! I have found you online you bite worthy spicy sometimes awesomely fatty and delightful jerky! I have fallen for you in high school before class when I had nerds asking me too many questions about homework. I would turn and breathe fire breath at them and today is so wonderful that I am placing another order for more! I can't stand waiting...I just ate the last piece and I hate that I can't sit still that long wanting more. Do you distribute in Los Angeles? How can one find some locally? It's that good guys, please order it yesterday you will pissed off only because there is no more left. Arrives on time, as advertised, hell better than advertised, I am so into the cajun flavor you have worked out Buffalo Bill you So make the grade with me <3  Mhmm my mouth is a little hot and tingly just like I remember it being so good!  You helped me restore awesome childhood memories via senses, I recommend this with all of my Western Galness.  I grew up going on trips up and down the coast where lots of jerky is sold at Farmers Markets from happy cows in Cali.  This takes the cake!!!!

Overall this brand is good but I think it is lacking in "spicyness" as they don't seem spicy at all. I don't , not like them but I just wish they had more "sweet spicy" flavor instead of more sweet. The package I got was a bit old I think as it was a bit dry but not inedible. Don't get me wrong, I love jerky but these could be better and maybe fresher. My only real complaint other than it's dryness is it just isn't spicy enough to be called spicy. I love peppered/spicy jerky and this really doesn't fully cut the mustard.

column9: What you want in beef jerky
column10: getting beef jerky in NYC is hard - your best bet is a drug store and it's always the mundane Jack's.  Finding this jerky was a dream come true - a huge back of jerky, for a reasonable price, that tastes fantastic.

Received bag of Black Pepper Slab jerky Buffalo Bills 18oz Black Pepper Western Cut Big Slab Beef Jerky (15 beef jerky slabs per bag) as a gift last week. Pleased to find a real traditional jerky with generous amount of cracked black pepper. Not your wimpy soft & moist & chewy style, this jerky is on the dry side, thin cut, and needs to be savored in small bites. Only complaint is that there is a lot of jerky in this bag - a ziplock would have been a nice addition. Will be ordering more of this.

OK, so I eat a lot of jerky--some of it slab, some of it not--and this was simply inedible.  Not even only from a human perspective; my dog wouldn't eat it.  Literally, she spit it back out (PETA peeps: yes, I feed my dog human food and no, I don't care if you think it's wrong).Back to the jerky.  It's nearly impossible to rip a piece off, let alone actually chew it.  Also......Cajun?  Seriously?  Not only did it not have a Cajun kick, it had absolutely no flavor at all.As for slab jerky, go for Tillamook Country Smoker brand.  I read a review somewhere about the TCS jerky that mentioned that it's sold in gas stations, and yes it is.  But it's very tender, and when you get one of their flavors (I've tried them all), they actually taste like what they are.Finally, in an effort to show that I'm not an affiliate of some other brand just criticizing the BB slab jerky, Buffalo Bill's honey pepper jerky ranks up there with some of the best I've ever had.  Don't buy this slab stuff, buy that...

column9: Bad but maybe closer to pioneer jerky?
column10: Super thin and also hard and fibrous. It was in large sheets that you couldn't  snack on. Didn't taste the teriyaki. Had a old beef taste. Threw it away. Maybe making it from one muscle is not the way to go? Needed a sharp knife really... Thought it was historically accurate to what the Indians had. Maybe that's what "Western Cut" means?
I received my order promptly. The jerky is really good, I ordered several types of this jerky and they are all great!!!!!

I have bought Buffalo Bills Jerky several times and it is always good.  I bought this for a friend.  I prefer the original or something mild myself.  However the dude that received it loved it, as he is from New Orleans.Choo Choo R Snacks delivered it quickly and sent me a sample teriyaki to go with it so I am munching on that right now and it is also a good western cut.Good product delivered by a company I have always received fantastic service from!!!!A+

This may be the best beef jerky I've ever tasted.  Just the right amount of chewiness and tenderness; not too tough, not too soft.  Great flavor, has a little heat, but nothing unbearable (at least to me).  The carbohydrate content isn't too high, so it works well for other low-carbers like myself.  A nice portable protein source.

Buffalo Bills western cut big slab beef jerky is flat out the best beef jerky on Amazon, hands down. The sweet and spicy listed here is tangy and tasty and it's almost impossible to eat just one. Try all the flavors, you won't be disappointed. I've had every kind of jerky from all kinds of different producers, and Buffalo Bills Western Cut Big Slab is the best by far. I give it as gifts for Xmas and birthdays, its really that good.The only problem you are likely to have with it is storage. Usually I eat the entire bag within a day or two, so storage isn't that much of an issue, but your mileage may differ. I either use a large zip lock bag, or re-use one of the round plastic containers from Buffalo Bills regular cut jerky. If you re-use a round container, you will need a sharp pair of scissors to cut the western cut big slabs to make them fit in the round container.Bottom line on this one is; Buy it, you will only regret that you took so long to find it.

We tasted this at the MD Ren fest and loved it.  We brought home 8 pieces so we could continue to enjoy it!  It is exactly what we love about jerky: a nice chew and extremely flavorful.  I would recommend to anyone who enjoys jerky to give this one a try!

column4: John H. Austin Jr. "John Austin 'bookworm & geek"
column10: This is great tasting, moist jerky, with a great flavor.  I give it high marks.I cannot say enough good things about the service of this company.  Everything arrived ahead of schedule, exactly as I ordered it, in great shape.
Love the product, great quality.  Price could be lowered a few dollars, but I'd still buy from them again.

I received this product within days after ordering it, and for standard shipping that's not too bad. The taste is amazing, and it's perfect for sitting at home, taking on the trail, or just having it around.

column9: Same old quality from the same old jerky, but with a new form
column10: Now I'm a bog fan of wild bill's jerky, but never had the black pepper flavor or eaten jerky slabs before.Well now that I have I can certainly say that both attributes are quite good, and work well together.The only downside would be that wild bill's is just so expensive, but so worth it, and that is a problem when you are a poor college student.

SHEETMEAT, baby... that's what I like to call it... Flat sheets of delicious meat is what Buffalo Bill's Teriyaki Western Cut Big Slab Beef Jerky is all about!I pretty much agree with Blake's take on this product... really thin, yet nice and chewy Sheet meat.  Excellent teriyaki flavor and as mentioned, perfect for cutting into little bite-sized bits...I like a little dish of this right by the computer at work.  When I have a bad moment, I just hit a little bit of jerky and everything is better, on the spot!Buffalo Bill's Teriyaki slab jerky.... Nothing better!!!!!!  Get some!

Its quite good, but what impressed me the MOST was the service. Along with the heaping amount of jerky, also offered was two differently flavored 'sample' packages, both of which were amazingly delicious. I'm more than pleased with the amount of jerky I received, and the samples were really very good! Arrived in a timely manner as described.
There was a lot of beef jerky or one pack. This could last a whole week for a family of 4 on a camping trip.

This was the best beef jerky I've ever had! Bar none! It shipped quicker than I expected and man though was it worth the wait!!! If I could, I would buy a life time supply!! No other beef jerky I've had could ever hope to match up against Buffalo Bill's!
I HAVE BEEN EATING BEEF JERKY FOR OVER 30 YEARS AND THIS RATES WITH THE BEST I'VE EVER HAD. EXCELLENT FLAVOR THAT MAKES YOUR MOUTH WATER FOR THE NEXT PEICE.

This seller has sold nothing but great meat products in a timely manner and I'd buy from them again in a heart beat.  This product really stands out when compared to the usual store bought jerky considering it's the true western style jerky that is sometimes hard to find. It's sliced really thing and dried thoughly, but the flavor is definatly not lacking at all once you take a bite, I actually think the texture of it is the best part. You can chew off a piece and savor the flavor for quite a awhile and is a welcomed difference to the norm. It's also strangely addicting and one piece goes a long way which is a good thing as I don't usually want to stop eating it once I start. I can't wait to share this with my friends and see what they think.

Very good Jerky, truly great quality product indeed! If you enjoy good Jerky, that is made with care, and made of quality beef, then give ChooChoo R Snacks a chance, because this is really delicious & you will want to come back for more!
This beef jerky punch a lot of flavor, lots of meat for your money and best jerky online period.
THis is some of the best beef jerky I have had in a long time.  It has the best flavor of any beef jerky out on the market.

Buffalo Bills 18oz Original Western Cut Big Slab Beef Jerky (15 beef jerky slabs per bag) Buffalo Bills 18oz Original Western Cut Big Slab Beef Jerky (15 beef jerky slabs per bag)]]This beef jerky is the worst I ever had. My dog's treats are more appealing than this jerky was. Do yourself a favor and don't purchase this product.

looking 4 good jerky I tried the big slab jerky & I didnt like it,too thin too tough.I Also tried the countrycut jerky and it was far better,very moist and tender.I am sure looking forward to trying all the countrycut flavors,I will be reordering soon. Although I didnt like the big slab jerky,the shipping was so fast I will be a return customer.

Very good Jerky, truly great quality product indeed! If you enjoy good Jerky, that is made with care, and made of quality beef, then give ChooChoo R Snacks a chance, because this is really delicious & you will want to come back for more!

I ordered this and the spicy from Buffalo Bills bills and this was definitely better than the spicy.  This has a good peppery flavor and it's a lot of jerky.  You will need scissors or a knife to cut pieces that you can eat.  The slabs are like 7 X 10.Like with the spicy jerky I'm not so sure this is the best quality meat.  My package still has plenty of fat, gristle, and tough pieces of things you just cant chew up.  I've tried lots of jerky and with good quality jerky I could eat a whole pound bag and never have the fat, gristle, and pieces I can't chew up like this.Bottom line...This is better than the grocery store/gas station jerky and if I rated on just flavor I would give it 4 stars but the tough pieces that you can't chew takes away from the overall quality experience.  Since I have had plenty of jerky that's not like that I know it can be done.UPDATE...Promptly after placing the review I received a call from Choo Choo R Snacks asking about my review.  Based on my review the premium jerky was recommended and if I would like they would sound out 2lbs.  If I didn't care for those I was offered a full refund on my purchase.  That is great customer service!  I'm happy to say that the premium jerky arrived today and is fantastic.  It's on par with the best trade show jerky mentioned above that I have had.  Thank again for turning a potential bad experience into a great one.

This is the most magical beef jerky I ever ate. It came in many a paper like sheet, and everyone at work loved it.  Right after eating aforementioned jerky, I turned into a cow, and spent the rest of the day having a crazy adventure, during witch I stopped a swarm of evil grass from taking over the world.  It began when I over herd a rouge blade of grass discussing it with a clover, who he had been shagging.  I followed him, and finding their hide out, located under the upside down kiddy pool in my yard, I devoured the lot of them.  After saving the world, I turned back into a human, and had another piece.  It did not happen again, but it must be like Narnia, and when the world needs the cool cow again, I will be ready, watching, and waiting.  Oh, and ordering more of this jerky.Review guidelines:Make it fun! Who says you can't be informative and entertaining?How about a little action? If it makes sense, cut to the product in use as you describe your experiences with it.
This tea is great! You won't regret buying it. It is very refreshing with a strong peppermint flavor - but not too strong if you know what I mean!
Personally, this was not strong enough for me. I found it weak. I think Celestial Seasonings or Bigelow Peppermint is much stronger and better for me.
I purchased this with subscribe and save to maximize my savings, and I'm very pleased with the product. The tea is packaged nicely, and it tastes great.
Love the tea and I couldn't find it locally except in little tiny boxes that were way overpriced. This pkg. and price were great.
I waited too long to open this product.  The tea bags are torn and leaking.  Don't waste your money.

Product was advertised as Porcini Powder.  The product that we received was labelled 'Dried Mushroom Powder.' It looked greyish rather than the richer cinnamon-brown color of porcini powders that I have purchased in the past from another company.  More importantly, tasted/smelled like "watered down" porcini, not 100% porcini.  Looks like a 'bait and switch' to me and we will definitely not order again.

This porcini powder tastes wonderful. It adds a deep richness and depth to tomato sauces and especially any type of Italian recipe. It's concentrated so don't use a ton at once. Has that distinctive mushroom smell when you open the top, but adds sooo much flavor to my cooking. Great in soups, too!
This mushroom powder is great with pasta, on popcorn, on pizza - anything, really. So glad I found it.Use Wine to Make Sense of the World

Very happy with this powder. I sue it when I want to add richness to soups, stocks, stews, whatever. A little bit adds a subtle amount of umami and richness (not necessarily identifiable by most as mushroom flavor), and if you use more the mushroom flavor is more pronounced. It doesn't take much to really enhance whatever you put it in.
What a great product to have for adding that extra mushroomy taste to many recipes.  Great in soups and sauces.  Also great in burgers and meatloafs.

column9: Tender, sweet, moist - but not spicy
column10: One of the best chinese beef jerky brands I've tried.  Great flavor, just wish it was spicy. Kind of pricy for the small amount you get, but I think it was worth it.  Will be sending some to family.
Tasted terrible and I do not know if I would ever get this type of jerky again. Meat tasted as though it was bad and the flavoring tasted like chemicals.

If you love dried apricots like I do this particular product will be a suprise.  In a nut shell, it is like a apricot fruit roll up.  Not sure what the company was thinking.  They are really good but, sticky and messy.

column9: Another great product from Kleins' Naturals
column10: These are apricot fruit leather-type snacks, in round form; the calorie, sugar, and fiber counts are great for healthy food plans, including diabetics.  The flavor is tangy, much like the California apricots.  I'll be sure to keep these on my list of things to reorder in the future.

column9: Great price for a great product
column10: Kernel Seasons products are terrific. They have both sweet and savory flavors, and Caramel is the best of the sweet flavors. Try mixing it with their Apple Cinnamon flavor- its like a candy apple! Glad that that Caramel and White Cheddar (which is wonderful on vegetables as well as popcorn) are available with Amazon Prime shipping, which makes this an unbeatable deal. You can get all the flavors at the Kernel Seasons site 10 for $30 with free shipping, so don't pay the unbelievably high prices for some of the other flavors I saw here on Amazon.
Could not believe that I was able to find this on Amazon.  This is my favorite when I go to the movies.  The price was better than I ever expected.  Way to go Amazon.

Not limited to use on popcorn. I found myself sprinkling it on hot buttered toast,sweetening up hot oatmeal. Seasoning is just sugar and brown sugar with a littlecaramel flavor, so the sky's the limit when finding uses for it. Just makesevery bite taste just a little bit better.Kernel Season's Popcorn Seasoning, Caramel, 3-Ounce Shakers (Pack of 6)
Can't find these anywhere except for the movie theater. Walmart had like 7 flavors except this one.  6 pack is totally worth it.  Great value.

column9: Only takes three words to describe this...
column10: Dee - Lish - Us!!!Great tasting and a more healthy alternative to other caramel coated popped corn treats.

I absolutely love the Kernel Season's caramel seasoning.  I recently ordered many different varieties from the company's website.  I wanted to try several before committing to purchasing 6 of one type from Amazon.  I went through the caramel extremely quickly and ordered a 6 pack from Amazon.The main ingredients are sugar and brown sugar, so it doesn't quite taste like caramel.  It is very sweet and very good, though.  It definitely takes care of my sweet cravings.I found that I tend to used less of it if I use it on kettle corn (I use 94% fat free Orville) and a butter Pam-type spray.  The spray helps it stick and with the sweetness of the kettle popcorn flavor, I do not need to use quite as much of the caramel flavoring to be satisfied.I HIGHLY recommend this caramel seasoning if you like popcorn and want to have a sweet treat!!
I use this every day on my popcorn along with a butter spray to make it stick.  It is sooooo good.

I ordered 3 sets and one of them was the wrong flavor.  It was very disappointing. The caramel is good but they sent some sort of BBQ flavor instead.  I live in Canada and would have to drive all the way back to the US to return the product which is not worth the price of the product.

This item was the first to arrive of several flavors ordered. It was also the first opened and used. I didn't take long to empty the 3 oz bottle. More needs to be applied than one would initially think, but it is in line with the instructions on the packaging.Very good caramel flavor. It really enhances the salty flavor too so you might want to back off on the salt added to popcorn.We used with an oil popper.

I love caramel!  I put this stuff on everything.  Oatmeal, popcorn, cereal, ice cream, plain yogurt, greek yogurt, fruit, etc.  I like most of Kernel Season's flavors, but this one is by far my fav!  I use the savory flavored ones on steamed veggies.

Loooooove the Kernel Seasons Caramel Popcorn Seasoning! Actually... My whole family loves it. The price is fantastic when you purchase a larger quantity and set up automatic deliveries. You get an additional discount on the already low price, and you don't pay for shipping. So my home will pretty much never be without it. This is the best popcorn topping in my opinion!

This seasoning is fantastic. If you like caramel corn, you must buy this. It tastes just like the real thing. It is very fine grained. If you shake it on while the popcorn is still hot, it works better.

column9: Mix with oil to make it better
column10: I love this stuff. I don't know why, but anything that would go good with caramel goes great with this. Its like having perfect caramel flavoring in a bottle.However, particularly for popcorn, the dry particles end up either on the bottom or in cracks of the popped corn. Since your tongue doesn't get into those areas, you don't taste it as strong as you do on wet foods. The trick I learned with popcorn is to take either melted butter or just corn oil and mix this into the oil first and then drizzle the mixture onto the popcorn. It make it taste that much better.

My husband is not a big popcorn eater... until I got this!  He loves to spray butter then sprinkle this Caramel seasoning on for a night-time snack.  I think it's pretty tasty too, but I love their White Cheddar.  That's my "go-to" seasoning!  So, we always have those two in the house to help with a healthy, high-fiber snack!  And you don't need to much of it either... a little goes a long way!

I get this regularly, and go through it more then my other spices. It's great on fruit, popcorn, coffee, and just about anything you're creative enough to put it on. I tried this for the first time at the movies, but it's hard to find in stores locally. Since I've got it, the whole family is hooked. Popcorn just doesn't taste the same without it.

my mom was eating less and less after my dad passed.  i got this for her and she eats popcorn every day now.  she also uses it on oatmeal and creamy rice pudding.  it has helped increase her appetite without forcing food on her.  i highly recommend it.  it's great and relatively low cal for a dieter too.

I have to agree with Matt, stuff doesn't stick very well - not uniformly anyway. And it does have a strange aftertaste.I tried it on my oatmeal, and it is good, but not great.I got the cheese flavor for my wife and she doesn't like it at all. And she LOVES cheese popcorn.So, our experience is not real positive. Difference in tastes I guess.Not a total loss, however, since I bought 2 boxes (1 caramel, 1 cheese) and there were 6 in each box.I couldn't return them, so I put the ones we hadn't opened in a Christmas basket I made up for work.They disappeared in a couple of days, so maybe some of my co-workers will like it and buy more.

The first time I got this it was amazing and it went extremely well with popcorn. The second time, about half of them were completely messed up. Instead of being caramel and sugar they were caramel salt flavored with a heavy emphasis on the salt. This is an excellent product, but it is not worth the price when half the order is messed up.

OK, I decided I was spending too much on bag popcorn so I went airpop and thus far it's gone pretty well.  I see this I got super excited I could have a guilt free sugary snack for about 100 calories that would also fill me up.  Wrong.  There are no free lunches in nature.  If something looks too good to be true, it is.  Whenever I use this it ALL falls to the bottom, it just doesn't stick to the popcorn.  No matter how much I shake it the seasoning will just not stick, at all.  I wind up getting plain flavorless popcorn every time.The taste?  Taste like caramel dust, which is pretty tasty but it's weird to taste caramel in that form.  I've noticed a strange after taste as well that goes through your mouth and out through your nose which is quite unpleasant.  OK so why did I give it 2 stars instead of 1, you say?  I LOVE this on oatmeal.  This is such a perfect topping for oatmeal, there's no after taste and you get a nice rich caramel taste with otherwise plain oatmeal.So, for what's it advertised, it's not very good, at all but.... on oatmeal?  Awesome.  It also tastes ok on apples and I wouldn't recommend it on ice cream.  I wouldn't buy this again all in all and I'm hesitant to buy another flavor judging by the lack of sticking to popcorn this flavor did.  Disappointment but salvaged in the end.

If you need small amount, this bottle is enough for 4 to 5 pinches.  Good quality.  It sealed with a cork and clear plastic wrap on top. I generally use it for arroz caldo and some spanish dishes like paella.Product of Spain. 0.70 gm.  Around six bucks a bottle at the store.

UPDATE  - I heard that Muir Glen had started transitioning their canned tomato products to BPA free cans but when contacting Muir Glen (General Mills), I kept getting a canned (no pun intended) response that they believe BPA is safe...blah blah blah.  But today, I finally got the answers I was looking for including how to tell which cans at the grocery store are BPA free.  Muir Glen started transitioning to BPA free cans (for their tomato products only) in September 2010.  Their shelf life is 2 1/2 years; therefore, an expiration date after March 2013 should be a BPA free can liner.  You can confirm it is BPA free when you open the can because the old BPA liner was white, but the new BPA free liner is a copper color.  I did ask General Mills to please label their products BPA free to help us consumers when shopping.  I hope that eventually all canned goods will be BPA free.  Let me know what you find when shopping.I am so excited to have a BPA free Organic tomato product, yay!  Thanks Muir Glen!Old Review -I love Muir Glen tomato products but sadly I had to give them up due to their can liners containing bisphenol A (BPA). I will not feed anymore BPA to my kids! I don't know why anyone is surprised that BPA acts like a synthetic estrogen therefore an endocrine disrupter--BPA was ORIGINALLY developed in the 1930s as a synthetic estrogen drug for women. Shortly after it was developed, a new synthetic estrogen drug came out (DES--remember how many women died of cancer because of DES?) so BPA fell by the wayside until someone figured out it could be used in plastics and can liners to help make them harder.I wrote to Muir Glen to see if they had any plans to try and remove BPA from their cans but they did not respond to me. Some companies are concerned and working to remove BPA (Eden Organics) while others are defending BPA--they are the ones that really upset me (Del Monte and Coca Cola are some of the worst--I won't buy ANY of their products anymore). Eden Organics has removed BPA from their canned bean products and is working to remove it from their canned tomato products.  Vital Choices is the only company I know of that has gone 100% BPA free but they sell mostly canned fish and a few other products but no canned tomatoes.I have switched to fresh food or jarred foods--no more cans for our family unless they are BPA free.  The lids of most jars have a little BPA but so much less BPA is leeched out compared to a whole can lining, still I would prefer NO BPA.  It just makes me sick that I fed my children with baby bottles that contained BPA.  I gave my children synthetic estrogen!  We already have prostate cancer in our family, and now I have increased my son's chance of prostate cancer even more by using BPA estrogen laden baby bottles--ugh!!!!!Contact Muir Glen and tell them you want BPA free cans!  We as shoppers, have a lot of power if we decide to use it.  In fact, contact all the companies that you buy canned goods from and let them know you don't want to feed your family BPA anymore.Let me know if you find any tomato products (diced, crushed, paste, ...) that are BPA free by responding to this comment--I will get an email.  I desperately want to make my chicken cacciatore again!I just read some more about BPA, Minnesota has banned BPA and several states are also trying to pass legislation to do the same.  So write to your legislators about banning BPA!  I also read the following from Fran Pavley the sponsor of California's BPA ban: "Well over 100 independent academic and government peer-reviewed studies have linked BPA to a host of problems, including brain and developmental damage, breast and prostrate cancer, early puberty, obesity, infertility, miscarriage and hyperactivity. Young children and babies are particularly vulnerable because their body systems are still developing.Still, the chemical industry remains in denial. It has employed more than a dozen lobbyists to kill my bill.  Lobbyists for popular formula brands are roaming the halls of the Capitol, telling my colleagues that alternative products aren¡¦t available, and a ban on BPA could cause a formula shortage. Yet at the same time, these companies are marketing a variety of formula and food containers to parents as "BPA free"."Scary!!!

column9: great value and no more BPA liners
column10: We mainly use this in conjuction with the 28 ounce cans of crushed tomatos to make the America's test kitchen Spaghetti Sauce. It was a top pick in the cookbook which is why I started buying it and I agree.  Also makes decent salsa in the winter if you really let the tomatos drain. (Another test kitchen tip).  They are canned within hours of being picked and the cannery is next to the fields so are super ripe when picked.  It shows in the flavor.  I just read on the Muir Glenn site they are moving to BPA free liners beginning the harvest of 2011?  There is no date on the News Article so maybe it was 2010. column9: Health benefits had been scientifically proven!
column10: Pleased with the product's quality and price. Packaging is good and very practical. Good value for money.Avoid buying flax powder, as the oil content starts to oxidize immediately upon exposure to air - this makes them rancid-tasting and unhealthy. Flax seeds are very healthy and should be used daily. Flax seeds contain Omega 3 fatty acids that are good for your health. Buy organic, brown or golden whole flax seeds they are inexpensive and you can keep them in a cool, dry pantry for up to one year.You cannot digest whole flax seeds (they will pass right through your digestive tract), you have to grind them up - use a regular, coffee grinder. Eat them within 15 minutes of grinding, and discard what's left, don't save the powder. Taken with any meal, ground flaxseed makes you feel full and satisfied longer. Moreover, its oil content protects the lining of your digestive tract, so it's perfect if you have a sensitive stomach.You will love ground flax seeds sprinkled on your salads or cooked vegetables. They're simply delicious mixed in fruit smoothies, protein shakes, yogurt, soups, or oatmeal. Just make sure that you take it with plenty of fluids 10 times the amount of ground flaxseed,otherwise it could cause constipationNormal daily serving is about 2 full tablespoons per 100 pounds of body weight; that's about 20 grams and 90 calories.List of health benefits of flax seeds:*Improve the cardiovascular health, lowers the blood pressure, "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and blood triglyceride values.*Prevent arterial clots that may result in strokes, heart attacks and thromboses.*Boost the immune system, reduces the inflammation in the body, and relieves asthma.*Support healthy joints and improves the absorption of calcium.*Soothe ulcers, irritable bowel disorders, and improves colon health, lowering the risk of colon cancer.Flax seeds are the richest source of lignans. These are phytoestrogens with powerful antioxidant, anti-tumor, anti-viral, anti-fungal, and anti-bacterial properties, 100 times more than the next best source - wheat bran.And that's not all.To fully realize the flax seeds benefits related to weight loss, you should understand one more thing. Its lecithin content dissolves the fats from food in your digestive tract and then the fiber and mucilage content trap these nasty fats, taken them to be eliminated from your body, rather than being stored as body fat.I don't claim to be a doctor but, I can read this is what I  have learned about the Flax seed: In short, ground flaxseed has been consumed widely in Europe and Asia, introduced to North America during Colonial days, but not widely used as food until the 1960s', when flaxseed health benefits had been scientifically proven.

column9: Product Comparison - Premium wins on Ingredients, Analysis and Price!
column10: I'm going to preface this review by saying that my kitties are not picky about food. We've made sure to expose them to a variety of dry and wet foods since they were very young, and they are usually willing to try new things. That being said, they loved this food and took to it with no problems at all. I mixed it 50/50 with their old food (a mid-range name brand), but I didn't even need to.I compared the ingredients and guaranteed analysis in Premium Edge to our current dry food, Purina One Hairball and also Taste of the Wild which I was considering purchasing as well. I found the ingredients in Premium Edge much better than Purina and, in my opinion, even a smidge better than Taste of the Wild. For example, PE's first 4 ingredients are: Chicken, chicken meal, peas, egg product (also a good source of protein for kitties). ToW's first 4 ingredients are: Chicken meal, peas, sweet potatoes, chicken fat. Purina's are: Chicken, corn gluten meal, brewers rice, poultry by-product meal. No comparison there. I'd much rather feed my cats a dry food that at least has some "real" chicken in it, although chicken meal isn't as bad as some people think it is -- it's just ground up meat and other bits like bone and tissue (which they would eat in a wild or raw diet anyway!) Then there's the guaranteed analysis to consider. More protein is always better, since cats are obligate carnivores and would not eat carbs if they had their choice. PE wins with 45% protein, followed by Tow at 42% then Purina One with only 34%.And finally price... Price per pound based on Amazon price: Premium Edge 18 lb. bag was $1.46/lb., ToW 15 lb. bag was $2.26/lb., and Purina One was $1.59/lb. for 16 lb. bag. So again, Premium Edge came out on top. This is what I will be buying from now on, until I finally bite the bullet and move my brood to a wet food only or a full-on raw food diet.
