I'll be looking somewhere else for my next anchovy fix.Update.....Well, I had four of these little things a couple of hours ago.  They are very good, and I'm still alive.  I've had better in restaurants, but these are better than any I've bought in a store or ordered online.  Still, I won't order them again because of the poor shipping practices.

We just returned from the trip to Spain and decided to throw a party with Spanish food. But, what are Spanish tapas without anchovies! I could not find such authentic food in Austin, TX at any store. Thanks to internet I was able to get a couple of Medusa White Anchovies and they taste absolutely the same as we tried in Madrid! Delivery was very quick as it was promised and they were still chilled when we got them. It's a bit expensive, but it worth it.

column9: Tasty but arrived at room temperature
column10: Very tasty anchovies, not salty, instead meaty and flavorful.  My only complaint is that it arrived in the mail with a completely melted ice pack (apparently it was supposed to be shipped and maintained at a refrigerated temperature, unknown to me at the time I place my order).  So, I took a chance and ate a few anyway.

I was concerned when the box arrived dented and the freeze packs were melted. It did not say on the jar if they needed refrigeration.  I did use the anchovies and they were fine . I ordered them from Amazon because they are not available in our area and I needed them for a specific recipe.
I can't stand anchovies but I ordered this for my husband fret he got hooked on them in Spain.  He said this was the closest thing we've been able to find in the us.  He wants more.

Arrived room temperature... but I knew that would happen given the other reviews. I figured they were probably ok still and ate them- they taste good and I didn't get sick so I think that it is fine.  I would purchase again once I run out...

It's nice to know when you can't find a product at your local grocery store you can usually find it here on Amazon.  My husband grew up on Wolf Brand Chili in Texas and you can not find here in Kentucky.  Not only did I find it, it was very affordable compared to the link on the Wolf Brand website had taken me to.  I was hesitant to try "canned" chili but I was suprised that I really loved it.  It makes the BEST Frito pie!

column9: Best Pre-made Chili On the Market
column10: This is the best pre-made chilli out there. Much better than Hormel or any of the other brands. No contest. It can be eaten alone or its really great for Tex-mex enchiladas or on burritos. Easy to make--just heat and eat. Can get it with or without beans, but get it without. They even have a lean version that's still good. Definite buy.

This is simple.  If you're going to have canned chili, I've spent about 60 years determining that this is the best canned chili.  In fact, I'll go so far as to say that Wolf's beats most the homemade chili I've tasted in its meatiness (not always flavor) and that includes my time living here in "semi-Mexico" on the Rio Grande.And then all you need to do is add some seasoning the ladies here use.  This probably is a better base.  A little this, a little that and you'll be in ChiliLand.  Though I never bother.Need I mention this is "without beans"?  Makes a big difference, Podner.  Better to add a tamale or two than a bunch of beans.

column9: Wolf is so far past the rest
column10: Grew up in Texas on this stuff. After my folks moved us to Washington I never saw it again. All the other canned Chili's have nothing on Wolf. Just read the other comments here. For a canned Chili it is awesome. Makes for the best Chili Cheese dogs you will ever have. This really should be the only Canned Chili. The others are kind of embarrassingly bad in comparison. Just do it, buy some Wolf and then go buy some others, grab some buddies and do a blind taste test. Here is another good example of how good it is, there is a review on here giving it One Star, when you read their comments, they are pissed off at how it was delivered to them, not the chili itself.

Being a native Texan and Wolf Brand being a Texas product, I had eaten Wolf Brand for many years. After moving to Utah a few years ago, I had tried every brand of chili available in the stores here, only to find that none of them is as tasty as Wolf's. In addition, all the brands available here are with beans. I like beans but I like my chili pure, without beans. Then I tried my hand at home made chili. My home made is good but no amount of tinkering with the recipe produced chili equal to Wolf Brand. When I found Wolf's No Beans at Amazon, I ordered a case (24 cans). The chili arrived in perfect condition (no dented cans)and I am once again enjoying my favorite chili.

I was happy to find this brand of chili without beans and since the product description says "Unique blend of seasonings and good hearty beef" I thought it would be a simple meaty chili. Unfortunately, the ingredient list above was (and still is as of now) for some other product and I didn't do any research. There are things I consider to be fillers- oats and textured vegetable protein (soy) along with ingredients you'd expect to find in a chili. For those who would like to know, the ingredients are: meat ingredients (beef, pork), water, tomato puree, rolled oats, tvp, chili pepper, & less than 2% of the following: salt, sugar, spices, garlic powder, soy lecithin, caramel color, and sodium tripolyphosphate.The taste of the chili is pretty good. It is very saucy- much more saucy than I thought it would be and I think it's best to serve over pasta, beans, or rice. The meat is of a very fine texture. I would have liked slightly larger pieces. The couple of times we ate it we had it over pasta with grated cheddar and it was very satisfying. (By the way, a can has two 1 cup servings of 400 calories each. Good if you want calories for your buck, bad if you're on a diet. I could easily eat the whole 800 calorie can if I didn't serve it with something.)Shipping was great. All the cans arrived without dents and had an expiration date of Jan 2013 (order date April 2011).Overall, I was fairly happy with the value and taste of this chili and I may order it again to make sure there's protein in the pantry. I'll be looking at some other brands though to see if there's one I like better.

I've tryed all the national brands and Wolfs is far and away the vey best canned chili I've had. Great out of the can and excellant as a base to "doctor" with added meat, beans, onions, etc. Great on hotdogs...just great!

column9: Best Chili in the World - Not just for camp outs!
column10: We love this chili.  We actually dump it into many other recipes to add kick.  Try this, cook up a big glob of rice or spaghetti, throw it into a casserole dish and then throw in two or three cans of Wolf chili and some grated cheddar cheese.  I know it sounds crazy, but we love it.  (Only in Texas...)

column9: ALL-STAR TEXAS CHILI!! HOME ON THE RANGE!!
column10: Anyone who is from the Lone Star State, or has spent appreciable time there, will know WOLF BRAND (Original) CHILI. Here in California, I have always had to order it directly from the factory. Now, thanks to Amazon.com, I can buy a case, shipping included, for the best price on the Net. This is not a weight-watchers' delight, but the quality and original flavor of WOLF BRAND CHILI remains at the top of my menu list. Great as a side, a full meal, or in any Tex-Mex themed recipe when you want some authentic flavor. This is the "mild" style, and other types of WOLF BRAND products are available if you want more heat, spice, larger chunks of meat, or beans. Cans arrived with no dents or dings, well packaged, and shipped immediately.
I have to order it in to California because the folks here don't understand how good the Chili really is!

When I first encountered the Wolf brand chili, here on Amazon, I thought to myself: "Well...here we go again...another canned chili product, that might be passable as a dog food substitute." As it happens, I went with the stellar reviews on this site and was not disappointed. The old-style Wolf label actually conjured-up visions of man's best friend, but the contents revealed a truly first-rate chili base. Armour, Hormel, Castleberry, and all of the rest, should just fold and get out of the game! Though this stuff was great straight from the tin, I look forward to tryin' it all doctored-up, as well. At two dollars a pop, delivered to your door, this is definitely bang-for-the-buck.

The can says no beans. One of the central ingredients of this dish is "vegetable protein," which contains soy flour. Soy is a bean. Therefore there are beans. Stop misleading these poor people who think this sludge is a no-bean delicacy!

column9: Every can dented even though package was intact
column10: Wolf brand chili is my favorite, but do not buy from this vendor. They are clearly packaging dented can they cannot sell. I received an intact package in which every can was dented.

I started making truffled tater tots (tater tots, parmesan cheese, truffle oil, chives) and bringing them to parties, so over the past year or so, I've tried a number of different brands of white truffle oil. Most of them really don't have a good, strong truffle taste, but this one always does.  I realize that it's a lab process, but I definitely can't afford to mess around with real truffles, and this really does taste great.

Getting this bottle of Urbani White Truffle Oil for our daughter and letting her experience using quality product; she told us that her dishes came out fantastic. It's the best truffle oil she had experienced. Thanks Urbani
GUAOOOOOO  , I LOVE TO COOK  USING THIS WHITE TROUFFLE OIL, ITS  AMAZING, ,JUST USE IT ONCE AND YOU WILL GET HOOKED TOTALLY  , THATS  IT. WHAT ELSE.

column9: I've tried the rest, now try the best
column10: Urbani is the most fragrant and authentic of white truffle oils. Don't bother with other brands; they don't compare. I have been using Urbani for years after being burned by two other kinds.

Good flavor and relatively strong aroma to this oil.  Could probably afford to dilute the pungency with E.V.O.O. in some delicate food preparations.  Make sure to keep it cool and out of sunlight to extend shelflife.  I will continue to use this product until something proves better.

column9: Truffle Oil? Well, at least the oil is real.
column10: I'm flabbergasted by the glowing reviews that "truffle oil" is receiving on Amazon! Those of you espousing a desire to drizzle this stuff on your food might be sorely disappointed to learn that the truffle flavor in those tiny [...] bottles of "truffle oil" are made in a laboratory. There's not a molecule of actual truffle in them. It's a sinful shame that's perpetuated despite being outed a few years ago in an enlightening New York Times article called "Hocus-Pocus, and a Beaker of Truffles." Read it and weep: [...]And if you see "truffle oil" advertised on the menu somewhere, you might ask if they're using any other artificial flavorings in their dishes...

Normally I'll make my own rib rub, but being that I dug Emeril's "Bayou Blast" on pork chops, I figured I'd give it a shot.  I've been working on getting my ribs cooked just right for a long time with much trial and error.  I finally get it right and BAM!!!, Emeril's rub totally ruined my perfectly cooked ribs.  This rub totally overpowers the meat, the sauce, and even it's own spiciness with saltiness a couple ribs into it.  A rub should complement a meat and not make it like a spicy salt-lick (It said there was sweet in there too but I couldn't taste it).  Thank goodness I only left it on a couple hours before cooking and not overnight like I (and most people) usually do.

This rub is awsome.  Spread fairly heavy all over ribs, wrap them in foil and bake for 2 and 1/2+- hours at 250-275.  Remove from foil and finish off on a BBQ to crisp the exterior, if you wish.  The are tender and have an awsome flavor.
These are the best strawberry (or any other flavor) gummies we have ever had!  Just delicious.  (Even better when they are frozen!!!)

column9: Cats slow to eat this product
column10: I have two cats and with the price of cat food going up like everything else, I jumped on the opportunity to buy this food during a lightening round offer. Unfortunately I should have consulted with the cats! One cat eats everything quickly and ravenously. The other is only anxious to eat Wellness Healthy Indulgence and Fancy Feast Gourmet Wild Salmon. Expensive tastes, so when this healthy variety was offered at 1/2 price I took it. I was truly surprised to see the good eater turn around from the bowl and leave. The slow eater did stay and work on it. I may end up donating these to the local shelter in my area, hopefully some cat there will enjoy it.
I like this cat food because it does not have meat by products.  I bought the dry cat food in this brand but my cat doesn't like it.  She does like the canned food version though!

Having lived in West TX for 13 years, I miss the Texas flavor in food here in the East.  Stubb's seasonings are good.  Many are available in the super markets, but for some reason the Burger Rub isn't found.  I think if you try this product, you will probably season all your burgers with it from now on.

The product is awesome.It's condition is unacceptable.Most of it is in a solid clump!We had to cut it open and crush it in a zip-lock bag to make it usable at all!Skip buying it here and get it in fresher condition from a grocer!

I love this product.  Found it first at my local BevMo! but couldn't find it there when I ran out, so I bought it here.  The only complaint I have about this product is that it tends to clump a little in the shaker and gets hard to get out of the container sometimes.  I fix this by sticking something in the pouring hole and trying to break up the clumps (a barbeque skewer works well here).  Anyway, great flavor, great product.

We haven't found something that is a must have for burgers before.  This is my favorite spice for hamburgers.  It makes them taste better than 99% of the burgers you can buy even at great restaurants. Just use fresh ground beef and the burger rub. It makes burgers taste like what you imagine a perfect burger would taste like.  Its too bad, it seems like it is being dicontinued 'cause we can't find it anywhere but here.  I guess it just didn't catch on.  Yes, it comes out clumpy(when it gets old), but sometimes even the ones from the store come clumpy.  Break the canister open, break it up, and store it in a baggie; its just spices.

I couldn't disagree more with the review that claims these taste like sand. As far as gluten free cookies go it's hard to find anything more delicious than these. The fact that they're so small makes it a little tough to dip them in unhealthy things like Nutella or peanut butter, but it's still possible. They remind me a lot of Teddy Grahams, but if you look at the ingredient list you can actually recognize the ingredients instead of just a laundry list of chemicals and additives.

My 11 year old son has Celiac and for the longest time he had to have grainy or rice crackers and he always felt like he stood out.  He couldn't participate in the class reward system of getting goldfish for finding and using spelling and vocabulary words.  These crackers are tasty, and of similar size and appeal of novelty crackers that aren't gluten free.  He loves them in this and the graham variety, and above all, he doesn't feel so alienated from his peers.

It can be hard to find gluten free cookies that taste good and don't make you feel like you're missing out on "real" cookies, but my entire family loves these! They have a great cinnamon and sugar flavor and a nice cookie texture--I agree with another reviewer they are similar in both texture and flavor to Teddy Grahams. I sent a box with my parents when they took my children to the park, and I warned them that they better not taste any themselves lest they become hooked. My mom now stops at a grocery store in the town she works in just to get some since they are not available where she lives/shops!

I love Annie's products and when I found these Snickerdoodles it made me think of when my grandma used to bake them.  Sure - they're not that good, but they are quite yummy and healthy and a quick easy snack.
My daughter has Celiac, and these little cookies are a great alternative to gluten filled snacks, like "Teddy Grahams" that kids love! She likes them, especially with a glass of milk!

I disagree that these have a sand like texture, even my gluten-free disliking kids thought these were great.  They are much better than the Annie's vanilla and chocolate bunny cookies.  I will definitely buy again!

column9: Glad to see more gluten free Annie's
column10: My kids plowed through a box of these last night.  We all loved them.  They have a perfect cinnamon flavor that is a nice change from the typical vanilla and chocolate cookies.I will be buying these regularly.

I recently found out I have a wheat allergy and have been trying out new foods that will work with my allergy. I found these in my local PCC shop and was sadly disappointed. I love the starting flavor, nice cinammon and sugar blend, good crunch like teddy grahams, however after you've been chewing for a few bites, you notice a markedly gritty or sandy texture to them. For me it kinda ruined the appeal. I don't know if this is typical of the manufacturer or because it's gluten free but I won't be purchasing this again.

column9: Pretty Good, Sandy Texture, Not Flavor
column10: I understand what one reviewer said about the cookies being like sand, but they don't taste like sand, they just have a sandy texture.  However, they are gluten-free, so perhaps that's the price you have to pay.  The taste is very good and cinnamon-y, perhaps even a bit too sweet.  I'm not dissatisfied, but don't think I would order them again.  I would prefer to keep searching for the perfect gluten-free ccokie snack.

We really like these snickerdoodle cookies - much better than other brands of snack cookies we've tried.  My husband and son are both gf.  My son is a very picky eater, and these are one of his favorites.  My daughter eats these, too, even though she is not on a gf diet.  Will order more when these are gone.

I've been gluten free for about 5 months now, and am always trying products to see how like the "real" thing they are. Well, these little cookies come close! They're great by the handful, and like others have said - do not taste like sand at all. They have just the right mix of cinnamon and sugar. I haven't tried it yet, but I bet they'd make a good pie crust, or even just a nice addition to ice cream!

I bought these because I wanted something to replace my regular cinnamon sugar graham cracker snack since I could no longer have them due to gluten intolerance! I never expected them to come even close, but they are super yummy. They have the same satisfying crunch as graham crakers and tbe same yummy cinnamon sugar taste. I will definately buy again!
These are not very good. My daughter and I agree, they are like eating sand.  I would never buy them again.
I was so disappointed that I threw them all out.  I don't know why it tastes so good at the stadium...is it because it stands out a long time?
If you've had a brat at Miller Park there is a good chance you've used the Secret Stadium Sauce.  I don't know what it is, I don't know want to know, but I will continue to slather it over my brats.

The special sauce served at Miller Park,I ordered this after hearing the broadcasters doing a telecast for Brewers baseball..rave about the flavor! It seems to be a special Ketchup sauce,but the kids love it!  well maybe they should try it on their Veggies,then they  would eat them?  well not a bad price and in a plastic bottle.which is a added plus!

column9: The Only dog-food my dog eats--for 4+ years now!
column10: Before I found Azmira, my YorkieXChihuahua was the pickiest eater EVER! I had purchased almost every brand out-there! I even made him food from scratch!  aarrgghhhh!  Now, our 2nd YorkieX dog (Mikka) also eats Azmira.  I buy one bag of Beef and one bag of Lamb, and mix in a sealed container.  BTW--I always put a new bag of food in my freezer for about a week. It's been 4+ years now, buying Azmira, and it's difficult to get the lamb (which is the better flavor, according to Gizmo).  2 small bags of about 4#'s, will last my 2 dogs months and months! I give them free choice, and they eat out of the same bowl. Neither dog is overweight.

I have been breeding and and showing dogs ...of several different breeds for over 30 years. This is the absolute BEST I've ever found,although I've always fed top quality  dog food.Currently , I have 3 Chows, 2 Sussex Spaniels and 5 Brusselsl Griffon.(downsizing, as we age)  All the dogs , but one Brussels Griffon, are now retired from showing, and I have not bred any dogs in several years. They all live with my husband and me as pets. (We're  slightly nuts, but have a good setup for the dogs,  so although many are AKC Champions, they can all be "pets" , in retirement.All are housebroken and well trained...none will ever leave our home.)I came to this dog food a fairly short time ago, but I'll never look back.It's not inexpensive, but the smaller portions needed because of the high quality of the ingredients, bring down the cost per dog. Weight control is amazing, and the lack of "fillers" makes every bite a healthy one. One of my Griffons is about to turn 15 , and the Chows... a breed inclined to bloat and stomach cancer, are all healthy at ages well past youth. One  Sussex Spaniel  and one Chow had been a little overweight , but are improving visibly on this food, and are also more active.You need to check your home area to see who carries it, because it's not currently found every where, but you can find it on-line  and it can be shipped.It comes with full instructions on how to judge quantity by size of the dog and it's much less that you would expect. Best of all, every single one of my 10 dogs LOVES it.  (I use the Lamb version)
A LONG WAY TO GO TO SOUTH CAROLINA FOR OUR FAVORITE BBQ SAUCE - SO HAVING IT SHIPPED FREE IS GREAT. CAN'T GET ANY BETTER THAN MAURICE'S

My friends bring bag loads from oversea and I could not believe that should not to be found in the US, but I couldn't lay my eyes and hand on them in any Manhattan or Brooklyn store. So, I used Amazon as a joker!Made them happy!
These are unique and wonderful candy bars.  Will be purchasing more of them soon. Better than most candy bars out there!

I'm guessing you probably already know what a mars bar is, so let's just assume you like 'em. Not a whole lot else to say. If you haven't had an English style mars bar before, I would say that they're one of they're one of the nicer candy bars out there. Well worth trying for anyone who considers themselves a connoisseur of fine junk foods! Do be aware though that judging by some of the other reviews posted, they're NOT quite the same as the mars bars that some buyers may have been expecting.While prices do fluctuate, as of the time of writing this package of 12 will wind up costing you just a fraction over $1.42 a bar. Amazon does sell these bars in packs of more than 12, and bigger the pack you buy, the better deal you get. So if you are able to find a deal that translates as good value from where you sit (and especially if you qualify for free shipping), this seems as good a place as any to buy your chocolate fix. If not, hey, look elsewhere.I took a star off because... Well, just the obvious. Mars bars are bad for you, duh! So please, enjoy in moderation ;-)Theo.

While it's impossible to find Mars bars in the US, I was thrilled to find them on Amazon.  The shipping process occurred in a very timely fashion.  I was a little surprised as to how the bars were packaged - all loose inside the box.  And while the taste is wonderful, the candy bars were quite stale.  So, I guess I will have to get my Mars bars fix when across the ocean.

My family and I love real English Mars bars and ordered these based on the description saying they are imported from England and are real "British chocolate". When they came, they are Polish Mars bars!! Don't taste the same at all and the texture is different. If you are looking for the real deal, don't order from this seller, as the description is flat out misleading. The packaging was woefully inadequate as well.
I ordered these for a friend who loved the old American Mars bars.  While these were good they were more like a Milky Way and contained no almonds.

I enjoyed this product, taste good without a bunch of sugar. Has good amount of sodium and potassium. As an athlete it makes more sense to be drinking this rather than those sugar filled sports drinks.

Greater than is a great concept and is a good drink overall. However, this flavor doesn't sit too well with me during a workout. I can drink it post workout but otherwise it seems to upset my stomach. I have also noticed this problem with certain brands of coconut water. Try the other flavors, I have had better luck with those.

I met the founders of Greater Than when they presented in my MBA class at Tulane University.  They brought samples to class, which happened to be right after I had completed a strenuous workout.  It is not sugary, not watery, all round an excellent product.  I've ordered the orange flavor to keep me boosted while working out in New Orleans!  It's super hot here so re-hydration is absolutely critical. Not only is the drink delicious (all 3 flavors taste great!) but the re-hydration was immediate & very effective.  It also boosted my energy level well, after drinking it I felt as though I had recovered much more quickly than usual.

My daughter is in a lot of sports, so we are always trying new sports drinks/coconut waters.  This is definitely the best we have found.  It's literally tastes like you mixed some coconut water with gatorade.  Super tasty!  All the flavors are delicious, but she likes this one the best.  Now that this product is on Subscribe & Save, it's an amazing deal.  Try some!

Tried this drink because it was on sale here at Amazon and decided to buy it after the two 5-star reviews.  There's a reason why there is only 2 reviews.  It's horrible.  There's nothing natural tasting about this stuff.  Stick with the natural coconut, it's organic, it's much better tasting, and it's cheaper.  I brought a bottle to my tennis match.  Was winning the match until I cracked open this bottle.  It was so horrible that I ended losing my match because I rather get dehydrated than drink this stuff.  Had friends try it for second opinion and they agreed.  Buy at your own risk...
This seasoning is just the best. I use it on EVRYTHING!! Givesfood a good flavor with out alot of salt!!
My friend is a big coffee drinker and he loved this coffee. Very flavorfull and smells great when perking.

column9: So good you won't believe it's legal...
column10: In our house, two other varieties of Saalzon organic chocolate (one with sea salt and one with salt and cracked pepper do not enjoy very long life spans....because we really enjoy their unique combinations of flavors and textures.You can add this offering to complete Salazon's "triple crown" of delicious and slightly decadent chocolate offerings. The large grains of salt and turbinado sugar do not overwhelm the chocolate. Instead they combine with it to make an excellent twist on a fundamental indulgence in life.This offers great rewards to the adventurous chocolate eater. Please don't tell my governor: he'll want to add a special tax on something so luxurious!

Great chocolate.  Just a touch of salt, dark rich chocolate, and a bit of sweetness from the turbinado sugar.  I'm ordering their chocolate with coffee now.I'm glad Amazon is finally carrying this product.

I don't usually write reviews but I feel compelled to do so based on a misconception going around about this product. This is not another snake oil fix-it-all.It contains grounded corn with herbs, not processed sugar. Yes it is full of carbohydrates and natural sugars, but it is not candy or a magical elixir. The Tarahumara Indians use it to fuel their ultra-runs, but that does not mean that you should gobble it up for a quick pick-me-up in the morning. You wouldn't eat running gels, protein shakes or Michael Phelps's lunch and then not do the work. If you want an alternative to GU or energy bars try this, if you are trying to get healthy by simply ingesting something; don't.

This pinole is a great product!  It tastes great and is properly advertised.  My husband and I use the pinole with water, almond milk or soymilk before and/or during our long runs which helps provide a lot of much-needed energy.  We've even tried it warm (drank it like tea) and my husband has added it to his morning, pre-run coffee with excellent results.  This pinole really is a versatile product that I highly recommend.  The shipping was a little pricey considering the cost of the product, but it is coming all the way from California so I guess that's about right.  We had no problems at all with the Seller.
If you want to get right to the recipe then buy this product.  Not having to toast the masa removes a huge time saver while using a high quality, ready to use product.

column9: A pleasant, hot, nourishing substitute for coffee
column10: Pinole is a powdery blend of toasted ground corn, sugar and cinnamon.  There is not too much sugar in the El Guapo mix as one reviewer claimed.  The balance is just right, not too sweet.  Pinole makes a pleasant, hot, nourishing substitute for coffee which often puts me on edge and stimulates an irresistible craving to snack on something.  My packets arrived labeled as 5 oz instead of 6 oz as advertised but they are still worth the low cost and a little goes a long way.

In a book called BORN TO RUN, it is written that the Tarahumara Indians of Mexico's Copper Canyon consume pinole (corn meal) for energy during their 100 mile runs.  That fact motivated me to try pinole, a food that I never heard of prior to reading that book.  Pinole is easy to make and it is good nutrition.  Pinole was delivered much quicker than I had anticipated from the Mexican Grocer.  I am not only sold on the product, but also on their excellent service.

Mexican pinole is a condensed food made from ground, roasted corn.  This product goes further by adding sugar and cinnamon.  This takes it from bland to sublime.  A very delicious and filling drink can be made by stirring a few spoons full into hot water.  Made just the way it should be, this pinole can even serve as a wonderful survival food.  This is the real thing.

column9: Too Sweet for Me - Tastes like Candy
column10: Tastes good, but I had expected something unsweetened that might have been healthier.  Note: The sweeterner may have been mentioned in the advertisement I might have missed it.  Fast accurate shipping/delivery.  All packages intact upon receipt.

The product description in Amazon is misleading.  The description says "Pinole Ground Corn" and it even suggests adding brown or white sugar to it.  But it is already full of sugar, which is exactly what I didn't want.
I carry these with me everywhere.  They make for a very healthy snack especially since they're organic and unsalted.  They're roasted for the perfect taste and crunch. My favorite almonds..

Maisie Jane is the prime organic almond company in an area knownfor it's almonds.  The snack packs are easy to carry in the carand purse. Almonds are among the most nutitious nuts helping tobalance blood sugar, containing a heart healthy oil, and providinghelpful amounts of magnesium, a mineral that many Americansneed.  To open the packs on the go, peel the top label awayand enjoy!

I have been ordering Maisie Jane's Organic Oven Roasted Almonds for a few months now.  i love them because they are organic, crunchy, oven roasted, always fresh, and a nice size.  Best of all, they come packaged in little 1.25 ounce portion sizes, which makes them a handy snack.I eat almonds for my health, but love them so much that I have a tendency to overindulge if there's a large container in the house.  These handy little packets keep me in line, but provide me with an easy daily almond fix.
These are the best almonds I have ever tried. Very fresh, crunchy and flavorful. I am very picky about my snack foods, and these are perfectly portioned and perfectly tasty!

column9: Fantastic natural organic almonds in right-sized packs
column10: I really like these as they are not over-roasted which destroys the Omega-3, rather they are "tender" i.e., not rock hard but just crunchy.  The flavor is wonderfully natural and refreshing, and not drowned in salt or Tamari sauce as the ones in the store are.  They do not hurt my teeth like the hard ones in the stores do.  I don't think that there is a better product, and it's organic!  The right-sized packs mean you won't overeat.  I like to enjoy about 10 nuts with a couple of pieces of dark chocolate for desert every night.  I never get tired of it and it stems my appetite for the evening while providing antioxidants and Omega-3 essential oils.  Also, almonds are said to be the only alkaline nut.I think Dr. Weil says that you should have a handful of nuts every day, and almonds are about the healthiest nut, I've heard.  I also happen to like these Klein's Naturals Raw Cashews, Organic, (Pack of 6) because they are sweet, not salty and quite fresh.  Again, saving the value of the essential oils in them because they are not over-roasted.
I read that almonds help to lose weight. Eat a handful a day. These packs are just the right size. Almonds are good for you, plus they fill you up.Try them.

Five stars and then some for getting my favorite cookies delivered to me! I hate fighting the grocery store because people are just downright rude. The more I can do online like this, the better! I also get my cereal,peanut butter and drink mixes this way. Better prices and no shipping. To quote one of my fave queens, Shangela, Halleloo!

I love anything made with cashews.  These cookies use to have a lot more 'whole sized' cashews which I really loved but now they are more homogenous.  They still have a great buttery, nutty flavor.  I don't buy them often though since they are high in calories and non-healthful ingredients.  A splurge now and then is terrific though since these cookies taste so heavenly.  I do recommend them... though in moderation.  Enjoy!

I bought this item while browsing for Pecan Sandies. I'm a senior who likes to keep "stocked up". Also I'm on low end of Soc.Sec. and don't have a car. I loved these cookies and am subscribing to them. The cookies arrived in 6 12-oz packages and not a broken cookie in the bunch.

column9: Delicious, high quality and versatile products
column10: This is a delicious product line, steps above the other condiments in this competitive category and worth every penny. I heard that it's used by fancy food companies in their own products (Whole Foods, Jeni's Ice Cream). And no wonder, it's terrific! The products have zillions of uses (serve with wine and cheese, garnish/marinate meats and fish, eat (artichoke parm) out of the jar.

Purchased this as a gift.  The jars were much smaller than expected so I had to purchase something else to make the gift look more substantial.  As far as taste goes, the recipient said she was eating them straight out of the jar, so I assume . . . pretty tasty?  Probably would not purchase again just based on size of the product.

I used the fig/almond spread as a filling for a layered cake. I got rave reviews from my coworkers, they really thought the spread had a nice flavor and consistency. Using the gracious gourmet spread as a filling gave more dimension to the flavor of my cake. I highly reccomend it!

column9: Not as hot as the name indicates
column10: The package was a little messy as the pop corn oil seemed to leak through the plastic.  Had to wipe it down before putting in microwave and then use a town to hold it and cut / pour into a bowl.  Did not have a lot of heat, just a slight pepper taste.

I had purchsed thi product for my son , who loves Hot or Spicy products. I also tried this product along with him and I will say this popcorn LIVES up to it's description. You have got to give this product a try If you love Hot and Spicy Snacks!

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: I use many different brands of pasta depending on the recipe but DeCecco is the only *elbow* pasta I use. These elbows are always part of my very best macaroni salad and macaroni and cheese recipes. Cooks up perfectly al dente on time, every time. Excellent flavor - with just a little salt in the water you could eat these plain right out of the strainer when they are done. Yummmmm! They have these tiny ridges on the surface which helps sauces to cling, enhancing the flavors of the recipe. Try this and see:Macaroni Salad8 ounces DeCecco Elbow Pasta1½ cups Hellmann's or Best Foods Mayonnaise2 Tbsp. white or rice wine vinegar1 Tbsp. coarse grained mustard (try Inglehoffer Stone Ground Mustard, 4-Ounce (Pack of 12))1 tsp. salt1/4 tsp. ground black pepper1 cup thinly sliced celery1/4 cup chopped sweet onion (*don't use red onion)1. Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain and rinse with cold water until completely cool.2. Combine vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper in large bowl. Stir in macaroni. Add mayonnaise, celery and onion.3. Place in refrigerator to cool for 2-3 hours. Serve chilled.Enjoy!

There's a reason why Carmella on the Sopranos had a cabinet full of DeCecco pasta in her pantry ~ it's the best on the market.  Moving to another state made this very had to get, especially the capilini so I ordered the five box package and plan never to run out again.

column9: Great to be able to buy this out-of-season; happy with shipping
column10: I buy fresh pomegranate seeds as often as I can.  I have a Vita-mix blender and I make fruit and veggie smoothies every morning.  I was almost out of pomegranate seeds that I had frozen in the fall and decided on a whim to search the internet to find where I could buy them.  I was so happy to find that I could purchase them at Amazon.  Even after I ordered them, I was still a little skeptical.  My pomegranate seeds were shipped immediately FedEx and they arrived the next day packed in dry ice.  There were two buckets of still-frozen seeds.  They were not sticking together; it was like a bucket of frozen pebbles.  I just had to scoop them out into small zip-lock bags and put them in the freezer.  I am so happy to have enough seeds to last another 2-3 months.

I am addicted to pomegranate seeds. When they were in season, I bought lots just so I could enjoy and freeze half for when the season ended, but alas, I ate them all before Februrary.  These are superb quality and come in 5 lb bins.  They are actually cheaper than Whole Foods and I am just so pleased I can feed my addiction in the off-season. I eat them frozen and I actually prefer the large bins. The shipping is expensive but I still think it is worth it.

Shipping was next day and timely, but the pomegranate seed are nothing compared to original. Not worth it even for a pomegranate addict like me. Luckily I can still get some ready to eat Pomegranate seeds 150 gram packets at Trader's Joe, they are pricey but at least satisfying.

I didn't have any water to re-hydrate this water so I used my own saliva instead.I was a bit disappointed that my water came off tasting more than a little bit like saliva. Not very fresh and not that thirst-quenching, but not awful in a pinch either.

column9: HELP!. Be careful with this product
column10: I accidentally put 5 pills instead of 1 in my bottle of water and added water to re-hydrate the dehidrated water. I think I overdosed myself and I'm really worried the additional dehidrated water pills will suck all the water of my body and dry me up. What should I do ?

column9: Looks like they decreased the package size :(
column10: So, yeah, this is a great product that does exactly what it says, and I do agree with a lot of the reviewers. BUT, look carefully at how many capsules you get - as I recall, you used to get 5 capsules for this same price. Sneaky price inflation, anyone?  I guess at the sale price, you can't be too picky, but still, as with any product, buyer beware.

This is a step down from the canned dehydrated water of yesteryear. Nevertheless it is a great gift idea. In any case, the picture doesn't really show what your buying. The product details are even less informative. The packet is about 2 inches by 3 inches in size containing small gel capsules that you can buy at your local pharmacy. Dehydratedwater.com is probably making a 300% profit on this product.

Taste a little bit like spit, but boy does it  Q U E N C H  your thirst.  Carry them around in your pocket and have something you DONT HAVE TO BOIL before use (unless you re-hydrate it with nasty-a$$ honey badger water).Dehydrated water capsules for the win!

column4: Billy Jones "patty poss ruzicka & william jones"
column10: , I remeber coming across it years ago , and I went to work and told my co-workers , told them I was going to send for dehydrated water samples LOL the website where I orginally found it , they are very selective on who they send the samples out to , I, they were like hm , dehydrated water that has got to be AIR , but know what ? it is true ,. I got it today and just opened it , and LOL air filled capsules hehehe , so funny ......

I freakin' love dehydrated water!  This is the best brand of all of them since they have the special high-tech dehydration process that blends and dehydrates the freshest and most delicious waters in the world!  There is no better dehydrated water available in the world.  I love to take it camping and I frequently give it as a Christmas or birthday gift.  It's the perfect gift for that special someone that has everything!

This has GOT to be the most AMAZING product ever conceived.  Who would have thought we could live in a time where that much water could be stored in such a small space!!  I am flabbergasted and intrigued why no one had thought of this before!  This is the ultimate in 2012-preparations and I will be purchasing another case of these with my next paycheck!  I'm dying to know what these geniuses will think of next!  Now, I need to go buy more aluminum foil for my BOB.  Wonder if they sell that too?  =-o

I really hope people out there don't think this is a replacement for actual water. As it states in the product description "Great novelty or gag gift item that others will talk about for years to come" please don't be fooled into thinking this will hydrate you. Dehydrated water is just as real as X-ray googles.
I took this backpacking with me. It is the best. I didn't have to bring any water. What a weight saver. I like to mix it with my Voss artisan bottled water for a real treat.

Ok good people this is very funny and all, but some actually think this is a real product. Shouldn't we be preventing this company to profit from ignorance? This is a very old joke that became a hoax, you know it, I know it, but some don't. And it is not like the company is giving it away for free...Amazon do you allow this?

column9: I am unable to Split these capsules for a half serving ;-(
column10: My family is very sensitive to everything.  Lots of allergies, overly sensitive to prescriptions, etc.  So, we regularly cut the dose in half of most things we use as a precaution.  In fact when I drink juice, I dilute it 60-75% with water - just becuase the flavors are so strong to me.So, I purchased these and planned to split these into smaller servings.  I was going to use my empty gel caps which I keep at home to be able to split them.  But, they do not use standard size gel caps!!I have always been able to use standard O,1,2 or 3 size capsules which I get from my local pharmacy.  But these Dehydrated Water Capsules must be imported, since they do not fit any of the standards US sizes.I am afraid to use the entire capsule all at once due to my very sensitive nature, so I can't really comment on its strength or it's flavor.  But if you are interested in splitting the serving size down I recommend you find an American source for these - as these can not be split.  jk  :-)

Best invention since sliced bread. It's easy to store for disaster preparedness, great for backpacking, and safe for my kids to drink.  And the best part, it tastes just as good as my regular water.  I have to buy more while it's still on sale.

Dehydration is the process of removing water.  Thus, it is impossible to have dehydrated water.  The directions say to dissolve the capsule in a bowl of hot water.  Why not just drink the bowl of water and not waste your money on the worthless capsule.  I can't believe that Amazon even allows this to be sold on their website.
Can someone stop with this nonsense of dehydrated water? Let me put it simple for you. The definition of "dehydrated" is lack of water. Wtf?????

PG Tips Loose Tea Jumbo Pack 1.5KG (3.3 LB) (England)I was introduced to PG Tips several years ago by an Englishman (now a citizen of the U.S.) who was quite insistent regarding proper brewing of the tea. He pointed out that brewing PG Tips too long would result in a bitter brew. His technique, which I follow, is to brew the loose tea, after warming the pot, for two minutes then immediately pouring up into cups. I like mine with a nice bit of milk but no sugar.I had great difficulty getting a good brew until I was given a 2-cup, Brown Betty. I initially used my father's tea pot in which he brewed Lipton's every after noon. It was too big (4 or 5 cup) and had the spout with pierced plug at its base which made it difficult to clean. Then I bought a tea pot and cup set put out by one of the greeting card companies. It was very cute and, hence, did not have the optimum shape to make good tea easily. It was a little smaller than my father's pot and the spout was clear. The spout did not rise as high as the lid so I had trouble keeping it from spilling before I could get it aimed at the cup. The two cup Brown Betty solved these difficulties.As to timing the brew, I at first attempted to keep my eye on the clock with a sweep second hand. I would get busy and miss the two minute point. I got a wind-up kitchen timer with a very loud bell. I warm the pot, put in one level tablespoon of tea, add 15 oz just boiled fresh filtered well water, put on the lid and cozy, then set the timer. When the bell sounds, I remove the cozy, place the strainer on my 16 oz travel mug, and carefully pour up the brew. Success every time! I add a couple of ounces of whole milk and enjoy my afternoon tea.

column9: A OK Tea ... There are better options though
column10: If I had to say anything about PG Tips, compared to its main rival, Tetley, is just a feeling of something is lacking. My tea background is mostly one of drinking the amazing thing called Barry's Tea Gold Blend but I have been looking to branch out a little bit lately. Having ordered a few brands, I taste tested PG Tips using boiled Pur Filtered water; when drinking PG tips after brewed for 4 to 5 mins, the flavor just drops out. British tea is traditionally a little bit lighter than what the Irish prefer to drink so I was expecting a lighter and little less complex taste..There is no real finish to your sip, it just stops about midway through the pallet then then it's just nothing. Rather disappointing.
This is great for everyday busy self feeders or you can get a attachable spoon from boon company that works great. Great taste and it's great for stroller snack!!!!

These flakes smell so very good. I love using them in soup and meat dishes. A little bit goes a long way, making this a fairly cheap way to get iodine and other good nutrients into your diet. The plastic packaging is also biodegradable.
I started eating this because my doctor recommened it for my thyroid.  I've cultivaed a taste for it and really like it now.
Product arrived in short order and is just fine.  I use it instead of salt on vegetables or add it to salads.  There is an occasional little crunch of shell, but I have gotten over that.
If you're trying to cut back on salt, these dulse flakes are a natural and healthy way to add a salty taste with minimum sodium. I use them mostly on beans and eggs.

column9: A little goes a long way and it works great with miso paste!
column10: These dulse flakes add a "taste of Maine" to Japanese miso. To make a wonderful miso broth, boil water.  Put a very generously rounded teaspoon of Roland white miso into a mug or cup and two teaspoons or so of dulse.  Pour the boiling water into your cup or mug, whisk the ingredients together and enjoy! To make an even more authentic miso soup, add small cubes of tofu and the chopped green ends of scallions (and a little of the white part if you want).This makes a wonderful soup and a tablespoon of dulse contains 330% of the DV  of iodine.  This is a good thing, since popular sea salt often contains no iodine - a necessary nutrient for thyroid health.

column9: Delicious and Nutritious Addition to Nearly Any Dish
column10: "Sea" foods, in this case as in "vegetables that come from the sea," are a vital component of a wholesome, natural, macrobiotic diet. Main Coast Dulse Flakes provide one of nature's power foods - seaweed - in an easy to use form. The flakes add great flavor to nearly every dish: whole grains, vegetables, legumes, seafood, eggs and more. They may be incorporated as an additive in just about any dish: add them to rice, grits, veggies, soups, salads, popcorn, etc, just as one would any vegetable used for flavoring -- sprinkle in by the spoon for complimentary seasoning or mix in by the cup for use as a primary vegetable ingredient. We love and enjoy them -- in lots of dishes made extra tasty by their inclusion. Happy eating!

column4: James Laabs "Author of the sports mystery &#3...
column9: Limited usefulness and strong fishy odor
column10: I bought the huge quantity (4 bags) required and it is more that a lifetime supply. The reason I bought this is I had read in a book that it is a perfect salt substitute and has lots of potassium and magnesium, which are helpful as a natural remedy for high blood pressure. What I learned is that a "serving" of dulse (what you need to have to get the minerals promised) is something like two teaspoons. Believe me, when you see and smell this stuff you won't be eating two teaspoons in ten sittings, let alone as one serving. So far, I have put it in clam chowder because it's already fishy tasting anyway.If you are interested in getting more potassium and magnesium, I suggest Naked Juice or Bolthouse Farms Banana-strawberry juice. It has a ton of potassium and tastes pretty good. Also, you can just eat lots of fresh fruits and veggies and accomplish the same thing.

I love these dulse flakes.  I make peanut sauce noodles very frequently and dulse flakes are a great addition that is healthy.  It's a great source especially of iodine but also iron, vitamin B6, and B12.  Low in sodium although they add a salty flavor!

I bought these because I had used pureed sweet potato when my puppy had a stomach ache, and he really liked it. However, the pieces are quite big for a small puppy, and it took him a while to chew it up. He must not have been able to chew it up small enough, though, because he later threw up and there were large pieces of the sweet potato chips in his vomit! I would recommend these for an adult dog, or a puppy who is a better chewer and doesn't have a sensitive stomach. I guess I can hold on to these till he gets bigger, or when all his adult teeth have grown in.

These cookies are great and this is the best value I've found after searching around. I first had one of these cookies at Smoothie King and was impressed with the taste, lack of dairy, and the protein/calorie content (high for muscle building/increasing to a healthy weight).  Great for a protein boosting snack or boosting protein to build new muscle after a nice workout.The cookies are large--about 4.5 inches in diameter and look/taste very similar to the more familiar Alt. Baking Co.(ABC) lemon poppyseed cookies you can find at most health food stores.  I learned that the L&L cookies have way more protein, and more iron and calcium with a smidge less sugar.  Perhaps L&L don't have as high quality ingredients (???), but they are over a dollar cheaper per cookie when you compare the bulk prices to ABC. Thought that'd be an easy comparison that could save someone else some time.  `As I'm looking at the packaging for the cookie to write this review, I am noticing several typos in the ingredient list--seems there are still some kinks to get out, but hey, the cookie itself can't be beat!

I have had these as a subscribe and save item for a while. The first couple boxes were fine, but the last two have been stale, even though the "sell by date" is months ahead. I have emailed the Lenny and Larry website, but never got a response. I had Amazon refund the last box, and I guess I will give them one more try before I give up.

Finally a vegan cookie that has flavor options and have some good, nutritional stuff in them. We've tried all of the flavors of these and they are all delicious. Pumpkin is my personal favorite.  My daughter's favorite is the lemon poppy, my husband the peanut butter and my son the chocolate/chocolate chip. We just buy them all now. :) We are vegan and there is no sign of animal products that we can find. These need to be split in two, but we love to share in our house anyway. I sometimes split mine in two and eat 1/2 with my coffee and then half for dessert later. They have so much fiber and protein in them, I'm surprised at how good they are.

I actually bought this product as a gift for a friend that loves protein bars/cookies and especially those from Lenny & Larry, so I knew this would be a home run. I has previously tried their peanut butter cookie and liked it, so it was no surprise that I enjoyed this flavor as well! I love the idea that it's healthy while being a really tasty treat - it almost feels wrong! It is more dense than what people would be used to for a cookie, but it shouldn't alarm you since it's not a snack, but rather packed with protein, nutrients and vitamins. You won't be disappointed with its flavor or its purpose to be a complete cookie.

I'm surprised there aren't reviews about these yet! I first came upon them at Whole Foods and am happy to see them offered as a subscribe & save item here. I haven't tried the other flavors, but I can definitely stand by the lemon poppyseed cookie -- it's not too sweet, not too lemony tart, and soft and chewy -- really tasty. Bonus that they are vegan, but what I really like is the amount of protein packed in. I stick to having half a cookie at a time since that amounts to about to the same amount of calories as a Luna or Zone bar (which average 9 or 10g of protein). Still, for 15g of protein in the entire cookie, 360 calories isn't horrible, considering it's really a dessert, too. I'll venture out to the other flavors soon!

I wanted so badly to love this cookie and unfortunately it's just not my cup of tea. It definitely tastes like a "healthy cookie" and the texture is extremely gummy. I tried dressing this up with some chocolate and even dipping it in milk and nothing really made this what I wanted it to be. If you're looking for a delicious lemon poppy seed cookie, I definitely suggest buying the one from the Alternative Baking Company. Their version is absolutely delicious and so beautifully lemon-y. Sorry Lenny and Larry... you just didn't do it for me. :(

I ordered this pack after reading reviews of many other products as well and happy to say I wasn't disappointed at all. I love white chocolate so naturally I loved that flavor the best. Although I don't like dark chocolate, that too was not bad! I mean I would drink it and like it even. I wish we could customize what we wanna have in the pack though. If so I would order most of it (if not all) to be white, being the white choc fan I am. But in no way that means other flavors are bad.It is sweet and true to the label (no need to add anything else other than water).
Land of Lakes is the best instant hot chocolate I have ever tasted. I liked all the flavors except dark chocolate.

I first found these a few years ago in a local store but they are only available around the Christmas season so I was very pleased to find them on Amazon who never fails me.  Obviously at this price they aren't gourmet but they all do have a good taste and it's so convenient to just open up a packet.  They also aren't that high calorie for those counting them.

My family loves this cocoa!  We have purchased this selection before and will do so again.  Usually this is a treat we enjoy in colder months but we ordered this in July.  The flavor selection is excellent-there is truly something for everyone and not an "off" flavor in the bunch.  We highly recommend.

I don't drink tea or coffee so hot chocolate is my go to warm-me-up drink! I have always been happy and satisfied with Swiss Miss or Nestle as long as I used a packet and a half to make it a little more chocolaty but after this I don't know if I can go back! I got this pack as a Christmas gift and it is so delicious and rich that when I finished the last of these packets off I was ultra disappointed with my cup of Nestle's (even with two packets in it it tasted too watery!) I even mixed flavors for fun like rasperry with vanilla or graham with artic white and they turned out great! Fun variety pack to find your favorites and the best packet hot chocolate mix I've ever tasted!
I am not a coffee or tea drinker. I love hot chocolate and the flavors are great, especially in early morning.

You will not receive AT ALL what the product describes! I got only 35 packets, and I had about 25 tiramisu flavored, which is not very good! It should not say you get six of each flavor, that was a blatant lie.

The different varieties are all good. I enjoyed all the flavors. Mixing them with hot water was very tasty, but they're even better with hot milk.The only downside is each pouch is only good for 6 oz. That's a pretty small cup.

Land O Lakes really makes fantastic hot cocoa. It is intended to be mixed with hot water, but I always leave room for a fair amount of milk. The result is the best you can get from a powdered mix - creamy and chocolaty. That said, I'm not wowed by the flavored cocoas. My kids like the raspberry and french vanilla but those flavors are too sweet for my taste. We all agree, though, that the mint and cinnamon are really good. That's why I was so disappointed to receive this collection and discover no mint or cinnamon in it. The photo shows cinnamon but it's not there, and it turns out the green box is the graham flavor, which none of us like. The dark chocolate was also substituted (I was looking forward to trying that one!). In summary, great cocoa brand but poor selection and not as pictured.

column9: Rich Even When Made With Water
column10: I first stumbled onto Land O'Lakes Cocoa Variety Packs at my local branch of a national warehouse store. As some other reviewers have noted, in retail stores this product is treated as a seasonal item, so by the time the winter holidays have passed, you may not be able to just run out and purchase it. It's a pity that it sells for so much more online because it is a really delicious hot cocoa.All the included varieties are made with real powdered milk, which makes such a difference in your final cup. There aren't many instant cocoas that can compete with homemade, but this is one that might. The varieties included in your pack do seem somewhat inconsistent, since different sellers claim the same "7 Variety Pack" but have different pictures and item descriptions. The sampler I had contained Supreme, Arctic White, White Chocolate with Peppermint, Caramel, Raspberry, Dark Chocolate and Vanilla. The other flavors that appear (either in product descriptions or photos) are Tiramisu, Graham, Cinnamon and Mint. Generally speaking, all of the mixes are quite good. I found the Dark to be a bit too dark for my tastes, and the Arctic White a bit too sweet; I solved the problem by mixing the two powders together, half a packet of each per cup, and loved the result.Another nice thing about these Land O'Lakes Cocoa Packs is that the individual pouches are all tin, not just paper, so they stay fresh a long time. In my house, they didn't last a terribly long time regardless, but the last cups were just as creamy and warming as the first ones. I highly recommend trying out the Variety Packs. They're perfect for large gatherings (just add hot water!) and there really aren't any bad flavors.

column9: tasty but not a gift pack
column10: Love the creamy taste of this cocoa but don't expect this to come as a gift pack.I received this item as a gift from a friend. The boxes were packaged together in cellophane & made a nice gift presentation. I liked it so much that I ordered two more as gifts. When they arrived the individual packages were just thrown into a mailing carton loose.I was there when the one family opened their box and i was so disappointed that it was not in the gift pack as i had expected. I am sure they are enjoying the cocoa anyway.I notified the seller twice.Each time they said they do not gift wrap. I did not want gift wrap, just the 'gift pack' as described. I gave up trying to make them understand.I feel for the $30+ i could have made up a much nicer gift bag on my own!

column9: The Best of the Imported Brands of Pasta
column10: Disclaimer: My mother-in-law spoiled her sons by making them homemade pasta any time they wanted it.  It was only when my DH went of to college that he had to experience the horror of boxed pasta.  Over the years he has realized that even the best of wives does not make homemade macaroni after a long day at work, and that he needs to eat boxed pasta.  (arrrgh)But there's boxed pasta and some stuff that calls itself boxed pasta that is decidedly inferior.  DeCecco is about as close to homemade as you are going to get without making it yourself.The spaghetti is a nice, mid weight string of pasta, with a good texture, bouncing back a bit when you bite it, and having a firm semolina texture. Little or no starch bleeds off in the water, and the pasta only absorbs enough to be cooked, no mushy macaroni here! Each variety has a preferred cooking time; if you follow that with a timer, you'll always be right.This spaghetti is a little pricey in the grocery store, which has to buy it from an Italian importer in relatively small quantities. Because of its price, it's unlikely that it turns over quickly and you aren't likely to get the best DeCecco around. The DeCecco Spaghetti from Amazon must turn over very quickly, because I always get very fresh product for a much smaller sum than in my market. Having to buy five boxes is no hardship for us -- we could buy three times that and still eat it all up in no time.If you haven't tried imported Italian macaroni, do yourself a favor: buy a case of this spaghetti and treat yourself with the lightest sauce you have.  Put a teaspoon of virgin olive oil in the boiling water to minimize sticking, and cook for the exact length of time suggested on the box.  Add sauce as soon as you finish draining.You won't believe that this is the same kind of food that they sell as macaroni at your local market. Be sure to make plenty for everyone.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: All things considered, this spaghetti ties for best taste and texture out of all dried pasta I've tried. The other brand is a very pricey import and frankly not so leaps and bounds above DeCecco that it would be worth the extra dollars to compare.This is the kind of pasta that can be eaten with just a simple dressing of olive oil and a few shavings of real parmesan cheese. Does beautifully with heavier sauces too though like a good beefy bolognese.Very pleased with this product and highly recommended.

column9: Simply put, it is the BEST.
column10: Feb 3, 2012"Simply put, De Cecco pasta is the BEST."I'm certainly no expert, but I have eaten a lot of pasta (fresh and dry) - both here (the USA) and throughout many of the regions of Italy. For my taste, De Cecco brand dry pasta is, in all respects, the BEST.  It cooks very well - holds up to and through the point of al dente without becoming mushy. Based on several different blind taste tests of plain pastas (without any toppings whatsoever - just removed from boiling, salted water at al dente), the De Cecco brand of pasta usually wins every time; at least, according to my pallet. Rustichella d' Abruzzo is another great brand of dry pasta, but it is really pricy; and, besides, the De Cecco brand, as I've already mentioned, usually comes out ahead (taste-wise) in the blind taste-tests that I have partricipated in.Both De Cecco and Rustichella d' Abruzzo can be purchased through Amazon.com.

I stopped purchasing other brands of spaghetti because the De Cecco brand is far superior in taste and quality.My local supermarket has this item for around $3.00 a box and are usually limited on supply so its wonderful purchasing this item on amazon and you cant go wrong with the price.De Cecco all the way for now on!

De Cecco Spaghetti is a very dilicious pasta that can go with tomatoes sauce and meat ball.  I also like to saute this spaghetti with onion, brocolli, and chicken breast.

I am a pasta lover. The quality of the pasta means a lot to me. Previous to subscribing to DeCecco spaghetti, I was in the habit of hunting down cases of Giuseppe Cocco spaghetti, and frankly, paying too much. Free freight was hard to come by.  Then one day as I leafed through a copy of Cook's magazine, I noticed an article that discussed and rated brands of pasta. Although my favorite  Giuseppe Cocco pasta wasn't rated, the editors chose DeCecco as their all-around favorite, and one of the reasons was that it was made in a more time-intensive way with a coarser ground semolina flour for a better product.  I thought I'd give it another try. My attitude had been that it was overpriced and often picked up a cardboard flavor from the packaging, especially if stored for awhile. I was pleasantly surprised by my first shipment. The boxes are better quality now and don't give off a taste to the product. The spaghetti cooks up very well--good flavor, nice springy "chew," good window of time for al dente doneness, doesn't break apart. At the subscription price of $2/lb, it's very close in quality to Giuseppe Cocco which is about $6-7/lb, so I'm quite happy with my subscription, but five pounds a month runs out too fast. How about seven or eight pounds a month?

column9: Thomas Jefferson couldn't just buy this at a local store, but YOU can
column10: Yes, this actually is better than standard spaghetti.  Common dried spaghetti tends to get mushy and break apart.  Even if cooked carefully, you probably notice that it is difficult to get your spaghetti to that "al dente" perfection.De Cecco pasta is denser and more durable, and cooks easily to a nice firm state.  It also has a rougher texture on the surface, which is supposed to help sauce stick to it."The best maccaroni in Italy is made with a particularsort of flour called Semola, in Naples: but in almostevery shop a different sort of flour is commonly used;for, provided the flour be of a good quality, is notground extremely fine, it will always do very well."- from Thomas Jefferson's notes on pasta, 1787While it is true that good pasta in Italy is typically made of Semola (or "semolina" as we call it), it is also true that, as Jefferson noted, there are quality issues involved in the manufacturing of pasta.  De Cecco isn't good because it uses semola (as do most Italian-style pastas in the US), it is good because it is made well.  Your everyday store brand of spaghetti is ground to oblivion out of any quality level of semola they can get their hands on, and the result is pasta which tends to turn to slush.
DE CECCO makes excellent products. Any of their pastas are excellent and easy to prepare. An Italian staple for everyday cooking.

column10: I thought it was.  I haven't found much difference in all the spaghettis I have tried over the years...until I tried this one.  In a word it is just plain "nasty".  I think all the others who have given 5 stars here have lost their sense of taste.  Buy anything else but this!!!

This spaghetti makes for some good food, but it certainly doesn't make the best shoes. I was advised to buy this specific spaghetti (De Cecco) along with a chocolate shoe mold (which doubles as a real shoe mold) in order to make my own shoes. After successfully crafting the shoes (after dehydrating them via baking), I tried them out. Note: the chocolate shoe mold doesn't offer different sizes, so the shoes were a bit smug. I won't let that impact my current review, however; I am focused on the spaghetti.Unfortunately, I have to label the shoes as a failure for several reasons:Durability: the packaging doesn't warn you, but as soon as you bake the previously boiled noodles, they tend to crack without too much strain. I am 14 pounds, and I cracked my right shoes after 2 steps. The left held out for 14.5 steps (a large gust of wind was the source of demise). Needless to say, I had to make 7 pairs of shoes to make it to the bathroom.Shock absorber: after baking the noodles, they refused to give as they tried to act as a medium between the ground and my feet. I suffer from lower-back problems, and the incessant cracking of the noodles absorbed shock temporarily, but failed to work for too long (steps 3-14.5 for the left foot)Style options: Sadly, De Cocco doesn't offer spaghetti in a variety of colors, such as turquoise and violet. I like to branch out from the norm, and I find myself with similar shoes to my peers as a result of the manufacturer's failure to diversify.These are three of the primary reasons that I have to label the spaghetti as "minimally versatile."

column10: This is delicious - it's not like the usual "gourmet" kiwi jam where mostly you only taste a sugar gooyness with no hint of actual kiwi, this has the full texture and flavor of the yummy little fruits. column9: Gritty, Obscene recipie and a metallic taste to boot!
column10: I'm not an organic person, so i don't normally order organic items. With that in mind, take this review with a grain of salt, as I'm comparing them to normal regular foods.The recipe on the side of the can calls for 2 cups of mix. the can itself is 2 and 2/3 cups in size. column10: This is the best stuff I have tried that's sour. I shared my warheads with my brothers!!! They loved it!

So, I was a kid when these first came out. They were really, really popular. ..anybody who was anybody ate warheads. I think the reason they were so popular was because kids would have contests-who could eat the most of these, who could hold it the longest before spitting the thing out, who could get the most in their mouth at one time...it was a status thing, basically. Most of us were a little scared of the candies because there would always be rumors of some kid in New Jersey who ate too many and whose tongue fell off-as far as I know that never actually happened, but when you're 7 or 8 you don't know that. Our moms probably started that one. However, if you ate too many your tongue would eventually go kind of numb and feel raw like you burnt off all your tastebuds, so the theory that someone's tongue burnt off altogether seemed pretty plausible. They'd also give you a stomachache.So, as far as sour candies go, these are the sourest I know of. Just thinking about them still makes my lips pucker. However, they really didn't taste that good. I remember Black Cherry was by favorite, but the other ones I wouldn't touch. Good memories all around, though!

****This Cranberry Weightless tea is lovely, and has a marvelous taste. It seems to work as a diuretic, which isn't a bad thing, since it does so by promoting urological health. It probably does contribute to "Weightless" (weighing less) but only by ridding your body of excess water; still, if it can do this in a healthy way, I'm all for it. I like drinking it as a calming ritual before meals, which for me has some value, too. It seems to work for me; even more importantly, I enjoy it.The ingredients in Traditional Medicinal's Weightless Cranberry are: bitter fennel fruit 150 mg, red clover blossom 150 mg, uva ursi leaf 135 mg, cranberry fruit concentrate 60 mg, cleavers herb 52.5 mg., as well as a proprietary blend of: organic hibiscus flower, organic roasted chicory root, organic parsley leaf, and organic stevia leaf.Weightless Cranberry is part of a line by Traditional Medicinals that includes the original Weightless and a Weightless Cinnamon-Spice.Traditional Medicinals seems to be a responsible company. They adhere to sustainable and fair trade practices, use organic ingredients when feasible, and base their tea formulations on sound research and knowledge.The brewing instructions for this tea are very important: "For maximum benefit, medicinal tea must be properly prepared. Pour 8 oz. freshly boiled water over a tea bag in a cup. Cover cup and steep 10-15 minutes. These steps directly influence the amount of beneficial components that will end up in your teacup! Gently squeeze the tea bag to release any remaining extract.Drink 3 cups daily, one cup before each meal, for up to 2 weeks, then pause a few days before resuming." So, Weightless is a long-brewing pre-prandial tea...if you want it to work properly.Also note the following cautions: "Cautions: Tea containing bitter fennel fruit and uva ursi leaf are not for long-term daily use without medical advice. Contraindications: Not for use during pregnancy, while nursing, or by children under 12 years. Side Effects: Teas containing uva ursi leaf may cause nausea or vomiting in individuals and children with sensitive stomachs."****

Our fat orange tabby had been on Science Diet all 9 years of his life. He started hurling on the carpet more then usual (usual being kitty revenge for some slight) so we contacted my boyfriend's sister who has been a vet for over 15 years. She said sometimes manufacturers just change the ratios or ingredients in a cat food and it doesn't set well with some consumers. Eukanuba was one of the recommended brands -- a kennel I worked at in college swore by it -- so we weaned him onto it and no issues since. I'd recommend it solely because he's picky ( hates treats, milk, cream, tuna fish oil ... Everything ) and because it settled his stomach.

I have a 12 year old female who is over 15 pounds and my vet recommended a lower fat dry food.  I switched to this food and for about 8 months did not notice any improvement in her weight.  What I did notice was at least 3 times a week blood outside her litter box after she had a bowel movement and a regular routine of vomiting. I became alarmed and brought her to my vet.  After a full "costly" check up, he asked me what food she was on.  When I told him he told me that it was not the first time he heard of problems with this brand.  I started giving her 1/2 and 1/2 wet food in the morning and Innova Cat and Kitten in the evening, problem totally solved!  It's been over a month and not only are the bloody stools gone, but no more throwing up.  Be very cautious with this food.

Eukanuba is a well-respected name in pet foods, and it's a bit pricier than some other big brands.  So when we wanted to switch our cat Caesar from Iam's and saw this on sale, I figured that I was getting quite a bargain.  Oh the folly...Chicken by-product meal, Corn grits and corn meal are three of the four top ingredients.  This is what the high cost buys - by-products and corn?  If we wanted to continue giving him crappy ingredients then we'd have kept buying Iams and saved the cash (not to mention the fact that Caesar actually liked it)!  I imagine the weight-loss claim is probably true, because my cat would eat just enough of this to get by...he hated it!  We decided to change to a new brand after half a bag, phasing the new food in with the Eukanuba  in growing proportions.  Throughout this short period, the kibble from the other brand was always gone first.If Caesar had liked it, I probably wouldn't stick with it on principle...I don't think I should pay top-dollar for substandard ingredients.  Luckily, Caesar came to that conclusion all by himself!

Eukanuba Cat Indoor Weight Control and HairballThis is probably one of the best kitty foods I've bought. I think it's very effective with hairballs. I still have to wait a little longer to see if it's effective with weight control.

column9: My dogs will wake from a coma when they smell these!
column10: I have 6 dogs... 1 takes valley fever pills & two are on thyroid pills and from time to time they require other medication.They however are NOT willing to take it. Cheese, Peanut Butter, Cream Cheese etc. I've tried it all & They are wise to my tricks!The Pill Pockets are great. They are so pliable that I just break off a piece of one, mold it around the pill and my dogs will nearly take my fingers off to get it!.One of my dogs is deaf and when she is sleeping she has no idea we are there.. If I wave the Pill Pocket in front of her nose she wakes up and snatches it like a shark!They are a bit expensive, but they last awhile if you just pull off the size needed for the pill.. It's a waste to use a whole one per pill. I can get about 4-5 pills out of 1 pocket.(using the large ones)

We have 2 dogs who are expert at ferreting out pills stuffed in anything and able to eat around them. Even the pill pockets did not work at first with our pickiest. However, after molding the pocket around the pill, I tried running some water over the glob and smoothing it all around with my finger. This made the pocket better sealed and created a gravy-like coating that even he now eats without hesitation. I think I may have finally proven to be smarter than a dog.

column9: Perfect Solution for my pet's meds
column10: We have a very clever Rottie/Shepherd mix who HATES taking medicine. We tried everything - cheese cubes, hot dogs, chicken breast - and she always found a way to spit the pills out. I had resigned myself to force feeding her medicine until my friend suggested pill pockets. They are great - with a texture almost like moist clay. It is therefore possible to mold them around large and small pills. My dog really likes them. Definitely worth the purchase price!

column9: Wonderful product, but do the math to ensure a good deal
column10: First, Pill Pockets are a GREAT product that really works... before Pill Pockets, I only had a 50% success rate getting our three dogs to take their pills when we used hotdogs and even steak leftovers. With Pill Pockets, the pill always goes "down"! [Note: DON'T waste your money buying Pill Pockets for cats if you have dogs. I read a review (listed under another seller) that stated that it was more economical to buy the PillPockets for cats because you receive 45 instead of 35.
