Well, the reviewer failed to notice that the Pill Pockets for Cats only weighs 1.8 ounces, and the Pill Pockets (Small bag) for Dogs weighs 3.5 ounces!]Buy the bag that, per ounce, is the least money. The Pill Pockets are like Beef Playdoh, and are easy to tear in half (we tear each one in half and wrap 1/2 around the dog's medication). Do a little research, and you'll save money. BTW, the multi-bag deals online at Amazon are not necessarily a good deal, be sure to divide the total cost by the number of bags you receive to see if you're saving $$.NOTE: The size listed on the Pill Pocket's bag indicates the size of the pill pocket, not the dog. Large meds require larger Pill Pockets; small meds like phenobarbital require only the small or a piece of a large pill pocket. These things are great, and go down my dogs easily.
These things are great!  Even my most fussy eater takes pills now without a moments hesitation.  Well worth the extra money!

This is the best way to give our dogs pills! We've tried other methods to get our dogs to take their medicine without success. The Pill Pockets and pills disappear instantly! Our seven-year-old arthritic cocker spaniel would find the pill in a piece of hot dog or hamburger and spit it out every time but with the Pill Pockets, she gulps it down! She can't wait to get her 'morning treat' every day!! Great product!!

I love, love, love this product! You never have to be slobered with saliva again trying to get your dog to take a pill, or pick up a saliva drenched pill off the floor! I actually get the bigger size and put 2 pills together in one pill pocket to save money. They are very soft, so even big pills will work with them. I put it in and kind of mold it to cover the top of the pill...takes a second. She loves them and it's her daily "treat"...I don't feel bad tricking her...she loves it.

The pill pockets are the best way to administer tablet medication that I have found. All my dogs, I have 3, devour them.  I would use them for training aids, but for a regular training use it would be expensive. However medicine time is special treat time and the "kids" will do just about anything to get their pill pocket

I have a 13 year old Beagle that I took in last year.  He is now on 6-7 different medications/day, 5 of which are in pill form.  The capsule pill pockets can fit 3 of those pills in just one treat!  He quickly got sick of cheese, cream cheese, peanut butter, and I didn't feel too great about the butter my mom tried so I tried these.  They work great! Without taking his medications regularly, he would get terribly sick and probably not last long.  The pill pockets have made the mornings of me force feeding pills history and given me peace of mind.  I'm grateful to have found them.  Though I am currently looking for a place I can get them in bulk, cheaper, since I use about two a day.  I recommend them to anyone having trouble giving pills to their dog.

column9: Greenies Beef Pill Pockets for Dogs
column10: I have a very finicky, old dog that is a pro at detecting medications. I had been unable to hide any medication he took on any type of food or product until I discovered these Pill Pockets. They were recommended by our vet, and they work! They are much more affordable online than at the local pet specialty stores.

column9: The BEST thing for medicating animals since....
column10: These pockets have helped me immensely! I take care of special needs dogs of which many are on daily meds. It is so convenient to be able to put their meds in a Pill Pocket and toss them in with their food. Dogs LOVE them and gobble them up like a treat. These are a must for anyone who has to medicate their animals on a regular basis.

column9: My dogs love the Pill Pockets!
column10: The Greenies Pill Pockets make giving any type of medicine so much easier. My dogs know when I just open the bag! I have 3 dogs and they all love it! I have to watch that I get the medicine in the pocket before I put it anywhere in reach of the dogs - they love it that much. I am forever done with cheese and bread and trying to wrap a pill in them - these are so much better and easier. I love them.

Not only did I get an excellent price on the Pill Pockets but the turnaround time, using standard shipping, was 3 days from the time I placed my order until it was delivered.  I understand why they have such a high Feedback Rating and it is well deserved.

Pill Pockets are the only way my dog will take his meds short of embedding them in a porterhouse steak.  These capsule sized pockets are ideal for the larger pills and capsules my dog takes on a daily basis.  This is a great savings over what my vet charges.

column9: These saved my relationship with my cat!
column10: My cat has to take TWO different blood pressure medicines now TWICE a day (I've had her for 14 years- she's worth the trouble). One of the pills is apparently very bitter- and the only way I could get her to take it was to "pill" her with it, straight, everyday. It was torture for her and for me. The vet recommended these (he had the beef flavored ones for dogs on hand) and it worked! The cat loves them and eats her hidden, bitter pill everyday without needing to be "pilled" anymore. We're both very happy! :)

These Greenies Pill Pockets make giving pills to dogs a breeze.  Just tear off enough to cover the pill, save some "blanks" as encouraging treats, and your fussy dog will swallow even big pills like his favorite treats.  Especially useful for covering sharp edges of split pills, or masking what might have been bitter tasting to the dog.  No fuss, no clenched jaws, no snapping at you for forcing a pill down his throat.  A BLESSING!  And, NO discovering "spat out" expensive wasted pills or worry over missed doses.
Good to do business with I look forward to doing business with them in the future.
In the past, I have had a difficult time getting my dogs to take medication. Using this product, they always remind ME that it is treat time.

column9: Gets Lilly the Pug to take her meds!!
column10: This product was recommended to me by a good friend. Lilly needs daily meds and in true Pug fashion ate the snack & spit out the pills. Now she looks forward to her daily vet approved 'treat' and Pill Pockets assures me that her daily meds are a breeze! Great product!!!

One quarter of a capsule-sized pill pocket is enough to cover a huge human-sized glucosamine pill. My dog inhales it! Pills used to be wrapped in cheese, but the dog stopped eating them this way.If your dog is fussy, buy a bag to try it. I think both you and your dog will love it.The pill pocket in Beef flavor does not have any effect on my dog's sensitive stomach (she has food allergies).

My schnauzer, Jake, has to take a pill everyday and these pill pockets, make it a breeze to give it to him.  He loves them.  I break them in half and since they are soft, you can just mold it around that tablet.  Then they can go twice as far.

This is the best number one way to hide pills from dogs. I have to give my dog a daily medication and this works wonders. Just make sure to follow the directions about smell transfer. Also, let it soak for a good minute! But after that, the dog loves it!
Service was great, and our dog loves the product.  They even work on gelcaps.

I bought this for my sister to use with her difficult dog.  She said she had tried EVERYTHING from peanut butter to cheese and it was always a trial to get the pill inside the dog.  Now, the dog begs for his pills in the pill pocket.  She actually just breaks a piece off and mushes the pill in it thus extending the pill pockets.  We joke that the pill pockets are like crack for dogs!

Pill pockets have been great for my dog who got tired of taking several pills and vitamins every day. He loves both the chicken and beef flavors, and thinks they are treats, even though there are many other types of treats he refuses.  I buy both the Large and Small pockets, mainly for variety, although regardless of pill size, you can use the large ones and just tear them apart to accommodate 2 or 3 smaller pills to get more for your money. The pockets are very soft and can be molded around any pill or capsule. They are much easier to deal with than using peanut butter or hot dogs, and if you're dog loves them, as most even picky dogs do, it is worth the cost to avoid pilling stress. The best prices are by ordering in bulk & checking the prices (& shipping fees) on Amazon once you are sure your dog likes them. Buying these at a local vet or pet store usually costs at least twice as much as online. Even my picky cat likes them as treats - but he hasn't tried them with pills inside yet.

I have two dogs, one of which takes seven or eight pills twice a day.  I fit them into two capsule sized pill pockets and he enjoys taking them...in fact, my other dog is jealous that she only gets one tablet sized pill pocket.  I used cream cheese, peanut butter, etc but eventually they always tired of it and the pill was ruined to boot.  Warning: pack these separately from pet food cans and other heavy objects or they will get smashed.  My dog has a very sensitive stomach but we have had no problems with these, although we have only tried the beef flavor.  I highly recommend them!

Since they don't offer the beef flavor for cats, I bought these just on a whim.  Well, I can actually get 3 pills out of one pocket from these and not only does that make them more economical, the cat loves them too!  They look disgusting, if you can catch my drift, but once you get past that, they're a great find.  Highly recommend!

I did some checking on the pill pockets and this was the best purchase rate.  Delivery was prompt which was great.  I am always buying these because I have several dogs of which get vit. pills, and other meds.Wonderful item

This product is a miracle.  My dog is so picky and won't eat just any treat.  Well, of course giving her a pill is not fun.  I was at the pet store today and the salesperson told me about this product.  We were skeptical but we figured why not try it.  Seriously, I put the pill in the pocket and squeezed.  My dog actually gobbled it up.  I was in shock! I highly recommend you try this product!!!!!

This product is ingenious!! My Rottie mix will run from anywhere in the house if she even thinks I'm opening the package. She has 3 different illnesses which force her to have to be on meds for at least a year, maybe more and this makes it so much easier on her and on me! HIGHLY recommend!!

Pill pockets is a great product.  My 13 year old golden retriever has to take 5 pills a day, and before I used to have to hide them in cheese.  Now with pill pockets, I just stick the pills in the pocket, and they are huge pills too, and he doesn't even know he is getting a pill.  And he just loves them too.  He thinks he is getting treats and looks forward to getting his pills every day.
This is an amazing product !!  My dogs think they are getting a treat !!

I have an old Chocolate Lab that has to take 3 different pills a day. She would spit the pills out if I hid them in cheese, cream cheese, etc. I purchased pill pockets and I am now able to feed her her pills and she doesn't spit them out. I have used both chicken & beef flavors and she loves them both, it is like another treat!

column9: Those Pill Pockets did a wonder
column10: I have Shiba Inu, this dog is extremely picky.I like to give my dogs (I have two) natural stuff as much as I can.I was giving my dogs garlic/brewers yeast pills against fleas.My Shiba refuses to eat any pills and because my two dogs keep eating each other food I could not add it there.Those Pill Pockets did a wonder; they made my life so much easier.I buy bigger one which is for capsules and I put three pills in one, and my Shiba absolutely loves it. I would recommend to by capsules size, even if you have to give your dog one small pill, you always can cut one pocket a half and it will save you a lot of money - you will use one pocket for two pills.

My dog loves these. The only problem that I found (my dog is nearly 12 and seems to be developing a sensitive tummy in his old age) is that they may not agree with my dogs tummy. They are fabulous and if you have a dog with a sensitive tummy, but don't need to use them more than once a day and can use the smaller size you'd probably be ok. The pills that my dog is taking are large joint pills which require the larger size pill pocket and he takes them twice a day. I stress that this is a maybe. Just something to consider before you buy if you have a dog with a sensitive stomach.

Great product!  These work wonderfully and my dog always eats them.  Maybe it's because he's a lab and will eat anything anyways.  The pill pockets are 100 times better than shoving my hand down my dog's throat to give him his medicine!

For people who do not have extra time or is not a baker, these mini tarts are absolutely fabulous! I fill them with a cream filling to make a fruit tart. They are especially made for a sweet filling. Most pre-made things are out of a phyllo dough. They have fancy baking cups to set them in and it  makes them very fancy.

column9: A great tea for healthy blood sugar
column10: I drink this tea regularly after meals and my blood sugar is better than ever! After a month of regular use, you can actually see it working whenever you check your blood sugar. I'd recommend this product to anyone with high blood sugar.

Adds sweetness and moistness to quick breads and cookies. I've also made a yeasted bread using part sweet potato flour, part whole wheat flour.  Works very well as a gluten-free flour.  Awesome nutritional profile.

I bought this because I thought it was the same as white sweet potato flour. I was disappointed but then after I baked cookies w/ it, they were actually good. Gluten-free, egg-free, dairy-free.  Will taste great though if you added eggs.I thought I'd share my recipe1 cup sweet potato flour1/4 cup canola oil(or safflower)1/8 cup honey1/4 cup water (or any other non-dairy milk substitute)a dash of salt1/2 TB baking powderOptional: chocolate chip cookies, shredded coconut and or almond pieces or any other nuts.Mix everything and roll into small balls. Flatten on cookie sheet covered with baking sheet. Bake for 10-14 minutes or til firm. They burn easily so watch.
Love this flour! Adds nice flavor, texture, and moistness to baked goods. Got a few recipes up on my blog if any interested - purelytwins.com

Wish there had been more recipes on the bag.  I have been adding sweet potato flour to recipes substituting it for some of the regular flour.  Works well but I'd  really like a recipe for sweet potato pancakes.

I received a set of leaves that I will be using to decorate my wedding cake with, they are amazing!  They are very realistic looking.  My order contained orange, yellow, and brown (still contained the correct number that was listed in the order info).  It was supposed to come with red leaves as well.  I emailed sugar robot and I was sent an additional 24 red leaves without cost in a very timely manner.  Customer service was excellent and the product is beautiful!

I recieved these leaves 2 days after the last day of the estimated delivery date. Also they were very small, and looked like they used wafer paper in a printer and printed edible pictures of leaves. They look nothing like the picture shown. I bought them for my wedding cupcakes and I will not be using them. Maybe they would be good for a fun activity with kids, but not for a elegant wedding.
Good tasting granola.  Seems to be gluten-free.  I have celiacs/gluten intolerance and I'm able to eat this when I'm not able to eat a lot of other granolas.

My dad loves granola, and we used to purchase the Heartland granola with subscribe and save. It was a great deal, and very convenient, but it is no longer available through subscribe and save, and the purchasing options are much more expensive, so we looked for an alternative. Sweet Home Farm is a good granola and it uses natural ingredients; however, it is more expensive. It is still much cheaper than the grocery store: our local store carries the individual Sweet Home Farms cartons (same as in this case) for $7.99/each. It's sold in cartons like small milk cartons, so there is a minimum of packaging.
I've looked and looked for a decent granola cereal, finally found it in this.  You actually feel full when you are done with a bowl, and the flavor and texture are perfect.  Highly recommended!

I sat and read each and every interview...until I couldn't stand it anymore and had to write my own.  The "new" mountain bars are OK-that's all.  The "original" mountain bars were "great".  They were taller, thicker, heavier, better looking etc.  Two of my aunts retired with Brown & Haley so I am sure I am correct.  Not only have the bars shrunk considerably...they are all made flatter due to being stamped out by machine.  There used to be more peanut bits on the surface...you could see them and you could really taste them.  No offense everyone but you don't really remember the original bars.  Ain't progress great?!!

I lived in Tacoma and bought mounyain bars from the factory.  I really liked them.  Now they are extremely downsized from what I remember.  Also, they now mix the nuts into the chocolate.  The bar is not coated with nuts now.I can't find then in stores locally, so I ordered some on Amazon.Bill BreiteSouth San Francisco
This is the best candy bar in the world. I used to buy them at Yardbirds in Chehalis when I'd visit my grandparents. I wish they sold them here in North Carolina.

Mountain bars are just as delicious as they were when I was a kid. They really shrunk in size though.For taste I would give 5 stars but every single bar came melted into a blob. So for this review they should be renamed Blob bars.They could have done a better job packing them.

I've loved these since I was a child.  The chocolate is a distinctively different flavor as compared to the typical milk chocolate that the national brands are made from.  The only problem with getting so many at once would be how to stop eating them!  Any candy bar fan should try these.
Made in my home state Washington. Made by Brown and Haley of Almond roca fame. Creamy vanilla filling with peanut encrusted chocolate on the outside. Yummy!
I used to get Mountain Bars all the time as a kid growing up in Oakland, CA. I am happy to see they haven't changed a bit..still the same size and the same yummy taste I remember.
I wish there was more popcorn per bag, this is the most delicious I've ever had! The black truffle and white cheddar go together well.

As a snackaholic, I decided to give this Black Truffle & White Cheddar popcorn a try. Afterall, I figured the air popped popcorn has got to be healthier than my usual potato chips. I was totally impressed! The flavor of the cheddar cheese is nice and light, not overpowering. The subtle flavors of the oil and salt are a perfect complement to the cheese. Combine the flavors and you have a delicious and rather healthy popcorn snack.

I grew up on Sunmaid raisins and when they started to cover them with chocolate I thought I was in heaven.  I cannot get enough for these things it is dangerous, lol.I find the chocolate is smooth and creamy and a nice intensity, the raisins are always soft and chewy.  These are perfect.

I absolutely love Raisenettes so I jumped at the bargain price, but never again.  The raisinettes were firm when I had expected them to be fresh, soft and juicy like the boxes I'd been buying from the supermarket.  I learned my lesson with this purchase -- next time, just stick with the supermarket.
Love them, but they weren't for me. No unnecessary sugar or i'll die :(  But these were fresh, inexpensive and a big hit on my movie night party I threw.
These are great for the movies or elsewhere! Keep a box in your desk if you get hungry!

This cheese has a very strong flavor since it is aged very long. Almost too strong for my taste, but otherwise a very excellent cheese, as you would expect an imported cheese from Holland to be. So if you like aged Gouda then give this a try.

We live in Texas and it is very difficult to find this particular flavor cracker, which of course is my husbands favorite.So when I found a whole box I gave it to him for father's day as a joke.  He loved it.  Now he eats them as a specialtreat.  Thanks.

column9: Go ahead and buy it, you'll be glad you did!
column10: This syrup is one of the best I have ever tried of any brand and flavor hands down! Not too sweet as the others said but still perfectly sweet with just the right amount of coconut flavor. Hats off to you Amoretti for getting this syrup so perfectly perfect! It works great as a half pump in a shot of espresso or cup of strong coffee and as a 1 1/2 pump iced latte flavoring making it not only delicious but a value!

Great flavor.  it faintly taste of coconut, but not so faint that you cannot taste the coconut.  It is pretty amazing to find a coffee syrup that is so flavorful yet with half of the calories.  Most of the syrups that I find have 60+ calories which discourages me from purchasing them.  Not to mention how sugary sweet watered down they are.  Amoretti syrups, are surprising not thin.  They actually seem like true syrups: thick yet thin.  I can not wait to mix this flavor with others to create brand new concoctions.  Maybe next I will combine coconut with caramel and white chocolate!

Not much to say other than that this is a really good tasting coconut syrup for iced mochas and I imagine lots of other things as well.  A little goes a long way and I recommend reading their little instruction pamphlet that lets you know how many pumps to use for different kinds of drinks.  I also noticed it has considerably less calories per pump than similar syrups but the same amount of flavor without tasting wierd or chemically so that is a big bonus for those of us watching our weight who still want to enjoy our summer iced coffee drinks. ;-)  I will definitely be ordering other flavors from this company in the future especially when it comes time for Fall and those pumpkin spice latte's! :-)  Very happy with quick delivery, large bottle size and great service, really nice informative brochure in the box as well.  2 thumbs up!
Drank one of these room temperature while eating a bucket of country crock with a ice cream spoon the other day. I've gotta say, I've been to better partys.
Very fruity and tasty - my personal favorite acai tea. Expensive as all Teavana teas are, but well worth it.
Loved by my little shelter-rescued dog who has problems digesting wheat.  Makes me nervous that country of origin is China.

I have purchased this product from local stores and have purchase the fries from amazon.  These chips that were delivered are rancid.  I can't even stand the smell myself.  It now is in my trash can!  DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT FROM AMAZON.

I have been buying Sweet Potato and Yam treats for my 3 dogs for the past year or two. My dogs love them so we make sure we always have a good supply on hand. I purchased these particular treats from this particular supplier because the price was a bit less than usual. However, they are so HARD that even my big dog has a hard time chewing them!! And my older small dog will not even try to chew them, though they are his favorite treat. This is the second time I ordered this product from this supplier and both orders were the same, the treats are too hard for the dogs to chew!! I ordered a second time hoping I just got a bad batch from them or something. However, both orders were the same, too hard for the dogs to chew!! I don't know if they have been allowed to sit around and get old and hard, or what. All I do know for sure is that I will not be ordering any more items from this supplier!! It's not cheap if you have to throw it away in the end!!

I just wanted to say that if you want to get your dog a healthy snack alternative, this product would be a good one; if the vendor did not ship you old, outdated, dried out and hard crap.  Very disappointed.  Luckily, I found a store that is close to me that carries this item that is fresh.  I would NOT recommend this vendor to anyone.

column9: MAY BE DANGEROUS! Product developed white mold!
column10: I bought these imported sweet potato chips because they are less than half the price of SAM'S YAMS which are my dog's favorite treats. The first bag seemed fine, but the stored bags all developed what appears to be a silvery white mold, although the expiration date is December, 2013. I have no idea if this could be dangerous to dogs, but I tossed mine out, because we have had terrible problems with food poisoning of our pets from imported ingredients.If anyone else has had this experience I would like to know if the white stuff is natural or is, in fact, dangerous. Thanks!

My dogs LOVE these sweet potato chews so I was excited to order them a 2 lb. bag here.  I was very disappointed when the chews came, though!  While they weren't rock hard as another reviewer stated, they are dried out and not nearly as fresh as what I can buy locally.

We've tried several types of sweet potato treats but this is the best we've found so far, mainly because it's the only one our yorkie will eat:) Others are so hard/rubbery you can't even cut them with a knife. This brand is chewable for bigger dogs and tearable for our yorkie plus she loves the flavor. My only concern is that the product is made in China but the ingredients seem pure.

I'm quite sure I reviewed this product before. But, since you're asking....my dog loves these SO much;I'll review it again.  If I'm leaving the house, and I'm going to be gone awhile; I leave him a coupletreats to keep him happy for at least a little while. I've given him a mixture of this treat & that treatover time. But he always/Always/ALWAYS.....picks this one out of the pile first. A perfect treat; especiallyfor a dog with either a sensitive stomach/or skin allergies. And wholesome too !!
My dog has IBS (can you believe it??) and these sweet potato treats are easy on his stomach and he loves them.  Great price on Amazon compared to the pet store.

When you are looking for a Organic Veggie Treat for your Dog. This is a very good one. It is Rubbery Veggie slice that the dog loves to chew.Do not give too many in a days time or you will have a loose orange stool to take care of. So 1 or 2 a day is best. I also found that although the puppies love to chew them if you give them more than 1 a day their baby teeth/gums become painful.I switched to the Sweet potato fries for my puppies to keep away from the gum/tooth pain. My adult dogs Love the chips.Great change from all the other Meat-additive treats out there.

Healthy Pets reports that sick dogs who have eaten sweet potato snacks show symptoms similar to Fanconi syndrome, "a condition in which the tubules of the kidneys don't function properly."  According to Healthy Pets, products implicated in anecdotal accounts include:Beefeaters Sweet Potato Snacks for DogsCanyon Creek Ranch Chicken Yam Good Dog TreatsDogswell Veggie Life VitalityAccording to Becky Lundgren, DVM, of the Veterinary Information Network, "Anecdotal reports from veterinarians indicate similar concerns about sweet potato pet treats made in China. Although no evidence is available that these sweet potato treats cause kidney issues similar to those related to chicken jerky treats, pet owners should be aware of the possibility."You certainly should. A prudent course of action that every shopper should take is simply looking for a "Made in China" label on any package of treats, and, if finding one, returning it to the shelf.

This product deserves no stars.I read ingredients SO carefully. In my local pet store I decided to get my boys something different and bought them this treat. Checked the ingredients and they seemed fine. Brand is "Beefeaters USA". After a few weeks my dog was vomiting, had bloody stool, and drinking a lot of water. Five hundred dollars later after xrays and blood panels he came back cancer-free and with nothing blocking his system.Puzzled, I googled some of the brands of treats I was feeding them, and information on the organic dog food I feed them. Beefeaters is made in China AND is on the list of tainted dog treats. Thinking it was only chicken jerky I did not think to check.I learned the hard way. I will now either make their treats or make sure it is safe before buying.

My little dog loves sweet potatoes, so this seemed like the perfect treat.  The 'chips' weren't what I expected, but she loves them.  The 'chips' are big slices of sweet potato, and are soft, not crunchy.  I was disappointed at first, but Misha begs for them, so that's what counts!  The slices are too big for my little girl, but cutting them into smaller sizes isn't a problem.  Will definitely order again!  It's a shame they are made in China, but I guess they are too expensive to make in America.  They are irradiated (according to the FDA - Food irradiation is the process of exposing food to ionizing radiation to destroy microorganisms, bacteria, viruses, or insects that might be present in the food.) so they are safe for our four-legged babies.
My dog loves these almost more than his regular food! Good size on my of the pieces although at the bottom of the bag they get smaller.

Who would have thought of sweet potato treats for dogs, but my three love them.  They must have a sweet tooth, because these treats are devoured.  Visiting dogs belonging to friends & family really enjoy them as well, so I recommend you give them a try.
My little guy just loves these things.  When given a choice of these chips or regular dog biscuits he chooses these every time.
I love that these are all natural. They are soft and chewy and fresh. My dog loves them and they are good for her.
I have ordered this product before and my dog just loves the sweet potatoe treat (not knowing it is also good for her!).Product arrives very quickly and is exactly as advertised.  Will re-order soon.
My dogs loves these and they are so good for them. This product is shaped like potato chips. They get so excited when I get them out.
These are great. My dog's favorite, and seem to be a healthy snack. They are easy to cut in half if you want to give a smaller portion.

I've ordered these from Amazon several times.  Orders have always been timely and the product has been perfect.  Both my dogs love these treats.  My older dog took a bit longer to warm up to them but now he loves them too!

Our family dog, a 5 year old (human years) Shih Tzu didn't take to this at first. It took a good week before he would try it. After he tried it, he was all over it. He's allergic to everything so it was nice to find a treat that he could eat. We found this at Pet Smart and got the clear plastic bucket (about one pound of treats). It's lasted him about 8 months now--serving it to him about 2-3 times a week ahout 2-5 of these treats each time. We'll be getting him so more of these. He's pretty happy when he gets these.

This is my favorite thing to feed my 11 year old aussie for a chew.  Her canines have become pretty worn, partially because she developed a habit of chewing her way out of chain link kennels about 5 years ago (which I no longer keep her in) but also because I used to give her very hard chews when she was younger.  I still give her a chew in the evening but it is always something pretty soft.  I like the Sam's Yamz but they are pretty pricey and then I found these!  I purchased my supply from Amazon which is perhaps I didn't have the same experience as the previous reviewer with them being pretty hard. The pieces in the bag I got were very soft and chewy.  With free shipping these are a great deal and don't wear done my dog's teeth!

My dogs love these.  There a healthy alternative to the other treats out there.  The one thing with these are it softens the stool and turns it orange.  If your dog goes on the neighbor's yard that's good but we all know the pain of picking up soft poop.  I guess it all comes down to how much you love you mut.I only give each about 1 or 2 a day and thier fine.  If your dog likes these, then try giving them raw sweet potatoes or sweet potatoes that have been semi cooked in microwave.  My dogs eat them as it was the beef or turkey jerky.

column9: This product is dog food not a snack for humans
column10: I was looking for heathy sweet potato chips and see this item.  Ordered it quickly and had to return it because itis for dogs not for humans.I have nothing against dogs or dog food.  But I think the Amazon website needs to make a clearer distinctionbetween dog snacks and human snacks and not list them all on the same page for people to choose.
though the quality of the pepper was excellent, it was much too expensive.  not a good buy--i could overpay anywhere!

I enjoyed Just the Cheese's Grilled Cheese snack so I thought I'd give the bacon flavored a try.  I love them!  I'm on a low-carb diet and these snack come in quite handy when I'm craving something salty and crunchy.  I usually keep a few bags of these in my car for to snack on during my drives.  I must warn that these snack are very salty though so I do limit the amount of these I'll eat.  Some people may have a difficult time with the texture.  It's almost like eating that little bit of overcooked cheese that oozed out into the pan the last time you made a grilled cheese sandwich.  It's crunchy but not oily.  It took a little getting used to, but now I can't get enough of them.  :)

The first bag I hated,,,the second not so much,,,,by the fifth bag I was rather addicted. I will try other flavors out of curiosity. I think you could doctor these up a bit on your own..maybe some lite Philly cream cheese and cayenne pepper and zap in micro just to warm.....or no sugar jalapenno jelly for some zip.....
If salty is a taste you like, you will love these snacks.  The flavor is good, but just a bit more salt than I would prefer.

column9: High Blood Pressure in a Snack Bag
column10: I like cheese. I like bacon. How could I go wrong with these snacks? Well, by not checking the nutritional information, for one thing. Each two-serving bag offers a quarter of the RDA of sodium! But even that could be excused and the snacks doled out sparingly if they were at all yummy. But they taste exactly like you'd expect something that supplied one-quarter of your RDA supply of salt to taste: practically inedible. I got through one tiny bag in the course of a week and am trying to decide how to dispose of the rest. I'd feel guilty even giving them to a food bank, and I certainly don't want a yard of hypertensive squirrels on my conscience. Foul! Save your money.

column9: My favorite gluten free rainbow chip
column10: Betty Crocker has always been the #1 baking brand for me and I LOVE this rainbow chip variety frosting as it's gluten free  ( as many people are unaware of ) and difficult to find this flavor sometimes at the store.  I buy from amazon since the price is much cheaper per jar than the grocery store and I can get this flavor.  The rainbow chips don't discolor the white frosting when applied to warm cakes/cookies;  they hold their shape and color.  I rate this 5 stars as it tastes great and looks professional for bakery decoration.Nutritional facts :  2 tablespoons are 140 calories, total fat 5 grams, saturated fat 2 grams,  trans fats 1.5 grams, zero cholesterol , sodium 70 mg, potassium 20 mg, total carbs 23 grams, sugars 20 grams.
This is the BEST icing ever! Only one grocery store sells it in town and now they are going out of business! I think it's time to stock up! : )
This is the best icing ever.  My family loves it, especially my children.  It would not be a birthday without this icing on their cake.  So good!

Paragon Dental Chews are a fantastic product. They are great for my dogs' dental care, and they love chewing on them as an activity treat. I usually buy the Twiggies and the Alligators. They are completely animal free, which I love, since it is hard to find chew bones with dental benefits that are veg-friendly. I would definitely and highly recommend this product for any dog and especially for those looking for products that are vegetarian without any animal or animal by-products in them.
these chips are so good. i found that these chips are hard to come by here in afghanistan but this company was able to mail these here to me. awesome.
I Highly recommended.". Hei, customer!! If you like fragmentatized chips, this is the product for you. If you like to eat chips with a small spoon? You can not miss any of those.
I did not realize that this was the price for ONE bottle.  That's my fault.  As a result I wouldn't purchase it again.

This tea has an unpleasant taste. I'm not sure why people say it is mild and smooth.Smelling the tea bag, you can get a whiff of the bitterness of some of the herbs. That bitterness is what you end up tasting after steeping the tea. It's a sharp, pungent taste mixed with more subtle berry flavors, and it is none too pleasant on the taste buds going down. I take my herbal teas without sweeteners because they don't typically need them, I just like to enjoy the flavor, but in this case, the flavor is not appealing at all.As equally surprising is the immediate effect upon drinking the tea: I feel a little "buzzy" and discombobulated, and it makes me feel pressure in my forehead and temples, almost as though the tea is dilating the blood vessels in my head (almost feels like a pre-migraine symptom set, but without the migraine). This begins after a few sips and lasts for about 1-2 hours after finishing the tea.Whatever herbs are in this tea seem to have a big effect on me physiologically, and keep in mind that no herbal tea has affected me in this way before (and I've tried several!).At any rate, I will not be buying any more Berry Detox.I would love to hear if anyone else experiences the same thing, or other strange side effects. There are quite a few herbs in this tea, so perhaps my body is reacting negatively to one of them.
This tea need nothing but hot water, it natural sweets, its spices and aroma its just very therapeutic and at the same time you a cleansing your body.
An enjoyable tea. I have only tried it hot; not iced, so I don't know how it is cold. It is smooth and has a nice fruity blend of strawberry, raspberry and acai.

My mini schnauzers love these. They chew the red part first and then the rawhide. Normally, we DO NOT buy chicken products made in China; however, this product seems to be ok. We have been buying this product for a long time and our dogs love it!

Amazing delivery speed. I got the package 2 days after I ordered, before I even got the shipping notification. The item was as described. I need the sugar for a specific beer recipe, and was unable to find any locally. The seller exceeded any expectations I had. Thanks a bunch!

column9: Just like Mexico----Only Smaller... Great for Cafe' de Olla
column10: Just a great product, just like the large cones you find in Mexico at any grocer, but smaller and perfect for making a small batch of Cafe' de Olla at home.  3 cones, 3 scoops dark roast coffee (whole bean), 3 Cin. Sticks, 1 tsp. Clove whole.  Makes just enough for my coffee press, boil the water, cones of Piloncillo and steap for 5 mins, grind the coffee and cloves and drop right in the pan, boil for a minute or two and allow to steap for 5 total, put in your press, and boom, real Cafe de Olla without the Barro de Olla.  Of course MexGrocer has a Really Nice Barro de Olla too, so I plan to get one to use when I have more guests over.  I did notice that many Mexican homes use just a large pot for Cafe no matter what so...  It's cool.... the product is a great buy, and is just the right size for me.  Saves a lot of time and mess from trying to cut down the larger cones to a size that works. :)
This drink is so great they brought it back for good in the stores !Taste exactly as I remember.

column9: YES! KEEP IT! BRING IT BACK FULL CIRCLE!
column10: YES! KEEP IT! BRING IT BACK FULL CIRCLE!Why should we drink High Fructose Corn Syrup or Artificial Sweeteners?The THROWBACK is the REAL WAY to make Pepsi, let's make THIS ONE the OFFICIAL ONE!Loved the taste :)
This makes a great, quick spicy dip. I used fat free cream cheese and plain greek yogurt to reduce the fat and calories, and it still tastes yummy.
The coffee is very good; the price is reasonable. This was a quick and easy transaction with vendor. I would recommend both the vendor and the coffee.

It's hard to find organic shade-grown coffee that's decaf and ground, so I really lucked out finding this. Great gift for the environmentally conscious coffee lover, and more affordable per ounce than most other comparable options.

I have searched and searched for a great decaf coffee and finally found it!  I like a good robust flavor and this one has it.  I only drink one mug of coffee a day and I want it to be memorable.  I'm so happy with this coffee that I have it on auto-delivery thru Amazon!  Not only is it good coffee but the company is also earth friendly.  That is what I call a win, win situation!!

This coffee is simply too sour for my taste, even when cut with a lot of heavy cream and sweetener. I've never gotten a good cup of coffee out of this bag. Perhaps it's too coarsely ground for my coffee maker, or perhaps I just prefer a darker roast; but either way I won't ordering it again.

We have a Keurig @ work and have had Tully's Kona before.  I bought my daughter & son in law a new coffee maker and ordered Tully's Kona 2 weeks before Xmas.  Coffee arrived in plenty of time and I really like the way they let you know the details of the shipment and provide tracking info.

column9: Great Find. Bold, rich, non bitter Highly recommended for Keurig owners
column10: I tried various K cups in order to find the one for my taste. Finally, a friend of mine gave me a pack of this and I used it with EZ cup and EZ filter on Keurig B60 system. 1.5 tablespoon of this finely ground coffee brews a great 8/10 oz cup of rich, bold coffee. This is BOLD but DOES NOT leave bitter taste in your mouth. The seller is quick to ship and has great communication in addition to offering free shipping.

If you're looking for a flavorful change from boring bitter coffee this is perfect. Full of smooth body rich flavor from the first sip, this finishes with a great coffee taste without a bitter or "too strong" ending. I enjoy drinking my coffee black without the additives to cover up taste that just isn't that good. I find this is so good tasting that there is no need to add anything. I do not enjoy Starbucks because to get the flavor you also have to take the bitter and too strong with it. I want a full rich flavor without thinking I am drinking bitter espresso. I would recommend trying this Brazilian favorite and see what you are missing. A mere 6 level tablespoons makes a full 12 cup pot in my Cuisinart maker, so this ends up being quite reasonable in cost as well. 5 Star in my book.
One of the best espresso coffees I have tasted.  Smooth and silky with no bitter taste at the end.  Very enjoyable and I strongly recommend it to coffee lovers, especially espresso.

I love this soy sauce. Years ago I dated a wonderfull gal from Thailand and the only soy sauce she used was dark soy and I fell in love with it. Now I have found this sweet soy sauce and even better. It's a wonderfull combination of sweet and salt. This soy sauce is also very thick. I use this with some water, garlic powder and olive oil to marinate salmon in before I put it on the grill and cook with apple chips. If you mix this with some honey, chipolte pepper and what ever you might think of this will make an excellent dipping sauce for egg rolls, chicken, crab ragoon and so on. The price here is good, give it a try - if you like soy sauce you will love this. Don't get confused by what I have said here - this is not a replacement for everyday soy sauce - it is in addition to for new and different ideas and taste sensations.
I like this mix. The fact that all you do is add water is the best thing. Unlike other that you have to add oil and eggs.And very tasty too

column9: Only pancakes that my kids will eat....
column10: We've tried several pancake mixes and this is the one we keep coming back to.  You just add water, wisk to desired consistency, and cook.  On a busy school morning this is a plus.  Caveat, I recommend that the batter be mixed at room temperature and if refrigerated the previous night should be be brought out and warmed up first.  This makes a difference in flavor and my kids are very quick to notice.  I use canola oil in a hot frying pan and the result is restaurant quality pancakes, unlike some other batters I have used.  As a former grillworker I can appreciate this!  Concur with the other reviewer's recommendation to add this product to Amazon's subscribe list.

column9: Best pancake mix I have ever used
column10: I love the fact that it doesn't call for an egg or milk.  Pancakes are very light, taste great.The Amazon price is right as well.  I wish they would put this on subscribe and save.

As someone who doesn't eat oils from corn, cotton etc., I like that this is made with palmolein oil. It was one of my favorite banana chips to buy back in Jamaica and it still is years later in the U.S:)
The Grace Green Banana Chips is the best tasting banana chips I have ever eaten. I will never purchase any other ones from now on. Go a head and try it for yourself. You will not be disappointed.
The Dentyne Classic gum is great, just like I remember it back in the 60's.  The newer Dentyne gum is pretty good as well but I prefer the classic much more.

This is a good alternative to a nutrition bar but it is caloric. The label is somewhat deceptive since the amount of protein is for two servings. Eating the whole cookie amounts to about 500 calories.

If you consider these a treat, you are an enemy of pleasure. In addition to their label advertising containing No Dairy right below the 'Vegan' statement, they put 'beat carotene' in their products. This particular item had brown sugar as the first of a huge # of ingredients; ultimately, a huge caloric black hole. Got these at a steep discount via WD, and still supremely unsatisfied.

Yes, its high in calories, never met a good cookie that wasn't though!! Its nice and soft and chewy and VEGAN! As a person allergic to dairy and eggs, I love these cookies!! Vegans and non-vegans alike will LOVE it! Its that good!!

I purchased this canned pumpkin to have a ready supply of it for some low cal, weight watchers type desserts that I like to make in the fall and winter... I am totally satisfied and happy with this purchase, as I have been with all products that I have purchased thru amazon.com... and their service is always perfect; they let you know when an item will be shipped, and give you a chance to skip a shipment if you want to as well... have never encountered a prob yet here, I am happy to say... and their prices cannot be beat...

column9: Pumpkin has more carotenoids than carrots and taste better
column10: Scientific research shows that eating foods high in carotenoids like pumpkin can give one a healthy glow that rivaled a sun tan and made them more attractive in tests...The article at healthland time dotcom "study can a veggie rich diet make you more beautiful" I purchased several cases of "Farmers market foods organic canned pumpkin" while Amazon had it on sale. Most of the cans arrived in great condition a few had dents but nothing severe.The pumpkin itself taste yummy -so I'm hoping to improve my health, eye sight and get some color without using self tanners ^_^
Case arrived quickly, in good shape and tastes great.  We made some pumpkin bread right away and thought it was the best tasting pumpkin bread we have had!

I read some negative reviews on the Farmer's Market Pumpkin but I'm glad I gave it a try anyway.  I was shocked when the pumpkin arrived two days after I ordered it.  The cans are in perfect condition and the pumpkin is a beautiful color, texture and taste.  I am very pleased with my purchase!!
This canned pumpkin is wonderful!  Been using it for pancakes, muffins, oatmeal, cookies, etc.  A great way to get more nutrients and flavor into whatever you are baking.

column9: Pumpkin puree arrived in perfect shape. Expires in a few years.
column10: 12 cans arrived in perfect shape. I received them on Jan 28, 2011. The expiration date on the cans is October 2013. Happy camper.

The color and flavor is both deep and bright. Really tasty.So far my favorite use is to stir in a little milk, along with some cinnamon, ginger & nutmeg, then pop it in the microwave for a quick and healthy treat. It's also good added to plain yogurt, or in a smoothie. Next, I want to try freezing it in ice cube trays (after adding aforementioned spices- and whatever else strikes my fancy at the time - maybe a dash of coarsely ground black pepper, or vanilla extract?), then putting it in the Vitamix along with agave & lemon, to make a pumpkin sorbet.Would definitely buy this again when it's on sale. No dented cans either.

What can I say? If your looking at this item you most likely already know its a superior product. I was skeptical of buying this item due to the can condition complaints. It is actually cheaper for me to buy this on Amazon then my local grocer so I decided to try my luck. Each pack of twelve are as mentioned in other reviews, factory packed and then in my case, both cases where put in another box by Amazon to ship. The cans arrived in "New"/"Mint" condition.Excellent product, for me cheaper then the local market, thus I am very satisfied.

column9: No problems with shipment, worked well in recipes
column10: I ordered one case on a lightning deal since it was significantly less per can than any grocery store in our area. My shipment arrived in perfect condition. It was packed well, and no cans were dented at all. The contents in the cans are the color and taste I would expect for pureed, commercially canned pumpkin (not gray or tart as some reviewers mentioned).  The pumpkin worked well in a vegan pumpkin pie for Thanksgiving, in pumpkin spice muffins for breakfast and in a cream cheese pumpkin dip to accompany ginger snaps on New Year's Eve.  I ordered a second case on a Manager's Special and that one arrived in excellent condition as well.  I was also pleased with the long shelf life.  I would give this product five stars if it was packed in BPA-free cans.

I took a gamble ordering since I knew other people were receiving them badly dented.  Luckily mine came without a single dent.  They were packaged in a tight fitting box inside a bigger box with some of those air packets.  With the 50% off sale and subscribe and save discount, they were under a buck each and are delicious in pumpkin bread :)

The pumpkin is delicious.  I have a scoop of pumpkin in my morning smoothie.  I open a can, put it in the fridge and use it throughout the week in smoothies, soups and sauces.  Pumpkin deserves to be used in things other than just pies and bread.I don't know if the packaging is different now, but none of my cans are damaged.

column9: Great Pumpkin, but very poor quality control in dented cans
column10: The pumpkin itself is great, but 6 of the 12 cans were shipped dented.  They had to have been sent in that condition because there was NO damage to either of the boxes in which the cans were contained.  Disappointed in quality control.

I love this pumpkin. I have always looked for organic pumpkin but it is not sold locally. My shipment arrived in excellent condition and the product tastes great. I have begun to eat it regularly as part of my diet, pumpkin has alot of fiber and vitamins that will be worth eating yer round. The discounts and free shipping are awesome, well done Amazon!

just had to issue a review asap.  just got my first order in the mail.  product packaged perfectly and arrived intact and not a dent anywhere.  it seems earlier reviews must have been heard by amazon b/c my packaging/product was terrific.  i have been trying to locate this item at an affordable price since a local organic grocer went out of business.  im in heaven.  the taste is terrific and now with subscribe and save i can get a regular supply and free shipping!!  totally healthy natural product that i use for all family (including my pets).  one more reason to love amazon!!

I was thrilled to find this organic pumpkin for such a great price! I've had trouble finding canned pumpkin at local stores during the year so I thought it would be great to have so much.  It arrived very quickly and unlike other reviewers, it arrived in very good condition. It was a great purchase!

column9: not even a single dented can
column10: I was worried about the dented cans, but mine was perfect. The expiry date is until 10/2013, very long. I'm very pleased!

I purchased Farmer's Market Organic canned pumpkin because I could not find Libby's anywhere. The shipping was first rate. Product is somewhat different than Libby's in that it is more liquid, not as solid, but pie was very good except sweeter than we are accustomed to. So will just reduce amount of sugar, which is a good thing anyhow, and enjoy the rest of the cans of pumpkin. I am glad to have enough for the upcoming holidays even tho Libby's is now back on grocers shelves. Thank you Amazon.

I bought this because of the pumpkin shortage (which is now over) to be sure I had canned pumpkin for the holidays.  Like other reviewers, I received a few dented cans, although only one was so badly dented that I hesitate to use it.  I have used the pumpkin in pie and pumpkin bread. It is a bit less dense than the kind we are all accustomed to buying in the grocery store, but it is by no means watery.  I did add an extra egg yolk to the pie to make sure it set up.  The pie was somewhat wetter than my typical result, but it held its shape and tasted great.  This made excellent pumpkin bread.  My family has devoured almost a whole loaf since last night.  If you are having difficulty finding pumpkin, don't hesitate to order this product.

The first order had the consistency of pureed pumpkin, like that in the individual cans that I buy (same label) from my local health food store....very good.  The second order, however, had the texture & consistency of a product to which FRUIT SUGAR or PECTIN may have been added, suggesting less quality for more profits....disappointing.  The condition of the cans on both orders has been excellent.
I sent feedback, product was fine, but I recieved 5 very dented cans and one that was busted open. Did not recieve apply from my feedback.

Purchased this item to bake with and was hesitant to order due to the negative reviews of dented cans with packaging.  I went ahead and ordered, received free shipping and the whole case was delivered DENT FREE.  The entire case of pumpkin was bubble wrapped and then enclosed in a box.  The taste of the product is great, a little less dense than the usual Libby's I have baked with in the past.  Will definitely purchase again.

I bought this pumpkin because there is none available in our markets due to the great pumpkin crisis of 2009 or something equally drastic.  Its primary use is to prevent hairballs in my cat and it works.  I usually mix it with some canned cat food, but when I ran out one night, I gave it to him straight and he scarfed it down as if it were candy.  It lasts a long time (he only gets about 2 tablespoons a night), smells wonderful and I plan to use it in some muffins as soon as I get the time to make them.  I like being able to give him something organic, as he's an older gentleman, and I like having organic for my own cooking.

With pumpkin being so hard to get, I ordered this not really expecting it to be much, I just needed pumpkin to make my pumpkin rolls. I make alot and sell during holidays and my family looks forward to getting them so I tried this and was amazed at the product. It was received in 5 days of ordering and not one can was damaged!!!. Much better that I expected. I will continue to order this from now on. It taste great and pefect for my baking.

I had been hunting for canned pumpkin for several weeks (with no luck in my local grocery stores) before remembering last year's pumpkin crop disaster, so out of desperation, I turned to the 'Net and ordered a case of the Farmer's Market product.I'm glad I did--this stuff is great! I originally wanted it for holiday pies, but have already used it for pumpkin pancakes and waffles with superb results, and have lots of other recipes still to try (but expect to have equally good results).It's not been watery in the can, and not a single can arrived with a dent, so I think this was an excellent purchase!  If I run out, I plan to purchase this product again.
This pumpkin was great.  Not watery like some other reviews and my shipment didn't have any dented cans.  Thanks Amazon!
I had heard the pumpkin crop was bad last year, so was very surprised to find this product at this price with free shipping...
I get this to add to my dogs food, it helps bulk up their stool & they don't scoot their bottoms.

The awesome price and free shipping is what sold me.  I found this same exact pumpkin available for order from an organic grocery in NY and they wanted to charge over $30 for only 6 cans AND they only ship FedEX which is not cheap.  I couldn't believe my good luck to find the same exact item on Amazon and that I could get TWICE AS MUCH for $10 LESS with free shipping!!

I have bought this canned pumpkin for a while now.  No complaints with product, no complaints with Amazon.  I get free shipping, it arrives very timely, and I use a lot of it since I feed it to my five cats.  Can't find it cheaper anywhere and it comes to my house.  Very satisfied with the whole package

Not Flat or old- looking, like some other canned pumpkin brands. This can is full of promise - the texture is vibrant, the color is great -- a nice orange color (no food coloring here) -- and can be used in so many types of recipes -- from soup to pie and everything in between.And of coures it's great to know that the pumpkin is organic.

I cannot recommend buying this product.  I think the manufacturer is fobbing off its dented cans on Amazon customers!  Out of a package of 12 cans, only 3 were not dented in the package I received -- and I see from other reviews that I am not the first to experience this.  I wish I'd read the reviews before placing my order.  I don't think this was an Amazon fault, since the flat was pre-packaged and I think Amazon simply shipped the flat as they received it from the manufacturer.  Amazon took immediate and very good care of me in this situation, exceeding my expectations, so I have no quibble with them.

I was impressed with the service (price) and speed of delivery - but disappointed when half of the cans in the case arrived severely dented. I didn't bother with asking for replacement - we had an immediate use for the product (made lots of pumpkin pie), so this is a word of caution to other buyers. We will do this again - but next time, we will not be so forgiving.
Canned pumpkin is a great "secret" ingredient for a number of diet recipes, from soup to chocolate fudge.  Trouble is you can't find it in the stores.  This stuff works and tastes great.

I had been unable to find any canned pumpkin at any of the grocery stores in our area for months and found the Farmer's Market Foods canned pumpkin by searching online.  I order a lot of products through Amazon and have been very satisfied with everything I have ordered.  Like many of the other reviewers, I need the pumpkin for my dogs -- and it works very well!  The product arrived in good shape, and the quality is excellent.  It is more expensive than it was in the stores, but as long as it is not available there, I will continue to buy it through Amazon.

With the bad season for pumpkins, it is impossible to find canned pumpkin in any store.  So I was thrilled to find it here at Amazon.com.  It will make many yummy things that would not have been made had it not been for this item at Amazon.com.Farmer's Market Foods Organic Canned Pumpkin, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)

I was extremely disappointed because out of a dozen cans half were dented. Obviously, the person packing the box should have noticed the cans were damaged. We kept the shipment because we wanted the pumpkin and didn't want to go through the hassle of returning the cans.

I'd really like to see the product description amended to address the dented can issues. That said--my second shipment had two VERY badly dented cans--but the rest were only slightly dented.  (This compared to my first shipment where every can was moderately dented).  Since I am using this for dog food--I have no problem using.  I just don't like to see this product sold as if it has no problems.  I am glad it is available though since there is such a pumpkin shortage.I'd like to update--my third shipment had only a couple of cans slightly dented.  I don't know if I just got lucky this time, or whatever issues there were have been worked out.That said, I am upping my review to 5 stars--however as other reviews have noted, the pumpkin is more watery than other canned pumpkin I have used in the past.  For my purposes that is fine.Taking my review back down to 2 stars.  I just received a shipment with extremely dented cans.  Too much trouble to return--and I will use them to feed my dogs.  I really hate that I don't feel like I have another choice right now.

column9: Great product, No dented cans, No problem
column10: I needed canned pumpkin to supplement the dog's diet but could not find any locally in Ohio due to the shortage. Amazon came to the rescue. The shipment arrived quickly in perfect condition. There were no dented cans. No problem. The dog loves the pumpkin and everyone is happy.
I couldn't find it in my local store, thankfully I found it on amazon and thanks to prime I got it in no time. No noticeable dents on the cans either.

We are very pleased with this pumpkin. We purchase it in quantity because we use it daily for our three cats. And we were surprised how with this brand, they do not turn their nose up at the food with it mixed in. We like it too!

I have another pumpkin eating dog (it really has helped her IBD) and couldn't find canned locally. I ordered three cases of this (error on my part but not worth undoing due to scarcity) and awaited arrival with some trepidation thanks to negative feedback on damage to cans. To my very great delight, only 1 of the 36 cans had a even a small dent so looks like the problem has been solved, at least as far as my shipment goes. Can't comment on product itself beyond saying that it really is helping the dog.
I was very pleased with the organic pumpkin. It tasted like it came out of my own garden.

taste was very good but texture was watery compared to other brands . i make a fat free /sugar free pumpkin custard using egg whites. only 400 calories for the whole dish . with other brands of canned pumpkin it is the same texture as a normal pumpkin pie minus the crust . this brand comes out a bit soupy but still quite tasty. for a custard it is fine but for a pie ,it would never hold up to being a pretty slice, to hold it's shape unless you  over baked it. mind you - with the shortage we are having i would buy it again , i will buy it again because the taste is good unless you over bake it .
ALthough the pumkin was good, almost 90% of the cans were dented and some badly.  Would probably not order canned goods again.

column9: Product is Fine, Shipping is Iffy
column10: I've bought this pumpkin before but cannot find canned pumpkin in the grocery store during non-holiday periods, for some reason.  Although the consistency is not as nice as Libby's pumpkin - this is a little watery, the fact that it's organic scores big points.  I mix it with my dog and cats foods, so the wateryness is not an issue.  My complaint is that it was not well packed for shipping.  Almost half the cans were damaged to a point that I would not have purchased them in the grocery store.  The contents seem to be fine, but I will try to find some other source next time, as the shipping seems to be a consistent issue in other reviews I have read for this product.
My dogs need pumpkin in their diet and it's not available locally.  This organic pumpkin, while expensive, fills the bill and my pups are happy.  It's good quality.  Liked the free shipping.
Item arrived swiftly however, a lot of the cans were dented. If you can live with a dent in your can, the product is perfect inside. Highly recommended seller.

column9: Good pumpkin, but a little strong
column10: I use a can of pumpkin for pumpkin cake. While the cake turns out great and sweet, the pumpkin itself is a little 'tart' (for lack of a better word) compared to Libby's. I've ordered several cases and they all have the same strong flavor that is almost overpowering.

column9: All 12 cans arrived in perfect condition!
column10: My local markets weren't carrying this brand this year and I only use the Farmer's Market brand for breads, pancakes, pies, oatmeal, smoothies, etc..  I was hesitant in ordering after reading the reviews regarding dented cans but all my cans arrived in perfect condition!  I'll be reordering from Amazon when I'm out!
I ordered 3 packs of 12 cans.  So far I have received 24 cans.  Of those 24 cans 12 were damaged.  I probably will not order again due to the damamge.
This pumpkin is just wierd. It smells awful and is much looser than any other canned pumpkin.I thought all canned pumpkins were the same.....so not the "case".  I really regret this purchase!!

I usually buy this at our local Whole Foods or Harris Teeter it's a great product but when I ordered it from Amazon all but 2 out of 12 cans arrived dented. Amazon quickly replaced the order but in the replacement case 9 cans were dented. That is really unacceptable. They did refund my $ but I really want the pumpkin so I am going to try one more time and order it again and see if I can get a case of undented cans.

I just ordered this product for the first time and I was really bummed when I got it yesterday. 7 cans out of 12 were dented pretty good.  Amazon was nice and gave me a full refund. Really sucks the can were damaged i was looking forward to making some organic pumpkin pie.

column9: I like my pumpkin in the can!
column10: I've been eating pumpkin from the can for years. All it takes is a can opener and a fork (and unless you're from Maryland -- one should never use a spoon) and a bit of pepper.Yum! Pumpkin is my favorite edible gourd. Though I do miss the delicious pumpkin seeds you can get from fresh pumpkin. Sometimes I'll bake the seeds and throw a little sea salt on top. That's a nice treat on a cool Fall day. I'll make a steaming hot cup of tea and eat pumpkin seeds and just think about things out on my porch.I imagine that Susan Lucci and I are married and that she's very experimental in the bedroom and not afraid to invite company to join us. One time I imagined this so hard I blacked out. I woke on my porch with pumpkin all over my chest and a slight burn on my calf from the tea.
6 out of the 12 cans are very dented!  Very disappointed.  Please send me 6 more!!!!!!!!!!!!! This was a gift.

This product is really good pureed pumpkin, but I have a problem with the cans.  I took out one can from the outside of the case to make pumpkin bread.  It is wonderful pumpkin...dark orange, tasty, full of pumpkin goodness.  However, a few days later I removed the rest of the cans from the case to put them in my cupboard.  From the middle row, right in the middle of the case, there was one can that was SO badly damaged, that I am afraid to use it for fear of me and my family getting sick from bacteria.  Now, please tell me how a can that is SO badly damaged, packed in the middle of a case, can go unnoticed by the person who is packing the case???  Or, are you that big a company that you have automation packing these cases, and it is just a strange coincidence that the only dented can ended up EXACTLY in the middle? I feel the can was placed there intentionally so that I would not notice, nor would Amazon (the shipper), no matter what side of the case it was viewed from.  Folks, we are not stupid, and we will get to that middle can eventually, so you are not hiding anything.  As the end user of this product, I feel that this can of pumpkin should have been caught at packaging and thrown in the trash...just as I have to do.  It's all about quality control.  This has raised the price per can by about .25 cents.  That means that instead of me paying $2.36 per can, I have now paid over $2.60 per can.  You have a great product, but I have a problem with a company who tries to pull the pumpkin over it's customer's eyes. Pumpkin is WAY to hard to come by right now and I was happy to have found your product on Amazon.  But, it has turned out to not be such a deal when I have to even throw away one can of pumpkin.  I give you a five star rating for your pureed pumpkin, but I deducted two stars for the wasted can.

Ordered this product to have some canned pumpkin--continuing pumpkin shortage at stores. Use A LOT of pumpkin! of 12 cans, 9 majorly dented, 2 minorly dented, 1 OK. Amazon refunded entire purchase price--they don't accept grocery returns.

I received these the other day and 2 cans were severely damaged, I had to throw them out, and 5 other cans came with minor dents. They were packed together so it didn't look like the damage took place during shipping.Edited note:Today is May 30, 2009 and I just wanted to post that Amazon wrote to me and told me this problem has been rectified. I'm happy about that because I need to get these for my dog and at times they are hard to find. Plus it's a great product.

I paid a little more for a case of pumpkin than I normally would but so far it has met all my expectations.  It's really packed into the can so if you need something really smooth, it takes some mixing.  It's been delicious in all the recipes I've made.

This is my second order and the cans arrived perfectly packed with no dents on any cans.  I am giving this to my basset hounds in hope of helping them with their anal glands issue.  But I may use some to make pumpkin muffins. My dogs love the puree in their food and I am glad to give them organic.  Although I don't think pumpkins are susceptible to pesticide spray since you dont eat the hard skin and the pesticide probably cannot penetrate the thick skin.

column9: Can issue resolved? No problems with cans, just with texture
column10: I was hesitant to order this because of the recurring complaint of damaged cans, but then noticed that those reviews seem less recent, and it looks like the shipping issue was resolved (I selected the "Amazon Frustration-Free" packaging).  The cans arrived in perfect condition, before their use-by date, etc.However, the texture of the pumpkin seems a bit off. We add the pumpkin to our dogs' food. Before buying this product, we typically used the large can of Libby's brand. The texture of this product is much firmer than the canned Libby's we were using, and it even looked like there was some congealed fat in the "Farmer's Market" can, which seems odd for pumpkin. Another difference is that it doesn't seem to be firming up our dogs' poop like the Libby's pumpkin did (sorry if TMI!). We will probably stick with Libby's once we finish the cans from this order.
This is a great deal and has worked wonderful in all my recipes.  We love pumpkin muffins with chocolate chips for breakfast.
The pumpkin is yummy and there were no dented cans.  Farmers, pickers, processors, warehouse persons, (did I miss anyone) did a great job!!!

I got hit by the same problem many others have...dented cans.  Of the 12 cans in the case, eight were dented.  When you divide the purchase price by the four useable cans that comes to $5.55/can!  RIPPPPP  OFFFFFF!!  As many others pointed out, the box was fine, it was just the cans inside.  I planned to return the offending cans, but in the meantime, I opened one to give some to my dog.  I thought I was buying pumpkin puree but instead I bought orange water.  Now that pumpkin is in stock at my local grocery stores again, I shall return to Libby or Publix brand.  You get 100% pumpkin (be sure you choose pumpkin puree, NOT pumpkin pie filling).  No water and no dents and most important only $1.49/can instead of $5.55/can.  I couldn't give this product zero stars which is what I wanted to do.

This canned pumpkin was purchased for my dogs, wonderful benefits for canines.  No dented cans, good packaging.  I will never buy any other pumpkin again even for my family's use.  The pumpkin we used to buy in the grocery store is watery, this pumpkin is firm, no filler or artificial coloring.  Texture is similar to stiff mashed potatoes. Simply the best!!

When my male dog developed recurrent anal gland infections, the vet recommended adding canned pumpkin to his meals for fiber.  Unfortunately canned pumpkin is a seasonal item in local stores.  I was very excited to find this item available via Subscribe and Save.  I have occasionally found dented cans but not frequently and not severely enough that we can't use them anyway.  Both my dogs enjoy it.

I use pumpkin in baking and for breakfasts year round for the taste and nutrition benefits. Going the organic route is SO much better than the stuff that predominates around the holidays. Just looking at the color of the pumpkin in the can you can see the organic is more natural. Farmer's Market is consistently good and buying it on Amazon is cheaper than getting it at Trader Joes or Whole Foods.

Our dog LOVES this! we buy the pumpkin or the butternut squash on a regular basis.  Our dog can't get enough. It's organic, which makes me feel better about what she eats and its high in fiber . . . which makes her BM's extremely well formed and regular.  treats diarrhea, constipation and its healthy.  a staple in her diet.
I needed to find organic pumpkin for a special diet my golden retriever is on. This is tough to find! I got it at an amazing price and it's really helping.

column9: Pumpkin Pie isn't just for a holiday
column10: Tonight was the second time I've baked a pie using this product both pies were excellent. Only regret is not buying two cases when it was on sale for $1.50 per can.

column9: This pumpkin is the best -- if you're using it for the same reason I am
column10: This is the best pumpkin available -- if you are using it for your dogs or yourself. I have two dogs with issues -- one is older and has a little trouble with upset tummy from time to time, and the other was on prescription food -- but this product fixed all that.Now they can eat the same food as the dogs with no issues -- and they all love it! That is a nice plus -- if you are worrying that your dogs won't eat pumpkin, I will be surprised if they don't eat this. My pickiest dog thinks it is wonderful.I also eat some of it myself, because I read somewhere that it is good for humans too, and I like the flavor. However, I didn't try to bake anything with it, so I can't say if it makes good pie or pumpkin bread . . .When I read the reviews, I was a little worried about getting dented cans, but mine were fine -- no dents at all, and nicely packaged in a box.Five stars and two thumbs up from me -- your experience may vary . . .

I found it to be watery. At least, more so than other canned pumpkin. It's likely less watery than fresh pumpkin puree, but definitely more watery than Libby's or the generic brand at my grocery store.The texture upon opening this organic one was smooth while the other was irregular. It made my pies taste a bit bland as well, but I also made a mistake with the crust (too much water) so that had a hand in my pie disappearing in two days rather than one.I really liked the art, though. The label. It's nice.Basically, it won't make a fantastic pie, but it'll do. Especially if you would like organic. I suggest straining through coffee filters (placed over a mesh colander) overnight or longer.

when I cannot get Libby's, I am very happy to get this.  I don't restrict  myself to organic.  It is watery, however. which requires  either straining or altering recipe.  This review is for organic caned pumpkin.
This product has been difficult to find in my area this year so I was thrilled to see it on Amazon subscribe and save.
I love using this canned pumpkin! It has a great consistency and tastes really good. Bakes well. Appreciate that it's organic!

I've been using Farmer's Market Organic Canned Pumpkin for a couple of years now.  During the great pumpkin shortage of 2009, Amazon seemed to be the only place that I could find canned pumpkin and so I decided to take a chance.  It is perfect!  It is creamy and smooth with no additives.  When it became available for Subscribe and Save, I jumped at the chance.  Buying it locally was a bit cost restrictive at about $3 a can.What do I use so much pumpkin for?  I first learned the wonders of pumpkin from Hungry Girl's daily newsletter.  (Hungry Girl: Recipes and Survival Strategies for Guilt-Free Eating in the Real World).  Sugar Free Devils Food Cake mix and a can of pumpkin = fudgy brownies.Then I inherited a cat with, ahem, problems.  Poor little thing.  While refreshing my pet care knowledge, I read about folks using canned pumpkin for their dogs.  What the heck.  Gave it a try and it seems to help.  BUT!! now she won't eat her meals without it.  She's hooked on pumpkin--a pumpkin junkie.  Thankfully, with Farmer's Market Organic, I can rest assured that, like her cat food, there are no harmful additives.Sadly, I've been unable to get the pumpkin from Amazon of late.  I even resorted to that other named brand and the difference is startling:  stringy and off colored.Fortunately, Farmer's Market Organic pumpkin is available in my local stores once again, however I am going to miss the Subscribe & Save option.

I actually only decided to write this review because all the bad ones almost prevented me from purchasing this.  Like a few other reviewers, I need this product as my dog has a tablespoon with every meal and the supermarket doesn't carry it at this time of year. All of the cans were in great condition, no problems whatsoever.

I love pumpkin for baking and cooking, but my puppy loves it to keep her digestive system running smoothly. I ordered a case of these for 1.63 per can.  As this can be such a hard product to find, that was a great deal for me.I also use this for teething treats by  freezing little bits in ice cubes (for freshness) and letting the puppy chew on them to help her gums.  There is no sugar or other ingredients and very low water content.I also did not have the problem that others encountered with the cans denting.

While these cans aren't flying out of the pantry like other bulk cans I've purchased from Amazon, it's not a problem because they don't expire for more than a year. I find this pumpkin brand delicious and nutritious. Also, the Amazon price is way cheaper than the Whole Foods price for this same brand.None of my cans arrived dented.

Due to our dog's  intestinal issues it was suggested we give him a couple tablespoons of pumpkin with his meals.
