Not the pie mix, but pure, organic pumpkin.It was pretty pricey at the pet store and not available in our supermarkets since it is a seasonal item. I always find the best deals on Amazon and this was one of them. Good price and FREE shipping on two cases, that stuff is heavy so the free shipping and no tax was a welcome reward. Now that Max is over his tummy upset we continue to give him this  product. You can also use this for baking, adding your own sugar and spice.

column9: Love the puree, hate the price
column10: Our cats love this stuff, and we love what it does for the cats' digestion.Price seems to have jumped pretty high recently on Amazon.  We shopped around on the Web and found cheaper sources.Free market at work.

I'd like to first make a note, after reading other reviews, I hesitated to buy this pumpkin because of issues with dented cans. When I received my order, every can was in perfect condition, and well packaged.As far as the product goes, I love this pumpkin for baking purposes. I make excellent pumpkin muffins with this and when I ran out and used conventional pumpkin, I was disappointed. So, we are hooked on this pumpkin, it's a must have for my muffins.I did read in other reviews that some folks that feed pumpkin to their dogs didn't like this product, and I will say that my dog who has digestive issues does better on the conventional pumpkin (I believe it has more fiber than the organic), and she doesn't like this kind much. But I'm not basing my 5 star review on my dog. She can eat conventional and we will eat the organic.

I was skeptical of ordering after reading about all the dented can issues, I got my order today. NO DENTED CANS! My order was packaged as if to survive the next millenium and the cans were in mint condition!Great bargain at the price.

column9: Better taste, organic, and not a dent in the box
column10: I was so happy to see all twelve cans in pristine condition and with "use by" dates two years off stamped on the tops.  Another highly pleasant surprise came when I had my first taste.  This pumpkin is without a doubt better tasting than Libby's.  With the Subscribe and Save discount, this superior product actually costs a tad less than what I pay for Libby's at my local store.  And with the added convenience of home delivery!  I use a couple cans each week because it is loaded with nutrients and fiber and being a thick puree it is very useful in creating good things to eat.  I have put about a tablespoon on a dish for my cat twice and she ate it up both times which rather amazed me.

The pumpkin is good, but 7 out of the 12 cans arrived dented (and not just little dents).  I read that dents aren't a big deal unless they are at the seams of the cans (which most of these are at the top or the bottom). Would have been a good deal, but I'm definitely disappointed.  Like other reviews said, these dents don't appear to be from them being shipped as cans that were even packaged in the middle were dented, makes you think they are selling the companies "seconds" or something.
I recieved my order with no dented cans.  What happened to $12 a case it's now $16.  My dog owning friends say it's still a good price.

We love pumpkin soup and eat it year round, not just during "pumpkin season".  And I make a pumpkin macaroni and cheese that even company raves about.  Normally I wouldn't serve mac and cheese to company, but this particular recipe is definitely 5 star quality. (I do not make pumpkin pie - don't like it.)I was really happy to find this brand on Amazon in 2011 for half of the price I pay through my food club when the product is on special sale.....and about 1/3 of the price that is charged when it's not on sale.It's really good pumpkin.  My original review gave this pumpkin only 4 stars because at that time it didn't come in a BPA free can.  It is now October, 2012 and I recently received a second case from Amazon and was delighted to read "BPA FREE" on the label.Thanks, Farmers Market, for caring about our health!  You earned your 5th star.The pumpkin is still a very good price now in 2012 IF you order it in the "frustration free packaging" from Amazon, but only slightly less than my food club.  But, hey, pennies count!
I received this item very quickly - cans were in perfect condition (no dents, like some of the other reviews).  Very happy overall with the quality of this product

I bake a lot of vegan cookies, quick breads and muffins... and pumpkin is a great ingredient to add moisture and flavor.  My grocery store is out of canned pumpkin more than half of the time so I've turned to amazon, and discovered this brand in the process.  The flavor is good and the price is great.  I always prefer to buy organic over non so that's a big plus.  I've ordered two cases thus far and will definitely reorder when I run out!

column9: Delicious - and no dented cans, as per other reviews
column10: There seemed to be a lot of reviews regarding dented cans, but my order was perfect....all in excellent condition and products with an expiration date of 10/2013.Superb!

I saw all the problems people were having with damaged cans but the sale price was too good to pass up.  I ordered two cases.  First case, not even a little dent.  Second case, bashed to heck.  Obviously not Amazon's fault since the boxes they arrived in were fine.  Farmer's Market really needs to figure out what is going on in their packing department!
I had damaged cans as well.  Eight of the 12 cans were VERY dented. The box was perfectly packaged and undamamaged.

Just received two cases.There were 4 dented cans. So what? I'll just use them up first.The last time I checked, this was $1.99 a can in the store.The code date was: 10/2013Remember pumpkin is a squash, and I plan to use some of it as a vegetable.
I purchased this 12 pack of pumpkin and was delighted.  All cans were perfect...no dents at all.  The pumpkin was flavorful and great to work with.  I would recommend this purchase highly.

I'll keep this short. My cat is old and has kidney problems. He is the one eating all the pumpkin puree and hasn't complained so far. It does get a bit watery compared to the other brands, but I needed the 15oz. cans so this fits the bill.
The product does exactly what it says for my dog.  However I have found/used other products that were just as effective for half the cost.

column9: Arrived sooner than promised in perfect condition
column10: I was a little concerned by all the negative reviews but was desperate to find canned pumpkin at a reasonable price, the free shipping closed the deal. No dented cans at all.
this is the best canned pumpkin.it makes an amateur cooks dishes taste gourmet.only reason i would not recommend it is that it mightget hard to find with the pumpkin shortage.
With the free shipping this product is a great bargain for those who love organic foods.

column9: GREAT Organic Pumpkin delivered with NO damaged cans!
column10: I ordered this pumpkin because my cat needs it in his diet. The first time I ordered many months ago, half the case was damaged, the company was having "packaging issues". But they assured me (their customer support was fantastic! Extremely nice, helpful, and friendly, and they made it right just as promised!) that they would take care of everything and they did, fast too! I originally ordered because it was "organic", which is very hard to find in the stores! I reordered when I was getting low. I received the case, the cans were perfect, and because of this product, my cat is alive and well! It was VERY important that my cat have this, so yes, I am VERY thankful they are still selling this product! I will continue to order it as long as I need it! THANK YOU VERY MUCH FARMERS MARKET FOODS!!!!!!!!!!!!!Sincerely,Chris

column9: Is this manufacturer using Amazon to close out damaged cans?
column10: Our dog gets pumpkin in every meal -- if yours does too, you know why.  You also know that one can only stash so many cans of pumpkin, and that somewhere in the spring most supermarkets start running out of canned pumpkin and can't get more or stop ordering it (understandably).  So, I was happy to see this product on Amazon.Unfortunately, as other reviewers experienced, many of the cans arrived dented. In fact ALL 12 CANS were dented, most severely so.  Thing is, unless Amazon wrapped the cans to the case flats, this was not an Amazon issue.  The case pack was well buffered in a larger box that was completely undamaged; neither the shrink-wrap nor the flat were damaged; and even the inner cans in the case were bashed up.This clearly indicates that the manufacturer -- or whomever wrapped the cases -- shipped already and obviously damaged cans.  I checked the product listing and there is no mention of these being seconds.  My message to manufacturer, distributor and/or Amazon: check the product or change the description so people know they are taking their chances.Thankfully, Amazon customer service came through with an offer to replace or refund.  I'm giving this one more shot for my dog's sake, and will hope for the best.

column9: It's way better than any other canned pumpkin on the market
column10: I buy canned pumpkins regularly because my cat craves for them. Used to buy these from Whole Foods but somehow they stopped filling the racks. You just can't buy other kinds of canned pumpkin with this kind of quality. It's not watery, not sweetened, and no other ingredients added.

This is the only organic pumpkin I have been able to find on the market.  Great quality and taste.  Less water than non-organic pumpkin puree, so I do need to stir it in a seperate bowl before adding to my dry baking ingredients.  We love this product!

Being unable to find canned pumpkin in any of my local stores, I held my breath (after reading the mixed reviews and mentions of damaged cans), took a chance and ordered a 12 pack.  Of the 12 cans, only 2 arrived undamaged.  Another 2 had small dents, which shouldn't affect the product or make opening the cans a problem.  Unfortunately, the 8 remaining cans are too badly dented to use.  Dents deep enough to have bent the cans sideways, and in the case of top dents, probably make it difficult/impossible to fully open with can opener. These will be discarded. Since some of the cans are dented on the top while others on the bottom, and the two undented cans were on an OUTSIDE row and the most severely dented on the INSIDE row, it appears that the cans were dented prior to packaging and not damaged in shipping.It is disappointing to see that damaged product is still a problem so many months after the first reviews called attention to the issue but an Amazon customer service rep. promised that someone would look into the issue to try to ascertain just where the damage is happening.  I haven't actually tried the pumpkin in the any of the 4 'safe' cans yet, so my review isn't based on the actual quality of the pumpkin but given the outrageously bad condition of the packaging there's no way I could rate this higher.
Sending it back to Amazon.  Most of the cans have large dents in them. The bubble wrap around the cans is fine, the box is fine, so I assume the cans were shipped with the dents.

column9: Is someone using Amazon as an outlet for dented cans?
column10: I received Farmers Market Organic Pumpkin 12 pack yesterday. 5 out of 12 cans were pretty badly dented, another 2 not quite so bad. Packaging was not damaged and cans were bubble wrapped inside the box so it wasnt packaging or delivery. These cans were sold and shipped already dented. Don't blame UPS. I will keep and use them they are dated 2013,however this is hardly what I paid for ???? . Someone is obviously taking full advantage of the pumpkin shortage to unload their dented can inventory. Buyer beware!!

I am afraid this was a huge mistake.  The cardboard shrink wrapped box was wet, moldy, and falling apart.  The cans inside were bent, covered in fuzzy black mold, wet, and I couldn't get them out of the house fast enough. Our dogs eat pumpkin and we go through a lot, so I was happy to see that Amazon could provide us with a case.  I would not recommend this product - it is a health hazard!

I was so excited that I found canned pumpkin since there is a shortage at this time.  However, almost ever can in the case was dented.  I don't know if it was shipped in that condition (poor quality control) or the damage occurred during shipping (poor packaging).  I would love to order this again, but don't want the hassle.  However, Amazon took the return with no additional cost on my end.

All the cans were dented. Every. One. It is as if a child hammered each one, some several times. Then they were shrink wrapped and put in the box. Is there any quality control here? While Amazon will pay for this 12 pound box of unusable cans to be returned and I will eventually get a refund - what a waste. Once returned there will be no ability for anyone to use this product due to the dents - Botulism anyone? Why would Amazon even bother to ship this product in this unsafe and unusable condition?T hey have paid for round trip shipping of a heavy box for no reason.

We eat pumpkin on a regular basis and it gets hard this time of year when all of the stores are sold out.I saw reviews here on Amazon saying the cans were dented, but saw that someone from the manufacturer had responded so I figured the problem had been addressed.NOT SO.  I received a case of these cans and it was wrapped extremely well - bubble wrap all over the place.  However, the cans INSIDE the case were dented and damaged - I don't mean a little dented, I mean several of the cans had their entire sides caved in in such a way that I could not open one can and on another can I couldn't remove all the pumpkin because the can was smashed so badly.Those most damaged cans were packaged in the middle of the case - seemingly intentionally disguising how badly damaged they were.  The cans on the outside were relatively OK, ALL of them were dented a little - every single can - but the ones on the outside were MUCH less damaged than the ones on the inside.I don't see how this could have been accidental, although anything is possible.The quality of the pumpkin itself was good, but I don't like using damaged cans in case the food inside has been compromised.
I have purchased this item before.  Once they were all dented and once they were not.  I would bet that if they run out of their dented product they are clearing out then they ship the undented ones.

column9: A good price for a good product.
column10: First, I want to review the product itself. I've used this brand of canned pumpkin before, so it was not new to me. I find the flavor to be a little more like a fresh pumpkin and the texture to be a little less creamy than mass market brands. But not to a degree where it causes problems in any of the recipes I use it in. The cost per can of ordering here on Amazon is less than what the local natural food store I usually buy it at sells it for. And since they were very low on stock last time I bought it and had no expected restocking date, I figured the savings and availibility made it worth the risk of ordering online even after reading the reviews.Which leads me to the packaging. Yes, as many other reviewers have reported, cans were dented. The outside packaging along with the other items in my order were in perfect condition, it was not until I got to the "ready to ship" flat of cans that were pre-packaged by the manufacturer that I found any damage whatsoever. 8 of the 12 cans had dents. However, they are only small dents and don't affect the safety or quality of the product in any way. I wouldn't have hesitated to purchase the cans off of a store shelf in this condition since the product is in very short supply, so it isn't a problem for me.

At a time of a "pumpkin drought" in the commercial market, when I couldn't find a single can of pure pumpkin in any supermarket, finding this product was a miracle!  We use pumpkin daily, as an addition to our dogs' diets, in order to keep their digestive systems in peak condition.  And Farmer's Market Organic Pumpkin is exceptional. It is slightly thinner in consistency than the store brands we've previously purchased which makes it excellent for its intended purpose. That it is organic is an added plus.

I give my dog pumpkin every to help control his weight.  With the pumpkin shortage, that has been very hard to do.  However, this brand has been the only one available when others have not.  It is high quality and I appreciate the organic health benefits for my dog.
This is the best canned pumpkin I have found.  Anything organic is always tastier.  I am very happy with this pumpkin.
This is  my second purchase.  Better this time.  Only one dented can, and less water.

I HAD to have pumpkin for my dogs so I rolled the dice after reading the mixed, but mostly dissatisfied reviews. One third of the cans were very dented. However, none were bulging which is the sign of spoiled food. We are using the dented ones first without issue - on the third of four right now.I must agree that it looks like a manufacturers "error". The dented cans were hidden in the middle of the case, surrounded by good cans. I would bet my last dollar that Farmers Market Foods is using Amazon to dump what they knew wouldn't sell on the supermarket shelves!Lastly, I will purchase this item again, dents or no dents and use it unless it's bulging. But it's unnerving knowing that something sneaky is going on at an organic food manufacturer.

This review is ONLY IN REGARDS to the PHYSICAL CAN.  I will review the actual product once I have tried it.  But for now please be advised before you purchase------- I read the reviews - Lots of dented cans....  I figured there were so many complaints that it just couldn't still be happening, right?  WRONG!  6 of the 12 were badly dented all along the upper rim seams.  Amazon did, however, make good on my order with an exchange.  Still----- disappointing that the product quality control is so poor with this product after all the bad reviews.

column9: Great product at a great price
column10: Since there is a national shortage of canned pumpkin, I was very happy to find an online source for this product. Our dog needs the pumpkin to keep her digestive tract regular and she loves it. This is a great product at a great price.

I was very happy to find this item available for purchase. My husband has diabetes and I use this pumpkin to make custand for him using Splenda as the sweetner. I could not find any solid pack pumpkin in any supermarkets. Publix had this item for a short time, but then it was unavailable. When I found it at Amazon.Com I immediately bought a case. It works fine and makes delicious custard. When the 12 cans are gone, I will order it again.

column9: Can't find in grocery store? Find at Amazon!
column10: It frustrates me when I can't find canned pumpkin in my local grocery store.  It is part of my regular diet.  I ordered it from Amazon.com and got the same brand product at a very similar price.  With no shipping charges, I found it a great deal.

All of my cans were dented.  Some cans had multiple dents.If we were told that and / or if they were discounted, I couldmake the choice; however, this was just a case of a manufacturermaking extra money on dented cans and taking advantage of the customers.GDn
I have used many brands of canned pumpkin, but this is the best I've ever tasted. It tastes sweet and fresh, no tinny taste at all.
This product is okay, the cans were all dented when received, all 12 cans.. This pumpkin is very runny...had to use more flour than the recipe called for.

I'm one of the lucky ones who did not receive any damaged or crushed cans, though, I would not have cared at this point since I was desperate for pumpkin.  I needed the pumpkin for my dogs.  I do, however, notice that it does not work as well for them (their anal glands) the way the regular pumpkin does (Libby's) but I like the fact that they are getting organic.

Like some of the other reviews, my cans were a bit dented in spite of the excellent packaging.  But just a tad, not enough to be concerned about the contents inside.  I've purchased organic pumpkin before from local stores, and it was a little watery, so that's probably one of the differences in regular pumpkin and organic.My dog and cat both need pumpkin to help express their anal glands, and the pumpkin is much cheaper and easier (especially on the cat) then taking them to the vet every few weeks.Thanks, Amazon!

I purchase the Organic canned pumpkin for my dogs. Sounds funny but pumpkin is wonderful for dogs digestion. I have been feeding my dogs pumpkin for years. column9: Good pumpkin, BUT too many heavily dented cans!

The price has jumped to $16 per case since last Friday so I will wait until the price goes back down again before I order more.I thought I would share my recipe since I mentioned it <smile>Pumpkin CupcakesPumpkin cupcake recipe with optional cream cheese frosting.INGREDIENTS:2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, or your favorite flour1 tablespoon baking powder1/2 teaspoon baking soda1/2 teaspoon salt3/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon1/2 teaspoon ground ginger1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg1/2 cup butter, softened1 1/3 cups sugar2 eggs, beaten until frothy1 cup mashed cooked or canned pumpkin3/4 cup milk3/4 cup chopped walnuts or pecansPREPARATION:Sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, ginger, cinnamon, and nutmeg into a bowl. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in eggs. Blend in mashed pumpkin. Stir in the sifted dry ingredients alternately with the milk, blending until batter is smooth after each addition; stir in chopped walnuts or pecans. Spoon batter into well-greased and floured or paper-lined muffin pan cups.Fill about 2/3 full. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes, or until a wooden pick or cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Frost with cream cheese frosting, whipped cream, or leave plain. Makes about 24 cupcakes.Cream Cheese FrostingINGREDIENTS:1/4 cup butter1 package (8 ounces) cream cheese or Neufchatel (lower in fat), room temperature1 pound confectioners' sugar2 teaspoons vanilla extractPREPARATION:Directions for cream cheese frostingCombine all ingredients in large mixing bowl; beat well until smooth. Makes enough cream cheese frosting for a 2-layer cake.

The Taste of the Wild food, either dry food or cans, both of our dogs LOVE, and my picky, sensitive sweetheart does absolutely great on them. No more upset stomach, and ZERO hot spots..!!! I highly recommend this food whole-heartedly, and we will keep buying it. Two paws up..!! :)

column9: Instantly gets my dog to eat his food!
column10: My dog (GSD - 2 years) is an extremely picky eater.  He likes the TOTW DRY dog food, but he only eats it when he feels like it.  Sometimes he will only eat every other day.  I started adding TOTW CANNED dog food (the same kind as the dry) to his kibble and he LOVES it.  Instead of just sniffing the food and walking away, he instantly eats it as soon as I put the bowl down.  I have read that canned dog food is much better than the dry kibble because there is less chemicals and although a meal consisting of only canned food could be pretty pretty expensive with a big dog like mine, adding the canned food into his dry allows him to get the benefits of the canned food, makes him eat more consistently, and even ends up saving you money.  Great product.

column9: Good quality and a fair price
column10: For some reason, Thyme leaves have become difficult to obtain in stores in this area.  I'd only been able to find the McCormick "gourmet" thyme leaves at almost $4 for a small bottle. The quality of these leaves is every bit as good as the "gourmet" leaves and the price is considerably less.
This tea is a mixture of rooibos, peppermint, and chamomile. When you open the bag, you are greeted with a wonderfully strong and pleasant aroma. It brews well and helps soothe the belly.

column9: Low price is not enough to justify
column10: These dates are one of the cheaper option for dried pitted dates on Amazon. I did not like them, though. Very dry, and some even have a tint of flavor of oil going bad. This is not bad enough to throw them out, let's say. But they are not enjoyable as dates usually are. You probably need to wash them, and they flake a lot, when you do.Maybe I will use them for cooking somehow. I don't recommend this product.
I did not like these. They were very dry and had a strange taste. Wound up throwing them out.
These dates are of very poor quality.  They are dry and tasteless.  I was very disappointed.

These dates would not have been BOUGHT by residents in the Middle East.  They were small.  Most had the consistency of the rawhide leather chew toys we give our dogs.  Many pits remain, and since these are so old, hard. and stale, they must be soaked in hot liquid for a while to use for baking.  Because there are so many pits and that nubby end thing, one must dissect and snip with scissors every single date into baking-size pieces.  Awful!!  I bet the Bergin Nut Company was chuckling when I ordered so many of their awful dates.  Yuck!!

Should have read the reviews before ordering.  These are VERY dry.  We were given another brand as a gift over Christmas and was going to buy them, but these were cheaper!  I'm learning cheaper is not always better.

I have been looking for REAL maple candy for years now.  Not the "creamy" kind that is found everywhere, but the type that has been cooked down so long that the sugar crystals truly harden.  I was hoping that was what I would find from Butternut Mountain Farms after reading some of the reviews, and boy oh boy, was I right!  This is not stale candy as some reviewers claim, but candy cooked to perfection!  I just finished an entire leaf and I am so happy that I could dance the jig!  Thank you Butternut Mountain Farms!  I feel like I'm a kid growning up on the East coast again!
This is delicious and I would buy it again.In fact, I did. Has a nice taste and one of thebest around.

column9: Should be better in the spring
column10: I really should have been more patient.  Maple season isn't for a few more months so I'm not surprised that the candy tasted somewhat stale (the sugar had hardened in some spots) and was a little bit grainy (felt like not all of the sugar had fully dissolved).  Still enjoyable with a mild maple flavor.
This is more like pure corn syrup candy with maple flavoring than maple candy.  DO NOT BUY THIS STUFF!  Ick!!!
I really have enjoyed this tea.  I drink green tea for health and for enjoyment.  This tea is great, not bitter.  Definitely would buy again.

This is SEL, otherwise known as real sea salt. It's a bit moist, a bit dark and a bit "nasty", but put a bit on a fresh cut tomato, and you will be amazed. It's sharp, a little bitter and lends a great taste to anything from soup to steaks. Try using it as a rub on NY steaks with just pepper.... THIS salt doesn't disolve during cooking and creates little explosions of flavor in your mouth. Some things are just good - - - this is one of them.

One of the nicest, smoothest cup of chai I've made. Nice mix of spices, largest overtone is the cardamom, but since i do like a half/half of tea with milk or soy milk as my chai drink, this is a good base for me.

column9: Tried them ;can't wait for them to be available.
column10: These are the first baked potato chips that taste great.  They're low fat and offer the benefits of Omega 3.  Tried them on an out-of-town trip.  First thing I did was check Amazon to buy them.  Not available yet but when they are, I'll buy a case.

I started drinking white chocolate mochas at Starbucks, but at almost $5 a cup, it was too rich for me.  So, I decided to try this product after reading some reviews, and I'm glad that I did!  It tastes almost exactly the same to me as what I was buying at Starbucks when I put it into coffee, but I've found that my favorite mix is to simply add it to cold milk.  I think that it has a wonderful flavor that way, and I prefer it cold instead of hot.As some others have mentioned - if you are looking for a cocoa flavor, this isn't a good choice.  If you know that you like white chocolate and mocha, then I highly recommend giving this product a try.

column9: How is Ghirardelli's white chocolate mocha? Yummers!
column10: I love me a good white mocha, but at 4 bucks a pop at the cafe and goodness knows how many calories -- its an occational treat.  I am really trying to stay out of Starbucks to save money; enter this very creamy and delicious mix from Ghirardelli.  It is such an inexpensive way to enjoy a white mocha!Ten reasons why this mix rocks:1.  It contains no saturated fat or trans fats2.  Each serving of mix has only 100 calories3.  It contains the coffee and is good on its own, but I add powdered espresso or cold brew for AM kickstart4.  I really like being able to control the milk fat content, it tastes really fresh and not like fake creamer5.  It is good hot or cold6.  This mix is ideal for keeping in your office7.  It contains regular sugar and not high-fructose corn syrup8.  One can lasts me four work weeks, but I don't have one everyday9.  It is good to take camping/backpacking for a yummy hot pick-me-up while "roughing it"10.It is awesome with a shot of dark rum, khalua or other suited boozy add in -- instant winter lifter ;)ECONOMY: At 19 servings a can for $4 (21 cents/serving) + milk (25 cents/cup), each white mocha is less than 50 cents!EASE OF USE: It mixes instantly in hot liquid.  If making an iced drink, stir the powder into a small amount of hot liquid before adding the cold milk and ice or you will have the movie DUNE on top of your iced drink.TASTE: To me it tastes very much of white chocolate, it may be just flavoring but it really works.  Actual white chocolate doesn't have any cocoa in it, just the cocoa butter, so I didn't expect any chocolate in the ingredients list and was not disappointed to see it missing.  If this had actual chocolate in it, it would be a black & white (or tuxedo) mocha mix.  It is important to read all the details and ingredients of a product before ordering to avoid disappointment over assumptions.FINAL WORD: Scrumptious and thrifty

This is the best white mocha mix I've ever had. It is perfectly smooth once mixed well, and doesn't separate as the drink cools like many other chocolate mixes. The flavor and consistency are both perfect. Ghiradelli gets the job done.Also is really good in milk shakes!Highly recommended.

column9: Just like the coffee shops use.
column10: This stuff is great!  I used to work at a coffee shop and this is what we would use for white mochas and white hot chocolates.  Ghiradelli by far has the best white hot chocolate mix out there.
I drink coffee every day all day but once I tried this....I don't want anything else....Can't find it anywhere around here so thank god....I could find it here.....

From reading other reviews, this white mocha mix seemed to be good if you like Starbucks white chocolate mocha. However, I did not like it at all. It does not taste anything remotely similar to Starbucks white chocolate mocha. As another reviewer pointed out, it is pure sugar. It does not have a chocolate flavor or a mocha flavor. I can't really describe the taste, but it basically tastes like you are drinking sweet milk with a subtle hint of chocolate.

This is a fantastic drink for winding down after a hectic day or just celebrating the fact that things went well.  I often have to find alternatives to chocolate and this white chocolate drink hits the spot!  My containers arrived quickly and sturdily wrapped in plastic to prevent any damage.  Thanks to the care in getting this to me.  I shall show my appreciation by thoroughly enjoying the product!

column9: Skip the coffee bar and not feel deprived!
column10: If you're a fan of white mocha drinks that break your budget at coffee bars, this is a purchase you must make!All the flavor and consistency that you'd expect is here, and you can make it yourself and save a fortune. I can't swear to it, but I'm willing to bet that this is exactly the same stuff they are selling at such inflated prices.Amazingly good and a wonderful value! (Buy it from Amazon.com and add in the savings on FREE shipping.)

Ghirardelli Chocolate Hot Beverage Mix, White Mocha, 19-Ounce Cans (Pack of 4)This is absolutely fantastic. It is an instant hot chocolate and coffee drink. You can mix it as strong as you like.It is good for adding flavor to a weak coffee some wimp has brewed. It has the coffee affect with the hot chocolate taste. It warms you up for hours. Its the perfect winter treat. It has a lot of calories, but gives you energy to move. So it probably helps you burn more calories than you consume.

I did not expect to like this (don't know what possessed me to buy it in the first place) but after preparing it for the first time, I realized it is absolutely amazing. It is even better when made using the "Back to Basics Coco-Latte" machine, because it creates a nice frothy top.It is a little sweeter than I usually like my coffee, but I think of it more as a dessert beverage or a special treat, instead of my morning coffee, and it is perfect for that.I highly recommend it to anyone who likes White Mochas, if they like them a little sweet. If you are expecting it to be exactly like a White Chocolate Mocha from that ubiquitous chain of coffee shops, you may be disappointed. But if you are looking for a delicious beverage to enjoy after dinner or on a cold afternoon, then you will love this.

This Hot Chocolate is the Best.  I have used Girardelli on and off for 50 years; but this is now the best ever.  I have made it up for many people, and all have really enjoyed it and have to have it.  I make with 3 heaping tablespoons of the Chocolate powder and 1/3 teaspoon of instant esspresso, dissolve with boiling water 2-3 oz. then fill cup with milk.  Heat in microwave, then drink.  Once or twice a day is requested by all present.

I found this little gem at CostPlus World Market & jumped on it. As one of those people that spend $5 at the coffee shop 3/week (& sometimes my friend's too!) I just had to have it.I was pleasantly surprised. No it's not the exact same, but that's okay. It's close enough & I feel like I'm getting that indulgence. I picked up some soy milk that I heat in the microwave & some peppermint extract that I intended to make my own simple syrup with but haven't gotten that far. I just put in a little to each cup. I love it and fully intend to buy more when I'm out.

I really wanted to like this mix, but I simply can't.  Naming it "White Mocha" and even featuring a chunk of white chocolate on the package is simply preposterous, considering it neither contains nor tastes like chocolate.  Yes, I did know beforehand that it did not contain cocoa, but I still hoped for a tasty beverage mix that somehow would pull off a similar rich flavor.  But rich this stuff certainly is not; rather, it produces a bland drink that is anything but reminiscent of white hot chocolate, completely failing to produce the feel-good sensation of warm cocoa.  The mocha taste is somewhat present, but hardly enjoyable.  Overall very disappointing, especially for the price and coming from a brand like Ghirardelli.
I wasnt impressed with the flavor it has a stronger coffee flavor then the ones we buy at kroger same brand and same flavor.

column9: One of the best hot chocolate mixes out there!
column10: I have been using this hot chocolate mix since Christmas. I also bought and used Godiva's hot chocolate mix.I have a preference for White Mocha, and probably this is why I found Ghirardelli better than Godiva's hot chocolate.For the best hot chocolate drink, I would definitely use both Ghirardelli and Godiva together.
I love this white mocha mix!! I usually mix with hot milk, but when I don't want too much sweet, but some sweet, I mix it with coffee! Mmmm, yum!
Ghiradelli puts out the best combination of coffee and white mocha ever. I have done extensive research and the taste of this drink makes me smile. It's like vacation every morning.

I have been drinking White Mocha Beverage for YEARS, until the price increase that made it impossible to buy any longer.  I tried many, many substitutes, different brands, chocolate milk, etc., without luck.  I am so happy to find it on Amazon and for a decent price.  This product has a very unique flavor and it is excellent. Not only do you get good taste, but milk also.  I would recommend this to everyone, young and old.  It is creamy, smooth and yummy!  It's easy to prepare, good for all seasons!  Try it, you will like it.
This item is a great for a homemade white chocolate mocha fix.  I will definately start buying a regular basis.

column9: Overly sweet, no white chocolate flavor, stale tasting coffee extract
column10: This is the cheapest stuff I've tasted in a long time. The coffee is rivaled by dollar store coffee instant crystals; it tastes cheap. Day old coffee tastes far better than this. Everything about this is just terrible. There is absolutely no white chocolate flavor.To be blunt; it tastes like oversweetened milk with very little, and very shoddy coffee. This is the shoddiest drink I've had in a long time. If you want the real deal, go with Caffe D'amore or Ghirardelli's white chocolate powder which requires both milk and coffee as opposed to just milk. Those are what real cafes use; trust me, I've worked in a few. Other reviewers (specifically one lacking the Amazon Verified Purchase tag) have mistaken this with Ghirardelli's sweet ground white chocolate powder. It may be loaded with stuff that's unhealthy for you, but white mochas are something you want to indulge upon, not sip and refrain from spitting back out.

This is good. It's not oh-my-god-I've-died-and-gone-to-Starbucks good...but good nonetheless. It's not very strong, so I've tried adding a bit of coffee. But this drowns out the "white" taste. I've tried using it in coffee instead of sugar, but that uses too many calories and the coffee doesn't taste much different. There are 100 calories per 2 tablespoons. I used a little more than recommended for taste, which led to me feeling sick after drinking a tall cup of it. So, I recommend just making an 8 oz. serving.I may try buying some syrup to go along with it. That's probably calorie overkill, however. To sum it up, I'm pretty undecided about what to do with this product.

Let me start off by saying that I am addicted to Peppermint White Chocolate Mochas. It is by far my favourite coffee drink and I absolutely must have one when I go to Starbucks or any other coffee shop for that matter. Having said that this naughty habit of mine can be extremely expensive and I have to have decaf because caffeine irritates my stomach. I first purchased this mix at a grocery store thinking that it sounded interesting. When I tried it for the first time I was absolutely delighted. This is literally heaven in a cup as far as I am concerned and it is one of the best chocolate mixes`I have had the pleasure of tasting.Ghiradelli certainly knew what they were doing when they concocted this beverage mix.This is best made with 2% milk( do not mix with water or non-fat milk....bleh) and for extra delight add 1-2 shots of peppermint syrup.Delicious !

I get this every winter to have in the mornings on the way to work.  It's fantastic!  I rarely have caffeine either, but this seems to give me a little kick as well.  But, it tastes so good when it hits your lips...
I have bought this product for years at a well-known grocery chain and then couldn't get it any more so was very pleased to find it here at a reasonable price.

This is especially good with a cappucicno-add about a teaspoon to it and the flavor will be very rich. You can make a Starbucks-style white latte with it as well.This goes a long way and I recommend it.

I love white chocolate so I was hoping that this would give me a creamy white mocha taste with my coffee.  But boy, my hope was destroyed be it was way sweet and no creamy taste at all.  Don't buy this if you're looking for creamy white mocha/chocolate taste.
This is the best hot cocoa I've ever had and is very hard-to-find in NE. The only place I've ever seen it in stores, is at a Stop-N-Shop in NJ.
While this product was exactly as described it was not what I was looking for. I did not research enough and bought the name not the product. It was described correctly ...Thanks anyway .

column9: very good but a bit on the sweet side
column10: the flavor was really good but my family has cut down on sugar quite a bit so it was a bit sweet.
Didn't enjoy the White Mocha as much as I enjoyed the chocolate mix. The white mocha was a lot sweeter than I expected it to be. The package was a great deal nonetheless.

I love hot beverages now that I have my water cooler with hot/cold water in an instant.  So great to just push a lever and have a hot beverage.  This sounded great, shipped quickly but I found out it is not mixed with water.  Directions state to mix with milk.  I realized after adding water so I added some fat free half and half.  It was very sweet.  Taste was ok.  I'll try it in coffee and by heating milk in the microwave.

This can is so tiny for the price.  The taste was awful. I made a cup and poured it down the sink. I doesn't have any chocolate flavor at all. A huge disappointment and a huge waste of money!!!! I wish I would've read the reviews before purchasing this product.

column9: Do you really call it White mocha
column10: Starbucks white mocha tastes so much better, I bought it thinking it will atleast be a little closer to the taste of my fav white chocolate mocha. Taste is just Ok, will prefer other White choc. Syrup mixtures any time.
This is nothing but sugar. Forget it.The double chocolate is great! When we are in a hurry, we eat the double chocolate on a spoon, followed by water!

Oops!  I purchased this product thinking it was a white chocolate or at least some kind of chocolate flavor. Boy was I wrong.  Way over the top sweet.  I have been giving it away to unsuspecting friends and relatives, but don't tell them I hate it.  Never again....

Just bought a 4 pack last week and was surprised to find that there's no chocolate as an ingredient at all in this beverage. The title seems to be misleading as it says Ghiradelli Chocolate hot beverage mix.

Nice, light caramel flavored hard candy with a honey center. It was too sweet for my taste. I felt the energy boost as a sugar rush because the energy bolt is followed by craving a cup of coffee AND was very hungry for real food not a little snack munchie! Of course I had plenty of energy to find something to cook and eat pronto. I'm not sure if the fast absoprtion of the honey causes the effect. Glad I was at home or a fast food drive through was in order.There are 9 pieces in each package. It takes 3 of these to get 100% of the daily recommendation of vitamins B6, B12 and C. I have no desire to have more of these.

I wasn't expecting to read the ingredients to find out the first one is sugar and the second being corn syrup.  Basically, this is just another candy full of sugar that puts you on an immediate high and then plummets you to a low.  The little bit of vitamin B6 and B12 plus C isn't enough to give the body adequate nutrients to make any difference.I'm disappointed.  I was expecting a product that actually gave energy/nutrients and sustained it; not just another candy.  The flavor was okay...sort of buttery but I ended up spitting it out before I got too far. I'm a huge honey fan and I didn't taste the honey but maybe that's because I didn't hit the center as other reviewers did.This product isn't for me at all. In fact, the remainder of the package went into the garbage.

column4: David L. Poremba "the past in review"
column10: There is a slight caramel taste to these "energy drops" and it is a good alternative to a piece of candy as there are the vitamins inside...

I decided to request Ambrosoli-Honees Energy Plus Vitamins after visiting the manufacturer's Web site to ascertain whether or not they contain any meat products or gelatin; I didn't note any but the claim is that they contain Vitamin B12 which is often of animal origin. I decided to err on the side of my sweet tooth and bit the bullet.I was only marginally surprised that I didn't receive a 24-pack, a situation that usually leaves me fantasizing about asking the manufacturer whether or not they can spare the single item I was given. Regardless of quantity, Ambrosoli-Honees are quite pleasant. Their claim to fame is their soft centers enrobed by a hard shell. I chose the caramel flavor over the plain (which I understand is their most popular variety) because they contain milk and butter--I'm a sucker for dairy. They didn't disappoint; based on their ingredients, I'd have been surprised if they had.Ambrosoli-Honees are a very simple candy with only a few, no-frills ingredients. And yes, they contain corn syrup--a very common ingredient in candy making and, for that matter, home kitchens. Be aware that this is NOT the same as HFCS; don't tar it with the same brush. Amrosoli-Honees are made in Italy and I don't think they know from HFCS there. They (the Honees, not the Italians) do contain honey but its presence isn't really evident until you hit the center. Except for the fact that the surface is rather rough and wreaked havoc on my soft palate (not a great trait in sucking candy), I enjoyed them quite a lot.I'd still like to know the source for the Vitamin B12 but barring that, this is quality candy. It's not, however, an inexpensive nosh (weak dollar, high cost of importing) so I probably wouldn't recommend Ambrosoli-Honees for those looking for a cheap sugar fix. However, for those who don't mind spending for quality who'd like to think they're getting the benefit of several vitamins, Ambrosoli-Honees Energy Plus Vitamins (at least the caramel flavor), are well worth sampling.

column9: They definitel;y got the caramel right
column10: Can't vouch for the energy aspect of these guys but they do have a pleasant flavor, sort of a subtle version of a Werther's candy.

Both my daughter and I gave these Ambrosoli-Honees Energy chews a try at the same time and our conclusion was that while the flavor is so yummy, we never really felt an increase in energy.  The carmel-honey flavor is right on target and the chewy center is delightful.  Can't truly say we felt any more energy from these chews then we do from sucking on a regular piece of candy.  As far as the vitamins in these chews, I wouldn't spend the money on them since we take a multivitamin already.

I'm not certain what "honey energy" is beyond a sugar rush, and to be honest, unless you're on a low carb diet, the chances of getting a rush from this small amount of sugar is pretty slim.  These drops contain small amounts of vitamins B6, B12 and C for which a number of health claims can be made.The candy is a product of Italy so the honey in it may actually be real, unadulterated honey, not the honey-flavored sugar water we get here in the states with inexpensive and mass produced honey (Much of it from China, apparently, and pretty much devoid of any nutritional benefit.) That alone is a plus, assuming I'm correct.  And that's a big assumption in this particular instance.Bottom line, though, is that they taste pretty good, with a crunchy shell and a chewy interior.  I don't know that I consider them effective dietary supplements or energy producers, but as a sweet bite they're not bad.

I found the Ambrosoli-Honees Energy Plus Vitamin Caramel drops to be a nice, sweet alternative to candy.  The caramel flavor is very good and there is a liquid honey center.  While they seem like hard candy, they are chewy in your mouth.  They are 20 calories each and contain 33% of vitamins B6 and B12 as well as vitamin C.  I think the liquid honey centers would make them a substitute for cough drops for those who like honey as a cough suppressantWhile I like the taste, I personally didn't feel any burst of energy.  I do like the taste (I am guilty of having a sweet tooth) and will more than likely buy these in the future.

column9: Taste Great but Energy? I think not.
column10: If I was rating this solely on taste, I would give it 5 stars. However, they are argued to provide "energy" and I found nothing of the sort to be true. Even after several (yes, they are that good), I still had no more energy than regular. The taste was like a caramel chew -- super good. However, I cannot agree that the Ambrosoli provides ANY added energy. Consequently, it makes for a rather expensive candy. I would not purchase this again.

column9: Go ahead and schedule your annual dental checkup now
column10: When I first popped one of these in my mouth, I was really pleased with the light caramel flavor of the hard candy outer shell. The flavor was a little more delicate than a typical Werther's Original Hard Candies, 34-oz., but it still felt substantial. When the candy shell finally dissolved and broke, it let loose a blast of pure honey, so much so I felt like someone had pounded a beehive into my mouth. Wow! Sweet! I tried another and this time bit through the caramel shell right away. I ended up with a sticky sweet agglomeration of caramel and honey that threatened to glue my mouth shut if it didn't dissolve all my teeth first. Wow! Really sweet! If my dentist doesn't own stock in the maker of this product, he should. Doesn't matter, though, because after eating this candy, I'm probably going to be making his next three BMW payments anyway. So, I'll just say, hey, this candy is fine, but it's nothing but caramel and honey mixed together, and it can be over-powering-ly sweet. As for the pick-me-up, all I can say is, yep, that's what sugar does. And the vitamin boost? Yeah sure, but a piece of fruit or a glass a milk could probably do the same. I have to say, this is not a bad product, but it's nothing more than a semi-natural candy masquerading as something (energy boost with vitamins) that it really is not. If you love visiting your dentist, schedule an appointment before you try this candy. If you'd just as soon stay as far away from your dentist for as long as possible, I think you need to stay away from this cavity catalyst candy.

column9: Individually Wrapped Drops with a Sweet Taste
column10: The packages as shown contain 9 individually wrapped drops that look somewhat like cough drops. The list of ingredients includes sugar, corn syrup, milk, honey, butter, natural flavors, trace amounts of vitamin A and vitamins B6-0.66mg, B12-2mg, and C-20mg each at 33% of the recommended daily dosage; three drops providing then the listed minimum requirement.The amounts of vitamins C and B6 are so minimal as to be hardly worth mentioning; the amount of B12 is phenomenal if their information is correct. The DV for vitamin B12 is 2.4 mcg daily and the label claims 2mg or 2,000 mcg per drop or 6mg or 6,000 mcg with three drops. I suspect there's a typo there and it should read 2mcg, not 2mg since B12 is usually measured in mcg.In summary the drops are small and convenient, but expensive. If the B12 value is correct it has huge quantities of that B vitamin; other than that the cost is hard to justify.

I tried this out in several situations, while I was on my feet and while I was sitting at the computer. I tried one piece. I tried three pieces at once. Nothing. I never felt in any way, shape, or form, energized. It just didn't happen.The flavor is nice, not too sweet or syrupy. They'd probably make a nice throat clearer when you didn't need a full on cough drop, but as to energy... it just wasn't there. I'm completely underwhelmed.

These chews are really pretty good. Caramel is good; liquid honey center is good. Like most of the other reviewers I didn't have a noticeable increase in energy or alertness. These are almost as good as a candy substitute though.

column9: Well, at least they're not vile.
column10: I'm pretty sure these 'energy' bars do absolutely nothing. They taste decent, even somewhat good, but I honestly couldn't detect a surge in my energy. Glad it has all these vitamins but it would be cheaper to just go out and buy some rather than waste money on these bars.

These candies are tasting good but as far as the "energy" goes, I believe that they mean the sugars in them. I personally would not buy these to eat every day. If somebody would offer me one, i would take it but that is pretty much it.Just take your daily vitamins. You would probably get 2 months worth for a price of this 24 pack.

column9: Didn't really give me any energy
column10: These candies were good. I'm not saying they weren't sweet. But they didn't give me any energy that I noticed. I enjoyed them, but can't say I'd go out of my way to buy any on my own, and it certainly wouldn't occur to me to recommend them to a friend. Relatively mediocre.

I liked this item from the first taste. It is like sucking on pure honey with caramel. I couldn't tell you if it boosted my energy level, but the taste makes it worthwhile however it affects your energy level.

column9: Keep in your car, purse or bag for quick energy boost!
column10: I was really not sure what to expect when trying the `Ambrosoli-Honees Energy Plus Vitamin Caramel', but I must say, I liked them!  I was pretty hungry the other day on a car trip, with no place to stop and get food at the moment, so I popped one of these in to enjoy: it definitely had an effect!  After a few minutes, I felt better, as a bit of energy hit (probably from the sugar) - I wouldn't call this a `healthy' item just because it claims to have vitamins, but great for on-the-go use!  I'm not certain about the effectiveness of the vitamins, but as something to have in your car, purse or bag as a back-up, would definitely recommend!

column9: Not any more energy than other candy
column10: These candies taste OK, but don't seem to give me any more energy than any other candy of its type.The filling also is very sticky and gets caught in my teeth. Just because it has some vitamins thrown in, doesn't make it 'good for you'. I prefer energy bars with protein, like Power Bar or Clif. Even so, they don't take up much space in your pack, so you could keep them around for emergencies.

The Ambrosoli Honees Energy plus Vitamin Caramels were absolutely delicious! You definitely get a caramel taste without the stickiness. I can't speak to the vitamin aspect but it does give you a little energy shake up. I kept a pack in my purse and during long tiring speeches, I sneaked one and it kept me awake. The wrappers are noisy but worth it!

column9: Tastes great... but where's the energy?
column10: For the various energy products out there, whether drinks or bars or drops, the trick is to hit the right balance between flavor and effectiveness.  Plenty of them can keep you wired all night, but frankly taste terrible.  The "Honees Energy Plus" caramel drops are on the total opposite end of the spectrum.The drops taste great, much like a caramel flavored candy bar, but unfortunately provide basically no energy. Besides a relatively small amount of sugar, the only ingredients in the drops that would actually help give you a needed boost are the B6 and B12 vitamins.  Oddly the amounts are rather small, with only 33% of your daily recommended value of each. To compare to other energy products, a 5 Hour Energy short has 8333% of your daily value of B12 and 2000% of your daily value worth of B6.Whether just popping one or taking four at a time, these drops didn't give me any noticeable energy boost at all, although they are amazingly tasty.

Tired of caffeine?  Me, too.  I have been trying as many alternatives that I can to the instant jolt of coffee and tea.  I have tried many solutions, as far reaching as NuSkin's "Vitality" TM to, well, this one.Ambrosoli's Honees Energy is good, tasty, and affordable--especially if time is more precious than money and you don't want to fumble with supplements.The product comes with 24 packs with about ten per pack.  It's a good way to start the morning or get energized before a workout.  It starts out as hard candy, and like Tootsie Pops before it, it melts in your mouth into an ooze of pure honey. All the C and B vitamins are there to boost your energy and help your well-being.While not the tastiest, Ambrosoli-Honees does the trick.

I was excited to try these honey drops, who doesn't want more energy?!  I definitely could use it at this time of year (the holidays).  The taste is pleasant enough.  It reminded me of a Japanese candy I remember eating when I was a kid.  Anyway, I never got that burst of energy I was hoping for.  The ingredients say that there are B6, B12, and C vitamins in the candy, but personally, I didn't notice any difference between this and any other candy.  If you love honey candy, then go for it.  But don't count on it to give you that burst of energy to get your holiday shopping list done!

This is good candy but as far as energizing you......I don't think so.  I will admit that I only got a single package to base my opinion on but I could not detect any "jolt" of energy from it. Maybe I wasn't lacking enough in energy to notice a difference but all I can say about it is that it does have a pleasant taste, however so does a lot of other candy (and this is coming from a real candy fanatic) that costs a lot less and is a lot more readily available!

column9: Honey? Yes. Vitamins? Yes. Energy? Not that I noticed.
column10: I will admit, these are some tasty little candies. The outer shell reminded me of Werther's Original Hard Candies. Once I reached the center, I was very pleased with the liquid honey core to be found there. Each package contains 9 pieces.This candy boasts 100% of the daily requirements  for B6, B12 and C, but that's only if you eat 3 pieces.When the package says "Instant Honey Energy", that's simply a fancy way of saying "It Gives You A Sugar Rush". It's tasty, it's sweet, but it's only a temporary burst of energy. Personally, I didn't feel any increase in energy, but that's just me.Bottom line, if you like sweet candies, this is a good choice...but I wouldn't use it as a vitamin supplement.

column4: Jaime Vendera "Producer of Kindle books for 7...
column10: Beware, these little gems taste better than candy! The Ambrosoli-Honees Energy Plus Vitamin Caramels are not only delicious, they also give you a little boost as well. When I received them in the mail, I put them to the side. Later that night, when I was writing on my computer, I decided to give them a try. Phew, if they weren't so good, I'd only have eaten one. But I opted for two in a row because this hard energy candy tasted better than most caramels I've tried...Big mistake. I couldn't get to sleep for a few more hours, haha. Now, with that said, it isn't like the Energy Plus Vitamin Caramels are full of caffeine or other energy pepping herbs. Instead, they are full of B-vitamins. So, I cannot honestly say that my brain or body were wired wirth nervous energy, like if I downed some hard-core energy drink. It was more of a mental boost with no crashing side-effect, which is a plus. I really like them and I am going to order some more just to keep around when I need to satisfy my sweet craving. The hard candy has a soft center with a mixture of honey/caramel flavor that satisfies my craving while giving me a slight boost. Perfect combo!

The boost of energy they advertise is from the B12 and, of course, sugar you get from these caramel drops.  Shortly after eating one of these I feel I have a little more energy but it is pretty short lived.  One or two of these may be able to help get you through one of those after lunch meetings that normally tend to induce commas.  Unfortunately, some of the sweetener is from corn syrup.  20 calories and 5g carbs per drop.  Overall not bad for a quick sweet energy boost.

column9: Don't expect anything more than a piece of candy
column10: Well, it's fine if you want something sweet, but in order to get any "benefit" you're supposed to have 3 of these.  That would equal 15 g. carbs and 15 g. sugar--what?!?!?!  I think I'll stick with portable fruit (grapes, dried apricots, etc.) for MUCH less money, less sugar, and some fiber.  If you are looking for a tasty candy these might fit the bill, but they're darn expensive compared to Werthers or some other quality hard candy.I do not recommend these.

These individually wrapped rectangles are billed as a good source of on the go vitamin enriched energy but in truth are just pieces of candy with an average flavor, unnecessary vitamin enhancement and no particular nutritional value. The outer shell dissolves quickly revealing a lump of waxy honey. The flavor is somewhat reminiscent of WerthersWerther's Original Creamy Caramel Filled Hard Candies, 5.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) but not as good.  It is not an offensive product but did not boost my energy level one iota.  Diabetics who have low blood sugar issues might find them useful but would be just as well off with a roll of StarburstStarburst Original, 41-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2) I would not consider purchasing them nor would it be a product that is outstanding enough to recomment. More spin than substance.

column9: Not Sure About The Energy Part...
column10: ... but it sure tastes great. Semi-hard on the outside and chewy on the inside. Great caramel flavor and not too sweet. Since I'm usually not lacking in energy it's been hard to tell if they have any effect on me. Either way they taste really good and I'm not one to eat candy very often. I also like the fact that each candy is individually wrapped. Recommended.

I was anxious to try something that said it could help in Energy.  I do take Vitamin B Supplements because I know how important it is for my body.  I will say, I didnt get any sort of "energy" from this.To get the full dose of 100% recommended doses, you have to eat 3 of these.  I did try one at a time at first & when nothing happened, I did try the 3... still nothing.I will say, the taste was wonderful & enjoyable.  Not what you expect for a vitamin... but still not sure I'd classify this as a vitamin.Maybe it gave me the recommended vitamin for the day - but it definately didnt delivery on the energy.

Busy. Busy. Busy. Tis the season to run around and get run down. The Ambrosoli-Honee Energy Plus Vitamin caramels are a delicious way to boost your immune system and stay healthy on the go.There's no yucky tang or aftertaste, just the flavor of caramel and honey. This supplement is buttery and sweet, and you don't have to feel guilty about indulging. I was pleasantly surprised these.

I really wasn't sure what to expect when I ordered these, but they do have a nice taste.  I can't say I noticed any sort of energy boost from them but they do claim to have those vitamins.  I'm not sure I'd buy them again myself but if you are interested in the Vitamin B and C benefits, this does seem to be a good tasting option.

I enjoyed the Ambrosoli-Honees Energy Plus Vitamin Caramel energy thingies (could they please come up with a longer name?), but I probably wouldn't buy them.  While they do contain vitamins, I'd prefer to just take a vitamin.  I didn't feel particularly energized either, although again they're reasonably enjoyable.They're not great and not bad.  If you like honey, you might like these.  I can't really see a great demand for these, but I'm sure someone will love them.  I prefer the non-carmel version to the carmel Ambrosoli-Honees Energy Plus Vitamin things.
Good drops with Vitamins C, B6 and B12.  If you like the taste of honey, you will like these.  They also serve a good substitute for throat drops to soothe a minor throat irritation.

The flavor of honey and caramel is divine. I didn't notice much of an energy boost, like one would get from caffeine, but I gave it five stars for its taste and the vitamins it contains. The children loved them! I wouldn't let them eat them at will (they're so good, I'm sure the pack would be gone),but they are a nice treat I will purchase again.

column9: Taste great! No idea if they are good for you...
column10: I tried these and loved them. They are a great tasting hard candy that claims to have vitamins for a boost of energy. I never felt a boost of energy, but I had to restrain myself from eating a whole pack at a time for fear that I might overdose on B vitamins. I have never gotten B12 shots, but I have friends who swear by them. These candies did not give me anything like the boost they claim to get from the shots. I think that I preferred the honey candies over the caramel slightly, but both are good.

column9: Can't speak to the vitamins but the taste isn't stellar
column10: I didn't notice any change in energy; truthfully I'd rather just swallow a multivitamin and be done with it.  The taste wasn't bad, but it wasn't great either; definitely not something I would ever find myself craving.

These little candies taste fine. That's probably all I need to say. There's 20 calories and 33% of Vitamin C and the B vitamins per candy, but who eats a candy for the vitamins? I'm highly doubting one of these candies will give you energy, unless you're starving and this is all there is...I certainly didn't notice any difference. They taste more like honey than caramel, which is fine, and have a pleasant bit of liquid honey inside.

These taste really good, and a lot of people could use more of the "B" vitamins, but it's only 33% of your RDA of vitamin "B". "B" vitamins are not easily absorbed by the body,  and usually to make any difference at all you need mega doses if they're taken orally. 33% is pretty much non-existent in terms of absorption, from what I've read.I didn't notice any energy boost from the pack I ate, but that's the way vitamins are, if you need them, it's very very bad if you don't get them, but if you don't need them, you're just making expensive urine.When my Dad had dementia, one of the things they tested for was "B" vitamin deficiency, that wasn't what caused his, but it's scary to think that not getting enough of just one vitamin could have been the culprit in something as severe as his dementia.If it doesn't make a difference, you probably aren't deficient or the amount of vitamin is too small and it wasn't absorbed and you won't really get an "energy boost." The product is kind of misleading in claiming that.It tastes good, it's nice candy, the vitamin "C" probably gets absorbed and the sugar will give you a rush, but I wouldn't count on this for vitamin "B", you need shots or a mega dose supplement for that.I'd read up on "B" vitamins before buying these, they're expensive and I really doubt their efficacy. If you need "B" don't mess around, get shots and don't count on a candy to help you.
I guess its healthy, when you get to the middle, the honey flows out, kinda cool I guess... taste is good, not great, fortified with vitamins, so better than candy...low cal also

column9: Good, but not as great as the Plain Honees flavor
column10: If you've had the regular "Honees" candy before, you will definitely enjoy these. They taste the similar but this product is caramel flavored in addition to to being honey filled and is infused with vitamins C, B12 and B6. If you've never had these before, these candies have a honey flavored sugar shell on the outside and are liquid-honey filled on the inside. If you love the taste of pure honey, you'll probably really enjoy these candies. I've loved the taste of honey since I could remember, so I really love these candies. I even use honey as a sweetener in my coffee, so I may be a bit biased in this review, lol. Anyways, there are 9 pieces of candy in each bar, and there are 24 bars in the box.  By the way, this product is imported from Italy, so it is pretty hard to find in stores.Pros:-Tastes very delicious-Each candy provides 33% of your daily needs for Vitamins C, B12, B6. Eat 3 for nearly 100% :)-Made in Italy.... which automatically makes it cool in my book ;)Cons:-The caramel flavor is good but sort of masks/overpowers the honey flavor.

column9: Pleasant taste and solved a nagging cough
column10: Worked well when I just had a nagging cough / sore throat and has a pleasant taste.  Not much more I can say about it than that.

column9: More like sugary candy than energy.
column10: The Ambrosoli-Honees would be more accurately described as "Sugar Plus Vitamin" rather than "Energy Plus Vitamin" as the description states. They taste distinctively like a knock-off version of Werther's Original candies, just not nearly as tasty. They don't taste too bad, but let's call them for what they are: sugary "feel good" candy. The gooey "honey" center was really thick and tended to stick to my teeth pretty bad. While the B vitamins are nice, I think any minimal "energy boost" you get from them would be canceled out by the sugar rush and resulting crash from how sweet these are. They're decent as a feel good candy, but I can't justify the price and I personally would not purchase them for my own use.

After popping one of these in my mouth I couldn't help but taste the familiar caramel flavor immediately.  It is more of a subtle flavor after you are sucking on it for a while but overall it has a decent taste.  It is a hard candy, which is a little weird to get used to at first simply because when you taste caramel it is usually a soft handy.  When you get to the end there is a soft center that has a hint of coconut.  It is packed with 3 different vitamins so not only do you get the sugary treat of a caramel candy you also get a full dose of vitamins B and C (if you have three of them).  These are a hit and a miss for me.  On the one hand you get the nice caramel flavor, on the other it doesn't strike me as something that I will want to reach for again.

This is a very nice tasting, albeit sweet, little throat lozenge. However, I am not convinced of its vitamin and energy characteristics because it seems too much like a candy. The flavor is nice (similar to milk'n'honey) but very very sweet. Might be good for a sore throat but otherwise, I'd go with some sugar free Ricola or the CVS brand.

These sounded so good.  I wanted to like them, but they seem more like a cheap candy than anything healthy.  When you get to the honey center you can barely taste it.  The outer part looks similar to a Werthers Original hard candy, but tastes nothing like it.  I've had imitation Werthers that had much more flavor than these.  I'm not impressed by adding a few vitamins and trying to pass it off as a healthy treat.  There are 9 to a pack at 20 calories each.  No fat, protein, or cholesterol.  So, they aren't bad for you.  I just don't see much benefit, IMO.

Much of what is written in the review below is the same as what I had written for the Honey Drops. I do like the honey drops better because I am more partial to honey than caramel; however, I do like caramel. The last paragraph particularly expresses an advantage the caramel drop has over the honey drop:Most health-conscious adults know the importance of the combination of B-Complex Vitamins with C; yet, we also realize that our B6, B12, and C are water soluble vitamins-- meaning that whatever is not metabolized in our systems is lost in our unused fluids, whether it be by urination or perspiration. Some compensate for this loss through time-release vitamins, but there is a concern from some that certain time-release vitamins are not as natural as other forms, not as effective, or not as easily assimilated.Ambrosoli-Honees caramel-filled Energy Plus drop provides a tasty and effective alternative to time-release, as well as a natural alternative to the acrid potency of recent caffeine energy drinks.The hard candy exterior is delicious and not so hard that you cannot easily chew one or two up and get to the even more delicious honey center. I weigh well over 225 lbs. so I didn't seem to have the kind of energy surge from only one drop; but two or three drops at my weight allowed me to notice a bit of alertness and energy when my energy levels would have otherwise dropped off. That put me up to about 60 calories at 20 calories per drop; yet, with the energy boost received from the three drops, I know that my activity more than compensated for the caloric intake.The caramel drops do not seem to have the same down side as the honey drops. The honey drops may not store too well for long periods of time because the honey might seep through the end of the hard candy leaving you with a sticky wrapper. This doesn't seem to be the problem for the caramel drop.

This product reminds me of See's butterscotch drops. Each 'bar' is actually 9 individually wrapped caramel drops. Three drops represent 100% of the vitamins it advertises, so three servings per sleeve. I was wary of tasty vitamins, but these really do deliver. They won't replace your multivitamin or god nutrition, B12 isn't always that easy to get, so these are a real winner in my household.

I choose to sample this item since I was intrigued by the "Energy" label, being like many American's, I am always wanting a bit more pep.I found the actual item description to be inadequate in providing me necessary details to assess the true healthfulness of the item.I am a label reader because even at the chain health food stores many of their items fall far short of healthy.Being health conscious and also experiencing health issues, I do not consider this a health food but a candy with some vitamins added.Here are the ingredients in order: Sugar, Corn Syrup, Milk, Honey, Butter, Natural Flavors, Vitamin B6, Vitamin B12, Vitamin C.In other words, it provides energy because it is nearly pure sugar.  Now, I like my caramels and this is a very tasty one (but I still prefer Werthers brand or See's)-however, I eat them infrequently since I am diabetic and I am  also lactase and lactose intolerant (allergic milk sugar and milk protein).The added vitamins are negligible in my view with the amounts at 33% of the USDA recommended allowance per square.I could see this being carried at a drug store or convenience store but not too likely at a Health food store.

Glad I had one. It tasted very good - honey caramel like but not excessively sweet.The rest my 3-yr old took, non-stop. And the roll was gone in 5-minutes. Should I have stopped him? Mmm...I think I need to buy more. Don't mind getting vitamins this way.Wait, as for energy - My 3-yr old did not take a nap after that. We went and mowed the lawn, which should have been my 9-yr old or hubby's job. After that we went to the park for the afternoon. Could be the sugar effect, whatever...

I've been using these at work, at lunch, and as a quick energy booster.  Wise usage of all natural sugars is advised, since the honey, especially, packs a real energy punch for the human system.I do not normally eat candy at all in a given year, but these are the best product I have ever seen yet, and all natural ingredients.  Portable, convenient, and powerful.

column9: Don't get the energy, but I like the caramel
column10: The only reason I'm giving this product a three-star rating instead of a four-star rating is simple: There isn't really any "energy" in it.  Sure, there are calories & those are converted to energy and all that, but wouldn't that mean that basically ANY food can be considered an "energy" food?Regardless, these candies are actually quite tasty.  They have a nice caramel flavour on the hard outside and a nice chewy honey on the inside.  It's a great blend that I've not come across too often, but it works very well.  They also apparently have some vitamins in them, so that's another benefit you can throw on the pile.Overall, if you're looking for an energy boost to wake you up, do not reach for these.  You're better off with energy drinks (or, if you want healthy, just grab an apple. . . they help keep you up).  However, if you just want a nice little sweet in your pocket, these are definitely worthwhile.  Bit pricey, I'd say, but tasty.-AP3-

I received one little packet. Each "caramel" is individually wrapped - thank goodness or they'd all probably stick together.It is small, but not overwhelmingly small. It tastes like caramel(ish) and has a small "shell" of hardness before the gooey/soft inside, which doesn't really taste like honey. If it does, it blends in well with the caramel/sweet taste making it an enjoyable "chew." I like them and have found myself wanting them more and more.*It was actually kind of hard to put them down and restrain myself form eating them all in one sitting. :)

I received these Energy Plus (Honey filled carmel drops) free as part of Amazon.com's Vine program to generate reviews. I like them allot. Frist they taste very good. Seocnd they have good healthy ingreedents including honey and vitimine B. And Third, they give you a nice feeling of renewed energy. The only negative is that it uses sugar and corn sweetener, If I were them I would stop using the later. I can highly recommend this product.

column9: Yummy... but not a lot of honey
column10: A nice little caramel with a hint of honey flavor. A glance at the label discloses the ingredients:SugarCorn syrupMilkHoneyButterNatural flavorsIf you're looking for a dose of honey in your daily diet, this isn't the way to do it. But it's a tasty candy and small enough to slip in a shirt pocket.

Ambrosoli Honees are candy, folks. The vitamin content in the drops looks almost like it was an accident. No protien? Even real honey has a gram or two of protien unless it's been so denatured that it's nutritionally valueless.It takes three drops to get 100% of the USDA recommended value of vitamin C, less than you'd get from eating one fresh orange. Along with the arificial vitamin C you'll get 60 calories (half of a can of sugary soda), 15gm carbs, 15 gm sugar, and still only nominal amounts of two or three other vitamins.These drops do more harm than good in my opinion. They're too sugary and deviod of any real nutritional value for me to take seriously.

column9: Carmel? Extra Energy? Not So Much... But Still Good!
column10: These hard "carmels" have a good flavor but  dont really taste like carmel to me, more of a honey taste than a carmel.The flavor is good, but not really what I was expecting!I also did not notice any extra energy from eating one.I would have given these a 4 star if they tasted more like carmel or if I noticed extra energy from eating one.Over all these are good but dont expect these to be like any other carmel you probably have had  and dont expect to get a burst of energy!

Tasty and convenient energy drops - the 'EnergyPlus' caramel drops are great to keep at your desk or in your car for when you need to give yourself a boost.  Each pack is in a silver-like foil package weighing 1.45oz (42g), and has vitamin B6, B12, and C supplements.  Once you work through the caramel exterior, you are rewarded with a nice dollop of honey in the center.  Nutritional facts: 1 piece = 20 calories, Fat 0, Cholestorol 0, Sodium 0, Total Carbs 5g,  Sugars 5g, and they are caffeine free.  The ingredients are simple and pure: sugar, corn syrup, milk, honey, butter, natural flavors, the above mentioned vitamins.

column9: Yummy Energy Candy That You Can Easily Carry With You
column10: Ambrosoli-Honees Energy Plus Vitamin Caramel "drops" are really more like candy. They are hard and rectangular. The outside candy has a nice caramel taste.
