I've always preferred dark chocolate to milk chocolate, but the Green & Black's milk chocolate came very close to being a dark chocolate, in my opinion.Well, the next time we returned to the store to pick up another bar we noticed they also had Green & Black's Organic Dark Chocolate (70 % cocoa, almost twice that of the milk chocolate bar). My mouth watered at the thought.Mmmmmm. Yum! This stuff is incredible! It's not sweet, at all. But it's not really bitter either. It's just so (how can I say it?)  chocolatey! Sorry, but I'm at a loss for words. Let's just say, it's the best dark chocolate I've ever tasted. It's rather hard and the bar snaps when you bite into it, but when you chew it just floods your mouth with a deep, dark chocolate flavor. You have to be something of a dark-chocolate fan to enjoy this. My wife says it's good, for example, but she still prefers the milk chocolate. If you're a dark chocolate lover, give this a try! Five Stars!Gary Peterson

I go to the co-op in my town specifically to pick up some of this chocolate, it is delicious! A bar lasts me a week or two, taking a piece or so at a time :) A little dark chocolate does the body good!

column9: Great dark chocolate at a great price
column10: This is one of the best dark chocolates I have ever eaten in my life. And I have been trying them for most of my 59 years. (What a incomplete world it would be if the only vendors of dark chocolate were Hershey and Nestle!)It is smooth, with a unique flavor. There are some fruity flavors in there, and not too bitter.The smoothness property is probably the biggest selling point, as so many of the brands of dark choclate are almost waxy in their consistency.The main reason I bought this is that the price from the vendor was excellent, even with some shipping expense.I highly recommend this chocolate. Search around for a local retailer and buy one bar, and you will be very pleased if, like me, you love dark chocolate.

column9: Best chocolate bar I've ever tasted
column10: I pretty much try every chocolate I ever see, and have attended the Austin Chocolate Festival from the second year onwards, and green & blacks is my utmost favorite. Head & shoulders above the rest. Plus, its organic & fair trade, so I can justify the price to myself (what a steal on amazon though, retail is about $3.99 a bar at whole foods or other comparable retailers). The few times I have been willing to part with enough of it to cook with, the resulting dishes, especially the dark chocolate cheesecake, were astounding. I'll keep sampling when I get the chance, but I doubt I'll ever find anything to beat my incumbent favorite.
This chocolate is organic and very good. It is not a sweet chocolate, but it is smooth and rich. It is a delicious way to get some anti-oxidants each day.

I love dark chocolate. I don't even bother with milk chocolate much since I turned 40, cause dark is where it's at!I love Valrhona, and I've also bought other high end chocolates over the past decade over at my gourmet shop or Fresh Market. I even love those chocolate truffles that are the store brand at Whole Foods (365 brand). But I've been moving into organic foods (and preferably local when possible) over the last year plus. One of the things I decided to do was try to replace my fave chocolate snacks with equivalent ORGANIC ones, including chocolate cookies.Well, I tried this high cocoa content of Green and Black's and their Mint Chocolate bar. I threw out both before I finished them. Neither did it for me.I really find them to be highly bitter. Not bitter as in the normal bitterness that a high cocoa content has. A really unpleasant bitterness, like coffee that's sat too long in the carafe.I've tried a couple other organic chocolates I picked at random at Whole Foods and have yet to find one that makes me go, "yes, this is it!"  Green and Black's 70% is soooo not it.So, FWIW, that has been my experience with G&B, which as you can see differs from the previous commenters who love it. YMMW.Back to Valrhona.Mir
This is the best Dark Chocolate.  It is smooth and melts in your mouth.  Dark and delicous!!

I'm not really a dark chocolate snob - will eat just about any brand as long as it's in the 70% range but this has become my favorite. It has almost a milk chocolate consistency with a dark chocolate taste which is very different from the "drier" dark chocolate taste that other brands have.  It's very smooth and rich tasting with just a touch of bitterness in the background.Not sure if there is a cheaper way to buy this on amazon.  I used to get it here, but found out that Target has it for about the same price - and sometimes on sale for $2.50 a bar.
I've tried all the organic dark chocolates out there, and Green and Black is by far the best, most consistent bar.  It's really, really good.

Everything I've ever read says adding milk negates antioxidant benefits.  They bind to protein.  Green and Blacks adds Milk Powder to everything, including their dark bars.  Unfortunately, if you want the real benefits of chocolate, it has to be raw (never heated over 118) and organic and you're going to pay through the nose.  I recommend Chocolatl available in the raw refrigerator section of your local Whole Paycheck ($8.50 for 3oz of Chocolatl is paying through the nose to me) or finding something else truly raw and unprocessed on Amazon.  You can get the raw cacao nibs from Navitas on Amazon for much less than whole foods, but the nibs taste like a**.  Look, I love the flavor of these, they're organic, which is nice, and if you're just out for the flavor, these are great candy bars, but don't think you're getting any benefit.As a side note, I actually wrote to Green and Blacks to (basically complain) ask why they'd add milk powder to their dark chocolate and they literally told me it was *residue* and they had to list it.  My Bull**** meter went off immediately, because why wouldn't they just state that "made in a facility that also processes milk" or such like, but no, they claimed the ingredient was listed as a result of irremovable residue.  Yeah...ok to me that's just disgusting.  And since when can't milk residue be removed?  How many years worth is built up at Green and Blacks?  It was both disgusting and literally unbelievable at the same time that they'd think that explanation was preferable to just saying "hey, we put milk powder in our stuff; deal with it".  Anyway, if you buy this, I hope you enjoy your irremovable milk residue chocolate.  :)

I never write reviews but this chocolate is so terrible I felt I needed to warn people away from this stuff.First, I was taken aback by the presence of soy.  It's really not needed, but whatever.Second, and more importantly, I'm not even certain there is actually cocoa in this.  I sure as heck didn't taste any.  My mouth was overwhelmed in a horrid menagerie of sweetness, alcohol, and a weird bitter fruity aftertaste.  In fact, I'm still trying to rid my mouth of the fruity aftertaste.  The sweetness is very overpowering for a 70% (supposedly) cacao bar, and worse of all it comes with an alcohol sting.  You know those sugar free diabetic chocolates?  Yeah, like that.  Yuckity yuck yuck.The aftertaste is...man, bad.  Really bad.  There are no adjectives in the English language to describe it.  Artificial fruit flavoring made by Satan...something like that.  With this nasty fruit taste comes the bitterness, but it isn't good bitter (like you find in cocoa) it is nightmarish.I don't know who is in charge of making this stuff, but I really think someone should lock them up.  5150 them.  They are, most likely, criminally insane.  This bar is a travesty.I'd really like to find an organic and fair trade substitute for my regular bar of chocolate; Lindt 90%.  I really expected this to be on par in quality (obviously a lot sweeter at only 70%) but instead I got a disgusting taste in my mouth and a stomachache.I seriously can't get over the fact that I tasted no cocoa.  How does this chocolate have so many rave reviews?  I must have fallen into a bizzaro universe where people throw ducks at balloons and nothing is what it seems.

column9: Dogs Love it!  And it's Good for Them, too.

column9: good for occupying for short periods

My dogs' absolutely loves these. -And I love the fact that they are not Rawhide, but still last them a while.  They are pricey, though--so always wait until they are on sale.

My dog LOVES these bones.  I haven't used them long enough to see if they will have a positive effect on tartar on his teeth, but breaking these bones down requires a lot of gnawing which in turn should be effective for tartar control. My groomer turned me on to these for teeth cleaning. My 2 shih-tzu's LOVE them! They go nuts when I reach for the bag. one a day is recommended, however, at this price x 2, that can't happen. This is the best price on line, even cheaper if you sign up for auto delivery.

My dog loves these treats...She actully expects them...she likes them so much she goes and sits where there at everyday and looks at them quickly...then back at you until she gets one ...best treat i've ever found too that doesn't cause my dog to itch...no corn or wheat...great product.
I bought this for a friend who likes only apple mentos.  I knew it was a good price and she was very happy.

I disagree with the previous reviews.  I think it's perfectly spiced, and it is mushy, but I think it's supposed to be.  Bhindi Masala is one of my favorite indian dishes and it's great to be able to have it at home after literally 1 and half minutes (opening the package and putting it in the microwave).  Yes it's better at a restaurant or cooked with fresh okra, but you can't expect it to be perfect out of a ready to eat pouch.  For what it is, I'm completely satisfied and will happily keep it on my shopping list.

column9: One of my favorite MTR dishes!
column10: Delicious, spicy and satisfying.  For a great, quick vegetarian meal add some extra veggies and serve over basmati rice.And like another reviewer said, it's supposed to be mushy.

column9: Tastes pretty good but I wouldn't make this a meal staple
column10: I love Indian food and I wish I had time to prepare it from scratch.  I purchased this product at my local Indian grocery store.  Taste wise, it is pretty good.  Nutritionally, this is not the best product. I would recommend it as a side item at a meal or a special treat.The product picture that is posted is not really representative of what you see when you heat the product.  The okra has been pretty much flattened - it has no rectangular shape whatsoever - and is stringy and mixed in with a relatively thick sauce (about the consistency of tomato paste).  So the picture really should be a red-brown sauce with stringy greens.  If you are a person bent on aesthetics, I don't think this would be the product for you.  I ate my Bhindi Masala over basmati rice.  It tasted pretty good but I noticed a saltiness to the product.  I love salt and for me to say that a product is salty is a rare occurrence.  The box indicates that this product is hot but I did not find the product to be overly hot.  I did not down a glass of water after one bite but the intensity may has been subdued slightly by the rice I ate the product with.MTR's Bhindi Masala is packaged in the ever popular pouch inside of a box. I don't really like pouches because the contents are usually difficult to remove.  True to my previous experience with pouches, I had to use a spatula to remove the contents that had stuck to the pouch's walls.  Another reason for my disdain of pouches is they are not typically recyclable.Each container of this product has two servings.  I think if you are pairing it with naan, vegetables, or rice that the two serving assessment is accurate and it could feed two people.I would not call this a health food.  My box has slightly different nutritional facts that those posted on Amazon.  My box indicated that the product has high fat content (20 grams per box), high saturated fat (6 grams per box) and high salt content(1152 mg per box).  Additionally, the product has 316 calories, 6 grams of protein and 4 grams of fiber per box.Ingredients: ladies finger (52%), water, onion, tomato puree (7%), milk, refined sunflower oil, cashewnut, salt, sugar, butter, ginger paste, ghee (clarified butter), green chili (2%), garlic paste, fenugreek leavesAllergy info:  This product contains milk products, cashewnut and may contain traces of other nuts.This product is vegetarian.This is a product of India.While I like this product, I don't think I would buy a high number of this product at one time unless I had someone to split the order with; the product tastes good but the nutritional content makes it something that I would eat with lesser frequency.
The taste is very bad. Its very very oily and the bhindies are totally mashed and mixed with the curry. I could never finish one packet at a time.

Let me start by saying that I LOVE okra.  I grew up eating okra dishes my mom made and I can't get enough.  I'm also lazy, so when I saw that I could get pre-made okra in a box, I had to try it.  There are a bunch of other MTR boxes I've tried and some (like the pongal) are actually pretty good.The Bhindi Masala was terrible.  First, there is almost no okra in the box at all.  There is an occasional bit of green floating around, but for the most part, the package is full of some dark brown sludge that looks like an oil spill. You can't tell one ingredient from another.  As with most of the India foods, there is a high saturated fat content.  I won't buy this again.  I like the Tasty Bite entrees much better.

For a long time, I was not interested in buying prepared food because of the strong dislike I have for mushy frozen food. But a friend in the food business suggested I try prepared food that is first cooked, then placed in a vacuum sealed aluminum(?) pouch.  All one needs to do is heat and serve.As I do not usually have the time to make rice, I have found a way to enjoy the Kurma, which is authentic, Indian cuisine, anytime I like at home.My suggestion:I do not like to microwave food, so I do the following: dice yellow or green squash aka zucchini (about 2 cups raw) in about 4 tablespoons of water in a 12" fying pan.  When squash is cooked in a few moments, open the pouch of wonderful Navratan Kurma, the mildest Indian entree that is tasty for anyone who enjoys a mild sauce with vegetables, and in a few moments, you have dinner for two.  Less than 250 calories a serving.  Not mushy!
decent priced for such good quality! just add a little honey and red pepper and it tastes just as good as it would fresh!
I love whole grain products cause of the health benefits for me personally and I think that this bread is wonderful for small sandwiches.
Love the bittersweet taste of this chocolate, accentuated by the addition of espresso.  Green & Black's is superior in my book.

If you don't like very dark chocolate, I doubt you'll like this - it's very dark and far more bitter than sweet.However, I DO like dark chocolate, and I love coffee, so I thought these bars were amazing.  You pop a piece in your mouth and get an immediate burst of espresso - the dark, strong coffee taste is outstanding.  As the chocolate starts to melt, the coffee flavor is replaced with bitter, decadent chocolate.This is a great deal, especially if you're planning on keeping all 10 bars to yourself (like I do).  A little piece of one bar goes a very long way.  I should warn you, though - these bars are definitely caffeinated!  If I ate a whole one, I'd be lit up for a week (and I drink coffee like it's my job, so it takes more than a little caffeine to get me going).I would definitely get these again.

GREEN & BLACK'S ORGANIC DARK CHOCOLATE, ESPRESSO IS SOME OF THE FINEST CHOCOLATE THAT I HAVE EVER TRIED. THE ESPRESSO BEANS HAVE BEEN SO INCREDIBLY FINE GROUND THAT THERE IS NO GRAINY TEXTURE AT ALL. THE CHOCOLATE FLAVOUR IS VERY INTENSE WITH A PLEASANT BITTER FINISH THAT IS WELL COMPLEMENTED BY THE ESPRESSO. THIS IS A FINE CHOCOLATE FOR SAMPLING ALONE AND USED IN COOKING AND BAKING. MY HUSBAND AND I ALSO TRIED "GREEN & BLACK'S" WHITE CHOCOLATE WHICH WE FOUND TO BE EXTREMELY TERRIFIC ALSO. THIS IS A "GROWN-UP" CHOCOLATE FOR A MORE REFINED EXPERIENCE. ENJOY!

These bars have fantastic flavor.  You don't want to eat them just before bed, though, because you get a double jolt of caffeine - from the chocolate and from the coffee.  I had some of these bars before I learned to read labels very carefully and check every single ingredient.Most people do not realize that "certified organic" is not necessarily 100% organic. The law only requires that 95% of the ingredients be organic.Note that the soy lecithin listed on the ingredients is NOT specified as organic. I personally do not want to be eating genetically modified soy OR the horrendously high level of pesticide and herbicide chemicals that go on GMO plants. This is why I gave these bars only a 3 star rating.  In other words, you may choose to eat them.  I do not.There are brands of excellent organic chocolate which do not contain lecithin at all and are still 'meltingly' delicious.  A couple examples: Vivani 72% dark and Theo 85%.

This item is now hard to find, Whole Foods and others stopped carrying this flavor. Thank goodness for Amazon! I stock up and keep them in my freezer. I melt chunks of it in my microwave,then add hot milk to make an incredible mocha. Take that, Starbucks !!

I just love this Green & Black's Espresso - Organic Dark Chocolate with Coffee.I have tried other dark chocolates in the past, but nothing as good as this one.The seller was very kind enough to notify me that they will not ship my orderright away when the weather was still extremely hot - since the chocolates mightjust melt during shipment, I really appreciated that. I didn't mind waiting anotherweek or so - since I had a great time indulging with the chocolates when theyfinally arrived. Will buy again soon!

This is my current favorite gluten-free bread. The slices are thinner than the Brown Rice or White Rice varieties and, in my opinion, it requires less toasting to make it palatable. (For my tastes, a light toasting is required.)It does stick together some and can be crumbly. The advantage with this variety is that, because it is so thin, if two pieces are stuck together, you can actually pop them both in the same toaster slot. After they are toasted a little bit, they come apart easily.

This is actually pretty good as a bread substitute - it's not going to replace fresh focaccia, breadsticks, bagels or croissants - but it will give you a good piece of toast. I can't stand it unless it's toasted (try at your own peril!), but am otherwise pretty happy with this as a gluten, dairy, egg, and soy free option. (Anything fitting that criteria is a win for me, so I'm a bit jaded)It's shelf stable until opened, but once in the refrigerator can get crumbly, fussy, and delicate. If you put in the time to gently pry the slices apart and toast them you should be pretty happy with the results.Weird side note: After toasting, if I put the bread on a plate it seems to "steam" itself and get soggy if I don't nudge it around or prop it up to cool initially.The description didn't have ingredients, here are the ingredients listed on the Ener G Foods site as of 08/30/2012: Ingredients: Filtered Water, Rice Flour, Tapioca Starch, High Oleic Safflower Oil, Pear Juice Concentrate, Bamboo Fiber, Yeast, Methylcellulose, Guar Gum, Orange Citrus Fiber, Salt, Calcium Phosphate, Baking Powder (Glucono Delta Lactone, Calcium Carbonate & Magnesium Carbonate). Enriched with Thiamin (Vitamin B1), Riboflavin (Vitamin B2),Niacin, Iron ,Folic acid and Vitamin D.

column10: with many allergies in the household this bread is a gift from the gods, my only negitive would be that the bread does break up when handling, but it is a very good alternative as many of their other products are, i for one will keep buying!

Zukes Dog treats are always moist and flavorful, but this flavor specifically seems to be delicious and a perfectly sized treat to be used for training a new puppy as they seem to be so delicious that they are worth doing anything for! I ordered this when I discovered that citric acid is the primary ingredient in Wyler's Light, a low-calorie drink mix, with the intention of making my own substitute by combining it with sucralose (Splenda). Although this worked, producing a sort of lemonade-flavored low-calorie drink, it turned out to be not economical due to the price of sucralose. However, I've found that it's still great to use citric acid to add tanginess to Wyler's Light flavours that I don't find quite sour or lemony enough, such as the raspberry flavour. With this particular container I usually remove the top entirely when using it so I can use a large spoon and measure out the amount I want precisely using a kitchen scale.

This is not  easy  to find somethings except on line.  I'm trying a new home make dishwasher soap, so needed the acid  food quality).  Now I just need to get the project done.  Thank you Amazon for carrying  the different item, or info getting them for us.

Several years ago, I went on a tour of the Celestial Seasonings tea factory in Boulder, Colorado.  The guide showed us the bales of tea as they arrived, machines that ground and mixed the tea, and a machine that put the tea in tea bags.  The tour included a visit to the room where the peppermint tea was stored.  Our guide told us that peppermint was stored separately so that it would not contaminate the other teas.  He did not tell us what was to come.The doorway into the peppermint room was surrounded by bright red stripes. This should have served as a warning to us.  We all innocently strolled into the peppermint room.  The smell of peppermint was overpowering.  It entered my nose, my head, my lungs, and then my whole being was infused with peppermint.  What a rush!  The crowd stampeded out of the room in a hurry.  For the rest of the day and into the next, all I could smell and taste was the mint.I am now addicted to Celestial Seasonings Peppermint Tea.  Every time I have some, I am reminded of that fateful day in Boulder.  The events of that day have changed my life forever.  Amazingly, the tea is still legal, openly sold in stores and on the Internet.  I think that the tea is great, but then again I am not an unbiased observer.  On your next visit to Boulder, take the tour.  Or go a safer route; buy the tea from Amazon.

This is Celestial Seasonings at their best-a plump bag of fresh tasty peppermint leaf, which brews up to a clean delicious cup of tea! Peppermint is one of the most enjoyable herbal teas with a naturally sweet, clean taste.Peppermint is an herb that has many uses in traditional herbal medicine. It is reputed to relax the muscles of the digestive system which helps relieve nausea. Peppermint combats flatulence, promotes bile flow and digestive juices, and has a mildly anesthetic effect which also eases indigestion. It is supposed to relieve anxiety and tension, soothe headaches and calm symptoms associated with the menstrual cycle.Celestial Seasonings gets extra points for their packaging: they utilize 100% natural recycled paperboard in their boxes and they don't package each tea bag individually. Instead they use a system of a waxed paper bag inside the box that stays shut when you fold it. It keeps the bags fresh and utilizes less packaging than individually wrapping each bag. The art they use on each box is beautiful as are the quotes and information they put on every surface.

I bought this sampler for my Mother and she loved it. This is a woman who does not function without two or three pots of coffee a day so she knows her coffee. As for me, I am not much of a coffee drinker but I tried most of the flavors and thought that they were very good without being overly strong. We got about two pots (8 to 12 cups) per bag without the coffee being too watered down. Definitely a hit with any coffee drinkers in your life. Be warned though, the box it is shipped in will have the name of the company and what is inside of it, so if you are trying to surprise someone maybe have it shipped to a friends house first. I bought this gift for my Mother's birthday.  I live in Indiana and she lives in Florida so I was not going to have the ability to wrap it.  When it came it looked like a ready to go present and she said the taste was fantastic.  Great buy!

The quality of the product is VERY good however and I'm sure my brother in law will love this gift since he usually drinks awful folgers!Shipped fast and I would order from them again for gift purposes!

I gave this to my boss and his wife for Hanukkah and they truly seemed to enjoy it. Perfect gift for anyone.
Kona coffee is hard to find around our area, so I was so happy to find this. It was beautifully packaged and I was able to taste the product also and it was very good.

This was a great gift for my son & his wife - they have had many sleepless nights with a new baby. After New Years Day dinner we brewed one of the blends and had it with pie. The aroma and taste was excellent!

I first came across the Lemon & Lime Ahmad Tea a couple of years ago in a gift basket. I loved it! I now have to make gift baskets and will be putting a box of Ahmad's in each one. This was a great way for me to share with others something that I consider purely delightful and for me to try other flavors! Which are by the way delicious!!! I think that Currant is my new favorite and I plan to order more in the near future.

I bought 4 boxes of Ahmad Fruit Quartet tea for my husband when he was going through his tea kick.  A gift from the cat on Father's Day, a year+ ago.  It is very good tea and the flavors are true.  We use it for iced tea in the summer.  Delicious, hot or cold.  We will definitely be buying more.

column9: Pretty good tea with some caveats
column10: I bought this Fruit Quartet recently thinking it would be nice for making iced tea.After reading the other reviews, I was particularly interested in trying out the Lemon/Lime variety.  You have to be careful with this flavor more than the others.  Let it steep past 3 minutes and it will taste somewhat bitter and medicinal.My favorites are the Peach/Passionfruit and the Strawberry.  I've had the P/P both hot and cold and it's very nice.  Have only had the Strawberry iced.The Black Currant doesn't have much BC flavor to me.  I find I prefer the Twinings version of this one.I do love the packaging.  The foil packets are beautiful and if you want to put teas out for guests to choose from, they make a lovely presentation.All in all, good tea, but all are strong and care must be taken not to let them steep too long.  I normally steep my tea for 4 minutes, but on these, 3 minutes is the maximum.I had a hard time deciding between a 3 and 4-star rating on this one.  I would give it 3.5 if I could.

My daughter-in-law bought this tea at Heathrow airport on her first visit to England.  She loves the strawberry tea.  I am so pleased to find this tea at Amazon.com and purchased the set to surprise her.  How delighted she was to receive them!  I love the teas, too!
We drink a lot of iced tea in the summer and this is a nice change to put in the rotation so there is a little variety.
This is a wonderful tea coming from someone who drinks a lot of tea. The fruit flavors are refreshing without being overpowering. Highly recommended.

The teas have been top drawer from the start.  An exhilerating cup every time!  My wife and I enjoy every sip accompanied by the occasional scone or biscuit.  You'd have be daft to not appreciate the snappy Strawberry tea or the crisp, aromatic Apple variety.  I'll be a frequent visitor to this tea oasis.
This Tea should not be listed as a fruit tea.  It is flavored black tea.  The black currant smells like cat pee!!!! it is so disgustingit is too bad I can't return this item.
This was a gift for my brother, and he loved the assortment!  I want to get it for myself.  Definitely a wonderful gift!
I love the chamomile tea. Its sweet and mild. Its excellent for a bed time tea.

This is the second Kay's product I have tried the first was the Nacho Cheese chips , which in my opinion were overly seasoned. I was reluctant to try a product again but glad I did.I had RNY and was looking for a semi-health snack with protein. This fit the bill. I use these more of a quick breakfast with a side of greek yogurt. It is filling and I can barely finish a whole packet. I usually will freeze it and it's a nice cool snack with the leftovers.It has a good light flavor, that does not overpower your taste buds. It is a bit dry but that is kinda the nature of these protein infused snacks/foods. I just love the crunch and it's nice to have that back again. I would compare it to a very weak golden graham with the consistency of a mini wheat without the stringy kinda mini wheat texture (if that makes sense at all, ha!)I have also started using this as a breakfast cereal. Adding it to soy milk with a little banana. It does get soggy in a few minutes but I still find it quite tasty as a high protein ceral in the morning. If you have ever had Quaker Oats "Crunchy Corn Bran" cereal, the consistency is similar to that once it is sitting in milk.

column10: I have 3 cats that don't like canned cat food except for this one and Solid Gold blended tuna.

I have order these private reserve filet mignons before, and this is my first reorder. They are high quality steaks. I've tried these steaks medium rare, medium, and medium well, and they were all super delicious and juicy. There was one time we even accidently made it well-done, and it was still good!! As my boyfriend calls this "the steak that tastes good no matter how you cook it."
The steaks were excellent.  Much higher quality than the standard Omaha steaks that I have ordered in the past (although those were not bad).

As much as my family and I love cheese from Italy and Spain, we love French cheese more.  France is a country that produces more than 100 cheeses, so it must have been difficult to choose only four for this assortment, but in my opinion, four of the very best were chosen.We are all watching our weight at my house, so we eat a lot of salads.  While cheese is definitely not a "diet food," a little in a salad goes a long way, especially when you're using Buche Chevre.  My children love it on crackers as well.My wife and I reserved the chaource and the epoisses for a "wine and cheese" party, but believe me, they are so wonderful and so special, you'll be tempted to eat them anytime, party or not.The Gruyère de Comté is just so special I can't really find words to describe it.  It's rich.  It's creamy.  It's delectable.  We often eat it as a dessert cheese.  Yes, it's really that good!If you're looking for a special gift, you can't go wrong with this French Cheese Assortment.  These are four of the finest cheese France has ever produced.

The service from iGourmet is impeccableEverything arrived in perfect condition i.e. ripe (and therefore "stinky" just like it should be!!)The Styrofoam packaging was the perfect vessel for delivery; the cheese arrived "alive" from not being over chilled.I have not had cheese of this quality outside France, and this is the first time I have found "perfect" cheese in the US.If you like top quality "stinky" cheese this is for you.........

The French cheese assortment is amazing. A selection of cheeses of a quality you cannot easily come by unless you have a great specialty gourmet store nearby. The Saint Andre is not my favorite type of cheese, but it is good on a nice loaf of crusty bread. The other cheeses in the selection are outstanding and I have received rave reviews from everyone I have served them to. Only negative is that they came extremely hot (even though they were in a cooler-type box with an ice pack that I assume had at one time been cold) and the softer cheeses were really melted. They still tasted great, but weren't as nice for presentation.

Guys, if you are tired of the traditional "wife gifts", try giving this delicious assortment to her....for no reason at all...besides, who do you think gets to share it.  Couple this wonderful sampler with some fresh grapes, fine olives, "Carr's" Table Water Crackers, Boars Head Sopressata...and of course (2) bottles of New Zealand's Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc....let's just say you'll have an evening to remember....Oh yes, don't forget the background music!  Cheeses were fresh, top quality, and with the complementing sides, a portion that would (if you wanted to) serve 4-6 people easily.
A great selection of cheeses!  There were two that were quite potent and two that were milder.  All four were excellent, especially with fruit and various sweet and spicy chutneys.

I received the four cheeses and was somewhat dissapointed because although I enjoyed 3 of the cheeses, only 2 of those 3 were meant to be served as a cheese platter (vs for cooking on the 3rd).  The fourth was horrendous and I ended up throwing it away (4 other guests of mine tasted it and agreed that it was not good - we could all tell that it was not spoiled and that it was simply not a good choice for an assortment).  I also agree that the assortment should have come with more information about the cheeses themselves along the lines of:  You have selected this assortment, cheese names, background, taste descriptions, and serving suggestions (food and wine pairings both).  All in all, one of the four cheeses was good enough to add to a watch out list so that I can hope to find it again while shopping at a local store.

The actual cheese is GREAT, if you can get them to ship to you.  Ordered items as gifts - took over a week to ship.  For timely gifts you would be better off going around the corner.  Otherwise a great deal.

This chocolate flavor goat milk formula tastes terrible.  My toddler won't drink it and after trying it myself, I understand why.  It is 'gritty' even after shaking for a few minutes. $30 down the drain.

I had really high hopes for MTR products, given the high reviews I've seen on Amazon. I bought a 5-pack of this vegetable mix, and it's just disgusting. I am very passionate about Indian cooking, and cook Indian food at least 4 times a week (and am an Indian myself). Firstly, MTR seems to use the exact same sauce base for all the curries (I bought the Paneer Makhani and it has the same revolting flavor base), and the sauce is just not right! If you tell me that it has Indian flavors, I won't disagree with you. But Indian spices need to be used better - they must be matured properly by cooking them off in hot oil, adding aromatics in the right amounts, etc. And the vegetables were semi-raw, with no flavors inside the veggies .. all in all, it can be a poor man's emergency meal, but no way on earth does it even REMOTELY deserve the number of stars it has! Very very bad food indeed .. =(
This is a very tasty ready to eat Indian meal. The curry is especially delicious. I will likely buy again.
I really like this product. It's very tasty and the package keeps well for months if necessary. On top of it this represents excellent value. It at least 30% cheaper from Amazon.

I love spicy, I love curry and I love vegetables, so I really love this meal.  The curry is hearty and filling, especially for lunch.  It only takes 2 minutes to heat, so it is great for a quick lunch if you are busy working.
Very good dish. I like mine extra spicy so I load it up  with curry but this is a great product

This is absolutely DELICIOUS!! Wow! I eat it with (also delicious!!) Annie Chuns Sticky Rice : http://www.amazon.com/Annie-Chuns-Express-7-4-Ounce-Microwavable/dp/B000GPTC8U. I sometimes add little bit of chicken or ground beef, but without meats it's absolutely delicious!! I can eat twice from it but am a small eater. This is going to become a subscription as I have the rice already...mmmmmmmmm!!
Really a nice and tasty product, but could have been less oily. It is one of the better products from MTR and I will surely order more!
This is a very tasty meal, and I would recommend it with either white rice or bread. Note that it is a little spicy (for my palate)!

This item is extroadinarily well packaged; beautifully executed.  Taste wise it may please many especially those who love spice with overtones of garlic.  Personally I prefer the Tasty Bite brand of jaipur Vegetables which which is thicker and heartier with cinnamonny rich flavor.
the Curry arrived well packaged and timely and most importantly was delicious. I highly recommend this company for future purchases

I tried Cascal, the only other wine grape soda pop I know and it's unpleasant. This, however, is great. It doesn't taste like soda pop, you can taste the wineness of the grapes. It's like a reflection of wine. It's enjoyable and not sweet tasting (but not sour either). No fake sugar, either, so no bitterness or after taste.

I discovered this grape juice in Napa while pregnant.  Now I buy it in bulk (to help with shipping) to take with me to Holiday parties.  I also bring it when we are at nice restaurants and have the waiter put it in a wine glass.  All the restaurants have been accommodating so far!  The Pinot Noir is the best, then Chardonnay, the Rose is okay.  I like it because it is not super sweet.I tried (nearly) all the non-alcoholic wine, they were terrible.  This soda is the perfect substitute!

I scanned the selection of soft drinks at the cafeteria of the Palace of the Legion of Honor today, and spied the Vignette Wine Country Soda, Pinot Noir.  I wanted more than water, but not a sugary drink.  The Vignette was so refreshing - a little sparkly, a little sweet, 100 calories in a 12 ounce bottle.  I will definitely be ordering this for an upcoming barbecue.

column9: Would not buy from this vender again.

I paid approximately $33 for a pound of STALE candy!  The candy was shipped to me in a low grade zip -lock like baggie.  The candy was stale and flavor-less! I will never order from this company again!!!

This is the ultimate coffee....other flavors of Folgers do not compare....Very Dark, but no bitterness, no acidity, a very Rich and Velvety coffee...i like my coffee to look black in the pot, not thin and see through....but i dislike overpowered coffee that is bitter...Adding more grounds to a pot does not make thin coffee better, it makes it bitter and harsh....this is strong in a chocolate velvety rich way without the overbearing notes a thin coffee has.......sorry i cannot make it clearer with fewer words...perhaps this will help...regular folgers is as a mandolin...thin and bright, this Colombian folgers is as a cello, dark, bold, but smooth and warm.....

column9: The best Columbian Coffee, but less coffee & higher price
column10: I have reviewed this product before when they were the same coffee, 3 tubs, bigger size, same price.  This is a 5 star coffee.  We have tried every Columbian coffee we can find, just because for some reason, we like the flavor of Columbian coffee, no idea why.  But from the highest end coffee to the cheapest coffee we could find, this was by far our favorite, Folgers Gourmet Lively Columbian is not the same, and it doesn't come close to being as good.We've been drinking this specific coffee for years now (though at times we are forced to drink something else because nobody can keep it in stock) all the local stores run out constantly of Folgers Columbian. It's hardly ever in stock and we buy as much as we can.  We have the same problem with Amazon.  It's rarely in stock, when it is in stock there's always only 1,2, or 3 left, I get the email that it's in stock and that very day it says "only -- left in stock".  The worst part that makes me really mad and I don't know if it's Folgers ripping me off or Amazon but I'm really really mad that they are charging over $35 ($30 for subscribe and save - which I did, but it will probably get cancelled because they will run out of stock )for a much smaller (27.9oz) size tub than before (34.5oz)-6.6 oz less per tub - 19.8oz less for $4 more (or for the same price with S&S).THEN COMPARE CURRENT PRICES FOR OTHER FLAVORS: 6+oz less per tub for Columbian, over 18 oz less coffee for the same brand different flavor on the same day from the same store-AMAZON, and it is not currently in stock at my grocery stores locally so I'm stuck paying this outrageous price or changing coffee, which I have tried before and might have to try again by the looks of things.3 tubs of Foldgers Columbian 27.8oz each for $35 (or $30 subscribe & save)OR3 tubs Folgers Classic Roast 33.9oz each for $31.64 (regular price, not subscribe and save)Is Folgers charging more for Columbian and therefore AMAZON is charging more for less coffee than I used to get for the same price/sometimes less?  OR since Amazon has it flying off the shelves, they can sell the smaller tubs for the same price as they used to charge for the bigger tubs or only stock the smaller tubs and then sell them for the same price as the other flavors because it is SUCH a popular flavor?  Folgers still makes the large tubs of Columbian because I just bought them two weeks ago when my local store had a whopping two tubs in stock, for the price I am now paying for the small tub.Just last year, I repeatedly bought from AMAZON 3 tubs of Folgers Columbian 34.5oz each for $31.24 (regular price, not subscribe and save)Now I get 27.8 oz for $35/$30 for 3 tubs - that's 6.7 oz LESS FOR THE SAME PRICE BUT THE OTHER FLAVORS ARE STILL AT THE CHEAPER PRICE.  I just want to know who decided to rip off all the people who are paying for this coffee to fly off the shelves - Folgers themselves or Amazon? and IS THERE SOME LEGITIMATE REASON OR IS IT JUST BECAUSE IT'S POPULAR SO IF YOU CAN CHARGE US MORE MONEY FOR LESS PRODUCT, YOU MIGHT AS WELL.I am a HUGE FAN of AMAZON and have never had any problems here for many years, they have excellent, personalized customer service and make most things easier and most of the time cheaper than anywhere else.  The only problems I've read about from other people seem to be from outside/independent sellers, so I'm trying to be open minded that maybe it's Folgers, not Amazon but I am really angry that the price is (in my opinion) SKYROCKETING, for what seems to be just because they can, with no consideration for loyal Folgers and loyal Amazon customers by one company or both.I know, I know, I should just buy some other coffee - absolutely, it's our choice which coffee we buy, at least as long as we have a free country. I am completely against price fixing, and believe in a democratic society where the free market is a free market and businesses exist for the sole purpose of employing people and making a profit, otherwise they would all be non-profit agencies and/or charities and not employ very many people etc.  But none of that stops me from wanting to know WHY?If Amazon's price didn't go up, I don't think mine should by such a huge margin,or raise all the coffee a little instead of jacking up one flavor to make up for the increased cost of all coffee/production and if it's not costing Folger's this huge amount more to make the coffee, then why does it cost me that much more? Or does it suddenly cost that much more to make only Folger's brand Columbian coffee?Dare I ask, is Columbian coffee suddenly skyrocketing because we didn't sign the free trade agreement with Columbia? I really want to know what the heck is going on so I can start adjusting to the ridiculous price increase, or start all over again trying to find a new decent Cup Of Coffee, last time it was out of stock everywhere, I tried 8 different kinds of coffee and none of them held up.My rant is officially over, I need to go make another pot of coffee.  Hopefully when I come back, it won't cost more than diamonds. Just writing the review has inspired me to get to the bottom of this!Bottom line - great coffee, recent price jump knocks of two stars.

I purchased 4 boxes of these from Costco. Uncle Lee's tea is part of a well known tea company in China, Ten Fu, which was founded by the founder of the renowned Ten Ren tea company in Taiwan. Many years ago Ten Ren came up with the whole leaf tea bag idea. The tea bags had whole leaves (bag grew larger as it brewed) and the teas tasted quite good. I thought this product is probably similar to that yet manufactured by a different company. WRONG! The teas are tasteless, and there is no whole leaf! How did I find out about it? One of the tea (paper) bags was not completely sealed and the tea leaves (fragments) were partially out. In the same box where this particular tea bag was housed, there was another sealed package with no tea bag in it, just air! Buyers beware.

Jawbusters are hard candies about the size and shape of a gumball.  Why I like them:  1. If your green tea isn't green, it's overly oxidized and probably doesn't taste great but also lacks the majority of the antioxidants the tea is known for.  Try cutting open one of your tea bags...more like brown tea.The Rishi Super Green is my favorite tea and reasonably priced.  I've tried a handful of premium green teas imported from Japan on a very small scale.  These were all very good, but also quite expensive.  I am far from a tea expert, but after drinking the super green I can't even drink the tsao, lipton or bigelow teas any more.  Give this stuff a try, it won't disappoint.

Wow, I was stunned to see the color of the tea after brewing. I used just 1 teaspoonful of tea leaves in my tea pot and added hot water just enough to fill up to regular-sized coffee cup that I use for 12 oz of coffee. The leaves produced unbelievably sparky fresh green color that green tea should look like, but I forgot how it should be as not many green teas sold can achieve this color! It was strong enough to add some more hot water later on to make a full 12 oz cup full of green tea. But one caution is that real green tea is very easy and fast to be oxidized if left in the air. Once it oxidized, you can see it as the color of green changes to brown, and it has reverse effect of the benefit of green tea in that case. SO, make sure to keep your tin can as tight all the time, and close the lid as soon as possible. After brewing the tea, drink it as soon as possible but of course don't force yourself to manage burn to your mouth!!

If you are timid or shy and can't find the tea that suits you,then try sencha matcha.It never disappoints. It is the best of both worlds. Sweet,veggie,and bright.Never to strong,never over done. I love it , I love it,I love it.

column9: Excellent and affordable premium Japanese tea blend
column10: This is a great Japanese green.  As noted on the front of the package it is a loose leaf blend of sencha leaves spiked with matcha powder.  Taste compares favorably with much more expensive sencha blends I have purchased from importers, with the characteristic grassy flavor of fresh greens.  And the ability to order this online from Amazon is awesome.Some people appear to have rated this product low because they were looking for matcha powder to "put in shakes".  This is not for "putting in shakes" and anyone who spent a minute researching Japanese tea should be able to figure that out.  If you want the nuance and pleasure of a true premium green you have to steep it yourself and you have to use loose leaf tea.  You also have to use the right temperature of water (less than boiling) and steep for the right amount of time.  This stuff is solid gold--cast not your pearls before swine.I am just glad rishi is out there making excellent accessible teas like this one.  Worth spending a little more (and spending a little more time preparing) a tea that will not disappoint.

column9: this is leaf tea, NOT MATCHA

column10: This tea is very good, but the packaging is quite deceptive. column4: J. Easter "I can find a place for just one mo...

This gets top ratings in my book and I will buy again.

column9: Very good rice! Comes out perfectly each time.
column10: I love this rice, it is fluffy and has a nice smell, sorta like popcorn popping. It is a verry long grain and it seprates from each other. Makes a perfect rice for Curry and the leftovers are great for Chinese Fried Rice. You must follow directions and let rice soak 15 minutes after cleaning it, but in 15 more minutes you have fluffy perfect rice. For the Latinos out there it makes good "Con Con" on the bottom of pan. 5 stars, I also like the bag it comes in, it zips up and you can hang it on a door knob or whatever you want.

We like Basmati rice but find it either (1) pretty expensive in the supermarket or (2) in too big a quantity (often 20 lb.) at warehouse stores. This was a good compromise - decent price and not too much to store/use in a reasonable time, plus the two bag pkg will make it easy to share with family or friend. I can't really tell one Basmati from another, but this seems at least as good as any we've had. Followed cooking directions exactly and it came out perfect.

Have been ordering this rice from Amazon.com for a few years now.Same good quality every time.And the price cannot be beat that I can find.

have bought this befor so you know i like it, but got these 2-5'lbs bags this time ( instead of 1-10'lb ) for the convenience of storage.

My mom needs a 100% gluten-free diet. It is of utmost importance to me to serve her foods that are as delightful as she used to be able to eat. This Heinz Cream of Tomato Soup is my mom's favorite of all the gluten-free ones she has tried. It is made in England and rarely available in the grocery store, so I love Amazon for making it available. I usually order a case (12 cans) to get her through the winter. It is ready-to-eat, no dilution needed. This soup can also be used in recipes that call for tomato soup. Just keep in mind that the consistency will not be as thick as a condensed soup. Heinz, Soup Cream Of Tomato, 14.1-Ounce (12 Pack)

I loved Heinz tomato soup as a child until it suddenly disappeared.  Campbell's was horrible, so I didn't have any tomato soup until a visit to England recently.  In a cafeteria I saw Heinz tomato soup.  I ordered some and it was really good, just the way I remembered it!  I also suddenly realized what the difference was between Campbell's and Heinz -  it was sugar!  When I got home I confirmed this by adding sugar to Campbell's - one packet (3.5 g) of sugar completely changed the flavor to something very similar to Heinz.  Still, it's great to have the real thing from time to time even if the cost is 4X!

I grew up and loved Campbell's cream of tomato soup, but when I moved to London for work for a year, I really fell in love with this version. It's all there, no milk to add, just heat and enjoy. And it tastes better. I still get it now since I've been back in New York.

Tomato soup was something I dearly missed when I found out I had celiac disease - until I found Heinz Cream of Tomato Soup.  Wow, was I ever happy!  This soup is worth every penny!  It fills my body with gluten free nutrition, my mouth with a wonderful familiar flavor, and my soul with amazing comfort feelings from the past!  Try it today - I know you'll love it!
This is the most delicious tomato soup you'll ever taste. Creamy no additives all natural healthy soup. Campbell's doesn't even come close!!

This soup is a staple in England, with its creamy texture and sweet tomato flavor it makes an excellent meal alone, or you can dunk bread in it, or grate some cheese in before heating - any way you eat it, it won't disappoint. It has the added benefit of having no artificial colors, preservatives or flavors in it.

column9: Really? Tastes good AND has 20g of protein???
column10: For fun, I went to the nutrition store tonight and bought about 2 dozen different protein/nutritio bars.  My daughter and I decided we would do a taste test of each one so that we could buy the ones we liked in bulk off Amazon. If you eat one serving (half the brownie) it is 170 calories and 10g of protein.I do wish it had some fiber in it, and that it was a little more nutritionally complete, but just the fact that I am now looking to buy a case of them should tell you something.

column9: This is How Chocolate Bars SHOULD be
column10: A luscious layer of "caramel" sandwiched between two velvety smooth layers of fine raw cacao.  As soon as you bite into this bar you'll be captivated by the contrasting textures and flavors that compliment each other to perfection.  Comes complete with nutrients and a long lasting energetic mood lift.  The wondrous world of raw vegan food just got a little better.

I admit it...I love most of the Rightously Raw bars. But this is my favorite! And yeah, yeah...it doesn't taste exactly like caramel. But come on! That's like expecting soy milk to taste exactly like cow's milk! Not gonna happen. I think the folks at Rightously Raw got this one...well...right. The filling has a richness & depth that are reminiscent of caramel, the chocolate is superb, and you can enjoy it with total peace of mind. I'll take that any day over a sugar-bomb of "real" caramel!

What an interesting treat! Yes, you may feel the flavor of raw cacao, but this aspect is mild, and you may not even notice it if you don't focus on it. What you are more likely to notice is how elegantly it's crafted in terms of mouthfeel (both the chocolate itself and the combination of the chocolate and the filling). I think this product is a masterpiece, taste-wise and texture-wise. The only obstacles for my family to buying from this brand often are the price and the presence of some added sugar (relatively little though, judging by the numbers on their labels; I just wanted to point out that agave nectar is especially high in fructose, the "worst" of "simple sugars", and this brand uses some agave nectar - hopefully very little). This brand's other bars, Acai and "Caramel", are similar, but "Maca" is NOT chocolaty and disappointing.

column9: The other 3 flavors are much better
column10: At first we thought the bar was damaged by heat... or was too old (despite exp. date saying otherwise). A few months later we bought it again (from a different store) - same problem. And now (especially since another reviewer had the same problem) I think this MACA bar is designed to be like that. It's NOT chocolaty. It tastes and looks like something else. It may satisfy a sweet tooth, but it's not worth the price. Their other 3 flavors taste fabulous (Acai, Goji, "Caramel"). Not the healthiest though, due to some added sugar.

column9: Very creative! (but "caramel" isn't the best name for it)
column10: What an interesting treat! Yes, you may feel the flavor of raw cacao, but this aspect is mild, and you may not even notice it if you don't focus on it. What you are more likely to notice is how elegantly it's crafted in terms of mouthfeel (both the chocolate itself and the combination of the chocolate and the filling). I think this product is a masterpiece, taste-wise and texture-wise. The only obstacles for my family to buying from this brand often are the price and the presence of some added sugar (relatively little though, judging by the numbers on their labels; I just wanted to point out that agave nectar is especially high in fructose, the "worst" of "simple sugars", and this brand uses some agave nectar - hopefully very little).The name is misleading though - I can't feel "caramel" no matter how hard I stretch my imagination. It's delicious, just don't expect that dairy flavor.This brand's other bars, Acai and Goji, are similar, but "Maca" is NOT chocolaty and disappointing.

I've had a LOT of raw chocolate bars. Nothing compares to this brand. I've tried all the different flavors and they're to LIVE for. I feel really healthy after eating some of this chocolate. I would recommend buying it at a local health food store because they're quite expensive to order here. I have the same thing to say about their other flavors.

I read some glowing reviews on blogs of these bars and decided to try this one as it was considered the "best tasting" by many.The outer chocolatre itself is good, but the "caramel truffle" had a quite unpleasant taste that I did not like at all. After two bites it ended in the garbage. Oh well...For now I'll stick to Lindt 85% Cacao bars which are cheap and meet my needs of a very low sugar chocolate treat.

I do not even know where to start, horrible texture, grainy, sweet, no flavor...Is there really chocolate in it? If i did not live so far from the store I would havetaken it back, did I say overpriced? I would not even try the other flavors, yuck!

I've had a LOT of raw chocolate bars. Nothing compares to this brand. I've tried all the different flavors and they're to LIVE for. I feel really healthy after eating some of this chocolate. I would recommend buying it at a local health food store because they're quite expensive to order here. I have the same thing to say about their other flavors.

I've had a LOT of raw chocolate bars. Nothing compares to this one. I've tried all the different flavors and they're to LIVE for. I feel really healthy after eating some of this chocolate. I would recommend buying it at a local health food store because they're quite expensive to order here.

These were selling in my gym and I decided to try this and the Caraeml (which I reviewed separately and gave two stars).I managed to eat two bites of the caramel. I spat out the first bite of this one. It tastes disgusting. Furthermore, despite it not being passed its sell-by-date (two months from now) it looks bad. The caramel bar looks like dark chocolate; this looks like medium brown sand.Definitely the worst chocolate I've ever had (and in a world full of Hershey's that is saying something).

This was an impulse buy while standing in line at an organic foods market. First off, I have to say that I've had raw chocolate before, and I really like dark chocolate. So after a surprising cost of $5 I was hoping for the best tasting sweet to ever hit me in the mouth. Wow, I just have to say that this was so awful that I feel like I have to warn the world. I was a little disappointed in the small size of it at first, but now I understand that no one could stand to eat one of these if they were full sized. For one, the "caramel" is an unflavored paste-like substance  , and the only way I can describe the whole eating experience is by likening it to having a pill get stuck in the back of your throat and being stuck with that rancid flavor until you manage to eat something less horrible. As I sit here in my buyers remorse stupor, I can't stop thinking about the many more pleasing things I could have done with my $5. For instance, I could go bowling, tip a stripper, wash my car, or buy 2 or 3 less disgusting chocolate bars. I'm only righting this review in the hopes that I may keep some other poor unsuspecting shopper from being duped as I was.

column9: What you would expect from Wild Honey
column10: I bought this honey due to the fact its not cooked and is raw which provides more nutrition than Grade A honey( Any Grade Honey is Cooked and filtered). This Honey is really cheap for the price if you subscribe. The honey is not as sweet as clove honey or regular honey because its from gallberry and palmetto honey. I'm glad I tried it and will probably continue to buy this honey for what I use it for(Make honey lemon water, and etc) but if your looking for a sweeter honey look else where, this honey is a more balanced taste. I recommend palmetto honey for a sweeter taste which can be found here Tropic Bee Palmetto Honey, 16-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4). Also the honey came perfectly packaged which was great. A+

I bought this one, and the company's orange blossom honey.  I'm a bit of a honey fanatic, and have tried many types of honey from all over.  For a wildflower, though, I love this one.  It's a typical wildflower, but with just a bit more spice and complexity.  Great stuff, very acceptable price if you do the subscribe.  Middle of the road in sweetness, not too spicy, but not bland either.  A very good all-around honey. Could put it in teas or in cooking equally well.  It reminds me of when I was younger, going to a flea market, and getting one of those straight-from-the-beekeeper pieces of honey comb with honey in it. :)I will probably still buy other honeys for their specific traits, but I think this may be replacing the clover honey I bought before it from Amazon, as the clover was a little too pungently, well, "clover".  This is complex enough a flavor, that it's not overwhelming you with any particular flavor.  Also, no bitter after taste like some honeys have. And you just can't beat knowing that it comes from lands not tainted with pesticides, and being a product of the US! :)Containers come wrapped in plastic, just in case of breakage I guess, and it has a little white bit you have to remove from under the squeeze bottle top, which is nice to see.  It looks like it shouldn't have a squeeze bottle cap, but it does, which is nice.
Fresh, pure, unprocessed, uncooked honey.  Fast shipping and no leakage.  Great size.  I use it in my tea every night.  Would order again in a heart beat!

Using Subscribe & Save, I got a 48 oz bottle of wild flower honey for roughly $12 and change.  This product is the real deal, produced in the US and packed in Florida, not imported and adulterated. It has a mild wildflower flavor that's perfect for everyday use and baking, my primary reason for purchasing honey in bulk.  The honey is uncooked, so it may crystallize after time, just reheat gently, and unfiltered, so it appears a bit cloudy, but that's a good sign.  This is one of the best deals in honey I've seen in awhile, as I've been buying it from local NYC beekeepers for upwards of over $12 per lb.
This honey is perfect for tea, as it is not too sweet and does not alter the taste of your drink.Healthy and loaded with vitamins and antioxidants too!!!!

This honey has a really nice smoky flavor, not super-sweet and flavorless like most commercial honey.  The only problem was that the yellow lid was cracked when we received it.  It still seals ok, but they could work on padding the package a bit better.  Highly recommend this to anyone who likes honey for its own flavor, not just as a sweetener.
This is the best honey we have ever tasted, will be ordering more. The price was great to. We have tasted a lot of honey but in our book this is the best by far.

One of the best values in raw honey. We subscribe and save, and this honey from the Florida Everglades is delivered to us every month. My wife uses it in her green tea and also in warm honey water. I spread it on my toast and pizza crust.
I like this honey. It comes in a bigger size, since I use a lot of honey for tea it's easier for me to buy it this way.  I would recommend it.

Great flavor, great price.  If you like a rather bold flavor in your honey this is the one to get.  It comes from the Florida area and what ever flower the bee's are getting there pollen from provides a bold (but not to strong ) flavor.  Excellent product.

Quick Look at Tropical Blossom Wild Honey:Pros: 1) Taste good 2) Looks rawCons: 1) Not boxed well 2) Advertised quantity misleading 3) Darker than picturedDetails:We received the Tropical Blossom Wild Honey today. It came in a package with several items ordered and came without any protection around it. It is a heavier plastic container and it does have an internal foil cover so added protection may not have been necessary but, the same package had loose metal tools included.  Nothing leaked or was broken but certainly the possibility was there.We immediately opened the bottle for a taste test.  It has a caramel, fruity quality to it that is quite pleasant and does not leave an aftertaste. It looks to be as advertised "raw and unfiltered" though I would say somewhat unfiltered because it is cleaner than some honey I have purchased that seems like it was pressed out by barefoot kids in a tub. It is a little darker than the picture. It is definitely a keeper considering our taste test.Cons: Most of the honey producers we have dealt with list their honey in fluid ounces or in pounds.  The conversion to weight makes a big difference in pricing for the fluid ounce measurement.  This advertiser states 48-Ounce Bottle. Well, the bottle surely isn't a 48 fluid oz bottle as you might be led to believe.  So if you thought it was 48 fluid ounces of honey and you just got 3 lbs of honey you just paid a premium for your honey because 48 fluid ounces of honey should be 4.5 lbs. The advertisement should state 3 lbs. of honey. A 48-Ounce Bottle is misleading and maybe done so on purpose. I'm amazed that other reviewers mixed the terms and didn't catch this. If it doesn't say quart or pounds I guess the question needs to be asked up front about what we are buying. It makes one appreciate the "Dutch Gold Company" with their "Bulk Orange Blossom Honey - 5 lb."  No mistake here and they have great packaging.Bottom Line :(  I paid $4.90/lb verses $3.25/lb. but it does taste good. Generally I try to keep the price to $3/lb and have received a good value like from "honeydabber" on Ebay though the product comes in thermally sealed bags for that price. Also the Dutch Gold Company on Amazon does it right too.  If it were not for the good flavor and what appears to be raw honey as advertised I would have given this three (3) stars because of the duplicity of the advertisement.  They are not the only ones to do this so buyer beware.

I love the value in this honey.  It's difficult to find good unfiltered and uncooked honey and this one fits the bill at a great price.  Note: because it is a raw unprocessed honey, the taste and color can vary from batch to batch.  I haven't had a bad batch though.

column9: As good as or better than any other wildflower honey
column10: Husband picky about Wildflower and Orange Blossom honey, does not enjoy clover.  Prefers Wildflower, says this is as good or better than others.  Easier to handle plastic bottle - we avoid the glass jars too messy.  Nice 48oz size - easier to store than couple smaller bottles in the cabinet.

this is the best flavor in a honey i have ever had. great in coffee and made an awsome carrot cake. will purchase again.  PS: have this on autodelivery. well worth it. look forward to every delivery of this quality honey.
I have used this to make cinnamon ice cream and also but some on my pancakes! It's a great product and worth a try.
My 7th year old and his friends loved the angry birds fruit snacks and since you can't find it at stores they were pretty popular. They were a hit!

column9: Loved by every child in a 300 yard radius.
column10: My daughter gasped so loudly when I opened the box of Angry Birds Fruit Snacks that I thought she had gotten a large paper cut.  She then held the box up to better see these wonders of modern molded fruit goodness, and said, "Oh, thank you, thank you, thank you!"After opening a package and tasting them, she declared them delicious and immediately started sharing them with her (equally dramatic) group of tween friends... which means I need to order another box.  The fruit snacks are soft and flavored well, but the real genius was marketing them with the adorable Angry Birds.  :)Since my daughter and her friends enjoyed these snacks so much, I will recommend them to others!

I love gummy things but these are the most disgusting ones I've ever tasted.  Furthermore, they are expensive.  I purchased 4 boxes without reading the details very closely.  Each box has 10 packs of gummies (each pack having 5-10 gummies).  The discounted price still comes out to 35 cents per pack.DISGUSTING, DISGUSTING, DISGUSTING!  And so far, each friend who has tried them agree!  Who would think an Angry Bird gummy could be so gross! :)

I was glad to have found these, but after trying them, I was sorely disappointed. All the gummies were HARD! They were hardly chewable by me, an adult, so I don't know how kids can chew this. I was disappointed that I had to give these away. They were lacking in flavor too. Only the red angry bird gummies were half soft, the rest were all hard. I don't recommend them, at least not from Amazon. Try somewhere else before you buy so you can give a quick squeeze to see if they are soft. I would have returned these if I had ample time to get replacements, but I didn't.

I bought this product for my research lab, and all the other grad students loved them... They are not just for kids. This product tastes good with an excellent texture that is not too gummy.  Also, as a bonus, they are decently healthy with no hydrogenated oils and protein to boot!!!!  I honestly could care less about nutrition but our lab nutritionist gave them the thumbs up.

column9: This was huge, full of chemicals and I sent it bacl
column10: I tought it would be healthy and an Easter treat for my grandkids.  I was not either one. If you are looking for a healthy snack, not this.

column9: Everyone ready now for cold weather
column10: Stephens flavored cocoas are wonderful. The family requests the candy cane flavor. Looking forward to trying the apple cinnamon cider.

I've been a "connoisseur" of dark-chocolate-dipped apricots for years and this is the first time I've ordered them from Amazon.This brand, Old Naples, was a real disappointment.The apricots have an artificial flavor, a strong aftertaste, and a stale, jelly-like texture.  It was not at all the melt-in-your mouth, sticky-sweetness that I have experienced from other brands.The chocolate layer is thin but more importantly, it's cheap chocolate. It's a waxy, flavorless, too-sweet chocolate that barely even looks like dark rather than milk chocolate.On the positive side, each one was individually sealed in cellophane so they weren't as messy as I expected, and the simple gold box was attractive.I would not order these again.
Delicious but messy; chocolate mostly off apricots but still very tasty;  package must have gone through a tumbling dryer; apricots still out of this world
Simply delicious! Moist, soft and rich! Totally delectable and satisfying... I'd order them again. These have always been a favorite of mine and my family.

These are sweet, delicious, addictive and quite expensive at approximately $5 per piece.The apricot flavor is explosive and natural tasting to me.I disagree with the reviewer who said they are "artificial flavor, a strong aftertaste, and a stale, jelly-like texture." The chocolate is dark chocolate, not milk chocolate, and it does appear to have a higher cocoa butter content to make it more firm on the moist apricot, but I would not describe it as "waxy".I highly recommend these as an occasional indulgence.

column9: If I only could have these delivered automatically every week!
column10: Very, very high quality and extremely delicious! I can't indulge in them as often as I'd like but would if I could. The dark chocolate is rich and flavorful and the apricots are succulent. Enthusiastically recommended!

I order these chocolate covered apricots over and over again as gifts and for my own indulgence.  Such plump and moist apricots---never dry or stringy in tecture.  Love both the dark and milk chocolate dipped.  Wish they had white chocolate, too.  An assortment of milk, dark and milk chocolate dipped apricots would be even better!A Very Satisfied Customer

column9: Product good very low packaging aesthetic !
column10: I am happy with quality of this maca but it came in a grey ziplock very unnadorned...not at all like the picture...but if that knocks a few $ off the price of the maca  I can live without the aesthetic!

I love Tazo "Passion" hibiscus-based iced tea, but not so much love for their green tea here and the reason is simple -- I don't like the mint. If you like your tea to have the liquid chewing gum aspect, you just might like this tea, but I'd rather they have kept it simple and let the green tea be the dominant flavor, but the mint ingredient overpowers everything and I've never been a fan of mint flavored teas.  I don't plan on buying this tea again unless they toss the spearmint, but I heartily recommend Tazo Passion Filter Bag Tea, 24-Count Packages (Pack of 6) or the Tazo® Black Iced Tea Bags (20-pc.) iced teas.  I've also found that The Republic of Tea, Double Green Matcha, 50-Count makes a good iced tea, you just have to use about 5 of the smaller bags to get similar strength as compared to the one large Tazo bag.
Wow! What a great flavour! Try it in some club soda or diet lemon-lime soda over ice, it's amazing that something called Desert Pear could be so tasty.

I just received my Brazilian Rain Tree an hour ago.  I want to first say that I have received several trees from Brussels and Brussels trees bought through Amazon.  They are always very well packed.  I have learned a great way to get the tree out.  I open the top of the box and remove the invoice and brochure.  Then I open the bottom of the box and set it inside a large trash bag.  Pull up on the box slowly and pull up the sides of the bag.  I was able to get my tree out and remove the peanuts with only four peanuts touching the floor.  It takes awhile to pick out the peanuts around the tree but it is worth it having a safe tree delivered.I am very surprised with my rain tree!  It is 20 inches tall from the soil and the trunk is almost an inch wide.  The tree is not straight up and down but has a beautiful curve too it.  There are tons of leaves and smaller branches.  This tree looks much older than I expected!  Right now the leaves are all folded up since it has been in the dark box for a few days.  There are no blossoms at this time but there are a bunch of thorns!  I am very happy and can't wait for the leaves to open up.  I gave the tree a drink of water and will baby it for a couple of weeks since it has had a few rough days.I agree with the other reviewer that it is better than other trees I have seen online.  I really struggled with deciding on what indoor tree to buy.  There are not many photos of this tree type online and the best ones are obviously specimen trees that are much older.  One of the main photos of the Brazilian Rain Tree seems to be copied a million times and used on many sights.  I will try to get some photos soon and put them up on Amazon.I have only had this tree for an hour but at this point I would recommend it!

Received as a gift just prior to Xmas 2009. Not my first Bonsai. Receives plenty of light and water. Have added Superthrive to water  as recommended by Bonsai enthusiasts. Has progressively lost leaves. At the rate it is going I will soon have only branches. Called seller Brussels this past Monday but as of this writing my call has not been returned.Updated: Found out that it is normal for the tree to lose almost all its leaves in the winter. The tree now has quite a bit of new growth.

I was very pleased with my Rain Tree.  Without a picture I didn't know exactly what to expect.  I looked up several specimens on different websites and the tree delivered to me was better than any picture that I found.  The delivery time was excellent.  I highly recommend this tree for the unique behavior of the leaves when it is left in the dark for 30 minutes or more.  It was really amazing.

I got these little trees and turned them into bonsai trees in little pots. I displayed them and they all sold immediately (except for 1 that was a gift). I hope more come out for sale again soon. These are the greatest little trees, they look nice and they sprout new leaves quick. I keep coming back whenever I see the name Brussel's, the best products and service on the planet.

One of most concerning facts regarding buying a Bonsai tree online is that you never know how the actual tree will look like, specially that most sellers use the same picture. Well i gave it a shot and I'm very glad i did.It's true that the tree I received was much bigger than what i thought (8 Lbs and over 20" high), but that's just not bad, but what i really liked was how close my tree was to the one in the image, plus how healthy and well packed it was.Overall I'm very satisfied and I'd difinetaly consider buying trees from this seller.

I would give this a better rating if mine hadn't died.  I didn't realize it would be so root bound by the time it got to me and when I realized what was wrong with it, it was too late.  No amount of TLC after repotting could save it.  SO... if you buy it, yank it out of it's pot (careful, they use some thick sharp wires to hold it in place) and place it in a large container and allow it to grow out a bit.  BE WARNED since it doesn't come with one.

column9: too expensive for what u get
column10: If you do not live somewhere where there is sun everyday of the year, do not get it. 1 day after it arrived, most of the leaves feel out. it was supposed to be a Christmas present and since most of leaves feel out we could not give it away. it was pathetic. it is definitely not worth 60 dollars.we really regret buying this plant.

This was a christmas gift for a dear friend.  It arrived well packed and as described...but then small flying bugs (gnats?) started to emerge, they have been coming alive for days now and nothing seems to stop them!  Friend asked Amazon for an exchange...sorry no exchanges, if you return it we will refund the money!!!  It was a gift!

column9: USE THE CUPS MORE THAN ONCE!!! EXTRA VALUE!
column10: I don't know if most people know this or not, but in Japan we put loose green tea leaves in a pot and just keep pouring hot water over it until the "taste" is too weak. All the water must be poured out after no more than 3 minutes or else the tea will be biter. Thats why most Japanese tea sets are so small. Green tea isn't meant to be left in a teapot like english teas. So my first cup of green tea was actually a little stronger than I am used to and I actually got 3 uses out of ONE k-cup. I highly recommend using them more than once if you are making the tea one cup after another....and it will save you MONEY!

column9: It's good stuff, better than expected.
column10: I usually buy numi green tea mao feng. And the tea from this k-cups is comparable. Numi tastes a little better, but the k-cup is more convinient. Thus, I am most likely going to buy this tea from now on.

Reading the reviews for this tea, I was skeptical, but made the purchase anyway.  Really glad I did.  If you're used to the watered-down "green" tea they serve at chinese buffets or cheaper restaurants, you may find it bitter.  Stick to water, this isn't for you.While not the same quality as good Japanese teas, It is the best I've had from the K-cups, and better than most of the tea bags I can get in the states.If you like REAL green tea, you'll probably love this.  If you're A WIMP, try Snapple.

I admit to being sceptical about having an instant tea that I would normally let steep for 5 minutes.  This is the most bitter green tea I have ever drank.  Maybe it's too concentrated, or the water's not hot enough.  I tried different drink size options, and that didn't work.  Maybe the black teas are better.  I'll stick to a different green tea, and brew it the old fashioned way.
Makes a great cup of green tea.  I use the middle setting and it is just right.  I tend to like my tea strong and this does not turn out too watery, very impressive for a green tea.
