column9: Yummy Spoonfuls vs. Jack's Harvest....My baby and I vote for Yummy Spoonfuls!!!
column10: I have become a big fan of Yummy Spoonfuls over the past several months.  Now that my daughter is getting older, I am now ordering "mushy" in addition to "creamy".  This food is really great.  I always taste everything before giving to my daughter and I have never had a negative experience with Yummy Spoonful's flavors.  I feel good that I am offering healthy choices to my baby and yes, it cost much more than jarred food, but it is soooo much better.  I think it is totally worth it.Last month, I placed my first order for the "mushy" variety pack and also placed an order with Jack's Harvest "little lumpy" sampler pack at the same time.  Both orders arrived promptly...they actually arrived the same day.  I purchased with Jacks hoping to provide a little more variety for my baby since she seemed to be getting a little bored with her foods and since Jacks had 5 stars on Amazon I thought they would be a good choice.  Now that both my baby and I have had time to compare the two brands, we by far prefer Yummy Spoonfuls.  My baby has not rejected any of the Yummy Spoonfuls flavors, but I can only get her to happily eat 1 of the 3 flavors in Jack's Harvest Sampler pack. I was able to compare Yummy Spoonfuls butternut squash and apples to Jack's Harvest butternut squash and apples since both variety packs included that flavor.  Jack's was so tart that I had to add in so much cereal to tame the taste before I could get her to even take a couple of bites and that was all I was able to get out of her...a couple of bites.  I have tried again a few times since then and she now completely refuses Jack's Butternut Squash and Apples.  I have tasted as well and I would have to agree with my baby...the taste is not very enjoyable.  A week or so later, my baby tried Yummy Spoonfuls Butternut Squash and Apples and to my surprise (after how she reacted to Jack's)...she loved it.  Not sure what could be so different, but it sure is.  Yummy Spoonfuls taste is so much better.The heart shaped foods that Jacks sends are cute, but I find that I have to find another container to store it in since she does not eat the whole heart in one serving so it is a little inconvenient for me.  Yummy Spoonfuls comes in small plastic containers and I find them very convenient.  When my orders arrive, I put them in the freezer then the day before I am ready for them, I simply take out what I want, put it in the fridge and let it defrost.  Then once my baby has finished, I wash the container and reuse for snacks on the go.Also, to those who want more variety like me, Yummy Spoonfuls has great customer service and they allow you to customize the variety packs to what you want/need.  I simply send them an email with what flavors I want (you have to choose at least 3 of the same flavor) and they will change my order accordingly.Bottomline,  I really think Yummy Spoonfuls is doing a great job, the food tastes great and the containers have worked out well.

column9: Happy with product - just what we needed!
column10: Health department regs in my state do not allow unsealed containers of food be brought in to daycare. This created a problem since I do not want to feed jarred food to my baby and they won't let me bring in homemade food.  Yummy Spoonfuls is the only company that I could find that makes individually packaged, frozen organic baby food. I feel better about sending it to daycare since it's frozen rather than jarred, and daycare happily accepts it. My baby has enjoyed every flavor available. I am so happy this product exists...I just wish it was a bit cheaper.

column9: Do not buy. . . .they lie about how many oz are in the containers!!!
column10: I wrote a few other reviews regarding this company. There is only maybe 2-2.5 oz of food in each cup. The food was fine but after I contacted the company about my discovery I got the run around. I ordered two different times thinking it was a fluke but it was not. Go with Jack's Havest brand. They do not lie about how much food you are getting and they do not package in wasteful containers.

I love yummy spoonfuls. The products are fresh and very tasty. It is quite expensive but I purchase them so that I may have a great alternative to homemade baby food when I do not have the time to make my own food.

I'm very happy with this product & will order it again.  I was skeptical about ordering frozen baby food off of the internet but this arrived completely frozen and was fresh with natural color. I had every intention on making my own baby food again like I did for my son but I just don't have the time & felt guilty for making it for him & not for my daughter. I was looking for baby food that was organic, fresh and tasted like homemade. While researching options I found that Yummy spoonfuls won the award from Cookie Magazine for best baby food so that is why I gave it a try. My daughter loves the taste of it, which shocked me because she is a picky eater. I struggle to get her to finish jar baby food. I think it is even better than what I could make at home, the portions are the perfect size and it is a lot easier.

There's the tradeoff.Yes, it's delicious, and the baby loves it. At over $3 per cup, it's also incredibly expensive, and I haven't seen any options to buy in bulk. As noted, it comes delivered in a huge styrofoam cooler, which ends up in your trash, the landfill and/or the ocean for every 12 cup variety pack you buy.So, the question is what's more important to you - the fact that it's delicious, or the fact that it's expensive.

column9: Too expensive and too much packaging
column10: If you're not able to make your own and freeze it, this is certainly the next best thing.  It is very expensive for not a lot of food, especially considering if you were making your own it would cost you one tenth of what they are charging.This comes in a styrofoam container.  So if you were ordering this on a regular basis you would be the proud owner of many styrofoam cooler containers... I'm not sure what to do with the one.  I know it comes frozen but it seems like there must be something out there other than styrofoam, honestly shouldn't the stuff be banned already?  My older two kids and I had a great time with the dry ice however.The baby does like the food so far.  Frozen instead of jars is an interesting idea, although I think I will freeze my own and continue to use my processor to process what we are eating for her and keep jars for emergencies.

column9: Tried frozen baby food and it was fresh
column10: I received my order of food yesterday, I am so happy with the quality of the foods.  It was so good I think I will join my little one and eat Yummy Spoonfuls myself.  I have tried many other brands of organic baby food and have alwys been dissatisfied with the quality of the food, mainly with taste and/or the texture.  I will say this taste nothing like baby food, it is very rich in flavor and very fresh.  The Carrot, Sweet Potato and Broccoli was creamy and delicious, it was so "orangy" it looked like I had just pureed it myself best of all my baby enjoyed it.  This morning I tried the Blueberry Banana and Brown Rice and to my surprise he wanted more. I can't wait to try the other flavors later tonight.For the price I am completely happy with the product I received.  I lve in an area where organic produce is not readily available.  It is important for me to feed my little one organic, good quality foods all the time and being able to order this product online and receive it in 2 days works out perfect for me.  I also love that it is individually packaged, makes it easy to travel with.  I took some this morning to his nana to feed him while I am at work today.  No more worrying where to find food for him when out on the road, it beats trying to fix myself.  As a working mom it is great to find products like this one which makes my life much easier without sacrificing nutrition, taste or time.  Thanks Yummy Spoonfuls!
The car shaped candy inside tastes like old school Pez! I ate it all so fast it wasn't even funny.
ONO I don't ever want to be without it!From sprinkling on salmon, to hamburgers or just sunny sideup eggs. This seasoning is da bomb.

This stuff is awesome.  I sprinkled a tiny bit on some chicken and cooked it in a pan with just a little olive oil (nothing else!) and it tasted fantastic.  No one flavor in the seasoning is overpowering (even the ginger)-- it's very nicely balanced and you only need to use a little bit.  I'm looking forward to using it more; I bet it would be great on fish.  Highly recommended!

I love this seasoning. We vacationed in Hawaii this year and the place we stayed in had a bottle of Ono Hawaiian Seasoning, so we tried it there and love to use it on pork in the crock pot. Delicious! Will buy again and do recommend.

Ono in the Hawaiian language means delicious, delightful, the best.  Ono truly describes this product.  A Maui friend introduced me to Ono seasoning and I have been ever so grateful. Whenever a dish needs something more, but what is it? a dash of Ono seasoning rounds out the flavor.  It is truly amazing stuff.  I use it in soups, salads, casseroles, on vegetables, meats, fish.  It seems expensive, but a little goes a long ways and it has a long shelf life.

I always pick up this stuff in Hawaii when I go, I am pleased I can now get it on Amazon.  This makes the best Kaula Pork without digging a hole in your backyard.  Just need a crockpot, liquid smoke, ONO salt, and a pork butt.  YUMMY.  Great on chicken too.
It's my new to go to spice! Before that I was all about the garlic salt lol  I love the flavors they blend well wish fish,chicken and even tofu!

Discovered this product during a vacation to Hawaii with my family. I bought some bbq being grilled and sold at local grocery store chain. The meat was so tasty that I asked for the seasoning and they pointed out ONO. I bought a container but eventually ran out. Luckily it was carried via Amazon and I have restocked several times. It is great on ribs, steak and fish. It is a fantastic rub that is great on ribs, steaks, and fish. The salt is brinier than table salt and gives an earthy flavor that really enhances the food. Try the spicier version as well!

An excellent low-calorie, low-salt cracker. I was pleasantly surprised that it actually tastes quite good.Pros: Low-salt  Low calorie  TastyCons: Doesn't whiten your teeth while you sleep.Bottom line: Good stuff!

I recently bought 4 different boxes of the K-Cups and I ALWAYS find myself popping this one in. The flavor is crazy good and I was completely surprised when I tasted the creamer that was thrown in. I love it. I love it a lot.

This is my favorite K Cup.  If you are a flavored coffee lover and like your coffee sweet and creamy this K Cup is for you. But I do not make this K Cup as a cold drink.  I make it as a hot coffee drink and it is yummy.  SO keep that in mind, also I make a large cup and then make a small cup using the same K cup.  Just don't take it out the machine.
I love this coffee it is so simple I don't have to add anything to it. This product made my Life a lot easier
Coffee was not as sweet as I thought it would be. It doesn't taste bad just not as good as if you just took regular coffee and put ice in it.
I love iced coffee so I decided to give this a try.  Its not too sweet or too bitter.  Very good back-up when I'm running late for work and unable to stop for my iced coffee at the coffee shop!

I usually only post comments on items that I either strongly like or dislike. The peaches have a great texture and taste fresh. The juice that they come in tastes great as well. The only negative complaint I would have is that when you open the lid a little bit of the juice often squirts out, but that doesn't bother me enough to take away a star. This is one of my favorite products!!

column9: Peach cups hard to open, messy - otherwise a great product
column10: Difficult to remove the cup's covering, so the juice that surroundsthe peaches spills unless special care is exercised. The covering is attachedso firmly it is hard not to spill some juice even while being careful.Especially for children or the elderly this is an important issue.The product inside the cup is good.

Having lived in the UK for 3 years, I figured the British must know what to do with a salt and vinegar chip... Boy do they ever! I dislike the US versions; too strong.This chip/crisp is absolutely the most delicious salt and vinegar product I've tasted.
Im all for spicy but this was killer... And salty. Not a fan. Just get the plain stuff and cook a cup at a time.

This quinoa was so easy to make and delicious!  I have read about the health benefits of eating quinoa but never tried making it myself.  The black bean flavor was fantastic.  Would definately recommend to everyone!

This powdered cocoa peanut butter is really good and easy to mix with water. Wala you have creamy peanut butter. I add the water slowly so i can get it to the thickness i like. Very nice substitute for the fat loaded type. I get mine at Amazon. I have prime shipping so no tax and free shipping make this right up my alley.

Perfect for smoothies, and snacks. Low in calories and taste REALLY good. A must have in my opinion especially if you like to eat as healthy as possible. You cut out about 150 calories from a typical 2Tbsp serving of nut butter. And it has chocolate! Can't beat that!

This is a really  nutritious hot cereal that everyone in my family will eat.  It's simple to prepare.  I make it in the slow cooker overnight.  I measure in the cereal, pinch of salt, and pour in boiling water, stir, and put the crock pot on the WARM setting, put on the lid, and go to bed!Next morning, hot cereal.  We serve it with milk and real maple syrup.  Not even the picky eaters turn up their noses for this breakfast.Amazon's prices for Bob's Red Mill products are the best I've found.  I store my extra bags in the freezer.  This cereal is also great added to homemade bread.

This cereal is so yummy,It is even good right from the package.I do use milk to make mine,not water. The shipping was really fast.I also used this in a baked quinoa, oatmeal cereal recipe and it worked out perfect!
The 5 Grain Rolled cereal is the best. I purchased this for my mother because I like it so much. It has so much more texture and taste than oatmeal. Try it. You'll like it.
Great way to get the fiber needed for my family and with a great taste. This was a great buy!
Really tasty. I boil water in the microwave at work and then I add the oats and dried fruits and yogurt.

I read the reviews before buying and thought this was a great item!  Everyone gave it 5 stars so what could go wrong.....Except that the taste was so bad that i didn't even swallow the first bite. I rather stick with quick oats from Sprouts then eat this stuff. Also quick oats is cheaper too.

I started buying this sauce when they were selling at the craft fairs many, many years ago.  I still try and keep my pantry in stock with at least one bottle at all times.  I use it in my meatloaf instead of ketchup as it adds a delicious flavor to the meatloaf.  It is wonderful on smoked ribs. We also use it with brats as a side sauce.  I highly recommend it.

We have been using Cranberry Grilling Sauce for years, even though it is now hard to find.  I have to pressure my supermarket to stock it.  It adds a delightful tart flavor to chicken, even if you don't use a grill.  I just lightly brown chicken tenderloins, add the sauce, and cook a little longer.  One of the quickest, simplest meals you can imagine!
the BEST deal on the earth--at one of our grocery stores just 1 packet sells for $1.79 and that's on sale here $.89 including free shipping--

I have been buying this product for years and all of a sudden it was no longer available at any of my local supermarkets.  The mild flavor does not have the bite the original recipe has.  I love this dressing and buying it by the case is at a tremendous savings as well.  Bon Appetite!

column9: Why is this dressing so hard to find?
column10: Good Seasons Mild Italian dressing mix has always been my favorite salad dressing, but it is not available in some parts of the country, and that has always puzzled me. I live in Virginia, and I always check to see if a store carries the product, and I've never found it. Prior to purchasing a case through Amazon, I had to import it from New England stores, where they still offer the product. Mild Italian dressing does not overpower salads, but rather adds a delicious combination of sweet, sour, salt, and spicy to almost any salad type. It is a very versatile product that works well with typical green salads, garden salads, fruity salads, and salads with grilled meats or cheeses. You can also create an excellent dijon-style dressing by combining it with a teaspoon or two of dijon mustard, and the result is excellent on salads with spinach, eggs, or fruits such as mangoes and citrus.

Although I enjoy all of the Good Seasons package salad dressings, the Mild Italian works the best for all types of salads and meals.  Plus I love making it up freash when I want to use it.  It is not a dressing that has been sitting on the store shelf for months and then months in the fridge trying to use it up.

I love this salad dressing and was happy to find it at amazon.  I live in Southern California and can't find it here, I usually bring it back from West Virginia when I visit every year.Price was great and shipping was free.

I cannot believe what a  poor experience this has been! I have passed this experience on to several others and be assured I will continue to do so.

column4: Donita M. Brown "Avid reader, tech geek.  Chr...

Amazon has the best prices and they deliver!  It can't get any better than that!  Shipment was fast, easy and well protected.  Thank you Amazon!

My 21 month old Granddaughter is allergic to cows milk and can only have Rice dream or Soy milk Sometimes the stores are sold out so having rice milk on hand is very helpful.  Thank you
I like the product, the only think I am not happy with is the fact that when I run out of milk I cannot have the avaibility to change my shippping date. Thank you

The boxes were packaged in a strong cardboard box and arrived in excellent condition.  The price at the time I bought them was less than $2 a box which was better than in the stores in my area.  I imagine the price fluctuates online more than in the store.

column9: There are better tasting, healthier alternatives
column10: I used Imagine Rice beverages for many years. I favored them for high quality ingredients, excellent flavor, reasonable price, and wide availability. I find milk and soy products cause digestive distress, rice beverages have no such effect, no cholesterol, very little fat, and taste great. Enriched has extra nutrition and is organic.However, Imagine now uses the cheaper canola oil in their rice milk products, including their Heart-Wise line of products. Canola oil contains erucic acid, a known toxic long-chain fatty acid. The USA FDA has limited canola oil to no more than 2% erucic acid to protect our health, and does not allow it in infant formula. In addition, medical studies show the erucic acid it contains is toxic to humans and animals in high enough amounts (see below). I have not been able to find any long term longitudinal controlled studies on humans to prove its safety as far as all the adversely affected organs.Because there have been Internet rumors about Canola that are based on misinformation, I provide some citations of scientific papers and government publications at the end of this review. This is a highly controversial subject, but concerns can be based on genuine medical research and not simply superstition, gullibility or hysteria. The FDA still approves at this time PABA food containers for people and infants, but they are not allowed in Canada due to documented toxic effects; this (and a hundred other examples) shows that FDA approval is not always the last word in food safety!Good Karma Whole Grains Ricemilk is organic and also canola and sugar free. It has a thicker, richer and creamier body and flavor, less watered down. The vanilla flavor is a delicious drink. Westsoy Rice Beverage has similar consistency to Rice Dream, but is canola free. I find it to be less sweet, less chalky, and more milk-like in flavor. The least expensive canola free rice milk I have found is Whole Foods "365" brand, which is more watery than other brands but tastes fine. (Some of the Good Karma products on Amazon have canola listed as an ingredient, but I believe that is outdated information. The Good Karma website and the products themselves do not list canola as an ingredient at this time.) I use "365" for cooking because it is inexpensive, and Good Karma for drinking straight because of its rich milk flavor and texture. The Good Karma chocolate flavor is super delicious and is very sweet, but unfortunately contains cane sugar rather than rice-based sweeteners.Some Imagine products and all the Good Karma products are also organic and made from whole grain (that is, brown) rice. Some Imagine products and some Good Karma products (the chocolate drink) contain cane sugar, which is a high glycemic sweetener, rather than a rice-based sweetener. There may be some Imagine rice milk products that are canola free, you have to check the labels, and it changes with time.The same canola issues (and cane sugar considerations) also apply to the Imagine frozen desert products. Good Karma makes rice-based frozen deserts that are probably canola free.[Health effects in humans shown to result from, or statistically linked to (different than caused by), erucic acid (_not_ Canola oil) in various medical research papers, review articles, and toxicology textbooks, include decreasing red blood cell count and autism. In animal studies there are many more documented effects of erucic acid including heart lesions and distortions of mitochondria. These studies can easily be found in the medical literature. They do not prove that the amounts of canola oil consumed by people will cause health problems, and the FDA has ruled that oil containing not more than 2% erucic acid is safe for human consumption except for infants.]Studies on erucic acid in rats and piglets show heart lesions, decreased red blood cell count, and other tissue and organ damage. Erucic acid crosses the blood-brain barrier and is known to affect nerve cells. It's not safe for infants by US FDA regulation. Check out this small sample of government and peer-reviewed medical journal articles documenting my statements, available online if you search for the titles.United States Legislation on Low Erucic Acid Rapeseed Oil, Federal Department of Agriculture, 1985, article 184.1555, sections 3 and 4.Growth Rate, Lipid Composition, Metabolism and Myocardial Lesions of Rats Fed Rapeseed Oils J. Golovko and Eric J. Murphy, The Journal of Lipid Research, 47, 1289-1297, June 2006.

The box contains 180 empty chocolate shells. I always order the big bulk buys of the hurricane popcorn or toppings from them and always receive the freshness and flavor I expect and ship time is fairly quick for shipping from an island. Great customer service as well if you have any questions! Thanks!

Hurricane popcorn is the best. The toppings make the popcorn. This time I decided to purchase the toppings only and add it to plain popcorn.  I was not disappointed.  Now that Amazon is handling the purchase I will continue to order the toppings online.
products came as planned. but i had like two bags that were already opened. im sure it was because oversight during product etc. but overall love my cheez its!

Great tasting cereal, and at Trader Joe's it is only $2.29/box.
The cereal tastes fine.  But I realized it has expiration date of April 16, 2010.  Amazon, please don't send expired foods to us.

This has 190mg. of sodium per serving - and thats a smaller serving size than most people would eat. You can actually taste the saltiness in the cereal. This is a warning: A love for good espresso is an expensive habit!!!I've been making my own espresso at home for 20 years. Every morning I would grind the beans, measure and tamp them into the filter, add water, steam my milk, and then wash the entire machine and repeat. I have to wake up early because this is a time consuming process. I've tried other pod machines, and they just don't make a good cup of espresso.I recently began using the illy Francis Francis Y1 with iperEspresso capsules, and the result is better than my manual method, and takes a little over a minute a cup.Generally, I take my cappuccino cup and heat an ounce of milk in the microwave for 30 seconds, use a hand frother for just a few seconds, press the button on the Y1, and in about 20 seconds it brews a 1 or 2 ounce shot of perfect espresso (you have to depress the button when you think it is finished - there is no auto shutoff). Wham, bam, done!As far as I know, the iperEspresso system is the only "pod" that comes close to a real cup of espresso with crema. And this crema is really a thing of beauty. If you don't know what I'm talking about, try it once and you'll understand. As someone who likes strong coffee, the dark roast is almost not strong enough, but the flavor is so well balanced. It's the perfect blend of bitter and sweet with a body worth savoring.This isn't cheap, and it's more wasteful than grinding your own beans. So take that into consideration. But, I've only had espresso this good in Italy. Constant trips to Italy would be very wasteful and expensive, so that's my barely rational justification.I'd also like to share that the Y1 seems to be the most affordable offering in illy's line of iperEspresso systems. It retails for $295, but illy offers a promotion where you can buy the Y1 for $125 when you order a minimum of 2 canisters (21 count) through illy's website (illyusa.com). There are no other requirements to fulfill. So the machine and the coffee adds up to less than the cost of the machine itself. I took advantage of this deal and I couldn't be happier.This coffee will put a new spin on your day. Not to sound too cheesy, but I can't wait to wake up each morning and enjoy my first cup.

They created a perfect method of getting the exact amount of espresso coffee into a machine, with a minimum amount of mess, that consistently produces an excellent pull. The only control that the operator has is the one that they would want, that is the amount of espresso produced.The problem stems from the way the capsules are packaged and delivered. For some reason, Illy chose a cheap-ass can that is pressurized with an inert gas. That causes the lid not to fit right until after the inner seal is pulled. Once you do that, the same lid loosely fits over the now air-exposed capsules. This makes absolutely no sense give that other capsule manufacturers go to great lengths to keep individual capsules sealed until ready for use. Why Illy did not consult with Lavazza on how to accomplish this relatively simple task is beyond me. Then you have the bulky can to dispose of when the capsules are gone.Why the '1'? Just to draw attention to this review. Anyone who has had a cup of espresso made with an iperEspresso machine will be shocked because it is indeed the best espresso possible, a barista can do no better with a $10,000 Gaggia. Maybe Illy will listen and fix the problem.

column9: Among the best Earl Grey tea available
column10: I enjoy a good cup of tea and my absolute favorite is Earl Grey. Twinings Early Grey is among the best on the market, alongside Rishi loose leaf. A traditional English tea, Earl Grey is a black tea whose principle flavor is from the rind of bergamot oranges. Although there are various accounts of its origin, it is most likely was an Indian recipe (China is also a commonly attributed with creating the recipe) which made its way to England in the early 1800s. Named after Lord Grey, the tea is a flavorful black tea that is best served nearly boiling hot with or without lemon. It is NOT served with cream.Twinings is one of the oldest conveyors of Earl Grey and still use the same recipe as they have for well over a hundred years (soon to be two-hundred). Their tea is also endorsed by the 6th Earl Grey and his signature appears on their packaging. Not that this means the tea is superior because of any endorsement; in this case the tea speaks for itself.While I do prefer loose leaf teas, these tea bags provide nearly the same flavor profile as the loose variety and will not disappoint the Earl Grey enthusiast. If you've never tried Twinings, you owe it to yourself to do so. Enjoy!

We used to be able to get it at a local big box store, which unfortunately stopped carrying it.  I like not only the convenience, but the taste.  This does not have any additives like most of the blends, and most significantly does not have salt (which many companies add because it is a preservative and adds cheap bulk!  I like being able to control what I add to recipes, which means adding salt when I want it, and not when I do not!  I use a lot of garlic in my cooking and usually have fresh on hand.  There are times when I actually prefer the dried.  It is a more concentrated flavor, so if you are adding it to a sauce where it will absorb some of the liquid you can get a more intense flavor than you can with the fresh.Then, there is the obvious advantage that it does not spoil as fast.  In fact, I have never had it spoil (and I live in a humid environment where things go off rather quickly).When this disappeared from my local store in bulk I had to buy it in small spice jars *for vastly more than this costs* something on the order of 10- 20x the price!  What you get from Amazon is an enormous amount (given that it is typically sold in 1 oz spice jars) which I suspect would last most people a long long time. I drink hibiscus tea on a regular basis, and have begun adding a splash of lavender syrup to each glass. It is refreshing and so delicious, and is also very good in lemonade. I am a trained aromatherapist and as such, am very familiar with the health benefits associated with lavender. I have included some of them below:Lavender is an excellent nerve tonic that may help treat migraines, headaches, anxiety and nervous tension. It is often used for insomnia in smaller amounts; in larger amounts has been used to increase mental activity. Lavender has been used extensively to treat burns and pain associated with sore muscles and joints. It helps restore hormonal balance and may reduce associated menstrual cramping. Lavender is widely used for respiratory ailments, colds, flu and sinus congestion. Added to a beverage, lavender is soothing for sore throats and laryngitis. Lavender stimulates the production of gastric juices and bile and thus aiding in treatment of indigestion, stomach pain, colic, flatulence, vomiting and diarrhea. Regular use of lavender essential oil is said to provide resistance to disease.UPDATE: Bebop Trading Co. is the absolute WORST vendor I have ever dealt with on Amazon. I placed a re-order with them and was very unhappy. They are playing a little game on here by offering the product at $5 and then charging $10 for the shipping. My advice to them is that if you can't play with the 'big dogs' stay out of the game! Seriously, you could get the product faster by Pony Express. Buy from a reputable company.

I must admit that I love all floral flavors (Violet, Rose, Lavender & Jasmine)so this syrup did not disappoint me.  I have used it mainly in Italian Soda's, because it is so refreshing in the summer, but it's also lovely in tea. It has a beautiful color (it does have a little food color in it) and flavor when used just with soda/seltzer water, or as an unusual ice cream topping for a plain vanilla.  I am going to experiment with it some more in my dessert recipes(& I am also going to buy the rose & violet flavors as well). I feel the aroma is sufficiently lavender and while the flavor is sweet (because of added sugar), it is clearly marked a SYRUP, not just an essence, so be careful when ordering if you require the flavor for a certain recipe.

I can't compare this flavor to other lavender like products, but what I can tell you is that it tastes exactly like Lavender smells. It is great with champaign, or in a vodka lemon drink to add some spice and give it an exotic feeling.
This syrup is hard to find in shops, so i was excited to find on Amazon. I love my lavender martinis, and urge you to look up a recipe..this syrup is perfect for them! =)

This product has to be one of the best lavender products out there. It is wonderful over ice cream, as a cool, refreshing drink in summer, and as an additive to anything you may like with a lavender taste.

This is a great product. I love lavender white mochas, but the cafe I go to that used to make them quit carrying the syrup. All I have to do now is add a couple pumps of this syrup to a plain white mocha, and I get exactly what I want. Best of all, I can adjust the amount of lavender flavor I want.  I also plan to use this in some cakes during this upcoming holiday season.Some more details: It is about the same consistency as other syrups you can buy to add to coffee. It is definitely on the thin side--don't expect it to be like pancake syrup; the consistency is more like real maple syrup. I bought the pump to go along with it since I knew I would want it eventually, and the shipping was cheaper if I went ahead and got the pump with the syrup. I don't know if other pumps would fit on the bottle, but the Monin brand one fits perfectly. It will make the height of the bottle much taller; I keep mine on my wine bar, which doesn't have a top. It wouldn't fit easily inside a standard cabinet. But if you like lavender, it's worth finding a place for it in your kitchen!

column9: Soothing and sweet with no fuss
column10: Tried this after attending a lavender festival where iced tea was being brewed with lavender seeds/flowers and then sweetened with honey. It tasted so wonderful that I decided to make it for myself.  After three attempts at brewing, I was ready to give up; process was tedious, results were wildly variable, and it took a fair amount of time. Decided to Google for an actual standardized recipe and came across this syrup. Put simply, a great idea! Time saving, uniform sweet flavor, and much less fuss. So far I've tried this in iced black, green, and white teas, all the aformentioned as hot tea, lemonade, and over lemon sherbert in a tuile as a dessert at a dinner party (everybody loved it). Great product!

I bought this to make Bubble Tea after having a lavender green milk tea at a local Asian restaurant. It smells amazing. It isn't as thick as I was expecting, and I like it better this way. It is more like the consistency of maple syrup. Again, it isn't thick. A little goes a long way, too, it seems. It is very aromatic and the experiece of the lavender hitting my tastebuds and zipping through my nose takes my mind offline for a moment. It's just peace. I will definitely be buying more and probably trying the rose flavour. Worth every penny, I promise.

column9: I love both this company and their products!
column10: Everything Monin by Sweetsaurus is done well and with thoughts for the consumer. Their packaging is delightful and a gift in itself. This syrup is wonderful in fruit aids, cold and hot teas and over ice chips and ice cream.I find the flavor to be perfect and exactly what  I remember from trips to Paris. I highly recommend Monin products

I went on a trip to the beach and found Lavendar Lemonade on a restaurant's menu.  I had to try it.  I took the first sip, and was instantly hooked.  As soon as I got home from my trip, I ordered one bottle of the Monin Lavender syrup for my parents, and one for me.  The flavor of the syrup is excellent and tastes just like lavender.  It's sweet and pairs brilliantly with lemonade, although, there's many other uses.  I am definately going to keep this stocked at my house!
I haven't tried this with actual cooking yet, but it's absolutely amazing in lemonade. Makes a really good lavender Margarita as well.
Only the best from Monin ! The lavender was perfect for my drinks and Monin always delivers quality products ! Very happy and will buy again.
Very good service.  Super packing job!!!  I highly recommend ordering from this company!

Nothing wrong with the product - I have bought this many times before.  However... it wasn't really clear that the Liquid Nation description of a Double Pack really means 1 bulk bag per the photo.  So for over $50 including shipping you get 32 cups of coffee.  Now that's expensive whichever way you look at it.Shop around and you will find bulk packs of 80 cups for only $2-3 more including shipping.  Shame on me for getting ripped off, I won't be using Liquid Nation ever again.
These prices are a rip-off I order directly  from Tassimo get free shipping and the coffee is half the price

I simply cannot believe these prices.  It is shocking! Tassimo is incredibly expensive to begin with, but with this company's mark up, it is actually CHEAPER to drive to a Starbucks and buy an expensive Latte, then make it yourself!

I had ordered a specific item but was sent something different without being consulted prior to it being sent. I ended up having to pay double what I had initially paid to return it. When I contacted this seller to try to remedy it, I was basically ignored after a couple of back and forth emails. Very unprofessional business practices. It is my opinion they are not trustworthy.I didn't want to write this but feel I now have no other option as they clearly don't care about their customers.

This may be the worst soy sauce in the world, which is amazing because it is expensive, looks great in the bottle, and comes from one of the most highly regarded soy sauce producers in Japan.  This is nothing but dark salt water.  It's too salty to use on food.  It's too salty to use in cooking.  It's a great way to destroy any dish.  Pity I have three large bottles ... I don't need soy-flavored mouth wash and I can't think of anything else to do with it.  Down the drain they go.  Don't confuse with Kikkoman Marudaizu soy, which is extraordinary.

column9: it matters not to me that this is corn and gluten-free...It's simply my favorite tasting chip!
column10: For me, these are addictive.I HATE rice chips so don't think for a minute they have that taste or texture. These are made of only good stuff, nothing artificial, and are so light and crispy...just barely a hint of bean but full of fiber and protein and things you never get in a chip. They are cooked in a healthy oil full of monounsaturated fat and sprinkled with sea salt.The flavor is so light it doesn't matter what you pair them with.  But, unlike regular tortilla chips, I love these straight up plain with no dipping sauce. The taste is that good to me.  They don't taste like a healthy or alternative chip yet you get quite a bit for little calories, a great amount of protein and fiber and the healthy fat.they are also high in potassium and cholesterol free.  Better yet since, unlike most chips, these are high in protein, it's a snack that fills you up and keeps you thereThey are low glycemic so there is no sugar or carb crash and blood sugar spike with hunger soon after eating, they are corn free for those with corn allergies and gluten-free for those with wheat allergies as well.rock on, Beanitos.

column9: Delicious and healthier alternative to other fried chips.
column10: Since these are fried in oil, they are by no means a health food, especially if you are focused on calories.  That said though, they are an excellent snack and a much healthier alternative to potato chips or corn chips.The main thing that surprised me about these chips is how good they taste.  To me, they taste just as good, and are just as fulfilling, as the other salty crunchy snacks that I tend to munch on in the evenings.  I enjoy them plain out of the bag, and also find that they are good with salsa or dip.I wish the price was a little lower on these, but otherwise I think they are great.  I highly recommend that you try them.

column9: Good and Better For You Than Most
column10: The taste is good to me. They don't taste like a healthy or alternative chip yet you get quite a bit for little calories, a great amount of protein and fiber and the healthy fat.

column9: Beanitos is the answer for a corn free chip!
column10: Just tried (and finished) my 1st bag of Beanitos Black Bean and Flax chips and they are really FAB!!!  So glad to have a good tasting, nutritional chip to have with salsa; I am to avoid all corn products and that can really be difficult!  A great find:)

We love the black bean beanitos!  They taste great, and also have fiber in them.  If you like black beans, you will soon become addicted to these!  (We didn't like the pinto bean ones as they had too much omega in them and tasted like fish oil)
I bought these on the advice of Dr. Oz.  I'm always looking for a healthy snack.  Unfortunately, in my opinion they taste like burnt potato chips.  I will not be purchasing these chips again.

This is one of my favorite Thai snacks.  It is light, chrispy, low in fat and great wasabi flavor.  Goes great with adult beverages!  Seller also has fast delivery.  Try this at a party and be surprised how good they are.  Wonderful alternative to potato chips.

This is NOT super hot pepper paste. It's more sweet than hot but it's got a tiny bite to it and a lovely zing.This is a fermented pepper paste and it is so addictive!This does not have MSG but it does have [wheat derived] glucose.Fermented foods take food to another notch and not only do they taste better but they are highly digestible and actually help regulate your gut flora (I know that sounds gross in print).This IS a product of Korea.Anyway, this pepper paste coupled with the Korean soybean paste is manna from heaven!Ingredients in this Yummy Gochujang:Red Pepper PowderWheat Flour Starch SyrupLiquefied Glucose

I always buy the Sempio Gochujang because the taste and scent is just like the one my grandmother used to make a long time ago in Korea. The taste isn't too sweet like many other brands. When I make my husband's food I have to watch the amount of carbs in his﻿ food. Sempio's brand has less carbs for each tablespoon, which means more sauce for his Bibimbap! BTW, Is it bad that I sometimes just take a spoonful and eat it when I get homesick for Korea?
This gochujang is the best so far that i have tried. It has its own unique flavor. Also it isn't just spicy and hot, but it also has sweetness! I love it! Totally recommend it!
This product is delicious. It is easy to use with just enough heat to give a bit of a kick without overpowering the flavor of the dish. Excellent for making all sorts of sauces!

column9: How to save/use 6.6 lbs of Gochujang?
column10: I have not tried this product, yet, but I love Gochujang in Bibimbop.. My only issue so far is that it arrived in a single 6.6 lb container. I was expecting several smaller containers. This is a year+ supply of Gochujang for me. Does anyone have a recommendation for saving it? Can I freeze it? Short of that, can you send me some recipes?
This Gochujang is hot and tasty. If you are not a spicy lover or you can not eat spicy stuff I would not recommend this. Otherwise I would recommend this hot pepper paste.
Huge !!! Great !!! I am loving it !!! Very Hot !!! Sweet !!! 5 Stars for this one !!!

I am venturing into the world of Korean cooking, and Gochujang is a common ingredient in marinades, soups, and stews.  I like my food pretty spicy, so I have to consider who will be eating my food, and adjust amounts accordingly.  At any rate, I would be hardput to find a value comparable to this one at any local Asian grocer.
I live in a different country and the Gochujang got here in safe!and the taste of this Gochujang is awesome!!! I love it and will use this comapamy again! Thank you!!!
Very hot, but smooth, great consistancy, for use with most Korean cusine. Just a dab will do, you don't want too much. This items is tasty, but extremely hot. Great side with most Korean dishes

column9: Nice item - Took far too long to get to me!
column10: Item was one of many purchased for a special fruitcake recipe.  Ordered 1/2/12 - was one of five (in total) items not stocked by Amazon - was assured it'd be shipped within a week to ten days.  Fine.1/22/12 - Amazon sends me a note.. "Barry Farm Foods has not confirmed the shipment" .. order will be canceled.  Do I wish to reorder?1/23/12 - The following day.. another message.. from Amazon.. items have been shipped.  (?)  Claims I should see items by 1/24/12  Well.. Okay..Took until 1/28/12 until the items showed up.  Order was complete - in that these were the items shipped directly from supplier to fulfill the original order.  Shipping charge for that single box was over $11.00.. (for a $22 order of 5 items) for something akin to 3 weeks from order to delivery.Pleased?  Well.. I did finally get the back-ordered items.  I didn't get them in what I consider to be a "timely" fashion.  Communications evidently broke down 'tween Amazon & Barry Farms, as demonstrated by the conflicting emails.  I think that given the long time frame, I way overpaid for so called "shipping" charges.Have had to completely readjust schedule for this special commemorative fruit cake.. it's baked now, turned out well.. is in the "aging" mood now.So.. you asked for this review.. this is it!  I was originally a bit distressed that part of my order would have to come directly from Barry Farms.. but was willing to accept a reasonable wait.  The delays and conflicting emails caused some consternation.  When the items did finally arrive, I was pleased just to have them.  The shipping charges seemed excessive, considering all the time the order took to get to me.  But, I've used the products now, and am really looking forward to sampling the end result.. which will not have the ideal time to age, but should still prove worth all of the hassle.  Peace  -Gerry

column9: Superb Variety of Biscuits in Different Shapes and Textures Perfect for Picnics
column10: The best news about the availability of Carr's Assorted Biscuits for Cheese on Amazon is that they were delivered to me without damage. I have been a fan of their crackers for years, and the nine types available in this selection do not disappoint. The types are the square Cream Cracker, the thick and circular Digestive, the light Small Table Water, the cookie-like Small Wheatmeal, the heavily textured Oyster Cracker, the large Cornish Wafer, the Oblong Water, the small disc-like Bran Carlton and the traditional Choice Grain.There isn't a loser in the bunch and you get several of each kind. There are even helpful pictures of recommended toppings on the box, though if you're lazy like me, you'll get a good wedge of brie and smear it on all of them. They are not the most nutritional of appetizers as the recommended portion of three crackers has 80 calories, of which 25 are fat, and 95 mg of sodium. But luckily the individual boxes are relatively small, so binging can be appropriately curbed. They are perfect for a picnic setting where you don't want to fumble around with noisy chips.

I have to say that I really like this product. Inside your box you will find a nine different biscuits, or crackers as I would call them.  I popped one in my mouth when I first opened the box without anything on it and they were fresh and delicious. Although it says, 'for cheese,' don't feel you can't put other things on them.  Grab some ham, or have them with your favorite soup.  These are some nice biscuits that you will find many uses for and you will enjoy eating.  I recommend this product.  Very good.

Carr's states on the box that these biscuits are "The Perfect Complement to Cheese," but of course, they're good for so much more...from peanut butter and jelly on the Bran Carlton biscuit, to caviar on the Small Table Water biscuit! The box also has some nice cheese serving suggestions, like cucumber slice, sour cream, and shrimp on the Oyster Cracker.My favorite is the Digestive biscuit, because I really like the wheatmeal texture and flavor, and also because it reminds me of my English Mum. It was always traditional in her day to wake up to a hot cup of tea and a digestive biscuit, and it certainly is a delightful way to start the day.Carr's Biscuits are the real deal, made in England, and with no "funny stuff" like EDTA in them. Get a couple of boxes of Carr's Assorted Biscuits for Cheese, some Cheshire, Stilton and Cheddar cheeses, warm up some beer, and make your next party an English pub party!

column9: If you enjoy a variety of wonderful cheeses these especially nice biscuits (crackers) make an ideal accompaniment
column10: If you aren't sure why these crackers are called biscuits, just feel comfortable that biscuits are what the English refer to when American's refer to crackers.  Carr's is an excellent maker of various biscuits for all kinds of serving purposes.  This collection has 9 types of crackers with 3 to 5 of each kind.  This selection says they are for cheese, and they are perfect for that purpose.  The box provides a variety of serving selections.What I enjoy about Carr's is that its products have a wonderful flavor, but each flavor complements the food it accompanies rather than overpowering the food.  The cracker is the foundation rather than the star of the creation being enjoyed.This offering has a dozen boxes of this selection being offered for the price.

column9: Yes, will buy Carrs Biscuits again!
column10: This was really awesome and the price I think was a good deal! Geat to snack on or eat it with tuna salad or ground meat and have a great lunch also!

I'm writing this review on behalf of my husband who grew up with Carr's.  This is his favorite selection because all the different crackers in it are good.The only drawback was that the first box we opened was mostly smashed up.  I guess this isn't surprising, since the crackers are made in the UK, shipped to the US, sent to the stores, then sent to us - but it was a fairly serious consideration.  Amazon made good, of course.  We have enough crackers to last until 2010 at this rate, and if there are any more smashed boxes, the local birds will eat well.

There's good variety in this package of crackers (U.S. terminology vs. English biscuits) & suggestions for using them for different hors d'oeuvres--despite the title of "biscuits for cheese."  Some are thin & crunchy (e.g. "oblong water" & "small table water") while others are thicker, more crumbly & with more flavor (e.g. "digestive", "small wheatmeal").  The "oyster cracker" is not the more-or-less spherical U.S. type at all.  I wasn't too thrilled with it (or the "choice grain") either.  I liked the assortment overall though.  I used a tapenade on them of chunky eggplant & olives.  The crackers held up well.  The "water ones" were great, the digestive etc. were a bit thick & flavorful for the topping.  As for health, there isn't much nutritional value; on the other hand not overly full of sugar, salt, or fat.  But, then at your party with the alcohol flowing & these as hors d'oeuvres you're probably not thinking health.

column9: Like drinking a Jolly Rancher green apple candy
column10: This product is super sweet! It really does taste like a jolly rancher green apple candy. Now, I drank it straight without the alcohol because I no longer drink liquor but still - it is super sweet. I'm going to try mixing it with a crystal light pink lemonade packet and see it that cuts the sticky sweetness a bit. Plus, there is just no getting around that citric acid "kool-aid" taste. It's still there.
I bought this to mix a low-calorie, adult drink, and I have to say--it has exceeded my expectations! So delicious over ice.

column9: Great Halloween Drink! Wow! Tart and Sweet!!
column10: This review is of the Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini, 1.69-Ounce Pack of 4: this flourescent green drink has the tartness that you would expect of an apple drink, although I did need to dilute it a bit to pull back on it's highly saturated flavor. That done, it is the perfect blend of tart and sweet. Did I mention the COLOR?? It is a bright, flourescent green, not unlike the color of those adorable VW beetles. My children say it looks like "ghost green," or rather like the green mist out of a Scooby Doo episode. It's such fun that we are serving it in a frozen slushie on Halloween as "ghost goo!"

Been trying to get away from soda the past couple of months and was looking for something to "liven up" my water, so I decided to order a couple of these.  This product did just that: a great taste with very little calories.
This tastes like the appletini mix without the alcohol. I like the lemonade better or the peach. Will try to mix and update

column9: Not too bad. Just a little on the sweet side.
column10: Even though I'm a guy, I still like most of the Crystal Light drink mixes. I've been using the single packets with bottled water for a couple of years. Its cheaper than soda pop and better than Kool-Aid. This one isn't too bad. Just a little sweet and has a different flavor with a bit of green apple to it and a little tart. It's a weird neon green color that kinda surprised me when I first mixed it up. About the only thing I can say against it is it has a odd, almost saccharin after taste. Some of you might not remember that artificial sweetener since they stopped using it a long time ago. But it had a taste that's hard to forget.  Overall, I like this one. Its a good thirst quencher, but that after taste takes a little getting used too. So if I see this in the store I'll probably buy some more of it. If you like something that's just a little on the sweet side and a little tart, you will probably like this one too.  On the plus side its pretty good with a little Spiced Rum in it too! The Rum takes out that almost saccharin sweet after taste. It might go good with a little sparkling water or a little Ginger Ale too.

This is definitely my favorite new Crystal Light flavor!  I am not a big drinker, but I like the appletini taste -- so I'm thrilled to have it in not only a non-alcoholic version, but a non-caloric version as well!  I am on Weight Watchers...it's always nice to find a fun new healthy treat or beverage.  I drink this at all times -- I just can't stand to wait for a 'special occasion' to have my Mocktail.  :-  Highly recommend, if you like that tart, green apple kind of flavor.

column4: Megan Bostic "I am Creative Chaos. I may have...
column10: This really tastes like an appletini, so if you like those, you'll love this.Some of the Crystal Light flavors taste kind of watered down, or too sweet, but this one is just right.  It's flavorful without being too sweet.Plus, it's Crystal Light, so it's low cal and low carb if that's the kind of drink you're looking for.I would definitely buy this product again.

column9: Delicious addition to the cocktail party
column10: I'm a fan of regular Appletinis so tried this mocktail mixture with a little Vodka at a game party last weekend. Passing the mixed drink around, everyone commented on how delicious it was and actually masked the taste of the Vodka.All in all, Crystal Light has taken away a great deal of my guilt for enjoying a tasty cocktail :)

column9: Wife says they taste close to the real thing.
column10: I picked this up for my wife who enjoys the taste of Appletinis.  She said that it tastes close to the real drink and that she enjoys it.  Her one complaint was that the packets are sized to make 2 quarts and that she's the only one in the house who likes Appletinis.  She would prefer smaller packages similar to other Crystal Light flavors.

column9: Tastes like sour apple Jolly Rangers, you can also use it in cocktails
column10: If you like sour apple Jolly Rangers and want to drink a beverage flavored as such, then this mix is for you.  The drink's aftertaste took me a little getting used too, but after I drank a couple glasses, I got used to it.  I don't normally drink low calorie drinks, except soda.  Another boon to this product is that you can mix it as a real cocktail.  The key to it is using a little of the powder and blending with a tiny bit of water, then adding vodka and ice to it.  It still has an aftertaste to get used to, but I prefer it over the regular sugary Sour Apple Pucker or other mixers.  It just takes some time to figure out the ratio of powder to water in order for the finished cocktail not to taste watered down.  If you mix a full 2 quart pitcher and then add vodka, it does taste watered down, so a much more concentrated amount is needed.But the drink without it tastes pretty good.  I find it cooling on a hot day.  It would be good for people who have to avoid alcohol, since it does make a decant mocktail.

This was so much better than I expected it to be.  It really tastes fantastic.  I love the nice tart apple taste.  It was so refreshing.  I made mine really cold with lots of ice and it was delicious.  This is my favorite of the three varieties available and I will definitely buy more.  It's such a nice change from all of the bland drinks available and I'm so happy the folks at Crystal Light got creative.  Yummy!

Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini tastes greatIt's like drinking a Jones Soda Green Apple but without all the carbonation or calories.my only issue is that they use Aspartame. with all the dangers that come with it, it'd be nice if they use stevia instead.Other than that, if you're looking for a great apple tasting diet beverage, this is pretty good.

column4: Nathan M. Rose "Movie Guy from FlickDirect"
column9: Great for parties or by yourself!
column10: This Crystal Light flavor is delicious! I always loved Crystal Light Lemonade, especially the pink, but this may replace it!  The yummy apple flavor is a nice swicth up and really refrashing. Plus, it's always better than drinking soda.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column9: Good, but a little overly tart for me
column10: I feel a little bit guilty giving this 3 stars considering that I've never had a true appletini made by a real bartender, so I've nothing to compare it to taste-wise. However, I can't justify giving it a higher rating because I just didn't enjoy it as much as I wanted to.Taste-wise this wasn't bad. It's very much on the tart side, which I usually like in my drinks and there's a decent flavor here. At times the drink just seemed a little too tart and I can see where people who don't like very sour things wouldn't really be as into this drink. People who are comparing it to a Jolly Rancher are pretty much spot on. I kept thinking that it reminded me of something and when I saw that others thought it reminded them of this candy, I couldn't help but think "that's it exactly!"This just seemed a little too artificial at times for my taste, too much like a packet of grown-up Kool-Aid. This might be what this drink essentially is, but Crystal Light is pretty great at making instant drinks so I did have some pretty high expectations going into this. I'll probably still end up checking out the other flavors and this is still a pretty decent drink overall. I think if I were to add something to it or dilute the drink a little more then maybe it'd be a little better for me.Overall this was a decent enough drink but I'd hesitate to make it a staple of my household beverage drinking.

I'm on the wagon this holiday season but I do like a good cocktail. Enter Crystal Light's Mocktail Appletini! I must say I wasn't prepared for the refreshing taste of this drink and the score of five calories per serving is an extra bonus. How do they fit something so appley, sweet and zingy into just five cals?I would describe it as liquid apple green synthetic nectar in a glass. Yum!

column9: Enjoy an Appletini with 95% less calories!
column10: Several of my friends have recently begun buying these low calorie flavored drinks you see in most grocery and convenience stores now. Cascade Ice is one brand that produces several based off of common drinks like, Lemon Drop, Pina Colada and Cosmopolitan.  They then mix them with their favorite spirit and have a low calorie drink. They're good because they're pre-made and portable, but you are paying a premium for that.  Either way although I've never been fond of these types of drinks, I was willing to give Crystal Light Moctails Appletini a shot.  One thing I can say I immediately liked was the ease of making the drink, it would be great for when my girlfriends come over. Additionally because the individual packets are so small, it would be just as easy to take some to a friends house to make.  As for the taste, it was pretty good. It definitely wasn't as tasty as an actual Appletini, but I wasn't expecting that.  After my initial taste I did add a shot of vodka into my drink and that made it even better in my opinion. I was curious as to how many calories are being saved off your standard Appletini and what I found was that the original is about 170 calories vs. the Crystal Light at just about 5 calories! Overall I believe that Crystal Light has done a good job of providing a pseudo Appletini and I could see myself buying additional flavors to try out.

column9: A Little Too Strong in Taste, But Not Bad in Moderation
column10: This has a very strong Apple Jolly Rancher taste which is not bad in moderation. It's not something I would want to drink often.  It's a break from the usual Crystal Light flavors.  The price seems a little high (though when you do the math it works out to less than 14 cents per serving.  I have not seen these in the store so I don't know if Amazon's price is comparable.If you don't mind feeling like you are drinking a large liquid apple Jolly Rancher then this might be a nice change of pace for you. Especially if you like Appletini's.

I got both the appletini and mojito mix from amazon vine.  While I enjoyed them both, I found the mojito mix more refreshing than the appletini.  Appletini was very sweet and tasted like a combination of apple and lemon lime kool aid.  I do enjoy these prodcuts.  It is easy to mix up and provides a great drink.  The packages are simple to open and the container could be reused for storage.  Overall I would recommend this for anyone who is looking for a sweet treat.

One of the apprehensions that I have had in the past about buying Crystal Light has been the aftertaste that isn't always pleasant that accompanies sugar substitutes. I must say that the new Crystal Light Mocktails have changed my perspective. The drink was delicious, there was no aftertaste and what's not to love about it only being 5 calories! Each packet makes a huge container that last for days. This is definitely a healthy drink that I have already begun to reccomend!

column9: It's ok at first, but not so good later...
column10: First of all, this flavor smells great.  But who drinks anything just for smell alone?  The first few sips are not bad.. it does remind me of an Appletini, however, if you keep drinking - well, let's just say it might turn your stomach a little.  The artificial sweetener aftertaste in this flavor is a lot stronger than what is found in the other flavors of Crystal Light.  I just don't think I could honestly sit and drink a whole glass of this particular flavor.  Great try - and I wanted so badly to rate it a 3 out of 5, but because I would not drink a whole glass at a time, I couldn't see myself doing so.  Sorry - go back to the drawing board on this one.

column9: Looks like antifreeze, tastes like Jolly Ranchers!
column10: This must be the most odd instant drink I've tasted.  Mixed by itself-(I didn't add alcohol) it tastes just like green apple Jolly Ranchers.  The color is an intense shade of green, but pretty.  I can see this as flavored ice cubes, or a mixer (VODKA!..lol) but I don't think I'll be drinking it plain.  I think I was expective more of an apple juice type drink....which it isn't.
Love - LOVE this! Drink plain pour your favorite vodka in it doesn't matter tastes delicious. Be careful of putting booze in it as you may have more than you think you are!

column9: Nice alternative...just sweet enough and just tart enough for me
column10: I really liked this flavor, apart from the bright color which seemed unnecessary.  It's a nice crisp green apple flavor that I enjoyed as an alternative to the standard flavors that are available. I thought the sweetness was just right as well as the tartness.  Didn't try it as a try martini with a shot of vodka, but could see it as a fun, low calorie cocktail.

column9: If you love green apple this is the liquid equivalent!
column10: I really enjoyed the taste of the Crystal Light Appletini Mocktail.  It is a low-calorie solution for someone who does not want to partake in the soda route.  I have always been a fan of green apple Jolly Rancher's and this is its liquid equivalent.  The name Appletini had me prepared for a "tang", slightly tart taste in the drink.  It was not as tart as I expected it to be.  It was actually quite sweet (almost too sweet).  Overall I would recommend this as a purchase and will definitely buy it again.

column9: Impossible to Believe This is So Low in Calories!
column10: I've never been a fan of regular Crystal Light, so I was very surprised to find that new product was so good !  Perfect for those who want a very low calorie "virgin" cocktail or a real one.I'm on a very low calorie, fat free, and sugar free eating plan at the moment, so having a yummy, naughty treat is more important than ever. And this one is perfect.  I haven't tried the other flavors, so I can't comment on those but this one is definitely worth buying!This product is highly recommended for dieters, diabetes, and sugar-conscious individuals.

I love the Crystal light products.  I think they are a tasty way to stay hydrated.  The mocktail appletini is a very new and different flavor.  It really does taste like an appletini!  It's has a great apple flavor as you drink, with sort of a sour apple finish.  I think this would be especially fun for parties- especially baby showers or others where you want something fun, different, and refreshing without the alcohol.

If you are wondering what this tastes like, it tastes 100% just like Jolly Rancher sour apple candy, only in a drink version.  For better or worse, the flavor is good but artificial.  It is somewhat refreshing, but I think about 6 ounces (about a juice glass) is the right amount.  I think if I drank a whole lot at once, I would get sick of it.Each package contains 5 packets which each make 2 quarts -- which is 2-1/2 gallons which is a lot.  4 packs = 10 gallons or about two dollars or so per gallon -- rather inexpensive.It is utterly simple to make.  The top of the packet easily tears off, and it is long and skinny to easily pour into any 1/2 gallon jar, bottle, etc.  It dissolves fairly rapidly.  Also, the plastic shrink-wrap easily removes/falls off, so you can reuse the oval container for whatever you want.

column9: I like it, but I can't make it sound good
column10: It tastes like green-apple-flavored candy, plus a bit of a slightly zingy aftertaste from the fake sugar and possibly whatever is supposed to be the "tini" part of the appletini flavor.That doesn't sound especially great, but I really like it.  It's good from washing salty or greasy flavors out of my mouth after lunch.  I can make it a little more dilute when I feel like chugging, or I can make it more intense for sipping.I have not been able to get anyone else to drink this stuff.  Both the concept and the color repels them.  So this will be another of those things I become famous for consuming at the office, much like my Orange Jols and Nile Spice lentil soup.

Nice sour apple flavor, full bodied taste with a crisp apple flavor.  Even the bright green color of this drink is cool.  This Crystal Light Mocktail has good sweetness but is not overpowering.  I've never tried a real Appletini, so I can't say if this is similar to the real thing, but this Mocktail is a very tasty diet drink.  The Appletini tastes better a day after mixing it (maybe the mix and apple flavors become better absorbed into the water after a little time).  A  nice drink to have in the refridgerator pitcher.  I finished an entire 8 serving packet in a day, but who cares? There's only five calories per serving! You can't ask for more than that from a diet drink in my opinion.

Crystal Light flavors are pretty much hit and miss with me so I was skeptical about this one.  I was almost convinced I would hate it.  For some reason a fake low cal "appletini" just didn't sound appetizing at all.  To my surprise this product is actually delicious!  It tastes like a lighter, crisper, slightly tarter apple juice.  Its very refreshing and you'll get a nice apple flavor without being too heavy or artificial tasting. It tastes a lot like one of my all time favorite low cal beverages, SoBee Life Water's Fugi Apple Pear drink.  I would definitely recommend this product!  Yumm!

This is a tad better to me than the Mojito flavor. It's final mix is a translucent green. It's not too sweet but doesn't have that totally artificial-tasting twang to it either. I would definitely buy on my own.

column9: So good even old folks like it!
column10: My 81 year old parents even love this drink--it's got a refreshing fairly natural apple taste and doesn't stain anything it spills on--good for drinkers of all ages. It should appeal to kids, of course, but a fruity drink that appeals to grownups--a keeper!

I drink Crystal Light Lemonade all the time and love it. This Appletini flavor is sweet but lacks any hint of crispness or tartness. I have never had an Appletini but I have had apple flavored hard candies. Because it really has a fake apple flavor, it isn't really refreshing. I'll stick with lemonade. This is not a flavor I would want to buy again. Also imparts a strange aftertaste that I don't notice with the lemonade flavors (pink or yellow).

Being a fan of both appletinis and Crystal Light, I wanted to give this a try.  It really does taste almost exactly like an appletini.  I'm half-tempted to add some vodka to this.  While it's not my favorite Crystal Light flavor (I like all the lemonade variations best), I'll definitely add this one to the ones I buy repeatedly.

Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini, 1.69-Ounce (Pack of 4)If you like Crystal Light drink mixes this is going to be up your alley. It is a unique flavor and tastes good. It does remind me of an apple martini (minus the booze) and is a refreshing treat. Given the artificial sweetener it does have a slight artificial taste but I drink a lot of diet drinks and am quite used to it. Nothing bad with that, it's the price you pay for wanting a very low to no calorie drink that isn't just water.I did try adding vodka to make a real cocktail but it kinda waters down the flavor too much. Making a batch with about a third less water, helped a lot with making a low calorie cocktail that also tasted good. Almost as good as in the bar, but with a lot less calories. Overall, an enjoyable low calorie drink mix that has real cocktail potential.

Crystal Light's new Mocktails Appletini tastes sweet despite the fact that it doesn't include the carb-packing sugar that makes most similar drinks taste so great.  At only five calories per serving, I have no problem guzzling this stuff down.  It's like drinking a liquid Jolly Rancher Sour Apple candy.I was very surprised at how really sweet this drink tastes.  I couldn't tell that there was no sugar in the mix.  Each packet in the container makes two quarts of Mocktail Appletini, and it's very, very simple to make.  All you do is add cold water to the mix and stir.  That's it!Crystal Light has come a long way since I remember tasting their products many, many years ago.  These Mocktails taste like legitimate sugary drinks and not like a diet drink at all.I highly recommend Crystal Light's Mocktails Appletini to anyone who want a low-calorie, sugary sweet drink!

Even as an adult I like that sour-sweet taste tingle of Jolly Ranchers.  And that's what this mocktail reminds me of--green apples.  That crispy, crunchy green apple taste is there.Food scientists tell us that we first 'taste' with our eyes.  Then our noses.  The actual taste buds are the last to savor food and drink.  The color of this mocktail is a very vivid green.  While not off-putting, it does not enhance the drink for me.  A calmer green would be just fine; after all, these are intended for adults, not kids.  Sniffing my glass prior to taking a sip, I anticipated the aroma of fresh, green apples.  The whiff I got was more of a chemical version of what apples should smell like; not at all fresh and natural.  However, once past my eyes and nose, I enjoyed the green apple flavor.  Since taste buds and odors are uniquely singular to each of us, I can only report to you my experience and not what you may decide about this product.Here are some ways I can see serving the mocktail:1.  Try mixing this drink with vodka and club soda, serving it very icy cold.  If you're having a party, it certainly would keep down the costs of packaged drink mixes.2.  Mix the drink with either water or milk and make popsicles.3.  Add ginger ale instead of water.I like Crystal Light's lemonade and iced tea flavors more than this one.  It's always good to give something new a try and that's what I suggest you do.

column9: Taste Better after you add VODKA
column10: Like many things you can drink, the addition of alcohol is all the difference.  These "mocktails" are just another 'virgin' style of drink which makes you wonder why bother.  In a real appletini, over fifty percent of the drink should be vodka or gin, without them all you get is a taste that reminded me of a granny smith apple.  While that's all well and good, it's not something I'd want to drink.  I found that the addition of alcohol made it much more palatable but then that defeats the whole idea of a "mocktail".  So at least for this reviewer I'll stick to real 'martinis' and when I want something non- alcoholic, I'll drink Ice-Tea.Zeb Kantrowitz

Crystal Light is a brand I have mixed feelings about.  I do like that their drinks are so low in calories, but they seem to contain more Aspartame and coloring than anything else I've tried.  My mouth is actually coated with red food dye for hours after drinking some flavors, and the Aspartame, which I normally enjoy in sodas, is really pronounced.  With that in mind, I didn't expect much from this Appletini flavor.The first flavor that struck me when I drank my lovely green mocktail was a surprisingly refreshing apple.  This is the best fake apple I've had.  What followed was the typical Crystal Light artificial aftertaste, but not as bad as in other flavors.  The green color also didn't stick in my mouth much.While I can't fully recommend this product, as far as Crystal Light goes, this is easily my favorite flavor.

My first thought when I saw this product was not positive...I thought...eww, a liquor flavored bevarge? Then I remembered that I've used regular crystal light a few times mixed with rum or vodka for a super low cal martini.So I had to try it.First, I made it with water only. If you are someone who loves the taste of apple, or has given up liquor or hate it, you'd still like this. It is NOT liquor flavored like a martini. It merely tastes like a sweet, crisp apple. I could drink this happily during a workout with just water. No liquor flavor to it yet the taste you love about an appletini.But I'm a fan of martinis. No lie. Especially appletinis.  So....Let's compare. A regular appletini:Calories in regular appeltini according to Livestrong (what I've found the be the most accurate place to look up calories): 502 caloriesBut, if instead, you make an appletini with this using 1-2 oz of vodka and the Crystal Light mix mixed with water to desired strength you are looking at 64-128 calories. 128 would be for a cocktail made with 2 ounces of vodka (gin is the same calories if you want to sub that.) You can cut it to 1 oz of vodka (totally doable for taste) and have a 64calorie drink rather than the 502 calories in the regular sweetened bev. I mean, 502 calories is more than I eat for DINNER. I sure don't wanna have 2 dinners with one that's liquid!...espeically if I have 2 drinks!Bonus? You are told to drink water with your alcohol to avoid a hangover the next day. Done! and Done!Negative: It is made with aspartame which is Nutrasweet. I personally avoid Nutrasweet almost always. However, I am still somewhat addicted to Diet Coke twice a week so until I crack that craving I don't mind substituting a cocktail that's low calorie and has loads less sugar for one that would totally wreck my calorie count for the day. I'd prefer stevia but in the end I still prefer this to a full-out bad boy appletini.oh, it tastes awesome to me! Fresh and crisp! I actually love this during a workout too (without the vodka...HELLO!) ...if you hate drinking plain water as sweet crisp apple taste will help encourage it!It should be noted, don't make one appletini with this full packet.  One packet makes 2 quarts. There are 40 servings per container. I'm not drinking 2 quarts at any time so if I use this just to flavor water I just sprinkle a little in the water to taste. For a martini, I create the water mixture to taste with a small sprinkle of the packet and add a jigger of vodka...and add in more of the packet and/or water if needed.I wish they made these in one serving or two serving packs.I will purchase this often I think...even beats the calories in a glass of wine and I love this taste with plain water or in a martini.Note: flavored with natural flavors, gluten-free

Crystal Light has entered the market of non-alcoholic mix drinks with a few flavors. This review is for the appletini mix and too me was not my favorite tasting of their new product line yet still flavorful. For a crystal light product this flavor is very well done. As with their other mixes it is not as good as a freshly made real drink but it is a refreshing drink with the green apple favor and a bright green color. An up side is that an eight ounce glass of crystal light has only five calories, The container contains five separate packets that will each make two quarts of the mix with just the addition of water. Note, if you do not like the regular Crystal Light products because of the artificial sweeteners you will rate this lower than I did. If you like green apple flavored hard candy's you may well love this mix.

I like the idea of having a no-alcohol drink with low calories and zero points. The Crystal Light Appletini is like drinking liquid Apple Jolly Ranchers; just delightful. My wife though it was a little sweet (this from a woman who puts multiple Splenda packets in her coffee), but I found it to be just right. This is certainly a big chance from the usual low calorie powder drinks. Can't wait to try the other flavors!

I don't drink alcoholic beverages so I don't know how a true Appletini should taste but since I am on a sugar-free diet I thought a little variety couldn't hurt.
