The first thing I noticed when I mixed up a pitcher of the Appletini Mocktail was the vivid neon green color that only a kid could like. Then I tasted it. As another reviewer stated, my first thought was of a sour apple Jolly Rancher only this was not very sour. In fact, this particular drink is excessively sweet and has a very artificial flavor and aftertaste. This is not something that I would enjoy on a regular basis - in fact I'm not sure I can even finish the first pitcher full.I know that so far this product has received many 5-star reviews but it was a stretch for me to give it two. I simply did not like it. I suggest that you read all the reviews before purchasing and make your own decision on whether this is a product you would enjoy.

I've never had an appletini, so I can't say if this Crystal Light mix tastes like one. However, it does taste like some apple juice that I've had. though, if the juice had had the glowing chlorophyll color of the appletini mix, I don't think I would have tried it.Good taste; alarming color.

I absolutely love the new Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini.  It tastes like apple Kool-Aid to me.  It is green, sweet, and very apple tasting.  There are 5 calories per serving and it comes with 5 packets of Crystal Light in each plastic bottle.  Each packet makes 2 quarts of Crystal Light.  I definitely recommend this yummy apple flavored drink!

column9: A nice low acid sugar free
column10: It's funny... my first though was immediately "Green Apple Jolly Rancher"... which was the conclusion of the most helpful critical review. I don't come with criticism though-- I enjoy it.The flavor is familiar and seems low acid compared to a lot of other packet drink options that are sugar free.  There may be a little more color/dye than I prefer, but it dissoved nicely and adds nice variety to the monotony of the flavors available in mix-yourself drinks.I rated it 4 stars instead of 5 because the flavor name is a little misleading-- I was imaginging this to be something that could easily be made into a mixed drink. If you want a green apple Jolly Rancher, then ok!~ But otherwise, the name might be a little inaccurate in my opinion.Refreshing, different, worth it to me for the variety.

I've tried all of the Cyrstal Light Mocktails, including the margarita and mojito mixes, and this one is another delicious hit (although the margarita is my favorite). I'm not a "mocktail" kind of person and so I added gin to this 2 quart mix and here's the skinny: Adding 8 ounces (1 cup) of gin to the 2 quart mix will make each 8 ounce appletini 70 calories or each 12 ounce serving 105 calories. That's amazing, considering each non Crystal Light version of an appletini is 502 calories (12 ounce serving)!! The taste is very much like apple pucker, but I do like apple pucker, so that was okay with me. If you want to avoid the apple pucker taste, try adding a 4 ounces of apple cider to the mix (only 15 calories per ounce). This will still only make each 8 ounce serving only 78 calories or a 12 ounce serving 124 calories, which is still eons better than the real thing. Anyway, I love all the flavors, and this is another one I'm recommending.

This item sounded really good and like something that I could enjoy while at work.  I was right.  It is really yummy and something that I would consider purchasing again.I didn't know what an Appletini was, as I don't drink very often (had a six-pack of Bud Light in the cupboard for cooking for the past six months), but I know that I really like apple flavored candies and what not, so I took a risk and it is wonderful.The only complaint that I have is I wish that they came in single serving packs instead of the 2 quart one, that way it would be a lot easier to transport to work and back.

This crystal lite is both tart and sweet. Its about time someone made a drink that is  flavored like granny smith apples.  This drink is luscious and only 5 calories per glass.  The grandkids came in for a drink, spied the green drink and hit it hard.  They usually turn their noses up at my diet drinks but they said this was the best stuff they had drank in awhile.  I agree. The first 2 quarts are gone.  Keep up the good work Crystal Light.

column9: Great change of pace for sugar free drinks
column10: Crystal Light's new cocktail based flavors are a welcome addition to the lineup of sugar free drink mixes out there, which traditionally has much fewer options for those who can't have sweet drinks.  Of course the cocktail versions are all rather fruity, with appletini, mojito, and margarita varieties now available.Of the new types available, the appletini variety is easily the most flavorful and packs the most punch.  It essentially tastes like a non-alcoholic version of its namesake, and isn't nearly as light as the mojito edition.And for those wondering, yeah, it's pretty tasty with a splash (or much more) of vodka as well.  For those tired of traditional fruit or iced tea flavors in sugar free drinks, this one is a real winner and a fantastic change of pace.

I'm pretty much apathetic to this flavor, to be honest.  I mean, if presented with water 'enhanced' with Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini, I'd drink it.  If not, I don't feel like I am missing anything special.  I like the idea of the mocktail flavors as an option; however, my big issue is that I get the apple flavor up front and then the artificial sweetener aftertaste, so it nullifies the intent in my opinion.  Try it, don't try it.  I don't have a recommendation either direction.

This was actually really nice. It's the color, taste and aroma of green apple, jolly rancher style. I liked the taste and the color was candy color green perfect.The only thing I would do differently is use one packet to one quart of water. At two quarts the power of the apple taste was really muted. With ice it's more noticeable, but with a 1 to 1 ratio it was a nice little punch of apple and on ice, I thought it was perfect as a drink.So for me it loses a star if you make it according to directions. Other than that, if you like green apple candy, you'll love this.4 stars.

I've tried many low calorie drink mixes as a way to spruce up a glass of water here and there.  Sometimes I just want something with some flavor!  I mixed up a jug of this (instead of by the bottle or glass, this makes two quarts) and popped it in the freezer so it would chill faster.  Everybody passed along the cold jug and poured themselves some and we all liked it!  Outside of the very green color, it has a nice flavor that is a little sweet and a little tart, not too strong but not watery.  I generally prefer products that do not contain aspartame, but I did not feel that there was much aftertaste at all, which was a pleasant surprise.  I do not feel like it tastes very apple-y, but it also isn't overly artificial.  Definitely a new flavor instead of a retread of a common flavor, a nice alternative to the same old drink or plain old water.

column9: Good flavor without the syrupy sweetness
column10: Great taste of real apple without the syrupy sweet candy flavor makes this a great choice.  So many fruit-flavored drinks are more reminiscent of candy than fruit and leave that syrup coating in your mouth that does little to refresh.  Not so with this drink.  Very good and very refreshing drink with the perfect hint of an apple-inspired cocktail.

This is perfect for the person who likes Crystal Light, and also like Appletinis (but dislikes the calories).  It's very similar - perhaps a bit less tangy and a bit sweeter, but it still has that nice apple taste. It also lacks, of course, the alcohol taste. This would also be perfect for the person who like the look and feel of holding a drink (I love the bright green color) but wants to eschew the liquor.I made it a bit stronger than the package recommended because I found it just *slightly* watery, but I usually add extra Chrystal Light no matter what the flavor, so it's probably just me.  I like my drinks strong!I think this is a fun new flavor of Chrystal Light and I hope they keep it around - I'll definitely buy it!*In the interests of full disclosure, I received this product through Amazon Vine*

This is a good drink. It is much lighter than I had assumed after reading some other reviews. It is not too sour. It does kind of leave an after taste, or a dry throat kind of feeling though. I do not think I would purchase these, but for a free sample, it was not bad.

column9: Refreshing Change From the Normal Lo Cal Drinks
column10: This drink mix was intriguing to my taste buds.  I love anything that is apple flavored, especially green apples, which is what the Crystal Light Appletini Mocktail tasted like.  It was a bit on the sour side, but for me that was a plus.  At five calories for a glass, it is also practical for anyone looking to stay on their diet.  The cost was actually reasonable when you look at the price of other sugar-free drinks.  I am already thinking about trying the other flavors in the Mocktail line.  Jim Fargiano, author of: The Spoken Words of Spirit: Lessons From The Other Side

I'd seen an add for these in a magazine recently, but my local grocery store hasn't had them in stock, so I was really glad to get the chance to try the Appletini flavor out.  It's delicious!  While it certainly doesn't taste like the real thing, it's got a nice, light flavor that is different from all the other powdered drink mixes out there.Also, a few reviewers mentioned that it tastes a bit like a Jolly Rancher in its sourness, but I don't think that it's sour at all.I try not to drink more than one glass of Crystal Light a day because I worry about the aspartame in it, which this one also has.Overall, a really tasty drink!  I'm eager to try to mojito one next.

column9: Bright and green and definitely appley
column10: I tried Crystal Light's Margarita drink mix last week, and now I turn to the Appletini, which has a much clearer, more focused and easy-to-define flavor. The taste is a lot like apple cider, but more mellow, not tart. The apple comes through strongly. And as far as being similar to the apple martini drink? Well, only in the nice, strong apple flavor. I don't detect anything else in there. But it's a very pleasant drink.As with the Margarita drink, the color is a neonish green, though brighter in this case.I appreciate the ease of using these mixes. The powder dissolves quickly into a nice, crystal-clear liquid. And it's a flavorful drink without the calories or the caffeine, so I can enjoy it in the evenings after work -- that's a plus.

Can't find any serious negative in this drink mix.  It's sweet but not too sweet.  There's no after taste.  The apple flavor is noticeable but not overpowering.It's a nice cool drink for a hot day.The rating is flexible.  I gave it a 4 but that could range from 3 to 5 depending on the price.  Since prices here are so flexible I can't determine whether it's a good value when you're reading this review.

column9: Most popular drink in my house!
column10: Here's the best description my family came up with --- This is like drinking a sour apple Jolly Rancher! Yummy and went fast! We will definitely buy this regularly.

column9: Relied on my wife for this one...
column10: To be honest, I'm not a big Crystal light fan myself, so I did taste the appletini, but I relied on my wife to give the final call on this one.  She felt, and I agreed that it wasn't quite as sweet as I expected it to be, but that's not a bad thing.  It does have a nice apple tang to it.  It got my wife's approval and therefore mine as well.  If you buy I hope you enjoy and thank you for taking the time to read my review.

Crystal Light flavors are hit or miss for me. This one is a miss. It smells like a Jolly Rancher but its more sweet than flavor. I don't hate it, but I think I will try something different next time. Its really just a sweet, green apple...ish flavor that I am sure will appeal to a taste bud that leans more in that direction than I do.

I love the flavor of apple and enjoy a good appletini.  Crystal Light has come up with a way to echo the flavor of appletini and apple without the alcohol and the calories.  One packet makes two quarts; just pour the packet in the water and stir to dissolve.  I prefer mine over crushed ice.  It's sugar free, low sodium and only has five calories per serving.  The packaging is eye-catching and holds the packets in a sturdy container.  You get five packets per container, which makes ten quarts, so it's very economical.  It tastes great! Not too sweet and not too tart, very crisp and refreshing.

column9: Good flavor, a little on the sweet side
column10: I like this flavor.  Definitely has a nice apple taste to it.  Really does taste like an appletini without the alcohol.  I do think it's just a touch on the sweet side, but I actually dilute my with about 1/3 water and 2/3 mixed beverage and it tastes much better (and goes a lot farther!).  I would recommend this drink, very refreshing and good.P.S. it doesn't really make a good mixer for a real appletini.  The flavor gets covered up by the alcohol (I tried using vodka) and it ends up just becoming a sugary water drink with alcohol.
Tastes fresh, a little tangy with great granny smith apple notes.  Cannot even taste a hint of artificial sweetener, all flavor is apples, tangy lemon and the like.  Would definitely buy.

I can get kind of nostalgic about the days when I was a kid, when I could go into Circle K or 7-Eleven, and get one of those great big sour-apple slurpees.  Sure they were 99% sugar, and would pucker up your face, and tasted nothing like apples, but it sure was good nonetheless.  Now fast forward many years later, and sugar is a no-no, but here comes Crystal Light coming out with these wonderful sour apple flavored drink mixes.Are these my favorite?  No, not by a long shot (that would be their heavenly Peach Mango).  They don't taste like Apple, and they aren't even the best artificial sour-apple flavor I've ever tasted, but it's the only drink of it's kind that I know of, that is sugar free.  And it is extremely refreshing.If you are like me and long for a guilty-pleasure of a sour apple drink, but without the sugar, these fit the bill.
This is pretty good,  I think the mojito would be better though.  I recommend this product for a nice refreshing pick me up.

column9: Tastes like a Green Apple Jolly Rancher
column10: My family loves this Mocktail by Crystal Light.  This Appletini flavor smells, looks, and tastes just like a Green Apple Jolly Rancher candy.  Every member of the family enjoyed this new flavor from pre-teen to adult.  I cannot tell you it if tastes like the alcoholic version because I have never had a real Appletini.  You could add vodka to this mix easily for an adult beverage.  We liked it just the way it was, and we will definitely buy this flavor again.
They are so simple and GREAT tasting. Love how convenient the packets are. We love them!! Who doesn't love a martini??

I have been a fan of Crystal Light products for years. Their mocktail line  of instant drinks provides another tasty treat to delight your tastebuds. Everyone I shared it with thought it was delicious and made an impressive mocktail. Appletini was the perfect blend of sour and sweet with no bad aftertaste.This vibrant green, pleasantly apple-flavored drink dissolves quickly and easily in water and can be ready to party in under five minutes. Once your friends try it you'll be lucky if a pitcher of it lasts that long.

column9: Not as terrible as you might think
column10: Good appletini mockup but way too tart. Need to add more water than they suggest. Takes on weird alien neon green color.

This drink has a definite apple flavor, although think artificial green apple lollipop flavor and not apple juice.  The drink is pretty darn sweet, perhaps too sweet for some, but tasty. Too sweet to be particularly refreshing or thirst quenching, but unique. The mocktails angle of this line of crystal light drinks seems to be more marketing than reality. I suppose one could add vodka or tequila to this drink, but it still would not taste like an apple martini, although the flavor does remind me of apple pucker liquor, although very sweet and not tart. If you tire of drinking Crystal Light's other flavors, such as punch or iced tea, this may make a nice change for a while. However, I suggest the Sunrise Orange, which has an authentic orange flavor, and not the artificial tinge of this apple mocktail.

column9: Not a big fan of this product
column10: It does slightly taste like an apple martini, but that's as far as it goes.  Had a couple of people try it and no one was willing to take it over an actual apple martini.  I suppose it is better than nothing...but not by much.  Give me apple juice.

Crystal Light Mocktails are AWESOME!!  I haven't even slipped in any ALKY.  This mix is so wonderful, it is really hard to believe it is sugar free.  The funny thing is how much my kids love this DIET drink.  We went through a two-quart pitcher in an afternoon.  Granted, there are five of us...but it was that delicious.  I look forward to trying some of the other flavors of mocktails because this one was so yummy!  Thanks CL for making being on a diet a little less dreary.

I first saw these Mocktails from Crystal Light advertised in a magazine and looked forward to trying them but couldn't find them at my local stores so I was excited to see that Amazon is carrying them. The drink is a striking green color and has a pleasant apple taste with just the right amount of tartness. I have also used this to make ice cubes which I add to my water for a little flavor.Overall, this is a refreshing change from the conventional summer drinks of iced tea and lemonade and for only 5 calories per serving, you can't beat it. After enjoying this one, I can't wait to try the other flavors as well.

Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini is delicious!  It's a low-calorie, non-alcoholic, refreshing beverage.  I've never had an appletini before, but if they taste like green apple hard candies, that is what this drink tastes like.  It's a terrific way to enjoy the flavor without the alcohol and the calories that always come along with an alcoholic drink.Crystal Light is super easy to make - although I prefer to use a bit less water than what the package directions call for.  This is a particularly nice treat in the summertime, at a barbecue or picnic.  I'm sure it will be delightful in the winter and all year long!

Crystal Light has long provided favourite products of mine, and this is no exception. It is a nice alternative mixer for those of us who need to be careful of carbohydrate consumption. It doesn't reproduce the flavour of a true cocktail, of course, but it is a pleasant, nicely flavoured product.

Each time I've tried the Crystal Light Appletini drink, my first taste is crisp, light, refreshing, with a color reminiscent of the green apples we all know...After awhile, though, the sour taste became predominant for me and I wasn't quite so enthused (I don't like sour and didn't anticipate the product being made that way). Still, for those who enjoy a sour taste, the reduction of calories for this drink mix, makes it a great alternative to the other flavors routinely available.The package for review included 5 2 quart packets. With a serving, it's about 5 caloriesI think you'd really have to enjoy the sour apple flavor, which I personally would not normally choose...I guess I could consider a sweetener...LOL...but that would be cheating a little for purposes of the review, wouldn't it.I'll leave it up to you who buy drink mixes... but I thought the price was high for 10 quarts of, essentially, apple juice? You decide...

The flavor is very light and crisp, tastes kind of like a green apple with a bit of a kick. One tiny little packet will last you quite awhile, or if you're having a party will provide enough for everyone. If you want to add a bit more kick it tastes great with a little splash of coconut rum. :D

column4: Trish "A Sun Salutin', Crochet Hookin' Chick!"
column10: I frequently buy mixes to flavor my water because quite frankly, I live in SoCal and the water is not the best tasting in the world.  Having said that, I enjoy a nice (regular) Appletini as much as the next gal, so I mixed this in a nice pitcher, added filtered water, stirred with a long glass drink stirrer and enjoyed.Granted, the taste is not an exact Appletini, but for 5 calories, I can let my imagination make up for the rest.  If you are watching your calories and/or it's not 5pm in your town, make a pitcher (I used about a cup or two water less than 2 quarts...I like sweet drinks) and give it a try.  It's not an exact replica of the drink, but it's close enough...you will get the essense of an appletini.

It looks like something out of an evil scientist's laboratory. I've had all sorts of green beverages, but this looks very much like that ominous green liquid that was in every episode of The X-Files! The packaging is what threw me off a little. I saw red/purple and assumed it was a red apple drink. When I saw the green I was pretty surprised. It's flat-out neon green. Which makes it fun in a weird way.Tastes a lot like green apple Now & Laters, only not as sweet or tart. Like, 65% of the Now & Later taste. It's pretty good.

column9: Wish These Were Available All The Time
column10: I read that the Crystal Lite Mocktails would only be available through the summer. OH SAY IT ISN'T SO!! I like these so much I really wish they'd make them available year round.I've never had a "real" appletini so wasn't sure what to expect. I'm not really wild about apple juice so I was hoping the taste of this wouldn't be too similar.....and it's not.This has a taste that's more like a Granny Smith apple. Sweet and tart at the same time, though not too sweet. I don't buy Crystal lite that often because most of the flavors I've tried are too sweet for my taste. This has a nice balance of tart and sweet.I put some of this in my slushy mug and it was wonderful. Wish I'd have thought to try this earlier in the summer because I can see myself drinking this long after summer is gone.The mojito flavor is still my favorite but I like this enough that I'll be ordering more of it.One last thing: about the container - you can peel off the plastic wrapper and are left with a sheer canister that can be re-used! I filled one with tiny twist pretzels that I keep in my desk. I buy nuts and trail mix in bulk and this container is a nice size to store fair amounts of those. I also like the shape. It's taller and more slender than many of the containers I use in my husband's lunches and this fits better in his lunch box. Not leak proof though so is best for dry foods.

I've never had a real Appletini so I can't say whether or not this tastes like the real thing, but I thought it was pretty good.  If I had not read the label and had no idea what flavor it was supposed to be, I don't think I could tell you.  It definitely doesn't taste like apple juice or cider.  Maybe slightly like sour apple hard candies, only it's not sour.  It's really pretty sweet.  The color of the drink is bright green, so that's kind of fun.  I can't say for sure that I'll buy this flavor again, but I will try the other Crystal Light Mocktails.  I'm always looking for new low calorie drinks to try.

"Crystal Light gives women..."Well then send me a copy of this months Glamour and call me Antoinette, because as a dude, I happened to enjoy this drink very much.  It tastes like an appletini, without the liquor, of course. Refreshing and tart, I'll definitely be adding this to my diet drink rotation.

column9: Jolly Rancher candy in liquid form?
column10: I admit I laughed out loud when I saw another reviewer of this product compare it to liquid apple-flavored Jolly Ranchers. Now that I have had it for myself, I have to agree that this was spot-on!I received a sample of this product through the amazon Vine program and had my daughter mix some up for us to try with the evening meal, tonight. The kids loved it! I think part of it was the novelty of the whole thing, as our family doesn't drink a great deal of powder-mix drinks aside from Gatorade. The color of the drink is nearly identical to apple Jolly Ranchers, the drink smelled like apple Jolly Ranchers, and the drink tasted like apple Jolly Ranchers. I have never had an a real alcoholic Appletini beverage, so I can't say whether or not this drink tastes anything like a real Appletini, but this particular mix was well-received by my kids. My wife doesn't drink soft drinks or kool-aid-type drinks, so she abstained from having any of it.Like other Crystal Light drinks, this mix is sugar-free and very low-calorie (only 5 calories per serving), so that should appeal to many consumers. I imagine most kids who enjoy kool-aid-type drinks will like this, and if you're looking to cut down on your children's caloric intake or frequency of cavities, this is a good alternative to those types of drinks.

column9: Too sweet and not very tart
column10: I'm not much of a drinker, but when my friends and I do get together, we usually have a celebratory Appletini.  We have perfected our recipe over the years so that it is not too sweet, not too tart, and doesn't have too much of a kick to it.  I was excited to try the mocktail but it was a disappointment.  The drink was much too sweet and not at all tart.  I added more water hoping to cut the sweetness but that made the drink very tasteless.  The idea is great but the execution needs more refinement.  Not a do-over.

I don't drink so I've never had a non-alcoholic appletini.  I do, however, always drink sugar free beverages.  I was optimistic about this one, Crystal Light has so many flavors I like!  I made a pitcher of it soon after it came.  It only took one tiny sip for me to know I can't drink any more of it!  It's SO sour!  My 12 yr old loves sour things so I'll give the rest to him but I will NEVER use this flavor again!

When it comes to matters of taste, the larger the number of people, the easier it is to judge. I don't think Amazon expected me to drink eight quarts of this, so I made a pitcher for some college freshmen. The consensus was positive across the board, and they all had good things to say about the taste. At least one of the young ladies mentioned that she never had a real appletini, and in theory none of them should have had them. But even the real ones should vary in taste, I suppose, so it should be taste that governs.I'd have no qualms about serving up a pitcher of these to guests.  I would not expect any mock drink to taste exactly like its alcoholic counterpart. Whether this taste exactly like appletinis I can't say, but ultimately what counts is that it tastes good.

I think if I were to like crytal light better, I might enjoy this more.Crytal light is very sour to me and very fake tasting in my view. But I guess it is kind of healthy if you compare to real lemonade etc.Appletini tasted like fake green apple flavored fake lemonade.OK, I like it better than just water - I am not a pure water fan. But I cannot take this in large dosage.
I got this out of curiosity because i love appletinis.  This drink is very good. I mad a big piture of it and it was gone in 2 days. I would recommend it to my friends.

column9: Tini on calories.  Big on apple taste.
column10: I really miss being able to have a cocktail or two, especially kicking back and watching the sunset, after a hard week.  It's not the booze so much, but the flavors and the look of some of the concoctions (tropical juices and flavors, to compliment the palm trees here on the Gulf Coast), that make it such a treat for me.  I was thrilled to see that Crystal Light has introduced some new flavors to their line, calling them "Mocktails"...  I don't mind the artificial sweetener, as I would not drink Crystal Light as a regular beverage for hydration purposes, the way I drink plain water. I'm not too thrilled about the artificial dye in the mix (I have G6PD deficiency and my family generally avoids food dyes derived from petroleum).  The flavor, though is wonderful.  It's very appletini-ish, reminds me of those green apple Jolly Rancher candies we used to get at camp.  Sweet with just a bit of tartness, but not calorie and sugar-laden. Perfect with ice cold water, served over crushed ice.  I think it would be fantastic over shaved ice/slushy ice...

Now, we have a lot of Crystal Light in the pantry (Raspberry Lemonade is a favorite). I don't mean to sound like a broken record about my recent Crystal Light Moctail reviews, but...This Appletini just *isn't*. Once you get it in your mind that hey, it reminds you of Jolly Ranchers, then that is all you'll think about as you sip it. Which makes it taste gross, the thought of liquid Jolly Ranchers in your glass. (Yes it also has the aspartame aftertaste...) Like the Margarita, it seemed to be quickly overwhelmed with the ice and would probably have held up better if using two pouches for the 2 quarts instead of one.None of us liked this, not even a little bit. The smell was a little gagful. It's not a flavor that I could consider mixing with something else to make it taste good. (That's pretty bad!) One plus, it's so green that you could probably foist it off on Trick-Or-Treaters in October, as "Witch Brew"!
The color was day-glo green, just like the Mojito. However, this tasted like medicine!  I couldn't even finish it.  'nuff said.

column9: Really strong taste but also gave me a headache.
column10: For the mixture recommendations on the package this is stuff has a REALLY strong taste and I don't care for that too much but that's an easy fix with just adding more water to knock it down a level. I don't mind the flavor at all but I quickly found out that I have a reaction to something in this mix as each time I tried I ended up with a headache from hell. The first time I just thought it was because I had been working on my computer for 16 hours a day for a couple days but after the next 2 times I realized it was the crystal light that was doing it.NOT COOL.The package says one packet makes 2 quarts, I watered this stuff down with a full gallon and thought it tasted pretty good at that level but the headache still happened even at that level.This product contains ASPARTAME, which is an artificial sweetener, I've never had the stuff before because I don't care for artificial stuff but apparently I can't have it to begin with as that is more than likely the culprit in the headaches that this stuff gave me.ASPARTAME/PHENYLKETONURICS contains PHENYLALANINEPhenylalanine is found naturally in the breast milk of mammals. It is used in the manufacture of food and drink products and sold as a nutritional supplement for its reputed analgesic and antidepressant effects. It is a direct precursor to the neuromodulator phenylethylamine, a commonly used dietary supplement.That's just a little bit of info for you, you can do with it as you like...I don't know 100% that this is what caused my headache but it's the only off ingredient listed on the back panel. With that I'm drawn to conclude that it is was caused the problems I had. Regardless I will be sure to stay away from products containing this stuff in the future...NUTRASWEET contains a form of aspartame in it as well.

I want to start this review with,"I have never had an Appletini, so I can't compare as to how this tastes against a real one."I really enjoyed the flavor of this drink.  The apple is very pronounced and crisp.  Very refreshing drink.I think it has a much stronger flavor than some of the other Crystal Lights that I have tried.The only thing keeping it from getting 5 stars is I found it tasted its' best when icy cold.  Once it started warming up, the taste wasn't as sharp, and adding too many ice cubes to keep cold watered it down quickly.This is one Crystal Light I would buy again.

I found the new Crystal Light mocktails at my local grocery store for about three bucks each initially, but now they aren't there any more.  This is the only place I know to get them. Crystal Light's new flavors are Mojito, Margarita, and Appletini. I love real Mojitos and Appletinis and I also love Crystal Light (though I had been a bit bored of most of the flavors at this point). The Appletini mix is like drinking Jolly Rancher green apple candy. It has that fake-apple taste and a slight sourness, which is very similar to the less expensive appletini mixes. If you make your own appletinis using things like sour apple pucker, you will likely not appreciate this.  I like it in small doses.  UPDATE: after 3 canisters, I really can't drink this one any more. It's too cloying.  But I still love the mojito!Each canister has 5 packets, and each packet makes two quarts. An 8 ounce glass is 5 calories. Keep in mind that a real appletini (3 to 4 oz) can be about 160 calories.If you want something similar to Appletinis and delightfully different from other Crystal Lights, you'll love this! I have several non-drinking friends who come to our dinner parties (which have lots of alcohol flowing), and this is a great option for them.I like the Mojito and Margarita better though.

I like both Jones Soda and the Izze in the sour apple flavor, but don't need all the sugar. While this is not carbonated like the aforementioned, it does capture that sour apple flavor quite nicely. It is a fun change of pace from citrus drinks or other diet sodas. I would love it even more if it was carbonated, but still find it quite refreshing. I hope Amazon branches out to carry some of the other "mock cocktail" flavors that Crystal Light has developed.**UPDATE** I have started putting a sprinkle of this into a diet ginger ale on the rocks and it is even better than the sugary apple sodas! Delish!

column9: Do you enjoy candy-like faux green apple flavor?
column10: If you love "sour green apple" candy, like the classic Jolly Rancher apple flavor, this is the best bet for the same flavor in liquid format. Mixed with enough ice to make it freezing cold and slightly weaker, it's refreshing. The "mocktail" marketing gimmick is really just a gimmick: cute packaging that puts you in the mindset of a more adult-oriented flavor. But it really is just candy green apple kool-aid. Whether you see that as a positive or negative recommendation is according to your personal taste.

I typically love all things green apple but this seems to be the exception to the rule. I made a pitcher, drank about half a cup and poured the rest down the sink. The flavor is what I would expect if Kool-aid could go bad. (not a fan of kool-aid either so that's pretty bad in my book)I still have the rest of the package left so we may experiment with it during our next ladies night. Maybe alcohol will help transform taste.... of course that kind of defeats the purpose.

Need an appletini fix in the middle of the day? Want to waste away to another place while at work? Well, Crystal Light's new Mocktails Appletini might be just what you're looking for. With a taste that takes you away to the islands, Mocktails Appletini is the answer to that stressful day. Obviously, these are non-alcoholic, but I figure I might as well put that in here (just in case someone asks). For a refreshing drink that is a break from the ordinary, try out Crystal Light Mocktails ...

Yum!  I thought this was delicious -- it was very sweet and appley and crisp- not bad for 5 calories a serving.  This is a great alternative to the standard Crystal Light flavors.  If you're comparing it to a cocktail appletini, well, you may well be disappointed, but if you're comparing it to Crystal Light lemonade, it holds up well.  I found the flavor more crisp than cloying, and very refreshing.The package contains five foil tubes of drink mix, not four as advertised, and not the individual tubes you often find now.  I just use a little of the powder at a time rather than making a whole pitcher at once.Interesting that this product is marked as something "for women" -- as I don't know what's inherently woman-only about an apple-flavored beverage, but after one tasted, my hubbie did wrinkle his nose after one sip.  But I like it and plan to get more.

column9: Not bad for a drink without the booze-bite.
column10: Okay, since this is minus the booze this is a severe setback as I was a fan of the original appletini for its potent and flavorful buzz.That being said for a low calorie drink this did have a pretty fair apple flavor and was refreshing enough to hit the spot & go beyond the usual kool-aid, berry flavors. Too bad it is a limited edition flavor as I could get used to this.

When you mix this up, you get a neon green drink that suggests something wild. But when you drink it, there's just a mild apple flavor. The Margarita Mocktail, though not exactly a margarita, had more zip than this does. If you're looking for a lo-cal apple drink, this is a good enough option and the color is interesting. But if it's the "mocktail" part that intrigues you, the margarita mocktail is a better pick.

I really enjoyed this item. The appletini flavor was quite tasty and easy to mix. Did it taste like an actual appletini? No... but it came so close that even an expert wouldn't notice the difference. Finally, a new crystal light flavor for those of us with a taste for something different!

The Appletini tastes better than crystal lights other mocktail mixes. It does have a slight artificial sweetener aftertaste.If you have used crystal light before you should be used to that. It tasted like one of those green sour apple candies. Like a jolly rancher candy.If you want a quick mixed low calorie drink this CL Mocktail will do in a pinch.

This Crystal Light drink stays right on target just like all the other Crystal Light products my family enjoys.  This drink was nice and refreshing.  It's nice to have variety when looking for drink options that are low-calorie and tasty.  We will definitely purchase this one again.

column9: So it's not a cocktail mix?
column10: Once we figured out this isn't intended for mixed drinks, the Boy took it to school to serve at a party. The 9th graders generally liked the tart/sweet combination--"surprisingly unique."  But a couple did note the "chemically" or "articifial" aftertaste that you tend to get with all these sugar free drinks.

column9: If you like Crystal Light and you like apple martinis, go for this!
column10: There's honestly not much to say about this: If you'd had one or two Crystal Light flavors, and you've ever had an apple martini, then this is just what you'd expect, no more or less. I like a few of the CL flavors and I like apple martinis, so I like this.But it's no apple martini...

column9: "One of the Better Flavors Crystal Light has come up with ~ Recommend"
column10: Distributed by Kraft Foods Global Inc we have "CRYSTAL LIGHT MOCKTAILS APPLETINI" (1.62oz  pack of 4), which Amazon sent my way through the Vine Program.* 1st -- This is on the green apples sour side, which is a plus for me.* 2nd -- This does not have that after-artificial-taste to it,* 3rd -- This has a refreshing low-calorie taste, which is an alternative to the other brands, nuff said.My Grandchildren Tommy and Ava live with me and my wife (Judy), we gave it the taste testand it passed with flying colors.In closing - My Entire Family - Would purchase this flavor again.

Crystal Light Mocktails AppletiniThe Appletini has a taste and smell reminiscent of the green apple Jolly Rancher candy, but not as sweet. It tastes almost like a real apple martini, except it isn't dry of course. Out of the three different Crystal Light mocktails I have sampled (Mojito, Margarita, and Appletini), the Appletini is my favorite followed by Margarita, and then Mojito.Each packet is mixed with approximately 2 quarts of water, and it mixes very easily. The liquid pours out in clear green color, and was a perfect complement with my meals or even by itself.Overall: 5/5 stars

You may recall that I first tried the Margarita. I absolutely hated it! Took one sip and threw the entire container out!Next I tried the Margarita. And I was in love with that! So refreshing and delicious!But I was totally unprepared for the delicious treat in the flavor of the Appletini! Definitely my all time favorite flavor [next to the Pink Grapefruit!]  that Crystal Light has ever come out with!Light apple flavor, although the color says lemon-lime Kool-Aid straight from your childhood days! LOLAgain, each canister comes with 5 flavor pouches, and each pouch makes 2-quarts. So, this is a big bargain when compared with diet sodas! Only 5-calores per 8-ounce glass, and no carbs or sodium!I highly reccommend this taste sensation! And for a little summer sizzle, serve this in your best martini glasses for an extra treat! You're going to love it!

column9: good, but mojito flavor is better....
column10: I think these new Mocktails are clever...a low calorie (5 calories per 8 oz serving) taste of some of your favorite drinks sans the alcohol (but who says you can't jazz them up yourself?).  I've tried two of the flavors, Mojito, which was my favorite and the Appletini flavor.  Both I liked, but the apple one didn't have the green apple bite I had expected, so I might make that one with a little less water to pump up the flavor a tad.  The color was just one notch down from day-glo....quite bright, which I hadn't expected, but that was ok with me.Overall, I would buy the mojito one for sure, and might purchase the appletini flavor.  Each container has five packets, that each make up 2 quarts of drink mix.  A nice thing to make up if you are trying to get your liquids in but aren't keen on drinking a lot of sugary and calorie laden sodas.

Tastes great!  I've had a few Appletini drinks and I have to say that this is as good if not better.  Add some Vodka and ice, then shake and strain into a martini glass to wow your friends.  Just drink as is in a glass with a few ice cubes.  It's really good and low in calories too.  Hard to believe there's no Apple liquor in it. I love all the Mocktails that I've tried.

Well the good news is that Crystal Light Mocktails are low in calories and sodium as well as being gluten free. The bad news is that a cocktail without the alcohol is like a party without the music. There just isn't any fun. Granted you could ADD alcohol to the product but that's not really the point is it? I mixed up Crystal Light Appletini and the first thing that hits you is the color. Vibrant lime green. Visually pleasing sure enough, but drinks this color are usually targeted toward teenage boys. As for the taste? One of my friends described it as Granny Smith apple juice. I myself think it tastes like apple cider with a hint of Jolly Ranchers green apple. The price is pretty steep, although to be fair each packet in the container can make two quarts so that's something. The packaging is eye-catching and I can see it drawing in customers on aesthetics alone. This product isn't for everyone but I'm sure ladies in their early 20's will love it.

I'm not normally a big fan of sugar-free drinks, but this product doesn't taste like a "diet drink"! It has a bold apple flavor and is very refreshing over ice. I love that each packet makes a whole pitcher, not just a glass. Just mix with cold water, and it's ready to go! It's only 5 calories a serving and tastes delicious!

Have you looked at the ingredients on Appletini mixers?  One of the main ingredients is High Fructose Corn Syrup.  UGH.  Crystal Light has now come out with one of their famous 5-calorie (no HFCS) versions.  It tastes similar to bar-made or HFCS-made appletinis, but has a lighter, less syrupy taste and feel.  I really enjoyed tasting a decent appletini without thinking about how many calories or HFCS were in the intake.  Yes, it has chemical sweeteners in it, but isn't that what HFCS is, too?There are a couple of downsides to these new "Mocktails."  First: the packets in the container force you to make an entire pitcher of mocktail mix.  That's great for a party, but for two, you have plenty of leftover.  We're just keeping the rest in the refrigerator for other nights.  Second:  Crystal Light doesn't put any instructions on the label for adding alcohol to their mixers.  I guess they don't want to encourage alcoholic drinking?  But are people really buying these just for the "taste" of alcoholic drinks?  Methinks not.  So we just added a couple of shots of vodka to a shaker, ice, and filled the rest with the mocktail.  That seemed (and tasted) about right.I think Crystal Light's new mocktails are a welcome addition to the HFCS-laden mixers out there.

Of the three Crystal Light Mocktails, I was excited about this one but it turned out to be my least favorite.  The flavor was so weak so I probably would recommend adding more just to give it some life.  The best thing about these mocktails is that they are so low in calories (5 per 8 fl.oz.), low in sodium, and gluten-free.  A canister yields ten quarts but right now, the product is a bit on the pricey side.  If you are craving an adult version of Kool-Aid, this is not for you because the flavors are very subtle.  But at least it won't turn your tongue blue.

column9: An amazing flavored drink that looks neon green.
column10: Crystal Light has really stepped it up in there "flavor department" with these new cocktail inspired beverages.  The flavor in question is "Appletini" and is mocked from the cocktail found in a bar and/or restaurant, hence their term "mocktails".  Crystal Light has three of these flavors on the shelf right now; Appletini, Mojito and Margarita.  The Mojito is crisp and clean, very good.  I haven't tried the Margarita, yet.  As for the Appletini....This flavor is wonderful; it is vivid, juicy, sweet and even a bit sour.  Another review in this forum claimed that this tasted a lot like an apple Jolly Rancher, in many ways I would have to agree.  This is really a nice break from the traditional flavors Crystal Light (or even Kool-Aid) has to offer.  How many times can strawberry, fruit punch, lemonade and grape be dressed up?There are five packets in the container, each making 64ozs (8 cups).  Once this drink is mixed it is almost a neon green color, reminding me of Hi-C's "Etco Cooler". I don't know if anyone else remembers that drink, it was inspired by Ghostbusters and Slimer was the mascot.I digress; this is a wonderful drink, with a wonderful flavor. It is low on calories and sugar free.  In addition, if someone really wanted to make this an alcoholic beverage rum or vodka could be added, since alcohol isn't included in the mix.  Who knows, maybe it will be included next time.....

I have tried the Crystal Light Mocktails in both the Mojito and Margarita variety,and loved them both, so I decided to try the third in this "limited flavor" series. As soon as I opened the packet, I could smell the sweet apple scent. It smelled just like a Jolly Rancher green apple candy. Yummy! I thought it might be a bitlike a  sour apple flavor, but I was wrong. Instead it was just the opposite, very sweet. In fact, the reason I gave this 4 stars instead of five is because out of the 3 flavors, I felt this was the only one I could taste a bit of the artificial sweetener. I know this is  used to keep it 5 calories and it isn't really too bad.  Other than that, it was perfect. Sweet, refreshing appletini flavor. When I made up my first pitcher of them, I decided to try a something different. Instead of taking water directly from my tap,or a gallon jug, I used individual bottles of water. It took 4 bottles to fill up a  2 quart pitcher, which is the serving size for each packet of The Crystal Light Appletini mix.  After mixing in the Appletini mix, I made sure it was well blended. Then I poured the mixture back into each individual bottle, making sure to blend it in between pours, so each serving would be evenly flavored. Now I had four perfect servings to take with me anywhere. Great for work instead of plain old bottled water. I have to say this was a great idea for Crystal Light and wish that they would introduce some more mocktails and not just for a limited time.

A delicious and refreshing taste, got hooked instantly and drank most of it the first day. Highly recommend Crystal Light Appletini.  I prefer to pour half the pack in a glass at a time rather than make a pitcher.

column9: A Tasty Adult Drink Without the Alcohol!
column10: I am so glad that someone finally came out for an adult drink mix with flavors for adults! I enjoy the regular Crystal Light drink mixes but they have that over powering kid flavor. I am not always in the mood for a full flavored kid drink.The canister has 5 packets that each make a 2 quart pitcher of appletini. If you are not familiar with Crystal Light , it is sugar free and low sodium. There are 5 calories in each 8 ounce serving. The packets come in a nice plastic container which keeps them dry and fresh until you are ready to use them.The Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini has a bright neon green color which at first had me thinking it would be another kid flavored drink. It smells like those wonderful Sour Apple Jolly Rancher candies I ate as a child. I was expecting an overpowering sour apple drink. What I was pleasantly surprised with was a nice, smooth apple drink that is mild but very tasty! It has a nice light taste that is pleasant and refreshing. I like that they are a low calorie option that tastes great!I can't say if this taste like a real appletini, as I am not a drinker and have never had one. I can say that this is a nice change of pace from the usual Crystal Light flavors. I would definitely buy this again and will be trying the other flavors as well. This will be a wonderful addition to parties for those who do not drink alcohol but want an adult flavored beverage! This flavor will also be finding a place in my every day pantry. I really enjoyed it!

This new drink mix by Crystal Light could be called Green Apple instead of Appletini, because that is exactly what it tastes like.  I enjoyed it.  It is light and crisp tasting, a bit tart and sweet.  There is a slight aftertaste because of the artificial sweetener.  But it is only slight, and that is how they can make this drink only 5 calories per serving.  There isn't any type of alcohol flavor in this drink, even though it is called a mocktail.  So if you like the taste of crisp green apples, you will likely enjoy this drink.

I like appletini's and this matches the flavor quite nicely.  It does have quite a chemically after taste if it's not very,  very cold.  I drank my first glass when I had just made it wrinkled my nose,  it was far too sweet and had a weird/strong after taste.  But I put it in the fridge anyways,  and cold with ice,  it's a nice drink.  I dilute it more than the maker recommends,  I use half their drink and half sparkling mineral water.  It's a refreshing change from ice tea and lemonade and though our first taste was through Amazon vine,  we will buy it again which is proof that it does work for us.

These have an appealing, sparkling-apple taste but the flourescent green color is a little offputting.  They seem to pack quite a phenylalanine punch:  I'm mildly sensitive to it and after my first couple of glasses, my hands were numb and my head was pounding.  If I wanted a hangover, I'd drink the real thing!  But if you aren't bothered by aspartame, this is a nice change from the usual anemic peach tea and lemonade flavors.

I love appletinis (the real ones) which I avoid because of the calories. I was pleasantly surprised to find that Crystal Light had a line of mocktails. I tried the appletini and really liked it. It tastes like the real deal but only 5 calories. This one is a winner!!Of course, if you do not like the sour apple taste this mocktail is not for you. Crystal Light has other flavors that you could try.
I found the Crystal Light Appletini to be refreshing without being too sour.  It's a nice change from the other Crystal Light flavors.  Hopefully it will be sold year round and not just seasonally.

As soon as I mixed the Appletini powder with water thoughts of apple jolly ranchers were brought to mind.  It's exactly how it tastes too, not like an appletini.  If you are looking for a good mocktail by Crystal Light go with the mojito flavored one, it's much better.

column9: a great alternative to the standard Crystal Light flavors
column10: Don't know what I was expecting when I ordered this...I am not a drinker, so I don't know what an "Appletini" is or what it tastes like, but I do know that I like the flavor of green apple...so......and it was a pleasant surprise! Refreshing, nice flavor...subtle, not too overpowering...and unlike the other reviewers, I found it to be wonderful very cold or even just room temperature...and of course, the price was right!

I only wish there'd been more in the package we got from Vine. They have a good flavor, and in a pinch you can make them non-mocktail without having to pull out all the bartending supplies. They're refreshing, tasty, not too sweet (which they shouldnt be, anyway) and are pretty nice on a hot day after work.

I loved the idea of this, however, I couldn't get past the test. Everything about the drink tasted artificial as hard candy. I didn't find this drink enjoyable at all, and certainly not worth serving to guests as a non-alcholic option.

column9: Crystal Light Appletini Flavored Drink Mix Is A Winner!
column10: I am always wary of flavoured drink mixes because sometimes the flavouring leaves a lot to be desired, but the Appletini Flavored Drink Mix by Crystal Light is cooling, refreshing and provides relief on these hot summer days. The flavour is crisp, light and almost makes you feel like you are sitting at a tiki bar sipping a cool Appletini. The only thing missing is the vodka but adventurous types can add that with no problem.Crystal Light's Appletini Flavored Drink mix is guilt free as it is only 5 calories per serving, 90% fewer calories than other similar brands. The canister comes in a 1.69 oz. (48g) size containing 5 flavor packets which makes 2 quarts per packet. The pre-measured packets insure quick, easy, accurate and delicious Appletinis as swiftly as you can add 8 cups of water. No muss, no fuss, just a refreshing drink to quench the thirst of children and adults alike.So beat the summer heat with a cool, crisp Appletini. One sip is all it will take to jump on the Crystal Light Appletini bandwagon.

This isn't Kool-Aid ! The Crystal Light Appletini was very refreshing when added to ice cold water. Great after yard work , or just for a refreshing blast.The package lasted a long time and we were able to enjoy this fine product for almost a month. Well worth the $$$$$

The Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini comes with 4 packs of drink mix powder.  Mix powder with 2 quarts of water, and you're good to go.  I like sweet drinks, but wasn't that keen on this appletini mix.  It's definitely sweet and has a bit of a tang, but I think it has a bitter aftertaste.  I'd definitely prefer to drink either a real appletini or lemonade.  The only way I can see myself serving this would be to pregnant girlfriends, but even then I think they'd rather skip it.Bottom line, try an O'Doul's instead.

I really enjoyed the Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini drink. I am not much of a drinker so the lack of alcohol did not bother me. This drink came close to the real thing without the alcohol. The drink was very crisp and refreshing. It also has a very nice sour apple taste. This is a Mocktail and is not suppose to taste like a drink with alcolol exactly.

column9: I'm a Crystal Light lover and I won't be buying this flavor... ever
column10: I'm a huge fan of Crystal Light.  I always have a pitcher full in the fridge and a packet in my purse for my water bottle.  I was so excited to try this new flavor but unfortunately for me... this one is a fail.  The flavor smells alright but the flavor tastes fake, for lack of a better work.  Initally, when you take the first drink it reminds me of a jolly rancher.  The flavor is very strong.  Before I even swallowed the first sip I was overwhelmed with the thoughts of a fake almost plastic taste.  The aftertaste is just awful.  I unfortunately don't have anything positive to say about this flavor and am absolutely sure that I won't be purchasing this flavor.... ever.

I am trying to stop drinking so many sodas.  I don't like koolaid, and I don't care much for water.  The flavored water I have had in the past has been weak and still left me feeling like I was drinking water.  I finally decided to give this a try. My first impression was 'Wow, this is strong!' Definitely like drinking a jolly rancher, but it grew on me. I have never had an apple martini, so I can't give a comparison.

column4: T. Lee "God has died lots of times, but someo...
column10: When you take the pleasant burn of alcohol out of a cocktail like an appletini, you end up with a taste hardly distinguishable from Jolly Rancher candy.  Not to say this is a bad drink.  Just that "Appletini" is not what comes to mind when I drink this.  It does have a pleasantly sweet taste, exactly what you'd expect from Crystal Light.

column9: Just like green apple Jolly Ranchers
column10: Others who said this tastes like a green apple Jolly Rancher are spot on, that's what this tastes like.  Not exactly like an appletini on its own either (you know, since it doesn't actually have any alcohol), but mixed with a shot of vodka and you've got yourself a good refreshing diet cocktail.  Also, it's more affordable than the diet cocktail mixers you'd find in the liquor store.BTW, it doesn't taste like a true green apple so if you're expecting that, sorry.  (But green apple Jolly Rancher?  Yes.)  And if you don't like sugar-free products or think they have a weird taste, or only like all-natural products, this probably isn't for you.  I've consumed Splenda and diet soda and Crystal Light for years and I'm used to it, so take that into consideration with this review.  =)

This is a great product that I love! While it doesn't taste exactly like an apple-tini of course, for what it is it's very tasty and very low in calories, so how great is that?  I made some of this for my gal pals and they really liked it as well.  It's a very refreshing and light drink.  I thought the flavor was very strong made by the directions but I find if I add a bit more water it's just right! I will definitely purchase this item again!

This drink tastes good.  I enjoyed it. I also had my daughter and my grandchildren try it--they drank even more of it and found it pleasant to the taste.  Once mixed and cold in the fridge, it didn't last long.  A good alternative to pop I think.Recommended.

I'm always looking to stay hydrated during the day and before workouts.  Drinking plain water can become quite dull and to keep it interesting, I tried these Crystal Light Mocktail in Appletini.  The bright green color makes it look like the name but taste-wise it seems a bit artificial.  A bit of an aftertaste kept me from really enjoying the flavor as much as I thought I would.  These might work better mixed with seltzer but with the plain water I don't think I would try these again.

column9: For those who like sour apple candy flavor
column10: This Crystal Light is very sweet and tastes like sour apple candy.  It's not bad when diluted with some ice sitting out on the porch in the summer, but I can see getting sick of it pretty quickly.  If you really like appletinis, but don't want the alcohol then this might be worth it for you, but I don't think I'd buy it again.

column9: The Crystal Light flavor list continues to grow!
column10: My wife and I love Crystal Light and we drink some every day.  We like that they have a broad selection of flavors and you can switch around between them to keep yourself from getting tired of the same old taste.  We just recently purchased some of their new Mocktail flavors to try.This one is an Appletini flavor.  We don't drink Appletinis so we have nothing to compare it too but it is not bad.  My first impression was that the flavor was a little weak when compared to the other Crystal Light products.  We had just made the mix with cool water and had it with lunch.  The next day it was much colder out of the refrigerator and the flavor was much better.We like Crystal Light because it contains no sugar and caffeine which we both need to reduce in our diets.  This product does have 5 calories per 8 ounce serving but that is very low and not an issue for us. Each packet makes 2 quarts and each tube contains 5 packets.  That means this four pack will make 10 gallons of drink.I gave this 4 stars as it is a good product but not necessarily my favorite flavor but, I would drink it again!

Heh, Mocktails.  Flavor without the alcohol.  If only Crystal Light offered a recommended alcohol to spike into their Mocktail, I'd probably give this 5 stars!  Anyway, on to the review.Each container comes with 5 packets of powder, each making 2 quarts of drinks.  Perfect for the picture during late spring or summer.  The fact that this is not sugar-based has the added benefit of you being able to mix this very easily, even cold.  With most of these types of packets (I also buy a lot of the Crystal Light individual drink packets, like Crystal Light On The Go Peach Tea, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)), I mix the powder with a small amount of hot or warm water, then fill it to the final volume with a combination of ice and water, to get an instantly ice-cold drink!I'm not an Appletini person, so I can't tell you how real this is.  The flavor is overall nice, and I think that if someone avoiding the sugar may naturally want to avoid the alcohol as well, so overall, this isn't a bad idea.  Personally, though, I'd probably add a shot of vodka or rum to each drink to give it the added ... flavor.  Final thought, if this is a bit too strong for you, feel free to dilute it by mixing it into 2.5 quarts of water instead of 2 quarts per packet, or filling it into a glass with ice.Overall, recommended.

column4: J. Rose "JR From the Ball so Blue"
column10: I'll admit I've never had the libation this is supposed to emulate. I will say, it is a good green apple flavored drink. Crystal Light has been making stuff like this for years. It is tasty, if a bit uncomplicated.

These Crystal Light Moctails are fantastic summery treats for grown ups! So many of the sugar free flavored drinks are not aimed at adults, but these are great! Though the Appletini flavor reminded me of Starburst (fake tart apple flavor), it was still refreshing. It was actually very good as a mixer with a shot of vodka in it,too!

column9: Not as good as the real thing but...
column10: This isn't the same as having a real appletini but it's a good for what it is. Has a nice strong sour apple flavor. Sadly, it does still have the after taste you'd expect from Crystal Light but once you get used to that it's quite tasty!

My wife hates to drink plain water. She's a freak. So she uses Crystal Light all the time to flavor her water. She loved this stuff and it was gone almost overnight. It is now her new favorite flavor. She went and got more and replaced her old standby flavors. She gives it 5 stars. I'll stick to water.

column4: Michael A. Saxton "Dark Lord of the Sith"
column10: Well, I can't really write an extensive review because, either you'll like this or you won't. I like most of the crystal light flavors (this one included) and what I appreciate the most is that they are flavorful with 0 calories. If you're the type who is trying to be healthier and drink more fluids, but really don't want to just drink water, the various crystal light products are something to look into. For this one, keep in mind, it's a Mocktail. Non-alcoholic (although I guess you could mix alcohol with it if you wanted to). I've never had an alcoholic Appletini so I can't really compare. I just thought this one tasted good. It tastes kind of like a liquid form of a hard candy, a bit on the sweet side so if you have sensitive taste buds, you may have an issue. I like that so I was fine with it. I doubt this is a replacement for an alcoholic beverage but I'll leave that for others to compare.
This is very sweet. A little at a time it can be nice but it is so concentrated that one pack can serve 8 people. At $17, this product is not worth buying.

column9: Like an apple Jolly Rancher candy
column10: Taste like a sweet green apple - I've always been pretty fond of apple flavored drinks. This reminds me of the apple flavored Jolly Rancher candies.

column9: Okay, but other Crystal Light Flavors are Better
column10: I appreciate that Crystal Light is trying to do something different.  I like many of their other flavors.  However, I just didn't like the taste of the appletini flavor as much as other Crystal Light Flavors.  Now, I will say that I've never had an an alcoholic Appletini, but always wanted to try one.  That is why I bought this.  It could be that I wouldn't like a regular Appletini either.  So, perhaps people that have had them and like them, would like this. I think also if you lie those hard candies that are apple flavored, you would like this.  It taseted similar to me.

column9: Very tasty sour apple taste, good for mixing ...
column10: I was happy to see this at Amazon-- it was at my local grocer, but only in July! It is a nice flavor, and I have been known to...ahem... "substitute" a bit of vodka for for the water!Kinda nice to have on hand for those who may NOT drink, yet still enjoy a festive looking cocktail.  Really fun!  I like it!

When I got this product I didn't really expect it to taste like an Appletini but I did expect it to taste at least half way decent which it didn't. It had a bitter taste to it and it isn't nearly as good as the real thing. I have had Crystal Light products before but this one was a real let down.

"Oh my God, this is so good," was the very first thought that came to mind as I took my first sip.  I honestly expected something ho-hum and too terribly sweet or tart.  Boy was I surprised!The directions say to mix a packet with 2 quarts of water.  I used an empty 1 quart Gatorade bottle and shook up the mixture to make my drink, so I got half the amount of recommended water.  Needless to say I thought the especially concentrated drink was going to be too sweet (I don't like syrupy sweet things) but this was anything but!  I poured the drink over a full cup of ice (maybe that helped dilute) and this drink is incredibly refreshing.  It tastes very much like an apple flavored Jolly Rancher.  My favorite part about this drink: 5 calories.  No carbs!The only thing that takes me a little aback is the very bright green color.  It reminds me of "ectoplasm" kool-aid from the years when Ghostbusters was popular!The kids love this drink, too!

I've been a Crystal Light drinker for ages, a particular fool for their Raspberry Ice products (though Fruit Punch makes the rotation once in a while, and it doesn't take much to talk me into other flavors). In theory, I loved what they did with this new grouping of flavors from the moment I saw them. I decided that I had to test them myself, and selected the Appletini variety.I hate to make the comparison to another product, but the similarity is uncanny. The smell and taste of the Crystal Light Appletini threw me directly back to my childhood. If you've ever spent too much time sucking on an apple Jolly Rancher, you will know what I mean! I will certainly be moving onto other varieties, now that I've been so happily enchanted with this one.

I tried this mixed as stated on the package and the apple taste was not strong enough. I expected more of a Jolly Ranch intensity flavor but it tasted watered down.  I even added another package of the mix and it didn't help. I drank it both by itself and mixed with vodka as a mixed drink and while it was palatable it would not be my first choice as a mixer or diet drink.

In the past I was a frequent buyer of Crystal Light, but got tired of lemon aid flavor.  Over time I have gravitated to lighter more delicate flavors that are not overpowering.  This product fills that bill.  It is tasty and has just the right amount of apple aftertaste to make it pleasing to drink and refreshing after exercising.  I like it and will look to purchase it in the future.

First off - I drink a lot of Crystal light and I love the appletini mixes in the grocery store although I never mix them with alcohol.This is the best of both - it's very sweet - but it needs to be in order to make cocktails with it.  It's the right color (although I bet it's artificial in all versions of the mix) and the perfect flavor.I'm getting some for Christmas stocking stuffers for my family members who are into cocktails but also always watching their calories.I haven't figured out if their calorie comparisons are related to alcohol free vs w/ alcohol but I *think* it must be compared to the full sugar versions of the mixer because otherwise it wouldn't make sense.If you or a friend like appletinis this is a perfect item!

I was super excited to find a new crystal light flavor to try. I am usually a huge green apple fan. However, I was highly disappointed with the Crystal Light Appletini. The flavor was horrible to me (very overpowering) and it kind of reminded me of kool-aid gone wrong. This flavor was not for me but it may be for you. As always this product is super simple to make...pour in mix, add water, and stir.5 stars for crystal light BUT 1 star for the appletini flavor.

I love Crystal light and drink it on a regular basis so I actually was pretty excited that I got the opportunity to get this. If you like Apple Martinis then you will definitely love the Appletini Mocktail. It has a slight sour apple taste and is very refreshing.  I even tried it in my blender with ice and it tasted so good.  I didn't add too much ice because I didn't want to water it down, but even after adding the ice, the Crystal Light still had a lot of flavor. I will be purchasing a whole lot of these in the future!

column9: For a diet beverage, not bad
column10: Let me put in a few qualifiers first. For one thing, I was drinking this at double strength, over ice, with vodka. I found that if you do make it the full on diluted version, it's got an off-putting taste that I can't put my finger on. However, at double strength, you can happily mix it with cocktails or blend it with ice to make a slushy, and you're in good shape. Unlike the margarita mix from the same brand, which has none of the tartness or flavour that you'd get from a margarita, this particular mix tastes almost exactly like an appletini.

Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini, 1.69-Ounce (Pack of 4)...very convenient, one packet of Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini dissolves quickly in 2 quarts of cold water, without any dried clumps of product floating on top, an aesthetically pleasing green jewel-tone color, sweet apple taste, no bitter aftertaste.Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini can be served any way you wish, imo -- use Your imagination -- I poured Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini over ice in crystal clear Bodum Pavina Double-Wall Insulated 12-Ounce Glasses, threw in a few bright red cherries, with stems attached, hooked a red and white candy-cane on the rim of the glass and added to my Holiday table set-up.  Instant "Wow Factor", I kid you not! :) Highly Recommended!  --Katharena Eiermann, 2011

The Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini mix is flavorful and very low in calories.  I enjoy the mix as a refreshing fruity drink.  I wish that the Crystal Light packaging included instructions on how to use this to mix with alcohol to make a real cocktail- that would be icing on the cake.  But for virgin drinks, this is a great choice!

I tried both the Margarita and Appletini flavors.  Neither of them was particularly strong-flavored.The Margarita, for me, had an odd coconut aftertaste at first.  Not unpleasant, just strange.  The more I drank, the less I noticed it, and my husband said he did not notice it at all.  When I set the glass down and didn't drink for a while, there it was again.The Appletini tasted like apples.  No surprise there.  My first impression was that the flavor was weak, but the more I drank, the more I tasted the, somewhat artificial, apple flavor.  Not bad, but not memorable either.Will I buy these again?  I would say no, although my husband said he'd possibly give the Margarita one a try again in the summertime.  For me, I'll stick with the standard lemonade flavor Crystal Light.  It's more intense than either of these.

My family loves Crystal light and we have tried many different flavors. Most of the flavors are delicious, but there are a few stinkers out there. We normally stick to lemonades, but this was a nice new flavor for us to try. This is like drinking an apple jolly rancher stick, so if you like that flavor, you'll love this drink. It's not a flavor that we would regularly drink, but it's quite good. As usual with Crystal light, this is a low calorie option for big flavor in a drink. Recommended!

Having previously tried the Crystal Light Moctails Mojito, 1.41-Ounce (Pack of 4) and  Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4) flavors with mixed results, I'm placing this one in the plus category.I don't usually drink Appletinis so I'm not sure how it compares to the alcoholic drink but I found it to taste like Jolly Rancher's Sour Apple candy, which I'm fond of.The taste is strong enough that in addition to a stand alone beverage I believe it could be used as a mixer.

This has a really nice green apple flavor.  It's not overpowering, it hits the taste buds just right.  It's easy to make, very refreshing.  And a great idea.  We also really liked the mojito mix with its nice minty flavor.

It's crystal light - and the packaging is fantastic! I really was hoping for something to add a little alcohol and have a mixed drink.  Not the case.  It has the slight flavor and local. BUT - the packaging is the bomb, it'll grab ya every time!! lol

I actually enjoyed the margarita flavor of these, but this taste a bit too artificial for me to enjoy.  I haven't had an apple martini so I couldn't say if it tastes similar, but it basically tastes like green apple candy.  It's a very pretty drink, but not all that tasty.  You can't beat the low calories though.  I'm not sure I'd drink this again.

Entirely too sweet and sour for my tastes. Reminds me of a sour apple Jolly Rancher, which is fine as a candy, but not something I want to drink. There also seems to be a ton of food dye in these Mocktails, which I'm not certain is necessary. This drink is day-glo green!  I'll stick with the Margarita and Mojito, which, although also have copious amounts of food dye, at least taste much better.

column9: love the flavor, hate the aspartame
column10: Unfortunately, the product description doesn't specify the ingredients of this.  Most sugar-free water enhancers contain aspartame, which I am highly allergic to.  I decided to take a chance, but was out of luck.  The Appletini flavor is excellent - and tastes very similar to a green apple Jolly Rancher (or even Apple Pucker). I loved it.  The product comes in packets, as a powder, designed to make 2 quarts.  So, this isn't a travel-friendly size but is good for home use.Too bad they didn't just use sucralose.  If aspartame doesn't bother you, I highly recommend these.  For me, I'll just stick with Mio and hope they offer a green apple flavor sometime in the future.

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column9: It does taste like green apples :-)
column10: Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini has a pleasant balance of sweet and tart, a realistic green-apple flavor, and the color of a Granny Smith apple. I don't have to care about the 'mocktail' part of it; it just tastes good, and I don't know where else I could get anything so close to Granny Smith juice without shaking the tree. Good job, Crystal Light!

I am a long-time fan of Crystal Light drink mixes, so I was excited to try this. I thought it was a wonderful drink. I wouldn't say it tastes like a martini though.. to a family member, I described it as "sour green apple punch." It's very tangy and refreshing, and very easy to make. I think it would be a good beverage for the summer, but the apple also puts me in mind of the fall. I would definitely recommend this, and I would also buy it again in the future.

I never  used to be a big fan of Crystal lite, however the New "Appletini" flavor has a bit of the sweet and tart that I am fond of, and turns the recognizable  Appletini green  when water is added.  I found that by adding a splash of ginger ale gave it more of a zing for those of us who crave a bit of effervescence.In case you like your Crystal less "lite"  you can add a dash of traditional vodka to make a quick and easy drink for those  drop-in guests or if you are like me and have zero bartending skills.I also like the fact that it comes in individual tubes and you can use the entire  packet to make a quart pitcher (which in my opinion is too weak) or use a smaller amount to make a glass. It is quite refreshing in a sour apple kind of way and I would buy it.
It's sad, but unless you like artificial sweetener a whole lot, this won't be for you any more than it was for me.

column9: Great Low Calorie Product for Those that are Looking
column10: Anytime I see a product trying to imitate another product, I'm sceptical.  I've tried Crystal Light many times and in may flavors, but honestly this does taste like appletini mix.  Personally I'm not a big fan of appletini's, but my girlfriend likes them.  I think it has a strong flavor for being low calorie.  Personally I liked the margariti flavor better, but that's just a preference.  Both were very full of flavor and worth the cost.  I will probably not buy these as much, but my girlfriend most likely will.  Either way, it impressed me.

A reviewer said that this tasted like Jolly Rancher green apple candy, and they are dead on right about that. This drink mix is so good. I don't like it as much as the Mojito, but it is eons better than the margarita. I hope Crystal Light puts these out in single serving packets. I'll buy them by the box load if they do.

This has become a new favorite in our family. I have been telling everyone about these crystal light mocktails. The mojito is my personal favorite. The appletini has a green apple like taste. I imagine that it tastes very much like an appletini might taste. It has a nice light refreshing flavor. My children and my husband have completely enjoyed this flavor. I will be ordering more of these.

As with other Crystal Light products, this powdered drink mix is potent (one packet makes a half-gallon), super low-calorie, pleasantly flavored/colored (a light green color, which is weird since the packaging is magenta), and quick to dissolve.These packets are a great way to whip up a bunch of appletini refreshment -- which can either be a refreshing alternative to lemonade, or a quick-and-easy cocktail mix for parties. I'm a guy, so Appletini isn't my favorite drink, but I did find it refreshing and keep some mixed up as an alternative to ice water when I want a little more flavor.Crystal Light, as with other artificially flavored drink mixes, actually balances out the alcohol flavor in mixed drinks; this Appletini mix is no exception.
