I find that the artificial sweeteners like Aspartame actually cut down alcohol more effectively than plain old sugar. This stuff mixes well with Vodka or white Rum.This isn't my favorite stuff to drink, but it does make a refreshing low-calorie alternative to other popular mixed drink flavors.

I love Crystal Light. LOVE it.  However, the crystal Light Mocktails Appletini flavored drink tastes awful to me. Either that or my taste buds are protesting the fact that there is no alcohol involved in any part of this drink!This product is simple, quick, and easy to mix.  The taste just wasn't for me and probably tons of people will like the taste. I am just not one of them.Natalie S. for Amazon Vine

column9: Confused. This doesn't taste enough like the Appletinis I've had to have the same name...
column10: When I first heard of Crystal Light's Mocktails line of flavors, I wasn't quite sure what to think. Are these intended as low-calorie hard drink mixers? Are you just supposed to drink the flavored waters made with these powders, and have that serve as your drink, minus the alcohol? The limited information on the back of the containers didn't help, although I suppose Crystal Light might not feel comfortable endorsing alcohol consumption...Either way, THIS particular flavor of Crystal Light's Mocktails line didn't help things. Granted, I haven't had many Appletinis, but comparing what this powder mixed up to the proper Appletini I tried at Carrabba's recently left me still scratching my head. This mix didn't make anything even close to what I tasted at the restaurant. The apple flavor wasn't all that "fresh" tasting, nor was it terribly strong or potently "apple-y", which I think would've improved this mix, had that been the case. It also didn't taste sweet enough, going by what my Appletini-loving friend said of the perfect Appletini. He described the perfect Appletini as tasting like a liquid jolly rancher with a kick. Alcohol or not (not, in the case of my mixture of this powder and water), this mix just, again, confused me. There wasn't enough apple taste to it, and I wasn't sure what else they were aiming for. Either way, they missed. If their Appletini doesn't even really taste like apple, should it even be called Appletini? If a tree falls in the woods, and no one's there to hear it...Crystal Light got a dead-on hit with their Crystal Light Moctails Mojito, 1.41-Ounce (Pack of 4) flavor. Appletini, however, is a total miss. Better luck next time...

I can't say that I've ever had anything like this. There's a strong apple taste and smell, but I have NO idea of what else. It's nice and sweet, and the color is pale green, which I prefer to bright, neon colors of kids' drinks. I realize I'm not being very helpful, but I'm at a loss for something to compare Appletini to!

Oh my !!This Appletini flavor is absolutely the BEST !!For being a simple Crystal Light drink that you tear open . pour into a pitcher , fill with cold water and enjoy--this is a FULL bodied apple flavored martini stirred not shaken and hold the gin !!!I love Crystal Light and I hope they continue to bring these fabulous non sugared soft drinks to us.Who misses regular sugared drinks and sodas ---when you can sit down and enjoy something like this ?Wonderful , simply wonderful.Try it..If you love the appletini taste..but can't always enjoy because of its sugar content..give this a try !!!It will not disappoint.

column9: Unlike the bright green ones, no industrial waste by-products
column10: We love these and buy them regularly despite the occasional hard one, because they are the only ones we've found that my wife won't have a chemical reaction to.The bright green color in the other brands comes from tartrazine (yellow 5), a chemical by-product of coal tar. It's been shown to increase irritability and other effects of ADD in some people (like my wife), and in others, actually causes serious allegric reactions. That's why other colors can be listed generically as "artificial color" in some products, but yellow 5 always must be listed explicitly.So, that pale "more like yellow" color one of the reviewers complained about is...well, that's the color of actual food - dried peas with wasabi on them. The bright green that seems so attractive on the other brands is someone's industrial waste disposal problem that they've lobbied to keep legal and convinced you to pay for the privilege of eating and feeding to your kids.I don't want to sound like a health nut, I eat lost of junky food. But after 20 years of undiagnosed ADD, my wife was finally advised to stay away from this color, and in the 10 years since, life is Better with a capital B. Her mood swings, anger and irritability that came from raging ADD symptoms are a memory. (One that comes back with a vengance every few years when she forgets to check the label on some food that doesn't seem remotely like it would have artificial yellow.)Do you know anyone who is perpetually irritated? Do your kids sometimes get way out of control? Well, that could be a million things. Really. But I know from first hand experience as well as research that yellow 5 is among the possible causes, and if you take a look at the labels on your food in your pantry, you'll see they've been feeding you this your whole life without your knowledge.If you'd like to see if yellow 5 is having an effect on you or your kids, try ditching all that stuff for a few weeks. And if you'd like a great crunchy spicy snack while you're doing it, munch on some of these - they're great!

5 lbs is like a lifetime supply!  these arent the bright green color we're used to, rather yellow brown (per the picture).  however, the taste is fantastic. the hardness/crunchiness others complain about doesnt bother me.  i like them crunchy.  Maybe dont buy if you use dentures or have weak teeth.  but then stay away from all crunchy foods.

These taste good, but most of the peas are too hard.  I'm afraid that I'm going to chip a tooth or something.  I like this product much better:  Hapi Hot Wasabi Peas, 9.9-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4), however they are more expensive.  I can find the Hapi brand at my local HEB, and I think I saw some at WalMart.  I don't think I will buy the Roland Feng Shui brand again.  I will finish up the bag and find something else somewhere.  I like the price, though, especially for such a big bag, and I have no complaints about the flavor.  Regarding the color, why should I care if they are green or yellow?  I just assumed that the ones that are really green in color are made that way with food coloring.

I just rec'd my 5lb bag.  The packaging survived the trip to Afghanistan - so no worries there.  The plastic packaging is sturdy and has a zip lock style seal across the top.  Now the peas!  I am a big fan of Hapi brand but was tired of paying the premium price.  I began my search for a reasonably priced veggie that packed a wasabi punch.  I found them on the first try.  Since I know Hapi best, I will make the comparison 1) Price:  Feng Shui is cheaper; 2) Taste: Hapi peas are a little sweeter and the wasabi is a tiny bit more mild that FS.  FS peas pack a bigger crunch - not tooth breaking crunch - more like a half popped popcorn kernel crunch.  Some of the FS peas have a huge wasabi punch.  In fact, I just ate one that brought a tear to my eye and prompted me to write this review.  3) Appearance: Hapi looks a little more appealing - but I am not sure that is a good thing.  How does a roasted or fried pea retain that neon color?  FS looks more natural and may be healthier.  Look at the nutritional information/ingredients for yourself.  The only real concern I have is that FS is a product of China.

Wasabi flavor is a bit weak and the pea flavor lingers in your mouth. Yeah, read that last sentence aloud to a friend. It's nice to have the big bag option, but would be nicer if they has a better flavor.
The peas were very hard, so hard they cracked one a tooth.  Other than that, they are spicy.They are also made in China.

Not really green peas... more like yellow?  They seem stale to us, definitely will not be buying these again.

I literally chipped 2 of my front bottom teeth on these after 1/2 of the bag I went through.Also in a handful they tasted like scrambled eggs and sulfer....So yeah I enjoyed it till I chipped my teeth (2) and tasted eggs....

There is also some variation in the hotness- every so often you'll get one that is very strong (I wish they were all really hot!).  Overall, these are very tasty and an excellent snack food.

Seriously, these are Kosher which means they have no funky ingredients.Love these peas, especially for the office.Crunchy, spicy and fun, they are a better alternative to chips and other fried snacks.This bag is the least expensive way to buy them and a great value/savings over the smaller packs Roland brand makes.
Got the peas and was worried about not being a bright color but i read the color is just that color not the pea.  These are great!!!

We had been buying Trader Joe's Wasabi Peas, but decided to give Roland Feng Shui a try since the reviews were decent and the price was cheaper.  We don't like them at all.Another reviewer made reference to "the occasional hard one".  Maybe we got a bad batch because almost the entire 5 lbs have been much too hard for our liking.  We like good crunch, but this is ridiculous!  I'm talking about the watch-out-or-you're-gonna-break-a-tooth kind of hard!Another thing we don't like is the level of wasabi heat.  It's very inconsistent.  Much of it is okay, some are too hot, and some are take-the-top-of-your-head-off HOT!!!We will be going back to Trader Joe's for our wasabi peas.  They may be more expensive, but they are SO much better.  Consistent level of crunch, even heat, and MUCH better flavor!

Very healthy as snack food goes, and I love the heat ! Thanks to the other reviewers I was prepared for the color and hardness but I'm OK with both.  The first pound lasted about a week. I suspect they're addictive.

This is an unbelievable sauce.  It is called a salsa simply because that is the word for sauce in Spanish (I hope I don't offend those of you that are familiar with latin food by saying that).  It is not a salsa like we think of in the States, no chunks of tomato or anything.  Simply a smooth sauce that can be used on anything to make it more twangy and awesome.  I have been searching for a way to get this in the States and am so happy to have found it!  BUY THIS SALSA.  When I lived in Florida they did not import it at the Latin grocery stores and it could only be bought by flying to Costa Rica.

While I realize there are costs to importing a product, this is way too much.  When in Costa Rica, I paid $2.00 a bottle for 280ml bottle retail in a tourist trap area, and was told later that I had paid too much at that.  This is a wonderful Salsa, but this is far to much money for it.

This "salsa" is used like catsup in Costa Rica...but better! It is made of different vegetables, and has a tang without heat. It is the key to some dishes, like the ubiquitous black beans and rice (Gallo Pinto). I was thrilled to find it available from Amazon. If only that was true of the cashew fruit wine...  Use it in traditional dishes, on eggs, sandwiches, in soups...it is very versatile and delicious! Enjoy, and, as they say in Costa Rica, Pura Vida!

column9: IF YOU EAT THIS, IT WILL SEEM LIKE YOU'RE PART OF MY FAMILY
column10: My great-grandmother made it, my grandmother made it, my mother made it, and now I make it! (I hope my daughters will make it and this chain will never end, connecting one generation to the next through food.) It is perfect for Thanksgiving.Here's the best recipe that is NOT printed on the packaging:Pour the corn into a big saucepan. Pour milk over the corn (my mother uses whole milk, I use skim. No one can taste the difference.). Cover the pan and put it in the refrigerator overnight. In the morning, put it on the stove and add butter (a stick for about three bags of corn. A third of a stick for a single bag, etc.) Add salt, pepper and about a quarter cup of sugar (for three bags of corn). Put the heat on low and stir every now and then for HOURS. Seriously. HOURS. Like, maybe, four hours. Or six hours if you want. It doesn't matter, you just let it stew,  making your whole kitchen smell like family and warmth and happiness and love. Add more milk every now and then when it gets too dry. Add more sugar every now and then, just a bit. Add more salt and pepper before you serve it. It should be the consistency of thick oatmeal. Not runny at all. You can eat it with a fork. It will make you happy. It will make you somehow, through the strangeness of the internet, connected to my family. I'll be happy knowing there are other people out there eating my great-grandmother's recipe.Happy Holidays!

This product makes special oocasions and Holidays come to life. It brings back Childhood happy memories. I've been having Cope's Dried Corn for Holidays since forever. It makes our family complete for special dinners even if everyone can't be there. It is easy to prepare and so good to eat. I have not found another product to compete with Cope's Dried Corn, it's the BEST.

We've been feasting on Cope's Dried Corn for several decades now after we first tasted it in Pennsylvania Dutch country.  It is unbelievably good, especially in the creamed version (the last recipe on the back of the box).  Try it -- I guarantee you'll love it.

It's terrific on broiled shrimp and chicken as well as making a good dipping sauce for all sorts of things.  I've tasted other sauces LIKE this, but none with as good a blance of flavors. column9: Eat this EVERY morning for breakfast...still not sick of it.
column10: I am a grits addict. These aren't going to be like the grits you get at your favorite soul food restaurant in the south, but it's satisfying enough, especially for its convenience.  Plus, its instant grits or no grits at all where I live.Each packet is only 100 calories, and has enough flavor that I usually don't add anything (even original is tasty on its own).Won't keep you full for very long, so I suggest adding a lil protein or fruit to your breakfast.Otherwise, its what I wanted and expected.

Pretty good sampling of their standard flavors.  I believe the only flavors missing are the ham ones (Gravy & Ham and Ham & Cheese), which I'd love to try.The bacon flavor is good, but the bacon is a little odd.  Cheddar Cheese is the best, and Butter is good, too.  Plus, each pack (12 per box) is only 100 calories.  Good for a warm snack when you're feeling nibbly.My only real complaint is that I'd rather they ditched the original flavor and replaced it with something more interesting.

Once the water is done, simply mix it with some grits in a bowl and breakfast is ready.  Now we won't run out anytime soon.  That's a good thing.

Growing up in the north and having naturally eclectic tastes I tried these grits years ago on a family vacation in the south. My family has loved them for years but they aren't available where i live, well only in butter and original in certain stores. I love the cheese and the bacon is to die for. Now I have more grits than I could feed an elephant and I am happy! They are warm, salty, creamy,buttery, bacony, cheesy, corny goodness. I have been known to add extra cheese, bacon or butter for an even more decadent meal or snack. Only complaint: I wish the variety had more bacon packets and included ham and cheese and red eye gravy varieties. Otherwise, I am very happy. Way to go Amazon and Quaker!

This is my first time trying flavored grits. I am so used to the original my mom grew us up on. I must say they are super good, my mom loves them and so does my nephew. My mother took a couple boxes to work for her friends and they all love them. This is such a great breakfast that is good for the whole family. They're grits. They're great, of course. I travel in California, so I need to have instant grits, or I won't have any at all. This is the only way I would be able to buy instant grits. Very pleased with the stuff. Will buy again when I get low.

It was not specified on this site and I did not know until I received the product.  This is something that should be clear on the product page especially since the FDA has specifically warned about chicken jerky products for pets that are made in China.  I am going to ask for a refund.

Received product in time given.  They are tasty and nice.  If you are a green tea person.  You will like these.

You do have to kind of have an quired taste for them though. The texture and taste may seem a little strange at first. I have one left now. I recomend to at least try these if you haven't had them because they really are good! :)

column9: Delicious chips cooked in coconut oil.
column10: I love these chips.  They taste delicious and aren't overly sweet, just a hint of sweetness.  They are also cooked in coconut oil which I prefer to eat over omega-6 rich vegetable oils.  The chips contain a small amount of added sugar.I buy these from Trader Joe's directly and enjoy their non-organic banana chips also which are 99c for an 8oz bag.

column10: Good tasting, nice firm texture, dutch licorice.  Not over powering salty, less so than Zout drops, but much more flavorful.  For me, the harder the licorice, the better.  So I open all the packages as soon as I get them, dump them in a big box and let them set as long as I can before devouring. I was pleasantly surprised with this licorice and now I'm a repeat buyer of this product.  Me and my German relatives love this licorice as well as salmiak pastillen, coins, katjes katzen.

This licorice was good, especially for those who like European licorice.  It's not too salty but still has a little zing to it.  It's pretty chewy, and has a generally good, full flavor.  Not the best licorice I've ever tasted, but still pretty good.
I AM A LICORICE LOVER AND THIS IS THE BEST!Use it in my tea, instead of sugar. Would recommend it to anyone who likes this candy type.
The nuts are the best if you like spicey!!! I have ordered them several times... and will order again... awesome!

However, the second order tasted terrible (burnt) and I ended up throwing all 3 bags in the trash. Consequently, I will never order these again. One product that I continue purchasing is the Ass Kickin Habenero beef jerky. The heat may be too much for some, but I enjoy it and the flavor is great. It is a bit on the sweet side though.

Our two cats just love the Purina Fancy Feast Gravy Lovers, White Fish and Tuna.  The smell isn't bad or too fishy either.  I highly recommend this variety for all the "picky" felines and their pet parents.  Great find!

I have five cats so getting all of them to like a food can be difficult. I give them wetfood as a weekly treat and this is the only type they all love and devour! They all love the gravy and two in particular mostly just lick the gravy so this is more food for my buck!

column9: awesome you would never know it was sugar free.

I use this all the time in my soups and stews the seasonings are great. When the recipe calls for canned tomatos I use rotel ,and what a difference.

I have a hard time trying to find this product in the grocery stores-they always just have the "Original" type. Should have known I'd find it on Amazon! And what a great deal!! If you like your food spicy (Like I do) - try this "Mexican" style. It's the 'Bomb'!! I use it in just about everything from soup to sandwiches to stews,etc. And it's great just by itself! Salsa anyone? If you like it spicy- Give this a try!! >^_^<

never tried rotel my entire life until now, what a waste! I'd heard about it a lot, but always dismissed it as "ok, so it's some canned tomates that's popular in Texas, whatever" ... oh well. at least now I know - it is great!next time I'll have to order the hot version. although these were surprisingly spicy and the cilantro is what I really like about it.no more salsas in glass jars, this is much tastier and less expensive.only 4 stars b/c BPA can lining, yuck. otherwise it would have been a solid 5.
a new, unopened bag, just as described, took longer than i had hopped, but worth the wait.

I have try just about all the different K cup flavors and the one that stand out is the JetFuel, That is number ONE if you want a good strong cup of coffe, 2nd in my book is the dark french rousted is just a little milder but very good flavor and satisfying cup of coffe.

Being from NYC, the international hub, we find everything and anything from around the world here.  It's only a buck a stick at my local international store so of course I had to try it.First reaction mouth to candy contact.  Chew Chew Chew... WTH?  They must've put in the wrong flavor because this tastes just like regular white mint Mentos!  Ten chews later.... ahhh...  a bit of licorice flavor, it's nice, not strong at all, just the essence of licorice.  Here comes the weird part.  Ten more chews and it starts to get SALTY!? LOL...  Now we have this savory licorice with a dash of mint going on in my mouth.  It's odd.  Goes on for the life of the candy, about one minute of chewing.  It was such an odd taste.  Last reaction was... OK, I need another one! Repeat until pack is finished!Sounds like fiction doesn't it?  I assure you this is exactly how this candy goes down.  I usually like a stronger licorice but this was, "different" in a good way.  Mentos,.. you've done it again!

I bought these for my daughter who LOVES licorice and Mentos.  Your distributor however, seems a bit flakey.  They took forever (from seattle)!!! They indicted that they 'couldn't find them' in their warehouse.  She is however, very content with the product.
Delicious!  One of the few gluten-free products I think might be worth the money because you have no idea that it's gluten-free based on taste.

I can only speak to the chocolate chip cookies. They are very moist chewy and flavorful. They are NOT gritty at all like so many gluten free products. I highly recomend them. The only downside is that like so many GF products they pack a lot of calories. They are very tasty though.

column9: Great cookies even if they weren't G-Free
column10: These may have saved my wife's life in the first two weeks after she found out she had Celiac's Disease. They are great by any standard. Came all the way to Florida and were still fresh-tasting and moist. I only got a couple of bites -- my wife hoarded the rest. Any cookie afficiaonado would love these.

These cookies are really great.  My kids love them.  We had a problem with delivery and when contacted, the company was courteous and quickly sent us out another box.  I recommend these cookies and this company very highly.  We will definitely order from them again.  Thanks!

I wanted something to snack on in between meals, so I bought some of this trail mix. I'm not familiar with the brand, but I must say this is some of the best trail mix I've had in a while. It has just the right balance of saltiness and sweetness. They didn't skimp on the dried fruit like some other mixes I've had (although I wish it had more almonds :). On its own, the coconut is kind of tasteless but there isn't much of it so it wasn't a problem for me. And as some one else mentioned, it's healthier than cookies. Also, it comes in resealable packages, so if you're on the go its convenient to just grab one and throw it in your purse/bag. Overall, definitely recommended if you like fruit and nut trail mixes.

I really liked this product but in my opinon it had WAY too many nuts in it-but then again it does say Fruit'n'Nut mix.Still too many nuts-I  picked half of them out and gave them to the squirrels-so they also like this product!!

One word: Scrumptious!!!Daughter, Hubby, Myself, Parents, Siblings, all love it!Great combo. Most mixes have candy. This one doesn't!. Sweet for kids because of the papaya and pineapple. Love it Love it Love it! Have ordered 2 times within one month. Good for school snacks too.
Forget the cookies & sugar - this is a healthy snack & a great gift idea
This is my favorite trail mix.The fruit,nut ratio is perfectly balanced.My order always arrives quickly.I would definately recommend this product to everyone.
I got these as a healthy lunch snack.  Taste great.  The price seems to go up and down so be mindful when you order or if you use the subscribe and save.

I was not familiar with this brand but decided to give it a try because of the reasonable price.  It is excellent.  The fruit and nuts are fresh and the mix of fruit and nuts is perfect for my taste.  It includes the large slices of coconut which I really like in a trail mix as well as many other kinds of fruit.  The pumpkin seeds are an interesting addition with a very mild flavor.  None of the fruits or nuts overwhelm the others.  All in all this is a really good blend at a great price.
I really loved this product..not too Bad a price for such a goodtasting snack and good Nutrition..Thanks for having this at amazon.

column4: B. WILLIAMS "B WILLIAMS LOOKING FOR LIGHT"
column10: What's Not to Like !!! Straight from the bag, sprinkled oncearal, combined with scrambled eggs, mixed with veggies; Emerald Harmony Deluxe Fruit 'n Nut Trail Mix is a product we keep onthe kitchen counter for use in anything and everything. Alwayscoming up with some new way to use it. A Great Topping forIce Cream...Of Course, we found it here on Amazon.com

These are really good and healthy. Use the "Subscribe & Save" option because you can always have them skip a shipment (or cancel whenever). Watch the price though as it fluctuates greatly. I paid 9.51 for mine (including shipping with "Subscribe & Save").

column9: Good trail mix, just a bit sweet
column10: This trail mix is a good, fresh product, just a little too sweet for my taste. I am mixing it with some raw nuts and seeds to cut the sweetness and that's working perfectly for me. My grandchildren and I are certainly enjoying it.

I was pretty excited about ordering this particular brand, since I'm a big fan of trail mix, and I had never tried the Harmony brand before. I can tell you now, after tasting, that there is way too much sweetener added to the fruits. I'm not understanding why extra sugar is needed, on top of the natural fruit taste. Some of the fruit is powdered so much, it tastes like a chewy piece of sugar. I read the reviews before ordering this product, and was aware of extra sweetener, but I wanted to give it a chance. I wish I hadn't, lol. There are plenty of raisins and peanuts. A few almonds sprinkled in, and (when you can actually find them) sunflower seeds. I'll be passing the additional bags on to family and friends.

The trail mix is delicious.  We took some on a road trip and it was a healthy snack we could enjoy in the car.The only recommendation I have to improve the mix is to make the pieces of coconut larger.  I am a coconut lover.Otherwise I think the mixture is a nice blend of dried fruit and nuts. I was impressed with the variety of trail mixes onAmazon.Amazon Verified Purchase
Very tasty snack.  I have re-ordered this item twice already.  Too bad the price increased $4.00 since my last order though.
Perfect mix for snacking.  Can't leave it alone. Great deal for the money - you can't go wrong. Fresh and fruity.

column9: A bit on the boring side
column10: The Good: 10oz bag (leave one at the office, one at the home office, one in my bag etc) and the resealable bag to retain existing freshness, not too heavy on the preservatives.  The Bad or Blah: a boring mix....the coconut (in most of my bags) was pulverized to the point one couldn't just take a bit of a piece of coconut (think flat bits, not shredded, but tiny), I prefer a variety of sizes in my dried fruits whereas the papaya pieces were all perfectly squared....and the pumpkin kernels were tasty, but some of the smallest I've ever seen.  Would I buy this again or suggest to my friends?  Probably not.
There's not a lot of the premium fruit and nut stuff in here.  Mostly peanuts and raisins.  Some coconut shavings, a few almonds, lots of dried sub-par fruit.  I won't be buying again...

This is a very good mix at a reasonable price. I snack on trail mix at work and put 1 of these out in the snack area with the standard pretzels and candy. My fellow employees must have liked since it was gone within a day
Great mix of dried fruit and nuts.  Tasted very fresh!I will look to purchase more when I run out of my stash.

column9: Good taste but prefer more variety
column10: Good tasting mix. Wouldve preferred more variety like Archer farms which is great.But I read its a lot more expensive here than getting at Target

Aside from the health dose of sulfite you're getting, the snack itself is alright.  The pieces are ok, the fruit are all frozen vegetable size, the mix is quite even.  The nut is sort of fresh.Everything is really middle of the road.  At the current subscribe-and-save price, it makes a good pantry item.
ordered this as a healthy snack, and everyone seems to like it around my household, the packaging wasn't the best so one bag ripped open during shipment, other than that it's all good.

Emerald Harmony Deluxe Fruit I shared with family, friends, FaceBook and Church members. The reply I receive great and delicious. The Trail Mix eat 1/4 for snack, with cereal and with salad. Don't just take my word, try all the Trail Mix, great price and size bags, I can't found  this brand Trail Mix in stores in Tallahassee, Florida.
Been munching on my nuts for a while. Lots of Fruit and Nuts.  More fruit than nuts I'd have to say.  Planters nuts has a more roasted flavor but this lacks that.  Overall good mix to munch on.
This trail mix was not bad. I wish it had more nuts...or more nut variety. Mostly peanuts and dried cranberries I guess. But overall still pretty tasty.

This product has a great flavor and is handy to bring hiking, to the beach, and other day trips.  I really like how its a decent protein/fruit/roughage source and that it does not have to be refridgerated.I would like to be able to buy it in higher qunatities at a better price though and that is why it doesnt get the fifth star.
Great product, reasonable price. A great addition to my oatmeal in the morning. Thanks. If n when I run out I will look you up for more.

These are very addictive, must learn to ration them, or you'll put on pounds, like I did. But for the price, they are a great savings over the larger bag found in Supermarket displays. The supermarket price is .98 a bag, while these are 50c a bag, I have bought 2 shipments so far.

column9: Not as flavorful as I had imagined!
column10: I guess I had too high a hope for this little cake.  I found it to be quite dry and lacking in nuts.  The cinnamon flavor was really rich and delicious though.  I will not ever buy it again but you should give it a try since it is so cheap and you can get it as 'one' instead of the usual multiples that Amaazon sells.  It was a unique flavor for a one time trial so I am glad I bought it but I don't need to repeat that mistake again.  Maybe the one I got was old though the expiration date was fine.  I love cinnamon so that made it worth actually eating along with a whole cup of tea to wash it down.  I say....give it a try like I did.

Just about anytime shortening is combined with cinnamon and sugar the end result is going to be good, so this is fine but not a wow. It's an dense eleven inch log, and I prefer my cinnamon pastries to be fluffier and sweeter. It's solidness made it good with ice cream, but of course that ups the decadence level.I purchased this as part of a $25 (or more of course, I managed to make spend just over $25) order using Amazon's Add-on program which meant that shipping was free. The items in the Add-on program are all inexpensive, mostly interesting food items so part of the fun was selecting what to try.

This is some seriously good pasta.  I've seen this at my local supermarket, but the cost per package is about 50% more than the price here.  I've ordered a few different varieties from Amazon, and they're all wonderful.The Fiesta (tri color) fettuccine is one of my favorites for cream sauces and for lighter "non-chunky" mixtures (like a nice bright pesto or sun-dried tomato toss).One of the biggest advantages is the time it takes to prepare -- this is NOT like the hard dried pasta you find among the cheaper store brands.  This stuff really takes only 3-5 minutes (tops!) to cook to al dente.  It's that fast.  And the flavor!  Wow!  It tastes like the best fresh pasta you can find.  The packages are 12 oz, but you end up with about the same amount of cooked pasta as you would from a 16-oz package of the cheap stuff.I'm sold -- and will continue to buy this stuff from Amazon as long as they carry it.

This is the best tasting pasta ever!! The recipes on the back are wonderful & so easy to prepare!You can have a gourmet meal in 20 minutes or less, with items found in your Kitchen & impress your guests!!

column4: Jennifer L. Lyle "Book, Techno, Purple, and F...
column10: This dip is wonderful, very creamy. The cucumber and dill I think are light, it's not overpowering. I ate mine with plain chips and pretzels and liked them both. I am going to order more and try with veggies - gotta save calories somewhere! (Don't buy this if you're trying to eat healthy!!) I am hooked, it's addictive! You mix this with sour cream and mayo, so you could save calories by using low fat varities. It's a good buy here as well, as I couldn't find any cheaper than $3 a package online. Enjoy! :)

Great tasting mints!  Not to spicy or hot, just right.  Great to know it is organic and the Newman name helps since money from the sale is used to help kids.  Price is reasonable and I love the packaging, easy to carry and find in your pocketbook (at least for women).

I love cinamon.  In fact I crave it.  I'll try anything cinnamon.These cina-mints have an earthy quality as described by another reviewer.  They are not near as hot as Altoid cinnamon and you get a lot less in the can.  They are thicker than Altoids If you are a cinnamon mint chewer you can easily buzz through a can of these in no time, without sweating up a storm.These are also vegitarian, Altoids are not.

I was traveling with a friend who had these and once I tried then, I couldn't stop sneaking into her purse to grab more.  They are nice and cinnamony and even though the box says HOT, I would not consider them to be spicy.  I looked all over for them (Whole Foods, Safeway, Trader Joe's, etc) and came up empty handed.  Thank goodness they are here on Amazon and you can buy them in bulk AND get a discount for signing up for a subscription.  I adore the tin tiger cases, which hold up to being tossed around my purse and stay shut so the mints don't all dump out at the bottom of my purse.  Anyway, I'm a repeat buyer, and totally recommend if you like cinnamon!
Nice! Cinnamon, not spicy or hot - they have kind of an 'earthy' taste.Just right on the flavor- tasty and addictive!

column9: Quite good, strong and not too sweet
column10: I like cinnamon candies. Hot Tamales Giant Bag (4.5 pounds)  were my favorite, but to preserve my teeth I needed a non-chewy candy. Newman's Own are great. The tiny little mints come in a nice reusable tin, the flavor is just right, not sweet and cinnamonny enough. I love the convenience of  Amazon. I find what I need, my Prime membership ensures quick & free shipping on almost everything.
Rather than a mint, this is more like cinnamon candy. It is hard for me to not just crunch into the little disc rather than wait. It is delicious and I enjoy the (not so spicy) cinnamon flavor.

then you will like these. I was a fan of cinnamon Altoids for years then I tried Newman's and was hooked. Altoids logo is "curiously strong", well sometimes their logo should be "ridiculously strong"!  I don't even eat Altoids anymore, these are my new favorite!!
I love cinnamon. They are a nice blend of sweet and spicy without being too hot. Also nice to find mints that are organic and not full of artificial sweeteners.

These mints are tasty with a nice kick.  I can't chew gum due to jaw pain and really enjoy a mint after eating to freshen up my breath.  After realizing that many mints contain aspartame, which I'm trying to avoid these days, I searched and found these to my delight.  I haven't seen them in stores, so I'll be ordering other flavors in the future online.

These beige mints are 10 kCal for 2.  They are made in Mexico and distributed by a US company.  Very similar packaging to the Altoids cinnamon mints, but a little less cinnamon.  If you're not looking for ultra-spicy, look no further!

I love these mints and when they were no longer available locally I was delighted to find them not only on Amazon but on a scheduled delivery!  Keep a box in the kitchen, one in the car and one in my purse at all times.  Love 'em.

column9: You can't eat just one of these mints.
column10: These mints are really good.  Just the perfect cinnamon taste. Not quite as hot as I prefer but after 3 the taste gets stronger. You can't eat just one. They are tasty. Best mint on the market.

column9: Jello Pumkin Spice Pudding is WOW!!!!
column10: I found this Jello Pumpkin Spice pudding in clearance after Christmas at my local gorcery store.  I didn't know Jello made pumpkin pudding, but I grabbed all of the pudding they had because it was 38 cents each and went home and tried it and fell madly in love.  When I make pumpkin pie, I double the spices the recipe calls for and even add more cinamin because I love it.  This pudding is exactly how I make pumpkin pie.  I love tasting the spices in the pudding and Jello made a fantastic pudding, the problem is that the stores I have gone to have the same pudding all the time (chocolate, vanilla, pastachio and butterscotch) and they don't sell the other Jello puddings and now that Christmas is over there is no pumpkin pudding to be found.  I want to buy this stuff in bulk because I love pumpkin and will eat it year round. Try this pumpkin pudding.  You will love it.

Bought a box of this at locally...I wish I had bought more!!!  This was REALLY really good!  I made the recipe on the box for Pumpkin Spice Mousse (basically, make the pudding and add 1 cup cool whip) My husband and I LOVED it!  I'd definitely purchase this one in bulk.
This has got to be the best instant pudding I have ever had!!I've been waiting for fall to arrive again hoping to get this pudding again... Let's go Jell-O.... I need my PUMPKIN SPICE PUDDING!!! :)

column9: odd.  tastes too salty.  something's wrong here
column10: I hadn't seen this in California but was visiting family in Georgia and had to pick up a box & try it.  Can't recommend it.  I enjoy dozens of great pumpkintreats over the holidays and this one, prepared with 2 percent milk not whole milk needs to go back to the drawing board.  I found classic turtle, seasonal flavorto try next.  Wish me well. . . .

I bought this mostly on an impulse, mostly because I have a rule that between the months of October and November I must try any pumpkin related food I see.  Unfortunately, I didn't get to try all that much in the way of pumpkin product this year, so I'm trying to atone.  So, Pumpkin Spice Pudding entered my home.  This is pretty much one of the greatest pumpkin based items I've ever had save one thing.  Why, Jello?  Why?  Why did you put SO much cinnamon in this stuff?  It's *almost* enough to ruin it, but not quite.  The fantastic pumpkin flavoring is enough to overwhelm the overuse of the cinnamon, but let this be a lesson on any future editions of this pudding, cut the cinnamon by about half and you have a 5-star product on your hands.

Betterdecor is a five star company and they are helpful with the shipping.  The order was placed quickly and shipped on time.  The water bamboo arrived in a well packaged container The bamboo was as tall as advertised and  in very healthy condition.  I enjoy looking at the water bamboo.  The bamboo is 48 inches tall. As an extra I received a plant fertilizer to keep my bamboo healthy.

I'm a real fan of iced coffee and was looking forward to this K-cup flavor. What a disappointment! No matter how it was prepared and no matter what was added to it, it simply tasted awful. Letting another flavor cool and then add ice would make a far better cup of iced coffee.

column9: Not what you are looking for.
column10: If you have ever had Douwe Egberts Kona Blend coffee at a restaurant you know how smooth and delicious it is. I did and have hunted for that taste ever since. For anyone, like me, thinking you had found it, continue to seek. This is not bad coffee, (that is why I gave it 2 stars) it just does not have the flavor of the restaurant variety DE Kona blend. If that is what you desire, do not spend your money here. This has no more flavor than a pot of Folgers.
Coming from the UK I always like to purchase chocolate from UK for my kids Christmas stocking/s as a surprise from Santa

column9: Damn Dr. Willi, why you got to be so tasty?
column10: Bought a box of these tasty morsels at a local German grocery. They are freaking delicious. The potatoes are super easy to make, nothing but a pan required. They taste like a cross between breakfast potatoes and scalloped potatoes. Add a little cheese and pepper and you are loving life. One box serves about two people. Much cheaper on amazon than in a store.

A friend gave me this product and I was so taken with the flavor I went all over looking for it, only to find it at Amazon. The shipment was sent quickly and we ordered several of their products and they were all delicious.If you want to add a German flair to your meal, this is the products to buy.
I wish they were bigger but our Australian shepherd LOVES it. should have ordered another one because hes had it for an hour and is half way done with it will order more!

My dog absolutely loved this Churpi Chew, but it only took him about 10 minutes to have it crunched into pieces and eaten. He's a lab mix who I would say is a moderate chewer - nothing extreme. For the price, I expected it to last more than 10 minutes!

column9: One of my family's favorite snacks
column10: We have tried several brands of dried apple chips, crisps... and this is out favorite.  Some are too dry or leathery, and I find another popular brand to airy (for lack of a better word).  These are just right; crip without being tough.  It is great to find a snack which feels like a treat, which has no harmful ingredient, and beyond that is actually healthy.  My kids love them and so do I (though I always feel guilty when I take a bag, thinking I am stealing their treats).  Now I do not have to have the guilt anymore, not with a 60 bags on the way!The price/ bag is literally 1/4 of what we pay for these in the supermarket! I generally wait for them to go on sale an then I stock up (though, it seems never enough as they disappear rather quickly).  Amazon's price on the bulk (60 bag) box is so reasonable that these can go in the lunch box every day!  I am much happier being able to send these into school than just about any other "treat" I can think of.I do not have a bag in front of me no, so I can not list all the nutritional information.  These do have sugar (which the original chips do not).  The cinnamon is natural (they taste like apple slices dipped in cinnamon sugar) so if you are trying to avoid sugar yourself, or for your kids you might want to look at the original chips.  These *do not* however have high fructuse corn syrup, trifats, sulphur, or any weird ingredients.  They really are natural in the true sense of the word which is something increasingly difficult to find.I revisited my review after noting that the size of the bag is different from what I have bought in the market.  The bags we buy are 2.4 oz which usually cost $4 retail or $2 when trhey are on sale.  This still makes this a very good deal, but not what I had originally thought (given that you are getting 1/3 as much).  One thing that puzzles me though is that these are listed as 100 calorie packs.  The 2.4 oz bags list a calorie count of 140.  if the nutritional information is accurate that would mean the proportion of sugar to apples is high in the calorie count packs.  that does not make any sense to me (that they would put more sugar in the calorie count packs) but I can only recount what I see.  I hope this is inaccurate, but can not say that it is.
You can't go wrong with these. They are delicious, but don't expect them to last long. The kids ate them right up!
product is good with the exception for it didn't not arrived when it was suppose to! great snacks for the kids!

i used to buy apple chips all the time and thought they would be a great treat for the kids, but i was wrong. there are STEMS & seeds in every bag so far, what a bad reminder of why i quit buying them years ago!! i love the flavor, but they really need to fix whatever the problem is (you'd think years would be long enough to learn people don't want to eat the core, stems, or seeds)

column9: SENECA CINNAMON APPLE CHIPS (7 OZ BAGS)
column10: Order received in just a couple of days.  Loved that I didn't have to go to the market.  Chips are fresh and perfect for snacks.  Highly recommend product.
THESE ARE FABULOUS!  I just wish there was a little less added sugar, but I definitely crave these.  DELICIOUS, YUMMY, WONDERFUL!!!!

So I thought that since I had never been ripped off by Amazon I would continue shopping for things on the site. I live in Texas and the only place to get these chips were from out of town or directly from the company EXCEPT they charge an arm and a leg for shipping a box of these chips to ones house. With that said i decided to purchase them from this seller and was VERY unsatisfied... I was truly disappointed in my purchase. Below are the reasons why:1. The bags were ALL deflated2. The apple chips were stale3. Some of the bags were opened4. There weren't exactly 60 as it mentioned5. The expiration date one some of the bags were over dueThe upside was that shipping costs were low and they delivered in a timely manner. Other than that there really was not much else good to say about this product. At this point I would have gladly spent the 20 dollars on shipping chargers from Seneca than to have bout them from the seller.
These worked great for the breast cancer awareness bake sale. They looked great, showed up in perfect condition, and tasted good.

My dog loves these things and although they are expensive, I feel good knowing that these are a much safer alternative to rawhides.  For those that aren't aware, rawhides do not digest very quickly and can clump inside of a dogs stomach resulting in an expensive visit to the vet. So to get on with the review...The Pros:  They are 100% all natural free-range, grass-fed beef.  They are made with no additives, no chemicals, and free of hormones and antibiotics.  They are human grade processed and USDA approved.  The are fully digestible, low in fat, high in protein and help reduce tartar and keeps your dog's teeth and gums healthy.The Cons:  They smell. They really smell... And they are expensive.  Value Pet Supplies has some of the best pricing I have seen.  I use to buy these things at the specialty pet supply stores (but they sell them for seven to nine bucks a piece) so when I found these on-line for more than half the price, I was ecstatic.  One thing to note.  Shop around at different websites.  The best pricing I have found is to go directly out to either the Value Pet Supplies Website or the Best Bully Sticks Website.
I give My Service dog these when we are in the car and also when she is resting around my home she love's them alot. Especialy in the car because she gets car Sick.

column9: Not the Jumbo size I come to expect locally
column10: I ordered these chew sticks thinking they were Jumbo in size.  Found they were not and my dog can chew them up in less than 15 minutes.  The Jumbo bully sticks I find locally are about 3 fingers in thickness with the same length as those sold here (12") and take a couple of days to chew.  Not at all what I expected for $90.00.  Will be going with Merrick or local from now on.

I purchased this item after reading the only review that was posted about this product.The product has a very offensive odor. My husband compared it to a slaughter house odor. While our five month old puppyChewed on the stick for several hours,my daughters dog was visiting and finished his in less than ten minutes. I am very disappointed in the product and will not be purchasing again.

column9: jumbo bully sticks satisfy my hearty chewers
column10: I ordered these jumbo bully sticks, in the hope they would live up to their advertisement, and they do.  I marvel at reviews where owners talk about their dogs working on bully sticks for days--not my two!  My dogs were going through regular-sized bully sticks in about 10 minutes!  They literally sit and salute the minute I bring out these treats for them.  Absolute peace reigns in the house for anywhere from 30-60 minutes.  I am completely satisfied with the quality, and my dogs give them a solid 5 paws rating.

Popcorn Indiana Smoked Cheddar Kettlecorn is my all-time favorite snack!  OK, to be honest, it's been my dinner on more than one occasion.  I've searched frantically all over town for this stuff when my usual source sold out.  You may be thinking, cheese popcorn?  orange powder all over my fingertips?  no thanks.  That's not this stuff -- it's rich, crisp, deeply cheddary and smoky, with a trace of sweetness all at the same time.  Wow!!

column9: Someone please remove this stuff from my home...
column10: ...before I eat it all!  I've actually known for a long time that this stuff was good...  ...and I stopped eating it for SPECIFICALLY that reason: It's TOO damn good.  Really, it is.  I was in a Walgreens the other day, with some time to kill, saw a nice, small bag, and thought "Oh, Hell - Just get it!".  Didn't touch it until today, and man, oh man...  This stuff is going to be the death of me, I know it.  I must resolve to never buy it again.  Someone needs to come here & remove it from my house, because I'm going to make myself fat!  It's OK, you can tie my hands while you take it out.  I'll probably try to fight you for it, though...

Product exactly as advertised: 8 bottles containing 2oz ready to eat formula.Although I breastfeed, I don't have the time nor inclination to pump milk to mix with baby cereal or 'water down' pureed food so I use this formula. Ready-to-eat in 2oz was the perfect convenience, especially since the lid screws back on. If these had a pop-top or tear-off-foil top that could not be resealed they would not be very convenient. My baby showed no signs of tummy problems when I introduced this formula. I cannot comment on how these would work as a bottle with the nipple attached because I never used it as such.The bottle cannot be recycled in my CT town's municipal recycling program. I considered deducting a star for that! Alternatively Similac really should use a biodegradable container such as those made with corn.

column9: Very convenient but TOO EXPENSIVE HERE

Although I absolutely love the size of these bottles, I would suggest that you shop around before purchasing them.  I found them cheaper at our local drugstore.

column9: I'll take my cake without MOLD on it
column10: ..that was a complaint from another customer who posted pics of her moldy cake on a popular social networking site, right after I posted my disappointment with the company. It solified my position to notify potential customers of what they are getting here.**** I'm writing this review as someone who received a FREE cake.I was so excited to receive my Fantasicake, but my excitement quickly turned to disappointment. My fantasicake was more like a sweet lover's nightmare! Icing everywhere! I thought I could salvage it by scraping it off the box but was caked up and dried. It looks like the lid for the icing wasn't completely sealed and all the icing spilled in the box during transit.Fantasicakes DOES NOT INCLUDE ANY ICE PACKS during transit, nor do they put your cake in styrofoam. They pack it in a plastic bag (unsealed, not shrinkwrapped etc) in a cardboard box. During the height of the summer, many areas reach triple degrees, and the UPS warehouses and trucks are even hotter. The fact that they don't put ANY gel icepacks to help keep your cake cool during transit, ESPECIALLY IN THE SUMMERTIME, really is shocking to me.My cake was warm when it arrived so i took it out of the shipping box, opened the lid of the cake box just to look at it, and icing was everywhere. I took a couple pics to show the company and immediately popped it in the fridge to cool down. During that time, I emailed Fantasicakes to tell them about the spilled icings and suggested that more care should be taken in packaging the items.The response I got was interesting. They know about the hot weather and clearly they know they don't include icepacks. They also know how rough delivery people are with packages. Offering me an extra cake with next purchase that could possibly be molded by the time it arrives? NO THANKS.Again, It must also be noted that I'm writing this review as someone who received a FREE cake. I have no axe to grind here. I want to give you guys an honest impression of what you will get from this company. While I thought the prices were great for a delivered cake, I can't take chances on sending a gift that is inadequately packaged for a perishable item and may arrive moldy. Prior to receiving the cake, I intended to purchase one for all the older women in the family as "just because" gifts. Not now!

As soon as the cake arrived at the door we had to cut some pieces and give it a try. Wow!! This is the most delicious and moist coffee cakes I have ever had. I was hoping to maybe freeze part of the cake so we could enjoy it again later, well my family had other plans. It was so good that we all gobbled it up within a day.

I have tried many teas in my life , & this by far has gone over the top with me ... I have tried 4 different flavors , all of which were very satisfying. The one I liked best is Tazo Chai , it has a spice flavor that just captivates the taste buds . It may not be for every one , but since I like the taste & smell of exotic spices , this does very well for me . I will buy it & keep it on hand as much as possible..

This tea takes me back in time.  When I was really young, my mom used to brew up big batches of iced tea.  First, she would get the jugs ready, and then pour hot hibiscus tea into them, and add a lot of ice.  We'd set them out in the sun and the natural light in mid-day would make the tea naturally sweet, as it brewed.  Those were definitely good times.  What better past time in the summer, than to brew a nice pot of iced tea on a sunny afternoon?  Tazo Passion Tea doesn't fail to disappoint.  For starters, one of the main ingredients blended to make it so delightful is hibiscus (along with orange peel, rosehips, cinnamon, lemongrass, natural tropical flavors, citric acid, licorice and red poppy).  If you like your tea on the (slightly) tart side, I reccomend you drink this unsweetened and relish its wonderful, natural flavors.  However, if you prefer some sweetness in you life, add a teaspoon of honey or your favorite sweetener for a different flavor note altogether.  Doctors are now reccomending people drink five cups of tea daily, for improved health.  Make Tazo part of your regimen!  It's a great way to take care of your health, while making an excuse for a much-deserved tea break.

****Tazo's Passion Herbal Infusion is a somewhat tart, deep, flavorful (hibiscus-y tasting) tea. It is not berry-like in taste, although it is red in color. It's difficult to describe what hibiscus tastes like, but I find it a most pleasant taste. My husband says it tastes like pomegranate to him. Although Passion contains licorice root it is not sweet.The ingredients in Passion are: hibiscus flowers, natural tropical flavors, citric acid, orange peel, licorice root, cinnamon bark, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy. It is caffeine-free!Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "A tantalizing deep red tea made from hibiscus flowers, exotic herbs and natural tropical flavors." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Passion as "berry, juicy, wine-like, merlot, sweet, earthy, dense". Tazo describes the aroma as "sweet, juicy, red fruits".I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as very good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as Numi. I'm soooooo spoiled by Numi teas, which is why Tazo Passion gets only four stars.****

column9: Fruity and Flowery - Delicious Iced Drink - Thirst Quenching
column10: Tazo Iced Passion tea is an herbal blend not a true "tea", since it has no black tea, no green tea, or any other kind of real tea. It is technically an herbal tea with some additional ingredients added. It has hibiscus flowers, licorice, orange peel, cinnamon, rose hips, lemongrass plus it as added "natural tropical flavors", citric acid, and fruit juice extract for the very red color.These are "iced tea bags" -- each bag is large and makes 2 quarts worth of iced tea. The directions indicate to boil 1 quart of water and to steep the bag for 5 minutes then to pour into another 1 quart of cold water to make the iced tea. This was easy to do.I like sweet iced (traditional) tea and also I enjoy herbal teas and other plant infusions. I first tried this tea with sugar added as I assumed I would want it, but then tried it unsweetened and found the flavor fruity and almost sweet naturally, so now I drink it without added sugar. I would say it tastes sweet and fruity and almost like a more sophisticated version of a fruit punch drink that kids usually like.Everyone is different and only you can determine if this is right for you...My husband enjoys unsweetened iced tea and hot traditional teas unsweetened and he felt this unsweetened iced passion tea was too "sweet" and "flowery". My sons didn't like it as they are used to plain water (which is 99% of what my husband and I allow them to drink) or having their flavored drinks even more dense such as pure fruit juices or artificially flavored drinks or having sugar-filled sodas. My kids have learned to associate flavored drinks with more of oomph and more sweet than this unsweetened herbal "tea", unfortunately.This also has a fantastic deep red color thanks to the added fruit juice extract.I really enjoy this as an alternative to drinking plain water all day long. It is nice to have a flavorful cold drink that has zero calories, does not have unnatural ingredients, and has no artificial sweeteners (as diet sodas have). It is quite thirst-quenching too.Drinking Tazo Iced Passion Tea also helps mask the flavor of city tap water which is good for when I am stuck with city water as my only water source.

This tea is offered cold at Starbucks.  After spending tons of $$ on it, I decided to purchase it myself and make is myself.  Starbucks adds lemonade to it if you'd like.Saves me $$ and I can make as much of it as I want.You can actually purchase the ice tea bags that are bigger so you only use 1 packet to make a big batch.

This is my favorite drink-it-anytime tea. It's tart and tasty hot on long winter days and wonderful iced in summer. A little squeeze of lime gives the iced tea a pleasant freshness. It's great straight or slightly sweetened. I brew a huge pot in the morning and let it cool on the counter during the day - slowly cooling it with the bags still in the pot seems to add a bit of sweetness and the color is ruby red. And no caffeine means you can drink it day or night. Yummy!
Best tea on earth! Tangy and healthy. Now I have it at home and can have it anytime! Great price too! I bought it in cases!

column9: slightly tart bold herbal fantastic tasting iced tea
column10: Normally I hate yucky flowery herbs like hibiscus and rosehips in my tea (such as Celestial Seasonings Tea) but one day while at Starbuck's, I was sweating, heated and tired in hot weather and wanted an iced drink but not coffee and since I'm really a tea drinker, I tried their Tazo iced teas and they tasted SOOOOO good and invigorating with just the purrrrfect balance of just enough herbs but still letting your senses know it was still TEA and the fragrance/taste comes out boldly!! The heated tea is nicely turned immediately, boldly, vividly, red in color. I don't need to add much sweetener even as it's tart but its tartness gives it more taste.The only drawbacks are its high price (compared to other teas which is why I'm always waiting for a sale on them) and having to wait to heat the water and waiting to cool it down in the refrigerator (or quickly in the freezer).  It's true as another reviewer said that it's very strong in taste after just leaving it in hot water for a few seconds so the longer you leave it in, the stronger and bitter or more tart it becomes and you could really be frugal and only need a tea bag for a half gallon to a gallon of water.  Adding ice helps dilute the taste as well as cool the tea down fast and cold, but I like my iced tea strong so i can taste its full flavor, so I try never to add ice.It's a delight as an everyday iced tea as well as a great gift for a friend.
This is the only only hot tea that I drink. It is amazing and there is no way to actually describe the taste. You just have to try it!

column9: The best!!! Allows you to make tea just as good as Starbucks!
column10: I have been a huge iced tea fan my whole life and a Venti Passion Iced Tea sweetened is my absolute favorite drink at Starbucks. While the iced tea is pretty cheap option at Starbucks, by buying this, I am able to recreate my favorite drink at home.I tie together 4 tea bags, add it to 2 qts of water and refrigerate it a couple of hours Then I add in about a cup of sugar syrup (made by boiling 1 cup sugar/1 cup water and letting it cool). Sometimes I flavor the sugar syrup with a little vanilla extract when I remember, otherwise it's still good.  Voila, passion ice tea! Add a little lemon juice for an extra kick. Alternatively you could add lemonade like they do at Starbucks as well.Enjoy.

column9: Spice It Up for the Holidays
column10: Blend a little apple cider mix into your Tazo Passion Tea and see what happens. This creates a magical apple cider experience with hints of cranberry and hibiscus flowers gathered in an ancient land.Snuggle Up Spiced Cider is a good choice because you can then spoon in the exact amount you desire, but packets of cider work equally well. This is the type of tea you would expect to enjoy after skiing in some distant forest where you are also munching on homemade brownies or eggnog cookies. Apple cider also works very well with the Gypsy Teas, especially the Lemon Jasmine.The deep purple/red color and hibiscus fragrance of Tazo Tea is enough to make anyone passionate about tea. Yet, is this really tea? It looks like tea, but it is really an herbal infusion made by steeping hibiscus flowers, orange peel, licorice, cinnamon, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy in a swirling of hot water.The original flavor is also slightly reminiscent of hot apple cider or hot cranberry juice which is why it is extra delicious with a cider mix. Tazo Teas are a mysterious experience into which you can lose yourself with a sense of abandon. So far I've tried more flavors than I can count and have always been impressed.~The Rebecca Review
