As far as the strawberry flavor goes, this is as far from a real strawberry flavor as you can get while still tasting decent. If you're hoping for anything other than an artificial flavor that resembles something berry-ish, then you might want to stick to the other flavors of Tic Tac. This is strawberry enough to recognize it, but I can't help but think that if I were to have this placed into a pile of other flavors, I might not be able to immediately identify it as such. I do like these, but I want to really stress that if you're looking for strawberry-strawberry flavor rather than the candy companies' interpretation of strawberry over the years, you'll be disappointed.Overall though, I liked this enough to buy it again several times. That there's a cute nod to the Beatles via the name is nice and will no doubt pull several people in to purchase them.

I like many flavors of Tic Tacs, but these are especially good.  There are two colors in the pack, both with a different type of strawberry flavor.  The darker pink is more of a true strawberry while the light pink has a subtle mint flavor at first, followed by a subtle strawberry.  I loved them both!

I absolutely LOVE these Strawberry Fields tic tacs. I found them at a Walgreens in Mount Pleasant, South Carolina while I was on vacation visiting my brother and his family. I bought 2 packs, and then went back and bought 5 more. Then I got back to the little town in Alaska that I live in and can't find them here anywhere. So here I am ordering them from Amazon. So happy to have found them here. I don't like mint or peppermint, I don't like the orange or melon or grapefruit, etc. The one and only tic tac flavor I like is the Strawberry Fields, although I haven't tried the cherry, so I may try them.

column9: Endangered Species Chocolate Tiger with Expresso Beans
column10: This is delicious chocolate.  It has crunchy bits of espresso beans in it.  The 72% cacao contains healthy antioxidants, so I don't feel guilty eating it.  The company contributes to endangered species conservation, so it supports a good cause.

This stuff is wonderful. I don't usually like dark chocolate. But, this is the exception. It is a perfect blend. Great pick me up. It is expensive, but 1 bar takes a while to eat and it is for a worthy cause. Kudos!

column9: Strong and In A Class Of Its Own
column10: I love this brand since discovering it 6-7 years ago, (and I have hooked my father on the cranberries & almond bar, and chocolate and raspberry bar), and this brand is amazingly among the lowest priced for "natural" chocolate (it's less than $3 a bar at my local grocery stores). I don't drink coffee because I'm sensitive to high amounts of caffeine, but I love the smell of it, and coffee ice cream, so I LOVE this espresso chocolate!  This flavor is rich and strong, with a subtly bitter finish from the espresso beans, so a little goes a long way!A warning: if you are not used to dark chocolate, then this is probably not the flavor to begin with, unless you are a coffee fiend.  I suggest maybe starting with an Endangered Species milk chocolate flavor first, and working your way up (too bad they don't still make the Panda bar, a blend of dark and white chocolate!). It may even be better for some novices to first try a different brand of dark chocolate with 55-60% cocoa content, like Godiva or Chocolove, and then gradually work their way up (since to my knowledge E. Species doesn't have any dark chocolate with less than 72% cocoa content).
If you LOVE dark chocolate and espresso....you WILL LOVE this chocolate bar!!! Besides, you can feel great about eating it...10% goes to a GREAT cause!!! =D

column9: Best tasting and with no guilt!
column10: I am a foodie - grew up in the restaurant business and have a penchant for sweets. I exercise regularly and eat a clean diet for the most part, so, loading up on sweets or junk is not an option for me. But, when I do get a craving for chocolate, I try to be as healthy in my choices without compromising flavor.I'm also a coffee-junkie (my one remaining vice), so, once I tasted the ES Tiger bar with espresso beans, I was hooked. I can have two to three squares in between meals with some raw nuts, berries or some other fruit and I'm satisfied. The espresso beans are crushed, so, they sort of melt in your mouth along with the chocolate. Very satisfying and for a great cause - you won't be disappointed. Never a stale piece.

I bought a jar of this sauce because it was highly rated by the taste testers at Consumer Reports as published in a recent (2011) issue. I was looking for a jar sauce that I could use and enjoy when I didn't have the time to prepare my own sauce recipe.Vincent's is good but not great. I've tried a number of premium sauces and at this point I prefer Michael's of Brooklyn marinara sauce. It can be purchased either on line at their site, at Amazon or at Whole Foods Market where occasionally it's on sale for $5/jar ($10 regularly).

This is a great help with my reduced-carb diet plan, and more. I use this about half-and-half with cornstarch, or sometimes by itself, to thicken sauces. (Note: By itself, it only takes about one-half the amount to thicken as cornstarch, but when used alone, it has a tendency to "flatten" the flavor of the liquid it's thickening.) I also sometimes use arrowroot powder to thicken fruit-based sauces -- unlike cornstarch, arrowroot powder doesn't cloud whatever liquid is used. And, buying this form, in bulk, is far less expensive than those little bottles in the spice section of the grocery store -- compared to this product, those are an extreme ripoff in price. The company is always great to order from too.

The product worked well to thicken juice from a dish.  It would have been better to have suggested directions on its use for someone like myself who has never used it before. Dissolve in a bowl and then add to the dish.

I only use Arrowroot now for thickening sauces and gravies.  It works much better than other gluten free flours and you use less so there is less chance of adding an unwanted flour taste to the end result.  And of course I LOVE Barry Farms; their delivery has always been trouble free and the communication is excellent.  The product is always exactly as described and I'm fully confident in all their gluten free products!  Love you guys.
Great product. Good price. I will buy at this store again. Superb quality. I use it for baking paleo style.
There is not much you can say about Arrowroot.  The product is as stated.  The price of the product was OK and the shipping was reasonable and quick.

I have ordered arrowroot powder from Barry Farm on previous occasions.  Great product, great price and great service from Barry Farm!  I use the powder to make a scented body powder.  It is luxurious!
Product was securely and well packed.  It arrived as was advertised.  Quality product for the price which was equitable.  Would recommend this item.
This company states it should be used in Dairy dishes--Do this only if you like slime. That's what it makes with dairy products--Chef R.

I have started having reactions to some of the canned food that I buy.  I do not know if it is the product or the cans but I wanted to make my own and find a way to freeze some of those products.  Since sauces and gravies break down when frozen (really nasty), I had to find something besides flour and cornstarch.  So far I love this for thickening things like chili, spaggetti sauce, etc.  I am still experimenting and haven't perfected the proportions yet but I will get there.

Previously I had only been able to find this is 1 or 2 oz. packages & had little packets taking up space until they were used.This has been great & I use it all the time instead of flour for gravy or Sauces & I don't have to wait to cook out the Flour taste. It's a staple in my pantry.
Arrowroot is a good, old fashioned thickener for clear sauces and gravies. I'm allergic to corn and wheat, so this is a godsend, especially when making giblet gravy for the holidays.

column9: Alternative to Corn Starch or Flour
column10: This Arrowroot powder is excellent for thickening in all recipes.  Does not add any flavor and it is a healthy choice.
I was very pleased with this purchase. It got here quickly and was just what I ordered. I want to try making some homemade body powder. I have not made it yet but will soon!
No complaints here.  Bag is not resealable so I just dump it all into a huge ziploc container.  Makes it easier to scoop for recipes too.

I placed an order online with Barry Farms on December 29th.  Their website stated that orders would be processed and shipped within 48 hours or at most 7 days. After my initial order confirmation, I heard nothing from the company about when my order would be shipped. I emailed them to ask about my order on January 9th and was responded to on January 12th (14 days after my order was placed) stating that one of my items was back-ordered. Their website specifically states that they do not hold orders for back-ordered items. I then called the company and told them I needed the items (with or without the backordered items) no later than January 22nd.  They ensured me that it would arrive by then.  I received an email on January 18th informing me that my order had shipped without the backordered items and I would be receiving a refund for the missing items.  However, the package did not arrive on the 22nd as promised, forcing me to purchase the items elsewhere.  I then emailed the merchant and asked for a refund of the shipping charges since they do not accept returns.  I was refused, stating that since the error was with UPS, they were not at fault (even though their website says they ship within 7 days, which they did not, and do not hold for back-ordered items, which they did).  This is unacceptable behavior from any merchant.  I should have been able to return my items for a full refund or at minimum received a refund for the shipping charges.  Now I am out $28 for items I no longer need and cannot use.
Who doesn't like Bit-o-honey?  This is a great value with super speedy service.  Good job!
These candies are about the first I remember my grandmother gave me when I was small, maybe 60 years ago.  They are just as good as ever!

I have 2 Boston Bull Terriers that are finicky eaters. This Royal Canin 21 for small indoor dogs is great. The only problem is that the retail stores that carried it only had it in small bags.  By ordering on line I was able to get the 15# bag at almost half the price the same amount for small bags. Plus it will last me much longer.Jim D
My dogs love this dog food and so do I because it doesn't contain anything unhealthy.  I have been feeding my dogs this product for years and they are very healthy.

So far, the best price I have found is on Amazon. I've taken cared of several puppies in my day and I've always used Royal Canine. Never had a problem and always praised for using this brand by vets. I usually take the 27 and 21 and mix them. I'm sure there are other brands out there that are good but Royal Canine is easy to feed for puppies and small dogs because they are little pebbles. Very distinct smell and healthy. Highly recommended!

column9: Great Price on royal Canin Dog Food
column10: This is one of the highest rated quality dog foods. The Amazon price was lower than PetsMart's price, even including the shipping charge. Well packaged, arrived when promised.

column4: Oregonian Ex Pat In UK. "Oregon Nan"
column10: I have had chihuahuas,and more recently teacup chihuahuas for over 40 years now,at present i have 3 and was introduced to Royal Canin Mini Indoor Adult Formula via a gift from a person who does not have dogs at all,it is one of the best and most thoughtful gifts my dogs and i as an owner have ever received,not a massively  expensive,bright,glittery or bling thing,just a great dog food that my 3 dogs have come to enjoy with gusto,it is now my sole and prefered dog food in the US and UK too,the dogs love it and the bonus is that it has an active ingredient that greatly reduces  stool odor.

column9: Only food my dogs will eat!
column10: I have two small dogs, five and ten lbs each and they are pretty picky eaters. I wanted them to be on the same food because we free feed them and did not want them eating the others food and getting an upset stomach all the time. My vet recommended several good brands, Science Diet, Blue Buffalo and Wellness and at first they liked the change but after a while they would just stop eating them. I saw this in the pet store and decided to try it and that's what they have been eating now for two years. I love buying this big bag and putting it in an airtight storage bin because it saves me a lot of money rather than buying the small bags at the store all the time. They both have nice solid poos that don't smell horrible and they are both very regular on this food. I will not buy anything else for my boys! :-)

My dog loves Royal Canin.  I stopped buying it because the smaller bags are very expensive.  I  tried a variety of less expensive dog food brands instead. I did not like the ingredients. My vet says - dogs don't need variety in food like humans do.  Its okay if she sticks to one brand.  When I found out I could buy it in a larger size for so much less, well, I bought it.  Oh, by the way, I have a miniature Pom.

column9: Royal Canin Dry Dog Food 15lb bag
column10: I love being able to order this item online with free shipping.  It is so much easier than going to the pet store to pick up and cart home.  Would definitely recommend.

I've found it difficult to find the 15lb bag at either Petco or Petsmart in Chicago. I've got two small dogs (shih tzu and hava-malt) who go through food pretty quickly so it was great to track the big bag down online and order it.
I have purchased Royal Canin before and thought it was such a good deal I ordered it again.  My maltese doesn't have smelly stools and is the right size for her little mouth.  I will order again.

My 5 year old Dachshund loves this food. It's been a task to find any food that she will readily eat dry or wet. The bites are small enough that she is able to eat more efficiently and without trouble. The price is a bit scary, but well worth it if you have a picky small dog.

I go through a ton of cat food and this is by far my favorite to feed to the cats however the cost averages $4.88 a box in the stores(for 12) as compared to this which only has 10 in the box. Not worth buying on Amazon.
I've always liked Heinz Vegetarian Baked Beans. I find the flavor to my liking. However, Your supplier over charges by quite a bit as far as I'm concerened.

column9: not as good as another brand
column10: I was quite disappointed when I received this.  First, it looked like someone printed a label from their desktop and stuck it on a small dark brown bottle.  It was very sour and not at all like another brand of verjus that I had previously purchased. I'm not sure this one was even from France.  I threw it out after I tasted it, so I can't remember exactly what it said on the bottle.The one I previously purchased - http://www.amazon.com/Domaine-du-Siorac-Perigord-Verjus/dp/B0008JEZ4K/ref=sr_1_3?ie=UTF8&qid=1341338906&sr=8-3&keywords=Verjus - is true verjus from France.  It is very smooth tasting and worked very well in salad dressings and gastriques.I won't be buying verjus from this merchant in the future.

This is an ingredient best substituted for lemon juice, but with a different flavor:sour grapes. I used it in dessert bars;subtle difference, but good. Also salad dressings, light sauces for chicken or fish. also quite good. Stars were lost because it came packed in styro peanuts, the bane of our existence. But the product itself is just fine.

column9: Not even close to Starbucks Pumpkin Spice
column10: Everyone in my family was disappointed with this coffee. We purchase Gevali monthly but this coffee missed it's mark.

I should have read the label on this: It is a spread, not jam. The flavor is acceptable, but I've been looking for a good rhubarb (not rhubarb-strawberry) jam since Bonne Maman stopped making theirs several years ago. I'm not rating my disappointment, though--even as a spread I thought this was average. I've also tried Andresy's rose jan (3 stars) and fig jam (4 stars).
SeaBears Smoked Wild Sockeye Salmon is simply the best you can get. Enjoyed by friends and family immensely, everyone loves it.

column9: No flavor, and the water source is known
column10: We don't have the best water on tap at work (it has a taste I can detect and don't like). I have several bottles of bottled water stashed away in my office in case I forget to bring fresh tap water from home.  I purchased Nestle Pure Life Bottled water because it got the highest marks from the Consumer Reports.Nestle has no flavor and Consumer reports gives it high marks for disclosing where the water came from and how it was treated.  Some brands do not disclose this information, because it is Environmental protection Agency does not require it.  This disclosure is voluntary (with exception of California).  Full disclosure seems like a good idea so you know what you are getting, so that's why Nestle Pure Life is my choice.

I take this to work with me every day because the water at work is disgusting. It is packed full of cholorine ( it reeks of it! ), who knows what else. This water has no taste ( some of the other bottled water tastes funny to me ) & is just better than the others I've tried. I buy several cases at the local stores every week. It is the best!

Nestle Pure Life is one of three bottle waters I drink....This water has a very smooth taste unlike some bottled water that taste very harsh going down..I know its very important to get your water intake in.. you can't go wrong with Nestle Pure Life...

5 packets of this tea was included with my order of Gold Kili ginger tea. I tried them both to see which I like better. They actually taste about the same, but this is more expensive and the packets are bigger. The tea is pre-sweetened with honey and sugar but it is not too sweet if I use a 6 oz mug. The flavor is not strong so those who like a little bite to their ginger tea may find this a little weak. Still, on a cold rainy day, this would be nice to sip while relaxing.
This a best product, we all love SHAN's Masala Mix(especially Biryani Mix). But here it looks so costly, we buy this for $0.99 each from local Indian Store....

Some people I know are animal-care professionals.  This is the food they feed their big hungry dogs.  The dogs love it, and they maintain their weight with this feeding program.There is only one problem though. The shipping rate is out of sight.

column9: Thank you Italy for this great brew
column10: One of the finest coffees from around the worldParticularly excellent decaf - which is quite difficult to find.

This will wake up your taste buds and your mind!  I enjoy complex flavors in all of my foods, and this one delivers.  I typically drink coffee, but I enjoy mixing it up from time to time, especially in fall and winter.Try it out, you will love it!

You have to try this instant chai. It is delicious! If you are someone who is working away from home, like I do, you'll enjoy the luxury of chai on the go. Buy this product to take along  So easy,fast and great tasting.  I love it!

I have been drinking Tipu's Chai religiously for over a year now. I prefer the Chai now simple life. It has the most wonderful flavors an allows me to add almond milk and my own sweetener (stevia). I had to stop drinking coffee for health reasons and Tipu chai has made the transition so easy. I need to get some decaf too so I can have it at night. The price point scared me at first but you barely have to use any of the powder to make a nice cup of tea. I use less than the recommended amount. All in all I highly recommend Tipu's Chai. It is authentic, has simple ingredients, and is affordable.
This is the real McCoy. Now I can investigate bigger packages / quantities. My daughter drank this tea brand in Japan, and this is the one.
I saw these at the store and became addicted to them.  They are very light to eat, and very tasty.  They also aren't greasy like a regular potato chip.  Liked them so much I bought 2 cases :)

I conducted a taste test of malted milk balls so you don't have to wonder. All are superior to bulk malted milk balls of uncertain origin.Ghirardelli: Best balance of chocolate with crispy malt insideDouble Chocolate Malted Milk Balls: More chocolate, slightly less malt. My favorite.Bissinger's: Clearly superior ingredients, the most malt flavor. My husband's favorite.Bissinger's Pumpkin:  Very good but not what I expected. Instead of using pumpkin pie spices they use real pumpkin.All arrived carefully packed with cold packs (shipping is expensive).Enjoy!

I bought these and Ghirardelli malted balls at the same time to do my own taste test. These have far more chocolate on each ball.... FAR MORE! Almost (I can't believe I'm typing these words) TOO MUCH! The other brand was good but these more like a real piece of chocolate....Delivery was thermally protected for possible heat. Good touch during warm months.

I have to agree with the other reviewer.  As much as I love chocolate, there is way too much on these.  The ratio of chocolate to malted milk center is crazy.  These would taste so much better if they had a normal amount of chocolate on them.  You end up tasting more chocolate than malt.  It would be nice if they would come out with a modified version that had a larger malted milk center and a regular amount of chocolate coating.  The flavors are great just, the overall size is great, just the ratios are off.

I have been looking for a good malted milk ball ever since Brachs changed theirs.  This one isn't it either.  Good chocolate coverage, but small malted milk center, and the chocolate flavor is a little off.

Item arrived promptly, but not as described.  It was not powder; it was a compounded block that needs to be grated.  Also, the box is marked that it expired in May of 2009.  It is April 2011 now.  I would not purchase from buyer again.

This product although matching in weight is NOT as depicted on the web page...it is not a plastic jar (which would ensure the dryness of the product) it is a very very poorly sealed cardboard box and you can see where a price tag has been removed, so I suspect old , returned stock... this view is compounded by the lack of manufacturing,sell by or use by date on the packaging even though there is a clearly marked space for the same....so I repeat  BUYER BEWARE!!!

I usually like this brand of mixes. Every other one I've tried has been very yummy and priced reasonably. These pancakes tasted like flour and water with instant oats. The apple chunks had a very rubbery texture. The pancakes were fluffy, but tasted horrible. Save your money and buy the blueberry flavor.

This is my favorite pancake mix! Mostly because it tastes so good, and it's actually kinda fluffy too. The fact that I'm a big fan of spice cake pastries also really makes me like this. It also has small bits of apple junks in it too which adds to the flavor. Completely worth trying.

My husband and I decided to try something different.  After reading about the gourmet steak sauce it was a go.  Let me tell you it was definitely a great choice!!  The taste is flavorful, with a hint of kick, and it has been great both for topping off our steaks as well as cooking pork and chicken!  It adds a bit of something that other sauces just don't have.  I really recommend trying it out, you won't be disappointed!

Some white chocolate is just sweet nothing. That's what a lot of people think when they hear "white chocolate". It's not chocolate, they say. It's just cocoa butter and sugar. But not all white chocolate is the same.Ghirardelli Sublime White Vanilla Dream is quite yummy, smooth and sweet and satiny. It has a rich taste with more than a hint of vanilla. It's cream colored, not pure white, sprinkled with specks of vanilla bean. Delightful!

Like the previous poster, I love this seasoning. I too have to resort to buying it online, because the stores no longer carry it, which is a shame.This can be used on everything, I even use in it my home made spaghetti sauce and it gives it a lovely kick.

column9: Best Creole Seasoning I have used.
column10: This is my favorite Creole seasoning.  I use it for fish, veggies, you name it.  I can no longer get it in stores in my area so I am resorting to getting it on-line.A+++

column9: Pretty good coffee, not the best
column10: I have been looking for a coffee to subscribe to, this isn't it.  That said, it was pretty good when coarse ground for the press.  Not as good fine ground for the drip coffeemaker.  I will keep looking.

...  for those of us counting Weight Watcher points, it's a find.  I've been using it on sandwiches and in coleslaw instead of mayonnaise and adding a dab of real Dijon to kick up the flavor.  Zero calories, zero fat, zero carbs?  I'm in.As for amazon sending expired food items, that's inexcusable but not Grey Poupon's fault.
All of the six mustards were outdated.  Beware of buying food at Amazon because the food could be outdated.
A great find.  Substitutes for mayonnaise and other creams on smoked salmon, etc.  Many guilt free delicious uses.  Suddenly hard to find on the shelf and glad to purchase from Amazon.

column9: Tasted "off" - Zero Calorie condiment/spread-"dijonnaise" version Grey Poupon
column10: Hoping this condiment would be a better tasting, higher quality "dijonnaise" - a dijon mustard and mayo hybrid, low calorie creamy mustard spread. Grey Poupon dijon mustard is a great product so I was disappointed in this product. While zero calorie, it tasted a little "off", slight bitter and stale aftertaste. I prefer the French's version of a dijoannaise over this product. Has more zing and is creamier.  The offer here was affordable and we did use the product but would not purchase again.
We ordered these to give out for Halloween, they were a good price, but be aware that the candies themselves were teeny.
My boys all time fave. Excellent protein sources, and all around ingredients. No grain is huge.
I purchased this dog food and I absolutely love it for my two small dogs, and they love it too! I can actually read most of the ingredients and it makes me feel good about what I'm feeding them.

column9: Canidae ALS Grain Free Dog Food
column10: This is a pretty good dog food if you are looking for grain free formula. Our dog didn't have any issue transferring to this food. Canidae overall is a good brand for dog food. If you are looking for a decently priced grain free formula this might be worth a try.

Canidae makes lots of flavors and types of dog food.  My Goldens have had endless issues with allergy problems.  Professional breeders and dog show people have recommended Canidae for it's grain free relative low cost dog food.  I have more "faith" in the quality of this brand than most and prices are reasonable in the higher priced group.My Golden "Amber" (eyes) does not seem to relish this flavor.  She is much more particular than any dog before so the search goes on.  So far I have four small bags of dog food and still searching for her preference.  Salmon is next.  At least Amber shows no problems with allergies which is common among pure breeds.Did notice since I adopted her coat which was fairly thin and easy to see the skin has changed dramatically.  In about three months mostly on this food type she has grown a thick undercoat which was normal on my last and missed Golden "Arrow".If you want an ANGEL personality in your dog choose a Golden Retriever but only if you can give generously of your love and kindness.  My Goldens get very stressed if I get stressed and speak loudly.  Most Goldens think all people are family relations and can't wait to run and greet but your still number one.  But she is not enthusiastic for this particular food.
I am so impressed with this company! I love their other products and now this pizza! the veggies are in the crust so my kids had NO idea! THank you so much Peas of Mind!

Make sure you don't pass these up the next time you're in the market for cat treats.  They disappear very quickly around here!  They do provide some nutrition so they are getting more than just something on which to chew for awhile, but the flavor is pretty unique and they always know when I bring them home from the grocery.  It's pretty funny to see our cats dash for the bag!  Highly recommend!

column9: Whisker Lickin's Tender Moment Cat Treats
column10: Flip loves these soft snacks with chicken and cheese flavor. The pack of 10 is very economical as well. When I shake the pack, he runs to me knowing he'll be rewarded well. As long as he's happy, I'm happy. Treat your kitty, he/she'll appreciate it.

First of all let me say this....WHAT AN EXCELLENT PRICE for this pkg of 10! Almost too good to be true. Now, for the product. I gave these to my little grand-kitty for Xmas. I choose the "tenders" as he is a very, very old kitty. His teeth are not sooo workable any more and these are "perfect" for him. Soft and chewy is what he can handle and these are perfect for him to enjoy. Believe me he does! Amazon always has such great values. =) happy customer as always!!!!

My cat, Sophie, enjoys eating 3 or 4 of these treats every night before she goes to bed. She gets so excited when she hears me opening the bag. She dances and meows with happiness.I like to purchase these treats from Amazon; the price is reasonable and I can stock up on them. I just purchased a second ten pack of them. I'd hate to run out of these treats. The packaging is great and they stay fresh for a long time.Sophie is a very fussy cat. She won't eat people food (not even fish!) or canned cat food. She eats only one kind of dry cat food. She loves her Whisker Lickins Tender Moments treats! We've tried other cat treats and she's turned her nose up at them. This is the only cat treat that she wants to eat.

My cat loves these treats. He enjoys the softness and I enjoy the fact that there isn't a hairball remedy added. So many treats now are hard and have the hairball remedy added. These are just good and simple, soft and delicious treats.

column9: A Great Treat for my Cats
column10: I like to give my cats a treat every now and then. They seem to like these quite a bit so I decided to look for them on Amazon. Since there are different flavors, I will be trying some of the other ones, too.I keep a package on my desk, and they remind me to give them their afternoon treat.

column9: Whisker Lickin's how do I love thee
column10: My cat just loves these treats, if allowed she would eat the entire bag at once, but we don't let her because we are good cat owners. Whisker Lickins Tender Moments Chicken & Cheese Flavor Cat Treats, 3-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 10)

Great packaging, price less than anywhere else, my cat likes this treat and literally "rolls over" in the corner where the treat bowl is kept. She mews until she gets a few morsels. by the way, she is over 13 also and helped me in this review
My cats threw this up right after eating.I gave to my son and his cats did the same.For some reason the hard food stays down same brand but different results.

I feed my cat top of the line cat food, but this is the only snack she loves. However, every time she has them I notice she vomits the same day or a few days later. Every time... I think they use really poor ingredients.

column9: 1st time was AMAZING, 2nd... not so much
column10: I ordered these red vines (I'm addicted) and they came promptly to my door.  They were super fresh and tasty, I think they lasted me a month and a half.  I was ecstatic because red vines are the best, as long as they aren't stale (like they always are at the grocery store on the east coast).  6 months later the order was placed again, they came fast but much to my dismay... the red vines were just as hard as at the store!  Why this sudden change in quality?  I am giving them one last chance and then I will make my final decision.

Red Vines cherry-flavored licorice is my favorite candy. This particular amount for the price is a great deal vs. the other offers listed on Amazon and what I've found in retail stores.They took an unusually long time to ship from the warehouse. I placed my order in on a Thursday and it didn't even leave the warehouse until the following Wed. I live in Southern California and the warehouse was located only one state away, in Nevada. UPS then let it sit in the Nevada location for another day, so it didn't arrive until Friday. I know the super saver free shipping can take up to 10 days to ship. However, this was the only item in my order and was available in stock.Basically, I love the product, but Amazon's customer service was definitely mediocre compared to my past experience. The convenience of having something delivered to your doorstep is pretty much negated by the lengthy wait. I got my agar agar yesterday, and I feel like I've been scammed.  The only reason I chose to buy from Barry Farm was that it was the cheapest option.  But that wasn't the case.When I first held the package (which is smaller than what is pictured here), I thought it was oddly light for 4 oz.  So I weighed it on my military grade digital scale and bingo, it's 3.2 oz.  Without the packaging that would mean 3 oz.  I thought it might be my scale so I weighed my mineral makeup that came on the same day, 1.3 pounds each for a 1 pound bag.  So Barry Farm only shipped me 3 oz of product when I payed for 4 oz, which doesn't seem like a lot but when you do the calculations it's quite a dent.Let me compare this to the other agar option on Amazon by NOW Foods.Barry Farm (3 oz) $7.90 + $7.13 (Shipping) =  $15.03 (Comes in a plastic Ziploc bag)NOW Foods (2 oz) $4.20 + $5.38 (Shipping) = $9.58/2 = $4.79/oz * 3 = $14.37 for 3 oz (Comes in a plastic bottle)NOW Foods (32 oz) $40.79 + $7.55) = $48.34/32 = $1.51/oz *3 = $4.53So including shipping,Barry Farm $15.03/3 ozNOW Foods  $14.37/3 ozNOW Foods  $ 4.53/3 ozWith a bottle instead of a plastic bag, my future purchases would be from NOW Foods.  I'm so tempted to get the 2 Pound bottle since an ounce is only $1.51 that way, but agar's gelling quality is so good that it gets used very slowly.Now about the agar.  I cooked it last night (1 Cup apple juice to 1/2 teaspoon powder), and left it in the fridge.  This morning I woke up to see it gelled quite nicely.  It doesn't have the doinky texture of gelatin jello and it's much harder to the touch.  I tasted it and didn't notice an exponential increase in the taste of apple juice, and the texture of the agar isn't as good as gelatin jello. It sort of just breaks apart in your mouth like...sand maybe? But at least it's supposedly healthy.So in terms of Barry Farms I gave it 2 stars instead of 1 star because at least the product worked.  But not going to buy from them again since I don't know if I'll be cheated.  Internets a scary place where merchant reputation is very important.  They should have put more product in the bag to ensure it measures at least 4 oz.  Now their reputation is tarnished.

Their shipping is expensive and they havent even shipped it yet. Had I known that it would take more than 16 days (and counting) for this company just to get the product out the door, I would have purchased from one of the many other sellers on amazon.

Any jelly I made with this agar agar was unpalatable, because it had an awful after-taste. The agar-agar smelled like medicine even while being dossolved in liquid.Not sure if I got a bad batch, but I wouldn't buy from this seller again.

Decent packaging, and amazing for baking. I couldn't believe how much more volume it gave to my gluten-free breads. It also makes them not brittle. Agar is hard to find in stores - highly recommended.

****This is a fine chai spice tea from Stash, made from blended black teas, ginger, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, cloves, and natural flavors of cinnamon, clove, and cardamom. I love these Dove Coconut Creme Milk Chocolate Eggs, will definitely order them again and again! They are creamy and delicious! The coconut is creamier than in similar products, such as Mounds

The surprise is, this sauce can be used as a stand-alone -- by itself, without any other ingredients, it makes a great marinade. I was browsing a retro/novelty candy website when I came upon Freshen Up gum. It brought back so many memories - I remember when it was first introduced and can even remember the commercials. It was the only non-sugarless gum I would chew.I started to place an order, but left the site when I saw that shipping was going to cost 2x the amount of the gum. Amazon was naturally the next site I went to - it's the site I can count on to find the product I need at the best price on the Net. I found right away, but it was being offered by a another company selling on Amazon. Although I am still disappointed in how much this company charged for shipping, it was at least a bit more reasonable than the original site I was at. Besides, I just had to try this gum once again.It arrived today and I couldn't wait to try a piece! I was a bit worried that it might not be fresh. When I put a piece in my mouth and bit down, it was just as I remembered it to be - Great flavor, incredibly soft and the squirt of flavor that every kid loved when I was growing up. I've been chewing it for over 30 minutes and the flavor is still going strong - that's something that sugarless gum just can't offer. Also, I have tons of dental work and the gum hasn't stuck to any of it yet (thank goodness!) I can't recommend chewing any sugar gum on a regular basis, but it certainly is nice to have around for a treat every now and then.Spearmint has always been my favorite flavor, but all of the Freshen Up flavors are great and long lasting. I've never been a bubble gum fan, but even their bubble gum flavor is great to chew!If you're looking for a soft, flavor filled gum to chew, you won't go wrong ordering Freshen Up. Try to get past the shipping charges and know that you will enjoy the gum.

column9: Best haggis I've had in the US
column10: Back home in Scotland I ate haggis at least twice a week and it's been a major craving for the 8 months I've lived in the US. This isn't that similar to tinned haggis in Scotland; mainly the texture of tinned haggis back home is finer and drier than this...but it is fairly close to the 'real' haggis in a skin and is spiced just perfectly. I think preparation counts for a lot with this haggis and I dry fry it in a pan whilst stirring it until it just starts to brown as I think that improves the texture. All in all it's great with a baked potato or just for fellow Scots missing a taste of home. If you haven't tried haggis then this is a great example of how good it is...and it really is like nothing else!

I need to start off by saying this stuff is amazing! When a person is first given the list of ingredients for haggis, the stomach may turn a little. Being an adventurous food taster, I had to try it. Popping the can the contents appear to be similar to dog food. Once you mash it up and heat it in the microwave, the haggis transforms into a bowl of steamy goodness. Who would've thought that a conglomeration of sheep's hearts, lungs, and liver mixed with oats could taste so good? I definitley didn't. I was pleasantly surprised how the flavors meld into such a magnificent dish. Anyone in the states who is turned of by either the ingredients or shipping cost, should reconsider and give this stuff a whirl. (especially if you enjoy beef liver or chicken livers) This product is worth the price. I will be picking up this stuff many more times.
The government won't let us get the real thing from Scotland, so this is the next best thing. Doesn't taste like canned Haggis from Scotland but no-one at our Burn's night party knows that.

For years and years we had said we would finally try haggis, but never had the courage to face it.  (We pictured chitlings.)  This Christmas I finally bought this product and we were entirely pleased with it and will buy it again.  As an alternative to cleaning and stuffing a sheep's stomach, I have to say it is convenient (think canned hash), and it makes a DELICIOUS shepherd's pie!  It doesn't require that scotch be drunk alongside it (or prior), but -- and in the tradition of Robert Burns -- it deserves a toast.  We recommend it most heartily.

column9: Haggis: a most under appreciated food!
column10: I love meat. All kinds. From sushi to chicken gizzards, I love it. I tried haggis sausage at a RenFair and wanted to try more. Unfortunately, it's difficult to come by in Seattle. (I know about the British Pantry in Redmond, but that's an hour drive for me). I found this stuff and tried a can. I now know I LOVE haggis. For those who aren't familiar with it... it's kind of like corned beef hash, only with oats instead of potatoes and lamb liver/heart instead of corned beef. It's got a strong taste, but I like that. My girlfriend even liked it on crackers. If you don't have the ability to get traditional haggis where you live, Stahley's Scottish Haggis is a worthy substitute.

column9: Not the real thing, but not bad, considering it's canned.
column10: I fell in love with haggis on my trips Scotland.  When visiting a Scottish shop in NC I purchased this brand along with another brand advertised here on Amazon (Caledonian Kitchen), just to compare.  Neither one are quite like the real stuff, but what canned food is as good as the original?  Both are tasty although both are a bit mild compared to what I enjoyed in Scotland.  I think I prefer the taste of this one. This brand seems to be a tad spicier than the CK and not so heavy on the liver.  I add a bit of ground black pepper and nutmeg which helps.  I was happy to see it on Amazon, but the price added with shipping costs keeps me from purchasing it.  For the little difference in taste, I ordered the less expensive CK in the 3 pack.  I'll wait till I go back to NC or another Scottish shop to buy this one.

column9: just the right amount of liveriness
column10: I bought this at a local import store. I was excited and kind of scared to try it. It's very good. I've never liked liver, and this has a livery flavor, but it's just livery enough to taste strong and interesting, but not revoltingly strong. I thought the smell did remind me of dog food, but it's saltier than dog food (yes, I've tasted dog food). It melts in your mouth, it's very soft and tender in texture, and the oats are chewy. It's fairly greasy. I hope to try this someday the traditional way with the skin, as the other reviews I've read for this product claim it tastes nothing like the real thing. It definitely tastes like nothing I've ever eaten before, and I would highly recommend trying it. It doesn't take much to get satisfaction form it. I guess it kind of reminds me of chopped liver (which I never liked as a kid, but I might like it now), only warm, and less strong in the liver flavor. I've had chicken hearts and I can taste the heart flavor, which I might be confusing with liver, as I like chicken hearts. I can imagine it would taste good with cheese.
I've been ordering canned haggis for several years so I could enjoy it on Bobbie Burn's Day (January 25th).  This was the best ever!

I'm not an expert, but this is comparable to haggis I tried on the Isle of Skye. Incidentally, true haggis includes lungs and other organs excluded from this U.S. recipe. Anyhow, forget trying to bring haggis into US. Your friendly 9mm-carrying Customs people will confiscate it.  Local shipment was prompt.
It tastes almost like the real thing! It has just the right amount of seasoning and texture. So worth the price.

THIS IS THE FIRST TIME IN 10 YEARS THAT I HAVE HAD THE JOY OF EATING HAGGIS. THE FIRST TIME WAS AT A RE-ENCAMENT EVENT. I FELL IN LOVE WITH IT. UNFORTUNATELY I HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO FIND IT UNTIL NOW. WELL WORTH THE COST

This is a very rich and tasty delight if you enjoy lamb and liver. I prefer it to corn beef hash for flavor. Perfectly seasoned and one can makes several servings, as this haggis is rich in flavor. Try some and this is made in America and does NOT contain any lung tissue like haggis made in Scotland does.

This haggis was very good - the centerpiece of our Burns' nite feast.  Made cock-a-leekie soup & clapshot to go with the haggis.  Wonderful.  Even the 3 & 6 year old loved it!We were concerned we wouldn't get it in time, so expedited shipping.  Received it within 2 days of order.  Great!
We are so pleased that it was so easy to order the Scottish Haggis through Amazon.  We enjoy all the recipes on the back of the can.  Thank you Amazon for giving us the access to get this product.
very surprised how quickly my order arrived at our  home.  Everything was well in order and I am very pleased with all transactions.
bought this as a joke for a person who lived in Scotland last year.  Have not eaten it and hope I am not invited when it is prepared and served.
This medium bold coffee offers a mild chocolate flavor with just a hint of orange at the finish. It is an enjoyable and delicately flavored coffee.
These noodles are amazing!!! You won't even miss gluten when you eat these. Be sure to follow the directions and rinse after cooking, it makes a world of difference.

I liked it because I live in a residence where we only have microwaves to make our food out of the dinning room, so, I just had to put it on a bowl with water and put it in the microwave. Easy to make, and yummy to eat. It'd be better if they delivered it to spain T-T

This is your basic Easy Mac.  I actually prefer this packaging over the version that comes with its own little bowl.  If you have a measuring cup that can measure 2/3 of a cup, and a bowl, you don't need to get the kind with the bowls, which I find wasteful.  Either way, they are a great snack.  I think they have 260 calories, so they are not a meal.  Either way, if you've had Easy Mac before, and like it, this is the same stuff.  If you are picky about your macaroni, this is not the macaroni for you.If you really find it bland you can always do what I do an put a little bit of sriracha in right before you eat it.
Who does not like Mac and Cheese.  This is typical Kraft.  Not the big fat pasta - but still good.  Super easy to fix.

The product description misleads you into believing that these are microwavable single serving cups when in fact they are packaged in individual pouches and need a bowl to be put in. I ordered this because the convenience individually packaged cups would of provided while being deployed in afghanistan, where bowls and time for washing dishes are rare, but i was sadly disappointed.

column9: I should have read the reviews
column10: Don't get me wrong, the product is just fine. I was just expecting the ones that come in the single-serving bowls, but these are just plastic bags with the noodles and cheese powder in them. No bowl included.

column9: Why is this listed in Gluten Free??
column10: In searching for Gluten Free, this product comes up numerous times. It is not Gluten Free..and for those with Celiac Disease, it's a definite food to avoid.

i remember i used to absolutely love kraft mac and cheese. Maybe it's because I'm older now and my palette has changed, but I just don't enjoy it as much anymore. It's not gross, but it's not great either.

column9: Try these tweaks for a tasty meal.
column10: Didn't expect too much from these so I was surprised that with a few tweaks, I really liked them. I use 3/4 of a cup of water in a handled, plastic measuring cup and microwave for 4 minutes. Using a spoonful of cream cheese to mix in the cheese powder seems to give the M&C just that much more flavor and richness. The measuring cup is a convenient dish to eat from...not disposable, but hey, what are dishwashers for...and there's less trash. For fewer than 300 calories, not a bad meal.
Bought these for my girlfriend in college on a few occasions she loves them what more can i say. Handy college food!
The macaroni and cheese was great. The product was exactly what was the description said. I have no complaints :D

We usually eat the cup version from Kraft. I got tired of always watching the sales at my local store and rushing out to buy them, so I ordered these. First of all, these are not the cups. There is a plastic pouch with noodles and a paper pouch with powder. You have to use your own bowl. Not really a big deal.The weird thing is they tasted funny. Not quite as cheesy. Really they tasted stale. My 3 yo won't eat them. My husband and I both tried them and agreed they are off. We threw them out. Waste of money.....

I just received this product and I am very disappointed.The description led me to believe that the product included its own cup and the convenience was the ONLY reason I purchased it.What I got was a box filled with little bags of noodles and little bags of powdered cheese.Not so easy after all! If I had wanted the basic original version I would have ordered Kraft mac and cheese...As it is, I feel like I am the victim of a bait and switch routine!Here is the actual product description copied and pasted from the page here on the Amazon site:Consumers in the US are turning to Kraft Easy Mac cups for the great taste of macaroni and cheese. Easy Mac cups are simple to prepare - just add water and put in the microwave for a few minutes - plus they are portable with a disposable cup that makes clean-up easy. Easy Mac cups are perfect for any need-to-eat-now occasion. Kraft Easy Mac cups is available in several flavors like original, triple cheese, bacon, cheesy taco, roasted garlic parmesan and Alfredo.Please note the frequent use of the word "cups" and the inclusion of the statement "plus they are portable with a disposable cup that makes clean-up easy."I can't help but feel ripped off...I would not recommend this product to anyone - it is grossly overpriced for what you get.And I will never order this product again.Unless you want to pay top dollar for tiny little snack-sized bags of mac & cheese, DO NOT buy this product.Kraft Easy Mac Original Macaroni and Cheese Dinner 18 Microwaveable Single Serve Packs

I bought this in bulk at Costco because I am a college student and needed something I could snack on while studying. These do require a microwavable bowl, as they come in individual packets. After eating it twice, you already get tired of the taste. It is not like regular mac and cheese at all. The noodles are sticky and after microwaving there is barely any water left to make the cheese powder mix work. It gets messy and the powder cheese crusts around the bowl. And you have to soak the bowl once you're done eating if you want to be able to get the mix out.5 months later and I STILL have a few packets left. I just can't fathom to eat it. Only way I would eat the rest is if I had absolutely nothing else to eat. Save your money and buy something else. Hamburger Helper makes great microwavable noodles that taste better than this junk.

If you follow the directions and add the amount of water they say, it can get pasty.  If you microwave it as long as the box says, it can also get pasty.  I hate pasta that is gooey, pasty and overdone, so I don't usually eat these.  Since they are convenient and easy for kids, you could still get them and tweek it a little by adding a little les water.

This turned out to be my worst shopping experience with Amazon.com.I ordered two boxes of these Kraft Easy Mac single serve packs.  I'm a longtime Amazon.com shopper but had never bought food from them before.  These box of eighteen packs were sold by an Amazon marketplace seller but fulfilled by Amazon.  We've been buying Kraft Easy Mac cups for the past year now and really enjoy them.  So we decided to try these single serve packs (no cups included).Shipping by Amazon was fast.  To make a long story short these single serve packs tasted absolutely nasty!  We opened up the other packs to be fair but they tasted horrible as well.  Nobody could take more than a tiny bite. They tasted that bad.I don't know where the seller stored these boxes or where they obtained their stock but never again will I buy grocery items from Amazon.com.  It's too much trouble to return them, costs too much to ship back even when Amazon pays for part of the shipping.  Buying food items from Amazon was not worth it.I would give careful consideration in buying these single serve packs from any of the secondary marketplace sellers.  A lot of sellers are individuals and not necessarily a business.  You never know where food items like these are stored at in someone's house.  We wasted good money.
I was very pleased with the packaging of the individual bags.  The order was quick and the packaging of the individual bags was unique.  I would definitely recommend this seller.

It is hard to find red pistachio nuts, but it is a Christmas tradition to have them - so, I had to resort to ordering online.  The nuts were perfectly fine.  The only issue I had was that while the nuts were $10.50, the shipping was $9.95.  I didn't realize it until after, as I had multiple items in my order from multiple vendors.  My fault for not paying attention - but, to basically charge as much for shipping as you do the product - a very small item - is ridiculous.

Just received my One Pound Bag of Red Pistachio Nuts and am a quite displeased with the bag I received.  First off, the "gift bag" they state the nuts come in is nothing more than a clear plastic bag with a white twist tie...was expecting something a little nicer if they are using the term girft bag.Also the one pound bag was not one pound....i have a kitchen scale and i weighed to bag to see how honest the company is and it turns out that it only weighs 383 grams.  One pound should equal 453 grams so they shorted me a whole 70 grams of nuts.Won't be buying again thats for sure!

I'm glad I found these because first off i love them and second they are very hard to find in my area. They always arrive fast(they have lighting fast shipping), they're always fresh, and packed perfectly in the box and arrive in good condition.

All Carr's brand products are wonderful, but what I like the best is this new flavor, Rosemary crackers.  My guests love them; I can't keep enough boxes in the pantry!And, of course, we can all appreciate that there isn't any partially-hydrogenated fats (trans fats) in these crackers.

I  first had these wonderful crackers on vacation in Florida 2 years ago.Took me a year for me to locate them in Pgh. PA. , found then at  a Kuhns grocery store, they had 2 boxes. I was thrilled bought em both and never saw them at any store since. I love these they are my favorite!!!!!!!!!! They taste great with everything.
This is the best cracker I have ever had, period.The flavor is unbelievable.If its not the best you ever eat, please send them my way.

column9: Please do not discontinue these they are terrific!
column10: These are my favorite crackers and I can't find them any where, Carrs if you read this please do not discontinue them!  They used to sell them at whole foods.  Now on amazon I am paying $0.35 per cracker, but they are so delicious It's worth it =)

column9: Why on earth do such wonderful products vanish from the market?
column10: These are my favorite crackers ever, delicious, satisfying, not too salty but plenty flavorful. Why are they disappearing from every store??

These are great crackers! At the time I ordered them I didn't receive them as Amazon was having problems with shipping the correct cracker due to the fact that their stock was mislabeled at the shipping facility.  I will order them again when the problem is corrected.

column9: These are sooooooooo good & you can't find them.  Why?
column10: These were available in the Dallas area for about a nano-second.  Can't buy them on the Carr's online store (WHY???).  I found them at a grocery store in Kenosha, WI (I think that it was pic n save or jewel).  They are incredibly good.  If you can find them, horde them.  If you know where they are in the Dallas area, please post this info.

I can't believe these are so hard to find in stores. I enjoyed them after trying them when I lived in Seattle and my girlfriend fell in love with them. Now I'm living in Portland and we can't find them anywhere and they're not avaiable for 3-5 WEEKS on amazon.I hope Carr's hasn't discontinued these! They're the best flavor they make. Excellent crackers.
I did not find the cheese rounds, honey dijon to be very tasty at all. In fact, I could not even eat one bag.  I would not recommend them to anyone.

column9: Just the Cheese Rounds, Honey Dijon
column10: Horrible!!  I am a cheese lover or all types of cheese, but this is one of the most disgusting tasting items I've tasted... I even looked at the ingredients to check and see if it was really cheese!
Not buying these again, EVER!!  Yuck! Yuck! Yuck!  It might as well have been roasted straw.

I was curious about these, and so I bought the least expensive selection of them.  First of all, it's a ridiculous price for what you get.  I'm sure that the reviewer who said that you can buy this for a couple of dollars at a big-box store is right.  But worse:  the candy is so stale it's hard and crumbly.  This stuff should have been thrown out.  That's what I did with it.  A complete waste of money.
go to walmart and get these for a dollar- their selling it to you for 12 bucks.. that's 3x the price.
We tried these a while back and really liked them.  Then, they became hard to find - thankfully Amazon had them!  I ordered extras just in case.

column4: Timothy K. Mccomb "toons and tunes fan"
column10: Dark chocolate, cool mint make this an excellent candy bar. The filling is smooth, not chalky with a thin chocolate coating.  I keep mine in the freezer to save, then i grab a couple for the road.

Shopzeus, which advertises with Amazon, offers 4 48oz barrels of Utz party mix at a very good price.  The problem was that they sent just one barrel.  After emailing them, they said that a warehouse employee will be notified to fix the problem as quickly as possible.  It didn't happen that fast, but nearly 2 weeks later, a package of not 3, but 4 barrels arrived.  But then the problem was they sent outdated merchandise, the sell-by date being 4 weeks previous.  The contents seemed okay, however, so I accepted it even so.  I saw another review where they sent one can of dogfood to a customer who ordered a case, and Shopzeus didn't immediately fix anything for them.  Also, a 92% positive feedback they have overall leaves 8% of customers not fully satisfied, and with tens of thousands of transactions, this figures to over 2500 of them having some problem.  So, be advised.  If an order works out, great.  If it doesn't, their claim to guaranteed customer satisfaction may leave one to wonder.  Kudos to Amazon whose buyers protection guarantee oversaw this, but also, and to my surprise, sent me a notice that my purchase price is being refunded.  I kept a friend abreast of this story as it progressed, and after learning the outcome, he simply emailed back, "I love Amazon".  You bet.
Always FRESH and always arrives sooooooo fast.Thanks so much!
Snack was very good. I only received one of the two. Is one being sent separately?

The Skinny Crisp crackers are excellent even for those who don't have to be on a diet, but Amazon is stating that you get a three pack of 5oz bags for $5.99, but when you get to the Netrition website, it is not true.  I called Netrition's customer service and it was a "too bad, so sad" attitude.  Try Connoisseur Market instead.
This is the cake part, you need to add your own Amaretto to it. And it really beats making your own!
Dry. Unimpressive. Doesn't taste anything like tiramisu. I wouldnt pay [ ... ] for it in the store, let alone this price plus shipping. Maybe their torta would have been better.

A nutritionist recommended this Teddie all-natural peanut butter to me. It doesn't have extra sugar and additives as many supermarket peanut butters have. It's low in sodium, also. Love it on whole grain english muffins or even a spoonful as a snack. It's a great way to eat protein and healthy fat. When you want protein, but are going light on meat, this makes a delicious meal on whole grain toast, muffins, or on a banana or apple or celery for a snack.

One can tell that the producers of this peanut butter attend to details. The plastic containers and seals were excellent on these jars. The product itself is way above any brand that I have tried so far.

column9: Nestle European v/s Nestle India products
column10: If you have tried Nestle Cerelac (Stage 3 - Mixed Veg and Mixed Fruits) from India, you will be disappointed by this Nestle Cerelac European version. This is becuase the Indian version contains small fragments of fruits and vegetables in the wheat flour suspension. That maks an interesting blend for the baby to eat and try new feeling for the food. But this European Cerelac is just a powdery mix and produces a blend paste like result.
Excellent product. I am a repeat client and my 8month old girl loves her cerelac.Delivery is prompt and packaging is perfect.  Expiry date is great !

I love these chocolates.  These decadent, creamy milk chocolate covered almonds are coated with a perfect layer of green tea powder.  They make a perfect anytime-treat!  The chocolates come in a  cute plastic container, so they make a nice present too!  I love these and will buy again.

I was a little hesitant to purchase this item because the can was 70 oz and what if I didn't like it?? Well, for store bought caponata, this is delicious. I had it over pasta with a little parmesan cheese and I was in heaven. I spooned it over toasted garlic bread and my eyes rolled to the back of my head in ecstacy!!  I recommend it highly and I am buying my second can today after receiving the first can yesterday!  ENJOY!!!!!
This is as good as you can get in a commercial product.  If you like a rich caponata you'll like this product.

Roland's Caponata: I order Roland's Caponata through Amazon in a 70 ounce can for about $21.00. When it arrives each month I divide the large can into small 7-10 ounce jars which I refrigerate.Roland's brand is the best tasting caponata I've found and the discounted price makes it an affordable treat. It has about 170 calories a serving and can be eaten by diabetics. Caponata is cooked eggplant in cubes, with capers, olives, oil, etc. in a light tomato sauce. Excellent at room temperatures. Available in the Italian specialty area of most markets at 3.99 to 4.99 for a 7 ounce can.
Disappointing flavor, bits of spice 'debris' in bottom of cup, does not hold a candle to other pumpkin spice cappuccini I have had - especially DeWares - would not order this brand again

Very good quality and taste.  I make mine with half water and half milk and the taste is wonderful, no mixing difficulty.  Most Pumpkin Spice Cappucino mixes I found did not have the good quality taste that this one does.

column4: Kimberly J. Karas "a New England mom"
column10: I wanted something simply convenient to mix up with the spring water hot tap.  Caffe D'Vita fits the bill.  I like the pumpkin spice flavor as well as the 16 oz size.  It is great for a little pick me up on a chilly day.

The Pumpkin Spice flavor is pretty decent but there are mixing issues.  It must be the "spice" part, but there's quite a bit of undissolved material that floats on the top and clings to the side of the cup.

Unlike the previous reviewer, the delicate taste of mint and lemon is WHY this is my favorite tea. It definitely has a little more flavor than the usual green tea without hitting you over the head with it. The delicate flavors don't overwhelm the green tea flavor but enhance it.This tea is wonderful both hot and iced. When I make it iced, I don't add any sweetener or other flavoring. The slight mint and lemon flavor makes it marvelously refreshing as an iced tea.

column9: Longtime user, best instant tea out there.
column10: I've been drinking this stuff every day for over 4 years now.  It has basically replaced soda in our house.  It is relatively sweet tasting - similar to sweet tea, but not quite as sweet.  I've tried many different types of zero calorie tea mixes and nothing seems to compare.  Not only does it taste great but is also chock full of antioxidants.  It doesn't get better than this.

This is a great value, and makes for some pretty good tea.  I probably use one 2 quart serving's worth every week.  That being said, it definitely has a different taste than the store bought cans and jugs, with perhaps a little note of citrus or something I can't put my finger on.  Overall, I'd still recommend it, but if you're looking to make exactly what you'd find in the store for less, this isn't it.

column9: Arizona Sugar Free Green Tea with Ginseng Iced Tea. I love this stuff.
column10: I will soon be 73 years of age. In my lifetime, I have consumed many flavors and types of soft drinks. Arizona Green Tea is the best tasting of all to my old taste buds. I like the kind that Amazon.com sells better [ASIN:B001THXOIS AriZona Sugar Free Green Tea with Ginseng Iced Tea Mix, 1.7-Ounce Tubs in Cannister (Pack of 4)], than the pre-mixed, liquid variety. I think it has a milder, better taste.After mixing a pitcherful, you can use the left over little container for storing little things. Or, do as l do and sort your pills into it. I am not kidding; those containers are handy little things to have around.As is normally true, Amazon.com offers the best price to be found. Amazon.com's subscription plan is an especially good deal.I strongly recommend buying this product from Amazon.com on a subscription basis. Then, you will never run out. And you will not find a better price anywhere. I have found none as good.

The convenience of having Arizona Green Tea in these great little containers is nothing short of FANTASTIC! I love AZ tea, but having moved to a much smaller home recently, I was having difficulty finding storage for the big jugs. This is the answer! Each little tub makes a half gallon, so it fits nicely into the fridge and i can make it up quickly in a snap. The taste is the same as far as I can tell. Twenty five stars to this product!! (Now, if only it came in decaf ;-)  )

This is the best iced green tea ever!!!  It is much better than the Arizona tea in jugs at the store.  I used to buy this at a local supermarket, I would load up with all they had on the shelf (about 6-8) metal cannisters, then they stopped selling it and this is the first time I have been able to have it in a couple of years!!!  My family and I drink about a gallon every other day!!!  I can't say enough great things about this product.

I used to buy the GREEN TEA WITH GINSING and it was very good but then they stopped selling it and replacedit with GREEN TEA WITH GINSING & HONEY.....way too sweet! And the diet kind had that funny taste.  I'm so glad I found this one....it tastes wonderful...AND HAS 0 CALORIES & it's way cheaper then the jugsin the stores. It's very simple to mix & it stays mixed. GREAT PRODUCT!

Got hooked on this tea a couple of years ago but didn't like buying it in the big plastic jugs because they're not recyclable in my area so I stopped buying it.  This definitely cuts down on packaging and guilt for me.  Taste is great also.

column9: Arizona sugar free green tea, in powder form
column10: I love this stuff and Safeway doesn't carry it anymore. Giant does not carry it. Walmart does not carry it. I can't live without it. Thankfully I can get it from Amazon.com :) Yaay

Arizona Green Tea has been my beverage of choice almost since it's introduction!  When my local megamart stopped stocking it, I discovered the "tea stix" (single serving), which served as a quick fix for my tea cravings.  While shopping for more stix, I came across the 1.7-Ounce Tubs here at Amazon.  While not quite on par with "factory-brewed", the little tubs provide a quick half gallon of green tea at a great price.  I'll definitely be ordering more when my supply runs low!

This is one of the better teas that I have tried.  And it is good for you.  Very happy to find it in the little tubs so that I no longer have to buy it in the small individual servings.  The taste is not too teay and the ginseng gives a little twist to the tea taste.  Try it and I think you will be pleasantly surprised.

column9: sugar free Arizona green tea ginseng iced tea mix
column10: Excellant flavor. Easy preperation.  Helps me drink my 6-8 glasses of water a day.

All of my local stores discontinued selling this and I am in a major metro area. This tea is much better than the pre-bottled product because it doesn't have the syrupy taste.  It's replaced Soda for my household and it's very good!  Thank you Amazon! You are amazing.
For long time I was looking by a sugar free beverage with good flavor. I really hate aspartame taste very bad, but sucralose is a great sustitute of the sugar and green tea taste amazing.

This is one of the few zero calorie drink mixes that doesn't contain aspartame.  If you google "aspartame poisoning"  you'll know why this is important.  It is light and refreshing and quenches thirst better than any other drink.

Honestly, this is all I drink.  I work around the country and I don't always like the taste of the water.  This is all I have been drinking since August, 2001 when I stopped drinking all drink with carbonation.AriZona Green Tea with Ginseng Sugar Free Iced Tea Stix, 0.7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

column9: Yay - no more plastic bottles to recycle!
column10: I was drinking this stuff all the time but hated all the plastic bottles. Found this mix here on Amazon - can't find it in any local stores. The powdered mix tastes just like the bottled tea. Got a subscription so now the tea comes to me!

column9: Just like one comes in jug
column10: Friend of mine who only drank AriZona tea told me that he now buys them as mix.  I tried it and find it very much like that comes in jug.  I used S&S and receive every 3 months.  I like it a lot.
This tastes quite a bit sweeter than the bottled product.  I watered it down some.

I did not realize that this product consists of about 24 individual little plastic containers of powder.  Have to open and discard each container each time you make the tea.  What a way to totally pollute the environment unnecessarily because these containers will last for hundreds of years. And all these little plastic containers are nested in 4 bigger containers.  I mean, c'mon, just have one container powder, and a scoop.

I originally bought the bottles from the grocery store. I found the canister on one occasion, tried the mix and was pleased, but I couldn't find it, again. The bottles were heavy to carry so my preference was the mix. Less storage space required was another advantage of the canister. I decided to look on Amazon and was pleased to find it. I'd give this six stars if I could. I have a prescription for this item.

Compared with Arizona's bottled teas, this product is clearly the winner. It tastes fresh, while the Arizona pre-mixed tea tastes stale... like it sits in warehouses too long prior to being sold... which I imagine it does. Other instant tea mixes vary from poor to barely acceptable. This mix is "clearly and refreshingly" at the "tea-top!"

Best tasting tea, especially at room temperature. Often I use three of the small containers per one gallon for added flavor , especially if I fill the container all the way to the top. Keep gallon container refrigerated over night for freshness. The tea has an excellent taste when hot. Ice or cold temperatures reduces its taste to me .

column9: Love this as a substitute for soda!
column10: I have been really working hard to cut out soda and think this is a great substitute to do that! Yes, it does have Splenda in it (and wish it had honey but how could it come in such a small canister)?The taste on this is great. I bought a mixing jug and mix this with just a bit more water than the recommended amount. The 4 packs have lasted me for months and should last be a bit more and I will buy some more when that happens.If you are trying to eliminate soda then green tea is a great way to go. The only downside may be the storage of it which is why I would recommend buying a jug to make it in. I almost wish I had a bigger jug so I could make two packets so it lasts longer. We drink a lot of this!

Best Product I have found in a long time. This Canister holds Six tubs that makes 2 Quarts of the Best Green Tea Ever!  I was so happy to find it in the convenient Tubs for travel or at home.  Finding it in the Stores was terrible, so when I found it on "Amazon" at such a great deal I could not pass it up! The Canister is sealed and each tub is sealed by them self...so they do stay fresh.They make them in different flavors & have Sugar-Free which I could not find in any store.  Even if you are not a Arizona Tea drinker you will be very surprised how good this product taste...Once you get these you will be on the Auto order before you know it.

Tea is Tea... I litte weak in the flavor department. But overall a good value...I like Arizona tea over other brands right now because of the great rpice from Amazon.. Amazon is also a good stock to own..
This is an item that I could no longer get in stores and I so enjoyed drinking it. I am thrilled to be able to get this product so convenietly and at a good prise, from a reliable source.
I've been drinking this tea ever since I first found it 5 years ago.  I stopped drinking soda pop and only drink this tea, it's that good.  So refreshing and light.

column9: Just like the jugs if you water it down a bit
column10: These are a great value but the instructions on the package are way too strong - It recommends one packet per 2 quarts of water, I found that 1 packet per 3-4 quarts delivered much better flavor

My whole family loves this ice tea drink. We go through a gallon a day. It is refreshing, sugar free, caffeine free and the cheapest drink next to water. What more could you want. It is easy to carry back home, my bad back loves that. It is easier to store in cabinets. We take the canisters with us when we travel, no threat of spilling. The canisters are better for the enviroment than plastic jugs or aluminum cans. Plus we use the empty canisters later for storing anything from nails, screws, threads, etc. Can keep things dry & sand free at the beach. Our extended family has grown fond of it also. It is not available in their area so they are ordering it by the case online. The only thing you need to do is clean out your pitcher routinely. A residue will build up on the inside of the pitcher over time. I love it mixed with cold water and chilled. My husband likes it a little stronger by mixing powder with hot water and chilling. It makes a difference.

I enjoy this item very much. I first had this product in a can premixed. not many places carried it, and then I discovered the sticks. they are nice for the office or a road trip, but the tubs a re nice to mix a batch for dinner. The tubs are well proportioned and I do not have the issue of unused mix in the bottom. The convenience of a subscription reduces the price enough to continue ordering through Amazon and so I do not have to continually browse for new sources.

I love Arizona Green tea, but hated dragging the big jugs home.  While this doesn't taste 100% the same, it is close and is very good.  I find it to be very strong, so I dilute it quite a bit more than the package lists.

I love this Jolt gum! I used to be able to buy this gum at my local gas station but it disappeared a couple years ago. I was very happy to find it on amazon. i bought 2 cases so i could hand out packs to all my friends. Great stuff. gives you a boost of energy with out the jitters. Tastes ok, especially if u chew it w a piece of Orbit.
Tastes like any other gum, but kicks like a cup of coffee. Best of all, you can take it with you anywhere, don't have to keep it warm, and it won't spill and stain your shirt!
AWESOME gum LOVE IT LOVE IT!!!!! Gives a little kick of caffeine in the afternoon when the coffee wears off!!!

Falling asleep in class? Staying up late for that end of the year project? Coffee machine broken or too expensive? Jolt energy gum gives you energy quickly, with a great taste and at a great price. You can't always drink coffee, but you can always have a piece of gum. I'd recommend this product to anyone and everyone. I gave out packs of this to a lot of my friends at the end of last semester before finals.
Pop a couple when you are getting sleepy while driving. Doesn't last long, but does the job and improves road safety in a flash.

column9: Great for when it's inconvenient to have coffee!
column10: I do a lot of driving for my work, and a lot of visiting other businesses.  I also drive a manual transmission, sometimes in heavy traffic.  It's not always the greatest idea to be driving in heavy traffic with one hand on the wheel, one on a cup of coffee, and needing to shift, or to be wandering around in a clients place of business.Jolt gum tastes pretty much like any other minty gum (there is a bit of a difference, but it is not unpleasant), but has just enough caffeine in it to keep me going!  It's great stuff, and I highly recommend it.

column9: These people are just drop shippers for costco.com
column10: Do not purchase. The people selling this item do not carry it in stock they simply dropship from costco.com and charge a premium for it.

If you plan on purchasing this item through Kitty Hawk Wholesale as a gift, and think it will arrive by a certain date, think again.  My experience with Kitty Hawk Wholesale was that they dragged their heels on getting this item out and then they lied regarding when it was shipped and when it would arrive.  Maybe they prefer to only ship on certain days.  Who knows?  But the popcorn was great!  My father much enjoyed it when he finally got to sit down with it, two days after Father's Day.
Rawhides like these can be difficult to find for some reason. My dog loves them. He is a power chewer and they last quite a while. I highly recommend them!

column9: Best formula out of all I have tried in 7 years
column10: I've cycled through various super-premiums with my Rhodesian Ridgeback over 7 years including Orijen, Wellness, Eagle Pack (old formulas), and numerous Natures Variety. Her poop looks like Willy Wonka chocolate bars on this stuff. It's super digestible with less stool. And don't be concerned by the dark color. The other food that I love is Honest Kitchen, a dehydrated food, but it is so expensive that I've only used it as an additive / topping but would also recommend those foods if you don't have a large dog due to the cost.

column9: Our Dog's latest Favorite Food came from Amazon
column10: Just as the caption above indicates, we have a 6 year old shitzhu who is very particular in what he eats.  But this latest dog food has become his favorite.  Thank you Amazon!!!

I would have liked this product since rabbit is all my dog can tolerate, but the ingredients list shows it is rabbit and salmon and my dog cannot eat salmon. The bag front makes it look single protein when it is not. I challenge Instinct to make it rabbit only or add salmon to the front.
