The food is very good, but the bag does not has zipper to keep the food fresh.in small space like mine, is better to storage the food in the bag original bag.

My best friend's husband loves these!!!!! He says they are "better than sex"!!!! I sent the 7.5lb bag to him for his 65th birthday. He  repackaged them and only allows himself a certain amount per day. At first he said the 7.5lb bag would last him several years, but in two weeks he's already eaten 8oz!!! This is a man who prides himself on self restraint, rigorous workout and nutritious eating habits.
I purchased this candy and it is very very good. Each color has a distinct tast. Fantastic. Would order again.
All in all the candy was good and fresh and very flavorful. The package was a little too large for me since it took me some time to divide it into manageable portions.

I had these growing up, I'm 39 and had them since I was 11. They are the best in the world. When i was shopping I always looked for them, than I looked them up on line and there they were. Will be buying again. I bought a 7.5 pd bag 2 months ago and still have some even with a little sharing. LOL . Thank you.
It is very delicious and I recommend you to try it.I had tasted before a long time and I surprised that Amazon sell it.
This is the best noodles I`v ever ate, I really  recommend this product  .soto mie so delicious i love it

Got it for my boyfriend! He loves Indomie and I couldn't find it anywhere in stores where i live.. I was so glad Amazon had it! Its just like Ramen, but more spicy and still unhealthy in large in take amounts, but its what he wanted so I would do anything to see he's happy. Shipping is a little bit pricey, but like I said I'll do anything to make him happy =]

column4: Richard C. Drew "Anaal Nathra/Uthe vas Bethod...
column10: I ordered the 35 pack and received two of each flavor, and three of one flavor.  I understand this is a random selection, so it's luck of the draw. My complaint - I visualize a couple of people packing these boxes, just tossing the K-cups in a box from other random boxes. No liner, separators, or even stacking. So when it arrived, a couple of the tops were slit open, obviously by hitting against the edges of another K-cup.  Nothing spilled out, so I was able to use them. Expiration dates were Mid 2012 thru early 2013 (I received the order in Dec 2011.) The earliest exp. date was five months away.Would I order it again? Sure. The price is decent - many K-cup samplers charge over a buck per K-cup.

I ordered the 35 pack.  Maybe I just got lucky but I had an excellent variety!  I have 19 different kinds, doubles of the majority.  With one flavor I got 3. There were probably 7 decafs.  They were thrown into the box, but none were damaged.  Overall, I'm happy and I'll probably order again.

I received the Crazy Cups Flavored Coffee Sampler (pack of 35) today and am quite pleased with it.  The K-cups came packaged in a brown paper bag encased in a sealed plastic bag.  (Since it was labeled a "sample" variety pack I didn't expect the cups to be packaged in a box - which is fine by me.)  The flavors were random as was the quantity of each flavor.  I liked that there was more than one or two of each flavor enclosed because this will give each person in my family a chance to try each one.The only way it could have been a tiny bit better was if they sent an additional flavor of the Donut House Coffee instead of 6 of the Chocolate Glazed Donut one. Same goes with the 5 Hazelnut Noisette.  (Although if I like them, I'll be very happy there were so many!!)FYI: In my sampler I received the following:Green Mountain Coffee:3 Caramel Vanilla Cream5 Hazelnut Noisette2 French Vanilla3 Southern Pecan4 Mocha Nut FudgeGreen Mountain Limited Edition Coffee:2 Pumpkin Spice2 Spiced Egg Nog1 GingerbreadGloria Jean's Coffee:4 French Vanilla Supreme3 HazelnutDonut House Coffee:6 Chocolate Glazed DonutIf the price remains low, I will be buying this sampler pack again - real soon!

The price isn't too bad, but I guess my expectations were too high.  Most of these coffees were very low on flavor.  The coffee part was okay I guess, but individual coffees aren't a good value, especially if you are someone who drinks more than 1-2 cups a day.  I ended up buying a K-Cup attachment and buying a large container of Folgers coffee and making my own.  This is a much better value.Summary:  Coffee okay (cost too much per unit)- Flavor, not so much.

The selection was OK, but not great, as it seemed that they had piled in all the flavors that didn't sell well and sent them along.  The mix was about 50-50 good and average.  Not a bad deal, but not really that satisfying.
I enjoyed trying all the various flavors.  This was an excellent choice.  Don't hesitate to try it.  You won't regret it.

column9: good deal if you want variety
column10: this is a good deal in terms of variety although there were more vanilla-esque flavors than others. i was somewhat disappointed to find out that there were only 1 each of the wolfgang puck flavors listed and multiples of the others. those were the ones i was really wanting to try! all in all, still a good bargain!
This is a really great assortment of K-Cups.  I have enjoyed every one of these I have tried so far.  I really liked the JMaka Me Crazy..funny title.

This item really shouldn't be listed as a gift pack, because of the packaging.The product inside is exactly as described, but the K-cups are just piled in a plain brown cardboard box. I expected that there would at least be attractive labeling on the box, but no. It's a plain brown shipping box. It's not a huge problem, but I wouldn't even consider giving this as a gift without moving the contents to a better-looking container. I'm using a good looking cigar box because I know my recipient will like it and use it again, but a nice basket or decorative tin would also be good choices.Also: the limited edition print is not impressive. The others in the series may be show-stoppers, but this one . . . not so much. You can see the image by clicking on its thumbnail on the item page, two birds with coffee beans. When my husband saw it, he said, "It looks like something out of a coloring book." I will not be including it as part of the gift.So, taken all in all, I'm not sorry I bought this item, but I'm glad I have a better container to put it in.

I don't know if I got lucky with mine, or if it's because my assortment was actually sold by Amazon (vs another seller fulfilled by Amazon), but I got a great assortment.  In my pack of 35 cups, all of which were in fine shape and did NOT come in a bag (they were in a box, which was packed in another box with bagged air for padding), I got 26 unique flavors, and nine duplicates (but a max of two of any one flavor).  The majority were from Green Mountain Coffee, but I also had some from Wolfgang Puck, Donut House, Timothy's, Grove Square, Van Houtte (only one of those), and Gloria Jean's.My only complaint, and this is very minor, is that two of the cups were cider drinks instead of coffee, but I'm perfectly willing to try out the cider in the evening when I don't want the caffeine.  Certainly not worth taking off a star.  I'll definitely purchase this assortment again, but I'll make sure my seller is Amazon.

I was so happy to see a k-cup variety of most of the flavors I would be interested in trying.  I was lead to believe what was posted in the description would be what I would receive.  From the description it said you would receive 25 different flavors.  What was received was 80% of coffee from Green Mountain in only 3 flavors and I received flavors that were not advertised like Limited Edition Gingerbread and Pumpkin.  I understand not all of what was advertised would be available but when I go to my local grocery store or WALMART I see Hazelnut Decaf and Kahlua, of which I received not ONE in my order. In fact, not one DECAFE was added to my order, which was expected.  If I wanted what I received I would have purchased the variety pack from the local Bed Bath and Beyond.  In addition, the packaging looked as if I took home something from my local market,stuffed in a brown paper bag and stapled closed. Please be aware what you see is NOT what you get. I am so disappointed with this seller I feel that AMAZON should put a process in place to limit a seller who has a bait and switch like this.  SELLERS should be more wary not to take advantage of their bread and butter..."THE CUSTOMER"!

Like the first reviewer, I too was surprised to get a box (no inner box at all) of loose k cups. There was a cardboard tube in the middle of the box to keep them from rolling around too much, but one was wrinkled so badly it almost fell apart.This is a nice assortment and you can compare different brands of the same flavors for your reference. But the package and presentation is low budget. Also no poster as described.Rating it a 4 for coffee assortment but a 0 for packaging and product misrepresentation!

Happy to recieve very quickly and we are having a great time trying the amazing different tastes they have to offer.Very easy to use in our new K Cup machine we also ordered at the same time.Great idea to get the variety pack to start then you can see which ones you prefer then order accordingly. Enjoy!

I ordered because it was supposed to be a variety of 25 different flavors without ordering 25 boxes. However, I only received 20 different flavors not counting the ones that technically are same flavor just a decaf version. I also received 4 of one pod when I thought it could have been a little more diverse. The product did not match the description given and that's what is disappointing. I would have at least like to have been shipped what I thought I was paying for and not ripped off about 5 more flavors to make the most of the variety. With that being said, I do not think I will be ordering from amazon again.

I was a little hesitant in ordering as there were several comments about the lack of selection, however, I was pleasantly surprised when I opened the box.  There was definitely 25 different flavors and about 4 which there were 2 of.  All in all a great way to sample different flavors without having to commit to an entire box of 16 which can be very costly especially if you end up not liking the flavor.  I love being able to sample some that I might otherwise be hesitant to try.

If you like a little flavor to your coffee I would highly recommend this variety pack. I like a bit of a switch up and not the same standard coffee every day so that is why I ordered this pack. Coffee tastes great and got my order within two days. Once I run out..I'll be back to order again!

After reviewing the other reviews I took a chance and ordered this directly from Amazon.I am also not a fan of decaf and was worried about how many decafs I would receive in my order.Only 2 of the 35 were decaf so as the title states I got the luck of the draw. The rest were all coffee and only four were labeled "iced coffee" versus coffee or cappuccino.It gave me a nice variety in an easy to open cardboard box. It gives me a nice variety of two of each item with the exception of "Island Coconut" where I received three of them which is ok.The box has an expiration date of 12/21/2012 which is fine as I'll easily drink 35 cups between now and then.I hope others have the same luck.

Alough there are quite a few negative reviews it seems the company has taken the consumer's advice and improved on the product. Just opened my box (yes box, not a bag as some older reviews stated) and it was like Christmas in October! 23 different flavors with 35 k-cups total, more variety than I've found anywhere else (especially for such a reasonable price). Some of the flavors I recieved were: mudslide, caramel vanilla cream, mild mtn blueberry, mocha nut fudge, chocolate glazed donut, kahlua original, pumpkin spice, vanilla skyline, butter toffee, island coconut, and maple sleigh. There were also some basics like french vanilla, hazelnut, etc. along with a couple(2) decaf (yes, decaf, it is called a VARIETY pack after all), and a couple(2) cappuccino k-cups. All in all, this is a fantastic way to try a wide variety of flavored coffees without spending a small fortune. Buy it, you know you want to :) Cheers!
Nice variety, but don't like the cappuccino's.  There are too many, 2 of each flavor; 3 flavors. There is also some teas. Rather have all coffee. Most of the coffee flavors are good.

I recently purchased a Keurig machine and wasn't cure what kind of K-cups I should get.I didn't want to commit to a large box of one flavor becauseA. I like variety and B. What if I didn't like the flavor?So, despite many awful reviews, I decided to take a risk and order this project.And like the title says, I was pleasantly surprised!The product came in a rectangular box, not the paper bag many reviewers were offended by, and the K-Cups were nicely organized inside.I received a wide variety of K-Cups from different companies. While many of them were vanilla or caramel, even those came in a variety of blends and companies.Also included were several cappuccino K-Cups, which I didn't even know existed.Additionally, considering it was fall, I received two Pumpkin Spice K-Cups - Yum!2 Brooklyn Maple Sleigh2 Brooklyn Hazelnut2 Brooklyn Vanilla Skyline1 Green Mountain Mocha Nut Fudge1 Green Mountain Wild Mountain Blueberry2 Green Mountain Island Coconut - Limited Edition1 Green Mountain French Vanilla Decaf1 Green Mountain French Vanilla1 Green Mountain Hazelnut Decaf1 Green Mountain French Vanilla Iced Coffee1 Green Mountain Hazelnut Noisette1 Green Mountain Caramel Creme Vanilla2 Green Mountain Pumpkin Spice - Limited Edition1 Green Mountain Southern Pecan2 Grove Square French Vanilla Cappuccino - Dairy2 Grove Square Caramel Cappuccino - Dairy2 Grove Square Hazelnut Cappuccino- Dairy2 Kahlua Original1 Gloria Jean's Mudslide1 Gloria Jean's French Vanilla Supreme1 Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee1 Gloria Jean's Hazelnut1 Wolfgang Puck Jamaica Me Crazy1 Donut Shop Collection Cinnamon Roll1 Donut Shop Collection Chocolate Glazed DonutAs well as a couple others that I have already drank and don't recall which they were.Overall I was very pleased with the variety I received and none of the included cups were expired, damaged or dried out in any way.Would definitely order again and suggest it to others!P.S. All of the included K-Cups were certified Kosher.
Have not found one I didn't like yet..lots included...all fresh and new...took a long time to get in but happy with the item
There were a lot of different flavors in this, and even some cappuccino ones. There were 1-2 of each flavor. I really enjoyed trying them.

When I received my purchase I could not wait to open it.  It was just like Christmas!.  I received many different varieties. So many choices I couldn't decide which to try first!  There were regular coffee, decaf coffees, Iced coffee and ciders.  I have now tried all of them and was happy with everyone.  I of course have my favorites now and so will order more of those but when a variety is called for I could not beat this package.

This is a great variety of wonderful, flavored coffees.  Our clients really enjoy them.  They get so excited spinning the carousel and picking out their flavor.  Even tho the brewing only lasts seconds, the wonderful aroma lingers on for hours!

column9: Way less than advertised selection, even when counting decaf as a seperate flavor.
column10: I was hoping when ordering this that it would come with many unique flavors to try, the main reason I bought the Keurig over other competing products was the selection of coffee flavors. This package does not deliver on the variety it promises. When counting each flavor without duplicates there was 21 selections, however three of these were decaf versions of the same flavor from the same company. The majority of the selections were either hazelnut or french vanilla from different companies, if you remove the decafs and choose only one of hazelnut and french vanilla from all companies there are only 10 different flavors of coffee, much less than the advertized 27. I will not be buying this selection of k cups again nor will I be buying any of "crazy cups" mixed packs.

I love my kuerig but it's hard to find flavors I like, especially in regular stores. After searching on line, I came across this product and I must say, it was worth it. I love the flavors, especially the coconut.

This is a great mix if you are looking for a mix of mostly light, fun flavors of coffee.  Only a few were not coffee like tea.  It was fun trying to decide which kind I should try next.  There were some I would never would have tried like blueberry coffee, however it was great.  Who knew? I would so get this again.

I expected to get a variety of coffee Keurig K-cups but ended up almost half in tea.  I do not like tea and neither do my friends.  Other times I ordered, there were only about three tea cups in the box.

I wasn't sure what to expect from a sampler but I was very impressed with the selection. There were 23 different flavors and the rest were duplicates. There was a good selection of different brands and thankfully only one decaf. If you're looking to try out a bunch of brands & flavors without having to buy a whole box, this is what you want. Great variety at a great price...

I hate committing to one or two flavors only. This was a great way to have many flavored options for my Keurig machine. It was a little bit more money than I would like to pay but it's far better than buying several different boxes. I expect to order this again. :-)

Used these K-Cups in the Mr. Coffee Single Server  that we got at Amazon.  Everyone on vacation really enjoyed chosing the flavor they liked best, and also enjoyed trying out all the varities.  Great buy !!

column9: Seems better than it is, for my taste
column10: I thought I would want to try every brand and every blend, but it turns out once I found my favorite, I wasn't interested in trying the rest. I like dark, bold coffee flavors and most of these were very LIGHT and left me feeling like I was drinking watered down coffee. Although I was really looking forward to the variety I didn't enjoy most of them and it soon turned into a chore to get through the box so that I could go out and buy the flavor and brand that I wanted most. If your unsure of which brand will be right for you or you like weak coffee go ahead and give it a try, but if you like rich dark bold coffee, skip this pack!

column9: Crazy Cups assortment fits the need
column10: I bought this assortment because I never look at what I select therefore I just want something different every time I have a coffee and this assortment fits the bill perfectly.

I was a bit nervous to order this product as it seemed that other reviewers had issues with a lack of assortment and broken cups.  I was very happy with my assortment, and there was definintely a wide variety of different flavors.  I will be ordering again!

This is the 3rd box I've bought.  I like to randomly choose one and be surprised. There have been no cups that I just absolutely disliked. As a matter of fact, there have been some that I really liked so I ordered boxes of just those.
The sampler package was a great way to try new coffees with our having to buy them in bulk! Liked all of the coffee's, but found there were some I absolutely LOVED!
Nice grab bag of coffee. Wasn't to heavy on one particular flavor either. My favorite was the Jamaica Me Crazy.
This product is awesome except it has Decaf in it. I purchased this thinking it was all regular coffee. Everything else was great.
I really hesitated to order this because of the reviews but I am SO glad I did. I couldn't be more pleased. Out of 35 cups, I have 23 different flavors to try. Thank you Amazon!

column9: VARIETY IS THE SPICE OF LIFE
column10: NICE SAMPLE OF VARIOUS COFFEES.  I FOUND I LIKED MOST OF THEM.  IT IS  A GOOD WAY TO FIND YOUR PERFECT FLAVOR. YOU GET ABOUT TWO OF EACH FLAVOR.  THEY SHOULD HAVE INCLUDED A COUPLE OF JAMAICA ME CRAZY.

I was skeptical about ordering these because of all the negative reviews, but still excited about trying some new flavors. I'm glad I wasn't swayed by what I read because I love what I received! I didn't get anymore that 2 of any 1 flavor and only 2 decafs. Which is fine with me because I can use those for company without having to buy an entire box. Also, my K-Cups were delivered quickly and without damage. Mine were shipped in a box, not a paper bag like I read in some previous posts. So, I am happy with my yummy coffee assortment and plan on getting another!
Variety of Kcups. Lots to sample. I found my favorite in the Kahlua cup. There was cider found in the assortment as well.

So, the point of this purchase was to get a variety of flavors to try.  The upside of this purchase was that 8 or more brands were represented and the box included regular, decaf, iced coffee, and cappuccino choices.  The downside was that I got duplicates of several k-cups!  There were 2 of each of these: Wolfgang Puck Creme Caramel, GMC Caramel Vanilla Cream, Gloria Jean Mudslide, Gloria Jean Butter Toffee, Jamaica Me Crazy, Kahlua, and Donut House Chocolate Glazed Donut.  I can understand one or two of the same, but that many?  It almost negates the point of buying a variety pack.  Even without the specific repeats, you're already getting multiple brands of flavors like hazelnut and vanilla.  Sigh.

I don't use my kuerig for all my coffee.  I brew my coffee in a pot daily:) Then I have a treat now and then with my Crazy Cups...I have a wide assortment depending on my mood so this works perfect for me.  Also nice for guests!  Great product.

Coffee was delivered in a very timely fashion, the product selection within was very good. I do have one very large complaint about the shipment. There were at least 6 K-cups that had broken top seals and there was loose product all over the box, causing a loss of coffee obtained for the money.  I may not select this again in the future, even tho what was usable was good.

The shipping this time around took a little longer but as always quality product. Love the different flavors gives a good variety I order them every couple of weeks to keep a good stock as a new dad I love my coffee

There are so many unique flavors, it's hard to choose which one to try next. We've had southern pecan, chocolate donut, pumpkin spice, and not a bad coffee in the bunch! This was a great idea for a 1st time keurig owner; now we know what we want to order in bulk.

we were sketchy about ordering this sampler pack, because of pervious reviews. but this is not what we expected.....this has a wonderful variety of coffee choices and they are all great....would highly recommend this to anyone

My wife and myself enjoyed all the different flavors included in the box. Each type of coffee included about 4-5 duplicates. Overall price the was a bit much compared to COSTCO and some the other locations. However,the different premium selections made it a nice treat ( Gloria Jeans, Kahlua Coffee Cafe, Wolfgang Puck, Green Mountain, The Donut Shop). I will probably pick up another box at Amazon.
I was looking for a mixed pack of k coffees and got exactly what I was hoping for!!! I love these mixed packs as they give the customer a chance to taste some new items!!!THANKS!!!

Quick delivery, good price, love it! So glad I got it. And its great to have variety packs to buy so you don't buy a huge box of a new flavor and end up not liking it. You can try multiple flavors until you find the ones you love. Very happy.

I bought this item reading the reviews and hoping that the seller had addressed the assortment issue.I received the coffee today and can report that they were packaged well in a sturdy box. None of the kcups were damaged and I didn't expect them to be since they are rather durable. Majority of the flavors seem to trend on different brands of hazelnut and vanilla but it'll be nice to see how each varies. I thought the assortment was great. I only received 9 doubles out of a box of 35. Highly recommended. I just ordered another one! After all, variety is the spice of life!I received:[Grove Square]Spiced Apple CiderCaramel Apple CiderFrench vanilla cappuccinoCaramel cappuccinoHazelnut cappuccino[Gloria Jeans]French Vanilla SupremeHazelnut x2[Timothy's]Kahlua original[Green mountain coffee]Caramel vanilla cream x2Golden french toast x2French vanilla iced coffeeMocha nut fudge x2French vanillaWild mountain blueberryGingerbreadSpicy eggnog x2Southern PecanHazulnut[Donut house]Cinnamon roll x2Choconut glazed donut x2[Wolfgang Puck]Jamaica me crazy x2Hawaiian Hazulnut x2Vanilla FrancaiseCreme caramel[Van houtte]Hazelnut

Fantastic package of different flavors for my Keurig Brewer.I enjoy a variety and it is fun to sample a different cup of coffee every day.  Every morning I say to myself "which flavor shall I have today?"  Can't say I have found my favorite yet. I love them all.
Enjoyed the various flavors. Really nice when you have company and they have a choice. Most flavors were fun to try. Would order again.
I was very happy with the asst. of coffee I received. It's almost exactly as the photo shows! I will be buying more!

There were definitely a variety of flavors included in the sampler, so if you're looking for a way to get a taste of a lot of coffees, this is fine.  If, however, you like your coffee a bit bold, it's not.  Most were very mild roasts, and adding a tiny bit of cream overpowered the brew.  One purchase was enough.
great way to sample a large variety of flavors and brands of k cups before buying a large quantity of one type. just got a keurig and loved trying all the great flavors!
Great item at a great price.  Less blueberry would have been great.  All the other flavors were great.  Thanks for a great time with COFFEE !!!
I love the variety in this pack, especially that there is 2 of each flavor. My kids were drooling over some of the flavors, I had to fight them off.

I was a little hesitant to order this flavored coffee k-cup sampler because of all the negative reviews, but Im glad I did. I recieved a great assortment of different flavored coffees, and cappuchinos. My assortment greatly resembles the picture shown for the item. Im happy I decided not to listen to the negative reviews.

I was very satisfied with the variety of coffees I received in the CRAZY CUPS assortment I purchased through Amazon.  I have consequently re-ordered and hope the variety in my second order is up to the standard I found in the original.

My variety pack arrived quickly and was packaged well for shipping.  The cups were all inside a sealed box, which was itself inside another box with protective plastic air bubbles for shipping.  As for the varieties, I had 25 different flavors, and several that had two of a particular flavor.  I'm very happy with the sampler, and I'm looking forward to trying the varieties, especially the iced vanilla latte one.

I was excited to get this varitey pack for our keurig, it seemed to have the best varitey I have seen for the best price. However when we got it it was 87% Green Mountain Brewing company and several of the same flavor, and not all that are shown above are in the assortment we recieve, which is a bummer because I wanted to try butter toffee and the donuthouse brand.. I suppose if you bought it again you would get different flavors but then you run the risk of getting a bunch you already tried and didnt like.. :/ But honestly this still is a good deal and all the flavors we have tried thus far have been very good..

This collection of flavored coffees is excellent. There was a variety of flavors - everything from ordinary hazelnut to chocolate glazed donut. It's like drinking dessert! It was a little heavy on the gingerbread but since I like that flavor it was OK.

I bought this sample pack for my daughter's 16th birthday to go with a Keurig coffee maker. The description indicates 3 different cappuccinos and an iced coffee flavor. I realize flavors could be substitiuted, but there was only one flavor of cappuccino and NO iced coffee flavors. The only reason I selected this sampler pack was because it included coffees, cappuccinos, and iced coffees. (The iced and cappuccino flavors are her favorite and she got 1 of those the rest was coffee.) This was not what I expected!

column9: very disappointed, only got 5 flavors our of 35
column10: very disappointed, only got 5 coffee flavors out of 35. I was looking foward to trying new flavors that I hadn't tried before and didn't want to buy a box of just one flavor to try new coffee.When I openned the box I was very disappointed to have only 5 flavors.Amazon..shame on you for packing it this way. I am returning it ASAP!!Crazy Cups Decaf Sampler, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 35)
Selections were 2 each of 17 different flavors with 1 extra so not a sample of all listed.  They do expire within a month of delivery, so will need to use them quickly.  A good bargain for the price.

column9: Second time ordering.  Better selection 2nd time
column10: First order came in a brown paper bag.  One of the K-cups was crushed.I was happy enough with the selection to place a second order in February of 2012.This time, the K-cups came in a cardboard box; they were loose, but none were crushed.I received the following flavors to give you an idea of what you may receive:Hazelnut noisette x2Vanilla francaise x2French vanilla cappacino x2Hazelnut cappuccinoHazelnutFrench vanilla supremeGolden french toast x2Creme carmel x2Cinnamon roll x2Chocolate glazed donut x2Hawaiian hazelnut aloha noisette x2Kahlua original x2Jamaica me crazySouther pecanMocha nut fudgeButter toffeeGingerbread x2Spicy eggnog x2Wild mountain blueberry x2Camel vanilla creme x2Hazelnut decafFrench vanilla decafFrench vanillaNot sure why they added the decaf cups - those were disappointing.  And there were 7 Vanilla/French vanilla variants and 7 Hazelnut variants.  It would be better if they limited these to two each.I probably will order again, but I would order from someone else if they guaranteed that there were no decaf and very limited French Vanilla & Hazelnut additions.

I was very disappointed with the selection in this assortment. The description listed 25 flavors....I received 5 flavors which mostly consisted of Pumpkin Spice and Eggnog with just one or two of the other flavors (french vanilla, hazelnut, mocha nut fudge)thrown in. This is not at all what was advertised; I understand that the description stated that "flavors may be substituted without notice" but there is a HUGE difference between 25 and 5 flavors. I really feel like they took their leftover holiday flavors that didn't sell and just threw them in a bag. The quality of the coffee itself was very nice I just wish that the product was what was advertised.
THE SELECTION REC'D WAS NOTHING LIKE PICTURED - ALMOST ALL WAS DUNKIN DONUT - NO KALUA - NO CARAMEL - LIKE SOMEONE JUST REACHED INTO A FEW BAGS AND SEND A FEW HANDFULS - NOT HAPPY WITH SELECTION -

column9: Really not worth the money. I will go through Keurig next time.
column10: I expected more K-cups not sure why. The value just wasn't worth it and 90% of the box was Dunkin Donuts. I expected a better selection. I was buy through keurig.com from now on.

column9: Good selection for a cheap price.
column10: Am enjoying choosing a different coffee every morning and I love the price for this luxury.  I love having the opportunity to quickly make myself a flavorful cup of coffee every morning at a reasonable price.

Although I'm glad I gave these a try, and it was exciting to try new flavors each time, most of the flavors were not to my liking.  The ones I thought I would like for sure turned out to be the worst (Kahlua, Mudslide, Chocolate Donuts, Eggnog).  They sounded delicious, but were not.  On the plus side, most of them smelled very good when brewed.  But the flavors or type of roast used were not to my liking.The best of the bunch was Southern Pecan.  Good, mellow, nice flavor.  I will order more of these.Also you should note these are all just flavored coffee - meaning there is no sugar or creamer added, and they are not cappuccino.  I was expecting some of them might be given their names (made them sound sweet, or creamy).  But they are all just plain coffee with flavors added, but no sugar or creamer.  So if you are worried about Hydrogenated Oils like I was, don't worry, none is included in these :).
Unlike other reviewers, I was given a great assortment of delicious coffees.  It seemed like a good value for a good amount of coffee.
Thank you! it was a gift for my son. It's the dream of every coffee lover. Arrived on time, perfectly packed and condition.

I was very disappointed with the order.  It didn't have the flavors advertised in the picture.  They substituted  flavors I didn't want or like and left out the ones I was really wanting.  They also just threw them in the box,bad packaging.  I felt they were getting rid of excess flavors they weren't selling or had plenty of and left out the special ones in the photo.  I will never order K cups here again.  I feel I have wasted my money.  If  had wanted gingerbread..I would have ordered it..now I am stuck with flavors I really don't like.

I had high hopes for the 25 different Crazy Cup Sampler, but was sorely disappointed.  I received just 11 different varieties and as many as 6 of 3 kinds..Not really much variety at all and none of many of the flavors shown in the purchase advertisement. I realize it said in the description that substitutions might be made without prior notice, but only 11 different varieties in an ad claiming 25 different varieties is a far cry from a few substitutions.  I'll look elsewhere next time for the variety packs.
Am still enjoying the sampler.  I love being able to choose from the variety every morning.  There are lots of great flavors in this sample pack.
This coffee was good quality, at a great price. Service was wonderful and always and it was shipped to our practice very fast.Thanks Amazon

I was a little nervous about ordering because of some of the negative reviews but I was very happy and excited when I got my order. Arrived in 2 days with free shipping (amazon prime member) and when I opened it, it was very well packed and I got 19 flavors! Approx 2 of each (a couple 3 and a couple just 1). I was really excited. Definitely a great deal to try so many flavors. Will definitely order again!

I just received my Keurig for Christmas and wanted to try a lot of different flavors. This variety was perfect. From Butter Toffee to Kahlua, it's all good. Now the problem is picking out which one is my favorite.

Contents of my 'variety pack'Green Mountain Coffee - Carmel Vanilla Cream - x6Green Mountain Coffee - Hazelnut Noisette - x6Green Mountain Coffee - French Vanilla - x6Green Mountain Coffee - Mocha Nut Fudge - x3Green Mountain Coffee - Wild Mountain Blueberry - x4Gloria Jean's - Mudslide - x1Gloria Jean's - Hazelnut - x2Gloria Jean's - Butter Toffee - x2Gloria Jean's - French Vanilla Supreme x4Donut House - Cinnamon Roll x1Kahlua - Original x1Totals:Green Mountain Coffee = 25Gloria Jean's = 9Other = 2Grand Total = 36Not impressed with the 'variety' but did get one extra and delivery was free and quick.  Glad I didn't get the holiday left overs.

Sorry to say, but not worth the $. I think if you could select what you'd like, maybe...but it had a lot of repeats and was disappointing to my hubby and I. No worries...you win some you lose some!  Great seller, though!

column4: Karen S. Van Heukelem "Trying to Pass"
column10: It was clearly a hodgepodge of seasonal overstock thrown in a brown paper bag. The packaging was sloppy, and most of the flavors were holiday ones that I'm guessing they were trying to get rid of (Eggnog, gingerbread, pumpkin spice, etc). None were broken, and it is nice to try new flavors, I just wish it wasn't so blatantly a way to flush out seasonal product! I got these as a gift for someone with a new machine so he could try a variety of flavors, but now I'm afraid the gift will look cheap since it appears to be a post-holiday special. A plus is that none of them were broken and all were accounted for.

I received my assortment package today.  I am extremely pleased.  The outer package was marked with an expiration date of 04/19/12, which is a non-issue, for me. Many of the k-cups were individually marked with expiration dates well beyond that.  All k-cups were in fine shape with no broken ones.  I received a total of 19 different flavored cups. There were 2 each of 16 flavors and 3 singles. A good assortment of great flavors. I will most certainly be ordering again.

If you love flavor variety, this is "the" sampler box to try!  I received a cross section of cappucinos; and fruit, chocolate or spice blends.  I found that I love the JamaicanMeCrazy and Golden French Toast and will now purchase those in the large quantity boxes.

I was really excited to get my package in the mail. The description of the different flavors sounded sooooooooo yummy and I couldn't wait!! However, like most of the other reviews on here, I was very disappointed. I only got three or four different flavors, two of which had a hole in them. They were just randomly thrown in the box, no effort was made to protect them during shipping. The flavors that I really wanted to try, NONE of them were in there. I got a lot of de caf french vanilla, some gingerbread (which is out of season and I'm a little uneasy to try), and a lot of Jamaican me Crazy. I must say, my excitement level to try this coffee has shot way down and I will not purchase from this seller again.

column9: Good, but all listed brands were not included.
column10: Ordered this package for variety and explicitly to try Grove Square Cappucinos...they were in the picture and listing but none came in the package, which was a major disappointment.

We ordered this package of 35 because it had the three cappucinno k-cups. And when we got the package (a shipping box with a bunch of k-cups thrown inside like other reviewers stated) there were NO cappucinno k-cups! Why include them in the image for sale if they aren't going to be in the sampler?!? Will not be ordering from them again.

I got a very nice assortment, but I suppose that may attributable to luck considering all the other negative reviews.  I purchased two variety packs the other being Crazy Cups Travel The World Sampler, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 35) and the variety of that one was awful, providing more evidence your selection will come down to luck. I will say that three of the K-cups didn't seem to have the seal pressure of the others, leading me to believe that the may have been punctured.  This is concerning in itself and certainly could affect the freshness.  All in all, I would suggest that if you are picking this sampler because of specific coffees listed, don't; you'll likely be disappointed. If you just want to try some different K-cups go for it.

Ok someone please tell me were they get off saying this is a sampler pack I mainly got 4 main flavors which were pumpkin cinnamon roll hazelnut chocolate glazed donuts and to top it off I ordered the 34 count so now I have a bunch of same coffee and the k cups are old looking  like they have been sitting around and not sold and please tossed in a paper bag will NOT be back!!!

I ordered this product even after reading several negative reviews and hoped for the best. I was not disappointed. I did receive the product in a brown paper bag. However, I didn't see anything wrong with the packaging. There were 35 K cups in the bag and all were in good condition.  I received 11 differet brands/flavors. The most of any flavor was the French Vanilla at 9 and the least was the Chocolate Glazed Donut at 1. Some of these I have tried and they are excellent. Others I look forward to trying and would definitely buy this product again.

This grouping of coffees gives you the opportunity to try many different flavors without buying a full box of one flavor.  Some reviewers have stated that the cups were all broken, because they were shipped in a brown bag.  This didn't apply to me, because I ordered something else with it and it shipped together.
I loved the variety picked for me in these samplers. Lots of fun holiday flavors along with many I would not have thought of trying. I have enjoyed each of them.

Unlike other reviewers, all 35 K-cups I received were flavored coffee.  It was such a great deal at warehouse deals I was willing to take the chance despite the mixed reviews.  I received no more than two of each.  Here is what my package contained...Donut House Cinnamon Roll (2)Donut House Chocolate Glazed Donut (2)Timothy's Kahlua (2)Gloria Jeans Butter Toffee (2)Gloria Jeans Mudslide (2)Gloria Jeans French Vanilla Supreme (2)Gloria Jeans Hazelnut (1)Green Mountain Southern Pecan (2)Green Mountain Mocha Nut Fudge (2)Green Mountain Wild Mountain Blueberry (2)Green Mountain Gingeread (2)Green Mountain Spicy Eggnog (2)Green Mountain Pumpkin Spice (2)Green Mountain Caramel Vanilla Cream (1)Green Mountain French Vanilla (1)Green Mountain Hazelnut (1)Wofgang Puck Jamaica Me Crazy (2)Wofgang Puck Hawaiian Hazelnut (2)Wofgang Puck Creme Caramel (2)Wofgang Puck Vanilla Francaise (1)Great way to try new flavors!  Can't wait to try more Crazy Cups Assortments!  They do arrive loose in a box, but no damage was noted to any of my K-cups.  I will just be throwing them in my desk drawer anyway, so packaging doesn't matter to me!

I bought the 35 k cup box and was very happy with my buy. There were 12 different flavors in the box and none were damaged. I have only tried one so far which is hazelnut and was delicious. I will order more again in the future!
The sampler is a great way to taste new flavors without committing to the entire box.  I found a few I love and will purchase again.
Well, it may be the luck of the draw, but, I thought my assortment was quite nice.5 different brands; 23 different types; 14 flavors; 3 decafWould certainly order again.

I've recently been ordering this selection for the office and they love it.  It's not an issue for us if we happen to get too much of one flavor and i've never had a quality issue with this order.  it's a great way to satisfy alot of picky coffee drinkers for me!

Despite the MANY negative reveiws, I went with my gut and kept the order in tack. I am glad I did. There was a HUGE selection - Many I would not have even thought of. Ordered a second set for the folks.

The verbage on the ad read "try 25 different flavors without buying 25 boxes!" My bag (Yes, it was just a paper grocery sack with a bunch of k-cups tossed in) only had 10 different flavors. And of the 35 k-cups I received, 25 were 1 of 3 flavors (Green Mountain french vanilla, Mocha Nut Fudge, and Caramel Vanilla Creme). Then there were 1 or 2 of a few other flavors thrown in.I contacted Amazon Customer service, who was very helpful and directed me to the seller directly since Deals for You is a 3rd party seller. They emailed me back and said that they had just changed the ad, that when I ordered (a week prior) the ad didn't specify 25 different flavors (it did, I specifically checked that and ordered because of that promise). They then blamed the issue on Amazon, saying Amazon puts these orders together and they can't control it. So they lied to me, called me a liar, misrepresented their product, and then refused to do anything to make the situation right when it was called to their attention.I have never left a negative review on this site, but after the service I received here, I have left negative reviews for both the seller and product.

The product description indicated a chance to try 35 different k-cup flavors.  What I received was half French vanilla (all the same brand) and 3 other flavors.  Not what I would consider a variety.  My first disappointing Amazon order.

You need to place this message at the top of product discription THIS PRODUCT IS FAR FROM WHAT IS SHOWN IN THE PICTURE AND PRODUCT DISCRIPTION, YOU WILL NOT GET A VARIETY OF FLAVORS BUT A LOTS OF THE SAME FLAVOR.  YOUR ORDER WILL COME THROWN IN A PLASTIC BAG INSIDE OF A BROWN PAPER SACK.  WE MIGHT FIND A FEW DIFFERENT FLAVORS TO THROW IN THE BAG, BUT DON'T COUNT ON IT, YOU GET WHAT WE HAVE IN THE STORE.  My first experience with Amazon that has resulted in a very disappointed and unhappy customer.

I purchased the 35 pack and received the following:Gloria Jean's Hazelnut 2Gloria Jean's Mudslide 2Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee 2Green Mountain Coffee Caramel Vanilla Cream 2Green Mountain Coffee French Vanilla Iced Coffee 2Green Mountain Coffee Spicy Eggnog 3Green Mountain Coffee Southern Pecan 2Green Mountain Coffee Mocha Nut Fudge 2Green Mountain Coffee Wild Mountain Blueberry 2Green Mountain Coffee Pumpkin Spice 2Green Mountain Coffee French Vanilla 2Green Mountain Coffee Hazelnut Decaf 2Green Mountain Coffee French Vanilla Decaf 2Timothy's Kahlua 2Donut House Chocolate Glazed Donut 2Donut House Cinnamon Roll 2Wolf Gang Puck Vanilla Francaise 2

I really enjoyed the variety in this package.. I didn't care for the decaf, i'm not a decaf kinda girl.  So that was the only reason I didn't give it 5 stars.. Make the variety pack without Decaf and i'll be a long time customer for life :-)Oh by the way, Chocolate glazed donut was delicious, please add more than 2 to the box...

column9: Poor variety, poor service on broken item, just plain poor
column10: Arrived in the professionally packaged brown paper bag. One item was broken.Poor variety with 6 of the same item of a few flavors, and obvious tryingto get rid of other seasonal flavors. One item slit down the side with coffeein the bag, and when contacting this seller, told me to take it up with Amazon.Never again with this shipper. Amazon should be more careful on who they share therename with.

column9: Beware - this is a rip off
column10: I was very disappointed when I received my shipment.  First, they were just all thrown in a paper bag, and one of them was damaged.  The biggest thing though, is they did not send me what the picture showed.  The majority of them were from the Holiday collection - spiced eggnog, gingerbread and french toast, and I don't think those are even in the picture!  It's like they put in there whatever is on sale at the stores - I just bought the Holiday variety box at Bed, Bath & Beyond for half off, so I was very disappointed that the majority of the 35 were from that collection.  I won't buy them like this anymore.
This Pack does not come with Kahla Coffee nor the cinnamin roll coffee which is one of the reasons i purchased it. You should have listed every flavor this included and how many. VERY DISAPPOINTED

DO NOT ORDER THESE!! Im EXTREMELY disappointed!! I was told I would get an assortment that included several varieties in the product description, and was only given HALF of what I was told I would get! They left out a LOT of the flavors I really wanted to try. I cant return this per the policy on this product which is stupid since its the fault of the packager (it was shipped to me in a brown bag...someone obviously puts them together, so its not prepackaged), and I cant apparently contact the seller either to tell them to make it right. WILL NOT ORDER AGAIN!!!

I too am disappointed in my "variety pack."  I too think the description and pictures are misleading! Shame on you Amazon! I thought I was getting the assortment pictured with two surprise flavors.  I spent a lot of time looking at the pictures of different listings to figure out which assortment I wanted. I received the shipment, no real complaints there, but was disappointed that 40% was French Vanilla from two different companies. Out of 35 cups that's 40% of total. I also had 6 flavors I didn't like at ALL (Holiday leftover flavors like Pumpkin Spice and Gingerbread, Spicy Eggnog).  Take 6 I don't like and didn't think I was getting (thought it was TWO random) and I really didn't save any money from buying in a store in town. I think the deception comes in the picture of k cups with two pictures of "surprise" flavors. I did go back and read the actual listing and to the sellers defense it says AT LEAST two random flavors.  First time Shame on ME, Second Time Shame on You AMAZON! The product SHOULDN'T be listed as a Variety Pack with specific pictures but rather listed as a GRAB BAG of random flavors from a variety of companies.  I will NOT purchase again as I am throwing away the six terrible flavors. Next time I will get with friends and have a swapping of flavors so I know what I am getting and not pay shipping!!
This variety mix included many flavors of regular coffee, but also decaf, which was a disappointing to me. I would not have ordered it if I knew this.

My 35 pack just arrived and I had opened it worried because some of the reviews had been so negative. Well I don't know if something has changed since then, but this was such a great deal. Exactly what I had been hoping for. They came in a STURDY box and NO DAMAGE was done to any of the K-Cups. It's random for sure, so results may vary from mine but I got:21 DIFFERENT varieties.No more than TWO of the same flavor.GMC: 2 Pumpkin Spice, 2 Southern Pecan, 2 Spicy Eggnog, 2 Blue Mountain Blueberry, 2 Mocha Nut Fudge, 1 Gingerbread, 1 Hazelnut, 2 French Vanilla Decaf (this is my only gripe, I was under the impression there would be no decaf)Gloria Jeans: 2 French Vanilla Supreme, 2 Mudslide, 1 HazelnutTimothy's: 2 Kahlua, 1 Cinnamon Pastry, 1 Mocha Java, 1 Decaf HazelnutWolf Gang Puck: 2 Creme Caramel, 2 Hawaiian Hazelnut, 2 Jamaica Me Crazy, 1 Vanilla,Donut House, 2 Chocolate Glazed Donut, 2 Cinnamon RollAll in all, brilliant! Like I said, my ONLY issue and the reason I was gave it 4 stars instead of 5 was the decaf thrown in. It won't get drank at my house. The 24 pack says caffeinated only, the 35 pack doesn't specify but it surely implied it would be the same type of assortment. It looks like a lot of the 35 boxes have a few decaf thrown in, so watch out for that if you mind it.

I ordered the 35 variety pack before reading the reviews and I'm glad that I did because I might have been discouraged.  I received the k-cups yesterday in a small cardboard box, and they were all in good condition; no damage.  As far as variety, it's great!  I received many different flavors with only a few duplicates:Wolf Gang Puck-2 Jamaica Me Crazy2 Creme Caramel1 Vanilla Francaise2 Hawaiian HazelnutGloria Jeans-2 French Vanilla Supreme1 Mudslide1 HazelnutGreen Mountain Coffee-1 Pumpkin Spice3 Mocha Nut Fudge2 Southern Pecan2 Caramel Vanilla Cream2 Gingerbread1 French Vanilla2 Wild Mountain Blueberry1 French Vanilla Ice CoffeeTimothy's World Coffee1 German Chocolate Cake1 Decaf Hazelnut1 Cinnamon Pastry1 Mocha JavaDonut House-2 Cinnamon Roll2 Chocolate Glazed DonutKahlua-2 Kahlua OriginalI know that this is a random sampling and there is no guarantee of which flavors you will get, but I received all the flavors I was hoping for and I can't wait to try my first cup!  I'm very pleased and I will order from this vendor again.  Thanks!

I got the 35 ct sampler and received 23 different varieties with no more than 2 of any type.  They were all flavored coffees.  The sampler did contain 1 decaf and 1 iced coffee, but that was not a problem for me.  All in all, I am very pleased with this sampler.

I ordered the 35 pack despite the negative reviews as I wanted to try some of the flavors.  I'm glad that I did.  There were plenty of different interesting flavors for my taste.  I've only tried one (Cinnamon Roll) and it was great - can't wait to try others.  I'm sending my sister a box as she loves flavored coffees and I know will enjoy the choices.The only reason I took a star is the price.  Just got a Keurig for Christmas and am a little shell shocked on how much a cup of coffee can be.

Not much to say here. Literally a cardboard "shipping" box filled with k-cups. Looked like somebody just grabbed a handful and just threw them in a box and sent them off. This may not bother some but to me this is poor presentation. I would have expected something similar to what you find in stores. An individual "manufacturer's" type boxing sent in a shipping box. Frankly, I worried about the integrity of the product. How would I know who or where this product came from. For all I know someone picked them from a "refused" batch and simply threw them in a box and called it good. Additionally, upon further inspection the k-cups looked a little dirty. It appeared that they had collected dust. Not sure if this was due to the packaging or simply bad product. I guess that's about it. I can't really speak to the actual coffee itself since I didn't try it.I should be fair and say, upon calling amazon with my concern they were happy to refund me entirely and asked that I dispose of the product since it's a non-returnable item. I will be tossing this.

I purchased this thinking I would get an assortment of several K-cups to try. I had 7 varieties, but with the name "sampler" pack I assumed there would only be 2-3 of each kind so I could sample several kinds to decide what I like, not just test the same flavor 5-6 times each.  Packaging was a brown paper bag taped shut and placed in a box with bubble wrap--some of the cups are a little dented. Not impressed overall. If I could return it I would and I will not order from this company again.

I am glad that I made this purchase. I too like other reviewers have mentioned only received 35 pods. In the package I have there were 20 flavors. Yes, there are a few different brands of vanilla but that is great for seeing which is better. As for the blueberry, surprisingly enough it tastes great with vanilla creamer. The box says the expiration date is 4/2012 but most of my pods expire in 6/12. I will purchase this again.

I liked getting the variety pack, I ordered it as soon as I got my Keurig brewer.  We ordered many of the flavors from the pack.  It did take a little longer to actually get the package shipped, and some of the cups looked a little worse for wear.  I did receive a nice variety, and none were close to expiration.

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column9: How did we live before this machine...
column10: How did we live before this machine...Keurig K-Cups Flavored Coffee Sampler Pack (35 K-Cups)....bought these for my daughter in law she loves these!~

Ordered the 35-count package as a gift for the Keurig lover in my life.  The selection received included 23 different flavors from makers such as Timothy's, Green Mountain, Gloria Jean, Van Houtte and Donut House, with no more than 3 of the same flavor, all intact and not expired.  However, the listing - which reads "ships in its own packaging" - isn't truly descriptive:  it's just 35 K-cups tossed into a mailing box and sent loose.  Perfect for enjoying yourself, but if you plan on gifting them, be prepared for a lot of tedious wrapping.

column9: Says there are 35, but there were only 31
column10: I've tried to contact the company but can't find a place to contact them anywhere.  I bought this item once before and was very pleased.  I hope they are going to send the rest of the order soon, but haven't heard anything about why the items were missing or when I can expect them.Edit:  I finally found a way to contact Amazon customer service and they have sent me the missing items.  It was hard finding the link to contact them.  This item is getting mixed up with the 24 count sampler.
Nice mix.  But would only be truly happy if I could pick out which cups are included in the package.

I was a bit annoyed @ Amazon's criticism of my review of this product.  The vendor would like feedback from customers.  I suspect the feedback is used to improve service.  Amazon "requires" 20 words or more.  They recommend 75 words to 300 words.  Really?  Keurig K-Cup flavors is a great idea.  My mother purchased the coffee maker for my wife's birthday.  She liked the variety of flavors. But the review, as I understand it, is about the product.  The cups fit the maker, the coffee tastes great (I guess since I do not drink coffee).  The product is a bit pricy but worth it.  Come on Amazon.  Get a grip.  I realize now that if I did not have 300 words to describe my opinion, I should not have left one.  However, I liked the efficiency of the vendor and the quality of the product.  I give them 5 stars.
This was great being able to get a variety of different coffees.  Only thing too many french vanilla and hazlenut coffees.
It's great if you are not fussy about what flavor coffee you drink.  This gives a great diversity to all the brands and flavors.

The KeurigK-Cug Flavored Coffee Sampler Pack is a winner in my book.  Between myself, my husand and 3 children, this sampler disappeared in a week!  There was only one of each flavor, but no bad reviews from the gang as they enjoyed each one of the k-cups in this sampler!  I would order it again!

This is a lovely assortment of terrific flavors!  I definitely found many that I would purchase separately!  I had a wonderful time sampling each one and only found one that I would not think of trying again.  Not bad!  I definitely recommend this collection.  However....the artwork that comes with this is not necessary and quite cheaply produced.  It went out with the shipping box.  All in all, I would order this assortment again.  It's nice to have so many flavors to choose from, especially when expecting dinner guests.  RECOMMENDED!!!

Was looking for a sampler box of k-cups that would appeal to my coffee-hound daughter & I & these fit the bill perfectly. Nice selection of varieties for a decent price. Enjoyed trying different flavors & discovering new favorites. Seller shipped item out quickly & was properly packed. No complaints here. Very happy/satisfied customer. Would definitely purchase again.
This sampler pack is wonderful!! I love being able to try the different coffees without having to buy so many boxes!!
What a great selection! The print was a joke, wrinkle up,looked like a child scribbled on it,(really!)  ANyway I may order this sampler pack again, I rec'd it very quickly!

The variety in this Sampler pack is just what we had hoped for; several brands, several flavors within each brand, something for everybody!The packaging for this sampler box is as described by other reviewers - functional for shipping. It did not appear to be a "gift pack." The coffee arrived quickly, intact, and as described.  The poster was included in a tube.We bought this coffee to enjoy on a daily basis in our own home, not for a gift.  The box was recycled 2 minutes after it arrived and the coffee placed in our carousel for ease of selection and enjoyment.  It is terrific to have a selection of brands and flavors without having to order or buy box after box.I can't wait until this product is available again.  We will order another as soon as it is.

Loved this sampler pack. Now I will know which ones are my favorite and I don't have to buy a whole box of something I might not like. Thanks. But I'm not happy at all with the new price increase on other packs. Will not be making another purchase because of this.

column9: Great variety, but glad"Gift Pack" was not actually a gift
column10: I'm very happy with the variety of coffee in this pack and all of the cups arrived intact without damage, but like several other reviewers I was surprised to find that the actual "gift pack" presentation did not resemble the picture at all - product was loose in a smaller cardboard shipping box inside of a larger cardboard shipping box.  Not a big deal since I bought this package for myself, but I would've been disappointed if I was planning to give it as a gift.I did recieve the print in a cardboard tube, but the edges of the print were completely wrinkled and even torn in spots from where the tube was bent shut at the ends.  I didn't buy this product for the print so I don't really care, but thought it was worth mentioning in case anyone wants to collect the prints that come with this coffee.

The coffee was great.  It's a wonderful variety of flavored coffees. If you're looking for regular coffee, you'll need to order that separate.  On another note, I'm giving this just 4 stars because there is no limited edition print.  Additionally, the K-Cups come loose.  They are just in a box that's in another box.  If you want to give this as a gift, you'll need to figure something out more presentable.

My pack came with 4 cappucinos, 2 apple ciders, 2 decaf and 10 of the flavors were repeated.  Not a true variety and why would they put cider in a coffee sampler pack? Ummmmmm.  It seemed like the company bought giant cases of each flavor K-cup and then threw them in a bingo ball sorter.  Never know what your going to get.  I will not be buying this again for one.

column9: and i thought KEUrIg wasnt too good! a++++++ luv this pack
column10: so glad i purchSED THIS PACK BECAUSE EVERY FLAVOR WAS GREAT! i WAS DISAPPOINTED IN MANY POF THE KEURIG FLAVORS UNTIL I PURCHASED THIS VARIETY PACK! IT;S THE BOMB YOULL LOVE IT IM SURE!
A great way to try a variety of flavors without buying a full box. A nice selection offlavors and brands to enjoy.

I wish I would have read the reviews BEFORE purchasing! It's true, I did not receive the majority of the flavors I was hoping to try. I feel like they should eliminate the picture they advertise, because it is entirely misleading.

I bought this for my husband as a gift this is a much better alternative to a box of k cups than most. My husband loved the different coffee and this is much more cost effective than buying 30 different boxes of k cups. I would recommend this to anyone with a kureig wanting to trying several different flavor coffees at a reasonable cost.
We were very pleased with he variety included.  The flavors are very good and 2 of a kind was the most flavor repetition we got, so we will be able to try 23 different flavors.

column9: i read the disclaimer and i'm still annoyed
column10: I understand that you may not get the coffee you expect and it's a grab bag. However, when I order flavored COFFEE, I expect to get COFFEE not apple cider. I feel like that's not actually being too specific (on my part). If it's a full on grab bag, call it grab bag. So, in short, YOU WILL HAVE NO IDEA WHAT YOU ARE GETTING WHEN YOU ORDER THIS.

column9: WARNING! Damaged K-Cups included in order.
column10: Several K-Cups were crushed and unusable.  This did not happen during shipping.  These were clearly purposely placed in the order so that they could sell otherwise unsalable merchandise.The packaging was fine.  These crushed K-Cups were in the middle of the bag, surrounded by undamaged K-cups.Also, there were 8 of the same K-Cup, and then 6 of another.There was NO Mudslide, Caramel Vanilla Cream, French Vanilla, Mocha Nut Fudge, Hawaiian Hazelnut, Jamaica Me Crazy, Vanilla Francaise, or Butter Toffee K-Cups.  8 of the advertised flavors were not present.There were 9 K-Cup flavors that are not on the list of included K-Cups.  These included unpopular flavors.This was pretty much a complete rip-off.

I apparently did not read far enough when I looked at the description, as I was extremely surprised to get loose Kcups in a box. Especially as this was a gift for my boss for Christmas, and wanted it to look somewhat gift like! Although its not a hard fix to find something to put them in, its not going to have the presentation i was after. Poorly done on marketing and being to the point the product..the only reason this got 3 stars was because of the variety of flavors
Not enough of a variety. Do not use decaf. I guess I was just disappointed with what they called a variety pack. Would make a better choice next time I spend my money.

column9: You Don't Get The Flavors You're Expecting
column10: I just opened the box... and the flavors inside are NOT AT ALL what's pictured in the product description photo.  I'm really disappointed and feel like I have no recourse.  Money down the drain for flavors I won't drink... and I'm bummed I don't get to try the flavors I thought I would.

The selection was great and it was fun to look at all the options. I have a better idea which brands & flavors to buy again and which brands to avoid.  I won't need this kind of sampler again -- now, I can buy only what I really liked.

The description seemed to contain favors I liked. However, when I got the shippment there were 6 k cups of flavors that I knowingly did not like. I would have not ordered this had I have known. They were the eggnog, gingerbread, and French toast from the Xmas season. They rest of the Krupa were good.
Did not care for the selection that were included in this case of k-cups.  Way too many hazelnut, vanilla and other too sweet products.
Have ordered from this person before and would order again, as well as, recommend family and friends.  From start to finish, excellent job.  Love the variety and the price is very reasonable.

This assorted collection for me came in a brown paper bag with most of the coffees being 4 flavors.  The assortment was not even close to what was pictured.  I am very disappointed.  15 of the k-cups were vanilla.  Will never purchase from crazy cups again.

I ordered a pack of 35...FILLED BY AMAZON. And I had at least doubles of almost every flavor they sent...I was suppose to receive at least 25 different flavors...that didn't happen...don't expect a good selection.  I received 18 different flavors out of 35. VERY DISAPPOINTED!!!! Will not BUY again. Also the packaging by Amazon was TERRIBLE...all were just thrown into an over sized box...very unprofessional.

column9: Glad I didn't listen to negative reviews
column10: SO GLAD I didn't listen to the negative reviews. If you read carefully the product owner said in Dec 2011 they changed the way they were selecting the types of coffee and doing so more carefully. This came today in a box (no paper bag like others have said) I counted them out and there were 35 like I ordered and there were very few repeats. The only one not there shown in the pic is the Iced coffee, but there were 2 flavors that were NOT pictured that more than made up for that. All expiration dates are for this coming summer and the box is labeled as expiring 4/19 (so im sure this is to make sure they dont sell any boxes with even 1 expired k cup). DO NOT pay attention to reviews that are dated after Dec 2011 because since they have changed the way they are doing things I think they gave me what I paid for, I paid about 20 dollars for 35 k cups of all varieties  I got what I wanted and saved a ton of money. Very happy, just hoping others arent scared away of a good deal because of OLD reviews. Thanks!

This was a hit or miss try for me. We are new to Keurig and I was chomping at the bit to try some of the flavored coffees.. OH MY GOD!! This was an awesome collection, only 2 of which I'd actually tried before. I can't wait to order more sampler packs now!

This is a first for me, because I never have written a review before. I feel like I need to this time because of all the other poor reviews this product has gotten. I ordered my k-cups before reading the reviews and felt like an idiot once I read them. I wasn't looking fwd for my package to come expecting it to be terrible and all the same flavor and not very well packaged. I was shocked when it arrived! Everything was perfect! Tons of variety, shipped nicely and quickly! I would def recommend this product and even am about to purchase another one! So dont believe the other bad reviews, if you're looking for a great variety sample pack this is for you!

column9: CRAZY CUP FLAV COFFEE K-CUP PORTION PACK FOR KEURIG
column10: Liked some of these but others were down right nasty tasting,didn't realize would have teas as well and de-caf coffee, come on what's the point.  Not impressed & could get exactly the flavors I wanted at Target for 1/3rd the price, who knew...  once was enough on this for me.

I just received my shipment and I am greatly disappointed.  I did not get any of the advertised flavors instead I got a few Dunkin Donuts flavored coffee.  The majority of the K-cups were Dunkin Donuts regular and decaf coffee.

I was very nervous about ordering this after reading all of the reviews.  I am glad that I went ahead and took a chance.  My box included a great selection of at least 20 different flavors.  Most of the flavors had 2 pods each, with a few singles and three of two flavors.  All of the pods were flavored coffee.  It looks like this company is responding to complaints that others have had, because the box was labeled with an expiration date (although as others have said, the pods were just thrown into the box).  The coffee was not damaged in any way, and I would order this product again.

I ordered this 35 cup assortment hoping for a wide variety of different brands and flavors to try new ones out with out having to buy a whole pack of the same one and not ending up liking it. First off, the package did come on time. But when i opened it, the cups were in a brown paper doggy bag, and a couple had broken and made a mess all over the bag. They weren't shipping carefully, no bubble wrap or anything. Just thrown in a paper bag. Than when i took them all out, out of all 35 cups, i got mainly Green Mountain Coffee. I got 3 Caramel Vanilla Cream, 7 Hazelnut, 2 Ginger bread, 3 Pumpkin Spice, 3 Mocha Nut Fudge, 2 Southern Pecan, 8 French Vanilla. (Thats 28 Green Mountain Coffee k-cups out of 35!) and than one random brand called Jet fuel, and one random Donut House, 2 Newmans Own, and 2 french vanilla Timothy's. Overall, only order from these people if you like Green Mountain coffee....and French Vanilla.

FYI....this product came to me with 9 decaf cups and an iced coffee.  I did not realize there would be decafs and if so wouldn't have purchased.  That being said...the other coffees have been great so far and i'm happy to get a sampler before spending my money on a large box.

I think this is a great flavored variety pack to try with your Keurig; however, make sure that's the only reason your getting it. Unlike some of the other reviewers, I did NOT receive a limited edition print in a tube or otherwise. Would also not buy this as a gift for someone else without having it shipped directly to me first so I can package it in something other than the plain box it came in.
Awesome again!  3rd or 4th time ordering the 35 assorted. Excellent with receiving order.Will order again!Thanks much
The variety of K-Kups that were sent to me were many. I was glad to try these. I'm amazed how many different K-Cups there are.I can now purchase K-Kups that I have already tasted.

I was disappointed with the selection that was sent to me.  25 were Green Mountain(7 French Van, 5 Country, 4Hazel Nut, 5 Extra Bold, 4 Breakfast Blend). The others were:4 Newman Spec. Decaf, 3 Caribou, 2 Emeril Jaz up, and 1 Gloria Jean.  I thought by the description and picture that I was going to get a couple of each variety, so I could try each one to see which one I would like best.  It seems like this was thrown together with what ever was left over, the packaging on the Caribou and Emiril were pushed in.  I've been getting my coffee K-cups from Amazon for a few years now, this is the first time that I have been let down.

Was very disappointed when I received this item today...  Everything was packed well and no items were destroyed in the shipping process but I had purchased this item as a gift for a friend but when I opened the package all of the k-cups were just thrown into another cardboard box.  I was hoping the k-cups were going to arrive in an attractive looking box suitable for gifting as shown in the product picture... Needless to say that the "limited edition print" was falsey advertised, nor I did not receive that item as well.
I liked some of the coffees and since it was a sampler I got what I ordered.  It helped me decide what I liked and what I didn't so I guess it was worth the money but I wouldn't order it again.

Now I know where all the K cups that no one would buy go. Largely not coffee cups. Some of the flavors included were Island Coconut (really?) , chocolate glazed donut, fudge, vanilla, eggnog, caramel apple, blueberry, spiced apple, caramel crime, cinnamon roll, French toast, pecan and toffee. This is not what I call a 'coffee' assortment but rather a bunch of awful flavored instant drink mixes. Add to that the fact that the expiration dates are only 2 months away and it is one bad deal.

column9: Awful purchase - not as described or pictured - DO NOT BUY
column10: This assortment was AWFUL.  I received 10 of the same flavor of holiday flavors (I ordered after the holidays) as well of 5-6 of other flavors.  This picture shows 35 different varieties, but I only received a few different flavors.  Also, these were shipped in a brown paper bag which caused many of the cups to be damaged.  I am very very disappointed with this order.  I will never purchase anything from Deals on Call LLC through Amazon.  It's a shame Amazon doesn't monitor its vendors more closely.

Ok, maybe it's me, but when I see that this is a sampler, with TONS of different flavors listed, I assume that I am going to get just that - tons of different flavors. Or atleast give me a similar number of each flavor. This order was a joke from the beginning. It arrived in a punctured box but perhaps that happened in delivery. I open the box and find a paper bag, stapled shut. I open the paper bag & find a bunch of tossed in k-cups. Then when I pull them out, I counted that I had like 9 of one flavor, and 1 of some and 2 or 3 of others... This really is incredibly unorganized. I will not buy from this vendor again.

When I ordered this item, I decided to be optimistic despite all of the comments about the "variety" received.  However, I  should have listened.  When I received the "package" it was 35 k-cups just thrown into a paper bag and they have a dusty/grimy feeling to all of the cups as if they have been sitting around on a dirty shelf.  As for the "variety" of k-cups I received 6 spicy eggnog, 6 gingerbread, 6 butter toffee, 6 supreme french vanilla, 6 southern pecan, 3 chocolate glazed donut, 1 golden french toast, and 1 mocha nut fudge!  To say the least I felt like they were just trying to get rid of the winter flavors (both of which I do not care for but now stuck with).  I will take my business elsewhere next time I want a true variety pack.

column9: Photo of selection is VERY misleading
column10: Maybe we're the only ones that actually enlarged the photo of the 35 K Cups before we placed our order.  We wanted to make sure that the variety was indeed something that we felt we would enjoy.  Obviously "variety" is just that, various flavors.  However we did expect to at least receive ONE of each flavor shown on the photo, and we did NOT expect to receive SEVEN pumpkin spice, FIVE eggnog, and FIVE Gingerbread (none of which are in the display photo) when placing our very first order with Amazon in January!  Of the 35 K Cups, 17 (almost half) were holiday flavors - I mean, come on at least be honest enough to promote the product as "nearing experation holiday coffee samplers that we can't get rid of...here's hoping you won't notice".  Seriously, give a little credit to the intelligience of your customers, or in our case "first and only orders".

This was suppose to be a 35 cup sampler pack. When it arrived(in a brown paper bag), I thought, OK this will be a good variety because I was happy to see that they were not spending a fortune on what I call useless packaging. But we were very disappointed when we opened it up. There were 35 K cups, but only 9 were not "Green Moutain" brand and of the 35, 18 were of 3 different flavors and a 4th flavor had 4 of it. That really does not give a very good sampling of flavors. Especially when 15 of the 35 are of a vanilla flavor(Vanilla creme, french vanilla, deluxe vanilla, etc.).I will have to think twice before we buy another sample pack, when it really does not give a very good sampling. No where even close to the picture that was provided. Keeping in mind that we did not expect exactly what was in the picture, but at least no more than 2-3 of any given flavor.

If I had wanted 8 Spicy Eggnogs I would have just bought a box of Spicy Eggnog.  The same for Butter Toffee.  This was truly dissapointing.  I would sure like to know how you plan to fix this.  I chose this for the many different types, so i could try them without buying an entire box.  I guess I got scammed big time.  When I saw the list, I knew it wouldn't be exact, but mine looks like a Winter Seasonal variety. Lots of Gingerbread, Eggnog and Pumpkin Spice.  I want my variety.

When I got my sampler pack, it did not have all 25 advertised  flavors. I counted only 13 of the flavors were included. Also, I got an uneven amount of each flavor. For instance, I got 9 "Southern Pecan" cups which is not very good.

column9: NOT a 25 flavor assortment as described.
column10: My husband and I were excited to try this assortment since it boasted the ability to try 25 different flavors without buying 25 different boxes.  While we certainly didn't receive anywhere near 25 different flavors, here's what we ended up with:1  Hazelnut2  Mocha Nut Fudge3  Golden French Toast3  Kahlua Original3  French Vanilla Supreme3  Cinnamon Roll4  Chocolate Glazed Donut4  Gingerbread4  Butter Toffee8  Pumpkin SpiceA few things..For the 10 different flavors provided to us, overall we got nearly enough quantity of each flavor for both of us to try.  Thankfully, we're already fans of the Pumpkin Spice, or I'm sure we'd be a little irked about the disproportionate number of those in our bag.  With that said, we're satisfied with the purchase, but simply wish that the product listing did not indicate that 25 different flavors would be included.

I had some reservations about ordering the Crazy Cups flavored sampler due to the mixed reviews. But obviously most people don't read the actual description, it clearly states "Due to availability some flavors may be substituted without prior notice." The other thing I noticed is that this sampler is sold by several different vendors and fulfilled by Amazon. I think that has also contributed to the mixed  reviews. I purchased the 35 pack from Amazon Warehouse deals. I didn't have my heart set on getting certain flavors, I just wanted to try some new flavors without buying and entire box of 1 flavor. My k cups arrived packed loosely in a box and none were damaged. I got an excellent assortment of flavors. Brands included Wolfgang Puck, Green Mountain Coffee, Donut Shop, Timothy's, Gloria Jeans, and Grove Square. Of the 35 I got 20 different flavors! As far as expiration dates, I only checked about 5 of them and they all had dates of June or July 2012. So I think the biggest factor is who are the packs actually sold by. I noticed most people don't say who theirs was sold by.

column9: you don't get what it says
column10: I am very disappointed in this sampler pack.  I bought this specificallly for the flavors listed and I was particularly excited about a few of them.  I did not get 5 of the flavors at all (most of the ones missing were the ones I was really wanting) and then I got other flavors that I definitely do NOT like.
