And I got several of just 3 or 4 flavors and then just one or two of the other flavors, needless to say, the ones I got several of were either the ones I do not like or the not so special flavors.  I am very likely going to send them back.

I very rarely order k-cups any more because they have gone up in price.  However, I was having company over for the weekend and wanted to impress them with a variety pack of coffee.  So I ordered a package of 35 sampler K-cups.  At least 95 percent of the cups were vanilla flavored.  Vanilla decaf, french vanilla, vanilla supreme.  I don't even like french vanilla coffee.  Very, Very disappointed!!!!!  Were is the variety?  Won't order these again.

I love that this sampler box actually comes with SO MANY samples of all different types of flavored coffees. It's exactly what I was looking for so I could try a bunch of different flavors and figure out which ones I like best. Like other reviews say, it is not a fancy gift box but if you're giving it as a gift it would be very easy to throw a bunch in a basket with creamer packs, flavored coffee liquor, coffee spoons and a mug, tie a big ribbon on the handle and give it as a gift that way. There are plenty in one box to make at least 2 of these baskets. The poster it comes with IS sort of silly but I just gave it to my niece to color on. I was only getting this for myself to try out flavors and I'm very happy with it. The price is great for this type of variety.

This sample pack had a wide variety of flavors included.  It is like a K-Cup warehouse exploded and they swept the mess into a box.  It included many varieties I would have never tried.  I am sure I will find a new favorite flavor here.

column9: Great Assortment, got to try out a ton of flavors
column10: I got to try a whole bunch of flavors which was really cool. Yes, the packaging is a little lame, if you're giving this as a gift just wrap it in gift wrap. My K-cups all came in good shape which is really all I cared about.The poster is there people....it's rolled up in the tube :)

I have purchased the Crazy Cups Flavored Coffee Sampler K-cups 3 times now, one 35 pack and 3 of the 25 packs and I have been VERY HAPPY with it each time. I am confused by some of the reviews. Each time I have received exactly 2 each of many different flavored caffeinated coffees, with a GREAT variety. Great flavors, that I have never seen anywhere else!  I have NEVER had any de-cafs or teas or hot chocolates. Just coffee. It is exactly what I wanted. Each time the packaging has been different, i.e. a brown paper bag in a plastic bag or K-cups loose in a box. But NONE of the coffee cups was damaged, so whatever they are doing it is working. I will definitely continue to order this! Especially since the price is also great.

After reading some reviews, I decided to take the risk and purchase this coffee sampler. I have had my Keurig for about two weeks, and I am so glad I made this purchase!The mix I received included:Gloria Jean's Mudslide x2Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee x2Gloria Jean's HazelnutGloria Jean's French Vanilla SupremeKahlua original x2Donut House Chocolate glazed donut x2Donut House cinnamon roll x2Wolfgang Puck creme caramel x2Wolfgang Puck Jamacian Me crazy x2Wolfgang Puck Hawaiian HazelnutWolfgang Puck vanilla francaiseGrove Square French vanilla cappuccinoGrove Square Hazelnut cappuccinoGrove Square Caramel cappuccinoGreen Mountain gingerbreadGreen Mountain spicy eggnogGreen Mountain golden french toast x2Green Mountain mocha nut fudgeGreen Mountain hazelnut noisetteGreen Mountain caramel vanilla x2Green Mountain wild mountain blueberryGreen Mountain southern pecanGreen Mountain french vanillaGreen Mountain french vanilla icedGreen Mountain french vanilla decafGreen Mountain hazelnut decafI feel that I got a very good selection of different brands and flavors. Looking forward to trying them all!

column9: Great Variety, I just wish FedEx held up their end of the bargain
column10: For $35 (with shipping) I would expect all 35 of my K-Cups to arrive in great condition. Well, FedEx crushed my box ending up in about 10 of them to either get punctured resulting in coffee everywhere in the box, or the sides of the cups crushed making them unusable. Anyway, when it comes to variety, it was top notch. I had about 20 types of coffee in my packaging, and they were all over the spectrum. I look forward to ordering the types of coffees I like, praying they make it to me in 1 piece.

column9: The selection is very much as anticipated!
column10: I was basically just interested in having my own personal k-cups to use with the office keurig machine, so I wasn't too concerned with the bad reviews regarding the balance of the variety of flavors (too many of 1 or 2, not a wide number of choices). So I was very pleasantly surprised upon arrival of my package -- the k-cups were packaged in a rectangular box (not the paper bag I saw mentioned previously), and the choices were awesome!!I would say that I got probably two of a whole slew of flavors: vanilla, butter toffee, blueberry, hazelnut, kahlua, spicy eggnog, the list goes on!! I think they really took in the feedback from customers because I really did not experience any of the negative issues previous customers had noted. All of my k-cups are not expired/good until at least this summer, did not arrive damaged, arrived in a robust cardboard box, and had 2 or so each of a large variety of flavors.Very excited to start trying the different flavors starting tomorrow!

column9: Not the flavors that are shown
column10: I bought the 35 count variety pack thinking it would be the flavors shown in the photo. We didn't get a single Wolf Gang Puck flavored coffee, which I was really looking forward to. I got a ton of Spicy Eggnog, which I didn't even know came in the pack and Pumpkin Spice, which isn't even listed. We also got several Blueberry Flavored coffees. One would have been great but 4? I only got one Chocolate Glazed Donut. There was also no Mudslide or Butter Toffee flavors. I didn't get a single Grove Square brand. DO NOT BUY this sampler, you don't get what you pay for, only gross, left over holiday flavors. Total waste of money.

column9: Crazy Cup K-Cup Sampler Receives a 2/5
column10: I received my package of crazy cup sampler to find that I received 8 spice eggnog!!! They tried to get rid of their holiday stock at my expense and I do not appreciate that. I also received 4 blueberry coffee cups and did not receive 5 types of coffee. I am very dissatisfied!!My son did a  silly YouTube video showing the sample that I received. I do not recommend this sample pack. The sample is packaged in a paper bag that someone throws whatever cups they feel like throwing in the bag. Do not waste your money.[...]

After reading many reviews about this product I was quite hesitant on buying it...I usually will not purchase a product with so many negative reviews. I decided to take a chance because I really wanted to try different flavors without buying  full boxes of each . I was pleasantly surprised with the selection....I didn't have more than two of any flavor, although there were serveral different brands  of French vanilla and hazelnut I didn't mind because I am sure they taste different.  Below  is a list of the kcups I received:GREEN  MOUNTAIN COFFEE2 spicy eggnog2 gingerbread2pumpkin spice2 mocha nut fudge2 caramel vanilla2 southern pecan1 hazelnut  noisette1 French vanilla2 wild blueberryDONUT HOUSE2 cinnamon roll2 chocolate glazed donutGLORIA JEAN2 French vanilla supreme2 butter toffeeGROVE SQUARE1 caramel cappuccinoWOLF GANG PUCK1 vanilla francaase2 creme caramelOTHERS2 Kahlua2 Jamaica me crazy2 Hawaiian hazelnutThis is a great product and I hope this review was helpful ( it's my first one)
Very, very disappointed.  Was expecting a variety of flavors.  Got 7 of three flavors, and a bunch of leftover holiday flavors.  will not order again.

Someone donated a Keurig at work so I wanted to try it out. I received an excellent assortment, the one pictured I believe. It was a great way to try the various brands, regardless of flavor. Wolfgang Puck was by far my favorite, however, I like my Dolce Gusto cappuccinos farrrrrrrr better.

This is a great choice, all the coffees are delicious.  I had a family reunion, and each one of my guests was impressed because they had the opportunity to choose their favorite flavor, they were all different.

column4: Beverly A. Owens "finding my true self"
column10: There are so many flavors, blends, and roasts available in the k-cup coffee lines. Buying this sampler was a great way to try different k-cups without having to purchase a whole box of a flavor that you might not like. My husband and I found some flavors that we will now purchase as a whole box and others that we didn't care for so much. I am really glad we purchased this sampler!

column9: Horrible tasting coffee with the exception of a couple great ones
column10: I personally recommend the Donut Shop.Just ordered a case for myself.To my own surprise; I have been extremely disappointed with almost everything else in this package, and it is almost finished so there is little room left for surprises.Get good coffee!

column9: disappointed but will have to live with it
column10: This product was described as "27 different flavors without buying 27 different boxes". This was a 35 pack so I figured there would be some doubles. I only had 18 different flavors. Not 27 like I was supposed to. After reading the reviews I had mixed feelings, but ordered anyway. There were many bad reviews and some good ones. The packaging was nice. They came in a box with little compartments that everything fit nicely. I just wish I had gotten the correct amount of coffees. I also received it after the date they said I would. I have ordered online before and it has never taken this long to get. I order last month and just now received it.

I was very pleasently surprised by the selection and the packaging of this product, I guess they listen to previous complains because the kcups were nicely packed in carboard box 2 kcups of the same flavour in one cell and no two cells have identical cups. So I got a total of 18 different flavours, two cups of ecah flavour, no decaf but some capucciono samples which my father loves
Showed up on time and was as described. This came with a wide variety and all of it was very delicious, would definatly order again.

This is exactly what I wanted so that I could try many different flavors. I have found a few EXCELLENT flavors and a lot of really good ones. I haven't found any yet that I completely dislike. My only wish is that I could get a variety box like this with no decaf. There aren't too many, maybe 10, but I RARELY drink decaf. But overall- I definitely recommend this for those who love flavored coffees.

There were a lot of doubles, way more than we thought.We bought one box of regular, one box of decaf, and there was decaf in the regular box.I think we will stick to making our own selections from now on.

Wanted to try a bunch of different types of coffee when I first got the Keurig coffee maker so I could see which one I liked and which one I didn't.. Can never tell until you try them all.. Can't take other people's word for it, you have to try it for yourself, especially something so special as that first cup of coffee you have in the morning!!!!
The keurig cups are a much better price than you find in most stores, and the best I've seen of a mixed variety. The coffee itself is very good, Ive tried just about every flavor.

This was a great way to try many different flavors.  I did receive 35 cups, there were a few that I had doubles of, but I don't mind because I still get to try many different flavors. The ones that are shown on the pictures are true to what I received.  I was leery about buying this because some people said how bad the assortment was, but I'm happy with mine.  I did not receive any tea or hot chocolate in mine, it was all coffee.  It came in a box and none of them were damaged.  If you want to try new flavors without having to buy many different boxes, this is the sampler for you!
Awesome variety! Wish there were a few more k cups in the pack but they all taste great! I'd recommend this to the average flavored coffee aficionado.

Wow - there are VERY mixed reviews for this item! After reading a bulk of them, I still decided to order the product because I didn't know of another way to try a variety of flavors without buying a box of each. The description above states that you will be able to try 27 different flavors of coffee without buying 27 different boxes (they must have changed the description, since a few of the reviews state that it reads 35 different varieties). After tallying them all up, I only ended up with 21 different varieties (sigh). I use the word "varieties" and not "flavors" because I did receive several French Vanillas and Hazelnuts, but they were from different companies. My cups also came packaged in a box, so perhaps they've done away with the paper bag thing?Here's the breakdown of what I received: Green Mountain: Wild Mountain Blueberry (2), Southern Pecan (2), French Vanilla Iced (2), Caramel Vanilla Cream (2), Mocha Nut Fudge (2), Island Coconut (2), Hazelnut Noisette, Hazelnut Decaf, French Vanilla, French Vanilla Decaf/ Donut House: Chocolate Glazed Donut (2), Cinnamon Roll (2)/ Grove Square: Hazelnut Cappuccino (2), French Vanilla Cappuccino (2), Caramel Cappuccino (2)/ Gloria Jean's: Mudslide (2), Butter Toffee (2), Hazelnut, French Vanilla Supreme/ Wolfgang Puck: Hawaiian Hazelnut Aloha Noisette/ Timothy's: Kahlua Original (2).These just came today, so I have only tried the Green Mountain Island Coconut so far - over ice (I don't drink hot coffee...I know, weird, right?). I love coconut, so this is my new favorite. I am already planning on buying a couple of boxes of this one tomorrow. I didn't even add anything to it - just drank it black, and loved it.So, I think this would have received five-stars from me if only it had actually contained what it said it was going to (27 different flavors)...but again, I am not unhappy with the variety that I did receive.

column9: Great Variety - best purchase I could have made
column10: There is a WONDERFUL Variety of flavors in this pack. I have fallen in love with about 5 of the types. The only bad thing is there are so many that I won't be able to use. For instance the tea, the cider, and the dark brews. I guess they are good for when I have guests over, but thats not all that often. I wish they we had the ability to chose the types of product we would like in the variety pack. If not you might get stuck with several kcups you have no use for.I DON'T know what people are talking about not getting a variety of flavors. I got plenty of different flavors and a couple duplicates (happened to be the best ones) I have been drinking now for over a week and A LOT of the flavors I didn't think I would like I actually do. I am also pleased they had a few decaf kcups for later in the afternoon evening when I am craving some coffeeThe good thing about this product is it allows you try several varieties and flavors of coffee with out having to buy an entire box of something in order to later find out you don't like the flavor. That would be a REAL waste of your money. I also got about 2 kcups of every flavor (or at least my favorite flavors) YAY! I am not going to sit and review all the flavors I have tried so far because everyone is going to have different opinions on the flavors. I will say I am happy with the fact that by purchasing this product I know what flavors I should buy.So if you want to taste a variety of kcups to find ones that you like. Purchase this product. If you don't like some of the flavors you can save them for when you have guests over.My Kcups also came in a cardboard box and I love it because I haven't purchased a Kcup holder yet so I use the box to hold all my kcups. It was packaged beautifully. Or as beautiful as you could expect to get a box of kcups.

I was wary purchasing the variety pack after reading/seeing the pictures associated with the product. However, I just received mine and I was very happy to see that each variety pack I ordered was in its own separate box and the variety provided was exactly as pictured. I would urge anyone considering buying the variety packs from crazy cups to do so! I am very happy with it and I can't wait to try the flavors with my new keurig! Dont be discouraged by the old negative reviews.

column9: Pleasantly Pleased - but not all coffee
column10: Only one major complaint... it was advertised that I could "Try 27 different flavors without purchasing 27 different boxes." as listed in the product descriptions, yet I only have 24 different flavors.  This is why I gave it 4 stars.  That being said - I will order it again.It is important to point out that they aren't all coffee as 3 are ciders and 3 are a "cappuccino drink," which is okay with me, but may not be with you.  I listed out what was in my box that was actually kind of pretty and could be appropriately dressed up as a gift box as it is a decorative black/white box.Additionally, I would have liked to try something from the Brooklyn Bean Roastery.Gloria Jean's* French Vanilla Supreme* Mudslide* Hazelnut* Butter ToffeeTimothy's* Kahlua original - 2Green Mountain Coffee* Island Coconut - 2* French Vanilla Iced* Mocha Nut Fudge - 2* Hazelnut Decaf* French Vanilla* Wild Mountain Blueberry - 2* Southern Pecan - 2* French Vanilla Decaf* Caramel Vanilla Cream - 2* Hazelnut NoisetteGrove Square* Hazelnut cappuccino* French Vanilla cappuccino* Caramel cappuccino* Caramel Apple cider - 2* Spiced Apple ciderWolfgang Puck* Crème Caramel - 2* Jamaica Me Crazy-2Donut House* Cinnamon Roll-2* Chocolate Glazed Donut - 2
NICE ASSORTMENT, ESPECIALLY IF YOU ARE A NEW KEURIG OWNER AND WANT TO TRY FLAVORS WITHOUT PURCHASING A FULL BOX.
I liked these samplers. I got a very good variety of flavors and only a handful of doubled flavors. Packaging was good, no broken cups. I would buy this again.

This was a magical box of mixed K-cups full of the most excellent and delicious flavors of coffee one could conceive.  Every flavor in the package was exceptionally delicious.  Also, there were quite a few of the limited edition or seasonal varieties in here, but none of the weird ones that nobody ever drinks.  I bought this for a gift but I'll be ordering another for me to enjoy.  When I opened the package and started reading all the flavors, I kept trying to talk my wife into letting me steal a few out of the box before wrapping it :)  I guess it is random who gets what varieties but I'm glad I ignored the other reviews and purchased this.  None of my K-cups were broken and there was a pretty even variety.

column9: Needs Larger Variety For The Price
column10: I gave 4 stars.  Would've been 5, if the variety was better.  What came was sufficient, however, and quite tasty :)

I never write reviews.  Ever.  I had to write one for this product because I just ordered my second round we liked it so much! I read all the reviews prior to ordering, so I knew how the packaging would be.  Yes, it arrived all jumbled up in a box (tossed around, is more like it).  Didn't bother the coffee cups, so it didn't bother me.  Went through and noticed a few ciders which on the cooler days here I didn't end up minding at all.  Depending on how serious you are about your coffee, which we are, we enjoyed trying all the new brands and flavors.  It would become a joke to my husband and I as we'd text each other throughout the day to tell the other if we liked our kind for that day.  We'd race to get the last one if there were more than one!  Yes, there are a few repeats, but we liked that.  We felt the variety was very pleasing and it didn't bother us that we had three or four of one kind.  We're not fans of certain ones, but we'll drink them just because it's fun.  I think for the amount you're paying for this many k cups, you can't beat it!  Enjoy, know you'll get some ciders tossed in possibly and some doubles (triples even) of this mix.  I'll let you know what comes in my next "variety" pack!
Like the mix of flavors but you probably pay more for the assorted selection. Still very pleased with my purchase.
So many flavors it's hard to pick one. They are all delicious and hard to pick a favorite. So easy to use, coffee is ready in a flash.
These K-Cups really give you a good choice to decide if there is one you would like. Personally I liked them all.  For the price it is a reasonable bargain.
I found the variety to be very diverse.  There were about 15 different types of coffee, with about two cups of each type.  Very much looking forward to getting through these!
I found some new ones Samples that  I had not tried before. They were very enjoyable and my husband and I find ourselves battling for our favorites.

How often can you say you ordered something and not only got what you ordered but it was better than expected. Some of the flavors we choose were unknown to us but each one was better than the last. The variety was great and the price was reasonable. Can't wait to order our next case.

I read all of the reviews about this product BEFORE placing my order and I was little hesitant.  I did order it and WOW, WOW, WOW am I glad I did!  I got a GREAT assortment of coffees - mostly 2 of each flavor which is great - one for me and one for hubby.  Whatever Crazy Cups has done to improve - it's working!  I'm so glad I gave them a chance!  And I will CERTAINLY order from them again!!

Received my order very fast.  Granted there was no fancy packaging but they all arrived safe and sound.  Received. Many different flavors  from apple cider to Jamaican coffee.  I loved trying the different flavors to see what I like so I could continue buying that flavor.  Did not like blueberry but love cinamon roll and southern pecan.  I would recommend it if you want to try new flavors
I enjoyed most of the coffee in this but several I did not. It has a good assortment and will depend on ones taste.

I was a little concerned after reading so many negative reviews but I decided to go for it and I'm glad I did. The selection was great. It does seem to be hit or miss, though, looking at the variety of reviews, so that's something to keep in mind. I'm not picky and didn't mind having some similar flavors (there were several "French Vanilla" from different brands).

Whatever problems this order used to have seem to be resolved. All the cups arrived in perfect condition and the expiration dates are far enough out. There was a great selection and maybe 4 or 5 dupes. Brands included Green Mountain, Wolfgang Puck, Gloria Jean, Donut House and yes, Folgers. All were flavored and there was an awesome selection, including hazelnut, vanilla, carmel, kahlua etc.Would def order this again-great value for the money and great selection.
A wide variety of flavors and brands and handful of "crazy" flavors that will be fun to try,too.  Only 5 flavors were duplicates, so great variety over all.  Have liked all of them so far!

This is my favorite item to order for my Keurig. There are so many flavors, my finicky palate never gets bored!  The only downside is there are probably 5-6 decaf varieties.  I don't drink decaf (I REQUIRE copious amounts of caffeine), so they sit on the shelf...
I had ordered a box of 35 but there were only 31 in the box.  Flavors were a good mix, but paid for 4 more cups!!

column9: Hit and Miss - mine was a miss
column10: It seems like whether or not this (or any of the other Crazy Cups samplers) are worth it depends on the day and who packs your orders.  I wasn't one of the lucky ones - over half of what I received were a vanilla flavor.  Sure, I've got vanilla cappuccino, regular vanilla from three coffee manufacturers, vanilla iced-coffee, decaf vanilla...  I assume they were out of the other flavors that day and substituted all vanilla.  Quite a disappointment since I was hoping to try a variety of flavors before deciding what to order.

Very happy and satisfied with the Crazy Cups Sampler.  At first I was hesitant to purchase because previous reviews had stated that the variety was not all that great, but in my case it was a great variety.  If you're into flavored coffee this is a great deal for you.  I plan on purchasing more boxes, the variety and price is well worth it.

I was hesitant to purchase this due to all the negative reviews, but I am glad I ignored them. I ordered the pack of 35 on March 6th, and received my order on March 8th (using Prime). My main worry was that they would arrive in a brown bag and the k-cups would be damaged. I was very surprised when my order arrived in a brown amazon box, and even more impressed when the k-cups were packaged in a white box instead of being thrown in the amazon box. My other worry was that I would receive a small variety of coffee with multiples of each. I was ecstatic to find that I received almost every flavor in the photo, and no more than 2 of some of the flavors.  Flavors I received:Wolfgang Puck: Creme Caramel (2) Hawaiian Hazelnut (2) Jamaica Me Crazy (2) Vanilla Francaise (2)Cafe Escapes: Cafe Mocha (2)Timothy's Kahlua (2)Green Mountain: Gingerbread (2) Spicy Eggnog (2) Golden French Toast (2) Southern Pecan (2) Hazelnut Decaf (1) Hazelnut Noisette (1) Mocha Nut Fudge (1) Wild Mountain Blueberry (1) French Vanilla (1) French Vanilla Decaf (1)Gloria Jean's: Butter Toffee (2) Mudslide (1)Donut House: Chocolate Glazed Donut (1) Cinnamon Roll (1)Grove Square: French Vanilla Cappuccino (1) Caramel Apple Cider (1) Spiced Apple (1)The only negative I have is the decaf coffee (I don't care for decaf). I would have preferred a multiple of something rather than receiving the decaf flavors. However, the picture does show the 2 decaf flavors I received, so I really can't complain.I am very happy with what I received, and will definitely be ordering this in the future.

column9: Do not fear the crazy cups!
column10: This assortment is great. If there were problems with packaging and/or shipping issues, the company has apparently solved them. The k-cups are not past their expiration date nor were they damaged in any way. If you enjoy an assortment of flavored coffees GO FOR THE CRAZY CUPS! You can't go wrong.

It seemed to take a really long time to get this order and there wasn't the variety of flavors that I had hoped for.  It included mostly the fall seasonal flavors.  From now on, I'll just buy the boxes of the flavors I know I like instead of getting leftovers.
Other than a few caffeine free cups, I enjoyed all the flavors in this variety pack.  Will definately buy again!

I received this shipment a little worried, because of the mixed reviews here. I'm happy to say I was VERY pleasantly surprised by the great packaging (the cups were in a box inside of a box and not just loose as mentioned in previous reviews)... the company must have read the previous reviews and fixed the problem.Anyway, I had an awesome variety of cups to try.... 2 of each. The French Vanilla Cappuccino is to die for, and the other cups are amazing as well. I love flavored coffees, and this was the perfect collection! I will order again. I think it's excellent that people have written reviews, because the company has obviously read them and fixed the problems!
This order gave me the chance to try many flavors of the coffee.  It saved me from having to buy a full box of something that I might not like.  I was very happy with my purchase.
I received 35 cups in perfect condition and a fantastic assortment.  This is exactly what I wanted as a gift for someone who just received a Keurig.  Thank you!!!
the k-cups came in a nice variety and all flavors are good so far. if u are looking to sample a bunch of flavors or u just like variety than this is for u.

I was very excited win my shipment of coffee arrived. I had heard mixed reviews. My coffee came with many different flavers. Some flavors had 2 coffees, some had only one. I was very pleased and will order again. Also my delivery came very quickly with standard delivery. Amazon verified purchase.

I really like this assortment.  I got 1-2 of 14 different k-cups.  I like having more than one, since I bought this assortment for the office.  I would probably give this assortment four stars, except for the fact that the seller responded to negative reviews by changing the packaging method.  That's good customer service.

column9: Came with everything in product description
column10: Good assortment, came with everything advertised with a few extras.  I look forward to trying this assortment.  There were quite a few hazelnut and decaf coffees, which I could have done with fewer of, but otherwise the assortment is good.  Would recommend to anyone wanting to try an assortment of flavored coffees.

column9: Great variety pack and fast shipping!
column10: Item exactly as described.  Great sampler pack for a great price and speedy shipping.  Would recommend to others looking to try a variety of K-cups.

Expected some brand variety and paid more than we usually do to get it, arrived with 90% Green Mountain (the brand we wanted a break from), 10% Gloria Jean, lots of repeat flavors. Not impressed compared to what we expected based on site info.

We just recently purchased our Keurig right before Christmas and have been trying out all the different brands and flavors since. I was super excited to find this assortment stock on here, and even more excited because the price seemed reasonable compared to the grocery stores. I noticed the "clause" at the end, "due to the availability some flavors may be substituted.." Ok, I totally understand. However, when receiving the shipment, I was cheated out of many of these flavors! On a positive note, the shipping was FAST!!!! Maybe I just bought at the wrong time?Chocolate Glazed Donut, Cinnamon Roll, Butter Toffee, French Vanilla Supreme (didn't get), Mudslide (didn't get), Hazelnut, Hazelnut Decaf (didn't get), Caramel Vanilla Cream (didn't get), French Vanilla, French Vanilla Decaf (didn't get), Mocha Nut Fudge, Southern Pecan (didn't get), Wild Mountain Blueberry (didn't get), Kahlua (didn't get), Creme Caramel (didn't get), Hawaiian Hazelnut (didn't get), Jamaica Me Crazy (didn't get), Vanilla Francaise (didn't get), French Vanilla Iced Coffee (didn't get), Caramel Cappuccino (didn't get), Hazelnut Cappuccino (didn't get), French Vanilla Cappuccino (didn't get). Due to availability some flavors may be substituted without prior notice. Amazon is the only vendor of Authentic Crazy Cups Flavored Sampelr Packs.I did get: Green Mountain Limited Edition Golden French Roast, Pumpkin Spice, Gingerbread, & Spicy Egg Nogg (which were not even listed on the products page).I didn't receive ANY DECAF! I was hoping to, since I am pregnant! Wow..just realized I didn't get over half the listing! Luckily, I am just starting out so I haven't tasted these K-cups yet!

I was cautious about buying this product after reading several negative reviews about it, but I went ahead and bought it anyway because I wanted to try different sorts of flavored coffee. When I received my package I was pleasantly surprised! I ordered the 35 K-Cup pack. I received all 35 cups in 25 different flavors which don't expire until mid-April. The cups arrived in a normal shipping box- nothing fancy, but it protected the cups from being ruined. Overall, a good experience.

We just got our Keurig for Christmas, but really wanted to try samples of all the coffees. This was the best option, I was a little worried from the reviews, but its nothing like it others have said. My cups came in a box that was packaged with an expiration date on the outside, some of the cups come with their own expiration dates. None of the cups were damaged, or even dusty like others have said. I ended up getting 20 different flavors. So a majority of them I got two of one flavor. Which I am fine with cause then my husband and I both get to try them. I am very happy with the product, and cant wait to order again.
There are at least 20 different types of coffee in this variety pack. Surprised with the other reviews that complain about lack of variety. I am very pleased with this product.

I like this option of trying all kinds of different flavors and brands etc.  However, I did not get to try all of them.  I think you should be getting exactly what you are paying for!  If you picture all the flavors you should be sending all the flavors no exceptions!  I did not get: French Vanilla Iced Coffee, Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee, Jamaica me Crazy, Creme Caramel, Hazelnut Cappacinno, Vanilla Francaise, and French Vanilla Cappacino... and that is just of what I noticed off the top.  I got like 5 Mud Slides though. I don't mean to sound completely ungreatful, I am  happy enough with the product, I just wish I would have got what I THOUGHT I was going to get until I read the fine print after delivery.

I really wished I had read the reviews before I ordered this assortment.  I specifically chose this assortment because of the particular coffees that were in the picture, especially Jamaica Me Crazy, Caramel Vanilla Creme, Kahlua.  This is what my (literally) brown paper bag contained: 6 french vanilla, 6 hazelnut, 4 southern pecan, 3 gingerbread, 2 chocolate glazed donut, 2 mocha nut fudge, 1 pumpkin spice, 1 cinnamon roll, 1 spicy eggnog and NINE, yes NINE, yucky wild mountain blueberry.  I think it's kind of stinky to get rid of unpopular product by loading it up into an assortment pack.  And it was most of the coffe was Green Mountain Coffee, which isn't neccessarily horrible but I also bought this particular assortment because of the variety of brands that were in the picture.  I'm disappointed and will now have to spend more money to try the coffees I thought I was spending money on already. It would be more accurate to lable this a K-Cup Grab Bag!

The coffee is great, of course! It is a great variety and nice selection, and a pretty good price. Why the 3 stars? Because I received 35 loose k-cups just thrown in a bag. No packaging, no box. It was weird. Only one k-cup came a bit crushed; all the other cups were fine. So, I guess the paper bag filled with 35 loose cups was ok. However, to me, that is poor packaging and poor customer service. I won't buy from here again because of that. I prefer my coffee in the appropriate packaging, with legal labels and legal selling information on the package.

if you are looking for a nice spicy tea with flavor this is it...soooo good.. I am not much of a tea drinker but this is my all time favorite....if you enjoy the flavors of ginger and cloves than you will love this tea
Having travelled to India many times, this makes a good authentic cup of spicy Chai tea. I haven't noticed the weak complaints that I have read in other reviews.

column9: Lacks flavor compared to Tazo chai
column10: I started my chai tea w/ creamer habit using Tazo chai which has intense flavor.I decided to give Twinning "ultra spice" a try and it completely lacks the same "kick" as Tazo chai.Very very disappointing.

The spice content is great, but it comes on a base of very watery tea.  This masala chai has a strongly imbalanced flavor; these same spices mixed with more black assam tea would produce a strong tea beverage, not bitter (steeping tea extra long releases bitter tanins, not more tea flavor), with a very pleasant flavor from the spices.  As-is, it is a failure.Since this costs as much as Irish Breakfast Tea bags, and I assume that the spices aren't free, it is my deduction that tea quantity is significantly lower in this particular blend.  Notably, if you were to use loose tea of the same composition, you would use more of it; although I imagine then the spice blend would be overpowering.  The best course would be to use loose Chai tea of the normal blend, and use more total quantity to raise both the tea and spice concentration together; or, for more spice, you would use an in-between blend, but again greater total quantity.This Chai tea is overbalanced towards spice; the total volume is too low for a proper balance.

column9: Even worse than their other efforts at chai tea...
column10: I agree with the review that states this tea is watery. The taste of the spices is also almost minimal, with a faintly medicinal quality. I have now tried three of Twinings' chai teas (one of which is discontinued) and while Twinings remains my favorite brand for black tea they simply cannot seem to make decent chai. Do yourself a favor and try Tazo or Stash instead of wasting your money on this.

column9: delicious fresh exotic flavor, unique and versatile
column10: Bergamot is reminiscent of orange or lemon extract, but with it's own particular personality.  It is a delicious substitute for lemon flavoring in teas and cookies. It makes a nice cologne, too.

This is the first time I've tried Yacon syrup.  As the name implies the consistency is one of thick syrup or molasses.  The taste is also like a subtle molasses taste.  Unfortunately it doesn't taste very sweet to me so I end up using a lot of it since I like my coffee sweet in the morning.  And at this price it's going to be a pricey sweetner. At the same time I ordered coconut sugar and will likely stick with that over this..we'll see. The Yacon syrup does disolve well in hot things - haven't tried cooking with it or in cold things so I cannot speak to that.  I like that it is a prebiotic.  Would recommend people try if they are looking for natural sugar and sweetner alternatives.

I love this cereal, but I use it just as much for baking.  I add it to my oatmeal cookies recipe, substituting a half cup for half cup of flour.  It adds a bit of extra nutrition.  I also use a half cup or so in my pizza crust.  I haven't bothered with the muffin recipe because there is not much fiber per muffin, when all is said and done.  I buy a high fiber muffin mix ready-made....lots of fiber per muffin and really, really delicous.  But still....this cereal is great.  I do sweeten it a bit, usually with preserves of some kind.  And I always add raisens while cooking it.  Someone posted that it is lumpy, but I have always found it to cook really fast and really smooth.

I tried this for the first time this morning -- what a treat! I'm not a breakfast person, but I eat a small bowl of Quaker Oatmeal almost daily so I won't be tempted to eat junk food at the office. I found Quaker Oat Bran at the 99-Cent Only Store in Los Angeles (where rejected products go to die) and decided to give it a try since oatmeal was getting boring. It was hot, filling, and  surprisingly tasty -- kind of like the Malt-O-Meal I'd eat as a kid. Now that I know it's hard to find, I'll stock up at the 99-Cent Only Store. :)

This oat bran cereal is essentially just like the Mother's Oat Bran also sold through Amazon and with Suscribe and save is a good value. It has a creamier texture than most other oat bran cereals I have tried.
Item was shipped in a prompt manner. Could not get item in local grocery stores. Complete satisfaction with transaction.

I eat oat bran or multigrain cereal for breakfast daily and need some varieties.  I tried this oat bra, and I am not disappointed.  I eat my hot cereal (cannot stand a dry one) with a serving of milled flaxseed, and this oat bran's taste and texture is enhanced. This one of the best tasting cereal.

This product was good, but it had a paste-like taste to me for some reason. I am new to eating oat bran after having eaten old-fashioned oatmeal for 30 plus years. It was a bargain for the number of boxes of oat bran that you are sent though. However, I think I will be sticking with the Hodgkins Mills brand that is also available here on Amazon.com in the future.

column9: Best tasting Oat Bran out there ...
column10: I know that some people's first reaction to the thought of eating Oat Bran is not "Oh boy yummy", but this stuff is just that.  I have tried many other brands and keep coming back to this one.  For what ever reason, Walmart here no longer carries this and I found this price to be cheaper than what some of the other stores want and bought the pack of 6 so at least I have it.  I love this for breakfast in the Winter and often use it for a "fill in" meal when I just am not sure what I want.  If you like good whole grain cereal give this a try.  I cook it with Soy Milk and its very good.  I highly recommend it for both its taste and its "Good for you" factor.  >^..^<

Been drinking tea for fifty years and did not know about black tes, but this one is the finest tea I have ever tried.  It is my morning wakeup and several times during the day.  It is smoloth, sweet and comforting.  It will be my partner for life.

First, these are 3oz jars. Pay attention - I didn't. Much smaller than what you can buy at a local grocery store and for more $$$. Second, they have a nasty taste.  I have always loved sun-dried tomatoes but these literally ruined my favorite dish and made it almost inedible. Ick.

Was disappointed when unable to find peppermint-flavored Certs in our area, as we love them!  Hesitated to order them through Amazon, not knowing how fresh the mints would be, but was extremely pleased with the purchase.  Will be placing another order in the near future.

column9: Amazon price is way too high
column10: I buy Vitamin Water Zero here in Colorado for $1 each for the 20 0z size.  The current price here is $39.99 for 24 bottles.  Why?Personally I like the Lemonade and Orange flavors best.  Followed by the XXX Acai - blueberry- pomegranate.  It is really nice to have a choice of beverage without caffeine and sugar or artificial sweeteners.  Lower the price Amazon !

column9: Delicious, nutritious, but online it's expensive-itious
column10: For some reason, this listing doesn't indicate what flavor of vitamin water zero is being sold on this page. Big oversight. I found this page because I was searching for acai-blueberry-pomegranate - the image here could be that particular flavor but is slightly lighter and may instead be fruit punch or dragonfruit.I was also wondering if there were any bulk pricing deals on Amazon that would save me the hassle of constantly lugging dozens of bottles from my local store, but that doesn't appear to be the case.One way or another, I am completely and totally hooked on vitamin water zero and recommend it highly. It is very tasty, and nutritionally has the following:100% of daily requirements for vitamin c100% for vitamin B5 B6, B1225% for vitamin  vitamin A100% for vitamin  niacin100% for vitamin  pantothenic acidmanganese, vitamin B3, magnesium and antioxidant mineralsThere are few if any preservatives.It's also ZERO calories and flavored with stevia, a natural sweetener, supposedly less questionable healthwise than sucralose/splenda or other artificial sweeteners.I've tried about six flavors of vitamin water zero (note that it looks  almost the same as glaceau vitamin water and glaceau vitamin water XXX so pay attention to the label) and acai-blueberry-pomegranate is by far my favorite. I don't care too much for the lemonade one - it's too sweet.In regard to the price, yes, it is over-priced here, especially when you add shipping. In my own local environment (near Boston), about six supermarkets and grocery stores near me carry it, at prices ranging from 99 cents per bottle to 3 bottles for $4 to (at pricey convenience stores) $1.99 a bottle. Given that I drink three bottles a day, the latter is too expensive. So basically I buy it in bulk at the lowest price, and dilute it to make it last longer. It's still tasty when you add a considerable amount of water to it.Amazon does have a listing or two priced at 99 cents a bottle, and with free shipping, but the only ones I've seen so far are is the lemonade flavor, which is actually quite popular. But if you're a person who prefers lemon in water without sugar, then you too would probably find the lemonade flavor too sweet.Since there are many electrolyte-type waters out there that are not very tasty, have limited nutritional value, a lot of preservatives and sometimes a hefty amount of calories - do yourself a favor at try glaceau vitamin water zero. However if buying at Amazon, do a search for all of them listed to find the best price and best shipping deal.

I love Vitamin Water and love the regular XXX flavor but this Zero crap is horrible! I know it says "Naturally sweetened" on the bottle, but yeah right! This drink tastes horribly of artificial sweeteners. It's bitter, leaves a horrible aftertaste, and is a chore to drink. If you are sensitive to the taste of artificial sweeteners, I do not recommend this at all.

column9: The best chili mix there is!
column10: I used a package of this mix about a year ago.  I go it as a gift from a friend.  I found it to be the best chili I have ever made!  I have tried many other brands since and none of them even come close to the Brown Bag Mix.  I was thrilled to see it on Amazon.  Thanks!

Hands down - this is the best chili mix EVER! I have tried all of the competitors and they have nothing on BB Chili! My family has made this chili for holidays, football games, etc. for the last 35 years. It's a must buy!
This is an aeromaric delight, with equally pleasing taste!! Highly recommend to tea enthusiasts! Everyone who I have given this to raves about its excellence! I wish it came in individual bags also.
Everyone always wants a cup of iced tea at my house!  I use one bag of this with 4 bags of  Lipton  small tea bags for my iced tea machine.
This tea is served at a local deli. I was thrilled to be able to buy it for home use!
My favorite beverage! Can't live without it! I also agree the mix of flavor and tea is a perfect blend.

column9: Best iced tea you will find
column10: The Tahitian Blend tea is without a doubt the best iced tea I have ever had.  I am not one to like strong fruit flavors that overpower the tea but this tea seems to mix in the tropical flavors in a mild way in a very clean tasting tea.  You will not regret ordering it.  I too found out about this tea by asking the server at a restaurant what tea they were serving.  I even bought a bag of tea from the restaurant to "tide me over" until I could order my own.

This is hands-down the best tea for iced tea.  I "discovered" it when I finally asked a waiter at my favorite water-front restaurant if he knew what kind of  tea they served.  He did!  Barnes and Watson Tahitian blend. Fabulous black tea with just a hint of fruit. I rarely write reviews but had to let you know about this  tea - it's really worth raving about.
Very good quality unbleached coffee filters.  Can't see any reason to buy any other brand.

A coffee filter is something that is used continually.  To be able to buy them in bulk is a large advantage.  The question would be, are they adequate and comparable to those I buy at 40 per box, every week or so, at the grocery store.  These are certainly adequate.  They are firm, easy to separate and conveniently packaged in cardboard boxes of 100.  They lack the little round tab but are sturdy enough that the tab is not missed.  I am very pleased.

I've struggled to get a good cup of coffee out of these.  They clog, they break, they generally make the process of making a cup of coffee arduous.I've been using melitta coffee filters until I bought a box of these filters, and never had a problem with them.  I will go back to Melitta and might not even finish using one box of these.

In the vast, wide, and ever expanding world of coffee filter options, the choice is simple: If You Care.Free shipping, Super Saver discount, convenient delivery to my door every 6 months? Yes, please!

I won't run out of coffee filters for at least a few years now, and I got them at a great price. No worse than the ones you pay a nickel apiece for at the supermarket, and probably better because they aren't bleached.

Never had one clog or split. I cannot tell the difference between these and the Melittas. And they cost half as much (if you buy them in bulk from Amazon).(FWIW, I do find the "If you care" offensive. Oh, so if I don't buy your product I don't care? That is pretty close to insulting your customer. -1 star for that. But, for half the price, I'll take them anyway.)

I bought Big Hunks when I came across them in retail stores, which wasn't very often.  When I did find them, they were usually kind of stale from sitting there for a while.  I came across this offer on Amazon and was impressed with the price so placed an order.  The box arrived quickly and I was very happy to discover how fresh the candy turned out to be.  If you like fresh nougat, you will probably be very happy with this item.

I was quite surprised to receive this order so quickly; actually 3 days earlier than was anticipated.  Not only was the nougat soft and chewy, but the peanuts were fresh and crunchy and had a "best before" date of 3/2012, so these bars are definitey fresh.  I will order this item again from this supplier and would recommend it to others.
My mom's favorite candy ever! They don't sell them where I live so when I saw these I had to get them for her. She loved them!
Valentines gift for my husband. Gobbled them upquickly because they were so fresh and yummy.
Big Hunk has to be the best candy bar out there.  Put it in the frig for about an hour and when you drop it, it breaks into bite size pieces.

its hard to find soft fresh big hunks. it was a risk to order off the internet, but it paid off perfectly. not only did i save money from what it costs in the stores, but it seems to be made recently vs the rock hard decade old big hunks sold in stores.

You can't buy these in the eastern states. I love this candy! I have been buying these since they we a nickle in Tucson, AZ. :) Very happy to see them on Amazon. I buy two boxes at a time. Love them!!

I'm extremely pleased with my Big Hunk order.  This is the second time I have bought them online.  The candy is fresh, unlike the candy store purchases in my area.  Plus the price is great.  The candy stores charge $1.75 each. This is quite a savings.  No more wasting gas driving to the candy store.  Excellent product, excellent price,  and excellent service.  Can't beat that.

column9: Fresh and taste just as expected
column10: This is a box of full-size bars.  Too delicious!  I need to get the small ones next time so I can avoid eating too much at once.
I can't get this product in Virginia, and my wife loves them. We have to order online. This product arrived in a brand new box, and were perfect.

this was by far a great service i had ordered this item the big hunk and i recived it the expected day. i could say it was a good service they even sent me a thank you note stating that they were welcomed by my purchase and to leave a review of their service and so that is what i am doing. hahaha. Honestly they gave a me a good servicce and with no troubles all easy who could argue with that.? :)

Traveled to the store every day for sundry items and bought a couple of Big Hunks. At $1.79 each I checked around for bulk sizes and found them at Amazon. Bought 2 twenty-four count boxes about a week ago and it's time to reload. Just a fantastic candy for anyone who loves toffee, Very fresh and love the 2 day delivery.Thanks so much.

I am a daily sencha drinker and I have had not so good sencha in the past, but this wins the not so good medal from me.  When I first opened the ziplock packaging I could hardly smell anything and the tea looked more brownish than I am used to seeing sencha look  It was loaded with stems (about 10% stems I would estimate).  This was all not a good sign.  Next, I made a cup and only left it in the water for about 1.5 minutes which is about the max I steep Rishi Organic Sencha before it turns bitter.  I was left with a cup of tea that barely smelled like green tea and was seriously weak.  Next, I tried to steep for 5 minutes and still no change.  I guess you get what you pay for.  The packaging and the deliver is good is the only positive thing I can say.  On to trying another brand.

column9: Yummy mustard and sweet brown sugar!
column10: We're big Bulls-Eye fans using a bottle of the regular "classic" sauce a week. We're always grilling up something for us or guests and Bulls-Eye is our go-to sauce. I thought I'd try something a bit different when I found these series of regional sauces: Bulls Eye Barbeque Sauce - Kansas City Style 1 bottle 18 oz, and Bulls Eye Barbeque Sauce - Carolina Style 1 bottle. We bought a six pack of the Memphis and the Kansas City and really enjoyed both. The Memphis was wonderful on pork and chicken and the Kansas City was sampled on some beef ribs. Already Bulls-Eye fans the variations were very nicely done. THe Memphis has mustard adding some light kick, red onions, garlic, white wine, and a bit of brown sugar adding some sweetness. A subtle tangy and sweet sauce. The Kansas City style was a bolder hickory, molasses, mustard, onions, and garlic and stood up better to the beef. My Memphis bottles came with a best use date 9 months from now, the Kansas City bottles just two months from now.Next order will be the North Carolina (ya'all) style.

This a a very tasty product and it makes all beat product taste good. I have been a fan of Kraft barbecue sauce for years but I just decide to try this brand Bulls's Eye. I am glad I did and I will be switching to this brand from now on.

This is a really cool product. For the first part you arn't paying a arm and a leg at the museums. It tastes pretty good. It is a wierd texture to explain. It is a chalky texture, but when it hits your mouth it gets creamy. Try to think its not cold frozen ice cream. its going to be like room temp. The only down side i see is the secondary wrapper inside. Its almost always broken or wripped. But, its nothing to ruin the product. Its sealed with the outside packaging. So i dont see why the other package is there. Unless its to help control the moisture.

If you like Lucky Charms cereal, this'll float your boat. The freeze-dried ice cream has the same consistency, particularly in terms of crunchiness. The dessert will get stuck throughout your teeth, allowing you to horrify your friends and save some flavor for later.You only get a single ice cream sandwich in a bag, which makes the whole thing seem overpriced and over-packaged.

Dehydrated ice cream is a very unique experience, and I love it. I used to get these for Christmas when I was growing up, and now that I can buy it here (and for relatively cheap compared to what they used to cost in local museums and gift shops) I am able to enjoy it more often.The packaging has always been well sealed on the outside, but they are quite fragile so usually the ice cream itself is shattered into quite a few pieces (though not too tiny). The inside wrapper is always torn as other reviews have mentioned, but if you read the back they actually *say* it will have slits in it because of the way it is processed. I'm not exactly sure how that works, but it's not a mistake or something to be worried about.I will continue buying these on Amazon!

I saw this on a cooking show so i was pretty curious. I ended up ordering it, the shipping took about 4 days. It tasted pretty good, not amazing, I expected it to be a little better. I probably wont order this again just because it satisfied my curiosity, But if you have never tried this I highly suggest trying it out.

column4: Mary Kirkland "I saw a woman wearing a sweat ...
column10: I bought this after seeing it on this site and was so curious about what it would taste like. So curiosity got the better of me and I bought it. I wasn't disappointed at all. I do believe it's supposed to be in a brick but mine was in pieces by the time I got it, no matter I would have cut it into pieces anyway. I got each of my family members to try a small piece and we all agreed that it really did taste like the ice cream...if ice cream were warm and in a freeze dried form.If you are looking to try something different, and I do mean different..then this is definitely for you. It was great fun to try this and share it with my family, but I think it was a one time buy for me.

column9: Not a toy but a nice food
column10: so i got the "freeze dried" ice cream it was already in pieces so i didn't need to cut it, it was good but i wont plan on buying it again. at first it taste like its melting in your mouth then it stops melting, it has a nice flavor of the vanilla & chocolate but the strawberry didn't taste like strawberry. overall it is good for a one time shot but not an everything thing. i would be sticking to my frozen Ben and Jerry's

column9: Just as fun as it sounds & tasty too!
column10: This was a humor gift for my hubby on his birthday. He had explained to me one time about how his dad had got him some while they were visiting the Air & Space Museum in D.C. while we were there visiting the National Mall & he hadn't had it since, but loved it. So what better way to surprise him! It come just as described and is cheaper than you can buy it at the Smithsonian Mall, that's for sure!! Great product, & you won't be disappointed! :)
This was a great, fun, good tasting treat.  We all loved trying it out.  I was very impressed!  If you are at all curious about trying astronaut ice cream you should definately order some!

My son loves these but.... the product description for this says "great price" and that these cost double at the local science centers.  This is very misleading since if it were true then the package would not contain only 1 single .7 oz package which is only two dollars and change at our local science center and the highest you will ever see is three plus dollars.  The price here is DOUBLE the science center price so they have it upside down.  My dad ordered this for my son thinking it was 3-packs probably having misread the "3 year expiration date" plus seeing that they said it was half the price that you pay at the science centers (UNTRUE).This is ONE pack only.  At least the one we received and nothing here says any different.  Buy it at your local center.  And forget making a comment that the review should be about the product and not the price as they put pricing claims in the product description making it part of the product and specifically misleading.

I'm not sure what my expectations were going in, but this wouldn't have lived up to them.  It tastes like a cross between styrofoam and the marshmallows found in Lucky Charms cereal.I was looking for something to take along on 5-day mountain climbing trips, but I think I'll stick to the old standards from here on out.Might be okay as a one-time novelty for pre-teen kids, but it isn't something you'd want for a serious after-meal snack on a semi-regular basis.
This is not a toy, but the ice cream is very good and its something different than your average ice cream. You get to experience with astronauts eat!

while making my gum paste flowers and roses,i wanted to make the look as real as possible, tried many greens , was not satisfide, most greens were not even close,  i tried this color and was very happy.it gives the look and shades needed plus looking as real as possible. will order itagain and highly recommed it ."Icing Color - Juniper Green".few drops can give you the right color. very good product.

column9: Love Wilton, Just Not This Color
column10: I made a basketball cake for my son and the instructions called for terra cotta icing color.  I was a little confused when I picked this item up, because the label on the dye shows a red color, nothing near "true" terra cotta, but the swatch (as seen left of the dye) shows terra cotta.  I went ahead and purchased this and wasted my time and money.  My icing came out pink and and grew closer to red as I added more dye.  I ended up using orange and various other colors to get my desired terra cotta coloring.

column9: Energy for Marathon, Grand Canyon, and Mt. Whitney.
column10: It's the best tasting energy "stuff" you can get. Way better tasting than Gu. It's the also the best tasting Sport beans in my opinion.I used it for marathon, hikes for Grand Canyon and Mt. Whitney. It never fails me.

had to give it a star just to rate this but I would give it a whopping 0 stars and a capital " YOU HAVE TO BE @#$%ING KIDDING ME!" these milks are 4.98 a six pack at wal-mart so that means you can buy 5 / 6packs of them for 25.00 equaling 30 milks....

This Green Mountain dark magic coffee is just what I was looking for. Strong enough taste to enjoy and it gets me going almost immediately. Haven't noticed any after taste and buying the 120 count it pans out to like $.61 a cup. Try it you'll like it.

column9: Great product at an outstanding price!
column10: If you are a coffee lover, this blend is for you. After trying more than a dozen blends, this is by far the best of the K-Cups. The seller ships quickly, and offers the best price I've ever seen for this product.
If you like coffee with a bold taste you will love this one!! I have tried several different blends of the K cup coffee and find this one to be the best so far!!!

column9: One of the best tasting bars out there!
column10: This bar is tasty, filling and good for you.  I love them and have one for breakfast every morning with a cup of brewed chai with almond milk.I am looking to eat free of wheat/gluten/yeast and this bar fits the bill.  Only 9 grams of sugar (compared to the 15 - 30 grams that other bars contain), plus 5 grams of fiber and 6 grams of protein.  The ingredients are organic and the hint of spice is very nice.I highly recommend!

These Bumble Bars are a real winner with my mother.  She LOVES them!  I buy them frequently for her instead of candy or other snacks which she cannot have on her restricted diet.  It makes me happy to make her happy with these wonderful, healthier, gluten free snacks.

My son's best friend has food alergies and stays away from gluten, aspertame, food coloring etc.  Even though my son does not have the same alergies, we try to eat along the same lines because it's healthy and my son likes to eat what his friend eats.The Bumble Bars are good.  I love the chewiness, I love the seeds and nuts.  The touch of honey is great.  And Lord knows active 11 year olds need all the wholesome energy they can get.  The sugar content is low and the fiber content is high.  It is just hard for me to save them for the boys!!!On a truly aestetic note.  The packaging is nostalgic.  I love that!

column9: Yum! Healthy snack for a child too.
column10: These bars are great!  Very soft.  I feed them to my toddler and I have to give him small pieces in his mouth, otherwise there would be seeds stuck all over.  Nutty with a slight honey taste.

column9: great power bar alternative- and gluten free
column10: We have tried a variety of granola, power bars and others - and this is the best that we have found - good source of energy, all natural, tastes great (we have tried all the flavors and the original is our favorite - followed by chocolate cherry)  And the other good thing is that they don't have all the sodium and sugar that most other bars will weigh you down with.  Great for a snack and the gym or at work.

If you haven't had Bumble Bars please do so. I love them, and the Lushus Lemon flavor is the only one that really stands out to me. It actually tastes like real lemon. Not that fake lemon flavor that you get in candy sometimes.Give it a try, I think you will be pleased.

The original Bumblebars are great.  They are unlike any other snack bar.  Very sticky when it warm, I've not had them when it's really cold out yet.  I would compare to rice crispy bars (but healthy) in texture.  Not like most other granola type snack bars.  But this is what makes it so good and unique.They hold me over when I'm hungry and need to stay at the computer.  I highly recommend!
This is my all time favorite 'grab and go' snack bar. It doesn't leave you with a sugar rush/drop, tastes great and is easy to stash in your pocket or purse.
Yes, these are a little sticky. But they make up for it by being addictively delicious.These are a yummy alternative to granola bars for those who need GLUTEN-FREE foods.

Tastes like lemon chiffon in one's mouth, but texture crumbles and is a bit crunchy (I like).  Messy food, but the wrapper, if one is careful, contains it well.  Filling too.  It's the single best non-dairy snack I've ever eaten.

column9: AWESOME VEGAN gluten free Organic SNACK BAR! My 11 yr old's prefered snack . He loves these better than candy bars.
column10: Great mildly spiced bar sweet but not too sweet. Really satisfies a hunger craving. Great for the whole family.Zesty Ginger, cardamom, and cinnamon enhance the natural flavors of sesame seeds, almonds, vanilla, and flax seeds. Mildly spicy and thoroughly satisfying.ALLERGIES:GLUTEN FREE BUT NOT NUT FREE -Contains The following allergens: almonds, soy.
