The fact that they don't even have the bottom portion of the "regular" K-cups while still maintaining excellent, rich flavor makes me a convert.This flavor, French Roast, is bold, strong and just what I'm looking for as a morning coffee, and holds up very well as iced coffee as well.I'll be buying many more of these!

This is a great waste saving package 'k' cup. Lovely strong nutty flavor. Be careful to seal the cups between use. To me, this coffee is fresher than standard k cups. Definitely worth the added hassle of reselling the pack.

Coffee is bold and very good. I like it better than Newman s and Folgers K-Cups. It is a bargain for the price. Also it is great that the "cups" are not plastic but just a filter :)My favorite k-kup for sure!
The cost of the San Francisco Bay K-cups is the lowest I have been able to find anywhere.  Good coffee too!  This deal is hard to beat.
I am a coffee snob.  This coffe is a mild french roast.  It works great in my Keurig.  This company has the right idea of less garbage, by using less plastic.  They prices is very resonable also.

I tried these alternative k-cups for the first time and thought they were pretty good. I don't think I'll be buying the traditional k-cups again. The French Roast were nice and dark roasted.My 80-pack came with 10 bags of 8 pods. When I opened a bag I put the ones I wasn't going to use right then in a ziplock bag. Not much hassle to save 50% on the cost of k-cups.

PURCHASED FROM MY FAVORITE INTERNET PROVIDER, Amazon.  I am a coffee nut...love a great cup of coffee.  If you want a full bodied coffee with great aroma and taste (not bitter), then I strongly suggest San Francisco Bay French Roast.

After reading the reviews we jumped in with both feet and ordered this and the Fog Chaser. Here's my take on the French Roast after drinking all 36 cups:* I prefer this to the Fog Chaser, but I like a darker roast.* Don't be scared by the look, it's just a K-Cup without the plastic case. I love that this seems more eco-friendly.* Okay, it's true, they smell a little funny. Not quite sure why they don't just smell like coffee, but who knows what other K-cups smell like without the plastic cover, right? Our solution was just not to smell them before brewing.* The taste is bold, and my first cup tasted bitter and not so great. We don't use sugar or sweeteners so there was nothing to mask the taste! But, like most new things, after a couple of cups over a couple of mornings I found the taste was fine, especially for the price. I don't know if I would serve this to company though, I like really dark roasts but most people don't.* I read a tip that said to prevent grounds in your cup, close the brewer lid slowly and gently. Works for us, we've had NO grounds in our cups.So there we go, I'm ordering them again to take advantage of the Subscribe & Save option. I'm not going to say that this is the best coffee I've ever had, but for that 1st cup in the morning it's just fine.

If you like Star Buck coffee, you'll love San Francisco Bay coffee. Nice bold taste. Fog Chaser is very strong. It will wake you up. French Roast is milder than Fog Chaser, but still has a great taste. It make Green Mountain taste like flavored water.
If you like strong coffee, this is the best one I have found. To keep it fresh, you probably want to put it in a zip lock bag after opening the 12-pod packs.

Love this coffee and love the price!I love the smell when I open the container and it is my new favorite coffee. I would recommend this to anyone. I keep it in a zip lock bag after opening to keep it fresh until used.
I work from home and drink aobut 5-6 cups off K-Cup coffee a day. This is good tasting coffee and the lowest price K-Cup on the market!

I did not buy these from Amazon, but apparently will in the future.  I was in my local membership-required-big-box store (am I allowed to say Costco?) when I saw this stuff for about 27 cents per serving.  Since it's very easy to return stuff there, I bought it.  As others have commented, it's unusual looking, in that just the familiar looking K-Cup ring and foil at the top are there.  The plastic cup around the bottom is missing.  But that doesn't matter and it actually creates less waste and probably costs less to manufacture.Off course, being green doesn't matter if the coffee tastes bad.  In this case, it does not.  It's got to be one of the two best French Roast K-Cups I have ever had.  Full of flavor, without being bitter or burnt.  I went back to the store a few days later and they had sold out and they are not sure of plans to get more, so it looks like I will continue to buy my coffee from Amazon, but instead of my usuall brand (Green Mountain French Roast), I will be buying these.
These K-Cups arrived promptly after ordering; the are convenient to use, and the coffee tastes great. Highly recommend the product. Have had no problems.

This has become our daily coffee. We were previously Starbucks (brewed at home) coffee drinkers, although I will say these are not quite as strong as Starbucks brewed coffee...not weak either though. I usually buy them at our local wholesale warehouse, where the price is a little better, but I come to Amazon when I am needing it fast and don't have time to go to the store. It makes a good cup of coffee, that I happily serve to guests. The only down side is that the individual packaging does not allow for display. Not a big deal.

The coffee is very good.  The cup looks different than the standard k-cup but who care as long as the coffee is good and cost effective. With monthly subscription,  it saves me about $10 a month for regular drinking for 1 person.  Do the math if you have more people drinking.  Recommend the coffee and subscription

The lowest price I could find for k-cups and still tasted delicious!!! K-cups fit my Kuerig and deliver the same results!  I tried several flavors and everyone is true to taste.  I will order again!!Why pay more for the exact same flavor as the other brands??

column9: Robust taste, packaging could be better.
column10: We purchase on Subscribe and Save, 3 boxes a month.  I like the little filters instead of the pods. The price is great. My husband thinks the coffee is stronger than our previous French Roast.  However I really like the robust flavor and, at this price, he just adds a little more cream.  If this had resealable bag I would give four stars. We had to buy a large airtight jar.

I'm generally a fan of dark roast coffees, and this is one of the better K-Cups of that variety.  Perhaps not as strong as Emeril's but better than the Starbucks French Roast K-Cups.  (None of the K-Cups I've found are as tasty as a well-made Aeropress cup, but the ease-of-use, cleanup, and ability to change varieties for each person more than make up the difference.)The form factor doesn't seem to have any significant disadvantage for my.  This box contains 3 12-count sealed plastic bags (each with one of those one-way air valves).  I've kept the "open" dozen in a Gladware tub.  All's well.

column9: Good tasting coffee and cheaper than most.
column10: I like this coffee and the design of the cup. Not the same as a K-cup but works just as good. I like the Fog Chaser better than the French Roast but this is a pretty good tasting one too. Can't beat the price..15.99 for 36 is much cheaper than any other on Amazon.

Always in the market for a cheaper k-cup (and living in San Francisco) I was happy to have stumbled upon the  San Francisco Bay brand. I was worried about the weird shape at first but it still works in the brewer. I like that the packaging is trimmed down so I don't feel as guilty about the environental impact of overpackaging  (told you I live in SF!)  The French Roast is very bold and at first I was unsure...I think I like  it just fine but plan to try another roast next time. It also tastes a bit more acidic than other brands but that isn't such a bad thing either. I think I am getting used to it. My problem is that I switch from several different brands all the time so I may y always notice that difference. I recommend this and plan to order this many more times!  I would give it another half star if i could!

column9: This is a no brainer, Great coffee
column10: I enjoy a good cup of coffee, when I found these little gems I was hesitant like other people. We were all brain washed thinking we had to use the wasteful K-cups. As they continued to raise the price of coffee up and up and up I was trying different ways to utilize my Keurig coffee maker, purchased refill cups etc you know how that works. Well this is by far the best way to enjoy a good cup of coffee, the way the cups are packaged does not bother me at all, I don't let it sit around to get stale , I drink it. If you notice the bags are vacuum sealed and a zip lock bag would not work people. If it is not broken don,t fix it, and this is not broken so just keep these prices affordable, and keep the quality of the coffee just the way it is.
I have tried a large variety of french roast k-cups over the last 4 years, even the re-usable k-cups where you add your own coffee, and this is by far my favorite.

I really like this coffee - no problem with the bags being open as they are long gone before they would have gone stale.  They work well in my Keurig B40 - I'm wondering if some of the people who've had trouble haven't perhaps used these in the really tiny version of the brewer that does not have a water reservoir.  Love the price and love the coffee.

column9: Nice Flavor - Freshness might be an issue
column10: I was surprised when I got these from Amazon because like the other reviewers said, the cups do not look like traditional K-Cups, because the bottom of the cup is a filter - not plastic like the traditional ones. But don't let this bother you - they worked just fine.The coffee was better than most - strong flavor. One of the better stronger brews.The only issue I see is that after you open the package, you must use the cups quickly or they will get stale. Some people like the K-Cups because they don't use that much coffee and so it is always fresh. But if you are like me and drink a lot of coffee, I don't see how you can go wrong with this coffee.

Yup not a K-Cup. If you don't like the non-plastic cup, then don't buy them.For our family, we like the taste, and the price. We've tried both this French Roast and the Fogchaser, and enjoy them both. We have not had any issues with grounds in the coffee. We keep them in a zip-lock bag after opening the 12 pack bag, so we have not had issues with them tasting stale (we drink them in about 2-weeks). I'm guessing that these cost less since they don't have to pay a royalty to Green Mountain Coffee Roasters for using the K-Cup name and design.If you're looking for a fairly inexpensive alternative to the K-Cup, these are a great choice!

Great bold french roast for the Keurig coffee machine. The flavor is bold and strong. If you are  a french roast fan, this is the best I have had for the Keurig yet. Even more, the cups are much more environmentally friendly than most of the others on the market because hey use much less plastic- just a small ring and the with a soft biodegradable filter attached.

column9: Not a traditional K-Cup, maybe even better?
column10: I bought these in an attempt to get some Kcups at a reasonable price that were NOT instant coffee. While I'm not picky about coffee, I'm not going to waste my  time with instant-coffee Kcups no matter how cheap they are. Using Subscribe&Save, these are half price compared to what I pay at Costco for my husband's favorite Kcup: Starbucks Cafe Vienna. They do not have the white plastic "cup," instead the part under the foil top is coffee-filter material in a curved-bottom shape. So only the foil top is pierced when the machine brews. I like to think this means less waste! They are packaged in thick sealed plastic bags in groups of 12. Aroma is extremely fresh, taste is great, just as strong/rich in my opinion as the Starbucks ones. Wish they came in more flavors and larger quantities!

column9: Great coffee to my unrefined, neophyte palate
column10: I'm certainly no coffee snob but I do know what I like... and I very much like the SFB french roast "k-cups". I do the S&S on these and it's pretty much the only coffee I drink now. The aroma is fantastic and the flavor is great. As for the folks bemoaning stale coffee, put the things in a tupperware container after opening the plastic bag. It's not an intellectual challenge.

I'm a coffee lover and enjoy all kinds but now drink k-cup most of time.This one is really tasty French roast, better than any other French roast.It's packed a bit different shaped container, but usage is same with other K-cups.Also it smells good too and the rich taste remains in the mouth longer.Price is also good comapred to other K-cups.One problem is it has too much of black resides at the bottom of cup.Good taste all the way but at the end I have to be careful not to drink residues. It definitely needs improvement for filtration.Due to too much remnants, I would not buy this again.

This coffee had all the rich flavor that I expect from a dark roast and minimal bitterness.  I suspect most folks are checking these reviews to find out if these weird cups actually work in a Keurig machine.  They do.  I had no issues.  The unexpected benefit was the great coffee aroma.  I love the Keurig system, but I miss the smell of coffee before it is prepared.  The aroma is back with these as soon as you open the plastic bag that they come in.  As much as I enjoyed the aroma, I felt compelled to store these things in another air-tight container, lest they lose their freshness. I also decided that I could not keep these cups in the rotary K-cup holder that we keep next to our machine.Despite storage issues, I would get these again for their flavor, aroma, and price.

Function: these cupless k-cups work perfectly in our Keurig B130 (the business version of the small personal brewer) which makes only a small cup.Less waste: We were really disappointed when we discovered that the plastic k-cups aren't recyclable. These are a terrific low-guilt, more responsible alternative.Less storage space: they take up much less room to store. I buy k-cups in quantity to save money, but then I had to dedicate a large cabinet to storing them! Not so with these, partially because they're less bulky and partially because...Great Price: these k-cups are much less expensive than other brands, especially at the Subscribe & Save price. At this price, I can buy less at a time and still pay less per cup than I could finagle with coupons & sales & bargain-shopping the major brands.Taste: Amazing!  I love a good dark French roast, and these are the best I've ever had.  Dark & rich but not bitter.  In fact, this morning I forgot to pour the creamer before I took a sip and I was amazed that it tasted really great.  I've tried to go without creamer before - I'd like to get used to coffee without it - but could never stand to...until I did it by mistake this morning and it was so smooth I drank the whole cup that way.  Trust me, this speaks volumes.Conclusion: I'm keeping my subscription, and I just increased the frequency of my deliveries because we found we drink these more than the regular k-cups. How can you beat cheap, tasty, less bulky, and less waste?

column9: Not a K-cup but works in a Keurig
column10: As the other reviewers have said, this is not a K-cup! I uploaded an image of one of these pods next to a K-cup for comparison. The difference is the filter is exposed in these pods as opposed to being fully sealed in a K-cup. Since the coffee is exposed to the air when you open the package, you will have to seal them with a clip or put them in an airtight bag or tupperware to prevent the rest of the pods from loosing freshness. Having said that, in my experience they are a great inexpensive alternative to use in your Keurig brewer. The 36 count boxes arrived as unmarked brown cardboard boxes, not the colorful retail packaging shown on amazon. Inside each cardboard box, there are three clear heavy duty plastic bags, each of which holds 12 of the pods. The bags are not resealable!

column9: Very good coffee, packaging needs a bit of work
column10: This coffee is very good, it has a nice aroma and a good strong flavor.I also like the "minimalist" k-cup design, but have a couple complaints with it.  Since the individual pods aren't sealed, you have to keep them in a sealed package to prevent spoilage.  It would have been nice if the plastic bag they came in was re-sealable.Also, since the coffee doesn't just come out of a small hole in the bottom of the pod, the first cup you make with these will wash all the stray grounds out of your machine and into your cup.  Be forewarned that you should wash the pod holder before using these.Overall I like the product, just be careful about the different pod shape.

column9: A Truly Great Cup of Coffee
column10: Unlike many others, I haven't paid much attention to the price of K-cups because I've been on Amazon's Subscribe & Save for K-cups for over a year now. Wanting to try another brew for a change prompted me to try these. I'd used this brand before in whole beans because they were at Costco so I knew I would like. Wow! These are very different from regular K-cups. Like another reviewer said, the aroma wafts like real brewed coffee and the flavor is rich and bold. I am so happy I took the chance on this. Subscribe and Save is the way to go!!!!!!!

I have been purchasing San Francisco Bay Whole Bean French Roast for years, for the money it has been a very consistent good cup of coffee. I bought a K-Cup brewer to please my guests. K-cup brewing really provides something for everyone without throwing pots of coffee down the sink.But I must admit that I didn't fall in love with all the K-Cup selections out in the market no matter what the price, brand or blend. They were generally hitting a 6 to 8 on a scale of 10. I tried the San Francisco French Roast last week and I really loved it. For me, it is the best out there in the K-cup world.

Though the lower than usual price caught my attention, I was concerned that this coffee, marketed for Keurig, was not packed in the common cups.  Rather, the coffee is in small bags.  Not to worry! They fit as well as the usual cups do. I was so pleased with my first order, I have ordered several more...and given some as gifts to other Keurig fans.

At first I wasn't sure but I figured, at the price i'd give it a try.I was pleasantly surprised at the flavor and quality of this coffee.The K-Cup design is somewhat different and you will need to storethe coffee in a zip lock bag after opening the bag containing thecoffee. Other than that, it's quality coffee at a very nice price.We are talking $0.41 each rather than $0.50+ each.You can't beat it!I'm now buying the 80 count and enjoying it even more asthe price is now $0.35 each.Try it...you'll like it!

I ordered this to see how it compared to the Fog Chaser. It is a good French Roast coffee and is comparable to the Tully's that came with my machine. French Roasts are good for K-cups because you stronger flavor out of one, however, for overall flavor this is not as good as the Fog Chaser.Price is excellent and the packaging is great as it has a much lower waste profile. It's also much easier to compost the grinds with these.

column9: As long as the dog is happy....
column10: My dog always liked these best when we went to Petco, they were just a bit too expensive. Now he's thrilled... but I didn't realize how many cookies makes up 15 pounds. Now I feel like I've got enough cookies for WW III !They come delivered in a box somewhat broken, but still a really good deal.

Where I live in Florida white Melitta filters are not available in stores. If you use a fine grind then the brown filters become clogged very quickly. Purchasing Melitta white filters in quantity is cheap and you can stop kicking yourself for dreading the next time you want to brew a cup of coffee! The brown filters are the equivalent of watching paint dry :)

I really love Andy Capp hot fries I cannot find them anywhere where I live and I live in a big city.They remind me of my teenage years. I have to watch my weight and I try not to pig out but when i do this is my favorite treat thank god for amazon!!!

Extremely flavorful and crunchy, Hot Fries have been my favorite snack food for a long time.  Unfortunately, it's not carried by every grocery market, so I appreciate that Amazon carries them.  These are baked and not fried like a lot of popular chips, which makes it a slightly healthier snack choice.Usually, a bag of this size is a dollar from a local shop.  So you do pay a small premium, but I can't argue with the convenience of having a dozen dropped off at my door.

i don't eat much junk food, but will always make an exception for hot fries!!they arrived quickly, were a good price, and were as delicious as i remember them.just be sure to have a napkin as fingers do get messy!!;-)

I have been a huge fan of Andy Capp hot fries for over 10 years now.  Unfortunately, for the past year now, they have really sucked.  Either they are so greasy it makes you sick or the fries are so hard it feels like your eating Corn Nuts.  Horrible, just horrible.  Not only here in Ohio or on Amazon either, it's everywhere.  I prize those random bags that are made correctly...I find them so rarely now; each new batch Andy makes is uniquely horrible.

I haven't been able to find andy capp hot fries in years. I guess my town don't have taste in food. But i was on Amazon and ran across these Andy Capp Hot Fries by the case and bought 2 cases. I should be stocked up for a long time!! Thanx Amazon for bringing back old time memories.

column9: Spicy and tasty, not very good for you though.
column10: These Hot Fries are a little hotter than I would like, but for those of you who like their snacks spicy then you will like these for sure. The bags are big and full, you certainly get your dollar's worth with Andy Cap Hot Fries.My only real complaint is the amount of preservatives in this product. Lots of MSG.  If you have issues with MSG you will want to avoid these.  The added MSG might be why these are so tasty and why it is so hard to put the bag down once you've had a few.
I love, love, love Andy Capp's Hot Fries. It's too bad I don't see it being sold in stores. I want to order another box, please?Victoria

column9: Just Like Being At The Truckstop
column10: Not a very popular snack, probably due to the salt content.  My wife loves the stuff and they're not easy to get unless you're driving through the highway and stop at a truck stop or go to your local "hood".  I went ahead and ordered this product off Amazon.  Terribly addictive; I limited myself to one bag.  They're not spicy to me (because I love spicy foods).  I'm more of a healthy snacker, so I think I'll go back to my nuts and carrots.
These are the same Hot Fries I would find it gas stations. When I moved to Florida I couldn't find these anywhere. I ordered these and they had the same taste I remembered.

This is just like the kind you get from the store, but much cheaper.  If you like this stuff, and eat it as much as my family does, then this is the way to go.  Get it as Subscribe and Save and it is even less money!

These came directly from the manufacturer and have an expiration date of June 7, 2012 ... not too shabby at all. Let the munching begin.It's been about 20 years or so since I've had these, but it seems the texture is lighter and fluffier now - similar to Cheetos Puffs. These are also incredibly salty, but they probably always have been.Because the texture is too airy for me, I'm dropping my rating down to 3 (3.5, if I could) stars.

Although some of you can find this product at the same price or sale-priced cheaper, it is worth it to buy from Amazon through subscription save prices to save the hassle of stocking up at the grocery store. I love that it comes straight to the house!

I love these hot fries they are basically the same price you would purchase these in the grocery store for. Just 3 cents higher.. no reason to complain there. Also these do not expire until Dec/12/2011 more than enough time for my family and I to eat them. I love these!

My son loves these and says they are the best hot fries. They are a little hot for me but I love the cheese ones. We just ordered those too and I ate a bag already...uh-oh! Will order again with Prime and also on subscribe and save..to save money.As a side note, we just realized we can get free movie streaming having Prime membership on Amazon with our Roku and Netflix 9.00 a month subscription.  Saves LOTS of money on movies. Yeah!
I am a subscribe and save customer. What can I say, my family and I love Andy Capp Hot Fries, umm, umm good.

I used to pick these up from the corner store as a kid and share them with my friends. These things used to be HOT and GOOD! Last time I brought a bag was about 10-15 years ago because I hardly find them anywhere but liquor stores and unfortunately I don't drink. These newer hot fries just aren't the same. They are extremely Salty! and only mildly hot. They also taste more like cheese doodles than anything else. No burn your mouth taste, no slender little fry shape, these just aren't the same. I made the mistake of buying 2 of these and sorry to say but these are too salty for human consumption. They should call them SALTY FRIES.

I had previously not had this type of tea; I purchased as a gift for my mother and she sent me a sample.  She loves it so I tried it out - very delicious with an interesting flavor.  If I were more of a tea drinker, this would be my main source.

column9: Thank god I can drink coffee again!
column10: Ever since I developed food allergies, my stomach hasn't been the same.  Anything too acidic is just too difficult to process.  But coffee...I can't give up coffee.  I've been dealing with the pain because I have coffee related needs.  Now I can have coffee pain free without sacrificing too much in taste.  Love it.
I have been using this product instead of regular salt and it has made a difference in my health and level of wellbeing.

column9: Organic, Low Sugar & No Artificial Sugar - Finally!
column10: We eat healthy. That means my kids drink very little juice and zero soda. By very little I mean I never buy it, they might have some at a friend's house or a party or something. Generally they drink only milk or water. But that means they feel left out when the other kids have sugar-filled juice boxes or caprisuns. Enter Honest Kids! Yes, they have sugar in them, that's what I like. Go look at a box of 'Roaring waters' - that has artificial sweeteners (and sugar too, something I never could quite figure out). I would rather my children had a small amount of real sugar than artificial sweeteners. Since they are used to drinking only water otherwise, they like these, they don't complain they taste watered down. In fact if you compare these to a typical CapriSun, its kind of like the difference between a Vitamin Water and Gatorade. When you are used to Vitamin water, (original) Gatorade is going to taste sickly sweet, if you are used to Gatorade, Vitamin water is going to taste like water with slight flavor. Ask yourself which you want your children to be used to?I've seen other reviewers complain that they are hard to open or messy - my 6 and 8 year olds have no problems with them.  They put the straw in themselves and don't have a problem spilling them.Now they don't feel left out when everyone else has a juice box, and I feel good about the amount of sugar they are taking in. At only 40 calories and no artificial sweeteners, this is exactly what I've been looking for!

Judy's Sugar Free Peanut Brittle was so good that I kicked myself for only ordering one package.  Anyone who likes peanut brittle but cannot have sugar should order this since it's just like the real thing.  Sometimes candy with sugar alcohols instead of real sugar can make a person's stomach do flips but this one didn't affect me at all, I was fine.  My only suggestion is not to do what I did and order a few packages at a time because it goes fast!

column9: Judy's Candy Co. Peanut Brittle, sugar free.
column10: Once again Judy's Company has come up with an amazingly great peanut brittle.  It is to die for! (Without the sugar and carbs.) The brittle is wonderfully sweet and full of peanuts.  I rather liked the peanuts the best.  They tasted fresh and full of peanut flavor, and they were "abondanza". Have you ever bitten into peanut brittle only to find mostly hard candy, and what little peanuts inside were stale tasting and smeeled strong?  I have.  Not this product. Yummmm. Jacqueline Silva

The product description is incorrect. It says that it has 7 servings in a resealable package, yet then states each serving is 3/4 cup and there are 9 servings at 100 calories each. The package itself is 3 pieces wrapped up in something like saran wrap and states 9 servings for 140 calories each. These inconsistencies matter to those trying to watch their diet and accurately measure food. The product was delicious, however.

This brittle is sweet, w/ plenty of nuts inside.  I did think it would have been a larger amount than what I received.  I guess I should have figured what size 8 oz. would be.  Another reviewer said that there was no gastronomical effects from this product but I did experience it.  But I think I'm more sensitive to maltitol than some people.  I still quite enjoyed the candy and would like to try some other products from Judy's Candy Co.

As I had to give up sugar about 30 years ago, I hadn't had any peanut brittle for decades.  Then I discovered and ordered Judy's Sugar-Free Peanut Brittle.  Great candy!!  Not only that, but my dog thought so too and ate my peanut brittle, scaring me as to whether the product was toxic to dogs.  I checked with the vet and poison control, and they confirmed the ingredients are non-toxic to dogs.  Whew.  So not only does it taste great and have a great consistency, but if your pet thinks so too, it's ok.Judy's Candy Co. Sugar Free Peanut Brittle 8 oz. package
Great Stuff tastes great and has given me back a favorite treat I lost when I became a diabetic!/Lots of peanuts!

This peanut brittle is outstanding.  I have not had peanut brittle for many years because I am a diabetic.  I saw this sugar-free candy advertised, ordered it and ate it.  This candy tastes great and put a smile on my face.  I bought 2 bags of it and am going to buy more of it and would highly recommend it to anyone.  Thanks Judy's Candy Company for making such a delicious sugar-free treat!
The peanut brittle is very good. Some of the best I have tasted, including sugar based varieties. I would highly recommend this product for those following a low carb or sugar controlled eating plan.
Great taste! it's crunchy and delicious, too bad I only order two, it's too small!

Judy's Candy Co. has a great Peanut Brittle that happens to be sugar free. It is crunchy, but not a jaw breaker, very generous with peanuts and a buttery sweet taste. I can highly recommend this candy.
I ordered th brittle from Judy's and it came from Low Carb. It was too hard and not enough peanuts for me.

These pralines came on time in great shape in a nice round tin.  The pralines are individually packaged so they stay fresh.  The taste of the pralines remind me of visits to New Orleans - you can taste the purity in each one.  So simple, butter, sugar, pecans.  Wonderful for the taste and the price!

I wish I could comment on how the candy tasted, but I never received the order. I was very disappointed, because it was Christmas present and if I had known,I would have ordered from a more reliable source. I ordered on December 9th and as of Dec 21st, they are a no-show. I just cancelled the order and will never order from this seller again.
they're now 5 points on the Points Plus system.  The bag still says 2 from the old days so keep in mind it's not the cheap points snack it was.  Definitely not worth 5 pts in my opinion.

Yes, these are more points with the points plus system, though even being high points they are still a nice little treat after lunch or dinner. They are good if you put them in the freezer, mmm! They taste good as long as you don't eat too many, byt bf got into them and got a stomach ache, but that will happen with anything!
Product is delicious and the tubs arrived on time.  I used to use a product by another name but this one tastes the same.  I was very pleased to find this brand.

Since we have been in Florida for 7 years, I wouldn't be caught without a bucket of Margaritas in my freezer. Everyone loves coming to our house and enjoying a nice frosty cocktail. They are so easy to make and always at the ready when anyone shows up! Amazon has the best price I have found anywhere and they come in packs of 3 buckets so I am never caught short!
Love these bucket margaritas!  They are the absolute best I have ever tasted.  So much fun to have poolside or on the beach for a great girlie afternoon!  Oh, and guys like them too.

I was worried about ordering this because it comes with three buckets, and I'm a bit picky about my margaritas--I hate when they are too sour. This is delicious! If you love margaritas but don't want to be stuck in the kitchen at the blender during a party, this is the best idea. Not only do I love this mix, but 10+ of my friends have tried it and love it too!

This has a strongly bitter taste of lime when made as directed.  Definitely not a natural made from scratch taste.  It made the worst tasting Margaritas that I've ever had.  My initial response is to just pour the rest of it down the drain and cut my losses.  I'm glad I only bought one bottle to try.
Love black olives and tapenades.  Sorry that this one was rather salty and pricey.  Great only with food as a condiment.
I had a chance to taste this when my daughter ordered this for me ...very smooth, did it with shots and of course my favorite dirty martini....a delight chilled...thanks for the experience.
I am a green apple lover and this product made the best green apple slushie. I was on cloud 9. I definitely recommend this product and I will be ordering again.

Love the moist coconut center. The chocolate is right amount of sweet too but if you prefer a stronger taste try bounty with dark chocolate. It's virtually unavailable in the US, so I'm glad that I could keep my bounty addiction going through Amazon!

I remember loving this product when it was still sold in the U.S. I was disappointed when it was dicontinued. I was very excited  to be able to taste them again.  They just don't have that same vanilla taste that I remember loving.  They were still good, but not great.
I got these candy bars for my wife.  She was very pleased with the quality of these candy bars.
Great tasting and a nice medium roast. This coffee is a great deal for the price.We really like the export also but for 1/2 the price this is a winner.

I received one complimentary can of this drink when signing up for a charity bike ride.11.8 fl oz (350 ml), 120 calories, 10 fat calories, 130 mg sodium, 22g sugars.Like others have described, the water has small pieces of tender coconut floating in it. The drink is delicious, refreshing, and "kind of" filling. Feels much better to drink this than soda.Ingredients: 80% coconut juice, water, sugar, coconut pulp, etc.What I don't understand is why would you add water and sugar to coconut water? One star off for that.I would buy this product, but would hesitate paying more than 75 cents per can. Your price tolerance may be higher, but you won't regret if you tried one can first.

column9: Very light, fresh, and tasty but buy elsewhere
column10: This coconut water is a light, refreshing drink with bits of coconut pulp in it.  It's wonderful with an Asian meal or on its own.  I bought a few cans from my local grocery store--I obviously would never recommend buying it here with $8.45 shipping for ONE can, but if it became available in a case pack, I'd definitely purchase.

Goya Coconut Water has been around in local US tropical food marts for decades.  A friend suggested coconut water to me ages ago for some issues I'd been having.  I started out with fancy expensive CW and one day on a whim I bought some of the Goya brand in a convenience store.  I wish I'd done so sooner!  If you love the benefits of coconut water but can't stand the taste or get your kids to drink it, this is a suitable alternative.  Lightly sweetened but not nearly at the same rate as sodas and other fruit juices with high fructose corn syrup.  It tastes great and don't be fooled, it has the same benefits as the designer $3 a bottle coconut waters being sold in health food stores.  I've been throwing my money away for years on other brands.  Don't buy this can.  With the shipping charges you may as well fly to Singapore and pick your own.Make sure you're drinking regular water with this or any other coconut water.  One of the things I noticed when drinking coconut water is that it has a diuretic effect.  Since I was a kid I've had this unusual water retention problem though, moreso than the average person, and coconut water makes me flush out fluids like crazy.  Despite the refreshing qualities of this water I've noticed there is a danger of becoming dehydrated.  The added water in this product is a nice bonus but it's not enough.  My guess is that the added water in this product is merely to allow Goya to offer coconut water to consumers at a lower price. It won't be enough to offset the effects of the juice so drink more water if you don't already.Goya has cubes of raw coconut floating around in this juice so you've got a good source of fiber there. The coconut pieces may pose a choking hazard for really small children and you can't drink it from a straw because of the chunks.  I took a star off for that.  Also the can isn't the most environmentally friendly packaging either.  Otherwise this stuff is the perfect refresher.

Why would anyone want to add sugar to coconut water???I mean, what's the point of spoiling it and making to it like all the sugary drinks out there.Can the American palate not tolerate anything that is all natural that does not have added sweeteners?I bet you that no one from the Caribbean or other places that coconuts are indigenous to would appreciate the alteration of this delicious water. We who are used to it do understand that the natural sweetness levels in each coconut varies, so some may be sweeter than others, and we are quite ok with that because it is natural.Please read ingredients people- not all coconut waters are created equal.

If you like coconut then you are in for a treat. It is not what I consider to be water as its a little thicker than 'juice'. It has lots of white cubed pulp inside..that is very tender and not like the sweet cocount you get in the supermarket.You can drink and chew at the same time so its really a meal in a can.Its also very healthy and so delicious a healthy substition for sodas.Buy it!!!....but in your local supermarket as the price here is steep as well as the shipping.

column9: More like Coconut Drink at Vietnamese Restaurant than Coconut Water
column10: I have tried a variety of coconut water: Zico (old), Zico (new), O.N.E., Vita Coco and Naked.I saw this at my grocery store for .99/can and had to try it.  I heeded the advice on the can to "shake well and serve chilled" and was pleasantly surprised to see coconut chunks as I poured it over ice in a glass.  This reminded me of a "coconut drink" I had at a Vietnamese restaurant in Philadelphia.  This is not like the other brands of coconut water, consisting of only coconut water with no added sugar.  The ingredients are: 80% Coconut water, water, sugar, young coconut pulp, and potassium something other (a preservative).  It has 120 calories per can compared with Goya's unsweetened version with 80 calories.  While the one with pulp has a little more sugar and fat; it also has more iron, calcium, and fiber and 50mg less sodium than the unsweetened version.  I will definitely buy this again - to drink on its own/with a meal though, not as a sports drink.  Also, it is far cheaper in store than on here! I would love to buy this in a case through Amazon's subscription program.
Authentic ginger flavour & goodness.  Dissolves quickly in hot liquids.  Unusual application: Crush a packet and sprinkle 1/4 over strawberries or Grapefuit.  Delicious!

Prince of Peace Ginger Honey CrystalsUnfortunately I got these on the last day of a local tea shop -- and I say unfortunately because I became instantly enamored of the product.  A single packet produces a decidedly strong 10-12 oz cup, very nice and gingery, reminiscent of the hot ginger tea sometimes served on cold winter days at a Haitian restaurant I know.  The honey adds a nice complexity to the cup, but I'm also looking forward to adding a few cloves and cinnamon stick.  Many other uses for the crystals come to mind as well as simply dissolving in water -- I've been using it to sugar tea, both black and green, and I'll definitely try another reviewer's recommendation for strawberries or other fruit.My only complaint is that I wish the packet had somewhat less sugar (but with the same ginger and honey strength).  One packet, at 17 g, is getting a bit close to typical desert levels (I checked some sorbet in my frig, 23 g).That aside, I prefer this to the ginger tea I've been getting at a local Korean market, a kind of marmalade or jelly with ginger slices in a jar.  Not only does this product have a stronger, hotter ginger flavor, but it can be used in place of granulated sugar.

I love this product and I share it with my family and co-workers.  JVS by way of Amazon is the best there is for online purchase and I will definitely continue to buy from them.  I am currently preparing for my third order in as many months.  Great for upset stomach, sore throats, stressful days and cool nights.Make it hot with water or milk to take the chill out!

column9: Best Cure for an Upset Tummy!
column10: I discovered this product years ago at a local asian market.  This is a miracle cure for an upset stomach, car sickness, seasickness, etc...My husband uses it when his IBS acts up.  When I go on a cruise, I bring one dose a day and I do not need to get the behind the ear tabs that I had used before.Before I found this, I would have to go get the ginger root, peel, slice, and steep to get a good tea for my stomachache, but this is tons more convenient.  Besides, who wants to do all that work when you are sick.The flavor is very strong so I found that I like it a little more watered down than it recommends but 1 or 2 "doses" when I am feeling queasy and it is gone.

The first time I drank this tea I almost gagged. I'd prepared it according to the directions but it was too spicy. I then had the good sense to add more water and a chamomile tea sachet to break down the spicyness...and it was wonderful. I then discovered that eating the ginger crystals by themselves was quite pleasant as well. I know it sounds weird, but the crystals are tasty, probably because they're so sweet...which leads me to my next point. Although sugar TASTES good, im not a fan of consuming too much of it. It's 17 grams per packet, which I think is too high for a cup of tea. It makes my teeth feel all gritty afterwards (no bueno). If they made a sugar free version I'd be sold :)

If you're into hot, spicy gingery tastes, you'll like this drink. It's intense, also because of the honey. I find it delicious, and I know some people who dilute it (using half a package per cup) to make it milder. Either way, it's yummy and satisfying. Very soothing on a winter day, and also if you have a cold or are suffering from nausea or stomach upset. It's also versatile. I dissolve a package into plain oatmeal--what an easy way to add unique flavor. I like that it's instant, and also that I can take along the sachets to work or on a trip. Highly recommend this!
I've been ordering this product for about a year now and take it daily (has improved my ph balance!) and this vendor always has it in stock and ships it fast & free! Can't ask for better

A coworker introduced me to these once when I had a terrible cough & cold.  At first I was hesitant to drink because of the strong aroma, but at FIRST SIP & INHALE, it immediately went to work!!  Instantly cleared my sinuses & soothed my throat so much, I knew I had to have stock at work & at home!  I also noticed I had improved enegy & just felt better all around!  I now drink these packets daily, if not twice a day, it was recommended that I drink one before bedtime & I did & woke up feeling FABULOUS!  It is hard to find these packets, I only found them at the mall's vitamin shop and I "think" at GNC, but Amazon has a great price & saves you the trip!!!!

I have been drinking this ginger tea for years, and can't live without it. I have IBS and digestive upset is a way of life unfortunately; however, this ginger tea is strong enough to provide a digestive tonic and it tastes good too. I wish it were a little less sweet, but I don't eat a lot of sugar normally. I am pregnant now, and have been drinking it throughout. It settles my belly and helps with the IBS symptoms as well. I have driven 2 hours before to get this from Chinatown, so I'm super happy that I can get it here when I need it as well!

I needed to find a coffee substitute for my husband.  Tried herbal teas, he said it tasted like he was licking a flower pot. I tried the Ginger Honey drink in his Thermos and he enjoyed it! The drink has enough "punch" in its flavor and the ginger is helping with inflammation and digestion. Good solution and it's easy to prepare-even he can boil water!

These are a staple in my pantry.  I make a two litter bottle of green tea with one or two packets of the ginger honey tea added.  I love the flavor and I don't get acid kick-back anymore.  I drink the honey ginger tea hot for a sore throat. It is wonderful in apple juice or other fruit juices as it give a punch to the drink.I also make a drink from green veggies and some fruit. This ginger honey really livens it up and makes it delicious. When I make shortbread cookies, I sprinkle this ginger on top before baking. I won an award for the cookies at a Scottish festival.  I buy 3-4 of the large bags at a time. It doesn't last long around here.It is great to sip on the front porch with neighbors and can be served hot in the winter and iced in the hot summers.

column9: I was looking for Jamaican Ginger Beer
column10: I found lots of spicy ginger beers at Amazon, but the best price in the lot was D & G, Soda Ginger Beer, 12-once (24 Pack); while $30 [$45 shipped] for 24 hard-to-find sodas isn't the worst pricing in the world,  it's still not going to be in my budget as an everyday beverage. This stuff is plenty affordable in the 30-count bag, and the flavor is exactly the spicy & sweet combination I remember from my youth in the South.It just arrived today, so I've not had the chance to try it with club soda in place of water, but I expect adding some fizziness will make this drink perfect! Look for an update to this review.UPDATE: almost finished  with bag one, ordering more. Mixing the bag with Blue Sky Natural True Seltzer,  12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24) does make a nice refreshing drink (I mix in a little Tang Orange Powdered Drink Mix (Makes 22 Quarts), 72-Ounce Canister for a citrus-ginger soda), but it's not as close to the Jamaican Ginger beer that I remember as I'd hoped.However, if I add it to store-brand ginger ale, it IS the flavor clone I'd been looking for! Five stars!Further update: There are many recipes foe home-made ginger ale on the web, and the process looks very simple...I'll keep a stock of these packets anyway, but I think I'll try fashioning my own brew this weekend!
a very strong authentic ginger taste. much denser then ginger teas. only issue for me is that it contains too much sugar.
Bought this for sea travel to relieve nausea, but found it works great for sore throat and cold symptoms.  Easy to use, tastes good, and I like the fact that you can drink it hot or cold.

It doesn't have as much of a kick as the kind I bought in China but it does have a nice flavor, and soothing. I would prefer to use my own sweetener but this will do when I want something while traveling. I like it to keep my stomach settled and to ward off colds. If you like the taste of ginger, you will most likely like this. If you want unsweetened, try the Gold Kili.

I am so addicted to the ginger crystals. The health foodr store in my neigborhood discontiued this product. I was so thrilled to find the exact item, and a better quality online. The ginger in the online version is alot stronger than the crystals that I purchased. I like to blend it with a nice berry tea or I will add lemon and a little tequila when I have a cold.

The product came as advertised. For the amount you get, the price is right, but the taste of the ginger is stronger than I expected. In fact, it's actually very, very spicy; it burns my tongue and throat, but not as if I were eating hot salsa. Will try using more water, to dilute the flavor.

I've been looking for a ginger tea that actually has the spicy taste of ginger, and I found it with this tea.  I don't have a "sweet tooth" per say, so I generally don't like a lot of sugar in things that I drink or eat.  Although this ginger tea is sweeten with honey and cane sugar, it's not too sweet for me to enjoy.

A sure fire cure for when I have an upset stomach. And definitely helps with my GERD symptoms (acid reflux). It just always makes me feel better, that's the best I can say about it. Try it after a heavy meal.
The ginger flavor is nice and strong.  The white sugar is excessive.  Nice convenient packages.  Similar to a strong, sweet lemonade.
I love ginger and I eat it all the time, but this is far to strong.  I tried to use it in a large cup with tea and it burned my throat and my wifes throat.  I threw the bag away after that.

I was drinking another brand of tea which is not sold in any of the stores where I live or on Amazon. I decided to give this brand a try after reading all of the positive reviews.I am very disappointed in this purchase. The tea tastes like sugar water. The ginger flavor is not strong at all. Even the crystals are lighter in comparison to the other product that I was drinking. Luckily, this product was very reasonably priced so I won't feel too bad about tossing the remaining bags if I can't find someone to give them to.I can't fault the seller here. The product was reasonably priced and arrived on time. I would purchase another item from them, but not this one.Just my two cents.

It's great stuff. Really simple to use, and really good tasting -- I only sweeten it with a spoonful of honey or two as far as additives go. I used it all throughout my pregnancy as an all natural solution to my all day sickness. Sometimes it was all I could keep down.I've recommend it to a LOT of my friends, pregnant and not, who are tea drinkers like myself, and I continue to thank the person who introduced it to me. It's good and soothing, not too harsh, like other ginger products I've tried, and it's good at any time; hot or cold. Hell, at the first sign of a cold, I start guzzling it down like nobody's business , an more often than not, it keeps my cold (especially sore throats) from getting any worse. It's something I'll swear by for life, I'm sure.

This product was amazing during my pregnancy.  I packed it everywhere to aid in my nausea.  It worked beautifully. I haven't used it much since, unless I have an upset stomach, because I'm not a huge ginger fan.  But hey ... if you're suffering from morning sickness or suffer from nausea, this may work perfectly for you as well.

I was very happy with this product and this seller. I added the product to Hybiscus flower tea to replicate Jamaican Sorrel. It turned out great. The product was well packed and promptly shipped. The taste was what I wanted. I will buy from this seller again.

column9: Great for seasonal allergies and cramps
column10: My colleague had me try this ginger crystal a month ago when I had cramps. After drinking it hot, my cramps went away during the rest of my cycle and did not need medication. Recently my allergies flared up bad and again it relieved some of my symptoms.

As Ginger is good to settle a stomach and, when I eat a Larabar Ginger Snap or a few Ginger cookies, it seems to satisfy my hunger, I had great expectations! I tried this cold and hot. I got a BLAST of Ginger heat in the back of my throat (expected) but no residual Ginger after taste,just an odd taste from the sugar (we use very little sugar so maybe just me). I had hoped to satisfy hunger but it doesnt seem to do that at all & seemed to MAYBE upset my stomach a little. Packaging quality & content uniformity is very good & dissolved quickly. I will be throwing the rest away partly because it is made in China and I am nervous about food items from there.

I was introduced to this absolutely delicious drink by a colleague and was so impressed I went ahead and bought three packs right away.  My family and many friends totally LOVE it! It also a good drink for busy people: it's ready in no time...very healthy too, especially during the colder months to help build a healthy immune system...

I have been making ginger tea by grating fresh ginger, mixing it with honey and lemon and adding boiling water. The qualities and effects of ginger on the body are quite remarkable. My husband and I have been battling the flu for 10 days, and the ginger tea really helps. It was getting tiring doing that by hand, so I found this product and decided to give it a try.Here are my thoughts:Pros:It's quite tasty, although very sugary. For me, as I love the taste of ginger drinks (ginger beer, ginger ale) I like the combination of ginger with sweetness, although I would prefer it to be artificial sweetener. I found that I need more than 6 to 8 ounces of water due to the concentration in each of the packets.It's very nice that each packet is individually sealed, which keeps it fresh for quite a while.Cons:It's very high in sugar. It's a peppery, sugary drink. I believe it will supply you with the necessary amounts of ginger to affect your health in a positive way. Here's the but though, because it's high in sugar, it's something that someone like I, who have higher than normal cholesterol would not want to consume too much off.So in conclusion, I liked the taste, but would prefer less sugar, or artificial sweetener. Perhaps sweetened with honey?

column9: Instant Ginger Honey Crystals Pack of 30 Bags - 18 g Sachets
column10: A nice healthy cup a...ginger crystals?...Yep! This stuff is great! I found this when I came across it somewhere on clearance once and althoug it's very strong (I only use 1/2 packet per cup); depending on how strong you like ginger, you might use more :)  For winter or fall this is a wonderful thing to have around.  Remember how I said it's strong, well, I get 2 cups per packet (I like my tea very strong, but I like this the way I described). The value here-wow, you just can't go wrong.  And no, I am not getting any compensation here for saying all this, I just found a product I like and it's hard to find for such a great price. I can't do dairy either or much coffee, so haviing things like this just make life a little more fun.  Plus, it's so much better for you and chepaer than a drive-through drink :)
The instant Ginger Honey Crystals are great. I love them. When I feel like a cold is coming on I have a hot cup and it works wonders and makes me feel better.
excellent product, i love it. have to drink it every day! dissolve almost instantly. i recommended this product to everyone.
This one is excellent. The sachets are 18g and make a nice cup of tea especially as the colder season is approaching

I had been brewing Ginger Tea from grated fresh ginger. Ginger Honey Crystals are easy and have a delicious flavor.  This is a strong tea and I enjoy it hot or cold.  I strongly recommend this product if you enjoy ginger tea.Instant Ginger Honey Crystals Pack of 30 Bags - 18 g Sachets

I was so looking forward to enjoy this tea and was imagining how wonderful it would be to have a cup of hot sweet ginger tea in the coming winter....unfortunately my stomach was not up to the `task'.  I have a sensitive stomach and get heartburn and acid reflux if I drink coffee or most of the over-the-counter orange juice.  I thought it's safe to drink this ginger tea but I ended up having mild heartburn every time after I drank the tea (even use just half bag of the powder).  And the same condition occurred after all three attempts, so I had to give up...  I did find out that I am ok with drinking the home-made ginger tea (three slices of ginger in boiling water and some sugar).  I would still recommend this to people with no stomach problems!!

I ordered this product after a friend of my mother's told her about it. My mother's friend uses it because she gets nauseous on a regular basis and ginger, which this product has in spades, helps a lot.I have a brain tumor which causes me to experience vertigo, dizziness, and nausea - all on a fairly regular basis. I have medication, ONDANSETRON HCL 8MB to be exact, which works, but gives me an incredible headache as a side effect of making my nausea go away. As a result, I need to take Aspirin at the very least, with the medication to offset the side effect. NOT a pleasant experience to say the least.I've had ginger before as part of juicing, which I do from time to time after watching the movie FAT, SICK, AND NEARLY DEAD (available via Amazon Prime streaming video and Hulu). However, I don't have the energy to make juice as often as I would like.This tea allows me to get some ginger into my system much easier. The ginger doesn't have the side effects that the aforementioned medication does, so it's my first choice. This tea is WAY too strong as is though. Instead of using a whole packet in a large cup of water, I use a teaspoon, and go from there if I need more ginger to relax my stomach. At least this means that the tea will last much longer.If you have chronic nausea for whatever reason, I'd give this stuff a try, just beware of the strength and be prepared to adjust the amount you use, unless you want your throat to burn from the high concentration of ginger.

This tea is awesome! Authentic Ginger flavor. Certainly clears the sinuses.  If you like the stimulating, fresh flavor and aroma of Ginger, then this tea will please you.  Additionally, I don't have to add any sugar or other sweetener. Also, there are no tea bags to deal with as the crystals dissolve rapidly for the perfect cup.  I like it cold too.  I also add less water than recommended for an even more robust flavor.  I like it strong!

This product is not only great tasting but very soothing effect on the stomach..Really love it hot or cold...Ireally like drinking this product hot after a long and tedious day.Tremendous and would order it again .

This product is tasty and calming!  I really enjoyed it and would definatly buy more!  In fact, I think I'll go do that now.  It is VERY sweet, and instead of putting honey in, I put in lemon.  Tastes a treat!

I found this item by  accident.  I was looking for ginger elixer that I could put in my beer like at PF Changs.  It does the trick with my beer, but I do drink it hot every night before bed.  It settles the tummy and no caffeine effects.

Makes a quick and tasty hot ginger tea.  I would enjoy it more with about half the sweetness, but that doesn't stop me from drinking it a couple times a day.  One packet could make 2 small cups.  If you don't like ginger, don't bother.  Will also dissolve in cold water, with a bit of shaking, if you prefer.
This is a delicious tea. my whole family is drinking it now and its all natural ingedients.great for cold night as you sip this warm potent tea. You feel its killing all your throat bacteria!
I was introduced to this product by my neice at Christmas. It is so flavorful and refreshing. LOVE it especially during this flu and cold season.

I bought this for the benefits of ginger and honey, and based on the high reviews. I enjoy hot teas and drinks in general. When I first tried this drink it was a little too spicey for me. I tried cutting it in half and that worked ok. The best solution for me is to add in a little cream or vanilla soy milk. It makes it creamy and just a little spicy like a chai tea. VERY enjoyable and soothing when not feeling well. It's also come in handy for morning sickness recently.

column9: Perfect for when you have the flu
column10: I love this spicy ginger drink & find it incredibly soothing when I'm sick so I keep it on hand for just such an occasion (and push it at others when they're not feeling well either!) I like to add a little lemon and honey. The ginger instantly numbs a painful throat and soothes the whole system giving you an immediate feeling a wellness. Love this stuff.

Holy spicy ginger BatMan, this stuff has some serious ZING! I love ginger lemon tea and LOVE ginger chews (The Ginger People Original Ginger Chews, 12 - 2-Ounce Boxes, (Pack of 2) so I thought I was well prepared, not so much! I dissolved 1 packet in 8 ounces of hot water and had to dilute it a bit. If you like spicy ginger zing, this is your product!

column9: I love this product and it's way cheaper than Whole Foods
column10: I love this product and the taste is amazing. I use it in recipes too that call for ginger instead of ginger powder. This is fast and convenient. I take it for travel and after a long scuba dive, super convenient and a great price. Love, love, love this...

This really tastes like ginger and honey!  Drink it hot or cold.  I like it as hot tea.  My son likes it both cold and hot.  It is inexpensive, too.  I will keep buying it as long as it is sold.  LOVE IT!!!

I received a small box of these Ginger and Honey crystals and I fell in love with them! What a great way to bump up your cup of hot tea. They are strong and I would recommend starting with a small portion. I ordered two bags of thirty packs and now my Daughter in Law wants a 30 Pack. Love It!

column9: I love Ginger any way I can get it.
column10: One day my mother in law sent me over some of these packets.  I was hooked with the first Packet.  I have a hard time with hot things.  The rest of my family could not tell the burn it gives.  They even like to just pour them into their mouths and let them dissolve.  The more of It I drank I finally got to where I can drink the whole packet now.  My doctor has taken me away from cream so my morning coffee was just horrible.  I now put one packet of this in my cup then put in a K-cup of my favorite coffee and wow what a wonderful spicy wake me up.I am a diabetic, and someone who does not like to eat.  So getting that little boost of sugar and honey first thing in the morning gives me time to get my breakfast ready.  I have low sugar and my doc is trying to get me to eat at least 1000 kilo/calories to 1400 kilo/calories.  Which is hard to do when you mainly eat raw vegetables and fruits. So for me.  This is a fast way to get my blood sugar up and stay up long enough for me to get some food in me.I know one person complained about the calories.  It does have 18 carbs per packet.  But the Ginger is good and very strong which works very well for settling my stomach. I used to have to take phenergan for nausea now a cup of this and I am good.I hope you enjoy this as much as we do.Atheena

column9: A thing I look forward to in the mornings
column10: It is a strong eye opener, the weak at heart should dillute it in a larger than 8oz cup/glass.  I enjoy it's strength and welcome all the ginger goodness.  I hope you'll try it and do the same.

A friend of mine told me about the ginger honey crystals. She gave me one to try and I was hooked. I use them when my stomach is upset. I have use them with cold and hot water. I prefer it in my hot green tea or just with hot water. It is very soothing. I have given a bag to my sister and she loves it.

column9: Fantastic product and fantastic to work with
column10: I have bought this product twice and will continue to buy this product. They are fast and always keeps me informed via email. I have never had any problems and the product always arrives without any problems. I give this 5 stars.

THERE SHOULD BE 10 STARS FOR THIS PRODUCT!  I love it and I drink it every day.  The price was also better on Amazon.com, so I always check here first when I see something that catches my eye.  Will reorder.

Wow! Just open a packet and put it in cold or hot water. Tastes great, nice and honey sweet. But you've got to have a taste for ginger. Don't know any other product like it. Thanks Alex, for recommending!
this tea, is not just like any other tea, and its pretty hard to find too...best ginger tea ever, is good for detox and stomachaches . got it pretty fast too, and was as described. thanks.

My husband absolutely loves these and I was thrilled to find them on Amazon for such a great price. However, the product pictured is a bag, but mine arrived in 3 boxes of 10 packets each.  Not a bad thing, just different from what is pictured/described. I deducted one star though, because I'd prefer if one packet made more.

column9: Hot Gingery Spicey Sweet Yummy Goodness!
column10: Heck with mixing this stuff with hot or cold water! Eat it out of hand! It is an amazing head clearing delight! You're tummy gets all warm and fuzzy inside and the little honey colored beads are sweet and gingery-peppery-crunchy! Seriously folks, I take medication for some pretty nasty headaches and the medicine is probably worse than the headaches. Well, Instant Ginger Honey Crystals Pack of 30 Bags - 18 g Sachets makes taking that medication tolerable. It's great stuff! I received the product faster than expected and at a fantastic price. Can't be beat. Excellent! Cheers!
I continue 2 purchase the Ginger honey crystal tea. It's the best!!!! I luv it hot or cold.It's very soothing and the price is EXCELLENT!
I love this stuff. I find it acts as a cleanser for your system. I did have to travel to China-town to buy but Amazon is much more convenient and runs about the same price.

My husband gave up coffee and drinks this daily.  It's 3 times the price at the local healthfood store.  Wish it was subscribe and save.  My husband doesn't tell my he is out until he is totally out.  Luckily it arrives 2 days after ordered.

The Prince of Peace Instant Ginger Honey Crystals originally didn't impress me because the first ingredient was cane sugar, followed by honey and then ginger.  Because we don't drink many sweet beverages, the 70 calories and 17 sugar grams seemed outrageous.  We also were not thrilled with the biblical proverbs imprinted on the packaging.  After opening the first pouch, however, our family was hooked on the spicy sweet crystals.  Each pouch contains 12 grams of ginger and it is very, very spicy, just what we like around here.  We empty a packet into a little jar and always have some accessible in the kitchen.  I use a little binder clip on a packet in my bag when traveling, so I can slip a few crystals on my tongue even when there's no water available.  I add this to white or green tea, mix it in my chai and add no other sweetener, sprinkle it on yogurt, fruit and fiber cereal in the morning, and even have used it to tone down an overly spicy seafood stew I made last week.  I don't know how, but throwing in about a half teaspoon worked a miracle.  The hot beverage is great when we're nauseous or just feeling less than perfect, and when chilled, is a perfect complement to one of those clear beverages we may drink for relaxation.  If you like ginger, think about taking a break from the ginger chews/candy and try these little delectable crystals instead.
Awesome! I had this tea years ago and was thrilled to find it! I share it with everyone! It's good for you, too!

column9: Spicy and satisfying, but not the best
column10: The packets make an easy and quick way to make a spicy and sweet ginger tea. However, I prefer using Ting Ting Jahe Ginger Candy (5.25oz) to make my tea. Every packet has 17g of sugar, yet doesn't taste as sweet as Ting Ting Jahe in my opinion, which has only 3g per piece of candy. I also think that Ting Ting Jahe has a cleaner ginger flavor, but isnt as spicy as this product. This product also takes up more space and isnt as good a value as ting ting jahe. If you are looking for the quickest way to make a drink, these packets are the way to go. However, if you are willing to stir around the ginger candies until they dissolve, the ting ting jahe candies make a much better tasting drink, with less sugar and a cleaner finish. Plus, you can eat them as regular candies if you wish!

I got this because I am pregnant and experiencing nausea.  I had never had anything like this, so I was not aware of what it would be like.  I did read the reviews and most people seemed to really like this product, so I gave it a try.  I did not like it!  It is very spicy, which to me did not seem fitting for a drink.  I was only able to get down half a glass of this.  If you are pregnant and looking for something to ease your morning sickness, try ginger tea instead.  I got some lemon ginger tea... it is very good!  Also try ginger hard candies.  I got some of those as well.  If you are just a lover of all things ginger, go ahead and try it!

We seen a show on TV where this type of rice was mentioned. I found it on Amazon and bought 1 bag to give it a try and have been purchasing it ever since. Although a bit pricey for rice, being how different the flavor is we use it for special meals only. Wish though it was offered in 5lb bags instead of the 2lb'ers.

After a 5 way bypass, all my husband wanted was some Carolina Gold rice. Our order arrived promptly and he was beaming.  We discovered it while in Charleston a few yrs. back and he's been in love with it ever since.  Thanks for helping him recover sooner than expected.

I ordered this Carolina gold rice with high hopes, after being raised on good rice in the south.  This was tasteless. After paying $11.95 for a two  pound bag and the unbelievable price of $8.34 to ship it to Washington I was very disappointed.  Mahatma yellow rice is a much better choice and only a third of this price and available in most grocery stores out here with no exhorbitant shipping charges.Don't waste your money on this rip off.

This rice will set you *way* back for a 2 lb bag, but if you want the heritage strain of rice that along with indigo was the foundation of the Colonial Carolina economy, this is the right stuff.  I cannot speak to its qualities as a side dish, but it is exactly suited for risottos and stews - thick and filling.  As a Revolutionary War reenactor, I splurged on a bag and brought it to an immersion weekend in winter at Jockey Hollow in Morristown, NJ.  1 pound of this rice cooked with venison and carrots on a hearth in a 14 x 16 log hut fed nearly a dozen hungry Continentals. For living historians who want an authentic, period experience, this product will satisfy even the stitch counters in your hobby.  Gourmets and Gourmands in modern times may have other thoughts.

Good decaf black teas are hard to come by, but this is the best one I've been able to find.  Still a little mild compared to teas with caffeine, this one still has good flavors and makes for great afternoon or evening cup.
We discovered this tea at a neighborhood restaurant, and it was excellent.  That's indeed why I had order it from you as soon as I saw it.

Having had Baci candy in Italy when I was younger I wanted some for the holidays. I couldn't find it being sold locally anywhere so i ordered on line. The candy arrived very timely and was very good, just as I had experienced it in Italy...........
One of my favorite chocolates in the entire world. Great packaging! And delicious!!! Super fast shipping as well!

I'll admit I had help discovering this brand of coffee; a major consumer review magazine to which I subscribe rated it as one of the best coffees available in the USA. That got me curious so I bought some and have been buying it ever since. It has a marvelous flavor which is never bitter and has always been smooth and rich.The review went on to compliment its aroma and flavor and said it was simply better than the competition and at a lower price. The 100% Columbian uses an Arabica bean which I prefer.For the typical user the ground version is much more convenient unless you have a reasonable method of grinding the beans at home. We have a small batch grinder but it is hard to use and to clean up afterward so I usually get the ground.A number of local stores still carry it but you may not have one in your neighborhood. As many of us have discovered, ordering from Amazon is so easy!In summation, if you enjoy your coffee black this is a very successful alternative to get a great coffee taste at a better than average price.

column9: Great coffee but packaging could be better!
column10: We've become loyal fans of Eight o'clock's ground Columbian coffee! Gives our days a great start!  Do wish Eight O'clock would improve the packaging so I could give their coffee 5 stars. We were hopeful when we saw the ads for 'new package'--but disappointed to find the change is color only.  Wish they would improve the bag's seal to lessen the chances we'll end up tearing the bag when trying to open it, and improve the method for closing the bag to keep the coffee fresh.  The twist tie frequently 'separates' from the bag. It's still our favorite ground coffee; and Amazon's flexible "subscribe-and-save" brings the coffee to our door, letting us adjust our schedule when we have out-of-town guests and run low early or get behind and don't need the scheduled delivery because of vacation.

column9: Great Coffee but much cheaper locally
column10: We love this coffee. It is all we buy now. BUT we can get it at Walmart in these 11oz bags for $4.78. The Amazon price is about double that.

column9: 8'o clock bean is the best daily use coffee on the shelf...
column10: other than the occasional starbucks or dunkin donuts, which i only buy when they are on sale and i have deep coupons to get a great deal, 8'o clock reigns supreme in our hose. the unanimous favorites are french vanilla and the colombian roast. it's always smooth, full bodied, never cheap tasting. five stars!

After reading reviews of this coffee on Amazon.com, I though I'd try it.  I bought Eight O'Clock 100% Colombian Ground, and I'm glad I did--it is great tasting, mild for a Colombian coffee, and much better than the coffee at local supermarkets.

column9: I dont like it, maybe others know how to brew it to make it perfect
column10: I don't like it, maybe others know how to brew it to make it perfect

To start out, let me say that I simply LOVE this coffee! The local stores simply do not carry this brand any longer, and I have been doing without until I came across this item on the Internet at Amazon.com! Oh, happy days!!! Now if I could only find "pods" made by them too!I may not be a coffee connoisseur or guru, but I know what I like, and this beats all those HIGH PRICED Seattle based coffee houses, hands down. Plus, it's about half the price!!omahamike

column9: Great!  Just don't buy it from Amazon
column10: Yes, Eight O'Clock Coffee is great.  But, the price on Amazon.com is way inflated.  I buy it at Wal-Mart for $3.44 per 11 oz. bag. or at H.E.B. for $3.68 per 11 oz. bag

I have a one cup coffee brewer that uses pods and ground coffee and this is by far the best ground coffee I've tried.  I agree with the consumer magazine that rated this as the best 100% Colombian coffee they had found to test.
I just got this coffee a few days ago. I had coffee with this bean yesterday and today morning. I can't like this coffee even if I'm trying so hard to like this coffee.

I wanted beans.  I had some backup Yuban for when I run our of beans so I had something to compare this to.  I think they are both about the same, ok for pre-ground. The Yuban was $8 for 2 lbs so I'd prefer Yuban to this.  I think I like the Yuban a little better(my taste) both don't come close to fresh beans. 8 o'clock beans are much better.This stuff is ok but not worth the money, imo.

column9: Coffee if very subjective... but i like this stuff
column10: Reviews were mixed on the Eight O'Clock Columbian.I liked it.  I liked it very much and will buy more, in larger quantities.It smelled good, tasted good and didn't give me rot gut 3 hrs later.But, coffee is very subjective.I recommend buying one bag locally and if you like, you buy more.  If not... well... then don't.  LOL
I find eight o'clock 100% Colombian Ground Coffee very tasty and the price is right.  I have been using this product for over a year. I am very happy with my purchase.

This coffee does meet the advertised promise of smoothness and 'lingering sweet taste' yet it is very mild in 'coffee' flavor. Because of this, it will only be one of my occasional alternates. Being a regular coffee drinker, I've tried for years to strike a balance between the quality and price of various coffees. This coffee is a winner in that category, so for anyone who prefers a milder tasting coffee (with less caffeine) I can recommend trying the Eight O'Clock Colombian.

column9: MOVE OVER STARBUCKS - This is BETTER!
column10: I was soooo tired of the coffee price wars at the grocery store...buying the one that was on sale so I could save a buck... Eight O'Clock coffee is actually cheaper..delivered right to my door and tastes WAY BETTER than the store coffee I was getting.I am so glad they have this delivery system and I can schedule the delivery as often as I want to receive it.Nothing makes me happier than a GOOD cup of coffee... :)

I really enjoy a good cup of coffee, and Eight O'Clock coffee is excellent.  I like my coffee with a strong caffine "punch", so I'd have to say that Starbuck's is my favorite.  Eight O'Clock is in the same class, but it's milder and cheaper.  Mine was shipped from the Amazon warehouse, and was very fresh.  I will definately buy it again.

Let me preface this by saying I am not a coffee snob, nor do I own a crazy expensive coffee machine.  I am a basic, "drink my coffe black" kind of guy.With that said, this coffee is awesome.  I bought this while I was deployed to Afghanistan as the coffee available to me in country was few and none. After reading a bunch of reviews I chose this flavor as I heard it was the best. You get 4 normal sized coffee bags and it last a while too.  This is pretty much the only coffee drink now, yes it's that good.The even bigger plus is that it's readily available everywhere I am stationed in grocery stores (if I chose to buy it that route) and it's rather inexpensive compared to other coffee.Highly recommend for someone looking to branch out and try a new coffee brand.
How can you complain?  It's cheaper than the grocery store and shipped to my door. Well, I could ask for a pack of 5.

I have enjoyed this coffee for a long time. I now have it coming to my home on a monthly basis and this was a great decision. I don't have to worry about running out when I'm rushing to work.
