The flavor of the coffee is rich and satisfying. It smells great when I'm waking up and smells great from my mug. The taste is wonderful. If you try it, you won't be disappointed. The cost is one of the best on the market. I will continue to support Eight O'clock coffee.

Firstly Eight O'Clock Coffee is great coffee. I haven't ever gotten any flavor that wasn't good. This is the first time for this one but I am sure it will be just as good as any of their other coffees.

Best coffee I've ever made at home.....Terrific flavor and aroma. I've heard that great coffee is not about the brewing method, not about the water, not about the coffeemaker....it's about the beans. Since I've kept all the other things the same except the brand of coffee, I've concluded that Eight o'clock must be the best.
MY FAMILY LIKES 8 O'CLOCK COFFEE VERY MUCH. IT IS EVEN BETTER THAT WE ARE GETTING IT DELIVERED TO THE DOOR EVERY 3 MONTHS. THE DEAL CANNOT BE BEAT.

The 8 o'clock coffee , itself, was good. However, one of the bricks had lost air and was no longer in it's original condition.The shipping was excellent. I recieved my order in 2 days after placing it.Thank you,marty

column9: smooth tasting but lacks the punch
column10: This coffee was reviewed by real coffee critics as one of the three best tasting.  I agree that it is the smoothest coffee I ever drank.  However, I buy coffee to wake up and this did not wake me up.  I would recomend Boyd's coffee for those of you that really want a wake up coffee.

This is my go to. Curb stomps the other big guys. Enough roast to cut through milk if desired. Consistently good flavor and deals with subscribe and save. I need to buy a burr grinder, and abandon this ground stuff.

column9: Awakening with the smell of Eight O'Clock Coffee
column10: I'm connected with that smell since i was in Ny it reminds me Manhattans smells early in the morning.Real coffee aroma smooth after taste and full bodied flavor.A simple great cup of coffee.
so easy to do auto ship each month on this great tasting, reasonably priced coffee. No way we want to ever run out, we make 2 pots a day thus go through a bag a week. We have to have our coffee!

column9: Product is great, deal is not.
column10: Eight O'Clock Columbian is the best coffee I have had in a long time. However, the price is not the best deal. WalMart has this coffee usually around $6.00 per bag. The price for the regular blend is a very good deal if you don't have to subscribe to monthly deliveries.
I tried this coffee a few years ago and absolutely loved it.  My market didn't have it last month so I ordered it from Amazon.  Great coffee at a great price!

I read good reviews about this product prior to ordering it during a promotion.The flavour is decent, but if I weren't already coherent by 8am, drinking the brew is unlikely to ever get me out of my pjs.PS: Been trying to give the remaining bags off to my friends ever since.
Eight O'clock is one of our favorite coffees and believe me we have tried many brands.  Yum, yum, hits the spots first thing in the morning!
I found this coffee at Dollar General for $4.00 today.  They only had ground.  No beans.  I almost ordred this last night from Amazon.

I never buy ground coffee always beans. This was a repeat auto order for a 33oz.bag of beans. I politely used your on line system to point out the error and ask for correction, paticularly as I do not use ground and you were charging me twice the bean price.The 'gentleman customer service' was slow, aggressive and spent ever answer trying to prove it was my mistake not AMAZON's and therefore my problem.I took the interaction no further, cancelled that standing order, my sales account and withdrew all my inventory.I am not happy with the NEW AMAZON and am testing competitors.

column9: Great coffee, good price, on time delivery
column10: Previous review - I ordered whole bean coffee to use in my Cuisinart coffee maker wth built in grinder, but received ground coffee instead.My new order for whole bean coffe arrived on time. This coffee is excellent. I have been experimenting with Starbucks and Tully beans for years - I now have a new favorite. The flavor is a little light, but delicious. I add a touch of Dark Roasted Columbian beans to round out the flavor. I heartily recommend 8 O'Clock coffee to all of my friends. This marvelous coffee isn't availabe in Oregon.(Go figure)SO I will continue to buy from AMazon.

I wanted to try Cherrytree Cola for no particular reason other than I'd heard Fentimans makes some pretty good drinks. So I ordered a few from Amazon, and they shipped in like three days. I absolutely love this soda. I don't drink much pop because the carbonation is overbearing for me, but this was different. It was much smoother than regular colas and had a great taste. The only downside is that it's expensive. I won't be purchasing more right away, but if I could I would!

This soda is pretty darn good!!!  It tastes a lot like their Curiosity Cola, yet with a cherry kick.  This was very distinct and has this kind of nice, potpourri smell and taste to it.  Very good stuff! Not on overpowering flavor, yet more of an adult drink, though kids will probably like it too.  I know I really enjoyed it.  4 out of 5 for me.
This is an above average soda.  I have had better cherry colas but they are harder to find.  When I get the urge for a decent cherry cola I will buy again.  A little pricey but worth it in the end.

I got a new dog this January and I had tried 5 different treats to no avail, cookies, 3 different bacon types, and a some meat type in a bone shape cookie.  He didn't care for any of them.  I love Nathan's hot dogs and when I saw this on my Walmart shelf for my dog, I knew I had to try it.  I was sold as soon as I read "human grade".  These treats aren't compromised with a bunch of weird fillers that really aren't good for our pets.  He loves these treats so much that I have been able to teach him 4 new tricks just by holding the bag in front of him. If you like having home deliveries, I recommend the Amazon subscription, it comes out to almost the same price as my neighborhood Walmart but I enjoy the convience of front door deliveries with Amazon.
My dog simply loves the Nathan's Dog treats! The quality has improved since my last purchase.  Bravo for the big full pieces.

column9: Luscious Nathan's Hot Dogs for dogs
column10: The Nathan's treats a big hit in our neighborhood. All the dogs run toward me when they see me. They all love Nathan's.

My dog BJ is a bichone frise and he loves these Nathan treats.  I keep them in a 3 drawer cabinet in the kitchen and when he wants them he just goes to the cabinet and put's his paws on the top and starts beating on the cabinet.  Barking also as in I want my nathan treats right now.  When we run out sometimes he does not like it when I tell him they are all gone but mommy has ordered more and they will be here in a few days.  I have to open the drawer and pick him up and show him there are none in the drawer.  My BJ is adorable and I love him so much.Ann Cooper
My dog loves Nathan's - they are the only dog treats that she will eat and I can no longer find them locally. Thanks to Amazon for selling them and for the great price and ease of ordering.

My 5 dogs just absolutely love these. Was purchasing these at Walmarts but they stopped carrying them. I didn't realize that they were supposed to be refrigerated but it didn't matter since they don't last long around my housewith all the poochies anyway.

Some bags contain moldy sausages and they all have a label showing LOT 0273. I still have the bags with moldy sausages in my refrigerator.I opened the bag and feed the treat to my pet without realizing some of the sausage are moldy. Until I take a closer look at it when my pet refused the treat, then I realized the problem. The bags was not opened some time ago and the sausage used in a later day.I called up Amazon and they replaced the shipment with no delay and apologized.I also called up the phone number shown on the plastic bag but have not yet heard from the manufacturer.I believe this is as serious as the pet feed that killed some of the pets last years that was contaminated and manufactured in China.
My dog just loves these treats however they must be kept in fridge after opening or they will spoil (got moldy).  They are still the greatest, your dog will love these little hot dogs.

I've been offering Nathan's Hot Dog Treats to my English Springer Spaniel, Sadie, for two years.  All have been ordered from Amazon.  Up until the last batch ordered, a couple of months ago, they were GREAT!  They smelled delicious, a fresh summer sausage aroma.  Although I have never tasted this product, Sadie certainly very much loves them.  However, this last batch had a distinctly different aroma.  It was no longer a fresh beef sausage aroma, it is now an indistinct slightly smoked aroma. It did not smell fresh.  All four individual packages had this appreciably less inviting (to me) aroma.  There was no apparent mold on the product or in the bag.  As always, I kept these treats in the refrigerator both prior to and after they were opened.  Each package had, as alway, a desicant inside it.  Something has changed in their manufacturing and/or packaging?  Although, Sadie still ate them, it was obviously without the prior gusto.  These Nathan's treats are rather expensive; I can go to Walmart and purchase four treat packages, totaling one pound, for less than $5.00 that Sadie will enjoy every bit as much as these present Nathan's treats.  Sadie enjoys all treats given with a few loving words.  The words are free.  Nathan's - you have lost a customer.

Sometime ago, I bought these treats for my dog.  They were not being sold by Amazon back then.  I opened a package and the treats were moldy.  I contacted the manufacturer (because Amazon wasn't the seller); they made me send the package back (full of moldy treats) at my expense in order to refund my money.  I'm sure the Postmaster General would have frowned on sending mold thru the mail.  Anyway, I haven't bought them again.

column9: Nathan's Famous Hot Dog Treats not fresh anymore
column10: I've been getting this product for more than 3 years now.  The product use to be fresh, it was soft and moist.  The last three months the product has not been fresh, it is hard and dry.Nathan's Famous Hot Dog Treats, All Beef, 4-Ounce Ziplock Bags (Pack of 4)

column9: These contain corn syrup solids, dextrose & sugar! toxic to dogs!
column10: If I could give these treats and a whole bunch of others 0 stars, I would. Sugar and other forms of sugar like corn syrup and dextrose are linked to cancer in dogs.  They're just as bad if not worse for them  than for humans.  Sure the dogs love them; but there are a lot of healthy treats out there that are just as well liked.  You're buying the name brand, advertising and packaging.

It is very inconvenient to have to keep these in the fridge so I will not be purchasing them again. Also, the portion size is very small for the price.

UNBELEIVABLE! People are so gullible, no these treats aren't toxic to your dogs, but they certainley aren't healthy either.  Just because sugar and fat taste good doesn't mean you should feed it to your dog! Get a clue and check out the ingredients in the treats and food you feed your dog, and even though some things are healthy for humans doesn't mean they are for dogs (e.g. SOY AND CORN) try thinking for yourself and doing your own research. SEARCH DOG FOOD ADVISOR.

The couple colors that work properly (yellow, mint green) seem great and the colors are vibrant, but most of the bottles are completely worthless.

Wow!! Great product.  We used this at Christmas to create some fantastic cookies.  It only takes a very little of the color to create very bright colored icing!! Would highly recommend this to anyone wanting to produce that "professional" look with their baking.

Good food coloring. Still need to use quite a bit to get good color, but the squeeze bottles are neat and easy with no mess and no need for spoons or toothpicks to put into batter or frosting.  Highly recommend to any decorators out there.
These colors are a great deal. I bought them to color macarons because I've had problems with liquid food coloring not staying bright after cooking. This worked great.

column9: AmeriColor #1 Color Kit Soft Gel Paste Food Color, 12 Pack
column10: AmeriColor #1 Color Kit Soft Gel Paste Food Color, 12 Pack (Nov-2011): Product description was accurate and product works as described.  Very vibrant colors that go a long way.  The gels need to be thoroughly mixed in the recipe but hold their color.  The colors from Kit #1: .75 oz bottles: Super Black, Sky Blue, Copper, Lemon Yellow, Forest Green, Mint Green, Deep Pink, Mauve, Peach, Burgundy, Red Red, Fushia.
My food coloring works great.  It gives vibrant colors and was shipped very quickly.
Great colors! Even the black and red were true and vibrant! I would definitely recommend this product to anyone looking for bright icing colors.

column9: Wish there was more color variety
column10: This is a good quality set of colors. I wish there was more variety of color, instead of various shades that aren't very different. A dark blue would be nice instead of a third shade of peach. The paste is thick which makes it easy to control the quantity, but harder to blend. My food color uses are pretty mundane - stuff for the kids to play with, making foods look funny, frosting, and the amount of time it takes to get the color distributed and not streaky is pretty frustrating.I probably won't buy them again, to be honest.
I absolutely love the colors. It is something different from Wilton's. But, the more variety the better right?!Wilton colors are beautiful too!

The seller put two of the same color in the kit. FLESH color no less. So just days before the Valentine cookie rush, I get a kit of food color MISSING the red color, but there is plenty of copper!I never here a word from the seller and of course did not receive a red food color. No way to call them. Will never buy from them again or use AMAZON. I should have stuck to EBAY.
I was born in Europe and love this sour cherry jam on home made crepes.  It's delicious and has just the right amount of tart to it for days when I'm craving a traditional breakfast.
this one of the best taste grapefruit drinks that I have tasted. I would recommend this product to everyone. good way to lose weight.
They call this 100% juice, with no added sugar - the FIRST ingredient is Corn Syrup!  And now I cant return it.  Dont waste your time or money on this product.

I love this food for my cat.  She has been on it for years and it's really the best for her breed.  If you own a Siamese cat you know that they love to eat quickly, and will usually toss up the food because of this.  This food is shaped so that they are forced to chew it and that slows them down.  Now, that doesn't mean that they will never toss up, but it drastically reduces it.  It's very high in protein and keep her lean and never overweight.  She has been very health all her life and her check-ups are always clean.  She has never had a UTI or other digestive issues.  The food is pricey, but it works so well.

I love this food. It smells pleasant. My Ragdoll Mix Garfield has a really sensitive tummy. She would also eat so fast that she would just barf up anything she had eaten. Not to mention she's a very picky eater. It's not the case at all with this food. Both of my kitties love it! It slowed Garfield down and forced her to chew and no more crying in the litter box, or running though the apartment with... anyway it was scary... Sadly I have two cats, I'm on a low income, and as much as their health is my to priority. I can't afford to buy this for them anymore. T_T Really great food though. I will buy it again when I can.

column9: Great for both my cats, even the non-Siamese.  Helps with hairballs.
column10: I use this food for both my young Siamese and my older cat, a former stray (not Siamese).  We have to watch the older cat's weight carefully.  Both cats eat too fast, and this food seems to slow them down.I recently tried to (slowly) switch them to a premium "all-natural grain-free" brand, and the older cat, who has medium-length hair, began to get daily hairballs no matter how much we brushed her.  We switched back to Royal Canin Siamese, and she hasn't had any problems since.  So the Royal Canin seems to help prevent hairballs also.

column4: Keith E. Webb "Creator of The Coach Model"
column10: The Biscoff Spread is unbelievable! The spread is made up of 57% Biscoff cookies. It totally captures the flavor of the cookies yet in the creamy consistency of peanut butter - but of course it's not peanut butter. It's amazing on toast, as a frosting for chocolate cupcakes, and for dipping fruit. It's available in the USA (finally!).In 2007, a Belgium reality show featured two inventors who created a spread (think Nuttella or peanut butter) out of Biscoff Cookies (they are called Speculoos in Europe). Lotus purchased one, patented it, and began producing the spread in 2008. Other companies followed. Lotus brought a lawsuit and lost the first round. There's nothing like cookie drama! I've tried 3 different brands, Lotus brand stands out as the most "cookie-like" and creamy.In Europe? Look for Speculoos Crunchy Spread. This one has 66% Biscoff cookies in a courser consistency (think: crunchy peanut butter). Not available yet in the USA. Worth an airplane ticket to Belgium to buy!Biscoff Spread, a fantastic turn toward the delicious!From: Best Anywhere Reviews

I had to throw it away.....because I couldn't stop eating it!  I tried the Trader joes cookie butter because a friend recommended it and then was told the biscoff spread was better.  I thought "how is that possible?". But it is!  This spread is heaven in a glass jar and unbelievable on an apple.  But beware....it is completely Addicting. I threw it away in a garbage can far away from my home so I would stop eating it.

column9: So good it should be illegal!
column10: OMG, I tasted this at a grocery store sampling table and nearly swooned.  Not recommended for folks who want to stay skinny, but if you're just looking for something totally delish to nom on, you've found it.  Once you realize how addictive it is, send me the leftovers, K?

Yes, this stuff is tasty. It can be used like peanut butter as it says on the package, so I suppose on bread, fruits, ice cream, milk shakes. I saw a recipe for a microwave mug cake using this spread. BUT be careful - it is not as healthy as peanut butter, so I don't see it as a real alternative. Peanut butter is great for feeling full in a jiffy, because it has healthy fats and protein. This spread is basically a dessert and that's all, and has next to no nutrition. I have to keep reminding myself of that, so I don't turn biscoff-spread-on-bread into one of my usual snack foods.

I was lucky enough to discover Biscoff Spread  (with smudged labels) at the 99 cents store and decided to give it a try since I am such a fan of the Biscoff brand of Belgian speculoos cookies that they have served for many years on Delta Air Lines.  It's an odd concept, a spread made of cookies, but I'm glad that I didn't let that stop me from trying it.The label says that this is a "European alternative to peanut butter."  I completely disagree as it it only has the look and texture of peanut butter.  It smells and tastes just like the Biscoff cookies, but sweeter, with a hint of caramelized sugar and cinnamon.  It is much more like dulce de leche than peanut butter.This spread is good with ice cream; on pancakes, scones, and apples; or just eaten from a spoon as a nice treat after a meal.  A thin layer even salvaged the plain graham crackers I bought by mistake instead of the cinnamon honey variety.  It would also be good on cupcakes, waffles, or popovers.  Eating it on toast doesn't appeal to me but maybe with raisin bread it would be good.  It really is tasty and hard to resist, especially with milk or coffee.The basic recipe for Biscoff spread is speculoos cookies, canola oil, and sugar so it's not particularly healthy.  Each tablespoon has 88 calories with 52 of them from fat.  On the bright side, a tablespoon only has 33 mg of sodium.Ingredients:  Biscoff 57% (wheat flour, sugar, vegetable oils [one or more of soy bean oil, sunflower oil, canola oil, palm oil], soy flour, brown sugar, sodium bicarbonate, salt, cinnamon), canola oil, sugar, soy lecithin, citric acid.

My tongue was confused the first time.  What is this stuff?  It looks like peanut butter, but doesn't taste like peanut butter at all.  It tastes like... COOKIES!  The taste of cookies was so unexpected that it actually took a few seconds to get the full flavor as I figured out what it was.Yes, you can actually buy a jar full of cookie paste, and it is delicious.  I wish they would put this stuff in those little single-serve plastic packets normally used for ketchup and mustard.  I would totally walk around with a pocket full of them so I could pull one out any time I wanted a cookie infusion.And no, it doesn't quite taste like cookie dough.  It tastes like fully-baked cookies.

column9: Fabulous - even better than peanut butter
column10: This stuff has to be tasted to be believed! I have no idea how they go from cookies to a delicious cream, but its worth a try for those who like something different on their sandwiches or with apples.  It has a slight cinnamon flavor, but none of the sticky mouth feel you would expect.Even lower in fat than PB, low in sodium and vegan.

The title says it all. I love the creamy goodness of this spread. Once I start eating it, it's hard to stop. Try it with Nutella. You can also find this cheaper at places like Central Market. I paid WAY less than they are asking here.

I really can't imagine someone not liking this, though I know there are people out there. It is sweet, as creamy as peanut butter, and has a caramelly note. There is a slight cinnamon flavor, but it is more cookie than cinnamon. I bet this would be great as a substitute for peanut butter in a cupcake frosting. I will be trying that soon!

Oh. My. Goodness.  This stuff is so good!  If you have ever had the cookie and liked it you will like the spread.  It tastes exactly like the cookie with the same consistency as peanut butter.  If you have never had the cookie it is like eating buttered cinnamon toast.  Delicious.

If you like Biscoff cookies, you'll love this stuff. There are no words that can express how wonderfully delicious this stuff truly is. I had my doubts when I ordered it but my love for Biscoff cookies convinced me to at least try it. I am so glad I did.It's smooth like creamy peanut butter and for those that haven't tasted the wonderfulness that is a Biscoff cookie, it's very hard to adequately describe it's flavor. Another reviewer said it was similar to a graham and I think another one thought it was closer to gingersnaps. I guess those the best american cracker/cookie comparisons, so for lack of better descriptions, imagine those two combined. For what it's worth, if you're like me, I don't really like gingersnaps and grahams are just ok but I think Biscoffs are heavenly. Just take the plunge and buy this spread, it's a great treat just out of the jar & an awesome "mystery flavor" for baked goods, everyone will ask you what your secret ingredient is!
This stuff is better than Nutella. When my sister recommended it to me saying it tasted exactly like the Belgium cookies, I scoffed at her. Turns out she was *not* lying... this stuff is amazing.

Biscoff Spread is super delicious. It tastes really good on apple slices and sometimes I even put it on my oatmeal. It's a spreadable cookie with a hint of cinnamon. I do think that Amazon is overpriced though. I got my 14oz jar at Winco for just over four dollars.

Having a peanut allergic son this stuff makes a great substitute.  texture wise it is exactly like peanut butter but with a slight cinnamon after taste quite pleasant.  I found it in walmart for under $4 a jar so I would suggest shopping around some. I bought the creamy version but a crunchy version was also available..also much more cost friendly then the peanut-free almond butter that was to be found for like $9/jar
If you love the taste of Biscoff cookies, you'll love this wonderful spread! Light and creamy, perfect! We love it!

column9: How can a jarred spread taste like cookies?
column10: I spend a lot of time looking at recipes.  I follow several food blogs and foodgawker is a daily addiction, which is how I first heard about s Biscoff Spread.  In one day, on several different recipe sites, I kept seeing Biscoff mentioned.  The first was for a cookie ball made using biscoff, since the recipe poster said you could substitute butter for the Biscoff, I mistakenly assumed that Biscoff was a butter alternative that I hadn't heard of before.  But later I saw it mentioned again and then again on different sites and with increasingly rapturous praises for this 'amazing delicacy' and I just had to find out what it was.I'm just that way, if all the cool kids are eating Biscoff, I need to know what Biscoff is before I dismiss it as a trendy waste of time.As it turns out Biscoff is not new.  At least in Europe it isn't and after just one tiny taste of the heavenly stuff, I think I can safely predict that it will soon be a regular product on store shelves in North America.Like others before me have mentioned Biscoff is sweet and has a texture somewhere between Nutella (sticky, hard to spread if it isn't at a room temp and whipped cream cheese, airy and light, easy to plop onto a cool bagel (the weather has been super cold here and still the Biscoff was spreadable with a spoon right after delivery).The texture is smooth with a slight powdery-ness and it tastes sweet. just like a cookie.  In fact, it tastes like cookies, which is so strange that at first I wasn't sure if I liked it, so I took another bite and it was blissful, sweet but not too sweet, just the way I like my cookies, nom nom.  Biscoff is a melt-y, buttery, cookie delight, I like it even more than Nutella and I have an urge to hide the jars, so that I wont have have to share them with my husband and son!While Biscoff is tasty alone, it felt like I should try it out on something, I put a smidge on a thin ginger crisp, yum, tried some on a slice of apple and then a smear on a piece of toast (my bread was stale and kinda yecky, so it wasn't that great).  The options are flipping endless.

column9: Where has this been all my life?
column10: I stopped by my local grocery the other night and notice some fresh croissants in the bakery section.  I normally don't by such things but they looked so good that I picked them up and tossed them in the cart.  Once I got home, I saw a little sample package of Biscoff Spread tucked inside.  Thinking it was like peanut butter, I put it aside and it wasn't until there was only one croissant left that I opened the sample and tried it.  OMG - after I finished it, I literally licked the little package.  I went back to the grocery store the next day, praying that they carried it in the full size version.  There it was!!!!  Tucked on the top shelf above the peanut butter, next to the Nutella.  It was pricey, $4.98 for 18 ounces - but in my humble opinion, worth every cent.

We use to buy the biscoff cookies years ago. A show on the Food Network mentioned the spread and we had to try it. It is not available at our store yet, so we will buy it online until Kroger carries it. It's a perfect replacement for peanut butter. It's good on bread with bananas and honey or jelly, and on crackers or by the spoonfuls. Try the cookies (which are available in the stores) first, if you're not sure about the spread. They both taste exactly the same.

If someone where to ask me what this product tasted like, I'd call it a sweet "Spreadable Graham Cracker". It is sugary with a faint taste of cinnamon. It is based on Speculaas cookies that are popular in the Netherlands and Belgium. This kind of thing is new to me. You can also get this at the Wafels and Dinges truck in NYC, if you want to try it out.
This product is a delicious alternative to peanut butter..Its quite addicting in its flavor and would recommend it to everyone.

column4: P. Carta "Live de life...drink de wine"
column10: Can a spread be fabulous?  Well we don't care.  This stuff is simply one of the best things ever.

I don't review a lot of things on Amazon, so that should tell you something. Biscoff Spread transcends anything I've ever tasted. It must have found its way to Earth from another realm, settling happily into my awaiting mouth. I discovered it at Publix the other day sitting conspicuously with the peanut butter. I love Biscoff cookies, so I figured, why not give this a try. It tastes exactly as presented...Biscoff cookies in spread form. Actually, it's better than the cookie. In terms of nutritional content, it's got about the same amount of fat and calories as peanut butter, and as you'd expect, almost twice as much carbs and sugar. So it should be used more sparingly than peanut butter, but it's worth every bit.I went Gollum over this stuff within a few hours of having it in my cabinet...it's seriously addicting. It's cheaper if you can find it in the store, but still more expensive than peanut butter...totally worth it, though.This was a new find for me, and I hope stores continue to carry it...otherwise, people will start bootlegging it and selling it alongside crack.It's that good.

I am pretty strict about Low Carb because that is my WOE, but this is the one item that I will probably keep in my cupboard that is definitely not low carb.  It is so delicious that it is hard to explain!  I have never had the Biscoff cookies either, but while running through Central Market and grabbing all of my fav items before heading back home, a sample lady asked me to try it.  I sort of wish I hadn't.  I spread a smithering on my rice cake and oh.my.goodness. I did a double take!  Heaven in a spread.  It tastes nothing like peanut butter, but it has the spread and consistency of peanut butter.I have no earthly idea what I will spread this on, because it will probably have to be apples or oopsies, because this is one of those items that really belongs to the High Carb crowd.  :D

column9: I keep the jar in the freezer, it's even better cold
column10: Recently, I bought a jar of this after having dental surgery when I was limited to liquids and mush foods for 2 weeks. I had never tried Biscoff spread before but I wasn't disappointed. Lemme tell you, Biscoff Spread made the 2 weeks bearable, but I went through the jar in about 3 days, taking tiny amounts of it off a dull butter knife because I couldn't really open my mouth much. It doesn't have protein like peanut butter does so for me it won't be a pb replacement... for me, Biscoff is a dessert treat. A super fantastic treat. I'm going to buy these as stocking stuffers - If you like cookies and you like the consistency of peanut butter, this spread is very good.Biscoff spread is amazingly tasty but it isn't health food, as I'm sure you've noticed if you've ever looked at the nutrition label. =) But everything in moderation, right? I'm one of those people who likes a bite of sweetness after a meal and this spread is a wonderful, rich treat.*Update* I bought a 2nd jar locally the other day but this time it wasn't as thick and it was rather greasy feeling in my mouth, and it dissolved in a second so I didn't get to savor the flavor of it much. I realized that we were now keeping the house about 6* warmer than we were just a couple of weeks ago and this temperature change was enough to alter the consistency of the Biscoff spread... a 74*F house was too warm. I now keep the jar in the refrigerator (edit: I now keep the jar in the freezer, it's even better! and because I have to basically chip it out of the jar, it slows me down when eating it so I can't shovel spoonfuls of the stuff into my face), and found that I really like the spread when it's cold (I eat it straight off a spoon, I don't spread this on anything). So if you happen to try Biscoff spread and you think it's greasy and isn't as thick as you like, it may be because your house is a bit too warm... try keeping the jar in the fridge or freezer.
It arrived quickly (Amazon Prime is worth it!), the spread tastes delicious and was exactly what I expected! The second jar is halfway gone already. It's a hit with everyone.

This is my new Nutella.....This craze is taking over.  I found it to be addictive. My husband who hates toasts & spreads & jams, ate 2 sandwiches!! I myself could not believe it. I have already tasted Biscoff cookies a few years ago.  And when I saw this at the local Walmart, I decided to give it a try.  I already picked up French bread from the bakery and completely surprised by the $1 instant coupon on top the lid ($1 off when you purchase French Bread)!!  So, the next day, for breakfast, there was this wonderful toast with Biscoff spread.  And I also tried it on apple slices.  YUMMY!!  But the only downside (if any) is that it could taste good only with bread* and apples, maybe because of cinnamon. But then, bread and apples are good for you! My 3-year old son (A very picky eater, most of the times plainly refusing to try new stuff) ate this and asked for more.  I remember going gaga over nutella when it hit the aisles. This is the newest entry and here-to-stay spread.As one negative review calls it greasy, well, nutella is.  And so is butter or vegetable oil spread.  When it tastes yummy and it is vegan, it is a good-to-go product.  As for calories, if you are on diet, why are you even here reading about spreads?  A smear or two on toasts everyday cannot do any harm.  I went ahead and made my own French bread and tried it.  OMG, deadly.P.S: *Bread means all kinds of breads like plain scones, bagels, muffins etc.  BTW, I also melted it for a few seconds in the Microwave and used it as a dip for homemade soft pretzels - WOW!!  I am now thinking of using it as cake filling or icing.  I bet it will work especially on apple cake!!

column9: Great product but beware of poor packaging.
column10: The product is amazing.  It's the consistency of creamy peanut butter, but it tastes like cookies.  Other reviewers rave about it, and I agree with them.  It basically tastes heavenly on anything or even by itself.The bad - the seller packaged both jars together with no protection between them, which caused one of the jars to break.  Fortunately, the other jar is fine, but essentially, I got one jar for the price of two.  I could get a refund if I return everything, but I don't want to return the undamaged jar, because the product is so good.

I spotted this yummy stuff as I was in search of something to spread on my multigrain crackers. This stuff is off the chain!!! I love it! I wouldn't go as far as to sub it for PB, as it is too sweet and not as nutritious....but spread a thin layer over multigrain crackers, toast, or fruit....and you're in for a real treat!

I had never had Biscoff Spread, heck I never had a Biscoff cookie before.  I had seen a few blogs where the spread and cookies were used in recipes for cookies and bars with rave reviews so I knew I had to find them.  When I began my search, I easily found the cookies at my local "high-end" market.  The spread was a different matter.  I searched high and low to no avail.  So I bit the bullet and purchased it through Amazon.  It is so delicious and although I haven't used it in recipes (yet), just spreading some on a wheat cracker is a tasty treat.  I just wish I could find it at a grocery store because I know it costs less than what I paid on Amazon!

Everyone who tastes this for the first time says "oh. my. God" without fail, it's that good.  But it's pricey.  I bought this from Amazon before realizing it was available at the grocery store down the street.  And it's cheaper in the supermarket ($4 at the store vs $6 online) so check locally before buying it online because you'll want to stock up.

The spread is exactly a Biscoff cookie in mushed form.The only thing bad that I have to say is that the seal is terrible. It's made of paper and doesn't come off the jar clean liked a waxed paper or foil type seal would've.

I saw a recipe online from Picky Palate that used Biscoff Spread as an ingredient in blondies.  I had never heard of Biscoff Spread before, but the blondies turned out very good!  I agree with others that the price on Amazon is too high for this item - go to the company website and find a retail location in your state.  Here in Virginia, I got mine at Wegmans for $3.79 per jar.  I found it in the cookie aisle, next to the Biscoff cookies!
One word, yummy.  It taste just like the cookie which I also love.  It's a great substitute for peanut butter with less calories.  If you haven't tried it, I highly recommend it!

column9: Please bring over the crunchy version
column10: This is an amazing spread I first had when living in the Netherlands...They NEED to bring out the crunchy version of the spread (which for me is the only reason I rate the smooth 4 instead of 5 stars. The crunchy gets 5+ stars!) Mix it with peanut butter and good whole wheat toast for a first rate sandwich!!

Recently I purchased 4 - 14oz containers of Biscoff Spread. It was shipped quickly and packed securely that none of jars were broken. Included in my package was a free 4pack sample of individual servings. This is a really really good spread. Just the right amount of sweetness and creamy texture. I love it!!  I can literally eat it like peanut butter right from the jar. You'll have to watch out or you'll empty the jar first serving lol. Addicting!!!

on the advice of friends i purchased this 2-pack.  everyone raves about how good it is and how it is a substitute for peanut butter.  i have to disagree.  it's like eating sweetened grease.a side by side label comparison (using Skippy Natural PB) shows that the two are very similar except for protein and vitamin/mineral amounts but i much prefer peanut butter.  the flavor of this stuff is okay but just too greasy for me.  i think i could mix up brown sugar and butter and get the same effect.so my vote is Yuck.
Wonderful stuff, but can be purchased in my local Wal-Mart for $3.59 per 14oz jar.  If we have it in Dresden, TN then I'd bet it's available almost anyplace.

If you have an addictive personality you will be HOOKED on this spread.  A friend bought it for me yesterday and I hate to admit I've eaten half of the jar already.  It is like dipping an apple into a liquid cookie.  This spread is so good I ordered a double-pack to ship to my cousin as a surprise.Biscoff's website also has recipes for using the spread.  Tonight I'm making banana smoothies with biscoff spread.  Can't wait!Biscoff Spread 14oz (Pack of 2)***UPDATE***I ordered this item on Sept. 19th to ship to someone who lives out of town.  I had to call on the 23rd because the order still said "Shipping Soon".  Today is the 27th and they still haven't received it yet.  If you are going to send this to someone as a gift you'd do better to buy a jar at a local grocery store, walk down to a UPS store and ship it yourself.  In this day and age, more than 10 days to ship something is ridiculous.  The makers of Biscoff better change their shipping policy or they will not get repeat business.  The shipping method is the only reason I've downgraded this product from a 5 star to a 3 star.

I ordered this product and when I removed it from the packaging it was in a plastic bag that seemed to be covered in grease (parts of the product).  I put it in the fridge anyway thinking maybe I'd give it a shot if I became daring one morning.  My parents thought it was trash (because the product looked so bad) so they threw it away.  Oh well, no food poisoning for me this time I suppose...

column9: Dogs love it and easier than raw frozen to store and feed!
column10: I feed Thrive to one of our dogs that tends to put on weight.  He gets some raw frozen (which we have for our other dog) but this guy actually does better with the raw frozen and a mix of the Honest Kitchen Thrive and Preference than just on raw alone.  We were giving him some high quality kibble but the vet suggested this was adding to his weight issues, said she's found that the less the food was processed, the more lean muscle mass the dogs tend to have.  Plus dehydrated is great to have on hand all the time.  Recently HK has begun packaging the food in a ziplock bag which should be great, the old bags were a pain to try to keep properly sealed.  Since I am only feeding one dog, and buy the bigger packages for the cost savings, I've been pouring the food into half-gallon mason jars and then removing the air with my FoodSaver jar sealer - works great!

column9: My Dogs Do Thrive on This Food
column10: My dogs, a Maltipoo and a Papillon, love this food and it seems to have improved the quality of their coats.  Our only problem is all the whining and begging while they wait for it to rehydrate! Feeding time is definitely the noisiest time of the day because they love this stuff!  I like feeding it because it is nearly like feeding raw without all the mess of handling raw meat.

I use Honest Kitchen Thrive and my Scottie loves it.  He can hardly wait for it to rehydrate, have his meat or cottage cheese on top and get it down at his level to eat.  He absolutely THRIVES on this food.  He is a healthy, lively and happy chappie. I would not hesitate to recommend this food to anyone.  It is super!

Notice how it says "Raw dog food" then "with chicken". It's written this way because it's not entirely raw, the chicken is cooked. Cooked proteins are likely to be allergenic! The whole point of a raw diet it for it to be raw so it isn't allergenic and is easy to digest, and of course the most important part of the dog's diet is the protein source. I wish this company would stop trying to trick people into thinking their food is raw. Some dogs do not do well on this product. The owners assume it is raw and then assume raw doesn't work. In many of these cases, the dog would benefit from a truly raw diet. For this reason I really wish The Honest Kitchen would straighten up and give up the practice of deceit. They are essentially harming many, many animals who could find relief on a truly raw diet. I have already had this discussion with their representative many years ago. The company did change their wording so that they no longer tell outright lies, but it is still deceptive. I can't imagine they care about anyone's pet if they carry on like this. If your pet has had issues such as hot spots, digestive upset, body odor, itchy feet or any other chronic condition, ask your vet if it could be an allergy to the cooked proteins in this diet. If it is, and you were under the impression that you were feeding raw protein, let the manufacturer know. They have to know how many pets they are harming, or they will never straighten up.

column9: Get it for St. Patty's day!
column10: A wonderful change from corned beef. Great for morning meals, or substitute for ham. Not as salty or fatty as ham or corned beef.

I used this to make a traditional Irish dish for my son. He really liked it. I couldn't enjoy it because of new denture, but still have some in the freezer in vacuum bags(there were four pounds and I quartered it) and plan on making up for it. Wes said he thought it tasted like corned beef. I'll let you know.

Review you say , does this sauce really need one ? I Mean it's got a taste that leaves you wanting More . You can drink it from the bottle well you might want to leave that to your friends. But I'm far to busy trying to find something it doesn't taste good on ! Tell u.m Duke sent ya and receive a smile lol..[...]

column9: Mary Kate the CRF feral kitty NOMMED it all up and nipped my finger to get more
column10: If you sift through my other cat food reviews, you'll see that one of my cats is a feral queen who stayed inside with me after I tnr-ed her colony seven years ago.  In the last 6 months, she's been sick with what her vet has pretty much decided is CRF (she would have to be sedated for a confirmatory blood draw and the evidence from the dietary interventions is pretty strong).  So, I've tried and reviewed a number of kitty foods for price, quality, whether Mary Kate will eat them, and, if she will, whether she can keep them down.The Felidae Dry Food for Senior and Overweight Cats succeeded where the canned version of the same food failed.  Mary Kate absolutely refused to eat the canned food, wouldn't go near it, which was upsetting, because the quality of that food was amazing, especially for a lower protein selection.  While dry food is not generally the best choice in CRF, especially with a cat who cannot be hydrated with sub-q fluids, this particular dry food seems to agree quite nicely with my particular cat.  So far, knock wood, she keeps it down.  That's important, because once she vomits up a food she likes, she doesn't like it and won't eat it until she forgets the experience.And she really really loves this stuff.  More than sardines.  More than tuna.Weird.But the ingredients are of excellent quality.  Much better, actually, than the renal diet dry foods the vet suggested.  And the nutritional ratios are within the ranges the vet said were okay; we may want to use a phosphorus blocker at some point, though.If you're dealing with a kitty who's got CRF or another condition where you don't want to stress his or her kidneys, first, my sympathies (it's so hard to have someone you love be so sick), and second, try a small bag of this.  Introduce it slowly.  And, if your cat will eat it, see how it works.

column9: Tasty food for a picky cat
column10: Our beloved Bengal kitty, Isabel, is 13 years old and suffering from kidney stones, which are inoperable in felines. She turned up her nose at the expensive, vet-sold brands and repeatedly rejected one national brand and flavor after another. Finally, to her gustatory delight (and our great relief), she made her choice: this particular Wiskas version is the ONLY kind she'll eat day in and day out. It MUST be Whiskas with the turkey AND GIBLETS in GRAVY. The gravy seems to add a certain flavor and texture she can't resist.We surmise that, like humans, our pets have food preferences linked to palate-pleasing aroma and taste. This Whiskas is the one that rings the bell for our Izzy. No, it's not the best choice for managing kidney stones, but she's got to eat. (So you won't worry that we're ignoring her renal problems, she's on daily medication and is doing quite well.)It's not an inexpensive cat food, but its packaging is very convenient and space-saving. The Amazon auto-ship program is a life saver. The cartons always arrive on time, and the per-package bulk rate is lower than the price of small quanities. Also, our local Target was the only place we could find this exact variety, and now the store no longer carries it. (Remember, our cat demands GIBLETS and GRAVY and accepts no substitutes).Give autoship a try. The price is better, and you can easily adjust the quantity and frequency of shipment or cancel altogether.

column10: I've had dogs my whole life and I've never seen such a picky eater as my pooch Sofia.  She's now 2, as healthy as can be, but won't eat.  I've tried tough love, going 5 days taking her bowl away when she refused food and I sorta believe she didn't like her food du jour for a reason (allergy, taste, something...).  I've tried at least 20 different kinds of high quality and expensive brands.  I had taken to squirting Salmon oil on the top of her kibble to make it more appealing and that generally worked for the types she was 'ok' with.However, Sofia eats this Vitality product without Salmon oil, days of starvation or visiting dogs which would sometimes prompt her to action.  For me and really for Sofia, this is the best food made.  Honestly I really can't believe a dog won't eat but she loves this!!!**2/20/12:  Updated ReviewThe picky dog is back, I had to buy more salmon oil so I can finish the bag.  Oh well it was nice while it lasted....It seems she liked the smaller bags much more than the large (22.5 lb) bags.  She didn't even give that food a second look but always ate the 4 lb bag food.

My dog Annabelle eats this food with relish. I like given it to her because of all the good ingredients it contains and all the vitamins and minerals to meet a dog's needs. What more could I ask for? (I only feed dry dog food because I want my dog to have clean teeth and gums. The wet food sticks gummy-like between the teeth which, of course, can cause tooth decay and gum disease.)
We have two 85-pound retriever mix dogs who really seem to enjoy the food.  They give it five stars!  The subscribe and save is a great deal for big bags of dog food--free delivery!

This dog food arrived quickly and was packed and wrapped well.  Food was fresh and smelled good which is why I gave it two stars.  However, I will not be buying again.  My dog has had the worst farts since starting this food.  I've had her on it for ten days hoping that she would adjust to it.  She rode with me in the car today and I couldn't get the windows down fast enough.  Whew!  Not recommended.

My dogs don't like this one as much as Happy Hips. Got it for their skin and coats but at least with one of my dogs there is some ingredient that causes her to scratch more. Wish Dogswell would look into what ingredient would cause an allergic reaction and make the change.

I had a store and I sold candy bars, and this was a favorite of all my customers.  I had to buy two to three of these big boxes per week.the chocolate on the outside is smooth and the soft middle was always soft and not hard and stale.  I never ever had a complaint about these.
For anyone who has been afraid to try these- you honestly can't tell the difference between these and regular pretzels. The kids love them.

These are great! Just like the other reviewer said, you honeslty can't tell the difference between these and regular pretzels. And they're healthier for you becuase they're made with whole grains instead of enriched flours....plus, Amazon offers them at a SUPER price. My local whole foods store sells them for around 2.50-3.00 a bag. It's a smaller bag, so $19 for 12 bags is super.

column9: tastes good but could have wheat in it
column10: I ate these pretzels for years and loved them and YES they are a great value.  I am wheat sensitive so spelt products are what I use for a substitute.  A law was passed a few years ago that requires companies to label their spelt products in the ingredients section as:  Spelt flour (wheat flour).  (I'm not going to get into why they do this here).  BUT this allows the companies to cut the spelt flour with 50% or less wheat flour and still call it spelt.  This was a nightmare for me, and after attempting to contact Vitaspelt to ask if they did cut the product with wheat flour, they never answered me so I don't eat their product for fear it will make me sick.  If you aren't wheat sensitive it's a great product, if you are BEWARE.  There is another great alternative, Newmans Spelt pretzels.  They do not have the wheat label on them and I switched to eating those years ago...very tasty!
pretty good pretzels, my kids like them, although they'd always choose a regular salty one over these.  I like that they have less sodium and are filling.
These are very good pretzels.  They could be just a bit saltier, though.  I only gave them 4 out of 5 stars because I like the Newman's Own Spelt Pretzels a bit better.
I prefer these vitaspelt pretzels over the smaller, red bag because they're organic and whole grain which means fiber.

This was a bit of a surprise to me.  I've been working at eating healthy for 20 years, I'm from the era where "white" meant pure and healthy.  So I make the best choices I can with the info I can find yet still eat somewhat "mainstream".  So for a crunchy snack, that meant whole wheat pretzels, and I enjoy them, the sweet wheat taste is nice.  However, I saw these and I was curious, the price is certainly reasonable compared to purchasing locally so I gave them a go - how bad could they be? They are amazingly like the fresh crunchy pretzels of my youth which included bleached white flour.  So much like them that I re-checked the ingredients.  I'm not sure what I was expecting, but I was expecting something different, perhaps that might take some getting used to but these are just great.  I would change brands for one with sea salt, but for now, I'm happy that my snacking can be a bit healthier.  If you are looking for wheat free, healthier or just wanting to try something different, I think you might enjoy these.

These are good spelt pretzels.  Although I like the original (small) pretzels a little better, but these are addicting.  These are the "regular" size of pretzels.  This is the second time that I have ordered these, and I will again.  They are nice and crunchy, not too salty, and taste great.

The ingredients listed on Amazon state that Canola oil is used in this product, but when the product arrived it contained Soybean oil. OVER 1 million people in the United States are allergic to Soy and I am one of them.

I have not found these in health stores n markets i shop... i should have gotten reg pretzels this brand, not sourdough... you can NOT taste sourdough flavor and there is not much salt on them. I was so excited to find them, getting them was a bit of disappointment.... ALSO THE LABEL SAYS: spelt (wheat) which is it, a concern of mine am i eating wheat or spelt pretzels?

column9: Very happy with taste, but price went up
column10: My daughter and I have been on a 'wheat free' diet for several years now.  WE are thankful for the health benefits that these choices have opened for us.  One top food item I've missed the most have been good, crunchy pretzels!  These Spelt pretzels fit that niche wonderfully!  Wow!  The bags are a good size that keep us going for snacks and dipping.  They are fantastic!!!I just came back to Amazon to order more and I was shocked at the price change.  Only two months ago, I paid just over $2 a bag....  and now it is about $3.60 a bag!!!  What's up with that?  I suppose then I'll have to look in stores to find a better price.  I sure would have ordered more in a heartbeat had I know the prices would change so much....  now I feel like I'm 'back to the drawing board'.

column9: Can't tell that these are spelt.
column10: The package that you will receive doesn't match up with this picture.  I have purchased this item twice and have been pleased both times. The pretzels are shipped well and actually have less broken ones in them than if you were to buy a package off the grocery store shelf.  These are quite tasty and you get the benefit of spelt.

I purchased these expecting little as it is organic.I find that organics and no saly products like chips find value by filling you up more than the national brands.I coudn't believe the tastye as ity was phenominal.tasted like the buttery pretzels in the stores but also had much much better taste.lenghth of shelf life must be considered though if you purchase by the case.But, this new ingrediant for me is just the best.Spelt is spelled tastety.
I love dried peaces!  These came in decent time.  I was worried when another rating said these were not dried properly, but these seem to be just fine.  Very Yummy!

These came a bit to soft and mushy.  The ones that were dried better were delicious.  I would say the bottom half of each bad were spoiled.  The peaches were not fulled dried.  They should be soft and somewhat moist but half of these were mushy and beginning to spoil.  I emptied them into a large container without fully inspecting them then tossed the plastic packaging.  I immediately tossed them in the fridge but quickly learned half were spoiled as I ate them.  If had kept the packaging I would have returned them and probably would have given them a chance at replacing them instead of refunding my purchase price.If you purchase these inspect the product fully before storing.  Maybe I just got a bad batch,that is why I gave them a 3 out of 5 in stead of  1.
Bergin Dried Peaches are always tasty but not always in stock. Don't let the price keep inching up, Bergin! Super Saver shipping on this item is also wonderful.
These m&m's arrived as expected.  They were shipped with an ice pack as well, which was nice.  Some were chipped in the bag, but I would expect that with going thru the shipping process.

This is a really good oolong tea. I love the sweet flavors that are inherent in the leafs. It is good for at least 4 brews if not more. I just follow the instructions on the packaging and It comes out tasting great every time. I use just over a teaspoon of leaves because the leaves are not balled up like some teas, they are more loosely dried.I bought this directly from the company, and I did the math. On Amazon 1.75 oz * 3 cans sells for $24.61 as of 9/6/11. However, if you were to buy directly from Rishi-tea.com you would actually save money per ounce. This is the link - [...]On Amazon: 4.69 per oz and you get 5.25 oz.At Rishi: 4.25 per oz and you get 1/4 lb.If you want even more of this wonderful tea, you can buy in bulk and get the tea for even cheaper!The only reason to get this tea on Amazon at the current price is if you have free Prime shipping, want to share with 3 people, like the tin cans, or like to burn money.

This Oolong is pretty good. I get two pretty good steepings out of this tea. Price should be lower, but it is not low quality. It is not the best Oolong, but is something that is worth trying and ordering more than once. The taste is similar to Bigelow Oolong tea in bags. This Oolong is a lighter amber color,obviously depending on how much tea you use and how long it is steeped.

This is one of my two "afternoon" black teas (the other being Twining's Afternoon Tea.) It isn't nearly bold enough for my morning palate. I love hot beverages, including coffee, tea, chocolate, and even herbal coffee substitutes. I wouldn't describe myself as particularly sophisticated in evaluating them, however.This oolong really does lack the astringency I associate with black tea. I would describe the flavor as mellow and smoky, but not aggressive in any way.I think the bit about this being a weight loss tea sold me on trying it, though I'm feeling too lazy to diet, so I can't really say whether this Wuyi Oolong could help in that regard.If I'm not in the mood for green or white tea, and I'm not feeling too lazy to deal with loose leaf tea, then this is what I take in the afternoon.

column9: Good tea but not my favorite
column10: Earthy, almost smoky flavor.  Complex.  Bold, almost coffeelike.  Good tea.  It was my sample oolong when I did a presentation on tea for public speaking class (I brewed sample pots and gave out tastes of each of the five types of tea) and it was very popular.However, I am more inclined towards the white teas, green teas, and black teas over the oolongs.

This is my favorite from Rishi's tea available on Amazon. I have tried Green, Black and White teas in my search of a perfect everyday tea, and have come to this one.  It has a unique smokey flavor, that you will either like, or complain about, but it definitely not bland.

Every product I've tried by Rishi thus far has been of good quality. Granted, there is higher quality to be found but it will come with a higher price tag. In my opinion, this is one of the best wuyi oolongs in the price range. The flavor is a bit hard to describe. It is very toasty and there is a little hint of pleasant smokiness. It is light in body while still being rich and robust. There is a definite caramel/chocolate-esque sweetness to it, and flavors slightly reminiscent of honey. If you're new to loose teas and interested in trying a wuyi oolong, then I highly recommend this as a good place to start. It is very soothing and comforting, and makes a great pair with carbohydrate-rich meals such as pasta and bread. This is good stuff.
I love this tea. It has a nice robust flavor, and I detect the faintest chocolatey tinge as well. The price is excellent, I think, as each Tbsp of leaf can produce 3 brewings.
Yummy and mild with no bitterness!! No caffiene jitter either.....I drink it right before bed too. Throw away your water pills...you won't need them w/this tea!! Love it!

My husband & I both love this tea!  It is a great afternoon tea that promises big flavor, almost tobacco like (we do not smoke!) and seems to usher in relaxation with each sip - but not sleepiness.  Don't know yet if it helps with weight loss or with lowering cholesterol but, if it happens, it will be another good reason to drink our favorite mid-day tea and lots of it!
We love this tea! It's very fragrant, dark and delicious, with a lovely Oolong flavor.

Again, I was dissapointed.  While this tea was alright in flavor, and I love the concept behind the company and it's dedication to fair trade (not that this is one of the fair trade teas) but I've been underwhelmed.  I have to say Numi's Sunset Oolong has a better flavor.

I've championed a number of Rishi's Chinese teas (and their chais) because they're excellent. This, unfortunately, was my introduction to Wu Yi oolongs many moons ago. Had I not looked farther, I'd have dismissed the entire category.Wu Yi "rock" oolongs are processed from bushes that thrive in mineral-rich soil. They tend to be on the "dark" side, i.e., rather highly oxidized. The best of them are sublime; however, that's not to say that there aren't good rock oolongs to be found that won't require that you refinance your home.In general, though, you get what you pay for. I trusted my previous experiences with Rishi, plus their description of this one's profile sounded right up my alley (someone over there writes very good copy). At the price, I figured that I couldn't go wrong.I was in error.The only thing I taste in this tea is smoke; it tastes like the leavings of a campfire. This is fine for a Lapsang red tea, but it's totally out of place in an oolong. Quite frankly, this is the worst "specialty" tea I've ever bought, and I don't believe it's due to a mere matter of taste--it's just bad, like Liquid Smoke. The fact that it's organic in no way compensates for the fact that it's almost undrinkable.I wasn't going to review this tea given that "if you can't say anything nice, ...," etc. However, Amazon made the point of recommending this to me, so I felt I had to set the record straight. Bottom line: look elsewhere to become acquainted with Wu Yi oolongs...unless you're a pretentious Finnish ugly-boy stalker-troll with liver-lips, of course.

column9: Was once lost but found again.

Like the Rosebud Powder found here: Rosebud - Powder - 1.3 OZ , I purchased this for incorporation into homemade Ras El Hanout.  Since the floral component of this Multi-Spice is quite small (floral powders easily overwhelming other flavours if overused), I ended up with quite a bit left over for use in my perfume-making hobby or in sachets, etc.I found this to be a high-grade powdered lavender, the floral 'nose' being greater than the (wholly expected and natural) bitterness of it.

Organic Grass Fed Ground Beef Patties TWO (1/3 lb. Burgers)After having a taste of this hamburger, we couldn't bring ourselves to taint the flavor with condiments or even a bun.  Better than a steak.  Because it's grass fed, it needs to be flipped every minute or so during cooking to keep it moist.  Well worth the effort.

Spinosi is one of the best brands of dried pasta I have ever had.  The texture is amazing! It has the smoothness of silk! Being Italian, I eat pasta 5 times a week and I never tire of it.  This is truely an awesome brand!!!!

the product is listed as a 150g 6-pack.Traditionally, when US companies do a bundle-pack they list the size of the individuals...so a 6 pack of canned soda would be a 12oz 6-pack, we would never see that listed as a 72oz 6-packI foolishly assumed I was getting a real bargain, 6 150g bags, for about $8!Oh so wrong. These are amazing chips but they just cost too much for the little amount that you get. They come from England so I suppose they have a way to travel. Hey just bring them to the states and I would be most happy!

I am more than pleased!!!!Walkers Worcester Sauce Crisps 6 Pack 150g

column4: d wilson "Visitor from a Perpendicular Universe"
column10: I had a bag of these during a trip to London. I was looking for Walker's Frazzles but this was the only bacon-flavored chips I could find at the Tesco. The taste is very similar to Frazzles if not better. It tastes just like bacon! Even suitable for vegetarians.

This chips kind of reminded me of bacon bits. The six small bags were the perfect size and there's no MSG. They were a little expensive, but considering they came from the UK it's understandable. Half the price was in the shipping. They are well worth the indulgence once in awhile.
If you like salt and vinegar crisps (chips), but would prefer the vinegar to lighter, you should love these.  Salty and slightly tangy and yummy!

This could possibly be the best tasting chip I have ever eaten. It has a nice smokey bacon flavor. I would make sure this item was always stocked in my pantry if the price was not so high for the amount you get, or if they would sell this "AMAZING" chip here in the states. I would highly recomend someone paying the price one time just to try this.
I loved the chips they were AWESOME!!! but that's just me. It arrived Earlyer than expected in the mail so that was even better, no crushed chips yay!
The crisps are awesome. Give me English crisps over american chips any day! I recommend them to everyone. The smoky bacon are my favorite but the cheddar bacon are almost as good.
Item came promptly however the crisps were 3 months past their freshness date. Was told I would get replacements.  Still waiting.
Bought these the other day while I was in Canada, they are delish! If they were available here in the states I would buy them.

I had these wonderful chips in Ireland a few years ago on vacation and was sad that I could not find them in America.  Now that I have I will be in so much trouble ordering them all the time.  I love these chips!!!

I ordered this product on Amazon to get some of the flavors we can't get in the US, namely, bacon, worcestershire, and prawn cocktail.  The photo of the product was so small and the description was so vague that I didn't realize until it came that what I was getting were actually 3 flavors of crisps that I can get down the street from my house:  cheddar cheese and onion, salt and vinegar, and regular flavor.  I was VERY disappointed.  Instead of trying again to order online, I will ask friends in the UK to shop and mail them for me.

I don't drink hard booze. I just can't handle it. Wine is about the strongest I can tolerate. However, my wife has used Myers's Rum (Original Dark) for cooking and has had good results with it. Well, this may seem a bit out of place but.... I came up with a lung infection (bad cold) in late June and just haven't been able to shake the aftereffects. My lungs feel somewhat clogged and I run out of energy easily. I was talking to a nurse friend about the problem and he advised to take some brandy in a brandy glass and to very lightly sip and inhale at the same time. The idea was mainly to breathe the fumes in, not to consume the liquor. He said the fumes would relieve the congestion. Okay, it seemed worth a try, but I didn't have any brandy. So I asked if my wife's Myers's Rum might work, being as it was rather strongly aromatic. He said to give it a try. Well, I'm reporting here that it worked marvelously well. The fumes are strong and make my lungs feel refreshed. The next day, I was able to breath better. I've done it several additional times since. So, that's your little helpful hint for the day. Also, enjoy the rum. It certainly smells good.Gary Peterson
this works great at keeping the stray cats away from my patio .....lasts about 2 weeks per bag. they smell it and wont come near.
Frontier bulk Cayenne is by far the best value for organic cayenne I have found. Shipping was very fast and quality excellent.

The delivery was pretty quick.  The 35,000 Hu ground pepper, of course, is pretty lively.  I am taking it to reduce colesteral -- it is supposed to be taken long-term before effects are shown.  Product and delivery are as advertised.

For its size, it's quick and efficient. Clean up is a breeze. From set up; chopping, grinding, packing and cleaning, it's a total of two hours for a months worth of ready to use meat. Customer service is the best. I bought this to grind chicken back for my dog's raw food diet. It is easy to use, and it is very fast. It saves me a lot of time. I am very very happy I have this grinder. A+++++

The STX Magnum stainless steel grinder is wonderful.  I purchased it to grind up chicken and vegetables for raw food for my two dogs.  The past 2 grinders that I used were relatively good but I would have to stop and clear jams fairly frequently or at least put it in reverse to clear the jams.  I was very happy that my first batch of over 50 lbs of chicken legs it didn't jam even once and it was so fast.  In addition to all of this the stainless steel body made it extremely easy to clean.  I am very very satisfied with this unit and even more satisfied with the customer service I received when I first received the unit.  Amazing.  Thank you.  Marilyn  Houston, TX

column9: The perfect grinder for dog and cat food!
column10: this grinder is super easy to assemble and operate, after grinding 100 pounds of dog/cat food by hand, decided it was time to break down and go electric grinder, so far tested with a "mini" grind and was super fast, easy to set up, run and clean up, wash all parts by hand, it took a couple min. and dried and stored...took bone in raw chicken, carrots( cut in 1/4 s yams, all with ease.... comes with excellent instructions too, was going to go with the turbo 3000, had a few questions, so called Jim, who suggested this unit and it fills my needs 100% My husband and I could not be happier!Nan

column9: GRINDERS DON'T GET ANY BETTER THAN THIS ONE!!!
column10: I purchased this grinder a little over 2 months ago from The Mercantile Station thru Amazon. Since that time have we run over 300 lbs of meat through it as my wife and I do not purchase hamburger from the stores anymore as we like to know what is inside our hamburger mix. We are also grinding up meat into hamburger for our relatives so this grinder is get a lot of good hard use. We had a smaller kitchen grinder for a couple of years before we purchased this one, but it was a much smaller size and it kept bogging down and our meat kept getting caught in the front of the grinder. This is why we decided to purchase a larger grinder with more power. The Magnum 1800W (we found out) is what is considered a size #12 grinder and not a size #5 or #8 like most smaller kitchen grinders and this larger output of meat made our job of grinding much faster. In fact we have been grinding 60 lbs of meat at a time and freezing it into 1 lb. bags. We double grind our meat with the largest grinding plate first and then follow up with the smallest plate for the second grind as this helps us mix the fat a lot easier. OK - the Pros of the grinder:1) Fast & Powerful HAWG grinder - 60 lbs. of meat (double ground) takes us around 15 to 20 minutes2) The grinder body itself is cast stainless steel easy to clean3) The parts of the grinding head are 100% cast aluminum - also easy to clean (NO dishwashers though)4) 3 stainless steel cutting blades - excellent so we can match them up with the 3 grinding plates5) Very Good instructions which also included tips on grinding meat6) Sausage Stuffing Tubes7) Tomato juicer attachment- nice extra, but we have not tried this one yet. NOW - the Cons of the grinder 1) NONE so far!We will be grinding much more meat in the future and if I come up with any extra information on the Pros and Cons of this product, I will add them to this review as time goes on, but for now we could not be happier. I can sincerely tell you if you are looking to purchase a fast and very powerful meat grinder, I would highly suggest that you buy one of these and I do not think you will be disappointed at all!

column9: Best grinder I have had bar none!!!!
column10: This is the 3rd meat grinder I have purchased, and the best by far.  We make our own raw diet for our cats, so a grinder getsa real workout from us.  We grind at least 40# of meat at a time when we use it.  With the other two grinders we had to reverse the grinder several times because meat got hung up.  Also, we would have to let it "cool down".  With this one we have NEVER had to reverse it, and the motor stays cool.  We do shut it down several times so we can crack the chicken leg bones with a mallet (we were told to do that by the manufacturer) and we do a bunch of legs at a time.  I would recommend this grinder to anyone wanting a GOOD grinder thatdoesn't hang up and have to be reversed or cooled down often.  This grinder is a real worker, and I would compare this with a grinder costing 3-4 times as much money.

I am very pleased with the product. did my winter canning with it and it work like a charm.I did have a problem when it arrived, I contacted the vendor and was shipped a new machine next day. Great customer service, any company can have a problem. Its how they back it up.I was very impressed!.
Great coffee and service. However, I am finding the same coffee at a lesser price at Bed Bath and Beyond.

Before buying this coffee, I read the other reviews, including the reviews on the box of 50.I didn't heed warning to several claims of the coffee being weak - my mistake.After trying more than 24 varieties of K-cup coffee, Green Mountain "Our Blend" is easily the weakest coffee of ANY K-cup I've ever tried. I was disappointed, but if you like extremely mild coffee, then this one may be fine for you.I tried brewing on the smallest Keurig cup size - a half cup of coffee, but this idea didn't work out. I learned to use only a fraction of half & half, otherwise the coffee would be as white as milk.For me, this box of 24 is more like having a box of 12 - because I need 2 k-cups to make a full cup of coffee.With a higher cost of coffee these days, it's important not to waste money. I personally would not recommend "Our Blend".Thanks for listening,Jeff

I have tried a lot of Green mountain coffee.  The Our blend is much much better than the breakfeast blend.  If you are looking for a reguler non flavored great tasting coffee I highly recommend this flavor coffee.
Discovered this coffee while having my KIA Optimas serviced; found the flavor medium roast, great coffee scent, delicious taste.  Highly recommend to avid coffee lovers.  gms

column9: Good for having on hand for guests
column10: I prefer an extra bold organic coffee k-cup, but I like to keep something on hand for guests who prefer a medium roast coffee.  This is smooth, light, and fair-trade certified.  Not a lot of flavor for my tastes, but totally fits the bill as a coffee k-cup with general appeal.  I would purchase it again to have on hand.
I don't regret purchasing the Keurig to taste these Green Mountain coffee.  Most of the varieties are super great!!  Thanks; price & flavor are super dupper!!
Aside from a non-flashy name, this is a great coffee.  Very smooth, perfect!  If is my favorite at this point, even over other flavored coffee.

I am a new owner of a Keurig coffeemaker. I had to experiment with different coffees, as I don't like my coffee strong. This Green Mountain light roast is just the perfect solution for me! Now I will purchase it in bulk.

I have been an avid Green Mountain Coffee fan for several years. I felt that this blend is too weak tasting for me.  It is the first Green Mountain product that I have not been completely satified with. column9: Good coffee, but not great coffee
column10: My husband and I typically buy our K-Cups from the Keurig website. We drank a few more cups than normal last month, after the birth of our daughter, and ended up running out of cups a few days early, so we bought a small box of these to tide us over until our auto-ship order arrived. I chose this blend because it's a medium roast and something we hadn't tried before.It's a good cup of coffee, and it's of a good quality, as we've come to expect from Green Mountain. It brewed up with a nice, inviting aroma which was quite welcome when the baby woke up at 3am for a few days in a row that week. It's also fair trade certified, which is important to me. There are some endemic issues with the Fair Trade Certification system, but the system as it stands is better than no system, and suffice it to say that I would be happy to pay more for a good cup of coffee with a fair trade certification, and to pay a premium for a truly fairly traded cup.Green Mountain's Our Blend gets 4 stars instead of 5 because the flavor doesn't quite live up to the wonderful aroma. I do not care for dark roasts or "bold" brews, (As far as K-Cups are concerned, "Bold" means there is more coffee in the pod in order to brew a stronger cup.) and Keurig offers several coffees which are medium roasts, and are quite flavorful. This one is quite good, but it's just a little lacking.I'd buy it again in a pinch. It won't be my go to blend, but it's inviting and tasty enough that I can recommend it without qualms.
Worst blend of Green Mountain coffee I have tasted.  Not worth the cost of packaging let alone the price itself. My guests all had the same impression "Very weak blend with no body".

I purchased this coffee after not being able to get any Kona Blend K-Cups.  It wasn't really my first choice, but I am fairly pleased with the purchase.  It is a nice blend, but not as tasty as the Kona Blend I enjoy.  I will say that the price was reasonable compared to buying at a retail store, especially since this purchase qualified for free shipping.  I might buy it again, but still prefer Kona Blend.
I love my Keurig brewer and the wonderful K-cups.  You can't beat the aroma and flavor of a fresh brewed cup of coffee!  Green Mountain produces really great flavored coffees.
Came on time and as described. I usually mix it with olive oil and use it as a dip. Clears any respiratory stuff and very yummy. Thank you!
They were a little stale, but I figured as much... the bucket isn't exactly air-tight. Still love them, these are one of my favorite candies :)
The tub is nice because the candies don't get broken en route. They're also fresh; nothing worse than stale, tough candy.
Never knew I needed this until I saw it in Food Network magazine. I ordered one for my father too. Great gift for the person who has 'everything' or doesn't need anything.

My husband is into making manly cocktails so I bought this for him since it seemed different.  We haven't figured out a lot of uses for it yet, but we discovered that it is a great addition to a bloody mary.

column9: Cat likes it. Tub looks big in the picture, but it's small in real life.
