column9: Good full flavored cup of dessert coffee
column10: This is definitely a dessert coffee.  It has a very mild blend of beans and the buttercream flavor lends its flavor to a very mellow brew.  Enjoyable and very palatable, but best enjoyed as a follow up to a meal or as a dessert accompaniment.

column9: Severe Coughing after eating one of these treats
column10: My Sheltie dog loves the treats but since giving her this bacon flavor treat she has sever coughing spells.  Deep throat spasms.

column9: A great way to learn about different flavors
column10: This is a great way of learning about different cheeses, and what there flavors are.Gorgonzola is a stronger cheese, usually used for salads - very tangy with a stronger after taste, something I think everyone can really enjoy in that matter. A classic is romaine lettuce, gorgonzola and apple slices.In contrast, gouda is a milder creamy cheese, great for breads. If cheddar were a starting point, I would say gouda is more creamy. It tends to break and crumble less easily, and really stick to bread surfaces better.Both will make you forget about the normal supermarket colby or cheddar. I recommend this sampler highly.

column9: A super excellent four cheese sampler...
column10: Once you taste the cheeses inclued in this set, you will never buy regular cheese from the supermarket again...Welcome to gourmet cheese...simply one of the best cheeses in my opinion...highly recommended...

Igourmet's Favorites is just as good as being in another country in person. Sampling the generous sized cheese's with a San Francisco sourdough and a glass of fabulous California wine, and never having to leave the comfort of my own home is the best.  Go ahead and treat yourself to a pleasant worldly experience.

I know I could never possibly afford a plane ticket to any country that may be a featured/sold item for a purchase through igourmet. So the next best possibility to experience this country would be a taste of the authenticity. I have never been disappointed in the quality and selection (cheese and teas). They may argue with my choice of wine (slightly chilled merlot) when I enjoy any luxury. Nevertheless, I ENJOY IT. You should too!
This was a gift to a friend who shared it during entertaining.  She was delighted with the quality and selection.

I am not a cheese expert nor do I claim to be one so this kind of cheese is new to me.  If you are not used to this kind of cheese you might have the same reaction I did and I guess since I am usually getting cheese that's found in the supermarket (like slices of Kraft cheese or a block of cheese) I found this cheese to be an acquired taste.  At 1st I thought the cheese was awful but than I thought about it and the main reason I thought that was since I am not used to the taste it might not be pleasing at 1st.  So I gave it a chance and over a few minutes I had found it to be great tasting and I wanted more and its the same way when someone eats it with me.  Even though when I let someone else taste this cheese they usually have the same reaction I had when I ate it the 1st time and I understand why, so I explain why it probably doesn't cater to their taste.  I have found its taste is still not for everyone so that's why I figure its more acquired if you are used to something else.  I have found any of the cheeses that came to be relatively strong tasting and always leaveing an aftertaste and that is not always a bad thing.  It was a nice way to taste the way different cheeses from different places vary.  Now that I have the taste for gourmet cheese and its grown on me quite a bit I don't know if I can go back to normal supermarket cheese anymore.

column9: Splenda Flavor Blends -- tastes good, packaging sub par

I love to take this flavor with me when I go for a hike, walk or any adventure.  I love the crunch and it really provides me with a great energy boost.... bring extra if you are with friends and family, I never return with any leftover!

Old, musty taste.  Bag not dated.  Imported from China. Nutrition information on sticker not standardized for US.  Seller not set up for refunds or returns.  Thumbs down experience.

There is no independent verification authority to confirm that this product is really organic. As far as I can tell, it is not certified organic by any authority other than the supplier and distributor. The 'Nutrition Facts" on the label have some strange entries like "Quantity of Heat" and "Thick Protein" which I do not understand. They sound like direct translations of Chinese to English. It is a "Product of China" as are most goji berries I have seen. My concern at a time when there is so much bad publicity related to food products coming out of China is that this product may be "organic" in name only and not in fact.

The Oh Henry remains the single best standard (medium track) candy bar available in the US.  Indeed, I would argue North America as a whole, although I do respect the advocates of the Aero.  While we're on the subject of Canadian candy bars, you should be aware that the Canadian Oh Henry bar is actually manufactured and distributed by Hershey, not Nestle; although I have a fondness for the Hersey company, once having worked near their original factory in Pennsylvania, both are now reputable companies, in contrast to some others I won't name.I think part of the glory of the O.H. is the simplicity which has allowed it to work as a combination even with the inevitable pressure to cheapen ingredients and chemicalize.  American candy as a whole has been hurt by this sort of cheapening, and I think this most affects wafers.  I understand that wafer based bars (like Kit Kat) are very popular, because the crisp wafer can be a vehicle to hold some of the sugar apart from the thicker ingredients, and so it gives a sparkle when you first bite in, but given that most of the caramel type fillers are corn syrup with very simple flavorings, and the quality of most wafer if you taste it on its own is pretty low, I think it makes sense to go for something with nuts--most peanuts stay peanuts no matter what.Further, and I'm not pointing fingers, I would have some concerns about cleanliness at any place that is using a lot of wafer, because unless flour storage is done in a satisfactory manner, you can find that the stocks are contaminated by various forms of fungal or animal life.  That wouldn't happen at a great firm like Nestle's, but that doesn't mean it can't happen elsewhere.  Having once had a foot in the larger business, I've become more cautious--still love the great Oh Henry bar! [4]

We couldn't drink this -- both my husband and my daughter tried it and while it didn't make them sick, they both said it had an "off" taste. Amazon didn't have an easy route for returning it so we ended up tossing it in the trash.

This product was good. It arrived quickly and was what I ordered. The only thing I didn't like was I thought since it was 24 packs it would come in a box and it didn't. Just in the bag it was mailed in. Other then that it was a great buy and very good.

I first purchased this product because I love the flavored oatmeal that Quaker makes, but found the packets too sweet for my taste and too high of a sugar content for a healthier diet. I was really excited to find the lower sugar instant oatmeal until I noticed that they contain artificial sweeteners to compensate for the reduced sugar. As someone who deliberately avoids "low fat" and "diet" products to keep artificial sweeteners out of my body, it made me mad that they did not make it more clear that this was not a less sweet version of their product, but simply an artificially sweetened one. I just feel that people should be properly warned that the food they are purchasing contains chemical sweeteners, and wanted to let anyone thinking of purchasing this know. If you don't mind artificial sweeteners, then enjoy!

This variety pack, as well as the fruit version (Lower Sugar Peaches & Cream and Strawberries & Cream) are in my desk.  I make a packet every morning when I get to work.  It takes about 15 seconds to prepare (we have a hot water dispenser so I don't need the microwave). It's the perfect breakfast in this respect.This stuff is great. Half the sugar of the "normal" version, but still tasty.  My favorite of the three is the Apples and Cinnamon, but I don't dislike any of them.  The important thing is that they taste just like I remember the "normal" variety tasting, although it's been years since I've had those. If I did a side-by-side comparison, I don't know how it would turn out.Anyway, it's good. Get it. :)

column9: "Weight Control" may be the better option
column10: After comparing the weight control version at the store to the lower sugar variety, in many ways you are better off eating the weight control variety. For the Maple and Brown sugar variety and the Cinnamon Sugar variety there is actually less sugar in the weight control formula. Another issue I have is when I add the recommended 1/2 cup per packet, it is usually too much water so pour slowly and stir when you are doing.That being said I try to start off every day with 2 packets of quaker instant oatmeal, with cut up apples in it! It is quick easy and good for you!
Tasty but low in sugar content and I really don't need to use any artificial sweetener.

Although there is no indication in the item description, this oatmeal contains artifical sweetener.  I didn't realize it until I received the package and saw that surcralose (the artificial sweetener in Splenda) was listed as one of the ingredients.

I also have this for breakfast every morning.  When I first started eating it, it seemed bland compared to the normal variety, but now the normal variety seems way too sweet.  Last time I checked, the lower sugar variety even had fewer calories than the weight control formula.  I wish it were available at a discount through "Subscribe and Save." Until it is, I'll just stock up when my store has its BOGO deals.
very good. I like eat it! it is very delicious. My roommate also very like it.  only one thing is too expensive.

column10: I am really happy with this oatmeal, tastes the same as the regular stuff, without the extra sugar. She put more sugar on the oatmeal than I put on a whole month's worth of oatmeal breakfasts. She made a separate bowl and saw how much I put on. She was shocked as to how little I put on...maybe a half a teaspoon for the whole bowl at the most. I'm not a real big fan of maple sugar and there are four of those in the box. The apple and cinnamon flavor is ok and there are four of those also. But..I'd like to find more of the lower sugar variety of Quaker Oatmeal in cinnamon and spice flavor. I looked on the web and there isn't any place that has just lower sugar cinnamon and spice Quaker oatmeal in it's own box. I found the regular version...but not the lower sugar version...in its own box. For that reason I only gave it four stars.

I eat this almost every morning at the office.  I like every flavor that comes in the package and enjoy sticking my hand in the box and pulling out a random flavor to enjoy that day.  I started eating the lower sugar version of instant oatmeal because my office-mate complained about the strong smell of the original (and I was on a bit of a health kick at the time).  I now prefer the lower sugar version and the original stuff is just too sweet.Overall, the product is great and Amazon's price for subscribing was better than what I could get at my local grocery store.  I admit I could probably find it for cheaper if I searched for it but the convenience of buying in bulk and not worrying about it on the grocery list makes it a winning choice.

I'm a health concious person, so eating something with a good source of fiber and low sugar is a big plus for me.  This tasted great especially with the variety and was very easy to make especially with my fast paced lifestyle.  I love the taste and quality of the product.I highly recommend it.

Every year I look forward to fall and winter in New England, in part because it means I can eat oatmeal again - and it's seasonally appropriate!  I'm not a fan of mess or preparation time, so "old fashioned" oats are not an option.  When I discovered a lower sugar version of a favorite childhood breakfast item - Quaker oatmeal packets - I was STOKED!These taste nearly identical to the "full sugar" variety, just a tad less sweet. ("Lower sugar" - imagine!) The first time I had them - and to be honest, the first time I have them every season - I do have a slight memory of the full-on version, but two bites in and I've forgotten about that.  These are delicious, satisfying, and I feel a bit better about the bit less sugar (and calories) that I'm putting in my body.I'm a huge fan - and going to eat some now!
This oatmeal tastes really good, and it includes my three favorite flavors. I'd buy this again. I can't tell that it has lower sugar.

I'm sorry too say taste of the products are awful and I don't like them at all.My fitness trainer told them to eat so I was eating, but it's difficult to continue with this flavors.I can't put an exact review of the product, but if you are looking for some quick oatmeal this will work.But from taste and other perspectives, this is not a good product to eat. At least I don't like them.

column9: Excellent for adults who want to reduce sugar intake
column10: I purchased this primarily as breakfast for my girlfriend, who is under strict orders from her doctor to get her sugar intake down. This is always a challenge, since she detests artificial sweeteners. As a compromise strategy, this product succeeds very well. As the boxes clearly explain, the normal sugar content for Quaker Oats cereal is 11-12 grams per packet. This product has a third of that (except for the apples and cinnamon flavor, which is half). An artificial sweetener, sucralose, makes up for any lost sweetness.Some reviewers mark this product down for misrepresentation. The product's packaging is actually quite clear and explicit about the ingredients, and while Amazon presents less information, I had a pretty good idea of what I was getting.As far as my girlfriend, she loves this stuff. She was practically ripping open the boxes before I even had a chance to unpack and organize things. Each flavor is very distinctly sweet, but not cloyingly so. The oatmeal is pleasingly coarse rather than creamy or mushy. The flavors are correct. I'm not a fan of oatmeal, and I still plan on getting more just for myself.Each packet is suitable for a child. We use two packets each for breakfast. That means the bundle of four boxes contains about 24 adult meals. Be sure to heat the water or milk sufficiently in making this. Otherwise, the oatmeal won't soak up the liquid, and it will be too goopy.So far as the rating...well, the one-star reviewers (only 2 of 5 of whom are verified Amazon purchasers) have made their point, but this is not a one-star product. It's a quality four or five-star product, and a great deal under Amazon's subscription plan.

column9: SUCRALOSE aka Splenda is used instead of sugar
column10: Very deceptive marketing. There is sucralose in this product used to make it sweeter. I fed this to my children not realizing they had not reduced the amount of sugar, simply replaced real sugar with a chemical (sucralose). If I wanted to feed my family fake sugar I would have bought the diet oatmeal. It should clearly read SWEETENED WITH SUCRALOSE on the label and NOT LOWER SUGAR.

They took out the sugar, but replaced it with sucralose.  I ordered this because I like less flavoring and more of a plain oatmeal taste.  If calories were a concern, I wouldn't eat instant flavored oatmeal at all.  Duh.Deceptively labeled and marketed, terrible product.

This product is boldly labeled "45% Less Sugar". It does not mention that it makes up the difference with sucralose, an artificial sweetener. It's only listed deep in the ingredients list. I feel this is very misleading and I am disappointed in Quaker. I've been a long time consumer of their products but they've just lost me as a customer. Hello Kashi!

This is a fantastic honey.  Most honeys you get a hint of what flower it came from.  This one you can really taste the Key Lime.  I grew up on the Florida Keys and ate Key Limes all the time and this is it.  You won't be sorry to purchase this.

I roast my own coffee at home, not commercially, just for my family, and for a church ministry called Celebrate Recovery which requires coffee for 50 people weekly. Sometimes it rains or I get behind on the roasting, so for backup I use Coffee Masters. I discovered their use at another church which goes through lots of coffee. I cannot honestly say that any coffee is as good as home roasted coffee, but Coffee Masters is close. Almost all their flavors are good, this particular one is a favorite of our people especially when blended with a good Bolivian brew. It is a very strong flavor, and you may like it straight, but if not, consider blending it with a normal coffee and you may have just the right flavor. I only give it 4 stars because of this home roasting bias that I have; others might give them another star.

I love Cameron's highlander grogg but Amazon doesn't seem to stock it so I thought I'd try this version.  It's just okay.  The flavors are not as distinct as others I've tried.  I probably would not order it again.

My wife's sister sent us Highlander Grogg coffee from another coffee maker in St Lois, and that became my new favorite coffee.  I had to find another solution when we ran out, and luckily found this on Amazon.  Boy, am I glad I did!  The flavor is awesome, and the price is reasonable.Once opened, I store the bag in the refrigerator as recommended on the package for freshness.WIll definitely buy again.

I received this product very fast and the plants looked awesome, I am in a cold environment and the plant seems to be adapting very well. I recommend this seller!!

I have been a huge fan of Venus Flytraps since I was a child and I've owned several of them over the years. Growing up in North Carolina, I never realized these plants were native to my state until I completed a college Public Speaking class. I decided to do an assigned 5 minute speech on carnivorous plants and ended up talking for about 15-20 minutes. While researching the Venus Flytrap and several others (Sundews, Cobra Lillies, Pitcher Plants, Bladderworts, Butterworts, Huntsmans Horns, etc.), I learned that the only place in the world the Venus Flytrap grows is within a 100 mile square mile radius of the mouth of the Cape Fear River in NC.This plant is intriguing for young minds and adults alike. I've spent many hours in my younger years capturing insects and feeding my Venus Flytraps. They grow best in a humid (but not wet) terrarium with lots of sphagnum moss and indirect sunlight, as they grow in a damp wooded mossy environment.Please rate this review if you found it helpful.

The seller definitely cares about the plants sold, he contacted me to let me know around when they'd be there and what to do when they arrived. The package came with thorough, easy-to-follow instructions and the plants. It's been I think about 6-7 months since I got them and they're doing great! They're huge and colorful and active eaters. I have them in a little jar by the window. They grew a cool flower right after I got them. I will definitely buy more plants from this seller!

I was very excited to receive this item so quickly.  I was imagining that this plant would already be planted but it wasn't.  I am so glad that none of the traps broke when I planted them.  The only concern that I have is one of the plants traps was completely black all the way to the roots.  I just hope that none of the other plants turn black too.  Also some of the traps are not as green as the others but maybe they are supposed to have a reddish tint to them.  Also all the traps from the roots to half way up to the stems are yellow.  I am not sure if I should be concerned about this either.  Other then that I am very happy with the plants I received and I can't wait to see if they grow bigger and have babies I can give to friends and family!

We bought these venus fly traps for use in a science fair project. We knew nothing about caring for them when we ordered. They arrived quickly and in great condition, along with planting media, pots, and directions so we didn't kill them by using tap water. They are now each in their own pot (we bought 12 plants total). We have them under a light and in a seed tray which has a heat mat under it. We need them to stay active until Thanksgiving and didn't want them to go dormant before testing was complete. Once we are done, they are going in the fridge for 3 months to sleep. They have done an amazing job keeping the fruit fly population down, even though that's not why we got them. They appear to be happy, eating bugs, and growing several new traps each. Even the moss we have them potted in appears to be sprouting now.

The Venus flytraps come in a little plastic baggy with a wet tissue wrapped around it at the roots so that it doesn't dry out. It also comes with some moss and instructions on how to set up the Venus flytraps as stated. When I received mine, two of my traps were already partially black and I could not recover them back, but like the others have said, I received 4 instead of 3 traps so it made up for it. Mine didn't really last that long, but it's probably because I didn't transplant it correctly. I think it'd help if the instructions were also a bit more clear on how to transplant it correctly and maybe possibly even pictures? In any case, the things listed within the description most definitely came within the package. Good service too as he emails you again to make sure everything is okay. (It was a little too late for me though)

the plants arrived within 5 days of hitting the order button and were very healthy. This was a present for my grand daughter and she was tickled. There were 5 plants that arrived and all have since perked up and are currently doing well under a grow light.

column9: What can occupy an active Jack Russell puppy?
column10: These chews can!  I know the writeup says they're for big dogs, but they're perfect for high-energy active chewers of any size.  They're good quality, and because of the pork layer, they qualify as what dog trainers call a "high value" treat, meaning something that a dog will really really want.  They're also good for dental health, because active chewing breaks up tartar and keeps that canine smile pearly white.  So if you need to distract your furkid while you do something that doesn't really require canine assistance (like making the bed, or putting away the groceries, or paying the bills, or...), break out the retriever rolls!As always, never give a rawhide chew without supervising your dog's chewing, because they can be a potential choking hazard, be prepared to occasionally step on a wet piece of chewed rawhide, and be aware that they do have a certain number of calories, so you'll want to limit the use of them, especially if your dog is the kind that puts on pounds at the drop of a hat.  But they're a real lifesaver -- particularly if your beloved companion turns up his or her nose at a plain rawhide chew...

These beans had very few clinkers after washing.  Rinse and sort, then soak overnight (do only one batch at a time).  Next day, simmer (SIMMER) for 2-4 hours.  Let cool and then put into a container that will easily let you change the water.  Change the water EVERY DAY for 14 days.  NO KIDDING!!!  Every day for two weeks.  The last day, add about 1/4 cup of salt for every gallon of beans.  Let sit overnight and taste.  If too salty, change the water and replace with less salt.  If not salty enough, add a little more salt.  These bean are so much better than the already prepared ones I can get in the grocery for $4.00/6oz.  Well worth the effort.  Put a couple of handsful in a bowl and get yourself a beer.

Wow! For a powder Chai this stuff is GREAT! I leave it at the office to share this warm fuzzy feeling for everyone to enjoy. Better than the Chai I buy at Green Bean and cheaper! Shipping was extremely fast as well.

I'm using this as a cured meat in veggie dishes that call for a pork component so it is fine but it doesn't have a delicious sausage flavor  to it but a milder salty pork product taste. This product was purchased to help someone who is going though chemo.  He needed something sweet but not overly sweet to help get him though those bad days after his treatments.  I have found this product to meet that very special need.  Everyone in our family enjoyed this candy and if you are looking for something to end that sweet craving without eating a bag of sugar I highly recommend this product.

If I had to pick just one candy to have for the rest of my life, it would be some fameous chocolate from Europe, but if I could choose two, Haribo Fruit Salad would come in second. This is amazing candy; I never tire of it. My wife and I consume about 30 pounds a year of this stuff, and it is definitely less costly than chocolate. The six flavors are all good, if not always identifiable. What is that green flavor, anyway? Watermelon? Maybe, but definitely not citrus. The flavors I'm sure of are Orange, Lemon, Grapefruit and Cherry. There is one that is maybe peach, or maybe passion fruit. Then, there is the enigmatic green. The soft gummi candy is coated with fine granular sugar, a nice touch. Haribo sells a version of the Grapefruit flavor in a single flavor package, and though slightly different from the Grapefruit found in this mix, it is wonderful, too.

I grew up eating these in Germany, and until I bought it on Amazon, have only eaten it once in the past 14 years. I was so excited to find it online, as I remember it being so good, but I was a little disappointed that it was sweeter than I remember. Also, the inconsistent textures within the bag didn't bother me, but part of the bag had soft (fresh?) gummies and part had hard (old?) gummies. Lemon is better than the common candy-lemon flavor, but orange tases like orange soda, but grapefruit is really the best.

column9: I should not be left alone with a bag of Haribo gummies..
column10: These candies are crazy addictive.  I had to limit myself to one of each flavor a day because I was finding I couldn't stop after 1.  After a while, I stopped following the restriction I posed upon myself and had to have my boyfriend place it up on the top shelf where my 5'2" self couldn't reach it.  Unfortunately in a weak state of mind I climbed my kitchen counter and ate more candies to my hard-working heart's content.  Did I mention I have a very strong sweet tooth?  These are very very good.

column9: Where is the Haribo rehab facility!?
column10: I am very aware that I have an addictive personality.  Especially when it comes to sweets!  I remember my Twizzler, Pop Tarts, Peeps and Jelly Fish addictions.  Currently, it's Haribo Fruit Salad that I just cannot get enough of.  I go through a bag a day, no exaggeration!  I should say I limit myself to a bag a day.In reading some of the other reviews, I see that the texture within the bulk bag might be a little iffy.  I have purchased bags with some gummi pieces that are too hard or soft.  I'm not too crazy about them, but with any luck, I'll get a bag similar to the texture that I have come to know and Love.  I have to agree with reviewer, Paul J. Carlson regarding the "flavors".  "The six flavors are good, if not always identifiable."  LOL!  Very true!  I always assumed that the green was lime.  I saw it mentioned in another site that it was apple!  So now, I see that it is passion fruit.  Hey, if they say so.  Who am I to argue?  It is hard for me to pick out which flavor I like the best as they're ALL good.  Peach used to be my favorite.  But lately, I find myself saving a couple of the cherry and grapefruit for last.Now, off I go to order my family sized bag (that I will joyously hide from my family)!Peace, Love & Haribo!  :)

column9: the whole bag in about 4 days...  :)
column10: i didn't know what addiction was until i opened this 5lb. bag of Gummi-crack!  OH MY GOODNESS!!!  Someone posted a 3 star rating because they didn't know it was covered with sugar - Look at the picture and read the product description.  They shouldn't allow ding-dongs to rate products because they don't know how to read.  This stuff is soooo flippin good I honestly can't order another bag.  I'd eat myself into a sugar coma!
I've always had a thing for this product.  Only at $6/pound, if I can find them at all, was just too much.  The price on the 5 pound bag is great.  Buy two and save on shipping!
This candy is by my far my favorite!  It so sweet, gummy and just excellent!  Beware, it is addictive!
Although loaded with sugar, I can't resist this delicious candy! I love it and so does the family. I order it every year at Christmas and share with all!

Haribo is the master of all things gummi.  The flavors of every type in this fruit salad mix are very good, even though the passionfruit one is a little elusive and an odd color (green).  These have a more tender texture than something like a gummi bear, which is why they are coated in sucrose.

column9: Six stars if it were Harry and David tasting...but very close
column10: For many years I've purchased or received as a gift these candies from Harry and David. Since there isn't one nearby where we currently live I tried to order online from Harry and David but they only offer it in their stores.Surprising since one....this forces me to look elsewhere and two...they are losing revenue and three...maybe a customer. These candies I rate as a five as Harry and Davids have a touch more to give them a six. This is a very good price as the one pound bag of these at Harry and Davids store is about 7.00. I will be purchasing these from Amazon again.Sorry Harry....
I prefer the Tropical Fruit variety that comes from Germany, but these are also tasty and addictive. It's a miracle that I have any teeth left.

column9: Amazing mix that is even hard to find at candy specialty stores
column10: If you love the white grapefruit Haribo candy as much as I do you wont be sorry when you purchase the Fruit Salad. The flavors are complex and realistic, you wont get horrible twizzler-esq fake strawberries with this company. If you are trying to sabotage someone's diet just send em two five pound bags of Haribo and they cannot resist. Seriously, this bag is a no-brainer, you will not regret your purchase.

column9: Texture and taste are far better than most gummis
column10: These are closer to the old Sunkist fruit gems than they are to normal fruit slices or gumdrops that you get in the grocery store bags.As for this particular bag - the candy was just a bit stale, but considering the price and source it wasn't bad - no one else but me seemed to notice - probably because most of the time this type of candy just borders on stale no matter the source.I have this on subscribe and save and plan to continue to purchase it.  It's a favorite at work, more popular even than good quality orange slices.
these did not last three days in my house  i thought i had found my favorite when i purchased the peaches from here but now i think i have found another favorite delish

My husband LOVES this candy! We originally got it on sale (6 oz for 99 cents), and he bought those out.  He had to go online to find this huge 5 pound bag.  We ordered it ONE MONTH ago, and we've already ordered another bag.  The candy has excellent fruit taste, even grapefruit flavored, and I hope this doesn't make him diabetic.

If you want the best value.  This 5 pounder is the way to go.Combination of their rubbery and less rubbery gummies. Each one is coated by sugar shaped granules but is not as sweet and not as messy that it scatters everywhere. A single piece is a good bite size; certainly much bigger than their gummy bears.Nice combination of flavors. I don't think they taste quite extraordinary; but nevertheless decent candies coming from the world's leading maker of gummi bears.
I ordered the 5 pounds of Haribo Fruit Salad and it arrived on time and packed in good condition. The product was fresh and I was very satisfied with the product and price.

column9: Haribo Gummi Candy, Fruit Salad, 5-Pound Bag
column10: Aboout 2 pounds of the 5 pound bag melted due to heat during shipping.  The candy is great and usually I do not have any concerns.
My favorite gummies! Grapefruit, peach, apple, orange, lemon, and not sure what green ones are but theyre all delish. They have a light sugar coating, old-fashioned style, lightly chewy.
These are really good! And the bag is huge. It came in great shape in just a day or two.
the best and freshest gummy s I have ever tasted the flavor is incredible on Amazon I get 5 pounds for the price of 12 ounces locally.

These candies are delicious. The shipment arrived within 2 days of the order date (thanks to prime) and were extremely fresh! They did not have the consistency I was expecting, but they're great nonetheless. I guess I was expecting them to be a little more "tough", but that can be easily achieved after opening the bag and letting them.. stale up a bit.. But either way I was very impressed with the freshness and taste of these gummi candies as well as the prompt delivery.

A friend gave me a small bag of this for my birthday a couple of years ago.  It was soooo good, I could hardly put the bag down.  When I found out she had purchased this item on Amazon, I promptly got an account for myself and ordered a 5 pound bag of fruit salad and a 5 pound bag of peach flavor.  I would have put this stuff on auto order but was vetoed by the boss (my wife).  I still sneak in an order for one or two of the various flavors every now and then.  Once you start nibbling, you can't hardly stop!!
OMG sooooo good and much cheaper to buy them this way.  They used to sell this stuff in the malls and it was several dollars a pound...  I am addicted

Finest Teutonic gummy candy. If you ever tried this you know what it is and you are getting your credit card right now. I would give it 6 out of 5 stars (yes, they are that good) but more then once they were delivered stale. Still good but they could have been amazing.

column9: Haribo's Gummi Candy, Charlene's book club's favorite
column10: I absolutely love this candy and look forward to ordering it.  It is delivered fresh and fast and all my friends love it too.  I share with my book club each Thursday afternoon and will no doubt use this as Christmas stocking stuffers for all my friends.  The fresh fruit taste is really good especially my favorites peach and grapefruit.  Thank you for such a wonderful product Haribo.
The Haribo gummy candy is our favorite and the price is great ...but should only be shipped during cooler weather. The last shipment was slightly melted when it got here.

These are the best gummy candies EVAR! When my sister lived in Germany she would send boxes of various European snacks and candy and would always tuck in a small bag of Haribo something-or-other. Their Fruit Salad is one of my favorites. One thing I've noticed in comparison between American gummy candy and European made Haribo, is the European flavors are stronger, sweeter, and just all around more intense. I'll put it this way, if you like the sweet-tart taste of say Starburst, Now and Later, Jolly Rancher, Airheads, etc. but prefer a softer, jelly candy then you'll probably like these. For some reason people seem to expect fruit slices to taste more like watered-down Kool-Aid than actual fruit. That being said, you may want to try a small bag of Haribo Fruit Salad before you take the 5 lb. bag plunge.

This candy has a sweet and tangy taste, and is soft and chewy.  The flavors are pretty close to what they represent RE the cherry, peach, orange, etc., taste like their respective flavors.  Yes, it does sound like that would be a "given", but some candy companies fail in that respect.  Thankfully, Haribo has succeeded in doing this with this particular candy.
I am a Gummi addict! That said, I doubt I will buy these a second time. Most of them are great but some of the flavors have an odd flavor. It's not that it's a bad flavor necessarily, it's just odd.

column9: Good, but not as good as other options
column10: First things first, don't make the mistake I did and order these in the Texas summer, they were mostly melted.That being said, I have been able to enjoy these.  The flavors are what you would expect if you have had the Haribo gummy candy in the past.  I love it.  I would recommend, however, the two grapefruit flavors and peach over this group of flavors.  They are very good, I particularly like the lime, but those others you must buy separately are superior.If you don't like grapefruit at all or peach, however, this might be the thing for you.

Everyone loved these and the whole bag disappeared within a short time. People keep talking about them too asking me to bring in more and where did I buy them. Haribo products are very tasty but this mix of fruit flavors seems to suit everyone.

Ordered these because they were out of my favorite (sour patch exploders) - and was surprised by how yummy they are. Every flavor -even the orange which is usually my leas favorite candy flavor. Also - the candy smells and tastes fresh.
This candy always tastes great. If you want it to taste even better leave it out to dry for a while until the outside becomes a little harder.
This is the best! My family loves this candy. We have taken it to softball games and when shared, they can't get enough! I have bought this several times and it is always super fresh! Thank you!
I am very satisified with my order.  It was fresh and arrived as promised.
Good taste, texture (not sticky gummy).  Was very fresh on delivery!!  Recommended. Little bit too much sugar coating, but ok.
While I found these very very tasty and yes they could be addictive, once again, they were stale and dry.  Poor quality.  I do not think this is the fault of Haribo, but they were just old.
Just a little bit too sweet for me. Good though. However, my wife and I love the Gold Gummy Bears.

I used to buy these fruit flavored candies at Byerly's and Lunds.  Then, they stopped carrying them.  I was greatly disappointed, as they were my favorites.  Recently, I discovered they were available from Amazon!  They are so delicious and taste just like the fruits...oranges, lemons, pineapple, etc.  A great sugar fix for those of us who need to stay away from chocolate (for obvious reasons!)  The price is very reasonable for 5 pounds of sugar heaven.Haribo Gummi Candy, Fruit Salad, 5-Pound Bag

column9: These are like Fruit Gems?  I think NOT!!
column10: These arrived today.  Based on another review, I had expected them to be similar to Sunkist Fruit Gems.  Any similarity, for me, was dashed as soon as I opened the bag - the candy smells like room deodorizer.  I still had hopes, though, until I tried to eat one.  The outside of the candy is as tough as shoe leather, and the inside is almost liquid.  I tried one of each "flavor" - they all taste the same, and that tast lingers - on and on and on.  Oh - and there is no nutritional information on the package - I thought that was pretty much standard now, if not a requirement.  The price is good, especially if you do Subscribe and Save, and that is why I gave this product the one star.  Personally, I would prefer to pay more and get something I like.

I've tried many, many gummis made by Haribo.  This one is TOTALLY different from the others in terms of taste and texture.  They are not as chewy as the others, almost more like a gumdrop?  I'm not even sure how to explain it.  Others may like this texture, but if you are expecting the standard Haribo chewiness like I was, you might not like this either.  The texture just ruined it for me...

column9: Great service and prices, crapy product
column10: I think a better description of all Non-Traditional, Gummy  Products as these are needed to eliminate confusion.  These Gummys, as the other Single Fruit Line are covered in Crystalised Sugar, and are more of a Sweet candy.  Traditional Gummbybears are aSoft in and out single source cansy, the one we had as kids, these are quite sweet and hard to enjoy.

I'm surprised Haribo allows their name on this product. It's nothing like their more traditional fare (Golden Bears and the like). It's something that I would expect to see from Brach's. I won't eat it (and neither will my grandkids). As it's said, live and learn.
These are lame.  They all taste the same.Gelatin is made from animal skin and connective tissue that has been chemically processed into oblivion with extremely powerful chemicals.
Great product.  I used it to make wedding mints and it worked great.  It said it was for the candy peices, but it worked for the mints as well.

But this was honestly the worst frozen pizza I have ever had, let alone the worst expensive 'premium' frozen pizza. Both Home Run Inn and Vito & Nicks frozen pizzas honestly make this taste like Playdough, which the crust was actually pretty close to in terms of taste.The cheese was nice and stringy but completely devoid of taste, just a stringy blob covering the top of the pizza. The sauce was average at BEST. The crust had the weirdest, most lifeless consistency of any pizza I have ever eaten and could barely be classified as a crust.I can hardly EVER be bothered to write reviews (this was my first online review in probably 5 years) but it was so bad I feel like I had to warn others - STAY AWAY, DON'T THROW AWAY YOUR MONEY OR WASTE PRECIOUS CALORIES EATING THIS TRASH!

I saw this at my local grocer and I love deep dish pizzas so I just had to buy this one.I followed the directions to a tee and sadly........the heavy hulking pizza turned out to be a major turd.The crust is way too hard around the edges and the inside of the crust...well have you ever eaten dough that felt like it started to expand in your stomach?Ewww.The sausage tasted like mouse droppings, the sauce was ok but nothing remarkable.The only good thing was the cheese and really?How hard is it to mess up the cheese?All in all I don't recommend this pizza it doesn't cook right even when following the direction word for word.If you want a good frozen deep dish nothing beats Davanni's.For what you're paying you should expect a product that's........you know........EDIBLE.You won't get that here.........unless you like rock hard crust with mouse poop sausage.Not recommended.
Saw this advertised on the food channel, so was anxious to try it......very disappointed.....hard crust and tasteless.....i wanted the sausage patty, but did not get it.

The new package which indicates Microwave or oven bake for a 10 oz deep dish is a lie.  I followed the directions to the letter and the crust was so hard it couldn't be broken with a hammer and the center was still cold.  Since it would be absurd to turn on the oven to bake such a small pizza for 20-25 minutes to serve one person.  That makes both cooking methods impractical and therefore the product is essentially useless and a total ripoff.  I won't get my money back, but maybe you can save yours.

Gino's East Pizza is unique. It is a crust and flavor all its own. If you expect to bite into a Domino's Pizza with a Chicago flair, you will be disappointed.  Gino's East Pizza has a unique deep deep crust that lends itself to the cornmeal style. the cheese is the first ingredient placed on the crust when building the pizza, then the (sausage) in our case, followed by a light amount of sauce. Very filling!  I would suggest no smaller that a 11 in pie, as the crust overpowers anything smaller.  The one we selected is the sausage patty. The sausage is a "manhole cover" of sausage on the top of the pizza. It's thin, but flavorful.  The manhole cover came from Chef Duff Goldman. It's one of his favorite pizzas. He has dozens mailed to his Ace of Cakes in Baltimore.  This is unique. We enjoyed it.  I would say it is worth a sample to make up your own mind.

I grew up on Mrs. Grass in the state of Ohio. I live in Arkansas now and the only place i have been able to find it is through Amazon.com. It has a much better flavor than other brands that are similar. Thank you Amazon for carrying Mrs. Grass brand for those people who know it and love it! PST

I LOVE MRS GRASS. I GREW UP ON IT AND STILL TODAY I EAT IT. I JUST ATE SOME A FEW MINUTES AGO. =) BUT I ADVISE NOBODY TO PURCHASE THIS ITEM FROM THIS SELLER. THIS IS A HUGE RIP-OFF!!!
