THIS IS A HUGE RIP-OFF BECAUSE A 5 OZ BOX OF MRS GRASS IS ONLY $1.40. $1.60 MAX IN SOME STORES. JUST LETTING YOU ALL KNOW. YOU CAN FIND THIS ITEM FOR A BETTER PRICE ON THEIR OFFICIAL WEBSITE AMONGST OTHERS.
this is a great product but very hard to find in stores ...i was thrilled to find it on amazon

As far as chicken noodle soup box mixes go, Mrs. Grass' is the best.  I had this as a kid, and I still like a bowl of it when I'm sick and want something simple.It's very easy to make, either on the stovetop or in the microwave, and there's something about the flavor egg that makes it more appealing.  The broth is really tasty and has real herbs floating in it, so it doesn't feel like it came out of a box.I have had the Lipton's variety of noodle soup mix, and it paled in comparison.  The noodles were smaller and less plentiful, and there was too much broth for me.  I'll stick with Mrs. Grass.

Amazon sells four Kraft Macaroni & Cheese Deluxe dinners. They're all pretty good. Each uses packets of cheese sauce, not packets of powder, so the cheese is never clumpy and distributes itself evenly. My husband, teenage daughter and I cooked up all four and did our own taste test. Here's what we found:This one, the Original Cheddar flavor, is good. Plenty creamy, it tastes like a homemade version of the Kraft standard (i.e., Kraft Macaroni & Cheese Scooby Doo Shapes, 5.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 24)).The Sharp Cheddar flavor (Kraft Macaroni & Cheese Deluxe Dinner, Sharp Cheddar, 14-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)) is slightly tastier, and has a subtle smoky aftertaste.The light meal (Kraft Deluxe Macaroni & Cheese Dinner - Light, 14 oz) is pretty good, ut when you try it side by side with the original flavor you can tell it's not as rich. Still, if you only buy this one you'll be happy. If you're counting calories go for it.The Four Cheese meal (Kraft Macaroni & Cheese Deluxe Dinner, Four Cheese Sauce, 14-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)) is, in our opinion, the best. With the most cheese flavor, it combines American, cheddar, colby and parmesan, and tastes similar to what you'd find at a decent restaurant. The parmesan flavor is especially noticeable.These Deluxe dinners cost about twice as much as the basic Kraft boxes, but in each case you can really taste the difference.

Kraft Macaroni and Cheese Deluxe Dinner rates five stars for taste and convenience. It's the perfect comfort food or go-to meal when you need something delicious and satisfying. I always keep it in the house. Sometimes I toss in a little left-over ham or chicken. With a little veggie on the side, it's a wonderful, fast meal and a total crowd-pleaser. If you're feeling inventive, toss some toasted bread crumbs over the top!Love it!

I have been eating this macaroni and cheese ever since my sister made baked macaroni and cheese and gave me the main secret ingredient she was using to get the base so good. This is easy to make and a decent base to make other cheesy dishes. Baked macaroni and cheese is one, the other I make a lot is homemade hamburger helper. If you brown the ground beef with half chopped onion, add the uncooked noodles and water and simmer for 10 minutes then add the cheese package along with shredded cheddar you have an easy, quick and tasty lunch or dinner!

column9: Delicious, but received extremely close to expiration date!
column10: The 3 boxes of Kraft Mac and Cheese that I was able to eat were very delicious however the expiration date was 7 days after it arrived, in fact 2 days before the estimated delivery date. I ordered this item on March 14th and it only arrived 7 days before the item's expiration date!! There are 8 boxes of mac and cheese and they have already expired now, if it had arrived 1 month before the expiration date it would be ok, but it is outrageous that you sell an item that you know is going to be shipped internationally with an expiration date so close to the estimated delivery date. In fact, the delivery estimate was from March 29 to April 13 which is actually AFTER the expiration date, this is simply scandalous!

My children, who love pasta more than life itself, both thought this stuff was weird, fake tasting, and excessively salty.  I bought two boxes since they were 2 for 1 at the grocery but will throw the other box out. Pretty inedible.

A little more expensive than your run of the mill blues, but for what it is, it's pretty good, and I didn't need any additional ingredients. if you're living alone or just want something quick and easy for the family, this is the stuff to get!
This mac and cheese isn't bad.It's better than the powdered mix stuff, and will more than go over well with dinner.
The item itself is fine but it is twice as much here than at Wal mart (plus shipping and handling)! Save your money!

Ordered on Friday, received on Tuesday. Very efficent shiping. Also very good that they had the words Gumball "REFILL" in product description, some gumballs offered will not fit in the decorative gumball machines, but these were spot on. Thanks Candy Crate. Merry X-MAS to you!!!!!!!!!!

The gumballs are good for about a minute. That's about it. Not a whole lot of flavor. The picture shows the container filled almost to the top. The one I received is 65% filled, just a little above the top of the label. Plus it barely fills the King Carousel gumball dispenser barely half way. While the gumballs taste good initially, the flavors wear off quickly, so I give this product one star for that and for the deception of the photo of the product which shows the container fills to the top when the actual product is filled partially above the label, and lastly for the heavily markup of the price which undoubtedly will increase soon. Quite a  disappointment.
Just bought this exact tub for $7.24 at my local Walmart. Don't be fooled into paying double just for the "convenience".

column9: Hard to chew and short-lived flavor
column10: We purchased this product to re-fill our gumball machine and were generally disappointed by how hard the gum was and how short-lived the flavor was, compared to other refill products we had purchased in the past.  Although we liked the price at the time, in retrospect, the purchase did not represent a good value.

I have one of those little gumball machines and got these to fill it.  I can tell there are different flavors though the flavors aren't very defined.  Still tasty enough for kids and most adults to enjoy!  And if you take a few at a time you can get some good bubbles out of it.
These are really hard to find in my town so it is great to be able to order them and get what I want quickly. My granddaughters love them so I have to have them.
Thanks, your product worked great! The gumballs have a lot of flavor and are very refreshing. I'm glad to have found you.

The double bubble gumball refill 53 oz jar was all in all great.  There were a couple things the dubble bubble folks could improve on.  My machine was empty and when I opour this into my machine it cam up to just above half.  I had to buy another 53 oz Jar to completely fill the machine. The flavor runs out a little to fast on the balls.  Other then that great product!!
I bought my twin nephews bubble gum machines for their birthday and this was great to putin the machine.  They loved it.

Just save your money and time, and just don't buy. The pictured jar of filled to the rim gumballs was not what arrived in the mail. The jar I received was filled just above the Dubble Bubble Gumball sticker. This distortion of the truth has led me to doubt my beliefs, that a picture is worth a thousands words. Don't get me wrong, it was a 53oz jar, but half full is half full. I plan to take the advise of other viewers and take my business to Wal-mart. I would advise others to do the same, especially when reputable companies use misleading photos to swindle us out of our hard earned money. And for the record, if there was a way to rate this less than one star, I would rate it a negative ten.

Thank you to the reviewers who mentioned that these gumballs are way overpriced on Amazon and suggested buying them at Walmart. I purchased them for less than half the price. My son is having a gumball themed birthday party, and I need a lot of gumballs. These jars are not as big as I had hoped they would be, so I'm glad to save what I can. By the way, these are half the size of the big gumballs you see in the big gumball machines. These are perfect for the small gumball machines for party favors, etc.
I paid almost $20 for these as a Christmas refill present.  I thought there would be alot more Gumballs than there were.  I felt ripped off after I bought it.
My amzing husband got me a gumball machine for Christmas and in it I poured these Double Bubble Bubble Gum balls and they are FABULOUS!! I recommend them highly

Granddaughter & family really enjoy the Gumballs. She is getting to save money & get the familyto buy Gumballs from her machine Dubble Bubble Gumball Refill 53oz JarDubble Bubble Gumball Refill 53oz JarDubble Bubble Gumball Refill 53oz Jar
I had a hard time finding gum for my machine.  Thei gum is perfect and the right size.  It is great and tastes good.
I just bought this exact same product at my local Wal-Mart in Minnesota for $7.24.  Great product, but too much of a price difference...

The label on the packaging says "8 fruitastic flavors" but there aren't any fruit flavors here. The initial (very) subtle flavor of the colored shell is gone after just a few bites, and then all that's left is the generic "gum" flavor.Every piece literally just tastes like confectioners sugar. No flavor variation at all. If you want fruity, check out a different brand.

I received this product which was to be a gift.  Upon opening the box, the gumballs were chipped so bad, I can't even use it for the gumball machine I bought them for.  More packing material would have saved me th money.
I hated this bubble gum. It did not hold the flavor for more than a few seconds. It also hurt my jaw as it is so hard to chew. I will not be purchasing this again.

column9: Cans of oxtail soup purchased through Amazon
column10: We looked forward to enjoying oxtail soup which is difficult to make and just as hard to procure. Although the soup we received was OK, each can was dented which lead to concern about the quality and age of the product.

Topps recently discontinued the Star Gazer Grape and the Bubble Gum/Cotton Candy Ring Pops. Plus, they are now Kosher. So, I was excited to see that someone still had the old flavors in stock. But, when they came to me, I opened the box and saw right away that they were not the Space Gems. The containers were filled w the new flavors and packaging.Space Gems had specific flavors and looked like a moon rock. The flavors were, Grape, Cherry, Lemonade and a few others.I wrote Topps and they confirmed what I already knew.I decided to return the product and get a refund.I suggest you change the description and picture of your products. The 2 ring pops in your photo are the space gems, but are now discontinued.I think they are now called Ring Pops Fruit Fest.The package came right on time and I would have kept them, if they were the Space Gems.
I buy from Omaha almost every month. Great meat and wonderful desserts! They are the main provider of meats for my family.
Our 3 yr. old Shih Tzu is very persnickety and we have tried various foods only to throw them away.  She really enjoys this so far.  We are impressed and she looks  forward to her morning feeding.

Bought the mix on a whim because my girlfriend makes the best Raspberry Chocolate Martini's and I just wanted to do her one better - and boy did I.  This mix is delightful and has incredible chocolate flavor - not artifical tasting at all. The sugared (espresso/carmal)rim is such an added tough - just yummy. Just disappointed that it is hard to find - wish I had bought more than one box - I'll learn next time - CHEERS :)

This drink mix is fabulous! Bought this at Home Goods on a whim..was having some girlfriends over..we loved it!They have been searching everywhere to buy it and keep it on hand..so happy to have found it on Amazon!!! So easy to make, and not overly sweet!

Made these on a sister's vacation. Used Vanilla Vodka. Let them freeze overnite. They were the perfect slushy, sitting on the dock drink. My mom & sisters all loved them.  Unfortunately had purchased mine on clearance at TJ Maxx. When I went back they were sold out. Thrilled to find them on Amazon. Ordered a 4pack for an upcoming Stella & Dot Jewelry party. Sure my friends will love them. Easy to make & delicious

This is the first time I tried Annie's products and it was not bad.  I found the flavor a little weak even though I added a little butter with the milk.  I found when I added some of my own Italian seasoning and crushed red pepper, the flavor perked right up.  The box says 2.5 servings, but I think it's really 2.

column9: Yummy twist on classic mac 'n cheese
column10: Only reason this item gets a 4 is because of the price. I can get this for $1.69 in my local store - and even cheaper when I have coupons (can't do that with amazon!). Otherwise, my family loves this version of organic mac 'n cheese (wish they made the larger size!). My 7 yr old doesn't mind the little green flecks - he knows they are the "special" tasty ingredient and now isn't as squeemish to see green bits in other items.

column9: weighing the cost of a moot situation.
column10: The stores near my house charge over $2 a box for the organic type. Half of me thinks it's great to have it avail on demand through Amazon for cheaper - the other half is ashamed to waste the fossil fuel on a special trip to my house.I think Annie's should be able to make their product a little cheaper by now - it's pretty dang popular. Oh Well, the Alfredo variety isn't avail thru Amazon right now anyway, so I'm stuck (again) watching for sales and stocking up - which makes the formerly-ashamed half of me happy!

column9: My favorite flavor is the Alfredo.
column10: I have tried many of the varieties offered and really like all of them.  They are nice to have on hand for when you really don't feel like having a large meal, yet you still want something warm and easy to make.  My child loves them and is pleased when a case arrives knowing that they will be available for dinner in a moment's notice.  Great flavor.  I prepare it adding one tablespoon of organic butter.  Definitely a winner!

Tastes great - a pleasant and not overwhelming flavor, great texture with the right level of creaminess and easy to cook.  Would highly recommend.  Kids love it, too.Having also tried the "Simply Organic - Alfredo Sauce" (from a packet) mixed with my own pasta, I can definitely say that this is better than how the separate mix turned out.

This is a terrific pasta product that I have enjoyed for years but have found increasingly difficult to locate in stores. Whole Foods, for example, used to carry it but has since (at least in my area) substituted their own house brand, which is not nearly as good.
Our family has eaten this brand for years, and love it.  This flavor in particular is my favorite.

My experience with this mac and cheese goes as far back as since it was introduced. I worked at a food coop while in college and we use to order directly from Annie herself. One day she (Ann Whithey) AND BERNIE (unfortunately he was in a cage in back of the van) pulled up to deliver our order. I can't say I remember her as a person since it was more than 20 years ago. I have also metMollie Katzen of Moosewood Restaurant and cookbook fame while managing a whole foods and natural foods supermarket.I can say however, that my wife and I thoroughly enjoy the Alfredo version to the point we've ordered it at least a dozen times at a dozen boxes at a time. We've experimented a whole lot with it and if you haven't added any steamed brocolli to the cooked mac and cheese we both highly suggest you give it a try. It adds flavor (especially when fresh brocolli is in season), extends the number of servings for a modest price, and might even help those who wrote about sodium levels.

column9: So much cheaper than in stores!!!
column10: This is Annie's best flavor of mac&cheese and usually it is very expensive (they stopped selling it around me about 10 years back and have recently started selling it again but at a very high price)...I love it!
My family just loves Annies brand Mac and Cheese!  This flavor is just the best and is gone in just a couple of days! It is organic as well.
For some reason, no local store stocks this variety of Shells and Cheddar.  Simply delicious because of the yummy basil!

I keep hearing about how wonderful is Annie's pasta so I tried this product. A big mistake. The sauce is extremely SALTY. I should not have purchase this product as now I have so many boxes remaining. I'll just keep the pasta and toss out the sauce packets. Stay away if you do not like your food over-salted.

I adopted my 4 1/2 year-old brown tabby, a little more than a month ago. According to his medical history from the shelter, he'd had frequent diarrhea and they gave him deworming medicine which apparently made him throw up and still didn't fix the problem. They told me the problem will soon go away since he had been just treated, so i didn't worry about it too much and took him home with me.The very next day, he had a very runny stool with dark blood spots at the end! Being a first time cat owner, I got scared and took him to the vet and she said his fecal exam result showed nothing out of ordinary and blood in stool is common for cats.I thought it would go away since I was starting to feed him good quality food, but it didn't.I kept seeing blood and loose stools in his litter box and whenever he had normal poop occasionally, I would get very happy since it didn't happen so often. Oh, and he was one gassy cat!I did my research and tried to put him on a raw diet but being a student, I just couldn't afford the time and the money. I heard canned food is better than dry, so I got him all-natural premium canned food but it didn't solve the problem.I have to admit he didn't seem to like it at first. He LOVED the previous food, but he just sniffed at the new food and walked away. It took him a couple days to get used to eating it. It's been about a week and no more diarrhea!! He's had healthy, normal poop for a week and I haven't detected any gas from him!! I still give him the same canned food, but he mostly eats the Natural Balance dry food. He doesn't go crazy over it but he seems pretty content with it, so I can't complain! It's a big, I mean BIG, relief!

I have to admit up front that it has only been a week since my two cats have started eating this food exclusively.  I don't want to jinx it, but this food is amazing.  I have a 9-year old and a 13-year old, both with extremely sensitive stomachs and can never find food that works for both of them.  I've tried the super high-end natural food which was way too rich and greasy.  I've also tried the low- to mid-range food like Science Diet, Iams, Nutro, and Purina...all sensitive stomach formulas, all with the same result - puke everywhere.After trips to the vet, multiple food changes, trying wet food only diets, considering raw diets, I finally came upon Natural Balance Chicken and Pea formula.  It was on sale at Petco, and so I got a small bag thinking if it didn't work, at least it wasn't an expensive waste.  I was skeptical, but hopeful.  Day 1, no puke.  Day 2, no puke.  Days 3, 4, 5...NO PUKE!  I can't begin to tell you what a difference it has made!  The best part is that they both WANT to eat this food.  They will meow when their bowl is empty and get excited when they hear the kibbles hit the bowl.If you have kitties with sensitive stomachs and feel like you've tried everything, I really recommend giving this a shot.  It's very reasonably priced, has NO grains and is made for cats with allergies and sensitivies to fillers.  Give it a try!

My cat was adopted from Humane Society as an adult. She demonstrated signs of allergies by excessive grooming that created red bare  spots.  I moved her to a limited ingredient diet on suggestion of my vet, and it does seem to help. She has fewer times when she engages in this excessive grooming, and her fur is in much better condition. A major plus is that she will eat this food. I had tried previously to move her to other cat foods, including Blue Buffalo and Wellness Core without success.  She has been on this food for about two years and is just back from her annual check up with good marks for her health.

My bottle feed kitten has suffered from loose or runny stools for his whole life after being weaned off the bottle. We have tried many high dollar foods and all types of sensitive stomach foods. After reading good reviews for this food I decided to go ahead and give it a try. No more loose stools within 2 days!!!! If only we had tried this product earlier. It is also important to me that my pet's food doesn't have corn fillers in it which this food doesn't. Science Diet lists it as one of the main ingredients in most, if not all, of it's foods. This product has been miracle for our baby!

column9: GREAT for Cats w/ digestive/allergy issues; they love it
column10: I have three cats, and two of them LOVE this food, one in particular. For one cat it really helped with her digestive tract issues, and whatever allergy issues she had...and for the other, he loves it and it's been a good way to keep his weight down (ironically, since it's made w/ duck). This also is made with natural ingredients (not a bunch of funky by-products), so I feel good feeding my pets Natural Balance...I highly highly recommend this (and the product line in general).

I bought this after seeing recommendations from people whose cats had digestive problems. My maine coon had the same problem and being long hair her soft stool issue wasn't pretty. Within days of feeding her this food wet and dry her problem stopped. Her poo does smell terrible but it's been like that with every good quality food she's had. In all I highly recommend this food to anyone who has a cat with digestion, loose stool issues.

After my cat developed some crazy skin allergies on top of an overgrooming issue, my vet suggested I try a strictly no-corn diet with an alternative protein (no chicken or beef.) This was one of the few foods I could find without any of those things & decided to give it a try. It has worked FABULOUSLY.Her allergies have disappeared, her fur has grown in soft & thick and I've even noticed a reduction in the stink of her poo. I highly recommend to it anyone dealing with a super-sensitive kitty.

column9: My cats do not like it
column10: We just moved, and can no longer buy the trader joe's cat food our two cats love. I ordered this because of the great reviews and healthy ingredients, hoping it would help one cat's health. (He recently had an overnight stay in a vet's office because of tummy issues.)Well, the first time I put it in their dishes, both cats just sniffed it and walked away. Later, one cat would take one in his mouth,then spit it out on the floor. These are cats who eat everything (including things they shouldn't) and get VERY excited for breakfast. Eventually, they stopped even walking toward their dishes when I poured more food in. One cat was barely eating anything. The other one (with tummy issues) suddenly became more interested in eating leaves tracked in the house. Finally, I broke down and bought them Purina One Indoor Advantage Cat Food, Hairball and Healthy Weight Formula, 7-Pound Bag at the store and they LOVE it. Plus the first ingredient is chicken (not chicken meal or by-product), not green peas. Right now they're eating half natural balance and half purina one, until they use up the bag.I'm sure this is great healthy food, if your cats will eat it. I did notice that they have very healthy looking stools in the ole litter box when eating it (Gross, but important, I know. The things we do for our cats!)Hope this helps another person who really loves her cats.

One of my cats had food allergy. He vomited once to twice a week so my vet suggested to feed him Hill's Prescription Diet d/d - Duck & Green Pea Dry Food. It helped! My cat stopped vomiting but it didn't help my wallet!  That particular dry food is extremely pricey (3.5 lbs for $24. Yikes!!)  So I had to look for alternative.  Nature Balance Green Pea & Duck is a great replacement and much cheaper (although not as cheap as I hope but I accept the fact that premium food cost more).  The only downside is that it is not available in the stores near my house. Although it is convenient to order online but still, I like to be able to pick it up in the local store.

This cat food was recommended by my vet for my slightly overweight, indoor kitty.  She's now hooked on it & turns up her nose at other food, even the same brand canned.  I had been buying it from my vet but it was a little pricy.  So glad Amazon carries it at a good price & has free shipping.  Takes most of the work out of feeding kitty.

My 10 year old tabby (Buttons) had started developing some serious skin issues. Her fur was thinning, she had scabs all over and she had a pretty gnarly case of dandruff. She was also throwing up in random places throughout the house. I found out she had allergies, we aren't sure to what exactly but decided to change her food. After spending hours researching and reading reviews online I decided on the Natural Balance Limited Ingredient food. Buttons had never had duck formula cat food so I decided to try it.Its only been three weeks and the difference is remarkable! My 10 year old cat is running amok like a kitten again. She has more vigor, has stopped vomiting and is back to chattering at me and looking for attention. Her whole personality has went from crabby and subdued to kitten-tastic, purr machine ball of fun. Her scabs are healing, she's no longer constantly itching, her eyes are clear and her cat box isn't a disaster area any longer. Not to mention, she gobbles up the food. I noticed that she doesn't eat as much as well.Bottom line: I have my cat back!

column9: My cat is doing great on this food
column10: He had developed allergies to something and just became miserable. The litter box was awful, his coat was falling out, constant gas and just began to look droopy, bumps on his stomach. I knew a trip to the vet would cost a lot so I decided after reading about this food to give it a try and it has been a true cat and money saver. He scarfed it down right away and the improvement started right away but now after a few months, he is super cat. His coat is gorgeous and the litter box has no smell I mean none and is much more solid. He never has gas now and always wants to play. It saved my cat from whatever was tearing at him and saved my wallet, after doing some quick math I made a trip to the cat toy section and gave him his cut.This has really turned out to be a great product for me and my cat.

column9: Great for my cat with allergies
column10: One of my cats has allergies and I am thrilled to have a food she loves and no more skin allergies!
My cats totally dig this food. They gobble it up with no issue and wait for more. Great limited ingredients, complete nutrition you can feel good about feeding your cats.

column9: Cat with Allergies and this is a great food
column10: My cat has severe food allergies (allergic to grains (wheat, corn, etc) and beef and chicken. I put her in the duck and green pea first then got the salmon and green pea and mixed them and she is in kitty bliss - she eats this food, has good weight and NO ALLERGY ISSUES. Most pleased with the dry and canned products! This has been a life saver for my and my cat.

I adopted two kittens a year and a half ago, and one of them instantly showed signs of IBS. This food quickly fixed all of her symptoms. Not only that, but they are very healthy and slim. Others are always asking what I feed them because they have overweight cats, and I always recommend this. Miracle food!

Other than taste preference, from my cat, haven't had a problem with her eating it.  She doesn't like the Venison.  But the chicken and duck, she devours.  They are of the 'pate' consistency.  My cat won't eat chunks.  I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this product.

My cat is a bit picky so I can say if he likes this, I would imagine most cats would like this. My problem is trying to find a food that he likes that doesn't make him have loose stools. Well, this isn't one of them. I gave four stars because he likes it and he doesn't vommit this stuff back up. Some foods he would eat, he would not tolerate well. This one he does just fine. But, the stool is the issue. Oh, and his diet is strictly dry food for your reference.

My cat suffers from a very very sensitive stomach. For months, she went though episodes of vomiting and diarrhea. We took her to the vet and tried different "sensitive stomach" foods, but nothing helped. This seems to be the only food that she can eat that will not bother her. She loves the taste of the food, she has stopped vomiting, no more diarrhea, and her coat is very shiny. The price is a bit steep, but it is a quality cat food. I would recommend this.

I was paying $70 for feline ZD. The last draw was when the vet told me I would have to bring the cat in for a physical in order to renew the prescription (it had been a year). So now, in order to continue paying for ridiculously priced cat food, I would have to spend an additional $60 office visit to get the prescription. Did some internet research and found this food. My cat has been on it for a a couple months and no allergic reactions. Her face use to swell and get puffy from normal cat food. So happy to be saving so much money, only wish I had done it sooner!

I was a big fan of Natural Balance because of the grain free formula, small kibble pieces, and competetive price.  That was until my cat became sick for a week and a $350 vet bill to determine the problem was this bag of kibble.  It was easy for the vet to diagnose: I changed my cat's food out on Monday.  By Tuesday, she was showing signs of nausea (non-social, lethargy, eating sparingly, licking her lips a lot).  On Thursday, I took her to the vet.  The vet said she had a fever and was nauseated.  She recommended I swap out the food which I did that day.  By Friday, she was showing signs of improvement, and by Saturday, she was back to her energetic self.  If you are like me and are willing to buy quality food because you love your cat, please avoid this formula.
I received my order promptly and found the Merckens Dark Coca candy coating to be the best of all the brands I found.  I would not hesitate to purchase this produce again.
Melts nicely in the microwave for coating.  Maintains a nice shiney appearance over time.  But most importantly, incredibly wonderful flavor.  One of the best chocolates I've ever tasted.
I'm all for easy to make adult beverages, and this fits the bill.  The perfect amount of sweet, and the mint flavor is divine.  Makes a great gift too!

These beans are fresh, have a nice, oily sheen and grind up a smooth brew. There is no harsh or acidic aftertaste and you can drink it black without a problem.This is a nice dark, french roast, full-bodied flavor, half decaffeinated that I grind on the finest grind to get the most out of the beans. It's nice to have a a half-decaf whole bean choice because I often have to buy separate decaf and caf beans to do the same thing.I would highly recommend this coffee.

I have been a fan of Celestial Seasonings products for many years.  I have tried many of Celestial Seasonings teas and this one is one of my favorites.I like this tea both hot and cold.  As a hot tea the honey chamomile blends into a very soothing drink.  I enjoy honey chamomile on cold evenings or when I have had a hard day.  I keep the pot on and have several cups while I relax.As a cold tea it is refreshing yet soothing.  It is a great drink to sip during conversations or when reading a good book.This is a healthy product.  The tea is caffeine free, contains no sugar or carbohydrates.  It is sodium free and has zero calories.Many Celestial Seasonings teas are herbal teas that are free of artificial ingredients.  Finally, Celestial Seasonings teas comes in a box of six that is at least $2.75 cheaper than in the grocery store.I highly recommend Honey Vanilla Chamomile Tea

This tea is the best! I put Splenda in my regular tea, but nothing at all in this one, because it has a very mildly sweet flavor, and no bitterness at all. When I was recently very sick, I made huge mugs of this tea, and didn't drink much else. It really helped! I don't detect an orange flavor, though, and was just surprised to see it on the ingredient list. I bet every batch comes out a little different, anyway. It doesn't make you sleepy, but it won't keep you from sleeping at all. Try it!

This was my first purchase of Celestial Seasonings tea, but definitely not my last. The Honey Vanilla Chamomile tea tastes superb and I can't wait to try their other flavors. Although they call it "honey vanilla" chamomile, the orange peel dominates the taste, but this is not a bad thing (if you like orange ;-). Good packaging and competitive pricing (especially when compared to Twinings) as well.

The other reviewers can definitely give you more information on this type of tea; the purpose of my review is just to recommend it. This is hands-down my favorite tea to drink in the evening as I am unwinding. I usually prepare an oversized mug of it with 2 tea bags, a to-taste amount of clover honey, and a packet of sugar in the raw. It's wonderful! I also sometimes use the same method with one bag of this tea and one bag of Celestial Seasonings' Vanilla Tea. That's also a soothing and relaxing blend. I desperately wanted to find a brand and flavor of tea that I would truly enjoy and after many, many purchases--this is it! This comes with my highest recommendations!

This teas is so wonderful!  I am not a huge tea drinker, but this tea tastes great.  I love to drink it after a stressful day, it really does relax me.  I also add a bit more honey and it turns out PERFECT.  You can't go wrong with this tea, the taste is much better then some of the other teas I have tried.

What a delicious, soothing, calming tea that caps off the night perfectly! Also, if you suffer from stomach problems (as I do) this tea tends to help calm it down a bit. It's worth it. The hint of honey paired with the tranquilizing chamomile is the perfect way to end the night.
Excellent tea at the best price.  This tea is hard to find in the grocery stores.  Why run all around looking for it when you can buy it at Amazon.com
This tea has a good flavor. It's a good blend of sweetness (without being overpowering) and herbal flavors. A nice tea to relax with.

I loved the smell of this tea but found the taste to be a bit to sickly sweet for me.  I use little, if any, sweeteners in teas, so the sweet taste of this put me off!  I have a friend who loves the sweetness, so this is going to be a matter of personal preference!
even just the smell of this when its brewing has a calming effectit is sweet and yummy. it has no caffiene naturally but does not make you sleepy

So I am not a avid tea drinker period. But I had a random coupon for celestial and thought, hey this one doesn't sound gross (was a bit apprehensive with the orange peel though). So I mad e some and put a drop or so of tazo chai concentrate in it for extra sweetness and wow was I surprised. This tea is sooooooooo good, and the extra orange peel extract makes it taste even better htan could be imagined. Definitely not my last celestial tea I am going to try (will still be keeping this in the cabinet though). :)

column9: A nice change from straight chamomile
column10: I keep pure chamomile flowers on hand because I love the flavor and aroma of a soothing cup of warm chamomile tea*. But occasionally I have a hankering for something a bit mellower, and rather than adding honey to my chamomile brew, I turn to Celestial Seasonings Honey Vanilla Chamomile. It has a lightly sweet flavor, but has no added sweetener. I brew it in a teamaker for 2.5 minutes at 175°, then drain the infusion into a serving vessel. From there, I can pour it into my cup in small quantities, where it quickly cools to the perfect, pleasantly warm drinking temperature. It's a waste to drink it hot. When the tea is warm, it takes on a creamy mouth feel that greatly adds to its already smooth character. This is just delightful stuff.*(Note to pedants: Yes...I know that technically it's a "tisane", and that "tea" is Camellia sinensis.)

I consider myself an avid tea drinker and although I don't care for most Celestial teas I do love this one.The flavor and aroma are really great and I like the hint of sweetness as well.You can't go wrong with this tea!
So perfect on a cold day - or ANY day for that matter!!! Add a little English Toffee Stevia and have a perfect treat to enjoy and share!

I can't always find this in the grocery store so I'm very glad to see it on Amazon. I'm a coffee fiend and this satisfies me as a substitute more than other herbal teas do. Maybe it's the vanilla and honey combination, but it has a nice balance and weight to it. I just scoured my cabinets to see if I had any hiding cause I'm craving a cup so bad! Good stuff. Can't wait to try it cold now that the weather is getting warmer.

My 5 yr old niece loves this stuff. She looks forward to her daily cup of tea (she makes it herself with milk & sugar)I never thought to try it until recently when I felt pretty anxious and stressed out and O M G! this stuff is DELICIOUS! It smells so yummy and comforting and its soothing and all around great! i did add a packet of splenda which gave it a little extra kick. i taste the orange peel, but nothing too overpowering. It was a little pricey at the grocery store but so worth it. i LOVE this stuff. Im hoooked!

I discovered this tea last summer when my flatmate offered me one. She reccommended adding soymilk to it. I love it and it's my favorite tea to drink at night. It calms me, but doesn't make me sleepy, just ready for bed. I think it's the best with honey and soymilk, but good with just plain milk too. yum yum yum. I love trying new teas, but I've repurchased this one over 7 times in a year.

Since my local supermarket didn't always carry Celestial Seasonings Honey Vanilla Chamomile tea, I was thrilled to be able to purchase it online at Amazon. It's a wonderful soothing & calming tea to drink, & I can drink as much as I want because it won't keep me awake like other teas containing caffine.
By far my favorite tea!  Absolutely delicious!  Sadly its not available in all grocery stores nearby.

I used to drink chamomile tea back when I was child and just needed something to settle my stomach. The blended teas of today just don't match that wonderful tea of yesteryear. However, my wife loves the honey, vanilla, chamomile combo. Like other teas we've grown to enjoy, this one is getting increasingly harder to find. Since I was ready to reorder my Stash brand Double Bergamot Earl Grey tea, it made sense to buy this at the same time. Surprisingly, even though both were ordered at the same time, this came separately even though both are being sold & shipped by Amazon. I am still waiting for the Stash tea.

I thought I liked Celestial's chamomile tea and then I tried this stuff. The aroma and taste are both extremely pleasing. The number two ingredient is orange peel, but I don't really taste too much of that. Anyways, this stuff is healthy, inexpensive, and awesome. I highly recommend it.
getting a little tired of vanilla flavor . . product good as described.. will add other chamomile to reduce vanilla flavor

My 4 month old LOVES squash and she started out with Gerber. But then I found that EB sells them in a pack of 12 for $11, while Gerber sells them in a pack of 8 for $10. EB is organic and comes in neat recyclable/reusable jars. Gerber's is not organic and comes in cheap flimsy plastic containers that aren't even worth saving. Guess which one I bought. EB, and she still loves it!-Mother Goose
i love earths best. its one of the best product out there. no chemicals. i gave it to my first baby and now im giving it to my second one.

I have been bought for my son(close to 5 month)to feed. Actually, my baby likes to eat vegetables and fruits from Earth best first trial kits than squash. But he is eating and I think that he will like more later as he is growing.

My little one has liked this one from the start; 7 months now and ordering the second box. The size is good too, as 2.5 onces of squash is about right.There have been complaints of Earth's Best carrying BPA in thier lids, but this is in all jarred baby food (due to the canning process) and does not make it's way into the food itself. All in all nutricious safe and yummy!

I feed both my kids Earth's Best brand baby/toddler food when I am unable to prepare food myself.  All flavors have a short list of ingredients, good flavor and a nice nutrition profile.I usually wrap these jars in a ziplock bag with a baby spoon and stash in the diaper bag for wholesome food on the go.  I like to feed my toddler what my husband or I eat, but it is great having a back-up if she is really not hip to the entree.Earths Best is the next best thing to mom's cooking ;)Off label use:If you are out of oil when making baked goods, like pumpkin muffins, you can add a jar of complimentary flavored baby food in a pinch and they will still come out moist! Happy accidents are worth sharing!

I usually make my own baby food but for convenience I tried a number of these when I went travelling and although she would eat them, (she basically eats anything), she didn't gobble them up like fresh proper food.  I tasted them and they really aren't that nice.  She also started  get diaper rash for the first time ever, every time I fed her these, and it cleared up every time I stopped.Basically they are good if you have no alternative, but nothing beats homemade.  They taste kind of nasty and processed and the kid could tell.  Plus a lot of the nutrients will have been processed out if them in the canning process,  so not the best thing to feed your child long term generally.  Making your food and freezing it isn't so much hassle.

Wanted my daughter to keep organic as much and long as possible so we tried this brand first & this veggie when she started solids.  I thought it smelled kinda gross at first but from the first spoonfull (& it's not so runny it won't stay on a spatula style spoon) she loved it!She'll eat a jar of this even after a full bottle if I let her!  No side effects noticed and I even tasted it & found it bland but wholesome.This is a great deal and cheaper than in store; arrives bubblewrapped to death and no weird or broken jars so far.

column9: Baby approved and BPA free lid
column10: This is a pack of 2.5 small jars, I don't know why I was expecting bigger jars, but my baby loves this squash and it's almost time to order another set. I was worried about all the reviews that mention BPA, I contacted Earth's Best and they confirmed that the lid is BPA free. I wish they made this into pouch though.

My daughter seems to really like EB's organic squash.  We have been trying to feed her all organic food, and it is so much easier to buy EB than to hunt down Gerber organic foods.  The price on Amazon (with subcription) makes buying organic baby food affordable, and we no longer have to spend time looking for sales at stores.

Earth's Best was the only company that I found that makes stage one organic squash. I insist on feeding the baby organic and wanted to make sure she had veggie options for stage one. Thank goodness for Earth's Best. There are lots of stage one fruits but few veggie options when it comes to organic so finding squash was a big deal.  Also, only one store (Babies R Us) sells stage one squash around here. The two grocery stores I shop carry Earth Best, but the options are limited.As far as the squash goes, no complaints! I like the fact that all Earth's Best foods are organic so I don't have to worry about looking at the label for the organic tag. I just wish they were less expensive or in bigger containers like Gerber organics.
My 6-month old loves this! We try to stick with Earth's Best and haven't been disappointed yet. This is a great deal on subscribe and save. Cheaper than in the store.

column9: Very good water but not the best
column10: The best water for tea is not heavily mineralized, orderless, and crisp. Crisp (vs flat) means to have disolved oxygen - which is more likely if cold and not repeated reboiled. Tap water is not acceptable due to typically being chlorinated and deoxygenated (filtering will likely not help). Some people prefer the taste of highly mineralized water (such as Tucson's tap water). And so, the two best selling brands (Pepsi Aquafina and Coca-Cola Dasani) are just straight from the tap. Coca-Cola even adds salts to help create that perfect tap flavor. But, salts can produce negative interactions with tea. Water for tea should ideally be pH neutral (7). My son feels a neutral pH is most important - but I normally drink tea with lemon juice ... and so a high pH might actually be better for the low pH of lemons. Did a blind test taste with friends and found the one water everyone liked least (always below Tucson's hard tap water) was Costco's Kirkland brand while the most popular was Fiji.Well recognized waters that tea experts around the globe agree are ideally suited for making exceptional tea include (in order of my preference):Highland Spring Non Carbonated Spring Water, 50.7-Ounce (Pack of 12) (United Kingdom)Best deal at half the price of others (pH 7.8)FIJI Natural Artesian Water, 50-Ounce bottle (Pack of 12) (Fuji) Best tasting (pH 7.5)Crystal Geyser Spring Sport, 33.8-Ounce (Pack of 12) (United States pH 7.9)Volvic Natural Spring Water, 500ml- Bottles (Pack of 24) (France pH 7.0)Nutriteam Countertop Water Distiller Stainless, Glass CollectionDon't use water immediately to allow for disolving of oxygen

I'm from Turin (Italy) and I'm used to the real Gianduiotti.I'm living in Texas now, so I decided to give these Gianduiotti a try.They are not the typical Italian brand product manufactured abroad. They are the real thing, imported from Piedmont.The shipment was perfect. At the end of July, when shipping chocolate is very difficult, the package was shipped by air and it contained a ice bag. The chocolate arrived in perfect condition. Top quality chocolate.Great service.

As Marco G. says, these Pernigotti brand Gianduiotti candies are first-rate, and Niche Imports cares enough about their products to add the cooler packs.  (You pay for that quality and the service, of course, but I think it's worth it.)  I disagree with Marco insofar as these are no more "real" than several other brands, except that Pernigotti *may* have been one of the first producers with the classic shape and composition of these smooth hazelnut chocolates.  In fact, if you go to a Lindt store, you can even find Swiss-made Gianduiotti!  Those aren't bad, but have more sugar, and taste, well, kind of like Lindt milk chocolate!  These Pernigotti use some combination of beans like in Pernigotti cocoa powder, and as a result have a richer taste.  Still plenty sweet, but less cloying than most.  (And no granules of hazelnut, as seems to be popular with some manufacturers nowadays.)  If you wanted to see what the fuss was about without actually paying shipping for a single bag, or to "risk" ordering enough quantity to amortize the shipping cost, you might try going to a Williams-Sonoma store and buying a tin of Pernigotti cocoa, and make hot chocolate with it.  Either you'll love it or hate it, and then you'll know whether or not these Gianduiotti are for you.  I feel the cocoa is way more complex than other brands, and that these candies are downright addictive -- they spoiled me against other brands, as Marco says.  I have only one minor complaint: Niche Imports takes whatever size bags and boxes the factory gives them, and never updates their listings.  So for example this product picture is a 200 gram bag, but the listing says 300 grams!  Are you being cheated?  Well, not exactly, but if you're the sort of person who gets bent out of shape about this kind of thing, e-mail them before you order.  Highest possible recommendation for this product!

column9: very good, but NOT Dilettante's "Ephemere Truffle Sauce"
column10: The picture is correct; the title is not -- this isn't "Ephemere Truffle Sauce".  This is Dilettante's "Chocolate Sauce", which tastes different than their original "Chocolate Truffle Topping", available in 10-oz. jars.  (Apparently "Ephemere" is now branding rather than referring to a specific product as it once did.)  The small jars are less pourable, more like a solid until heated, and seem to have more of that "volatile aromatics" kind of smell.  This chocolate sauce smells and tastes more like a "hot fudge sauce", i.e. a more-cooked flavor than the truffle sauce.  (No, this isn't like that awful supermarket "fudge" sauce; this has 65% cocoa!  Don't even read the supermarket ingredients list or you'll choke...)  So: If you're making coffee mocha drinks -- or make hot chocolate restaurant-style by using fudge sauce plus microwaved milk, rather than stirring cocoa powder forever on the stovetop -- then this is your stuff.  However, if you want the ultimate ice cream topping, buy the small jars instead.  Having now tasted both, I prefer to go to the trouble of making my own!  The recipe from Cook's Illustrated July/August 1997, page 21 requires two types of chocolate: solid plus cocoa powder.  I use Lindt Bittersweet bars (also available in smaller sizes at supermarkets or a local Lindt store if you're so lucky), with Pernigotti Cocoa (also available in smaller quantities at Williams-Sonoma).  Alas, these ingredients cost the same or more, plus it takes your own labor!  But the complexity of flavor -- deeper than either Dilettante product -- is worth it.

column10: This coffee is good but, for me, it's nothing special. I will buy it again because it's a nice, mellow blend, and my favorite daily coffee, Nabob, must now be shipped from Canada. However, on my first order to the Canadian company, it's taking a long time to be delivered (still haven't gotten it).The reason for only three stars is not about the quality of the coffee but the fact that the description of the product does not mention the fact that this "Kona coffee" is actually only 15% Kona. If you look very carefully at the photo of the disc, you can see that information, and there's a legal disclaimer saying that the product may not match exactly with the description. So it's my fault for not reading more carefully, but I was happy to see what I thought was 100% Kona and wasn't careful. I've bought the 15% Kona before in a local store and did know that there was such a product in the Tassimo discs, but I just read the product title and ordered.As I said, the coffee tastes good, the amount of coffee is the usual amount, neither the small cups of some European coffees or the extra large size, and I would recommend the coffee. Just be aware that this is blended coffee with only 15% Kona. And don't expect it to come in a flash, as it did when Amazon Prime delivered it.
Of all the coffee's available for Tassimo this Kona has the richest flavor and fantastic aroma byfar my favorite.

i am a true german and love  our breads and i have used this to make my own bread and now it is by far better than the breads i used to buy at wholefoods and they were very good breads, if you love the german style bread this is the solution to your problems along with a very simple recipe. i had tried so many different ways and nothing worked like this stuff!would never bake another bread without it anymore.

I used this my first time making sourdough bread.  I followed the recipe on the package and it turned out fantastic!  The crust was amazing and the taste was unbelievable.  My husband hates sourdough, but I had him try a piece right out of the oven and he loved it too.

column9: Fairly yummy, some concern over ingredients
column10: Simply based on taste, I give this "Sweet Tea" flavored water-enhancer a pretty good rating. It's certainly a lot better than Crystal Light or some of those other powders. I'm health conscious and drink pretty much nothing but water and the occasional carrot juice. After a while, I do admit, water can start to taste bland. I would occasionally like to drink something sweet without having to worry about all the sugar. Enter this MIO stuff, which seemed like it could fit the bill: in theory.I'm not a nutritionist, so I don't know how actually healthy this stuff is. My guess is that it's not healthy at all. Generally speaking, anything that tastes this sweet is not good for you. Here are the ingredients: Water, Malic Acid, Propylene Glycol, Citrict Acid, Contains less than 2% of natural flavor, Sucralose and Acesulfame potassium(Sweeteners), Potassium citrate, Polysorbate 60, Blue 1, Yellow 5, Red 40, Potassium Sorbate (Preservative).So yeah, a bunch of stuff I've never heard of plus some icky dyes. Personally, I'd just rather drink up a nice cool glass of purified water. It feels clean and tastes good. But, if for some reason you simply MUST drink something sweet, these little juice-it-ups might help out.  Overall, I'd never spend a dime on them. And I DEFINITELY wouldn't spend $6 for a little bottle. But, because it was tasty, I do give it a solid average rating.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: Yummy good, and always along for the ride!
column10: I leave these MIO Sweet Tea drops in my desk for the water at work. The office provides "purified" water which has a flat taste -- until I pump up the flavor with a few drops of this! It turns your water bottle into a nice glass of sweet tea. These are so handy, I always have one around!

column9: Similar to Crystal Light, but with flexible portions
column10: If you like Crystal Light Tea, you'll like MIO Tea.  The biggest difference is in portions.  The Crystal packets are one-size-fits-all, made for a 1/2 liter water bottle.  If your bottle is 20 ounces, you'll get a weaker tea.  If you have an 8 or 12 ounce glass, good luck estimating half or 3/4 of a packet to match your water volume.The MIO container, on the other hand, is good for any size portion, though it may take some practice to master it.  One average squeeze of the teardrop is good for 8 ounces, two for a half-liter, and so on.  Each person's squeeze is variable, so you'll need to get the hang of how much works for you, and for how strong you like your tea.My only complaint is that it's hard to tell when the teardrop container is on it's last squeeze.  I ended up with a bottle with 20 ounces of water and enough tea concentrate for about 12 - very weak tea, indeed, and a waste.I tried the Mio Peach Tea first, and the Sweet Tea is a MUCH STRONGER tea flavor.  Where the peach flavor is a light color and light taste, this Sweet Tea is a strong flavor and darker color.  But it is not a very sweet southern-style sweet tea, in my opinion.  The tea flavor is stronger, but it isn't all that sweet.

column9: A little flavor or a lot, the choice is mine
column10: I've been using MIO in my water for quite a while now. I like that it allows me to give my water that something extra, so that it makes me more inclined to get my daily intake of water in. Additionally being able to choose how much or how little flavor you add is nice too; me I found that with most of the flavors I like 2-3 quick squirts in my water bottle which holds 24 ounces. MIO Mango Peach is by far my favorite, with Sweet Tea as a close second. For some the taste may be unappetizing and I admit at first I wasn't sure I liked it, but it grew on me and now I use MIO on an almost daily basis.

column9: One of my favorite new products!
column10: My Dad is a diabetic so I am always on the lookout for Sugar-Free items that he can enjoy. Mio is now one of those products that our whole family enjoys. It's easy to use, the taste is fantastic, and even the kids think this is cool. You control the amount of product in your drink so everybody can get their desired strength of flavor. I also love the fact that I can take this along in my purse and enjoy it any where I go. So far Sweet Tea is my favorite flavor, but I plan to try all of these.  Thanks Amazon!

column9: Not bad, but I wouldn't carry it in my pocket
column10: MIO Sweet Tea is an interesting little gimmick that turns a glass of water into a drink that tastes something like sweet tea.Mostly, it tastes like the bottled or canned tea you'd find in a gas station or convenience store, but definitely not as tasty as fresh-brewed Southern style sweet tea. I didn't like it enough to drink a whole glass of it. I made some for my wife and she wasn't impressed, either, and she's more of a sweet tea drinker than I.I think I'd rather drink a glass of cold water than a glass treated with this stuff.

So, the concept of this is actually pretty good in my opinion. You have this little bottle, and you add as much of the flavor as you want to a glass of water to meet your tastes.With this flavor "Sweet Tea" I think you have to really really like sweet tea in order to appreciate this. I like sweet tea, but even at the lowest dose suggestion I could never get a taste that really suited me. I tried a couple other times with less (than recommended) and still was not able to get it to my liking.I can appreciate that this will be a product that some will absolutely love. But, I also think it is one that some people (like me) just don't like. I would be curious to try other flavors though. Maybe one of them is more to my liking.

column9: Light and refreshing, not too sweet
column10: I took away one star because I have never been a fan of plain sweet tea. I have always felt that tea needs a bit of lemon, or some other background flavor.  However, I did enjoy the beverage I made with this. The liquid that comes out needs little agitation. I used a 2 second shot, feel free to use more. I liked this, and plan to get more.

I am overall impressed with the taste of this product.  I try to drink my share of water during the day; and this product helps add variety.  For myself, I have found I'm using about a teaspoon for every bottle of water.  (16.9 oz). This gives me just enough sweetness for my taste.  If i add more than that, in my experience there is a funny aftertaste.  But that's one of the perks...you can add as much or as little as you want.  I also find the container convenient to take to work, etc.  Lastly, I feel that it is a great flavor, but nothing beats real tea.  I gave it a four because I can buy it cheaper in the store...but still a great product.

First of all, let me say that this product is not bad... it actually tastes very good, but there is a misnomer here... it does not taste like tea. Not sure what flavor I would assign to it, but it's certainly not tea - at least not the tea I grew up drinking. Would I buy this again, probably not; their mango flavor is the best by far (5 stars)... But if you try this and enjoy it, more power to you.

column9: A Cool Way to Improve Water Intake
column10: I have enjoyed this MIO Sweet Tea. It is easier to add to your water than the individual powdered drinks that always seem to end up with powder everywhere. Squirting the concentrated flavor takes a little practice - my first glass was WAY too strong, but it has a good sweet tea flavor. This would be great to drop in your purse - the plastic snap lid won't leak. I like the idea behind this and would be interested in trying other flavors to see if they are as good as the sweet tea one!

Please note this review only covers the MIO Sweet Tea flavor.Flavor - An approximation of "Sweet Tea," but not close to the real thing.  (If you give McDonald's version a 10, this ranks about a 1 in similarity and quality.)  It has a very distinct chemical flavor that lets you know that you're drinking something artificial but if you're used to diet drinks and try not to think of it as sweet tea but something "in the tea family" it'll get you by.Convenience - Very convenient and useful assuming you find a flavor you enjoy.  (Keep a bottle with you and you can make your own drinks at restaurants and save yourself a lot of money.)Value - Assuming the price remains at $19.99 for 4 bottles that each make 24 servings you're paying about 21 cents for each 8 ounce glass which is reasonable.  Even considering you'll most likely only get about 12-15 servings depending on how sweet you make each one and how large your glass is, a cost of about 33-42 cents a glass is comparable to a can of soda from the grocery store.  (Much cheaper than something from a vending machine or convenience store.)Overall I would recommend they change the name of this flavor to something less misleading like "Brownish Tea Flavored Substance." It would be more honest, although, admittedly, not as marketable.

It's just okay. I don't dislike it, but I don't love it. I like the idea of Mio. It's easy to carry in my purse so I can use it to flavor my water at work. It's much handier than the little powder packets and you can add as much flavor as you want. Not to mention, you don't have the powder flying up in your face when you pour it. It's easy to control. It won't leak out when you tip the bottle. You have to squeeze for any liquid to come out. I heard that fruit punch is the best flavor and may try it sometime. I like Mio because flavoring my water gets me to drink more water and Mio contains 0 calories.
When i received this product it had leaked out all over the place. Very bad packaging. I wasn't able to try it. So, I don't know if it tastes good or not.

column9: Good control, easy to use and portion
column10: This tea is pretty tasty, and I do like that you can control how much you put into your water.  You can make it stronger or weaker depending on your taste.  It is very convenient, easy to throw in your bag and add to your water anywhere.  Great idea for hiking, travel, camping or anytime you want a refreshing drink but don't want just plain water. The cap stays on pretty tightly but I did put my bottle in a zip lock bag just in case of leaks, though there were none. I would recommend this product for busy people or anyone on the go.  It is small, lightweight and easy to use.

column9: Easy to use, easy to carry.
column10: I do like this tea, however I think I prefer the peach tea.  Anyway, good sweet tea taste and can be lighter or stronger as you prefer.Easy to use....just put a few drops in a glass of water.  Container is small enough to keep in purse or pocket and so far I've not had a problem with it popping open.Also seems to last a long time.I do recommend this product, however considering your point of view, may be a bit pricey.  But it seems worth it.Thank You!MEF

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column9: Easy tea, ready to dress up as you see fit
column10: Of the Mio flavors, I found the tea to be the least satisfying, but a bit of lemon or mint wakes it up just fine. It's still a simple, mess-free way to fix something without calories or caffeine. I just leave the little squeeze bottle in the front of the pantry and use it whenever I want something besides water to drink.

I've had instant and canned teas in the past and was less than impressed with those products, so I was hoping for something better with the MiO Sweet Tea.  At first I got the mixture wrong-- I put 1 tsp into 8 ounces of water.  There was too much of a citrus-like after taste, and of course the flavor in general was too strong.  Once I got the mixture right (use 1/2 tsp for every 8oz), my opinion changed.  The flavor is great, and I love it!  The 24 servings of this product were gone in no time, as I made 16 ounce servings frequently.  I imagine the liquid would easily stain clothing, so be careful as you squirt it out, but otherwise I have no reservations in recommending this.

I've had MIO drinks before and they were delicious but I've not had the sweet tea before. It was no disapointment and equally great tasting. I most love about this product is the control you have as to how much flavor you can add to your drink. It was also great for making mixed drinks at parties and convenient.

I don't use these all the time but they are handy to have around when you just want something a little different.  Impact is mostly psychological since it's really just food color and artificial flavors/sweetners. But the squeeze bottle puts it ahead of the powders by several steps. No mess or empty pouches to deal with. I'll continue to keep these around.

I've been curious about these MiO Liquid "Water Enhancers" so I tried the Mango Peach flavor it was good so now I've tried Sweet Tea. It comes in a cool little bottle with a flip lid and non drip type nozzle. So, if you were so inclined, you could easily carry one around in your pocket.About two quick squirts into a bottle or cup of water (I prefer a bottle so I can shake it) is enough to flavor your water. And it is a decent flavor. Not too sweet but surprisingly it does taste a lot like real sweet tea.  My wife tried it too and was surprised at the tea flavor.One item of note is that these are not health products. They do not have vitamins. They only flavor water. I just wanted to mention that because I was not sure myself before I tried one.So it's a cool little product and if you drink a lot of water and want some flavor in it you could do worse. And it is portable and lasts a pretty long while. I think this particular one is probably my favorite flavor.

column9: Wanted to like it, but it tasted like flat soda pop
column10: I love Sweet Tea.  But it's not good for me.  Too much sugar.  So I need to cut back.I was excited when this came up for review, as a co-worker of mine had been using it.I tried it a couple of different ways - adding more or less to each bottle of water, trying to find a good flavor.  But it never ended up tasting like tea to me.  It just tasted like a flat cola.Also, I noticed that these are much cheaper in the store than they are on Amazon.

reasons I like this better than Crystal Light1. no powder mess2. dissolves better than powders since (duh) it is a liquid. -- this is especially important since I like my drinks with ice.3. With powders like Crystal Light I would often have dry clumps of powder in my drink.  Also there would often be a film that would build up on my drink bottles.  Since using MIO I have not noticed this4. smaller amount of space and more drinks -- Stores neatly in my desk drawer5. nice taste not strong or overwhelming.I had avoided buying this due to apparent cost.  however a little goes a long way and I can easily control how intensive of flavor I want in my water.

I have been using the powder mixes you can add to water bottles for a while, but I have to say I like the MIO liquids better. The best thing is that you can control how much flavor you want by how much you squirt in. With some powdered mixes, I have had to add two or three packages to get the flavor I wanted. With MIO, you just add a drop or squirt more.As to the flavor, I love Sweet Tea more than any other tea, an MIO is the best I have tasted. Far to many forget about the "Sweet" part of the Tea. This Sweet tea is sweet enough for me and as above, I can control how strong I want the tea flavor.MIO also has lots of other flavors to choose from, but I do hope they have a lemonade in the works.

column9: OK Flavor.  Mimics Sweet Tea, But Not Quite the Same.
column10: MIO Sweet Tea tastes somewhat like sweet tea once you put about 3 healthy squirts into a regular size water bottle.  With the amount of squirts necessary to produce the sweet tea flavor (tastes like tea, but not overly sweet), I doubt that the MIO bottle will actually have enough liquid to flavor 24 water bottles.Flavor-wise, the MIO sweet tea flavoring tastes somewhat like sweet tea.  The flavor resembles instant tea more than brewed tea.So, overall, the MIO sweet tea flavor is OK.  It is a nice change from the berry or fruit flavor choices, but isn't quite on par with the real thing.

I also recently tried the peach variety of this Mio water enhancer. As with that one, I felt I had to do two squeezes here to really get some flavor. And you do have to stir -- the liquid is not going to automatically dissipate in the water. Not bad things, just observations. But hey, it's a tiny little package that will flavor up to 24 glasses of water, so that's convenient.As far as the taste, it's definitely sweet tea coming through. I never knew what sweet tea was before moving to the South, having been a huge fan of straight (unsweetened) hot tea all my life. But this flavor is fine and reminds me a bit of the instant tea mixes like Nestea. At two squeezes, it's lightly sweet, not overly sweet.

column4: Writer of Books - Mage - Mom to Two "Writer, ...
column9: Cool design, great idea, not great flavor.
column10: Most importantly, in my opinion (from the sweet south) I don't think this tastes much like sweet tea at all. I am pretty used to the flavor you get from the sweet tea we sell at my BBQ pit job..or McDonalds etc. I am used to diet teas too, like Crystal Light. But this has barely any flavor and at best would be good for tea drinkers who like weak, unsweetened tea.I did give three stars because the packaging is soooo cool. It looks cool, makes you want to buy it, it's just a fun container. Also, the idea of having a wee squirt bottle you can carry in your purse or backpack or briefcase and add flavor to a bottle of water...love it! It's like a flask for the on-the-go crowd of the new millennium! It's just such a neat idea! I do think whatever flavors they offer though, need to be a lot stronger so you don't have to add so much to get a good balance.I'd say this is a great idea. I can see lots of flavors like cotton candy, (various snow cone type flavors), coffee, latte, maybe even something like broth that you could add to hot water? Cocoa! I can even see fun candy flavors, like M&M, Reeses, etc and you could mix them together in the bottle. A good future is possible, just give us more intense flavor!!

It is very easy to make a nice cup of caffeine-free drink with this product. Just add few drops into a cup of water and it tastes great. The flavor is good, but I would have preferred a little more sweet stuff in the product. You can adjust the amount of stock depending on the size of the cup. It is convenient to carry to the office. You can also use small portions, if you don't want to make a whole pitcher of tea; recommended!1. Flora Flor-essence Liquid Tea Blend 17-Ounces Glass Bottle2. Lemon Masala Chai - Organic Loose Leaf Tea - 5 Ounce Bag (Approx. 40 - 48 Cups)

I had already tried the mango peach flavor MIO and loved that.  The Sweet Tea delivers the same punch.  It is flavorful and left not after taste at all.  MIO has a repeat customer in myself and I cannot wait to try any other flavors they come out with.

Let me start off by saying that I normally don't use artificial sweeteners, except for the occasional packet of stevia added to a fruit smoothie. If I have iced tea, I drink it unsweetened. I just couldn't handle the chemical aftertaste of MIO Sweet Tea.  My husband and kids drink a lot of sweet tea that we brew at home, so I wanted them to give this sugar free version a try.  They didn't care for it either.  My youngest son, however, does like the Berry Pomegranate flavor.  Maybe someone who is already accustomed to using artificial sweeteners would like this.

column9: Tastes good & convenient - but hard to judge amount
column10: I liked the idea of adding how much flavoring to water that I want. I typically use crystal light preloaded packets, but they can be too sweet. The MIO is a ice idea because you can see how much you are adding, however the bad thing is if you are NOT using a clear bottle you have to add a little, taste add some more taste.. etc.. And then if you add TOO much, then you have to add water etc..On the whole the sweet tea tastes pretty good, but if you overdo it it tastes too sweet.. so just add a little at a time!If they re-do the bottle so that it pops say a half an ounce out per squeeze it would be a lot better!On the flavoring - you an control how sweet it is ****One the value - you can really get a lot of bottles of water out of these more if you don't like VERY sweet water ****No calories! ****Cons:However if you are not careful you can't control how much you put in (If not in a clear bottle) **Does taste a little "fake" and a little aftertaste if you do make it very sweet. **Overall I like the idea, and now that I know how much I like in a 16 oz bottle - 2 small squirts (or a light tan! color) I like the flavor.***Jim

When I first saw a commercial for this product I was a bit skeptical whether or not it would live up to expectations.  Personally I found that the product lived up to, and maybe surpassed some of my expectations.  If you are like me, constantly looking for ways to spice up your drink without the extra sugar and calories, this is a great product for you.  Mio allows you to add as much extra flavor as you want, you can add a drop, or pour the entire bottle into your drink, the result is a sugar free drink that is specifically designed by you.I personally really enjoyed this product because it has no calories, and no sugar in it.  Drinking 8 glasses of water a day is a struggle, but this is one way to get your water intake and enjoy a flavored drink without any extra calories.  If you are looking to cut back on your sugary drink intake, this is a great product to pick up, because it will allow you to enjoy a flavored drink without the sugar.

This is a neat product.  I really like that it is liquid instead of powder and a very nice "purse size".  I am a sweet tea drinker from the south....so I like my sweet tea brewed the old fashioned way best of all, but this would be great in certain instances.  It has a very nice taste close to sweet tea. I really like that it is caffeine free.  My son and daughter-in-law loved it when added to the bottle of water they are always carrying around.  They said that they would buy it for their water and try other flavors as well.  I like that it has no calories, but not the added sucralose.  I am not sure about the price...seems a little pricey to me, but I may be tempted to try the peach tea.

column9: Tastes OK and handy, but prefer real H2O or tea
column10: This flavor enhancer for water does work and tastes OK, but I don't find any value for me. I prefer plain water or real tea. But, some people might find it good because it is easy to bring along  and use when on an outing if one definitely isn't satisfied with just water. Plus, it has no calories, so will work for diet-conscious people. The only real negative is it adds an artificial ingredient to water, so there is some risk, probably negligible, but, at least for me, I would never buy it.

For those of us striving to increase our daily water intake, this is a great item to give water a little something special. I am not the biggest fan of some of the Crstal Light flavorings (which never seem to dissolve 100%). This is a little different. Instead of a powder, it starts out as a liquid, which mixes and swirls into your water very easily.The container is small enough that you could easily bring it on vaction or day to day travel.Midway down the ingredient list, is "sucralose" (which I'm not a big fan of), so I don't drink tons of it. That is the only "negative" I can think of.Mostly, I am a plain water drinker, but it is nice to have a flavored water that doesn't add carbs or calories to the waistline.I think this is a much better product than some of the others I have tried. I will be buying this again!
I keep MIO at work. A few drops to a bottle of water and I have my iced tea fix. Since the tasty tea is zero calories, it's guilt free with very little aftertaste. Good stuff!

I used to occasionally buy the Crystal Light Sweet Tea product in the summer, but the Aspartame (Nutra Sweet) Sweetener in Crystal Light would always give me headaches. The CL powder tasted kind of fake tasting to me and a little too strong.  MIO Sweet Tea, on the other hand, is a pleasant tasting liquid with good sweet tea flavor without being too sweet or strong/harsh tasting, like the CL powder.  I also like the fact that you can just slip it in to your drink without having to make an entire pitcher of the stuff.  Very clean, sweet(but not sickly) tasting tea, and there's zero calories per serving!

column9: It Tastes Better Than Water But.....
column10: MIO has created a number of liquid additives for water that add no sugar or calories to that wonderful H2O.  It is meant to give you something of a taste outside of plain old water, and I applaud them for this.  I also like the idea of having a portable container of "additive" so that I can drink it with water anywhere I go.What I'm not so wild about is the flavor of the MIO Sweet Tea additive.  It isn't bad, mind you.  It's just not the best tasting tea mix I've ever had.  In fact, no "additive" tea mix that I've come across (powdered or liquid) has ever suited my taste.  If I want tea, specifically sweet tea, I'll brew some at home and drink the real deal.This MIO additive is only good if you're on the go and are either too cheap to order sweet tea off of a menu or buy it in a pre-packaged bottle and opt for free water instead.  It's also good if you want some flavor added to your water.Overall, it's a really good idea and an okay tasting additive, but I'll stick with real sweet tea instead.

The MiO Sweet Tea water enhancer is surprisingly very good and actually does taste like sweetened tea.  I use two squeezes into 98 oz glass and the results are quite good.  This flavor is the best that I have found for the MiO series.  There is no dry or bitter after taste.  It is simply smooth tasting like sweetened iced tea.

column9: The Third MIO Flavor I've Tried...
column10: I regularly drink herbal iced teas at home, but I also bring powdered flavor packets and bottled water to drink at work.  I much prefer the flavor of real iced tea, but flavored water can be a good convenient and cost effective drink while away from home.  The MIO flavoring is a good concept for flavoring water easily since you don't have to deal with messy powders  (which often seem to spill and go everywhere), but it has some flaws that keep it from being a great product.This is the third flavor of MIO I've tried, (the other two were the Mango Peach and the Peach Tea).  The Peach Tea is still the best as far as I'm concerned, but the Sweet Tea flavor is decent.  It wouldn't fool anyone into thinking it was real Sweet Tea, but it's still drinkable (although it can have a slightly bitter aftertaste). As far as taste goes, it's about on par with various powdered flavor packets I've tried.  If you are interested in MIO, you might want to just try the Peach Tea one first because it was the best tasting of the three I've tried.
