By-products aren't even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product. It is just not a good quality cat food. I suppose you get what you pay for. I think the only reason why it was cat-approved may be because it contains artificial flavors that taste good to cats, and because I usually feed them dry food for dental reasons and wet food puts off much more of a scent for them to enjoy. I recommend to stay far away from Friskies, as it is simply a very low quality filler food. Some Friskies flavors are even worse than the ones I listed and contain no real meat. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat real, identifiable, pure, meat, and there just isn't enough real meat in this food. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you can identify and would eat yourself- provided that you eat a typical (not vegetarian or other restricted) diet. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural foods such as Natural Balance, Blue Buffalo, Halo, or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or low quality foods.
I have used these for training my puppy.  they work great.  He will do anything for one of these.
As always, we received a great product.  Our furbabies love these!!  We will continue to do business with them!!  Quick delivery as a reasonable cost too!

I rarely write reviews, but this time I feel the product turned out to be below my expectations.First - it's a really good value (at the local craft store I bought 7 pc net for $3, which is exactly twice more expensive than this product)Second - the pretty bag is made out of organza in its top part, so it arrived torn, even though it was packed well.Third - there's no true information about the size of coins. About 2/3 of them are large 2 in, but the rest 1/3 is smaller 1 1/4 in.Fourth - they are not as neat as more expensive ones: some are unwrapped, some are smashed, letters on the coins is barely visible, which is also ok for the price.Considering all of the above, the price is good, but the quality is below average. 3 stars!

Needless to say the chocolate is outstanding.  What was equally outstanding was the seller!  I needed this for a holiday gift and when I asked the seller to help... they did.  I received it the NEXT DAY!!!  That's what I call service.

column9: Delcious chocolate at a pretty good value
column10: We actually bought these locally for the holidays and they've been a total hit. The bag is so huge, you can open it and rebag them or box them for smaller packages.It really is a delicious Belgian chocolate - we used to live in Belgium, which made me a chocolate snob, and I think many of the gold coins are nothing more than that cheap, waxy tasting stuff or equivalent to a drug store candy bar.These, on the other hand, have the rich flavor of good chocolate, smooth and creamy, and the coins make them a good size for an occasional treat if you are otherwise likely to overindulge.I would definitely recommend them.There must be 150+ pieces in the bag - I took one to a huge party (about 150-200 adults and kids), spread them around on all the tables and the buffet, and there was definitely enough to go around (granted, all the kids hoarded, adults didn't eat too many). Of course, IMO, good chocolate like this is often wasted on kids! LOLOh yes - the beautiful bag also makes an excellent, reusable gift bag - we used it a few times during Chanukah.

Bag contained a huge number of chocolate coins, and not one was smashed, unwrapped or otherwise amiss. Package they come is really nice -- more attractive than shown.  Chocolate good, too.  Highly recommended.

These chocolates are delicious! I bought them for a large party and we are using them for party favors.It was hard to tell how many were in a bag but another review said about 150+, so that is what I wenton. Wow! When the bags of chocolates got here, my daughters and I counted the coins and in each bag, therewere OVER 200! I have to say that I was very thrilled about getting so many and the quality of thechocolate is so much better than the ones you might get in the grocery store. I then realized that I wantedmore of them and the seller was soooo great to talk to! They had just a few more and in less than a weekafter I ordered them, they were at my door! These are the only chocolate coins that I will ever buy againand this is the only seller that I will every buy them from!

My son has a St Patty's birthday so naturally I wanted gold coins for his party.  However, I hate the cheap and waxy chocolate I usually find and, one of my son's friends has a peanut allergy which he can't eat chocolates since they usually aren't labeled adequately.  So, I read the description really well, saw that the ingredients and allergy info were clearly listed and took a chance.  WOW!  WOW! WOW!  These chocolates are amazing!  They were a HUGE hit at the party, such excellent milk-chocolate and a beautiful, thick gold embossed wrapper.  The parent of the friend with a peanut allergy was excited that they were a safe and a special treat.  Very elegant.  Excellent quality for a more formal event.  Plus the bag is a heavy, silky, sparkly fabric that serves as a classy way of carrying and storing them.  The kids' eyes lit up when I reached into the bag and dropped golden coins into their outstretched hands.  It was almost magical ;)  I kept the leftovers in the freezer and we enjoyed them for a few weeks after the party, too!  Good to know:  I think these are a seasonal item for the holidays but they had leftovers in Jan/Feb for sale on Amazon.  Knowing chocolates keep for about a year, I figured they should be OK.  They were!  No old, white or dried out pieces.

column9: Can not be used as a gift
column10: This chocolate tasted good, I bought the bags as gifts, but they were wrapped in cheap plastic. The customer service was bad, saying the pictures were for illustration purposes only, and the shipping was slow. Cheap plastics bags sure are good Christmas Hanukkah Gift Bags. =.=

Ordered the coins in the bag JUST as illustrated.  They came with no card and no bag.  I complained and they said "sorry, we ran out of bags".  They should be forced to change their photo that included the bag and that statement that they come in a bag.  Amazing.  They even charged me the full price knowing full well that they "ran out of bags".  Today they said they will send a pre-paid envelope to me so I can send them back.  Gee, what a sweet thing to do...

Wow!  This is a great value for the price compared to other sources.  I consider myself a bit of a chocolate snob, and for the price they are pretty darn good! I did not count the coins, but I would anticipate the other reviewers were correct, 150+ coins.  1/2 dollar and quarter size.  I am going to use them for a pirate themed cake and cupcakes!

I have to say I placed my order and was hopeing that these would be wonderful! Well I recieved them this morning,(very fast I must say!) and I am so very happy!!! the bag is beautiful! the Chocolate coins are beautiful!!!! and then I tried one(maybe two hehe) and these are wonderful!!!!! the chocolate is so yummy!!! We do Elf Magic Elves for Christmas who always leave little Chocolate coins along with other surprises, and usually just pick up a bag at Big lots, they are good.....but I'm sure those Elves will be telling Santa about these...This year we are starting a new tradition for St. Patricks .. We will have a visiting Leprechaun that will stay for a week!!!! And this will be his Leprechaun Gold!!!!! The kids will go crazy for these!!!(I now have had three!...)lol...Thank god that the bag is huge!! (two hundred coins)hehe.

column9: These chocolate coins were great, no problems
column10: They tasted good, looked lovely, the bag they are in was in great shape, it was all well packed, they were not stale, and were really festive as part of our Chinese New Year's table decor. It was mostly coins between the size of a half dollar and a dollar coin, with a few coins that were bigger than a quarter mixed in. Nothing was "tiny". It was a nice array. These were shipped by amazon. For what they are, the chocolate seems quite good. I mean, you don't buy these as some kind of gourmet chocolate and only about three had slipped off part of their gold covering. I would order again.

I'm only adding this review because the other reviews had almost convinced me not to purchase these chocolates. I'm so glad I did anyway! They are in perfect condition, and as another reviewer mentioned, there are tons - plenty for the 15 kids coming to my daughter's rainbow birthday party. Whatever shipping problem they had must be resolved, because these arrived quickly and flawlessly.
Chocolates coins arrived quickly and are delicious.  Would definitely order again.The quality and quantity are as expected. Would recommend to everyone.

I should have believed the other reviewers! When I opened the box the bag that the chocolate was in was torn open and the chocolate coins were scattered all over the box! I was very disappointed! This was a gift and there was no way that I could give this to anyone! There is no way that the outer bag ripped inside the sealed box. This ccompany needs to check out what is going on with who is packing the boxes that are being shipped out!

I bought a bowl of this last week because the packaging interested me and the flavors were very appealing. I wish I would have stuck to the regular chunky soups.My first problem was that the bowl the soup came in wasnt microwaveable. This was an immediate turnoff as I am a college student and our dorms have microwaves in them but no sinks... We have to go into the communal kitchen to clean our dishes, it's a hassle. If I would have noticed that the bowl wasnt microwaveable in the beggining I wouldn't have bought it.For this I kind of expected the flavor of the regular chunky beef stew, but better... but flavorwise this soup is just really disappointing, the smell of the soup when you open the can isn't very appealing. The broth is very bitter and doesn't really taste of beef very much. The potatoes are a little on the hard side... as if slightly undercooked. The mushrooms were few and far between and didn't really taste like anything so it was kind of like eating rubber. I had my hopes up for the beef because I usually eat that if I don't like anything else, but it was very dry and had a strange flavor to it. Overall a very unpleasant, overpriced bowl of soup. I would have preferred a ramen noodle cup over this any day.

column9: better than most canned soups but don't expect a miracle
column10: I like the taste of this soup. It certainly doesn't taste home-made, but I like it a good deal more than most traditional canned soups. Actually, given the poor reviews, I was pleasantly surprised by this. However, it's still essentially canned soup, its nutrition so-so (especially the salt), and it's expensive even in the supermarket.

column9: There must be something wrong with me - I guess...
column10: Campbell's Slow Kettle Beef Stew with Bella Mushrooms is not something that I partake in on a regular basis. However, I have had it twice in about 6 months. It is not my favorite and it is not a healthy alternative to much. However, for me, the two times that I had it, I made it with a side of egg noodles and I've liked it. It's not something that I yearn for or would buy unless I had a coupon - which is the only time I will purchase it. I keep a container in my cupboard for that seldom-time scenario where I really don't want to cook something because I'm either too tired or just can't decide what I want. It's a food that I'll have in the winter after shoveling the roof and clearing the deck - I'm hungry, tired, and just a bowl of soup won't do it for me. They're also fairly compact so I can toss it in my survival bag - if I can't find anything more compact and easily discarded. So - I give it three stars as it fills a niche for me.The best way to sell this is that "whenever I eat Campbell's Slow Kettle Beef Stew with Bella Mushrooms, my stomach doesn't get upset." They can put that slogan inside one of those yellow clouds on the front of the can - "Won't Upset Your Stomach!"
Not only was I mislead by the packaging like others, the soup itself was horrible. I'd rather drink soapy dishwater.

Although it looks like a microwavable convenience meal, the container is not microwave safe.The chunks of beef and vegetables are large and hearty, however the broth is somewhat bitter.Overall, I will not purchase again.

column9: I expected much more from this soup; packaging not easy to recycle
column10: I saw an advertisement for this new line of soups and was really interested.  I often have soup for lunch at work and thought this would be a nice treat from my usual Campbell's Select Harvest or Thick & Chunky soups.  Considering how much more it cost than those soups, I had high expectations.Before I get to the taste, I want to talk about the packaging.  The usual Campbell's soup comes in a metal can that is recyclable in almost every community recycling program I know of.  This soup package will require more effort from me to recycle.  Instead of a can, it is packaged in a #5PP plastic container with an unlabeled plastic lid.  My community recycling does not accept #5PP so I will have to save it in a bag with my yogurt containers until I have enough to bring them to a local grocery store that collects it.  But even that will take work because the interior lid is an aluminum poptop and there is an aluminum lid on the plastic container.  So I will have to find a way to get the aluminum ring off before I can put it in with the plastic.  I wish Campbell's had stayed with the traditional can packaging.The extra work for recycling and the extra cost might be worth it if the soup were really fantastic.  I didn't think it was.On the plus side, the chunks of beef and potatoes are much larger than even in the thick & chunky line.  And it has portobello mushrooms.  But the carrot pieces were small and the ratio of broth/sauce (it's thick like stew sauce) to chunks of meat/vegetables was thinner than I expected for the price.  I also didn't care for the taste of the sauce.  I couldn't identify why I didn't like it but it didn't taste good to me.  This was a lunchtime "splurge" that wasn't worth the price.  I'm not sure I'd want it again even if the price were much lower.I won't buy this flavor again and, unless there is a coupon giving significant savings, I don't expect to try any of the other flavors.

Dallmayr is a smooth medium roast coffee that goes well with milk and is really a dessert coffee (for after a heavy meal).  The coffee has a wonderfully rich aroma and a slightly sweet character to its taste.  Its not bitter and is mildly acidic.  .  .  This is NOT a wake up coffee.  .  .  Those of you who are used to Starbucks will be pleasantly surprised by this coffee.  .  .

I bought this for a friend as she mentioned she had received some crazy tea from someone else with a flower in it. I went searching and found this. She said it was even better than the one she had tried. Apparently it goes great with Italian Cream Cake too! I don't drink tea, so I'll trust her taste. Plus, it really is a fun gift for tea drinkers.

Tea balls are tied together with unseemly string.  When you try to cut the string, the whole thing falls apart.  Plus, the tea doesn't taste like much of anything, nor does it smell good.  Highly disappointing.  Upon a closer search of the manufacturer, this may not be that legitimate given that it is only sold in large packages online using third party suppliers like Amazon.

I've bought many types of blooming teas and this one was a mistake. The tea they make is ok, but not incredible. The bloom looks more like a tumble weed tied in the middle with a very visible string and topped with a flower.

Finding this blooming tea was almost impossible until Amazon started promoting this item.  It is a good flavor tea, and if you have a clear pot the tea unfolds and adds to the drinking experience.  Local stores have started carrying the tea and it is double the price that you can get it here.
Each tea bloom is separately packaged so the tea stays really fresh.  Loved it!
This did not bloom nicely at all and it tastes like nothing.  Nothing that I paid $15 for.  Thanks for nothing AMAZON!

column9: bit too sweet and the cans unfortunately contain BPA
column10: The other flavors are better in my opinion because these sardines have a bit too much sweetness to them to where I can't taste the fish. The brand is good quality though. My biggest disappointment remains that this company along with many others continues to use BPA in the lining of the cans. There are other options out there that do not contain BPA but they cost a bit more. I think if more people realized you are ingesting a chemical compound that was tested to be used as female hormone replacement therapy, more people would avoid cans with these type liners. I know there is no "definitive proof" and opinions vary on whether it actually effects cancer rates, but think how breast cancer rates have sky rocketed. Remember that the next time chug a cold canned beer down you are drinking a detectable amount of female hormone replacement.

column9: Where there's Smoke there is Fire!
column10: I tried these last year at a Food Network TV roadshow in Cleveland..They were being raved about their Maple Goodness by a very famous TV chef named Michael Symon. He said it was his new "go to" snack food.These are not the boney nasty cheap sardines you see in a can ... These are beautiful fresh sardine fillets (NO BONES) Smokey and Delicate.After I tasted them I ended up buying 24 cans online because they can be very hard to find, even their online company store does not carry them.If you like good BBQ or Good Smoke Pit Meats you will not be dissapointed with this healthy Smoked Meat alternative loaded with good Omega 3's ... I have a friend who gave up the high fat BBQ he loves and he has been missing the full Smokey Flavor he craves ... These Smokey-Mapley sardines are his new favorite food item and good for his Heart! ... The taste is Smokey and Sweet from the Maple Syrup and it's just the right balance not too smokey and not too sweet ...My kids loved eating these when we were camping this year and wanted them for breakfast every morning, so good bye greasy sausage links!My favorite is to serve these with Brown Sugar Maple Baked Beans.My Wife had a Fancy-Schmancy party and she made a Dip using these and people went nuts wanting the recipe and wanting to know where they could buy them (Forget Trader Joes) This has got to be the New and Best Flavor combo for seafood for 2011 and a Blue Ribbon Winner in our house for sure!PLEASE LISTEN TO THE PEOPLE AND DO NOT DISCONTINUE THIS FLAVOR!!!!LOVE LOVE LOVE THESE!!!Wish Bar habor would Bring Maple Blind Robbins onto the market so we would have a dry smoked fish too, like beef jerky.

I'm someone who prides myself on enjoying unusual foods, so I bought these sardines almost impulsively.I won't say I dislike them, but I can't bring myself to praise them either. Perhaps they have to grow on me.I like sardines, I love maple syrup, and I usually enjoy smoked foods. The combination of the three, however, is a bit much. By itself, I cannot tolerate the overpowering sweetness combined with a distinct smokiness. The taste of the fish itself has taken a back seat to these two much more dominant flavors.It took me a while to find something that actually worked: cream cheese. Toast, cream cheese, and these sardines created a pretty good open-face breakfast sandwich. Cream cheese has a way of tempering even the strongest flavors (vegemite, smoked salmon, capers, etc). There are probably other good ingredient combinations, but I have yet to find them.Bottom line: These fish are very sweet and quite smoky. Be prepared to experiment a bit to find an enjoyable way to eat them.

They definitely could be eaten for breakfast.  I was skeptical of whether or not I would like these, but they are great and I went ahead and bought another order to take advantage of the special this month.  These are my new favorite sardines.

The combination of maple syrup and sardines does indeed sound a bit strange but it's delicious! And the sardines themselves are very impressive, I'm going to try the non-maple type by Bar Harbor as well.If you are a sardine lover, don't hesitate to try these for a twist on the ordinary.

column9: Smoked Sardine Fillets mildly glazed with Maple Syrup -Fabulous!
column10: Bar Harbor Skinless Boneless Smoked Sardine Fillets, 6.7-Ounce (Pack of 6)This product was developed to help customers new to canned fish products and looking to incorporate more healthy fish into their diets. The all-natural, wood smoked, skinless, boneless sardine fillets are mildly seasoned with pure Maple Syrup, providing a semi-glazed finish. The mild, natural fish flavor with the hint of maple makes a delicious, healthy alternative to other breakfast proteins such as bacon or sausage. These were sampled at the 2011 Summer Fancy Food Show this past weekend in Washington, D.C., and people were amazed at the flavor and finish of this product! Sure to become a favorite! Working diligently to get a product image uploaded soon!

I have only had boneless skinless sardines once before, and I was expecting these to taste similar, although somewhat sweet.  They are sweet, perhaps a little too sweet, but it does have a very good flavor.  It really reminds me of smoked herring, the kind you get in the long thin can (branded Kipper Snacks at my local store).These are pretty good.  I purchased them on sale at a local health food store - I am not sure if I would pay full price for them, though.  One good thing about this can is the size - it has 3.5 servings at 150 calories each.  A normal can of sardines only has about 150 calories total, so maybe it could be considered a better deal because of this.  However, it is kind of a meal in itself.

Just tried these and enjoyed them a lot.  They taste better if microwaved for about 20 seconds to take the chill off.  I just ate a can of them, but what if they were served with other breakfast foods, like eggs or muffins or hash browns?
I know that you're thinking "Fish and maple syrup... yuck!", but if you like bacon that has gotten into some maple syrup, this is the smoked fish version of that.  I could eat pounds of this stuff.

column9: Cans were soaked with Ammonia Floor Cleaner !
column10: The 6 cans were sealed in a plastic bag.  When I opened the bag I was hit with the PUNGENT smell of AMMONIA. The paper cardboard label wrap around each can was soggy and half soaked with a peach colored liquid that smelled like toxic AMMONIA FLOOR CLEANER !!Then when I went to the Amazon Return page, I discovered that this item CANNOT BE RETURNED !!I had high hopes for this item because I was hoping to finally find a Sardine that did not taste fishy and was willing to pay $3.47 per can. ($20.84 for 6 cans, $17.71 if you subscribe). I also liked the idea of buying an American product to support the Maine fishing industry.Fishy taste?  I AM NOT EATING SARDINES DOUSED WITH TOXIC AMMONIA FLOOR CLEANER !  I don't know if it was packed in the 6 pack bag this way by Amazon or by the Bar Harbor manufacturer, but due to the fact that these are Pop-open cans where the metal top already has a cut thin opening so that it's easy to pull the metal lid off, I am wary of eating this because the ammonia may have seeped inside because ammonia is corrosive.I should be able to at least return this but I just found out that grocery items are not eligible for return. What a let down!***UPDATE:  AUGUST 4,2012  Amazon did refund my money, Amazon is awesome!  I washed off one of the least soaked cans under running water for 10 minutes to get as much of the smelly ammonia off to see if I can salvage one can to at least taste this product.The Smoked Sardines were stiff and tasteless.  It had the texture of dried fish, and there was ZERO taste of maple syrup, none whatsoever.  Not worth the expense.Regarding the ammonia soaking, usually any product defects such as dents or dirt comes from the product manufacturer and is shipped out by Amazon as is.  This 6-can pack was in a bag which probably came from Bar Harbor that way.

A very high quality, palatable food. One of the *only* dry dog foods that all of my chis will eat. The SHIPPING CHARGE on this stuff is OUTRAGEOUS - almost as much as the food itself. Go to www.artemiscompany.com and enter your zip code. They locate a store near you where you can buy it. Most pet food stores charge about $50 for a 33 lb. bag. Save the $36 shipping fee for something else... toys and treats, perhaps. Or donate what you saved to your local rescue organization or shelter.  If you can't buy it near you, other vendors ship it for about half what these guys charge.

column4: B. K. Anderson "book, music, & aquaria lover"
column10: I've been feeding my cats a mix of nutro and this product (for variety) and they all seem to love it (two kittens and an adult cat).  The kibble is good sized and not too hard (so easy for the kittens to break up).  The ingredients look good but I wouldn't feed as an only food for kittens (even though marketed as an all ages food).

For every Dogsbar sold one is donated to a dog in need!  What a wonderful company.  I take these with us when we go hiking and keep some in my purse.  They are organic and made in the USA.  Also check out the Dogsbutter by the same company.

The 'regular' version of this biltong is mild all around. It's mild on flavor, not much coriander, salt, or vinegar taste. The texture is nice, typical biltong. The taste though is extremely oily, and extremely mild. If you like the taste of fat or oil, you're in luck. If you're looking for a strong biltong taste or healthy protein snack I'd look elsewhere.
The product was perfect exceptionally tasty and a taste of home in a far away place, would recommend this product to any homesick South African.

We were eager to try this product, in a household with one diabetic and more than one person trying to lose weight.This product is intended to take the place of pasta or rice (depending on how it is cut) and is really a pretty decent substitute. Some people are put off by the appearance or odor when the package is opened, but you'll find after you rinse with water that there is really no odor and it is perfectly bland. It derives its taste and smell from whatever you add to it. In texture, it's more chewy than pasta, a bit hard to bite through and easy to choke on. Again, this can be overcome by choosing a kind that's been pre-cut into small pieces. As a substitute for pasta, you may not do any better than this.And now I must come to the reason I titled this review "use with caution." With one exception, everyone in my household liked this product but had severe stomach cramps within a couple hours of eating it. We're pretty hearty and not inclined to have easily upset tummies or food allergies. We liked this product and wanted to use it so we gave it several tries, but with the same result each time - severe stomach cramps within a short time after eating. We eat other foods that have a high fiber content with no difficulty.So - I wouldn't suggest avoiding this product, because many people eat it without a problem. I do recommend that you try it with caution and don't order a lot of it until you know that you're able to tolerate it.

column9: Give it a try... you might like it :)
column10: Konjac (often also called shirataki) noodles are fairly new to the American market, so don't be turned off by negative reviews, learn about this product, try several different varieties, maybe several different brands, try to cook it with different meats and veggies, and I believe most of you will like this product.DO NOT expect it to taste like regular (made out of flour) pasta because it won't. These noodles are made from yam root plus fiber. Konjac noodles have no taste and will absorb any flavor you introduce into the dish. They tend to be kind of "rubbery", so if you're offended by that, try tofu shirataki noodles (these are original konjac noodles with added tofu). They are softer than original konjac noodles. They also look white which makes them look more like regular pasta. Try both kinds and then make up your mind.Both kinds come water packed and both have to be rinsed THOROUGHLY before use. I, personally, prefer original konjac noodles because (to me) tofu shirataki noodles have a fishy kind of odor, it takes longer to rinse it out of them and the smell still lingers sometimes (or maybe my nose is too sensitive). Konjac noodles can be stored at room temperature and shirataki tofu noodles need to be refrigerated.In any case, check out the many sites dedicated to this great product and I am sure you'll find a recipe or two to your liking. This product is as close as you'll get to zero calorie food. That said, let me give you one more friendly advice:this type of food is NOT nutritious, so make sure you are taking your vitamins and/or get the necessary nutrients from other foods. This product would definitely be beneficial to people looking for a low glycemic impact food.Here's just one of the sites you may want to check out:[...]
I was first introduced to OMG through their Maqui Berry powder but this was also quite a pleasant surprise!  Tastes fabulous and is a solid source of antioxidants and other healthy things.

I ordered this for a Anniversary dinner that was Italian cafe style and these were going to be gifts for each couple. They weren't at all what was pictured or advertised to be.....there were NO colorful herb inside ( as pictured) and NO red seal...the whole thing came in a plain clear glass bottle with nothing special in it or on it. Pretty deceitful on the advertisement!! I can only hope that the flavor in the bottle will be oregano flavored as described. This cost me with shipping almost $30.00, not much of a discount there for what I received, pretty disappointed!

column9: Not what is pictured but still Ok
column10: I am planning to use this as a wedding favor. The oils have a gold cap instead of red, and there are no herbs in the bottle. They are the same product sold on other sites for over $5, so I'm happy with them.
I ordered these little bottles as party favors, and I think it worked great.  They are attractive and the olive oil has a strong herb flavor.  We liked them!

column9: Horrible Supply Chain and order picking
column10: Ordered this for a party as a favor and they sent regular olive oil instead of infused. Got with cusstomer service who rushed an order again. This time they sent the same plain olive oil! Customer service was fine, but the ability to execute the proper order is definitely lacking. I'm still in the process of returning 18 bottles of olive oil to them. Frustrating.

I've been eating this rice for over 48 years.  As long as I can remember its been on my plate at dinner time; the smell of Kokuho Rose cooking is wonderful, it tastes delicious all by itself.  On Thanks Giving day eat it with gravy. The cloth bags it comes in can be made into aprons. Who needs bread at dinner when you have rice.

These are sooooo yummy! Only bad thing about these is I will eat all six boxes, so I limit my purchases!! Being gf is hard to find delicious snacks that remind me of some of my old non-gf favorites. These butter cookies are very moist and do taste like a butter cookie. Also the ingredients used in these are very high quality, which I love!! Only caution: if you are allergic to almonds these do have almond meal in them. I do highly recommend!!!

These cookies have been a special find for me since I have a problem with sugar in addition to being gluten intolerant.  The reviews range from love to hate and I would not base my purchase on them unless they were all bad but it is interesting to see the range on something I've really enjoyed and am so grateful for, being a sweets addict.  I try to keep it down to one cookie at a time but sometimes I can't resist a second one.  I think they are delicious.
These cookies are delicious, have a good texture, and are quickly becomming a family favorite.
You will like these. They are rich and heavy. Soft and chewy. They are not low-fat.Personally, I prefer the crunchier pecan varieties.

I love these cookies. They are not cloyingly sweet like most gluten free products. Sugar is, in fact, the last item on the ingredient list. Before I had to go gluten free, Pecan Sandies were my favorite cookie. These are even better, and that's saying something when it comes to gluten free.

I found these cookies to be surprisingly delicious and decadent.  They absolutely fooled my taste buds in to thinking I was eating traditional butter shortbread.  Yes, they are slightly less dense and a little more crumbly, but I found that to be a bonus.  Traditional shortbread is kind of a gut bomb if you have more than a couple bites.  And that would be my one caution with these--it's quite easy to eat more than one or two.  Prop the nutritional information up against your cuppa tea to remind you that it may be wheat and gluten free, but it is NOT without calories....I think these cookies are a find and I will definitely buy more Pamela's Products. I also appreciate the company's history and dedication to gluten-free.  This isn't some corporate giant getting on the gluten free band wagon in order to take advantage of America's latest foodie focus.

I have used Pamela's products for a long time now, and really love these Butter shortbread.  You don't feel deprived that you are not eating a REAL shortbread cookie - very buttery and not too sweet.  I highly recommend these cookies!

I love these pamela's cookies.  Her other cookies and biscotti are good too.  I would order these again.  Some flavors are not available in stores.  They are a little softer than regular shortbread cookies, not as crisp, but still have a good taste and flavor and it's easy to eat too many.

Yes! It is not like a home baked old fashion cookie but a cookie that is good and satisfies that need for a sweet. It is a little crumbly. YES it is A great wheat free and gluten free cookie but Each cookie has 130 calories and 70 fat calories out of the 130. Not a diet cookie; with 5g of sugar. I highly recommend this cookie for all people who need A great wheat free and gluten free cookie.
The only way to improve on these, in my opinion, would be to make them from only organically-grown ingredients.  The taste and consistency are unsurpassed in my experience with shortbread cookies.
Pamela's products are usually very good. These cookies, however, are not. They were horrible - bad texture, bad taste. YUCK!!!

While the overall flavor of these cookies is OK ... the texture is too crumbly and - somehow - they manage to be dry even though slightly moist at the same time.  Also, there are only NINE cookies per box.

These cookies are not of the quality I have come to expect with Pamela's Products.  In addition, there are only 9 cookies per box.I regularly use the bread and flour packages that Pamela's Products produces and highly recommend them.  These cookies fall short of quality.If you need to be gluten free, and in desperate need of a cookie only then would I recommend these.
The cookies are inedible. I was shocked after all the high reviews. The consistency is nothing like shortbread, or any other cookie for that matter.
can't tell they are for people with food sensitivities.  They are simply good cookies.
This is an excellent snack mix, not overloaded with any one item, and low in sodium.
I love this stuff!  Very tasty, even with no salt.  All I would add are chopped walnuts, but I just do that myself.

I don't like eating trail mix. It usually tastes too healthy for me. I have to admit the fact it said dietary also turned me off. But once I opened up the bag and started eating... I haven't stopped eating this and kept on buying it... its the best trail mix that I've had that is healthy too. Get it! You'll love it.

i like this mix of nuts.  it says "dietary" on it, and i'm not sure what that all means.  i know there is no salt and carb count (8g) is low.  i just bought it because i like eating nut mixtures.  this has sunflower nuts, raisins, pumpkin seeds, cashews and almonds.  the raisins add a soft texture to the crunchiness of the nuts and i like that a lot.  as far as ratio is concerned, like any nut mixture that has cashews, they are far and few in the bag.  mostly sunflower nuts.  i still don't mind though.  overall, i'll buy this mix again.  i know good sense has a lot of different products to choose from.  it's worth checking out.  it doesn't say, so it's probably not organic.
This snack mix is sooooo...good and healthy too! I usually not a fan of trail mix, but once i tried this snack, i couldn't stop! I put this in mostly everything. Yoghurt, soup, rice, etc.

Good Sense Trail Mix - Dietary Snack Mix is my favorite snack.  Most nuts are salted, but these are not.  Many snacks have chocolate and other sweet things that make them not so dietary, but this snack mix only contains raisins for its sweet taste.  I love all the little sunflower seeds and pumpkin seeds with cashews and almonds mixed in - perfect.

This is good stuff. I snack on it throughout my workday to provide a healthier energy sourcethat doesn't weigh me down. I'm on the road all day, you see. Also this product doesn'tcontain anything that will melt in the heat of the day/truck.

Good Sense Dietary Snack Mix is superior to many trail mixes.  It is excellent to use as a snack or to mix in with your breakfast cereal for that wholesome energy boost that you get from the all natural ingredients and no salt is added.  I would highly recomend this product to anyone.
Can't find these in the store anymore and glad I can get these online with you. The snack mix has sunflower nuts, raisins, pumpkin seeds, cashews, and almonds. Which I love and good for me too.

I used to buy this at WalMart every week. I love it. Then WalMart got "smart" and decided to package it themselves in a big bulky 11 oz plastic container. This product/package had been selling. That one bombed. Now I can't get it at all, so I was glad to see I could get it from Amazon. I hope you keep selling it. It's a great dietary snack.
I finally found it, a healthy snack without Sodium!! I am a very happy customer. This is easy to eat at anytime!
This is a great snack.  Lots of stuff in there.  Not salty like many nut-based snacks.  It goes fast at our house.

My wife and I absolutely love these snacks.  They're somewhat "healthy" and they're very tasty.  After we purchased these we found them cheaper at Wal-Mart.  Since then though, Wal-mart went with a cheaper "clone" from another company.  It comes in a plastic container, has the exact same ingredients, and the price is a lot less than the name brand item.

column9: Good Sense Trail Mix, Dietary Snack Mix, 8 -Ounce Bags(Pack of 12)
column10: I find this trail mix to be very satisfying as a frequent addition to my fresh salads at home.  Great mix of sunflower seeds, pumpkin seeds, almonds and raisins without the added sodium.
This line of quick noodle entrees is unusually good.  I find the Vegetable & Eggs variety the best, but the others are good too.

The product description calls this soup base "light," but I actually found it quite savory--and also quite salty, packing a whopping 1,320 mg of sodium!  The noodles are, like the name implies, those clear glass noodles, and can be a bit difficult to wrangle onto the spoon.  All that said, I'm a big cup o' soup fan, it's tasty, the dehydrated veggie brick rehydrates into some pretty decent bok choy, and I don't have health issues that require me to limit my sodium, so I don't regret the purchase.

I really hoped I'd like this one. Absolutely Not. I found the noodles to be "squishy" and the broth tasted a little bit fishy to me. I had to toss it and the remaining 5 Cups out as well. I can't say it's a faulty product, just that I didn't like the taste and noodle texture. Amazon is an amazing way to try out things that might not be easily available locally, so I'm glad that I tried it at least.

These are some of the best soups I have found. No MSG in ingredients. I love all the flavors they offer. The egg with vegetables is really good. I bought a bunch of them at Big Lots for $1.50 apiece and used my 20% discount on top of that. They are really good when you add your own mushrooms, edemame beans and Morning Star chicken like strips to it. Lot of soup for the price if you know where to shop. Makes you feel like your in some little village in China eating soup at the local hangout by the authentic flavor.

I really liked these until I read the sodium content.  The Crystal Noodle has excellent potential but the sodium content is dangerously high.  My favorite flavor is the mushroom but I recommend the company try something else for flavor and lower the salt content.  Try using sea salt for those who watch the sodium in their diets.
These noodles are very tasty and light.  Not fried or greasy, lots of vegies.  A great lunch to go that won't fatten me up!  Love them!
These have okay flavor, nothing to get excited about.  The vegetables hydrate well, but not the egg.  I like Thai Kitchen's instant rice noodles and noodle bowls WAY better.

column9: Full of veggies, low-calorie, delicious, easy to prepare
column10: I have been searching for the perfect instant noodle to eat as an easy, low-calorie meal at work, and I think I may have found it!  First of all, I love harusame (bean-thread/glass/crystal) noodles.  In my opinion they are tastier than standard ramen noodles, plus they are SO much healthier!  Now, my personal tastes aside, I am very impressed with this brand of instant noodles because the package of dehydrated ingredients is so large and FULL of good things.  In this "Vegetable and Eggs" bowl, after you put the water in, the top of the bowl is literally covered by baby bok choy and eggs.  I really feel like I'm getting a full serving of vegetables when I'm eating this.  And the baby bok choy is bright green and delicious even though it has been dehydrated.  IMPRESSIVE!!!  Some other reviewers have complained about these instant noodles being expensive, but when you think about what you get, this bowl of noodles is totally worth its price.

After finding these fantastic noodles at Big Lots for a whopping 60 cents, I fell in love with them.  Originally, I purchased the mushroom flavor.  Those were the best.  However, when I went back to buy some more, they only had the veggie flavor.  After reading the ingredients, I found that by adding a generous helping of black pepper, the broth for the veggie was just as good as the mushroom variey.Only drawback is that they are hard to find.  Amazon carries them, but at a much higher cost.  After writing the manufacturer, I was told that Amazon is the cheapest.  Since I bought out the local Big Lots, I'm limiting myself as to how many I can indulge in.  Too bad they are so expensive!
This lasted for less then 5 minutes before my APBT had it broken into sharp jagged slivers. If You have a large dog with strong jaws expect a trip to the vet if you give this to him

column9: TERRIBLE Product, easily shatters into small sharp bits
column10: DO NOT buy this product if your dog is large or has strong jaws.I am always searching for good chewing toys for our 1 year old Great Dane.  (Note that she is in the lower 10th size percentile for Great Danes, so she's not even that monstrously large or strong.)She was able to crush this bone into hundreds of tiny sharp pieces within minutes of chewing.Also, the product was very greasy and left grease stains on her dog bed.I had purchased three, but I threw the other two away with the collection of splinters from the first.
My dog loved it.  Each bone was big and lasted quite a while.  My sister's dog (the recipient of 2 of the bones) also loved it.
My dog loves the bones but they seem to splinter more than some other bones. Just have to keep an eye out
But this is amazing for beer making. I have been making heferweizen beers with this product and I am a huge fan.

column9: NOTE:  This is a bag of cracked wheat, not cracked wheat flour.
column10: NOTE:  This is a bag of cracked wheat, not cracked wheat flour.I ordered this and got a big bag of cracked wheat.  The title is incorrect.

column9: Great product for emergency baby/toddler meal. Beware of quantity!!!
column10: These taste great and are an easy meal or snack when you are out and about and need a healthy quick fix for your kiddo. The grains add a bit of heft and longevity in the tummy that the fruit only variety offer so it will satisfy your tots hunger for a good amount of time.We went through a phase for a few weeks were DD was not napping, falling asleep at 5:00 PM for the night but waking up crying because of night terrors and hunger at 11:00 PM. She'd be tired, grumpy and in no mind to go to the table and eat a meal.  It was hard to get her to eat something since she was so upset.  I tried the pouch meals and it worked so much better than trying to spoon yogurt into her mouth.  I would comfort her on my lap in a rocking chair and feed her one of these. She calmed down so much quicker as she slurped it up and was able to fall asleep and sleep until morning. YAY!These are also easy to toss in the diaper bag.  No glass jar to break if it gets dropped or kicked which is a great relief since I used to keep Earths Best jars wrapped in a ziplock in my bag before these pouches and was a little worried that one day one would break. I have not had a pouch explode on me, but I still pop it in a ziplock just to be safe.I ordered one pack of these, shipping weight listed as over 3 pounds, so for the price it was for a 12 pack.  I got one single pouch, not one 12 pack as described so beware of that! Amazon made it right, but not getting what I ordered was frustrating.  Very good product though.
My kids like this packed with their lunck for school. The size of the cans is also convienient. And, its healthy. whats not to like!

column9: Great Alternative to Oreos and Other Sandwich Cookies
column10: I thought these cookies were a bit pricey, but with Subscribe and Save, the price is comparable to other organic sweets on the market. Luckily for me, the taste was NOT like other organic sweets on the market, and that is a good thing. While other organic cookies can be very dry and crumble after a single bite, the Late July cookies have a creamy filling that isn't greasy like Oreos. The outer cookie has a good crunch and texture that holds up well and doesn't crumble. There is no such thing as a healthy cookie, but if you get an occasional sweet tooth, these cookies are a great way to satiate that tooth without completely blowing your diet, and are organic to boot.There is no taste, smell or look of green tea in these cookies, you would never know they had green tea if it wasn't for the label. That is also a good thing, and knowing that you can get some of the great benefits of ECGC without a strong tea taste is a nice added bonus to these treats.These cookies are now my official sweet treat splurge that, in moderation, won't blow my food routine.

This is a excellent cookie.  If you want something that really tastes like a cookie with dark chocolate in it, then this is the cookie for you. Not too sweet, either. If you're watching calories, 2 cookies = 100 calories but tastes even richer.

These (the Dark Chocolate flavor) are really delicious. I have no desire to ever eat an Oreo again - these are much better. The chocolate taste is fresh and full-flavored without that chemical taste that you find in supermarket cookies. My whole family loves these cookies, too. I get extra hugs from the kids when I pack a couple of these in their lunchboxes.I do think I should warn people that the box is not kidding about these being "intense and decadent." If you like intense dark chocolate in the cookie *and* the filling, there's an excellent chance you'll love these. But if you  prefer a milder milk chocolate flavor, you may wish to look elsewhere. But for a dark chocolate lover like me, these are really awesome.

I'm not one who normally eats any cookies. I have tried plenty of cookies though. I also completely agree with the other reviewer who says these cookies are way better than Oreos. These are so much better there's really no comparison. I saw these in a store and the box caught my eye. When I saw the ingredient list it looked like something I would like with unusually high quality and healthy ingredients. I thought they were pricey but I thought I'd give them a try. Now they are one of my main foods I ALWAYS keep in stock. I highly recommend these. They are not too sweet but definitely sweet enough. I could easily eat an entire box in one day but usually struggle to keep it down to about half a box a day. Yes they are very addicting!! If you like chocolate I don't see how you wouldn't like these. These are really good!

column9: They changed the recipe. Thye're not as good now.
column10: Late July recently changed the recipe for their Dark Chocolate Sandwich Cookies without any direct notification on the packaging. They disappeared from the shelves in the Denver area and when they reappeared, they were different. The new recipe isn't nearly as good. There's less of the intense cocoa taste that we enjoyed. They're drier. The cookie is more like a dry, less tasty cracker now. Sure they're marginally healthier - a bit less fat, more whole grain and fiber, less sugar. That's fine, but the taste of the cookie has been compromised such that they're just less tasty, empty calories now at 50 calories a pop. We originally switched from Newman's chocolate creme filled chocolate sandwich cookies to Late July's because they were so much better. Now they're not as good. We live pretty far from the Denver area so we stock up occasionally. Since there was no obvious notification of the recipe change on the packaging, I bought our usual supply for a couple of months. Mistake! I'll be donating several boxes to the local food pantry. Hopefully, someone will enjoy them!

Tasted for the first time, the dark chocolate sandwich cookies today.  I am very very impressed by how truly good it is.  Nothing waxy, too sweet & fake.  It is delicious, with great chocolate flavor, texture.  I just want to thank Late July for such great snacks.  Goes great with Blue Diamond's almond milk (unsweetened version is my fav.)

These are wonderfully delicious... not too sweet, not at all bitter as some dark chocolate can be.  Wonderful on it's own or crunchy enough to stand up to milk or tea.  All of the ingredients are organic and things you can actually pronounce; they are made with whole grain and have antioxidants; honestly I think these just about qualify as health food!
I like the individual snack packs and the cookies are a treat. I will purchase again; just what I wanted.

column9: WARNING: These cookies are highly addictive!
column10: These are even better than Oreo's.  And the nutritional content is much better so you don't feel "as bad" about eating a few.  I gifted a couple boxes to a couple "Organic only" eaters.  They loved it.  The green tea flavor is almost not there, but I think this makes a more pleasant for the general public.

These are the best chocolate cookies I've tasted. They have a bittersweet taste that satisfies my cravings very quickly and really helps me on portion control. I am so glad they are available through subscribe and save!
This is a great alternative to oreos.  Lots of sugar, but better ingredients.  Cookies arrived in perfect shape (no crushing and well-within the freshness date printed on the package).
These are so good!  And 1 Weight Watchers point/each.  Problem is eating just one.
These are delicious!  Very similar to Oreos, but I think I like them better.  The chocolate ones are good too.

column9: Rich chocolate taste, semi sweet cookie
column10: The first time I tried these cookies the dark chocolate flavor bowled me over.  If you like dark chocolate, and think Oreos are just too sweet, then these are the cookie for you.

These cookies are incredibly good ! The cookie itself is crisp, and very flavorful. The vanilla bean filling is heavenly...and, they are full of organic, healthy ingredients. Wow !Late July is a great company, producing great products !

I used to love these cookies, but now they changed the recipe and they taste bland and uninspired. These used to have that certain something. Tasting these cookies for the first time was like finding a taste that was a beloved childhood experience rediscovered. Now they taste like every other mass produced chocolate cookie.When will companies understand that if it ain't broke, don't fix it. Another disaster reminiscent of 'New Coke'.We used to seek these out in the grocery stores. Sometimes we'd make a special trip to a grocery store we knew stocked them, just so we could get our 'Late July Fix'. Sadly, I see no need to ever buy these again - unless they change the recipe back to the way it was. But how are we to know, and if they do change it back, can we trust them to keep it that way?

Rhonda and Meredith are 100% correct. We have eaten dozens of these cookies and loved, loved, loved them. They were missing from local stores for a few months. Finally they reappeared so I grabbed a box. YIKES. In my email to Late July I said the new cookies tasted like "burned chemicals and vomited chocolate". And isn't it interesting, I've had no reply from Late July. Very sad. What was once delicious and dependable is now, for mysterious reasons, the worst cookie/burned chemical vomit ever created. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

My comment completely echoes Rhonda who left her review above.  These used to be one of my very favorite cookies.  I hadn't bought them in a month or two probably, then really craved them, so bought a box today.  Noticed the new packaging when I opened the box - no big deal.  But the cookies were completely different than before - and not in a good way.  They are AWFUL.  I ate 3 trying to like them - but the whole box went in the garbage.Hugely disappointing - definitely won't be buying them again unless someone tells me they went back to the old recipe.

column9: Why did you change the recipe?  They are now awful!!!!!
column10: I have been an avid fan of these cookies for years.  My family went through dozens of boxes a month for our use, taking to functions as our donation, giving as gifts.  They were a dark, rich, wholesome, deep taste experience.  In May, 2012, I couldn't find them on the shelf in any of our normal stores.  After a few weeks, they were back.  I took them home and opened them and was surprised to find that the inside container was different.  It used to be three rows that ran the short end of the box.  Now it was two rows that ran the long end of the box.  No big deal had that been all that changed.  I took a cookie out and popped it in my mouth expected the same dark, rich, wholesome experience, and the cookie tasted so bad I almost threw up.  It was sickly sweet.  It tasted like a combination between an oreo and a health food bar.  All they did was move to the middle ground where those who like health food bars won't like the oreo sweet taste and those who like oreos won't like the health food bar taste.  They are awful.  And, I'm so sad, because before they changed the formulation, these were the best cookies on the market.  I turned so many people on to them.  Now that they changed the recipe, none of us will ever be buying them again.  They are now the worst cookie I have ever tasted.

I always eat cookies in bunches... 2-3 large cookies, 20 small ones, though I am health focused. When it comes to cookies I can't help it. I tried a vanilla bean with green tea cookie today and stopped at one. It was so special, I didn't need more. The two chocolate biscuits are the perfect combination of cocoa and sweet, and so crunchy. The vanilla bean filling is soft. When you eat the cookie you get the feeling it was home made last night, cooled, you took them out of the jar. No after fullness or taste, that you get from non-organic, super market cookies. Until now I'd only buy the mini white chocolate cookies from Late July, now I'll be buying this one too. Perfect to serve with tea! Amazing product. Must buy!

column9: addictive -- much better tasting than conventional sandwich cookies
column10: I've never been a big fan of sandwich cookies (usually prefer shortbread) but these really hit the spot. They are quite sweet so I drink water instead of soymilk when eating. They dont have a chemical aftertaste and contain noartificial colors or HFCS. I have to watch my glucose levels so cant eat more than 1 per day but that one cookie is more than enough to satisfy me. Highlyrecommended for office parties and kid's birthday parties. I would be proud to serve this to my friends and family too.

These cookies are should I say healthy and delicious!! They're not greasy and most of all, it's non hydrogenated and uses no high fructose corn syrup as seen on the box. Try them, way better than Oreos!!
Fabulous flavour without un-natural ingredients! THe chocolate actually tastes good and the creme filling is super! My kids love these cookies and don't even know that they are Good for you.
Everyone in my office raved about how good these cookies are. Calorie count is very reasonable and cookies are DELICIOUS!!

I first saw these in BJs. I liked the fact that they were organic and used all natural ingredients. I had a hard time finding them. When I searched amazon and found them I was ecstatic.Not your average sandwich cookie. Don't expect it to taste like an Oreo. For you health conscious folks out there who can't resist sandwich cookies try these. They are not overly sweet and taste great. You can twist them apart and lick the cream from the insidejust like the other sandwich cookie.

Bought these when they were on sale so I have many boxes!  Really enjoy these cookies and my kids do too.  That's saying something because I remember not liking dark chocolate as a kid.  My husband's favorite is the vanilla bean w/green tea version.  Both are winners in my book.  Thank you Late July  for making healthier snacks and sweet treats!
My girls love these cookies and the Vanilla Bean flavor too.  They make a great treat for school lunches.

My daughter is lactose intolerant and I ordered these cookies for her.  Unfortunately, they are not as good as oreo's which is what the other reviewer said but since my daughter loves them and they are dark chocolate that is good enough for me.
I never liked sandwich cookies... until these. I have to keep the box out of reach so I don't demolish the whole thing in a day!

My husband loves oreo's and I like natural or organic for my family. So I bought these for us to try. I got to try them first and had to stop myself after eating six, my kids had 2 each. My husband frequently finishes off his dinner milk with a few of these cookies. They are way better than oreo cookies. the taste is great and they dont have that greasyness like oreo's do. You cannot taste the green tea either. I put a case of these on my repeat shipping order for every six months. Well worth every penny and not all that artificial junk in them either.
These cookies were great with milk.  And it took less, only 3, to satisfy my sweet tooth or chocolate craving rather than the conventional name brand version's eight before stopping.
These cookies are awesome!  My kids and I totally enjoyed dunking them in milk.  This packaging was perfect for their school lunches.

column9: Delicious...but buy the dark chocolate for portion control!!
column10: I wrote a similar review for the dark chocolate.  I bought both flavors from amazon at the same time, and I still have 5 and a 1/2 boxes of the dark chocolate and only 2 boxes of the vanilla and green tea.  I think that says it all.  They are both very tasty, but the vanilla and green tea are just like oreo's to me...I want to eat them all like the cookie monster.  If you are concerned about portion control...go for the dark chocolate.  Less is more.

column9: Crisp, lovely filling--a delicious organic cookie!
column10: I've had my share of iffy organic treats. Late July, however, has won me over with their consistently quality snack foods. I've tried the crackers (very nice crispiness and flakiness, even), and their cookies rock.I thought I'd stick with the decadent dark chocolate ones (which I love), but these are a nice change. Both are excellent organic cookies--meaning they are hardly all-out healthful, as they are after all a treat, a sweet, carb-filled product that isn't a natural fruit or veggie, etc. But when it's time for you to sit down with a glass of milk or you want a sweet yummy thing after a good meal, these are totally delicious.I do taste some different taste than in chocolate with vanilla cream cookies that I've had before--Hydrox, Oreo, etc--but unlike the really awful Newman's sandwich cookies, these are superior. Very crisp. Sweet. A clean aftertaste, almost fresh.The texture is very satisfying to the teeth, and it just seems to be a product that care is taken with.Thumbs up.Mir

I loved the vanilla sandwich cookies. I was not happy with these. I love chocolate so I tried these too. The chocolate filling was dryand crumbly. I will not buy these again. I am sticking with the vanilla.

I had high hopes for these cookies because I adore Oreos and I love other Late July products (my favorite is the mini-peanut butter crackers).  I was disappointed, however.  These cookies taste stale and greasy to me.  They are way less sweet and less flavorfull than Oreos.So I took them to work to get rid of them, and coworkers went wild.  They were gone quickly, and I know some of them plan to buy these regularly now.Each cookie has 55 calories, by the way.I recommend trying to find them at your local grocery store before buying them in bulk on Amazon.  Here in Minneosta, Cub Foods sells them in a 9 oz box for a few dollars.

column9: Hard to not eat the whole box!
column10: These are the best tasting organic cookies we've tried so far!  The cookie has a nice dark chocolaty flavor and good crunch and the filling is creamy and tasty.  I must admit I was hesitant about the "green tea" aspect but you can't taste any tea in these cookies.  By far better than any Oreo in our opinion (not greasy like Oreos).  The worst problem with these cookies is putting the box down and not eating too many!  My 6-year-old's comment after purchasing one box in the grocery store?  "Mommy do they have them on Amazon so we can get a whole case?"  They ARE that good!

I bought these based on all the great reviews but I did not like them at all. The chocolate cookie is not too bad but the filling was not good at all. Had a strange aftertaste. My child likes them so at least someone does and I do not have to throw them out. I will not be ordering again!

column4: Chi "Who loves to find bargains and lives a g...
column9: Fabulous and Out of this World Delicious Cookies
column10: OMG! The first bite I had I am hooked addicted to those cookies forever. If you eat Oreo then you have this cookie, I bet you'll buy this Late July product from now on. What a difference! I totally love the dark chocolate taste in my mouth. It's not overwhelmingly sweet, it's "rich" though. One pack is just right. I tried to eat 2 packs at one time, then it ended up too much for me. They were over-killing my taste buds. My 15 months toddler likes it too. But only for a little little piece, otherwise, it's too much. I am so happy that I try Late July's products. They are so GOOD!

Absolutely the most delicious, decadent chocolate sandwich cooky on the planet! Great nutrition, superb taste, what more can you want? When you open the foil inner pack, the rush of deep, intense chocolate aroma is captivating. Yet another fantastic product from the Late July family.

This product contains non-organic MonSatan soy lecithin (banned in Europe, causes cancer and organ failure in lab rats). Organic sources of soy lecithin are presently available - no good reason to use this poison. Most of the companies that use it have been bought out by the same mega-corps that make junk food, etc. USDA organic products are allowed to contain 5% GMOs.

column9: I love Late July products, but this one is dookie.
column10: These dark chocolate cookies were dry and lacked any flavor. They were very close to cardboard. I payed regular price for them because they would never go on sale. I regret buying them; these were pretty bad and took me and my husband a couple weeks to finish the box. It was more of a chore really. We should have returned them to Sprouts where we bought them, but we were too embaressed to return a box of cookies.I had tried Late July's Green Tea sandwhich cookies and those tasted just like Oreos. They were awesome and that is why I expected these dark chocolate ones to be amazing. Oh well.

column9: I really wanted to like them
column10: Considering I am a huge dark chocolate fan--and I don't mean the Hershey's dark chocolate. I typically like to eat chocolate with 65-70%  cocoa content, and was excited to see the dark chocolate cookies. I tried them and actually (sort-of) liked them at first. The taste was not sweet, but not bitter either. However, after eating a few of them, I had to admit to myself that they just weren't anything special. I tried to give them away at an office party and absolutely no one wanted to take them home after tasting one. I had essentially purchased a case of cookies that I couldn't give away. I typically don't ever leave reviews that are negative; if I don't like something, I just don't review it. However, I tried several other Late July products because I liked the company's stance on many (food-related) issues, and they all left me feeling that same Blah. While others may enjoy these cookies, I just can't recommend them. If you're looking for great-tasting, organic cookies, try Country Choice (also available on Amazon). They are vegan and delicious.

Delicious cookie and great treat! Ingredients and care toward product is 5 star! Reasonable amount of fat considering it is a sweet dessert. Certainly, a good (treat) choice in respect to so much better for your overall body and health than any standard store bought cookie. I highly recommend, give to my children and guests proudly, and I would not hesitate to purchase, again!

At first I wasn't too sure of these.  They have a distinct taste and texture.  The cookie part is both crunchy and a little chewy, and the vanilla bean filling definitely has a green tea taste.  I tried them and a few days later the taste was still haunting me.  Now they are my favorite cookie!

column9: I did not like them, but lots did
column10: Lots of people liked these things and I love their crackers but I found these cookies to be disgusting. That is my opinion. I thought they were dry, stale, and unpleasant tasting. I don't think this batch was compromised as they were crispy and broke cleanly when I bit into them. Could be they are just not to be for my liking.
By far I think these are the best cookies I have ever tasted. Do not tire of eating them day or night.GWG
ProsLove these cookies....These are among the best i have ever hadConsAddictive!
Wonderful chocolate cookies and much healthier than most others.  You have to try these!
Having grown up on Oreos I found that I love the taste of these, but the filling is lacking.Whereas Oreos filling comes close to the sides of the cookie, these don't.

My daughter is lactose intolerant and she loves these cookies, I would not say they are as good as oreo's as the other reviewer say but they are pretty good and the taste is pretty good.  I ordered these with the green tea cookies from the same manufacturer.  Not bad

column9: Vanilla Bean with Green Tea are Way Better than Oreos!
column10: I don't buy these because they are organic, I buy them because they taste SO good! My favorite is the Vanilla Bean with Green Tea. They taste much better than Oreos. The cookie part is softer and these don't leave a shortening-greasy film/taste in your mouth. These taste like cookies from when I was a kid; no chemicals.If you've never had the Late July cookies before, give them a try. Yummy!

Tasty and the omnipresent "organic" makes the ingredients list look longer and more diabolical than it is. Chocolately for sure, but not cheap. The cookies also dry out and simultaneously get soggy/overly soft if left out for even a few minutes.

column9: So Good They Should Be Illegal.
column10: Nothing to complain about when you buy these. They are fresh, delicious, organic, reasonably priced, and delivered to your door.

This cookie is the cure for the sweet tooth.  I am one of those people that usually has trouble just eating a few cookies, but I easily stop at just 3 (or 4).  I think there is something about the dark chocolate that is more satisfying.  The vanilla and green tea one's are another case.  Don't buy those if you have trouble with portion control.

If you are looking for something to ease that chocolate craving but also want something healthy, low fat, high fiber, & organic, this is it! This is the best chocolate cookie ever. Reminiscent of Oreos, but Waaaaaaay better! And Good for YOU! I am so excited about finding these. I can eat chocolate and not feel guilty!

I was attracted to this box of cookies because of the "brand". "Late July" sounds like a wonderful brand name, and late July does bring back wonderful memories for me: it sounds like a fish fry with homemade french-fried potatoes and cole slaw and hush puppies, an ice bucket, iced tea, a cool breeze blowing from the fan, a porch, and lots of love. That's what I thought of when I saw this brand. Also, it is natural and therefore, vegans can have this product.Vanilla bean with green tea:  The cookies didn't taste good. The flavor idea was pretty good. There was a hint of good flavor. Vanilla bean with green tea sounds wonderful. Possibly, the bad taste was due to all the soy and soy products used.  I managed to eat this whole box (of vanilla bean with green tea) without throwing any out.Dark chocolate:  Horrible.  I couldn't even finish the whole box; I had to throw out most of it.  (And I'm the queen of conservativeness.)  The "dark" chocolate was so dark and so horrible, that it was too much for even a chocolate lover.  The chocolate had a horrible taste.  Not to mention the horrible taste it left in your mouth.  (Possibly too much soy, and whatever was in that chocolate.)  I literally had to go and buy some lemons and ate two, and also some potato chips, just to get that taste out of my mouth.Never again.

column9: Tasteful gum but BEWARE BEFORE BUYING FROM AMAZON WAREHOUSE!
column10: I almost ALWAYS limit my reviews to just the product but to warn others from making my mistake; BE CAREFUL ABOUT ORDERING THIS ITEM!If you purchase from Amazon Warehouse (based on my experience), you end up with just ONE single pack of gum. The photo is of an entire box and the price is practically the amount of an entire box at what I paid for but you receive one single pack of gum in the most ridiculously un-eco-friendly large box. I mean, the box I received it in had more packaging and air bubbles than the actual gum and I could have fit my head in the box. Really ridiculous of Amazon.-------------The actual gum? It taste fantastic. It has the gooey inside that sort of oozes out when you bite into it and has a refreshing taste to it, not at all weird. Very down to earth and the citrus flavors are subtle and not overbearing. It won't last long but is something good to chew and that's mainly what I use it for while I'm doing work so my mouth isn't idle and keeps me from wanting to munch on something unhealthy.
This is for one single pack of gum.  It is not for a box like the picture.  Do not buy.  This is the first scam that I have seen on Amazon.
This is one single pack of gum. I thought I was purchasing a box with nine packs and thought the picture backed this up. You will receive one single pack with nine pieces of gum.

before ordering this item thinking it might be a good deal, realize it's a scam. Show a picture of a different product then screw the customer.It's only for 1 pack.save 3 bucks and buy it at the grocery store.

column9: So much better than salt, we use it all the time

My brother sent me a bottle of Artisan Salt Himalayan Pink Mineral FINE Gourmet Salt. Haven't used regular salt since receiving it. If you look it up and read about where it comes from and contains, I'm sure you'd switch also.

I used to buy my Lapsang from Teavana but they stopped selling it. I also used to buy some from different packers like Twinnings among others but they became harder to find in stores in my area.I ordered this not only based on price but mainly based on the good reviews on this site. It's not as bold or as tangy and the smokey flavor is quite different from the others. It's hard to describe the difference but if you're used to some other Lapsang tea, you might one to try a smaller quantity of this one first.The description says it was smoked using oak while most lapsang use pinewood, maybe that's what causes the difference.Now I mix it half and half with regular black tea, it's not as strong or as bold as I would like but at least I get back some of the tarriness this tea is lacking.

Jelly Belly's are hard to find in bulk any more in my area. I like the cinnamon jelly beans best. I ordered a pound of them. They arrived quickly and were nice and fresh. I am doling them out to myself sparingly and savoring each one!

column9: Whatever happened to HOT cinnamon candy?
column10: Valentines Day is one of those rare holidays where I join the Philistines whose favorite candy is not chocolate.  Forget the heart shaped box, the chocolate chip roses, the cakes.  Give me cinnamon that's hotter than a scorned woman's temper.Except, where did it go?  Somewhere in the past few years, cinnamon candy got namby pamby.  Someone told me that people complained.These are not the red hot Jelly Bellys I used to get. You know, the ones that made your nose run?  And in a cold February, there's nothing better. (Well, nothing I'm going to talk about here, anyway) They're sanitized, expurgated, dare I say it?  MILD, kiddie candy.Still looking for my sinfully hot cinnamon for the year.  Any suggestions?Rebecca Kyle, February 2009
I order this 10 pound box of jelly bellys and they came very quickly.  The  box is heavy and the jelly bellys were perfect.  If you are a cinnamon jelly belly fan this box is for you!

This one is a real keeper.  There's something about that grilled feature that my cat goes crazy for and this one seems to be a favorite. I particularly appreciate the low odor, high protein features, but he just wants the "stuff."  My cats' coats are just gorgeous on this stuff and it also seems to increase their energy level.  Can't recommend it enough!

column9: fancy feast grilled liver & chicken feast in gravy
column10: My ten year old cat is very finicky on cat foods he likes. The grilled liver & chicken in gravy is one of his favorites. Food are in chunky pieces in gravy.

column9: Loaded with chunks meat and lots of gravy
column10: Cee Cee kitty loves this and pretty much dives into the plate before I can finifh putting it down in front of her. I hear that the chunks of meat help scrape the tartar off cats' teeth -- whether this is true or not, I don't know. And of course, since it's wet (canned) cat food, it helps add fluids to her diet, other than what she drinks from her water bowl -- cats, being descended from desert kitties, take alot of their fluids from their "prey" - in this instance, their food -- so I make sure I feed my cats mostly canned (wet) food in addition to some dry, and of course, their bowls of fresh water.Cee Cee's been eating Fancy Feast for the past 7 years.
