I tried this cat food because my one cat has stomatitis, which is very painful and he can't eat hard food when he has a flareup.  Also, my vet felt that allergies to additives and grains in cat foods could be part of the problem.  There is nothing in the applaws except shredded chicken breast, no taurine or other nutrients.  Romeo loved it.  It looked delicious and smelled like something you would want to eat yourself.  When I ordered a case of the 5 oz cans it was not so great.  The smell was off and my cat wouldn't touch it.  I ended up shipping the the case of larger cans back.  If this alone was fed to a cat, veggies or other nutrients would have to be added.  Now I am trying Weruva which has necessary nutrients added, but no grains or fillers. Bottom line is that smaller size cans are more expensive.  There dosen't seem to be consistency between these small cans and the larger size.  Also, necessary nutrients for cats not present.

column9: The best value in coffee so far
column10: I learned to drink coffee in the Navy, so it was a long time before I learned that it didn't have to taste like battery acid, or have similar gastronomic effects.I started with Pete's and Seattle's Best, graduated upward to some excellent local roasters, and then after moving out to The Boonies, tried about every organic coffee on Amazon. Medium, dark, espresso, french roast, Italian roast, from nearly every corner of the globe; you name it, we tried it.Then I stumbled upon the Bean Company, which attracted me initially because it is located close to home. Think global, invest local, I say. We tried several of their roasts, and this one wins hands down. We use a Capresso burr grinder and a Saeco espresso maker, extra fine grind, compressed 40 pounds, and about a 25-second draw. Pure bliss. Perfect balance, perfect roast. Dark, yes, but never burnt. The French roast makes a better espresso than their espresso beans do, at least with our setup.Can you get better coffee. Yes. Definitely, but not for anywhere near the same price. I had a shot of espresso at Stumptown's in Portland last year that sent me out of this world, but so did the sticker shock. The Bean Coffee Co. french roast, on the other hand, is so cheap and so good that nothing comes close in value. You could spend 3-4 times as much, and not be as good.We've gone through about 30 pounds so far, with amazing consistency, and I bet we go through hundreds more.

The bean quality and roast quality of this bean is a step above the average bean at this price point, but the darkness was a little more than expected. There seems to be a lot of ambiguity when buying a French Roast, so much that it's hard to gauge it's true meaning of darkness. This bean falls more into the category of an Italian Roast, being truly darker than the majority of French Roast's that I have tried in the past, mind you this is labeled as a "Dark French Roast".Remember, there is no such thing as an Espresso Roast, just blends. This bean does a great job at producing a quality / smooth espresso pull every time so far. You do need to grind it a lot finer than you would a mild bean, and don't expect the caffeine quality to be high (Darker the bean, the lower the caffeine). I pull a 28 second shots on a Gaggia Classic using a Virtuosa Percisio Grinder at setting 9k, and tamping with a Rattleware 58mm Tamper with roughly 30 lbs of applied pressure to the puck. The taste as said is smooth, but only for those who enjoy a strong, very bold, espresso drink. Makes wonderful Machiottos and Dupio Espresso though, be watching for a shot of the beans shortly.

I have become a bit of a French Roast snob, tasting as many as I can in search of THE one which pleases my palate best. So far The Bean Coffee Company, Le Bean (Dark French Roast) Organic Whole Bean Coffee, 5-Pound Bags is that very best one.I prefer organically grown coffee and this is 100% organically grown Arabica beans. The fresh flavor has great depth and is rich and smooth. The beans are beautiful ~ dark and glistening! The aroma is heavenly. The beans are low acid and antioxidant rich. This is truly a coffee of exceptional quality!The Bean Coffee Company, Le Bean (Dark French Roast) Organic Whole Bean Coffee, 5-Pound Bags is also an exceptional value at Amazon. The price per pound with Amazon's Subscribe and Save program is better than the price per pound of organic French Roast coffees I have purchased elsewhere and the quality of this coffee is much better.I'm very happy to have found this wonderful organic French Roast coffee!

This is a very refreshing and clean tasting product.  I love the fact that the tops come capped with this nice thick foil to keep any dirt out off the part your lips go.  The orange flavor has a bit of a bite which, to me, just means its not loaded with sugar to counter the bitterness.  Don't think this product is bitter, just not too sweet for my taste buds.  I hope to try the lemonata by the same manufacturer when it goes on sale.

I love the orange more than the lemon. The lemon is quite strong. But both are good. Got a multi case (2 6pack of orange and 2 6packs of lemon) at Costco this weekend for only $10.49 (with a $3.50 off coupon)Knowing that Costco doesn't always carry products at all times, it's good to know I can find these on Amazon. Too bad they are more than double the price on Amazon though.

I have loved these San Pellegrino Aranciata's for many years now. Finding them here on Amazon for a subscription price of $16 and change was too great to pass up. They are generally around a buck each (or more) everywhere i shop.The taste is bright and crisp, with just the right amount of sweetness. I dont let myself do so, but i could easily drink a twelve pack in a day if i wanted to. They are that delicious. They also make great mixers, if you are of a mind to enjoy an adult beverage.So, for me, great deal, and a pleasure to have a ready and cheap supply.

column9: Price was right, but shipping method wasn't for this fantastic beverage.
column10: First off, all of the San Pellegrino Sparkling fruit beverages are fantastic Italian style sodas!  I only wish Amazon would carry the San Pellegrino Chinotto (bitter orange flavor Italian soda), as it seems this flavor in particular is quite hard to find. In fact I can't find it at a decent price and in large quantities at all within a 110 mile radius of my city!Now I must say that the price was right for this product when I ordered it, but the shipping method didn't work out so well. The box was pretty beat-up, the corners seemed crushed and the walls were bending. The box was really a little too big and the bubble-padding material was either popped during shipment or not inflated when it was packed. For a product like this, it should be properly padded, as these types of carbonated beverages can explode or leak when the cans get dropped or dented.  Many of the cans were dented. In fact I wouldn't be surprised if the package was dropped or had heavier boxes on top of it.  The carrier may have had no idea what was inside, but Amazon did.I felt lucky that none of the beverages exploded or leaked, being that most of them were dented around the edges of the tops and bottoms. Maybe this was just a problem with my individual shipment? It is just soda, but I think it deserves to arrive in new condition like any other item and not banged up.Overall, this product is wonderful. I would consider ordering it again as long as the price is comparable to buying it locally, but I hope my next order is packaged and handled with a little more care.Update 3/20/12: I found this product to be much cheaper in the same quantities at a local club/warehouse type of store... I am now leery about about having items such as soda cans shipped and even more reluctant to re-order if the price is higher than what I can buy it for locally.

This water is awesome! Very light and refreshing! Do not want to be without again! Great orange taste! Just what I needed.

The taste is crisp and slightly tart, without being sickly sweet. The typical American orange soda is way too sweet, with a noticeable artificial flavor. The only suggestion I would make to enhance this product is to cut the sugar altogether and substitute some additional juice concentrate, e.g., apple, pear, peach, mango, papaya, guava, etc.

This is an all natural, great-tasting soda that will be a great addition to any selection of non-alcoholic beverages. It is not nearly as sweet as fanta, it contains no artificial coloring (it's actually 16% orange juice), and the bottle looks fancy. My family loves it!

column9: San Pellegrino Sparkling Beverage, Orange, 11.15-Ounce Can (Pack of 24)
column10: I love its slightly bitter orange flavor Italian soda, as it seems this flavor in particular is quite hard to find. In fact I can't find it at a decent price and in large quantities. It was like someone rewound the clock for me as a child living in Sorrento, Italy. This is actually a carbonated beverage that is refreshing on a hot day; it's like Sparkling water with a twist, and it  just tastes "clean". I don't know if it has enough additives for the American market, but I hope people continue to buy it.

I found this refreshing beverage serendipitously while looking for something to drink on a hot Southern California day a while back. The 7/11 store was out of 7up and I was tired of the cola beverages, so in the specialty section with all the juices there were a few can of San Pellegrino Aranciata Sparkling beverage. I bought one of the Aranciata and one of the Limonata. I used to drink a lot of Orange Crush and Sunkist and those were too sugary for my adult taste and didn't drink an orange soda for years. . . until aranciata cam along. The fact that it contains 16% orange juice with a tad of sugar just enough for my palate. The Limonata has a lot of pucker power and is a bit to tart for me, but may be good for a mixer beverage. The Amazon price is reasonable with FREE shipping is great as this item is difficult to locate even though some say that Costco sells it, but wasn't stocked whenever I visit the store.

When I was a kid and went to visit family in Greece I would get these bottles of orange soda that tasted identical to Aranciata.  Fizzy, a little bite, and not too sweet....  It actually used to kind of gross me out that you could see the actual orange in the soda (oddly enough, orange food coloring never seemed to bother me.)  About a year ago I tried one of these and was blown away.  It was like someone rewound the clock 25 years.  This is actually a carbonated beverage that is refreshing on a hot day, doesn't load you down with sugar, and just tastes "clean". I don't know if it has enough additives for the American market, but I hope more people continue to buy it so I can get my fix a little cheaper.

By contrast, the limonata beverage San Pellegrino Sparkling Beverage, Limonata, 11.15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24) is fairly sour, so depending on what you're looking for, you can choose between the two. If you like oranges or if you are tired of the usual Sunkist/Fanta/Crush orange soda flavors then give this drink a try. It is a refreshingly different twist on a familiar flavor.

column9: Several packages for the same yummy product
column10: OK, so I'm used to drinking (and have a preference for) the cans that have the aluminum top you peel back--it's a teeny tiny frustration to have to, well, clean the inevitably dusty, traveled top of any can, whether with a damp towel, rinsing, or my shirt if I'm not feeling particularly energetic.That said, the price through Amazon (at $2 higher than The Chef's Warehouse that charges $9.95 for shipping) is much better, and this is JUST the kind of thing that, while it's pretty near-identical the price of my local grocer, I appreciate not hauling far.Now about the soda... I'm NOT a soda drinker. I abhor that corn syrupy colored mess called cola (though Cheerwine keeps a spot in my less than three!)... in general, my stomach, as I sort of banned this drink category for 360+ days a year at the age of 13, gets very upset when carbonated water is put in it, especially with caffeine in most carbonated things... and another interesting tummy woe is orange juice. Unless it's fresh squeezed and "normal" orange juice (not the awesomely rich Florida kinds of oranges), well, I'm sorta not able to handle that, not even after prilosec entered my world.Now for the confusion. This stuff... it tastes amazingly fresh, the carbonation isn't excessive, with 18% juice, I get some natural vitamin C (pills are no good anyway, not for 99 thousand out of 99,001 people), and I'm not drinking pure buzzed OJ. I am also not getting mouth sores or anything of the sort that I recall getting when OJ was one of those everyday 12 ounces of it items... yeah, I wasn't terribly smart, but then again, metabolism of a hummingbird forgives just about all food habits... I'm older, wiser (don't use semicid), and this is that mature drink for me...I think it is perfect for people who, like me, can't do straight OJ, who can't quite bring themselves to inhale pure sugar/corn syrup sodas, who don't want their drinks tasting like food coloring, you get the picture... it just tastes like a fresh citrus spritzer, like the bubbling of champagne with the juice content of a margarita and no alcohol. If you like tonic water, this could replace that kind of unhealthy addictive drink (for your eyes in particular, as quinine leads to blindness when used for more than a couple months). If you like margaritas or screwdrivers or want some fizz without it being fake Fanta fizzle, then this is what to drink.It isn't particularly surprising (to me) that this happens to be my run-to drink when I'm eating cheesy Italian foods... it seriously was made FOR rich Italian dishes (seafood, I'm not so sure on--I think vino would be better for fish dishes)... plate me up something with creams, cheeses, maybe prosciutto and butter sauces, etc... and this somehow feels like its bubbling acid is helping my stomach along--maybe just because the most healthy of adult tummies still (well, when the diet has gone adult and is less saturated with fats, less gooey, less fried, less American in general) have some trouble digesting cheese on cheese on gooey awesome cheese with some roasted-in-olive-oil veggies, of course, and the occasional land mammal commonly consumed in Italy.My point? If you're eating pizza, calzone, lasagna, or even other Euro-derived foods... or if you're eating some fried chicken, even, this drink is an amazing counterpart. If you take anything like proton pump inhibitors regularly (prilosec, aciphex, etc., or even zantac types of meds), then this could be that perfect add-on when you go off your healthy food diet and splurge for something you know might irritate. No, I'm not selling it as a medicine, though mmm this DOES remind me of when cola used to be good stuff (when it was just a bit of sugar and when real cherries were in the cup) and why they decided to put some things in such syrups to deliver more effectively... it's darn good stuff. It's NOT your everyday soda. To my knowledge, they are adamant against using corn syrup, and having had the stuff in blue, in pale blue/yellow, and in a couple other cans, also having had it in glass bottles (panna is also made by them, so you can imagine the quality of the water that goes into this drink!)... well, it's all been some water, some OJ, some sugar (but not a lot), some natural CO2, and ... maybe natural flavor? column9: Worked fine but rinse repeatedly before use!
column10: I'd never stuffed sausage before last week when we decided to make a batch of boudin blanc to take to my mother-in-law. This not only ensures their cleanliness but helps expand them, too, thus preventing the tears mentioned by another reviewer.The casings should be cleaned after soaking in warm water for 30 minutes. Cleaning is most easily done by inserting the end of a funnel -- or sausage stuffer attachment -- into one end and *slowly* running warm water through the entire length, unraveling and untwisting as needed. This should be performed at least twice.Since we'd known to do that, we had no problems whatsoever with these casings. The boudain turned out wonderfully, and I'm looking forward to making more!

column9: Essential product for the home sausage maker
column10: I bought these casings for my first attempt at making fresh sausage at home. They arrived quickly and as described for the most part. There are a few key things to note about these casings:1. There are 5 separate casings (each to hold approx. 5 lbs. of sausage), which simplified the process for me as a sausage-making rookie.2. The package is resealable, which is great for making 5 lbs. of sausage at a time. The casings can be stored in their own salt or you can add a bit of kosher salt to ensure freshness for several months.3. After being soaked in warm water for 30 minutes, it's really necessary to rinse them in cold water a couple times to remove the intense salt flavor. I used a small funnel, which really simplified the process.4. Make sure to include enough water in your sausage recipe, or else these casings will tear rather easily as you stuff them. I used my LEM 5-lb. stuffer (LEM Products 5 Pound Stainless Steel Vertical Sausage Stuffer) and suffered a few broken casings initially due to not adding enough water.5. These casings take smoke very well and have held up nicely in my Weber smoker.Overall, I'd recommend this product for its convenience, natural taste and texture. The only downside I've seen is a lack of durability, but that's not much of an issue with a little practice.

I bought this dog food because the bag showed pictured of veggies and chunks of meat, and with a name like "Beneful" I thought I was purchasing a nutritious brand of dog food. My dogs did eat this food at first, and slowly began to not like it. After reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my dogs. The first three ingredients are Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, and corn gluten meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, dogs cannot fully digest corn as they are carnivores. Corn it is just a cheap filler that can cause dogs to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. Most inexpensive low-quality pet foods have lots of these fillers and cheap ingredients with little to no nutritional value.The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging if the product does not contain the pictured items; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself- provided that you eat a typical (non vegetarian or other restricted) diet. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural foods such as Natural Balance, Blue Buffalo, Halo, or Wellness. High-quality foods tend to be more nutritionally dense, meaning you will be feeding a much smaller amount for the same number of calories. If you do the math to figure out the cost for the number of calories you need to feed your pet, many premium foods are CHEAPER than the awful crap you're buying at the grocery store.

column9: S O O O O O......G O O D...! ! ! ! !
column10: When I was little, I coined a word for things that tasted SO good, just about nothing else could compare.  The word is: "scrumptuutious", (pronounced "scrump-TOO-shus", or "scrump-TOO-tee-us", if you prefer an English pronounciation....  Very, very few foods qualify for this appelation --but "ROBINSON'S APPLE & BLACKCURRANT -- also known as "Fruit Squash" -- qualifies with a capital "Q"!If you buy this delicious drink, my first suggestion is that you remove the labels, as much as is possible, from the tall, elegant plastic bottles. (This was not too difficult at all, at least for me, as the bottles I received had their labels very, very lightly attached to begin with.)  Then take the bottle(s), and put them in the refrigerator, and have the refrigerator's light shine through the bottle(s).  The dark-red liquid inside is so extraordinary, that you may see a beautiful, optical illusion: It may seem as if the slim, elegant bottle(s) is (or are), suddenly filled with the most equisitely beautiful and costly ruby....shaped just like the bottle(s)!  Or, if you wish, a non-alcholic beverage that looks exactly like the finest of fine red wine!  Of course, this is really just the pure, transparent concentrate inside, lit up and lit through, by your refrigerator's light....but it really is something quite wonderful, and quite beautiful, to see!I suggest you do this JUST after having received your bottles.  For this way, they are unopened, and you get to see the whole bottle lit up.  However, once the bottle is opened, the wonderful taste within will probably be a precursor to there not being very much left in the bottle, for very long....no matter how much you, and/or others in your household  try to restrain yourself! (selves!)If you like grape juice, you will absolutely LOVE this drink.  (If you don't like grape juice, it is possible you won't like FRUIT SQUASH either,,,but to be sure, give it a try anyway...) There is a slightly more sweet, slightly more acidic taste to this drink than plain grape juice has.  Black currants are, I have learnt, a separate variety of small, dried grapes. (Note too that "currant" is spelt with an "A").Don't let the price scare you off....this is a CONCENTRATE!  The front label directions of this Fruit Squash -- describing milliter servings -- may be a little confusing for those used to ounces, instead of milliliters.... But on another Robinson Prouduct -- the equally scrumptuutious LEMON BARLEY WATER, (also, I must shamelessly admit, reviewed by me for Amazon.com) -- it is more clearly stated:  ONE part Robinson product, to FOUR parts water. Actually, these directions are also on the Apple and Blackcurrant fruit squash....but only on the back label, in far smaller letting.  (Note to Robinson's Sopft Drinks, Limited, and Britvic.com -- PLEASE put these far more clear,"one part Robinson's to four parts water" directions, on ALL your products, in LARGE lettering, on either front or back label.  Your American and other customers who are more familiar with ounces than they are with milliliters, will thank you!) In any event, this means that each 1 liter bottle, (slightly more than a quart), will make FIVE liters of fruit squash!  This is a bit over one gallon & a quart....and thus the concentrate serves to save LOTS of room in your refrigerator, as well as allowing one to add whatever water, (tap, Evian, distilled, etc.), one wishes!Robinson's Apple and Blackcurrant is good either hot or cold.  It's also good to add to recipes....either full or half-strengh...when "grape juice" is called for.  But please....use full or half-strength ONLY for recipes! It is tempting, I know, to try the concentrate full-strenght for drinking...and, (as I am, after all, reviewing this product for the benefit of other people), I did take the liberty to do just that, once or twice, (ok, maybe I tried it full-strenght three or four times....just to make sure, and ONLY for testing purposes, you of course understand...: )  Anyway, drinking this product full-strength led, for me anyway, to my heart beating faster than usual.  A danger sign...so I stopped doing it.  Grapes are used to make wine, after all, and though this product is non-fermented, and thus non-alcholic, a strong, concentrated dose of liquid grapes DOES have a negative effect...albeit, for me, (weighing as I do, some more than few pounds overweight), only a slight negative effect.  On the label of both Robinson Proucts which I have tested, in fact, are words of warning to be sure "to add extra liquid, if given to toddlers, (and children)".  It is far more economical, and far safer, to follow the directions and add the four parts water for drinking, (and perhaps also cooking), purposes.  The taste is remarkably the same to drinking the concentrate "straight"...and if, like me, you like things extra, extra sweet, a small bit of extra sugar, (mixed with the smallest amount of boilt water, to dissolve), and or artificial sweetener, can be added.This is, as I have said, a non-alcholic drink.  But it is SO very tasty, so VERY satisfying, that it can be served with pride to even those trying to moderate, or eliminate their consumption of alcholic drinks -- or to those who, for religious or other reasons, have decided to foreswear alcholic drinks altogether.  Diluting it to five or six parts water to one part conentrate make it, I think, the perfect treat for children's birthday parties!It's kind of difficul6 to believe that only 8% of this product is from comcntrated Apple Juice, and only 2% is from concentrated Blackcurrant juice.  The front label proclaims, however, that there are "NO ArtificialColours or Flavours" inside, and this is true.  In all, the ingredients listed are: Water.  Fruit jiices from concentrate, (Apple 8%, Blackcurrant 2%)  Glucose-Fructrose syrup  Sugar  Citric Acid  Natural Colour, (Anthocyanins)  Preseratives (Potassium Sorbate,  Sodium Metabisulfite)  Acidity Regulator, (Sodium Citrate)  Sweeteners (Aspartame, Saccarine)  Natural Flavouring  CONTAINS A SOURCE OF PHENYLALANINE.All in all, a pretty good label -- especially these days.  NOT entirely natural...but with ingredients found in many other soft drinks, none of which taste quite this good!..................................................................."I can't believe how good they are!"  This is how my sister, visiting my mother and I in New York from her home in Denver, described her first taste of GUYLIAN Belgian Chocolate sea-shells, (also for sale here on Amazon!)  I suppose this was her way of saying "Scrumtuutious"!  Either way, this also describes the delectable, wonderful taste of ROBINSON'SAPPLE & BLACKCURRENT.  Five stars....and, (as the company has been in business sine 1823), a Hundred and Eight-Six "Cheers!"

Also, we had a soil test that showed extremely high levels of phosphorous in the soil.  The reason for this?  Years and years of Miracle Grow by the previous owner.  Phosphorous doesn't leach out of the soil so it just builds up and up with repeat applications.DON'T buy this product unless you have consulted a knowledgeable plant or landscape person first. column9: Good taste and perks you up !
column10: Despite a slight vitaminy taste, I love these! They really do perk me up when I need a pick-me-up. I like that they have very few calories. Nice raspberry flavor.

I have been drinking Good Earth Decaf Green Tea for many years and it is my favorite tea.  This tea is not purely green tea leaves - it also contains lemongrass and other flavors.  It is flavorful but mild.  Ingredients: Decaffeinated Green Tea, Lemongrass, Natural Flavors (Contains Soy Lecithin), Rose Petals and Peppermint.Be aware that the Good Earth Decaf Green Tea does not have the more delicate flavor as real Japanese green tea (and not a roasted flavor like Genmai), but it is great as an everyday tea.  If you are expecting green tea like in Japanese restaurants, this is not it - if you want that, get high quality loose tea leaves and brew it with the correct temperature water in a teapot.  (Although maybe the Good Earth green tea would taste more similar to Japanese green tea if brewed like Japanese green tea should be - read on...)I often leave my tea bag steeping for a long time (I know, not recommended for green tea, but it likely does extract more of the beneficial antioxidants), up to 30 min, and this tea does not get bitter.  It also does not get bitter if the tea sits around before drinking.  One Good Earth tea bag works fine for my large 16 oz mug.  I have found that other brands of tea can be weak and not flavorful if using only one bag for 16 oz water.I also like that this tea is decaf since even the smaller amount of caffeine in green tea affects me.  Decaf green teas are somewhat hard to find.  This company uses a CO2 process for decaffeination, preferable to a solvent extraction process.Note that this product is available in 18-count and 25-count boxes.  My local grocery store has stopped carrying the 25-count and only stocks the 18-count.  I like that Amazon carries the 25-count boxes since I go through a lot of this tea!  It is also a better deal at Amazon.I have tried many other brands of green tea (decaf and regular) over the years and keep coming back to Good Earth brand.  Highly recommended.

column10: Since this product is getting harder and harder to find in local grocery stores, I was very pleased to find it offered here and at a competitive price.  I will keep coming back for order refills as my supply dwindles.

I am a regular user of Necta Sweet and used to purchase it at Walgreens, CVS or Rite Aide.  All of those pharmacies stopped carrying it so I found this product through Amazon.

Just reordered this product after first ordering over 2 years ago.  12 bottles takes some time to use -- but there was no deterioration in product quality and the 500 ct. bottle meant unsealed bottles didn't have to be open for months on end.  Many people don't like saccharin because they feel it has an aftertaste.  I find that it is more about the quantity you use.  Most toothpaste is saccharin sweetened but I don't hear people complain about the aftertaste of their toothpaste, probably because the toothpaste manufacturers don't overdo it with the saccharin.  This product works great for sweetening tea and coffee among other beverages. One 1/4 grain tablet is like 1 teaspoon of sugar in sweetness. If you need to sweeten a 1/2 gallon or a gallon of something, adding pellets is way easier than opening a bunch of little packets or even spooning out some other sweetener.  Just pour pellets into the bottle cap and count what you need. For whatever reason, it (any saccharin sweetener) does NOT go well with Kool-Aid brand soft drink mix. It does mix well with Wyler's and Flavor Aid.  For my tastes, I find that 20 of the 1/4 grain pellets sweetens a 2 quart soft-drink packet very well.  If you really feel like you're still getting aftertaste, try 16 pellets and two packets of Splenda.  You can always add more of either NectaSweet or Splenda if you prefer it sweeter. When adding directly to already chilled beverages, give the pellets a minute to dissolve and then stir well.

I have tried many sweeteners but the taste of this is consistent and does not leave an aftertaste.  I buy this by the 12 pack case and use it everyday.  The only thing I don't like about it, is that does not dissolve as well in cold drinks.

Dissolves quickly, which was my pet peeve with other brand substitutes in pill form.  Try this for any drink requiring sweetener, it's great.
Despite a promise of delivery in about 12 days, the product arrived in less than half that time.  Perfect timing since we were leaving for a trip.

There aren't many manufacturers of this product anymore, despite the cancer link being debunked decades ago. It's nice to see a company still producing this item, which must have a fairly low profit margin. Bravo, Necta Sweet!
This cereal is very tasty, and stays crunchy in milk. It makes a healthy snack as well. The whole family loves it.

This is really tasty stuff, and I sure wish it were organic as stated in the product description above, but let's not confuse "natural" with organic. Organic means grown without chemical pesticides and grown without using genetically modified seeds. There is no guarantee that this is the case with "natural" products such as this and likely they could be GMO and sprayed with pesticides. If it were truly an organic product I would have given it 5 stars, and it certainly is priced like an organic product. Still, quality of ingredients aside, it is very yummy. But so is junk food.
It has a nice taste but is way more crunchy than I thought it would be. It isnt at all like the shredded wheat products---but i'm learning to like it.
One of the best tasting cereals on subscribe and save.  If you like life cereal, you will probably enjoy this too.
This is my favorite cereal.  I love its flavor and the fact that it remains crunchy for a long time in soy and rice milk.  The fact that it's good for me is an added bonus.

I only tried this cereal because some of my standard cereals are now charging an arm and a leg! I was quite pleased with it. In fact, I don't even use it as a breakfast cereal, but for snackin' when I want something crunchy , not too sweet, and not too caloric. I would recommend it.

We absolutely love the Barbara cereals, but this one is the best on taste.  Thankfully our 5 1/2 year old girl/boy twins love it too!  Good balance of vanilla flavor to fiber to protein (with added almonds).

Health Valley Organic Soup, Vegetable, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)I was buying this product at my local market but they stopped stocking it, so I looked for a way to purchase it online, and I found it on Amazon.  When I order two cases it qualifies for free shipping, which makes the price per can a few cents less than what I was paying at the market.  The delivery time is less than a weekI am looking for more food items that I use in volume to purchase from Amazon.An excellent product and a good way to buy it.

I used to buy Health Valley soups at Stop & Shop, when I had a car, but now I shop at the local market, where they sell the usual commercial garbage like Campbell and Progresso.  Health Valley is the closest I've come to truly fresh, homemade soup and it is worth every penny.  The Vegetable soup is my favorite.Because Stop & Shop doesn't provide Peapod service in my area, I've had the soup delivered to my door directly from Health Valley, Vitacost, or through Amazon.  Vitacost is the only store that lists all ingredients on their site and is willing to sell you as little as one can per order, and they used to take great care to deliver the product undented - unfortunately, that's no longer the case; cans arrive dented.  Being able to purchase a single can is good because you can sample different varieties in one shipment; and Vitacost sells at a discount.  At Health Valley, you have to purchase two cases of the same product at the list price, and at Amazon you need to purchase one case (12 cans/case) at a discount, and you get free shipping.  However, the Amazon cans arrive badly dented; some are in such bad shape that the electric can opener cannot handle them.
This is the best no-salt soup I've ever tasted.  It's hearty and full of flavor.  Never miss the salt.

column10: This dry cracker, which is something like a Jacob's cream cracker only with just that little bit better texture and flavor, is the best biscuit in the world for a snack or a mini meal. My son absolutely loves this cereal. Definitely recommended for a healthy meal for your little one. He was getting a little tired of the plain rice cereal and I think this one is more filling with more flavor.
I just love Pate Pasteta. This one is tasty and cheap. If you haven't tried Pate before, this is a good opportunity to get it cheap and try it.

Great snack if you're into a baked cheesey filling. If you're watching portions, this is a great item. Good buy for me.

column9: great product - hard to find in our area
column10: We love the cracker/cheddar cheese combos.  Finding them is a major hassle and then it is only in 1 bag size.  These individual packages are great for on the go and the price is right!

This is a pretty good quality and tasting organic walnuts.  Of course because it is organic it is like twice the price of other walnuts.  Still not sure if the organic nuts vs. non-organic nuts will really make a big difference or not to our health?  The only real dissapointment was that you get much more "pieces" than you get "halves".  This is the key thing that prevented me from giving it 5 stars.

I by and large agree with the previous reviewer (A.M.). Personally I don't mind whether they're pieces or halves or fulls or whatever -- they're walnuts. You can use Amazon's "Subscribe & Save" to buy these at a slightly cheaper rate. You can always cancel the subscription at any time in the future *after* your first issue has been shipped. Given a subscription rate of $24.77 as of the date of this review, each ounce costs $1.03.While walnuts are excellent for health in moderation, do not overeat these! I suggest reading the Wikipedia article and the references listed there for more info. It is beyond the scope of this review to discuss this.Given the higher costs of organic walnuts, I wish someone could tell me definitively whether it is worthwhile to buy them over non-organic. For instance, a statement such as "Organic walnuts were measured to have xx% the pesticides of non-organic walnuts, and non-organic walnuts are naturally low/med/high in pesticides" would help greatly. Because walnuts have a hard shell, I suspect that organic really doesn't make that much of a difference, though I could be wrong.

column9: Confessions Of A Die-Hard Coffee Drinker
column10: Good Earth Green Tea - Lemongrass 25 tea bags--No way, no how, was I ever going to be a tea drinker. Coffee was my perker-upper of choice, and loved every jittery cup of it. I still like my morning cup and the aroma of good coffee brewing in the morning. Whenever offered tea by friends I'd always decline - "coffee if you've got it please". I would settle for the last of a pot that had been heating for hours rather then try tea. So to say I am no expert on tea is ...well... the truth. My experience with tea was the occassional cup at a Chinese restaurant, or the cup loaded with honey for a sore throat. So when I say I Love This Tea - you can be sure that's the truth as well.It started with a coupon. It was a bargain to pick some up at my local market, and thought well, maybe I should have some on hand for all those tea lovers I know. I remembered the green tea on the shelf and thought what the heck, maybe it will hold me over till I get to the store. I liked it! It gave me an afternoon pick-me-up that I wasn't expecting and even thought it tasted pretty good as well. I don't remember what kind it was as I have been through several boxes of green, various brand and flavors of the tea since then. Then I hit on this Good Earth Lemongrass. This one I loved.It was the best I tried. So naturally my next stop was here at Amazon. And naturally I found this great deal.The taste is wonderful and so is the aroma. Light and citrusy, but slightly sweet - not what I thought "lemongrass" would be.I didn't need to add anything at all. It is caffeinated, but comparably much less then coffe per serving. It gives me a renewed and refreshed energy in the afternoons without any jitteryness.It also doesn't seem to be dehydrating - as coffee can be.Not to mention the other health benefits. According to the box, this blend is rich in antioxidants. It may be served hot or as Iced Tea.Ingredients: Green Tea,Lemongrass,Natural Flavors,Rose petals and Peppermint.As I said, Amazon has the best deal. I bought the six pack of 25 bag boxes. One box comes out to be less then the 20 bag box sold at my market.It is also sold in multi packs of the 20 bag boxes here as well:Good Earth Green Tea, Tea Bags, 20-Count, Boxes (Pack of 6)  [Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging].Oh and on the tag of each bag(which are slit to sit on the edge of the cup) are some delightful and inspiring quotations or proverbs that may start you out with a smile. Here are a couple of them I'll leave this review with:"You will never be alone with a poet in your pocket"...John Adams"Flowers leave some of their fragrance in the hand that bestows them"...Chinese ProverbRemember to breathe, eat healthy and enjoy....Laurie

BUT I have to say, I'm very disappointed in the new/latestGood Earth green tea.  I tastes like flowers, of some sort.  I am not a fan and I am stuck with 6 boxes of 20. UGH! I have been drinking lemongrass tea for about five years. I like the taste of course, but mainly I drink it for the fact that it helps to kill cancer cells. However, once I started al the various treatments, I know that the drinking of the lemongrass tea was a major help in the battle. I am now free of cancer cells. I also notice that it is almost impossible to find Ginseng tea.  Amazon??help here please??

This is my favorite green tea.  I find that the lemongrass flavor compliments and perhaps masks some the grassy flavor that green tea can have. It gives the tea a brighter and more fresh flavor. Why oh why doesn't Amazon carry this tea.  They carry almost every other Good Earth tea flavor.

Love the delicate flavor of this green tea I 've tried other green teas but all of those seemed bitter by comparison. Good Earth's Lemongrass teas has been my favorite daily tea for years now.  Do follow the instructions on the box(or tea bag) for the best flavor.

column9: the product HAS changed, not just the packaging
column10: The new box says "NEW LOOK! same great taste!" and that is a patent lie.I have been drinking this tea for over 10 years.  The previous reviewer is right - the tea is different now.  I had some of the original/previous tea and then I got a big order of the new tea, and I tried them side by side. I noticed that there are fewer tea leaves in the individual bags as well (this was obvious to the naked eye, comparing with the previous tea bags), so it's not as potent as the original. That being said, the new flavor is so bad (to me) that I am going to have to give away the 6 boxes.

Good choice in quotes.
This tea is smooth, delicious and just wonderful.  It smells wonderful while you are drinking it!  It is my absolute favorite green tea!

The addition of Lemongrass with the Green Tea had always made this my favorite of all green teas I have ever had. I couldn't wait to brew it and smell the amazing aroma as well as enjoy the taste. column9: One of the best lemongrass green tea.
column10: I drink a lot of green tea and this was the first time I tie the lemongrass green tea.I was sceptical at fist, but the scent is very soothing.

I enjoy a few cups of day.  Even when it looses it's 'heat', it's still enjoyable! Best is that it's good for you!!!

This is a very refreshing tea! Plain green tea tastes like cut grass to me! The lemongrass flavor makes it a whole different animal! It is one of my favorite green teas. I have not tried it as iced tea, but i think it would be wonderful.
My husband drinks this every morning for breakfast. It tastes good and smells wonderful. I can always tell where he is in the house by following the lovely aroma.

Each morning I brew a mug of Good Earth Green Tea to enjoy with my cereal and Bread, peanut butter and jam.  The Lemongrass flavor has been a favorite for a long time.  Finding it in a larger packet is great, and the price is right.The little messages are enjoyable, and finding out about the author is fun.Good Earth Tea Green Tea, Lemongrass, 25-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)  The delivery time from order to receipt was very fast, and packaging was excellent, no damage outside or inside to the product.Another Amazon happy customer. This tea has great flavor.  It never gets bitter, no  matter how long the tea bag sits in the water!
this is my favorite tea in the whole world.  i had some friends who claimed they didn't like green tea--until i brewed them some of this.  now they are hooked, too :)
This tea has the best flavor. It's good hot or cold. It has plenty of flavor and doesn't need a sweetener.

This tea has a wonderful aroma and flavor.  It's also just beautiful to look at, with the rose petals floating amongst the tea leaves.  I would reccomend it to anyone.  I'm not big on Earl Grey normally but this one is just lovely!

column9: It was wild Sturgeon caviar; But?
column10: After tasteing the caviar Christmas Eve morning, I decided to use it to garnish my devil eggs.  Yes, you get what you pay for! Next time, I will return to my local fish monger and pay the $125 for a half ounce she charges.[...] American Sturgeon Hackleback Wild Caviar, 2008, 1 Ounce, 1 ounce Jars

column9: stop complaining, it is what it is - COTTON CANDY
column10: I understand that people are disappointed in the product, but there is no reason to give this a one star review.  I carry this in my store and it is a hit with the customers - even Hot Tamales fans like myself.  I agree that it isn't initially what you would expect from something titled "Hot Tamales cotton candy", it isn't spicy and has only a faint cinnamon flavor.However, I love it for that reason.  We carry the Mike & Ike cotton candy as well as the traditional circus colors and the stars and stripes kind.  The Hot Tamales cotton candy is great because it is a break from the fruity flavors.  I can taste the cinnamon, though very faint, but I love it!  And so do our customers, we sell a lot of it.The one star reviews are ridiculous.  As long as you know that it isn't a strong cinnamon flavor, what is there to complain about?  The cotton candy is fresh, super fluffy and tastes great.  Perhaps there is a flaw in the advertising, they should state that the flavor is not overpowering, but if you strip away the Hot Tamales brand and don't give anyone preconceived notions of what the exact taste is, this cotton candy is a hit.I would give it 4 out of 5 stars because a little more cinnamon would definitely be a plus, but I chose to gave it 5 to counter the other 2 overly negative reviews, because it is definitely not as terrible as the others are claiming.  Again, all of my video store customers love it and keep coming back for more.  Take a chance like I did and try it for yourself, after reading this review and choosing to buy it I doubt you will be disappointed.

I bought this and repackaged it for a baby shower.  It had a very slight cinammon flavor and pink, it's not like the puffy cotton candy you would get freshly made and you can't refluff it, I tried, but it was definitely worth the price I paid for it and what I needed it for.  Quite a bit came in one package, I was surpised.

column9: Does not taste like Hot Tamales Candy
column10: This cotton candy tastes like plain sugar, like eating a spoonful straight from the sugar bowl. It does have that nice, melt-in-your-mouth texture that characterizes cotton candy. It is pink colored and has a very slight "warm" aftertaste. There is no cinnamon flavor or smell. It is quite disappointing when expecting the spicy taste of the chewy, oblong Hot Tamales candy. There is not even the traditional vanilla flavor that makes carnival and fairground cotton candy so tasty. In contrast, Spun City Cotton Candy, sold on Amazon, is a delicious treat. Spun City Cotton Candy costs more, but it's made with superior ingredients and has very good flavor. Kid's will probably eat the Hot Tamale Cotton Candy and be happy, (it is almost pure sugar, after all) but to someone who wants a bit of taste in the mix, this one is likely to be a letdown.

There is disgusting, and then there is unconscionably disgusting. There should be a senate subcommittee appointed to investigate how something so catastrophically wretched can ever make it to the tongue of even one unsuspecting consumer. We deserve to be protected against this kind of confectionery terrorism. One bite and your mouth is ground zero.Hot Tamales Cotton Candy. Not Hot. Not Tamales. Not Cotton. Not Candy. Protect yourselves...stay away.

I love this sauce.  For years now I have used this sauce as a marinade for pork tenderloin and everyone loves it and asks for the "recipe".  If you are looking for traditional teriyaki - this is NOT IT - it is sweeter and thicker than most teriyaki sauce and does have a pineapple flavor to it.  We love it and would recommend it highly.

I was actually introduced to this by a cook where I work, and yes it has a very distinct flavor. Hawaiian style Teriyaki is much sweeter, less salty, and thicker than your average grocery store stuff, which is more like Japanese style. I used it to marinade chicken, and it was the deepest marinade that my friends and my mother had ever seen. I personally liked the flavor and like to pair it with ginger and pineapple. Perhaps it is because I was given a heads up that it would be different than what I was used to, but I thought it was pretty amazing and I plan to order some and give them to my family and friends who also like it.

This is different than the traditional teriyaki sauce but delicious. It's an absolutely great marinade. (It's better as a marinade; it can be used in the skillet but doesn't pair as well with vegetables in a stir-fry.Try it for pork tenderloin -- either whole, or cut into cubes for kabobs, or boneless skinless chicken breasts.  I cut them like chicken tenders, marinate, put on skewers, and grill. I've done this for camping, picnics, and parties on the deck. The adults and the kids loved it.Shop, put your meat(s)in zip lock bags, add some World Harbor Maui Mountain Teriyaki, then freeze. When you are looking for a quick and delicious dinner, thaw and grill. I serve it with rice (or yellow rice), a vegetable or salad, and fresh fruit for dessert (melon, pineapple, grapes or berries). (Nice with Pinot Grigio or a cocktail with an umbrella!) It's a summer winner. I've gotten many compliments and many requests for the recipe! The pineapple in the teriyaki sauce also helps to tenderize the meat.

Taste is of course a very individual thing, but I ordered these assuming it'd be just like Kikoman teriyaki sauce, but instead it was just horrible. The taste was just off, and I ended up pouring them down the drain.

column9: Not teriyaki as I like it

column9: Best Aloe Juice on the market

i love this stuff but after buying a case i realized it was cheaper ($1.69 vs $2.50) at bally mart around the corner from my house !!

column9: Why this is the best drink ever.
column10: Here's the best thing you can drink that's still unknown to the masses. It tastes phenomenal and is healthy at the same time. Aloe is great for digestion and can calm some serious problems. But you'll forget about that when you taste it. It's so light and healthy and crisp and natural and refreshing and perfect. No other drink lives up to those adjectives. The flavor is like a smooth white grape juice with some honey and aloe magic thrown in. I especially love it on a hot day. Yes, Aloe can be nasty by itself but with the right tweaks it's heavenly. I gave up soda decades ago, and this is the only thing I've ever wanted to drink like soda, for pleasure alone. It has some sweetness to it, but I disagree with a few others saying it's too sweet. It comes from powdered aloe rather than actual aloe chunks in other drinks. But the benefits are still there. I would love to see this product be available everywhere as an alternative to sodas, especially if that means the price would become lower. I'm a foodie and consider this my greatest drink find of all time. Actually maybe it's better not to tell too many people. : ) Do a subscription to save, as you can cancel anytime. Cheers!

column9: A little slice of So Ko

At the time I noted that there was also Aloe Pulp Juice available so this time I tried a couple more bottles without even thinking about it. That was a mistake. column9: Has a bit of a chemical taste.

Furthermore, there is an oddly chemical taste to the drink, which may be a product of the honey.This drink is also nearly cloyingly sweet, and, though I do enjoy a sweet beverage, something this sweet is a bit off-putting.Of course, drinks are a matter of personal preference, so, to each their own. :)

I have been drinking J1 Aloe Pulp Juice for months now.  In October Amazon ran short so I ordered from JVS ($79.04 vs $60.00 from Amazon).I did not receive 24 bottles of J1, I received 24 bottles of JayOne Aloe Juice.They do not taste the same.J1 has the Superior Taste Award on its label, JayOne doesn't.J1 is sweetened with Honey and Organic Cane Juice, JayOne isn't.I am disappointed that JVS is misrepresenting their product.  These are not the only discrepancies, the vitamin contents are different as well as some other ingredients.Believe me, they do not taste the same.

Flavorful, mild curry. Rice is a little chewy, so I usually let it stew in it's cup an extra minute or two, or even shove it in a bowl and nuke it in the microwave for a minute at the end...and I often add extra vegetables, too. (Can you tell I eat this stuff at home, not at work?)

column9: Good combination of flavors and textures
column10: This product is easy to prepare and did not create any surprises in the microwave when I followed the very precise directions.  Unlike a lot of instant products that are just zap and eat, this takes about 10 minutes to prepare.  The resulting combination of textures - brown rice, wild rice, crunchy nuts, soft cooked raisins - is very satisfying and interesting.  The flavors are good and the dish is filling.  The curry flavor was not pronounced and was obscured by the several other flavors in the dish competing for attention.  As others have noted, if you are thinking of this as a meal for one, think twice, since one serving is half the package and there's no easy way to make half.  If you consume the whole thing, it's 60 grams of carbohydrates and 300 pretty empty calories - filling but not necessarily nutritious.  Still, if you can fit 300 calories of mostly starch into your menu, the taste and texture won't disappoint.

column9: i love love love love this curry
column10: I have purchased many of Dr. McDougalls microwavable ramen type cups. This has jumped up to my favorite. The texture of this pilaf is lovely. The raisins and nuts add such a wonderful feel with the rice. I add some extra curry to mine but I do not think there is anything wrong with the way it comes. You can not go wrong with only 3 grams of fat for the entired thing. I usually bring some extra veggies or two pieces of fruit with me to make this a more complete meal but you could cook this then put it in a real bowel with tofu(im a vegan) or meat if you choose, bring a salad or it might be enough for you all by itself. I just love the flavor of this. It can get a little messy if you do not watch it in the microwave because all microwaves are not made the same so times will be off. I will be getting this again for sure. I would recommend this to anyone.
I am very happy with this curry rice pilaf.  It's so easy to make, it's healthy, and very tasty.I highly recommend it!

I've bought this soup multiple times, as well as Nile brand soup and other McDougal soups.  The trick is to cook it for 60 seconds, let it rest, cook another 60 seconds after that.  I do find these soups boil over if cooking straight through.When I go on trips, I take the soup out of the container and put in a ziplock bag, then toss in my suitcase with one microwaveable bowl.  The packaging is mostly air inside.  So I can get a lot of soup in a small space doing it this way, control my calories, and know I'm getting something mostly healthy, other than the salt.

A mild curry rice with some nice sweetness from raisins and some crunch from almonds.  Several green peas and dried carrots also visible.  Rice has a nice chewy texture, love the chewy bits of wild rice.  Perfect amount of sodium for me - 26% of your daily recommended in one cup.  But if this is a meal, that seems perfectly acceptable.Nice portion size too: about two cups' worth.VERY happy to have a easy meal/snack like this that doesn't rely on beans but rather a starch.  I wish there were more instant rice/grain pilafs like this around!Will order again.
This stuff is really great, vegan or not.  Well worth $2 / meal!

Just checked the price,it's now 16.78 for six 2.5oz cups. The last order I had was 11.10 for six 3.4oz cups. Even if the Amazon ad oz. size is wrong, it is still almost one dollar per cup more!? 5 stars for the product and 0 stars for the price hike. I really like this curry but I'll buy something else until the price comes back down.12/13/2011 NEW REVIEW: Now the Price is up to $18.27. And 25% less in each cup and over twice the price per. oz..

The Black Bean soup is very good and even better the next day. The Split Pea was also quite good. The Vegan Curry is not really a soup but a nice rice dish. They are very easy to make but I recomend heating them longer than the directions recomend and instead of the suggested 8 minutes steeping time you wait a bit longer for the beans to soften.It is a good instant soup but if you reheat it the next day it's a great instant soup that is actually quite filling. The price is fair and delivery was quick. I would recomend this product to lazy people who like good soup, like me.I will buy this product again.Dean

column9: Great soup, if only it came in single portion packaging!
column10: I really enjoy this product, but would assume that when I purchase a soup "cup" that it would contain one serving. The dietary information is for 1/2 container! No lies, just missleading. If it were not for this issue, I would have rated it five stars.

This is one of my favorite McDougall soups.  It taste great.  Really filling.  I never seem to tire of it.  Also, smells wonderful.  I have it on auto ship.  The flavors are so nice as the weather is getting cooler.

take 1 container of same on warm flatbread or tortilla, mixed nuts and baby spinach.so good you might weep.the price increases 67% now that i've fallen in love?you DO know what we call boys like u, don't u?what? free shipping?? ooooh, u know what i like!

One of  Healthiest foods from Dr. McDougall,...I will order more because It's healthy foods and tasty with very low in fat and easy to eat at work , at my desk and it s delicious for foods in cups and it s cheap.

This is my first purchase of Dr. McDougall's products and I ordered 6-packs of several different kinds.  So far, I really like the Vegan Curry Pilaf and the Vegan Black Bean with Lime Soup.  There are times when homemade (although delicious) is just not convenient when you want something that is quick, good, and filling for those times when you are in a hurry!  Two-day delivery can't be beat and they were packaged with great care and were in perfect condition.
This product is alright. I LOVE the lentil couscous one. This one is a bit salty, just not as good as some of the other. But it is a great product on the fly.
This product tastes average.  Not very spicy and I find the texture odd.  The flavor of the fruit, veg, and rice together is pleasing,

Just pour hot water on it and let it stand for at least 6 min.  Then you have a delicious raisin curry with almonds.  One of the best instant meals I have had, and I eat a lot ready-to-eat meals for lunch.  If you like the flavor of curry, you cannot go wrong with this one.
This is so incredibly tasty! I love it. Healthy, easy to make, portable... wonderful! I wish it was a little bit spicier though. It is very filling and only 250 calories.

This is a surprisingly tasty, cheap, and healthy snack or light meal.  I wish it had a stronger curry taste but for what it is it's great.  I also like that it isn't entirely white rice, and the raisins are an interesting touch.  Already on my second order and will probably return for a third!

I'm not vegan but I thought I'd try this because it's all-natural, I love curry and I love ramen-style products for snacks. The fruit in it actually goes quite well with the rest of the ingredients, but the rice does tend to need a bit longer than the recommended 8 mins, otherwise it's chewy. Also - make sure you stir well or the you'll get a big ol' glob of salty seasoning. I do agree with another review that the salt could be toned down a bit.
This curry tastes really delicious, and also smell so good. It is a mild curry in terms of heat, but fully flavored.This always cooks perfectly for me, following the package instructions.
I have tried most of Dr. McDougall's soups and they are all delicious, easy to fix and very nutritious and filling!
This is another of my favorites from Dr. McDougall's Right Foods.  It's very filling and I can make it quickly for a healthful lunch.
I think the Curry is one of the best flavors...very thick and hearty and makes a good meal.  I've tried several of the Dr. McDougall flavors and Curry is probably my favorite..
I like this one, although his split pea soup and the minestrone is better.

column9: Tasty but not as handy as it seems
column10: This meal is tasty, filling and quite healthy. The berries really compliment the crunchy spice of the rice. HOWEVER, it is not as easy to take this "on-the-go" as you might think. The water needs to be boiling BEFORE it's added to the pilaf, so you need another container to heat the water in. Not always easy to find when you're taking this meal to go. I have found it works well to use hot water from a water cooler or coffee pot.

i hope people don't think this is what vegan food is supposed to taste like. BLEHHHHHHHHHHHHHH THAT'S BLAND! there are many many other good microwaveable vegan meals out there, don't eat these because you expect health food to be gross. believe me, these are overpriced and underseasoned...try  annie chun

I bought this product along with Dr. McDougall's Tortilla Soup and Dr. McDougall's Hot & Sour Noodle Soup and I must say that I waste my money behind Dr. McDougall's products. All three products I bought taste very awful and worst food I have ever ate so far. I have never experienced this kind of bad taste in my life. Now I going to throw out all 15 cups. if McDougall can give me money back I for sure return all my items.

This is really great coffee.  I only drink decaf and usually get Starbucks but Starbucks does not sell decaf K-Cups.  I tried several other brands of K-Cups and this one is the best.  I like strong coffee and darker roasts and this one is as close to Starbucks as I have found in K-Cups.  And I love that I can get this on Amazon Prime.  That's the icing on the cake!  So if you like strong, dark roast, I highly recommend this.

I have tried every supposed dark roast/bold decaf k-cup out there, none of which remotely compare to my favorite non-decaf which is Green Mt. Double Black Diamond.  Finally, this is a decaf that is every bit as good the best "regular" coffee.  If you are looking for a rich, bold decaf, I highly recommend this!
I've tried many so called bold K Cup Decaf's. Most tast watered down. If you must drink Decaf and you want something that tasts like real coffee try this one. Dr Ron. Jupiter, Fl.

I had been desperately searching for a flavorful decaffeinated alternative to my usual Jet Fuel K-cups, in vain.  Then someone told me about this stuff, so I bought a box, and it is GREAT!  If you like flavorful, dark roast coffee but want to skip the caffeine, this is the only way to go!

I had to switch to decaf a year ago to appease my doctor.  I have ordered every decaf kcup I can get my hands on.  This is hands down my favorite.  It tastes like caffeinated coffee.  Most of the others have a very similar/weaker flavor.

The package arrived on time and in good shape, but wasn't the decaf I ordered. Was full-caf which my husband drinks,so we kept it. Seemed to be too much of a hassle to return something the ultimately we would use.Good price for the product, just the WRONG product.

column9: FREE SHIPPING for $35 orders-----LIARS..do not believe this
column10: I ordered these because it stated FREE shipping for orders over $35 dollars...Happy Dog Place did not give me free shipping...I called them...they couldnt care less...WHY state free shipping for orders over $35....my puppy loves these BUT we will not be ordering from them again ...they argued with me when the add states FREE SHIPPING...I want my $9 back...The product gets 5 stars..the company and customer service gets zip
My dogs love these.  They are well priced for what they are but I found better priced bull sticks at costco. 12 for $24 but they are not as thick as these.

These are definitely my dog's favorite brand bully stick.  Warning for the faint of heart - they are stinky.  Some people don't like smelly bully sticks but these are the one sthe dogs like best.  Great quality.  Great deal.  Love 'em!!!

I have a 9 month old GSD puppy and she loves these things. The only problem is that they don't last very long, maybe 20 minutes per stick. Other than that she could chew on them all day. I give it to her on occasion as a special treat.

I've been buying the Cadet 12" braided bully sticks at my local pet store for a year, and they are always consistently thick and accurately measured. Some of them do stink but not as bad as many brands...it's true that the lighter the color the lighter the smell...of course not like we have a choice online. I'm shocked at the Amazon price, at $4 dollars each for a 12" braided stick, it's about half the cost of regular pet stores, and almost a buck cheaper than I've found at out local Pet Club.
These are some of the best Bully Sitcks I have purchases.  They were very thick and fresh.  The dogs loved these sticks. I will definately purchase more.

column9: CONFIRMED: Back to the original recipe
column10: I can confirm that they are back to the old recipe.  Coconut milk and water, nothing else.  Consistency and flavor are very good.  It's not as thick as Thai Kitchen, but I am guessing that's because they don't use guar gum as a thickener.

I have tried many brands of coconut milk and this is by far the best.  At least 1/2 the can is the thick coconut paste prized in so many recipes.  The only ingrediant is coconut extract, oh and water.  Every can is the same, no inconsistency from can to can.  I have a hard time not scooping it from the can directly into my mouth.  Have used this in rice, soups, curries, marinades, cakes/cupcakes and drinks.I understand they make an organic product that is not as good due to an emulsifier, but haven't tried it myself.

I have tried Thai Kitchen, this Natural Value, and several brands of coconut milk from my local Organic grocers.  This is one of my favorites.  I love the fact that it is not full of sulphites, and other "junk".  Love it on my porridge in the morning.  Try it, you won't regret it!

Please read the page at the following link to see what the problem was with the change in the Natural Value Coconut Milk.  I rated this product as a 5-star because I admire the company for putting the explanation on their home page!!  Besides that, I think that the original coconut milk is one of very few that does not have any guar gum or preservatives and I am so happy that they will be going back to the original.It seems like the link didn't work.  Here is the gist of what happened -On our last order from the canner, we received a totally different product. Our natural coconut milk now has guar gum in it, plus unspecified emulsifiers and stabilizers. We did not order it like that, and unfortunately, the canner not only changed the formula and the ingredients, they took the word "Natural" out of the "Natural Coconut Milk" description. They made some other changes to the ingredients and nutritional information as well - all without telling us in advance they were doing that. The Light Coconut Milk has been changed as well. If they had told us in advance, we would have said "No Thanks" and found a different canner. So we are back to producing our original formula natural coconut milk, with no guar gum and no emulsifiers and no stabilizers...but it will be about 60 days before the "same old" product is back on store shelves.Also, I have emailed Cohen at the Natural Value site and he answered as follows:Amazon pulled the coconut milk at my request and told me they may not bring it back...it's going to be "up to you" to ask for it. We're looking at about 45 days.So, if you want Amazon to carry it (the original formula) again, please email them and tell them!!Doreen
I just ordered this (January 2011) and it arrived GUAR FREE.I hope they update the listing soon.Great coconut milk yogurt.Great coconut milk hot cocoa recipe here[...]

I have been ordering this coconut milk forever because it had NO additives. I just received my latest shipment, popped open a can, and had a little taste. It didn't taste right, so I looked at the label. They've just started adding guar gum! My son can't have that, so the case is useless. I just looked at a can from my last order. They've changed it. What a waste.

This is very runny. I used it in my coffee and it doesn't add the creaminess that Thai Kitchen's coconut milk did. It also doesn't have that coconut milk flavor. It just tastes bland. I'm quite disappointed. Now I have 11 cans I have to figure out how to use.I wanted to update. The can has a money-back guarantee printed on the label. I emailed them and they sent me a refund. While I'm still unhappy with the product, the customer service was fantastic.

The first two cases I bought were very satisfactory. I mixed the coconut milk into a shake, along with bananas and cocoa and drank it straight. It was great, very fresh. I could use it on anything: salads, etc. The third case I bought had a completely different texture, smooth and creamy versus the flaky, part solid/part liquid texture of the first two cases. Unsure about it, I put a sparing amount in my shake. Minutes later, my stomach starting to act up. It couldn't digest this coconut milk properly. My wife's stomach's reaction was even worse than mine. (I've also had a similar reaction before with another brand of coconut milk, bought much less expensively at an Asian grocery). So then I looked at the ingredients, and lo and behold, there were at the end: "guar gum, stabilizers." Looking back at the description of this item here on Amazon, I see it says "No Preservatives. No Stabilizers." I also have found from other reviews that people have discovered the ingredients have changed. A once-great product is no longer, and in fact, is not as advertised.

column9: Very good quality, natural coconut milk
column10: A very good quality, natural coconut milk with no additives. I bought a case of this online after trying the coconut milk available at the supermarket in my new home town - pretty dire (Thai Kitchen). This is just what is says on the tin: coconut milk, no additives, does what it should: separates into liquid and hard coconut milk/fat in the can when cold. Perfect for Thai green curry. No artificial taste or texture (the other milk tasted like a thin paste made from flour and water). Five stars. Gonna buy another dozen cans soon...
This light version of the Natural Value coconut milk is great for making SCD legal (24 hour)yogurt.  It perfectly blends without the excess fat and has no added gar gum or thickener.

column9: Does anyone else notice a strange odor upon opening a fresh can?
column10: I ordered a case of this about four months ago to replenish my dwindling supply of coconut milk.  Fast-forward to today and you can imagine my shock when I opened not one but two! cans of coconut milk with the foulest odor imaginable.  I also notice that the taste is not so much of a coconut flavor AND it seems to be runnier than other coconut milks.  I hope this is just an odd batch and does not happen to my next batch.  Does anyone have the same experience with this brand of milk???

I bought this brand of coconut milk after a great deal of research. I wanted to avoid the additives and preservatives that most other brands contain. I have made my own coconut milk at home in the past from dessicafed coconut. It turns out incredibly delicious but is a LOT of work. I was looking for a convenient and safe alternative. Natural value was a huge disappointment. There is nothing about the taste or smell that suggests that it is made out of coconut. It has an unappealing bland taste. Why buy coconut milk if it tastes nothing like coconut? I will never purchase this product again.

I've always bought Thai Kitchen Coconut Milk or whatever is available at Walmart. But I decided to try this brand based on reviews and the price. I've only used it in curries, but so far it tastes great and I can't tell the difference between it and the Thai Kitchen. So go ahead and give it a try!

My family drinks a lot of coconut milk (about a can a day) and this is one of the best brands available.  I also recommend Chaokoh but it isn't available directly from Amazon yet and is probably better to just purchase locally.  This Natural Value Coconut Milk is one of the few that has no fillers or preservatives though which means it is perfect for making healthy coconut yogurt with the Salton YM9 1-Quart Yogurt Maker.  If you haven't tried making coconut yogurt yet I highly recommend it!A lot of people are still under the impression that Coconut milk is bad for you.  There was some faulty research done years ago on hydrogenated coconut oil which is mostly to blame for this.  If you are one of those people that are still convinced coconut is bad I highly recommend reading The Good Fat Cookbook.
I have been eating this stuff almost every day for several years and I still love it.  It is especially good in a fruit smoothie.

Gives sauces, stews, soups, etc. intense flavor of FRESH COCONUT. Unlike other coconut milk, it's more homogenized so easier to use, i.e. not clumping into thick fat with surrounding liquid. Most brands give welcome creaminess, but none have this marvelous, intense FRESH COCONUT flavor. Did I remember to say FRESH COCONUT flavor?

column9: Not as advertised - contains guar gum and stabilizer.
column10: The description says it contains "no stabilizers", yet the case I received on 2/24/10 contains guar gum and stabilizers. The ingredients list reads: "Coconut extract, guar gum, emulsifier, stabilizer".I am very unhappy about this - the ONLY reason I ordered it was because it was advertised as not having any stabilizers.

I love this brand not only because they returned to using no additives but also because this is by far one of the best milk replacements I have found. I use it for baking, cooking, anywhere I would use milk. And if you don't know what to do with the congealed oil at the top of the can, you can either heat the can a little and it will melt back into the coconut milk, or you can take it out of the can and use it in place of butter.

I got mine 2 weeks ago and have already used several. Great products, full of flavor, pure and BPA free ans too! Definitely a must to include in your life, especially beneficial and good for the paleo diet

I recently bought a case of this through Amazon.  There was no cream at the top, it's universally white almost as if homogenized.  And it has upset my tummy all week after using some it my coffee.  I am really disturbed by the lack of consistency with his company.

Although some extraction methods might be superior, or other products be organic, this one suits my needs very well, and the price can't be beat with the shelf price in local supermarkets at about $3 to $4 per can. The ingredients of Natural Value are "Pure Coconut Extract, Water" and the fat content is 17 to 19 %. It is very rich and creamy with a mild flavor and aroma, and works well in Indian cooking. I took off one star because the cans are not BPA free. I am disappointed that it is not currently available as I went through a full case very quickly.

This is by far the best coconut milk we have found, because there are no added gums. (Be careful - the organic version does contain guar gum.) We have one family member that is very sensitive to gums, and the rest of us just don't like the taste or texture.Last time I checked the can still had BPA, but sometimes with food you have to pick your battles!
Some of the cans were very good, some had a very offputting metallic taste and smell. I'll skip the reorder.

I was wary due to some of the negative reviews. I did my own taste test and have to say I've never found a better Coconut milk.I opened the can, the aroma was pure heavenly fresh coconut. It tastes delectable and melted very nicely into the meal I prepared.I'm happy I found this product and love the fact there are no additives at all.

I have purchased the Organic coconut milk many times.  It has a fresh, coconut taste and is very smooth.  But, it has guar gum added.  I decided to give the regular Natural Value a try (non-organic, no guar gum).  It is a very different product.  The coconut milk has a strange smell and flavor.  It is unpleasant and does not taste like coconut.  The can contains a lot of liquid and the coconut solid is somewhat grainy in texture compared to the organic.  Overall, I am unhappy with this product.  I cannot recommend it.

I love that this coconut milk does not contain any additives.  Just coconut milk. No guar gum, or anything else.  It tastes good. The cans arrived in good shape- no dents or other problems, and on time.  Will order again

Has a kind of off taste that I don't care for.  I have also tried the Roland Classic Coconut milk and find it better.  Roland has xanthan gun and this one has guar gum, if it makes a difference to anyone.
Natural Value Coconut Milk gets a five star rating from me for its high quality and complete customer satisfaction.

column9: nothing at all like their organic brand
column10: I thought I'd try this non organic coconut milk from Natural Value after loving the organic one (but not loving that one's price)! What a mistake. And what a waste of money as I just can't stomach this stuff. It smells funny and tastes like who knows what.. some sort of metallic flavor. ugh. Perhaps a bad batch? Not sure but definitely will not order this ever again..

This product is excellent. No chemical after-taste or smell like other similar products. It has creamy coconut texture unlike products with added guar gum. Some reviewers complained of not receiving right product. No such problem here. Unfortunately Amazon has suspended the sale due to those complaints. I am anxiously waiting for its availability again.Natural Value Coconut Milk Lite, 14 Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)

column9: good coconut milk, but I now purchase a different brand...
column10: I was new to the whole concept of using coconut milk, oil, etc., after I read Coconut Cures.  I thought this milk was fine, and was happy to use it, until I tried Thai Kitchen brand - and now I will never go back!

column9: I just wanted coconut! Not guar gum.
column10: The first case I purchased was beautiful: just coconut and water. Sure, you had to stir it, but the flavor: yum. The next case poured smoothly, but the stuff tastes fake due to the addition of guar gum. I won't be purchasing this brand again until they change it back.There are other brands for people who look for texture over taste.  Unfortunately, Natural Value has joined the ranks. It is a shame.

column9: This is not what I wanted
