I followed the directions when making it, so I don't *think* I used too much mix, but you might try using less than the instructions call for.I'm going to try it again at some point, using less mix and keeping it stirred in between sips, to see if that helps.  But otherwise I have 3 more canisters to try and give away - if you haven't tried it, buy as small of a pack as you can for a taste test first.

This is a great treat for the Fall and Winter months hunting, camping or just snuggling up to watch a movie. The cinnamon is not too overpowering with the chocolate and has a rich cocoa flavor. My wife drinks it as an alternative to coffee so she can sleep at night.
Ok it makes a Great Cup o' Chocolate! But I really use it in my baking of Brownier, Cookies, etc. Such a good addition to any scratch baking project.

column9: Great Hot Chocolate w/a bit of spice
column10: This makes an excellent hot chocolate.  I also make my own gourmet hot chocolate mix and I use a bit of this to kick up some of the mix.
Tried this while I was visiting in PA. All natural ingredients, while the flavor is exceptional!  Try this one, you'll never drink any other!

This is, hands down, the absolute best hot chocolate ever. First had it years ago in a little cafe in Va. Have been ordering it online ever since. Have also given it to friends & family as a gift and everyone raves about it. A wonderful taste of chocolate mixed with just the right spices. Try it once and you'll be hooked.

To me it seems like too much sugar, not enough chocolate, a little heavy on the spice. Sugar is the first ingredient. But if not for the sugar problem I wouldn't complain about the spice. I tried adding 1/2 pound of powdered cocoa to the 3 pound bag and it was still too sweet. It's amazing to me how far this is from "the best hot chocolate ever" like other reviewers rated. Def try a small bag first to see who you agree with.

column9: Too Spiced And Not Chocolaty Enough
column10: Unfortunately, I was disappointed with this chocolate--too heavily spiced and too sweet; not enough of that velvety, smooth pure chocolate that I prefer. I have 4 tins that I will give away to friends and family.  I'll be back and will let you know how they like it.

A wonderful taste surprise that has spoiled me for all other hot chocolate drinks there ever were.MOCAFE Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate is a rich, creamy, spice surprise that is not your mama's hot chocolate. If you are a hot chocolate drinker don't miss this.

This is probably the best-tasting cocoa I've ever had at home.  A friend gave me a small tin of it years ago as a holiday gift.  We enjoyed every bit of it but had trouble finding more until it turned up on Amazon.  Smells great, tastes great, and is made with real ingredients (not artificial sweeteners and weird chemicals).  Really fantastic stuff.  It's also great in brownies and cakes - adds some spices above and beyond what most people expect.  Tastes like fall, in the best way possible.  Here's a recipe to try:  a few frozen bananas (for chill and body), about a  cup of crunchy peanut butter, about half a cup of almond or regular or soy milk (more milk if you like a thinner shake), a scoop of this cocoa, and blend.  Drink it right away.  Filling, lots of vitamins, and naturally sweet.  I know people who swear by it as their daily breakfast.  Yum!

I got the 3lb bag and the recipes on the bag call for "scoops." A scoop was not provided in my bag, but they say that 2 scoops is equivalent to about 8 tbsp. However, the nutrition information is given by 38g serving, not by tbsp or "scoop." I measured it out with my food scale and 38g came to exactly 3 level tbsp, so if I made the Iced Chocolate as directed (2 scoops/8 tbsp), I'd be getting almost 3 servings of chocolate mix (420 cal before the milk!). I cut the milk in half (3oz hot and 4oz cold) and use one serving (38g/3 tbsp) chocolate, served over ice, and to me it is delicious with a nice strong spicy chocolate flavor, and it is a reasonable 217 cal when using skim milk.Different palates are going to have different preferences as far as the balance of spice and chocolate, but I can tell you that I like it. My husband does not care much for cinnamon but he also likes it, and my children like it too. We have only tried it cold so far and are looking forward to trying it hot!
I purchased this product because of the reviews I read and I'm so glad I did.  I love it.  If your looking for a good hot chocolate this is it.  Sweet, spicy chocolate...very good.
This is the best drinking chocolate I have had on the market.  The spices are perfectly combined for an authentic Mexican taste. The seller delivered 100% as promised.Thank you.

This stuff is just awful. Doesn't taste like chocolate in the slightest. I've had very good Mexican spiced chocolate that actually tasted like chocolate. This stuff is just a mix of cinnamon and a bunch of other overpowering spices that are not pleasant. I can't believe this stuff has such good reviews. It's iky
I've been using the MOCAFE Azteca for years.  Sweet and a bit of spice.  Mixes easily.  And you can get by with half the suggested amount.  Nothing warms you up faster on a cold, winter day.

i love this spicy chocolate. it's perfect for anytime. the best way to make it, is to heat your milk on the stove and add the chocolate as it is warming. i also add some whipped cream to my cup with a sprinkle of chili powder on the top. love to curl up and just relax with a warm cup.

if you want to try an excellent brand La Parisienne Couture Cocoa you will find is the best one on Amazon.So far I have tried:Bellagio Sipping ChocolateLake Champlain Hot Chocolate MixesLa Parisienne Couture Cocoa (My Favorite)MarieBelle Mocafe Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate (didn't like at all)Jacques Torres Classic Hot ChocolateVosges La Parisienne Couture CocoaSarabeth's Kitchen Hot ChocolateLa Maison du Chocolat Tasse de ChocolatLove to hear others feedback.....
This stuff is good!!  That's all I have to say.  Rich chocolate, sweet but not overpowering, with a taste of cinnamon and almonds.  Great combination.

column9: Not nearly as good as 2 other Mexican Spiced hot chocolates.
column10: This is the 3rd brand of Mexican Spiced hot cocoa that I've ordered.  This by far is the poorest in tasting.  The other 2 were far superior in flavor.
...but you'd better like sweet. This is not for those who want dark or semi-sweet chocolate. For those of us who like sweet, this is decadent . It is worth the $! Go for it!!!
this is the best mix i have found.  i have been buying it for the last four years and plan on buying it as long as it is for sale.
I had 6 sample packets 1.25 oz. My oldest daughter 12 yrs loved it with whole or 2% milk. Have used some mixed with my morning coffee. Best Hot Cocoa mix I've tried.

So chocolaty and spiced just right! I decided to try this brand after reading all the wonderful reviews. I'd never had spiced hot chocolate before - just the plain store-bought instant kind. WOW! The flavor of this just blew me away! Best cup of hot chocolate I've ever tasted!! I'm hooked!!

Love this stuff.  It has one of the best combinations of chocolate and mexican spice flavors of any I have tried.  I used to live near a bookstore where the cafe made mochas with this cocoa and now I buy it at home for the same purpose.  It also works really well to add a little spice to your cookies.
First found this hot chocolate on the Museum of Natural History of all places. There's a great blend of sweetness and spice. It's so yummy!

column9: Can't get much better than this.
column10: This awesome mix is not your usual Hot Chocolate so if that is what you are looking for do not buy this product. But if you are looking for a chocolate that tickles your senses then you definitely want to buy this. The first time I tried it I was not sure so I drank some more, still couldn't decide so I drank some more. So I still couldn't decide so I drank more and then I knew. . . . Ahhhhh What a delicious hot chocolate this is. One that can not be defined.MOCAFE Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate, 14-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4)

This cocoa has ruined all other cocoas for me! This is all I want now, but to be honest it is a little expensive, especially with shipping always applied. So when it arrives I hide it. I leave the Swiss Mix and the Nestles out, and save this for moments when I just want to indulge myself. I have shared it occasionally, but only when the kids are very, very good. Try it and treat yourself.

My husband is not a coffee drinker and the nippy mornings left him a little jealous of my warm cup of coffee.  Having just returned from a trip to Santa Fe where I had purchased it originally, I introduced him to the pleasures of morning hot chocolate.  He was hooked!!  Now for the other use, today , the day after Thanksgiving clean up we were at breakfast without any milk in the house, but an abundance of leftover decaf coffee from the celebration, his long face was brightened when I spooned in a bit of MOCAFE Mexican Spiced Chocolate into a cup of decaf.  WOW! a new taste and he loved it!What else can I say, it's a hit around our house.

As a family living with Celiac Disease (Gluten Intolerance) as well as Dairy/Lactose Intolerance, finding tasty hot chocolate mix that doesn't taste like tree bark and dirt (my children's descriptions for other brands we've tried)  is a challenge, until now. THIS chocolate is amazing- we mix this with hot Silk (tm) Brand Almond Milk and WOW! Even our non-Celiac friends and family love it- it is smooth, creamy, rich and delicately spiced. Just amazing and well worth the price! We LOVE it! ADDICTIVE!

column9: The best pre-mixed spiced hot chocolate ever!
column10: I first tried it about seven years. Trader Joe's use to sell it in their stores and at the best price ever!  I am a hot cocoa fanatic AND I'm Mexican.  Per my qualifications, I say this is a great blend.  The ingredients are fresher than Abuelita and the sugar isn't as gritty.  I only wish I could find it wholesale.  Price is a bit steep at Amazon...16 oz. (3-pack) - 34 cents/oz14 oz. (4-pack) - 43 cents/oz.The 3-pack is the best deal (just over $1.00 per 8 oz. serving).  You can get 69 servings for $32.67.I have yet found a better prepared Mexican hot cocoa, seven years later.

This product is, in fact, a spiced, chocolate drink.It is yummy.It is not super-chocolatety, but it does have enough chocolate flavor to warrant it being labeled a chocolate drink.  It *is* very sugary, but what reasonable person believes that a chocolate drink should be anything other than a treat?I give it four stars because while very yummy, it does not send my consciousness into the higher stratosphere of the realm of pure, abstract deliciousness.  It is, however, a product I will purchase again.It tastes sweet, cinnamony, and chocolatey and has some other flavors I cannot identify.  I recommend it if you like or are curious about such things.
I really like to put this on top of the coffee before brewing.  Yummy!
This is a fabulous drink that our entire family enjoys ! It has just the right combination of spices and chocolate.

column9: not my cup of tea, so to speak
column10: This product is great if you like the particular spices used in the mix.  Unfortunately, although I am drinking it, I am not enjoying it as the flavors just don't jive with my palate.  If you really like the spice combination (I like cinnamon, for example, in almost everything, but in the chocolate mix it just doesn't make it for me), you'll love it.  I guess my advice is the product is fine if you like the flavor combination, but I would advise trying the mix in a small packet to determine whether or not it's for you.  I have this huge quantity to consume, and I rarely partake of it as I don't really care much for it.
This is the best spiced cocoa I've ever used. I love to put it in my coffee every morning!
This hot mexican spiced ground chocolate is a great defroster for the winter blast weather.  I love sipping this hot chocolate while watching the snow flakes falling.

I really like this product. I NEED coffee in the morning, so I add this to my coffee, in addition to adding a teaspoon of ground espresso to the cup as well. This has a nice taste to it, not too too sweet & just a bit of a cinnamon-y flavor. Its very good. A little pricey, but buying it in quantity like this saves me a few trips to Whole Foods.

YUMM!! And it's Lactose, Gluten and Soy Free* (*Save Soy Lecithin/lecithinan, which it seems that many with soy allergies can tolerate)Ingredients - per package (3 # bag)Pure Hawaiian cane sugar, Premium Forestero cocoa, ground chocolate (sugar & Cocoa processed with alkali, unsweetened chocolate, soy lecithinan emulsifier, pure vanilla), spices, all natural flavors & salt&Although the tins come with the scoop (which holds about 2.5-3 T.), I get a better price buying the 3-Pound Bag and using a 2 T. coffee scoop. I found the secret to using this in a manner I can enjoy it, as I find the original instructions make it way too intense.  I only add 1 scoop (2T.) to a cup, then add enough hot water to fill the cup half full, stir, then top off with almond milk or coconut milk.  Yummm!!  And, being Diabetic, I get my daily cinnamon!MOCAFE Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate, 3-Pound Bag

The MOCAFE Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate is a very interesting drink. Not knowing what to expect [I speculated that the hot chocolate would have a touch of heat], I made a cup as soon as it was delivered. To my surprise, it has a strong cinnamon [and probably nutmeg] flavor - it is a good hot chocolate.I mix the chocolate powder with steamed/frothed milk from my espresso maker - I find this makes the drink much better. It takes a couple of cups to really make an opinion, but I think it is a good hot chocolate to drink every day.

We discovered a cafe that had excellent Mexican mochas about three years ago. They were expensive but we didn't visit that often. Then we discovered this was the powder used to make the mochas. It is all natural and tastes great. It is really rich and has nice spicy undertones. This is the cheapest way to purchase it in bulk.Now we make our mochas at home with an espresso machine and steamed milk. This also is loved by our children for hot chocolate.

I first got this in Ridgeway, CO., driving 40 minutes each way to get a mocha made with thismix. Then the woman who was making my coffee during my stay let me know it was just amix. I couldn't believe it, but it's true, a very delicious mix you can do right at home.
I love hot chocolate, but I found this mix repulsive. There wasn't a strong chocolate flavor and the other flavor notes where far too sweet.  I had to throw it away. I will never purchase this again.

column9: Good, rich and high quality but not what I was expecting
column10: I rather enjoy mexican hot chocolate and am used to getting the thicker ground Ibarra style version.  The ingredients are quality and it makes a good drink appreciated by guests but unfortunately is not exactly what I wanted.
I found this product in a coffee shop in Chincoteague, VA  And was blown away by it's taste.  Energizing, but not too over the top.  And I received it quickly.

column9: Love the cocoa, not the packaging.
column10: I found this cocoa at Bristol Farms while looking for a healthier cocoa without the partially hydrogenated oils in most of them.  I love the spiciness of this cocoa and put half a scoop in my coffee every morning.  I don't drink straight coffee so I carry this powder with me when I travel too.I was thrilled to find this item on amazon after Bristol Farms ran out for a while.  I have received a few of the 25 lb boxes with no problems, but my last $113 box is in the trash after I cut the plastic tie and found baby silverfish in it.  These bags are not sealed, just have a plastic tie aroung the bag opening so lots of tiny things can crawl in.  I know we have silverfish here at my husband's house, but now that I have just thrown $100 in the trash I wonder why they can't seal these bags?  I'm going to have to start buying a smaller quantity and just pay more per ounce so this doesn't happen again.  Unless a few people are drinking this or you only have one serving a day you need to plan for storage of this powder for quite a while.

column9: Do Not Buy Mocafe Azteca D;oro 1519 from Amazon.com!!!
column10: Do Not Buy Mocafe Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican ground chocolate 3lb bag from Amazon.com. Ordered 1st time on 7/18/10 did not receive Azteca, instead received CHAI The excuse was could not stop the order in time.  2nd time received Chai again although on Amazon's website the product advertised is Mocafe Azteca 1519 ground chocolate. This time i'm told to buy from a out side vendor. SAVE YOUR SELF THE AGGREVATION AND DO NOT BUY FROM AMAZON!!!MOCAFE Azteca D'Oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate, 3-Pound Tins (Pack of 2)

column4: Lingering Lethal Poisonous Lene of Death
column9: MUCH better than all purpose flour!
column10: I have despaired after moving to the US, because I couldn't get my cakes light and fluffy like I used to in Europe. I have searched grocery stores, and speciality stores, and have not been able to find anything but cake mixes. That does now work with my recipes, so I was getting desperate. Swans Down Cake Flour to the rescue!I just baked a fluffy sponge cake today, and it came out great! Definitely will buy more, as this is some good cake making stuff!

These are tasty but expensive for how many you actually get. I ordered them for a baby shower and everyone seemed to enjoy them. they are cute but probably not worth the expensive cost plus shipping. I was stuck in a time crunch so it worked out but would not re-buy.

We ordered the coins to aid in revealing the gender of our baby at our baby shower two weeks early. When we got home from work we found the box behind the bushes at our front door. The ants had made their way into the package and the cold pack that was included was melted. We did not try to get our money back. We just chalked it up and placed another order thinking we would get the new package delivered to my husband's job in the same quick timeframe. This time we received them 3 days after the shower!!! Never again!!!!!

This is exactly what I thought it would be.  The little individual packets of cereal.  Great for snacks.  I actually bought them to send for lunch at school.  My 5 year old loves having cereal for lunch.  I decided on these for the great price but when she couldn't screw on the thermos top and got milk every where this was my solution.  I even put them in the car for snack in the car.  They are only 8 grams of sugar.  I couldn't be happier!!  Thinking about getting another box.

I enjoyed Brown & Haley Almond Roca butter crunch.  The outside coating was chocolatey with bits of crunch and the butter crunch inside was tasty and not hard like other butter crunch I've had. I was very satisfied with this product and would definitely order it again.
Brown & Haley Almond Roca's are delicious!!! I've given these as gifts to many close friends and family and they all seem to like it a lot.  Highly recommend to those who have a sweet tooth!
Lakewood's Pina Colada is my absolute favorite juice. It is utterly delicious and fresh.  So excited Amazon sells it. If you like "Pina Colada" in general, you will love this organic healthy juice.

I haven't been able to find the Weight Control Oatmeal in the stores for over a month, so I was thrilled that Amazon offers it at a great price!For those of you who haven't tried it, it's EXCELLENT! Fresh banana taste that warms your bones!

I'd like to thank the geniuses at Quaker Oats for taking the boxes of Banana Bread oatmeal out of production. We loved it. We were going thru a 1 1/2 boxes of it a week here in our house. And now that it's no longer offered we buy zip, zero, 0, none, null set boxes of oatmeal. (We're not interested in buying the variety box and tossing out most of the contents)But thanks to the geniuses at Quaker Oats we eat Pop-Tarts and dry cereals.Banana Bread oatmeal was part of a diet that helped me lose 30 pounds in three months. (but they won't have to worry about me making such a claim again)One last time, thank you Quaker Oats for listening to a spreadsheet instead of your customers.

I was thrilled to find this flavor available at amazon.  I had not seen it in the grocery stores for a while so I called Quaker and was told they would no longer be packaging the Banana Bread flavor alone.  It would only be available as part of a variety pack.  This, of course, is the only flavor my husband likes, so I'll buy it from amazon until it's all gone. :-)

I think this is the best oatmeal ever and is getting hard to find in the stores in my area.  I think it has a true banana taste which is hard to pull off.  It is filling and a healthy choice and I hope Quaker continues to make this flavor.

I have been using regularly the Quaker Oats "Lower Sugar" line for several years and loved the convenience and taste, but was not thrilled with the nutritional characteristics of the product.  A few months ago I became aware of the "Weight Control" line, and gave it a try.  Initially, I was uncertain about the different texture -- it is stickier probably due to the addition of whey to boost the protein content -- but after 3 or so days the texture didn't bother me.  I really like the better nutritional underpinning of this product, i.e. very little sugar, more fiber, and a lot more protein, which means it satisfies my appetite through the morning until lunch time!  My personal preference is for the Banana Bread flavor over the others.  Often I will take a small baggie of berries or even sliced bananas to mix in with the oatmeal after I've completed microwaving it.  I enjoy this every morning at the office, and occasionally at home on the weekends.

column9: Please bring it back!  Call or Write to Quaker Oats
column10: Like several others, I was devastated when I no longer could find the original Banana Bread Instant Oatmeal. I cannot believe that it was not selling well. How much do you have to sell to call it a success?  Quaker had a product that was so much healthier than the sugared cereals that too many parents buy their kids, and they take away a very healthful cereal - one that a person will almost surely like immediately.  You could also add healthy fruits to it and make it an even better product for breakfast, for kids and adults.From someone who cannot eat cinnamon, just think of how many other cereals from Quaker have cinnamon in them!  I have a serious illness and this is one of the very few things I can eat. I need this cereal.  I hate buying a variety pack and thowing away most of it, but I have been doing that to get the 2 packets of Banana Bread cereal. I'll have to stop that however, since it is too expensive to continue buying it that way. EDITED on SEPTEMBER 16 2011- I have stopped buying the variety pack, or anything else Quaker if I can avoid it at all. I still have so much touble finding something I can eat that is healthy for me, that tastes good and that is easily digestible.Also, have you noticed that those two packets of Banana Bread Instant Oatmeal do not taste like the original?  They are not very good at all. Quaker changed the ingredients somehow, and either thought we could not tell the difference, or didn't care what we thought. But it is definitely different from the original, when it comes to taste. There is also less of it, since I used the same bowl for the original and for these wth the two packets, and I can tell by the amount it makes. What a ripoff they are pulling on the customer!I ask all of you who want this cereal to be returned to the grocery shelves, in its own box and not 2 in a variety pack, to call Quaker Oats and request this.  The number is "toll free at 1-800-FOR-OATS (1-800-367-6287)"EDIT on July 24, 2012.  Someone told me, in a reply to this note, that I should not waste food and should donate the packets I didn't like. I just wanted to say that I NEVER waste food- and that the packets I didn't like were given to my son and his roommate. I hope the person who must have been trying to educate me would now agree with MY choice of what to do with food I don't like.

I absolutely LOVE this oatmeal.  I have no idea who can possibly feel full from one regular packet of oatmeal.  However, the weight control oatmeals are quite filling... and very delicious.  The banana bread is my favorte flavor and like other reviewers, I couldn't find the one-flavor box anywhere.  They were available all over up until a few years ago and they suddenly disappeared.  I decided to write to Quaker and they actually responded and told me all the local supermarkets that sold the single-box banana bread flavor in the past month.  Turns out there is ONE supermarket (a Price Chopper) in my entire county that has it.  I have since stock-piled 6 boxes in my house.  Try contacting the company.  Don't pay the ridiculous price asked for on Amazon!!

I was disappointed that eight packages of oatmeal were removed from their original sealed box and shipped loose.  I chose to pay more on Amazon as opposed to EBAY which was dramatically cheaper, because EBAY sellers specified that they removed the oatmeal packages from their original sealed box for shipping purposes. (makes the package lighter, smaller and cheaper to mail).  When it comes to purchasing food thru the mail, I prefer it in it's original sealed box.  Quality has been fine, though.

column9: Wife loves the banana bread flavor but it's hard to find.
column10: My wife loves this banana bread flavor of weight control oatmeal.  It is impossible to find in a non-variety pack.  Our local supermarket used to carry just boxes of weight control banana bread but now it is only available in the weight control variety pack.  Amazon is about the only place I could find just the boxes of only banana bread weight control and I'm not sure how much longer it will be available on here as I heard quaker oats is discontinuing the banana bread only box.  Great oatmeal!

I've been eating Quaker Instant Oatmeal for years. I like most of the flavors ( even the plain ) and the banana cream is wonderful but they only sell it in the variety pack. I figured this would taste just as good as the banana cream so I ordered it. That was a mistake. This was terrible ! It had almost no taste and the taste it had was that of a diet after-taste. That's the only way to explain it. It has a chemical and paste taste...if that makes sense. I thought of donating it to my local foodbank but I feel bad giving such a terrible tasting product to a family in need.

My biggest problem with Amazon is their return policy, or lack thereof, on unopened grocery items. I ordered the four pack since they can't seem to sell single boxes, and ended up hating this stuff. Now I'm stuck with three new boxes of inedible oatmeal. I couldn't get passed the  artificial sweetener aftertaste.

I purchaed this cereal some time ago in the grocery store.  I loved it but all stores stopped selling it.  I am so glad it can be purchased through Amazon.  It is so easy to prepare and fabulous.  I eat it every day -- not only for breakfast but sometimes dinner too.  It is so filling and I love the banan taste. Also low calories.  Can't beat that.
Impossible to find in the grocery but amazon made my connection.  Can't stick to my diet w/out this.  Best oatmeal on the market.

I bought this not because it was a 'weight control' formula but because of the flavor. I love Quaker oatmeal and I love Banana bread so I figured it would be a logical thing to buy. I'm glad I bought this because this oatmeal is delicious. It has a real banana flavor - not a fake banana flavor. And it does remind me of eating homemade banana bread. I love the fact that it's got 7g of protein and 6g of dietary fiber because I'm trying to get more protein and fiber in my diet.

I had had a very hard time trying to find Quaker Banana Bread Oatmeal.  I was quite excited when I found it at Amazon.  The service was excellent. The price was right.  I am delighted to have my oatmeal again.

When I could'nt find these at any of the supermarkets anymore, (I guess 'cause they've been discontnued) I quickly went on amazon and to my amazement they had it available for order there. Gotta say, by far the best tasting oatmeal I've ever had so for sure they're my absolute favorite. Keep up the good work amazon and always have these around. Big fan! Bye the way, I also find this to be true for a lot of the other hard to find products out there that I like. When in doubt or can't locate it else where check on amazon.com

column9: Over $10.00 per box?? You got to be kidding!!!
column10: Shame on you, Amazon, for even listing this!  The brown-sugar maple variety, 4 - 8 pack boxes sell for just under $13.00 - but the Banana Bread 4 - 8 pack goes for $49.99???  Give me a break!!!

column9: Banana bread is twice the price of the other flavors?
column10: Surely the banana bread is priced wrong?  $35 for 4 boxes of 8?  The other flavors are half that price.  I have been wanting to get this flavor again since they stopped doing the single flavor boxes in the supermarket and I am keen to add it to my cart but can't justify paying nearly $9 a box for it, especially when I am buying in bulk now too!
I use to buy a pack about every-day, THESE RAN OUT !!! Don't order in the summer-time, they'll melt, ......LOVE THEM and real fresh and NOT MELTED,..

I have been a tea drinker for years now.  Red Rose is our favorite in the household.  Regular for my husband and decaf for me.  We just recently moved to Tulsa, OK from Redmond, WA and the stores don't sell Red Rose.  We did find the regular at an Albertson store but no decaf.  Now it is ordering it on line from Amazon.  It is a great black tea and we are glad we can order it from Amazon.
i love this gum it is my favorite gum i have had i really think the flavor does last for awhile than other gums
Product excactly as shown, shipped quickly and Love all the flavors that can be used to prepare a variety of food items. Very pleased with the order and transaction - highly recommend!

column9: Mediocre taste, expensive, and label falsely implies product is decaffeinated
column10: 1) This product is not at all decaffeinated. The "99.7% caffeine free" on the label refers to the percentage of stuff in the container that is not caffeine, rather than a portion of caffeine that has been removed from the cocoa. It is no more meaningful than it would be to write "100% nightshade free" on the container. See the comment thread under Matt's review for more information. 2-star penalty for misleading advertising.2) This cocoa tastes no better than cheaper brands I've tried, and it is more expensive other brands that taste better. 3 stars for taste.3) The fat-free aspect is not very significant, at least not to me. Cocoa powder is roughly 20% fat, but you only need a small amount of cocoa powder to make hot chocolate.4) The metal containers, while nice looking, do not function well. It is difficult to open them without spilling some cocoa.

This is a great product with a rich chocolate taste and best of all it is decaffeinated so you can make hot chocolate late at night and not have to worry about not being able to sleep.  Also great for those who are on Suzanne Sommers' weight loss program - this product is Level One!

Absolutely deceptive advertising.I use in the AM Equal Exchange Baking Cocoa for my hot cocoa - FANTASTIC, Organic and Fair Trade but I can only drink it in the AM.So I tried this. 6 oz container (not 8 or larger) and the powder is so light it can fly away - probably due to removing fat albeit .5G per serving - not a lot.Overall, the taste is decent with a little stevia and hot liquid of your choice. BUT, because it is so light it requires double to have reasonable amount of flavor.It HAS NOT kept me awake at all though, so in the very least for me it is decaf - beyond that, this product is mediocre.
I have been using this brand of cocoa for over 10 years and love it but I can't order 12 cans at a time! If you make it available as single cans or even 3 or 4 I would buy, but not a dozen!

This may or may not be a tasty cocoa powder, but is not decaffeinated and it is not free of caffeine.  The product is simply cocoa powder, the same thing you get if you buy Hershey's or any other brand of unsweetened cocoa.  The label states that the powder is "99.7% caffeine free."  This is true because -- you guessed it -- cocoa powder naturally consists of 0.3% caffeine.  This is not comparable to statements that (for instance) decaffeinated coffee is 97% caffeine free, which means that 97% of the original caffeine content has been removed.If you make a cup of hot chocolate from this powder, using one tablespoon per 8 ounces of milk, the caffeine content will be reasonably low -- approximately 15 milligrams -- but perceptible to someone who is very sensitive to caffeine.  If you make what we might call the Angelina's cocoa recipe (about 80 grams of cocoa), you will have 240 milligrams of caffeine, about the equivalent of a "tall" Starbucks coffee.  Do not buy this powder (as I unfortunately did) thinking that you can make your favorite brownies, truffles, or even hot chocolate with any less caffeine than those recipes would have if you made them from another standard unsweetened cocoa powder.Rated 1 star for deceptive advertising.

Alba Bonanica seems to be the going the right direction with some of their products, but this one could improve.

I didn't get much use out of this before the warm weather left us, but the use I did get was satisfactory.  I didn't get burned despite prolonged sun exposure, and it held up well in water and sweat as advertised.  It's a relatively inexpensive and effective sunscreen that is vegan.  Not much else I can really ask for in a sunscreen.

column9: Alba Hawaiian Natural Sunblock with Green Tea, SPF 45 4 fl oz (113 g)
column10: Has a nice fresh smell, makes my face glow but on days when my skin is feeling particularly oily not good. Doesn't have a mask-y effect. Good sunblock except if I use it even near my eyes(i need sunblock around my eyes, especially under), they will at random later on in the day, just start watering profusely, you can't even keep them open for a sec. Unfortunately I found this out while I was driving. Other sunblocks used near my eyes did not do this.

column9: Tasty way to get flaxseed - but exactly how much?
column10: I am trying to get milled flaxseed into my diet, but my sweet tooth still has a fierce grip on me.  So when I stumbled upon these Omega 3 Munchies while looking for non-instant powdered milk (another story, another review), they went into my shopping cart faster than a discouraged Atkins dieter can say "carbs ...NOW!"And holy cannoli, these gems are yummy.  Not too hard to chew and the sugary bits do not get glommed onto the teeth, like some carmelized treats.  But I would like to know exactly how much flax seed each serving has (and there are 5 quarter-cup servings in a 5 ounce bag - who are they kidding?).  A book I am reading urges people to incorporate 1/4 of milled flaxseed into their daily diet.  I know that same book would not be pleased with these ingredients: evaporated cane juice, brown rice syrup, and maple syrup, all of which come before flaxseed.But for now, just let me enjoy these, okay?  They've got to be better than the Belgian Chocolate-Covered Oreos that somehow also made it into my shopping cart.

I live in Texas. While visiting our daughter in SD recently, she purchased these at her local grocery store. She served as salad topping, but then we ate a couple of packages by the handfuls. I went back the next morning on our way back home and purchased all they had in the maple and cinnamon flavors. I emailed the company and asked where I could buy more locally (Texas). They advised that this is a new product and only available to date in the Midwest basically, but that I could order through Amazon! I am thrilled! These are fantastic! a little on the expensive side, but just learn to "pace yourself" and not eat too many! Maple is our favorite; cinnamon is good too; haven't tried banana flavor. Enjoy!

column9: great mocha frappe with little peices of chocolate chips!
column10: Saves time and money from trips to the coffee shops by making your own!  This flavor is like a mocha with peices of chocolate chips in it also.  Very good

column9: the best coffee mix on the market
column10: This mix is easy to use. I have one of these drinks almost every day.I mix mine with ice and milk and it keeps me satisfied until dinner time.I think that the jave chip is perfect.Thanks Amazon for having it available.

column9: Best Prepared Pizza Sauce I have ever had and I have had many!
column10: This is really the best Pizza sauce I have had and I have had many a pizza sauce.  This is not watery nor chunky like most marinara.  This is the right consistency and is very flavorful.  It is pricey and I haven't tried Muir Glen which is a little less but I have tried the Ragus, Contandinas and many other brands and this is the ultimate.  I can probably make about four naan bread sized pizzas with one can.
Have ordered this item twice. Both times it was received stale dated i.e.  past the "best before date."Disappointed they would repeatedly send us stale dated stock.
it's the best. we will all ways buy this bbq sauce, good on pork chops.i will have to find it in my home town.the best

Panettone is a delightful fruity Bread. The dough is very smooth and chewy, sweet and confort. Ideal for tee, coffee and fruity wine (not sour). In some countries like Italy and Brazil they are very traditional specially around the holidays. In Brazil they are traditional as eggnog for us at Christmas. With that said. Bauducco is one of the best in the world, the consistency and texture is just right on this one, (and thats a big deal) hard to find, so if you know how a panettone should taste like, this is the best one for you. We love it. We normally go through 20 from November to New Years eve. I recommend, totally.  : )

This is just the best thing ever!  I've been able to buy it around the Holidays at Walgrens here in Florida.  I buy several at a time and sometimes have 3 or 4 sitting around the house especially as the season nears its end. We've tried three different kinds, chocolate, one other that we didn't like, and the classic "Panettone Specialty Cake" (26.2 oz) which is our favorite.This product will never end up as French Toast of Bread Pudding in this house - it's just so delicious on its own.
I tried several different kinds and this one is the absolute best. It is so moist and chewy, with an amazing smell when you open the box. Highly recommend!!!

I love when this stuff comes out in stores every year, because that means I get to make bread pudding!  This bread is incredible for bread pudding, as it has spices and dried fruits already built in.  Just cube up, let sit overnight (or if in a hurry, just use it as-is), and use it as the bread component in a good bread pudding recipe (I recommend one from the Food Network).  This stuff is incredible!  It also makes fantastic stuffing!

column9: Worst Panettone I have ever had.
column10: Please don't be fooled. I thought I was purchasing a brand that was international, but it is made right here in the good ole USA.I have had a lot better! The taste is like a raisen bread.
This was the best stuff for my first trimester!  Even my husband enjoyed nibbling on it. Not too sweet and full of ginger flavor.

My concern before this was ordered was if it was made in the USA.  My e-mail was quickly answered with a yes.  If you are a crystallized ginger lover this is the place to get it.  GREAT price and GREAT taste.  We will order from this site again.  The only problem I have with it is keeping my husband from devouring it before I can use it in my baking.
This product is very delicious but the quanity was a little small... It came in less time than stated and the beans are simply delicious!!!
Very good product.  Shipped quickly and arrived in good condition.  Has a long shelf life so it will keep for a long time.  I would recommend purchase of this product.

I hadn't had many opportunities to eat chocolate covered espresso beans but the few I'd had were good. I was really looking forward to these. My only real  gripes were the shipping costs and the fact that it took way to long for my shipment to arrive, in my opinion.

It's chocolate. It's coffee. How can you go wrong?!? I'm impressed with the company and I received my product way before the suggested delivery date. Item came with a re-freezable ice pack that worked great. I'm using it over & over again when I pack a lunch.Trust this seller. Nothing but great words for the entire transaction.

After searching to find the bean with MILK chocolate and paying extra to get it here before Christmas I open the box and find that they are in fact DARK chocolate.  Clearly states Milk chocolate in the description.  Now its too late to resolve the issue before Christmas.  No phone numbers to call so that customer service can overnight what I ordered.

We just received the chocolate coated cherries I ordered for my wife for Valentine's Day and we were very disappointed with the product.  The coating was very light and the cherries were dry inside, tasting stale.  It certainly was not up to the standards we expected from Ghirardelli.
Its simply awesome. Writing from phn .... Details will be added later. This This is my 4th pack and I am going after more.

I love all the flavors, orange spice is my favorite. One thing to keep in mind is that the flavors require different amount of water. It's probably a matter of taste but I would still say so. The Irish breakfast needs the most and ginger one the least, not much difference though. Once you get the perfect amount to your taste, you are gonna love them.

Ordering 100+ bags of black breakfast tea at once is a seriously big commitment for anyone, a commitment you really only should make when you know your way around your black teas. If you get a tea that you end up hating, all you'll get is 100+ rather disappointing mornings. So for people as inexperienced and undecided as me in the choosing and drinking of black tea, Stash has this sampler. It's always a small treat to wake up and be able to choose exactly what I want from the 20 or so bags of six flavors that I set out for myself. Even the ones I'm not crazy about are welcome variety because I can switch it up every morning.Grab this sampler if you want variety, if you want to take a plunge into black teas, and especially if you're looking at black tea as an alternative to coffee - I find about 2 ten ounce cups of tea give the same caffeine as one cup of coffee of the same size. If you're trying to reduce your caffeine intake, you can gradually dial it back to one cup, and steep that one cup longer. It's a (relatively) painless way to cut back.

Bought this assortment mainly for guests, but we drink it every day! We received double spice chai instead of English breakfast tea, which was a bonus. Bergamot is what gives earl grey tea its distinctive flavour, so double bergamot earl grey is that much better. Orange spice might be my favorite, but the peach is excellent, too. I used to keep some ginger root in the freezer to grate and make tea (good for upset stomach) which was much less convenient. Now it doesn't take all that work, and I enjoy it just because I love ginger. Irish breakfast tea doesn't really have a special flavour, but it is a bit stronger, with more caffeine.
A great tea assortment.If you love a nice easy to make tea youwill love this. It is black tea so it is stronger than some.

This item, though a cute idea, really doesn't live up to its title. The pink is fun, especially if you use a glass mug to see the whole drink. The "hot chocolate" part of the title is very disappointing. Of course, I wasn't fully expecting a milk chocolate taste, but I honestly can't even say it tastes remotely like white chocolate...or really any kind of chocolate for that matter.If you're looking for a novelty drink, this is cute, especially for young girls. However, if you're expecting something akin to hot cocoa as it is generally understood to be, I would look elsewhere.

My 9 year old absolutely loves it!  Of course she is a fancy Nancy fan and whenever I sit down to have my Latte, she feels all grown up to have her fancy hot chocolate with her Mommy.  Love the taste and aromatic coconut scent.  I think its great she loves it and its different, she loves it and that is the most important thing she feels she now has her own special drink like Mommy when we cozy up to hot drink.  I have to find some more as she is upset she has ran out and we were lucky to find this one at Home Goods, now have to see where I can order some.
This is a very pretty container, and my granddaughter loved the blue color when mixed with water-- but--- it tastes more like coconut than chocolate-- should be labeled hot coconut drink.

column9: Dents in 2 of the tins when arrived
column10: This cocoa is like any other cocoa, other than it is white and turns pink when touches liquid.  The tin is cute, but 2 cans were dented when they arrived. Not sure if it was from shipping or the seller.  A bit over priced in my opinion as well.

I bought these along with several other Raggedy Ann & Andy hot cocoas.  The Beary Blue and Pink Hot Chocolate both came with dented cans. I'm not sure if they came from the seller that way or if this happened during the shipping process, but I decided to keep them anyway.  This is the only set of hot cocoas that had a sticker of Raggedy Andy wrapped around the tin insted of it being imprinted on the actual tin. Kids seem to love that it turns blue once it touches the milk or water.

column9: Luck O' the Irish Hot Chocolate Mix
column10: Good thing I got this from the bargain bin or I would really be perturbed. Whatever the claims, this mix has no chocolate flavor of any kind. A more correct description would be Coconut flavored drink mix. Apparently the 10 oz rating is including the weight of the "cauldron" because there's no way there was 10 oz of product inside. You might get three cups of "hot chocolate" per container if you like the "flavor" really mild.It really wasn't worth the price I paid and certainly not the inflated regular price. Two of the three cauldrons were dented heavily so those won't even be much use as decoration. Look for a better brand.

I took this tea to some of my Chinese friends who are in the U.S. for a foreign exchange program at the university I attend. They all agreed that this tea tasted the same as what they have in China, the only difference is that in China their tea is loose-leaf, not in tea bags. The tea tastes great with and without sugar (my Chinese friends took it without sugar since that's the traditional way there I assume) and even I, who likes tea with some sugar think that it's great without the sugar, in fact, one sugar packet (I used Splenda) overwhelms the flavor of tea. If you want a good green tea with the traditional Chinese flavor, this is for you. The package did not lie in saying that it is "Unblended China Green Tea" it was worth every penny. The only thing is, amazon does not have the cheapest price (if you consider the cost of shipping) but whether you get it from amazon or from somewhere else, it is definitely a great tea.

i was really surprised when i tried this - it tastes amazingly close to real eggnog, even when i used nonfat dry milk. it has exactly the same texture as real eggnog, and the flavor is very good. a fantastic bonus is that it has zero fat, but you'd never know it when you drink it - you'd swear it was the real thing. if you like eggnog as i do, you have to try this.

Okay.  I admit it. I was a little leary when I discovered Aspen had an egg nog mix.  I love their cider, but egg nog is another thing entirely.  Guess what?  It was great!  I mixed it with Lactaid and it tasted wonderful.  I can also vouch for combining the egg nog mix, milk, vanilla ice cream, and ice in a blender to make a smoothie/shake.

This was so great!  I am lactose intolerant and cannot have regular eggnog, and this is great with Lactaid!!  I use it to make Chai eggnog lattes!  Very happy with this product.  Only problem, I wish it came in a bigger size!  The carton is kinda small and I used it all up in about a month having 2 or 3 eggnogs a week.  Still really like it!

I have always liked the Aspen spice mix for apple cider, so I thought I would try the egg nog mix. My son and I both really like egg nog, and were pleasantly suprised with this mix. Understand, that it is not as good as real egg nog, but is quite good. Egg nog is not cheap, but this is not a real bargin either. I will use this during those dry times of the year, when you can not buy egg nog in the stores.

My father recently was discharged from the hospital after surgery.  He was losing weight & had no appetite.  I started making him milkshakes with this product (with ice cream & heavy cream).  He was able to drink them, and he put on weight during a time when he wasn't able to eat solid food. The eggnog mix got us through a tough time.  Very tasty.

column9: Closest thing to eggnog PDQ there is
column10: Since the real PDQ crystals have gone the way of the dodo, other than making real eggnog this is about the only thing I've found that makes it easy and quick.I bought a 9 pack and have gone through only one of the cartons so far, but with a sprinkle of nutmeg and a little more vanilla, this is by far the best way to have a glass of milk!I love the holidays because I can buy eggnog at the store and stock up on the real deal. This gets me through the rest of the year.
Mix with milk, and eggnog. Its good for a powder, and you can have eggnog Whenever, Wherever. Took it while traveling. soo its good. Not bad.
It wasn't too bad overall, but it did not taste quite like the traditional egg nog you buy in the store. I don't think I'll buy it again unless I'm really jonesing for some egg nog come summer.

My wife is the big fan of mulling spice and eggnog spice, I just knew to find it in William Sonoma but it just serve only during chrismas time, and she was so dissapointed when trying to find it now she can't find it in WS, so I find in Amazon to surprise her, out of my expectation she was way too happy and make it very nice drink and food with those spices....she is the best cooks for me.

This has to be the Scrooge joke of Christmas, for the price it is so small only made 2 glasses.The taste is nothing good at all, just plain tasting it is nothing great.Says you can get one quart, you only get two small glassful.For the price they charge, for such a tiny amount, the profit for them is very high.If you want something to just add for a tiny flavor, go ahead. But if you want this for Holiday cheer, dont waste your time.Of all the things I have bought on Amazon, this has to be the biggest loser product they sell.I would send it back, but they said once it is open, sorryWant to have a good Christmas, dont buy this to entertain your family or friends with.Shame of such a rip off product

I ordered one carton, and the company sent me three.  I didn't want 3 cartons!  If you try to return them, they will make you pay the shipping for the items you didn't order!! Moreover, the stuff is terrible because it doesn't stay mixed in the milk.  It separates into a gross layer on top.  What a waste of money!!
I can't really give you a review.  I sent it to a relative who is stationed overseas and looooves eggnog. Haven't heard back if he liked it, but then again, he's been a little distracted obviously.
You can get DE coffee in USA at hollandsbest website. Great grind and aroma. You have to feel it to believe it.

I discovered this outstanding coffee in a Southern California hospital cafeteria flowing right out of their giant urn!  This coffee is so flavorful and satisfying that I'll often head down to that same hospital's cafeteria for a cup if I'm in the area.  I also enjoy walking past the same facilitie's Starbuck's Coffee cart, positioned directly outside the cafeteria entry, because I feel like I've got a secret the Starbuck's drinker's will never know.  The regular and decaf are equally outstanding in both aroma and flavor and I was pleased to find it sold here on Amazon.

I will never understand why a favorite restaurant chain ended their relationship with DOUWE EGBERTS?All I know is that now that I can buy it from Amazon & brew it @home tomy heart's content, "they" LOST a coffee customer......BIG TIME!  I have loved this brand for over 15 years,& I enjoy it now whenever I please. A DELICIOUS TREAT.

When my wife commented how she had always enjoyed Payday candy bars as a child, I thought to "pick some up" at the local supermarket. Imagine my surprise when I found NO payday candybars at any grocery, Dollar store, Drug store, or gas stations. On line, I found Payday was now part of Hershey Chocolate, yet I found no way to order on line from them. At this point I fell back on my 'default' solution and checked Amazon.com. I found our beloved Paydays available in several sizes,varieties even in yet to be released CHOCOLATE. I immediately ordered the snack size in amounts to last for months. My package arrived promptly and we are enjoying the freshest, tastiest Paydays ever!

column9: An oldie and still a goodie!
column10: I needed to decorate for a themed function with the theme being "How to Succeed in Business".  Every successful business person looks forward to PAY DAY!  Plus they're the perfect size & very yummy with BIG peanuts inside, not just little pieces.  As for the seller, they shipped super quick, packaged the candy very well, and sold it at a great price.

column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column10: If you like peanuts and caramel you'll love PAYDAY bars. The snack size make it easier to control portion/calorie intake and still allow myself/yourself a great treat/s. My rule of thumb for buying candy here is if it's less than $3 or $4 for a pound it's a good deal. Lots of the products are over priced and lots are good prices- you just gotta look around and compare. Remember not to order things that melt when the weather gets warm- common sense guys and gals.

I purchased this on Feb 14, 2011 for about $14. It was a good deal that day. They arrived fresh. There were a lot of candy in this package, I shared them with friends and coworkers. Also with family that came home from school. It had been a long time since I last enjoyed a Payday candy bar. I really enjoyed these.
I have always loved these nut rolls. They are just the right size for a snack, well two actually. Loaded with fresh peanuts and the inside is heaven.

column9: Awesome deal on quality organic sprouting seeds!!!
column10: I've been buying my sprouting seeds from this company for quite a while. I love how high-quality they are, and that they have a high-yield and are organic. Most people who have never sprouted before may not realize that you can't use regular seeds from the garden center of a store to sprout. It takes specialty seeds. I have a huge pantry and am well-stocked-up on most everything we use on a regular basis. I wouldn't say I'm necessarily planning for Armageddon, but having food and water storage makes a lot of sense to our family. When my husband lost his job years ago, we had plenty to eat and used cash resources to survive til he got another job. Sprouts are a great way of providing optimum nutrition for your family, take almost no space, are always grown and eaten fresh and can be grown on a countertop or dresser or anyplace warm enough for you to be...no special equipment is needed--you can use a jelly jar if you want to. I have EasySprout sprouters, which make it easy because you can also use the container and snap the lid on it to refrigerate after the seeds have sprouted. They sell these sprouters here on amazon for about $12 and they are a great deal. This particular blend of seeds are very high in protein...so if you are wanting to go vegetarian or just cut down on your meat consumption, this blend is a great choice. I also sprout other things, like seeds and grains and put them into favorite family recipes. Very cheap, nutritious, green/earth-friendly and tasty. The added benefit for me personally is that my 6 yr old sprouts in her own sprouter and she is excited to eat what she grows!!  This is a child who used to refuse to eat most vegetables, so we're stoked about it.
THis is another great Russell Stover product.  I have tried many and they are all really worth the money if you cannot eat carbs.
Great product and I can't find it at any store in my area.  I was glad to find it online.
Smells so good get lots of compliments on the aroma and taste!  Great mixed with other black teas to create your own blend.

column9: Roasted almond oil for superb salads
column10: When I opened my first can of Roasted almond oil and sniffed,the aroma itself almost made me drool. I prepared a salad of fresh greens topped with fresh orange slices and dressed it with the roasted almond oil and an orange champagne vinegar. I have also used balsamic vinegar. I sprinkled the salad with toasted sliced almonds. Everyone I have served it to thinks it is the best. I have also added a little oil to steamed green beans and added toasted slivered almonds to that.

I had tried walnut oil previously but found it a bit overpowering in flavor.  Almond oil is similar, but just a bit lighter in taste, letting the other salad components come through.  Store this is the refrigerator.  Luscious oil, highly recommend.

Great flavor! Be sure to refrigerate even before opening because oils tend to turn rancid if kept out. The only thing is I wish that I could have bought the oil separately instead of in packs of 3. It will take me years to use it all and with the possibility for rancidity I don't want to have to throw it away. As far as the product itself it is very good quality!

This oil is delicious, as is their walnut oil.  But every single time I receive a shipment, the cans are dented.  If you order this mention it and ask them to wrap the containers in bubble wrap, don't just throw the bubble wrap in.

This is an excellent product line of oils.  I have used other La Tourangelle oils for cooking, but I use their almond oil, mixed with epsom salt, as a natural facial scrub.The price was extremely reasonable, and the delivery was very quick, even before I expected the arrival.

These oils are lighter in flavor than their descritions.  But still a good value. My Biggest problem was the cans were all damaged, not by shipping but by the individual that packaged them.  I ordered 5 of the different flavors, each oil has 3 or 4 cans with the offer.  In the first shippment 9 cans were crushed, not dented.  The 2nd order had 11 cans damaged.  My intent was to give these away as gifts; of course in that condition I was not able to!  If you want these oils for personal use by all means order them.

I am unable to finish one bottle of almond extract because although it gives cookies a certain special something in store bought cookies, at home, it gives an edge to the flavor that no one likes although I have adhered to the recipe measurements.I have made a simple ice cream with just this oil and it tasted similar to buttered almond.
This is my favorite salad dressing! I don't use anything else - just salt, pepper and almond oil! It smells heavenly. Tastes even better! :-)

In the last couple of years, I have done a lot of research on healthy food products and healthy eating. So I have gotten away from using the various vegetable oils, and had been using primairly olive oil. When I found this product and some of the other nut oils, I now sometimes use them for the health benefits. I have been using this almond oil for a Ceasar dressing that calls for vegetable oil and it works great. Some of the nut oils can be used for frying and others are better for salad dressings and cold recipes. Some seem to feel that the nut oils add flavor, but this is not my experience. I really haven't noticed any difference in flavor, but the health benefits of nut oils are more than enough to convert recipes calling for vegetable oils.Some of the nut oils are also supposed to be good for the skin and hair. I have tried almond and macadamia oils on my face at night, and the skin does absorb it. I tried mac oil on my hair once, but wouldn't do it again. My hair was pretty well slicked down, and I washed the oil out immediately. For salads and any cooking that doesn't use high heat, I would highly recommend this almond oil for its health benefits.

My 1 yr old Mastiff/Germ Shep/Lab mix Capone is PICKY! Basically when we got him he had been fed people food, not dog food. I spent well over a couple hundred dollars trying different dog foods, and out of all the dry kibbles, THIS is the ONLY thing he will eat. Not to mention, its cheaper than most of the other ones. I did ask my vet, and he said this was a great thing for him to gain weight. This dog is supposed to be a good 80-90 pounds, and hes only 75 pounds. When we got him he was 72, but hes gained a few since then, and that was back in late may/early june. This is probably the best food for a dog that likes gravy more than the actual food itself. Capone LOVES what I've always called his 'mush', and we used to do this for my last dog Dexter (cocker/lab) and he would eat just bout anything. Its great for a cold day, cause to them its basically like hot soup or a hot drink for us. Every morning he smacks the heck outa his bowl wanting me to make 'mush'. Sometimes when I dont make 'mush' he wants moist and meaty as a topper, but for a picky dog, go find some of this, dollar general has it where I live, they may in other places. Try this and moist and meaty if you have a half starved dog like I do. I've tried everything, beniful, purina, all that. The only stuff I wont give him is pedigree, mostly b/c my cat tries to eat it and it gives her VERY bad 'bombs' if you catch my meaning. He turned his nose at it. I swear if it wasnt for this dog food, my dog wouldn't be alive.

column9: One of the best gluten free crackers ever!
column10: It's hard enough to find gluten free crackers that taste wonderful, and to be without seeds or nuts (these are on my "no" list too), but these Wellabys are tremendous. The only con I can think of is that it's extremely difficult not to eat the whole package in one sitting. I am grateful to have found these on Amazon. Personally, this is my favorite flavor out of the lineup, but the rosemary is pretty awesome too. If you can handle dairy, try some creamy blue cheese or Brie. Uh-oh... I think my calories are blown for the day!
Tasty, crunchy. No gritty taste. It is hard to believe these are really gluten free. But they are. You must try

Pay no attention to the review that says this tea is too strong. It's not. It is a great tasting tea with a great aroma. My whole family loves it. I bought the Tassimo to make coffee, but we make more tea than anything.
The tea made with the pod is too strong for my taste, but we share the first cup and dilute with hot water.  I can make at least 2 more cups with the pod that are perfect.

In reality, each bottle is worth two drinks or more. Here's how to get the most bang for your buck. After you spend $16.00 to $25.00 for the four-pack, buy a 1-liter of either (or both) Sprite and/or club soda for a couple of dollars.If you have a sweet tooth, do a 50/50 mix of Tru Blood with Sprite. If you prefer to dull the sweetness, then do the same but with club soda. Be creative and mix to your taste.Remember, this beverage has a slight fizz to it (carbonation), so you'll need a fizzy mixer to help it maintain its integrity.You might also want to keep you first empty bottle so that you can poor half of the subsequent bottle into the first bottle and store your mixes.Also tastes great with freshly-oxygenated arterial blood at 98.6F.  (Just kidding.)Hope this helps.Jet-

This soda is really delicious.  I was able to try a sample of it at a booth at a local conference in Seattle and was instantly in love with it.  It's a very unique (and yummy) flavored soda because of the blood orange, and because of that it only makes spending the money for it worth it. It's sweet, but not overly so.  The bottles are quite hefty which adds to the authenticity, they really do look like the ones on the show.  Whether you are buying the soda for decoration (we have one of them on a shelf) or for drinking, it's worth the price for this unique soda.  I highly recommend it.

While I do think that the bottle design rocks, and it stays true to the bottles we see in True Blood, the drink itself, well... it's not BAD, but it's not great either.I didn't want to spend the $25 USD for the four pack I saw at Hot Topic, especially if I didn't know if I was going to like it, so thankfully Saturday Matinee sells the single bottles for about $5 USD a pop.Tru Blood actually tastes better warm, or at least room temp, which I found out after popping my bottle in the fridge. And it's not something you can chug. It is very much something I could only sip a bit at a time. It tastes more like a REALLY sweet fruit punch, but I couldn't find any hint of blood orange in it.If you're not a fan of overly really sweet drinks, I wouldn't recommend it, but if you DO like really sweet stuff, then go for it.I will say, though, that every fan of the True Blood series should try the drink at least ONCE. Build your own opinion from tasting it yourself. If you're not willing to drop $25 for a 4 pack of it, you can sometimes find the single bottles at Borders, the larger Barnes and Nobles stores, or Saturday Matinee.I would also recommend that people who are diabetic, STAY AWAY. Sugar cane is the second ingredient in Tru Blood.

column9: Despite the cost, it's worth it
column10: I really enjoy this drink and have just bought my third pack.  First of, consider that you are actually buying heavy glass, solid prop replicas.  The drink inside doesn't matter so much.  The bottle is most important.  It looks just like the show.  It's very large and substantial in your hand.  Also the glass is quite thick and heavy.  But what's disappointing is that it has a paper label.  I really wish it was something more long lasting. There's something just really enjoyable and rewarding about holding this heavy bottle that feels like you're drinking something really from the show.As for the drink itself, I actually don't find it sweet tasting.  I think it tastes a lot like Orange Crush, but a little bit less fizzy and more complex.  I wish it was more carbonated.  At first I didn't care much for the taste, but the more I drink, the more and more I like it.To get your money's worth, though, just wash them out gently and refill with some Orange Crush or Sprite and a few drops of red food coloring if you want.

column9: Royal Basmati Rice, Food for Royalty
column10: We keep a burlap bag of Basmati Rice (Royal) 20lb on hand.  With the current fear of rice shortage, we suggest you get yourself a bag of this rice now.Royal Basmati Rice brings eating rice to a new level.  I first learned about it a few years ago in New Orleans at a combination Middle Eastern restaurant/grocery.  The owner there had not heard someone from Mississipi talk before, and he kept following me around the store because he was fascinated with my accent.  He asked me if I was from Scotland.  He sold me my first bag of Royal Basmati. "This is what we use to feed our customers," he said.  I had no idea that rice could taste that good.Here is the way the Royal people recommend you cook it:Cooking Instructions for Stovetop1 cup of uncooked Royal Basmati Rice yields 3 cups cooked Rice.Measure: 1 cup of rice, 1 ½ cups of water, 1 tablespoon of oil, butter or margarine, a pinch of salt.1. Rinse measured rice 1 to 2 times or until water is clear to remove extra starch and drain.2. Place the drained rice into the saucepan and add measured water, oil and salt.3. Place saucepan (uncovered) over high heat and bring to boil, stir occasionally.4. Let water reduce slightly below the rice level and the lower the heat to the minimum.5. Place a tight lid on the saucepan and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.Herre is the way we cook it:We don't wash it.  We simply place 1 cup of Basmati rice and 2 cups water in a Calphalon Tri-Ply Stainless-Steel 8-Quart Stockpot with Glass Lid.  We bring it to a boil and cook it at medium heat until the water is absorbed.  That's all.The rice is supposed to last two years if kept under 70 degrees.  It can be refrigerated.  We simply keep it on the shelf without a problem.Cooked rice can be kept in the refrigerator for six days or frozen up to six months. To reheat just add 2 tablespoons of liquid, cover and heat for about 5 minutes on top of the stove or 1 minute on HIGH in the microwave. Fluff with a fork.You can freeze  Basmati rice before or after cooking. Store it in an airtight container to prevent frost from forming on itHere is a dish using Basmati from Flavored with Love: Mary Lou's Family and Friends Can Cook:SHRIMP CURRY2 pounds medium raw shrimp, peeled and deveined (Country girls don't devein their shrimp.)2 tablespoons peanut oil (or canola oil if peanuts are a problem)3 large garlic cloves, minced½ cup green onion, diced½ cup pea pods, strings removed4 cups assorted oriental vegetables, chopped into large pieces Juice of 1 lime3 blocks Golden Curry Sauce Mix® (mild or for Louisiana tastes,  medium hot)2 tablespoons chicken broth½ cup unsalted cashews1 cup uncooked rice (Basmati is excellent with shrimp curry.)Prepare the rice according to the package instructions.  Heat the chicken broth in a small saucepan and stir in the curry blocks until they are dissolved.  Heat oil in large non-stick stove top skillet, electric skillet, or wok. Add garlic and green onions and stir over medium heat 1 minute. Add pea pods, assorted vegetables, lime juice, curry blocks, and chicken broth and stir over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender but still crisp.  Add the shrimp and cook while stirring gently 2 to 3 minutes.Serve over rice and topped with cashews. 4 servingsHere is a recipe using Basmati rice from The Collard PatchCRAWFISH ETOUFFEE COLLARD ROLLSRiceIngredient½ cup uncooked rice (Basmati is excellent.)PreparationCook the rice according to package instructions, but do not add salt.  You should have about 1½ cups of cooked rice.Sauce for Filling and Top of Rolls  Ingredients1 can (15 ounces) tomato sauce1 can 14½ ounces) diced tomatoes with basil, garlic, and oregano1 tablespoon sugar½ teaspoon rosemary1½ teaspoons ground red pepper1½ teaspoons black pepper2 teaspoons Tony Chachere's® (sodium free)3 tablespoons minced garlic¼ cup red wine vinegarPreparationMix all the above ingredients in a blender until the tomatoes are liquefied.Pour the sauce into a saucepan and simmer it uncovered while you prepare the other ingredients.Crawfish FillingIngredients1 stick (¼ pound) unsalted butter1 tablespoon olive oil½ cup self-rising flour1½ cups warm water12 ounces peeled crawfish tails1 package (12 ounces) Creole seasoning blend (onions, celery, green peppers, red peppers, and parsley)1 cup sauce for filling and top of rollsPreparationMake a dark roux by browning the flour in the butter and oil.Add the warm water and stir until the roux is smooth.Add the crawfish and seasoning blend along with 1 cup of the sauce.Simmer until the crawfish and vegetables are tender and enough liquid is reduced to a semi-firm consistency.Adjust the seasoning to taste.  You may want to add some more Tony Chachere's®.Add the rice with minimal stirring.Collard LeavesIngredients2 bunches collards with medium large leavesPinch of baking sodaPreparationAdd the baking soda to a shallow pan or skillet of water.  Separate the collard leaves from the bunches; wash them.To tenderize the collard leaves place them into a pot of boiling water and blanch them for 1-2 minutes.Cut off the stemmy spines for a couple of inches into the leaves.  They should be tender but firm and intact.The RollsPreheat the oven to 350°.Spray a 13 X 9 X 2" cooking pan with non-stick cooking spay.  Line the pan with a single layer of leaves that hang over about 3".  If necessary, place some leaves in the bottom of the pan.Place the top of a leaf facing you on a cutting board.Dollop some mixture in a row across the top of the leaf and begin rolling away from you.After a single roll, fold the sides of the leaves around ends of the mixture extending the folds to the far end of the leaf on each side.Continue wrapping to the end of the leaf.Place the rolls, seam sides down, in the pan on top of the leaves.  Pour the remaining tomato sauce over the top.  Be sure to drizzle the sauce over each leaf.Fold the leaves over the top.  If necessary, place some leaves in the center.  Spray with cooking spray (or coat lightly with olive oil.)Bake 40 minutes.Equipment/UtensilsPot to cook the rice * Blender * Saucepan * 2 skillets * Cutting board * 13 X 9 X 2 " * Cooking panAbout the Preceding Recipe:When you serve the rolls, garnish them with some parsley.  Serve them with some grilled French bread and some iced tea.I hope you enjoy these recipes and find this review helpful.

I have been using Royal Basmati rice for something on the order of 30 years, having been introduced to it by a friend from India.  I live in Hawaii where a lot of things are ill available.  That said this is the brand carried by our local costco and so it is my default.  My *only* issue with it is the size of the bag.  I generally spend and hour or so repacking it for storage once I have opened the bag: something of a chore... and it does provide a challenge in terms of storage space.  All that said I came here looking for Basmati in smaller packages, but have to say that on one occasion I tried a different brand and it did not cook up as well: was a bity grainy and softer- did not hold up well (got soft, broke down a bit).  in terms of taste... I am 100% satisfied with this brand.  i just wigh it was available in smaller apckages!I will offer some advice to people new to Basmati.  it is a long-grain white rice: softer and more absorbent than brown rices or short grain white.  the way I prepare it (as I was taught by my friend who is a life-long consumer (for lack of a better word)1. rinse well.  Measure the quantity you want. (note: it cooks up to 2-3 times the bulk of the dried rise: very fluffy!)  Rinse in cold water swishing it around in the pot and continue rinsing until the water runs clear.  if you do not do this the rice will be stickier and not as fluffy.  some people like it this way (i do not).2. Use less water than you normally would with white rice.  I generally measure 1 to 1, or just a bit more water: around 1 1/4 cup of water to one cup of rice.  I make mine in a rice cooker, and if you make it on the stove top or with a pot which is not air tight you may need to use more water as some will boil off.  Add a pinch of salt and small amount of butter: a small pat for 1-2 cups of rice.  I frequently add saffron or turmeric to the water, occasionally cinnamon and or nuts/ raisins. (when I am serving it with curry).  The rice is very absorbent and takes spices nicely.3. When it is done cooking let it rest for a few minutes off the heat source.  Fluff with a fork before serving.  the rice at the bottom of the pot typically absorbs a bit more water.  i stir it in to distribute before it sits.  that generally equalizes the moisture so you get an even texture.I don't know why I am even thinking of messing with something that works ;)  This is a product I have been very happy with for a long time!  I have never  found bugs or hulls or bits of detritus like I have when purchasing in bulk bins at the health food store.  My one and only issue is the size of the bag.  I really wish I could get this in 5 pound bags (and am sure apartment dwellers would share that sentiment).  This is a lot of rice, BUT, it is the only white rice I buy/ use so we never have a problem finishing it.  My only issue is storage space.

column10: Anna's Thin Ginger cookies top my list in search of the absolute BEST!  I'm very pleased with my "double order" of Anna's cookies from Amazon--which I must confess are just about half gone. Just like all the other flavors of Anna's thins. A real winner. Must be diet food, no?
