These were a hit with the candy buffet group.  The flavor was excellent and the color was spot on.  There were a pale pink, which fit in perfectly with my pink candy buffet.  Shipping was fast.  I was very pleased!!

Strawberry Whoppers are one of our very favorite candies.  Fortunately they are relatively inexpensive because once we open a box we eat them all.  Of course they would last a bit longer if we didn't have to share them with Max and Lady, our two miniature schnauzers, but they are very demanding.

Description:The manufacture website describes Batch 37 Spicy Trail Mix as the following:"Now there's a snack mix for the true "hot head". Just one bite and you'll see this isn't an ordinary nibble. So hang on to your buds and try Mo's mouthwatering, eye-tearing trail mix."However, this barely counts as a description, for starters, its based off the Batch 37 hot sauce, see:  Pain Is Good, Batch #37 Hot Sauce, 6.7 fl oz. It contains a mix of Peanuts,  Cajun Sesame Sticks, BBQ Corn Sticks, Almonds and Cashews, dusted in a nice smokey/salty Habanero BBQ seasoning. It contains Peanuts, Wheat, Soy, Milk, Cashews and Almonds so suffers of food allergies/intolerance be wary.  About 1/4 a cup equates to 160 calories, 110 from fat (Remember, this is mostly nuts, fatty but nearly as bad as it sounds on paper), and 115 mg of salt, 8g of carbs (only 1g from sugar), and 5g of protein... made in Kansas. The "trail mix" is a snack mix as there's an inherent lack of more standard trail mix ingredients like raisins/craisins/dried fruit/M&M/Chocolate that tend to comprise trail mix.Review:There's not point to explaining hot food, either you like it or don't.Now that I got the boring stuff out the way, is it any good? Simply yes. I've eaten both Dave's Burning Nuts (known best for Dave's Insanity Sauce, a must try for hot heads) and Da Bomb Ghost Chili Nuts. Both are simply peanuts dusted in heat, which makes for nice but bland munching. I more or less bought these blind, and figured I might end up with 6 containers of unlikable nuts. However, its hardly the case. Comparing these to the other two aforementioned hot foods, these are easily the most desirable. Dave's Burning Nuts are neither hot enough nor special enough to warrant ordering online (in my opinion). Da Bomb Ghost Chili Nuts are pretty good, with a long lingering heat but sadly the seasoning can only be found on peanuts.  Pain is Good gets oodles more points for offering variety. While comprised primarily of peanuts, there's crunchy Sesame Sticks and Corn Sticks, the lone almond and the occasional cashew which keeps things more interesting. They also pack more flavor, the bits of cajun and competing flavors help keep this more complex and tasty. As far a heat goes? I wish more companies used the Pain is Good metric. I was a bit disappointed to see these were only "medium" hot, but they're considerably hotter than Dave's Burning Nuts which Dave's rates as an underwhelming 7 out of 10. Fellow hot heads probably won't break a sweat even, although the zing probably is more than average person would care for. They're not quite as hot as the Da bomb nuts, but they're surprisingly hot... and tastier. It took a lot of restraint not to eat the entire 8 oz container in a single sitting. I'd like to see these kick up the heat a notch higher, but the heat is enough to make me happy, and excellent companion to your favorite beer.Will I buy these again? Most likely. I haven't bought a lot of food on Amazon.com but this is easily the best food stuff I purchased.

If you enjoy spicy peanuts, these are top notch. Please know that this more of a trail mix than just nuts, but delicious all the same. After i received my first order i ordered another batch, the jerk nuts and the 100% pain nuts.
This product is amazing! A new way to enjoy your popcorn. Great texture and taste!

column9: I'd buy this again and that says alot
column10: We eat a lot of rice, usually brown rice or red rice or the darker grains and most times use an electric rice cooker unless I'm preparing risotto.  There are instances, however, when I simply don't have the time to prepare rice and until now, I didn't consider options other than freezing leftover rice in small packages for emergencies.  I never cared for Uncle Ben's Minute Rice and assumed that any prepared and packaged rice would be similar to that rice which one of my sisters adores.  Annie Chun's Rice Express Multi-Grain Sticky Rice has proven my aversion was unwarranted because this product has turned out to be a lifesaver when having only a minute's time.  Now if you don't have a microwave or pot with water and source of heat, I don't think this would be very good, but if prepared as directed, it's quite delicious and I'll buy it again.  The texture is like sticky rice, the flavor is like multi-grains, the color is speckled and appealing, and it's great to have at work with leftovers.  Sprouted brown rice is a definite winner.  Since no refrigeration is needed, it's safe in a drawer and is a relief even when you have forgotten to bring in something else.  In my opinion, since it's rice, you can add practically anything and have an enjoyable meal full of good carbs.  With no oil or salt added, you cannot go wrong with this rice!  Finalize those details according to your own tastes and dietary restrictions.  Because of the cost, I'll continue preparing rice in the electric rice cooker, but for appropriate times, this will be a household staple.

column9: I have this on Subscribe & Save
column10: This is bland on it's own, but takes well to anything you add, I add honey or agave  and sometimes fruit for breakfast, or chopped egg and sometimes a pat of butter (I know bad, but it's not every day)and different seasonings for breakfast or anytime, it's very good. I usually add about 1 tsp of water to it before I microwave it. It's So handy when I'm really strapped for time.I have this on Subscribe & Save to get every month, so I am a fan.

This is a good product to add as a side dish. It has a nice texture, color and taste and isn't your everyday boring, plain white rice.I love that I can just pop it in the microwave for 1.5 minutes. Grab it on the go, or appreciate it after a long day after work.

column9: A very convenient addition to lunches
column10: It's hard to cook for one or two people and not have a lot of leftovers.  Annie Chun's Rice Express Multigrain rice gives me more options when I prepare my lunches to take to work.  I have found the Multigrain rice to be flavorful and its easy to store in my desk at work.  I can quickly add leftovers for a hot lunch or I have even been known to heat these packages and add fresh fruit for a filling breakfast break.  Buying by the bulk from Amazon also saves me money.

Adults will appreciate the good flavor and ease of carrying and nuking. One container is very very filling for one person, almost starch overload, so really best to share with someone else as a side dish.

column9: A lunch saver for the gluten intolerant
column10: Some days I just get tired of having to come up with another gluten free meal to pack for lunch; or I've gotten home too late to start a pot of rice for supper. That's the time to grab an Annie Chun Rice Express and pop it in the microwave. In 2 minutes I have a delicious bowl of rice. Add a bit of cheese and an apple and I'm ready to take on the rest of the day. It amazes me that something that can sit in a spare drawer at work can be so easy to prepare and taste so good.

As a Hypoglycemic I love to have this rice on hand.  My family can eat the white rice with the Chinese food and I have my yummy multigrain rice.  In fact I have had some problems with family members wanting to eat my rice instead.  For convience it cannot be beat.

column10: Delicious and extremely healthy!The secret is to heat it in microwave for 90 seconds, open it, put it in a bowl and add some water (or any liquid, such as soy milk or whatever you like). That separates the sticky grains and the volume increases.Fantastic!
I get a pack of 6 items every month.  I love the taste.  It takes only 90 sec. in the microwave to cook it.
It is mixed kind of wild rice. A bit tastier.Good for a change. Depends on your taste.

column9: A fast and healthy Asian side dish
column10: It has no added salt, is whole grain, and is made from rice varieties impossible to find in supermarkets. I use it with whatever stir fry I make in my wok.  It heats in the microwave(do not overcook) and provides enough for two portions. Be careful if you reheat the left over portion a second time.  It dries out and gets hard unless you add a little broth or coconut milk before putting it back in the microwave.  This product is sold in some health food stores and gourmet food markets,but it is difficult to find. Amazon makes it easy.

Love Annie Chun products.  Got the 6 pack through the warehouse deals.  The expiration date still had several months to go; the rice eaten within two weeks.  Will most definately order again, regular or through the warehouse deals.

column9: A staple for a quick dinner
column10: I bought this to use as an easy staple to fix lunches for work, and it's the perfect size.  I enjoyed the chewy texture and it was great since it only take like a minute to heat up in the microwave which works when you have a short lunch like I do.  I would definately buy this again and I look forward to trying some of the other of varieties.
do not buy this.  the only reason i gave it 1 star is there is no lower rating.  it tastes like mush and has absolutely no taste.  it did not taste remotely like rice,

With other formulas, my daughter had really bad gas pains and far more spit-up incidents.  After switching to Gentlease, she has really thrived, gaining weight appropriately and seeming tremendously happy with it (and not so happy when we're 30 seconds slow in providing it to her :D).As for the corn syrup solids, this is simply there as a replacement for lactose, which is removed from gentle formulas.  It has to be replaced by something, so they use corn syrup solids.  I don't think there really is any major concern here, as sugar generally is sugar once it is broken down in the body, but I can see the reason for others to be concerned.One thing I would like to see, however, is Amazon include this on a subscription plan like Amazon Mom.  Enfamil is not inexpensive, and it is a regular consumable for my family.

I almost feel bad that I'm not giving this product a five star rating.  Our baby is breastfed but also requires supplementation with formula.  At a time when every night at 8pm sharp colic was driving our infant into a 4 hour inconsolable torrent, and after trying many different formulas and remedies, switching the formula we used to Enfamil Gentlease drastically improved just about every part of our lives.  Finally, with more sleep, we were able to enjoy and build our relationship with our little girl.  And, most importantly, we didn't have to watch her suffer every night.I only worry that the first ingredient is sugar.  All of the other organic formulas bring back her colic, but I would have preferred  a product in which corn syrup was not used, or at least not the first ingredient.But the outcome is what counts, I guess.  On this formula, I must say that our baby has thrived.  She is healthy and happy, so for that reason I would highly recommend this formula.

column9: Works well but read the ingredients!
column10: I used this with my daughter as a supplement during her growth spurts when I wasn't producing enough breast milk for her. She tolerated it better than Similac or Similac Sensitive. I was however, disappointed to see that the first ingredient is Corn Syrup Solids. Since it was used only supplementally, it didn't bother me too much but it is something to consider. I researched this and found that since this is designed to be easier to digest, it contains less lactose which is the main "sugar" in other formulas. My pediatrician recommended trying to switch to a lactose based formula at six months when her digestive system was more mature. I did that and she was able to switch pretty easily particularly when the formula was mixed with some expressed breast milk.

My daughter was a premie and was on the Enfacare until 6 months. As soon as we were given the okay by our doctor to change her formula, we went straight to gentlease after friend recommendations.What I haven't told you is our poor baby struggled with very bad constipation, so bad she would vomit from straining so hard but because she was early we could not change her formula at free will.As soon as she started gentlease the constipation stopped. Now she poops like a champs :) As for keeping her full, yup did the job.  I recommend it.

column9: Baby is doing well on this, but...

column9: Corn syrup solids is the first ingredient

I bought this giant box and realized after feeding this stuff to my son for a few days that the first ingredient is CORN SYRUP SOLIDS! The equivalent with Similac also has corn syrup as the first ingredient. I have stopped using Enfamil and I am now using Gerber Good Start Gentle (first ingredient whey protein). It doesn't really work that well and it takes forever to dissolve but at least I am not feeding my kid corn syrup.

column9: My kitten begs for this canned food

column9: Our 5 cats LOVE EVO - purple can.  3 yrs and still loving it
column10: We used to feed our first 2 cats Country Pet frozen food since it was THE next best thing to a natural raw diet for cats.  Then we added 3 more to the clan and our freezer couldn't hold the required amount for 5 kitties.So with the help of our holistic vet and a bit of research we found EVO.  (CANNED ONLY)  It's the next best thing if you don't have the freezer space for Country Pet....or making your own.Our cats love it and they also enjoyed the 95% Chicken & Turkey canned. I've turned many friends onto EVO and Country Pet and everyone has had amazing success with the health of their pet.  :)I've found a case of 13 oz EVO for as low as $18.75 and as high as $27.

column9: High Quality, Good Price, Very Convenient
column10: Great option for those needing a high-quality wet food for their kitten/cat, very convenient for stocking up and saving many trips to local pet stores for the smaller cans. One note, its almost necessary to have one of the plastic can covers to easily store the can in the fridge between uses. column9: Happy with my first-time online cat food order
column10: [...]It showed up in several days, no hitches, and was just what I'd ordered. It was pretty well-packed, though a number of cans were dented (but no breakage, thankfully), perhaps in transit - that's my only (very minor) complaint. I'll gladly reorder this when the time comes.

column9: Quality Flavorful, Versatile Tea without the Caffeine.
column10: My search for a good all-purpose decaffeinated tea ended with Twinings English Breakfast Decaf. Twinings English Breakfast is a blend of Ceylon, Kenyan, and Indian teas with a crisp, full-bodied flavor that isn't heavy or bitter. It's a great tea for any time of the day and with any accompaniment, on its own, or with sugar or cream.Twinings employs the carbon dioxide method of decaffeination for their decaf teas. The tea is exposed to compressed carbon dioxide, which acts as a solvent, extracting the caffeine while leaving larger molecules unaffected. The process preserves more flavor and removes more caffeine than water process decaffeination. 97% of caffeine must be eliminated for a beverage to be called "decaffeinated", which would leave only a few milligrams of caffeine per cup of tea, regardless of the method.For a departure from plain tea, these are my favorite recipes:*Homemade Mint Tea*This is wonderful consumed hot and incomparable served over ice in the summer: Bring about 3 quarts of water, 2 English Breakfast Decaffeinated tea bags (remove the string), 1/4 cup of sugar, and a handful of sliced fresh mint leaves to a boil in a saucepan. Simmer for 10 minutes. Let cool, then strain. It will keep a few days in the refrigerator.*Lemongrass Tea*This has a smooth, mellow lemon flavor without the acidity of lemon tea: Bring about 3 quarts water, 2 English Breakfast Decaffeinated tea bags (remove the string), 1/3 cup powdered sugar cane juice (Sucanat, Florida Crystals, or substitute sugar), and half a stalk of lemongrass, thickly sliced, to a boil in a saucepan. Simmer for 10 minutes. Let cool, then strain. Serve chilled or over ice.

I don't usually write reviews but I think there is some information about this product that will be helpful.  I had a terrible yellow jacket problem and could not eat in my backyard at all.  I researched yellow jackets a lot on the internet and found that different species are attracted to different kinds of bait and that the key to yellow jacket control is to attract the queen before she sets up a nest in the spring. Once she lays eggs, she produces so many yellow jackets that it is practically impossible to stop them all. The queen yellow jackets where I live in northern California are attracted to protein baits, not sweet baits, and the queens leave hibernation in about March of each year to start their new nests. This product is the only one I found that uses a protein bait which is why I love it. I can put it out in March, catch the queen and no yellow jackets  come summer.  You can make your own protein bait with tuna etc but it will rot in a few days and yellow jackets do not like rotting protein so you have to keep replacing it. That does not happen with this bait.If you have a different kind of yellow jacket, this product may not work for you.As to the top falling off, it is not a screw on top. You have to push the top on until it clicks. I agree that it is not sturdy and I use a new one each year.Bottom line: know the kind of yellow jackets where you live. If you need a protein bait and don't want to mess with a trap every few days, this is the product for you. Put it out at the time of year when queens are swarming and looking for a new nest.

column9: I've used these and every other kind...
column10: And they are ONLY as good as the season you're trying to use them in. If you do your research about the feeding habits of wasps/hornets and stinging things, you will see that they are attracted to sugary things early in the year, and you should set this kind of trap out early. Like before you even SEE the first flying terror early. Before you're thinking about "I need to get rid of these things" you must be getting rid of them! If you wait until May, you're WAY too late in most places. You really need to catch queens to reduce local populations and that happens as soon as the ground starts to warm. Think NOW (I'm in VA. It's February). As the year progresses, they like protein to prepare for over-wintering. It's also the same time they tend to get more aggressive. So you put some tuna or raw meat in small quantities in your traps instead. I also get a TON of bees and wasps around my pool which is also salt water and a great spot for thirsty bugs of all kinds it seems- never mind that I border a forested preserve. What doesn't nest in my yard has free rein right behind my pool! I use a combination of traps on my fence line and those cheesy looking fake wasp nests that you can hang from soffits (wasps are territorial and avoid other wasp's nests). My traps are going out this week, it's been unseasonably warm. The ground is warm and once I even consider putting veggie seeds in the garden, it's time for bee/wasp/hornet control too. The fake nest things go out a little later in the spring. It's a combination that has worked well. Yes, Flies and misc flying things are also attracted. It's sugar in most traps. What do you expect?Something else to consider... there are many kinds of bees and hornets. Some look very much alike. Honey bees and yellow jackets, esp when the bees are small can look very much alike. We NEED honey bees. You really don't want to get rid of your good bees and you can encourage what you like, and discourage what you don't. Poisoning the good things just leaves more space for the bad things to eat and breed. Before I kill anything I'm sure I've got a hornet, and having some wasps around isn't a bad thing either. They predate nuisance flies and other things I also don't want around. If you kill all the wasps, before you know it you're overloaded with flies! So the enemy of my enemy is indeed my friend. If I was deathly allergic I'm sure I'd feel differently, but if you're not give a thought to what you're doing and when.

column9: Use this trap and the bait recipe below to slaughter 'em!
column10: I am deathly allergic to jackets, wasps, hornets, etc, so I've been searching for as many ways to control as possible, since I live in the "sticks".  While I haven't caught any wasps, I catch between 5-10 yellow jackets and/or hornets per trap per day ... THE KEY IS THE BAIT: DON'T USE THE ONE THAT COMES WITH THE TRAPS ... INSTEAD, FILL ALMOST TO THE LINE WITH MOUNTAIN DEW, THEN ADD 3-4 CAPFULS OF APPLE CIDER VINEGAR ... this trap was average at best until i read about this bait-mix on line.  They can't resist.You do catch a lot of flies too, and other random insects, but day in and day out, you'll catch whatever jackets/hornets come around.  I have to change them once every 3 days b/c they fill up so much that the insects can actually use the dead ones as life-rafts and, obviously, that delays the dying thing.Best natural trap (or maybe it's just the bait recipe?) I've ever tried, and we've tried a bunch.
This have really worked for us.  They are convenient and disposable.  It has stopped the bee stings on our deck.
This producy works !!! Period......They were hitting it minutes after I hung them in our yard......havent seen a bee since......great product
Caught none, in fact there was a yellow jacket nest being built about 6 feet from it. RAID did them in!

We have a bad hornet season, especially near the pool. The little buggers like to drink the water. This product didn't help - they are cheaply constructed and didn't trap ONE BUG the whole season. Wouldn't bother again. I don't know if it's ALL Traps that don't work, or if this one specifically was useless.

Oddly this trap is catching all flies...no yellow jackets. I know they are around..is the bait the same as the fly catchers?So, like my review of the fly catchers-this trap will STINK from feet away when half full like feces so you wont want it around sitting/food areas like patios. We love that they are disposable but DOUBLE BAG it first or your trash can will reak. Even when they catch bees, traps do smell badly. So we expected this. Why we switched to disposable vs re-use.Easy to use, good price. They dont catch the good bees like Bumbles.
It has been up for 3 days now and the yellow jackets just fly past and don't even give it a nod!

column9: Best wasp catcher on the market.
column10: After the attractant is gone you can just fill with a little sugar water or apple juice and it works just as well.  We hang this up near our hummingbird feeders to keep the wasps from going after the hummers.

column9: Still waiting fro it to catch something
column10: Sort of flimsy - easy to set up but has not caught anything yet.  Bought these becasue last year had a problem.  Maybe they just did not show up this year.

I found this salt on a discount bin and wondered if I should get two of them. Of course, I purchased only one thus kicking myself!This salt is fantastic!Regular iodized salt that we are used to is mild and somewhat bitter. This salt is completely different! Large salt crystals (similar to the Kosher pickling salt size) are perfect for meats, stews and bagels; by putting this in a salt grinder makes this suitable for all other uses.Note: the taste is very salty, strong and finishes slightly sweet.It does not take much of this salt to flavor the dishes so only use about 2/3rds of what you would use regular salt in your recipes.

So the salt is fine, but the poorly designed "cylinder" is not very sturdy and today, while pouring some salt into a soup I was making.. the lid came apart from the canister and poured the whole container into my soup... obviously ruining it.  Buy something else and save yourself the hassle.  It also CAME complete clumped up...

Reviews are about the PRODUCT, why does Amazon allow people to base their biased opinons on cost or shipping or customer service. Can't these people read? I use this sea salt, the blue canister. I quit using refined table salt & sodium chloride because I have high BP. First, I researched online "sea salt healing properties", then I bought this sea salt, then I used this sea salt, and I continue to use this sea salt; therefore, my opinion is based upon this PRODUCT, not cost...duh! 5 stars!
Please do some comparison shopping.  Salt Works sells it for $3.25.  And you can find it in stores for much less than this.
I get these every year for my Dad and this is the place I always come because of their shipping prices and the speed at which they ship.
Nothing has changed since I was a kid.  Still delicious! Not so great for a diet, BUT worth the few I sneak into my day.

column9: More expensive than Costco or Walmart--FYI
column10: I love Twizzlers and ordered this without comparing prices.  Costco and Walmart were significantly cheaper--FYI.If you aren't familiar with Twizzlers, they are red, sweet and delicious.
We love the Twizzlers Twists.  We also share them with our dog.  She enjoys them too.  Thank You Amazon for selling this item.
Got them decently fast, but they taste a bit weird. I think they are stale. Even if the flavor is a bit off me and my household are still enjoying them.

column9: Smooth taste, without the jitters - for Flavia owners only
column10: A couple of years ago, my friends showed us the Flavia machine and then gave me a taste of how good a cup of coffee it could make. We immediately went out and bought one and have enjoyed using it ever since. While I have tried all of their different blends, we have settled on the House Blend as our daily brew. My wife can only drink de-caf and I find that the difference in taste between regular and the "un-leaded" is beyond my meager taste buds ability to tell the difference.  Especially since I usually put in sweetener and milk.The taste is smooth but with a good body. The blend has a good just-brewed coffee aroma but can be sharp and intense if you stand close by the machine as it steams out a cup. I have not tried to drink it black but I have sipped it with just half & half and it's quite nice.If you have a Flavia machine and want to cut down on the caffeine you drink, you will be pleased with the decaf house blend.4 and not 5 stars because I don't love the sharp aroma at brew time.

After reading such positive reviews on this cereal, Special K Cereal, Vanilla Almond 17.5 oz, I purchased it at my grocery store, which it is called Value Size, not Family Size, but it is the same size, and the same cereal.I thought maybe it would be my new favorite cereal.  Boy was I wrong!!First of all it is sickenly sweet, beyond belief!!  In one serving there was ONE slivered almond!!  I didn't taste vanilla at all!One bowl was enough.  Now Iam sorry that I purchased this larger size thinking I wanted enough to last me awhile.  Now my thinking is that I just have a larger box of this cereal to give away, and at $4.79 for this box of cereal I think I definitely wasted my money!I think I will go back to Special K Red Berries with I did like, and have purchased quite alot of it in the past.I would expect more from the Special K Brand. I like to try new things, including cereal, but not this one!!

This is described as a "1-Pound jar of mushrooms". Well opening the packaging I was surprised to see that the jar was half full. One huge jar literally half full of very small slices of very dark, very dusty mushrooms. I use dried mushrooms a few times a week and have bought them from many different sources, including from a street seller in China. I have bought dried mushrooms from other sellers on Amazon but I will never ever buy these from this seller again. "Ultra AAA"? I don't think so!(I took a picture, but am unable to attach it. A pity.)

column9: t'aint what they say it is
column10: These mushrooms are presented as "porcini". These mushrooms had a very dark brown color unlike porcini. the taste was o.k.,not that of porcini.At the least I would say that the seller does not know his mushrooms, or he thinks that the buying public are completely ignorant. I would venture to say that mushrooms are Sillius Leutus not Porcini ( Boletus Edulis).
Fine Mother Goose Liverwurst/Pate'  has a pleasant aroma, smooth texture and absolutely  addicting to the pallet.

I have been searching for goose liverwurst for years now. Living in Texas they don't have a clue what it is, if it ain't beef they don't know from it, LOL.They, Gaiser's, had to ship the product twice because I never got the first order. They took care of it pronto, so I'd have to say they are a good responsible company with that delicious product. 5 Starts for them.

This is by far the best liverwurst that I have had.  Coming from a German, that is saying alot.  This is very fine and smooth.  Lots of flavor and richer than most liverwursts.  It is just this side of being a pate", which is a good thing.  Definitely try this!  Came packed cold and can be frozen if link is not opened.

So happy to find this online. It's my favorite Chinese chili sauce. It's not really chili oil, but chili flakes with smattering of peanuts in oil, but has a wonderful flavor. The bottle I received from Amazon was even drier than usual (less oil), but that didn't affect the flavor so I will continue getting it here. Over the years I have used this product the amount of oil varies, but the flavor (which is the important part for me) is always the same.

Our family loves this popcorn.  The only place I can find it is here at Amazon and at Bob's Red Mill store in Oregon.  We pop it in oil, but it is so good we only add salt and never have to add butter.  This makes it a lot better than all the other popcorn in the stores.  Try it you will become in instant fan.

column9: no after-taste, great tasting stevia product
column10: I really love this liquid stevia.  It is sweet, not bitter and has absolutely no after-taste.  Exactly what you want in stevia.  I've been using stevia as a sweetener in my drinks and cooking for the past few years now.  I couldn't dream of going back to sugar at this point.  I've tried a number of different brands and this one is one of my top choices hands down.  I also like to keep a powder around for cooking purposes.  Tried many powder brands as well, in terms of taste and price, this brand is the best I've found; 100 Grams (3.5 Oz) Stevia 95% Steviosides Bulk Powder.  Come to my home and you'll find both products in my cupboard.  Highly Recommended!

I have tried pretty much every brand was was about to give up on stevia but after reading so many reviews that were positive about this brand I decided to try one more brand. I really wanted to find a natural low calorie sweetener. My search is over!! this is the best tasting! I'm hooked now! Doesn't have a strong after taste like all the others I had tried and a 2 ounce bottle goes a long way. Easy to dispense with the dropper.Look no further!
Oh My this is the best stevia!! No bitterness and no aftertaste. The first artificial sweetener to not have an aftertaste. And because it is a liquid it dissolves completely.

This is the only liquid Stevia I've found that doesn't have an awful after taste. I use it in everything from coffee to cocktails and it is fabulous. Great way to cut sugar from your diet while still enjoying some sweet stuff. It's highly concentrated so a little goes a long way.

I tried Sweet Leaf stevia first and was sorely disappointed. On recommendation I tried a bottle of NuNaturals and it is night and day better! No bitter aftertaste! So pleased and will stick with this from now on!

I love NuNaturals alcohol free Stevia.  The dropper is so easy to use AND not at all messy, as when using granulated "sugar-free" sugars.  I use between 10 and 14 drops in my smoothie (drop after you've loaded your blender with other liquids or use last.)  No strange after-taste....perfect sweetness.  I'm looking forward to trying other NuNaturals products.

I love this stuff! I am trying to cut white sugar out of my life, but it is so hard because I hate sugar free stuff. I hate the taste of aspartame, sucrose, and other artificial sweetners. Stevia is a natural sweetner that tastes good. I drink lemonade & tea sweetened with it. I have put it in oatmeal, plain Greek yogurt, cereal.... a wonderful, healthy alternative for a hard core sugar addict! I even carry a bottle in my purse at all times!

I was addicted  to the KAL Pure Stevia Extract in powdered form, until they changed the formula.  (Why mess with a winning formula?)  So I dropped that company's product fast.For some reason, I like the liquid from NuNaturals better than their powder.Anyway, really glad I found this. It's just sweet, with no bitter aftertaste at all, unlike some of the other products out there.I have it delivered on the recurring order deal that they have going.  Very happy so far.

If you can't have alcohol, this is hands down the best stevia on the market. Very sweet but not at all bitter. A little goes a long way. I use this to sweeten coffee, yogurt, just about anything. I even combine it with the Nunaturals white stevia pure extract powder for baking, and it works great! I won't use any other kind now!

column9: Love NuNaturals!  Recommend the Alcohol Free.
column10: I love NuNaturals liquid stevia!  It has a great, sweet flavor without the weird aftertaste that some brands of stevia have.  I made the mistake of buying regular NuNaturals liquid stevia (WITH alcohol, in the white bottle) the last time, and it isn't as good.  It takes a lot more drops to get the same amount of sweetening as the alcohol free.I will definitely be buying this again.

I am trying very hard to cut back on my sugar intake and this is going a long way to help me. This brand is THE BEST for stevia. I had bought others and been dissapointed with the after taste they had? This is what I use to sweeten my ice tea and I use the vanilla flavor version in my hot coffee. It makes them sweet and tasty without the sugar and no blood sugar spike either! This is the brand of stevia to try if you are wanting to check out the option of using less sugar. My sister is a nurse and she is the one that recommended this product to me.It just takes a few drops so this will last a long time too.

I love this stevia - I have tried the Sweet Leaf powder, which is very bitter in comparison, and the Vanilla Creme and Lemon Drop Sweet Leaf drops, which I don't particularly care for. Though this is my first bottle of unflavored stevia drops I have no desire to try another brand because it is nice and sweet without the bitter aftertaste of the others I've tried.

In my opinion, this is the best of the stevias out there. Perhaps the best of all the 'faux' sweeteners, too.Perfect for folks who cannot have sugar at all, in any form.Being liquid, it mixes well with everything.

Well after many brands of stevia I have finaly found one that is NOT BITTER. I have tried many brands and even some flavored ones and could not drink the stuff. I wanted to switch from splenda and sweet and low in my coffee to stevia as it is a natural product but , yuck I could not get past the bitter taste untill now. The search is over for me. A little goes a long way so take it easy and start with a drop or two and build on that for the sweetness level you desiere.

column9: Much better than the powdered Stevia
column10: I would recommend this to anyone who needs to eliminate sugar from their diet.  It does not have that bitter taste as the powdered does, but it does leave that slight sweet taste on the tongue, but not bad.  Not as great tasting as regular sugar, but seems to be better for the health.

This compact little bottle carries the power to sweeten a lot of coffee and tea drinks.  I began using this product when I developed gestational diabetes.  The stevia did not move my blood sugar at all and gave me something I could add to my beverages besides sugar.  It is highly concentrated, I personally use half a dropperful per cup.  Due to its size, it is easy to carry around in a purse or bag.  This tastes far better than any of the artificial sweeteners out there.  It is really good in peach flavored ice tea.Since I am now at increased risk for developing type two diabetes, I continue to watch my carbs, and to use this product.  I also have several friends who are diabetic or have other carb-aggravated disorders, and I like being able to share the little bottle I carry with me with my friends when we are out.There are a few things to be aware of with this product. It is super concentrated, so experiment with drops at first until you figure out how much you like.  Too much and it becomes bitter.  I also am not aware of how to use it to replace sugar in baking.  It seems like the liquid form would change a recipe too much to really make this the best option for baking.  As long as your using this to add to something the way you might add spoonfuls of sugar, it is great!

I've been using stevia for 3 years now since I found out I was allergic to sugar. Out of everything I've tried this is by far the best. No bad aftertaste. I do end up using more than the other brands but who cares a bottle still last me a couple months and I don't have to miss out anymore. My family uses it in their green smoothies every morning now that I got nunaturals. When I used the other brands they wouldn't use stevia because of the bad aftertaste. I get the alcohol free stevia because I'm also gluten intolerant and figured this was better. You will not be sorry you switched to this product!

I received this the 2nd day after ordering.  It is the best for sweetening.  I have tried other brands and didn't like them.  This actually doesn't have an aftertaste.  I'll be buying this brand from now on.

column9: Great taste, others may be sweeter
column10: THis product was great in my tea.  However, I do think I used more than when I was ordered the Source Naturals brand (which I got from IHerb.com).  Great sweetness and no aftertaste in my morning tea.

This Nustevia product is the best I have ever tried. There is no bitter taste. It is very sweet and only takes a few drops. On a previous review, I spoke about another product and how tasty it was. However, this one beats it by a long shot. I highly recommend it. I am glad I tried this one.
This liquid stevia has no after taste and blends easily when making smoothies and other drinks. It's also great in oatmeal.

For someone like myself who doesn't like to consume sugar, this is a useful alternative. You need just a few drops to sweeten most things, sometimes just a couple of drops will do. It has all natural ingredients and no strange after taste. I've used it in tea of various kinds, from regular black tea to green tea, chamomile, etc. I generally drink those teas as they come, unsweetened, but occasionally I use a dash of Stevia just for a different flavor. I've used it to sweeten other things as well, and I've no complaints. I am pleased with this product and recommend it to anyone seeking to escape the bondage of sugar, with no bad aftertaste.

I have tried 2 differ powder forms of Stevia and one other liquid..... So far the NuNaturals Nustevia Alcohol Free Stevia I like the best.  Yes there is still a bit of an after taste but not as bad as others I have tried.  I have just decided that the after taste is just going to be there regardless of the brand/type.  This one has had the least amount of aftertaste.
No aftertaste, isn't overpowering, doesn't mask the flavor of the food. We use this on our steel cut oats and protein drinks, no bitter aftertaste like the powders.
After reading the Amazon reviews, I tried this when my Sweetleaf was running low.  Great stuff, no bitter aftertaste at all.

I ordered this to replace the no-carb stevia packets that were completely hardened in their packaging. Called the company about the 'caked' packets and despite promises of 'looking into it' they never got back to me after 3 weeks. I gave them another chance and ordered this alcohol free stevia. I have been using stevia for years and this product is not very good (you have to use twice as much for it to 'sweeten' what you're putting it in). I will not be ordering anymore products from this company.

column9: NuNaturals NuStevia Alcohol Free - Yummy & Truly Non-Bitter
column10: I am changing my sugar loving ways and losing weight. I usually take 3-4 teaspoons of sugar in my coffee - I only need a few drops (3-6) of this to have a great tasting cup of coffee with no bitterness like some stevia products have.I have used about 2 ounces a month average - adding this to oatmeal, coffee, and non-fat greek yogurt everyday.Couldn't be happier with the taste and quality. I was told about this by my daughter who uses the other flavors. I personally prefer no flavor in my sweetner and I am allergic to aspartame.I have lost about 8 lbs in one month by adding oatmeal with golden raisins and walnuts for breakfast, and non-fat greek yogurt with vanilla extract+cinnamon+frozen fruits such as blueberries/strawberries/peaches/cherries to my diet. I have not exercised more than normal. All I have done is followed the advice in Dr's Oz/Roisen book "You on a Diet". I recommend this book as a great owners manual for your body.NuNaturals AF Stevia has let me keep the sweetness I crave without the calories. I'm in love.

This is the first time I've bought this, and I love it. I add a few drops to every full glass of water, and it tastes better than any flavored water I buy at the store. Since purchasing this product, I have consumed quite a bit more water each day. I am hooked on this product.
This is the best price, best tasteing stevia. Its also the healthiest sweetener I have found. I use it in shakes my kids cereal, coffee and a lot more.
It takes only a few drops for perfect flavor for my coffee.  Great for diabetics that want to avoid sugar.

I've tried several brands of stevia -- I found them funny tasting.  I persisted in trying different types because of the lure of an all natural, no-calorie sweetener.  The artificial sweeteners don't agree with me.  And I never liked the idea of putting them in my body.  Nu Naturals Liquid Stevia is MUCH better than any stevia I tried before.  I use it in cold and hot foods/beverages, as the lone sweetener or sometimes with a natural sweetener like maple syrup or honey (to reduce calories).  Because I like it so much, I haven't bothered to try Nu Naturals Stevia Powder, so I can't offer a comparison.  I highly recommend this stevia product!

column9: Best I Have Used So Far...
column10: I usually purchase this from my neighborhood Whole Foods Store. I saw it on here for a comparable price and was going to order something anyway and added it to my order. I started purchasing this brand because it has no alcohol base unlike a lot of the other brands that I have tried, it's more reasonably priced, it doesn't seem (at least to me) to have that bitter aftertaste as strongly as some others and a little goes a long way. I use this in everything, even baking.I noticed also that they sell a granulated "no bitterness" baking blend of this brand on Amazon and will have to give that a go as well. A bottle usually lasts me about 6 - 8 weeks (I drink herbal tea on a daily basis) as long as there is no holiday involved...lol.

column9: Tastes very good, but melts way too easily
column10: When I am short on time to eat a proper meal, one of these bars and a beverage fits the bill.If I eat one of these and have a large coffee or a glass of iced tea, I won't be hungry for 3 hours.They taste great, have a nice texture and a good balance of protein, carbs and fats.I have tried all the flavors and the triple chocolate crunch is my favorite.They don't spike and crash my blood sugar like some bars do.If you have them in any kind of heat, like stashed in your purse or car, they will melt in the package.I keep these at home in our pantry to grab if the baby is upset and I haven't had a moment to eat anything.The price here on Amazon is the cheapest you will find ANYwhere.
package arrived on time and in good condition. these bars are great for watching carb intake

Like all the other reviewers, I have tried many protein bars.  These are by FAR the very best I have ever eaten!  Great for post workout, or a grab and go in the morning or for snack.  They taste like those sugar wafer cookies I ate when I was little... Of course, these don't have near the sugar - so I guess it's more like the sugar wafer cookies with a "less sweet" but still delicious filling! :)  Peanut butter crunch and cookies and cream are both d'lish!

These are the best vanilla protein bars that I have tasted.  I have purchased them at several Vitamin stores, and at amazon.com they have the lowest prices.  I get migrains and I am limited as to what I can eat.  This works for me.

column9: Great for the money and tastes good
column10: Tastes good like a real wafer cookie.  Cheap for what you get, too.  This one's a keeper, and I have bought it many times over.

I ordered these right before Christmas without doing a lot of research on them.  They came very quickly and are delicious!  I have seen them in nutrition stores for double the price that I paid for them. I would definitely buy them again-

I have been eating Power Crunch Bars for several years now and like almost every flavor. Triple chocolate is a great dessert. I keep Power Crunch bars handy so if I get hungry, I can get some protein. Love them!!

column9: One of my favorite protein bars
column10: I think it is all a matter of taste.  I personally love those wafers.

column9: I LOVE the Tripple Chocolate Power Crunch Wafers.
column10: Creamy, crunchy and just plain good.  I buy them by the box and they are the best tasting protein bars I've found and getting them on the internet is the best economical way.  You can afford to buy more than 1 or 2 boxes at a time.Bonnie

I've been trying protein bars recently because I have been tired of drinking Muscle Milk on tough training days. I recently tried this bar and really loved it. I like it because of the different texture than a lot of bars. Most I have tried have been sort of gummy and chewy, but this has the nice cripness of the cookie wafer. The bar tastes really good and I will buy this one again
Love this product - these are the best of the variety. This company shipped them promptly - will definitely purchase from them again!

These Creme Filled Wafer bars taste absolutely amazing!!!  They do not have any of the chalky taste of most high protein bars and it is very light and crispy, compared to any other bar on the market. I have a very busy lifestyle with work, the gym, surfing, mountain biking, etc, so bars and protein drinks are a staple.  I have tried many bars and this one is my favorite.  I used to love zone bars because they were crispy and not as "Dense" as most protein bars, but then I discovered these bars and I will never go back.  These bars are the perfect snack when you need protein fast. I take no xplode before I workout so I can't eat anything 2 hours prior to my workout. My workout are usually 1 to 2 hours long and not eating for 4 hours can really put a strain on your goals of bulking up.  I take a power crunch bar with me to the gym and eat it during my workout. Its light enough where it doesn't reduce the pump I get from the no xplode and it's just enough to get the protein you need to build muscle.

I have been on a high protein diet for the last few years.  I can say with a high degree of certainty that Power Crunch is one of the best products on the market.  I HIGHLY recommend it to anyone.My favorite flavors are Peanut Butter Creme and French Vanilla.

column9: Great for trekking while on holiday
column10: I was lucky enough to meet the creator of Power Crunch while on holiday in the Sacred Valley in Peru. We had 2 weeks of day to day trekking in the Andes and our in-take of daily Power Crunch bars really saved the day. The terrain, the altitude and the food were challenging while being of our normal whole-food diet. I felt like Power Crunch really helped my body adjust and get a little extra out of an eXtreme vacation and tour schedule. I'm so excited by the taste and texture I'm ready to find a distributor in Asia so that Power Crunch can be part of my active daily lifestyle. You only need to try one to be hooked; do it when you need a little extra boost and you'll be back for more.

If those dense, heavy nutrition bars are too rich for you to tolerate or if you can't handle them after a hard workout, this one is worth trying.  It's very tasty and light.  The wafers give it a nice texture and crunch and it will remind you of those creme wafer cookies from childhood but much tastier and with better nutrition.  I will say that if you're looking for a "super bar" this may not be ideal because it does have a little more fat in it than other bars I like and a bit less protein and carbs, but it's worth buying because it tastes really good, it's light and easy to digest.  For me, this is a great meal replacement bar/snack or great after a light to moderate workout.

I chose this product as I am not crazy about chocolate flavoured products. This goes well with coffee and good if you are in a hurry. It keeps me full till lunch time. I worry about the fat content however. I probably would need an input from a dietician regarding that.

I was advised to use this power bar in my diet and I can't believe how good it is! I have tried many brands and I do have to say this is one of the best I ever tried. I would highly recommend this product to anyone.

I work out every day and when I am on the go I grab one of the power bars and it is the best snack you can put into your body after working so hard. 15% PROTEIN and more than anything the flavor is the best compared to any other bar. Can't be without them!!

Delicious and very effective.One of the competitors pushed one of these bars into my hand during my first figure competition last summer and I was blown away by the incredible, not your typical protein bar, taste of this product. I love them.Fitness buffs and non-fit folks should earnestly give the Power Crunch bar a try.....you'll feel the same way!

column9: These are the best....I highly recommend them.
column10: This is a great product -- have not found anything on the market I like more -- peanut butter fudge is delicious.
These are great. I'm in training and they're a life saver as a snack that keeps me in my high-protein program. There is some sugar in them which I wish weren't there but man are these things good.
I loved the crunch in these protein supplements.  They are the lowest in calories from what I have been able to find.  Very tasty too.  Much like a wafer cookie.
Great tasting, but contain hydrogenated soy and/or cottonseed oil and PH palm kernel oil!

Normally I would have rated this product high as a high-protein bar with a good flavor.  However, the manufacturer has loaded the bar with artificial flavor and artificial colors (yellow 5&6, red 3, blue 1).  Therefore I do not recommend it as a diet or health product.
Can't say I really love them. A little too sweet and too thick as a taste...But good calorie count.

On the go all the time, but still want to eat healthy? Are you sick of all the dry, mediceney tasting protein bars? Then these Power Crunch bars are for you. Seriously, the best bars I have EVER had. Great stuff!!

I love this protein snack bar. Tastes more like a candy bar than a protein bar and is easy to eat, easy to digest and a very quick & satisfying snack. I use it as a meal replacement or a fast way to stop my chocolate cravings. Love it.
This is one of the best tasting bars on the market.

column9: These don't taste bad. They don't taste great, either.
column10: They don't fill you up.My plan was, for lunch, to slowly eat one of these with a large glass of water. It's what my friend does with his nutrition bars.However, not only are these incredibly light, small, and I mean small, we're talking 3-4 bites, maybe 5-6 half-bites. Even if you chew 1-2 minutes(nearly impossible)They have a kind of sandy texture. Like you've just eaten caramel dipped in sand.The taste is alright, but I am disappointed. Triple Chocolate and I could not taste the chocolate. It barely tasted like anything...just had a kind of bland taste to it.At this price...I am disappointed massively. These were top rated by so many...But I think I will try the bar my friend has - his are 32g's of protein, 2.5x this ones, and only 30-40 more calories. Those are filling from what I've seen, have way more to them as well. Bigger, about 30% bigger size as well. To top it off? They are the same price and often on sale...they also have Vitamins and anti-oxidants.These, I don't know. If you down them with a Glass of Carnation instant breakfast, it goes well, kinda a good combo, not to heavy, just right. But this + water...not filling in the least.These are treats for after a meal, I suppose. I was looking for meal replacers. Ect, replace a breakfast here, or a lunch there. So I don't lose any muscle, just fat.I would recommend them if you want something very light to have as an after-snack to a small mealBut these are not meal replacers. column9: Not as good as I hoped...
column10: Not a great taste...not a product I could honestly recommend. Also it is a wafer, not a bar...I would stick with a bar.
Power Crunch Bars are fabulous ! Great energy boosters and taste just like regular vanilla waffers. A total must for body building !

column9: Not The Best Option Out There...
column10: I had high hopes for these bars... I am a huge chocolate wafer fan! I am familiar with protein/energy bars and knew going into it that there would more than likely be a hint of that chalky protein bar flavor... but it hit me like a brick wall with the first bite. Luckily my husband has tastebuds that are muted to flavor, so he has slowly been able to work through this box of protein bars so we weren't just throwing money away... but wow. Just overall very disappointing. I went by reviews before deciding to purchase these, and most reviews were awesome...  so I can only assume that these are just one of those bars that is hit and miss. Some are going to love it, others are going to hate it. Unfortunately, I am in the latter group for this one. (And as a side-note, I shouldn't even call this a protein bar since it only contains 13g protein --- my all time favorite protein bar contains 20g. Granted, 13g is still a lot... but if you can choke this down, surely you can choke down a 20g bar with more flavor. In the future I will stick with my tried and true Chocolate Mint Builder's bars.)

column9: Tastes Great But Is It Really Good For You?
column10: A friend of mine gave me a couple triple chocolate bars to try out. They were very tastey and I was going to buy a box until I noticed they contain partially hydrogenated soybean oil which I stay away from.
I ordered triple chocolate crunch bars and received cookies and cream, which are too sweet.  I've been eating them, but I don't like them.

Over the last 3 years I have sampled every major protein bar offering and I have to say these Power Crunch bars are my favorite.  It has a very sugary, chocolate taste that is similar to real chocolate wafer cookies. Power Crunch does not have the thick, hard protein "paste" you'll find in most bars. The chocolate wafer style is soft and almost disintegrates in your mouth - quite a contrast from most protein bar offerings. I've eaten probably a dozen a week for the last six weeks and I still cannot get enough of these bars.In all fairness most protein bars have 30+ grams of protein - more than double the amount than the 14 grams in Power Crunch. So personally I consider Power Crunch to be a very healthy high protein candy bar rather than protein bar. But after tasting Power Crunch, it'll be a long time before I reach for another Detour, MET-Rx, Oh Yeah, South Beach, or any other bar.

I work at a nutrition shop that sells protein bars/protein and other supplements, and i got to say...This is the BEST protein bar i EVER tasted in my whole life. This does not taste anything like all the other protein bar which has this milky paste over it. Price is ok but taste? just WOW!!! here are the nutrition fact for the product, Calories 210, Calories from fat 115, total fat 13g, saturated fat, 5g, cholesterol 0, sodium 80mg, potassium 195mg, total carbohydrate 10g, dietary fiber 1g, protein 13g!! I hope this review was very helpful :) have a great day and enjoy the bar if you plan to get some!!

i am a fan of power crunch, i work in a gym, so i am constantly overlooking protein bar nutrition, i picked power crunch because its not high on sugars and carbs, and all the junk protein bars may contain. i usually take a bar to school or work as a snack and i also have one after a work out, as well as a protein drink.  I LOVE, LOVE LOVE, this bar.

column9: A *true* protein bar, does NOT contain hydrogenated oils!
column10: My wife and I love these Power Crunch bars!  They have a great protein content and are low carb, which is great for our current exercise and diet routine.  Contrary to what's listed above, it does *not* contain hydrogenated *anything.*However, we're a bit concerned with the Palm Oil and Palm Kernel oils, and were told by BNRG that this was the healthiest alternative for the chocolately coating on the outside and the inside filling that would remain solid at room temps.My suggestion to them would be to make an alternative variety that has NO chocolatey coating (much like Bisco's sugar wafers), thus limiting the amount of oils that they'd need to use in these otherwise stellar protein bars.

I have had the vanilla, triple chocolate and PB versions of the power crunch bars and those are all very good.  The cookies & cream flavor however tastes very strongly of fake sugar.  For some reason the other flavors do a better job at masking this, the C&C  does not.I recommend having these with a hot drink, if you drink something cold while eating them you get a weird filmy coating to the roof of your mouth.  All flavors work well at keeping hunger away for 3 hours and do not cause gastric distress like some low carb bars can.  I prefer the other flavors over the C&C, but these are fine if the other flavors are gone and I need a quick bite with my morning coffee.I do not crave sweets after I eat a power crunch bar; sometimes sugar substitutes make me want to eat more sugar, but these actually cut my sweet tooth off at the pass.

column9: Doesn't taste low carb at all
column10: These are so good, you'd never know they're low carb.  They're crispy with a really nice chocolate taste.  Delicious!

column9: Taste like a chocolate covered wafer. With STEVIA!!!
column10: I was looking for a bar to snack on that wasn't loaded with carbs and sugar. This was it. It only has 4g of sugar in the whole bar and the rest is STEVIA. I couldn't tell at first and i wondered why it still tasted sweet so when i read the label I found the stevia. LOW LOW LOW on carbs too. I hate the gummy yucky..chewy texture of most health bars or power bars. this was a nice change and crisp. I only eat the Triple chocolate and the chocolate peanut butter. Those are the only two flavors that use STEVIA. the other flavors use sucralose and tasted waaaayyyyy too sweet.I bought them online here becuz at the store they were usually 3/$5. SO this was a bargain.Love them, Thanks. Taste even better cold out of the fridge.

I have been controlling my weight for the last 6 months (lost 22 lbs) falling off of the horse eating cake and stuff but when I discovered these 2 weeks ago, my "sugar jones" was redirected from high glycemic snacks to these.  If you have to sin, these have 13g of protein, 5g of sugar so they won't put you in a diabetic coma. I recommend Peanut butter cream.

column9: Hydrolyzed protein is the best absorbed
column10: These bars contain hydrolyzed whey protein, which is the highest quality. It doesnt matter if a bar contains 100g of protein if you dont absorb any of it. Hydrolyzation "pre digests" the protein so it absorbs more completely and quickly. These bars are the only ones that contain only hydrolyzed protein that I've found. Hydrolyzed protein also gives less gas. They taste great as well. They are very light and melt in your mouth a bit.

Power Crunch bars are perfect for me. Unlike most protein/health bars, these are very easy on the teeth, very soft, yet crunchy from the wafer cookie part. They easily melt in your mouth. The taste is great on every single flavor! The vanilla was good but boring. Peanut butter fudge and cookies and cream are VERY good!I've been using protein bars to lose weight. I've lost 100 lbs now and will continue to live on these wonderfully healthy bars from Power Crunch. Yum! And the numbers on the label are great, too!

Has a higher fat content then I like but power bars should be eaten more early in the day anyways, so the fat will convert to energy (unless you overeat)a very light and yummy power bar considering it tastes just like a chocolate covered wafer.a new favorite power bar

I hate all traditional Protein Bars. I understand that this is not a protein bar but I consumed more protein than I would have otherwise. Definitely enjoyable to eat and makes for a great snack when I get home from work and head to the gym before dinner.

Compared to other protein bars, this one tastes the best. It is not chalky. It is easy to eat. Not too sweet like some "energy" bars. However, almost half of the calories is from fat and the protein content is lesser than other protein bars. Maybe as a snack. Definitely not a protein supplement.

column9: This is a diet food???  WOW!

column4: Seeker of Great Deals "Seeker of Great Deals"
column10: I have bought these bars for years, but when I was no longer able to find them locally - I tried on Amazon!  Of course, ANYTHING you are looking for, you can find on Amazon! Yes, but when I am on the go, these are amazing!

I have tried many health food bars. None of them are as delicious and rich tasting than these! Power Crunch Bars are the best health food bars  and I will never go back to the grocery store bars.

These look delicious and when you first chew, they are delicious. But it did not take long before I started feeling nauseated and ill. There is also a terrible aftertaste that lingers for a while. Be careful.

These are the most delicious protein bars out there!! I dislike anything that has that weird health product taste, but these taste like the wafer cookies I ate as a kid! They arrived very quickly and were great!

column9: Delicious and Nutritious - best tasting bars on the market
column10: These don't taste like good for you food, but they are. My 2 year old loves them. column10: I LOVE this protien bar.  Best that I have EVER had.  Do not order in the summer.  I got them and they were totally melted, BAD.  I did find that by refrigerating them you could at least salvage the bar.

I have tried all of the flavors and have to say that chocolate is my least favorite. However, the vanilla, pb creme, and wild berry are all awesome.  The wild berry is almost like a strawberry birthday cake made into a wafer bar.  There is a pb fudge that is just ok. They should sell a variety box!  Also, get these shipped in cooler months. And I recommend storing in freezer. :)  And i forgot the cookies n creme.... Also delicious!

After having lap band surgery, I needed a good protein bar for after my workouts that was low in sugar, this is a great product!

Ive tried every bar, these are BEST. Just the right amount of protein, fat, carbs, sugar, everything. They have a wafer like texture like an ice cream cone. awesome. Vanilla and cookies and cream are the best. i don't like cinnamon roll much.

column9: Good dietary supplement for an older person...

I don't like the taste of many energy/protein bars because many of them have that dense, vitamin-tasting quality about them.  These bars are different.  Very delicious and taste like an indulgent treat but is low in sugar and high in important protein and has 4 gm fiber to boot.  Glad I found them on here..cheaper than local store.
taste as good as a candy bar..with better nutrition!!I have eaten a lot of different protein bars..this one seemed to not have that weird after taste that is the standard of protein bars.
Yummy and a good exchange of nutrition for the calories. The bars are crunchy yet creamy because of the coating. It reminds me of a KitKat bar!
I love this wafers! Received them sooner than expected and planning on getting some more as soon as I finish my first batch

Most protein bars are either loaded with sugar (and if you are in the market for protein bars, you probably don't want tons of simple carbs) or sugar alcohols (which are an excellent laxative! it does let manufacturers say say 'low sugar' on the packaging though), have a strange taste to them, and honestly aren't as good as a source of protein as they may appear -- most contain Soy protein.They also tend to have a texture that isn't very appetizing, either really chewey or really gooey.The main difference with these bars is that they taste amazing. They taste what they look like - a giant chocolate wafer, have very little sugar and no sugar alcohols either. They have a pure whey protein source, no soy protein in these (I always read the packaging on protein bars and sadly soy protein is very common). But the fact that it has 0 sugar alcohol, very low sugar, whey protein instead of soy and taste delicious really does make up for the higher fat content.Now it isn't really a downside but they are dry and make your mouth water a ton - make sure you have something to drink with them.
