column9: Most tasty protein bar I have ever had
column10: This is the most tasty protein bar I have ever had. I introduced to people at work and some of them just get hooked. It is not as chalky as other and tastes like real chocolate wafer.
These are the best protein bars ever and the cheapest place I have found to buy them, will continue to buy from there again!!!

I am so glad I bought these bars! They are absolutely delicious and a refreshing treat from all the other bars out there. I gave up on protein bars because I couldn't find one that tasted decent but these are really good. I've tried the peanut butter cream (awesome) and vanilla. Love the wafer taste.
Power Crunch are the best protein bars out there in my opinion.  Best flavor, not a lot of calories or carbs.I've liked every flavor I have tried so far.

I can now make all the Tiramisu I want plus all the low carb variations that are out there.  Specialty items like this are hard to find in country stores where I live so I keep them in the freezer and escape to Italy anytime I want.  I love this product being on Amazon and the free shipping was the "icing" on the lady finger!!

could not find these anymore at our local grocers,,,panicked and bought the case of 12,,,,use these for tiramisu and other recipes and froze several of the packages,,,they held up very well in the freezer and the price was fair
I consider the Alessi Savoiadi lady fingers to be a good value with great taste, very low fat, and a long (9 mo.) shelf life. I liked the last batch better as they were more crisp.

column9: Too crispy, too big and too many
column10: I bought a case of these to make some desserts.  I had no idea I would get so many in each 7 oz. package, or that they would be so big, or that they would be so crunchy.  Taste is fine.  Just know that if you're making a dessert and you expect the ladyfingers to suck up the sauce or sherry or liqueur, buy more sauce/sherry/liqueur than you planned!

These dry chews help scrape teeth clean and helps whiten teeth.They are not appealing however, to every dog. Of my two dogs, one will eat them and one will not. The one who does eat them didn't really love them at first bite, it was more of an acquired taste.Reducing plaque and tartar is something every pet owner must think about and these chews made right here in The USA are one way to accomplish that along with brushing your dog's teeth.

I really really wanted to get excited about this coffee, but for all its advertising, its really average at best.  I was ruined by buying some Sumatra that was recently roasted at $14/lb.  Going from that to this is like driving a Ferrari to driving a Honda Accord.  Sure, an Accord isn't bad if you know nothing else, but after having driven the Ferrari this was a disappointment.  It's not horrible, but no way its worth $10/lb.  I was spoiled and now I can't go back.  I'll use this up then go back to the heaven that was the other coffee.

These little biscuits are great for our little dachsies...pricey,but they are all natural, grain free. But this box is only  19 lbs. not the 20 lbs. advertised in the product description.  In the past they were 20lb. boxes ....now there's a little sticker covering the 20lbs printed on the box and it states there are only 19lbs!....wish they would lower the price as well. Good cookies though and they love them....
My sister, in California, sent me a package of these cookies around Christmas time.  I decided to purchase some as they are a good treat with a cup of coffee or tea.

column9: excellent tea, blend with herbal tea for delicious midcaffeine tea
column10: The chai mate has too much caffeine for me, as it is as much as a cup of coffee - although they claim it doesn't give you any jitters, for me it does. I blend this with one of their herbal (non-caffeine) chai's - the roobios is great - using a half-half ratio. The resultant mix is delicious with milk and a bit of honey - and is a great pick-me-up in mid morning. Teavana's teas also always make me feel better - each of their teas has a special "healing" power to it - I am not sure if it is true or not, but I do feel like I'm doing something better for my body by drinking their teas.
I tried this tea at a Teavana shop and fell in love. It is absolutely delightful! I ordered it 2 days ago and I received it in the mail today! Incredibly fast!

column9: Very nice chai with a unique flavor
column10: Just got this tea in one of the IntoTeas gift sets and I'm loving it!  It's replaced my morning coffee and it much much healthier than the former with the same amount of caffeine.  Also, I have noticed that the caffeine "high" (for lack of a better word) is not as jittery as coffee but still gets the job done and gives me the energy I need in the morning.The taste is fantastic as well, and it's very unique.  I can't quite place all the flavors, other than of course the chai, but I'm very impressed.Here's to hoping the other Teavana teas I've got coming are just as good!

I normally get this tea at Teavana stores in the mall or their website, so was excited to see it on Amazon (as I have tons of gift cards here). It seemed to take a little longer then other products to arrive but came in great shape and came with a free sample just like my other orders from the Teavana site have (which makes sense since they're partnered with Amazon). I drink the Samurai Chai Mate with the White Ayurvedic Chai  and they taste fantastic. They're supposed to be full of caffeine but for me they're my anytime tea. I have to steep a little longer then recommended time as I like my tea strong (with a bit of sugar or honey :) but it tastes great. Not to sickly sweet like some fruity teas.It is sweeter then some of their other teas, so if you don't like sweet then you may want to try out some of their others. I recommend going into the stores and sampling their array of teas they usually have set out. The blend they normally have of this one is good but not always what comes out at home though so don't just go by that one, they use German rock sugar which costs a little more while most people will use normal table sugar, honey, or artificial sweetener which will affect the tastes. Anyway, go try the tea, find your tea, and drink happy :D
This is the best chai tea I have tasted, and since it has 100% of the caffeine of coffee, I usually have 1-2 cups in the morning. Highly recommended

I picked up this tea with another chai white tea and I mix the too together. The tea is full of flavor. I am not much of a coffee drinker, so I like that this tea has the same caffiene amount, but I do not feel the affects of the caffiene.
Mate teas often have a strong herbal or "green" taste that can be unpleasant. Samurai Chai does not. It is delicious.

column9: Love, love this with the Ayurvedic White Chai - delicioso
column10: Teavana had the Ayurvedic White Chai combined with this as a store sample. Loved. Ordered. Tastes just the same at home. Delish.Note - we ordered a tea kettle (on Amazon :)) that allows you to brew to specific temps. I recently learned the temp coupled with the steeping time makes all the difference.One more thing -- Teavana has an app. It provides directions for preparing all the teas they sell, including combinations between varieties. AND it has a little timer for steeping.Good job Teavana.
Great Tea, arrived on time, and in air tight tea package to preserve flavor. Also mixes well with other tea.

column9: Americolor is good but vendor is questionable
column10: I've purchased many different Americolor gel colors and am happy with them when they are fresh. I purchased 7 bottles from this TCP vendor and 5 of them were old, one even had a use by date of one year before my order! Working with TCP to get a refund has not been as pleasant as working directly with Amazon. I finally did get a refund but only for the product, not the shipping charges. The products were old and unusable. I am very disappointed with this vendor and will purchase my colorants from another more reliable source. Americolor is good TCP is not.The two yellows I ordered from TCP were good and fresh and the student pack that shipped directly from Amazon was good and fresh. I'm happy with these colors but will not order again from TCP because of the other 5 old colors.
These work soooo well! Black is actually black & red is actually red! (No more grey penguins and pink santas for me!)
The colors are so strong-a little definitely goes a long way!  The colors are beautiful.  I like them better than the Wilton food colorings I've been using for many years.
I use the gel colors to dye my royal frosting for cookies.  They work wonderfully and they do not have a nasty taste, not even the black or red colors.  I would definitely recommend these!

column9: Company Needs to DOUBLE CHECK items being SENT.- They did, problem now solved.
column10: Just like the others, I received two different colors. Instead of the AVOCADO and COPPER as described, we received FUSHIA and TEAL. Americolor is a nice product no doubt, but this seller must pay attention to the product description and items they are sending. Very misleading. Avocado and Copper are the main reasons why this SET was bought instead of the other sets. Either DOUBLE CHECK the ITEMS you are sending OR CHANGE THE DESCRIPTION ALL TOGETHER! Sending the box back is too much of hassle. Pay attention, TCP.update feb 6:I sent an email to TCP regarding the mistake in colors and the company is gracious enough to send me the right colors as described and pictured originally in the order. I was also informed that they will ask Amazon to revise the description on this particular set. Thank you TCP for your response and willingness to resolve this issue with less hassle. :) I am now a happy camper. Bought the edible markers from you too. thank you.

I ordered this because the description indicated that Avocado and Copper were included but they were not. Instead I received teal and fuschia. The other colors were included as advertised and it would be too much trouble to return so I will just get the other colors at a local cake supplies. Would have been happier if I had gotten what I expected...

I like that this food coloring does not clump like Wilton does over time. These colors are beautiful and vibrant. However, sometimes to get a deep color you have to use a LOT of coloring. ESPECIALLY with the red food coloring. I just kept putting it in and I never got the true red that I wanted :( other than that these are wonderful!

I am also disappointed that this kit did not come with the colors listed. The copper was the main reason I chose this particular kit and it was not there. However I do like the colors that are included. They mix well in hot water and look great on the yarn!

I'm sure this product will be awesome, and I'll be trying them this weekend.  The missing star is because this kit does not include Copper(flesh tone) or Avocado.  It DOES include Fuchsia and Teal.  Buyer beware!

column9: Easy To Use, Doesn't Take Much
column10: These colors are easier to use than the Wilton colors as they have flip-top droppers.  Also, the colors are more intense.

The title says it all...In LOVE with these colors. They are beyond perfect. So true to what the outside label says. They surely stain your hands when mixing/using them, but after baked they don't stain your mouth! I love this set and will surely be burning through these colors and buying a new pack soon. If you are looking at other brands or tired of food coloring not giving you true, high quality colors...look no further! Just take my word for it & add it to your cart now :)

I originally purchased these to make rainbow cupcakes for my daughter's birthday last October. The batter was dyed 5 different colors and layered in the cupcake wrappers - the colors were vibrant and worked great! Since then I have used these for coloring frosting on several occasions. The variety is great and I would definitely purchase them again.

The AmeriColor Paste Food Color 12 pack kit that I purchased is great! The colors are vibrant and they are so easy to use...no toothpick needed! No mess either...just pop the top open and squirt out a little bit.  I love them! I would recommend them to anyone looking for a good start, or an addition to, your food coloring palette.  It has every color you need to start any project:  Super Red, Leaf Green, Lemon Yellow, Royal Blue, Super Black, Orange, Deep Pink, Chocolate Brown, Sky Blue, Violet, Avocado, & Copper (flesh-tone).  Doesn't leave your icing with a funky taste either! Great product...I highly recommend the AmeriColor Student Soft Gel Paste Food Color 12 pack Kit.

Didn't received copper or avocado even though it stated in the description that they were to be included in this package. Instead, like a few others here, I was given teal and fuchsia. Other than the missing colors, everything else looks nice and I will make do with what I have and pick up the missing 2 colors later on.

So much better and more vivid than the liquid ones from the grocery store.  So nice to just have them around all in one box!  I've used in cookie frosting and cake frosting so far.  No taste that I've noticed and being gel, it doesn't add any liquid to your frostings to break them down.

I love these colors.  The ease in which you can add them to the icing or glaze is great.  The color is true and does not fade as far as I can tell.  I will find out how long the colors do stay in glaze this weekend.  So far I like these much better then the other colors out there.
I bought this, and so far, it works well. Can be thinned down with vodka to "paint" on fondant. If you are trying for an intense color in gum paste, try powdered. This makes it super soft.
I bought this looking for a good starter set to try out americolor.  It's a really good assortment of basic colors and then you can supplement with anything you might need for specific projects.

After trying wilton gel colors I wanted to try these because I like the idea of a squeeze tube. The colors are more concentrated and easier to use. I highly recommend these to anyone who has only used wilton colors. They are worth the extra expense.

The quality is great, the gel works very well, and creates vibrant colors, even black is black if you use enough! But the red is still dark pink. I had been hoping that buying this more expensive 12 pack would create better results than your average 4 pack liquid food coloring you can get from the grocery store. But the red in this pack still isn't the vibrant red red color you need to for say, Lightning Mcqueen. I do love the variety of hues, the fact that they have the darker primary colors and not just the pastels.

The product itself is great.  Fast, free Prime shipping can't be beat.  Why the three stars, then?  The picture shows that you will be getting a color called AVOCADO, but what I received was clearly marked as TEAL.  Normally, not a big deal.  However, I only ordered this particular collection of colors to have another shade of green besides LEAF GREEN.  There is a different collection of colors available containing TEAL which I purposely avoided.  While I am happy with the quality of the product, I am disappointed with the misrepresentation of the color selection.

I LOVE Americolor soft gel food color. A little goes a long way, and the colors don't lose their tint when mixed into icing/fondant. Item came as described, and was shipped quickly. Received within 5 working days! Thank you!

column9: would be better with the right colors
column10: I'm thrilled that this food color is safe for my nut-allergic daughter, but it would have been perfect if only it had the right colors. Since I ordered this set specifically because it had the flesh (for angel cookies) I'm disappointed. I saw the other reviews saying they received wrong colors but hoped to get lucky. Guess not. I'll still keep buying Americolor though.
I know from experience what I was ordering and was not disappointed in any way.  Shipped fast and arrived intact.
The chocolate came to me melted and destroyed with no remorse from the company and little to no help in fixing the situation. I would not buy from this vendor again.
I purchased these for a friend who has an addiction.. Lol. Before I gave her the box I took a few and wow.. These are good

I've never been a mint gum user, until now. My daughter offered me a piece of this gum about one year ago and since then I am "hooked". Target has been my go to for supplies of Splashing Mint however, it has been "clearanced out" and CVS doesn't carry it either. So, Amazon to the rescue!  I purchased 2 12-pack boxes and think that I will buy more because as far as I can tell, this flavor and its Splashing Fruit cousin are no longer manufactured. The expiration date is well over a year from now and I'm sure that I'll go through my current supply by mid-winter. This may seem like a silly review, but I'm embracing the pleasurable simplicity of Trident Splashing Mint Chewing Gum.
Perfect. Love it! Great deal. Everyone at work chips in and I purchase gum for work, this will last a while. :)

I bought this seafood seasoning to get to $25 on on my order so that I can get free shipping. It turn out to the a great product! Smells and tastes great! Love the grinding function. We use it not only on seafood, but also with vegetables and other food and they all turn out to be great. High recommend this product!

column9: We just happen to love this candy.
column10: We received the package fine. I give some of these to others who also love this candy.  BIG BAG, good candy.

We normally buy a case of individual sugar packets usually containing 2000 packets but we've found that there are a large number of partially filled or empty packets so we weren't sure how many full packets we were really getting.  Also, it wasn't uncommon to have leaking packets getting sugar everywhere.  Ants and bugs love that.  We decided to try Domino sugar cubes and they've worked out great.  There is never any doubt about how much sugar you are putting in your coffee or tea etc and no mess.  The price could be a bit cheaper but we feel it is worth it because of the benefits.  We would buy the product again.

Somehow the cube dots sugar is a supermarket missing article nowadays. I had to order from Amazon and I am very satisfied with my purchase. Delivery was fast, sugar was sweet, so everything fell into place.
Great product.  I use the cubes (or dots if you will) to accurately measure and restrict my sugar use.  Determine the number dots needed and be sure for ever after.

column9: TASTE GREAT BUT FIND IT CHEAP
column10: WE HAVE USED SEVERAL JELLY BELLY SNOW CONE FLAVORS THE KIDS ALL LOVE THE COTTON CANDY NOT ME SO MUCH BUT THEY LOVE IT.  WE HAVE USED THE COTTON CANDY, BERRY BLUE, VERY CHERRY, AND MY FAVORITE GRAPE SODA AND LOVE THEM.  I WOULD NEVER PAY $11 FOR THEM THOUGH.  THEY SELL THEM AT STORES LIKE TARGET FOR LESS THAN $4 A BOTTLE.

column9: Tastes okay but a little goes a long way
column10: This stuff tastes good, but if you use too much its like cough syrup, and I dont mean that in a good way.  When I make a shaved ice for my son, he'll usually put 2 different flavors in it on each side, and I put a small stripe of this down the middle.  A real small stripe.  That works.  If you dump 2-3 tablespoons of this into a cup of shaved ice like other flavors, it wont get eaten.  Not as good as some other jelly belly products, but its a nice little extra flavor to use sparingly.

Purchased the pink cotton candy and blue rasberry flavors. Both were gross. They were very thin and left a weird burning sensation in your throat as you ate it. There are far better products from other brands out there!

Bought this a a surprise treat for my son who LOVES Cotton Candy. Boy, was he disapointed, after crushing the ice and pouring the syrup on top, the taste verdict...."IT TASTES LIKE MEDICINE!"  Very disapointing, we won't be buying any jelly belly flavors again!

I ORDER THIS SYRUP 3WKS AGO WITH MY ICE SHAVER I BOUGHT OFF OF AMAZON AND MY 2GIRLS REALLY LOVED THE TASTE AND I DID TRY IT MYSELF AND IT WAS NOT AT ALL BAD. SOME WHAT SMALL BOTTLE IF USING IT 3 OR 4 TIMES A WK WHICH WE DO BUT WE JUST ORDER DOUBLE BOTTLES ONCE WE GET HALF WAY DWN. NOT TO STRONG IN TASTE AND NOT TO SWEET. ITS REALLY GOOD AND WE WILL ORDER AGAIN AND AGAIN.
We have tried several different flavors and brands, and while it might be a little pricey here we found to cotton candy flavor to be one of the best we have tried.
This syrup met our expectations.  It works well with our shaved ice maker and tastes just like what you would get at a fair.  A little goes a long way.
This price is insane.  11 dollars for what equates to kool aid and sugar.  Bed bath and beyond carries this for 2.99.

column9: Genuine low sodium (one of the few)
column10: Every other brand of chicken broth I have found contains 600+ mg of sodium. Pacific Natural Foods free range low sodium chicken broth contains 70 mg, practically a 10:1 difference! So-called reduced sodium products typically contain 400+ mg. If your health requires low sodium, this is the brand. And the quality and flavor are superb.

Once again, Pinoy Outlet comes through. Ordered this product by accident, and Pinoy Outlet offered to take it back even though it was my fault! I kept the product and ordered the correct one, which was shipped promptly.

I love Nature's Path Oatmeal. I suppose someone reading my Amazon reviews might think I love it a little too much as I have purchased and reviewed almost every flavor. That's probably true. I do eat it every morning.This texture of Optimum Zen is excellent, as are all of the Nature's Path Oatmeals. However, when I tasted this one for the first time, I was in for an unexpected surprise: Ginger. One of the many flavors in Optimum Zen is ginger and it is a little bit dominating. It pairs very well with Chai. However, I suspect that if you didn't like ginger, this oatmeal would not go over very well. So if you like ginger, are in for a unique oatmeal experience, buy it. If you're not sure, if I were you I would go to the local grocery store (only the organic-style stores around me carry Nature's Path) and purchase one box. You'll spend a little extra, but it'll be worth it with this flavor to make sure you like it before you buy 6 boxes.

Since breakfast is the most important meal of the day, this oatmeal is a great option. It's delicious and so easy to make and filling enough to carry you until lunchtime without needing to visit the vending machine. I love the ginger and don't find the taste polarizing in the least.  I bought this bulk package and it lasted me a whole year and never became stale.
My family loves this oatmeal. It's not too sweet and you can actually see the oats.
This is the best oatmeal I have ever had. There is nothing that could be done to it to make it any better. I never knew that healthy and great taste could come in the same package!

It tastes good. There aren't many cranberries in it, but it may be the batch I got. You can taste the ginger but it is not really strong. I love ginger and could handle a lot more. If you do not like soy nuts I don't recommend this oatmeal, they are dominant in the texture and taste. I like that it is not as sweet as the most common brands of instant oatmeals you can get at the grocery store. I will buy again.
Good flavor without all the chemicals found in other instant oatmeals. Much more reasonably priced through Amazon than at the health food store.

I'm a type one diabetic, and this oatmeal is a fantastic breakfast for me:1.) Ginger helps stabilize bloodsugar2.) The organic nature and lack of sugar in this oatmeal doesn't cause bloodsugar to "spike" like normal oatmeal or syrup.3.) Because bloodsugar isn't fluctuating (fluctuations in bloodsugar cause hunger) it is a filling and lasting breakfast leaving me satisfied for hours...4.) Tastes Great; I'm not kidding. It's a phenomenal tasting oatmeal with great flavor.I highly recommend this to anyone looking for a healthy breakfast, but as a diabetic, I can say this oatmeal is a great breakfast for anyone with bloodsugar issues!!
This is great oatmeal - at a good price. I dont taste too much ginger though - I didnt find it to be very strong, which is fine - ginger can be overpowering.  The cranberries are a good touch.

Simply the best instant oatmeal brand you can buy. If you can find it at a local food store, be ready to spend as much as 5.00 a box. Have it delivered by Amazon to your door for half that price, and begin to enjoy instant oatmeal done right.
This is a nice flavor.  The cranberries are a great change from the raisins.  Ginger instead of cinnamon is also really nice.  It's not too spicy either.

This is my absolute favorite instant oatmeal.  Cranberries and ginger...delicious.  Also, the ingredients are all natural, nothing artificial.  Tastes great by itself.  I also often add in a shredded apple or sliced banana or blueberries.  You can't go wrong!

Siberian Huskies are naturally picky eaters but this food really excited her.  Anya attacked it like my Goldie/Shepherd mix did.  My Goldie/Shepherd mix has problems with dry skin and a diet rich in fish oil was suggested.  It worked for her but gave her 'fish breath', my daughter said.  I recommend this food for any dog that gives you that "what the heck is this again?" look with ordinary foods.  I recommend it for Huskies and for dogs with itchy skin.  Its a real treat "Like stealing the cats food."

With the imminent demise of the Natura Pet brands (EVO, Innova, et. al.) after their purchase my P&G, we've moved to the somewhat higher priced Orijen line, with excellent results. Similar to Natura, Champion is concerned about ingredient quality and sources (avoid China), and produce their own food in their own plants (though Natura did not produce their own canned products). Palatability of the Orijen products we've tried (including their cat foods), and they smell like food, not gnarly "dog food" that makes you gag when you open the bag. The Acana brand from Champion is similar, but lower protein and nearly as expensive.I prefer the fish formulation, as dogs (and even more critically cats) have difficulties in synthesizing the omega-3 oils they need when only provided vegetable sources (canola oil and flaxseed are common). (AAFCO requirements are bogus -- they are an industry group that has rejected NRC recommendations and instituted their own, simpler ones. The NRC "upset" the industry when it required feeding tests to see if the diets actually met dietary needs.)Shifting to a high protein diet can seem scary, as you are likely to have loose stools for a week or so. Take it slowly (mix in with your old food) and you should be OK.My only hesitation (past the $60 for 30# price) is that for tiny, senior dogs the kibble size may be too large. Our nearly toothless, 16-year-old toy poodle has difficulty with it. It is about 3/8" disks, not large, but not as small as EVO or Innova "small bites" size.Check you dealer for Champion's "buy 12 get one free" or breeders' programs, depending on your status.

column9: We Love it, THE BEST YOU CAN BUY!!!
column10: I have had my 22lb. Terrier mix on this since she was 1 yr old and she just turned 3 yrs old. She just had full blood work and liver/pancreatic enzyme readings as I have her on Atopica for allergies and they advise once yearly blood work. So far 3 tests total, one before Orijen, another after one yr on Orijen, and another after two yrs of being on Orijen. My vet said my dog has excellent blood/liver/pancreatic readings, in fact, he said better than most. In fact her readings where so good that he asked me what i was doing/feeding her and told me to keep doing what you have been cuz her blood work is so good and especialty as she is on Atopica and Comfortis. Orijen Fish is the only dry dog food I could find that didnt use chicken fat in it, which my dog is very allerigic to. My dog is also allergic to the follwing (confirmed by allergy testing, yes it was expensive)...chicken, turkey, beef, lamb, bison, pork, and most grains like rice, oats, wheat, corn, flax, etc...as well as fleas. I feel this food has saved my dogs life as I cant find another food she can tolerate and thrive on, yet she also loves the taste and is holding a perfect weight on only 1 cup a day so even though its pricey, only having to feed 1 cup a day makes it very ecomonical. I feel this is the best dog food I can buy for my dog.

column9: Orijen 6 Fish saved my dog's life
column10: I have an 8 year old chihuahua named Rico. He struggled with digestive issues when he was a puppy. His vet diagnosed him with a protein allergy and said he would always have to be on a hypo-allergenic diet which is only available through vets with prescription. The food fixed Rico's digestion problems, so I thought nothing else of it. A few years later, he started having seizures. Awful, atypical seizures that would last for hours. We sought treatment from a neurologist who prescribed different medications. Some of which didn't work. Others made him loopy and unacceptably not himself. Thanks to a wonderful woman who read my post on a pet md message board, I did research on the food Rico was eating. Not good!! The food had an ingredient known to cause seizures, BHA, though none of the numerous vets we saw even mentioned food as being a culprit. I immediately researched hypo-allergenic, natural foods. Against medical advice, I took him off the medication and started him on Orijen 6 Fish that day! He has not had a seizure since then. Not one. I can't say enough good things about this food...and always doing your own research after consulting with professionals. My brother started feeding his dog this food, and I hope you'll consider doing the same.

I was looking for a kibble to replace the Innova I'd been feeding for many years (the change had nothing to do with quality and everything to do with not wanting to support factory farming and inhumane slaughtering practices).  Orijen 6-fish was the best I could find, short of switching my "domestic wolves" to a vegetarian diet.  I've been impressed how easily the dogs have adapted to it.  I started them on a 50% mix of Orijen-Innova, which is a quicker introduction than is usually recommended for new food.  They never had a bad poo, never had stomach aches.  They like the kibble so much that one started guarding the closet where it's stored.  I had to put the bag in an airtight storage can to stop that behavior.  Both dogs used to nibble grass after eating Innova, and they don't do that any more.  They are bright- eyed and energetic.  They aren't as gassy as they used to be.I should note that my dogs are young -- 7 months and 1.5 years.  I would not recommend feeding such a high protein kibble to an old dog ("old" depends on the breed).I found a company that delivers this at a discount if you agree to schedule regular deliveries.  And they pay for shipping!

My two dogs LOVE this. I should warn people that its REALLY fishy smelling. Nutritionally, this is one of the best, and while its price is fairly high, will surely result in a healthier dog and maybe lower vet bills. Orijen has a few different types that I rotate to give my dogs some variety - fish and I think some sort of red meat version.

column9: Freshest ingredients and low in allergens. How can you beat it?
column10: I had been feeding my dog the same food for years but never knew he was allergic to it. I later learn that the formula was changed because it was bought out by Proctor Gamble. Go figure. My dog was chewing himself to the bone.I tried 5 different new foods--all of the highest ingredients. Nothing cheep for my dog. But he either was still allergic to it, wouldn't eat it, or had diarrhea.Then I found Orijen 6 fish formula. It was like giving my dog crack! He LOVES it. And his allergies no longer bother him.There's a video on the Orijen web site that I highly recommend. Between the experience I'm currently having with my dog and the food, plus learning to the extent that Orijen goes to make the freshest human-quality dog food blows my mind.There is NO OTHER KIBBLE that is as good as this food. Hands down!!! It's worth every penny.
This is the best Fish Kibble on the market now.  If you animal has any allergies to other kibble foods, this is the way to go...no itching, no scratching, great skin and coat.
It has taken many years to finally find a dog food that works well with my Boxer. Finally firm stools!! She loves it! Expensive but you feed less since the protein is so high.

My dog has servere allergies to EVERYTHING!!! This food has helped mello out her skin. She's a Shepard, basset, lab mix! Now although some complain about the price, to me my dog is like child so if she's healthier I don't really care how much it costs me. She hasn't had any problems such as diaherra, stomach problems or anything of the sort. She does tend to drink a little more water but it's due to higher levels of protein, so I just take her out an extra time during the day. Otherwise I truly have no complaints about the dog food, sure the price is a bit high and shipping is insane, but the rating is on the dog food not the selling company! :) I highly recommend this PRODUCT!

Like another reviewer, I'm in the same boat with puppy allergies. My dog is very allergic to chicken - even just two of those chicken jerky (all natural) treats has her with flaky skin and itching by the next day - and it's extremely hard to find dog food that doesn't at least use chicken fat, if not chicken meat as filler due to the comparatively low cost of poultry.My pup is thriving on Orijen Six Fish. Her coat is shinier than it has ever been (it took a very long time and multiple brands of dog food to figure out that chicken was the problem). Her muscle tone has always been decent (she's a dobe/sheppard mix) but now those muscles are 'sculpted', and although she's never been over-weight, her waistline has also never been so well defined. She is sleek, shiny, bright eyed, and always full of energy. Prior to the Orijen her coat was dull and flaky constantly. You could feel sores under her coat and on rare occasions she'd have to go to the vet for steroid shots. Even on Wellness, Evo, Taste of the Wild, etc, etc, good brands all, nothing worked for my dog's issues until the Orijen.On the down side, the price is outrageous for dog food. It's that simple. And although I've seen many reviews (elsewhere and one on here) giving the argument that "but because it's better quality food your dog will eat less", I have to disagree with that and say, if anything, Mazzy eats more of the Orijen than she ever did those other foods. I don't know if that's simply because she feels better (she also used to burp constantly and I worried about bloat) or if she just likes the taste a lot more, but she used to eat maybe 3 cups of food per day - maybe, and with the Orijen, she will easily eat four cups, and sometimes wake up in the night for a fifth (I semi-free feed, adding one cup at a time to her bowl when I see it empty). That's a lot of money at $40+ for only 15 pounds.I do think it's an excellent food, but if your dog does well on something else, I'd say go with that instead because Orijen is going to be more expensive AND hard to find if you aren't ordering online.
too bad it's too high in protein and gives my doggies diarrhea.  i usually mix it in with another lower protein doggy food to prevent this.

Before I get into my commentary about the Orijen 6 Fish, I have to say that I have fed my dogs and cats raw for many years. We bought a 9 week old Pekingese recently from a breeder. She provided us with a 2-3 week supply of the food. I went ahead and fed it because I didn't want to change it too fast. His stools were big, soft and stinky. I found a shop that was selling it here and went out there. By coincidence they were going to have an Orijen rep there. So I talked with the rep who said that a puppy shouldn't be eating the 6 Fish and he recommended a puppy mix. I bought it and took it home. Basically I had the same results. I switched him to raw. I think  he has a bit of a nervous stomach as he has a few problems but nothing like with the  Orijen.I have read a lot of 5 Star reviews from people who seem to be conscientious and observant. I have also read some 1 and 2 Star Reviews from people who also seem that way. The only thing I have to say is that it is not for everybody.

After 1 1/2 months on this food all three of my dogs had dangerous liver readings. After 3 weeks all three went back to normal. this is a dangerous food and can kill your dog be careful. I would not recommend feeding it unless you are willing to pay very high vet bills and lose your dog. the company never responded to my emails or phone calls.
Product taste is fine, but such a small quantity in each packet.Suggest larger quantities.

I have recently adopted my son's cat and have spent the last few months educating myself about cats.  After learning that most cat foods are too high in carbs I decided to change his food supply. Transitioning him was easy, lucky me!!  Over time I've bought various brands of grain free cat food, both dry and wet. Most he ate, but some he just picked at. Then I came across the wellness brand and bought all their varieties.  He loves them, some flavors more than others, but he'll eat them. I recently bought wellness core and bingo!...we have a winner here.  He absolutely loves this food and wipes his plate clean every time; something he has never done with any other brand.  He especially loves the chicken, turkey and chicken liver.  The minute I put this down in front of him he doesn't come up for air until it's all gone.  It makes me happy to see him enjoy his food so thoroughly. His coat has developed a nice sheen to it and he has lost his excess weight. I'm glad that he prefers this food but even if he didn't, it doesn't say anything negative about this brand. Cats have preferences just like us.  This is one of the best canned, grain free foods out there.  I highly recommend it.

In April of last year our cat was diagnosed with diabetes.  Our vet started him on insulin twice a day and asked that we bring him in for testing once a month.  This didn't sound right to me because a human diabetic tests almost every day.  We asked permission to self test.  We started testing him in the morning and at night before feeding him. By using the Wellness Core Cat food with its lack of grain and high protein content his blood sugar readings began to come down.  We found that we slowly had to reduce his insulin.  He has now been off of insulin for three months.  We still test him once a week but he is now a good weight, he has no dandruff and his coat is glossy.  He also has far more energy.Winnie's Mom

column9: Fantastic Food for Good Cat Health
column10: The pet food industry can be one of the most infuriating as you start doing research and discovering what trash manufacturers (and the vets who get paid off by the manufacturers) push onto the unsuspecting public. For reference, don't ask your vet - do some Internet research at sites like, for example, [...]. What you'll find is that even the supposed "high-end" lines from basically every major supermarket label are horrible for your fuzzy friends. People who trust the marketing or trust their vets overpay and feed their cats foods that are full of carcinogens, cheap ingredients that are inappropriate for a cat's digestive system, and byproducts that provide nothing of value and are basically a way to make cheap profit off of literal garbage. It's a tragedy, as these same cats end up with shorter lifespans, kidney problems, UTIs, cancer, and a host of other issues, all of which could have been avoided by a high quality food.This is an A-Grade food. What you'll find here is very high protein content, many meat meals, good carbs and oils, and no grains, which is great as a cat is not an omnivore, it's a carnivore, and it simply does not need grains. It has 50 percent protein, which is among the highest you'll see in cat food. The first 4 ingredients are all meats.What you will NOT find here is the kind of junk you'll see in things like Purina One and Science Diet - byproducts (aka beaks, feathers, bird feet), brewers rice (aka the waste product from making beer), wheat flour (a leading cause of pet allergies), corn gluten (a cheap waste of space), and things like "liver flavor" (because they don't want to pay for the real thing). I didn't just pull those ingredients out of the air - I was reading the ingredients list of Purina One. It's pathetic.Don't feed your cats trash. Pay a little more to feed them good food now, and they'll lead longer, healthier, more satisfied lives as a result. It's worth it.

I can't say enough about this cat food!  My fifteen year old cat is diabetic and has been on insulin since July.  While he is not completely off it YET, I have reduced his insulin by two thirds and hope that he'll be able to be completely off.  The benefits don't stop there.  I have two other cats - one that used to throw up every day - and one that has no current health issues of any kind.  My kitty that used to get sick, for some reason, every day, has only had two episodes of throwing up since I changed her to the core cat food two months ago.  My other cat looks fabulous, sleek, glossy coat(the coat on my two kitties with health issues has improved as well!) and lean and not overweight.  The benefits don't stop there, though!!  An amazing difference in my litter boxes!!  Less waste to clean up and very low oder!  My vomiting kitty used to have very foul smelling bowel movements, too.  Now there is little to no odor at all.  Urine seems to have less ammonia smell as well.  A GREAT PRODUCT! - Low carb as well!

column9: Fantastic food, the best available in the market
column10: I did an extensive research on the web about the best food for my kittens (5 month old). Two brands came up: Evo and Wellness core. One of my 2 cats liked Evo but the other had a hard time digesting it (gas and soft stools). Evo canned food has stronger smell too. I tried Wellness canned food (chicken turkey) and both of them liked, with no digestive problems. I also tried its seafood one but one of the cats did not quite like it. Now, this chicken turkey and chicken liver formula is their basic food.I have also tried several types of Weruva. They seem to like the soup but had a hard time eating the chunk of chicken. Also the Weruva can has far less fat content which worried me whether it was sufficient in terms of calories for very energetic kittens. Bottomline: Wellness core is the solution.

column9: Very healthy food, cat loves it
column10: The first 3 ingredients of this food is Salmon, Whitefish, and Herring - straight up. This food stinks like fish really badly but I'm sure that makes my cat love it even more. It is grain free and is loaded with 50% more protein than the Wellness Complete Health canned variety (that is not CORE). Thankfully I can find this for $1.49 per 5.5 oz can at my local store instead of $1.75 here. I give it 5 stars.

column9: A pate food that my picky cats like
column10: I bought this after trying a few of the 'healthier' cat foods out there. My cats love Fancy Feast, but I want to feed them better food. I've tried several 'healthy' brands that they hate (Newman's Own, Weruva, Natural Balance). They're extremely picky and turn their noses up at just about everything! So frustrating.After reading reviews of this, I bought some and gave it a try. Both of my cats really love this food. They normally won't touch a pate-type food (preferring cat foods with 'bits' in gravy) but this one they love. It's not smelly and it doesn't upset their stomachs, and they're always eager to eat as soon as I put the bowls out, so I consider this a success and have purchased more.So if your cat is picky and won't eat a lot of the 'healthier' foods, give this one a shot.

Petco has the same food online for 38.93 and free shipping over 49 dollars.  Just passing this along.As for the food...my cats would vomit after eating all the time and my vet put them on some expensive prescription food.  The prescription food didnt' help the vomiting.  I did research and found this food to be grain free...and after feeding it to my cats they haven't vomitted since.Next time you go to the pet store look on the back of every cat food and you will see the second ingredient as either rice, grain, corn, etc.When was the last time you saw a tiger eating rice?  Exactly my point!  You will see a difference in the softness of your cats fur after feeding them this food for a while.  Try it out!

column9: Core Cat food is the best
column10: I got a new cat who happens to be very allergic to everything.  The vet put her on Core cat food and now she is doing great, no signs of allergy distress at all.  I put my other cat on it so I wouldn't have to deal with two diets and she has improved in her health and hair quality.  It is grain free and closer to the natural diet a cat requires than other foods on the market.  I really recommend it, especially to cats who show signs of a poor coat, loss of weight, etc.

I have two cats of ages 1 and 3 years old.  My 3-year old is a very picky eater.  She never liked eating canned food and stubbornly stuck to her dry kibble.  Well, all this changed when I introduced this Wellness Core Chicken can food to her.  She can't get enough of this stuff!  Now, she would meow loudly and persistently at my feet as I dish out the food, eagerly waiting for me to set down her food plate.  She gobbles it up at every meal.  I was simply amazed how much she loves this stuff.  I never got this reaction with other wet food I've tried (EVO, Weruva, Halo, Chicken Soup for the Cat's Soul, Merrick's, Felidae).  My 1 year old cat eats anything, so as expected, she gobbled up the food as well.  Big two thumbs up from my feline family!

column4: Clarese busy busy "Comfort and Convenience Se...
column10: My cats are on a grain-free diet. Although they prefer the turkey/chicken version, the fish is acceptable as well. They are all three eating their fish Wellness Core which is good for my cats with different food preferences.

It's expensive, that's for sure -- but well worth it. My feral cats have many health problems, so it's important they eat well. This brand (Core Wellness) is incredibly healthy. I've noticed a shinier coat on both my cats, and they love the taste. It's definitely worth it, especially if your cats are older or have health problems.

This is one of the few wet foods that my cat, who is not a picky eater, actually refused to eat.  He grudgingly ate it for the first few days and then when I fed it to him today; he took one sniff of the dish and walked away.  This product does have a blended-meat, pâté type of consistency which, from the other wet foods he hasn't taken to, seems to be a style that he isn't a fan of.  I do use the Indoor Health dry food that this company makes and my cat seems to enjoy that very much.

column9: Pleases the finicky AND is grain & gluten free!
column10: I've been feeding my cats a combination of  Max Indoor Adult Roasted Chicken Flavor Cat Food, 16-Pound and Nutro MAX CAT Salmon and Whitefish Entrée Gourmet Classics Adult Canned Cat Food for years now.  Sadly, my older two just were not as crazy about the canned stuff as they are about the kibble.  I have been trying to find something they will eat that isn't junk (I think they would eat SPAM every day if they could).  After lots of research and a lot of trial and error, finally!  Wellness CORE has done the job.  They like - no, LOVE, the chicken and the fish flavors.  The texture is smooth, and it smells like something I would eat myself.I have been slowly increasing the canned food and decreasing the dry, which is good for all kitties.  Yes, this is expensive for cat food, but I'm OK with this. One day I will take the plunge and transition them to a full-raw and all-natural diet such as Feline's pride (not available on this site or in commercial stores) or god forbid make my own cat food.  Until then, I'm just glad the gals are happy.

My cat has been eating only CORE since I got her as a 2 month old kitten.  She's now 17 months old, full of energy and with the shiniest coat you can imagine.  She also barely sheds, which is a real bonus!  I did a lot of research on cat foods after losing my previous cat to kidney failure, and this is at or near the top of all the lists.  She eats 2/3 can daily, and is supplemented at bedtime with 1/4 cup of Wellness CORE dry food.

column9: Only Canned Food Snippit Can eat
column10: Wellness food is worth the extra $$.  I am so impressed with this product.  My kitty, Snippit, has had a very delicate digestive system her entire life.  Believe me, it's no fun cleaning up barf every couple days.  But since I started her on Wellness Core (dry and canned), the barf episodes have nearly been eliminated.  She can even eat the Wellness treats with no ill effects (before, we couldn't do any kind of treats).  She acts much brighter and happier and her coat has improved in sheen and texture.  I've put my dogs on Wellness food as well and seen similar results in their coats.  Awesome product!
My cats love this food and you can't beat its nutritional value. Both Paws Up!!!!

My 8 year old cat was diagnosed with inflammatory bowel disease. She was having blood and mucus in her stools.The vet prescribed a couple of different high fiber diets, neither of which worked. He also tried giving her steroids.The steroids worked while she took them, but once off them her symptoms returned. He wanted to do more testing.I spent $500 on an ultrasound, which was inconclusive. Next, he wanted me to do a $4000+ procedure (colonoscopy)which would give a complete picture of the state of her disease. The next course of meds would be a combinationof chemo and steroids.Meanwhile, after also mentioning this all to the breeder that I got my cat from, she told me to try the Core diet.I had helped all her cats that had similar symptoms. She was pretty sure that all my problems were being causedby grain allergies. So, I made the switch, using both the Core canned and the Core dry kibble. In addition, Iadd probiotics and food enzyme powders to the wet food, daily. My cat is now almost completely symptom free.Occasionally, I see a little mucus and maybe a smear of blood in the stool. My occasionally, I mean maybeonce in 8 weeks or so, where as before, it was every day.I am sure the probiotics and the enzymes help, plus the holistic vet did some acupuncture, but I am thinkingalso, the Core diet was the most beneficial treatment of all.

The proof is in the pudding - I have two cats and they love this stuff! I like that fact that this cat food is high quality. The 1st four ingredients are all fish, not like a lot of other cheap products. If your cats like the taste, then this is a good choice.

column9: Cat loves it just as much as the chicken/turkey version.
column10: Same as the turkey/chicken version except it smells like fish. Smells like a freshly opened can of sardines. The cat seems to like both versions equally, but I personally prefer to feed him the chicken core wet food because it doesn't smell to me. I hear variety is good so I will continue to buy this product even though it stinks to me, but in the end it all comes down to the cat.

column9: My Fussy Cat Likes this the Best
column10: I was buying Pet Promise for my cat, but the company has stopped making it.  Next was regular Wellness & Pet Guard as well as other top line canned cat foods.  My girl was always fussy with any of these brands.  Even the Pet Promise.  She is still fussy with the Core but eats much more of it than any of the other cat foods.  This makes me very happy knowing that not only does she like this food, but it's so darn good for her too!The price is high for canned cat food, but it is cheaper than buying it in the store (if you can find it!) & you get free shipping!I'm glad I took the risk & bought a case, I (well my cat that is) will be trying the other varieties next!
My cats did not like this food at all. I have 6 cats and they all turned their noses up at it. It seems to have good ingredients but if your cat won't eat it that doesn't really matter does it?

column9: Wellness Core is good ~~ maybe not their best product however
column10: I bought this cat food because my cat had recently been diagnosed as diabetic.  The first, and recommended, action to take when hearing such a diagnosis is to immediately change your cats diet to a wet food only, low carbohydrate diet.  I did my research and found Wellness Core to be a good option because it was grain-free and was composed mainly of protein.  Upon doing more research I discovered that some of the original Wellness canned cat food (non Core) has a lower carbohydrate count, and a slightly higher fat count, than the Wellness Core pictured in this review.  The whole point of changing my cats diet was to lower her carbohydrate intake so as to (hopefully) lower and stabilize her blood sugar.  I (ultimately) spent more money on food that had a higher carbohydrate content.  Beyond that, the food is seemingly of good quality.  My cat liked it however only AT ROOM TEMPERATURE.  Once refrigerated, the food didn't quite seem to capture her attention as much.  My advice:  Wellness Beef and Chicken Formula.  Lower carbs, higher fat, and 1% lower in protein count (big deal) and cheaper.

column9: At First Perfect, Now Won't Eat It
column10: I adopted my beautiful Siamese mix kitty (looks like a snowshoe) in August 2012.  I have never had a cat before and didn't understand how beneficial wet food is to their health.  Because I'm used to dogs, I thought the wet foods were meant to spoil your cat and that they contributed to obesity.  I was so wrong!  Even though I leave it out, she doesn't even touch her dry food anymore, and that's fine with me since Wellness foods are so high quality and balanced.I researched all kinds of foods before settling on Wellness.  Since I have always had dogs, I thought Blue Buffalo was the best brand of pet food available, but I think that's only true for their dog foods. It seems like Wellness foods are more specialized for cats (for the ingredients, taste, and texture).  I can find Wellness in stores in a pinch, but it's best to buy it through Amazon.  It did take a week or so for her digestion to normalize to the high protein levels in the wet food because she was used to eating low-quality food.  Now that she's used to it, though, I notice that she's even more playful and happy!  Everyday I notice how incredibly soft and shiny her fur is compared to when I got her.  She definitely regulates herself and is not gaining weight.  I think the wet food is also wonderful for keeping cats hydrated- I see her drinking less when she eats the wet food, yet she pees normally.I have decided to feed her Wellness Core as her "base food" because it has higher protein than the entrees in gravy, plus I can buy it in bulk for less than I can in stores.  I started mixing in Cubed and Sliced Chicken, Minced Tuna, and Sliced Turkey for variation (she does tend to get sick of the Core if that's all I give her every day, and prefers the food in gravy).  I'm also going to switch between Core Indoor and the Core Chicken/Turkey/Chicken Liver.UPDATE 10/18/12Unfortunately, Lulu will no longer touch this food.  I had to start mixing it with other food to get her to eat any, until eventually she lost weight because she wouldn't touch it even if it was thoroughly mixed in with other food (I always found remains of this in the bottom of her bowl).  I found out she just likes non-pate style foods better.  She still loves other Wellness foods, but they have to be in gravy.

Cat *loves* this flavor above all the others and I've tried most.  I'm not a fan of feeding the same variety over and over and try to mix things up.  I wouldn't call her finicky but there are some flavors she'll turn her nose up and won't eat until she gets really hungry.  Not this chicken liver recipe, though.  It's usually wolfed down and she's looking for more.I like Wellness because they tend to have more meat and protein than other brands.  Personally I think Wellness is worth paying for.  Not really a fan of the added potatoes on the ingredient label because I have yet to see a cat pounce on one for their dinner.  I think this has become the "substitute filler" since people have realized grains aren't healthy for cats.  I doubt potatoes are any better.

We always use wellness core food for our two 13 year old cats after their mother died from diabetes. They are very healthy and playful. This food brand is the best. The cats enjoy the flavor of both the canned and dry food. We won't give them anything else.

column9: Wellness Core is a good product
column10: My cat likes the Wellness Grain-Free canned cat food I switched to Wellness after my 6 year old tabby was diagnosed with diabetes it is a little pricey, but I think he is doing well on this product.

column4: Clarese busy busy "Comfort and Convenience Se...
column10: Two of my three cats wake me each morning to give them their daily serving of this moist cat food. The other one who has serious allergies licks the sauce and buries the remainder. I am pleased that two of my cats like the food and that I am able to control some of their allergies.

I thought I was feeding my cat healthy food, and although he had a hearty appetite and ate a lot, he was not gaining healthy weight.  He was several pounds underweight. I discovered that cats should be fed all protein.  This was news to me.  I bought this product along with Wellness Core dry cat food and have been feeding it to my cat for about 7 months.  My cat gained a few pounds and his eyes look healthier and he is more active

I feed my 12 week old cat a combination of this wet food with the core dry food. My cat eats the dry food but he definitely prefers to eat the wet stuff. I store it in the fridge in my kitchen and now every time I go to get something from the fridge my cat comes running and meowing and begging for some more wet food. Each can I divide into 4 servings and just plop it on top of the dry food each time I wake up, come home, or go to bed, so this pack lasts about 1 month usually. I used to feed my cat Science Diet because I listened to my vet and when he ate that food he had very coarse hair, now that he eats wellness he has a nice silky soft and shiny coat. $40 a month to feed my cat the healthiest canned cat food I can find, seems worth it in my opinion.

I had always been a believer in giving my 9 year old male cat some flavor variety at mealtime. He always seemed to appreciate it too. Not since I gave him this... He wants this food and no other! For 4 months straight he has had nothing but 'Wellness CORE Chicken, Turkey and Chicken Liver Recipe' three times a day... And he devours it today just as lovingly as he did the very first time he tried it... Hey, if he's happy (and healthy) then I am happy. One can of Core's protien centered nutrition per day, along with a hairball supplement twice a week which includes omega oils etc. as well as 'Greenies' treats (which he also loves) ensures me he is getting a complete and nutritious diet, that keeps him happy even... (at both ends lol) If it were only so simple for us humans...

Bent, damaged cans, 3 of which were broken open and had to be discarded; that's 6 dollars in the toilet. I also buy 24 can packages of the cheaper cat food for the ferals, which always arrive in pristine condition. This Wellness is the most expensive cat food available, the packaging should reflect the value of the contents.

column9: good food, but won't buy again
column10: Bought the chicken as an alternative to another canned food, but my cats stool ended up too soft, resulting in messy paws, mud pies.  He had this a few times prior to switching, and he was fine, but I guess he can't have it every day, so I returned the rest of the cans and switched back to the old stuff.  It just didn't settle well with my cat, but I know it is a high quality food, and suggest purchasing a few cans before making a commitment

Several cans in my shipment had small dents that did not affect the quality of the product. However I had to call the company as directed on the side of the can to let them know that I threw out four (4) cans of the shipment that had rotted (the smell was horrible).  Despite advertisement of 100% satisfaction guaranteed, no one has responded to my calls in three days.  I have five cats and buy a lot of the product, well I used to buy a lot.  I'm going back to Evo and/or other quality brands that stand behind their products.

My cat will eat it, but doesn't really want it. She goes crazy for store brands, especially fish. I thought that if I bought healthy fish canned food she would like it, but, not so much. I guess you have to raise the cat on the healthy stuff, but if they're adopted late in life maybe you can't force them to like the healthy stuff.

the food itself is very good, but when I got the package, there were 2 cans broken on the bottom, sauce is out everywhere, the smell is very bad. even there is label - ready to ship.not sure if this is damaged during the shipping or before the shipping...

This Honey has very good taste and texture.The photo shown above is not of actual product. Actual product is somewhat small but thats not really a problem as the mass is 8.8oz as described, and actually the jar is much better than the one shown here.

I order two to six jars of this honey each month. It's one of the better tasting honeys I've found (I think India might have the best honey.) I'm always trying out new honey, but some of them are disappointing and I have to make sure that I have this honey on hand -- it's my backup plan.Soliga forest honey is rich and floral with the perfect amount of sweetness. This honey has a waxy scent that reminds me of when I used to eat gooey pieces of honey comb. I prefer it straight from the jar as I require more than one spoonful to taste it in my tea (which unfortunately makes the jar empty sooner than I'd prefer.)I titled this review 'Almost perfect' because I prefer unfiltered honey. Depending on how you look at it, filtering can be a good or bad thing, especially for anyone looking for something that is smooth and not gritty. You won't be finding any pieces of wax in this. Filtering removes pollen which slows the crystallization process. If you're wondering why your soliga honey hasn't turned solid, then this is probably why.This is one of the most intelligent packaging designs I have seen in terms of honey jars. It is a small, round glass jar with a plastic lid. The lid is BPA free. The lid is made of polypropylene and there is not just one seal between the mouth of the jar and lid, but two seals! I don't have to worry about anything harmful leeching into my honey from the jar or lid.Many companies use aluminum lids that contain a layer on the underside of the lid called a food liner. I believe (but I might be wrong) that the food liner is there to prevent your food from being contaminated with aluminum, or to prevent corrosion from acidity levels. Aluminum is actually harmful to your health but very difficult to avoid. Food liners usually contain BPA. There is very little chance that they won't contain BPA. When a company claims that their food liners are BPA free it doesn't always mean that it is safe. Most food liners are made of 'plastisol' which apparently contains PVC. That's just as bad, if not worse.BPA and PVC in food liners defeats the purpose of organic practices and lifestyles. Always make sure your honey has a BPA (and PVC) free lid or make sure that there is at least a seal between your honey and that lid, or you may as well buy non-organic honey (preferably locally) for a better price.Other organic honey with BPA and PVC free packaging:Certified Organic ManukaReally Raw Honey, 1 X 16 OzWee Bee Naturally Raw Honey -- 1 lb EachHnz Organic Clover Honey, 1.1PoundsJarWholesome Sweeteners Organic Raw Honey, 16ozI recently asked the company if their honey is shipped to the USA in barrels. It is not barreled (yay.)

column9: WORKS! They ALL like it; no force feeding here!!!!
column10: With 7 large Greyhounds of my own plus fostering new Greys from the track all the time, this house has a minimum of 10 Greys in it at all times. I own and foster only special needs Greyhounds (never a shortage of them),  mostly due to broken legs and hocks at the track. I make glucosamine a daily staple in their morning meals (with my Vet's approval of course), regardless of their ages. I've tried countless products, some they liked and some they turned their snouts up in rebellion. Even my 3 older ones who have about 7 teeth total among them like these. (For my toothless wonders, I crush them before adding to their  bowl-break into pieces in my hands then use a small 'smack and chop' chopper on the cutting board and scoop the small pieces into individual bowls). My other 4 who still have most of their teeth wait for me at the top of the cellar stairs while I'm filling their bowls and placing one of these peanut butter biscuits on the top of each. While 1-2 try to distract me as I'm hauling all these bowls up the stairs, the others bob and weave in attempts to steal the treats out of the bowls as I near the top of the steps. Have to admit defeat on occasion when I'm not paying attention :(In any event, haven't met a Greyhound yet who does not love these. Not only that, I have seen remarkable improvement in agility, desire to play and romp, renewed interest in toys, consistent improvement in ease in pouncing on the beds, serious athleticism in swiping the tomatoes from my topsy turvys in the yard, even stealing a 3 lb pumpkin off the back step to munch on behind the tree in the back yard. The younger ones have resumed 'running laps' around the yard while the older ones (2 are 11, 9, 8, 5 and 2 are 4) seem younger and instigate play more often than before. They are energetic, not as stiff after a nap or nighttime, want to do more, play more, walk more/further and, while it may be my imagination, the older ones seem to be eating better. (They had gotten to a point where sometimes they would eat, sometimes not, sometimes just nibble a few bites and walk away).All in all, they like this product and I am thrilled already with the positive changes I see in my 'kids' who are always with me and the fosters who arrive in rough shape but leave for happy, responsible homes upon adoption. I dislike pumping meds into any pet when something else will help. I'm sticking with this product. It works for me and mine. I wouldn't purchase 7-10 6 lb bags of this product at a time if my pups weren't exhibiting such remarkable improvements. Their quality of life has definitely improved. Packaging says to allow 4-6 weeks for best results but it took less than 3 weeks for me to begin seeing significant changes in all of my guys and gals. Can't wait to see what 6+ weeks of using this product will produce!Each ALL NATURAL biscuit contains 500 mg glucosamine and is a substantial 'treat'. Biscuits are approx. 3-4" long and perhaps .75" high and quite crunchy to promote strong teeth and healthy gums. They are a bit difficult to break other than in halves. After that initial break, they are too tough to break into smaller chunks, thus the need for my abovementioned 'chopper'. Each bag purchased to date has arrived in excellent condition. Out of 14 6-lb bags to date (2 separate orders), only 2 biscuits were broken in half; nothing was crushed or broken into small chunks. Very little residue at bottom of resealable bags. Unfortunately, I did count the biscuits in the first 2 (original order) bags to determine whether or not I would stick with this product pricewise, but I've forgotten now what that count was so I cannot share that at this time. And because I'm back to order more, if I remember, I'll update this review when I count them again. Directions for use: 1/2 wafer/biscuit per 40 lbs body weight twice daily.PLEASE NOTE: Some (not all) of the statements on the reverse of package - thought I'd share before you buy:- Administer during or after the animal has eaten to reduce potential incidence of gastrointestinal upset.- An exam from a vet is recommended prior to using this product.- Keep out of reach of children. In case of accidental overdose, contact a health professional immediately.- Safe use in pregnant animals or animals intended for breeding is not recommended.- Consult with your vet before using this product in animals with clotting disorders, being treated with anticoagulant medications, diabetes, or any metabolic disorder causing hyperglycemia, history of urinary tract stones, and known allergies to shellfish.
