The chocolate is slightly better in that it tastes a bit more authentic than this stuff, but it has the same artificial sweetener aftertaste and odd texture.  I won't be trying any more Walden Farms products--I'd rather buy a low-calorie product that I actually enjoy than a no-calorie product that sucks.

I have been purchasing this calorie free Caramel Dip directly from Walden Farms for almost a year now - it is a great way to feel like you're cheating without all the sugar & calories!I prefer to heat it in the microwave and then use it as a dip for apples.Every time I eat it, I am truly amazed that they can make something taste so good without all the calories, sugar & fat!!!  There is sodium in this caramel, so if you need to watch your sodium intake, check the nutritional facts at the Walden Farms site to make sure it isn't too high in sodium for you.If you are dieting, or need to watch your sugar intake (but still crave sugary tasting foods), I would highly recommend Walden Farms Caramel!

i opened my jar of caramel dip without the highest expectations, and i pretty much got what i expected. this dip can be good when put on something else (bread, in a protein shake, etc.), but on it's own it tastes too chemical to enjoy. it's definitely not the best, but for 0 calories it's pretty darn good. i like the chocolate dip more though.

column9: I literally almost threw up when I tasted it!
column10: I want to make clear that this is the first time I have ever bothered to write a review for a product on Amazon, and I have saved this review for such a disaster.Since this is an extreme diet product, I was expecting it to not taste good, but in the least, I was expecting the flavor to at least remind me of what it was trying to resemble.I took a fingerful from the lid, put it in my mouth, and felt my eyes suddenly straining to focus on objects around me to escape the reality I was in. IT WAS AWFUL! I really thought I was going to throw up, and I was at work! Ack!Walden farms does make a decent blueberry fruit spread, and the chocolate sauce is so-so. This one should have never left the factory. I prefer adding a few calories to my gut with a lower calorie option than to ever eat this product again. Chemicals galore! Yuck!If part of your tongue got blown off in some bizarre accident, this product is for you, otherwise only buy it to prank your friends.
I was shocked when I got this! It was really, really good! Granted, it doesn't taste like caramel, but EXACTLY like butterscotch. And I loooove butterscotch!

This stuff is nasty. The texture is like a mix of jello and pudding and the taste as others have said is chemical.  The taste resembles nothing like caramel, it's got no "food" taste to it at all. I have found that walden farms products are all very synthetic tasting...waste of money.
I would give this item a zero if I could.  It tastes so bad!  I don't care that it has zero calories, it's not worth it!  Buyer beware!

This IS the sweetest of the Walden Farms products I have tried so far, which is only 3 so far. It has a wonderful brown sugar smell when you open the jar. The consistency is.... different. The best way I can describe it would be marshmallow fluff (without the stickiness)  that has been aerated. It is not the sticky gooey caramel that I am used to so it can take a little getting used to. Now the taste isn't exactly straight caramel flavor to me. I would make it out to be a more molasses flavor but it is still very good. My wife, who loves caramel on her apples said that she could eat this on her apples and be completely satisfied. I don't think you can get better praise then that.

column9: Really Good, Totally Free Caramel Dip
column10: Honestly, I didn't think I was going to enjoy this product but I'm on a very restrictive diet for health reasons so I bought one jar. You know, hopefully it would satisfy a sweet craving if (more like when) one comes on.I tried this with a cut up gala apple. Simply dipped the apple slices in a little and I was totally impressed. Granted it is not exactly like the full bore caramel you'd find at Halloween but come on now. To be able to have something that tastes this good without the guilt?! I'm sold!I honestly and truly recommend this product. I've only tried it on apples yet but I think anything you can use caramel for you could use this for too. I'll find out because this is something I would keep in my pantry even after I'm better enough to come off this horribly restrictive diet. This is THAT good! And I'm a foodie. I love food, I love experiencing different cultures and different tastes. Keep an open mind and try it. You might well be as impressed as I was by this.

I have used this dip in a number of different ways, and each was wonderful.  Mixed with softened cream cheese, I used some as frosting on a low-carb cake and the rest in small spoonfulls refrigerated to make luscious caramel candy.  I have also used it as a simple dip for strawberries, and on top of an egg-custard to make it taste like flan.  It is incredible that anything can taste so good and be not only carbohydrate free, but calorie free!  I love this product and will be ordering more very soon.
ill admit has a slight after taste but definitely worth it. The zero calories more than makes up for anything negative about this product. Love Walden farms.

This stuff is potent!  Seriously, I could dot my tongue on the surface and taste a mouthful.  This caramel dip is so sweet, it's like saccharine.  It's so saccharine, a diabetic would pass on it.  And it really doesn't taste too much like caramel.  I mean, vaguely, it does, but that's if you haven't had caramel in A REALLY long time.  As with most WF products, don't look to this as a replacement; look at it as an alternative.  I have a feeling this jar will be in my fridge a looong time, which could be good or bad.

I have loved Walden Farms products for many years.  This is one of my favorites!  I love to sit down with a bowl of apple slices and this dip.  So yummy!  I also love all the jams, the chocolate sauce (fantastic in fage yogurt), the pancake syrups are absolutely fabulous, and the honey dijon salad dressing.

Based on the one comment I bought this dip, and now I wish I hadn't.  I thought it would be a great dip for apples.  Unfortunately, the dip has an odd foamy texture and a terrible chemical sweet taste that is definitely not worth it.  It is not worth any stars at all.

I use this caramel for an unusual purpose: as a topping for a low-carb cheesecake with a hazelnut crust.I have served this cheesecake to many, many people, and it goes over like gangbusters. No one even guesses that the cake and the topping are virtually carbohydrate-free. They just love it!I'm back here, today, ordering again. I ran out and went to the local grocery where I purchased "regular" caramel, which I found to be too sweet, competing with the taste of the cheesecake itself.Now I'll makesure I always have some on hand.

I just had some apple slices and dipped into it for thefirst time.  I cannot tell this product from the real thing.  I just purchased two jars of it, and will continue to do so.  It is terrific for those of us who watch our caloric intake and wish to remain thin and healthy.
Of the four Walden Farms products I tried, this was the best, but it was still terrible. I threw it away.
This stuff had a bitter-tasting chemical flavor, and this was just picking up a tiny dot on my fingertip.

column9: This picture is wrong - this is not the product for sale
column10: I ordered this product a few weeks ago, believing it to be the six-star, aged sweet vinegar as clearly pictured in this listing.  What I received was the "regular" Colavita less-aged, no-star vinegar, which is an ok product, but not as good as the six star sweet product.  When I contacted the seller, they claim that Colavita does not make the six-star product anymore, which might be true, but they certainly should have changed this picture then.  I'm still trying to negotiate my return and refund.

column9: What you see isn't what you get
column10: I love Colavita's Aged Sweet Balsamic Vinegar.  I ordered this and was so disappointed to find that although the box was for the sweet aged vinegar, what was inside was their plain vinegar that is not aged and is definitely not sweet.  I've had both and I know the difference.  They do still sell it, but the bottle is smaller and different than this one.  So beware when purchasing this item from anyone, and especially I know of this place.  This is false advertising and I can't believe after all the hastles I went through to be able to send it back and get a refund they are still showing this as the vinegar they are selling.  How do you make a company stop falsely advertising a product and sending you something different?  I'll never do business with them again.  Had they unknowingly sold me the wrong product and been quick to resolve it, I would have a different attitude, but then to find they even still advertise this, makes me very angry.  I am trying a different vender now through amazon and hope they are selling the correct product.
This is our favorite coffee and it is at a decent price too, it comes in a big brown box and the K-cups are loose in the box but I put them in a plastic container I have so it is fine with me.

I have tried all the Via blends, and my favorite by far is still Starbucks Tribute.  It was so sad when they ran out last year.  My back-up is the Columbian, always good, but I have always loved Sumatra.  The cherry is a note, and does not come across as a 'flavor'.  I do not like flavored coffee.  I heat this in the microwave for two minutes in a mug of 1% organic milk.  Yummy!Starbucks writes:  . . . "Spicy & Cherry" and "With beans from all three of the world's coffee-growing regions . . . Aged Sumatra, sun-dried beans from Ethiopia, and coffees from Papua New Guinea and Colombia come together to create this spicy and full-bodied blend with dark cherry notes."

I like the VIA Colombia instant coffee. It's medium but still a little dark for me, so I make two cups of coffee with one pack... :)Very good deal from Amazon compare to the price in store.I'll but this product again.

I've learned that I can cutopen the top of the packet, pinch it to divide the micro-ground coffee in half, and it makes a nice cup of coffee! Be sure to know how many ounces your cup is, or, you may be making very strong coffee. Try experimenting a bit to s t r e t c h the individual packet servings. :)

column9: IF YOU LIKE REALLY ORDINARY COFFEE...
column10: My husband and I agree that this brew is really ordinary. If you don't like espresso, or strong coffee, this blend if for you! It reminds me of the coffee I used to drink before finding Lavazza, an Italian coffee we've drunk since 2007 when we came home from France with memories of that divine espresso. Now, we've gotten lazy and enjoy the Starbucks VIA italian roast instant coffee--the key to our appreciation being the strong but NOT BITTER flavor.

These do not ATTRACT flying insects. When used near a light source or an area when flying insects are buzzing around, they work great. I have an issue in my area with those TINY no-see-ems that get right through regular windows screens. They buzz around my computer monitors and are generally a PITA. I hang these traps right under my desklamp and under my ceiling light.  The little buggers fly into or land on them. Problem solved!

We have a terrible problem with flies buzzing around, but this fly trap did not catch one fly!  We have two set up near the doors, where the flies are and after a week - not one fly has been caught. After reading the other reviews, I will try to put them near a light to see if that helps.

I used these, hanging them very close to my swarm of flies, for about two weeks. The swarm of flies seemed to like about two feet off the ground above a Persian rug. I had about 10 flies. In two weeks, these TWO traps collected one fly, while the other ~9 just swarmed around and refused to leave or die.The flies popping into my house lately are different from the buzzing house fly I grew up with. The bzzzzzz house fly I can swat pretty easily. These new flies are silent and fast moving and not interested in ever landing on something. They are also long-lived.I tried schmalyn's recommendation and moved them around, even left on one the floor where they were swarming. Still no luck.I do not rec these traps.Afterward I got the SUPER sticky strips that you unroll. My flies were too smart for that stuff too, but if I waved them around I could catch flies in the air with the extreme stickiness that doesn't exist on these Victor traps.

column9: have to figure out where to put it
column10: These didn't work for me for a few days until I figured out the secret: you have to put them RIGHT where the flies go. (You also have to ignore the sad little buzzing sounds when the flies are dying...) In my case, I moved the trap around during the day depending on where the light was. Sunny kitchen? stood it on the countertop. Overnight? put it right next to a light that was attracting the flies. Once I did this, after days of no flies on the traps, I woke up to discover 14 flies stuck the next morning.  Flies were eradicated completely. I'm ordering these again the next time I have a problem.

I chose these fly traps because they are poison free and look much nicer than the fly strips, a la gas stations and such.They work well, but actually not as  well as just mentioned ugly fly strips, so your choice.  easy to use, easier than fly strips...just hang them up.  rough way to go, but the flies are just too much.

column9: Do Not Waste Money or Time
column10: What a joke of a product! Been up for a week, in well lit area right at back door where the flies swarm in. One would think by now a fly would of accidentally landed on it. But none. We have swatted at least 50 in that time span all around rear slider. It appears this repels flies rather than attracts. Luckily it is not too expensive or I'd really be upset. Go with ANY other product, or trust me, the flies in your home will be safe to drive you nuts!

column9: Works Great on gnats around small animal cages
column10: We always have a box or 2 of these fly traps around for use around the guinea pig cage. I place them on top of the cage to attract the gnats we deal with seasonally. It seems like something about the color really attracts them, as the traps become quite full. When I tried the same shape traps without the color, the effect was much less. As a sticky side becomes full, I turn the four sided trap over to expose the next clean side. The gnats come from outside and are attracted to the guinea pig's litter and hay. To keep the gnats from taking over I keep the cage as clean as possible to prevent eggs from hatching and keep the traps on top of the cage. They have been a wonderful tool for our household.

column9: My flies aren't the least bit interested...
column10: They're sticky, all right, but the "patent-pending three dimensional patterns and colors" must be designed for more sophisticated flies than we have around here.  They are prettier than disgusting curly fly paper, though.The only trap I have found effective is the Victor "Fly Magnet" series, which use powdered bait you mix with water.  They really work - but are far too foul-smelling to use indoors.
I have lots of flies in my house.  I set up the two traps.  They have been up for three days and have caught a total of four flies.  I will stick with fly tape.

column9: Great for sticking on your dog's tail but for little else!
column10: We caught one fly for the cost and time of hanging the trap.  I think it just got tired and picked the wrong place to rest.  The strips on the trip "traps" your purse strings and nothing else - save your money!P.S.  I just tossed the 2nd trap from the pack into the trash unused.
dont waste your money. this is a piece of junk. I could have saved myself the $9 and just have drawn a picture of a fly on a post it note. Tons of flies where it is hanging but none on the trap!!!

I had mine setting in my den and my kitchen, the two places flies like to annoy me.  They've been set up for a week now and not one fly did they catch.  I would imagine that in a place where you have hundreds of flies flying around one would land on it sooner or later.  But when you only get up to 5 flies at any one time the trap holds no appeal to the fly at all.  And the topper is they paint dead flies already on the trap making it look even uglier.  What was the plan there?  The fly was to say to himself, "Hey a dead fly.  I think I'll go land there to see what he died of."
Excellent and cost effective way to get rid of mosquitos. I keep the traps outside under a covered awning and let it do its magic. The backyard area is enjoyable once more.
This thing was hanging on the window for 2 days, managed to catch only 1 tiny fruit fly...I'd save your money, these fly catchers don't work at all. Just clean your house!

column9: Black tea is good, has no taste of ginger flavor
column10: I'm going to include a picture of the tea leaves I just brewed so you can get a glimpse of the large cut leaves of this black tea from China.  Because I bought it at a greatly reduced price, I'm not too upset that I taste no ginger whatsoever in the brew.  There was no aroma either when the perfectly sealed canister was opened, revealing the bagged tea inside.  The bag was not sealed, but folded over, and the leaves looked very black.  Because this is called, Roland Ginger Tea/Canisters, 2.5000-Ounce (Pack of 8), and it does not expose any ginger essence at all, I can only rate it at 2 stars for being a black tea (as described on package and Amazon) which was perfectly presented and at a great price for black tea from Hong Kong in little mauve metal canisters with cute images of ginger and a pretty decoration.  I cannot recommend this as a ginger tea and will move forward with presenting these canisters as part of assembled gift baskets with Melitta Tea Filters, 40-Count (Pack of 6) and [[ASIN:B001GCVLVI, Walkers Shortbread Assorted, 8.8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)]], Tea Bag Buddy, White and more.  The cute little canisters are attractive and can be used after the tea is exhausted.  I may also include Ting Ting Jehe Chewy Ginger Candy Value 10 Packs - 10x5.25 Oz so the lack of ginger in the tea won't be sorely missed.

These Confetti Ice Cream Cups are a favorite at my house. The ice cream is smooth and rich, and the confetti sprinkles make this treat more appealing to young children than plain vanilla ice cream. My only negative comment is that these Confetti Cups disappear too quickly at my house to warrant buying them very often at their price.

I bought this product from a local outlet several times and have always enjoyed it quite a bit. I usually brew 4-6 times in a row using my 16 ounce infuser and the same 2-4 teaspoons of tea. The price seems a little more worthwhile when considering this. The tea itself has a flavor that I would call smooth and green, a little strong but not bitter at all. I can only compare this to other Teavana loose leaf teas and various brands of bagged teas (Stash, Yogi, Lipton, and others), but gyokuru imperial is an all time favorite. I also like that despite giving a strong caffiene boost to my day it never has given me the jagged feeling or lift and drop that I have come to expect from coffie and strong black teas. It is a short steep tea made for 40 seconds to 1 minute per serving which I like as I am a little impatient with preparing tea. If you have a tea store nearby, do yourself a favor and ask to smell this, it will taste much the same when finished.

column9: A very nice mild green tea
column10: I love Japanese green tea and had read that gyokuro is the finest variety, so I decided to splurge on this tea. The tea is very nice, but not worth the price (in my opinion) compared to other sencha teas at a quarter of the price. I prefer a tea that brews bright green with a distinct grassy taste. This tea (using 1.5 teaspoons with 8 oz. of 175°F water and brewing for for 3 minutes) brewed tea with a faint green hue and a delicate, mild flavor. The flavor was fresh and sweet but not as bold as I had hoped. As one would expect, a second infusion (brewed for 4 minutes) was even weaker and only beneficial if one is being frugal (or wants to avoid the caffeine that is mostly extracted in the first infusion).

I have tried a number of gyokuros and this one is way to overpriced for what you get. H&S has good gyokuro as do others here in Japan that sell directly from their farms.Did I mention how horrible Teavana's customer service is? They don't respond to emails,etc. You have to wait on the phone for hours. Simply unacceptable. Feel free to check their facebook wall to see customers voicing the same concern. The company simply does not seem to appreciate its customers and apparently many people feel the same way. I will no longer buy from them due to their poor service and overpriced products.

I love the packaging these peanuts are in, and they are perfectly good peanuts if you are looking for a can of peanuts- but there isn't really a strong cheddar flavor to them. I was hoping for a big flavor profile with some spice, but unfortunately these did not deliver.

column4: J. Hanna "There is nothing more enjoyable tha...
column10: Love the fun packaging and the name Lord Nut Levington.  These nuts have a unique flavor, and would be fun for a party.  I love spicy stuff, but I did not find these spicy at all even thought they had a bit of jalapeno in them.

Somewhere along the line I switched from ground coffee in a can to whole bean coffee that you grind yourself. There was no turning back. From that time on the only question was what kind of whole bean coffee. I've tried dozens. Finally, I settled in on Trader Joe's Columbian Supremo. It was excellent! However, I found myself running out with no trip to Trader Joe's in the near future. So, I picked up a bag of Starbucks French Roast while visiting my local discount store. Starbucks was excellent, wasn't it? I've always thought so in their shops.This Starbucks French Roast Coffee is quite good. I might prefer a slightly less robust roast, but that's just a personal preference. What I notice about it more than anything else is that when I have guests over and serve coffee, I always get compliments and they want to know what kind of coffee I'm serving. I guess the wonderful aroma and the robust good taste just overcomes them. Well, that's worth something, isn't it? Personally, I might go back to another purchase of the Trader Joe's Columbian, but this is quite an excellent coffee, without question.Gary Peterson
If you like Starbucks Bold coffees, this fits the bill. I couldn't find it any cheaper elsewhere. Unlike some of their coffees, this tastes just as good as the coffee you get from their stores.
My only complaint is that the package did not have ties on each end to close the package
I get this at costco for a lower price. I drink this coffee everyday and I love it. It is very strong and flavorful. If you do not like a strong coffee though look elsewhere.
The picture shows two bags of coffee, but you only get one. A horrible value! Misrepresentation marketing.  Beware!

This is honestly the best tasting cereal out there.  It's plenty chocolately, which also means it's quite sugary, but surprisingly, its sugar content is 8g per serving, which is less than a lot of cereals (specifically, the sugary kids' cereals).  Depending on how you feel about sugar, I wouldn't count on it being a "healthy" breakfast food, but it sure makes a tasty one.  It's also an excellent snack.  I hate to admit it, but I can eat (and have eaten) a whole box of these in a single day - by myself.Regarding the gluten free issue - all the boxes I've received (and have purchased in local stores) say on them that they are gluten free.  I believe that the other reviewers are taking issue with the ingredients list posted on this product description page, as opposed to an ingredients list directly from the box.  This is, therefore, not an issue with the Chex, but with Amazon's description.  The ingredients list is posted online by General Mills here: [...]

column9: Chex (Except for Wheat) are GLUTEN FREE
column10: Chocolate Chex are GF.  All Chex are GF.  They are produced in a completely gluten-free facility.  I got VERY sick from some recently (I have celiac disease), but it was because I got so giddy in the store when I saw that Chex were gluten-free, that I forgot to check each box I bought.  I bought one box that said "gluten-free" and one that didn't.  I got extremely sick from the one that didn't say it...because it wasn't gluten-free.  There are still boxes from when Chex weren't GF on the shelves. Also, the "malt" flavoring in the ingredients is not from barley.  Check your sources before you post that online.  :)  It's rice malt which is very different, and very gluten-less.I LOVE CHOCOLATE CHEX!  They are absolutely delicious, with the perfect amount of chocolate.  They make the milk delicious, too.  I don't like them for breakfast, but I LOVE them in the afternoon.

Chex has recently gone through a confusing period-- especially if you are CILIAC.  My local grocer carried Chocolate Chex, which originally were CORN or CORN and RICE in composition.  Then some pencil-pushing office nerd decided that no, we should change the recipe to ALL RICE. The rice-only product leaves me feeling bloated.  So I went to Amazon, read the product description very carefully, saw that it was the corn/rice blend,and ordered a crate.  I was not happy to find that the product they shipped to me was ALL RICE.

column9: GLUTEN FREE OR NOT GLUTEN FREE, THAT IS THE QUESTION.
column10: The box clearly states gluten free, but in the ingredients list, barley malt extract is listed which is a gluten ingredient.  So which one is it?  A dangerous risk for many especially those who have enjoyed Rice Chex and might believe the front cover of the chocolate variety...

column9: Lists Malt -- That's NOT Gluten Free
column10: This comes up on Amazon as being Gluten Free, but as a mom of a son with celiac, I always read the ingredients. This description has malt in the ingredients, and malt is made with barley, which has gluten. These may be wheat free, but not gluten free if the ingredients list is correct. Maybe ingredients changed, but I would not suggest this to anyone on a gluten free diet.

Great flavor!  Hope they bring back the Strawberry Chex.  They made a great breakfast pair.  I like that they mixed flavored with regular Chex.  Cuts down on the sugar without cutting down on the flavor.

This was a great deal with free shipping and $10 off. My children thought it was great Mom let them have chocolate for breakfast! I knew they were getting whole grains and lots of nutrition to start their day off right.

There are two different types of Chocolate Chex cereal. The pictures on the front of each one is different.  There is this picture and the other one has woman raising a bowl in the air.  Even though this box of Chex Chocolate cereal indicates it is the same as the other box, the recipes for each one.  For instance, this Chocolate Chex uses molasses and the other one uses brown sugar.  There are a couple of other ingredients that are different, but I don't remember what they are.  The appearance and taste of the two cereals are different.  I DO NOT LIKE THE CEREAL WITH MOLASSES IN IT.  I LOVE the cereal with brown sugar.So this is a cautionary tale that just because the boxes say they contain the same cereal, make sure to compare ingredients to be sure.
I love Chocolate Chex!  But, rather than eat it for breakfast, I eat it dry as a snack.  It satisfies chocolate cravings for less calories than a chocolate bar.

column9: Somehow different than the Chocolate Chex that was sold in the grocery store...
column10: I was so excited to find this available online.  This was my favorite cereal and they quit selling it in all the local stores here.  This is somehow not the same cereal.  Tastes different, squares are smaller not near as good as the one I am used to buying.  I went from so excited to so sad...

column9: Put it back on Subscribe and Save!!!!
column10: We are addicted to this cereal in my house and not one local store carries it. Enter Amazon.com.My only criticism is that Amazon has inexplicably removed this cereal from its Subscribe and Save program. Booo! Hissss!Now instead of roughly paying roughly $3 a box (delivered) we're paying upwards of $6 a box!

I love this cereal.  Unfortunately, Amazon does a disservice to the GF community by having a factually inaccurate ingredients list. All Chex, except for Wheat and Multi-Bran, are certified GF and DO NOT have barley malt.  The flavor of this cereal is really good - not too sweet, and just chocolately enough.  It does get a little soggy after awhile, so if you're a slow eater with a texture issue you may not love this cereal.  But it's definitely a great, inexpensive option for those of us who've been paying so much per cereal box that cereal became a treat instead of a staple!
These are very good. My family likes to mix in a bit of the Cinnamon Chex and pour vanilla almond milk over it. Its like a dessert!
I'd love to be able to eat this, but barley malt extract contains gluten!  This is not safe for true celiacs.

I loved this 'gluten-free' cereal.  I was pretty disappointed up to now with the taste of gluten-free products until I tasted this cereal. I love it as a snack or for breakfast with sliced bananas...there is hope!

column9: Chocolate Chex are my family's favorite cereal!
column10: I have Celiac disease and am thrilled that General Mills has started labeling so many of their products that are gluten free. The Chocolate Chex were originally a purchase I made for myself because of the gluten free status but my entire family (who don't have Celiac) loves them! I have to buy 3 or 4 boxes at a time and hide 2 for myself!

column9: Great Cereal! No Barley Malt in the Gluten Free Version
column10: Great deal on this cereal. I am getting it auto shipped as my family loves this cereal. I saw a review of this cereal about it not being gluten free as it contains barley malt.... well I actually have this product and I checked the ingredients and it DOES NOT CONTAIN barley malt. I think Amazon is listing the ingredients for the non-gluten free cereal.
My three year old son calls these "The most delicious cereal ever."  We just love chocolate chex.

Two thumbs up for Chocolate Chex!  Especially since they now make it gluten free.  The price was right and less expensive than my local store and when combined with other orders the shipping was free.

column9: Great as a snack and cereal
column10: Chocolate Chex is great, not only as a cereal, but as a snack. It's a great non spicy substitute for the Chex Mix that we all have enjoyed at arties and get togethers. However the management of my neighborhood grocery store tell me that it's no longer available. I'd like to know why the distributors have chosen to confine this product to web distribution status. That's the big problem - the distributors are deciding what they want us to eat, instead of simply supplying us with what we want. Let's get it back on the shelves.
i have a hard time finding good foods, i'm gluten and lactose intolerant as well as vegetarian, and i love this product! it's great with almond milk and very very addictive. will buy plenty more!
[...] is a great product! 17 fruits and veggies!  CAPSULE FORM, GUMMIES for kids!  And a tasty POWER MIX to make SMOOTHIES!

When my local grocery stores stopes carrying Chocolate Chex, I turned to Amazon to find my favorite cereal treat. It's just the right combo of chocolately sweetness mixed with good old Rice Chex...perfect for an adult sweet tooth!

My sister has celiac and we couldn't find gluten-free cereals in Turkey. While I'm in US I wanted to send a gift to my sister in Turkey and I bought this. Perfect, it took 20 days to arrive, still in perfect condition, my sister is happy. Thank you!

I would love this cereal even if I didn't have to eat gluten free.  It's delicious, with just the right amount of chocolate flavor for a cereal.  I get it through Subscribe & Save because I never want to run out!

column9: An answered prayer for Autisic Kids!
column10: My son has autism so as a family we are on the Gluten-free diet and trying to find GF foods that taste good is hard!  So happy that Chex is gluten free and that they are expanding there product.  A great buy for moms who seek to help their kids thru this GF journey.

Tastes great - but the only gluten free product that my son thinks makes him feel sick. Don't get it! He eats chocolate rice cakes, milk with some other products.... We'll try again when he's up to it.

column9: Who doesn't love chocolate?! Even by the handful as a late snack!
column10: We typically steer clear of sweetened cereal. Chocolate Chex is one of the few that we can eat and not feel (too) guilty about! Very filling and yummy, these can be eaten even by the handful for a quick pick-me-up! Even the kids will ask for a small handful in place of a snack. Hopefully Amazon can continue to keep these cheaper than the store!

column9: Truly a fabulous cereal for Gluten Sensitive Folks
column10: This was my first order with Amazon for Gluten Free Chocolate Chex Cereal, and I am very, very happy. The cereal is very good. Until I found it on Amazon.com, my cereal choices consisted of Cocoa Pebbles and Trix, as they are both Gluten free. There were times I would go to Walmart for Cocoa Pebbles, and the entire shelf was bare.My store does carry the Honey Nut Chex, and they cost more than if I order them through Subscribe and Save. The cereal is so good, you can eat it with milk, or dry as a snack. I'm truly excited and pleased with this cereal, and the experience with Amazon. Thank you so very much!
This my families favorite cereal. We couldn't find it at the stores anymore. So when I found this on amazon I couldn't buy it fast enough
Excellent product at a great price. Not available at my local grocery store. I have 3 children with Celiac Disease, so this is a wonderful breakfast option for them.
My local grocery store has all the other varieties of Chex but this one and I love the chocolate in the morning.
I thought we would give it a try.  It was a good deal, but the fake chocolate has a bitter taste.  We prefer the regular Rice Chex.

These are so yummy!  My 8 year old son has gluten allergies and he loves these.  Everyone in my house loves them and we have o gluten issues.  They taste just like regular cereal, cant say enough about them!!

This is a great cereal.  Whether for a snack dry or with milk as a meal.  Kids love the flavor as do I.  This cereal is much more expensive at our local grocery store and only one store carries it in our town.  The other three grocery stores do not carry the chocolate version.  I am hooked!

Everyone who is gluten intolerant should look this up on the Chex website.  It's reformulated & gluten free.  Ingredients are:Whole Grain Rice, Rice, Sugar, Fructose, Canola Oil, Cocoa, Salt, Artificial Flavor, Molasses, Nonfat Milk, Vit E, and BHT to preserve freshness.For those who are newly diagnosed Celiac and might have food sensitivities like corn & dairy/casein, you will want to stick with just the regular Rice Chex & spark it up a bit with fruit like bananas.  I can't tolerate the Chocolate Chex but my daughter can, as her system isn't as damaged prior to being diagnosed.These taste good, as do the Cinnamon Chex & Honey Nut Chex.  But we can't tolerate corn so we don't buy the Honey Nut.  The Cinnamon Chex are pure rice too.Hope that helps
This cereal is the best cereal around.  Has great flavor and my whole family loves it.  Wish i could find it on my store.

column9: A great hard to find cereal offline
column10: It's very difficult to find good gluten-free options in our local stores, so we're very pleased to be able to pick up a case of the Chocolate Chex cereal at Amazon.  I don't think I've ever seen the chocolate version of Chex locally, and because it can get a bit boring just eatig the regular Chex, the Chocolate Chex have become a big favorite!  If you don't like Chex, you probably won't like the Chocolate Chex version either, but for Celiacs, it's a fantastic option.

the packaging was terrible and all the cereal was crushed into crumbs.  I mean, it still tastes good, but didn't hold up to the shipping.  I WILL buy them again because there aren't any stores around us that sell gluten free chocolate chex and we need GF food, and LOVE the choco chex.

This cereal is absolutely delicious. My 7 year old has Celiac's, so we decided to try this cereal. To my delight, it is a favorite by all my children and especially by my daughter who has to eat gluten free.  I would highly recommend this!

First off, I should say that I didn't read the ingredient list on this product as carefully as I should have.  As anyone with food allergies, I'm ultimately responsible for carefully reading all labels.  The peanut flour was clearly marked in the ingredients list.  I just wasn't careful enough.  My main food allergy is wheat, so I am always on the look-out for gluten-free products.  However, I'm also allergic to peanuts, though not deathly so.  This product includes peanut flour, which was a little unexpected in my opinion for a chocolate cereal that doesn't include peanut or peanut butter in the title.That said, the cereal is okay.  I was hoping it might be something like Special K chocolate, which was an occasional treat before I developed a wheat allergy.  Unfortunately, it was nothing like that.  There's a chocolate-like dust applied to standard rice chex.  It's artificial and it colors your milk like milk chocolate, more like sugary kid cereals.  I didn't think it was disgusting, just not my taste.
YUM-O! Tasty and chocolaty. Tastes soooo good with both milk and a spoon! Complements my Japanese Floor Lamp and 3 Wolves Howling at the Moon t-shirt collection. Thanks Chex!
So happy I could order these - cannot find in the stores anywhere near me! Arrived on time and in great condition :)

We love this cereal!  It is great for the Chocolate chex mix and basically thats what we use it for!  The only draw back is that I had to order from Amazon because none of the stores we have in town carry it anymore.  I'm not sure if this will be a seasonal thing or what but the Chex website needs to up date there "Where you can find our products" section.
best cereal ever, but no supermarkets by me carry it :(  luckily, i can easily eat 6 boxes in a month
This cereal is great even for snacking on. I shop often for gluten free products and the Chex cereal is one of them.  I love the taste.
this is great I love it i was very sad that the stores don't care them any more .But thanks too amazon i can enjoy again.Anna

column9: Choco-imitation, but what do you expect?
column10: General Mills has been experimenting with choco-imitation cereals for years now.  While the flavor is not bad by any means, it is not really chocolate.  The texture is very good, but the flavor should be more authentic, so I give it 4 stars.

column9: I was lucky I could buy this at Amazon!
column10: I have been looking for this product at the store and could not find it anywhere else. Thanks Amazon!

I wanted a cereal that was tasty, not too sugary, and could also be eaten as an afternoon snack. I think this cereal fits the bill on all 3 fronts! It's got a bit of chocolate in it, but that's mostly just from cocoa powder, so it's not too sweet. The carbs aren't too high and it has some fiber too, so that's good. I like the conveneince of buying 6 boxes at a time, I take some to work, and some for home. It's a win-win!

I bought my first box in the store when I saw it was gluten free.  I loved it, but, oh so expensive (and there really isn't that much cereal in there, considering the size of the box).  Still, it was SO good, I wanted MORE!  I was happy to find it on Amazon AND on the subscribe and save program.  This cereal is great with milk, but, it is also delicious dry as a snack or part of a packed lunch.  A great "healthy" way to eat chocolate.  As for the folks who complained because it is no longer corn and rice...well, some Celiacs and gluten intolerant folks are also allergic to the proteiChex Mix Chocolate Cereal, 14.25-Ounce Box (Pack of 6)n in corn and cannot have anything with corn in it, either.  (I can't use cornstarch in anything I bake for one of my friends).  So, overall, taking out the corn makes this cereal safe for consumption for a larger number of food sensitive folks!

Once again Amazon.com has came through in a big way! We were very disappointed when our local grocers stopped carrying Chocolate Chex cereal. Amazon has been there for us for many years, and we will fathfully continue to shop there for anything, and everything.Thank you so much,Nadine R
This cereal is great. Too sweet for basic breakfast food for me but make s fair snack. And the kids love it.

I absolutely LOVE this cereal!  It tastes great and doesn't get soggy.  I have it in a bowl with milk or just take it as a snack in a baggie to munch on dry.  Best of all, it's GLUTEN-FREE!  I am so thankful for gluten-free Chex cereal!  It's life-changing for me as a Celiac patient!  :)

And being a chocolate lover, when they also made Chocolate Chex gluten-free, I could not wait to try it.  It was quite a disappointment.  To me at least, the chocolate flavor seemed to be just that - flavor - not what actually tastes like real chocolate.  It's not awful, and I won't have a problem eating the whole case of 6 boxes, but it'll be just a bit at a time until all the boxes are gone.  I don't anticipate purchasing more of it. My kids are normally allergic to peanuts too but probably not sensitive enough to trigger a reaction (but the other little boy did).  I am just surprised to find that

column9: This is not a gluten free product
column10: This cereal is called gluten free but it is not.  On the ingredients list on this page one of the ingredients is barley malt extract.  Barley malt is gluten so if you have a gluten sensitivity or celiac disease, don't but this product.  I've informed Amazon of the error.

The cereal however is not the same as it used to be. The squares are so tiny now and they are flat instead of hollow like they used to be. Once milk hits them they get soggy instantly. column9: CAUTION: MSG in Chex Products; Read Labels Carefully
column10: I like the "idea" of Chex products, however, many of them contain MSG -- a very dangerous additive for almost anyone. It's best to buy plain Chex (check the label) and create your own snack mixes, if that's what you use it for.Many "Gluten-Free" products are now being processed with additives that are NOT gluten-free (nitrites, MSG, soy, corn meal, i.e., more corn meal than gluten-free grains), which limits the purchasing options for GF safe foods.  I only submit this comment for that reason.Again, Chex in general is a good product, just please read the labels carefully.
I bought this product at the grocery store and could not believe it when I realized there is 10% of daily allowance of sodium. Not a healthy cereal at all!

column9: There is a difference between the Original and the Gluten Free
column10: I knew when I purchased this Chocolate Chex, that I wasn't getting the original. But I was so addicted to the original that I bought this anyway, knowing it wouldn't fulfill my tastebuds.I think it was in 2010 when they changed the recipe to Gluten Free and the only place I could find Chocolate Chex stopped carrying it last year. But that was pretty much a waste of time.Ain't it funny how companies bend over backwards to please a Minority population?And, leave the rest of us to do without.

column9: Great for milk and for making yogurt!
column10: I make my daughter's yogurt since the only whole fat yogurt available in stores where we live is Stonyfield's, and they're almost $1/cup. The recipe uses 3c. whole milk and a cup of dry milk, which sent me on a search for a dry milk that was more nutricious than the plain old nonfat dry milk that most places carry. Nestle Nido Kinder was my answer: I like that it's fortified with so many nutrients that growing kids need, fiber was a huge plus since my daughter sometimes has regularity problems, essential fatty acids, and the taste is really good. My daughter also likes it mixed as a drink as well, and since it taste slightly different than regular milk, it's a nice change every once in awhile. I compared this to toddler formulas that are out there, and this has just as much nutrients for more than half the price (with S&S discount 30.7cents/oz. and Similac Go&Grow toddler formula is 76cents/oz. on Amazon). I've also purchased Walmart's version of Pediasure before I discovered Nestle Kinder, and they're also nutrient comparable, but Kinder is WAY cheaper than even a generic pediasure (it cost $1.31/8oz. bottle and an 8oz sippy of Kinder made with nursery water cost 40.6cents to make). I highly recommend trying this with your toddler if you're looking for something to supplement your child's diet that is also budget friendly.***Update from two years ago when I made this review: The price more than doubled! I was paying $13 for this 3.52lb. can with Subcribe&Save. I love the product still, HATE THE PRICE!!! I'm sorry, but I'm sure not making almost triple what I was so I sure can't afford to pay that much for the same product.***

Another reviewer mentioned using this to make yogurt, so I bought some.  I use this only and it makes seriously good yogurt & is cost effective, too.  Tastes good to drink--kids shouldn't get all the good stuff!
MY 4 YR OLD TILL THIS DAY LOVES THIS MILK...........BY ITSELF. SHE EATS THE POWDER...AND IT REALLY IS DELICIOUS. I HAVE SOME TOO SOMETIMES WITH HER!

I have a one year old and he really likes to drink this, it has a good flavor and I can see how he chooses to drink this milk instead of any other king of drink... right now I'm using one can per week and I think that is great with all the nutrients and probiotics to keep my baby healthy.  I will keep on buying it for a while!
My child loves the taste of this.  I prefer to give this to him over whole milk as it has added nutrients.

I switched to this milk I found at my local supermarket when my child turned 1, it has all the nutrients to help my child grow, even though he's going through that phase when he would today and not tomorrow, so I can peace of mind since this milk is fortified with vitamins and proteins that whole milk don't have. Plus 1 can last at least me two and half weeks. I think I'll continue to use this milk until he is more use to solid foods and eats regularly.

I got this when i was looking at amazon for toddler formulas. I checked the ingredients and many of them are found in the regular formulas. Yeah.. it does not have all the nutrients that a formula has but come on... its so cheap and i am already giving my son the multivitamins and DHA. So its a nice replacement.
great product. very clear  expire / production date.fast shipping. very happy  with nido. that s why this is my second time buying from  this seller, thank you so much

My daughter recently turned 1 and I was having a hard time switching her over from infant formula to whole milk. This product was did the trick! She loves it and it is so easy to mix with warm water and give to her. The best thing is I found it on clearance at my local Walmart for only $7! I would have had to pay at least 6 times that for the same size container of formula. What a great product and regardless of the price what a great deal.

column9: This stuff should be marketed to adults, too!
column10: I recently received a free sample of Nido 1+. I'm not sure why (I don't even have kids), especially as the packaging was all in Spanish. However, I have purchased powdered milk from time to time over the years and I was curious about the taste of this Nestle product. Wow! Other than being slightly (but not overpoweringly) sweet, this tastes closer to fresh whole milk than any other powdered product I have ever tried -- and I've tried a lot of them. And it tastes GOOD. In fact, on the basis of taste alone I would prefer drinking a glass of this to regular whole or low-fat milk. That's something I thought I'd never say.I've tried it on cereal and oatmeal and again, it's better than the real thing. But the really big news for me is that it's also excellent in coffee. I'm a stickler for having real milk in my coffee and will only use that powdered non-dairy stuff when I'm desperate for a caffeine fix and there's no alternative. This stuff can go into your java in either mixed (liquid) or powdered form, and it makes me one happy coffee-drinking jitterbug. Who knew that the best powdered creamer is actually infant formula? (To be 100% accurate, this isn't marketed as infant formula, but as a fortified milk-based drink for young children.) Oh... my cats Chloe and Marmalade give it 2 paws up too.Now for the not-so-good news: Prepared according to the manufacturer's instructions, it appears that, quart for quart, Nido is more expensive than either ordinary powdered milk or regular supermarket-branded milk. However, it is fortified with additional nutrients, including vitamins A, C, D, E, B6, B12, and K, along with Niacin, Folic Acid, Iron, Calcium, Thiamine, Riboflavin (all good stuff), and for some people (like me) that offsets the price disadvantage. Also, being a dry product, it should store well, so it's a natural as a back-up for the real thing or to keep on hand as part of your emergency supplies. It certainly makes sense for camping trips and backpacking.Now, looking at it as a coffee creamer, it MAY actually be cheaper than the detestable non-dairy powdered stuff that is sold for that purpose. I'll have to look into the prices to tell for sure, since it's been years since I've bought any powdered creamer. In my opinion Nido is far superior in taste (which, I suppose, shouldn't be surprising, as non-dairy creamer is, well, non-dairy, while Nido is made primarily from real milk). I also have a bunch of cold blended coffee recipes (you know, chocolate-caramel-mochaccino-type drinks) that call for powdered non-dairy creamer. It's hard for me to imagine how Nido wouldn't improve those recipes 1000%, although I haven't tried using it that way yet. Oh -- let's not forget about smoothies! A few scoops of Nido should add a nice creaminess to my fruit smoothies, and a nutritional boost as well. I think I'll try Nido in place of protein powder and see how that goes. I see from the nutritional label on the Nido can that four scoops (the scoop is included in the can) contains 6 grams of protein.I'm almost finished with my free sample, and I'm already planning to buy a big can of Nido 1+ when it's gone. Fortunately, the sample included a $4.00 coupon, so that really helps, but I'm pretty sure I'd be buying it anyway.  I'm not a huge consumer of milk (I buy it mostly for my coffee) and occasionally the milk in my refrigerator will start to go bad before I've used up the entire gallon jug. (Yes, I know I could buy it in smaller quantities, but the way it's priced at my supermarket, it's much more cost-efficient to buy the gallon size.) By using Nido instead of liquid milk, I shouldn't have that problem, as I can mix it up in whatever quantities I need.The bottom line is that this stuff tastes really good and has a great nutritional profile, so I don't see why Nestle seems to be marketing it exclusively as a product for little kids (hint hint). Why should they have all the fun?

You won't regret buying Nido. i used it with my son who is now 6 and am using it with my toddler. Loaded with all the essential vitamins, nutrients plus iron, it is way better than ordinary milk. And the price is right.

Good job Amazon!
I've been giving my babies Nido Kinder ever since they stopped the formula, they love the sweet taste and I love the convenience

column10: Enjoy the product, but this price is extravagant.  Last time I ordered it from Amazon is was about thirteen dollars.  Sheesh.  I hope they find a way to bring the cost back down.

This is a hard to find item. My aunt LOVES this cook and serve and is unable to find it anywhere.  I was thrilled to find it for her and surprise her.Very pleased with the seller, also.

column9: Good, but Dark & Sweet version is so much better!
column10: Royal Brand makes the best pudding...and while their Cook and Serve regular Chocolate flavor is good--the magic is in their Dark & Sweet Chocolate one. Rich flavor, dark and creamy--regular chocolate (any brand) just seems bland and doesn't compare. I have been a long-time pudding connoisseur, having tried many different brands over the years in search for one as good. Dark & Sweet is my favorite and has been difficult for me to find for a long time. (my friends laugh, but I drive out of my way to find it when I am in a location that I know carries it--and when I find it, I fill my suitcase and stock pile it!)I have just heard that Dark & Sweet is discontinued...all I can say is, NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!! Very sad...if Royal was smart, they'd focus on marketing Dark & Sweet as their only chocolate. (perhaps it was too confusing to offer two chocolate flavors? My guess is, due to lack of shelf space, many stores never bothered to carry both--in fact, when asked, many managers seemed unaware there even WAS another Royal chocolate flavor offered) If stores carried Dark and Sweet, and the public became aware of it, they would blow Jello and other lesser brands out of the water. True Chocolate lovers know the difference...and I know I'm not the only one!

This is the third 23 oz container of Tones Minced Garlic that we've ordered. It's simply fantastic, at a fantastic price. We add it to just about everything except our breakfast cereal. The taste is amazing. It re-hydrates quickly, so it can be added to anything from a can of soup to a baked dish. I sure recommend this product! And we'll be ordering more soon.

column9: What every Italian man needs more garlic!
column10: Tone's Spices Minced Garlic (23 oz) is an absolute requirement for this un uomo Italiano  (Italian man). A very good value, and who doesn't need more garlic?  Ciao!

A reliable brand. When I was shopping at a major warehouse store (gee who could that be lol) I discovered they sold this and loaded up my cart with Tone's. I buy gourmet brands too but I like having my shelf full of Tone's products for everyday use or backup. Flavorful, long lasting, and considering its a dried item as close to fresh as you can get.

It made my Oregon brats taste just like back home, perfect! This is great mustard, hot but not too hot, spicy with a good "bite". This is a must have if you are grilling brats for the game or making sandwiches.
If you love horseradish, you will love this mustard. Don't feel like you can only put it on your Beer 'n' Brats - we put it on all kinds of food for some added kick!

Was at a local fair and bought a bratwurst from a vendor.  They had this mustard.  I put a generous helping on my brat and found a place to sit and eat.The first bite nearly blew me away!!  This mustard is NOT for the faint of heart!  But if you like spicy mustard, you have just found your nirvana.

This is the closest thing to German Feuer Senf I have tasted in the US. In its own right, it is an excellent mustard with enough horseradish to provide a kick. The mustard has an outstanding taste, not too sweet like many other brands. The only problem I have with this product is not the mustard itself but the availability by Silver Springs. The mustard is worth 5 stars, company distribution worth 1 star, total = 3 stars. I guess if the company refuses to make this product more available, it will die a slow death.

We serve this mustard at the Golden City Brewery.  we got one tiney bottle once and everyone liked it so much we now order the 1 gallon jars in bulk.  Goes great on our bratwurst.

It just depends on your needs and if you are really serious about using a more natural product then you'll eventually get used to the taste of this (just as some take a while to get used to taste of artificial sweeteners!).

column9: Stay away from products like these made in China
column10: Companies like this go to great lengths to try to disguise the fact that their products are made in China. Some are advertsing "Made under US supervision". In this case they keep emphasizing that their products are "tested in the US". I wrote to them asking where the product was manufactured and they never responded but it appears that the products are actually made in China. "Tested in the US" means close to nothing as they obviously cannot test every single treat. In the last few years the FDA has issued three warnings about chicken tender/jerky treats made in China and their harmful effects on dogs. Thus you are taking a real risk by buying a product like this. Curiously in the case of this product it is not any cheaper than buying a similar one MADE in the US so I can see absolutely no reason to buy these. I fully appreciate that dogs like these types of treats. I know of no dog that does not. However I also know of no dog that reads FDA reviews, notices or warnings and thus the responsibility for buying the proper safe treats is on you - not the dog.Follow-up: Company has now replied and these treats are made in China.

I love the flavor of these cookies, but hope that Pamela's fixes the recipe so they don't crumble in transit (or upon the first bite if you are lucky enough to get a cookie that is completely intact). I've tried several of Pamela's cookies and this is the only one that was COA (crumbs on arrival) :-)
These cookies taste good but were in pieces so it was just eating coookie crumbs not a whole cookie.

OMGThese cookies are perfection.  They're healthy and taste better than any other cookie (healthy or not) out there.  So goooooood with a cold glass of any milk.It's a shame I can't get these shipped internationally since stores are always out of them.... No other cookie comes close.
A crunchy delicious peanut butter cookie with chunks of chocolate buried throughout. Slightly crumbly but not dry. Perfect for the gluten free diet, kid or kid within. Enjoy

This is my favorite store bought cookie. Crumbly texture, great flavor and gluten free. The only problems are not eating a whole box at a time, and sometimes they arrive somewhat crumbled from shipping.

These cookies were a real gluten-free surprise; however, although we are used to gluten free cookies breaking apart easily, the pack of 6 was so poorly wrapped by Amazon that every cookie arrived crumbled in pieces.  Try to find these cookies in a store instead.

I got this pack of cookies for my mom she cant have gluten she loves them so much she will buy more and she says she can tell they honestly are gluten free. It can be hard for people want to eat well or have special diet needs to have treats so I am happy I found these.
For all you Gluten Free people out there, this is the best buy for the money.  Excellent product.
Pamela's products are incredible!  These cookies, specifically, taste great!  Kids and adults alike will love them Celiac or not!

To be fair, I should say that I haven't ordered these cookies from Amazon.com yet, so I can't speak for the condition they arrive in. I sampled them recently and was looking for an online source for family in another state.In any case, the cookies I tried were surprisingly delicious! I picked up a sample packet at a local health food store, and didn't have high expectations. I bake the vast majority of my own goodies, I'm a very experienced baker, and I don't normally eat gluten-free products. I was happily surprised to find that these had a good peanutty flavor, pleasantly crumbly texture, and lots of little chocolate chips. Unfortunately, I think that the crumbly texture is probably what makes these less than ideal for loose shipping.

My husband is gluten/casein free and misses yummy sweets.  I ordered these cookies for him for Christmas thinking they would be fabulous.  They came in handy individual packets full of completely crushed but delicious cookies.  I should have called for my money back, but I don't want Amazon to discontinue the product, I just want the shipping problem fixed.
I AM SO DISAPPOINTED BY PAMELA'S PRODUCTS ORGANIC PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIS. ALL THE COOKIE SMASHED WHEN I RECEIVED IT.
I will never buy Cookies OL again. What I got was 5 boxed of cookie crumbs.Not one full cookie in the shipment.

I love the taste of these cookies but they were mostly just crumbs. I bought the dark chocolate  as well and thet hold together like a normal cookie. I got a second box of the PB and they were still just crumbs and flour rather than cookies.
I ordered these cookies recently. When they got to my home every single cookie was crumbled in a million pieces. And they tasted awful. The worst cookie ever!! :(

I'm glad that Stella & Chewy's has come out with this new flavor of freeze dried raw food for dogs. The SURF N TURF is a combination beef and wild salmon and my Shiba Inu loves it.The round patties are dehydrated and you can just add some lukewarm water to reconstitute them again. There is a fishy scent to the patties, but it's not overpowering and I think it adds to the enjoyment of dogs olfactory senses and makes the food more appetizing.Anyway, if you're thinking about trying a raw diet for your pooch but don't want to go through the mess of frozen raw or DIY (do-it-yourself), I recommend the STELLA & CHEWY'S FREEZE DRIED RAW SURF & TURF. It's perfect for small to medium size breeds. I don't think it's good for larger breeds because you'll probably go through a bag every other day or so, which can get expensive. Also if you have a picky eater, which I do, I suggest trying this or the Stella & Chewy's Freeze Dried Dog Food for Adult Dogs, Beef Patties, 32 Count, 16 Ounce Bag.And since Stella & Chewy's are adding more varieties to their freeze dried line, like this and Stella & Chewy's Freeze Dried Dog Food for Adult Dogs, Lamb Patties, 32 Count, 16 Ounce Bag, your furry kid can get the nutritional benefits from eating a wide selection of different foods.

column9: love Stella and Chewys (my dog does)
column10: Great dog food!! keeps well and my dog loves it! He likes some flavors better than others but then changes his mind and eats the one he didn't like before with gusto. And it is good for him.  Great to take when you travel

My dog is a very picky eater, but he loves the Stella & Chewy's brand, this flavor in particular. I usually take a couple of the patties and break them up, then sprinkle on top of his food, and he starts eating. Great product!
We love these "Excellent" products, from Stella and Chewy...This is our third product to try...Easy to store prepare, and travel with. Our Yorkie is a finicky eater !

I am always happy with Stella and Chewy's. The company shipped as promised and was fast delivery. This is one of the only staples that I need to have in the pantry for the little one. He's super picky, but will eat the patties!

My two dogs, a pug & Shitzuh, love the Stella Chewy's Surf & Turf.  They're pretty finicky but I don't have to encourage them with this food, they can eat it any where, any time, any way - dry or wet, it's a great product!

column9: Stella and Chewy's - fantastic and easy!
column10: This is what our girls get for breakfast every morning. They LOVE their Stella and Chewy's dehydrated surf and turf! I feel good about feeding Stella and Chewy's, because it's a fantastic quality dog food, and it's so easy-I just hand them a little steak and breakfast is done!
I have tried this product and absolutely love it.  Almost tastes like mom's dutch apple pie.  Definitely recommend this jam!!

I researched foods very carefully when we decided to change over, and we decided to try Natural Balance, duck and potato formula, for our 2 dogs, and our son's 2 dogs.We found that the pieces were not overly large, with was nice for the senior, and smaller of the 4.Then, we discovered that they loved it; one, and all. They wouldn't leave the bag alone, and when we tried to change them over slowly, they just picked the Natural Balance out of the bowls, leaving the old food behind.Even so, none experience the slightest system upset at the changeover, not even the one with the sensitive stomach, and everyone looks good, is acting well, and continues to look forward to their meals. Even the dog who has never eaten a whole bowl of food in a meal since he was a puppy is now regularly doing so.I can't guarantee the same results for every dog, as each is an individual, but after trying it on 4 different breeds, and age groups, I can say that I'd recommend it highly as worth a try for someone else!

Our local pet store owner suggested this food when I showed her my dachshunds ears that were red, inflamed and never seemed to clear up even after I don't know how many antibiotics our vet prescribed. Within a few weeks they were totally cleared up and we never had the problem again.Also, he used to get hot itchy spots on his belly in the summer and those never came back either. I highly recommend it!

We made the switch from Iams to this food about 3 yrs ago.  We actually did not switch for health reasons for the dog, but instead because I had a crawling infant that was allergic to everything.  Obviously I don't let my kids eat dog food but I was worried the baby might find a piece, stick it in her mouth, and have an allergic reaction.  This food fit the bill as being free of all my daughter's allergens.Within a month we noticed a HUGE change in our dog!  She's a border collie/lab mix and her coat was much healthier looking.  Her nails used to have a lot of breakage and that stopped.  The biggest most important thing that stopped though was her diarrhea.  Previously I had never considered it could be from her food since she didn't get it every day.  However maybe once every 3-4 weeks the poor dog would have explosive diarrhea in the middle of the night that would end up all over my walls (ugh).  Ever since we switched to Natural Balance 3 yrs ago not ONE time has she had that problem.  She also stopped having ear infections.I know other reviewers have said the formula changed and while we did notice that the kibble looked different it did not affect our dog at all and she's still just as healthy with no problems at all.  At one point we tried to switch her to another grain free dog food, Taste of the Wild, because we couldn't find Natural Balance in the city we moved to.  Even though we did a slow transition that food made her really sick, she had horrible disgusting gas, and once again she had diarrhea (thankfully all outside during the daytime this time!).  We went back to Natural Balance and she was once again her old, healthy, self.

I've been feeding my dog this food for three years now due to her allergies.  I haven't had any problems at all, I'm not sure what the deal is with all of the negative reviews.  Perhaps they changed their dog food too rapidly which causes negative side-effects.  You need to mix the old food with the new food for several days before changing brands.

column9: Has done wonders for my dog
column10: I've been using this food for 3 years and did not even notice the formula change.  I have a dog that used to get chronic ear infections, hot spots and infected anal glands.  Since I put her on this food she has not had ONE problem with any of the above.  It has saved me hundreds of dollars in vet bills.  Occasionally we will get a bag of this food that is a funny color and the dogs don't eat as eagerly so, clearly there is occasionally some inconstancy with the ingredients but I have never had a problem with either of my dogs becoming ill from it.  It's been a real help to us.

By the title, you should get the hint of what this product is all about. First af all, I have fed this Duck and Potato dry food to my dog for 4 years and never had a single issue, in fact she was a heathly vibrant dog with great vitality during that period. I bought 4 large bags about 5 months ago, because I like to keep a nice supply on hand. After I fed her from a freshly opened bag, I was greeted with a bloody diarrhea crime scene all over the house at 3:00 in the morning. Actually, it was more blood than stool and I freaked out not knowing what was going on, she was then shaking uncontrollably in discomfort. I took her to the vet and $200 later after all the tests, we found nothing. I put her on a strict chicken and rice formula for a month and she was just fine, so I decided to start feeding her the same Natural Balance again, not knowing it was the food doing it and the same nightmare happened again(bloody mucusy stool). Another month of Chicken and rice and no problems. Well, tonight I mixed in literally 15 small pieces of that Duck and Potato with a bunch of rice and chicken and I can already hear her stomach gurgling like it did before. I promply gave her an anti-diarrheal just to be safe, but i'm watching her close and it'll probably be another sleepless night of cleaning up a disaster zone.I just finished reading other reviews tonight on the net about other people having similar problems and it's all because this company changed their formula. I think the "new" formula is worse than that tainted malamine food that got in the supply a few years ago. My pet store won't return the bags I have, because I never thought about keeping the receipts from a product I've used for soo many years without problems, now I have to eat another $200 and toss this junk on the garbage. I won't even consider giving it to my neighbors dog, because I'm not the sadistic type.This product should be recalled and it's not healthy for any dog. Even if it seems the dog might not be showing bad symptoms, it can't possibly be good considering what my dog has gone through. Shame on you Mr Patten for cutting corners and you better come out with a formal apology for this mishap. I am using several types of your canned food at the moment(except the duck and potato canned food) and the are no problems this those(yet), but rest assured I've lost faith with the reputation of your company and will move on to other healthier avenues for my dogs dietary needs.

This dog food reduced my dogs itching almost immediately and they liked the taste as well. I have no problem getting them to eat it. It has almost totally stopped their wheezing as well. I was not aware that diet could control wheezing, but it seems to have worked that way. I can only conclude that the wheezing was caused by food allergies.

I just transitioned my 9 month old Collie pup to this formula from Eagle Pack Large Breed Puppy food.  He likes it fine and it hasn't affected his digestion or stools.  He doesn't suffer from any allergy problems, so that doesn't apply in my case.  My biggest concern was whether the new food would cause loose stools (my collies always seem to be sensitive to this), but no problems.I did notice that the current ingredient list on the back of the bag is: Potato, Duck, Duck Meal, Potato Protein.... So apparently they've restored the duck meal ingredient to the formula.  I selected this product based on suggestions from a animal nutritionist that works for a local Pet Supplies Plus store.  She seems to know her stuff.Edited 4/8/2011: Well I spoke too soon.  After being transitioned over to this formula for about 3 weeks my dogs stools became consistently soft (not loose though).  I was disappointed because his eliminations have become very regular and smaller - just too soft (like peanut butter).  After beginning to add some high fiber kibble (Science Diet Adult light) to this formula things have begun to firm up nicely.  My previous Collie seemed to need a higher fiber diet to maintain the desired "output".  I'm not sure if I'll completely transition to another food or just continue with a mix.

column9: Great food for dogs that have chronic loose stools
column10: have tried pretty much every dog food for my 12 year old lab who gets terrible gas and diarrhea. Specialty formulas(Science Diet WD)  from the vet didnt work along with Solid Gold. This is the only food we have found that totally has solved her problem. No clue why there have been complaints. This food has really done the trick.

column9: Great for a dog with a sensitive stomach
column10: My dog loves this we had gone for the cheaper lamb and rice formula but my dog stomach wasn't adjusting to it very well. We decided to go up in cost and try out the Duck Formula. Now my dog doesn't have any more issues with his stomach and he really loves eating this food. I would definitely recommend this for any dog. We have a normal sized dachshund and he is very picky but scarfs this food like it was a treat every day for him. The larger size is definitely a cheaper way to go especially for a small dog, just make sure to have a good storage area to keep it in as the bag doesn't seal.

column9: CHANGED THEIR FORMULA - MAKES DOGS SICK
column10: Our boxer was on Natural Balance Duck and Potato for years and did very well on it.  After they changed the formula, he experienced horrible vomiting and diarrhea.  He has also had an major increase in skin irritation (ear itching and paw chewing).  The change in the formula was not made apparent by the company for months.  Later they indicated the changed with a small sticker on the bag.  Very disappointed in the company and hoping that no permanent damage has been caused to our pup.

column9: Formula change- Now it makes the dogs sick.  Avoid this food.
column10: This food was the best out there until Spring 2009, then they changed the formula.  If you check the website, they admit they lost their access to the "quality" duck protein they were using.  Easy way to tell was the food went from light brown to greenish.  That, and after your dog eats the new formula, he will throw up and have diarrhea all over your house. I have two mutts, neither of which are picky eaters.  Both of them chose to starve, rather than eat this food after the formula change.  When combined with the fact that Natural Balance was part of that Chinese dog poisoning issue a few years back, I don't trust this company not to kill my dogs.By the way, if you buy it from PetCo, you will never know, since this food is a good seller, and PetCo has been editing its reviews of the product to delete anything that puts people off the food.  They should be ashamed of themselves, and I won't be getting food there, anymore.Do yourself and your dogs a favor and avoid Natural Balance Ultra.

Please see my review of the canned version of NB's Duck and Potato Formula.I am very impressed this this product line. Both my dogs have been able to easily digest both the kibble and the canned versions. I've begun to mix in the dry formula with the canned for my 18 lb Shih Tzu, and I was shocked that she actually ate every bite of her dinner tonight. She's never been a fan of kibble in the past. I also have an elderly Chow Chow who loves every form of the NB's Duck and Potato she's tried (kibble, soft and treat - both the bone/dry and the soft versions). Both dogs have solid poos and high energy - after 10 days. So far so good... keeping my fingers crossed as it's been a long journey to find a food that suits both dogs and their various ailments.

column9: Great for our boxer with Colitis
column10: Our boxer has had colitis since she was a puppy.  We struggled to find a food that would not cause it to flare up.  We've been using this for a few years now without any problems.

My dog has food allergies, we think it's chicken. Chicken is on almost every dog food made. So we have to buy this expensive stuff. But my dog loves it like whoa. Haven't tried any other flavors, but duck and potato?! He eats better than I do. I only purchased this on Amazon.com to avoid an extra 5$ of tax a brick and mortar store near me would charge. It's pretty much the same price everywhere I've found it.

I purchased this food assuming my dog would love it, but he totally hates it. And when he does eat it because I am feeding it to him he gets really bad diarrhea even with a small amount. I will NEVER purchase this food again, it should be call Diarrhea Balance.

column9: Perfect for our pug! No more skin problems
column10: Last year after my then 2-year-old pug had several successive skin rashes, my vet suggested that we put him on a limited ingredient diet that cut out corn and other grains and instead used potatoes as the carbohydrate source. After trying a couple different brands and formulations, I finally found the one that worked best for our pug was Natural Balance LID Potato & Duck Formula.The kibble is a small oval-shaped disk. It's fairly flat and measures just a hair over half an inch wide. I read that they also have it available in a smaller size for small breed dogs. But my pug, which has a fairly small mouth, seems to have no problem eating this kibble.We once tried another brand of limited ingredient dog food from Royal Canin that contained rabbit and potato. I didn't like that one because the kibble had a strong smell. This one from Natural Balance does not.I was very pleased to see within one month that our pug's skin was free of redness and irritation. When we were gone on vacation for over a week Spanky got nothing else other than this food (no treats!) and his skin showed rapid and remarkable improvement. It seemed fairly obvious that we had finally found a suitable food for him. He hasn't had any gassiness and his stool is not loose or showing any sign of intestinal distress. Spanky will eat pretty much anything, so it's hard to say if he enjoys this food any more than another brand as he basically inhales his food. However, it does seem to keep him full and from begging for so many treats. To me this is usually a good indicator of a quality food, as it doesn't just go right through him like corn-based foods do.Definitely a 5-star food.
I wish I listened to the other reviewers who warned about the diarrhea. This gave my dog bloody diarrhea! I wouldn't feed this to your dog, please avoid it. I'm going back to my old food.

column9: NEW FORMULA TOXIC - DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!
column10: I have been feeding this dog food to ny dogs for two years without incident.I am so glad I read these reviews because recently I noticed the food looked different when I poured it into my dog's bowls. Soon afterwards I had several of my dogs coming down with recurring bouts of bloody diarrhea. I had no earthly idea what could have been causing the trouble. I just logged onto Amazon to see about automatic shipping of this food and discovered that this brand did in fact have a new fomula change (unbeknownst to me) and that others have been having the same bloody diarrhea in their dogs since the formula changed. I will never ever buy this dog food again! I will never recommend it again. End of story!

column9: My dog will eat everything, except for this.
column10: My dog NEVER refuses food. For years she'll eat pretty much anything, but not this. That, combined with some of the other frightening customer reviews, worries me. Maybe it was once good and they changed the formula, or maybe my experience is just a fluke.
