But for whatever reason, my hungry dog would rather eat just about anything that I've ever given her instead of this food.

I've been buying Natural Balance Duck and Potato for my dog for over 2 years.  This is the first time I've every purchased the dry dog food from amazon, and probably the last.  This batch was over cooked, has a burnt smell to it.  The food is usually a light brown color, this is a dark brown color.  Marley is a picky eater, and still eats it, but I would recommend staying away from getting is directly shipped from amazon.

I read all of the reviews I could find about this food, and despite the warnings, we started one dog on this food because of suspected grain allergies. His ear/paw infections quickly cleared up and he seemed healthier than ever.  We fed him this for about 6 months without a problem.  About a month ago, we decided to transition our other dog onto it, as well.About 3 weeks ago both dogs started to get very sick - the worst diarrhea I've seen.  It started with one dog, so we took him to the vet.  After screens for parasites and bacterial infections turned up nothing, and antibiotics weren't helping, the other dog also became ill.  On the off chance it was the new bag of food we had recently opened, we fed them something different one day.  Within 24 hours both dogs were fine.  I don't know if it's simply inconsistencies in their production, but I cannot take the chance that I might poison my dogs with a bad bag of food.  We will no longer feed them any Natural Balance food.

I have a 140 lb Dogue de Bordeaux (French Mastiff) with chronic colitis. Needless to say, it was a real nightmare to find a dog food that would not give him diarrhea. We went through numerous foods, including other high end products, for a year and finally found Natural Balance Potato and Duck. He still has bouts of colitis but they are fewer and farther between, and with metronidazole to help clear it up, we seldom have issues with diarrhea anymore. Thank goodness!  I will say, though, that I was disappointed that they changed the formula without warning consumers that they would be doing so. After all, those of us who buy this product do so BECAUSE we have dogs with sensitive stomachs and need lots of notice before changing their food!  However, I can honestly say that this product saved my dog's life because I could not have kept him a reasonable weight nor myself sane if he had continued to have such frequent bouts of diarrhea.  Hooch thanks Natural Balance, too!

Well executed but cloying and saccharine."The Cross" was an instrument of torture, and at the end the deposition it was coated with blood and excrement.Hard for me to swallow it as a cookie, but then again some folks "Christianity" begins and ends in sentiment.
Timothy's English Breakfast Tea K cups have the best flavor and body.  And they rock with the Keurig Brewer.  Every cup is fresh and delicious.

column9: Tried them all, this is the best.
column10: It's unusual when the tea k-cup with the best price is the best product. I am and have been a tea drinker for more than 40 years. Thank goodness for Keurig and k-cups. Thank goodness for Timothys and their English Breakfast tea. It is by far the best and I have tried all of the K-cups that are available out there.
Husband loves this tea especially in the morning.I recommend using the large cup setting on your Keurig Brewer unless you prefer your tea extra strong.
This is strong, so maybe water it down with lots of ice cubes or put milk and sugar in it.
This was a great tea. It is not weak I use the 12 oz size and it is still good. Glad I aqm doing the automatic delivery system.
Excellent cup of full bodied black tea. Great for drinkers who add milk. The tea is hot enough for take the addition of milk
I ordered this for my mom who like to drink breafast tea in the morning. She has tried many of the teas for the Keurig and likes this one the best.

Got a personal Keurig brewer about two months ago.  Finding tea locally is nearly impossible.  Have had Timothy's for about a week, and it's wonderful!  Full-flavored and strong without being bitter.  I have purchased three types of unflavored teas, and this is (by far) the best!

If I could have given this product no stars I would have.  I don't know if the product was old or just a case of bad tea.  I opened both boxes (one for home and one for the office) or I would have returned the product.  The tea not only tasted bad but it smelled bad as well. I even had others try it and they had to throw the tea out as well.
I love English breakfast tea, but have found some of them bitter.  This is the best one I have found so far.  It has strength without the bitterness. Great job, Timothy!!!

I was surprised to discover that I can brew 16 oz. of flavorful tea, very comparable to the Yorkshire Gold I normally brew from leaves!I have even brewed a 20 oz pot when I wanted a milder tea in the evening.It does not have the richness of Bewleys Clipper Gold or Twinings Irish Breakfast, but it's close.The only drawback is cost, but that is compensated by convenience.

I got an English Breakfast tea in with a sample pack and I was surprised at how good it was.  Right after that I noticed the Celestial English Breakfast Tea k-cups on sale at my supermarket.  As soon as I tried the Celestial I thought, "Whoa, this can't be right - it doesn't taste anything like the one in the sample!"  Then I realized the sample cup had been a Timothy's and ordered some of them.  Yup, that was more like it.  I use milk and sweetener with the middle size on the brewer and it's just the right intensity for me. I can't believe how various brands of the same "flavor" can be so different.
The price was great on this item.  It was purchased as a gift and was so convenient to have it sent directly to the recipient.
I have had 4 different English Breakfast Teas for the Keurig.  I do make a 12-13 oz. Cup.  I like it in that size.
These are tasty, but a lot of work to make. They also were a bit expensive. They're good, but I don't know that I'd buy it again.
They tasted awful! I followed the directions step by step, took about 30 minutes to make them. The final product was not worth the time it took to cook them. We won't be buying them again.
These Dixie Carb products are awful.  They might be low carb but they are full of fat, hard to make and taste awful.  See my review on the pecan sticky buns for the gory details.  Don't bother!

These are great if you're doing a low carb diet. Buttery and soft on the inside I'm not sure I would compare them to a real cinnamon bun but they're great tasting in their own way -- with this one thing -- don't put the glaze on them. The glaze introduces a real splenda like aftertaste which kinda ruins it. Instead just eat them without the glaze and they're great. Be sure not to overcook them or else they'll get hard - but even without the glaze there are a great semi-sweet treat.

This product tastes just like any other cinnamon bun!  I was skeptic at first...but the taste is very good.  Everybody at home liked them. At 3g net carbs, it is a treat you can afford in your coffee break in your low carb lifestyle.

column9: Good for kitties, good price too!
column10: I'm glad Amazon now carries this product. I have tried cheap grocery store brands, those inferior corn based products make a difference in my cat's behavior, quality of her fur and overall health. Natural Balance is highly rated by several web sites evaluating cat food as it has no corn or other fillers. Canned food may be a better choice for her health, but my cat won't eat it, this is a good second choice.It really does not cost more than the grocery store types as she needs less food due to it being nutrient rich. One 6 pound bag lasts a little over two months for my 10 pound short hair. Less food fed means less poop to scoop, not as stinky too!  It's rare to find her hacking up a hair ball or vomiting, unlike a major well-known brand where she puked almost daily. Her coat is shiny and soft. No fat belly. She has energy to spare!I like being able to have it delivered to my home, no extra trip needed to a specialty pet store.

column9: Preferred by All three Finicky Cats
column10: I did an experiment when I bought this slightly more expensive than usual cat food. I set bowls of their current foods out. Chicken for the Cat Lover's Soul came in third.EVO, which is the healthiest for one cat because it has no corn meal, became a treat/snack because it is most expensive, California Natural came in second and Natural Balance is first. However, knowing cats, if you do, this choice could change at any time because of the finicky part of the experiment. Although the full fat California naturals can be a favorite it really is fattening for indoor cats and they do not care for the low fat variety.I feel satisfied because this is a healthy choice. There was one bowl that I removed from the test: Meow Mix, because they put something in it besides cornmeal and other questionable by-products, that act as an addictive. They can have Meow-Mix as a treat also, until they use of the bag.So, my cats-- two adult (consenting) males and one kitten-- vote for natural Balance.Thank you

I adopted my cat from a shelter about 9 years ago and fed him one of the better grocery store brands without incident. Suddenly, about 9 months ago, he developed an allergy to that food (or something) because his fur got dull and started falling out in clumps. I took him to the vet and ruled out anything healthwise -- the vet pointed to a food allergy. So I tried Natural Balance. Not only did my cat have a renewed interest in his food, slowly his fur began to return to normal. Now it's healthier than ever, the thickest, softest, silkiest fur you could ever want! Plus, he never spits up or gets hairballs. It's worth paying a premium to have such a healthy, content cat.

column9: Natural Balance rated among the best dry foods
column10: UPDATE 12/2011:This is a ridiculous price for this product.  The review below was written when this item was but $12 and some odd change.  Now it's $23?!  Go elsewhere - you can find it much cheaper.------------ORIGINAL REVIEW:I love this food.  I knew the Purina One dry food I was feeding my one cat wasn't the best.  After researching several different reputable websites for dry food reviews, I decided to purchase Natural Balance.  Several different sites had included Natural Balance among the best dry food (especially for the money).  I have been very, very happy!My cat switched foods effortlessly.  I didn't even gradually introduce it like I should have - one day she was eating Purina One, the next Natural Balance.  The one major thing I've noticed after weeks on this food?  Her coat is SO much SOFTER/SHINIER!  She's so silky and soft now!  Holy cow!  I know if it's doing such good things for her fur it's a good sign.  Her bowel movements have always been nice and solid, and they look even better on this food.  I also have to feed her less each day, which makes the 6 lb. bag last longer than 6 lbs. of the Purina One would have.  All in all I'm a convert, and I will keep buying this food.  Thanks, Natural Balance!

Natural Balance has been on my rotation list for my two cats for the last 4 years. They love it and the ingredients are healthy.BTW, Amazon has good price comparing to local store and I save the trip to the pet shop.

This food works really well for my cat and we have never had a problem with it. He has no hairballs, a nice shiny coat, and maintains a healthy weight even though he's a bit of a piggy.The only problem I have is with this price on Amazon. I decided to just check the price here since the idea popped in my head, but I'm appalled to see that it is $20+ for a bag with Prime, when I usually pay around $15 at the chain stores and $10 at a warehouse store for the same exact product.I usually buy products on Prime because they're more affordable and more convenient, but I think I will continue going a little bit out of my way since it saves me about $10.

column9: My cat really enjoys the flavor
column10: Item arrived quickly. Overpriced, Amazon should be a little more competitive with other stores.My 3 yr old 12lb finicky cat really likes the flavor and crunchiness of the food. Her coat is shiny and she is in great health!

i was skeptical at first, i had been a loyal science diet customer for years.  One of my cats has had skin issues for about 2yrs and the drs never could figure it out, i thought i might as well try a better food sorce, how many cats do you know in the wild that will hunt the wild corn cob? I felt i was feeding my cats corn flakes with vitamins and chicken flavoring.  On Natural Balance, my one cats skin is clearing up, and both my cats are not begging to be fed all day long, this fills them up and i feel good about feeding it to them, they had no problems changing over either. which really surprised me. Very happy with Natrual Balance. Thank you!!
This catfood has no fillers, the main ingredients are chicken, brown rice, salmon and vegetables. My cat thrives on it. It's a bit more expensive but worth every penny.

column9: My cat loves this product, I kinda don't
column10: My kitty is the epitome of vacuum-ism. She will eat anything that kitties deem edible. Raw and cooked meats, strings, her own whiskers...you get it right? As such, she loves food-time (too much)...There is this awesome pet supplies store near where I live, and I go there often, since I love that place and help try to support their business. Every time I shop there, they always dish out PREMIUM cat food samples (and dog food too) out front. Last time I went there, I got almost ten sample bags. Anyways, since my cat is a little smartie, she'd pick out the better food from her usual food, and just gobble up it up, leaving her old food in her bowl.--Moving along, this one hands down, was one of her favorites. My issue is, that the kibbles are ridiculously *small*. So small, that she eats them whole, and therefore eats more. I wound up having to switch her food, which is a shame because this is a higher quality cat food, which lacks the corn-soy-wheat filler that is just ever-so-popular with all the more known brands of pet food.Ingredients:Chicken Meal, Chicken, Brown Rice, Barley, Oatmeal, Chicken Fat (Preserved With Natural Mixed Tocopherols), Duck Meal, Potatoes, Carrots, Lamb Meal, Canola Oil, Natural Flavor, Salmon Meal, Dried Egg, Brewers Yeast, Duck, Potassium Chloride, Whole Ground Flaxseed, Choline Chloride, Taurine, Natural Mixed Tocopherols, Spinach, Parsley Flakes, Cranberries, L-Lysine, L-Carnitine, Yucca Schidigera Extract, Dried Kelp, Zinc Proteinate, Vitamin E Supplement, Niacin, Manganese Proteinate, Copper Proteinate, Zinc Sulfate, Manganese Sulfate, Copper Sulfate, Thiamine Mononitrate (Vitamin B-1), Vitamin A Supplement, Biotin, Potassium Iodide, Calcium Pantothenate, Riboflavin (Vitamin B-2), Pyridoxine Hydrochloride (Vitamin B-6), Vitamin B-12 Supplement, Manganous Oxide, Sodium Selenite, Vitamin D-3 Supplement, Folic Acid.

I have fed my Munchkin cat Science Diet for years but she threw up a lot. I added a hairball remover to her diet and that helped a little but she still threw up. Since my dogs love Natural Balance, I thought I'd try it for her. She not only loves it and eats more, but I haven't seen her throw up since I started her on it 2 months ago. We are a Natural Balance Family now.

I did not get this from amazon i got it from petkare 2 I was feeding my hedgehogs *yes hedgehogs eat cat food* chicken soup cat food and kitten food for the babies i have, the reason i switched is because diamoned pet recalled their food due to salmonella which would explain the green poop my hedgehogs were having for the past 3 days,all though natural balance does not have some of the ingredents  chicken soup has Natural balance is still a good brand of cat food and since its for kittens and adult cats it saves me money instead of paying 11.00$ on both cat and kitten food on chicken soup im spending 15.00 on one bag of food same weight as chicken soup saving 7$ which i could spend on other things i need for my pets like bedding or other pet food for my other pets

column9: Just as good as everybody says....
column10: I fed my cat expensive food the first few years (like Science Diet--altho now I'm told that Science Diet isn't that great), then gradually switched to cheapo supermarket-brand dry food, & Friskies wet food. He eventually got really sick, got a bad respiratory infection, had a bunch of hairballs, & was shedding something terrible. After a round of antibiotics, he was better, but still shedding terribly. I switched to Natural Balance dry food, & the difference was almost miraculous, in his coat, no more hairballs (altho I also put some laxatone daily in his wet food), & his overall health & energy.Even tho I still kept him on the Friskies wet food (?), but recently I've started feeding him (expensive!) Natural Balance wet food. The main difference I've noticed with that is even less poops to scoop, but I think he also may eat less. Lastly, I don't know if I can name a good online retailer of Natural Balance here, but it rhymes with "Mr. Blooey". Amazon is very good too, of course, depending on the price--it pays to shop around.One last thing--I bought the 1st 6 lb. bag of Natural Balance dry food here on Amazon when it was only $12.99 (!). And almost on a fluke--I thought all the rave reviews almost sounded too good to be true, but they're spot on.

My cat loves this food. Keeps her on a good weight, and seems to really enjoy eating it. The pebbles are also a nice size for digestion. She enjoys it so much that she doesn't want to eat canned food :/

I normally research products in depth before I buy them but for some reason I blindly purchased Science Diet for my cats for years. One cat is of normal weight but was constantly throwing up his dinner. The other cat is overweight and had horrible smelling stool that was often on the soft side.Once I began researching cat food options I was embarrassed by what I had been feeding my cats - mostly plant by products which are not naturally in a cat diet! No wonder they had digestion issues.When we switched to Natural Balance the overweight cat took to it immediately and the normal weight cat took some convincing. I simply filled his bowl with half of the old food and half of the new and gradually took the old food away. Within 10 days he was completely switched. Every cat is different, just be patient with them.2 months later and both cats are doing much better. My normal weight cat has only thrown up his dinner once or twice (compared to 4 times a week!) and my overweight cat not only seems more satiated between meals (doesn't ask for food as much) but he has lost a lb or two and has normal bowl movements.Overall I am very happy with this product and am so glad I finally opened my eyes to find a better option. Also important to note that when I compared the unit price of my old food against the unit price of Natural Balance they were almost the same. I always assumed a natural food would be more expensive and I was really wrong.

This is the best, most high-quality food I have fed my cats. After researching cat food ingredients and finding out just how bad most cat foods are, I decided to try this. My cats seem to really like it and it's done wonders for them. My one cat who was overweight is slowly but surely losing weight, and both my cats also seems healthier as well as far as coat health, eyes, energy, etc. It may be pricey, but I really recommend it.

My only concern with this pet food is that it is made with chicken and salmon meal.  I try not to feed meal or by products to them when possible.  However, it is hard to find a dry food that all three picky cats will eat.  And one cat who has a very sensitive stomach does very well with it.  I would recommend it. The shipping was fast and packaged well.

column9: Cat food solves problems for me
column10: I have two cats - one older cat who had started occasionally vomiting after eating for no reason the vet could identify,  He suggested changing to a different food. The other is a young, rescued cat whose coat was dulland rather stiff.  I tried Natural Balance for them. The older cat no longer vomits and the coat of the youngerone is now sleek and glossy.  What a difference!  A little more expensive, but they don't need so much and itis well worth the cost for the wonderful results.  There was no problem with getting them used to a new food -they loved it immediately.

Yes!!! I finally found a quality food that all 3 of my cats love! I have tried several others(halo,paul newman,taste of the wild,core,and others)and this is the first one I can tell that they really go wild over.Plus the price is not as high as some of the high quality foods.If they continue to love it this much and get along well with it I will definatley continue to buy this brand.Would have done 5 stars but it is pricey for normal people and kind of inconvenient to always be buying at a pet store or online but I do like it well.

column9: Natural Balance Ultra Premium Formula Cat Food
column10: My cats love this ! I also give them the Chicken Soup for the cat lovers soul cat food, both the wet and dry.
THIS IS AN EXCELLENT DRY CAT FOOD WITH NO BY PRODUCTS. MY CATS LOVE IT.  GOOD PRICE ALSO.

column9: An affordable healthy option for my kitty love
column10: My kitty loves this, and it's a great healthy choice.  I highly recommend it.  I used to have to hitch a ride several miles to pick up a bag of this (started with the duck and green pea style, and finally settled on this), but now I can get it directly from Amazon.  Hooray!
This was a first time purchase for cat food online... I will do it again!  Cheaper than going to the local pet store and saved me time and energy!  Well worth it!

Didn't work. I thought I would try this food with my cats to give them something different. I figured it has to be boring eating the same taste of food over and over. I currently feed the Royal Canin (#27) and when I received this new food in the mail today, I mixed just a little bit in with their old food. I was going to mix a little more in each day (like your supposed to) but they ended up puking the first day and their food bowl was almost completely full still.I think I will just stick with my Royal Canin since I know they like it and give them that wet food in a can here and there for a treat and a little different taste.

It's a healthy product and the cats enjoy eating it.  I've purchased this product in the past at the pet store and am please to find out that I am able to order this product on-line with free shipping.

column9: No go for the furry family members.
column10: Looks like this bag of cat food will have to go to the shelter or get given away. Both cats do not like this food.  I'm not sure why, it is small enough and is made with excellent ingredients?  Looks like we will stick to the familiar brand from now on.

column9: Best Rum of India !! An effective medicine in Winters :)
column10: I was never having hard drinks, as I'm a Beer lover all the time!It was in one of the coldest winter during college life. I was having cold and it wasn't getting better for continuous 3 weeks.Then one of my friend came to rescue by offering Old Monk. I was reluctant in having any sort of hard drink. But he insisted it could help in getting rid of the cold. And finally I had 4 pegs and it worked like a charm. Cold was gone in next 6 hours and I felt much better.Since then, Old Monk has been one of the best companion during winters, whenever there is extreme cold, I prefer having Old Monk rather than Beer ! And guys this does taste good despite its strong flavor. I recommend just try it once and it can give a run for money to any other international Rum brand !!

I first bought President butter because all I needed was 1/2 pound. When I got it home and out of the package, I knew right away it was different. It is more yellow than grocery store butter and has a pleasant butter aroma. The taste is outstanding: the way butter used to taste when I was a kid. I am on a tight budget, but I make room for President butter. It's the only kind I buy.

I first had President Butter in France; but when the one grocer in the Kansas City area I knew of stopped carrying the butter, I was disappointed.  On a lark I searched Amazon, found and ordered several packages.  With shipping, it was a little pricey but the butter arrived still frozen and I am delighted to know I can still get President butter - once you try it, nothing else will do.

column9: . This is THE BEST butter you can buy.
column10: There is no comparison to anything else on the market. We first came across this butter in Nassau, Bahamas in 2005 and in the recent years we can't get it on the island. Desperation for this butter brought me to the internet. EXCELLENT CHOICE. Rich buttery taste
President Butter has an exquisite taste. It can take even the most hom hum foods and make them great. Makes a panini to die for.
Do not order this product in the summer months!  In the first week of September I only got a small plastic bag of liquid butter and paper.  It wasn't shipped in a cooler.

column9: DRY AS DIRT AND ALMOST TASTELESS
column10: Dr Ozz recomended roast chicpeas as a healthier alternative to roasted nuts.But these things are almost tasteless and so dry it takes a glass of water to wash even a few down.I consider buying these a waste of money.
I like these roasted chickpeas a lot. I usually consume these with tea. Just a palm-full of these keep you full all night. They are healthy and quite delicious.

When I first tried this tea over a year ago, I was instantly in love. This tea has a light but rich taste; the roasted rice lends itself well and almost gives this tea a buttery quality. The quality of the tea leaves themselves is great, with a beautiful deep green color. The tea is worth the price, but it comes with an added bonus: if you buy this online here, you get two tins instead of one-- perfect for gifting or sharing. This tea is a tea I would serve to someone who claims to hate green teas, just to showcase the variety green teas can have.

My wife and I really love Genmaicha tea, and we've had it from several tiny tea shops and purchased loose leave tea from those shops and the taste has always been fantastic. We have a larger tea purveyor that sells strictly Tao of Tea, and we purchased a tin to replenish our supplies.Other Tao teas have been very good. I am, to be honest, very picky as most teas just don't end up being something I like. So, while I definitely wouldn't be a very good judge of many teas, this one I feel I can fairly review.We did not purchase ours from Amazon, however I came across it here looking to replace it. The can we purchased has very little fragrance and looks very dry and not very fresh. For brewing, I use a tea tumbler that allows the leaves to expand, and I do not use boiling water, but around 185 degrees.The flavor of Tao of Tea Genmaicha is very weak and disappointing. I suspect they used a very cheap green tea based on how sad and dry it looked. The brewed product has very large leaves, indicating its probably a later harvested batch, which is typically the cheap stuff. I've been told that the best green tea is picked in April/May and the leaves will be smaller and contain more flavor. This stuff tastes more boring and lower quality than the stuff I get when my friends drag me to get cheap sushi off of the conveyor belt restaurant.I would not recommend buying this tea online, and if you must buy it locally, I would do so and open it up to inspect before leaving the store, as to avoid wasting gas when you return it.

I really enjoy this tea and have tried a lot of different green teas, especially the genmaicha.  This tea has a robust toasted flavor and I have not found a better tea to replace it.  I would like to find a tea with less packaging to minimize waste....
I am enjoying this tea, it is mellow and delicious.  The tea is mostly toasted brown rice with very little leaf.
I buy these on Amazon every time I run out since they are much cheaper than purchasing them through Wholefoods.They are low in sugar and taste delicious. I love them.

I drink the English Breakfast, and Jasmine from this company and am very pleased with the quality and flavor of those. Therefore, I felt somewhat confidant in trying this without a review, oops. While the leaves are of a very good quality, I have yet to find a piece of fruit. It is flavored it seems by only artificial means, and not a very pleasing flavor at that. I  am sorely disappointed, and will have a lot of this tea to figure out what to do with. I tried for the life of me to find a sample size of this to try, but had to punt and buy the regular size, you win some you lose some.

One of the pleasures of a Keurig is that you can serve a friend or a guest a cup of coffee that will please them and their tastes, not just what you brew for yourself everyday.  I happen to enjoy strong, deeply roasted blends (the kind that you usually find at the specialty coffee shops which seem to be all over the place now).  However, not everyone shares my enjoyment of a strong, full-bodied cup of coffee.I have many friends who often say something like "I love coffee but Starbucks is just too strong for me".  Enter Donut Blend.  I have purchased many boxes of Coffee People's Donut Shop Coffee and it is a favorite for many of my friends and family.  When Timothy's announced that they were coming out with the "Original Donut Blend" I got in line to try it.  Here is my take on it:It is certainly a little lighter than Coffee People's version but the taste is more complex with clean, bright notes of spice and low acidity.  Surprisingly, it reminds me a little of the Peaberry Kona coffee that I brought back from Hawaii.  It is a perfect blend for those who like their coffee black or with just a little cream and still want it to taste like coffee.  If someone drinks several cups a day I think that Timothy's Donut Blend will not overwhelm their taste buds and will still taste fresh cup after cup.  Mind you, I drink Newman's Own Bold Blend on a regular basis and will continue to do so, but if I am having more than two cups (for those "special" mornings when nothing seems to go right) or if I am having a cup later in the day I will drink this one.Just rating it on what I want in a coffee I give it four stars, but judging it for what it is (and not just what I like), it fully delivers and deserves five stars.Coffee People Medium Extra Bold, Donut Shop K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) [Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging]

When my wife and I had to make a selection from more than 100 varieties ofK-Cups available for our new Keurig brewer, we made a rating sheet copiedfrom the Keurig listing of all the brands and types.  We marked a ratingof one to five points for each cup we drank for several months. A ratingof one point meant "Perfect, couldn't be better", and five pointsindicated "Don't like this one".  We rated one to nine cups of each of 30coffees evaluated.  Timothy's Extra Bold Parisian Nights came out on topwith the most number one ratings.We found that our preference was for the Extra Bold Roasts.  We do notprefer the weaker strengths.  The Parisian Nights has great flavor andaroma with no bitterness.  This is a great cup of coffee.We're now on our sixth Subscribe and Save shipment of 4 boxes every twomonths which proves our satisfaction with this coffee.

I'm a chocoholic and have tried every mocha, swiss almond chocolate, etc. coffee I've ever seen, k-cup and not k-cup.  This is the best.  It may actually be better than German chocolate cake--it's like a no-cal, fat-free dessert.  My favorite way to drink it right now is to throw in a packet of Splenda and a little bit of Organic Valley chocolate soy milk, though it's good without sweetener or creamer.  It's chocolaty, with a hint of coconut.  I highly recommend for anyone who likes coffee (it's not a weak coffee, like most of the flavored kcups I've tried).  Also, Amazon's price for Timothy's is the best I can find, subscribe and save price comes out to around $0.37 a cup.  Enjoy!!

column9: Good Coffee Good Price  No Waste
column10: Timothy's Colombian Decaffeinated is a good tasting coffee for a good price.  The savings are even better if you sign up for the auto renew program.  Also, we have found that you can use each cup twice.  Therefore it's like getting twice the quantity for the money.  I checked with the Keurig company and they said by processing the cups for two cups of coffee or tea will not hurt the machine.  Best, Al

I bought a Keurig coffee maker for Christmas this year. We all enjoy different coffees in our household and making a pot of any type coffee is a waste. My husband is an espresso drinker, so I purchased Timothy's World Extra Bold Rainforest Espresso coffee to be made with the small setting on the coffee maker which uses 5.25 oz water. This makes it stronger, and he really has enjoyed this coffee. I really recommend this to anyone who enjoys a bold espresso coffee. He was born and raised in Italy and has purchased his coffee grounds from Italy for years to make an authentic cup of espresso. He is fussy about his espresso, so if he likes this one, it must be good.

Thanks to our purchase of a Keurig, I am a converted coffee drinker. Timothy's German Chocolate Cake is my absolute favorite. A delectable blend of warm caramel and coconut gives this coffee a deliciously sweet note while retaining a medium-bodied blend. It isn't too sugary - it's just right! In fact, my hubby and his coworkers all claim this as their number one flavored coffee too. It is scrumptious.

I currently use Coffee People's version of Donut Shop and when I saw Timothy's version I wanted to give it a try. This is not as full body as Coffee People's version but I really like the smooth low acidity taste. If you don't want a bold rich flavor I think you will love this smooth great tasting coffee as much as I do.

column9: Need to brew small cup size.  Check the price!
column10: I have been getting the Coffee People Extra Bold Donut Shop K-Cups but I used to buy and enjoy some of the Timothy's coffees too so I thought I'd try this.  Our family are Dunkin Donut coffee fans.  We even fill the my k-cup with preground DD coffee occasionally.  I found the Timothy's Donut Blend to be very bland, almost watery.  I have the Keurig that allows 4 sizes of cups to be brewed.  I usually brew on the 3rd largest size.  I decided to try this coffee with a smaller cup and it was better, but I wish it worked well at the larger sizes.This probably explains the discrepancies in the reviews.  Those who can only brew (or choose to brew) smaller sizes probably like this coffee.Make sure you check the price before you buy.  Click more buying choices to get to Amazon's price which is almost half the price of Liquid Nation's and it is eligible for prime.  Why doesn't that show up as a default?

column9: If you prefer a smooth cup of coffee
column10: I purchased this item after reading through the reviews on Amazon.  I have to say that I haven't been disappointed. The cups contain a blend of arabica and kona coffee.  They brew with a nice aroma and color.  I would describe them as a medium roast with a medium strength.  Depending on your mood you can adjust the strength by adjusting the cup size and changing your creamer.  I've had success using whole milk, half and half, and light cream, with light cream being the best in my opinion.  The taste is mellow and very smooth.  I have read other reviews here that have described them as weak or tasteless.  This is simply not the case.  I would compare it to the coffee from Dunkin Donuts.  If you prefer your coffee extra bold, dark roasted, or strong (Starbucks) then you are just not going to be happy with these.  Also, if you prefer to "double brew" your cups to get the most for your money, you will be very disappointed.  These will brew a delicious cup of coffee, but only if you use them as directed.  Finally I have to say that Amazon is the best place to buy these.  They have the best prices and fast shipping.  Add this to your subscribe and save to get 15% extra off.

For those who like a bit more flavor than the soft breakfast blends -- this is the best of the bunch.  I have worked through most brand "bolds" and come back to this one every time.  Black Tiger is similar but does not have some of the added flavor notes found here.

What I first look for in a bag of cacao beans is size consistency. With some cacao bean products there are a lot of nib-type pieces and smaller, shriveled looking beans.  The vast majority of the Live Superfoods Raw Organic Cacao Beans were full and plump. They tasted very fresh all the way to the bottom of the bag.  I will be buying these beans from Superfoods again.
These must be good for you because they taste horrible. I eat them with Tamari Almonds and it improves the experience.

column9: I have been using them for 2yr now
column10: They make a difference, it took about two weeks to get use to them in my diet. I eat 1 oz a day. Other coworkers have started buying them too. You can feel your daily workouts improve and your hunger between meals disappear.

I did not know one could order raw chocolate. I was surprised to find it on Amazon.com and very pleased when it came in the mail. I have eaten some but mostly will keep it just to have real cocoa beans.
Small very well built cans filled with suggary not very lemonade or raspberry tasting clumpy powder. Didn't go very far. Dissapointed overall with price vs quality in McStevenson Sipperville Product
Loved em good value. Turned out to be a God send my hubby griped cause I ordered then we got snowed in without other food so he stopped griping.

I used to grind Crema e Gusto beans in a grinder and use it in a $700 Gaggia semi-automatic espresso machine.  After losing the best espresso machine ever made (for $700) to a divorce, I've invested in a $20 stovetop Bialetti and use pre-ground Crema e Gusto.  In both machines the coffee is excellent.  Full-bodied, smooth, never bitter (unless you leave the Bialetti on the stove for too long and come back to a melted handle and rubber gasket).  Excellent coffee.

column9: Strong, yet smooth and not bitter
column10: It's almost impossible for me to find ground espresso locally. My new espresso machine, the Breville BES840XL the Infuser Espresso Machine doesn't have a grinder, so I decided to try this. It's wonderful -- strong, yet very smooth and not bitter. Seems very fresh too, considering it's ground. Makes a super Raspberry Mocha Kiss, which rivals what I used to pay $5 to $6 for at Seattle's Best.Raspberry Mocha Kiss (my OWN version of Seattle's Best)Espresso shotSteamed/foamed milkHershey's chocolate syrup (I use sugar-free)Torani raspberry syrup Torani Variety Pack, Sugar Free, 25.4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)Whipped cream

column9: Finally got the correct kind of coffee
column10: After living in Italy for 6 years the search for the perfect coffee has been long.  While the packaging is different, this coffee is smooth and has a bit of sweet too it.  I use it in the Mukka express I bought while living there and it makes the best cappuccino.Then adding this to the mix, a perfect crema and light flavor make it an excellent mix.

column9: A Rich, Smooth Cup of Espresso...
column10: I purchased this espresso brick for my mother who loves coffee, especially espresso.  While I am not very partial to coffee, my mother can be very picky with the quality of her coffee.  The Lavazza Crema e Gusto turned out to be a very good gift for her.  She loves it!  According to her, the coffee comes out Rich and Full-Bodied, while also being very smooth.  There is no bitterness at all to the coffee.  She makes her espresso using a 3 cup Bialetti, which seems to do a good job getting the flavor out of the coffee grounds and into your cup.For the Espresso lover out there, while it may not be a premium cup of Espresso, the Lavazza Crema e Gusto Italian Espressoo Brick did not disappoint.  You get excellent quality espresso for a fair price per cup ... 5 stars!

I would highly recommend this coffee, it's delicious and smooth. I had never tried this brand until I bought my Bialetti 6799 Moka Express 3-Cup Stovetop Espresso Maker, and wow - what a great combination!

I send coffee to my adopted Soldier.  I tasted the Lavazza arabica in a black tin and I loved it. For this type of Lavazza it is "great Taste". Without coffee, soldiers would be in deep trouble and it "make wonders".So definitely I prefer Lavazza to Illy.  The Illy coffee I bought first time (Moka) was disappointing in flavour and taste.  I usually drink 100% Arabica coffee.  Anyway if my soldier is happy with Lavazza, he will get lavazza till he gets back Home.  It was first time I think he tried this brand.

Although I'm a fan of Lavazza, this particular mix tastes good but is too light, even though I use twice as much as usual.  I also want to take this opportunity to let you know that the Lavazza pods are not good for Senseo.

column9: Of the LavAzza Coffee's this is my favorite
column10: I started drinking LavAzza when I was working with the Italian's as a subcontractor back in the mid 90's in the middle east.  After lunch I would have one espresso to pour over my cup of ice cream, and then I'd have a regular american size cup of coffee of espresso after that.  I never had problems staying awake during the afternoon.  Predominantly we drank the black can version in the middle east. I didn't come across this version until probably 7 or 8 years later.  I think it has a slightly richer fuller flavor than the black can.  If you want to compare it to well known brands, I'd say its close to Starbuck's Italian, but richer, fuller and definitely smoother.  In comparison to the inexpensive Puerto Rican espressos you can pick up in Publix (among others stores) in Florida, it doesn't have the slightly burnt flavor of those brands, but isn't quite as intense either.In general none of the LavAzza brands have that over the top, slightly burnt flavor I associate with French roasts.  If you want a rich, smooth espresso or cappuccino, I think LavAzza is the way to start, just remember to make it in a proper espresso maker.  I've used the standard stove top Bialetti stainless steel espresso maker for the last 10 years  It does a good job, and will last indefinitely.
I bought this for my daughter twice and she says its great coffee.  This is a second hand review since I haven't tasted it but my daughter knows her coffee.

Lavazza is one of my favorite Italian espresso brands and it was really nice to find a brick of Lavazza espresso at a good price. I sent one to a friend who is a coffee lover and he loved it very much. I recommend it if you like good espresso.
If you are looking for a mediterranean taste then this is for you.  Nice coffee grounds but not for expresso, not for my liking.

After tasting another well-known Italian coffee brand I figured it was the right time for Lavazza. The other well-known brand was smooth and rich. This coffee was extremely acidic, bitter, earthy, and old. Very disappointed in Lavazza, especially with all the great reviews.

I purchased this multi pack for my mother, who snacks all day. If you have elderly parents, and you are worried about their nutrition, I think a cracker with cheese is a better choice than cookies. She reported these had an excellent cheesy flavor, and weren't stale at all, thanks to being separately packaged in the 3 ounce pouches. If you also have the problem of a loved one saying "oh, that's too much" or "I can't eat all that", this 3 ounce size is perfect for nibbling, and they can always open another package to get more! I was actually looking for a higher fat and calorie content like these crackers for her, but if you're younger and cling to your pounds- make sure you stick to one package ;)

column9: Mocha Java is a type of coffee not Mocha Chocolate
column10: People please keep in mind that the Mocha means Indonesian and Ethiopian bean blended coffee.  It is not a Mocha Chocolate as some are used to.  It is usually named MOKA JAVA.  Still a great cup of coffee for a Moka Java blend of coffee.  Usually of the light variety, it is quite close.

Since I got my Keurig coffee maker, I have been trying to find the one coffee I could designate as my favorite.  My preference is for something medium--not too strong, not too weak.  The assortment that came with my Keurig was mostly of the dark roast kind.  To me, dark roast tastes somewhat bitter or maybe burnt.  That is not what I want my coffee to taste like.Accordingly, I have been ordering a variety of the so-called "medium roast" varieties to assess them and find the right one for me.  I've had the Kona Blend, Columbian, and Private Blend--to name just a few.  So far, I like the Private Blend and Mocha Java (both by Timothy's) the best.  They are both mellow and aromatic and do not impart a bitter aftertaste.

I ordered this for the "mocha" flavor but really cannot say that I found it.  I will say however that this does make a very nice smooth cup of coffee, so much so that although I ordered this for "after dinner" coffee, I have been making it for breakfast.

column9: Makes a great cup of coffee
column10: To reiterate what M. Collins stated in his/her review "People please keep in mind that the Mocha means Indonesian and Ethiopian bean blended coffee. It is not a Mocha Chocolate as some are used to. It is usually named MOKA JAVA" Thank for that great tip.For a medium blend this is a smooth full bodied coffee with little acidity and after taste. I don't like a coffee that stays on your palate and with you most of the day. I drink my coffee with Liquid creamer and a sugar Substitute. Great flavor if you don't like a coffee that "bites Back"

Having only recently purchased our Keurig brewer, my wife and I have been experimenting/taste-testing with various flavor/vendor offerings. I prefer the flavored variety while my wife prefers the fuller bodied blends. The Timothy's World Coffee, Mocha Java, was a pleasant surprise for both of us. It had the special flavor that I enjoy and the full bodied flavor my wife enjoys. The Mocha flavor was sufficient enough to not have to enquire what flavor was just made for me. It also was not so over powering that a second cup would become sickening. Nice balance! Great price point by Amazon. Should have taken full advantage and purchased 4 double packs for the ultimate savings! We can now add Timothy's to our vendors of choice.Robert

We have had a Keurig machine at work for a year now and I have tried many types of coffee.  The mocha java was so smooth and rich that I broke down and bought a Keurig brewer for home.  I have other types for guests, but this is my favorite.

column4: Coffee Lover in Gainesville VA "Coffee Lover ...
column10: Mocha Java is one of the smoothest cups you will ever have with a full bodied taste.  It is so mellow it is almost buttery.  I love it.

Ever since Green Mountain bought Timothy's , their coffee has not been as good .Big corporation buying all the k-cup makers is not doing the consumer any favor.Timothy's used to be a tight run family business that actually cared about the product. Now Green Mountain cares about one thing and one thing only..sales volume.

column9: Mocha Java is the best k-cup I have found
column10: Timothy's world coffee Mocha Java is the best blend of smoothness and boldness I have yet found in a k-cup. I have always enjoyed Mocha Java and often buy whole beans and grind for use in the k-cup reusable filter but these are close enough to allow me get a good cup of coffee for my commute without having to grind.Definitely recommend to anyone who likes a smooth bolder coffee.
Mocha Java is almost as good as going to Starbucks for a cup of coffee.  I recommend it to anyone who likes the Mocha flavor of coffee

column9: WAY TOO EXPENSIVE & no longer on subscribe & save!!
column10: This is a good blend and I signed up for subscribe & save at $19 for box of 48. We drink alot of coffee so I used to place an order every 12 days. It's no longer available under the subscribe & save program which means it costs much more even at the listed $37.99. Too bad because I won't pay more for coffee. I ordered reusable k-cups and have my favorite Starbucks blend ground for much less than the Timothy's brand.

column9: Sorry to see it go off Shop&Save
column10: This is my favorite Coffee for Keurig. It is my 'First Cup' of each day.I was not happy to see it being deleted from the Shop&Save program.There does not seem to be a good replacement option for this product either.

I've been using my Keurig for about 6 months now and I have tried a lot of different coffees. So far 2 of my favorites are from Timothy's! The MOKA Java is #1 followed VERY closely by the Kona Blend. And to reiterate what was said above, this has NOTHING to do with chocolate, it's a BLEND. It's a fantastic cup and I HIGHLY recommend it (If your not into fake cups of coffee and like the real stuff. But if you like the flavored kind, go for the blueberry by green mountain I think it is)(if interested, a couple of my other favorites are Caribou Breakfast Blend and the Coffee People's donut shop)

I've tried many of the K-cup varieties and have found Timothy to provide some of the best tasting.It was a miracle in itself that I even bought a Keurig machine.  I am a real coffee snob!  I have always ground my own beans and have never liked packaged ground coffee.  But, I found the exception with Keurig and Timothy's World Coffee.  The Mocha Java is one of the smoothest of medium bold coffee.  Not bitterness at all.  I find it very difficult to have just one cup!

column9: ...sorry, like this one least of all....
column10: We've enjoyed the k-cup varieties very much over the last 2 years....but I'm sorry to say that this one just doesn't cut it.  Ok, it isn't chocolate, but it really tastes like coffee that's been burning in a pot for a few hours.  It surprised my husband and me that it tasted so bad since we've enjoyed many of the Timothy coffees.

This is one smooth cup of joe! Not for the expresso lover but great otherwise. You can get 48 k-cups for less than 16.00 if you order during October 2008 and use code KCUPS255; you'll have to subscribe and save also but if you don't like it you can always discontinue. Bet you won't!
First, Mocha Java isn't Mocha...No chocolate here.  This is a well rounded, easy drinking cup of coffee.

Timothy's Mocha Java k-cups are awesome! This coffee smells good and tastes better.We enjoy it all day long. We have been drinking this coffee for two years now and have recommended it to our friends who own the  Keurig Coffee Makers. We order four boxes at a time to make sure that we don't exhaust our supply. We have tried other brands of similar k-cups, but Mocha Java is still our first choice.We have replaced our Starbucks daily habit with Timothy's Mocha Java k-cups.

I have had Mocha Java at my daughter's house several times, and always enjoyed it.  I have a Keurig B-70 model brewer.  My daughter's brewer is one of the old style that does not allow cup size selection (only makes a small cup).  This coffee is great when brewed as a small cup size, being too weak in the normal cup size.

column9: Pricey but the flavor is bright & rich
column10: These k-cups are a blend of Ethiopian beans and Indonesian beans which makes an exotic bright coffee that sits nicely on the palate with a rich finish and it stands up to cream and sugar. I love it for a bolder coffee taste to start my day or for a flavorful cup in the evening to sip while watching TV. If it was a big cheaper I would order it more often.

column9: Taste is great, but packaging is faulty
column10: Have ordered this product twice before with great results or I would not have ordered it a third time.  This time though, out of five 'k-cups' four have been faulty, meaning, they have failed to engage the Keurig coffee maker properly making a huge mess on the counter in my office.  I know it's this Timothy's order because I have cleaned up the mess, cleaned out the coffee maker and tried other k-cups and the maker works perfectly, so it's not the maker - it's the Timothy's k-cups.  I'm very disappointed because I really have liked this coffee flavor in the past and wish it made the product correctly.  I'll keep trying the other k-cups in the box, but with care.  I'm just wondering if they changed up the formulation on their plastic somewhat and this has caused the problem?????

Mocha Java is my favorite of all the k-cup coffees that I've tried so far.  No, I wasn't confused about the "mocha" in the name.  Like others have pointed out, the name comes from a port in Ethiopia - not about chocolate.  I don't like bitter/acidic coffee and this isn't.  I enjoy the flavor so much that I don't need to use as much cream to lighten the taste.  When I want stronger coffee, I use Newman's Organic Extra Bold - my first cup of the day.  Otherwise this is my go-to coffee.

column9: As I suspected, another excellent coffee!!
column10: Mocha Java, a very nice cup of coffee.  No annoying flavors or bitter after taste with this smooth coffee!
My wife and I love this coffee.  The taste is awesome, the hint of mocha makes the coffee sooo smooth.
This coffee is the best! Rich and smooth, just the perfect way to awake in the morning! Will be buying again!

I like this coffee because it can hold it's own against flavored creamers and high brew temperatures. I like my coffee HOT. This often means a bitter tasting coffee. I also like flavored creamers. I know, call me a girl, but it's hard to find a good coffee that you can add a flavored creamer and still get the basics of the coffee. I need not mention then INCREDIBLE deal when it comes to price for this coffee. Subscribe & Save is the way to go on this one. It's a standard delivery for our house now! Did I mention my husband likes it too.

New to the Keurig coffee maker this was our first cup. We really like this system not only for the taste but it makes you feel kinda special brewing your own individual cup.The Timothy's Mocha Java is my favorite even after trying several other brands and flavors. It explodes with a flavor kick and has great taste. No aftertaste, not bitter even after my 2nd cup last night. Medium bold blend, rating 4.0 on our scale of 1-5, but:I am still looking for that perfect 5.0 cup of coffee.

For those looking for a 'chocolate' coffee, understand that this is not it.If you want chocolate in your coffee, then get some Hershey's.For those wanting a good consistent medium coffee then go with this.With the free shipping and discount if you enroll in the subscription, you decrease your per k cup price to about 40 cents, about as good as you can get.
I have to say that I love Timothy's coffee and this product lives up to the timothy's name. Although, I have to note that my wife absolutely hates the taste of this coffee.

I started drinking Mocha Java (which is Not a flavored coffee as so many might think because of the 'mocha" but is rather a region for beans to grow) when I had a subscription to Gevalia coffee and loved the rich flavor of this coffee.  When I got my Keurig I thought I would still have to get the coffee from Gevalia and make it through the filter.  Since I enjoyed Gevalia coffee so much, I was somewhat skeptical to try the K-cap since they tend to be a darker roast than I like.  Wow was I surprised to find the Timothy's brand to be quite smooth, rich and just a great cup of coffee.  I drink my coffee black, so it is important that it not have too much acid and this one is just great.  I have it on my Suscribe and Save to get every month but if I am not careful I can drink this up in no time at all!  It's a little pricy but so worth it to me to indulge and no calories!
We have tried 4 or 5 kinds of the K-Cups and Timothy's is our favorite.

the biggest downfall with Keurig coffemakers is having little or no control over the type of coffee used and yes, I have the insert to make my own.  Timothy's mocha java is one of the better ones and it's not that great.
Timothy world coffees are excellent, I have tried several flavors and enjoy everyone of them. I recommend these coffees to everyone, and I will continue to purchase them myself.
I've tried several brands and flavors for my Keurig and find that Timothy's Mocha Java is one of my favorites. But please do not be fooled, this is not a chocolate flavored coffee.

column9: Did not care for this coffee at all
column10: I was really hoping to like this coffee because the price was right and I liked that I could have it delivered on regular intervals.  The coffee did not have a good taste at all and left a horrible after taste. It also gave me heartburn. I will only buy Green Mountain kcups from here on in.

This is a very mild medium roast.  Not very strong, but flavorful.  I brew it on the 8oz size cup.  Has a sweet and nutty flavor with a hint of cocoa.  It's got one of the best aromas of any coffee I've tried. Even my wife likes to drink this one, and she's usually a fu-fu(flavored) coffee drinker.  This is a really good blend!
Excellent coffee but I recommend using the small cup brewing for a better taste.  I like my coffee strong.

Mocha Java is a must for those who enjoy a mild and smooth tasting coffee, it is comparable to Italian Roast. I tried a few Timothy coffee brands and must say that this is a must for those who like a mild smooth coffee.
excellent BREW and you can not beat having a subscription for purchasing it(quality, price and delivery time)

We have a delivery subscription to this variety of coffee, but not until after we had tried about 15 other varieties.  Timothy's Mocha Java suited both of us the best.  Strong enough for my husband, mellow enough for me.
I love this coffee! A nice flavor, not too strong, just a hint of mocha.LOVE THESE K-CUPS!
Will make a good tasting cup of coffee even on large brew size.  Slight hint of chocolate makes it an enjoyable break from basic coffee without being a "desert drink"
I love this coffee.  I can't really taste the mocha, but that doesn't really matter to me since the taste overall is so good.
This coffee is great for anytime.  It really doesn't taste like mocha to me, just a good cup of coffee.
I ordered this just to try it and I am glad I did!  This is by far my favorite coffee!

column9: Appreciating a good cup of coffee
column10: This was my first time purchasing Moch Java coffee.  Let me tell you this was a real nice tasting cup of coffee smooth and enjoyable.  You won't be disappointed when you try it.  I can't wait to buy more.
For low price and great taste this product is worth to get.  Incredible taste and aroma.  This is the only product i would purchase. it beats out green mountain coffee.
Very excellent mild tasting coffee.  K-cups are great.  A one cupper has never been easier.

column9: Good enough to subscribe to it / Not any more (May 2011)
column10: I wasn't crazy about this while indulging in the first box but have grown fond of it.  I find it irresistible when adding a 1/2 teaspoon of cocoa powder (unsweetened) to the medium size cup (7.25oz).  It adds another layer of taste that brings it up to a more sophisticated level.Added 31 May 2011Sadly, I've grown to crave this cup of Mocha Java.  Why sadly?  Well it is no longer available on subscription and secondly; the price has exploded from $19.55 in January 2010 to the current $33.79 May 2011.  Whaaaat?  Up  $14.24 in just 16 months.  At this price, I can grind my own higher-end coffee and break even thanks to the refillable k-cup adaptor.Gonna miss ya!

Not quite sure why this is called Mocha Java, since the Mocha flavor is lacking.  However, the coffee is quite smooth and it is perhaps one of my husband's favorites.  I on the other hand prefer something with a little more chocolate flavor such as Timothy's German Chocolate Cake. This blend definitely has the hint of choclate that I was looking for when I ordered the Mocha Java but it also has a touch of coconut flavor and a scent that I enjoy.  In Timothy's defense, they don't truly market Mocha Java as a Flavored coffee but rather as a "medium roast" blend of "Ethiopian and Sumatran coffees".  However, unless you really researched this, the name is misleading.
We have a new Keurig coffee maker and just love Timothy's coffees, any flavor, but especially the German Chocolate.  Great price too.
does taste smooth and my boss really likes the taste. I prefer more bold sowish it was a little bolder but still like it.

column9: MOCHA JAVA is highly rated at the K-CUP EXCHANGE
column10: There have been several reviews on Tim's Mocha Java here and on the K-Cup Exchange on Yahoo groups. I just tried it and found it wasn't for me (tough on my stomach). But it tasted great. Luckily, you can trade unwanted k-cups at the K-Cup Exchange on Yahoo Groups. [...]Hope this helps sensitive stomach coffee drinkers

First, I guess I'll reiterate that this "Mocha" is not chocolatey. But it is a delicious, medium-strength cup. Not very acidic,which is perfect for the mornings and an empty stomach.  I actually subscribe to this, because I drink at least one cup of this every day.Also, all of Timothy's World Coffee is fair trade. They pay their farmers a living wage. That is equally important as taste, as far as I'm concerned.

column9: OK coffee, but where's the mocha java flavor?
column10: While this is a nice, dark cup o' joe, I can't even detect the mocha java flavor (not even just smelling it when brewing).
A bit disappointed in this one. Was hoping for more of a taste here. pretty boring.

column9: bold taste, but don't taste mocha
column10: I bought it for the mocha taste, but I don't taste it at all.  It's overall a good coffee, but I was disappointed that it didn't have more of a powerful mocha taste.
I thought since the title of the product was "Mocha Java" it would have a chocolate taste - but it mostly tasted like plain coffee to me.

As another previous reviewer has already mentioned, don't buy this coffee expecting the mocha; you'll be disappointed.  The taste is good so don't think it's horrible, but I just wish Timothy's had flavored it more with mocha as is stated in it's name.
not a bad cup of coffee.. would have liked it to have more of a Mocha taste though.
Good coffee but did not taste like mocha. Not a strong mocha flavor but a good coffee overall.

column9: Just Weak Coffee, No Mocha To Be Had
column10: I purchased Timothy's Mocha Java because of the price and I wanted to have a nice cup of mocha coffee.  What I got was a cup of weak coffee.  There is no mocha in this k-cup whatsoever.  I don't know how Timothy's defines "mocha", but is sure doesn't have anything to do with chocolate.  Do not waste your time and money purchasing this product!

I have given all positive reviews for K-cup flavors except this one, where's the mocha?  Doesn't smell or taste like mocha, not sure what they were going for here but Mocha doesn't seem to be it.  It's not even really that good a cup of coffee, whatever they added in to try and be mocha just adds some bitterness and not much else.  I tried to drink them but ended up tossing most of them away.  Too spoiled by so many other good flavors to waste time drinking this one.Best Timothy's flavor is their Rainforest Espresso, oh wow that's good, and best flavored k-cup overall is Green Mountain Caramel Vanilla, you haven't lived until you've tried that one.  This Mocha, ehhhh, keep looking.
Did not have a hint of "Mocha" - just plain coffee.  I will drink it, but will never buy again :(

I had a few cups of it. Decent coffee but I bought it because it was supposed to be a Mocha Coffee. I'm a little disappointed, not to say that I won't drink the rest of them. If you want Mocha, you better bring some with you.

I love Sahale snacks and this one hits the mark.  It's got a little kick that is very satisfying. One thing that separates Sahale from other snack products is the variety of textures and flavors you get in every bite.  I highly recommend Sing Buri blend.

This is an especially felicitous blend of crunchy pecans and chewy cranberries, spiced up with a little black pepper and orange zest. Good to eat out of hand, and also good to toss into a salad for some extra flavor and texture.

Just get them! We absolutely love this snack! The flavor is unique and refreshing. We even hide the bags from eachother so we get our own stash! The other flavors are good too, but this is Sahale shinning STAR! Thanks for such an "out of the box" snack!

column9: Exotic & Delicious but Amazon product info needs editing
column10: Great snacks, but look at the image of the product to see the ingredients.  Amazon has errors in the information they're posting;  try to see what's in the photo of the product -- the nuts and spices are visible on the package.  Amazon has mixed this one up with the description of another from this same line.

I really don't know how to describe Sahale's Valdosta Pecans better than L. Thorson did: "This is an especially felicitous blend of crunchy pecans and chewy cranberries, spiced up with a little black pepper and orange zest. Good to eat out of hand, and also good to toss into a salad for some extra flavor and texture."After trying this snack I'd purchased away from my usual shpping spots, I couldn't remember the name of it and bought various nut snacks of other brands that I thought may have been the same, but was repeatedly sadly disappointed. Just yesterday I found the real thing again and decided to see if I could get it from Amazon. So glad to see I can. And very happy to see the 2oz size bags. Like another reviewer mentioned, it's hard to stop before eating the entire 5oz bag!

column9: slightly stale-tasting, and sometimes tough to chew
column10: I got a good price on these, so I gave them a try, and as a quick snack they're not BAD, but they have a slightly stale flavor (in spite of being nowhere near their 'use by' date), the dried fruit bits tend to be VERY small and hard, and over-all they're blander-tasting than I'd expect, considering the wonderful and flavorful ingredients that went into them.I can eat them for a quick emergency snack, and wouldn't hesitate to offer them to a guest, but I won't re-order.

I tend to have good luck when it comes to vending machines, and always come across one that has something stuck in a rung, free for the taking once I shake it a few times. Recently I spotted a pack of these almonds in one, shook it out, and gave it a shot. I hadn't tried them before since they were in the 'healthy' vending machine where the cheapest thing is a fiber cookie for nearly one Abe Lincoln. But hey, when almonds are free, I won't turn them down. Almonds are already great on their own, and these suckers add other great ingredients to the mix, making for an excellent snack.You get the usual crunchy almonds, apples, flax seeds(!), balsamic vinegar, sea salt and red peppers. Flax seeds make everything better, in more ways than one, and I'm really glad that snack foods are starting to feature these more. The apple taste is faint but you definitely get it as soon as the almonds hit your tongue, and the red peppers...something that I've actually never had in my life, aren't strong at all. That was my only real concern with this snack when I was opening it. Despite my heritage, I've never had any kind of spicy foods, but I bit the bullet and I absolutely love these.As usual with great snacks, the only bad thing is the price, but Amazon has a pretty good deal on them. While 'soledad' might mean 'loneliness' in Spanish, you'll be able to overcome that feeling as long as you've got a pack of these babies around. Buy some immediately...or shake 'em out of a vending machine.
The Valdosta Blend is by far my favorite.  I love all nuts, but these are really outstanding!
this is a wonderful snack. Has a sweet-sour thing going and is a must-try for nut lovers.

I bought the variety pack and tried this flavor second (see my review for Socorro). I buy natural snacks for my kids (freeze dried fruit etc with no added sugar), but I find them bland. So I ordered these and loved the Socorro, but this one was much more spicy. My 4 year old did NOT like this one - too spicy for her and for me.

I LOVE Sahale snacks!  Especially the black peppered pistachio/almond/dried cherry mix (which is about impossible to find now)I ordered several different flavors of these snacks recently thru Amazon.This one I can't stomach, though.  It reminds me of B.O. (Body Odor)Sounds crude, but it's that bad, in my opinion.  I'll continue to buy Sahale brand where ever I can.  Top notch products!  This one just has a putrid taste to me...

Stumbled upon this snack in Charlotte Int'l Airport - Didn't want to have a big lunch, so grabbed a personal size of this pecan mix.  I read the label and figured I'd give it a try.  Unbelievable snack.  The taste was so awesome that I logged onto my laptop in the terminal to email my wife the link so we could find where to buy them.  You've got to try this snack.  Perfect balance of sweetness and just a little spice to throw you off.  Addictive.  Just ordered some and cannot wait to receive.

I find that this product fulfills my cravings when I want to snack.  It isn't too salty or spicy, just the right amount of both salt & pepper and the cranberries take care of sweet & sour, all in one pouch.  Of course, the pecans aren't too bad as a base for all of this goodness.  I originally discovered Sahale snacks at Costco, but it was only a one-time sampling.  I was very pleased to find them on Amazon.
These are so tasty. The perfect blend of sweet ant spicy heat.  I will be buying more.  Soledad is my favorite.

Valdosta snacks are heaven.  All Sahale snacks are heaven, but this one really rocks.  The combo of the crunchy pecans and chewy cranberries would be delightful enough -- add the pepper and oh!!  Anyone who loves these should order the sampler pack to try the Maple Pecan which is currently only available in that selection.  I'd have to say those are the only ones better than these.  Oh, and if you try them and love them, bug the Sahale guys to make more on their Facebook page.  I do!  *Joy*

The mix of pecans, dried cranberries, salt, pepper, and touch of sweetness is an interesting mix. At first my reaction was just, "Meh" but after trying the third or fourth little bag I was hooked. Crunchy, chewy, salty, peppery, and a little sweet sounds odd, but it works.  I will be ordering these again!  They were fresh, nicely packaged, and the 2 oz. serving is just right for a snack. YUM.
Tried this product at Costco and of course they did  not have them available when i went back to get them. Found them here in the individual size, great find.

I love nuts and have tried at least a hundred different varieties and preparations. These are my favorite. Warm, spicy nuts with tart dried cranberries. You have to be a black pepper lover, but if you are you really need to try these!
LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this snack and so much more affordable here, than buying them at Starbucks (which is where I "found" this little treat).

These are some of the best nuts I've ever tried! Love them! They are unique - slightly sweet with just a hint of spice and the dried apples make a really nice touch.  Wish I could buy them at my local grocery. Awesome! I've tried other Sahale varieties and all of them are absolutely terrific, but these are my favorites.

the soledad blend is the perfect mix of sweetness and kick. i discovered them while on a business trip after missing breakfast... stopped by the terminal store and scanned the aisles for something nutritious with a reasonable amount of cals. then i spotted these - major yum! i started picking them up at starbucks but after a few bags glad i thought to see if i cld order them and never be without. amazon shipped them quick and they tasted fresh. i prefer the 2 oz bags bc i keep a few at work, in the car and take a few when traveling. the size is perfect for tying you over between meals or for those days you're too busy to grab a bite. i've tried other sahale flavors and varieties, but i find these are the best.
Sahale makes quality snacks, and I think this is the best of the bunch.  The pecans are salty with a little peppery kick, and the orange zest/cranberries add the right sweetness.

i first seen this product at my store and i grab one bag i give it chance omg when i got home i open the bag and could not put it back finish the whole thing when back to store and bought all the varietys they had can clomplain i love them all

These are so good. I bought some in a store to try and then loved them so much I bought a case online. They are delicious. They're different than any other nut blend I've had and everyone who I've shared them with has raved how yummy they are.

column9: Oh, yummy--with a bit of a kick
column10: I first saw these at my local Whole Foods, and as I am a vegan nut fanatic (they make for great snacking), I had to try them.  I love how there are no mysterious ingredients, no preservatives, just wholesome fruit and nuts (with a little sweetener).  The Soledad mix has spices that give it a bit of a kick, which is mellowed by the sweeteness of the apples, the brown rice syrup, and the date juice.My only complaint is that when I'm done snacking, many of the flax seeds wind up on the bottom of the bag.  Flax is very good for you--an excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids, but it's hard to eat a handful of tiny seeds.However, if you are looking for a healthy wholesome snack, Sahale's Soledad is a great option.

This mix has a lot going on, and it all works. Perfectly toasted/glazed almonds, chewy little bits of apple, balsamic for tang, and flax seeds to make it officially "healthy". Great for between meals...or even for "the trail"!
My son loves these Sahale snacks.  He is a hay rancher and always has them handy while he is working in the hay fields.Sahale Snacks Soledad Blend 5 oz. 6-Pack Bulk

Soledad is an AMAZING mix--I love how low sugar and high protein it is. My husband loves it to (and he's a junkfood junkie).The cayenne definitely gives it a little kick/heat, but it's not unpleasant (in fact, it's my favorite part of this blend) and I noticed that the heat is strongest with the first couple of bites and then mellows out. It IS a surprising amount of heat compared the wimpy, over-sugared trail mixes/nut blends that are on the market, so be prepared. :)The almonds are whole, high quality, and gorgeous, and the apples are tiny, diced pieces so they're easy to eat, not too sticky, and not leathery. One thing that I thought was weird when I picked up the bag (I got it at Costco) was that the mix felt like it was congealed into one big piece. This is just how it is--the small amount of brown rice syrup makes everything stick together (no, it's not sticky to the touch), but it's very easy to break off chunks or individual almonds.Enjoy! I HIGHLY recommend this mix for any adult who loves delicious, high quality, satisfying, healthy snacks! :)

I did not actually try the product, but I ordered them for my pilots and passengers.  From what I have heard from them, they are GREAT!!.  This is a snack for you take on the road instead of eating potato chips and stuff.  Good snack!!
Yum, yum, yum. The Ksar pistachios are sweet and pleasantly spicy, but TOTALLY healthy! I am allergic to oats, so I can't take regular granola trail mix hiking. This is a perfect alternative!

I have all of the flavors and never remember which is best, but they are all good.  Different nuts dominate each blend, e.g. walnuts, almonds, pecans, macadamias, etc.  They have a bit of dried fruit in each variety, again, all different, and an unusual kick to each. column9: An all natural hot sauce that compliments not overpowers..
column10: When it comes to adding a little kick of heat to some wings, or seafood, pizza or even a burger I turn to a brand of hot sauce that has not let me down in over 20 years of using it.  TABASCO.  What makes me stick to TABASCO pepper sauce, for some added heat, is how it adds the heat.  This hot sauce does not come across overpowering which will destroy the natural flavor of the food.  Instead it adds a sweet "kick" to your food, giving it added flavor while spicing it up a few notches.This product contains Distilled Vinegar, Red Pepper and Salt.  It is a very simple product that is all natural.  TABASCO "Ages" their Hot Sauces in wooden barrels like one might age a wine.  They re-use the barrels after a batch is done so with each batch the flavor continues to stay bold and get better and better.Is TABASCO for everyone? Probably not as it does have some nice kick to it.  However if you are a fan of spicing up the food in your life there is no better brand to have sitting around the house.  It works for almost every food product out there and I personally would say it has about a "MEDIUM" heat to it(2500-5000 Scoville units).  5 stars for a product that has stood the test of time for over 150 years**NOTE: If you are looking for a more "MILD" spice you should try the Green Pepper sauce.  A nice sweet green pepper flavor with very little kick (600-1200 Scoville units)**NOTE: If you want a more smokey flavor with your spice, try the Chipotle pepper sauce.  It goes great with BBQ or meats with a soft kick.  "MILD-MEDIUM" heat (1500-2500 Scoville units)
