column9: It's only a 'taste' - not the real thing
column10: A very watery, toned down version. Very smooth, because there are no solids like there should be. Go to the trouble to buy Chaokoh if you want real flavor.

Normally the Thai Coconut milk is great - very smooth and tasty.  For some reason every can in the 12 pack I ordered was chunky meaning there were chunks of coconut in it.  It's kind of hard to drink chunks of coconut, and I didn't have anything to filter them out.  It was the same kind I always get (I checked the cans a few times) so I'm guessing I got a bad batch or something.

A beach on Ko Samui. A bikini-clad waitress brings you a coconut, then produces a machete. "Pour vous, monsieur," she says, bringing the blade down upon the coconut with a raunchy thwack that strangely excites you. Why did she speak French? You don't care. She unwraps a straw, and places it gingerly into the coconut. "Merci," you say, confused. You didn't order a coconut. Even so, as you sip the sweet sweet milk, the sound of the waves remind you of an old lullaby, and you close your eyes, adrift in the warmth of the setting sun.You open your eyes. You are in your apartment in Brooklyn. Was it all a dream? You are holding a 14-ounce unit of Thai Kitchen Pure Coconut Milk. Eleven units remain--maybe it wasn't a dream, after all.

column9: Cans received were 5/6 through edible lifetime
column10: The cans I received were packaged in November of 2007, and expire in November of 2009, about 4-5 months from now.  Since I will only have 1/6 of the shelf life of the cans, I will give them 1/6 of a full positive rating, or one star.  This is a hazard of ordering from Amazon, I guess.  In a store I would have seen that and not bought them.

column9: It is not pure coconut milk - contains ghar gum
column10: Bought two cans of this brand to make coconut ice cream and one of my guests took one spoon full when I took the paddle out and had a serious allergic reaction causing her hives and other reactions.Since she had previously eaten a different dish with coconut milk from another company we looked to see the difference.  In this case the can said it was pure, but on the label at another place it stated that it contained ghar gum which is apparently used to thicken it so as to make it look more like coconut cream.  Search for ghar gum on the internet and see the possible complications before eating it.No one else had such a reaction, but not all the ice cream was eaten after seeing her reaction.

This is bad coconut milk. It has guar gum which mixes the cream and liquid. They should be separate in the can, solid cream on top and liquid underneath. Tastes like flour and water, can't taste coconut! Very disappointed - made my usual great Thai curry taste poor.

column9: Little Pricey but great way to sample
column10: This item is alittle pricey but it is a great way to sample all the Luna bars before buying.  I live in a rural area that only carry several of the Luna bars and I have been wanting to try other favors before purcasing in large quanity.  This box contained every favor of the Luna bars. It is awesome and I was so excited when I recevied my product and that I can now sample all the different Luna bars!

Hooked on Indian food, but two hours from the nearest such restaurant, I suffer. However, buying a case of Jyoti's Madras Sambar is arguably as good as having such a restaurant closeby. I have never had better canned or bagged Indian dishes; by far the best of the lot. Madras Sambar is a favorite.

In the summer of 2000, I stayed with various families in India and most all served me excellent dishes with various spices to make me smile. Well, since my trip, I've not had a Indian meal served with such excellence until my dear ol' mother had me try a can of Madras Sambar! What a surprise!!! In addition, this is probably the best canned food meal ever!She made mention too how with this 12 pack, each can is only $2.50 with the free shipping off Amazon. That's cheaper than what most stores sell them for. And it's delivered to your doorstep! Thanks mom!

It's 100% vegetarian and very delicious! Easy to heat up and serve! The taste is very close to home-made sambar. We always order a case of 12 whenever we run out of it. fast shipping!:)I like most of the Jyoti products.
Yummy vegan Indian food.  All you need is a can opener and a microwave, and you've got a tasty meal.

column9: The first disappointment for me from Jyoti
column10: As someone who loves Indian/Bangladeshi food, I have been trying various JYOTI foods, given the good reviews here on amazon.Well, this is the third item I tried and I didn't even finish my serving. I found a rather offputting flavor in the stew/soup. Maybe it's the tamarind. Not sure. (And I say this as someone from the Caribbean who used to eat tamarind sno cones and as of last year had some homemade tamarind honeyed-juice my sister made--she has a tamarind tree. I'm not anti-tamarind.)Whatever it was, this was not like ANY lentils or lentil stew or lentil soup I've had in assorted Indian restaurants in the last 30 years. It tasted overly earthy and odd. Maybe I just got a bad batch. Dunno. But I wish I could be as enthusiastic and give a thumbs up like the others here. I do. But I can't. I really didn't love this.I'm gonna open another can later on and try again. But this has been the one major letdown for me from Jyoti. I almost made this one star, but since I give room to the fact that the problem may lie with a batch or with something askew in the can I opened, I'll leave it at two stars.Now, I'm afraid to try another Jyoti from amazon. I may head to my local Indian supermarket and see if they have the saag and try one can. After this experience, I won't pay for a whole case again. Bummer.

Sambar out of the can isn't very great, but cooking it with some water, tamarind and onions for another 10-15 minutes turns it into really delicious authentic south indian sambar. I would say after cooking it tastes as good as sambar at any good south Indian restaurant here in LA.

Madras Sambar from Jyoti is really tasty stuff. Its made of special a type of lentil and eggplant which gives it its unique tang taste. The taste is acquired and i loved the Madras sambar when i had it in childhood the first and only time with rice cake idlis.I have been craving it ever since but never could reproduce the same taste in several sambar dishes i tried till now. Very Good with rice foods!The bad part of this particular product is if you have a little too much, say 1 whole can in a day, the thing will digest and produce ammonia or ammonia smelling thing. I think it comes out through sweat glands. You know what that will remind you of ? Urine!! lol. So have this in medium amounts only in my opinion.

column9: Love Jyoti, but didn't like this flavour at all
column10: We love Jyoti products, but this one didn't taste very good, smelled weird, and was really soupy/sloopy.  The only Jyoti product we just didn't like.Then again, I have not tried any other Madras Sambar so I may not like the dish in general.The Matar Paneer is superb (I know, canned Indian food sounds gross, but it's not!), as is the Punjabi Chole.
once you try this oatmeal you will never eat the instant [wallpaper paste] types again!!! We eat it on a daily basis and have lowered our cholesterol considerly.

column9: Intense Ginger Experience and Digestive Aid
column10: *****This Organic Ginger Tea from Yogi Tea is ideal as a digestive aid, and it also purportedly enhances circulation. It's a lovely, intense, all natural herbal tea made from organic ginger root, organic lemon grass, orgnaic licorice root, organic peppermint leaf, and organic black pepper. The taste is exactly like ginger, spicy and peppery, with sweet overtones. It's very nice anytime, but especially after a meal.Note that this review is for the six pack of Organic Ginger Teas, an amazing savings on Amazon by buying in bulk!I am definitely impressed with this tea and with Yogi Teas in general. Ginger Organic Tea comes with an expiration date (a good thing, because it's not full of preservatives, plus you can tell if it is fresh). Yogi Tea seems to be another company (like Numi, Aspen, Traditional Medicinals) that values sustainable and healthy practices. Their web site has a helpful glossary of tea ingredients and is beautifully designed, with info about each tea they make.Yogi Tea writes this on the box about the tea's benefits: "Our 100% Organic Ginger tea has something to offer to anyone who wants to get or stay healthy. For millennia, herbalists from all over the world have known of the healing, soothing and energizing qualities of this root, considered the "universal medicine."  Organic Ginger (Zingiber officinale) has been used worldwide as a safe and mild home remedy for a variety of conditions, including motion sickness, occasional upset stomach and intestinal gas, as well as minor menstrual cramps. Ayurvedic practitioners have used Ginger for years as a way of activating the body's fire element (Agni), which burns up Ama (the body's toxins, comprised of both undigested food and naturally occurring toxins). When Ama is decreased, the body gains strength, balance and harmony. As a natural warming energizer, Ginger is also known to support the immune system, promote rapid and complete digestion and increase intestinal tone and peristalsis.  Furthermore, it works as an antioxidant and has been shown to safely and effectively relieve nausea associated with motion. Our 100% Organic Ginger tea tastes delicious and provides the highest quality of a timeless remedy."There is a warning on the box that if you have indigestion or heartburn that persists you should see a doctor. There are no other cautions or warnings on the box except the standard disclaimer that the tea is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.Highly recommended.*****
I liked the tea, but did not like the peppery taste. It was too peppery, overpowering the ginger taste.

This tea tastes fantastic. The subtle taste of black pepper and licorice adds a great touch.Be aware that this tea has ingredients other than just ginger, including licorice, peppermint, and black pepper.
I am a true fan of all things ginger, and this tea is wonderful.  Very warming and spicy.

I have purchased Yogi tea for years now.  This tea is fine, but I was disappointed by the slight misinformation.  I'm not sure why they simply call this tea "Ginger" at least on the front of the package.  I am now paying much more attention to the actual ingredients of Yogi teas because this has 4 other ingredients of which 3 are in greater amount in this one.  I just wanted plain ginger tea and this has licorice, lemongrass, peppermint & black pepper.  Black pepper & licorice are very strong flavors especially if you aren't aware they are steeping in your cup.  It's a fine tea, yet holds a misleading title.  That's all.  Thank you.

The tea is fine, but beware of the poor quality of the bags.  Twice in two evenings, with bags from different boxes, I have poured hot water over the bags only to have them break.  I don't have this problem with Alvita, PG Tips or other tea bags.  If you're going to purchase this tea, remember to pour the water first and then introduce the bag.

This tea is absolutely delicious after eating a rather substantial meal.  I served it to friends after having curried chicken, which is a little spicey.  It was the perfect ending to a flavorful meal.  I drink this in the evening....or in the afternoon....or for my morning break.  If you like ginger, and if you like tea, I'd recommend this ginger tea!
I use this as an additive to green tea or oolong.  It's a soothing addition that takes it up a notch.
I found this tea to be a bit bland when compared to the Triple Leaf Tea. What I liked about triple leafe and found lacking in Yogi is the spiciness.

column9: A yogi tea with a hint of ginger
column10: The Yogi brand "Ginger Tea" has a whole lot of flavors other than ginger.  It reminded me of the Yogi Kombucha and the another Yogi tea that was called 'relax' or 'stress relief'.  I guess if you like how those tasted, you'll like this one.  I'm used to the Thai or Malaysian brand ginger mixes that contain only ginger and perhaps some sweetener, and those will reward you with the real gingery heat, punch, and bite.I would call this a "Ginger-flavored Yogi Tea." Kind of like how Cherry Coke was more Coke than Cherry.  If you like the taste and character of ginger, you'll be dissatisfied with this.  I should have read the fine print on the box which proclaimed, "a unique blend of herbs and spices to complement ginger's piquant flavor."  The Triple Leaf ginger tea product at least claims 100% ginger.Come to think of it, if you grate fresh/frozen ginger and steep in boiling water, the flavor is a lot better than any of these packaged products.  But that would be too easy...
I have purchased this tea through Amazon twice, both times it came in on time.  It is a good product and taste as expected

column9: Ginger tea for a ginger haired girl
column10: I enjoy this tea at room temperature - make a carafe of it and sip all day.My only complaint - wish the peppermint were not so pronounced. I like a pure ginger taste.Yogi teas are very high quality, though, so will continue to use other teas from this line until I find my absolute fave. The Healthy Fasting is super great.

If you are looking for a product that can bring you the raw intense power of black pepper then this is the tea for you!! While it was steeping I was actually thinking this stuff smells sweet and delicious... then I tasted it. It was packed with the pepper I was looking for! So again if you like ginger stay away from this tea but if you want a vile brew that tastes of nothing but ethnic pepper then by all means buy as much as you can drink!
The tea overall is good, but WAY too much pepper flavor for me.  It's got a real bite! I'll look for something with less pepper taste next time.

This is my favorite Yogi tea so far. I've tried two of the detoxes and the Relaxation one. I've also tried other ginger teas. But I always come back to Yogi Ginger. (Twinnings has a good one too but I can never find it).I love this tea. It's gingery, spicy, and sweet with a hint of other complementary herbs. This tea is so relaxing and soothes my stomach after not-so-great menu choices. I love ginger so I like to let it steep for a long time with hot hot water to get it extra spicy. It can also be made for very light and delicate flavor if that is what you like. Just adjust the steeping time.Ginger is good for the body but I don't always have time to buy and boil fresh ginger to make myself tea that way. And honestly I'll only take time to do that when I'm sick. Also, I doubt anyone wants to bring a bag of fresh ginger root to work to make tea at the office. So this tea is perfect. It has great flavor--you can really taste the ginger. It's totally portable so it nice way to get my ginger any time, any where.Try it. If you're not sure whether you'll like it or not, try steeping it for only a short while and gradually amping it up until you decide how intense you like to take your ginger tea.
In small amounts a tasty tea but for a whole cup it is just too much pepper for me.  Prefer ginger tea without pepper.

column9: Ginger tea is delicious, light and good anytime of the day!
column10: I love this ginger tea and decided to buy it online from Amazon because it is MUCH cheaper than getting it in the store. It is good anytime of the day and it has a slight kick to it (from the ginger). I usually drink it plain but sometimes add lemon and honey when I am sick to make a great pick me up. Best of all it is caffeine free. It is offered at a great price and I will be returning here to get more when I run out!

Personally, of all of the teas I have tried, I think YOGI is just the best...if you want an intense ginger flavor, this is the tea for you.  This is just one of  many products I have purchased from Amazon...I am always beyond pleased with the product, service and price...THANK YOU!!!

I'm in my 8th week of pregnancy, and I'm currently experiencing the dreaded morning sickness (which is really all day sickness).  I have read that ginger helps with nausea, so I've ordered crystallized ginger, and this ginger tea.  I can't stand the crystallized ginger, but the tea has been very helpful.  Early afternoon, when my nausea is at its peak I make a cup of this, and my sickness is all but gone.  I don't like the smell, but I hate the smell of everything nowadays.  It's pretty spicy and it warms my mouth, throat and chest, and when it hits my stomach it neutralizes the nausea.  Love it.  It's awesome.  Not sure if I'll drink it once my sickness is over, I don't like the taste, but my taste buds are off because of the pregnancy.

I love all things ginger, so my opinion may be a bit biased. Fresh ginger is a favorite of mine because of the spicy, astringent bite it has. This tea reminds me of that, although the spicy bite is probably due to the black pepper added. I've tried other ginger teas, lemon ginger teas, green ginger teas - they all seem to have a dry/dull ginger flavor, and I always come back to this one. I love this tea with a dash of honey. It's sweet and spicy and gingery goodness.

column9: Lemon ginger taste is much more nicer
column10: I have tried both Ginger and Lemon Ginger teas and my favorite is Lemon Ginger.

column9: Good tea...but more than just ginger
column10: Based on the name of the product, I was under the impression that the tea bags contained ginger root.  Period.  It turns out, however, that they also contain lemongrass, licorice root, peppermint leaf, and black pepper.  I still like the tea, but I would have liked to know before buying it that it contained ingredients aside from ginger root.

While I do like this product I must say it is NOT for the person looking for something that is a delicate ginger flavor. You MIGHT get that if you just run hot water over the bag and not let it actually steep in the mug. I went by the directions that say steep 5 to 10 minutes and boy I wish I had not done so! It was so strong that instead of fighting migraine like ginger is supposed to, it made it worse for a little while. I suggest if you want something light in ginger flavor that you go for sweet ginger peach instead of this product. If you want STRONG knock you off your chair ginger flavor that feels like a kick in the face, get this one.

column9: Works good w/nausea but strong ginger taste
column10: yeah yeah...it says it's ginger so why hold back stars for strong taste?...because it's a biting, bitter ginger taste. I have to brew it w/add'l tea bag of other flavor to lighten the intensity...but w/the Yogi Stomach Ease, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6) or Organic Chamomile Tea 16 Bags (chamomile is more bland than stomach ease) the ginger is tolerable.Ginger DOES work for nausea but a quicker, less offensive relief can be had when eating a small piece of dried (sugared?) ginger. The tea I use for maintenance for a particular problem.
Being a Acid refluxer this stuff is great right after dinner. I noticed it helped me considerably so I came on here and got the 6 boxes for cheap.

I first tried this tea about a year ago and I have been drinking a cup of it just about every night since then.  I am addicted!  I like spicy flavors so for me, the intense ginger and pepper combination is really appealing.  I suffer with digestive problems and this tea has really helped me sleep through the night without tummy troubles.  Highly recommended for those who want a zippy, spicy tea that is also very soothing.

I've been an avid fan of yogi teas for years, especially the green teas. I've experimented with quite a few other brands, like stash, celestial, etc, but this brand always seemed to work best, be it the green teas, relaxing teas, cold seasons, etc. I tried the lemon ginger tea while pregnant, especially since I had constant heartburn and indigestion. A cup of this tea with some honey worked so much better than popping tums in my mouth. It's very soothing to your stomach. It also helped relax me enough to be able to sleep in my 3rd trimester. There were times I would pass out even before I finished my cup. When I got sick in my 7th month, I drank this tea with the cold season one, and it worked wonders. Since it helps with clearing out your stomach, I'm assuming it also kept my weight in check as well, though I ate a lot during this pregnancy. My sister-in-law is pregnant right now, and she claims it really helps her with her indigestion as well. I highly recommend this tea.

I have been drinking this tea for over a year now, mostly after meals to help my stomach settle down. It's difficult to find in stores around my area and when I do, it's much pricier than I find on Amazon. Buying this on Amazon has simplified my life and now I always have the tea on hand. Thank you Amazon!
This will stop a bad tummy upset... Gave to my kids... I drink it if at all sick...

When it comes to tea, I really can't get enough flavor. I love the various spices, so I was thrilled when I found this tea. It is intensely ginger, but also amped up with several other spices (Ginger Root, Lemongrass, Licorice Root, Peppermint Leaf, Black Pepper). Trust me, it isn't for the faint of heart.Though there are only 16 bags (less than the usual 20 for most brands) per box, each bag lasts two full (large) mugs without becoming weak. So I find it worth the money. Though I frequently buy tea on Amazon, I actually buy the Yogi Ginger tea from Trader Joe's as it is typically quite a bit less expensive there ($2.29 in my area at this time).

Ginger is excellent for many things that ail you and this product is reasonably priced and suits my purpose.  Nothing thrilling to say, if you want to get some ginger and you can't trek to the supermarket to get fresh ginger then this is just what the doctor ordered.  Also it can be used to make multiple ginger beverages.

column9: My favorite tea for any time - day or night
column10: Excellent tea.  I don't have digestion issues, but am convinced that my digestion remains as good as it is as a result of drinking this (and chamomile) tea on a regular basis.  I highly recommend it to anyone who likes herbal teas AND ginger.
I really like the taste of this herbal tea.  I have been buying it for years.

column9: Great tea at a reasonable price
column10: Ginger tea is a great drink at any hour of the day. Gives the tongue that little tingle which is a catalyst of synapses in one's brain or a digestive panacea for one's stomach. Refreshing in the summer and warming in the winter, it is an all-seasons drink. In a pack of 6 boxes, can be purchased at almost 1/2 the price one would pay in a retail store. Great deal!

Yogi Ginger Tea is great for soothing stomachaches, but I can't say much about the taste. Pepper is the overwhelming flavor in this tea, and I wish the tea were sweeter. It tastes exactly as if you soaked ginger slices in water.
Great for settling the stomach right after a meal.  I drink the tea now in place of taking antacid tablets.  I've just placed my second order and thinking of trying the Lemon Ginger also.

Don't mind the reviewer saying it tastes nasty.  It's quite good, and, as with any tea, you can brew it as light as you want.  I don't think this tea is too strong at all, I brew it with the hottest water I can for as long as I can.It's a very healthy, tasty, beneficial tea.  Highly recommended.e
This ginger tea tasted very peppery, I cannot drink it. Does not taste so much like ginger.

I bought this tea because my job was stressing me out and causing a lot of anxiety, indigestion, etc. and I use and love the other flavors of Yogi tea.  Unfortunately, I can't handle the taste of this one.  It's just too strong - almost burns your tongue because it is so spicy.  I normally like ginger but this is too much.

column9: Good for kitties if you can get them to eat it.
column10: My cat seems to enjoy the other Felidae canned food flavor, so I thought I'd try another flavor, to keep him from growing bored or finicky.He seemed reluctant to eat it at first, and then just refused to eat this stuff altogether. He actually didn't eat for nearly two days. I thought he was sick! Turned out he just hates this flavor.But Felidae is a great, protein-rich brand!

Love the rice... The box it came in however, was a complete disaster, not to mention there was only 2 pounds instead of the promised 5.  I have been ordering products through and from Amazon for more than 5 years, and this is the first time I have had quite this experience. Very disappointed.

This rice is the healthiest rice for your body. The flavor is nutty and crunchy. It is loaded with many vitamins and minerals..much more than you would nreceive with brown rice. Wish it was also in long grain.

The rice tastes amazing. Best I've ever had. The packaging is deplorable. I've orded this a few times, and each time the bag was broken inside an envelope, with spilled rice in it. C'mon! For 15 bucks shipping or whatever you charge, at least get the packaging right. I'd have given it five stars if the packaging wasn't pathetic.
I used it in chicken soup and it turned the soup purple!  Pass on the black rice and stay with thw white variety.

My dog loves these cookies! I just wanted to let people know the box is 13oz and not 14oz as they are saying. One ounce is no big deal so this is just an FYI. No problem with Amazon at all, I use them frequently and this is the first time this has happened.

I am a huge fan of these all-natural baked treats.  I have tried countless treats and rest assured your dogs will love these!  Make sure you smell these when you open them.  They smell like homemade oatmeal cookies in your cookie jar.  My dogs loved these treats!  I was searching for quality no salt no sugar treats for some time that my dogs love and I found them!  The Three Dog Bakery LicknCrunch are also amazing.

column9: Great Taste but buy it cheaper from your local store
column10: These pastes are great. You can also use them with Yoghurt as a marinade for any kind of meat. Leave it overnight and grill it the next day. I cannot believe the price on Amazon. You can get them at most large Indian Grocery stores for about $ 1.50 per packet. $ 5 is an absolute rip off...AND you pay extra for shipping.....ridiculous!

These were perfect for medium-sized canned escarot.  I could bake them in these shells, so it makes an impressive treat.  Be aware most cans of snails this size (appropriate for these shells) will contain 20 or so snails.  One of the shells I received was rather brittle, and I am concerned about serving it, afraid some could come off into the food.

Bought these to replace some old shells.  They were in worse condition than my old used ones.  So brittle and most broke with the first use. Unless making it for 2 people you'll need more more than a dozen to serve.  Also, If only making it for 2 people, how do you find a can of snails with only 12?  I find they always come in 20-24 quantities.  The ones that do come in 12 count are GIANT snails (read: way too large to fit in these shells, you'd have to halve the snail to fit, leaving you with 24 snails) So either buy multiple bags of crappy shells, throw away half your can of snails, or serve it 2 days in a row.  None of which I'd recommend. I found the shell size to be small, I enjoy a large shell that can hold lots of butter. MmmmmmI would recommend these if you are a 1 time shell use person, but honestly who does that!. They are cheap and will last you a setting or 2.  Once a shell cracks I find them useless as they wont hold the buttery good stuff.I would recommend checking out this product.  Great price, good quality, and some cans of snails to boot!:Roland Snails & Shells, Giant , 12-Count Tubes (Pack of 2)
I bought these for my Shell Dweller cichlids and they love them. Have a nice wide opening which is great for the bigger Shellies too. Thanks, Eric

Although I ultimately decided not to use these when I baked my escargot, they were an inexpensive item and all shells arrive unbroken.  I still have them and plan on figuring out some other decorative way to use them.
Don't be fooled by the fancy french name. They are nothing more than snail shells.

column9: Old lollipops. Don't waste your money.
column10: I usually buy my Charms lollipops at BJ's, but they only sell the assorted box.  That is why I was willing to pay more for this product. When I received the package the box looked old.  Like it had been setting around a warehouse for some time.  I decided to try one and regretted it. The lollipops are way past their "freshness" date.  They are nasty.  Don't waste your money purchasing from this seller.  I wish I would have read the reviews before I spent my money.  I requested a refund.  I think I'll stick to buying them at BJ's where the lollipops look and taste fresh.

I do enjoy the sour apple blow pops so I was excited to receive this package. First off, it did take some time for this package to arrive. Secondly, as I opened the first blow pop, it looked pretty old but I was expecting some to be in that condition. But basically every single one I opened so far, each one looked very old and not fresh. I am very disappointed that this company would send off the product in this kind of condition. I will never order from this seller again and very disappointed. Wish I could receive my money back but I know that will not happen. Save your money and purchase somewhere else.

column9: Love sour apple? Love bubble gum? You'll love this product
column10: I must confess that I am addicted to these and am thrilled to be able to purchase them in bulk. Great price for a yummy treat!
I've had a few boxes already and they've always tasted fine.  I can't really compare them to a local stores since they don't have any. A few different companies sell them, I buy the cheapest ones.
Charms Sour Apple is the Best ! the others are good too , but since I was a kid many moons ago and still as an adult with my nieces and nephews .. we all squabble over the sour apple ones.

I ordered several items from same seller Mex grocer.  They sent me a one pound size package of corn husks instead of the 8oz.  They arrived clean and large pieces, no mold, no corn silk stuck to the husks.

column9: Two out of Three ain't bad... kind of.
column10: I just received my order for El Guapo corn husks. Two of the 6oz packages were fine. The third was moldy and no good.

I read all the reviews before I bought the corn husks and it was all good reviews so I went ahead and orderd 3 packages. Big mistake the first package was all dirty with bugs, corn silk, and mold. I expect the package to have some corn silk and some (2 or 3 ) molded husks, but when I have to throw all 3 bags,  away that makes me mad and I'm not going to return husks I already opend and tried to wash. So it was a big waste of my money and thoses of you who gave them a good review were either working for them, lieing or are lucky they got good husks.
What a great enrichment toy for our shelter cats! Just cut & tie together & viola-a toy! and spray with some catnip & the cats go crazy!
I like the low acid coffee because it does not upset my stomach. The Puroast brand is the most flavorful that I have tried.

The boys love it!  When they are driving me crazy tag-teaming for attention, just rub some of this on their favorite toys, and they are very quickly occupied.  First, they beat the daylights out of their toys.  Then, they may play fight for a while.  Then, they "sleep it off".

column9: High grade catnip for the headiest cats
column10: This catnip comes on the twigs with the dried up buds attached. Most catnip, including Sojos, comes pretty finely ground.  This catnip they just clipped the stems and let them dry and then put the whole thing in the bag.My cat really likes it.
good fresh product- very stong scent and my cats rolls all over it. Not quite as sry as other buds I have gotten but still very good and MUCH better than the ground up stuff in the pet stores.

column9: A little messy, but the cat loves it!
column10: My sister's cat absolutely loves this stuff. The only downside is that it gets EVERYWHERE. Otherwise, perfect product. I wish the bag were a bit bigger, but the cat seems to only need a little at a time, so it shold last quite a while.

This catnip was a tremendous hit with all of my cats! Nice chunky buds on the stems that my cats seem to prefer to the powdered catnip. Good packaging and I'll definitely be ordering this product again.

column9: My cat loves this ... but he doesn't get "high".
column10: My cat loves this catnip.  We put some out for him almost everyday and he eats it up.  The only difference between this and other brands of catnip we tried is that he doesn't get crazy or playful or even sleepy on this like he does on others. column9: Da Cat go crazy for these
column10: These catnip bud are Exactly what I was looking for.  Fluffy little buds of cat nip still on the the stalk.  We can take a few out and feed them to our cats directly.  The scent is very distinct and smells fresh every time.  Great product

My cats like good catnip but I've *never* seen them so frantic. No mess-they're licking the floor trying to get all the molecules. They actually scarfed those big dry buds. They'll throw them up because there was no chewing involved. Cosmo is sliding along the floor and contorting in ways that aren't possible.They're both longhaired, fluffy cats and Darwin's fur is sticking up at weird angles and is studded with the leftovers.Now they're beating the tar out of each other with looks on their faces that say, "I will kill you -I HATE YOU!." These are normally sedate kitties. I better keep buying it for my safety.
That's enough said.  The babies went crazy.  The product came when expected and in the expected condition.  I would certainly buy it again.

When I bought this product I was expecting my cat to go crazy with this stuff due to the reviews, boy was I wrong. It does nothing for my cat, absolutely nothing. Waste of money. Catnip that came that with a Christmas stocking gift pack was a 1000 times more effective.
I had great expectations for this product. Sheila seemed to like it at first but the potency, even left in the bag, seemed to decrease in catactivity. OK for short period of time but fades!!

We initially bought this item as a gift, but our cat found it and SLASHED the bag open with her claw. She ate one of the buds in its entirety. She then laid down for like 2 hours without movement and even let us pet her belly (she never normally lets us do that). For the next 24 hours we watched her be crazy.We never normally give our cat any nip.This stuff is WHACK! hahaa..

column9: even works on the most discriminating of kitties!
column10: My cat snubbed her nose at most nips...until she met Bellrock Growers Catnip.  It's an excellent product! Perfect for the pickiest of cats - I mean, those with a refined palette.

My cat isn't too fond of many catnips but she took to this stuff right away. She's a fan of the Bellrock treats as well which was a big factor in my buying this product. I've always gotten high quality products from the Bellrock company.
These are great for poking in the big Kong because they take some work for the pups to get them out. I like that the packaging is all recyclable and it keeps them fresh.
They smell great and my dogs love them. They appear to be of great quality (with non-gluten ingredients), I am tempted to have some with tea :)

column9: Are you a Celiac, Wheat free, or Allergic to Wheat?
column10: I am allergic to wheat.  I don't merely have the problem the average Celiac suffers, for the last 15 months, I have a topical and violent reaction to wheat.  I have the epipen, avoid at all costs wheat germ in my shampoo, and any would be assassin need only have a handful of flour to do me in.  Note to my enemies, retaliation can come at any time. j/kAnyway, losing bread and pasta is one of those lamentations for all Celiac, related intolerances and allergies face.  This corn pasta is the best though.  You need a meat sauce in my opinion to cover up the corn, and a good rinse is vital, but treat it like pasta.  Boil in water, but don't overcook.  Rinse with cool water and bring the temperature to cold quickly.  Serve immediately with sauce, in baked casserole or as a macaroni and cheese.  Buy in volume and the price is more than reasonable (we buy bread from Jason's deli for 12 dollars a load, this is a godsend and far cheaper).  It will crumble over time in the fridge, but so would good homemade or store bought pastas.If you are not allergic to Wheat, I'd still bet on another pasta, but my Wife isn't wheat free and enjoys it(or grins through it).  I call it a good meal and worth the time.

I was shopping around for nutritional yeast, and based on the price and the reviews I found online, I decided to go with this brand.  It is definitely packed with nutrients and is a great source of many vitamins and minerals.  It's flavor is good, although this is the first nutritional yeast I've bought, so I can't compare it to other brands.  The smell upon first opening the jar seemed a bit strong, but it wasn't as bad after using it and opening/closing the jar a few times.I am mostly writing this review to let other potential customers know that this product is NOT VEGAN.  I guess everyone defines veganism a little differently, but this nutritional yeast contains whey from milk, so if you don't want to eat dairy, or can't for some health reason, you should be aware of that before you purchase it.  I will quote the ingredients list from another website:"Other Ingredients: Nutritional yeast, calcium carbonate, whey (from milk), magnesium carbonate, potassium phosphate monobasic, choline bitartrate, niacinamide, potassium chloride, d-calcium pantothenate, para aminobenzoic acid, bromelain, GTF chromium yeast, inositol, cyanocobalamin, ferrous sulfate, selenium yeast, papain, pyridoxine hydrochloride, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, sodium chloride, zinc sulfate, manganese sulfate, biotin, folic aicd, potassium iodide."This is the same as what is on my jars' labels.  You can get the entire nutritional facts and ingredients from the Twinlab website [...]  It's a nice product at a reasonable price in a large quantity.  In fact, it's going to take me a while to go through two pounds of it (how much yeast can a guy eat?).  When I finally do finish it, I won't be ordering again due to the dairy, but if that doesn't bother you, I would actually recommend this product as it seems to be a good deal.  I gave it four stars because the dairy thing was really my fault.  I should have done some more research of my own.Happy shopping.
I have used this product for many years and I had recently moved to another state and could not find it. I checked amazon and found it. I highly recomend this product.

Brewers yeast is loaded with many essential nutrients.  It is packed with nutrition.  I especially love this Yeast Plus product as it is even more loaded with vitamins and minerals.  Brewers yeast is not something to write home about as far as taste goes.  So, I mix a heaping tablespoon into my smoothie every time I make one which is several times a week.  That covers up the taste.  I especially take this product because it is loaded with B vitamins and potassium.  Though brewers yeast is not great tasting, another advantage of this product over others is that it seems to have a much milder flavor.  Sure, it's not ice cream, but it will do a whole lot more to benefit your health and well-being.

I'd give it three and a half stars, couldn't decide between 3 and 4.I use a lot of nutritional yeast, mostly for popcorn flavoring. The taste of this one isn't my favorite. It is a rather strong taste, but I'm glad to have it for variety. Good value for the money.It is a dense powder. Most of them are light and flaky. This means I can keep a lot more in a small container at work.

This is the first time I tried this yeast, and since I liked it, ordered another one. It is quite powdery and not flaky. It has a strong smell I'm not used to with yeast, but I like it nonetheless. We use it on popcorn and in soups and (as hippie as this sounds) put it on our fried tofu with soy sauce. I trust Twinlab and that is why I was willing to try it.

column9: Who expected to find milk products in "nutritional yeast"?
column10: TwinLab super rich yeast had RAVING fan reviews; and looked to me like it would be the right choice.I am on a totally vegan diet for personal health reasons, and "nutritional yeast" is a frequent ingredient in vegan recipe books....Imagine my disappointment when i received the product (Amazon really is Amazin' at fast shipping), pulled out the product, and tried a taste.Something didn't seem right.  A closer look at the ingredients told me why.The third ingredient is "whey (from milk)".Egad, boys and girls! THAT's NOT VEGAN!Well, I'm not blaming anyone but myself.I lapsed my habit of reading the label before buying, and did so at the wrong time.And I will find the "nutritional yeast" of my dreams; oh, yes I will.I know you are out there somewhere; and I shall not rest until I have found you.

column9: Charms Blow Pops Cherry Lollipops - 48 pack
column10: Great product! Have ordered a total of 5 boxes so far. They are perfect if you have quit smoking. I love Charms Blow Pops, especially the cherry ones.

Charms Blow Pops Cherry Lollipops - 48 Lollipops/Boxnot much to say about Charms Blow Pops Cherry Lollipops. they taste great and if you eat one a day like i do you have a mouths supply. win i got them i counted them it had 49 one extra in it. great buy!!!!

I've found after drinking a cup, I have less of a need to take ibuprofen or other OTC pain killers, as well as feeling much more calm and relaxed. This tea is great. I like the taste. It helps with constipation too. But what I really found helpful about this tea is calming my PMDD. My PMS was getting really out of hand. I was getting to the point where I could hardly function during my pre menstural. When I drink this tea regularly it's incredible the difference I see. Really helps me with my irritability and bloating. This tea has become a necessity for me.

column9: Best natural pain relief out there for severe menstrual cramps
column10: This is a MIRACLE tea!I'm a 24 year old, otherwise healthy & fit woman who has always suffered from severe menstrual cramps. Every month, I used to take LOADS of ibuprofen and pamprin for 3-4 days at a time so that I could function and go to work. I saw this in a health foods store and tried it, because I was desperate and it's cheap! I thought the benefits would be as a placebo, or the psychological comfort of drinking something warm when you're in pain. I was mistaken. I feel it actually does a great job of preparing my uturus for "that time" and keeping it relaxed and efficient when the time comes---meaning a lot of effective, natural pain relief.How I use it: I start drinking 2-3 cups of tea per day beginning 3-5 days before my period starts, and then even more if I start cramping. The first day or two of my period, I might have 5-6 cups of tea. This tea TASTES GREAT (not medicine-like at all) and you really can't overdo it. I've been able to wean myself off the ibuprofen to where I'm not taking more than the labeled ibuprofen dosage (about 1/4 of what I was using before). I don't suffer from prementrual symptoms (just agony during menstruation) but I have girlfriends who do and they swear this stuff works for that as well. Amazon has the best price anywhere. Do yourself a favor and try this at least once. If you're a MAN reading this (I know, what are the odds): buy it for your significant other! She'll thank you for life (or until menopause)!

I like this cozy tea. It really does help with stopping cramps and other PMS miseries. It is good to drink it as soon as PMS symptoms start bothering you. Drink a cup of it two or three times a day during your period.

yoga tea's women's moon cycle is a godsend.  i have suffered from pms since i was a teenager (for me it is manifests as irritability, sensitiveness and exhaustion). i start using this tea at the first sign of pms symptoms, usually a day or two before my period, and then continue to use for the first two days, when my cramps cause pain.this tea smells and tastes wonderful - reminds me of baking something with cinnamon and nutmeg.i try to squeeze a few cups out of each bag. if you are using this for cramps, go ahead and drink it throughout the day. it really does help!! better than advil!if you are considering trying this tea, don't hesitate. really. it is wonderful.

I'm an active woman in my late twenties with no other physical problems apart from severe PMS/PMDD (symptoms including 3-4 day long migraines, fatigue and body pain, skin rashes and emotional upsets). I started drinking 2-3 cups of this tea (single-strength) about a month ago and noticed a HUGE improvement in symptoms- going from that laundry list above to a few hours of fatigue and a headache is enough to make me stick to this in the long term. Just to add, this list doesn't include cramping so I can't say whether it would help with that.. though I imagine it might.Previously, I've tried other herbal teas and never noticed significant differences (improvements/ worsening). This tea was the first to make such a significant difference, and not have any side effects either. The taste and smell were both quite soothing too!

I love this tea, I have used it for years.  I used to use plain raspberry leaf tea (that's what relaxes the muscles and eases cramping), but this tea adds other ingredients, plus ginger, which is just so warming to the body, and when it starts warming me up, I feel more relaxed, and that makes the cramps lessen too.  Sometimes I still pop an ibuprofen if it's a bad month, but always having this tea on hand really makes a difference for me!I drink it throughout the month too, often in the winter because of the warming qualities, or when I feel stressed, because the muscle relaxant ingredients do help with that as well.  I'm a skeptic about most things, but I'm a believer in this tea!

This tea has worked miricles!  For at least 6 years I have had migraines associated with my period. I reacted to the perscription migraine meds.  As the years past, the severity of the headaches increased as well as the duration.  I have taken this tea the last two months and only had a very minor migraine the first month- none the second- which has never happened in years. I drink cup every other day when I'm not on my period, then increase it to 1 to 2 cups a day the week before.  Then the week of my period I drink 2 to 3 cups a day.

Never in a million years did I think that herbal tea actually worked.  This tea proved me wrong.  The taste leaves something to be desired, so from the start I was not impressed.  However, the cramps I had been suffering all of a sudden whooshed out and left me feeling better than I do during the other three weeks of the month.  It was amazing!  I would suggest this tea over any western medicine for your moon cycle!

This tea has saved me so much pain from cramps.  It really works.  I used to take up to 9 advils on my bad days, after taking this tea a few times I got down to 2 to 4 advils - and most days I don't take any advils any more.  And I don't even take the tea during the month, just on my cramp days.
This tea lives up to its claims;  it really works!  Tastes good too!

column9: This tea is like a Christmas miracle.
column10: That's the text message I sent my sister yesterday.  And, yes, it's only August.I hate to sound overly dramatic and prone to hyperbole, but this tea is worth its weight in gold.  My periods have been more and more painful, especially in the years after ditching the pill and turning 30.  Days 1 and 2 are pretty horrendous, with me laid out on the couch with a heating pad and 3-4 Aleve every 8 hours.  I get the kind of cramps that cause hot flashes and bouts of nausea, and about the only thing that helps is lying completely still with my eyes closed.  I'm fairly "lucky" that days 1 and 2 never occur on a work day; I don't know how I'd get through the day.This time around - at the advice of other reviews here - I drank two double-strength cups of this tea right as my cramps were hinting their arrival (so, a total of 4 tea bags that evening).  I drank another bag of tea first thing the next morning, and was able to walk my dog for 2 miles in the heat and humidity.  Major, major feat for the first 12 hours of my period.  Throughout days 1 and 2, whenever I felt cramps coming back, I immediately brewed a bag of this tea and drank it.  Within 15 minutes, the cramping was gone.  That's faster and more effective than any pain reliever I've tried.  Normally, I end up taking at least 12 Aleve during a cycle.  This cycle I took only 3, and those were only a precautionary before I went to bed.  I fully anticipate not having to take any pain killers next month.I cannot say enough good things about this tea.  It's the only thing that's ever worked for my wretched cramps, and it's natural.  It feels as if my life were handed back to me.

column9: Didn't relieve my PMS but it did get rid of my migraines!
column10: I've been suffering from mentrual migraines for years. Drinking water, taking the right vitamins, and exercising regularly reduced the frequency and the intensity of the migraine but I would still get them. And it was getting to a point that Excedrin wouldn't even touch the pain. Well, my worries are over (almost). I took this tea during my last cycle and I only got two migraine epsisodes compared to 7-10 I usually get. I was so thankful!I originally bought this tea to relieve my PMS, namely fatigue and crankiness. The tea didn't help with those symptoms and it actually made me more grouchy and I felt like I was getting hot flashes throughout the day (hence the 4 stars). But compared to lying in bed with a migraine and being utterly useless, they were nothing.

I have very serious period cramps problem. I have to take painkillers every time to stop me from kicking pillows and rolling on my bed. SInce I've been taking painkillers for many years, I was looking for a healthier natural solution than chemical painkillers. I found this product, read some reviews and decided to give it a try. Last month, I drank lots of this tea during my period- about 5-6 tea bags a day, and to my surprise, I experienced my first period without pain in many years! It also reduced my tiredness. I don't like the taste too much(I added lots of honey) but I don't care because the effect is satisfying and it's natural! : )  Love this product!!!

I've had this product for just over 2 weeks and first of all, I hate the taste of the tea. It's pretty vile to me and tastes spicy and like licorice. I am a serious unsweet tea drinker, I love testing them out, and usually love them all. Despite that, I find myself having at least 2 cups a day because it makes me feel so calm and relaxed. I've tried many teas and herbs to help calm my mild anxieties, and this one surprised me at being the best of all!If I drink it during the day, it relaxes me and makes me feel at peace but still able to function at top level. If I drink it at night, it helps me fall asleep and sleep well. When I wake in the morning, I am not groggy, I just feel ready to start my day and refreshed from the great sleep!I find it also helps reduce pain with headaches, so I'm taking less Advil than normal. I received this tea when my cycle just started. I found I was still in a lot of pain, however, I did feel more relaxed while drinking this. I'm hoping if I keep drinking during my whole cycle, it will have an even better effect, but we will see. Even if it just makes me feel more relaxed during that time of the month, and keeps helping with the headaches, it is so worth it! I highly recommend this product to anyone

I admit that I was at first skeptical of Yogi Woman's Moon Cycle Herbal Tea, but after drinking it daily for the past month, I am now a believer!  Usually I suffer from moderate to severe menstrual cramps during the first two or three days of my period.  However, this last period was almost pain-free!  I drank one to three cups of double-strength tea every day and experienced only mild cramps on one day.  I will drink this tea from now on!  Oh, and it's delicious.  No sweetener needed! :)
Though at first I don't like the this tea because of its strange flavor, but soon I got used to it. It really works on me! Don't need to take painkillers anymore with this tea.

The first month I tried this tea I still had pms pains of headaches and bloating and intense cramps during my period.  I was a bit turned off by the taste and smell as well in the beginning.  But I continued to drink it around the next month and noticed my usual pms bloating went down with my food cravings and headaches were non-existent.  I felt like something was "wrong"...and questioned myself if I was going to skip my entire period?  Well a couple days before my period I had a lot of twitching feelings in the lower abdomen than I have had in the past but no spotting.  My period was pushed a little further past my regular cycle. On the night I got my period the pain was extremely MILD on/off and only lasted until the next morning instead of the whole day.  I'm on the 3rd day and have absolutely no pain and taken way less ibuprofen than I have in the past.  The second day of my period is usually the most painful and this is a huge change for my menstrual cycle and pms.  Another thing I notice is the blood seems to be flushing out of me faster/more heavily.  Highly recommend.  Worth a try and even if it doesn't work for you it's still good tea.

column9: This tea really controls those hormones...
column10: I cant say that it gets rid of my cramps completely - but this tea works has worked wonders for my acne, weight gain, mood swings, and crazy appetite the week right before I get my period. I almost couldn't believe it. Now before my period if I just cant stop eating, I'll drink a cup of this and feel much better.
I love this tea for PMS but anytime I feel stressed it's a great comfort. It's got a very strong herbal/earthy taste which I really enjoy.

I must say that for prepackaged tea, Yogi Tea is my favorite tea.  High quality ingredients, unique flavor blends, that seem to offer some aide.  While I personally prefer Calming or their Bedtime tea to the Woman's Moon Cycle, I must say that drinking this tea does help lift the spirit.  I do like the flavors better of Calming and Bedtime, but this has an execellent flavor as well.
I have suffered from menstrual cramps for as long as I can remember.  Just a cup or two of this tea helps reduce the severity and duration of the pain.
This is one of the best things invented to alleviate cramps.It has worked wonders for me.

I absolutely love this tea. I had bought the pack and it sat for a month before I even thought about trying it. I am not a tea drinker and thought this would taste terrible and do nothing for me. Then when my cycle started and was having really bad cramps I gave in and made a cup. It tastes wonderful and actually helped me relax and ease a lot of the pain. I had my doubts about a cup of water with dried herbs sitting in it being able to do anything for me but it really does help to ease the pain and help your body relax. I now find my self having a cup every night. I would definitely recommend for any women.

I was definitely skeptical about this tea before I tried it, so I have to say how pleasantly surprised I am. I tend to get very bad cramps. I'm talking advil every 4 hours, hot water bottle on my lower abs, all while I writhe around in pain. I know that taking so much advil isn't good for your body so I really wanted to find a natural remedy to alleviate my cramps. I wasn't sure Moon Cycle would work but it really does wonders. It eases the cramps and I definitely feel more relaxed after drinking it. The smell is bit unpleasant to me, but the taste is good. It tastes like fruit and cinnamon and maybe cloves. Whenever my period is starting, I know to get my Moon Cycle tea ready.

I love the taste of this tea!! It's so sweet similar to honey or brown sugar. I actually take this tea to encourage my monthly cycle (my body doesn't want to cycle regularly on its own for some reason) and I found that this works better than provera. It encourages my own hormones without adding extra hormones to my body. I recommend this for any woman who has difficult or painful periods, or women who just don't get a period at all. It has parsley and dong quai which from what I read helps to bring on a delayed period. Which must be why it works well for me. GREAT STUFF, GREAT TEA!!!

This stuff is great for PMS. I drink 2 bags of it at a time and I'll have 3-4 cups of it in a day sometimes. It's very calming and it relieves a lot of PMS symptoms. Like all Yogi teas it has a nice, but interesting flavor to it.

I suffer from severe menstrual cramps that, at their worst leave me vomiting and doubled over in pain. The mood swings from the pms are another story. After reading so many glowing reviews about this tea, I decided to try it for myself. Let me tell you, I feel like a normal person during my period for the first time in my life. Drinking this tea along with taking Hyland's menstrual cramp pills Hyland's Menstrual Cramps Tablets 100 ea have made my cramps so light that I only had to take one 200mg ibuprofen to take the pain completely away. I feel like I don't even have my period, which is something that never happens. This tea is a Godsend!

column9: Not the most amazing, but definitely take the edge off.
column10: I get very bad cramps that make me dizzy, nauseous and have pain radiating all throughout my abdomen and lower back. Midol and ibuprofen don't do that much for me and so I'm always open-minded when it comes to things for cramps. I didn't have high hopes for this tea, but I was pleasantly surprised. The tea greatly reducing my bloating, which is usually quite severe (I sometimes look like a pregnant whale) and did make my cramps a little better. Was I still in pain? Yes, but it wasn't quite as bad.

I have suffered from debilitating cramps and PMS symptoms every since I was a pre-teen, both of which are aggravated by ovarian cysts. I started drinking this tea a few years ago and it has offered me considerable relief of my symptoms without drugging myself into oblivion with OTC painkillers. I find this tea works best if it is drunk throughout the month, and upping to 2 cups a day right as symptoms start. However, it doesn't do too well in stopping symptoms once they start.

column9: Didn't help with severe menstrual cramps
column10: I took it for a few months and I didn't notice any difference. I drank 2-3 cups a day for at least a week before my periods but it still didn't help. I had severe menstrual cramps though. By severe I mean the kind that make you throw up before pain killers start working, feel like you're going to pass out, and writhe in such pain that you are unable to do even the simplest things. This tea probably won't help if you have it that bad.

column9: I love this tea, it's so good!
column10: This is really great tea.  Very, very good.  I am usually the type of person who HATES warm tea, but this stuff is definitly the exception.  I love it.  I make several cups of it a day with 1 - 2 small teasoons of honey.  It's also great without honey.  The Yogi "Woman's Energy" tea is also great too, with a lot of the same ingredients in it.  I am so glad that I gave this tea a chance, I really, really like it.  You should drink 2 - 3 cups a day through out the month and 4 - 5 cups a day during your cycle.  Which is pretty easy to do because it is so good.  I keep a tea kettle on the stove with hot water on my warming unit so I cane make tea through out the day.  You should steep the tea 5 - 10 min but if you forget about it and steep it longer it doesn't taste bitter or gross.  I haven't had this tea long enough to see any benifits from it yet, but I will update my review later.  I look forward to trying their other teas.
I suggest starting this tea a few days before your cycle, and continue a few days afterward. The taste is not awesome, but it did seem to help.

column9: good if you are not allergic to chamomile
column10: Yogi Tea's Woman's Moon Cycle tea could be a lifesaver for you, as it has for so many reviewers here. Personally, I don't like the flavor very much, and for me I find that it doesn't mitigate my symptoms much, either. Your Mileage May Vary, naturally. For a long time I was having a cup every morning, thinking of it as a daily tune-up; maybe I built up a tolerance...? I ran out of the Woman's Moon Cycle and started relying just on the Yogi's Ginseng tea, which includes Dong Quai but not the raspberry leaf that is supposed to be such a help for women (I have a horse-owning friend who says it works on mares, too!!), and I haven't noticed much difference in how I feel.Finally, some people may not realize that they are allergic to chamomile. It's a common traditional "relax and sooth" ingredient, and is in a lot of teas (it's also what Peter Rabbit's mother gave him after his adventures with Mr. McGregor!). For the people who felt nauseated using this tea, or find it has a laxative effect, that may be an allergic reaction.I would love to find something that really does help with the water retention and the hyper-sensitive emotions that come at different times in my cycle. For me, this tea is not it. Blessings on all of you who get such benefit from it!

column9: I like it but my body hate it
column10: The first time i had it I was put off by the aroma of the ginger. I hate ginger but the tea had a good, spicy taste. The downside? My cycle had been normal up until this point but after drinking it this month my period is 4 days early :( and I'm not happy about it. Parsley is an emmanogague and is the last ingredient on the list. Vitex can also mess up the cycles when they are normal. With a sensitive body I guess the parsley combined with the other herbs caused me to ovulate earlier in my cycle thus bringing down an earlier period. It took years to make my cycles normal and I was using this to manage the PMS and pain I get associated with my moon. Will not be using again :( 3stars for the sake of someone else's luck with it because I know I'm out of the ordinary.
I'm not really a fan of the flavor and I think it gives me a sore throat. I'd like to think it works, but I don't think I'll be buying another pack for the reasons I've already listed.

This herbal tea is huge aid in reducing symptoms of pms.  I started using this years ago and was buying it from the local health food store for about five dollars per box.  I used it a week before my cycle and then every day during.  It made an immediate and very noticeable improvement.  My husband bought it for me when I started running low.  He noticed that I wasn't the witch I used to be when I drank the tea.  I make sure to keep this stuff on hand all of the time now.  Another thing I also drink is fresh lemon balm tea which also helps very much.

My PMS has gradually worsened over the last several years to the point where I really only have one good week a month. I was desperate for something to help control mood swings, breast tenderness, etc. and make me feel normal again or at least not so grouchy. This tea has done it! My breast tenderness is nearly gone and I feel normal, happy, and am a more pleasant wife to my dear husband! We both are very happy with this tea. (I drink 2 cups per day two weeks prior to my period and increase it for the week prior).

column9: This tea keeps me from bloating....awesome tea!!!
column10: I am doing my natural thing and not buying any overcounter medications and I am not on any presc. meds. I know when I use to be on my period I used to take a motrin or midol. I had headaches and bad cramps, the medication did take some pain away but not all you know it just suppress the pain.Well, ladies I have came across this tea, and I have to tell you, it took all my pain away. I know everyone's body is different so it might worked differently for others, but I know for me it worked. I know my body and I feel a difference no bloating. I loved it some much I ordered the 6 boxes. As for my husband he couldn't understand why I needed that much tea but it would be for his sake if I kept the tea in the house or all hell will break loose. For me the tea me had going to the bathroom, fleshing my system out, the way midol or pamprin would do but without the medication.So if you want to try something natural for pms or cramps I say buy one box and try it out, it is so worth it. I know I drink like 3 cups of day a couple days before my period and when I am on my period. I love this tea!! Enjoy!!

column9: A must have during your moon cycle!
column10: Really works! This is a well researched and well balanced combination of herbs. The key ingredients are red raspberry leaf (amazing), dong quai and vitex - all great women herbs. Also included is calming chamomile and warming cinnamon & ginger. You might need to use 2 tea bags and drink fairly frequently but its indespensable. Its also worth exploring their plain Yogi Woman's Raspberry Leaf, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6) - not as tasty but very powerful. PMS can be greatly helped by their Womans Energy tea which is great to use any time during the month.A must have during your moon cycle!

This tea works surprisingly well at controlling PMS symptoms - I make sure to always have some on hand.  I'm so glad that I discovered this!  I've shared it with several friends, and they are always amazed at how well it works.  Moon Cycle can be hard to find in stores, but it's always on Amazon, and for a great price, too!

column9: Tea works wonders, but I hate the smell & taste
column10: I ordered this tea to help with bad periods. I have painful cramps and I feel very prone to migraines throughout the week of my period. I recently drank about 2 teas a day during the week of my period, and it really helped. I can tell when I feel prone to migraines, my head/scalp, neck and left eye feel a certain way and I can just feel I need to be careful or I'll get one. I always feel very close to getting a migraine during the week of my period. Drinking the 2 cups of this tea each day this week has done wonders, it greatly diminished or totally got rid of my pre-migraine symptoms, and I had virtually no cramps as well. The only drawback is I really dislike the taste of the tea and the smell. I think it's the fennel in it. So I just try to chug it down and eat something afterwards to remove the taste.

I've been taking this tea on and off for the past 6 months. If I don't take this tea I'm irritable, have severe mood swings, cramps and sometimes even fever during the days leading up to my cycle. Taking this tea daily 1 1/2 weeks before my scheduled time eliminates the moods, the headache/fever, the cramps, everything! It also helps in the cleansing process itself. No side effects and no harm to your system make this tea a MUST. I'm buying another box :)

I discovered this product a couple of years ago and I've been hooked.  I get the worst cramps every month, so bad that I have to take advil even though I hate taking anything for pain.As long as I start drinking this tea 3-4 days before my period, all is good!  My period arrives on time and the pain is gone or tolerable enough that I don't have to take advil.  I go through a whole box that time of the month b/c you have to drink it all day for a few days before/during your period to make sure you stay ahead of the pain.If you get horrible PMS, bloating, cramps or headaches before/during your period, I highly recommend you try this product before taking pain killers.

column9: Give it a try at least?
column10: I have can have very bad PMS symptoms... I think this helps? At the very least, I don't mind the flavor and it keeps me from drinking soda or coffee which would make that all worse.  I notice no negative side effects, so I will continue to stock up on it.  This got delivered timely and I like that it is in bulk because only 1 store in the metro area (the huge natural foods store) sells this kind of Yogi.

column9: Can really notice when I am not drinking it
column10: I have had hormone problems in the past couple of years and after getting them tested and realizing they are way out of balance I went looking for natural products to help.This is one of my favourites by far.  I have been drinking this for 3 cycles now I usually start 2 weeks out with a cup of day and 1 week out increase it to 2-3 cups a day.  I can notice when I haven't been drinking it, my emotions start to get out of control and I feel very stressed out.It has a good blend of herbs that are proven to help relieve pms symptoms and balance your hormones.  I will keep ordering this tea!!!!
It's perfect tea for special days.I ordered a big pack a month ago. It really helps ease menstrual symptoms and there are just herbs...I will buy it again.

I am not a fan of tea. I do not normally drink the stuff, any flavor, any type, for any symptom. BUT, I am now a believer. This tea is amazing. I suffer from severe cramps (Yes, I do cry because of it.. I even sometimes ask my sister to punch me in the stomach so that it would take away from the pain!). I have tried prescription pain medication and birth control to alleviate my pain. The prescription pain meds always made me sleepy (which is terrible while I'm at work, or need to drive) and for personal reasons I am not on birth control at the moment. When I wasn't taking either, I would take between 6-10 ibuprofen each day for the first 2 days of my cycle. Don't get me wrong, I still have to take it, but not nearly as much. So far, I have only drank the tea during the cycle, usually about 5 bags each day. I have done this for the past 3 months. But, I am going to start drinking it throughout the month... I'm hoping it will help the initial monstrous pain I get when my cycle decides to surprise me.Also - you can't beat the subscribe and save price. I was paying $30+tax (for 6 boxes) before I found it here!
This tea has worked very well for me. It helps with anxiety, bloating, and cramping. It generally keeps me in a good mood.

column9: Does not work; severe cramps continue
column10: As I write this, I am doubled over with pain and so nauseated I can barely keep from throwing up.  I am on my third cup of tea.  Yesterday I had four, and before that I had two, then two again on the day before that.  So I can say with absolute assurance that it does not work for me.  Please don't waste your money on this product if you have debilitating cramps each month, because this tea will not so much as "take off the edge."  It seems only those women who are lucky enough to have "minor aches and pains" each month will find relief from their symptoms with this tea.

column4: End of the Dream "end of the dream"
column10: As a long-time green tea (and coffee) drinker, I was much pleased with this Genmaicha Tea.  The brown rice is roasted sufficiently and in sufficient quantity to give a nice balance to the green tea, both sharpening the flavor while sweetening it a bit.  But don't get confused: it is not a "sweet" tea.  The brown rice gives the tea a sense of "hops" as one would find in a quality brown beer.  If you are a fan of the style of Genmaicha tea, I heartily recommend trying this brand.  I'll be back for more!

Our puppy (small breed) loves these and we could previously only find them at the vet's office.  They can be broken into pieces for training as well.  It is much more economical to purchase 6 packages at a time.
Our little dog loves these treats.  I think all dogs like Butler Lean Treats.
Good training treats and healthy for pups.  One small treat can be broken into 2 or 4 for training.  My dogs love them!  Very good for small pets.

These treats are loved by big and small dogs.  My daughter's Rhodesian Ridgeback and Yorkie love them.  My mini dachshund loves them as well.  He will do just about anything for one of these treats.  They are good for training too!  And, best of all they are LEAN treats that won't put the pounds on your animal.
this product is great.  my dog loves it.  i had to purchase it from my dog's vet.  the problem was that i got shipped a different product than what i ordered.

Lean Treats are the healthiest dog treats. I have ordered them several times and will continue to buy both this superlative product and well as order from this company. Orders arrive quickly and are well packaged. Ten stars for Lean Treats!

column9: Not the variety advertised, but still good
column10: The description states "6 packs of 7 different flavors" and that it is "available in four delicious flavors: Chocolate Supreme, Chocolate and Raspberry, Chocolate and Mint and Chocolate & French Vanilla."  First, I should have known there would be issues since "6 packs of 7 flavors" equals 42 packs and I only purchased 36.  I received 24 packs of the Chocolate Supreme and 6 of the Chocolate/Raspberry.  I thought that I would also be getting the French Vanilla and Chocolate Mint.  While the hot chocolate is delicious, just beware that you may be getting a surprise variety and not exactly what they specify.  Still a good price for it all, but I really wanted some Chocolate and Mint hot chocolate!!

column9: Did not include Chocolate Supreme Flavor
column10: This product does not ship with all of the flavors that were advertised. I received raspberry, mint, and french vanilla. I received NO plain chocolate which is the best of the flavors, in my opinion.The raspberry and french vanilla taste fake and chemical-y as well as being too sweet even for a sweet-tooth like myself.Save yourself the trouble and bad aftertaste: only order Chocolate Supreme. Avoid the Variety Pack.

column9: variety pack only came with two flavors
column10: Description of product lead you to believe there would be four flavors: vanilla, raspberry, supreme, and mint. Product only came with 12 raspberry and 24 supreme. VERY deceptive, would not buy again.
Not as described - except by the other reviewers.  Only had 3 flavors.  Canceled my subscription and will buy the flavors I like individually.

Butterfingers i would have to say is the best chocolate in the world. With its milk chocolate cover and its crunchy peanut butter in side! Its delicious!!!!!!If i could i would rate this item on a scale 1 to 20 with 20 being the best i would give it a 20!!!!
i love butterfingers and i am addicted to if since i was in highschool, i live in dubai and i order it frequently from the internet.............. yes i am crazy
Shouldn't order it when hot outside. They arrived slightly melted, but otherwise all was fine.

Butter finger candy bars are a time honored classic. Other than snickers, there is no better tasting candy bar IMO. You really can't go wrong whenever you order your favorite candy via Amazon. The main reason people buy foodstuff like this on the web is to buy in bulk and perhaps save yourself a little money. You can also save on gas because buying like this keeps you from making repeated, short trips to the local, around the corner convenience store in search of your favorite candy bar. Amazon is always good and I did save a few bucks by buying two cartons. I actually purchased these for my mother and not myself so she should have enough to last her for awhile.The biggest disappointment I had with this is the seller took too long to get the item to me via FedEX. They should have shipped USPS. Only use FedEX and UPS for expedited shipping. If you wanna keep the shipping charges down to a min. and get the item AQAP, always ship USPS.
They are Butterfingers -- how can you go wrong? If you are buying these, you know they are good, so why even go on with my review?!
This product came up when I searched for butterfinger bbs, so I ordered them and was very dissapointed to find out this was not the product I wanted.

I have always love regular "cinnamon tea" in bags.....Celestial Seasonings, etc. I received this as a gift, never heard of H&S, but here I am buying more!I have a nice large thermos that I USED to use for coffee at work, but now I drop in a sachet and it is perfect for the just over 2 cup capacity. The good part is, that if I leave it for too long, it isn't bad cold, like coffee is! This is delicious tea.

column9: Great Cookies but unfortunately lots of pieces
column10: I love these cookies, they are my favorites. And the price is a good price. The packaging was very good, the original box from the manufacturer placed in an Amazon box, with all the requisite protection. I don't know what happened, but every bag that I have opened so far, contains about half full cookies, and the rest in various states of brokenness. They still taste great and I don't really mind. However, if you were giving them to someone, I think it would be somewhat disappointing.

I remember going to Knott's Berry Farm in California several times when I was a kid.  The line of jellies and jams were delicious, as well as all the other treats they had there.  These cookies bring back those memories.  They're delicious as can be and ought to be in every home where shortbread is appreciated.

I love these cookies, but I am very disappointed at Amazon. I bought 2oz package (Pack of 32) and chose Two-Day Shipping. When I got the cookies I found out the expiration date is coming soon. Only "23 days" left. The label is AB091910. If my understanding of expiration date is correct. Can Amazon sell food to people like this??  I even have no right to return it. Very disappointed!!

column9: Love this cookies, love the packaging
column10: These cookies taste great, and are a great deal compared to other snacks that I could buy.  The packaging not only makes it convenient, but also means I won't eat too many.  Much better then paying $1.50 for a candy bar at the corner store.

Was craving these as the vending machine downstairs at work only stocks them occasionally. Wish they were sold in stores. So had to resort to finding them on Amazon. They arrived quickly and in great condition. Hopefully I can make them last over a month before I'm forced to reorder more. Nom nom nom.
i love this cookies,will recomend to my friends&family and even to my enimies.thats how much i like them you will too ,wen u try them!.

I really like these cookies. They arrived in good shape and were fresh. I have to admit I personally prefer their Boysenberry cookies but other family members prefer these. I like them both. I really like the 2 oz packages to keep me from overdoing it.
I like this cookies.Raspberry jam filling in the cookies tastes very good.But.. It's too sweet for me.

I absolutely love these cookies and I can't find them in the stores. I can find them once in a while in a vending machine. Although they were a bit harder than what I can get out of a vending machine, they were still good!

With the apparent demise of Red Bull cola (or at least reduced availability..) I've been looking for an alternative with similar taste, and I was hoping Flatt cola would be a reasonable replacement.
