On a whim, I ordered the 16-pack.Well, it honestly exceeded my expectations. Nice crisp, lightly spicy flavor, great design on the can & packaging, and good energy supplement content. If you're looking for a Coke or Pepsi clone, this isn't it.. but if you want something that tastes unique with the added benefit of an energy drink, give it a try.  Highly recommended.
Flatt Cola was so good, the pack was gone in two days. I'm definitely going to buy it in the future. I had my doubts, because it said "Flatt", but it actually has a strong taste.

The product is great.  It gives you a boost and is very smooth tasting, unlike some energy colas.  It actually has less of a syrup taste than I am used to, but that is definitely not a bad thing.  The one and only negative aspect is the size of the can.  At 8.5 ounces, it is gone within minutes.  But, I guess they marketed it that way so that you will buy more.  Not a bad strategy from a marketing standpoint.
I love Flatt Cola i drink atleast one can a day it is deffinatly my favorite soda/engery drink i highly recommend trying it.  Flatt cola rocks.

So far this has to be my favorite of all of the "Energy Cola"s I've tried. More carmelly than Red Bull Cola and less spicy than Howling Monkey.The thing that attracted me was their marketing reminds me of long since gone "OK" soda.I was also quite happy to support a local business.

A decent product though the price is extremely high for 16 cans shaped like the smallest cans of Red Bull (a fairly overpriced and overhyped energy drink) and relatively speaking has similar quantities of caffeine vs a regular can of Coke if you are only getting 2/3rds liquid volume.This cola drink is $1.50 each can and the lack of info on it sort of was of concern, and that it is a small 8.4 ounce can.For awhile I was getting good deals on Red Bull Cola. This was a result of people in America discovering that Red Bull Cola contained de-alkalyzed (the alkaline being "cocaine" extracted) coca leaves, they stopped buying it--or at least--Red Bull stopped selling it on the market. In fact to most people's ignorance all Coca Cola still has a small(er) amount of de-alkalyzed coca leaves (though they will vehemently deny this, just like they denied ever producing Fanta Orange so that the embargos of cola bean (and coca leaves) from South America would not impede their sale of product to Nazi Germany, and so that they could also advertise for the Nazi Jugen.) Anyway the drug supply ran out and I was getting itchy for some substance; maybe the drinks had hints of alkaline after all and I wasn't feeling it with this one.Decent and it reminds me of the same spirit from Howling Monkey Cola; I was also a little dissapointed that Rockstar Cola wasn't being produced in mass quantities and seems to have stopped.

column9: Amazing, good to the last drop.
column10: Give this cola a try. It's unlike anything else out there. A smooth tasting cola with the right amount of caffeine to get or keep you going. All this with natural cane sugar and vitamin C. Maybe more importantly, without the energy drink taste. I'll be ordering more.

When I first tried this product, I wasn't thrilled...the sauce was a bit gritty and clumpy...and REALLY strong.But I've found the solution.  Add extra dairy substitute (I use unsweetened rice milk) to thin the sauce out a bit and stir CONSTANTLY to prevent clumping.  Add 1/2 a bag of frozen peas to the pasta when cooking...and then once it's completed...refrigerate it overnight, and microwave the next day.  That is the secret.  The sauce has time to rest and becomes creamy and develop a mild, cheesy flavor.  I really recommend this!

column9: Excellent for children and adults with dairy allergies!
column10: My son is highly dairy allergic and this is the ideal way for him to eat "mac and cheese", while the other kids at daycare eat the original version. We use unsweeted rice milk and the recipe works perfectly. To bolster the nutritional content, although it is already a healthy product, add any kind of frozen vegetables to the cooking water when you make the shells. Our whole family has gone to a very low level of dairy consumption because of my son's allergy, so we don't eat many cheese products and aren't comparing this to Kraft or Annie's (we've never even tried them). If you eat it hoping it will taste just like what you are used to, you may be disappointed. This product has a lot of flavor, is healthy, and has a nice consistency. We have all come to enjoy it. I feel so fortunate that there are products like this and like Sunbutter (another favorite) that give kids who have allergies similar choices for common "kid foods". Plus,the company is also very Earth-friendly and there is no better price that I have found than this one!

We've been making and using the macaroni and chreese products for years. The Shells & Chreese is our favorite. When my kids were teens, they could make this for themselves. Now that my son is at college, I send him a case of these at least once a semester, because he can make these easily at school. When I make it, I add a bit extra milk and a small amount (1/2 - 1 teaspoon) of Earth Balance margarine for flavor. This is easy to make and tastes great. Very convenient.

I don't eat dairy, so I miss out on the convenience of certain pasta meals that often come in blue boxes. They may be not super nutritious, but they're easy comfort food, and this is a great alternative. Okay, so Chreese doesn't really taste like cheese. But it does taste very good in its own right. The flavor is sort of a nutritional yeasty, garlicky, salty yumminess.  Maybe it's because I really like nutritional yeast, or because it's been years since I had real cheese, but whatever the reason, I LOVE Chreese. I also love that this product isn't too shabby in the nutritional department, with 14 grams of protein and 7 grams of fiber per serving, plus B12 (25% RDV), and iron (15%). Definitely worth trying if you avoid dairy.  There is an equally delicious version made with whole wheat pasta if you want a bit more fiber (or prefer your noodles elbow-shaped): Road's End Organics Mac & Chreese, Organic, 6.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)

column9: Easy to prepare, good texture and filling
column10: I love this product.  After making my homemade versions of mac and cheese-less sauces and coming up with mediocre results and spending more time in the kitchen than I wanted to spend, this product is a dream come true.  My son is 11 and once he latches onto something he likes it's hard to convince him to change to something else.  At his age health reasons are no motivation to avoid dairy.  We're both lactose intolerant but can 'get away with' some dairy.  I'm vegan, but he'll still eat some dairy cheese pizza and mac and cheese on ocassion.  I continually try to come up with alturnatives, but when the cheese versons are so quick and easy and frankly taste better, it's a constant battle.  Until we found this product.  He claims it's as good if not better than the cheese versions (Amy's or Trader Joe's) and actually likes that it's creamier and more filling than those cheese-based brands.  I don't know how the reviewers (with fewer stars) prepaired theirs, but we used Almond Breeze unsweetened milk and put a little more than the recommended amount of 1/2 cup, maybe 3/4 cup, and it made it smoother and less sticky.  Using a wire wisk might help too, to mix the sauce before adding the pasta.  Then we added alttle sea salt and pepper and some Vegan Grated Topping by Galaxy Nutritional Foods.  Yum.  My son can prepare it himself and I can feel good about the ingredients.I'm happily ordering a new case of 12 boxes...  Oh, and they're also extremely lightweight and convenient to toss in your bag and take along with you when you travel to visit non-veg family.

I'm vegan and have been craving some yummy mac n cheese for some time. After reading such good reviews about Amy's frozen vegan mac n cheese, I couldn't wait to get my hands on some. However, when I finally did try it I was pretty disappointed in the artificial taste and ooey gooey (in a bad way) texture. This is coming from someone who normally likes Daiya cheese. WTH?A week or so later, I saw this Mac & Chreese at my local Wholefoods and despite feeling really skeptical after my last experience, I bought some.For the milk, I used plain, unsweetened almond milk and a bit of earth balance butter and an extra special ingredient, mustard! Just a little gives a very cheddary taste. I was surprised! It seemed a bit garlicy, but I didn't mind, I like garlic! I'm craving it again right now. Next time I might try it baked with extra cheese and bread crumbs.As for the texture, it was pretty spot on for me. Very cheesy. Also, it's WAY cheaper than Amy's icky mac. Yay!

I am vegan and although I don't crave other types of cheese, I absolutely LOVE this mac 'n cheese alternative.  I highly recommend adding more soy/rice milk than the 1/4 cup the package instructs you to add... I use at least twice that, plus a little melted Earth Balance, and I stir vigorously with a whisk (as with any powdered sauce, this is critical to avoid clumping).  It's important to let the sauce cook until it turns yellow - if it's still peachy in color, it's not done.  Anyway, aside from needing more liquid than the box calls for, this is pretty  much perfect as is.  I sometimes add a bit of salt, and as other reviewers have mentioned, it's great with frozen veggies added.  I add broccoli or peas.  It's healthy and natural and so easy to make, I eat this for lunch with my 10-month old son all the time - he loves to eat it and to hear the sauce squishing in his little fingers.  :-)  Btw, I ate this CONSTANTLY when I was pregnant - a super easy protein source which I could fatten up by adding extra Earth Balance if I was craving fat.  I'm not sure omnivores would be impressed by this product, but if you're vegan or allergic to dairy, give it a shot.  I can't get enough of it!  I'm on the Amazon subscription service now!!!

column9: Excellent Cheese Alternative for the Dairy Allergic  or Vegan
column10: If you are used to macaroni and cheese, this product is not for you, but if you have a dairy allergy or are vegan and long for a cheese substitute - this fits the bill.  The sauce is a cheese-like consistency but does not contain milk protein of any kind.  It is based on nutritional yeast.  The taste is different from cheese but quite good.  If you have allergies in the family, or are vegan this is a quick and tasty meal.Road's End also makes some gluten free varieties and the chreese sauce mix is sold separately.
I'm surprised people like it so much -- to me, it tasted like the sauce was about 90% garlic. Very overpowering and non-cheesy flavor.

I'm a vegan and have prepared a couple different homemade "mac and cheeze" recipes at home, and all of them ended up in the trash. I saw this at Whole Foods today and thought I'd give it a shot. Those who say it has a very strange odor and/or taste probably aren't familiar with nutritional yeast, which is one of the main ingredients and what makes it so strong-smelling. I added about 3/4 cup unsweetened plain soy milk and 1 1/2 tablespoons of organic Smart Balance (lower calorie earth balance, also vegan). I cooked the sauce in a separate sauce pan and added it to the drained pasta after it had cooked and thickened a bit. I also added maybe 1/2 teaspoon of mustard. Sauce was very creamy, but not big on flavor really. I ended up adding salt, cayenne pepper, and after all else failed, threw in maybe 1/3 cup of pepperjack daiya (don't usually buy that stuff either so it was lucky I did today!). After the addition of a little Daiya it was really good. It was relatively cheap for being a vegan cheeze product, I think like $2.00 or so. I will probably buy it from time to time, but I can't give something that came in a box a 5 star review when I had to add so much to it (and change the cooking instructions!) This is probably great for vegan/extremely lactose intolerant kids who haven't ever really had the Kraft stuff. Definitely better than the real thing nutritionally (well maybe not after I was done with it...).

We have been vegan for about 9 months and have purchased this twice now.  We use 1cup soy milk and heat it up with no butter or added fat. Nice and creamy and a bit garlicy- yum! Fed it to non vegan kids and they liked it too.

I know I should not have expected this to taste like real mac and cheese, but I did. Someone else reviewed it as tasting like cardboard and garlic, they were right. I'm sure with the right add ins it would be better, but I wont be buying again after I finish this case.

Ok, so it's not really cheesy, but it tastes good in it's own right. It's as quick and easy to make as real mac & cheese. While the shells are draining, I let the chreese sauce heat a bit in the pot. It give it a bit more creamyness. It gave me something good to eat while going through chemo when my mouth was sore & my stomach was upset.

I am a vegan who used to LOVE my mac and cheese.  That is the one thing I have really missed. So i decided to go out on a limb and try this version by Roads End.  I am so glad I did! this is amazing!! The flavor is great- it has its own very distinct flavor but it doesn't make me miss the real deal for even a second.  I use almond milk in mine to make the sauce I pour a little in over medium heat and stir the cheeze mix until it has broken up and creates a thick sauce.  Then I add the pasta back in stir it up and the last item I add is a little Daiya cheeze mix it up really good and you have oh so cheezy mac and cheeze.

column9: Finally, a vegan mac from a box!
column10: I've always made homemade vegan mac 'n cheese, but it was a little time consuming.  Finally, I found this product.  While it's not as good as my homemade, of course, it is an excellent choice for a quick meal.  I love nutritional yeast, which is a main flavor in this box, but for those who aren't familiar with it, it may be a slightly odd flavoring.  Not bad at all, just different.  Especially if you're expecting it to taste like traditional mac 'n cheese from the blue box.  If you like nutritional yeast you'll love this box.  If you've never had nutritional yeast, give it a try!!

It's OK in a pinch, but other vegan cheese sauces are better (but I have to make them myself).  Whole wheat pasta would have made it better.  Next time I buy some processed form of Mac and cheese, I'll just buy the sauce mix: takes up less space and I can choose the pasta.
While I appreciate their effort to create a vegan mac & cheese, I just don't like the flavor. It doesn't taste real at all to me and has a strong garlic flavor.

I usually have mac and cheese cravings once a month. Since I'm vegan I decided to give this a try. It's definitely not the real thing but it satisfies. It took a couple tries to figure out the way I like it best. I prefer water to milk, I use almost 1/4 cup more water than it suggests and I add Earth Balance butter. I love to mix in cut up veggie dogs or crumbled soy chorizo. A dash of garlic salt when it's done and voila!

Since going vegan 10 months ago, I have tried making my once-favorite meal several times to no avail. The cheese was never quite right and, as you know, that's what makes it or breaks it for this dish. I took a chance with this product and was pleasantly surprised. I used unsweetened soy milk and added a little earth balance and the result was a creamy consistency JUST like the non-vegan boxed variety! The taste was great; not exactly like Kraft but good enough in and of itself. I will definitely purchase this again.

column9: Much Better Than I Thought It Would Be!
column10: I recently became a Vegan, and I am trying to stay away from soy products.  I absolutely love macaroni and cheese, and thanks to the new Vegan 'cheese' DAIYA [...]) I am so glad I can have it.  But unless I have time to melt the DAIYA myself with butter, plain rice milk, yadda yadda, I wished I could just whip it up quick like in my old Annie's macaroni and cheese days.  Well, went to Whole Foods a few days ago and happened to notice this stuff on the shelf.  Reading the ingredients, i was glad to see it did not contain soy, and some of the ingredients were similar to what is in DAIYA.  I bought 2 boxes and eagerly awaited trying it.  So, made it tonight with 1/2 cup organic plain Rice Dream, and 1 TB soy-free Earth Balance spread.  My husband spit it out.  But he is FAR from being a vegetarian or a vegan, so take it with a grain of salt, lol.  However, my three little mac and cheese addicts (meaning my 3 little boys age 3, 5, and 7), loved it.  By the time I served myself some, it was cold so I put it on a paper plate and zapped it for 50 seconds.  Well, guess what?  Zapping it made the sauce thicken into a rich texture (without zapping it was thin/watery), and I LOVED LOVED LOVED it.  It even tasted kinda like a light cheddar cheese!  I still prefer DAIYA over any vegan cheese alternative out there, BUT this company's version of 'cheese' is a close second.  I will definitely buy more!!

My whole family loves this chreesy alternative to dairy mac & cheese and because of the nutritional yeast, it has fiber, too.  I have tried to make a dairy free cheese sauce myself and although my husband and I enjoy it, this is the only one my son will eat.

column9: I had to spit it out!
column10: I was so excited to try a cheese-less mac and "chreeze." I'm vegan and like just about every kind of food you can think of, but this stuff was by far the worst thing I have ever tasted in my entire life. It didn't taste like cheese all. I added extra rice milk and earth balance to no avail. I took a bite and had to spit it out....and for someone who drinks green drinks and all sorts of concoctions on a daily basis, that says a lot. Steer clear of their mac and chreese and try their gravy instead (it's really good)!

The most distinct thing about this product is the odor of the cheese sauce.  Mixing it with my favorite soy based milk, it had a very strong smell to it; and frankly the smell wasn't a very good one.  But, not being one to waste food, I was set on trying it anyways.The taste...  is unique.  It's nowhere near as strong as the smell was, but it does make an impression.  I really don't have the words to describe what exactly the taste is, but I can understand how people would spit it out if they tasted it.  I wouldn't label it disgusting, but I didn't find the taste to be all that good.  I did eat the entire box, and will eventually eat the other 11 boxes, but I probably won't be ordering anymore of this brand.

column9: Very good if you prepare it well!!
column10: I've prepared it a few ways.. and it's been great to blah.  But if I prepare it the great way it's consistantly great!  I mix 1/2 cup of unsweetened almond milk with the powder package in a seperate small pot and make sure it's well mixed together with a whisk.  Once the shells are ready, drained and rinsed I pour them in and blend it with the sauce well.  I also add about 1.5 tablespoons of earth balance vegan buttery stick and heat it on medium-low for about 2 minutes till the sauce is thick enough it sticks to the shells well but not too thick.Anyways, whenever I make it that way it's a hit!I tried it with unsweetened almond milk, original rice milk and coconut milk beverage and the unsweetened almond was best by far.  & the vegan buttery stick makes it more creamy.
I bought this because I'm vegan and do not eat dairy.  I was hoping it would be a good cheese imitation but it wasn't.  Instead of being creamy, it kind of clumped all together.  I didn't like it...

I am well-versed in all things dairy-free. I eat tons of dairy replacements, most of them quite good substitutes. This is by far the worst tasting substitute I've had. It doesn't come close to replicating any kind of cheesy flavor. It's a bit like peppery cardboard and smells like vomit.Use your dairy free budget and "splurge" on the Amy's frozen Vegan Mac & Chreeze. MUCH better.

I recently admitted to myself that I'm lactose intolerant, but I don't want to completely give up on mac and cheese in a box. I found this at Whole Foods and decided to give it a shot.The pasta itself is good. I like the tiny shells. And I got the sauce to its proper consistency. It looks very appetizing when done right. However, it tastes disgustingly bland. There's no cheese flavor whatsoever. It's like liquified garlicky cardboard mixed in with pasta. I feel like throwing it up, even though there's technically nothing in it my body can't tolerate. Ugh.

Green Mountain Southern Sweet Perfect Iced Tea, 22-Count K-Cups for Keurig BrewersI'm a TRUE Georgia Girl!! I know how sweet southern ice tea should taste. Well this Chick is no longer in Dixie. I've been searching for the perfect sweet tea for the past 5 yrs. Anyone who has made southern sweet tea the old school way, knows that it takes a lot of time to get the consistency just right. Once that's done the tea goes fast, thus the cycle continues. This tea is awesome!! Keurig makes it easy! Just keep in mind the K-cup is not REALLY sweet. Southerners call the tea itself "SWEET" not because of the suger but because of a particular taste. (This is a hard point to get across if you are not accustomed to drinking many different sweet teas down south) I use a glass pitcher, fill a fourth of the pitcher with sugar, then fill the entire pitcher with hot boiling water. Stir with a long spoon...(careful it will be HOT) until the water is completely clear. It's what we call a SIMPLE SYRUP down south. Before you brew your K-Cup, drop a splash of simple syurp in your glass or over your ice. The Sweet Perfect Ice Tea will then truely be PERFECT! FYI: If you live up north like I do and crave ice tea all year round...You'd better stock up on your K-cups by end of summer. The company considers the GREEN MOUNTAIN SOUTHERN SWEET PERFECT ICE TEA a seasonal item, (the NERVE!!) making them almost impossible to get in the winter and tripple the cost!!!! Enjoy!!!

column9: can never have enough of this
column10: This beverage has just the right amount of sweetness and taste.  It's not overbearing like most bottled teas and it is probably better for you than traditional soft drinks.Here three quick tips to keep in mind for best results.1.  Put plenty of ice in your glass before brewing2.  Be sure and stir the tea before drinking3.  You may want to add a bit of ice after brewingAs with any beverage you will have to experiment with different amounts of ice to find the amount that works best for you.A quick note about Amazon's wonderful customer service.  I recently ordered some of this tea and the box was all bent and some of the k-cups were slightly damaged.  I contacted Amazon customer service via email and with in less than one hour they emailed me back.  They told me to keep the tea and refunded my money.thanks Amazon

column9: Just like fresh brewed iced tea
column10: This was the closest to home-brewed iced tea that I have found. I love it. Havewent through 2 boxes already!!!!

This is a good K-Cup..the key though is to brew using the smallest size...of course thats less tea but it gives the closest to the "authentic" sweet tea that most of us that are familiar with the drink, are used to. I also think you could drink this one hot..Overall very good taste, not overly sweet but a good enough sweet tea taste to brew, grab, go & enjoy!

This is an excellent tea.  However, if you are expecting the delicious, "put me in a diabetic coma" southern-style sweet tea, this isn't quite it. It's sweet, but not southern-sweet.  That is easily rectified by a splash or two of simple syrup and voila!  It becomes the sweet tea we love.  What I do like about this tea is that it meets the taste demographics of both those who simply want a sweetened iced tea, and with a little addition, a delicious southern-style sweet tea.  Great job to those who designed this one.

This Sweet Tea takes just a second to make and tastes just as good as any you will try. I use a little bit of Agave in mine, and it makes it taste just as good as any other sugared down version. Also, you can't beat the fact that you can just drop it in your Keurig and have a glass ready in less than a minute.

column9: Sweet and lightly spicy iced tea for k-cup summers
column10: Is this an authentic Southern sweet tea. No. And, so what? Green Mountain/Celestial Seasonings K-cups are a delicious summer beverage for Keurig owners.My wife purchased a Keurig B40 Elite Gourmet last Christmas. I was reluctant at first to switch from our stainless steel French press but we have now tried more than a dozen coffee blends. The wide range of roasts and flavors available are impressive.This is our first iced tea k-cup. Following the directions produces a strong glass of black tea over crushed ice with just a hint of spice (although the only flavored ingredients listed are evaporated cane juice and black tea). I find I like the tea even better if I let the mixture sit for five minutes before I start to drink it.One serving is 70 calories and contains caffeine. The exact ingredients are: evaporated cane juice, black tea, rebiana (sweetner from stevia) and tricalcium phosphate (a natural free flow agent). Personally, I don't add more sugar (not necessary) but I garnished a glass with fresh lemon.Rating: Five starsGreen Mountain/Celestial Seasonings also offers k-cup iced teas - specially designed to brew directly over ice - in the following flavors:Sweet Peach Black Perfect Iced TeaSweet Lemon Black Perfect Iced TeaSweetened Raspberry Perfect Iced TeaBlack Unsweetened Perfect Iced TeaBTW: During the summer, I drink mainly unsweetened ice tea, like House Mugicha or Ito En Golden Oolong but when the mood hits me, I'll look for a sweet tea. Until I found Celestial Seasonings k-cup, I favored Sweet Leaf Tea, Original Sweet Tea. I recommend all of these iced teas.

Love Love Love this flavor...just as good or not better than I can make it. So easy with Keurig Brewer. Brew it and throw away...Sometimes hard to find Southern Sweet Tea, they are always out. Anyway, this is wonderful..very enjoyable.

column9: I Love It!!! Very good flavor...
column10: I love this tea. Whether it's 6 ounces over ice or 12 ounces hot I think it's great. I do add about a teaspoon of sugar to it because I like my tea really sweet but I don't see that as a problem. This is a very good tea served hot. I can't believe I'm going to say this but... I didn't think I could taste the tea bag before... but I did. This is an excellent choice in my opinion you can't go wrong hot or cold.
Good tea, but I like my sweet tea, Sweet! & this is not sweet enough, so I added some of my own. Then I liked it!
I was a little disappointed with this product.  I didn't think the tea was sweet enough, and it was a little more expensive than the other K-Cup teas.

My husband loves sweet tea and he is the pickiest person in the word when it comes to food. He actually loves this sweet tea. Having been born and raised in the south, he likes it really sweet and though I didn't think this was as sweet as some I have had, it has a great smooth flavor.
Almost as good as my southern friends homemade sweet tea. I just put in my second order. This is really good iced tea.
This was disappointing as it is the first K cup product I have bought which was not good. It produces a weak tea...way short of what southern sweet tea is.

I drink at least one of these k cups EVERYDAY at work! I make my own sweet tea at home using splenda, but this is perfect because I can make the tea early in the morning, put my cup in the freezer and by lunch time I've got perfectly cold sweet tea to enjoy for the rest of the day. I love it!!!
This Tea has wonderful flavor and it is so convenient to use the K-cup.  I like the 22 pack as it last longer than the smaller packs but still fits in the cabinet well.
I think we went through the 12-pack in a couple of days, now I'm anxiously awaiting more. This subtly sweetened iced tea is perfect.

column9: Sweet Iced Tea at the Push of a Button
column10: I got the chance to try a sample of Celestial Seasonings Southern Sweet Tea as a BzzAgent.  I love iced tea and Keurig, but I usually like a less sweet tea, so I have to admit to being skeptical when I popped that Celestial Seasonings Southern Sweet Tea K-Cup into my Keurig.  I needn't have worried!  I was pleasantly surprised and pleased by the iced tea this brews.  I used the 6 oz setting to get a stronger tea flavor, and this K-Cup delivered exactly that.  It has a nice strong black tea flavor, and it is lightly sweet, not at all overpoweringly sweet like I was expecting.  Pop a slice of lemon in there and you've got the perfect glass of sweet iced tea in less than a minute!

i love this tea hot and cold. i actually use each cup twice sometimes three times if im making a pot of iced tea i can run the cup thru the third time and  still get a good color to add to the pot, no sense in watsting the leaves. I do that with a lot of these cups. but this sweet tea is yommy hot for breakfast or with ice in the afternoon you just cant go wrong. and each box is wrapped for freshness. i know the cups are sealed but i like the idea that the boxes are sealed in plastic. i buy a lot at one time. this makes me feel it stays fresher, longer.

However this is not authentic southern sweet. It can be, if you add 2 tablespoons or more of granulated sugar to each 6 ounce cup you brew. Then it comes close to sweet like southern sweet tea is sweet. The tea taste is great at the 6 ounce brew level, but there is no way to get enough sugar in a K cup.

column9: 4.5 Stars Interesting Blend of Sweet and Bold
column10: *SAMPLE SUPPLIED BY MANUFACTURER*This is the better deal at 86 cents per glass(including shipping)  as opposed to the packages offering less quantities.This product is a robust tea with just enough sweetness to keep most people happy.  Oddly enough the taste is almost that of a honey being used to sweeten the tea instead of refined sugar.  Rich  tea flavor and bold enough to withstand the watering down that can sometimes seems to happen when you use the Keuring for making iced products.I love this product. I've been down south and have had true 'southern sweet tea' and this comes close.  As a matter of fact the tea I used to get down in Georgia and Tennessee was somewhat too sweet for my taste.  I used to have to cut it with some unsweetened to keep my taste buds happy.You may be able to find this elsewhere for less but I've been finding that those places are usually sold out during the height of the summer and don't carry the iced teas in the winter.  With Amazon it seems that you may be assured to be able to get it whenever you're craving it.

I didn't want to rate this product low just yet.  I would like some advice before I give it a lower rating because you all seem to enjoy it so much!I get the strangest aftertaste when I make this tea.  It's almost metallic.  Here's how I brew it:  Large cup setting with some extra sugar, then I add ice after the brewing.  Should I do something different for a better taste?  I checked my ice and my water to see if they were the problem, but they are not.  Also, nothing else that I make with my machine has this aftertaste.Advice would be appreciated, and I will update this review when I find the perfect way to make it, in case someone else is having the same problem as me.

I don't know how this is "sweet" tea. I live in IL after having lived in NC. This is not sweet tea, even by Illinois standards. It tastes plain and unsweetend. If you want a plain tea, then this is great. The flavor of tea is there, not sweet though.

This tea tastes pretty good. As a tea lover I think it could be a little stronger, as it doesn't have a very strong flavor (though I do use my cups twice to fill a small pitcher). It is sweetened with sugar (18g per k-cup, I think) and stevia. I'm not a big fan of artificial sweeteners but I'd much rather it be stevia than another toxic chemical sweetener. There is no foreign after taste, which makes it more agreeable. If you like sweet iced tea and you are willing to use stevia, I recommend this product.
I am a big sweet tea guy but I hated screwing around to make it. I was wishing it could be as easy as coffee is to make in my K machine so I did a quick AMAZON search and found these...perfect!
I was actually pleasantly surprised at how good this tea tasted. I am a Southerner and know my sweet tea. A++++
This tea is nowhere near sweet enough to be described as southern sweet iced tea, but adding a packet of Splenda to it makes an adequate approximation.

column9: Not sweet but still an excellent brew
column10: This product would get 5-stars if the what was in the K-cup matched what was advertised as being in the K-cup.  This tea was not sweet whatsoever.Aside from that, this is the perfect tea for me.  Brewed over ice or consumed hot, this has been my go-to beverage since I received my order.I will definately be purchasing this again.
I love this brand of southern sweet tea.  It really has a great taste and is just sweet enough.  I am always happy with my purchase.

This tea has a nice flavor for ice tea, but was expecting a little sweeter, I had to add about a tsp of sugar to my liking and I don't like that sweet. But everyone taste sweet, salty, sour etc.. differently so only way to know is buy and judge yourself. But for convenience its great.

I drink sweet tea occasionly and whenI'd make a whole container I'd end upthrowing almost half of it out, sinceI'm the only one drinking it,it wouldget a funny taste after a couple ofdays.  So these are ideal for me andthey really taste good(not sickinglysweet).  I highly recommend them fora single tea drinker.

Green Mountain Southern Sweet Tea is as good if not better than most K-Cup teas. Being black tea, it has that strong flavor one expects to find in Black Tea. The deliverly was prompt and the packaging was in perfect condition. I will certainly order again.

I probably should've never found this k-cup because I can't drink anything else now.  This is that good.  I will admit its not a simple syrup type sweet tea.  I lived in the south for a period of time and I've certainly tasted sweeter.  Its more a half sweet tea, half unsweet tea but it makes just the perfect combination tea that is just right.  It does seem to brew all the sweetness first though, so it needs a good stirring before you drink. . my only recommendation.  Overall though, this makes a perfect refreshing glass of sweet iced tea!  Love it!
Order came really quick and was just what i expected. It is the celestial seasons perfect sweet ice tea. this product is amazing. i love my keurig

column9: I'm addicted!!  Fav of all Keurig
column10: This is better tasting than the home made sweet tea I've been making for years and I'm pretty much addicted to it!  This stuff is so hard to find in stores that I now buy it on Amazon rather than constantly searching local stores for it and rarely finding it.  Thanks Amazon!

We go through a pitcher of sweet tea in our house a day, three meals a day; it's a staple to our diet. I say that to mean we're quite the connoisseur of sweet tea.With that, I wasn't overly impressed at first. The cane sugar gives it a unique taste but I still found it weak. BUT... I did accidently stumble upon - if I let it steep in the cup after it's made for maybe 10 minutes, it's profoundly different (and better)!I won't be rushing out to buy these but I was curious as to their quality... not bad for an "instant" sweet tea.
Great tasting tea. Just add a little simple syrup to your cup. My kids really love this stuff. Great way to make a quick glass of ice tea.

I purchased this for my teenage daughter - the sweet tea expert at our house. She LOVES it. Even though it is actually to make ice tea with, she makes it as a hot tea. She loves to have it if she is ill or cranky. It is a very soothing tea and tastes great. I also like it as a hot tea. It is pretty much a perfect beverage.
This is my boyfriends favorite drink in k-cups. He drinks it over ice in the summer time and loves it hot in the winter.

This doesn't taste much like the Southern sweet tea I'm used to, and I live in Georgia.  I wouldn't say I totally hate it though, I'll probably finish these and as long as I start a cup thinking I'm getting a sweetened iced tea, instead of a Southern sweet tea, I'll be satisfied with it.
So, far this is the best tasting tea I've ever had.  I LOVE it!  I will definately be buying some more of this.
This tea gets diluted out by the ice and ends up very weak.  Not good at all as an iced tea.  Great as a hot tea though.
My son uses about 2 boxes a month of this sweetened iced tea k-cups.  Since he's hard to buy for, we purchased a couple boxes for Christmas.  They arrived quickly and securely packaged.

I love southern style sweet tea, so I was pretty excited to try the Kcup.  It really isn't what I would consider "southern style" like what is served here in Virginia, but it is still pretty good.  If you really want the southern style extra sweetener is probably needed!
I love this tea with a slice of lemon on top of the ice before brewing.Sugar is in the cup which is the perfect amount of sweetness for me.
But actually as with any variety, there are many we didn't like... but now we know !Wish it were in a smaller quantity for our test batch .... but 5 stars for delivery and packaging and price !
Not too sweet and very tasty. May not be sweet enough for true fans of "Southern Sweet Tea", but tastes fresh and brisk.

I love these K Cups so much. They are perfect for me. I like tea sweet but not too sweet. They are perfect. I brew them on the 6 or 8oz option over ice and they turn out great. I tried being cheap and brewing over it again but that just made the second glass taste like watered down iced tea. So I just make it regular now. I highly recommend these to anyone who likes their tea sweet and wants it quick!!

I usually make iced tea using the teabags and the microwave and don't add sugar. BUT, once in a while I like sweet iced tea and the Southern Sweet Tea is perfect. Not too sweet. This is the only tea I use with my Keurig.
As with other reviewers these are very nice.  Not too sweet for southern style ice tea relatively mild.  Could stand to be a little less expensive.

I tried the Green Mountain Southern Sweet Perfect Iced Tea & was very impressed. I had to make 2 K-Cups to make a full glass but it did not take very long. I was surprised of the sweetness of the tea. I will definitely be buying more of them.
This tea is great. I have just returned from the south and love the sweet tea there. This sweet tea is perfect. Not too sweet. Just right.
This tea is great, just like Grandma made. It's sweet, but you also taste the tea. Not like some that is just sugar water. Excellent product!
I love sweet tea, but this one is too sweet. From the reviews, I was excited but I don't think I am going to finish the box. Very convenient way to make sweet tea, but I wish it tasted better.

Once again, Green Mountain got it right! Perfect for when I don't want to make an entire pitcher of tea. Just the right amount of sweetness. I'm hoping Green Mountain comes out with a sweet tea that is just a little stronger (tea wise), but I still won't complain as long as I have this.

column9: Good Taste for a quick brew
column10: I was shocked how good this tea is. Now for individuals expecting sweet almost thick tea, this is not for you. The sweetness is subtle compared to homemade sweet tea, but it is definitely good enough to hit the spot. Plus if you consider the calorie count of only 70 calories, I think it is worth it. I will be purchasing this again.

The key to making and enjoying this tea is the amount of water and ice you use.I fill a 16 oz cup with ice,then I put 6 oz of water in the keurig.I have a min keurig so I have to use a coffee mug to catch the hot tea then pour it over the ice.It is worth it for a wonderful glass of iced tea.My only thing is,one cup is never enough!!lol My 10 year old daughter makes this on her own,loves it,as does my 14 year old son.If you like it a bit sweeter put a packet of pure via or splenda in the hot tea before adding to the ice.
After adding some Sweet & Low or sugar, it tastes just like the sweet tea you buy from a fast food place! I will be buying more boxes. Everyone at the office loves it!
A bit on the weak side after you add enough ice to chill it down... but tasty and wonderful fresh brewed taste. I'll buy it again.

I love Iced Tea and Sweet Tea. Unfortunately I live in Utah and its not really a popular item and most places have a pretty poor brew. Luckily I can new have some at home! I love the taste. Some of my friends from Tenessee say its not near sweet enough to be called Sweet tea, but its a quality tea taste and just the right amount of sweetness for me. I wouldnt have it any other way. I would love to see this become a subscribe and save product and be around for a long while!

I love Sweet Tea.  The Sweeter, the better for me.  This is good, it is sweet, it is drinkable...it does not have artificial sweeteners so it doesn't leave a bad aftertaste.  It doesn't have a strong lemon flavor like some teas have, which is a plus in my book.  If you want a sweetened tea, this is it.  But, if you want a super sweet tea, keep looking.

column9: Couldn't get much closer to traditional sweet tea!
column10: I just bought this despite the reviews that insist it is not sweet enough. With the first sip, I thought they were right. Then, I stirred and it was just right! This wasn't as sweet as McDonalds but it reminded me more of Cracker Barrels tea.
I love this tea!!!  I add a little extra sugar because I like it super sweet but this tea is awesome.  The only thing I dont like is everyone is ALWAYS sold out of it because it is that good!

column9: Great Sweet Tea A KEY BUY
column10: This is by far the best brewed tea I have made. I enjoy good quality tasting tea and this takes the cake. It is really nice to be able to have a glass of tea in minutes without all the messy bags. I will be keeping this in stock at my house for sure.
this is not southern sweet tea by any stretch of the imagination.  it's very bitter with barely any sweetness to it at all.

column9: Delicious, but prices are way off.
column10: This is a tasty product, but not quite sweet enough for me as it comes. A spoonful of sugar makes it right, but the prices for this stuff are ridiculous.The tea supply was not (to my knowledge) affected by the recent coffee shortage which raised prices across the board. This price comes out to almost 60 cents a cup and I pay less than that for Kona blend k-cups, even with the shortage. I will not be buying this product just because of that. Profit is ok, obscene profit is not. Shame on you Green Mountain!

This is not what I would call Southern sweet tea. I was raised on sweet tea and this is simply iced tea. If you are looking for something that is as sweet and sugar laden as your grandmother's tea, this is not it. It is great iced tea, put some sugar in the bottom of the cup before you brew it and it can make delicious sweet tea as well. It is a great alternative to making an entire pitcher when no one else will drink it.

column9: Beware if you can not use artificial sweetners!!
column10: I purchased this for my new Keurig. It has stevia which is an artificial sweetner! Would have been nice to have seen this before I spent the $$ and purchased!

column9: Tony the Tiger's Flakes-Always Have What it Takes!
column10: Tony the Tiger is an iconic image toward which many people of my age (49) gravitate, as our memories are peppered with visions of  childhood mornings, lingering over bowls of Sugar Frosted Flakes.  The boisterous, jovial tiger could be seen during any cartoon show invading some child's home and declaring that "THEY"RE GREAT!" to the young innocent and his well-groomsd chums.  This particular item is an exact taste match from those days packaged in modern, vacuum sealed, plastic  "bowls."  I have initiated my third order of a pack (96 bowls) of these little marvels, as my last "stash" is rapidly diminishing.Each small squared-off delight contains enough precious, fresh little flakes to satiate the immediate urge for cereal without the temptation to consume more than is inherent with those big boxes and their requisite large openings. Like rectangular, lip-less mouths, those open-topped, time-tested, colorful containers silently beckon the customer to ingest more, even if to just satisfy a slight, lingering want.  The portions in these little bowls are a rational alternative to that sort of intake and the attendant  weight gain risks.My wife also enjoys partaking of this product, and I  warrant that her mood has been all the more positively effected by our shared slurping and gulping of said product.  I might well have reported favorably upon this food were there no other benefits than a smiling spouse and happy house, so the added benefits of good taste doubly validates my analysis.I would also note in conclusion that I've yet to witness one of the bowls to rupture or for the cereal to other-wise suffer contamination.  We have on at least two occasions fought off assaults  of marching legions of voracious ants bent upon wholesale raiding of provisions and generally establishing permanent bases in our kitchen.  Our counterattacks were inevitably always successful, but not without severe losses of valuable, vulnerable foods.  The Frosted Flakes in each case remained sealed and untouched.  Even mice would seem to have bypassed these little mini-safes and moved on to crack easier stores of goodies (and always to trigger that "snap" in the night that brings a primordial peace of mind in knowing, as in days of yore when pioneers stalked the woods, that the night's hunt was good).  Kellogg's Frosted Flakes Bowls, 1-Ounce Bowls (Pack of 96)

column9: The product GREAT - Amazons price not so great!
column10: You can buy the same thing @ smart and final in packs of 24 for $6.49. You do the math.. $6.49 x 4 = about $26-$27

Some of the packages were broken open, and others seem really stale, like the flakes were petrefied or something...It was kind of a mess with the open packages spilling cereal all over the rest of the box.  I will say I had ordered something similar in the past (but a bigger individual serving) and there were no problems with that purchase...
Bought these for my daughter who is in college & she and her roommates love them! Very convenient packaging & well worth the extra money.
this was a great buy and I recommended it to everyone.I would use amazone again for all my needs.

column9: Price was right and no clean up.
column10: These are very handy, I know they are more expensive than buying the big box but no clean up in the morning is great, just a spoon and I'm off to work.  I had bought the larger size earlier but these are a better size for me.
great for me and great for the soldier in iraq.  use as a snack to take my pills in the evening.

I am hooked on this coffee, great taste good assortment of flavors, easy to open for 10 cup coffee makers, tastes even better drinking out of Red Soxs coffee mugs, also a amazon purchase.. Great Price

column9: Newman's Advanced Chicken/Rice for Active or Senior Dogs 5 STARS!
column10: I read labels. I was really happy to see a dog food free of 'poultry by products' and other questionable items. The pieces are small, the taste must be good as our dog gobbles this up like candy. Since switching from another 'vet sold' pet food, our pooch's health, looks, sleep, demeanor and well everything is much much better. He is an extremely active dog and this food provides easily accessible nutrients and bulk. We live in the backwoods of Montana and now we will have to mail order it in. Even with the added expense, it's worth every dime. Simply...... THE BEST.

I've tested a lot of flours, including mixing my own.  Bob's tastes like lentils because he uses garbanzo bean flour in his mix (seriously, everything will end up tasting like beans).  Pamela's is okay, but a little gritty.  Most flours end up gritty because of the rice flour in them.  Beth's Flour by Gluten-Free Pantry is the BEST!  I can make any recipe from any cookbook by substituting her flour for gluten ones.  It is not gritty and actually tastes like "real" flour!  The only problem is that GF Pantry may be discontinuing it because it is becoming more difficult to find on the market.  Sad.  Please try this flour!  You won't be disappointed!
This flour works for most baking projects. I have had great luck though my bread still is not like regular bread it is getting better.
We use the morsels for baking, particularly for baking banana breads. They are a standard. Your price is conducive.

Check out the complete ingredients list shown in the Label Information area.)I don't find the licorice flavor to be overly strong, but you will need to like the flavor of licorice to enjoy this blend.  The hint of cinnamon, ginger and pepper adds a touch of warmth to the blend, while the orange, clove and cardamom boost the spicy sweetness of the tea.  This is now my favorite organic herbal tea and I can't wait to try the Egyptian Licorice Mint tea too.

My mother, sister, and now all of our husbands are completely addicted to this tea. It is our favorite. We all enjoy the lingering sweet taste and find it excellent for clearing the palate of other, less pleasant clinging flavors.

Egyptian Licorice tea is my new favorite tea. It taste great, is mildly sweet with just a hint of cinammon. Also, it seems to really soothe my acid reflux which is a big plus. column9: Great blend and not too strong
column10: Yogi is a wonderful brand for herbal teas. I discovered black licorice tea several years ago and have been an addict ever since!  When my local store stopped stocking it recently, I panicked briefly but relaxed when I found it at Amazon and subscribed to it.  My first box arrived yesterday and I had to try it out right away. Yogi Tea Organic Egyptian Licorice is the best tea I ever tried. Sweet and full of body.

column9: Nice mild exotic taste, no sweetener required...
column10: Received my first Yogi Egyptian Licorice Herbal tea as a sample from Yogi Teas, and just loved it so had to have more.Found it from the local natural food store for a little while but then they said it was discontinued, and they only carried the Egyptian Mint Licorice which, in my opinion, was not nearly as good - the mint simply overpowered the licorice (although, to be fair to that product, I am not a mint-lover). This is my favorite herbal tea.  It has a slight sweetness from the licorice and the flavor is bold enough to compare with coffee.highly recommended.

My daughter & I both love licorice tea.  This particular tea has a wonderful strong black licorice flavor, we often drink it after meals as a spicy-sweet, no calorie dessert! It does carry a warning not to use if pregnant or nursing.

column9: Yogi Egyptian Licorice Tea, Pack of 6 (16 teabags each)
column10: Fantastic product and cheaper than buying it at the store.  it's also really difficult to find it, since these Yogi teas are gaining popularity.  It's very soothing for stomachs, and because of the hint of cinnamon, it can be drunk without adding sugar but is still sweet.  Great product!

I love this herbal tea blend.  It's naturally sweet and has a pleasing taste as well as a pleasing aftertaste.  Descriptively, this tea is soothing yet has a very slight bite of ginger with a hint of tangerine zest and cinnamon.

I drink this tasty tea for adrenal support.  I struggle with adrenal fatigue and 2 cups of this tea a day really helps. It is also wonderful iced. The flavor is wonderfully spicy...not like black licorice.  The licorice root naturally sweetens the spice flavor.

I've served this tea to a number of friends and family and they have all raved.  I love my teas a little sweet and this one provides it without having to add any sugar or honey. column9: So nice to curl up with
column10: I am so glad my market had this on sale and I tried it.  And, I love that I can order 6 boxes at once. column9: Color enhancing? You've got to be kidding!
column10: A steady diet of this caused my goldfish to lose color.  And I don't mean a little.  I mean she went from being a gorgeous red and orange to shock white.  Other goldfish in my tank also started losing colors.  After inspecting the ingredients, trying to figure out the problem, I discovered it's full of fillers, and more importantly lake colors.  A lake color will only disperse in oil, sucrose, or alcohol.  It's also the same stuff you find in your makeup.  What do you think that does to a poor fish's digestive system?  I will never buy this again.  Oh, and that color change issue with my goldfish? 1 year later, on a good frozen pure food diet, the white goldfish is still white, and the ones who lost some of their color, never did regain it.

The fish love it, stay healthy, live long and prosper. We have two ponds with approximately 90 total goldfish, 2" to 8" long, some plain, some fancy. We sure haven't seen any problems with "air bubbles trapped within their bodies." The fish have been living on it for over five years, so I think it's pretty good stuff.

column9: Good food for growing big fish
column10: I've been feeding my goldfish TetraFin flakes for about a year.  My goldfish are not very picky eaters, but I like the fish flakes because they are colorful.  I hate to admit it, but it's true.  The flakes are large, not little crumbs, so my fish can grab a mouthful with each bite.  It makes me feel like they're satiated when done.  I live through my fish, silly me.The container has a little slide opening up top, which makes just a tad more convenient for feeding the fish.  It's funny how much nanoseconds count, but it's the little things in life.True to Tetra's claim, their fish food doesn't cloud the fish tank.  I've never had a problem with that, so I'm not sure if fish food ever clouds the tank, as long as we don't overfeed.My goldfish are over two years old, and they're getting big and fat.  Pretty soon, I'll need a new fish tank or maybe have to give away some fish.  I didn't think they'd ever get this big.  Thank you, Tetra.
I've alway used this stuff to feed my fish in my 10 gallon tropical/temperate aquarium. They work fine with tropical fish. I strongly reccomend for beggining aquariasts.
My fish eats this stuff up and seems as happy as a fish can be.

I figured i would buy this online since it was cheaper than in the stores and my fish had about 4 days left on their food. if i waited my fish would have probably died.lol. i had to go out anyway to buy fish food because the shipping was soo slow.

Hmm, my outdoor pond goldfish like it, as well they should as this comes out to $36/lb, more than lobster.So, what to do? Buy and grind up fish and wheat germ and whatever else is on the label?  Nothing motivates my fish like mosquito larvae, but living amongst those evil bloodsuckers is more than I want to do.Oh, well, I'll just get whatever seems to be the best deal at the time and maybe the herons and egrets and racoons  will live a better life near the top of the food chain. column9: Pretty much the tastiest stuff ever, if you need to flavor 164 pounds of meat!
column10: You've probably seen small bottles of Montreal Steak Seasoning in the grocery store (the most common size is 3.4 ounces);  you're buying almost 20 times that much with this purchase.  To put it in perspective, the McCormick website suggests that you use 1 tablespoon of seasoning per pound of steak (which is too salty for my taste, actually).  With 58 ounces of steak seasoning, you can flavor **164 POUNDS** of meat.I love this seasoning and use it almost religiously on steaks, chicken, fish, popcorn, you name it...and a single 29 ounce bottle last me almost two years.  Luckily, the steak seasoning keeps pretty well AS LONG AS you store the bottle in a cool, dry place, and transfer the amount you want to use into a smaller container.  The salt in the mixture soaks up any moisture in the air, so if you live in a humid environment, the seasoning will start to clump up pretty quickly.That said, if you're feeding a large family or survive on a completely carnivorous diet, this is the best pre-mixed steak seasoning I've ever tried.  The coarse spice grind is delightful, and there's something in the flavor that surpasses the standard "salt-pepper-garlic" steak flavoring combination.  The seasoning is quite versatile and you can use it to dash up poultry, sauteed veggies, even baked potatoes.Just watch your sodium intake...this stuff has 100% RDA of sodium in a single tablespoon!

column9: I use this on any steak I grill
column10: I was at a friends home having dinner and had the most delicious steak I've ever tasted.  She told me it was all because of this product and ever since I use it on every steak I make.  You won't be disappointed!

This seasoning is essentially a blend of dried garlic, black pepper, and rough salt, (among other lesser ingredients), all of which go a long way towards enhancing the flavor of a grilled steak.As to McCormick spices in general, they are consistently excellent and always fresh, a consideration which is of imperative importance in cooking. Either one is a great choice.If I am using the propane grill, I marinate the steaks first to give them extra flavor that they do not receive with the tasteless propane.  Sometimes I sprinkle the Montreal seasoning on the marinated steaks when I put them on the grill to give an extra layer of flavor.The flavor profile of this seasoning is not spicy, but it is flavorful. column9: BEST SCOOP FOR FELINE PINE PELLETS

column9: best scoop for clay clumping litter
column10: ignore the "little pearls" litter type specific item name - this scoop is perfect for rice grain size 1-4mm Oil-Dri type clumping litter (like Tidy Cats Scoop or A&H Super Scoop).  this hard plastic scoop has a 5"x5"x2" hopper and a 6" handle, which i find is the perfect "man" size for scooping out 4" deep of litter in my 2'x3'50gal bin that i use as a litter box.  this deep hopper allows me to comb the box biweekly instead of daily after my two 8 pound cats, and this large deep scoop makes the job easier.  like most cat owners, i have a collection of other scoops i no longer use, and will tell you why i will never by another type:  the round holes on this scoop not only allow good litter to sift though, but also keep clumps from breaking up while rolling around in this scoop.  you'll notice this scoop is more hole and less screen, which allows the good litter to sift through it quickly which really helps when you are racking 30-40LBs of litter at a time.  the handle is perfectly angled for comfort and to prevent you from touching the litter even while deep scooping, especially since there are no holes on the sides of the hopper to get litter on your hands, like most other scoops.  the only downside is all the heavy lifting you may do after 2-3 years with this scoop wears out the plastic where the handle connects to the hopper - you could superglue it, but i opted to just replace it.  I would argue it's better to buy 6 plastic scoops so you have replacements in case of misplacement, breakage, or regifting, then spend the same money on a steel scoop which won't be any better, and if you misplace your steel scoop you are back to square one.  i prefer plastic because a metal scoop cuts wear and tear into a typical plastic walled litter box, while plastic on plastic will not.  you can buy a single Litter Scoop for Litter Pearls - 11 in. x 5 in. here, but I think you'll be better off buying a few, since your cat loving friends will want to "borrow" yours as soon as they see it in use.

Nearly every scoop out there is made for clay and other granule/sand litters. This scoop is marketed for the pearl litters, but works well for the pine and other pellet type litters. I purchased mine elsewhere so I could buy just one, but wanted to review it here because I'm so happy with it. The large size makes scooping the box quick and easy and the larger holes allows the clean pellets to fall through with minimal effort.
