There is sugar but it isn't sweet, except the nice light sweet finish.Chockalet Chip Kale Krunch is made to be both healthy and a delicious experience. Yes, it is pricey, which makes me want to play around and try and make my own... but omg my mouth is telling me that I am quickly developing an addiction that is going to lead me towards kale seeking tendencies by the time I reach the bottom of this bag.The changes at Kaia foods are positive thus far, at least as far as this chip is concerned. They got it soooo right that I am excited to see what they might do next... that and I can't wait to try the other bag they sent me, Quite Cheezy Kale Krunch.

I had high hopes for this product after seeing it on "The Doctors". I think I should have tried fresh kale beforehand. I did not like the taste at all. It's hard to describe, but I would have to force myself to finish the bag.
I have tasted a number of different kale chips, and I must say this is the very best out of all of them. If you love chocolate, you'll love these! It satisfies a sweet-tooth craving for sure!!

column9: Single Can, then bought a Case
column10: Thank you amazon.com for giving us the option to buy a single can, until we know that baby can digest it. I'm happy to say, then we bought a case.

column9: Stuff is great, but this price is OUTRAGEOUS!!!
column10: This listing says $.35/oz but if it's really only a 12oz can, then it's actually $2.66/oz and SIGNIFICANTLY more expensive than the market price.  You can get a 25.7oz can at BabiesRUs for $20.

Who would have thunk that such a simple combination (half iced tea and half lemonade) would taste so delicious?  And Arizona makes the best version of the Arnold Palmer.  Tea-licious!Please note, this review is for the product, not the price.
This is three times the price you would pay for the same product at your local grocery store or WalMart.

After trying all the flavored coffee Variety packs sold on the Keurig site, this probably rates #1.I'll be the first to say that Southern Pecan did not sound like it was soon to become a daily staple, but the richness and flavor of this coffee is one of the best in the k-cup selection.  The flavor of the coffee is reminiscent of a pecan pie, the coffee is quite flavorful and is even sweet on it's own.I generally probably over-sweeten and cream my coffees, but with the Southern Pecan I find just a little sweetener is great and often take it without any cream.  This coffee smells great as well, easily filling the entire office with it's rich scent.I've been purchasing an assortment of k-cups for the office and find this is one I have to constantly re-order.I do recommend shopping around a bit as k-cup prices tend to be constantly fluctuating on Amazon.
24 ct boxes of Southern Pecan are available on plenty of other sites for about $12.  Why does Amazon think they can charge more than twice that?

I am really picky about my coffee.  For some reason, I decided that a flavored coffee would be nice for the fall and winter.  I like other Green Mountain Coffees, especially their darker blends.  The southern pecan was fairly weak, and I wasn't crazy about the Pecan flavor; I got more of a praline taste rather than a nutty flavor.  This is probably not a bad coffee fo everyone, but it's not my cup of tea (so to speak)!

This flavor is a staple in our household. It has a smooth pecan taste that is not syrupy or too overwhelming, and is a great morning coffee to start the day (though of course you can drink it at any time).Shop for price. A box of 24 k-cups should cost less than fourteen dollars.
Not as good as the reviews i read. Will not reorder this product again. Delivery time was great. Green Moutain has better choices than this one.
This is our all time favorite.  We have ordered severl times and it is delicious.  I highly recommend this for yourself or for family members.

If you enjoy coffee with a nutty flavor, you will enjoy this coffee. It packs lots of flavor even into a large cup though it is not overpowering. It offers a natural not chemical taste with no after taste. I find that it mixes well with many flavored coffee creamers. I have ordered this coffee in the past and will continue to reorder it in the future.
I figured when I bought this that I would either love it or hate it. I hate it. Making one cup leaves the office smelling sickly all day. The smell just lingers. It was just way too sweet for me.

As a rule, I do not like flavored coffees. This is certainly the exception! I love this coffee. The flavor is not overbearing but leaves a wonderful aftertaste. The aroma is to die for. The coffee is not quite strong enough for my taste, so I make a smaller cup, and it is perfect! I highly recommend you give this one a try.
Doesn't really taste like pecan pie, but it is delicious nonetheless!  I would definitely purchase again from Amazon. The price was commensurate with other K cup prices
I love this coffee. Now my daughter loves this as well. What a great flavor! I can not wait for more.

I found the Southern Pecan to be just OK. I am not a huge pecan person, but if you are I am sure you will like it more than I did. It is hard to rate any Green Mountain flavor lower than 3/5 stars, but this is just not my favorite.
My husband and I really enjoyed this coffee. The smell is delightful and there is not any bitterness. Highly recommended!
The main manufacturer never has this product for sale. That is why I get them from you. I get everything mostly through you. You are dependable.
The product arrived timely and remains an excellent flavored coffee. It has been my favorite for a long time and Green Mountain variety is superb.
I buy all my coffee from Amazon since it's cheaper and I need a LOT with three teenagers at home.  This flavor is pretty decent.  Could be a little stronger.
Yummo! This southern pecan coffee just might be my new favorite! If you like pecan coffee, I definitely recommend trying this one.

column9: Good, but not as good as French Toast
column10: Admittedly my Keurig is not my primary coffee brewer.  I tend to use it at work, and only after the coffee I bring is gone.  That being said, I enjoy this flavor of coffee, and it is easy to drink black (I don't have access to fresh creamer at work).  That being said, I love the French Toast K-cups a lot more, though they are seasonal.This cup of coffee is smooth, and the flavoring is not overpowering.
I can't taste any nut flavor in this coffee.  It's not a bad tasting coffee but if you're looking for a pecan taste I don't think you'll find it here.

Almost a year into the Keurig coffees, we decided to stick to Green Mountain for a while.  We like flavored coffee.  This Southern Pecan could have more pecan flavor for our taste.  Not bad but a little too weak.
This is a good "change of pace" coffee.  Good aroma while it's brewing and a good taste if you like a sweeter coffee.  I would recommend.

Not bad.  The usual bent can or two when buying canned goods from Amazon, but the price is right.  Try a can from your local grocery store to see if you like it, first, of course.The "steak" isn't bad at all with a decent texture and taste. Similar to the Roadhouse Chili line.  It will fill you up and is not bad on a cold day.  There is a generous amount of meat and a fairly tasty sauce -- it also has large beans in it which are good, and some corn, red peppers, tomatoes, and so on.  Overall, this is a pretty good quick meal and fairly tasty.  It's probably not easy making a canned meal with consistent quality and taste in mass quantities, so have to give the food engineers at Campbell a thumbs up on this one.After eating a few more cans of this, I actually came back and bumped my rating up from 3 to 4 stars.  In context, I am comparing this to other canned chilis, not home cooked chili!  It's a filling and satisfying meal.As someone else here mentioned, you can buy via "Subscribe and Save" for best price.  It's a good service and very convenient if you want a case of this stuff.2011-2-17 Update: I am now on my second case and this has become my favorite canned chili.  It's a good meal. very filling, and the quality has been consistent.  I find myself eating this fairly often during these cold wintry days for lunch or dinner when I'm looking for something quick and convenient, or just want a good bowl of chili.  A little grated cheddar on top and you're all set!2011-10 -- Raised rating to 5 stars as I have now been through several cases and no more dented cans, quality has remained good, and I really enjoy these.  Very hearty and filling and flavor is good.  Lots of meat chunks.  Best canned chili I've found so far.

This is a good product for a quick and tasty meal, and lends itself to amendments like hot pepper or olive oil. Just add a few crackers and a salad and voila. I was expecting mostly beans, but it's about 50/50 and the beef is in real chunks, not microscopic like in most chili. Needs a little salt, for my taste. I got this on "subscribe and save" and saved a little more, and having it delivered sure beats lugging it home from the store. I will definitely buy this again.

So tasty & not overpowering with the spices(re:  doesn't revisit you later).  With lots of large tender chunks of steak it's a hearty meal in a can.  Very disappointed that our Kroger stores no longer handle it but happy and surprised to find it at Amazon & cheaper too!

real chunks of beef - excellent flavor if you like medium spice - may have too many beans for some customers - enough red pepper and corn to be seen - It's the way I'd want to make chili if I had lots of preparation time.I eat it straight - I know of folks who use it as a topping for nachos.

I can't fault Campbell's for designing (engineering) a food product for the masses.  It's their job.  But taste is intrinsically subjective.  To me, there is a sweetness in the sauce that I don't really care for.  Were it not for this, I would give it better marks.  I am a down-home chili lover to be sure.  But taste is taste.  There are adequate other vegetables in this to fill the stomach for quite a while.  As to the calories etc., bring 'em on!  I'll never consider "low fat" in any food.  I'm evolving into a higher life form and I need all the calories I can get.  I have tried other Campbell's soups & stews and they are just OK.  But they could reduce the sweetness in this one for my taste.  Oh, well......
Whenever my little chili lover is coming over, I am always sure to have the pantry stuffed with this excellent chili. Great product.
This is one of my favorite canned soups. Good flavor & amount of food. Not left hungary after eating this. Usually just have a slice of bread or small salad with this. Delicious!

Ordered 12 cans of this and it was gone very fast. The larger than normal cans were just right for a big eater such as myself. The chili was very good tasting, and loaded with chunks of tender meat. At least one piece of meat in every spoonful, and in some cases, 2. Never a single spoonful without a chunk of meat, and that tells you just how meaty it is. 8/10 I give it, because I have tasted better chili, but dont get me wrong, this stuff tasted just fine.

It's darn near impossible to find steak chili period at the store, let alone good stuff. So at $2.40/can with free shipping, and it tastes good and through 4 cases none have tasted different and no dented cans (althoug who really cares if the cans a different shape; doesn't change the chili at all. Add pepper flakes, cheese and tortilla chips you got a super meal

column9: Healthy dog food that he eats!
column10: Vet recommended, researched on line and the dog eats it: we have a winner!What else can I say? It's dry dog food.

Herbs de Provence can bring many dishes to life. Baked chicken and root veggies are a good place to start, for those who are not familiar with this herb mix. Then expand the horizons by searching all the wonderful online recipes. Winter is coming; it's time to enhance those savory stews and one-pot dishes --- to take the plain to the extraordinary.I personally like this French gray salt and herb combination because I don't like to overdo it with the herbs. I prefer a more subtle flavor. However, if you prefer more herbal punch, you may want to stick with purchasing the herbs alone, or make your own mix, which is quite easy to do. Otherwise, you will be fighting with the salt.If you need to watch your sodium intake, you need to know that this product is heavy on the salt --- and the crystals are very large, so it is easy to over salt your dish. You will be fine, if you make adjustments for salt required for your particular recipe. This is just something to consider, when ordering this combo product.I can attest to the freshness of this product.  Upon opening the glass jar, the fragrance was very potent and lovely. I also prefer having the herbs in a jar with a twist-on-lid.  This will help maintain freshness.All said, I highly recommend this product, with the reservations mentioned. These concerns are manageable. Just remember that this product is predominately salt, with herbs as the secondary enhancement, but the herbs won't go unnoticed.

My Father is 93 years young and very hard to buy for since at his age he wants or needs nothing!  So I was with him and found that his favorite things are The NY Yankees and Snickers.  So what do you get him for Christmas - a case of Snickers!!Thank you for having these available
Arrived fine in 98 degree temps, I was worried but the recipient said it arrived in good shape. Temps were in the upper 90's but the seller ships with complimentary cold packs.

...how I love thee, let me count the ways.  48, such a great number, gives me happiness knowing that you are nearby,...soon to be in my tummy.Used free super-saver delivery and it arrived in less than 3 days from point of order.
What can I say, I am addicted. That is why I do not buy them any more. I cannot maintain the discipline I need to keep them in the house. :(
i found this to be a very easy way of getting what i wanted quick and i was very satisfied with this product and the time it took to arrive to me a my home
I ordered this big box of Snickers and sent them to my boyfriend for a surprise!!!! He loved it and they were gone in a week!

column9: This box takes me back to my youth
column10: My parents were never very religious, but they still celebrated Easter Sunday.  By celebrated I mean they gave us each a basket of candy in the morning and then we'd go out to eat for dinner.  Jesus, God, and the crucifixion were never discussed.They used to give us a variety of different chocolate Easter related products, like Cadbury Eggs, chocolate bunnies, and Peeps.  On the eve before Easter 1990 my parents gave me a box of 48 full sized Snickers bars.  It was purchased at Price Club (which became Costco) and was the same box supplied to convenience stores.After dinner I opened my box and had a bar each before I began playing what would become a marathon videogame session of Rambo for the Sega Master System.  My father sat down and watched me play."Did you open your Easter box?""Yeah, but I only had one.""Just one?""It's not like I could eat them all tonight."He considered me for a minute and then said, "You know what, I bet you could eat them all tonight."After hemming and hawing with him for a couple of minutes he finally began to taunt us.  "What are you, a wimp?  Go ahead and start eating, do it!"My manhood was then challenged and he was getting angry.  I knew better than to poke the bear.The first 10 bars went down pretty well.  Since I knew I was in for the long haul I began pounding the candy bars with Diet Pepsi (hey, why waste calories?)  The combination of the massive amounts of sugar and caffeine made me loopy.  I paused my game and laid down for a bit.  My father yelled at me to keep going.The next couple of bars weren't so easy.  This challenge would be won by pacing.  I decide to eat no more than 5 or 6 Snickers bars an hour.  I must have polished off an entire case of the soda as well.  At midnight my father went to bed, but before he left he told me that I had better finish that box.  "Make the family proud!"I ate the last bar around 5:00 am.  My brother celebrated the victory with me and then we started waiting for my parents to get up.The wait was broken almost two hours later.  Ever since the first couple of bars I had felt gross, but now I felt deathly ill.  At around 7:00 my stomach lurched and the urge to purge hit me like a truck.  I ran to the bathroom and lost all control.  I shot nougat, chocolate and peanuts everywhere.  I filled the sink and the toilet.  I was so loud that I woke up my parents.For a second I had imagined a triumphant victory where my father exclaimed that he was proud of me.  That image evaporated when he yelled, "You ate all of those things?  What are you an idiot?"Over the next couple of hours I evacuated half digested (and fully digested) Snickers bars from both ends.  If you melt a Snickers bar in the microwave you can get the same image as I saw...once again, from both ends.  After the first bout of vomiting my nose was bleeding from the small jagged peanuts that had flown out of it at 30 mph.  Luckily the nougat kept most of the blood from spraying all over the place.  It felt like I had wet cotton balls shoved up my nose and a serious case of stomach flu.  It seemed like I had an endless supply of material to spew forth, and after 48 bars I guess I did.  No one seemed to care that I was heaving all day - even my brother lost interest after an hour or two.By late afternoon everyone else was ready for dinner.  We all piled into the car and drove to a Chinese restaurant.  We had to pull over twice for me to chuck, once I didn't open the door fast enough.  I'll leave it at that.I remember placing the order for egg drop soup.  The next hour was spent in the bathroom.  By the time we got home though, I did manage to eat and keep down the soup.  It didn't taste very good and it was cold, but it stayed where it was supposed to.It was at least five years before I ate any chocolate at all - the smell made me gag, and almost 13 years before I risked eating a Snickers bar again.  I remember eating the thing and then waiting, but luckily nothing happened.  I no longer like the taste of Pepsi - that night converted me to Coke.So, yeah.  Buy the box.  Just don't eat them all in one sitting.

Not much to say here.  These are regular sized Snickers bars packed into a box.  For people who need large quantities of candy bars for events, prizes, or personal consumption, these are the way to go.  We eat a fair number of candy bars in our household, so I get this box, keep them in the refrigerator, and we are set for at least two or three months.

Everybody seems to believe that Snickers are awesome.  But I just don't see it.Up until recently, I had never tried a Snickers bar.  But unfortunately, I lost a bet with my friend (Walter).  Otherwise, I would never have eaten a Snickers bar.Now that I have eaten a Snickers bar, I can say with absolute conviction that they taste awful.  I recommend Ding Dongs or Ho Hos.

column9: The best of the best instant noodle in the world!
column10: When I was a kid (growing up in Indonesia), my mom always cooked Indomie for my breakfast.  It was because I loved it and easy to make for my mom :-)Until now, I still eat Indomie for breakfast or even dinner occasionally when I was too lazy to even go out to eat.You won't be disappointed, it is so easy to make and the taste is deliciouuuuuuus!I could have it everyday, but I know I need more nutritious food.  Great instant noodle are hard to find.  Top Ramen sucks!Goreng = Fried or Stir FryPedas = Spicy or HotMie = Noodle or LoMein :-)

Although, I understand that the Goreng part of the name means noodles without broth, I'll never stop calling this ramen (meaning noodles with broth). The Indomie products that I've tried (original, satay, and pedas) are all delicious. Make no mistake, not all oriental noodles do it for me. When our local Asian market ran out of Indomie, the owner told me to get a different brand that he promised I'd like better. I ended up throwing it out, because the taste was just awful. Indomie (original) however, has a mellow taste, with enough spice to keep you interested.  This Pedas variety in particular increases the heat for the spice-addicted of us, without killing the flavor of classic Indomie noodles. My suggestion? Try it and see if you're not addicted after the first bowl.

column9: Layers Of Mild To Moderate Heat & Flavor
column10: Years ago, I used to love McCormick's Mexican Seasoning, perfect for tacos, casseroles, homemade tamales and enchiladas. It only came in tiny bottles, and I was hoping to find a larger size but with the same mild yet full flavor remembered.Never did find it in the last few years, but happened upon this blend, with mild ancho chili powder combined with the dehydrated garlic, onion, oregano, celery and bay I might normally add myself.  On a heat scale of 1 (very bland) to 10 (screaming hot scotch bonnet), I would rate this a 3, meaning kid safe and husband approved.Wonderful sprinkled over pork steaks, grilled chicken or steak and as general seasoning for the Mexican dishes mentioned above...you can always add some cayenne pepper or hot sauce, if you'd like a more medium (5) to hot hot hot (8-10) heat level.  Received this in fresh condition with at least a 9 month expiration date, something that's important for our smaller family. It's also about half the cost of those itty bitty glass bottles of the original seasoning used before.

I wanted this spice after seeing Tyler Florence use it in one of his cooking episodes on Food Network.So glad I was able to find it on Amazon because this seasoning is AMAZING!Shared it with my son as he loves to cook, especially mexican food.Great seller on Amazon with fast service. It arrived on time.

This is the best summer sausage I've ever had, not hard and chewy, soft and delicious.  It disappeared in my home between my husband and myself and our kids.  Only complaint was there wasn't enough!  Well worth the price!

These were good crackers.  It was just what I was looking for.  However, the entire amount was in one thin bag that was not properly sealed.  I think they would have been freasher if the bag had a proper seal.  I would have prefered several smaller bags, but I guess the large bag helped with the cost.
i use this in recipes and also add this as my salsa base when fresh tomatoes aren't avail. Makes a great companion with chili beans, velveeta for a great dip. Long lasting date on can, very fresh.

It is sometimes hard to find this at grocery stores in NY so it is great to find it online.  Use two cans (drain the water from one) and mix with a 32oz loaf of velveeta "cheese".  We have this at every party and the only time we have leftovers is when we make a second dish of it.

These are the very best beans on earth for making chili.  I was so excited when I found them on Amazon to purchase!  These beans are from Pennsylvania and I am too but currently live in Colorado where I can not buy them.  I have called the Hanover Bean company a few times throughout the years I have lived out west and they still won't ship to me.  The case of Hanover Dark Red Kidney Beans came quite quickly and will order again from the seller Ozbo.  Thank You!

I've been using Satin Ice for a year now on my cakes.  I purchase it from local bakery supplies stores as well as online.  It is nice and smooth, soft and pliable. It doesn't require much kneading and tastes like vanilla, a bit on the sweet side though.  If old (over a year), it will taste rancid and be a bit hard but can still be rolled out.  Wilton brand rolled fondant is gross tasting and not as soft and pliable.  Marshmellow fondant is more pasty tasting and gummier.

Satin Ice is the best tasting fondant I can find on the market.  It's a little more sticky than other types of fondant but you can keep it from sticking to your hands by rubbing some crisco on your hands before working with the fondant.

column9: Quick Delivery and Very Easy to work with!
column10: I had to complete a wedding cake and needed black fondant. I was so happy when I found Satin Ice. It was black, tastes way better than white fondant and was very very easy to work with. Awesome item and highly reccommended!

I have been using Satin Ice for many years, but lately, the quality has diminished. Cracks appear almost immediately. There is little to do but to start over and pray. That is unacceptable. I will be researching alternatives for my business. [...]

I recently purchased a box of these cookies at my local grocery store because I have to regulate my blood sugar, but sometimes I just need a sweet treat to satisfy my sweet tooth. I honestly thought these were going to taste like cardboard, but I was pleasantly surprised! They are very coconut-y, so if you love macaroons, you'll love these cookies.These cookies are slightly soft, but not chewy, and I don't feel deprived of "normal" cookies when I eat them. Best of all, my blood sugar doesn't go haywire after eating them! They use fructose rather than aspartame, so people who can't consume phenylalanine can eat these, unlike other low glycemic products.The serving size on the box is 4 cookies which is good because I usually feel like my sweet tooth is satisfied after just 2 cookies, and 4 cookies is a REAL treat!

My two year old is a Type 1 diabetic and naturally he doesn't understand why he can't have the same foods his brother and sisters have without getting insulin. To try to combat this (and donate to research at the same time) I bought these cookies.Overall, they will do in a pinch. While they were full of coconut flavor they were dry as dirt. The sweetness is a treat and of course, the fact that BG doesn't go crazy is a plus. Truth be told though we prefer other low carb desserts.

column9: 6 boxes of cookies all expiring in less than 2 months
column10: The 1-star rating is given to the shameless company that sell and ship this product, not to the product itself.The reason i NEVER order food online is bcoz they only ship you the product expiring VERY SOON. Prior to ordering from amazon, I went to several gourment markets in my neighborhood that said they carry the product, but actually they do not. I resolved to my last option- online order. and guess what? all 6 boxes of cookies arrived in the condition that I've feared/expected- expiring in 1.5 month from the date of arrival.

I recently bought 2 packages of Bergin Pecans and my family immediately requested Pecan Pancakes for a full week.  They were fresh and oh so good!  I have also noticed that purchasing Bergin Pecans through Amazon is cheaper than purchasing pecans from my local markets.  The quality of these Pecans are excellent and I definitely got my money's worth in quantity. I absolutely recommend purchasing a bag or two of Bergin Pecans, they taste awesome!

Sap sago is an unusually flavored, very low fat cheese that grates well and makes excellent topping for salads or an ingredient for pesto.  The package comes with several Swiss recipes.  The product arrived promptly in good condition.

We searched high and low in grocery and specialty stores for this fragrant and tasty imported cheese, which we have enjoyed for many years. Luckily it is available at Amazon. Sap Sago is a very hard cheese, which you grate and mix with butter; then spread on your favorite cracker. A little goes a LONG way!
Gourmet contacted me, and we discussed issues.  Overnight the problem was solved.I would definetly use gourmet and Amazon again.  Thank you for professional and satisfing response.

I can't wait to get this! In the 70s-80s, we used to go to Germany quite often and always made sure we stocked up on "krauter kase" (sap sago). It's actually from Switzerland and for some reason has become really hard to find in German grocery stores. I was thrilled to find it on Amazon. My favorite way to eat this is by dipping bread and butter into the grated cheese. Yum! (I'm going to surprise my sister! She'll be so happy!)

This is the first Gluten Free mix I have used.  Not allergic to Gluten but trying to cut down on our intake.  They turned out very well.  Nice and fluffy with a dark golden color.  Plus the ingredients are NON-GMO.  Kids couldn't tell the difference between this and our usual Bob's Red Mill.Update to original review.We tried this again and I am surprised at how much it makes.  A great value!  Plus it is whole grain.  Will definitely purchase in the future!
We love this product! Tastes wonderful and is great with mixing fruit into. They dont taste gluten free at all!
These beans are very good:  meaty and tasty-I'm glad I purchased a case.  I also like the fact that they do not have any added preservatives, color etc. and that they are imported from Italy.

These beans are amazing! They're packed in water and nothing else. I just received my shipment last Thursday, very well packed. I was very hungry I decided to try them out of the can. I rinsed the beans in cold water, drained them well and heated them in the microwave for one minute and then added a little extra virgin olive oil. Delicious! So creamy and meaty and no salt. I highly recommend these beans. I can't wait to make minestrone soup with them. Buon appetito!
Great beans to keep on hand, great for pasta e fagioli! I would buy them again.

column9: So happy I made this purchase!
column10: Living in the south, I was a little worried about ordering chocolate for Halloween.  I decided the Wonka Mix Up Halloween Bag would be a better option as we're still in the 80 degree weather range in October.  You get 2 bags, each containing 200 pieces of candy.  The candy is small, but filling.  I sampled some of the Nerds and Sweet Tarts and was happy to find everything was fresh and not stale.  One bag alone filled up our rather large candy bowl.  I'll probably put one bag out for our Halloween party and pass the other bag out the following night on Halloween.  I'm very satisfied with this purchase!

The bag was huge and had a nice selection of candy.  Candy was fresh.  Had sweet tarts, bottle caps,  nerds and laffy taffy.  My family had rather had more of the laffy taffy.  Wish we could have requested our preferences.  The next family might want more of one of the other candies.  Just a thought for next year.  Thanks for a great product.
Too much Laffy Taffy not enough Nerds.  Almost all of the Laffy Taffy was Banana flavored which is one of my least favorite flavors.

Just ordered a single 3.5 pound bag at $39 because of vague descriptions... returned it. I didn't apprecaite that and saw a 2-bag item for the same price when I checked the next day.  Needless I will return and NEVER order from this company again.  Who charges $39 for a small bag of candy?.. rip off for sure.

This should satisfy your (or your kids) sugar craving for a long time.  The biggest downside is the limited variety--Bottle Caps and Sweet Tarts come in a variety of random flavors, but the Nerds and Laffy Taffy are limited to two flavors each.  The Laffy Taffy comes only in Banana and Strawberry flavors and the Nerds comes only in Strawberry and Grape.  Not a problem for handing out at Halloween, but if your family's doing all the eating, the flavors may get old long before the candy runs out.Still, it's a lot of candy, and it's pretty much what I expected to get.  Not a bad buy.
We used this inexpensive (8.76 at the time) candy for my sons 1st birthday pinata and bought more for Easter Egg Hunting!!

This candy came fresh and cheap at about 4 cents a piece. The sweet tarts and bottle caps are on the small side I think there is three of each in the wrapper but it will work just great for the trick or treaters.
This bag helped us keep going on a busy Halloween night - we never ran out of candy and this bag has a good assortment.

column9: Lot of candy, fair amount of it was at least a little stale
column10: Two huge bags of candy - one bag filled one of those tupperware shoe boxes overflowing.  Most of it was a little stale - the laffy taffy was harder than it ought to be, the sweet-tarts were softer etc.  But still it's a fair deal for a work candy jar or a party or halloween.  Seems to include all four types in equal measure - nerds (grape and strawberry) laffy taffy (mostly strawberry, some banana and a few cherry and apple) sweet tarts (assorted) and bottle caps (assorted).

I ordered these items very close to halloween and thought that I would not receive them on time.  To my surprise I received the package a few days early.  All items were packaged  individually which made it very easy to pass out.  The time it took between my order and the receipt of the candy was very prompt and everything was in perfect order.

Got this candy for Halloween.  I live in a neighborhood where children stream uninterrupted for over 3 hours.  So this is the second year I purchase my supplies via Amazon.com.  Order came on time and there was more than sufficient with all the other products I ordered.I had never tried Wonka candy, but it is actually pretty good.

I was happy to find a place where I could get whole yellow peas,I wasn't able to find them in any grocery store, I used to eat them as a kid in Germany and finally I can have them again,thanks for carrying them,and the transaction with the seller was really easy and fast,when they are gone I will order more,thanks,Christel.

I needed some yellow peas for a Polish receipe.  I really didn't want 10 pounds of them, but that's the only way I could find them.  Their taste is not terrific.  I have used them in some other recipes.  I suggest mixing them in with lots of other things, like in vegetable soup.  I still lots of peas left.  Wonder if I will ever use all of them although they don't seem to deteriorate much over time.

I was born in Germany and my grandmother used to make whole yellow pea soup a lot and I loved it,I am so happy I found them here online,because they are not available in the stores here in Michigan,you can buy yellow split peas but that just isn't the same,I reordered them recently because I went through the first ten pounds rather quickly,I did give some to my son and also to a german friend,thank you so much for carrying them,when these ten pounds are gone I will order again,happy holidays,Christel.
We love Crystal Light Fruit Punch.  Granted, this is a LARGE amount of punch but works great when mixed in a very large container.  Nice price.

column4: Leah N Gold "laugh, love & live as much as yo...
column9: Very Good and hot! A lot more flavor subtlety that expected...
column10: This is now one of my favorite ramens ever.  If you're looking to graduate from the stuff you find in the regular American supermarket and your tastebuds are adventurous, you could do a lot worse than this.  It tastes citrus-y, peppery with other notes underneath that round out the flavor so it's not just too 'bright' as some citrus-y foods are or too hot as some peppery foods can be.  It is definitely quite hot, however, so if you're not into hot food, think 3 times before trying this.  That said, you should know that it comes with three separate packets and you don't have to add all of them to the mix.  The main flavor packet is a must, but the pepper packet and the paste could be left out and you'd still have a meal, though not quite as delicious in my opinion.Tastes really good with added dried shitake mushrooms, dried shrimp and dried seaweed, all of which add bulk and absorb the flavors nicely.  This is a creamy ramen -- if you haven't had one of those before, this is definitely the one to start with... again, assuming you like things hot.

I love the shrimp flavor mama noodles, both in their original silver packeted incarnation, and in this creamy shrimp flavor golden packet. Before I tasted the creamy flavor I was skeptical that it would work- kind of like when someone makes a peanut-butter and cheese sandwich. I was amazed at how tasty they were though.Ny only complaint with this amazon offering is that it is way too expensive- you can buy this at a local chinese supermarket for less than $10, so the $30 pricetag is steep. I am not talking about chinatown in sanfransisco either- i get these for $9 in minneapolis in the middle mid west!

column9: Almost as good as the real thing!!
column10: This is my new favourite instant noodle! The Tom Yum soup base is almost as good as the real thing. At 76 cents a packet and under 3 mins of cooking time (you don't even need a pot, just pour boiling water and cover for 3 minutes) this is definitely my go to meal now when I'm short on time.

I thought these noddles seemed like an interesting buy. I love shrimp anything. It took awhile for the packages to arrive, and when they did I fixed a pack right away.I thought I was gonna burn my tongue off. I didn't see anything written in the product discription or title about "extremly spicy" I was only expecting what it said "Creamy shrimp flavor", how that translates to spicy I have no idea. If I had known it was spicy I wouldn't have bought it, now I have several packs of noodles I can't eat.This is a warning to anyone considering buying these, they are VERY hot and spicy. There really should be something in the discription forwarning this. This is why my rating is so low, for lack of warning.

column9: Vivier Grapeseed Oil: A Far Cry From What I'm Used To!
column10: First of all, both tin's had dents in them (I left feedback on that).  Second, the tin says on the side under ingredients "May contain trace amounts of other tree nut oils", for for those that may have allergies- BEWARE!!I'll admit that this is only the second grapeseed oil I have bought.  However, compared with the one that I had been buying (Napa Valley Naturals Expeller Pressed), this is certainly a far cry!  It's a very light color, like vegetable oil, not green like "NVN".  The taste bland; the smell is almost rancid.  I can't tell the expiration date.  There's a small stamp on top that says "10:17", and underneath it "J.01.12".  Aside from a "B2B Space" website (in French), there is no official website to contact them.I planned on using it for cooking (mainly popcorn) because of the high smoke point.  Won't even do as a moisturizer; when it came in contact with fabric it left a rancid smell behind.  Thankfully both cans were a combined $13.68.  Had I paid the full price (basically double), I would say it's definitely not worth it! Needless to say, I won't be buying this again.  If you're going to use this for cooking, I suggest you try another brand!!

I love blended mochas, but can't have them when I diet.  I use this powder to make my much beloved blended mochas and it doesn't seem to stall my weight loss efforts.  I have purchased my 4th can to date, and still love the taste!  It is worth the price to have my treat, and still be successful in my dieting efforts.  Thank goodness for Big Train products!

They serve this in the cafeteria where I work.  They make it thus:  fill a cup with ice.  Pour iced coffee into the cup.  Put the ice and coffee into a blender, and add two scoops of the Lite Mocha Mix.  Blend well.Delicious, and under 200 calories -- compared to 400+ calories for the non-Lite versions.

I follow a low-carb, low-sugar food plan but of course I get the sweet tooth every once in awhile.  This drink helps curb my sweet tooth and satisfies me without making me feel guilty.  If I want to indulge a little bit more, I use chocolate milk instead of regular to make it and it adds just a nice hint of richness to it.  I highly recommend this to everyone and anyone who asks me what I use for dessert and I truly think it is worth the money.  You get a nice big container that can easily last over a month depending on how often you drink this.  One reviewer commented on the price but if you look at it like this... you can easily spend $30 at Starbucks in one to two weeks.  Plus with Starbucks, you get extra calories.  So if you like coffee type drinks and want something sweet, this is your drink!
The product makes a delicious blended mocha.Received product a few days after order.Somewhat expensive, but worth it.
Oh my God,,,,this is the most amazing low carb drink I ever had. I love it. I tastes like S******* cold coffee...I will certainly order agin

column9: The best low carb frappuccino powder out there.
column10: I use this with unsweetened almond milk for an occasional treat and blend with ice!.  Perfect.  The very large can lasts quite a while.

I really like this mix. I got it two days ago and have already made two shakes.  I use 6 oz coffee, 2 oz water, 1 oz heavy cream, 4 ice cubes and one scoop of mix.  It tastes pretty good, definitely better than any other low carb drink mix i've had, and i've had many.  I can taste the fake sugar in it, but that's only because i've been off all sugar and sugar alcohols for quite a while, so i am sensitive to it.  i doubt if a normal person would notice at all.
This stuff is very tasty and convient. If you are willing to fork the money over for something you are simply going to drink, then definitely buy some.

column9: Easy, less expensive, delicious homemade Italian Beef
column10: Excellent dry powder mix.Louie's Italian Beef Seasoning, 3-Ounce (Pack of 8)Nutrition info:Zero fat;  660 mg sodium; 5 gm carb;zero protein; cholesterol 20 mg.Tastes great! As authentic as you can get from a mix.  Skip the one-dimensional, high sodium packets of Italian dressing seasoning for your Italian beef sandwiches, and use this instead.Modifications:***After adding the mix to the water, i mixed it with pan drippings from roasting the beef; this gave even more complex and beef flavor.  I used the pan drippings plus about a cup of water to completely rinse out the roasting pan.***I also shorted the water by 1/4 cup (using 5 and 3/4 cups instead of 6 cups water), instead adding about the same amount of liquid from a jar of Mezzetta "Golden Greek Peperoncini" sliced peppers, to give it a little extra kick.

I totally agree with the other reviewer-this is the best product I have found for crock pot Italian beef. I ordered it from amazon when my grocery store ceased to carry it and it does not disappoint. It's not too salty and leaves the meat tender and with flavor.

column9: Outstanding quality gourmet assorted Italian cookies
column10: Over the holidays in December 2011, I purchased this product for two individuals and had the cookies delivered to both friends at their homes.  The cookies arrived fresh and in excellent condition and were enjoyed by both individuals with them both telling me they enjoyed the cookies very much.  I would definitely buy this product again and not hesitate to order from this supplier for delivery anywhere.  This is a company I have complete confidence in to provide a good quality product upon delivery and who cares about their customers.  Will order again.  Thank you.

The product does indeed have less acid and your stomach will appreciate that if it's sensitive, but the flavor is just simply not good.  My wife and I could not finish the coffee we ordered.  I really wanted to like it but just could not.

Ramune is the Japanese version Lemonade, and it is a really nice drink, if you can get the glass ball to move away from the opening without spraying yourself with your drink. If you have been sprayed once too often, but love the taste, perhaps you should try this candy.I am pretty addicted to the stuff, and eat them 3 or 4 at a time. I enjoy just letting them sit in my mouth with that fizzy taste. They really taste quite a lot like ramune should. Sucking on some ramune candy is nice way to pass time reading, actually. They are quite refreshing.These candies are not hard, and quite chewable for those who prefer that.For anyone looking for a candy that is not over-the-top sweet, give Ramune Soda Candy a shot. It is a nice candy and makes a great snack. Even the container looks like a ramune bottle.
This stuff tastes just like Sweettarts.  I recommend it to anyone who can get their hands on it.

This is my favorite Japanese candy. I first had it 30 years ago when my dad was stationed in Japan, and it's as tasty as ever. It's sweet with just a hint of tartness -- it really tastes like a lemon-lime soda in candy form.

column9: It's Ramune in candy pellet form!
column10: Ramune is a popular Japanese soft drink that has a marble sealing the bottle. To open a Ramune, you have to use a special poptab to push the marble into the neck of the bottle. It's a fun drink, very popular with kids of all ages. Ramune comes in several different flavors, but the original flavor is very much like a Sprite or a 7-Up, in other words a very basic lemon-lime soda.Now, you can recreate that taste with Ramune candy. It comes packaged in a miniature plastic Ramune bottle and tastes remarkably like it's liquid counterpart.  If you love the taste of Ramune, it's a no-brainer that you'll also love this candy. It's high on my favorites list, especially for quick snacking when I don't want a heavy sugar overload. You get a cool fizzy sensation if you just let the candy dissolve on your tongue.Way fun, just like Ramune itself. Can be had for around 99 cents at any Asian market. Order online only if you have no other way to get ahold of this stuff.

It wasn't as big as I expected it to be, and I think it's only worth around $2-$3. But, it was good to try. It wasn't that fizzy, more powdering, but tasted very good and I couldn't stop eating them. It's a fantastic treat for anyone who loves Japanese Candy and Ramune drinks.

I got this for a friend that likes japanese candies. I myself have tried it, and it was a nice treat. First off, this fascinating ramune soda candy is in a small plastic bottle that is reminiscent of a ramune soda drink bottle(minus the marble and glass bottle), and it is about half the size of one as well. The candy is in the shape of pellets and sort of tastes like ramune, but the taste could also be similar to Smarties or Wonka Fun Dip candy sticks in pellet form. Nonetheless a great candy.

column9: It's been a couple hours and they're almost gone
column10: It's official- I'm addicted. I can't stop eating them! These candies do not remind me of Sweet Tarts- as Sweet Tarts are hard and tiny, and these candies are softer and thicker. They are pressed candy powder that comes apart and dissolves when you chew it. The sweet, unique taste fills my mouth, and instantly I reach for another.In the two minutes I've taken to type this review, they are now gone and I'm contemplating buying in bulk. They aren't fizzy at all, but they are delicious!

This soda is AMAZING!!!!! you have got to get your hands on it! It tastes like real candy (sweatarts) and once you take one sip you have to drink the entire bottle! Then you have to come back to Amazon and order more!!!!! Loved it!

If you have an Asian foods store anywhere near you, get these great candies there! They will often have these for $1.50 or less a pop! Don't waste your money unless you're desperate, and if you're desperate buy them in the bulk 20 pack!These candies are not too sweet and very cute. Finding the little faces on the candies are the best! I've found a good 5 different expressions so far (My favorite is the kissy face.) Have one, or have a whole bunch! Chew them, suck them, play with them, or just eat them!I tend to not eat the whole bottle in one go; they're like mints to me but VERY ADDICTING!
The candy isn't even fizzy its just powder and sweet tarts taste better than these

column9: I don't need cinnamon rolls that badly.
column10: I got this in a Care Package from the Celiac Disease Center. I tried it right away because the expiration date was approaching. They were pretty easy to make and they tasted okay, but they were kind of hard - not soft like cinnamon rolls should be. I would have to need cinnamon rolls pretty badly if I were to go through the trouble to make these again. I wouldn't recommend it to my non gluten free friends for sure.

After 4 years of eating GF (and NO cinnamon rolls), these were such a treat! I could eat them all in one sitting, so I have to restrain myself. They are a little heavy and aren't equal to Cinnabon, but for me, they are YUMMY.
Unless you're desperate for gf sticky buns, this mix isn't worth it. The roll came out tough and relatively flavorless. Not recommended.

The Caribbean El Yucateco is a midway point between their regular habanero sauce and the hotter Salsa Kutbil-Ik -- the sauce smells spicy but a bit fruity when you open it up, but once it's on your tongue it tingles pleasantly. (disclaimer: I really like spicy food, so my "tingles pleasantly" may be "burns horribly" to some folks)  The sauce has a bit of onion powder and a rich flavor, and isn't too heavy on the vinegar since it uses a carrot base like Melinda's habanero sauces.  The piquant burning feeling lasted about 30 seconds if I took a drink of water and ate some tortilla chips to 2 minutes if I just let the flavor dwindle away normally.  This is good stuff; give it a try if you like your hot sauces flavorful instead of a pure capsaicin kick in the teeth.
A nice change from typical Mexican hot sauces.  Very good and unique flavor.  Flavor ends with a pretty good kick.

My rottweiler is allergic to beef, and so I've had to stop giving her marrow bones and regular rawhide. I was thrilled to find these pork chews. She loves them, my shoes are safe, and they're sold on Amazon for a better price than at Petsmart, especially considering the free shipping with the Prime membership.

While these bones are pretty large, my 20 lbs dog is still able to thoroughly enjoy them.Sometimes I jam other (softer) treats into the folds of the roll as an extra incentive for him to chew.One bones lasts quite a while.A little pricey, but worth it (especially since one bone lasts my little dog so long.)

Both of my kitties love these, but be warned, anytime you have a food item that comes in this type of resealable bag you are going to have a cat stampede! They learned the sound of the bag quickly and they love these treats!
My cat LOVES these treats. I love that they are low cal treats. She begs me for these every evening. I love that they don't have any menadione in them.
These treats are good for your cat.  They like them and they aren't very expensive.  My cat really likes them.

My four cats LOVE these treats!!  They go from easy going animals to crazed fiends at the sound fo the bag opening.  No one wants to share.  They all want the whole bag for themselves.  It is a sight to behold!

Pumpkin...who'd a thunk it!Helps with our cats digestion and *ahem* what comes afterwards!Been giving them Weruva products for 2 1/2 weeks, chicken flavors including this one....let me just say that litter box clean up has been a BREEZE.Plus, they LOVE THIS STUFF!!!! It's like a Nom-Nom fest!Give it a try!!!!

I bought this pouch along with several other wet cat food brands to see which ones my 4 picky cats (who eat more dry food than wet) would like, and I have to say this one beats the others hands down.  Because it's real shredded chicken pieces in a small amount of liquid, my cats couldn't really tell the difference between this and regular chicken.  The one benefit this has over regular chicken is that it is a balanced diet that has all the nutrients adult cats need and is AAFCO approved.  Needless to say, it was gone within a minute or two.  I will need to try Weruva's other flavors and get more of the Pumpkin Lickin Chicken for my babies.

column9: Weruva Pumpkin Lickin Chicken pouched cat food
column10: The cats do love this food and I feel good feeding it to them because it is high quality food.  Read the ingredients and you may forget you are looking at a pouch of cat food, no ambiguous contents like "poulty by-product meal" here.  My only caveat is the cost.  Yes, I know you pay more for good quality cat food but I have read that even a lower quality wet food is better for your cats than the best dry food any day.  I feed my cats wet food once daily and they have "grazing priviledges" with a bowl of high quality dry food (Solid Gold Indigo Moon Holistic Cat Food) that I typically have to fill once a day.  I may buy this once in a while as a treat but they seem to enjoy the less expensive leading brand just as much.

Was looking for healthier food for an old cat, especially wanted to replace canned food which has been linked to thyroid disease. This food gets good reviews for being in pouches, but our cat really does not care for it. She is not finicky, but never got exited about it. She does like the liquid, but she ignores the food itself. Also, once she licks the juice and picks a little at the chicken the remaining chicken gets dry really fast and she never goes back to eat it.
I had to give this to the local cat shelter; my cats wouldn't touch it.  FYI, cats don't like vegetables!  I should have known that myself.

130 calories, 0 carb, 14g protein, 2g saturated fat (6g healthy fats), 30mg cholesterol. high in omega-3s, free of any preservatives or fillers. if healthy foods are what you're after and you're not afraid of deep sea fish, this tuna is a very good choice!if flavor and texture are what you're after, on the other hand... this tuna is still a great choice! this is the only olive-oil packed tuna i've tried so far, and i've liked it so much i've stayed put (i've heard good things about progresso's, which is similarly priced, and some brands that are out of my price range-- frankly, i just can't afford to fall in love with a $32 can of tuna...)the first thing you'll notice on opening a can of this tuna is that the contents smell *good* -- not rankly fishy, not oily, not acrid or stale. it's yellowfin, not albacore, and the flesh is pink and comes in thick, meaty layers, not watery bits and pieces the way some tunas often are packed. the texture is succulent-- moist without being watery and rich without being greasy. the flavor is good, too-- the tuna itself has a very satisfying meatiness to it, fine tuna flavor heightened with a bit of salt, and the olive oil gives a little green sweetness at the same time. it's the only tuna i've felt compelled to describe as "beautiful" right out of the can... also great in casseroles, on canapes, in tuna salad sandwiches, etc. it has a robust flavor that stands well on its own and also performs well alongside other ingredients.of course it's a good idea to keep an eye on the amount of fish you consume, particularly tuna, which has been documented as containing high levels of heavy metals in several studies. look up guidelines suggested by the Seafood Choices Alliance and the Environment Defense organization if you're unsure of what is generally regarded as safe for someone of your age and gender. That said, when you do consume tuna, it should be GOOD tuna. this is the canned tuna that i buy for myself, and i DO find it to be GOOD! i think you will, as well.dolphin-safe & wild-caught-- enjoy!

column9: The best tuna in a can
column10: This tuna will make you rethink those casserole and sandwich recipes.  Packed in good quality olive oil, it is tender and flavorful and tastes like -- well -- tuna!Cook your pasta, add your favorite sauce in a jar, and at the end, put in a can of this tuna (drained).  Don't break it up too much, just heat it through. Or just pile the tuna on a sandwich with a little mayo and some pickles on the side.I buy it by the case (much cheaper than in the Italian delis) and give it to people I really really like.

column9: Best Tasting Tuna On The Market
column10: Take it from an Italian, this is the best tuna and so glad I found it at Amazon. Can't find it anywhere in Las Vegas. The family had this shipped from NY to us because it's worth it.Try it with pasta. Put some olive oil in a pan, sliced up garlic, red onions, and some tomato sauce. When the onion and garlic is translucent (don't let it burn), add a couple of tablespoons of sour cream, add the whole can of tuna (oil included), mix it all up and put it over your pasta...WOW!!!!!!!!!!!!!!Update: I found out that this tuna comes from Thailand. I used to think it came from Italy. The caution here is mercury. There are no government controlled food inspections in Thailand as there are in the US, so you may be taking a chance with mercury poisoning. I'm very disappointed and will not order again...

column9: You will love Genova Tonno Tuna!
column10: I got very spoiled when I lived in a big city having access to this brand of canned tuna packed in olive oil.  The flavor and quality truly canot be beat! Recently, I moved to the country where there are no grocery/specialty stores that carry this product or anything close. I was so happy when I found that I could order it on line.  Everyone that I serve this tuna to agrees that it is the best!!  You can literally eat it right out of the can with a fork!
Incomparably better than regular tuna.  My favorite for all uses.

column9: Best Tuna fish in a can
column10: I eat Genova Tonno tuna every week. It is packed in olive oil and lightly salted, with no preservatives or soy additives. I just open the can and eat it with a fork. It has great flavor, texture, color and smell. I recommend that you try it.

I had heard that tuna packed in olive oil tastes better than any other type, but until recently I had never tried it.  I found this tuna at a bent & dent store, and bought 4 cans.  I wish I'd have bought more!  As soon as I opened the can, the smell was so good I just knew it would taste good as well.  It was far less "greasy" than tuna packed in vegetable oil.  I simply set it on paper towels for a while to get the excess oil off.  The texture was lovely, and the taste was just fabulous.  I thought I liked tuna before, but now I love it!  I could just eat the whole can of it with a fork and be perfectly happy.  It makes the absolutely best tuna salad I've ever made, and it's awesome simply plain on top of lettuce with a little dressing.My only problem with it is that it is quite a bit more pricey than what I used to buy, but I will simply adjust, because it's worth it.

This is the best bang for the buck in yellow-fin in olive oil tuna. Olive oil is a preferred fat as is tuna. A small can of this tuna, an apple, a small v-8 and you have a lunch less than 300 calories with enough protein to keep you satisfied. I have seen similar products in gormet magazines for rediculous prices and this product is reasonably priced and of such a high quality, that one need not add mayonaise, relish, and all those flavor boosting additives. It is wonderful by itself or atop a salad with lemon juice for a meal of less than 300 calories.Nutrition FactsServing Size 2 oz (56.0 g)Amount Per ServingCalories 130Calories from Fat 72% Daily Value*Total Fat 8.0g12%Saturated Fat 1.0g5%Cholesterol 30mg10%Sodium 250mg10%Protein 14.0gVitamin A 0% * Vitamin C 0%Calcium 0% * Iron 2%* Based on a 2000 calorie diet
by far the best tuna ever.  i just mayo from whole foods and it is the best. its fast and healthy and best of all it tastes great!

The tuna is the best canned I have found thus far.  Unlike the tuna that is found on store shelves today, either watered down or swimming in a no taste oil.  The Genova Tonno tuna packed in olive oil is excellent to cook with; it imparts its flavor throughout the dish you are preparing.  It is also very chunky not broken up like the tuna being canned nowadays.  I will be ordering another case soon and I very much recommend it.
This is a great product. It's good for sandwiches, salads, or just eating out of the can with some salt and pepper. I don't know why it's not more available, but it's great.

If there is a better canned tuna I haven't tasted it. I've been eating "name brand" solid white tuna for years and this completely blows that away. Honestly, it makes ordinary canned tuna taste like cat food.
Superb, none better. Great right out of the can. In an Italian salad with onions and capers it's great.

This tuna was recommended in a book "How the Rich Get Thin".  It wasn't much more expensive then regular tuna you buy at the grocery store. It is a little more difficult to find. I purchased it at HEB Central Market.It has a bold yet at the same time light quality. I drained it and it wasn't at all oily or greasy. Very tasty.

This tuna at its very best.  Packed in olive oil and then only the best cuts of the fish,  you can open this and go straight to the Salad Nicoise you really wanted.  Or just put the tuna on some toast and sprinkle with some balsamic vinegar.  Either way, you will smile.

column9: Best Darn Tunafish in all of Christendom. .  .
column10: OK - I know it seems ridiculous to review tunafish online, but I'm currently working in montreal and there is NO canned tunafish that is as good as this brand. Sure they have olive oil and all sorts of tuna infused flavors like dill, peanut and sundried tomato, but even their Italian "gourmet" tunafish does not have the olive oil infused almost creaminess and texture of this tuna. I don't know what they do to this tunafish, but this is the best tunafish. Hats off to Chicken of the Sea. Better buy up before there's no more tuna in the ocean.

This is very good tuna and I've purchased from them previously, but this time they get only 1 star as 16 of the 24 cans were dented, some looking as if they were beaten with a hammer. They were delivered via FedEx and the outer packaging itself is not damaged, so I can only surmise they packed up a bunch of dented cans not caring whether their customers get decent product or garbage. For $50, I don't want to have 2/3 of it away...

column9: Good tuna (not the best, but good) and a great value
column10: This is not the best canned tuna I've had--that is sold by Ortiz and is more expensive.  I save that for special dishes.  This is what I use for tuna salad.  It is good, comparable to Cento tuna, and far superior to anything I can buy in my small-town grocery stores.  The 6-oz. can is a nice size and the pack of 24 cans is a superb value.

column9: You'll never go back to Star-Kist!
column10: My Italian grandfather used to buy this brand by the case and give it to us for Christmas.  Essentially, I was raised on it.  Then he passed away and we couldn't find it in stores.  Now it's back and I'm in Heaven.  But beware!  Eat a can of this stuff and you will be hooked for life.  The is no Tuna but Tonno.  Accept no substitutes.
this tuna if fabulous...it is hard to find in colorado and ordering it a case at a time ensure that i always have it when needed --works well in tuna salad; by itself and paired with pasta

column9: This is what canned tuna is supposed to be!
column10: I first bought Genova Tonno in olive oil a few years ago from an upscale market near our downtown apartment. It was on clearance for half price (< $1 for 5 ounce can), so I picked up a couple cans. Wow! this tuna was the way I remembered it should be. Solid packed, moist, and not a floating mess of tuna bits you find now in those cheap Chicken of the Sea and Starkist products. I immediately bought out the remaining dozen cans, and was sad when I finished the last one.Since then we moved from the downtown, and I was pleasantly surprised to find it still at some of the Milwaukee area Pick N Save stores. It usually retails for about $1.90 and is rarely on sale. I think the last time I bought some, I saved a nickel a can. It doesn't matter, because I always know it'll be good. I can eat it plain, but a little mayo and I get two hearty sandwiches out it.So ignore the water canned stuff and buy this if you see it in your store or here on Amazon if you don't. You won't be disappointed.

This is better than other canned tuna in olive oil. It's chunkier and tastier.  Especially good for the recipes in "The Mediterranean Prescription" by Dr. Angelo Acquista....a fantastic book & recipes for following a Mediterranean way of eating.

I bought this cat food because of the wonderful low price and I enjoy the adorable cat on the commercials. My cats did eat this food, in fact they really enjoyed it. However, after reading the ingredients and doing some research, I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my cats. The first three ingredients are (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) are ground yellow corn, corn gluten meal, and chicken by-product meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a cheap corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with cats and dogs." Basically, corn cannot be fully digested, it is just a filler and causes pets to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more (more for us to clean in the litter box), and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Friskies at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful cat food. I suppose you get what you pay for. I think the only reason why it was cat-approved may be because it contains artificial flavors that taste good to cats and because I usually feed them dry food for dental reasons and wet food puts off much more of a scent for them to enjoy. I recommend to stay far away from Friskies, as it is simply a very low quality filler food. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat meat, and there just isn't real meat in this food. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural, dry foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or corn.

The soda stays fizzy forever (we left a half of a bottle with the cap on outside fo the fridge for over a week while we were on vacation. We came back and the soda is still fizzy.). You can control the fizz and we don't have to run out for a case of seltzer everytime my boyfriend realizes he's out. Plus, if you're concerned about wasting less and drink alot of seltzer then you'll quickly realize how many fewer bottles you leave out for recycling (better to not use in the first place instead of recycle!!!)Try a Torani or Monin syrup if you want "real" soda.
