When the lab first tried these, they cut her gums, and when she would leave pieces of the chew on the floor, if I stepped on them before noticing them, they'd cut my foot!  I noticed this about ALL the varieties of Dogswells Sweet Potato Chews.  I threw them all out.
My 2 poodles just love this product. And they are good for them. And I received them in just 2 days with free shipping from Amazon.com.

column9: Dogswell Veggie Life Happy Hips Chicken & Sweet Potato, 5-Ounce Blue Pouches (Pack of 6)
column10: These doggie treats are very good (Just ask my dog!) and quite a bit cheaper than purchasing them locally. Same product I had  been purchasing at the local pet store but at quite a savings.

column9: A great snack for your dog
column10: My poodle just loves these healthy and nutritious snacks.  The natural sweetness of the apple combined with the chewiness of the chicken wrap makes a perfect treat.  He jumps for joy at the sight of the bag (which is resealable for freshness).  Great choice!

The only problem I have with this item is ONLY giving my dogs one a day! They love them! Better than almost everything else! They are hard to get locally, so I ordered them on here. I have a golden and a belgian, and both are larger and one is already showing hip issues. So I give them both supplements (the best I can get) and this is just one more item. I keep organic peanut butter cookies and other snacks for them, but they would prefer these!The order arrived quickly and was wrapped well. I will order again!

column9: Great Substitute for Freebirds Chicken Apple Wedges When You Can't Find Them.
column10: Our dogs love the Freebird chicken apple wedges, but the economic two-pound bag is too hard to find since I purchased them at here-today-gone-tomorrow Costco.  The small bags are a bit pricey BUT they're not made in China.  My brother always insisted that we only buy dog food made in the USA when we had our three labs.  Now I have a beagle and a blue heeler with my guy, and we are always trying to treat them for good behavior.  I found and buy these at Petco.  The bag has more content than the usual packs of Freebirds, and they like them as well, but I didn't realize until reading other reviewer comments where they came from.  Filled with condroitin and glucosamine for the mature dog with hip problems (the blue heeler), I thought I'd give them a try.  Though I don't see any distinct improvement in our 12 year-old Sydney's hips, I don't see anything detrimental either.  They come to the cupboard after coming in from outside or a bath just as before and gobble them down like a kid with candy.  The China factor makes me a little uneasy, especially at that price, but I see no ill effects thus far.  I asked my vet today what she thought, and she said that they're probably fine as long as they're not recalled, but the laws in China are less strict about what they put in their products.  It makes me wonder if I want to risk my dogs being a recall factor if that should happen, so use your own judgement.  All I know is that my own canines love them, and others here seem to have no problem with them either.

column9: My toy dogs LOVE these treats!
column10: These are my Yorkipoo and Shih-Tzu's favorite treats!I've tried getting other brands of similar treats, but they don't compare to the quality of these Veggie Life Happy Hips Chicken & Banana treats.  Even our Labrador loves them!  It's a lot to order at one time (6 packs), but they're well sealed so they stay fresh.
Okay so maybe my dog loves any treats but we think he loves these the most. Not only are they yummy to him but they also help his 12 year old aging bones.
These are great, healthy treats for your pooch. The larger pieces keep them busy for a it as well. Much, much better than rawhide! We've tried a couple different flavors and our dogs love them all!

My granddog stayed with me while my son was deployed to Afghanistan, and I found these special treats for her. They seemed unique, and healthy, so I gave them a try. She loves them! I only give her one a day, after dinner as dessert. She knows what that word means, and will whine if I wait too long to give it to her. She is an older dog, and does have some joint issues, so I really like that these treats have glucosamine and chondroitin. Who knew that dogs like apples!
Love the benefits of hip & joint care since I have a Great Dane. She enjoys getting one every morning after she goes out. Good in more ways than one!

I own a shih tzu that hardly eats anything, and as far as treats go will only eat Happy Hips and (groan!)- Snausages!  Unbelievable!  He'll turn his nose up at filet mignon, but will wolf down a Snausage!  Of course I would rather he eat something somewhat healthy and I have bought many 15 oz. bags of Happy Hips treats through local merchandisers for around $18.99 a bag (plus tax).  Comes to a little over $20 a bag.  Three 15 oz. bags through Amazon with shipping - around $35, vs. three 15 oz. bags through local retailers - over $60.  Same great product - do the math.
My Springer Spaniel  ate them right away but the Malamute sniffed it a lot and finally ate them. I'll stick with the Happy Hips Chicken products.

column9: HAPPY HIPS MAKES A HAPPY HEALTHY HUSKY!
column10: What a wonder healthy treat we have discovered! I never would have imagined that Teecos Niceah Misty Blue would eat bananas!!! Happy Hips also aids us in our training. Niceah is a certified AKC registered Pet Therapy Dog and our patients have enjoyed giving Niceah her Happy Hips Chicken and Banana Treats during our visits. We highly recommend these treats to all happy canines! Robin and Niceah Kulik

The Dogswell Happy Hips Sweet Potato Chews I bought from Amazon were stale.  I have bought these before, in local stores, and they are supposed to be pliable and "chewy".  Although the bags had expiration dates that were in code, each bag I opened, contained "stale" chews.  They broke like crackers and I could hear my dog chomping on them like a bone.  I buy them so I can bend them over and put them in her toys or bones - she can spend a lot of time trying to get at the "treat".  With these, all I could do was feed them to her like snack crackers.  I was very disappointed.  I will continue to buy them, as they are a good product, just not from Amazon.

column9: My dogs love em.... but what's with the white spots?????
column10: I would give it 5 stars but deducted a star due to questionable quality. There were white spots all over the sweet potatoes which worried me as they looked like bacteria or something. I emailed the company and they told me that they had already tested it in a lab and it was found to be starch, which occurs naturally on sweet potatoes. But I still feel uneasy about giving it to my dogs. Why wouldn't they post this info on the bags then?????
This is a fun little gift for sharing some sunshine with a co-worker or friend feeling a bit down. The box is the perfect size for a neat little surprise. The gum even tastes good too!

Well my fault for ordering cat food from a non pet supplier. These were NOT the larger bags I expected. These are 3 tiny almost sample size? Sighsssss live and learn. Dont order any cat food from this place. Its a rip off.

column9: If you are watching your weight, don't break this seal
column10: You know how shortbread can frequently be boring?  Patterson's does a nice "finger style" and Royal Edinburgh does the very best petticoat tails, so it is helpful to only open these when you are sharing or just don't break the seal on the package in the first place--they are nicely crunchy without being too crumbly, and really nice flavor so the little devils call out to you when they are in the house.  Better than I bake on my own--and I have had practice!

I bought this for my Father's 90th Birthday and he enjoyed it so much he REFUSED to share it with any other family members. The cookies came very quickly and packaged quite well. I would recommend this cookie to anyone who enjoys shortbread or has a sweet tooth.

I was so excited to receive the box of cookies.  Shortbreads are my favorite and I love to use them in gift baskets.  I was shocked and horrified when I opened the box and 99% of the cookies were broken.  Cookies taste good, packaging is horrible.  Major disappointment.  I took pics and sent them to Amazon along with a letter stating what had happened. However, I never heard back from them.

I've tried all of the flavors, and this one strikes a particular chord with my mouth.  I like spicy foods, and try every snack with even a hint of spice.  These snacks go so quickly that my mouth is ready for more and my brain forces my eyes and hands to keep searching in obviously-empty bags.  They have a light and tremendously satisfying crunch, which adds greatly to the entire experience.  I will order some more right this very minute.

My dogs love these bones.  I bought all sizes.  My jack russel loves the big ones and the small ones.  My 60 pound mutt loves the big ones. They are great.  They are able to digest them and able to enjoy the bones.  I bought so many of them.  Petsmart for some reason discontinued them I was so upset.  I was so happy to see them on Amazon for a great price. I highly recommend them.

column9: Doesn't last long for agressive chewers
column10: I don't like all the controversy surrounding rawhide bones and don't want take the risk of my Lab getting a blockage so I exclusively give him Booda bones which are safe. My lab is an aggressive chewer and considering this is edible it makes him that much more excited as he LOVES food. He enjoys these bones but devours them in less than 20 minutes. I usually give it to him for a few minutes until he eats half of it and then I take it away to save for next time. This obviously would get very expensive so he has his non-edible Nylabones most of the time and these are special treats.

column9: Great for dogs with stomach problems
column10: My dog gets sick eating a lot of dog treats (even Milkbones), but has always done well with all the Booda bones.  She really loves them & they're good for getting rid of the tartar on her teeth.  I highly recommend these.

Our Siberian Husky is overweight and on a diet.  She also is great at building placque and tartar on her teeth - baad breath! She has a touchy stomach on top of it all.  Tried these bones in all flavors and she loves them.  They help with her teeth and breath.  She gets one bone for her lunch (she's a 3 meals a day gal).  Her other meals are now canned green beans with either yogurt (plain) or low fat cottage cheese.  She has lost about 11 lbs and is doing great!  No more throwing up her food!

column9: Goodbye Rawhides! Hello Peace of Mind - & Dogs Love 'em!
column10: Love these! Well, because...we have 3 dogs (2 were unplanned children ;-) & our 60-LB German Shepherd AND our 40-LB we-have-no-clue-what-she-is dog have both choked on various shapes & sizes of rawhides. The Shepherd choked so badly that, this time, it wouldn't come up. She couldn't cough & started to literally choke to death. I actually straddled her back, attempting the only thing I  knew how to do - the human Heimlich Maneuver! Like where exactly is a dog's sternum, anyway? Well, I tried anyway and thank God it finally did dislodge & we got it out! Was it the Heimlich? I don't know. Probably not. I mean, she still won't tell me... After all, I guess it was very traumatic for her.But in all seriousness, what I do know, is that was the last time any of my dogs have had any kind of regular rawhide bones! Which, I really wanted to let everyone know of my personal experiences; I believe anybody who is at all concerned about giving their dogs rawhides and/or experiencing a similar problem is on the right track to avoid them.Our small part Chihuawa/part something else, first 2 times in-a-row, threw up repeatedly w/rawhide pieces and w/foam. He was VERY sick the 3rd time, so we definitely stopped that! The ONLY kind I did finally take a chance with were granulated rawhide munchy sticks, & they're all fine w/these; though I'm still nervous about them choking on a piece, but neither of them have had any problems with Boodas so far, & they don't swell up in their throats like regular rawhides.So, now... It's Booda Bones!Yes, they are a bit on the pricey side, especially for my 2 larger aggressive chewers. I agree with some other reviewers that they are not very long-lasting. But it's all I'll give them now. But, for my half Chihuahua/half something else(20lbs), I give him the smallest ones and they are like mega-saurus bones for him(it is my hope that the manufacturer will start selling these in bulk packages, for less $). I get 3 different sizes for my 3 different whatever-they-are-dogs. They absolutely love them! This includes the assorted flavors, the bacon-flavored, and the yogurt-flavored. Whichever is cheaper at the time and shipped by Amazon.And I owe a big thank you to Brian Amazon, all of you for all of your reviews, Booda Bones, and Amazon!** Confession: This was originally a comment I posted to a reviewer by the name of "Brian Amazon" a long time ago. I have been buying Bones from Amazon, and, only Booda Bones, ever since. They are so great that I've been wanting to write a review, & now finally have the chance to (I have, however, resorted to copying and pasting much of my original [brief... LOL] comment, with some editing).
My dog loves Booda Bones.  They are a bit pricy so I only give him a couple a week as a special treat.  I'll continue buying them from Amazon for the best price.

We have a dog with a liver shunt - so she can't have a lot of protein / can't digest protein.  Booda Bones are the BEST treat for her (and our other dog loves them as well!).  The only 'downside' whatsoever is that they're a tad expensive - but they're worth it!

column9: More of a treat then something to keep your dog busy.
column10: Let me start by saying our dogs love these. As soon as they see the bag they stop whatever they're doing and run to their crates (where we typically give these to them). However, for our dogs these are definitely more of a treat then an activity. I have one dog who is an aggressive chewer who finishes these in under five minutes. He doesn't chew them as much as bite of chunks of it. My other dog isn't quite as strong of a chewer but it usually takes her just around fifteen minutes to eat the whole thing (this review is specific to the Biggest Boodas). So for my dogs this is less of a chewing experience and more of a treat. And when the eat them this quickly, they do get expensive quick.

My dog loves the chicken, steak, and peanut butter booda bones, but he's not as fond of the spearmint/peppermint variety.  My dog will eat it if offered, but my dad's dog who I often sit for will not even touch these.  I wouldn't recommend for a dog who prefers meat.

column9: My dogs have rated Booda Bones 5 Stars!
column10: I have three King Charles Cavalier Spaniels and they are picky, picky eaters even when it comes to Treats.  They love the peanut flavored Booda Bones and have one every day.  They insisted I write this review on Amazon so their opinions could be known.  They're pushy that way...

I was very disappointed by the product.  They are NOT long lasting as I was lead to believe.  I was going to buy Chewlotta's which take my dog about 2 hrs to go through 1, but I thought it was too pricey at $3 a pop.  My dog could eat this whole bag in less than 2 hours.  He does enjoy them though.

column9: Dog really likes, but they go fast.
column10: I have an 11 pound Couton De Tulear.  Small sharp teeth.Dog loves them.These don't last long.  From a value standpoint, I prefer "Checkups," when Costco has them in stock.

column9: love that these are yogurt flavor!  my dog loves booda bones!
column10: I have no problem w/my dog eating these.  He loves these booda bones. I had never seen the yogurt ones; he loves them.
Our dog, a Siberian Husky, just loves Booda Bones.We give her one for lunch most everyday and shepesters us till we give it to her.

Our Boston Terrier loves these bones - we give them to her as a treat or to keep her busy when we have company.  For a 16 lbs. dog she's a mighty chewer and these last her a couple of hours, with breaks to investigate if she's missing anything!  We'll buy more of these!

column9: My dog goes crazy for these!
column10: My chihuahua loves these, especially the peanut butter, chicken, and bacon varities. They have become increasingly hard to find at pet stores so I was happy to find them on amazon. I like that they are safer than rawhide bones and easy to digest and she really seems to enjoy them more than other bones I've bought for her. I tried a few other brands when I stopped being able to find the booda bones at pet stores and she would not even eat some of them. You can't go wrong with these, they are reasonibly priced, safe, help reduce tartar, and dogs seem to love them.
My 3 year old miniature schnauzer loves these bones. I'm really glad that they started making them wheat-free because he has food allergies.
My dogs beg for these treats every night after dinner.  I always make sure I have plenty of supply at hand.
My dog is addicted to these and they're actually fully digestible and don't hurt anything. I've purchased them from everywhere on the planet and will buy from here from now on!

column9: My dogs do not like the flavor
column10: Regular flavor Budda Bones are great for my dogs but they apparently do not care for the minty flavor on these.
The dog really loved these bones and it seemed to freshen her breath.  It was a good treat for a dog with tummy troubles.
My dog really enjoys the Booda bones.  I was very pleased with the price I received and also the fact that they arrived  earlier than expected.
OUR BEAGLE JUST  LOVES THIS PRODUCTSHE TAKES ONE WITH HER WHEREVER SHE GOESESPECIALLY LIKES O CHEW WHILE IN THE CAR
We have three darling Shitzus.  All of them adore Booda Bones and look forward to this wonderful treat.  Thank you Amazon!!

I have a dog who until we adopted her never had oral care,so her teeth were in bad shape. We brush her teeth every 3 weeks and give her 1 booda bone weekly . Not only are her teeth cleaner but some of the staining has gone away. Our vet told us that these are the best thing for her because they digest easily and do not contain plastics.
These are great, but my dog likes to augment them with other types of bones
These took FOREVER to ship and when they did arrive they were not as durable as advertized.  Was looking for a bone to keep our dogs busy, these were more like a snack.

We discovered Grill Mates Salmon Seasoning a couple of years ago and kept a steady supply in our pantry. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to find it the last time I went shopping. After a few fruitless trips to different groceries, a quick Google search confirmed my suspicion: Weber had stopped making this seasoning mix. Fortunately, there's Amazon. A 23 ounce container of this will last us a very, very long time. Recommended for anyone who likes seafood (we also occasionally sprinkle a little on chicken for nice flavor).
I love this seasoning blend used with grilled tilapia. I have had trouble finding it and just found out it was discontinued by McCormick. I plan to stock up!

Since Tonnes stoped manufacturing their "Salmon Seasoning Spice", I hunted about the internet until I came across the Grill Mates product.  We have been very happy with the delivery and quality of the spice.

Got these steaks as a Christmas gift. Four steaks for 90 bucks could be worth it, but in this case it's a scam. They market these as a quality of beef you can't buy in stores but that is simply not the case. There is very little marbling in the steaks and they are Choice beef at best. But let's not forget that Omaha refuses to actually use a USDA rating for their beef. They just use fancy words to make it sound like you are getting amazing steaks when in reality if they were that amazing they would be prime cuts and labeled as such. Take my word for it and go with a company that offers USDA Prime steaks, there are plenty if you just google it. Also, last time I was at costco they actually had a good selection of Prime strip steaks at a price that is cheaper than these. The only reason I did not rate as 1 star is because 3 of the 4 steaks I received had a larger portion of filet than you typically expect with a t-bone. Still, find the prime and stay away from this low quality but well marketed beef.

Recently, I used this spice to marinate some sea scallops. Very very tasty! I bought the spice to make a certain dish that I have yet to attempt. In the meantime, this spice is useful.  The company was very prompt sending the product.
I was surprised to find this on the sweet side. The combo is a nice change of pace. A little goes a long ways. We have tried sweet, savory and traditional uses and we were quite plz'd.

This is a top quality Green Tea and certainly on-par with the best I have tasted (I drink a lot of green tea and tried various brands). Note, this tea does not come in a tea-bag. If you are looking for the highest quality green tea, then this tea will deliver.There is a significant difference between tea of this quality and other high quality expensive teas. This tea is composed of first leaves that sprout in the spring, which definitely has a freshest flavor and aroma with the most potency. The quality drops significantly after the first leaves are sprouted.Even though it is very expensive as a whole, you are only paying around 50 cents per cup. How many top-quality things in life costs 50 cents? Despite the high cost, the benefits are far higher especially if you break it down by per cup of tea.The tea is shipped directly from Korea (it takes about 2 weeks to arrive). It's best to get it from May to June because these leaves are the "first picks" of the spring and is the freshest during that time.The quality shows in the the color, the aroma, the taste, and the kick. The color is light (not dark) green. The aroma and taste is a subtle unami with a very slight tinge of bitterness. The caffeine kick is subtle and very gradual.You only need to use a pinch (about 8-12 leaves) per cup. Don't use too much or else the bitterness will overun the taste. Do not use boiling water; rather use merely hot water. If you use quality bottled water, then the flavor of this tea will be enhanced even further. For me, I enjoy good tasting water even more especially with this tea.

column9: Bold aroma yet its flavor doesn't get in the way
column10: This has a distinct aroma and yet it only brings out the original flavor of the foods you sprinkle it on.  It does what a good salt substitute should do which is to bring out your favorite flavors.  Actually, it seems to do the job even better than salt itself.  Most of the elderly folks that live around here prefer this to salt by far because it doesn't have that tingling aftertaste.  I would recommend buying this if you can't find this at your local grocery store or supermarket even though the shipping is more expensive than the product.

My husband loves salt. But, he also loves this product. It is the only salt-free product that he likes. Since he has Congestive Heart failure, it is important for him to leave off salt.Also, I use this product as the seasoning when I make cheese substitutes. It makes the cheese have a great flavor. YUM!!!

I began using Chef Paul's Magic Seasoning blends 3 yrs ago. This salt free product is THE BOMB.Plenty of flavor--but no salt. It's perfect for adding that extra kick to a recipe without making it taste too salty.I use it in my traditional Chex Party Mix this time of year. This salt-free seasoning blend is a great product for those that sanction their salt consumption. It has great flavor and it is much less expensive via Amazon.com than in-store purchase (if you can find it).
This is the best sodium free seasoning I have ever tasted.I'm enjoying eggs and meat again.carolyn from california

This wasn't available at Amazon in August 2010 so I bought it online elsewhere.  I bought it based on the 5-star rave reviews here.I have to say I'm disappointed.  This product is basically a blend of peppers with a little sweetener added.  I find it kind of yucky.  I realize everyone has different tastes.  I wanted a salt substitute to sprinkle on a bowl of brown minute-rice, which I eat often.  This seasoning is not remotely as tasty as table salt, or as tasty as Onion salt.  To be honest, Onion salt (from Ralphs aka Kroger) tastes 10 times better.For this review, I sprinkled some of it on a paper plate in front of me.  I dipped my finger into it right now and tasted it.  First impression is a little bit of very light sweetness, followed immediately by a bitter taste in the mouth, then some pepper burn on the tongue, creeping back in the throat. I've got to drink some water.  I also tried it on rice 3 times earlier in the week.I'm a little irritated.  It doesn't deserve five 5-star reviews. My wife and I drink about six glasses of iced tea daily... each.  We have two pitchers that we rotate through in the fridge at all times.  Whoever empties a pitcher is responsible for rinsing it out, tossing in four bags, refilling the pitcher, and putting it back to get cold.  The pitcher on the inside is the current one.My wife is a year post-bariatric surgery patient.  Until we discovered this stuff, she used to have problems keeping properly hydrated.  The doctors don't particularly like the idea of her ingesting so much caffiene, but they frankly prefer it to once-every-two-month visits to the ER for intravenous fluids.Personally, I love Monin Blackberry syrup.  I learned about it through Chili's restaurants; I used to gladly fork over the $2.50 for their iced tea, which was always too weak and didn't have quite enough blackberry syrup for me.  Now, thanks to the Amazon subscriptions to both products, I have all I want for about 25 cents a glass total.  My daughter is equally fond of Monin Mango syrup, I may send her a case for Christmas!

I use the store bought Lipton (less than $2 for a 100 ct).To make GA style sweet tea, boil water in a small saucepan.Once it's at a rolling boil, turn the heat off and place 5-6 bags in the pan and let steep for about 5 minutes.Remove the bags once the water is dark brown.Pour over 1 c. sugar in a gallon pitcher. Stir to dissolve sugar.Fill the rest of the way with water and stir.You can add more sugar if you like it sweeter (we sometimes use 1 3/4 c sugar).This tea is delicious, and not-sickly-sweet. Secret to sweet tea is to dissolve the sugar in hot water.

I throw a bag in an all glass coffee pot and put it in my microwave till it comes to a boil then take it out. It cools off, I put it in the fridge and when I want tea I pour about 2/3 glass add more cold water and ice and it is just right to drink. It is good tasting tea. You won't be disappointed.

This is the only way I can find the gallon size Lipton tea bags and it's a great price too.  I order a few at a time so I don't run out and I get free shipping when I buy more than one at a time.  Amazon is the absolute best way to get this item.Mobile, ALKim

I like very strong iced tea and I use one bag for 1-1/2 qt. and make that much every other day. It's so easy to just pop one big bag in rather than unwrapping several small ones. The material used for the bag is different than the regular size; thicker, sturdier.I like this size!

Our family drinks about two gallons of iced tea a day. Liptons gallon size bags make it easy to have iced tea on hand at all times. We put 3/4 cup of sugar into hot tap water add one tea bag and let it sit on the counter for a couple hours, remove the tea bag stir and refrigerate. So simple and so refreshing.
This tea is perfect for getting that "sit in the sun or fresh brewed" tea taste in just minutes. I've used "cold brew" for over a year now and it always wins out over the brewed tea and sun tea.
I have always had to open 10 or so normal teabags to make iced tea in my automatic iced tea maker. Not anymore. This is a perfect solution...1 big bag is all you need.

column9: i love liptons...and specially the big nas
column10: i am a huge ice teafreak. I have a 3 gallon water tank in my fridge that is always holding Ice Tea.the cool thing with this bags is I need 3 for my whole tank.I have been told the right way is boil one pint of water for each gallon of end product you need and mix with water after the brewing. Must say, tastes great and is very convenient.I will definitively buy it again!

column9: Premium price for the benefit of home delivery
column10: I am a subscribe and save customer for the regular size black tea bags as well as the 20 count superfruit blends, so I bought this before doing my homework.  I just happened to visit my nearest warehouse club and spotted this tea for $8.77, nearly half what Amazon is charging.  Anyone who thinks this is a bargain is living a sheltered life.  I am cancelling my subscribe and save for this item.

I fill a glass gallon jar with cold water and add 7 regular size tea bags to the water. I put the lid on (if I have one. If I don't, I use tin foil, saran wrap, or a quart ziplock bag) and then put it outside in direct sunlight while I'm gone to work. Once I get home, I take the tea bags out and add a cup of sugar to the warm tea. Stir it up really well and then put in the fridge to chill. YUM!

column9: Not as good as luzianne and not southern style
column10: Overall it was okay, but I much prefer the luzianne iced tea though. This tea is not as smooth as luzianne. It has a very strong flavor that I would attribute to Indian teas (lipton is after all british/european company). This is not necessarily a bad tea- it is just something I imagine would be better hot rather than iced. Luzianne is smoother, better (in my opinion), and easier on the wallet.
works great in our new sweet iced tea maker!  Lipton tea is the best! What else can I say? Yummy!
Lipton teabags are the best for making sun-tea and the only people that make gallon size bags which makes that even better when i make my sun-tea during the summer thanks Amazon for carrying them

column9: Better Tasting Than Any Pre-Brewed Tea
column10: Several years ago, I was introduced to these one-gallon tea bags by my local warehouse club, but they no longer sell them.  Now I buy them from Amazon.  Brewing instructions recommend steeping the bag in about 1 quart of boiling hot water.  After the brewing process is complete I remove the tea bag, add ice to cool it, pour the concentrate into a one-gallon plastic jug and add water to make a full gallon. I then store the jug in my refrigerator.Growing up in the state of Georgia, always having fresh-brewed iced tea at home was almost a religious rite.  My mother was a home-economics major and one of the first gifts that she gave me when I was equipping my own household was a crockery pitcher for making tea.  After more than 40 years, I still have and use that pitcher, which will last a lifetime with care.  Unlike glass, which can shatter with temperature extremes, or a metal saucepan which can add a metallic taste, the modern equivalent to my old crockery pitcher is the Fiesta Pitcher Fiesta 67-1/4-Ounce Large Disk Pitcher, White which is the perfect size for this process.The result from this small effort not only costs dramatically less (about 35-cents per gallon) than buying jugs of tea that have already been brewed, my tea is fresher and tastier.  Brewing just a few jugs of this tea yourself, I believe, will convince you to wean yourself from even the best brands of already-brewed tea

I thought the larger family size bags were the best until I found these gallon size on Amazon! Doing the math, one gallon size bag equals about four of the large family size bags. For those making iced tea by the gallon, it makes sense to use one larger bag than four. I hope this product continues to be made available by Lipton.

This is the best iced tea and so easy to make, in 10 minutes you will be drinking the tastiest and most refreshing drink.  Fill a 2 cup glass measuring cup with water,  microwave for 4 minutes,  place the tea bag in the water.  Let sit in microwave for 5 minutes,  remove tea bag,  squeeze bag slightly to remove all the tea goodness,  but don't squeeze it to much, because the bag will split.  Fill a rubbermaid pitcher or a glass tea jar with the spout with 14 cups cold water,  pour in the brewed tea concentrate.  Its ready to drink,  I fill a red solo cup with ice pour tea over,  drink and repeat,  so refreshingly tasty. Store in the fridge to keep it nice and cold.  I also take it to work with me everyday, I pour it into a lifeline stainless steel bottle with a handful of ice,  drink it all day and when I run out I just fill the bottle with water.  So much cheaper then buying something to drink everyday when I'm at work. Its a great deal and its all natural drink.

column9: Best combination of economy and simplicity
column10: We used to buy a case of tea bags from Costco or similar location, then we'd go through the whole process of unwrapping 12-14 tea bags to make a gallon of Iced Tea.  Wow is this so much better!!!I did a quick cost comparison and these "Gallon Size Tea Bags" are a little more expensive than buying individual tea bags but the time savings and simplicity is certainly worth it.  They come in one large box, unwrapped and ready to go.  If you brew a gallon at a time or multiple gallons then this is simply the best way to do it, you'll never use individual tea bags again.

If you drink a lot of tea like I do this is for you.  Makes a gallon at a time:  Heat up a teapot of water to boiling, pour the water in a gallon container, and throw in the giant teabag and stir the bag around a couple of times.  Let it steep for a while (the longer the stronger) and remove the bag and top off with water up to a gallon.  If you pour the boiling water right on top of the dry teabag, it often ruptures the bag and you have to strain out the teasleafs.
So easy to just drop one of these bags into water, to make a gallon of tea. No mess, no unwrapping, just open the box and product is ready to use!!
These gallon tea bags work great with Mr Coffee Iced Tea makers!  One bag makes a gallon of iced tea...and you can subscribe via Amazon and save money with FREE SHIPPING too!

I use to chuckle when I read about busted tea bags until my last shipment. The 1st 48 count box I had 17 unsealed tea bags. Just opened the 2st box of the 48 count double box and found 8 out of 24 tea bags not sealed! And I still have another box of 24 to go. :( I to have chosen to cancel my subscription. I'm a poor country boy and cannot afford short changed boxes of Lipton Tea. I realize it is not Amazon's fault. They never bagged the tea. Oh well. Thank God for Walmart!I may give Amazon another chance with my tea order in 6 to 9 months. Maybe by then this poor shipment of unsealed tea bags will be gone. Going to miss the convenience of the gallon size tea bags.

I am an iced tea-a-holic and know good tea when I taste it. I already use Lipton tea bags in the family size bags which takes 3 bags to make a pitcher of tea and really could use 4 to make it strong enough for me, so this box of 24 tea bags at $3.00 a box makes 8 pitchers of tea. I ordered these tea bags with subscribe and save and got two boxes of 48 bags each for app. $10 total and one bag makes a rich, smooth, strong pitcher of tea with the best taste I have had in a long time. I can make 96 pitchers of great iced tea. I am so happy to have found this great bargain and this good tea. Other tea lovers should try it, you will not be disappointed.

I receive this tea as part of Subscribe & Save and I haven't had a problem with it. The bags are convenient for sun tea or brewed ice tea. The bags themselves have all been sealed, but I have found loose leaves inside the box just as you do when you buy tea in a regular grocery store. When you consider the quantity of tea you are dealing with in these boxes I did not find it to be an unreasonable amount and I did not have to toss any of the bags due to bad seals. I have now received 2 shipments and have no complaints.

perhaps it's just my bad luck of late, but in the two cartons i rec'd, many of the bags were improperly sealed and had to be discarded. further, a couple that seemed intact managed to open during brewing. a good concept that failed for me.
This gallon size bag is perfect for gallon size jugs of ice tea.  The tea isn't too weak or too strong.  Just right.

I have a Mr. Coffee tea maker ~ use 1 of these gallon sized tea bags in it, and it's perfect!  Makes excellent tea, and actually saves me more money than buying generic & using 8 bags to get tea strong enough.  I went on suscribe & save w/ this one ~ I'm convinced this is a way better deal than I can get in a store anywhere around here, and as we're avid tea drinkers I'm loving this!

column9: One of the Four Lipton Teas That We Keep in the Pantry
column10: Living in Houston, Texas means really hot summers! Here, an important part of any hot summer is plenty of iced tea. Most of the year when we have company iced tea is always on the menu. There may be times in the winter, when temperatures plunge down below 60 degrees that we may not serve iced tea; but that rarely happens I'm happy to say.Lipton's Iced Tea has been the iced tea of choice around our house for decades; my wife always does the preparation as she follows a strict pattern for brewing tea. First of all she makes it strong always using multiple bags of tea per gallon; she figures she needs to compensate for melting ice ahead of the fact.She likes hers without anything in it, I prefer mine with sugar. Either way it tastes really great.

column9: If my math is right, it's a good deal
column10: First off - the product itself is delicious. This is so much easier than opening a million little tea bags every time I want to make iced tea.
these gallon bag sizes make it a lot easier to make refrigerator tea.

Before we were using single serving tea bags strung together to make a gallon of tea. Recently purchased a Lock & Lock Storage 1 Gallon Large Pitcher (available on amazon) and these are great just drop the massive bag in and you're done.

I'm a huge Indian cuisine fan and I've tried a lot of the grocery store sauces and kits.  Spicy Nothings only has 3 flavors right now, but all 3 are spot on! column9: So easy to have great tasting curry!
column10: The spicy and tangy curry was fantastic.  It has a great balance of flavors and doesn't need anything added to it. Just pour over whatever you've stir-fried and it's wonderful.  I tend to like a "medium" spiciness with full flavor and that's exactly what this is.  It makes for a great quick and easy meal that's very tasty and healthy.
for my taste anyway.  The flavor is great but I'd like less burning. I'll recommend it but you have been warned.

I seriously love this stuff.. The madras is good too but this is my absolute favorite. In the process of trying the othersI've been to many Indian restaurants and this stuff is pretty much dead-on accurate in flavor profile.Thanks for quick and easy Indian food!!!
It's good.  I'm happier with this product than I have been any other including some indian restaurant meals.Bought one, now I'm getting a case.

Tried this as a sample once and was hooked! This is the best Indian-style prepared sauce I have ever tried -- I have tried many and was always disappointed -- this one really delivers. I eat it with naan, with rice, on meat, as a dip for pita bread, or whatever I'm having at the moment. I have it on the table like some people have ketchup; if what I've cooked up comes out bland, I just add a little sauce to my plate.My favorite flavor is the spicy and tangy (vindaloo). column9: Stash Earl Grey Is The Cream of the Crop
column10: I could not disagree more with the previous reviewer.  Stash Earl Grey tea is my gold standard.  I've regularly used many different brands -- including some of the "subtle" kinds that the previous reviewer favors -- and nothing compares with the bloom and fragrance of the Stash.  The others are either too "orangey" or too tepid (although much more expensive).  If Earl Grey tea is worth drinking over the many weak-flavored imitations and other black teas out there, then Stash is the only choice.  I've used it for more than 20 years, and I always keep coming back to it after flirting with other teas, because it is of the highest quality and consistency at the most reasonable price.  Five stars for Stash!!

***This Earl Grey Tea from Stash is plain, and definitely not subtle because of a strong bergamot component---way too strong! If you really, really love bergamot you may like it, but I much prefer a more subtle and more complex tea. It tastes like perfumed black tea; I could hardly drink it. I could not tell the difference between it and Stash's Double Bergamot Black Tea---both are just swimming in oil of bergamot. I am an Earl Grey fan, but just couldn't stomach this tea.It seems like the quality of the black tea is very good, though, because even with a longer brewing time, the tea did not become bitter...so, if you can stand being hit over the head with the bergamot flavor, you might enjoy it.Only recommended for those who want a strongly perfumed bergamot Earl Grey.***

Unquestionably the most refined of teas, Darjeeling comes from a region in the Indian (West Bengalese) Himalayas close to the Nepalese border, 7000 ft above sea level. Originating with the small-time, private, mid-19th century plantations of a British civil surgeon named Dr. Campbell, tea has long since transformed the region into a major economic center, with over 80 running gardens producing over 10 million kgs (over 22 million lbs) of tea on a total area of almost 20,000 hectares (approximately 75 square miles), and employing over 50,000 people on a permanent basis, with a further 15,000 being hired during the plucking season (March - November). The area's natural climate with its mixture of rainfall, sunshine and rich soil makes for a very distinctive flavor, and to be called "Darjeeling," tea *must* have been grown *and* processed in that particular region.Darjeeling tea comes in several harvest varieties or "flushes": the lighter Easter harvest or first flush, and the stronger Spring harvest or second flush, which has an unmistakeably fruity, Muscatel-like note. (There is also a Summer harvest or third flush, which is even stronger than the tea from the second harvest, but it is somewhat less refined and therefore less popular than the first two varieties.) Twinings' variety is a second flush tea with a subtle, quintessentially Darjeeling perfume; a great introduction to this region's exquisite teas that will hopefully make you curious for more.

column9: Good value and fun introduction to the 'champagne of teas'
column10: Twinings is known for delivering consistency and value. This tea is no exception.Most of the Twinings Darjeeling blend is black, but you can spot some green particles. The Twinings loose tea has no uncut leaves. The blend uses smaller, less-expensive particles which infuse more quickly than whole leaves.The Twinings tea has enough tannins to tolerate milk or a sweetener. It has some harshness when infusing is done at too high a temperature or for too long.If you drink tea without additions, I suggest steeping not more than 2.5 to 3 minutes to control bitterness. You may even want to check every 15 seconds starting at two minutes, since Darjeeling can quickly 'bolt' to a point of unpleasant sharpness. To avoid particulate matter in your drink, use a strainer or infuser with a fine mesh. (Amazon sells Tovolo, Teeli, and Frieling/Swissgold filters with very small openings in their screens.)To gain the best flavor, I recommend brewing at a temperature of 185F or cooler. (A clean candy or meat thermometer can quickly guide your efforts.) If you have been brewing with water that is near boiling, you will be shocked by the huge transformation from using water that cools a couple minutes after reaching the boiling point.I have enjoyed quality Darjeeling, the 'champagne of teas,' for over three decades. And, how do I rate Twinings? A bargain. If your enjoy Twinings, I suggest trying some other Darjeeling teas, perhaps estate grown. The better Darjeeling teas come from the higher elevations where the cooler mountain environment slows leaf growth and develops a fine flavor. Where should you search? Check reviews at Amazon and other sellers. Among the packaged brands, I love Peets - normally known for their coffees.Twinings is a bargain and a fine introduction to the wide range of Darjeeling teas.

Twining has a distinguished line of fine teas. This Darjeeling is one of Twining's best. Darjeeling is a fragrant tea variety with a refreshing but not overpowering tea flavor. Twining's version has no off tastes or after tastes -- just good old fashioned Darjeeling. It brews well a cup at a time, but is also fine in a pot. It brews well over a fairly wide range of steeping times also.You can buy this tea either in bags or in bulk loose tea. I strongly recommend the latter, as loose tea gives you so much more flexibility in amount and strength of your brewing. However, I can attest that I find absolutely no off flavors from the bags. So if you are on the go, by all means, carry a few bags with you in a plastic bag or other sealed pouch.You can pay more for a good Darjeeling, but you will be hard pressed to find a better Darjeeling at a lower price than this Twining.

column9: Good Gum - Worth the Extra Cost?
column10: I like Trident Vitality...but is it worth the extra cost over traditional Trident? Meh.There's a bit of ginseng in the gum, but...well...I'd never have known this except that it's on the package.I've found the flavor to be good and long-lasting.So...good stuff that's a bit expensive.

Trident Vitality packs have only 9 pieces of gum per pack, as opposed to the similar Orbit White or Dentyne Ice's 12 pieces. However, I usually chew 2 pieces of the Orbit or Dentyne where I only need 1 piece of the Trident as the pieces are larger. The length of time that Trident lasts is comparable to Dentyne and Orbit, if not better. The gum itself has the same hard outer shell, but the inside is softer than the other two which makes it less "annoying" to begin chewing.
