It just won't work.Well, the other day I was in our nearby grocery store and I spotted some Trident Vitality gum of a variety called Awaken. That sounded like just the thing to have in the glove compartment of the car. It's a real fresh, zesty, peppermint-flavored gum with added ginseng. Tastes real good. Plus, it's sugar free. It comes in little "pillows" rather than sticks and I'd probably have to chew a couple to get a good effect. It's somewhat expensive for chewing gum, but if it helps to keep me awake on the road, it's well worth it.Gary Peterson
That is my newest discovery in chewing gum market. And so far the best. I used to like Wrigley products, but Trident is the winner right now.

column9: No ginseng taste, very sticky, a bit gimmicky
column10: For whatever reason, I didn't realize this was the 'chicklet' style gum squares as opposed to stick gum.  Normally I wouldn't purchase this style of gum because the packaging seems wasteful for what you get product wise and because there's no wrapper left to spit your gum out in on the go (blister pack houses the gum pieces).That said, I think the box is pretty cool (the top 'clicks' when you open and close it) and the gum is tasty but sticky!  I could definitely see this as being problematic for anyone who has dental work, such as braces (though I suppose technically if you have braces, you shouldn't be chewing gum).As for the Vitality "Awaken" aspect of this gum, pure gimmick IMO.  Ginseng infused my tushy!  It seems to me they just put 'Ginseng' on the box to attract 'wellness seekers'.  There's absolutely no Ginseng flavor to this gum whatsoever and that doesn't surprise me, since it probably wouldn't suit most western palates.  If you want to know what Ginseng is 'supposed' to taste like, albeit sweetend, so you at least have an idea of what this gum 'doesn't' taste like - do a search for Lotte Ginseng Gum.  Haven't had it in years but that's the gum we chewed as kids in Korea for that real 'ginseng' taste when there weren't any honey soaked ginseng roots available for us to nosh on.That said, if someone were to offer me a piece of this gum, I wouldn't decline - but it's something I would pass by at the checkout counter.  I'll probably stick to my orbit or stride.

column9: Not a gum chewer, but this is tasty
column10: I don't chew much gum, more of a hard candy person, but I did find these chiclets (candy coated gum) to have a nice flavor, not overpoweringly sweet or minty with a subtle herbal flavor. The flavor does last for a reasonable time, best guesstimate is around 30 minutes, at least that's the longest I was willing to chew on a piece.The gum is packaged in a flip top box with each individual gum separated in a blister pack sheet of 9. Aside from the taste did I notice any added benefit from the 'dash of ginseng,' not that I can tell. The amount in each piece of gum is fairly small based upon the location of Ginseng extract in the ingredient list, so I wouldn't expect this to be a substitute for any supplements people are taking (I'd rank it more in line with holistic medicine levels).Bottom line, I find the gum good, but not good enough for me to switch away from my hard candy habit. P-)

column4: Sean P. Logue "If you can't win, change the r...
column10: I'm guessing spearmint is more popular, because it always seems harder to find peppermint, which I greatly prefer.Unlike many of the "how strong can we make it" gums and mints out there, this one doesn't try to dissolve your tongue. Instead, it has a nice, clean taste, that lasts a long time and fades off very evenly. Chances are, the gum taste will outlast you, unless you are the type that chews gum until it dies, no matter how long that takes.The "awaken" thing is marketing. In other words, don't expect this to actually wake you up like a cup of coffee. It won't.Sean P. Logue, 2011

I like sugar free minty gum.  That's what this is.  The packaging is classy, cellophane wrapped box with 9 foil bubble wrapped pieces inside.  The piece size is a little larger than similar gum, I purchase. If you usually have 2 pieces, maybe one will be enough. Since I only have one piece that doesn't help with the cost, which is a little high. I would like this better in the non-individually wrapped canister. I keep that type in my car. I keep this in my desk and at home.I like the crunchy shell. The gum is kind of soft at first. Gradually it gets firmer. The minty taste really lasts.  It contains ginseng extract, but it must be a tiny amount. This is everything I want in a gum. I will get it again.

column9: Great Flavor, But Perhaps Not For Kids
column10: I love the peppermint flavor of this gum.  I find that a piece lasts about 15 minutes before it has lost too much flavor to continue.  My sons, however, did not like the taste.  They described it as "too spicy" which for them means that the flavor is a little too intense.  I do find that the pieces are a little small for an adult mouth, though, so I have taken to popping two at a time.  As for the "energy" fron ginsing, et al, well, I would like to say that it is like a double espresso, but I really didn't notice any "energy" boost from this.  Nevertheless, it is a great tasting gum and worth it just for that.

I love to chew gum, but my biggest difficulty with gum is freshness. How well it stays fresh in the package and how long it stays fresh in my mouth are both big deals to me.Trident Vitality - at least the peppermint "Awaken" flavor - solves both problems.The coated style and blister packaging both seem to ensure that the gum maintains freshness while sitting on the store shelf or hanging out in a purse waiting to be needed. I have popped it into my mouth freshly bought and then another piece weeks later, and it tastes the same every time.The biggest surprise has been the long-lasting softness and flavor freshness. I will admit that I don't typically chew gum for more than about 45 minutes at a time before growing tired of it. But, it's primarily because most gums are well beyond their freshness limit by that time, and I hate to chew tough, flavorless gum. I have not been able to outchew this gum! I have grown tired of the persistent, fresh flavor long before it or the softness has even begun to fade.I mainly hold back from giving this gum five stars because of it's price. I will admit, though, that it's a price I'll tend to pay (at least for me - maybe not for handing out to the kids!) because it is such a good gum.The only other thing that could improve on the brand would be for Trident to put out a cinnamon version of Vitality!

column9: I like the taste, but it has a lot of packaging...
column10: I like the smell and taste of this gum.  The ginseng does awaken me a bit and gives me a fresh start to my day.  I tend to chew gum when outside walking to errands to keep my mouth moist since I live in a dry area.  My only critique is that the packaging is quite large for having only 9 pieces of gum inside and I have a pouch purse the pack barely fits in, so I have to take the inner tray out.  I wonder if there is a way for the company to use less packaging for this item.  I do like the design of it though.

column9: Awesome Gum...Just Don't Leave It In a Hot Car
column10: Of all the gum I've chewed in the last few months Trident Vitality Awaken is one of my favourite. (The Reinvigorate flavour is pretty good, too, but is a better choice when you're craving something sweet rather than something minty.)The Trident Vitality Awaken has a great minty flavour that, for me, lasted approximately 20 minutes. Each piece is neither too large nor too small and is packaged individually in a little plastic cell, backed with foil, which I like because then I'm not left with a purse full of gum wrappers.There is, unfortunately, not much for me to say when reviewing this gum. It's really good gum with a strong mint flavour, just don't leave it in your car on a summer day or you'll find all your pieces of gum cracked with some of the insides oozing out :( I ruined one pack that way but have since learned my lesson and will carry this gum in my purse and not leave it in my car. Even with that I'd still buy this gum.

column9: Very good, but not for more than a few hours!
column10: My husband is a marathon gum chewer.  He often chews the same piece of gum for up to 6 hours while at work.  He says that this gum has a nice texture.  It's good for blowing small bubbles and cracking them.  The flavor is good too, not too strong, but just right.  However, after about 3 or 4 hours the flavor and texture start to deteriorate and he has to switch to a new piece.Most people don't chew gum for that length of time anyway.  So this should be good for just about anyone.We got the Awaken kind, and we didn't really notice that it helps us keep awake long term.  But perhaps when you first put it in your mouth, the burst of flavor from the liquid center might wake you up just a little bit.We like it and will probably try it again.

column9: A yummy chewing gum with a little kick.
column10: Trident Vitality Awaken (9 Count) chewing gun is a new product for those gum chewers looking for something refreshing and with a little bite.  "Energy" gum has been out for awhile (I've tried Jolt Gum around six years ago) with Rockstar coming out with their version a year ago.  But those gums are loaded with caffeine (enough as a cup a coffee) and the only thing they do is make your heart beat a little fast and are not very good when you're driving on long road trips (stick with plain old black coffee).  Trident's offering is a whole lot better tasting and I enjoyed the easy kick I received from it.The taste is very pleasant and the energy comes on gradually (not like a speeding bullet) and it doesn't give you a funny after taste either.  If you're looking for a bite of energy in the morning (and not one that will make you crash) then I recommend getting a pack of Trident Vitality along with a regular cup of black coffee.  What a way to start of your day!

column9: "Well, we're finally getting some more RETSIN" - Jerry Seinfeld
column10: *written by her husband*So when I heard that they were going to have Ginseng in this gum, I just thought it was totally unnecessary.  I mean, isn't the taste supposed to already move ya? (Juicy Fruit)  Shouldn't a minty gum already give you "that little lift" of "pure chewing satisfaction"?  (Wrigley's Spearamint) You would think that if you put "a piece of America" (again Wrigley's) in your mouth, it would make you energized already.  But since this product is made in Mexico, maybe we're supposed to see something unique.Look, let's face it, I like how it chews when I first put it in my mouth. I could chew it for about an hour before I could get very tired of it.  And I've practically used about half the pack they've given me.  The aftertaste is pretty cool and nice.  So on that account, I can give this a very good rating.But...ginseng?  Ah, I suppose it takes all kinds to advertise.  Just like how we are glad that we are finally getting some more RETSIN.  But for me, all I want is some sort of gum that will double my pleasure and keep me humming along.  I guess it does the trick.

column9: Long lasting, great taste.  People seem to like it.
column10: Got this and shared some with office co-workers,who liked as well. The package is certainly deluxe, right down to the tiny magnets that keep the box closed (thank goodnesss one will never have that nagging fear of gum falling out of a box.. LOL).The flavor is strong enough and the gum has a nice texture, as one would expect from a premium brand. I found the flavor to last about 30 minutes, about average.I like the IDEA that this wakes you up a bit, too!

column9: This Humdrum Gum Left Me Glum
column10: Summary: This is a mint gum with ginseng, packed in a 9 piece bubble pack. It has an interesting flavor, but fell short on the two things I really look for in gum - long lasting flavor and fresh breath.What I liked:- The flavor is really good. The ginseng adds a bit of exotic spice that compliments the mint nicely.- The texture is great. The outside is crisp, and the inside is so soft that I thought at first that the gum might have a liquid center. Biting into one is really fun.What could have been better:- The flavor drops off quickly. The flavor is really strong for the first minute or so, but after a few minutes, I can barely taste mint. (That last hint of mint does last quite a while, however).- There's little or no breath freshening effect.All in all, I liked the flavor, texture and freshness but I think I can get more for my money -- i.e., gum that leaves me with minty breath and holds its flavor longer.  "Tooth whitening" would be a plus too.

I love the taste of this gum.  Initially the peppermint flavor is crisp and cool which sends a lovely sensation to your sinuses.  Then the peppermint mellows out and you're left with long-lasting flavor that freshens your breath.  I really don't know if I'm having any effects from the ginseng.  I've never used ginseng before.  Is it supposed to make me feel more energetic or vital---as the name of this gum Trident Vitality---seems to indicate?  Ah, well.  It tastes great and there is no aftertaste.  Stays fresh the whole while you're chewing it.

Admittedly I'm not a gum fan (after years of having braces, you don't miss it), but I devoured a few pieces without any issues.The packing is quite nice - comes in a blister pack so I can pop off two pieces and not have to worry about destroying a pack of gum by virtue of being in my pockets. It's like a chiclet.The gum is crunchy but quickly turns super chewy in seconds. I like it. The taste is minty but not harsh or overpowering. The mint taste seemed to last longer than I expected. The gum isn't meant for blowing bubbles, just chewing. Unlike another reviewer, I had no problems with the gum not sticking to my permanent retainer.Overall I like it - I can't say that I was getting a buzz from the ginseng, but it's not too bad. I do like the the feel of breathing out a mint flavor from my nose.

I've used Trident White gum almost daily for years and was expecting this new product, Trident Vitality, to be just a gimmick to up sales.  But it really is a better gum.  The flavor doesn't have that bitter undertone of Trident White and the texture is like real gum.  I'd actually forgotten how much better real gum is to chew until I used this new gum.  I can't say I noticed the ginseng or that I felt more "awake" from using this product but I definitely prefer it to Trident White and will be buying this new one instead.

column9: Hey, they've made gum chewing fun again!
column10: I am not the gum-chewer in my family: my far better half is and Trident is her brand. But duty required me to try this product in order to render a review. Hey, they've made chewing gum fun again! There is a thin Chiclet shell that breaks easily and releases a flood of intense flavor. It is sort of minty, but not overpowering. I have no idea of what ginseng tastes like. But whatever: the taste is strong and pleasant. There's not so much gum as to create a glob as in those wonderful old days of Bazooka Bubble Gum. But I am not a kid any more and my taste for Bazooka has long ago evaporated. But Trident Vitality is just the right amount and as I chew it longer, remarkably long lasting as well. It stays soft and flavorful, though not as intensely as that first  blast. As I said, as someone who hasn't chewed gum in years, this is enough to get me to consider the habit instead of sucking on hard candies.Jerry

This is a great improvement to Trident. The flavor is bold and tastes great. I chew gum a lot of the time. I can honestly say this has a long lasting flavor. If you breathe in you can still feel it working. I think it is a pick me up if you are feeling bored at work or in school, Great gum

column9: Great taste....will not keep you up.
column10: For full transparency, I have to mention that I am a Trident fan. I do not normally chew any other brand. With that said, I tried the Trident Vitality Awaken gum, and the taste is typical Trident mint with a HINT of ginseng. Most people probably wouldn't taste it, but if you try the regular peppermint and the Vitality, you will notice a difference. It's initial flavor, like most others, is much stronger, and mellows within a minute or so. That is not to say that it loses its flavor. It lasts as long as other Trident gum. I did not time it, but at least half an hour. AS for the strength of the taste, I did not find it as strong as an Altoid, but still, it is NOT mild....it will clear your sinuses. Two problems with this, however....First, the packaging....while I like the fact that I won't lose a piece of gum in my pocket, I am not thrilled with having to open the box, pull out the gum packet and then pop a piece out. It's more work than I am used to just for a pack of gum. Of course, you can just keep the packet and toss the box (that's what I did). The other is the assumption that AWAKEN would keep me awake....it did not. Now, keep in mind, if I drink one cup of coffee at 5pm I'm up until 3-4am. I take off half a star for those....and it's just enough for me not to round up to 5 stars. I like the flavor, I like the consistency, and even the packaging looks refreshing....and it is. If you like peppermint, give it a try, you'll probably like it!

I did not think that a chewing gum could be so tasty and good.  We go through several full containers of sugar-free gum a week and without equivocation this is the best tasting of any gum either of us has tried.  It is now (side bar: there is nothing like reviewing a comment:  the "now" had been entered as "not" and that's a wrong)  our favorite.  Not only is the taste striking but above all the flavor is longer lasting than even the regular Trident products.Trident continues a trend that I find distasteful, however.  That is a case of Under sizing.  It has not been that long ago but you could buy a half gallon of ice cream but not now.  It's 56 or 48 oz for the same price or more.While I sincerely dislike under sizing, it will not cause me to stop buying the new Trident.

I always buy Trident gum at the grocery store. I've moved to other brands but always fall back in line with Trident. I'm not sure what it is but they know what they are doing when it comes to gum.Trident Vitality is no different in the fact they know what they are doing. The gum is softer then I'm used to but also has a variety of distinct tastes which I am not used to coming from Trident.I don't honestly believe in the herbs that give you energy, after chewing the gum I didn't feel like running a marathon,should I have? I don't know.It's good gum, buy it for what it is, you probably won't be disappointed.

I found this gum to be pretty good. Its a sweet (but not sugary) peppermint. Great for after dinner, and long lasting.  I don't believe in the ginseng stuff so I am not going comment on that, beyond the fact that I don't feel particularly 'energized' after chewing it.  I would think they would promote more the fact that the sweetener they use in the gum has been shown scientifically to inhibit tooth decay.  I chewed for well over 35 minutes with no loss of flavor, and only slight stiffening.

column9: Very pepperminty and long lasting flavor
column10: This is a super minty gum and the hint of ginseng flavor makes it a little more interesting than the average peppermint gum. I like that it's sugar free and has Xylitol added, which helps reduce cavities. If you can't brush your teeth during the day, chewing this gum is the next best way to have a cleaner mouth and better breath. I love the 10-pack container, very convienient. Everyone in my family who tried this gum liked it as much as I did. 5 stars!

column9: My husband says two pieces are enough even for his big mouth
column10: I got this gum for review for the Vine program, and I highly recommend it.I am not a big gum chewer, but I do like it both as a sweet treat and to freshen my mouth. Usually peppermints are too strong for me, but this one was just perfect - it definitely has that minty snap to it yet it's not overwhelming. I will definitely be buying this gum in the future.As an added endorsement, my husband chews gum all the time, and the more minty, the better. He even likes Altoids  which make me tear up. He usually chew  Dentyne Ice Sugarless Gum, Artic Chill and he will chew 3 or 4 pieces at a time. He said to tell you all, and I quote, "I only need two pieces of this for my big mouth".Sold. So recommended for those of you who like minty gums, and even for those of you who think you don't. Give it a try and see if you like it as much as I do.

I've been chewing Trident sugar-free gum for decades because the lack of sugar seems like the best way to go when grinding into my teeth for hours.This is a very different gum from the old Trident that I'm used to,it has a sugar-free shell that coats the outsides of the gum,kind of like the Chiclets I have chewed in the past but without the sugar.It's a very nice gum and it has Ginseng added to it as well.The taste is really good and there's no weird aftertaste from the sweetener like some gums I've chewed in the past.It's a very nice and refreshing gum to chew

I chew gum a lot and I only like certain minty flavors. This peppermint is more subtle than most gum. I prefer a stronger minty taste, but it tastes very good. The gum stays soft and doesn't become a chore to chew like some typically do. The taste doesn't last as long as Orbit gum, which is what I usually chew. Apparently there's ginseng in it, but I don't really notice any difference from other gum. My only other complaint is that the packets only come with 9 pieces. I have problems enough switching empty packets for full ones in my purse with Orbit which has 14 pieces in it.

I say this whole-heartedly, this gum is really good! We chew a lot of gum, everyone takes some when we go to church, three times a week! So that is a lot. This gum made our breaths fresh, tasted really good, not too much peppermint. Just the right amount. It held its flavor and didn't dissolve into a big slimy mess. I can't wait to try the other 2, this one really set a good tone for the rest!!!

column9: Refreshing with a clean peppermint taste
column10: This sugarless gum has a great peppermint taste that is subtler than most other gums with peppermint. It has a dash of ginseng and has a lasting (about 10 minutes) peppermint flavor all for under 5 calories a piece. The taste is smooth and left my breath feeling refreshed.  I would definitely purchase this.Don't be fooled by the names Vitality and Awaken on the package because there's no caffeine in this gum.

I'm not sure that this gum improved my well-being or any of those other sorts of claims, but it was tasty and pleasant to chew, which is pretty much all I ask of my chewing gum anyway.  This gum has a good peppermint flavor, though not too strong.  I don't really taste the ginger, but I suspect that's what tempers the peppermint.  The texture is quite soft; softer, I'd say, than other chewing gums, which I found pleasant.  This gum kept it's flavor well.  Can't really ask for more than that.

This review is for the Trident Vitality flavor "Awaken (peppermint with ginseng)".What a great idea.  I always chew mint gum at work, (Trident or some dental equivalent whenever possible).  I like that it's good for your teeth and keeps coffee breath at bay.But now with the Vitality line, there is an added bonus...a bit of energy with your gum.  As far as flavor, consistency and dental compatibility, Awaken is indistinguishable from a regular piece of peppermint Trident.  But Awaken has a bit of ginseng thrown in.  Ginseng is an age old root extract that people have used for centuries.  (I used to take ginseng pills when I was on a serious workout regimen.  And man did it work!)  This gum isn't as strong as a pill of course, but I have to say that it was a perfect afternoon refresher.  Rather than choking down a cup of coffee in 90 degree heat or drinking one of those jitter inducing energy drinks, a refreshing stick of gum with a boost is a much preferred alternative.  I highly recommend this to those who chew gum regularly and like a quick and easy way to get a boost.

column9: Mild peppermint flavor lasts longer than you can chew it
column10: This is an excellent new gum by Trident that really gives Take 5 a run for its money in the flavor department.  I chewed a single piece for over 45 minutes, got tired of chewing it and yet it still retained a lot of flavor.  The peppermint was not overwhelming and after a while you could taste the subtle hints of ginseng that really balanced it out.  For the first five minutes it was rather soft and mushy but ended up keeping a nice consistency which lasted longer than I did.  Great new Sugar free gum.

Trident has produced a new line of sugarless chewing gum with some extra-healthy properties added in.  This particular flavor is infused with Ginseng, which is known for its health benefits.As a sugarless gum, "Vitality: Awaken" is decent, but not great.  I am a tea drinker, but it almost tastes odd when the hint of ginseng shows up within it.  There is a nice minty flavor, which isn't overpowering and doesn't sting my mouth as some mint gums do.Each pack comes with 9 pieces in a foil-backed plastic tray, so each serving is punched through and doesn't have to be unwrapped from paper or foil.  For only 9 pieces, the price is a little high, though.The gum held its flavor for a long time and also didn't become overly stiff-- it's easy to chew, nice and soft.Overall I give this a somewhat positive review, but I'm not crazy about the ginseng taste and the price.  Free samples of this are fine, but I probably wouldn't go to the trouble of purchasing it in the future.

When I first got these, I thought they were going to be some gum form of energy drinks, with a promise to wake you up and get you through the day.  That is an awful lot to promise for a chewing gum.But it turns out that, while they might not get you through the day, the Vitality gum is actually quite the eye opener.  There is a really nice, sharp mint taste that stays strong while you are chewing.  The package lists a "Dash of Ginseng," and I really think it is just "a dash" seeing as how I couldn't find ginseng on the ingredients list.  But even without an herbal enhancer, whatever is in this gum does in fact wake you up and get you started.I really enjoyed these, enough to keep buying them on my own when my supply runs out.  I like having a piece to chew on in the morning when I am heading for work to give me a little morning boost.

I like Trident gums because many of them contain xylitol. Xylitol is a naturally occuring sugar which has been shown to be toxic to mouth bacteria. The bacteria take up xylitol thinking it is a sugar they can metabolize, but instead, they die. Hence, xylitol prevents tooth decay and all that bad stuff. In addition, some studies suggest that the xylitol from chewing gum can go up into the eustachian tube and prevent some types of infections, like a middle ear infection.Trident Vitality lists xylitol as the fifth ingredient. While it's great that it's even present, I think they could put more of it in the gum. For instance, the Lotte Xylitol gum (available at Korean and other markets) lists xylitol as the #1 ingredient, in addition to just gum base and applemint flavor - and it tastes good.Unfortunately, Trident Vitality includes artifical ingredients which probably aren't good for us:Isomalt, gum base, maltitol syrup, maltitol, xylitol, natural and artifical flavoring (including ginseng extract); less than 2% of: acacia, acesulfame potassium, aspartame, blue 1, candelilla wax, erythritol, glycerin, soy lecithin, sucralose and titanium dioxide (color). Phenylketonurics: Contains phenylalanine.At the least, I hope that these big gum manufacturers will move away from using aspartame.

Trident Vitality Awaken SGL, 9-Count (Pack of 10)  I love chewing gum and can get particular about what I buy. For me, long lasting flavor is a must.I have been chewing Stride and 5 for the past year. I do like to switch the brands and I was glad I could try out Trident Vitality Awaken.I really like the packaging that comes with this blister pack of gum. It has a fold over top instead of a sleeve that most brands use for their gum.I like this because the gum stays protected in my purse. With the sleeve packaging I have to put the gum in a separate pocket or else the gum ends up in the bottom of my purse.Trident vitality is pillowy soft and stays that way well after two hours of chewing.The flavor is minty but not potent and it isn't overly juicy sweet where all the flavor is swallowed in the first 5 seconds.I love to snap my gum and blow bubbles and I can do that with this brand with no problems.The flavor here is really good and it does last for the duration that I chewed (more than 2 hours-Violet Beauregarde anyone, lol) I love this gum and I will be adding it to my list next time I am at the store! I also plan on trying the other flavors!

column9: Nice flavor gum, your dentist will like it too!
column10: This gum has an interesting, vibrant peppermint flavor. I liked it as it wasn't overpowering, but it was still nicely minty. It also had a nice "mouth feel" not being too hard to too soft.I didn't notice anything out of the ginseng part. But then again, I chew quite a bit of peppermint gum, so I got it for the sugar-free peppermint part, not the ginseng part.Comes in a nice package that will protect the gum, but still has a slightly modern look. One quibble- it comes in packs of nine, not a dozen as is more common.Chewing sugar-free gum between and after meals is very good for dental hygiene.  Not as good as brushing, sure, but it's a handy way to help keep your teeth and breath fresh.

column4: Shawn Kovacich "Author and Creator of numerou...
column9: Loaded With Peppermint That Last A Loooooong Time
column10: This is a nice, strong peppermint flavored sugar free gum. It is the smaller pieces of gum with the hard shell on it and a soft center with a burst of peppermint flavor and the Ginseng. I admit that I'm not a fan of the Chiclets Peppermint Chewing Gum like gums. When you first chew it, you really notice the strong peppermint flavor. The gum starts out rather soft and sticky, don't try blowing a bubble right away, but it firms up the longer you chew it. The peppermint lasted until I was done with the gum and probably could go a lot longer.Now, the packaging sucks. You have a fancy little box and a foil package of nine pieces of gum, which is way too much packaging for nine pieces of gum. I also don't understand the point of the Ginseng in it, I don't thing it made a difference, especially when the peppermint is strong enough to kill every last germ in my mouth and perk me up.I admit getting this free for a review was great, but honestly, I wouldn't buy it when I can get more gum in a pack of Orbit Peppermint Gum.Shawn KovacichAuthor of the Achieving Kicking Excellence book and DVD series.

column9: Peppermint for the first kiss, ginseng for the libido
column10: Trident Vitality is more or less an overpriced breath mint with ginseng panacea. Some buyers no doubt are looking for an energy boost while others hope for increased nitric oxide output (improvements in erectile dysfunction). I just wanted to rid my mouth of a club sandwich stink (it worked). This is not a popping, snapping, long-time chewing gum but it will revive your breath.Taste: The peppermint is strong enough to mask what I ate for lunch without searing my taste buds. The ginseng itself is not perceptible beneath the "peppy peppermint."Texture: The light candy coating melts away to a soft chew with ginseng grit. As the crunching effect disappears the consistency becomes sinewy -- about 3-to-4 minutes -- and less enjoyable to chew. By this time, my breath is minty and I dispose of the gum.Packaging: If a gum company ever needed to submit itself to Amazon's Frustration-Free Packaging Trident would be the one. Most pellet packs slide into a cardboard sleeve. Trident instead chose to engineer an entire box to house nine pieces of gum. Overkill? Yes. User-friendly? No.Rating: Three stars.BTW: The American Dental Association finds that the physical action of chewing these gums for 20 minutes after eating stimulates saliva flow, which helps to prevent cavities by reducing plaque acids and strengthening teeth.

The trident label is one I have trusted for years for good, sugarless gum.I can't really taste any Ginseng in the gum (not that I'm sure I'd knnow what it tastes like anyway...)I didn't notice any difference in my "alertness" level after chewing a couple pieces.

I was pleasantly surprised that the gum from Trident was indeed lively with a good taste.  I've had Trident gum before (though I'm not much of a gum user).  This gum had a hard shell (some of the Trident gum I've tried in the past came in a paper wrapper and had no candy shell), but thankfully, it was a soft gum, and did not make me concerned I was going to break a tooth when I first popped it into my mouth (I've had gum like that, especially gum containing xylitol, though I don't know if that ingredient was responsible for that factor).I also didn't know if I could taste the 'dash' of ginseng; I couldn't, or, at least, the taste wasn't unpleasant.The overwhelming taste one experiences is positive.  I don't know if I got a burst of vitality or not, but the gum tasted good, lasted a long time, and I'd probably get this again.Recommended for those patients who chew gum.

This gum tastes really good and doesn't have the 'sting' of some minty gum.  There is a liquid center that thankfully doesn't gush and is barely discernable. There are some chewing gums in which the flavor lasts longer, but this gum would last long enough for most people.  Once you reach a certain age, you don't wanna be chewing gum for long periods of time anyway. (Maybe I should just speak for myself in saying that.)To sum it up, my mouth feels clean when I pop a peice of this gum in after I drink a cup of coffee, so I'm happy.

I loved the flavor of this gum--not as strong as some wintermint I have had---very refreshing clean feeling.  Doesn't stick to my tooth that has a cap--which is a plus.  didn't easily or quickly lose its flavor.  I don't know if it made me vital or awake as the name implied--i didn't feel either when I chewed the gum.These are not sticks of gum--they are squares--crunch a little like chicklets gum--but if i remember right, this is bigger than they are.  While one piece is sufficient--I also liked chewing two.This has enough "fresh" taste that it helps my daughter with her sensory integration issues--any strong flavored gum helps her.

Putting aside all of the "Vigorate," "Rejuve" and "Awaken" marketing, Trident Vitality is a pretty solid chewing gum.The peppermint flavoring is not as intense as other gums (there's not a huge spike in flavor when you first bite in that quickly dissipates), but its flavor does last a while.The gum itself is fluffier than most other gums. That is, it's not as tough and dense as other brands like Orbit and Eclipse.I received the gum as a free sample, but I would definitely buy it.

I didn't feel alert or awakened, but the flavor did last for awhile.TRIDENT VITALITY is peppermint flavored and tastes really good. There's no bitter or strange herbal taste and each piece of gum is sugar-free. They're also soft and easy to chew. They come 9-pieces to a pack, and each is in its own blister for freshness.While chewing, the gum didn't stick to my fillings, crown, or dental implant, so that's a plus.Again, if you're looking for something to wake-you-up you'll have to keep looking because TRIDENT VITALITY won't do it. But it's a great tasting gum, but a little on the pricey side. You can get more packs and pieces with the same taste and same effect (none) by buying Trident White Gum, Peppermint, 12-Piece Packages (Pack of 12); plus it's about two-dollars cheaper.I'm being generous by giving 4-stars and that's for taste. column9: I really like Dalfour Fruit Spreads
column10: We started buying the berry flavors of Dalfour about a year ago.  I find the flavor very good, although sometimes a little subdued (because it's not packed with sugar). column9: Loaded with sugars and contains undeclared fats; not a health food
column10: People, learn how to read nutrition labels. Servings are typically divided into just one or two cookies. Two cookies contain about 100 calories, 24 g carbohydrates and 14 g sugars. The calorie breakdown is over 90% carbohydrates, mostly from sugars. This is a BIG red flag. No one should consume junk like this. Don't be misled by the "Fat Free" label. (see second paragraph) Refined sugars are far, far worse for dieters than fats are; poly- and monounsaturated fats are in fact beneficial, and calories from fat provide more stable energy. With the exception of trans and saturated fats, (they raise bad cholesterol) you really shouldn't be on a low-fat diet. Sugars are the worst thing for dieters, as they aren't as likely to be metabolized as energy, and will typically be stored as body fat. (mostly around the mid-section) High-fructose corn syrup (an ingredient in SnackWell's products) is specifically linked with an increased risk of obesity and diabetes. The human body simply is not meant to metabolize this much sugar, nor sugars that are unnaturally processed. I can't provide links to research on the subject, because Amazon has rather ridiculous policies that censor URLs, names of other sites, stores, competitors, etc. from reviews. Be sure to complain to Amazon.com about this practice. Still, it's easy enough to open a search engine and type "snackwell devil food nutrition facts" or the like.Bear in mind that products are not required to declare nutritional content when the servings are divided into small portions, and the content would be less than 0.5 g. Each cookie actually contains 0.17 g saturated fat, which Nabisco neglects to mention. Trans fat content is entirely unaccounted for, though it may actually exist. This means that "Fat Free" claim was just a blatant lie. Will anyone hold Nabisco responsible for unscrupulously deceiving consumers, though? Can anyone demand that they pull misleading products off the shelf? Nope. Welcome to corporate America.Don't let Nabisco and other "health-conscience" snack companies scam you. Read labels closely, and be suspicious of small servings. If a single serving contains less than 0.5 g trans fat, then it doesn't have to be declared; the label will inaccurately specify 0 g. If the portions seem ridiculously small, then it's safe to assume they're trying to hide something from the consumer.On a side note, please ignore "helpful review" ratings. Re-distributors of products will often vote down critical reviews, because they demote the very products they're trying to sell on Amazon. It's all politics.

We have two cats and we were feeding them with "Advanced Pet Diets Select Choice" food but unfortunately it was discontinued so we had to research for another great product. We were recommended this cat food by several people who know what the ingredients suppose to be in it and because this food is made by the same company so we expected same quality.When we got it and opened the bag we noticed different smell (not very pleasant ) and that this food is very dry( the old one was kinda oily ) and both cats didn't like it at all, sometime they don't even want to come and eat it even they are hungry. Now we will have to donate this food to the pet shelter but we learn the lesson, the only way to find the right food is not just by reading the ingredients but buying samples and give them to the pets.

column9: Tastes great and is great for them
column10: I'm so impressed by Pinnacle that I'm trying out some of their wet food such as Pinnacle Chicken & Tuna Formula Cat Food - 24 5.5-Ounce Cans.  It's tough to evaluate the health of the food when I'm not a vet, but it seems to have decent ingredients: the first two ingredients are Chicken Meal and Chicken, versus Friskies where you have to go three ingredients in to get to chicken by-product meal, and way down the list to even get to something with the word "meat" in it (meat and bone meal).At least as importantly, my cats eat it.  I won't say that they love it the same way they love the Friskies: I can harass Purina for their ingredients, but I don't think anything healthy will really ever match Friskies for taste!  I guess it's sort of like hot dogs versus a chicken breast on whole wheat bread with low-fat mayonaisse.  But I'd rather keep my little kitties around for as long as I can, even if the food doesn't taste all that great.

My cat is crazy about this cat food!  He has not been accepting of three others I have tried to give him.  He has a sensitive stomach but this food causes no problems for him.  Amazon is the only place I have been able to find it as it was discontinued at two small stores that couldn't maintain an inventory of it for some reason. Grain-free cat food is hard to find and I'm so grateful to have a source now through Amazon. Little rescued Sonny thanks you too!

I ordered these to help keep me full and not be hungry so often. I was not prepared for how much fiber they have! They go right through me. They have no flavor of their own, so they don't taste as bad as they smell--you rinse them off before you put them in soup, stew, or sauce.

column9: JFC Brown Skirataki Noodles 220 calorie meal !
column10: Shiratake Noodles which are only 25 calories per bag provide a very low calorie meal.  The noodles must be washed in a large screen or collandar with very hot water for several minutes to remove a somewhat fishy smell.  Drain the noddles well and then cut them several times in a bowl with a dinner knife and fork so they are not so long. Get "O" brand organic garlic marinara sauce at Vons and pour half the container (180 calories) over the contents of the entire bag...add a little Kraft parmesian/romano shaker cheese on top and you have a meal which is only about 220 calories...slightly rubbery but acceptable...enjoy!

YUCK.  The worst!  Do not purchase.  I saw these noodles on a segment of The View and  one of the ladies commented that they smelled fishy and it was quickly passed over by the guest chef who offered rinsing them as a solution.I was looking for a low-calorie pasta-like alternative and was quite excited about this product and ordered 4 packages:1.-  The come suspended in a liquid2.-  exceptionally fishy smelling3.-  placed them in a colander and rinsed and rinsed and rinsed to get the smell out4.-  they are a gelatinous, disgusting glop os worm-like noodles (if you dare to call them noodles)Even under sauce, they are heavily robbery and gelatinous.  I thought that I would give them a second try and put the dish in the fridge. NO, they are still horrible and I am not a picky eater.I threw them and the other 3 packages in the garbage.  What a waste.

column9: A real, hearty ginger brew with a bit of a kick.
column10: My local BevMo used to carry this.  I loved it and would buy it regularly.  But, apparently not regularly enough as they stopped carrying it and there is nowhere else around here that carries it.  So, it has become the holy grail for me.  I have no interest in wimpy canada dry or schweppes ginger ales.  This is the kind of ginger brew you want them to use in a good "Dark and Stormy" and the little bit of "heat" really gives it that extra kick.If the idea of a hearty ginger brew appeals to you, you've got to try this. As some carbonated beverage company used to say, it's the real thing.

I am a ginger soda aficionado of sorts, and recently becoming pregnant - it's my 'go to' when i'm feeling a bit queasy. So needless to say I've had just about every ginger brew i can get my hands on at the local Whole Foods, or my co-op, and this is hands down the best ginger I've ever, ever had.

My dog can be a very picky eater.She will starve if she doesn't like her dog food.This is a food she took to immediately, cleaning out her dog bowl.I can rest easy knowing she is getting a really good form of nutrition, and that it is very economical.Buying this product is a win-win for you and your dog.

I mix this kibble with my  own meat and sweet potato recipe for Jack our dog.he is 57 pounds and is active 2 hours a day. 2 meals a day consists of 1 cup kibble mixed with 8 oz. meat. in the morningand 2 cups kibble fed in the evening.This diet has improved his coat and seems to be keeping him healthy and happy!

My dog loves this food. When we adopted him at 7 months we fed him the puppy version and he seemed to like it less; since he got older and we switched to the adult version, he has started to clean his bowl. I know friends whose dogs have had yeast infections that have been linked to the food they eat -- Ultramix doesn't contain any of those problem grains (corn, soy) and our dog has never had any problems associated with these types of food. Overall, a healthy and seemingly tasty adult dog food!

My dog is a picky eater with a sensitive stomach.  He loves this food.  He does not have the constipation that some other dog foods have caused him to have.  It is also natural with meat listed first on the ingredient list.

column9: Excellent quality and our dogs love it
column10: I have been looking for an online source to order dog and cat food for a long time. I finally found exactly what we were looking for. This is a quality product with no fillers. It's a little expensive but cheaper than buying other high quality/high priced foods in the grocery store. Plus it's delivered free to my house. We will continue to order it here as long as it's available.

column9: Great tea, buy it from the Twinings website
column10: This is a delicious tea, representative of the name (a spicy, cold-weather tea) and the maker (Twinings, the venerable English tea company known for great tea since the 18th century, when some of theirs was thrown overboard at the Boston Tea Party).  They seem to have forgiven us. Although this tea would go down fine at any time of year, I love it best in winter when its fruity spiciness heats me from the inside so I can endure the bitter New England weather.Be aware that you can buy this tea for $2.99 (and sometimes, on sale, for $1.99) per box on the Twinings web site. Google for it. It's delicious tea and I'd pay more for it if I had to but the prices on Amazon are patently absurd.
Be aware, this came as a single box.  I thought I was buying a 6 pack for that high price.  I love the tea, but buy it straight from Twinings if you have to pay this price.
I found the curry powder to be very good. I wish there could be a bit less cinnamon. The price because of the large quantity, was much better than those little bottles at the grocery stores.

This flavor is delicious!  I used it in the crockpot with chicken breasts and it came out great.  It has a nice smoky flavor like a good BBQ sauce, and is a little spicy too which makes up for the lack of sodium in it.  Excellent product, it makes eating healthy very easy!
This was a perfect way to marinate the chicken since I am watching my sodium.  It was tasty and easy to do.
i just love all mrs dash products i for one have high blood pressure this make things a little easier to watch

I also ordered this item as a gift for someone dear thinking it was clear glass,it turned out to be polythene. I checked on [...] and they have the detail of their products as <Clean glass and (Pet) bottles>. I just want you to add a little more descriptions to items that are made in different forms. That little detail could help your company save on retured items expenses and increase you credibility.
I have had the water before,  in a glass bottle.  I gave as a gift, only to find out the bottles were plastic.  For the price did they have to skimp on packaging.

The water didn't seem crisp or refreshing. The bottles were pretty and very interesting though. I would rather have something that looks great and tastes great also. Still on the search for the perfect tasting water. I would recommend this for parties, but not for need. The amount is mighty small, and might leave you thirsty for more water.

I work at CVS and whenever someone buys this water bottle, it's because of how appealing the bottle actually looks rather than the water. These come in two different types of bottle, one being glass and other being plastic. This one is a plastic bottle. Don't get me wrong, the plastic bottle still looks beautiful and is very sturdy, it's not your average poland spring bottle. Aside from the looks, the taste of the water is no different than Poland Spring or Nestle bottled water. These usually sell for $1.60 at CVS so, this price online is kind of high. If you really want to try this water, or just want the bottle for the look and future use, just go to a local drugstore or grocery and pick one up. It will be much cheaper and you will get to see and feel the bottle in person to see if it's for you. Overall, it's a good buy and offers a very appealing bottle but the taste is pretty much the same as any other bottled water. I personally bought a bottle because it is so sturdy and I can refill it for everyday use, plus the appealing presentation of the bottle doesn't hurt either.
Voss taste great, clean, but you can purchase this on clearance at grocery stores in florida in the plastic containers, not sure about if its available in glass in grocery store.......
This is good water from Norway.It comes in convenient plastic bottles that should not get broken getting shipped to your home. That is nice.Enjoy and be refreshed and hydrated !

I loved VOSS water in the 11.2-Ounce bottles. $11.14 per pack of 12. Unfortunately, I have to stop purchasing as the price has increased significantly from $11.14 to $18.89 per pack of 12. :(I would rate the water five stars and the pricing one star.

This product came to my door from Amazon and when tasted it had small clumps in it, definitely something was wrong.  The product was within date, so I called Labrada and talked to their costumer service.  They told me that it was nothing to be alarmed, that it was due to the protein coming into contact with cold temperature, and it was probably caused during shipping.Labrada immediately shipped me out a brand new box and the new box was perfect.It's really nice when a company provides great customer service.  I was worried because I bought it off Amazon instead of a retail store, but they said that was fine and they would still honor their product.
Def fills you up. I lost 12 pounds in 2 weeks so far and this drink in between meals gets me through the day!
No problems at all with the packaging or the delivery.  I was not so much a fan of the flavor, but that is just my own preferences.

Nutrition-wise, these were everything I was looking for in a meal replacement on the go. High protein, extremely low carb, with 1/5 of your daily nutrients, these are fantastic.But sadly, the taste was pretty bad.  I bought them because they came up as a crazy good deal - $16 shipped for 12 RTDs is really amazing.  However, the flavor is pretty bad.  The fake banana flavor isn't so bad, it's the terrible taste that the vitamin and mineral mix has.  Seems like it's something that some people taste more than others, but to me it tasted like I bit into a multivitamin.  It finishes with a really sickly fake sweetener taste that lingers along with the vitamin taste. I don't get that with most protein powders or RTDs, this one comes through far more than I've tasted before.It is definitely better cold than warm. I'll probably try them in coffee like the reviewer who loves them, to see if they are at all palatable to me that way.  I hate to waste, but as is, consuming these would be like taking medicine, rather that actually eating.

I have only tried the vanilla ice cream flavor and this is so good I drink it in my coffee, no joke. This by far the BEST protein shake flavor I have EVER had. To me there is NO aftertaste. Believe me I've tried them ALL and this one is the best taste.

column9: Wished I had tried just one first
column10: These taste ok but unfortunately for me they do not agree with my stomach, I plan to give away the rest of the carton.
I don't think it's bad, just so so. I would buy it again but it does have a little  aftertaste that's not banana,(mabey a fake sweetener?).
Do not buy on the go RTD. The taste is horrible. Suck it up and pay the little bit extra for the 17oz lean body.

column9: Very strong chemical taste. Wont buy again...
column10: I was very let down by these drinks. The Atkins and Slimfast low carb shakes taste fine. However, there was something very wrong with these. There is a very strong chemical taste to these shakes and it doesnt taste like banana at all... These shakes also dont mix well either. As much as I shake them, theres still small chunks of something as I get toward the bottom of the shake and its pretty unpleasant.Im giving them 2 stars since I will try to finish the case I bought, though Im going to have to use them in a blender with other ingredients to cover up the taste. Really defeats the purpose of "on the go" when you have to drink them at home only.

column9: Great potato chip! Not as thick as you would imagine though
column10: Lay's Natural chips are excellent. I love the way they taste, how crisp they are and that I don't get a bad aftertaste like I do other brands (with all the preservatives). That being said, Lay's Natural Ruffles are my fave and are actually stronger (do not break as easily) than the thick cut.FYI - these chips typically retail for around $3.50 an 8.5 oz bag. So keep that in mind when purchasing! :)
Even though thick sliced chips sound good, these chips are not. They are over priced, took forever to ship and came in crumbled pieces.

I was exited to find a filling, so i do not have to go through a headache to create my own...bu this one got too much bad stuff like corn syrup and modified corn starch... looks like it has more corn than poppy:)

I use this on roasted pecans - incredible. Have also used on shrimp, homemade baked potato fries (potatoes cut in strips and baked, not fried) and other items. Love this spice. Use it like salt (as in salt to taste) and you get a very nice hot flavor with cayenne pepper and other spices along with it.A little bit goes a long way - we've been working on one container for a year and will order another soon.

Deliciously salty and tangy with a hint of spicy - absolutely perfect for kicking your chicken or veggies up a notch very quickly!Use sparingly - it's strong - and no need for additional seasonings with it (it's pretty salty on its own).My favorite on wilted spinach for a delicious, very low calorie side dish. Also excellent on eggs in the morning or as part of your standard beef or pork marinades.
I like just a little, but people who love spice can add more.  This spice mix is great in eggs, tuna salad, just about everything.  And keeps well, doesnt clump.
I didn't think this was possible but it is. That's all you can taste too. There's a little heat at the end but that isn't enough to make this a worthwhile product sorry.
I love adding this to my dishes to give it a kick, some nice heat but not too much, and a lot of good flavors too. It works great on anything you want to add a little heat and flavor to
I bought some TC's Creole a long time ago and loved it.  Haven't been able to find it until I searched Amazon.  This stuff is the REAL DEAL.  Hint: try it on pizza. OMG!

column9: Good stuff but over shadowed by liquid marinade.
column10: Whenever I use injectable marinade and make fried chicken, I always use this stuff.It works really well on the skin. Great Louisiana flavor.Contains sand though. Very tiny (even compared to regular sand particles) pieces used for anti-caking.For a premixed seasoning, no complaints.

I was introduced to this seasoning by a friend who prepared a dish in my home.  I was not able to find it in any local market and my friend could not recall where he had purchased it.  I bought other brands that were not as potent.  I finally found Tony Chachere's Creole Seasoning by doing a search at Amazon.  I placed my order and received the seasoning a few days later.
truly the very best all purpose seasoning available. i'm surprised it is not more widely known. perfect for meats, fish, and vegetables
seriously great on just about everything. my favorites are french fries and hamburgers, they're just not the same without tony's on them.
I have used this yeast for several years and think it yields the best. 20% yield fermenting after only seven days, consistently.

This cookie is very good. I eat as many as I dare, but my primary use is a a substitute for graham crackers when making 'crumb' pie shells for ice box pies and cheese cakes. They work wonderfully and provide an alternative flavor.  Also great as a substitute cookie for making that Southern favorite, banana pudding.

column9: I've Given My Heart To These Pepperidge Farm Cookies !!!
column10: Pepperidge Farm has a long history of making premium quality cookies; and these "Chessmen" butter cookies are certainly no exception. They contain no artificial flavors, no preservatives and they are crunchy but oh, so wonderfully smooth as you roll them around in your mouth before you swallow them. Awesome!Another reviewer notes that they are aesthetically pleasing; and that reviewer is correct. The cookies have four chessmen on them--you get the rook, the bishop, the queen and the knight--this enhances the appeal of the product. Yes, chess players will love that; but just about anyone who enjoys a good cookie can appreciate these butter cookies. Even if butter cookies aren't your personal favorite, you will fall for these ones--they're THAT good!The cookies are kosher, if that matters to you; and they are certainly designed tastefully enough that you can serve them as snacks for any company you may have visiting you. One caveat, however--these cookies do contain sugar and some fat; and the sugar could convert to extra fat in your body if you are not too active. If sugar and/or fat content pose dietary concerns for you then I would ask a doctor before eating these cookies.Overall, obviously, these cookies are just about the best and they will remain some of the best because of the classic Pepperidge Farm high level of quality control. Buy a bag or two and enjoy some tonight!  SMILES

We were out grocery shopping the other day and, for some reason, the Chessmen cookies called out to me. Usually, I'm not a fan of crunchy cookies, even if they ARE from the delectable Pepperidge Farm bakery.But I decided to try these buttery treats and let me tell you...I am not disappointed! (In fact, I'm munching on them right now.) They are so buttery--so melt in your mouth--they'd be *perfect* with coffee, tea, or hot chocolate--but I tend to snatch them when I need a snack because I haven't eaten all day. (I know...bad habit!)And, this may sound corny, they are beautiful to look at! Not only do these cookies have a raised chess emblem on the front, but they are also washed with eggwhites. (I can tell because of the glistening, golden color!)Rook, Bishop, Queen and Knight--they're all here in buttery brilliance!So if you're in the mood for a fantastic butter cookie, you will LOVE Chessmen from Pepperidge Farm. (And if your favorite soldier or student loves chess--and cookies--this would make a great addition to any care package!)

column9: None broken in my packages...rate product, not packaging anyway...VERY SWEET COOKIE.
column10: Very sugary, a sugar cookie is more descriptive...very good for a sugar cookie though, guess I was expecting a buttery shortbread...a bit disappointed.All Pepperidge Farm cookies have great eye appeal, but they are run by big business.They hop theirs up with too much grainy sugar...just tried the milk chocolate chips kind too...not at all like homemade, because of the grainy, overly sugary taste.
This was a replacement order and they were broken. I mentioned to customer service that they should be bubble or something

It's cheap, it's organic, and it's Clifford! I pack these in my son's lunch every day, and on the weekends he thinks he's getting a treat if he gets one. Clifford juice is great! I like the fact that it isn't too big. My son gets a (reusable) bottle of water every morning, and he does not drink sodas unless he steals some from my friends. I don't like him getting empty calories, and most juice is just that. This has some nutrients but isn't too large. He gets a little sweetness, but not too much. I have this on subscribe and save, so it's even cheaper.
My nearly 3 year old loves these juice boxes and they are the smaller size, so he doesn't waste as much!

These little juices are great for lunchboxes, picnics, trips, or just at home! My kids always ask for more, "Clifford juice"! The only complaint I have is the boxes are pretty small, so they don't last long! but all in all, good product!
Our 2.5 year old son really liked these organic juice boxes, but they are no longer in stock, at least via the subscribe and save program.  I would purchase again if available.

Just tried this coffee on a whim, and it is terrific!  It offers a rich coffee taste without bitterness, and it makes me happy.  Good coffee for everyday....we add a little regular coffee in the mornings, and use this "straight" at night, so we can sleep...always tastes good.

This is a very good coffee - and a money saver too.  Usually but my coffee at a price club, but bags are getting smaller and the price raises.  This is shipped to my door - no hassle - and a great cup of coffee!!

column9: Coffee Bean Direct Decaf Breakfast Blend, Whole Bean Coffee, 5-Pound Bag
column10: Great taste for a decaf. Better than most decaf's but not as good as regular coffee. Great value.Will buy again.

column9: Maybe I am missing something here
column10: I am a huge Keurig and k-cup fan, so I couldn't wait to try the new iced coffee line. Well, maybe it's me but I can't find any difference between this iced coffee and making it with a standard k-cup.  The instructions say to brew one of the smaller size cups of hot coffee into an ice filled cup.  Of course the ice melts and dilutes the coffee, just as it would if you used a standard k-cup.  I used to do that whenever I wanted iced coffee so I don't see any reason to use a special "iced coffee" k-cup.  I am going to give Green Mountain the benefit of the doubt here and assume I am missing something, because I wouldn't like to think this is a marketing scam from GM.
This item is just OK.  It does make a 16 ounce glass of iced coffee, however it could be stronger both in the vanilla and the coffee.

When I bought these k-cups, I was expecting creamy vanilla l, STRONF iced coffee. The ice obviously melts in about twos minutes and becomes unbelievable diluted. I cannot taste any vanilla whatsoever. The only reason I'm giving it two stars instead of one is because if you add some flavored creamer, it tastes a LITTLE better. Definitely never buying this again and will never refer it as iced coffee to anyone. With that said, the regular green mountain k-cups are always very satisfying
My wife loves iced coffee and is totally happy with this one. Which is what I expected,I have never had a bad coffee from Green Mountain

column9: Watered Down, BUY DONUT SHOP ICED COFFEE
column10: Bought a box of these and liked it. Then I tried the " Donut shop Sweet and Creamy Regular Iced Coffee" and that is 3x better than this one. The best way to get perfect iced coffee is:Brew over 6oz water setting. Fill the cup 1/2 with ice and add the dairy creamer. Brew it and then add the sugar and mix. Put in freezer for about 10 minutes and sti again and there you have a perfect Iced coffee!!

*SAMPLE PROVIDED BY MANUFACTURER*I have to agree with most all of the reviewers here.  There is no way that an unflavored non-iced coffee wouldn't work as well or even better than using this flavored product.  I used the 6 oz.cup size to prepare this, and I was amazed at how flavorless and watered down this product was even before  adding my cream and sugar.I can small the vanilla scent but I cannot taste it and there is no sweetness to this product.
Both boxes were outdated.  February 2012.  Product still taste ok, but no where was it mentioned...Too much of a hassle to return.  Price was right.
Brewed this up this morning, used the smallest cup size, ended up with what was pretty much brown iced water. To say it was diluted is giving it too much credit. Stay far away from this K-cup.

I brewed this coffee in a 24 oz double walled tumbler that I filled three quarters of the way with ice.  I then added cream and sugar to taste and enjoyed a very good cup of iced coffee (better that Dunkin Donuts, IMHO).I am assuming that there must be double the grounds in the k cup because the flavor is not diluted.  Definitely worth a try!
Love Love Love this iced coffee!!!  I look forward to this iced coffee every morning.  Has great vanilla flavor without being too sweet!
I would have liked to know that you need to put together the arrangement yourself.  The flowers were beautiful but since it was a gift I would have preferred that it came as a completed arrangement.

Had an issue with first order which the excellent customer service resolved quickly and with professional courtesy.  Florals and greenery arrived and appear fresh and healthy. Picture is of fully opened flowers, so when they arrive it seems the vase is not so full, but after a few days it "plumps".  Roses have noticeably pleasant scent.  Would use and recommend this vendor again.

I purchased these as a birthday gift for a relative.  I've sent her flowers in the past from this company, and she has always been delighted with them.  She called today to tell me that these were "the most beautiful flowers" she had ever received.  It looks like I'll be ordering more bouquets like this for Mother's Day!
The flowers were amazing, the only thing I must say is that the vase arrived broken but beautiful flowers, lovely & lively colors, excelent and quick service.Thank you so much
These flowers arrived in good condition, but there were not as many as what's shown in the photo, and I was a little disappointed that it looked so sparse.  The vase was square, not round.
Women love flowers but not PROflowers. Women also vote-with their ballots and with their dollars. Proflowers continues to advertise with Rush Limbaugh and advertisements are endorsements.

column9: A wonderful gift for any of the women in your life!
column10: Before I am judged too harshly let me say that what I mean by "for any of the women in your life" is that we all have women that know who really deserve to be thanked for all that they do for us.  Wife or girlfriend (not both!); mother; grown daughter; co-worker;  assistant; your child's teacher; etc.  And what can say "Thank you" better than a gift basket of wonderful, decadent, delicious chocolates?I sent this to a customer of mine.  She is the head of her company's training department and I wanted to send her something special on her birthday to let her know how much I appreciate the work that she does in helping my company to train and teach their employees.  I knew that she was a dark chocolate fan and this basket has quite a bit of high-quality dark treats.  She called me the day that she received it and she couldn't thank me enough!  She was blow away by the variety and quality of the chocolates.  I will certainly be buying more in the future.

This is just powdered tomato. No additives. The nutrition facts listed above are accurate. There is no added sugar.I did not for the product any sweeter than a can of low-sodium tomato paste. You may find it "sweet" if you are accustomed to the loaded-with-sodium "national brand" tomato paste that you find in the grocery store. There is barely any sodium at all in this powdered tomato. Take care of your blood pressure: Eat less sodium!Now for the best part: According to its Web site, Frontier is an outstandingly socially and environmentally responsible company. The package in which my product was shipped consists of 100% recycled materials, sourced locally (in Iowa), and printed with soy ink. The packing peanuts are the kind that dissolve in hot water.This matters to me folks. I will certainly buy more products from this company.
Great product, just a trifle sweet. No ingredients label so not able to see if sugar was added, but otherwise very pleased with the product. Smooth purchase transaction

Claxton Dark Fruitcake has been a holiday tradition in our family since the mid 1950's. I ordered it directly from the company this year and when I served it at Thanksgiving, my guests and I thought I must have been fooled by a counterfeit website just claiming to sell Claxton fruitcakes.  It was at best 40% fruits and nuts and consisted of a gummy light colored "cake".  I emailed the company and expressed my disappointment.  After several emails back and forth and after today talking to one of the owners, they assured me that it was the original dark recipe.In reading the ingredients, I noticed that corn syrup, sugar and high fructose corn syrup were listed after flour which was the 4th ingredient.  At the very end were listed molasses, spices and 3 artificial food dyes.  High fructose corn syrup wasn't widely available until the mid 1970's to mid 1980's, so I'm not sure how it was one of the original ingredients.All of the people I talked to seemed to have the attitude that I was so stupid that I couldn't possibly be observing what I had correctly. Although they offered to send replacements if I returned it at my own expense, they told me that what I would receive would be identical to what I have.  One of the owners informed me that they had received zero complaints this year.I am grieving the loss of an almost 55 year tradition, but the other 4 cakes are now in the trash.

Delicious.  At least it looks healthy.  420 cal per 4oz serving, but you don't really need 4oz.  And 13g fat.  Keeps well in refrigerator - we have just finished some from a year ago. I heartily recommend it.  I am from England many years ago, and never had fruit cake as good as this.

Except for the fruitcake I make myself, this is the best I have ever tasted.  A little sweet for my taste, but otherwise outstanding.  I have ordered these a couple of times online, and they always arrive in perfect condition.
These fruitcakes are my passion.  It's great to find a place to buy them outside of the Christmas season.
The product was as described, at less money than the manufacturer would have charged and it arrived in quick time, undamaged.

I don't think that this is a good deal. I saw the same 1 pound fruitcake loaves at a local discount grocery store for $4.99 each. That would equate to $15 a box. Why is Amazon charging $10 more? What a ripoff.
The fruitcake wasn't what I expected.  Too much fruit and other ingredients, can't taste the cake part of it at all.  As far as the taste of the fruitcake it was great but no cake taste whatsoever.

column9: Design Smudgy & Dirty Inside the General Mills Box
column10: I bought these for a cute celebration of St. Patrick's Day for my Team Members.  I was trying to decide between the little boxes and these and chose the cup over the box because of the convenience of just adding milk to the cup.  Though the idea was still cute, each cup had very smudged artwork and the cups all had black ash on the outside of them while sealed in the General Mills box.  It was so bad, I almost thought they might be counterfeit.  The cereal seemed to taste the way it should, but since I bought these for their branding and aesthetics too, I was disappointed. Next time I'll get the small boxes instead.

column9: I was surprised by the quantity.
column10: My dogs love these. I know the description said how many packages I would get but I ordered something similar from another seller and didn't receive what I thought I was buying. Wanted to help out on the comparison with this relatively expensive brand of canned chopped clams and Snow's, a brand easy to find in supermarkets where I've lived.The textures are very different.  Snow's has additives to retain some semblance of fresh clam's springiness; being "natural," Bar Harbor's are somewhat rough/chalky, but not so much to be unpleasant (I've tried both cooked briefly--under a minute--for clam sauce with pasta).  Interesting also that Snow's has added sugar, probably a small amount.  I find both delicious, with the flavor of Snow's clams a little "louder," a plus for Snow's.Some other relevant considerations.  A can of Bar Harbor clams has 150 calories and 8g of protein, whereas a clam of Snow's has 75 calories and 4g of protein.  To me, this is a plus for Bar Harbor--seems to mean more food in the can (I always eat a whole can, which is supposed to be 3 servings for both).  On the other hand, while I've never opened two cans side-by-side, I haven't noticed a striking difference in the volume of the meat.  Also striking that a Bar Harbor can has 150% daily value of iron, compared to only 6% for Snow's!  So something about the Snow's processing seems to be draining nutritional value.  Snow's has slightly more salt, too.OK, I think these are some good considerations for the buyer!  Myself, I'll probably buy Snow's regularly just for its cheaper price, and occasionally upgrade to Bar Harbor whenever I feel I need to eat more iron.  Bon appetit!

Before you plunk down your  $$$, I suggest you shake the container; you'll hear a lot of sloshing--that's the itsy, bitsy clam pieces in the great gray sea. For a Bar Harbor All Natural Chopped Clams, 6.5-ounce can, I measured 2 ounces clams, 4.5 ounces liquid.  I close with, "Where's the clam?"

column9: Terrific dietary supplement and entertainment value in one!

Reports of people scaring their pets and waking themselves and loved ones up from a sound sleep with the substantial and epic flatulence is not as exaggerated as you might think. Marathon farting with longer durations and louder volume than you have ever experienced is fairly common.The good news is, the gaseous emanations are very often "all bark and no bite" (to put it delicately) and so can be very entertaining if you have small children or an immature husband (or wife). column9: Great taste and texture - and high fiber!
column10: Although a number of reviewers have expressed concern about gas and bloating, I have not had any problems with these bars - yet. I eat beans and high fiber cereal regularly, and I put inulin supplement powder in my coffee, tea or yogurt when I think to do so.  It doesn't surprise me that these bars can cause gastric upset because I have experienced mild symptoms with the inulin powder put out by Metamucil under the name FiberSure - but not the embarrassing flatulence that some people speak of with these bars.  The key fiber ingredient in the bars is inulin from chicory root.The dark chocolate almond flavor is excellent and there is no aftertaste or weird texture to the bars.  I bought a few boxes at BigLots for $2 and I hope to buy some more, but if not, with Subscribe and Save, a box of five bars costs $2.38.The ingredients may not be entirely organic or wholesome, but the sugar and fat content compare very favorably with other bars.  I would recommend that you add a high protein food such as nuts, peanut butter or Greek yogurt to create a more balanced "meal" or snack since the bars do not contain a significant amount of protein.  Of course, you should add fruits or vegetables to make a more complete meal.Happy Snacking!
